jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk needed in Pretoria to provide clerical and document management services in a registry environment, requiring Grade 12 with no prior work experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate / Grade 12 (NQF level 4) as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. No work experience required. Skills / Competencies and Knowledge: Basic Job knowledge in terms of exposure to a Registry Environment and knowledge of Electronic and Manual Filing and Administration. Skills: Communication (verbal and written), Interpersonal Relations, Flexibility, Planning and Organising, Technical Competencies, Document management (Manual and Electronic), Archiving, Communications, Record keeping. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: The purpose of the post is to render effective and efficient administrative clerical services to support the delivery of registry and document management services. The successful candidate will render general clerical support services, including registering, stamping, sorting and distribution of incoming and outgoing physical and electronic documents and mail. Open new files and register them in the Register of Files Opened, and close files and register them according to the registry procedure manual and file plan. Replace worn-out file covers as and when required. Manage a SharePoint folder for Ministry documents. Complete control sheets, report files that are due for disposal, and record all documents to be scanned in the Register of Scanned Documents. issue and issue, and receive (physical and electronic) files. Photocopy and scan records as requested. Arrange and pack records as per transfer list and conduct logistical arrangements for the transfer of archival records. Driving change and operational excellence and ensuring compliance in own area of work.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Cilo Tel No: (012) 427 8514, Ms N Khosa Tel No: (012) 427 8260, Ms N Sekele Tel No: (012) 427 8599
jobs.applications: Link: CLICK HERE
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Persons with Disabilities and Youth (Male and Female) applicants to be addressed. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. OTHER POST

af.title: Registrateurklerk
af.summary: Registrateurklerk word in Pretoria benodig om klerklike en dokumentbestuursdienste in 'n registratuur-omgewing te verskaf, met 'n Graad 12 as vereiste en geen vorige werkservaring nodig nie.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 (NQF-vlak 4) soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority. Geen werkservaring nodig nie. Vaardighede / Bevoegdhede en Kennis: Basiese werkkennis ten opsigte van blootstelling aan 'n registratuur-omgewing en kennis van elektroniese en handmatige liasseer- en administrasie. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), interpersoonlike verhoudinge, buigsaamheid, beplanning en organiserings, tegniese bevoegdhede, dokumentbestuur (handmatig en elektronies), argivering, kommunikasie, rekordhouding. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Die doel van die pos is om doeltreffende en effektiewe administratiewe klerklike dienste te lewer ter ondersteuning van die verskaffing van registratuur- en dokumentbestuursdienste. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste lewer, waaronder die registrasie, stempel, sortering en verspreiding van inkomende en uitgaande fisiese en elektroniese dokumente en pos. Nuwe lêers oopmaak en in die Register van Oopgemaakte Lêers registreer, asook lêers sluit en registreer volgens die registratuur-prosedurehandleiding en lêerplan. Veelde lêeromslae vervang soos en wanneer nodig. 'n SharePoint-lêer vir Ministeriële dokumente bestuur. Kontroleblaaie voltooi, lêers rapporteer wat vir vernietiging in aanmerking kom, en alle dokumente wat gescan moet word, in die Register van Gescande Dokumente aan te teken. Uitreik en uitreik, en ontvang (fisiese en elektroniese) lêers. Rekords fotokopieer en scan soos versoek. Rekords reël en pak volgens die oordraglys en logistieke reëlings tref vir die oordrag van argiefrekords. Verandering dryf en operasionele uitmuntendheid en nakoming in eie werkarea verseker.

zu.title: Umglasi Wokuqophela Koshicilelo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umglasi Wokuqophela Koshicilelo e Pretoria ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokubhalisa nobuphathi bezixhumanisi zendawo yokuqophela, okudinga ibhasikili le Kholishi neze inyanga yokuqeqeshwa ebesiyona.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Sochwepheshe Seli liseNqangi / ibhasikili le NQF 4, ngokuvunywa ngumphathi wamazwe emhlabene. Akudingeki namhlanje ibhasikili lobuciko bobunye. Amakhono / Ukuziphatha Nokwaziswa: Ukwaziswa okuyisiseko ngohlelo ngokungenisa kwendawo yokuqophela nokwaziswa kokuqophela ngokugxila kubuchwepheshe nangendlela yokwenza umsebenzi wesigaba. Amakhono: Amafonesi (aphuma emlonyeni nawebhalwe), Ukuxhumana Nabantu, Ukuguqula, Ukwakha Nokuhlela, Ukuziphatha Kwebuqwephetha, Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo (Ngendlela yokuqophela kubuchwepheshe nangendlela yomuntu), Ukuqoqa koshicilelo, Okuqukethwe yiziphoqo, Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo.
zu.duties: Inhloso yesikhundla ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezibalulekile neziphumelelayo zokubhalisa ezinhlelweni zokusebenza ukuze zisekele izinsizakalo zokuqophela nokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Umuntu oqokiwe uzonikeza izinsizakalo ezinhle zokubhalisa ohlelweni, okuhlanganisa ukubhalisa, ukushaya isithombe, ukuhlukanisa nokusatshalaliswa kwemibhalo emaphakathi nakhubazayo nokuthunelwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuvula amafayela amasha nawabhalise kwi-Rekhodi YamaFayela Avuliwe, futhi wavale amafayela, abhalise ngokuhambisana nenyathelo lokuqophela nendlela yokulungiselela amafayela. Ukushintsha izi-ant ezibadallwa njalo noma kunjalo uma kunesidingo. Ukuphathwa kwamafayela e-SharePoint ukuze kusetshenziselwa imibhalo. Ukugcwalisa amafomu okulawula, ukubika ngamafayela okumele akhishwe, nokubhalisa yonke imibhalo ezoskeniwa kwi-Rekhodi Yemibhalo Eskeniwe. ukukhishwa nokukhishwa, nokutholwa (kwemibhalo yobuchwepheshe nangokomuntu) kwamafayela. Ukwenza izithombe nokuskena amafayela njengoba kuceliwe. Ukulungiselela nokubeka amafayela ngokulandelana okwensiwe, kwenze izinhlelo zokusetshenziswa kwamafayela okusethunyelwa kusethunyelwa. Ukushintsha izinkalo nokusebenza ngokuphelele, kubheke ukulandelwa kwemithetho esikhundleni sakho.

xh.title: iClerk ye-Registry
xh.summary: Kufuneka iClerk ye-Registry ePretoria ukunika iinkonzo zolawulo nolawulo lwamaxwebhu kwimeko yeregistry, ifuna iGarade 12 ngaphandle kwamava womsebenzi wangaphambili.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sikaMasipala weSigaba 12 (NQF level 4) njengokukhonjwe ngumBhunga weMimislo yakuQinisekisa eMzantsi Afrika. Akukho mfuno yamava emsebenzini. Amakhono / Ukuzinza kunye nolwazi: Ulwazi olusesikweni ngokwamava kwendawo ye-Registry nolwazi ngeFayili ye-Electronic nokuBhala nokuLawula ngesandla. Amakhono: Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukuHlobana nabantu, ukuPhefumla, uQwluse nokuHlela, ukuSebenza ngamakhono obuchwepheshe, uLawulo lwamaxwebhu (ngocingo nangekhompyutha), ukugcina umcelimngeni, uNxibelelwano, ukuGcina amaxwebhu. Ukuhlala kwikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Injongo yesi sichabo kukunika izixhobo ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo zolawulo eziphuma kwisenzo sokunceda ekunikweni iinkonzo zeregistry nolawulwa lwamaxwebhu. Omele kufunele anike iinkonzo ezizizo zolawulo, kuqukuqa nokubhalisa, nokubeka istampu, nokuhlela nokusatyalaliswa kwamaxwebhu neposi abakho ndawonye nabangangomnxeba nokungangomnxeba abakiza nabaphumayo. Ukuvula amafayela amsha nibhale kwisiBhalwa samaFayela aVuliweyo, kwaye nivala amafayela nibhale ngokwesikhokelo senkqubo yeregistry nendlalifa yamafayela. Ukutshintsha iinkamba zamafayela eziqhelekileyo xa kufuneka. UkuLawula ifolda ye-SharePoint yamaxwebhu oBaphathiswa. Ukugqiba amaphepha olawulo, ukuchaza amafayela afanele ukuba khutshelwe, kwaye ukubhala yonke imixwebhu okufuneka iskanwe kwesiBhalwa samaXwebhu aSkeniwe. Ukunikwa nokunika nokunikwa nokunika nokuthathwa (ngokomzimba nangomnxeba) amafayela. Ukwenza iikhophi noku-skena amaxwebhu njengoko kucelwa. Ukulungisa nokubeka amaxwebhu ngokohluho lokudluliswa kwaye kwenziwe izicwangciso zokuqhubela amaxwebhuendawo yokugcina. Ukuzisa utshintsho nokugqwesa kusebenza, kuqinisekiswa ukuthobela imimislo kwelakhe ndawo yakokusebenza.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Injury on Duty
jobs.summary: Manage the administration of occupational injuries and diseases processes within the Department of Correctional Services at National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Degree/Diploma in Occupational Health/Hygiene or Safety Management or equivalent qualification. 3- 5 years’ relevant experience gained in an occupational health and safety environment. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies and attributes: Knowledge of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA). Knowledge of Public Service Regulations. Knowledge of collective agreements with regard to occupational injuries and diseases. Knowledge of DPSA Circulars with regard to occupational injuries and diseases. Knowledge of Occupational Injuries and Diseases statistics. DCS employee occupational health and safety policy and processes. Labour Relations Act. HR Mandates regarding occupational injuries and diseases. Policy analysis, monitoring, evaluation and implementation. Information collection, analysis, interpretation, dissemination with regard to occupational injuries and diseases policies, regulations and acts. HR policies related to leave, performance assessment, discipline, grievances, skills development, occupational health & safety, employee wellness, remuneration & allowances, etc. Presentation and communication skills. The ability to access and interpret required management information. Technical report writing. Knowledge of OHS Act. Project management principles. Listening and problem-solving skills. Networking/liaison with stakeholders. Basic Conditions of Employment Act.
jobs.duties: Manage the administration of occupational injuries and diseases processes within DCS as stipulated by Occupational injuries and Diseases Act. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of policies and processes pertaining to occupational injuries and diseases. Conduct occupational injuries and diseases research. Ensure that incidents are reported, medical assistance is provided and that the compensation claim process begins as soon as possible. Management of performance information, human resources, finance and assets.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Besering tydens diens
af.summary: Bestuur die administrasie van beroepsbeserings- en siekteprosesse binne die Department of Correctional Services by Nasionale Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Graad/Diploma in Beroepsgesondheid/-higiëne of Veiligheidsbestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3- 5 jaar se relevante ervaring opgedoen in 'n beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsomgewing. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en attribute: Kennis van die Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA). Kennis van Public Service Regulations. Kennis van kollektiewe ooreenkomste ten opsigte van beroepsbeserings en -siektes. Kennis van DPSA Circulars ten opsigte van beroepsbeserings en -siektes. Kennis van statistiek rakende beroepsbeserings en -siektes. DCS-werknemersbeleid en prosesse ten opsigte van beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Labour Relations Act. HR-mandate ten opsigte van beroepsbeserings en -siektes. Beleidsontleding, monitering, evaluering en implementering. Inligtinginsameling, -ontleding, -interpretasie en -verspreiding ten opsigte van beleide, regulasies en wette oor beroepsbeserings en -siektes. HR-beleide verbonde aan verlof, prestasie-evaluering, dissipline, griewe, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, werknemerswelstand, besoldiging en toelaes, ens. Voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede. Die vermoë om vereiste bestuursinligting te bekom en te interpreteer. Tegniese verslagskryf. Kennis van die OHS Act. Beginsels van projekbestuur. Luister- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Netwerkwerking/skakeling met belanghebbendes. Basic Conditions of Employment Act.
af.duties: Bestuur die administrasie van beroepsbeserings- en siekteprosesse binne DCS soos uiteengesit deur die Occupational injuries and Diseases Act. Koördineer en moniteer die implementering van beleide en prosesse rakende beroepsbeserings en -siektes. Voer navorsing oor beroepsbeserings en -siektes uit. Verseker dat voorvalle aangemeld word, mediese bystand verskaf word en dat die vergoedingsaansoekproses so spoedig moontlik begin. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Umncintiswano ophethe izindaba: Ukulimala emsebenzini
zu.summary: Phatha ukuphathwa kwezinhlela zokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwe Department of Correctional Services e National Head Office.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/Diploma ku-Occupational Health/Hygiene noma ku-Safety Management noma izifundo ezifanayo. Izinsuku eziyi-3-5 eziyisipiliyoni ohlotsheni oluhambisana nemvelonke emhlabeni wezempilo yokuphila komsebenzi nokuphepha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono nezici: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA). Ulwazi ngomthetho wezinqubo ze-Public Service Regulations. Ulwazi ngemvumelwano ehlangene mayelana nokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho ye-DPSA Circulars mayelana nokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngesibalo sokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Inqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-DCS mayelana nezempilo yokuphila komsebenzi nokuphepha. Umthetho wezinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi we-Labour Relations Act. Izimiso ze-HR ngokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Ukuhlaziya, ukubuka, ukulinganisa ukusebenza kanye nokuqashwa kwenqubomgomo. Ukutholwa ukuhlaziya, ukuhumusha kanye nokusabalalisa ulwazi olumayelana nzenqubomgomo, izinqubo nemithetho yezilimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Izinqubomgomo ze-HR ohlobene nelayisense, ukulinganisa kokusebenza, inhlawulo, izikhalazo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezakhono, izempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi, impilo yabasebenzi, nokuqashwa nezibonezelo, njll. Ikhono lokwethula futhi ukuxhumana. Ikwanza ukuthola nokuhumusha ulwazi oludingekayo oluphathwayo. Ukwibhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS Act. Izimiso zokuqashwa kwezinhlela. Ikhono lokulalela nokuqamba izisombululo ezinkingeni. Ukwakha ukuhlobana nabantu abahlobene nendaba.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphathwa kwezinhlela zokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-DCS njengoba kushiwo ngumthetho i-Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Hlanganisa futhi ubuke ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo nazo zonke izinhlela ezingezansi mayelana nokulimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Yenza uphando ngokuhalimala nezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba izehlakalo zibikwa, lusizwe ngempilo nokuthi inqubo yokuqashwa iqale ngokushesha okukhulu. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemisebenzi, abantu, imali, nezimpahla.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo: Iinkcakzo ezenzeka Kumsebenzini
xh.summary: Phatha ulawulo lwenkqubo yeenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo kwisebe leenzelelo zolungisa eNtloko eNguni.
xh.requirements: Degree/Diploma kwisoQhavo sokwakhela umsebenzi okanye kuLawulo lokhuseleko okanye izidanga ezilinganayo. Iimbelu zokuqonda ezi-3-5 ezifunyenwe kwindawo yokwakhela umsebenzi nokhuseleko. Ukuzazi kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iimfuno nokuziphatheka: Ulwazi ngomthetho weenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo (COIDA). Ulwazi ngemigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngezigqibo ngokomthetho mayelana neenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Ulwazi ngeziqendu zeDPSA mayelana neenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Ulwazi ngeebalo zeenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Inqubomgomo yempilo yakwakhela umsebenzi nendlela yokusebenza kubasebenzi beDCS. Umthetho weQhagamshelwano loBasebenzi. Iimfuno zeHR ngokwenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Uhlolojio, ukulawula, ukulinganisela nokusebenzisa inqubomgomo. Ukuyila ulwazi, ukuhlalutya, ukucazulula, nokusasaza ulwazi mayelana neenqubomgomo, imigaqo nomthetho weenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Iinqubomgomo zeHR ezihlobene nokushiya, ukulinganisa ukwenza umsebenzi, isohlwayo, iingxaki, ukuziphilisa ngeziqu, impilo nokhuseleko ekwakhiweni komsebenzi, impumelelo yomsebenzi, umvuzo nezibonelelo, njalonjalo. Amandla okubonisa nokunxibelelwana. Amandla okufumana nokuchazula ulwazi olufunekayo ekulawuleni. Ukubhala iingxelo ezinzima. Ulwazi ngomthetho weOHS. Imigaqo yolawulo lwamaphulo. Amandla okulalela nokusombulula iingxaki. Umdibaniso wemiba/hlobano nabathathi nxaxheba. Umthetho weemeko ezingundoqo zokusebenza.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo lwenkqubo yeenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo kwiDCS njengoko kuchazwe ngumthetho weenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Lumkisa kwaye ulawule ukusebenziswa kweenqubomgomo nendlela yokusebenza ezihlobene neenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Zenza uphando ngeenkcakzo ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi nezifo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiganeko zibikiwe, kunikezelwa uncedo lokwelapha kwaye inqubo yezicelo zexabiso iqale ngoko kunokwenzeka. Ulawulo lolwazi ngeveveliso, abantu, imali nezibonelelo.

jobs.summary: Chairperson positions on the Correctional Services Parole Board across multiple regions, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years' management experience.
jobs.requirements: A recognized and appropriate NQF level 7 qualification in any Criminal Justice field, Social Sciences or related. Previous 5 years’ experience in management or decision-making position. Demonstrable experience of and ability to conduct effective evidence-based decision making, weighing facts and evidence, analysing and critically evaluating large volumes of complex information and identifying key issues, within tight deadlines and working on your own initiative. Demonstrable independence of mind and sound judgement, with the ability to make evidence-based decisions that are accurately documented. Excellent interpersonal skills: the ability to gain respect and maintain rapport through effective communication and influencing skills – with the confidence to challenge opinions where necessary, work collegiately and resolve differences to reach sound decisions. Excellent communication skills, both written and oral: the ability to communicate sensitively and effectively with a wide range of individuals, varying your approach as necessary and treating others with respect, to listen actively and evaluate replies in order to probe issues. Excellent written skills: the ability to draft well-formed written reports which summarizes evidence in support of a decision or recommendation. Demonstrable high standards of corporate and personal integrity and conduct, such as a strong commitment to fairness, equality and the ethos of supporting the wider public or community good through your contributions. High levels of time management, organizational and administrative skills, together with strong personal motivation and commitment to professional self-development. Evidence of experience of any aspect of the criminal justice system and an understanding of the importance of the victim’s perspective. Previous experience in management or decision-making position.
jobs.duties: Analyse and critically evaluate information in order to identify continuing risk/dangerous-ness in an individual offender’s case, where information may come from a variety of sources including electronic and paper documents, electronic updates and evidence given at oral hearings. Apply knowledge and judgement to offenders’ cases in order to decide whether they can safely be released into the community and to set conditions where release is appropriate. Oversee the hearing of cases in order to assess risk. Work collaboratively with other parole members in order to make judgements about the available evidence and to provide a concise and structured summary of relevant factors in reaching a decision or recommendation. Facilitate report writing, draft reasoned summaries and decisions. Be an effective ambassador for the Parole Board when representing it at hearings or any other event. Facilitate administrative roles associated with preparation for hearings, hearings and revocations/cancellations, public education on parole, facilitate invitation of victims to hearings including court attendance as a result of litigation by offenders.

jobs.notes: For re-advertised posts: Candidates who previously applied need to re-apply. Call for applications to serve as members of the correctional supervision and parole board. The Minister of Correctional Services in terms of Section 74 of the Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998 invite interested and suitable candidates to apply for an opportunity to serve as members of the Correctional Supervision and Parole Board. The Parole Board is an independent body whose main aim is to protect the public by risk assessing offenders to decide whether they can be safely released into the community. The main role of a Chair (and Vice in the chairs absence) is decision making. Decision making in light of a number of factors, that is:- rights of the offender (as far as the right to be considered in light of relevant legislation), calculation of the minimum detention period, understanding of criminal justice value chain, court papers, sentencing remarks, copy of the judgment, copy of the warrant of detention, case law, SAP 69 and 62, understanding the various reports by the DCS professionals, understanding of the rehabilitation process, risk assessment, victim/community empathy, public safety etc. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re- appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. zu.title: Isihlalo
zu.summary: Izikhundla sobusihlali ku-Correctional Services Parole Board kumaphindi amaningi, kudinga izifundo ze-NQF level 7 namava eminyaka yeminyaka eyisihlanu kokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esivunyiwe nesifanele esingeni le-NQF level 7 kunoma yisiphi isikhundla se-Criminal Justice, Social Sciences noma esihlobene naso. Amaphamba eminyaka eyi-5 esikhundleni sokuphatha noma sokwenza izinqumo. Amava abonakalayo nokuhlola ukuwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe ngobufakazi, ukuqonda kanye nokuhlaziya imininingwane, ukuhlaziya futhi uhlola ngokujulile imininingwane eningi enobudoda nokubona izindaba ezibalulekile, phakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe nokusebenza ngokwesipho sakho. Ukuzimele kwegqondo nokuhlola ngokulungile, nokuhlola ukuwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe ngobufakazi ezibhalwa ngokunalwele. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nomuntu: ikhono lokuzuza inhlonipho negcina isihlobo ngokuxhumana ngokuphumelelayo namakhono okukhuthaza - nokuzethemba ukupikisana nemibono lapho kudingeka khona, ukusebenza ngokuhlangenwe ndaba futhi uxaze izinkinga ukuze ufinyelele izinqumo ezilungile. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo: ikhono lokuxhumana ngokuzwela ngokuphumelelayo nabantu abahlukene, ukushintsha indlela yakho njengoba kudingeka ukhulule abanye ngokubanhlonipha, ukulalela ngokuzibophezela futhi uhlolisiswe izimpendulo ukuze uphendule izindaba. Amakhono amahle okubhala: ikhono lokubhala imibhalo yokubika ehlelekile elandela umbhalo obhalwe kahle ongumnqumo wobufakazi ukuze sekela isinqumo noma incomo. Amazinga aphezulu obuqotho bomuntu ngamunye nomkhuba omuhle, njengokuzimisela ngokuzimisela ekwenzeni futhi ekulinganisweni, nasemkhakheni wokusekela umphakathi omkhulu noma ngokuhamba kwakho kuqhube umphakathi. Amazinga aphezulu ezenzakalo zesikhathi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zolunye, nokuphathwa kwezindaba, kanye nokuzimisela okuqinile komuntu ngamunye nokuzinikela ekuziphuculeni ngokobungcweti. Amava enkomba yamaphuzu kanjalo yonke imikhakha yekhoso lemikhwezela lamanjengomphakathi.
zu.duties: Hlaziya futhi uhlola ngokujulile imininingwane ukuze ubone ubungozi obuqhubekayo noma ubunzima encimeni yomphakathi oyedwa ogwetshiwe, lapho imininingwane ingafika khona emithonjeni ehlukene okuhlanganisa namadokhumente abhalwayo nangesithuba, okubhaliwe okubhalwayo nobufakazi obunikezwa ezintweni zokulalelwa. Sebenzisa ulwazi nokuhlolo kumacala abogwetshiwe ukuze unqume ukuthi bangakhululwa ngokuphepha emphakathini bese uhlela izimo lapho kukhululwa ngokufanele. Qapha okulalelwayo kwamacala ukuze uhlole ubungozi. Sebenzisana ngokuhlanganyela nabanye abalunga be-parole ukuze wenze izinqumo ngobufakazi obukhona futhi unikeze isifinyezo esihlelekile sezinto ezibalulekile ekufeni isinqumo noma incomo. Siza ukubhala imibhalo yemibiko, bhala izifinyezo ezinenzuzo nezinqumo. Yiba nomelwane ophumelelayo we-Parole Board lapho umela ibhodi ezintweni zokulalelwa noma kunoma yisiphi isenzo. Siza emikhakheni yezindaba zokuphatha ehlotshaniswe nokulungiselela okulalelwayo, okulalelwayo nezinkimbinkimbi/nokukhansela, ukufundisa umphakathi nge-parole, siza ukumema abathungiwe kokulalelwa okuhlanganisa nokubhala izinkomba ngenxa yokulwa kwamalunga ogwetshiwe.

xh.title: USihlalo
xh.summary: Izithuba zokuShicilela njengoSihlalo kwiBhodi yeParole yeenkonzo zokuLungisa ekuwohlokeni kwamaphondo amaninana, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso seNQF inqanaba 7 nokuhlola kweminye emihlanu kwindima yolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esivunyiweyo nesifanelekileyo seNQF inqanaba 7 nakwisimahamba-mabala esinjengonomaxwebhu eCriminal Justice, ezeSayensi zeZentlalo okanye ezinxulumene nazo. Uhlolo lweminye edlulileyo le-5 kwindima yolawulo okanye yokwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo kunye namandla okwenza izigqibo ezisezinyanweni ngenkqubo eqinisekisiweyo, okulinganisa iinkcukacha nobungqina, ukuhlalutya nokuhluza ngokucokisekileyo amanqanaba amakhulu wolwazi oludidiyeloyo nokubona izinto ezibalulekileyo, kwixesha elilinganiselweyo nangaphandle kolawulo lwomntu owayo. Ukuzimela ngokwengqondo nokwenza izigqibo ezinzulu, kunye namandla okwenza izigqibo ezisezinyanweni ezibhalwa ngokuchanekileyo. Amabala aphambili okusebenzisana nabantu: amandla okufumana intlonipho nokugcina undophu ngokusebenzisa isazinzulu sokunxibelelwana nokuchukumisa – nokuba namandla okugxeka iimbono xa kuyimfuneko, ukusebenza ngokubambisana nokusombulula iingcamu ukufikelela kwiigqibo ezinzulu. Isazinzulu esihle sokunxibelelwana, esibhalwayo nesenomlomo: amandla okunxibelelana ngokuzipatha ngokuzingca nangokusebenza nabantu abahlukahlukeneyo, ushintshe indlela yakho njengoko kuyimfuneko uhoye abanye ngentlonipho, ukulalela ngokuzimisela okujulileyo ukuhlalutya iimpendulo ukuze uhlole iingxaki. Isazinzulu esihle sokubhala: amandla okubhala iiripoti ezilungiselelwe kakuhle eziquka ubungqina ngokusekela isigqibo okanye isiPhakamiso. Izingqiqo ezisezantsi ezikhulu zobuzwe nokuzipatha ngokwako, njengokuzimisela okuqinileyo ekubeni sincinci, ulingano nendlebe yokuxhasa uluntu ngokubanzi okanye ilungelo lemiphakathi ngeminikelo yakho. Amanqanaba aphakamileyo olawulo lwexesha, ebandakanya ulawulo lolwazi, lwezobuqu, lolawulo olubanzi, kunye nendlebe eqinileyo yokuzinikela ngokwakho nokuziphuhlisa ngokobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngamaphupha onke amanqanaba olwazi mayela nendlela yomphakathi wocingo kwaye uqonde ukubaluleka kokuqonda ngakwabathindi. Uhlolo lweminye edlulileyo kwindima yolawulo okanye yokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Hlalutya nokuhluza ngokucokisekileyo ulwazi ukuze ubone ingozi ephila okanye ubungozi kule meko yomphulukhulu ngamnye, apho ulwazi lungavela kumathuba amaninana aquka iimaxwebhu asetyenziswa kwindawo yekhompyutha nangaphezu kwepepa, izihlaziyo zekekhompyutha nobungqina obunikwe kumuzwa wemilomo. Faka ulwazi nengqondo kumanqanaba ophulukhulu ukuze uqgibe ukuba angakhululwa ngokhuseleko emphakathini nokumisela iimeko apho kukhululeka khona. Lawula okuzwa kumanqanaba ukuze uhlole ingozi. Sebenzisana kwakhona namalungu amnye eBhodi yeParole ukuze uzenze izigqibo malunga nobungqina obukhoyo ukuze unike isishwankathelo esicafunziweyo esinomdlandla wezinto ezinxulumene nazo ekufeni isigqibo okanye isiPhakamiso. Yenza iiripoti ezibhalwa ngokuziphatha, bhala iishwankathelo nezigqibo ezinesizathu. Yiba ngumrhwebi osebenzayo weBhodi yeParole ekuqhubeni iimvakalelo okanye nasiphi na isiganeko. Lawula iindima ezolawula iindlela ezidityaniswe nomalungiselelo wemivakalelo, iimvakalelo nokuqhaqha okwenziwa emva kwentlalo, imfundo yomphakathi malunga neParole, ukumema abathindi kumivakalelo kuquka nokuza kundlu lugqatso njengemveliso yokulinganyelwa ngumphulukhulu.

jobs.summary: Vice-chairperson sought by the Department of Correctional Services to chair board meetings, evaluate offender risk information, and sign documents in the absence of the chairperson.
jobs.requirements: A recognized and appropriate NQF level 7 qualification in any Criminal Justice field, Social Sciences or related. Proven 3 years supervisory role or community leadership experience as well as active involvement in community-based structures. Commitment to a corruption free administration. A good standing with the community with extensive life experience. Proven special interest in the Criminal Justice System.
jobs.duties: Chair meetings in the absence of the Chairperson. Sign documents in the absence of the Chairperson. Participate in the analysis and evaluation of information in order to identify continuing risk/dangerousness in an individual offender’s case, where information may come from a variety of sources including electronic, paper documents, electronic updates and evidence given at oral hearings. Apply knowledge and judgement to offenders’ cases in order to decide whether they can safely be released into the community and recommend appropriate conditions where release is appropriate. Participate in the hearing of cases in order to assess risk while work collaboratively in making judgements about the available evidence and formulate a concise and structured summary of relevant factors to aide in reaching a decision or recommendation. Participate in report writing, assist in drafting seasoned summaries and assist the Chairperson in recommending a decision. Be an effective ambassador for the Parole Board when representing it at hearings or any other event.

af.title: Ondervoorsitter
af.summary: Ondervoorsitter gesoek deur die Department of Correctional Services om raadsvergaderings voor te sit, oortreder-risiko-inligting te evalueer, en dokumente te onderteken in die afwesigheid van die voorsitter.
af.requirements: Erkende en toepaslike NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in enige Kriminele Regspleging-veld, Sosiale Wetenskappe of verwant. Bewys van 3 jaar supervisoriese rol of gemeenskapsleierskap-ervaring asook aktiewe betrokkenheid by gemeenskapsgebaseerde strukture. Toewyding aan 'n korrupsievrye administrasie. Goede standing in die gemeenskap met uitgebreide lewenservaring. Bewys van spesiale belangstelling in die Kriminele Regsplegingstelsel.
af.duties: Sit vergaderings voor in die afwesigheid van die Voorsitter. Onderteken dokumente in die afwesigheid van die Voorsitter. Neem deel aan die analise en evaluering van inligting om deurlopende risiko/gevaarlikheid in 'n individuele oortreder se saak te identifiseer, waar inligting uit 'n verskeidenheid bronne kan kom, insluitend elektronies, papierdokumente, elektroniese opdaterings en getuienis wat by mondelinge verhore gelewer is. Pas kennis en oordeel toe op oortreders se sake om te besluit of hulle veilig in die gemeenskap vrygelaat kan word en beveel toepaslike voorwaardes aan waar vrylating toepaslik is. Neem deel aan die verhoor van sake om risiko te assesseer terwyl saamgewerk word om oordele te vel oor die beskikbare getuienis en om 'n beknopte en gestructureerde opsomming van relevante faktore te formuleer om te help om 'n besluit of aanbeveling te bereik. Neem deel aan verslagskrywing, help met die opstel van volwasse opsommings en help die Voorsitter om 'n besluit aan te beveel. Wees 'n effektiewe ambassadeur vir die Paroolraad wanneer dit by verhore of enige ander geleentheid verteenwoordig word.

zu.title: Onobhala ophethe
zu.summary: Department of Correctional Services ifuna Onobhala ophethe ukuba ahola izinkomfa zebhodi, ahlolole ulwazi ngobungozi bezidlakela, asayine amadokhumenti ekubeni khona kukaSihlalo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezikwaziwa futhi ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kunoma yisiphi isikhundla se-Criminal Justice, Social Sciences noma okuhlobene nalokho. Okugqamiswe iminyaka eyi-3 yokuqashwa esikhundleni sokugada noma isiphiwo sokuba ngumholi womphakathi kanye nokubandakanyeka ngokusobala ohlelweni olusekelwe emphakathini. Ukuzinikela ohlelweni olungenabo ukhekhethe. Ukuma kahle emphakathini okuhambisana nokuhlangenwe nakho okuningi empilweni. Ukukhathala ngokukhethekile kwi-Criminal Justice System okugqamiswe.
zu.duties: Ukuhola izinkomfa ekubeni khona kukaSihlalo. Ukusayina amadokhumenti ekubeni khona kukaSihlalo. Ukubambe iqhaza ekuhlaziyeni nokuhlola ulwazi ukuze kushicilelwe ubungozi/bukhulu bengozi ohlangothini lwezidlakela, lapho ulwazi lungavela kumthombo ohlukene okuhlanganisa oyikhomphyutha, amadokhumenti ewebhu, okubhalwe ngoyikhomphyutha kanye nobufakazi obunikwe izinkomfa ezenzelwe ukuzwa ngomlomo. Ukusebenzisa ulwazi nesipho sokwahlulela izigaba zezidlakela ukuze kuthathe isinqumo sokuthi zingakhululwa ngokuphepha emphakathini yini futhi kunconywe izimo ezifanele lapho kukhululeka khona. Ukubambe iqhaza ekuqoqweni kwezigaba ukuze kuhlolwe ubungozi ngenkathi usebenza ngokubambisana ekwenzeni izinqumo ngobufakazi obutholakalayo futhi kwakhe isifinyezo esicacile futhi esahlelekile sezinto ezibalulekile ezingasiza ekuthathweni kwenqumo noma isincomo. Ukubambe iqhaza ekubhalweni kwezibalo, ukusiza ekwakheni izifinyezo ezinothelekile kanye nokusiza uSihlalo ekuholweni ukuthathwa kwenqumo. Ukuba nomelane onamandla we-Parole Board lapho amele kona ezinkomfweni noma nakwenye yinoma imuphi umcimbi.

xh.title: Onobhekisano-phini
xh.summary: Isebe lezezoLungiselelo lokuLungisa abantu sifuna onobhekisano-phini abazakuba ngabahlangabezeli bemiyalelangano, banqonde ulwazi ngengozi yabaphuli-mthetho, basayine amaxatso xangekhoyo onobhekisano.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esamkelweyo esifanelekileyo esinguNQF level 7 naliphi na icandelo lezoBulungisa eziGxebengwe, ezezenzululwazi zeNdalo okanye ezinxulumene nazo. Iminyaka elithathu evunyiweyo yomsebenzi wokuzalathisa okanye amava obuqhankqalazi bomphakathi kunye nokubandakanyeka kwesebenzo ezakhiwo-based community. Izimiseko ekuphathweni okungalunganga. Ukuma kakuhle nomphakathi ngaphezulu kwamava obomi. Inqanaba elithandwayo elizodwa kwindlela yezoBulungisa eziGxebengwe.
xh.duties: Ukuhlangabeza imiyalelangano xa ongekhoyo onobhekisano. Ukusayina amaxatso xa ongekhoyo onobhekisano. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kokuhlalutya nokunqonda ulwazi ukuze kuqatshwe imeko yengozi edlayo yicala lomphuli-mthetho ngamnye, apho ulwazi lubungoka iindidi-nndidi eziquka izinto zesikhombisi, amaxatso ebhodi, izihlaziyo zesikhombisi nengxaki ebonakaliswa kwimiyalelangano yomlomo. Ukusebenzisa ulwazi nolugqibo kumanqanaba abaphuli-mthetho ukuze kugqitywe ukuba banokhululwa ngokhuselekileyo kumiphakathi kwaye kuphakanyiswe iimeko ezifanelekileyo apho ukhululo kubefanele. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuvinweni kwezicala ukuze kuqatshwe imeko yengozi ngelixa usebenza ngokwamanyano ekwenzeni lugqibo malunga nobungqisi obukhoyo nasekuqejweni isishwankathelo esicocekileyo nesicwangcisiweyo sezinto ezibalulekileyo ezinceda ekufikiseni isigqibo okanye isindululo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekubhaleweni iingxelo, ukunceda ekulungiseni izishwankathelo ezinekomityi nokunceda onobhekisano ekuphakamiseni isigqibo. Ukuba ngumthunywa osebenzayo weParole Board xa umela kuyo kwimiyalelangano okanye naliphi na isiganekelo.

af.title: Gemeenskapslid
af.summary: Gemeenskapslede word gesoek om op paroolrade te dien, deel te neem aan besluitneming-verhore en oortreders se herintegrering binne die Korrektiewe Dienste-raamwerk te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Erkende graad of nasionale diploma in een van die volgende velde: Kriminele Regspleging, Gemeenskapsontwikkeling, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Polisiewerk of Menseregte-verwante veld. 5 jaar se ervaring in gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk en/of Kriminele Regspleging. Vorige ervaring in 'n besluitnemingskapasiteit sal voordelig wees. Gepensioneerde professionele persone word aangemoedig om aansoek te doen. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en klintefokus. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Vertroulikheid. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrip van die Paroolraadstelsel.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal verantwoordelik wees om by te woon en deel te neem aan die besluitnemingsrol in Paroolraad-verhore. Tree op as 'n fasiliteerder van gemeenskapsherintegrering namens oortreders. Beskerm die belange van die gemeenskap, oortreders en die staat. Verseker objektiewe en regverdige toepassing van die vrylatingsbeleid. Voer ad-hoc-take uit soos deur die Raad bepaal. Verseker vertroulikheid ten opsigte van Paroolraad-vergaderings, besluite en dokumentasie. zu.summary: Kuyafunwa amalungu omphakathi okukhonza kumabhodi we-parole, okuthatha inxaxheba kulezi zinkulumo-mngqgango zokwenza izinqumo futhi sisebenzela ukubuyisela abanquliwe emphakathini ngaphakathi kohlaka lwe-Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: I-degree noma i-diploma yezwe elamukelwe kwelinye lezinkalo ezilandelayo: Criminal Justice, Community Development, Social Science, Policing noma inkalo ehlobene ne-Human Rights. Uzothi 5 years’ experience emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa imiphakathi kanye/noma ku-Criminal Justice. Ulwazi lwangaphambili kwizikhundla zokwenza izinqumo luzoba yinzuzo. Abasebenzi abangathuthukile bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake izicelo. Ikhono nemfihlo: Unxibelelwano. Ukuqondiswa kwayiklayenti kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuzithoba nokwethembeka. Ukugcina efihlekile. Ubuhle bokuba nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ukuqonda i-Parole Board System.
zu.duties: Ophumelelayo uzobekwa umthwalo wokubakhona baze bathathe inxaxheba kwindima yokwenza izinqumo kulezi zinkulumo-mngqgango zamabhodi we-Parole Board. jobs.title: ICT Steering Committee Chairperson
jobs.salary_text: In accordance with National Treasury rates
jobs.summary: Lead the ICT Steering Committee advising the Accounting Officer on ICT governance and strategy for the Department of Electricity and Energy.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 9 qualification in any of the following fields: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) or Computer Science, or an equivalent qualification with expertise in Information and Communication Technology (ICT). A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience in senior management or executive leadership in ICT, with a portion of this experience preferably within the South African public sector. Demonstrated expertise in ICT governance, strategy development, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, and the management of large-scale ICT projects. In-depth knowledge and understanding of the South African ICT regulatory and policy landscape. Professional membership and good standing status in relevant bodies is an added advantage. In-depth knowledge of the PFMA and the Treasury Regulations, as well as other governing prescripts. Exhibit independence of mind in deliberations and be proactive in advising the Accounting Officer. Applicants may not be in the employment of the Department and must have no business or personal relationship with the Department.
jobs.duties: The Chairperson will be responsible for leading the Committee in advising the Accounting Officer in fulfilling their statutory responsibilities in terms of the Public Finance Management Act and other relevant prescripts as they relate to the following key areas: ICT Governance and Strategy: Leading the Committee in overseeing the development, implementation, and monitoring of the ICT Strategy and Enterprise Architecture, ensuring alignment with the strategic objectives. ICT Investment and Resource Management: Chairing the review and recommendation of the ICT budget, overseeing major ICT capital projects, ensuring value for money, and monitoring expenditure in line with PFMA and National Treasury requirements. Project and Portfolio Management: Providing leadership in the oversight of the prioritisation, execution, and delivery of all ICT projects, with a focus on project governance, risk management, and benefits realisation. Cybersecurity and Information Security: Steering the Committee’s oversight of robust cybersecurity and information security measures, including compliance with POPIA, MISS, and the National Cybersecurity Policy Framework, and managing ICT-related risks. Service Delivery and Digital Transformation: Guiding the Committee’s monitoring of ICT service performance and reliability, championing digital transformation initiatives to improve service delivery, and overseeing the management of service level agreements (SLAs). Compliance and Legislative Alignment: Ensuring the Committee’s oversight of the ICT environment complies with all relevant legislation, including the PFMA, SITA Act, ECT Act, and POPIA, as well as applicable National Treasury regulations and minimum ICT standards. In addition to the above, the Chairperson will be responsible for: Setting the agenda for Committee meetings. Chairing all Committee meetings, ensuring constructive dialogue and effective decision-making. Representing the Committee’s views and recommendations to the Accounting Officer. Acting as the primary liaison between the Committee, the Accounting Officer, and the Audit and Risk Management Committee on ICT governance matters.
jobs.applications: Applications should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. You can email your application to Quoting the relevant reference number to: ICTSCChairperson@dee.gov.za
jobs.notes: NB: Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received after the closing date, will not be considered. The requirements stated on the advertised posts are minimum inherent requirements; therefore, the criteria for shortlisting will depend on the proficiency of the applications received. The Department reserves the right to determine suitable candidate(s) during the selection process. Confirmation of final appointment will be subject to a positive security clearance. Due to the larger number of responses anticipated, correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Applicants who have not been contacted during this period may regard their applications as unsuccessful. OTHER POST

af.title: Voorsitter van die IST-strydkomitee
af.summary: Lei die IST-strydkomitee wat die Rekenpligtige Beampte adviseer oor IST-bestuursbeheer en -strategie vir die Department of Electricity and Energy.
af.requirements: NQF level 9-kwalifikasie in enigeen van die volgende velde: Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IST) of Rekenaarwetenskap, of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met kundigheid in Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IST). 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring in senior bestuur of uitvoerende leierskap in IST, met 'n gedeelte van hierdie ervaring by voorkeur binne die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor. Getoonde kundigheid in IST-bestuursbeheer, strategieontwikkeling, ondernemingsargitektuur, digitale transformasie, en die bestuur van grootskaalse IST-projekte. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse IST-regulerende en beleidslandskap. Professionele lidmaatskap en goeie staande status by tersaaklike liggame is 'n bykomende voordeel. Diepgaande kennis van die PFMA en die Tesourie Regulasies, asook ander regeerende voorskrifte. Toon onafhanklikheid van gedagte tydens beraadslaging en wees proaktief in die advisering van die Rekenpligtige Beampte. Aansoekers mag nie in die diens van die Departement wees nie en mag geen besigheids- of persoonlike verbintenis met die Departement hê nie.
af.duties: Die Voorsitter sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om die Komitee te lei in die advisering van die Rekenpligtige Beampte om hul statutêre verantwoordelikhede na te kom ingevolge die Public Finance Management Act en ander tersaaklike voorskrifte soos dit verband hou met die volgende kernareas: IST-bestuursbeheer en Strategie: Lei die Komitee in die toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering, en monitering van die IST-strategie en Ondernemingsargitektuur, wat belyning met die strategiese doelwitte verseker. IST-investering en Hulpbronbestuur: Voorsit die hersiening en aanbeveling van die ISTbegroot, toesig hou oor groot IST-kapitaalprojekte, verseker waarde vir geld, en moniter besteding in ooreenstemming met PFMA- en National Treasury vereistes. Projekt- en Portefeuljebestuur: Verskaf leierskap in die toesig oor die prioritisering, uitvoering, en lewerings van alle IST-projekte, met 'n fokus op projekbestuursbeheer, risikobestuur, en voordeleverwesenwording. Kubersekuriteit en Inligtingsekuriteit: Stuur die Komitee se toesig oor robuuste kubersekuriteits- en inligtingsekuriteitsmaatreëls, insluitend nakoming van POPIA, MISS, en die National Cybersecurity Policy Framework, en die bestuur van ISTverwante risiko's. Dienslewering en Digitale Transformasie: Lei die Komitee se monitering van IST-diensprestasie en betroubaarheid, bevorder digitale transformasie-inisiatiewe om dienslewering te verbeter, en hou toesig oor die bestuur van diensvlakooreenkomste (SLA's). Nakoming en Wetgewende Belyning: Verseker die Komitee se toesig oor die IST-omgewing voldoen aan alle tersaaklike wetgewing, insluitend die PFMA, SITA Act, ECT Act, en POPIA, asook toepaslike National Treasury regulasies en minimum IST-standaarde. Benewens bogenoemde sal die Voorsitter verantwoordelik wees vir: Die opstel van die agenda vir Komiteevergaderings. Voorsit van alle Komiteevergaderings, wat konstruktiewe dialoog en effektiewe besluitneming verseker. Verteenwoordig die Komitee se standpunte en aanbevelings aan die Rekenpligtige Beampte. Optree as die primêre skakel tussen die Komitee, die Rekenpligtige Beampte, en die Oudit- en Risikobestuurkomitee oor IST-bestuursbeheeraangeleenthede.

zu.title: Usihlalo weKomidi Elihola i-ICT
zu.summary: Qhatha iKomidi Elihola i-ICT elitfuna ukweluleka Ofisi Ebalulekayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwe-ICT nenhlelo-mgomo kuMnyango Wekagesi Namandla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zenga-NQF izinga 9 kunoma yisiphi isikhundla esilandelayo: Inkonzo Yolwazi Nokuxhumana (ICT) noma ISayensi Yekhompyutha, noma iziqu ezinganayo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe kuInkonzo Yolwazi Nokuxhumana (ICT). Okungenani isiphephelo seminyaka eyishumi (10) sobuhlakani bokuphatha noma abaphepheli abaphezulu kwi-ICT, okuhlanganisa kube nesigaba esithile salo hlaka lomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo seningizimu Afrika somphakathi. Ukwaziswa okuvezi amakhono ku-governance ye-ICT, ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlelo-mgomo, ukwakheka kwephakheji yamabhizinisi, uguqulo lwezinto eziyisikhombimsebenzisi olwazisiwe, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezinkulu ze-ICT. Ulwazi olujulile nokukuqonda kwesimenge-simenge se-ICT semithetho nenhlelo-mgomo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwamukelwa njengelungu ngokusemthethweni nokuba ngaphansi kwezemidlalo ezinhle kumhlangano ofanele kuyisibeluleko. Ulwazi olujulile nge-PFMA nezezezezo zelulekile eMgodini weNesihlalo, kanye naloanye imithetho ephatha. Ukubonisa ukuzimela kwezinkinga ezinkathazayo nokuba nokubambe iqhaza ekwelulekeni Ofisi Ebalulekayo. Abafaki isicelo abangabi ngaphansi kwesikhundla somsebenzi koMnyango futhi kumele bangabi nobudlelwano bezimboni noma bobuqu noMnyango.
zu.duties: Usihlalo uzobe nesibopho sokuhola iKomidi ekwelulekeni Ofisi Ebalulekayo ekugcwaliseni izibopho zomthetho ngokomthetho WeMali Yomphakathi kanye naloanye imithetho ehlobene nezindawo eziyinhloko ezilandelayo: Ukuhlelelwa kwe-ICT kanye nenhlelo-mgomo: Ukuholwa kweKomidi ekuqapheleni ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokubhekwa kwenhlelo-mgomo ye-ICT kanye nokwakheka kwebhizinisi, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinhloso ezinhlobonhlobo. Ukufakwa kwemali kwe-ICT kanye noPhatho lwamathuluzi: Ukuholwa ekubukeni nokunconywa kwebhajethi ye-ICT, ukuqapha izinhlelo ezinkulu ze-ICT ezimali, ukuqinisekisa inani lemali, kanye nokubuka okuchithekile ngokuhambisana ne-PFMA kanye nezidingo zeNesihlalo Kazwelonke. Ukuhlela kwezinhlelo nokubhaliswa kwesikhwama ezibalulekile: Ukubeka iqhaza ekuqapheleni ukuhlelwa, ukwenziwa, nokuhambisana kwezinhlelo zonke ze-ICT, ngaphandle kwesikhundla sokuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphathwa kengozi, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwenzuzo. Ukuphathwa kwe-Cybersecurity nokuphepha kolwazi: Ukuqondisa ukuqapha iKomidi mayelana nezinyathelo zokuphepha ezinamandla ze-cybersecurity nokuphepha kwamagama, okuhlanganisa nokuhambisana ne-POPIA, i-MISS, kanye nenhlelo-mgomo ye-Cybersecurity Kazwelonke, nokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene ne-ICT. Ukulethwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye noguqulo lwezinto eziyisikhombimsebenzisi: Ukuqondisa iKomidi ekuqapheni ukusebenza kwezinsizakusebenza ze-ICT kanye nokuzethemba, ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zoguqulo lwamagama ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kwezinsizakusebenza, kanye nokubuka ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano zamazinga ukukhonza (SLAs). Ukuhambisana nomthetho nokuhambisana nemitsetfo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqaphwa kweKomidi emkhakheni we-ICT kuhambisana nomthetho wonke, okuhlanganisa i-PFMA, umthetho we-SITA, umthetho we-ECT, ne-POPIA, kanye nemithetho yeNesihlalo Kazwelonke kanye namazinga aphezulu e-ICT. Ngaphandle kwalokhu okungenhla, usihlalo uzobe nesibopho sokwenza: Ukumisa ihlelokhasana lokuqondisa kwezinkulumo zeKomidi. Ukuqondisa zonke inkulumo zeKomidi, ukuqinisekisa ukuxoxisana okuhle kanye nokwenza izinqumo eziyisiciko. Ukumela izinkombandlela kanye nezindaba eziyisiciko zeKomidi ezingenele Ofisi Ebalulekayo. Ukumela njengesinxhumanisi esiyinhloko phakathi kweKomidi, Ofisi Ebalulekayo, kanye neKomidi ePhatha Ibizo Lengozi mayelana nezindaba zokuphathwa kwe-ICT.

xh.title: USihlali weKomiti yeQondisa le-ICT
xh.summary: Yiba ngumphathi weKomiti yeQondisa le-ICT enika inkuziso kuMath athi Accounting Officer malunga nokulawula nengqiqo ye-ICT kwisebe le-Department of Electricity and Energy.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezilingana nanqanaba le-NQF level 9 kwenye yaleminye yezindawo zilandelayo: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) okanye iComputer Science, okanye iziqu ezingemnqanaba onazo nolwazi olukhulu kwi-Information and Communication Technology (ICT). Ulwazi lweminye elingangethanga ngamashumi (10) eminyaka ukuba ngumphathi ongumntu ophakamileyo okanye unobuntu ophezulu ekubeni ngumtshomi kwi-ICT, kananjalo kulindelekile ukuba inxalenye yalolu lwazi ibe ngaphakathi kwelizwekazi lolawulo lwase-South African public sector. Ulwazi olubonakalayo ekulawuleni i-ICT, ekwakheni iingqiqo, ezakhiwo zemikhakha yemibutho, ukuguqulwa kwesithili sobuchwepheshe, nakulawulweni lwamaphulo amakhulu e-ICT. Isizathu esijulileyo sokwazi nokusiva indlela elawulwa ngayo nemigaqo ye-ICT e-South African. Ukuba lilungu lemibutho ngobugcisa kwaye ube ngumntu ohleli kakuhle kumacandelo ahlobeneyo ngaphezulu kwenye. Ulwazi olujulileyo malunga ne-PFMA nemiGaqo ye-Treasury, nakwezinye iinkqubo ezilawula urhulumente. Makubonakale ukuba unengqondo ekhethekileyo nakwiingxoxo kwaye ube ngumntu ongakhawulezisi ngokuvakalisa izimvo ku-Accounting Officer. Abantu abangathunyelwa ukuba bengaphantsi kolawulo lwe-Department kwaye makabikho nabayilowo naye na kwi-Department ngokwezoshishino okanye ngobuqu.
xh.duties: USihlali uya kuba ngumphathi weKomiti ekunika inkambiso ku-Accounting Officer kwizigqibo ezisezinqanabeni ngokomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act nasezinye iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwesi sithuba esilandelayo: Ukulawula nokuQamba iNgqiqo ye-ICT: Ukupatha iKomiti ekulawulweni, ekusebenziseni, nakusololeni iNgqiqo ye-ICT neSakhiwo seMibutho, kuqinisekiswa ukuba zihambisana neengqiqo ezibalulekileyo. ULawulo lweNqanaba leeMali nokuZisa iZiseko ze-ICT: Ukupatha iKomiti ekubuyakeni nakunika izimvo malunga namathani we-ICT, ekulawulweni kwamaphulo amakhulu e-ICT, kuqinisekiswa ukuba imali ithengisa ixabiso elifanelekileyo, nakusololeni ukutsalwa kwemali ngokwe-PFMA nemfuno ka-Treasury yesiZwe. ULawulo lweMisebenzi neQela leMisebenzi: Ukubanabomvakeli ekulawulweni kwangaphambili, ekwenziweni, nakuphumelelweni kwayo yonke imisebenzi ye-ICT, ngolwagqo ekulawulweni kwemisebenzi, ekulawulweni kweengozi, nasekufezekiseni izibonele. Ukhuselo ngoluBuchwepheshe bokuphulwa nokuGcina iNkcazelo: Ukukhusela ukulawula iKomiti ngokumanyano nemithetho yokukhusela ngobuchwepheshe nokulondolozwa kwenkcazelo, kuqinisekiswa ukuba kuhambisana ne-POPIA, i-MISS, neMigaqo esiZwe yokukhusela ngekhompyutha, nakulawulweni kweengozi ezihlobene ne-ICT. Ukunikeza iNkonzo nokuQamba ubuChwepheshe bokutshintsha isimo: Ekukhuliseni ukulawula iKomiti ngemisebenzi yokuhamba kakuhle kwakunye nokwethembeka kweenkonzo ze-ICT, ekuqhubeni imizamo yokutshintsha ubuchwepheshe ukuphucula iinkonzo, nakulawulweni lwemigaqo yamazinga abasebenzi (SLAs). Ukuzinza nokuHambisana noMthetho: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukulawula iKomiti ngendawo ye-ICT kuhambisana nayo yonke imithetho egqitha kuyo, kuquka i-PFMA, i-SITA Act, i-ECT Act, ne-POPIA, nangakumbi namathethonqamlezana e-Treasury yesiZwe namazinga amancinci e-ICT. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSihlali uya kuba nolwazi lokubeka iNqanaba lokudibana neKomiti. Ukupatha onke amadibano eKomiti, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kubakho ingxoxo ekle neengqibo ezisebenzayo. Ukumela iingqibo neengcebiso zeKomiti ku-Accounting Officer. Ukuba ngowokuqala ongumlamli phakathi kweKomiti, ka-Accounting Officer, neseKomiti yoLawulo kweNgxangxgi nokuGcina ngemiba yolawulo ye-ICT.

xh.title: Isekela Mlawuli: Ukulawulwa Kolwelo NeeNkonzo Zesondlo
xh.summary: Phatha ulwelo neenkonzo zesondlo, iinkqubo zokuqeshwa kwezakhiwo ngezibizo zeSebe leZaKhalazo nokuSebenzela kwaGauteng.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso kumqangatho we-NQF 6 njengokuqatshwa yiSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA) kwiNtlongo konikezelo lukawonke-wonke/iNtlongo yeshishino/iNtlongo karhulumente/Ulwelo/ukulawulwa kwezuthutho. Iminyaka yamahlanu (5) yamava apho unyaka bomashi (2) ukwela inqanaba lokulawula neminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ebafundisayo ngokulawulwa kolwelo okanye kwezithutho, amava eeNkonzo zokuNcedisa okanye kuLawulo kwemisebenzi okanye uLawulo beePropati. Ulwazi: Government immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA)19 of 2007, iMigaqo yokulawulwa kolwelo, ukuLawulwa kweeMali karhulumente, iMigaqo nokuQhuba kwisebe, iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iMigaqo yeNkonzo yakuRhulumente, iMigaqo kaBatho Pele, iProtection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), iOccupational Health and Safety Act (OSHA), iNational Archive and Records Act (NAARA). Ikhono: Unxibelelwano, kuqatshelwa iinkcukacha, uBukhosi, uCwangciso nolungiselelwaniso, iKhompyutha, uPhando, ukuzibandakanya, uQhagamshelwano, iMali, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuThatha isiigqibo, ukuLawulwa ixesha, ukuLawula nokuQonda, uNzivo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikela ngeenkonzo zokulawulwa kolwelo ngaphakathi kwiphondo. Qhoboshela ukunikela ngokusebenza kakuhle kweenkonzo zokuNcedisa ezisebenzayo ngaphakathi kwiphondo. Lawula ugcine iinkqubo zokuqeshwa kwezakhiwo nokuqatshwa kwemigelela kaRhulumente. Lawula onke amagugu oSebe ngezantsi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director UI Operations
jobs.summary: Assistant Director UI Operations to facilitate employer services, claims adjudication and registry services in the Northern Cape provincial office.

Coordinate local appeals and complaints in the province. Coordinate general support. Manage resources in the unit.

af.title: Assistenterdirekteur UI-bewerings
af.summary: Assistenterdirekteur UI-bewerings om werkgewerdienste, eise-adjudikasie en registerdienste in die Noord-Kaapse provinsiale kantoor te fasiliteer.

Koördineer plaaslike appèlle en klagtes in die provinsie. Koördineer algemene ondersteuning. Bestuur hulpbronne in die eenheid.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wezuba Wezinhlelo Zokusebenza Ze-UI
zu.summary: Umsekeli Wezuba Wezinhlelo Zokusebenza Ze-UI ukweseka izinsiza zomqashi, ukwahlulela izimangalo nezinsiza zerejistriko ekhofisini lesifundazwe sase-Northern Cape.

Uzalo lokuqasha lweminyaka emine (4) lapho kufanele kube ukuzoba okusebenzayo konyaka (2) kulezi zinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kube khona okwamnyaka (2) uluzu lokuba nhloko kulezo zinsiza. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. zu.duties: Ukweseka umsebenzi wezinsiza zomqashi esifundazweni. Ukuhumusha ukunikezwa kokuhlolwa,okuqinisekiswa nokwahlulelwa kwezimangalo. Ukweseka izinsiza zerejistriko esifundazweni. Ukuhumusha izibhaxo nezikhalazo zaseduzelayo esifundazweni. Ukuhumusha ukweseka jikelele. Ukuphatha izinsiza kwelungu.

Iminyaka emine (4) yamava ngokuqinisekileyo apho iminyaka mibini (2) kufuneka ibe ngamava okusebenza kwendawo ye-Operations, kwaye iminyaka mibini (2) kufuneka ibe ngamava okuba ngumphathi. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amandla: Ikhompyutha, Ukwabhala iingxelo, Ulawulo labantu, ULawulo lwexesha, Unxibelelwano (lolu ngokuthethwa nolubhalwayo), Iimvozdo zabathengi, Amandla okulawula, Amandla okwala.

af.title: Statutêre Dienste Beampte
af.summary: Statutêre Dienste Beampte benodig by die Provinciale Kantoor in Bloemfontein om nakoming van arbeidswetgewing af te dwing, met 'n regtelike kwalifikasie en een jaar se relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: BPROC/ LLB/ BCOM LAW. Een (1) jaar in die regsnakomingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Transformasie en bestuursake in die openbare diens. Openbare Dienswet. Tesourie Regulasies. Departementele beleide en prosedures. Korporatiewe bestuur. Skills Development Act. Openbare Diens Regulasies. SDLA. Vaardighede: Fasilitering, beplanning en organisering, rekenaarvaardigheid, probleemoplossing, ondervringsvaardighede, aanbieding, innoverend, analitiese, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Drie-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Rekeningkunde/ Finansies. 2 jaar se funksionele ervaring in Finansiële Verslagdoening. Kennis: Besigheidsstrategieë en doelwitte van die Compensation Fund. Doelwitte en prestasievereistes van die direksiraat/ sub-direksiraat. Compensation Fund Dienste. Waardeketting en besigheidsproses van die Compensation Fund. Regulasies, beleide en prosedures van die Openbare Diens, Dol en Fund. Terwylige belanghebbendes. Kliëntediens (Batho Pele Beginsels). Fondswaardes. Vereiste IT-kennis. IT-bedryfstelsels van die Fund. Tegniese kennis. DPSA-riglyne oor COIDA. Wetgewende vereistes: COIDA-wet, regulasies en beleide. Openbare Dienswet. Occupational Health and Safety Act. PFMA en Nasionale Tesourie Regulasies. Promotion of Access to Information Act. PAJA. Grondwetwet 108 van 1996 (soos gewysig). Road Accident Fund (RAF). Unemployment insurance Act (UIA). Algemene kennis van die Openbare Diens Regulasies. LRA, EE Act, SDA & BCEA. Vaardighede: Vereiste tegniese vaardigheid. Besigheidsskryfvaardighede. Vereiste IT-vaardighede. IT-bedryfstelsels. Besluitneming. Selfbestuur. Begroting en finansiële bestuur. Mense- en prestasiebestuur. Ontwikkeling van ander. Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossing. Projek- of programbestuur. Spanleierskap
af.duties: Om onafhanklik te beplan en werk wat na Statutêre Dienste verwys is te administreer vir die afdwinging van nie-nakoming ingevolge arbeidswetgewing. Assist die ASD: SS in die afdwingsprosesse vir IES. Help met die strategie vir Statutêre Dienste. Help met die facilitering van die implementering van kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme vir die inspekteurs in die provinsie. Statistieke vir die eenheid opstel. Transaksies hersien en magtig. Algemene grootboekaktiwiteite uitvoer. GL-rekordverslag vir die rekeninge uitvoer. Jaareindtake uitvoer.

zu.title: Inkulu Yesevisi Esemthethweni
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkulu Yesevisi Esemthethweni Ebonweni Lezifunda eBloemfontein ukuthi qinise imithetho yokusebenza, kudingeka iziqu zomthetho nomyaka owodwa wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: BPROC/ LLB/ BCOM LAW. Unyaka owodwa (1) kumhlabahlezi wokuhambisana nomthetho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Izinguquko kanye nezinkinga zolawulo kwinkonzo kahulumeni. Umthetho Wenkonzo Kahulumeni. Izimiso Zezimali. Izinqubomgomo zomnyango kanye nendlela yokuqhuba. Ulawulo lwebhizinisi elihlukene. Umthetho Wokuthuthukisa Amakhono. Izimiso Zenkonzo Kahulumeni. SDLA. Amakhono: Ukumiswa kwezindaba, Ukuphatha nokuhlela, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okuphendula imibuzo, Okunikezwayo, Okusha, Okuhlukaniswayo, Unxibelelwano ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Iziqu zesikhungo samaphakeme esithatha iminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) esemukelewe yi-SAQA kwi-Accounting/ Finance. Iminyaka emibili (2) yokuhlangenwe nakho ekubhaleni imibiko yezimali. Ulwazi: Izinhloso nezifaniso zebhizinisi le-Compensation Fund. Izinhloso zephakethe / kwephakethe elincane kanye nezidingo zokusebenza. Izinkonzo ze-Compensation Fund. Ukuhamba kwentengo kanye nenqubo yebhizinisi le-Compensation Fund. Izinqubomgomo, izimiso kanye nendlela yokuqhuba zenkonzo kahulumeni, ze-Dol nakwe-Fund. Balabo abahlobene nenhloso. Inkonzo Yabathengi (Imigomo kaBatho Pele). Amaxabiso e-Fund. Ulwazi oludingekayo lokusebenzisa i-IT. Izimiso zokusebenza ze-Fund IT. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe. Izeluleko ze-DPSA nge-COIDA. Izidingo zomthetho: Umthetho, izimiso kanye nenzinkubomgomo ze-COIDA. Umthetho Wenkonzo Kahulumeni. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwemisebenzi. I-PFMA kanye Nezimiso Zezimali Zesizwe. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukwaziswa. I-PAJA. Umthetho Womthethosisekelo 108 ka-1996 (ushintshiwe). I-Road Accident Fund (RAF). Umthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabangasebenzi (UIA). Ulwazi jikelele ngezoMthetho zentimiso kahulumeni. I-LRA, I-EE Act, I-SDA & I-BCEA. Amakhono: Ukuziphatha ngobuchwepheshe okudingekayo. Amakhono okubhala ibhizinisi. Amakhono e-IT adingekayo. Izimiso zokusebenza ze-IT. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuzilawula. Ukubhalela kanye nokuqasha imali. Ukuphatha abantu nokuqasha abasebenzayo. Ukuthuthukisa abanye. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphatha noma ukulawula izinhlelo. Ukuba ngumholi wetimu
zu.duties: Ukucubungula ngokuzimele nokuphatha umsebenzi okuthunyelwa kwisevisi esemthethweni ukuze kuqinise ukungalaleli komthetho wokusebenza. Ukusiza i-ASD: SS eminqubweni yokuqinisa i-IES. Ukusiza entungweni yesevisi esemthethweni. Ukusiza ekwakhiweni kolwazi kubahloli abasezifundeni. Ukuqoqa izibalo zephakethe. Ukubuka futhi uvume izinhlanga. Ukwenza imisebenzi yalebula jikelele. Ukwenza ukuqondanisa i-GL kwama-akhawunti. Ukwenza imisebenzi yasekugcineni konyaka.

xh.title: Isebe lamasevisi esithatywayo ngokomthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneka isebe lamasevisi esithatywayo ngokomthetho kwiProvincial Office eBloemfontein ukugcinwa kokuzithoba ngokomthetho wemisebenzi, kufunekela ifayidheshini yomthetho kunye nomyaka omnye wamava ahambelana nalo.
xh.requirements: BPROC/ LLB/ BCOM LAW. Un (1) yaka kwibhondo yokuzithoba ngokomthetho. Ilayiseni yokuqesha ephathwayo. Ulwazi: Iindaba zokutshintsha nokulawula kwinkonzo yomphakathi. Isiko senkonzo yomphakathi. Iimithetho yeTreasury. Iindulamthetho neenkqubo zesebe. Ulawulo lecorporate. IsiSiko sokuPhuhlisa iNtetho. Iimithetho yeNkonzo yaBaphakathi. SDLA. Amaphepha: Ukukhokela, ukuCwangcisaokuHlela, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amaphepha okudiba, iPrezenteishini, okutsha, ukuHlalutya, unxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhaliwa. Ifayidheshani yethatu yemfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 6) evunyiwe yiSAQA kwi-Akhawunti/ ezeMali. Iyaka ezi-2 zamava omsebenzi ekubhalweni kweNgxelo ezeMali. Ulwazi: Iindlela namagama eqhinga kunye neenjongo zeCompensation Fund. Iinjongo kunye neemfuno zokuqhumisa imisebenzi kwindawo / kwisub-directorate. Iinkonzo zeCompensation Fund. Ixabiso elilandelanayo lemisebenzi neenkqubo zoshishino zeCompensation Fund. Iinkonzo zabaphakathi, iDol neemithetho zeFund, iindulamthetho neenkqubo. Abanomdla abahambelanayo. Iinkonzo zoMthengi (iimpawu zeBatho Pele). Iixabiso zeFund. Ulwazi olufunekayo lwe-IT. Iinkqubo zokuqhuba i-IT zeFund. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe. Iindlela zikaDPSA kwiCOIDA. Iimfuno zoMthetho: iSiko seCOIDA, iimithetho neendulamthetho. IsiSiko senkonzo yomphakathi. IsiSiko soMthetho woMpilo loKhuseleko lweMisebenzi. PFMA neemithetho zeTreasure yaseNasjonal. IsiSiko soNyuso lokuFikelela kwUlwazi. PAJA. IsiSiko soMgaqo-nkqubo 108 ka-1996 (lutshiwe). I-Siza leNgozi zeNdlela (RAF). IsiSiko soMshicilelo wokhuseleko lweNgqalasweni (UIA). af.title: Staatsrekeningkunde: Finansiële Verslagdoening

zu.title: Izimali Zikahulumeni: Okubikwayo Ngemali
zu.summary: Kucutshungulwe kubekwe futhi kubhalwe izimpesheni zezimali, kuhlolwe izinkomba, kukhutshwe imibiko yokuzihlalela kwenziwe imibiko yonyaka yezimali e Compensation Fund e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziphakeme ezingaphansi kwesiqu samabanga (NQF level 6) ezivunyiwe yi SAQA kwezimali/ezemali. Unyaka owodwa (1) wamasheya ezimali. Ulwazi: Isakhiwo sezimali (GRAP). Ukuqonda izinto ezingamakhomphyutha (Amasistimu ezimali, Amathuluzi). Ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo nokuhambisana nemithetho. Izindlela nokubaluleka kwebhizinisi le Compensation Fund. Bahlali abahlobene. Izenzo zabathengi (Imigomo ka Batho Pele). Imithetho yesevizile yomphakathi (PSR). Umthetho wesevizile yomphakathi. Imiyalo yokuqondisa ukuthenga kwe Supply Chain Management. Umthetho wokukhuthazwa kwemvume yokufikelela kulwazi. Izidingo zomthetho: PFMA kanye Nemicimbo ye National Treasury. Imithetho yesevizile yomphakathi. Amakhono: Ukubona inkohlakalo. Ukuhlaziya imininingwane nokubika. Ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nabahlali. I GRI (Global Reporting Initiative) kanye nezinga lesi IV king. I GRAP (Izilinganiso zokubikwa kwendawo). Ukuhweba. Ukuhlaziya nokutolika imininingwane (Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukubikezela nokubikezela okungaphambili). Ukuqonda izinto ezingamakhompyutha (Amasistimu ezimali, Amathuluzi). Ukubuka, ukwenza lula kanye nokuhumusha.
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa kokuqonda kubekwe izimpesheni. Ukuhlaziya futhi kuhlolwe izinkomba zemali. Ukwakhishwa kwemibiko kusistimu zemali ngenjongo yokubika ngokuzihlalela. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ekulungiseleleni imibiko yezimali yonyaka. Ukugada imithombo.

xh.title: I-Akhawunti kaHlahlembi: Ingxelo ngeMali
xh.summary: Qhubeza kwaye uposte iintengiselwano ze-akhawunti, qinisekisa amarekhodi, khupha iingxelo ezingabakho sobhozo kwaye ulungise iinkcazelo zegcinekelo lemali yonyaka kwi-Fund yokuHlawula ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ze-Undergraduate (inqanaba le-NQF 6) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwi-Accounting/Finance. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava kwi-Accounting. Ulwazi: Uphawu loLwazi lwe-Accounting (GRAP). Ulwazi lwe-Digital (Amajelo eMali, Izixhobo). Ukuqonda nokulawula i-polisi nokuthobela. Iindaba nezijongo zoshishino ze-Compensation Fund. Batho ngabantu abalulekileyo. Iinkonzo zoMthengi (IimPezulu zeBatho Pele). IimGaqo zoMsebenzi woLuntu (PSR). uMthetho woMsebenzi woLuntu. IimBhalo zoLawulo lwoQoqosho kuThengiso. Ukukhuthaza ukufikelela kolwazi kuMthetho weNkcukacha. IimFuno zoMthetho: i-PFMA kunye neGaqo leSizwe le-Nazophulo. IimGaqo zoMsebenzi woLuntu. Ikhono: Ukuqonda ukudlwengulwa. Ukuhlalutywa kwedatha nokuvelisa ingxelo. Uphuhliso nabahanjiswa kwabantu. IimFuno ze-GRI (Inkcubuselwano yeNgxelo yoMhlaba) kunye ne-King IV. IiNqobo zeNgxelo zaKwakhona (GRAP). Ukuqhathanisa. Ukuhlalutywa nokutolika iNkcukacha (Ukucinga ngeNyango, iNkcazelo yamaxesha amaza). Ulwazi lwe-Digital (amajelo emali, izixhobo). Ukuvezwa, ukulungelelanisa nokuThetha phambi kwabantu.
xh.duties: Qhubeza ukuqhubeza nokuposta iintengiselwano. Hlalutya ukuze uqinisekise amarekhodo e-akhawunti. Khupha iingxelo kwijelo le-akhawuntu ukuze kubekho iingxelo ezilungeleyo. Sonda iNkcukacha ulungisa iinkcazelo zegcinekelo lemali yonyaka. Ulawulo lwebalulekileyo.

zu.summary: Hlola izindawo zokusebenza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuziphatha ngokomthetho wezabasebenzi, qhube izingucingo futhi wenze ukuthi umthetho we-Basic Conditions of Employment Act usebenze emikhakheni ye-Labour Centres.

Amakhono: amakhono okuhola, ukulungiselela nokuqamba (umsebenzi wakho), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubuzwa imibuzo, amakhono okuxhumana okuhlaziya ulwazi.
zu.duties: Qhube ukuhlolwa kwabasebenzi ngegiju lokwenza isiqiniseko sokuhambisana nawo wonke umthetho wezabasebenzi. Qhube izingucingo ezivezwe ngemicimbi ehlobene nokwephula umthetho wezabasebenzi futhi wenze ukuba usebenze lapho nasezingeni elidingekayo. Qhube ukuhlolwa okubanzi (Blitz) njalo ukuze ulawule ukuziphatha ngokomthetho wezabasebenzi. Qhube imikhankaso yokuqashisa ngomthetho wezabasebenzi oveziwe nowabeliwe. Siza ekubhaleni amaphulani okuhlola, okubikiwe nokuhlanganisa izibalo ngemicimbi eveliwe.

xh.requirements: Izemvelo ezifanelekileyo zeminyaka emithathu (3) kwiQumrhu loBantu noBudlelwane/Umthetho we-BCOM/LLB. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Umthetho weMigaqo yeSiseko yoBomi obuPhakathi koBasebenzi, iNkqubo nemigaqo yeSebe, Umthetho woPhuhliso lweZakhono, Umthetho woBudlelwano babasebenzi, Umthetho woMvuzo wokuGqibela koBasebenzi, Umthetho woMnikelo woMvuzo wokuGqibela, Umthetho woLingana koMsebenzi, Iinkonzo zoMthengi (iMigaqo ye-Batho Pele). Amandla: Amandla okukhokeza, uCwangco loLungiselelo (umsebenzi wakho), ulwazi ngekhompyutha, amandla oBudlelwano nabantu, amandla oKusombulula iingxaki, amandla oBuzo, amandla oNxibelelwano oluchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza ukuhlolwa kolusebenzi ngenjongo yokugqibisa ukuzithobela bonke umthetho wabasebenzi. Yenza uphando kumacala axeliweyo anokuthintela umthetho wabasebenzi uphinde ulawule apho naxa kudingeka. Yenza ukuhlolwa okungenisa isifo (iBlitz) rhoqo ukuze ulawule ukuzithobela umthetho wabasebenzi. Yenza imikhankaso yokukhusela umthetho wabasebenzi ochongiweyo onikelwe kuyo. Plan and conduct allocated pro- active (BLITZ) inspections regularly to monitor compliance with labour legislation including compilation and consolidation of reports emanating from such inspections, Plan and conduct Advocacy campaigns on all labour legislations independently analyse impact thereof, consolidate and compile report. Contribute at a higher level to planning, drafting and maintenance of regional inspection plans and reports including execution of analysis and compilation of consolidated statistical reports on regional and allocated cases.

xh.title: Isiphengi se-Bcea
xh.summary: Kuphendulwe iindawo zoluntu ukuvakalelwa ukuzithoba ngomthetho wabasebenzi, kwenziwe uphando malunga nokwahlukana nomthetho, kwayenziwe ukusebenzisa i-BCEA, i-LRA, i-EEA, i-COIDA ne-OHS Acts kwiZiko leMisebenzi le-Mthatha.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zesithathu (3) zemfundo ephakamileyo ezahileleyo kwabasebenzi/ i-BCOM Law/ i-LLB. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Iindlela nomgaqo-nkqubo zesebe, i-Skills Development Act, i-LRA, i-BCEA, i-Skills Development Levies Act, i-OHS Act, i-COIDA, iikhowudi ze-SABS, i-UIA, i-UI Contributions Act, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Immigration Act. Amakhono: Ukulawula, ukuCwangcisa nokuHlela, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nokuziphatha kwabantu, ukuphatha iingxabano, ukuNxibelelwana, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuPendula ngemibuzo, okubhalwayo nokuNika inkcazelo, okutsha, ukuHlalutya nokuThetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa ukuze wenze isiphengi esinengqondo ngenjongo yokuqinisekisa ukuzithoba ngawo onke amathetho abasebenzi ngokwawo, i-BCEA, i-LRA, i-EEA, i-UIA COIDA, i-OHS ne-UCA. Cwangcisa ukuze uphendule ngokuzimela kwezi phimbalwano ezibikiweyo ezingqamisana nokwahlukana nomthetho wabasebenzi, uze usebenzise njengoko kufuneka kuquka nokulungiselela ukuvela eNkundleni njengongqondiswa welizwe. Cwangcisa ukuze wenze rhoqo iziphengi ezabelweyo ezingalindanga (i-BLITZ) ukuze ulolame ukuzithoba ngomthetho wabasebenzi kuquka nokudidiyela nokudibanisa iingxelo eziphuma kwezo ziphengi. Cwangcisa ukuze wenze amaziko okuchasa ngawo onke amathetho abasebenzi uhlohluthe ngokuzimela umphumo wawo, udibanise uze udlalule ingxelo. Yiba negalelo elingaphezulu kwinqanaba ekucwangcisweni, ekubhalweni nokugcineni iindawo zocwangciso nezinxulumene neengxelo zemiphendulo kuquka nokuwela kwengxelo yamanani ngokubumbana kwemiphendulo yesithili neyamaphimbalwano abelweyo.

zu.title: Umhlanganisi Wokuqeqesha: Ukuphatha Amaphrojekthi Abasha a-EPWP
zu.summary: Ukuhlanganisa ukuqeqesha, ukunikeza amandla abasha namaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa othisha abakhiqizayo kuDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment eCape Town.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ku-Training and Development/ Developmental Studies noma izifundo ezihambisano endaweni enomthelela njengoba kugunyazwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yemvelaphi ekufezeni ocwaningweni e-Training / Training and Development noma endaweni ehambisanayo. Ulwazi lwezinqumo kanye nezinhlaka zokuqeqesha kanye nentuthuko. Izinqumo kanye nezimiso zomnyango. Ulwazi lwebhajethi, ukuphatha izinkulumo, izimali kanye nezinhlaka zokuqasha. Ulwazi lokuqapha nokuhlola. Ulwazi lwendawo yobuqhwaba. Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe, okufundwayo noku khulunywayo). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlola ulwazi nokubika. Amakhono okuqeqesha nentuthuko. Amakhono okuphatha abathintekayo kanye nokweluleka. Ukukwazi ukusebenza amahora amaningi ngokuzithoba. Ukukwazi ukuqoqa futhi uhlolishe ulwazi. Ukukwazi ukuhumusha imithetho yakho kanye nokwakha izinqumo ezifanele. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngabanye kanye nakubahlanganye. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi komfutho omkhulu. Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi ucubungule ngaphansi komfutho. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukuqalwa kanye nokuqamba kwamaphrojekthi okuqeqeshwa, abasha abakhuthazwa kanye nothisha abakhiqizayo abathuthukiswa. Ukuba nabahlanganeyo abaqoqa amaphrojekthi kwabangela amaphrojekthi. Ukuhlola izidingo zokuqeqesha zabathatha isiqophamthetho esifundazweni. Ukwenza ukucwaningwa kwezakhono zamaphrojekthi ukukhombisa ukuthi kuzuzwe okufakiwe kokuqeqeshwa. Ukweluleka ukuqamba koqeqesho, ukunikeza amandla abasha kanye nokuthuthukisa othisa abakhiqizayo abaphrojekthi. Ukuhlola izinhlaka zokuqeqesha futhi uphumeze ukugunyazwa. Ukwakha ishedi yokuqeqesha bese uyolanda ukuphathwa kwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi ahambisana ne-EPWP, hlanganisa ukuthunyelwa nokuhlolwa kwamabiko anyakeni emaphrojekthi, hlanganisa ukuzigcina esifundazweni ngemibuzo yokuhlola ngamaphrojekthi a-YED. Ukwakha isisekelo sedatha yabasha abangemaphrojekthi a-EPWP kanye nothisa abathuthukiswa abakhiqizayo. Unikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kwabathintekayo abangenwe ekuthuthukiseni amandla abasha kanye namaphrojekthi othisa abakhiqizayo abaphuma ekuthuthukeni. Unikeza inkxaso yokubuqhwaba.
