xh.summary: Phambukisa iimfundo, namandla ezintsomi nokuphuhliswa kweekontraka kwiProjekthi zeLungiselelo lweSebe lezoHlaza, lezoLwandle nokuBhalisa nokusingathwa kweNdalo kwiCape Town.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwiziFundo zokuQeqesha nokuZinza / i-Developmental Studies okanye isiqinisekiso esehelayo kwicala elinxulumeneyo njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Amava ohlobo lweminyaka emibini (2) kwiFundo / uQeqesho nokuPhuhliswa okanye kwicala elinxulumeneyo. Ulwazi malunga neenkqubo neemila zokuQeqesha nokuPhuhliswa. Iinkqubo neemila zeSebe. Ulwazi malunga neYure yemali, ulawulo lweekontraka, iinkqubo zokutheNgqangqtho zokuhlawulela nezenza imali. Ulwazi malunga noLawulo nokuBika. Ulwazi malunga nokusingathwa kweekhomishini. Amandla okunxibelelana (okubhaliweyo, okufundwayo nokuthethwayo). Ukuba lisekhompyutheni. Uhlalutyo lwamaxhoba nokuBika. Amandla okuQeqesha nokuPhuhliswa. Amandla okuLawula abanini nzala nokuKhokelela. Amandla okusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela. Amandlaokuqokelela nokuHlalutya inkcazelo. Amandla okutolika iimithetho yokulawula nokwakha iMila ehambelana nayo. Amandla okusebenza ngamanye okanye eqele. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwendlalo enkulu. Amandla okuqamba iliso nokucwangcisa ngaphantsi kwendlalo. I-License yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phambukisa ukuqaliswa nokucwangciswa kweProjekthi zoQeqesho,okuNika amandla iZintsomi nokuPhuhliswa kweekontraka. Khokelela iindibano zokuZingela iiprojekthi kubadvunyuli beprojekthi. Yenza uhlalutyo lweemfuno zoqeqesho kumathatha ekwindla. Yenza uhlalutyo lwamandla eprojekthi ukuze kuqatshelwe iifayili zoqeqesho. Khokelela ukucwangciswa kweProjekthi zoQeqesho,okuNika amandla iZintsomi nokuPhuhliswa kweekontraka. Hlola iinkqubo zoqeqesho ukhokelela ukuvunywa. Yiza noluho lokhuqeqesha ulawule ukuphunyezwa kwalo. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweeprojekthi ze-EPWP phambukisa ukungeniswa nokuhlola iirepoti zenyanga zeeprojekthi phambukisa ukuzaliseka kundwendwe lwemfundiso kwii-issues ze-YED projekthi. Yiza nedatabase yabaThatha inxaxheba kwi-Epwp Youth nokuPhuhliswa kweekontraka. Nika inkxaso kulawulo lwabanini nzala abanxulumene neProjekthi zoNika amandla iZintsomi nokuPhuhliswa kweekontraka. Nika inkxaso yekhomishini.

af.title: Bosbouvervoorman: Vergroening en Bestaansmiddele
af.summary: Bosbouvervoorman gesoek om saailingproduksie toe te sien, take aan arbeiders toe te ken en plantgesondheid by 'n Limpopo-bosbousentrum te monitor.
af.requirements: Graad 11 (NQF-vlak 3/4) of relevante equivalente kwalifikasie. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis van voortplantingsmetodes en plante. Kennis van rekordhouding. Toesigvaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, numeriese vaardighede, luistervaardighede, verantwoordelik, pligsgetrou en oplettend tot besonderhede. Vermoë om met moeilike mense te werk. Vermoë om lang ure vrywillig te werk. Vermoë om met beperkte toesig te werk.
af.duties: Voer produksie-aktiwiteite uit in ooreenstemming met die operasionele planne. Ken take aan arbeiders toe volgens die produksieblad. Verseker dat saadversameling en steggies van plante gedoen word. Kontroleer saailinge en plante vir plaag- en siektes. Merk vir die grawe van putte, plant, oorplant en snoei. Verseker dat korrekte saad versamel word, naamgee, etiketteer en tel al die plante. Verseker oes-aktiwiteite en berei brandgordels voor. Hou toesig oor die instandhouding van die kwekery, plantasie en houthowe: beheer onkruid. Lewer algemene ondersteuningsfunksies: doen voorraadopname, adviseer en help die publiek in die kwekery, plantasie en houthowe. Verskaf opleiding en ontwikkeling aan personeel. Verskaf opleiding ter plaatse (bv. natmaak van plante, snoei, onkruidbeheer). Verskaf afrigting aan personeel.

zu.title: Forestry Foreman: Greening and Livelihoods
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-forestry foreman ukugcina izinqamuleli ezithwebulayo ukwaba imisebenzi kubasebenzi kanye nokuqapha impilo yezitshalo esikhungweni se-forestry e-Limpopo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade11 (NQF level 3/4) noma iziqu ezingabhekanayo. Akukho mkhankaso ofunekayo. Ukwazi ngendlela zokwanda kwezitshalo nezitshalo. Ukwazi ngokugcina amarekhodi. Izindlela zokuqapha, izindlela zokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Izindlela zokuhlobana nomuntu, izindlela zokusombulula izinkinga, izindlela zokubala, izindlela zokulalela, ukubekezelela, ukuzinakekelaisibonelo, nokunaka imininingwane. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima. Ikono lokusebenza amahora amade ngokuzithandela. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphandle kokuqaphwa okwedlule.
zu.duties: Qhuba imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ngokuhambisana namaphulani okusebenza. Aba imisebenzi abasebenzini ngokusho ikhasi lokukhiqiza. Qiniseka ukuthi kuqoqwe izimbewu kuthathwe amagatsha ezitshalo. Hlola iziqhamezi nezitshalo ukuthi zitholakale yini izinambuzane nezifo. Uphawula ukumba izigodi, ukutshala, ukufudulela nokusika izitshalo. Qiniseka ukuthi kusetshenziswa izimbewu ezifanele, kubhalwe amagama, kubekwe amathegi kubalwe yonke izitshalo. Qiniseka imisebenzi yokuvuna ulenze izivikelo zomlilo. Qaphisise ukugcinwa kwesibaya sezitshalo, esivini sezitshalo namawolothi: lulula izitshalo ezingezinhle. Nikeza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokwesekwa: yenza ukubala kwempahla, welule futhi usize umphakathi esibayeni sezitshalo, esivini namawolothi. Nikeza ukuqeqeshwa nokuvelisa abasebenzi. Nikeza ukuqeqeshwa ngokusebenza (isb. ukunisela izitshalo, ukusika, ukululula izitshalo ezingezinhle). Nikeza abasebenzi isikhuthazo sokusebenza.

xh.title: iNkundla yeBhodi yeMithi: Uluhlaza nezindlela zokuPhila
xh.summary: Kufunwa inkundla yebhodi yemithi ukulawula ukulungelelaniswa kwemithi, ukwaba imisebenzi kumabhorola, nokugcina impilo yemithi kwindawo yemithi eLimpopo.
xh.requirements: iGrade11 (NQF level 3/4) okanye isifanekiso esifanelekileyo. Akukho mfundo yamava efunekayo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokwandisa nokutyalwa kwemithi. Ulwazi lokugcina irekhodi. Amapondo okulawula, amapondo okunxibelelwana (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo). Amapondo obudlelwane bomntu nomntu, amapondo oxazululo lwezinkinga, amapondo ezibalo, amapondo okulalela, ungowamntu onoxanduva, onobugcisa, kwaye unakhe ukunakela iinkcukacha. Ulawulo lokusebenza nabantu abanzima. Ulawulo lokusebenza iiyure ezide ngokuzithandela. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngaphandle kolawulo olulinganiselweyo.
xh.duties: Qhuba imisebenzi yokulungelelanisa ngokweplani zokuqhuba. Yaba umsebenzi kumabhorola njengakwephepha lokulungelelanisa. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuqokelelwa kweembewu nokusika kwemithi kwenziwe. Hlola imithi nakwindalo yayo ngemikhwa nezifo. Phawula ukuvalela amadlebe, ukutyala, ukutyala kwakhona nokusika imithi. Qinisekisa ukuba iziqholo ezifanelekileyo zifungiswa, zigqitywe, zibekwe i-tag kwaye zibale imithi yonke. Qinisekisa imisebenzi yokuvuna kwaye ulungise iindawo ezikhusela umlilo. Lawula ukugcinwa kwenursari, iplentishoni namadlebe okhuni: lawula izityalo ezingafunekiyo. Nikezela ngemisebenzi yonke yoncedo: yenza ukubala kwesitokhwe, yala kwaye ncedise abantu kwinursari, iplentishoni namadlebe okhuni. Nikezela nokuqeqesha nentluko kumbasebenzi. Nikezela ukuqeqesha kumsebenzi (umz. ukuchela imithi, ukusika, ukukhupha izityalo ezingafunekiyo). Nikezela ikhonsathi kumbasebenzi.

jobs.title: Groundsman: Greening and Livelihoods Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 16 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: The Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment seeks a groundsman in the Northern Cape to maintain grounds, plants and lawns; Grade 9 required with no prior experience needed.
jobs.requirements: Grade 9 (NQF level 1) equivalent qualification. No experience required. Knowledge of National Forestry Act 84 of 1998, National Veld, Fire Forestry Act 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Problem solving skills, Interpersonal skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work long hours voluntarily. Ability to work individually and in a team. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict.
jobs.duties: Perform routine activities in respect of grounds, irrigate and water plants lawns. Conduct weeding and weed control. Prune and trim plants, performance cutting, seeding and transplanting of plants. Mow lawns, dispose of organic waste, dig compost, dig, spray and maintain flower beds and edges. Perform general routine activities in respect of infrastructure support. Seeds collection. Cleaning of seeds. Seed pre-sowing treatment. Preparation of seedling trays. Sowing of seed. Preparation and sowing of cuttings. Ensure planting and transplanting of seedlings and trees. Filling of planting bags with soil. Prepare space in beds for transplanting. Transplanting of seedling from trays to bags. Transplanting of trees from small to bigger bags. Packing of transplanted trees. Provide general labour in the nursery. Mixing of sand and compost. Manual and chemical weed control. Irrigation of seedlings and trees. Assist with stocktaking. Tagging of plants correctly. Check seedlings and plants for pests and diseases. Assist the customers coming to buy trees. Responsible for the tools allocated. Report any damage in the nursery to the Foreman. Ensure the use, cleaning and basic maintenance of tractor and dumper. Move sand and compost to the tables or beds. Move seedlings, crates and tree. Keep equipment and machinery clean after use.

af.title: Grondwerker: Implementering van Vergroening en Bestaansmiddele
af.summary: Die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment soek 'n grondwerker in die Northern Cape om gronde, plante en grasperke te onderhou; Graad 9 vereis met geen vorige ervaring nodig nie.
af.requirements: Graad 9 (NQF vlak 1) ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis van National Forestry Act 84 of 1998, National Veld, Fire Forestry Act 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) en Occupational Health and Safety Act. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goede interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los.
af.duties: Voer roetine-aktiwiteite uit ten opsigte van gronde, besproei en water plante grasperke. Doen onkruidverwydering en onkruidbeheer. Snoei en knip plante, voer snywerk, saad en oorplanting van plante uit. Maai grasperke, raak organiese afval ontslae, grawe kompos, grawe, spuit en onderhou blombeddings en rande. Voer algemene roetine-aktiwiteite uit ten opsigte van infrastruktuurondersteuning. Saadversameling. Skoonmaak van saad. Saad voor-asaai-behandeling. Voorbereiding van saailingbakkies. Saai van saad. Voorbereiding en saai van steggies. Verseker plant en oorplanting van saailinge en bome. Vul plant Sac Sakke met grond. Berei ruimte in beddings voor vir oorplanting. Oorplanting van saailinge van bakkies na sac sakke. Oorplanting van bome van klein na groter sac sakke. Pak van oorgeplante bome. Verskaf algemene arbeid in die kwekery. Meng van sand en kompos. Manuele en chemiese onkruidbeheer. Besproeiing van saailinge en bome. Bystand met voorraadopname. Merk plante korrek. Kontroleer saailinge en plante vir peste en siektes. Bystand aan kliënte wat bome kom koop. Verantwoordelik vir toegeken gereedskap. Rapporteer enige skade in die kwekery aan die opsigter. Verseker die gebruik, skoonmaak en basiese onderhoud van trekker en dumper. Skuif sand en kompos na die tafels of beddings. Skuif saailinge, kratte en bome. Hou toerusting en masjinerie skoon na gebruik.

zu.title: Umphathi wegceke: Ukuphila kwesilimo nokusetshenziswa kokuphila
zu.summary: Umnyango i- Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ifuna umphathi wegceke e- Northern Cape ukuthi agcine indawo, izitshalo kanye nesibaya; i- Grade 9 iyadingeka bese kungekho mfuno yempilo edlule.
zu.requirements: Umfundo we Grade 9 (NQF level 1) oilingana. Akukho mpilo edingekayo. Ulwazi ngo National Forestry Act 84 of 1998, National Veld, Fire Forestry Act 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) kanye no Occupational Health and Safety Act. Amakhono ekuqondweni izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono amahle okuhlobene nomuntu siqu. Ikhono lokusebenza amahora amanengi ngokuzithandela. Ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye kanye nendawonye. Ikhono lokusebenza phansi kwegci elinzima. Ikhono lokusebenza kanye notho oyingxenye bese uxazulula izingxabano.
zu.duties: Zenza imisebenzi eqandiswayo ehlobene nezinto zokwakha, ukufaka amanzi kwizitshalo nasensimini. Qoba futhi ulawule utshani. Sika futhi ulungise izitshalo, sikise okuncane, hlakaze futhi ufake izitshalo ezisha. Sika utshani, zixoshe izinto ezingcolile eziphilayo, khweza, qhiba, faka futhi igcine amabhedi okuhlaza kanye namaphasi. Zenza imisebenzi eqandiswayo ejwayelekile ehlobene nokwesekwa kwakho konke okwakhayo. Qoqa imbewu. Hlamba imbewu. Phatha imbewu ngaphambi kokuyifakela. Lungiselela amatreyi embewu. Faka imbewu. Lungiselela futhi ufake izigaba zemithi. Qinisekisa ukutshalwa nokufakwa kwesitshalo esisha kanye nemithi. Gcwalisa amasaka okutshala ngesikhathi. Lungiselela isikhundla kumabhedi okufaka izitshalo ezisha. Faka izitshalo ezisha avela kumatreyi ayela amasaka. Faka imithi ibuye ivel kumasaka amancane iyela amakhulu. Hlela imithi efakiwe. Nikeza umsebenzi wezandla esibayeni sezitshalo. Hlanganisa isihlabathi nomkhaba. Ukulawula utshani ngamandla nangamakhemikhali. Faka amanzi kumatreyi nemithi. Siza ekubaleni izinto. Beka amaphawu izitshalo ngendlela efanele. Hlola izitshalo nemithi ukuthi inawo yini izilwane ezibangelwa ukugulela nokutheleleka. Siza abathengi abeza ukuthenga imithi. Yiba nomsebenzi wemithi enikiweyo. Bika noma ikuphi ukonakala esibayeni sezitshalo kumkhulu wabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa, ukuhlanzwa kanye nokuqashelwa okuyisisekelo kwethrektha nedampa. Hambisa isihlabathi nomkhaba etafulezini noma emabhedi. Hambisa amatreyi, amakheyisi kanye nemithi. Gcina izinto zokusebenza namashini mahlanzekile emva kokusetshenziswa.

xh.title: Umgcini wezithuba: Ukuzalisa okuLuhlaza nokuZalisa iimPilo ekuZalweni
xh.summary: Isebe lezoLwathi, ezoLwandle nezeMihlaka lifuna umgcini wezithuba eNtshona Kolone ukuba agcine izithuba, izityalo neensimi; Kufuneka ibekho isebe lesi-9 kwaye akukho mfundo yangaphambili efunwayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-9 (inqanaba le-NQF 1) esilinganayo. Akukho nako emsebenzini efunwayo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezoLwathi kazwelonke u-84 ka-1998, uMthetho weVeld, weMilio wezoLwathi u-101 ka-1998 (NVFFA) noMthetho weMpilo yoMsebenzi nokuKhuseleka. Amakhono ekusombulula iingxaki, amakhono abantu. Amakhono amabalwe ahle aphakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza wedwa nakwindyindi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo enkulu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuwusombulula umahluko.
xh.duties: Kwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo malunga nezithuba, ukufaka amanzi izityalo neensimi. Kwenza ukuqhotsa usolwa nolawulo losolwa. Ukusika kunceda iityholo ezintsundu nezityalo nokuzisika, ukusika ngokwenza, ukubeka imbewu nokuvelisa izityalo. Ukusika insimi, ukulahla iphefumlo organic, ukutsaba amacubungula, ukukhahlela nokusela ukutshaya amacubungula, ukugcina amacubungula neendawo zeebhole. Kwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo ngokubanzi malunga nencumbo yokusekela. Ukuqokelela imbewu. Ukucotha imbewu. Ukupreparatha imbewu ngaphambi kokutyala. Ukuqokelela iitreyi zembewu. Ukuhlaba imbewu. Ukulungiselela nokuhlaba iindawu zokuhlaza. Qinisekisa ukutyala nokutshintshela iintyatyambo nemithi. Ukuvala iisaka zokutyala ngenhlabathi. Ukwakha indawo kwizithuba zokutshintshela. Ukutshintshela iintyatyambo ukusuka kwitreyi ukuya kwisaka. Ukutshintshela imithi ukusuka kwizakana ezincinci ukuya kwamakhulu. Ukupakisha imithi etshintsheliweyo. Ukunika imisebenzi yabantu elungele nanayiphi na imisebenzi kwivenkile yembewu. Ukudibanisa usale nomquba. Ukulawula usolwa ngesandla nakwekhemikhali. Ukuwisa amanzi iintyatyambo nakuqokelela imithi. Ukuncedisa ukubala izinto. Ukupeyinta izityalo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukutsheka iintyatyambo nezityalo malunga neento ezonakalisa izityalo neezifo. Ukuncedisa abathengi abeza ukuthenga imithi. Ukuze ubenobulumko kwizixhobo ezingeniswe. Ukuxelela iNkokeli nayiphi na imonakalo ebonakalise kwindalo yembewu. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa, ukucotha nolungiselelo loqobo lwesithuthi nakwisixhobo esithwala izinto. Ukuhambisa usale nomquba ukuya kwiitafile okanye ezithubeni. Ukuhambisa iintyatyambo, iikhrateki nokuqokelela imithi. Uku gcina izixhobo namashini acociwe emva kokusetyenziswa.

jobs.title: Casual Worker: Communication Service Agency
jobs.salary_text: Hourly rate of R156,40 for a maximum of twenty-four (24) hours per month
jobs.summary: Casual worker providing secretarial and administrative support to the Chief Director's office, requiring a diploma or degree in office management and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an appropriate National Diploma (NQF level 6) or Degree (NQF level 7) in Office management, Office Assistant, Secretarial and Administration qualification / or any other related qualification / training course as recognised by SAQA. Working outside normal office hours. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and management of all activities relating to the office of the Chief Director. The candidate will be expected to render administrative support services to the Chief Directorate. Provide secretarial support services to the manager which includes coordination of meetings for the Chief Directorate, compile the agenda in consultation with the Chief Director., arrange catering for the directorate’s meetings, provide accurate minute taking and timeous availability of minutes., follow up on action decision with the relevant officials. Ensure proper filing of all incoming and outgoing documents and index for each file. Scrutinize routine submissions or reports and make notes and/or recommendations for the Chief Director. Verify and submit all payment advices/orders/petty cash documents to the Chief Director for signature. Order and control stationery and office equipment. Follow- up on the information for OPMS and Risk Reports. Serve as sub-office asset holder. Follow-up with the rest of the sub office asset holders on their submissions. Arrange flight bookings and travel and subsistence Advances/ claims for the Chief Directorate. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work the manager. Manage the diary of the Chief Director. Provide receptionist support service to the manager. Management of monthly projections, finances and orders. Compile reports received from other Directorates into one reporting line with the Directive on the Professionalisation of Human Resource Management and Development in Public Service.

af.title: Kasuele Werker: Communication Service Agency
af.summary: Kasuele werker wat sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Hoofdirekteur se kantoor verskaf, met 'n diploma of graad in kantoorbestuur en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie as vereistes.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6) of Graad (NQF vlak 7) in Kantoorbestuur, Kantoorassistent, Sekretariële en Administrasiekwalifikasie beskik, of enige ander verwante kwalifikasie / opleidingskursus soos deur SAQA erken. Werk buite gewone kantoorure. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beplanning en bestuur van alle aktiwiteite wat verband hou met die kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur. Die kandidaat sal verwag word om administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Hoofdirektoraat te lewer. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan die bestuurder wat die koördinering van vergaderings vir die Hoofdirektoraat insluit, stel die agenda in oorleg met die Hoofdirekteur op., reël spyseniering vir die direktoraat se vergaderings, verskaf akkurate notule en die tydige beskikbaarheid daarvan., volg op oor aksiebesluite met die betrokke amptenare. Verseker behoorlike lêer van alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente en 'n indeks vir elke lêer. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings of verslae en maak notas en/of aanbevelings vir die Hoofdirekteur. Verifieer en dien alle betalingskennisgewings/bestellings/kleinkontantdokumente by die Hoofdirekteur vir handtekening in. Bestel en beheer stasieer en kantooruitrusting. Volg inligting vir OPMS- en Risikoverslae op. Tree op as sub-kantoor batehouer. Volg met die res van die sub-kantoor batehouers op oor hul voorleggings. Reël vlugbesprekings en reis- en verblyfsvoorskotte/-eise vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings te tref. Verwerk die reis- en verblyfseise vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die bestuurder. Bestuur die dagboek van die Hoofdirekteur. Verskaf ontvangsondersteuningsdienste aan die bestuurder. Bestuur van maandelikse projeksies, finansies en bestellings. Stel verslae wat van ander Direktorate ontvang is, saam tot een verslagdoeningslyn ooreenkomstig die Direktief oor die Professionalisering van Menslikehulpbronbestuur en -ontwikkeling in die Openbare Diens.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wesikhashana: Communication Service Agency
zu.summary: Umsebenzi wesikhashana onikeza inkxaso yobumfihlo kanye nolawulo kofiso likaChief Director, ofuna idiploma noma idigri ekulawulweni kofiso kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesiqu seNational Diploma (NQF level 6) noma iDegree (NQF level 7) ekulawulweni kofiso, Office Assistant, Secretarial and Administration qualification / noma noma yisiphi esinye isiqu esihlobene / ikhosi yesikolo njengoba ivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Ukusebenza ngaphandle kohora lwejovu evamile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethwe uzobe nesibopho sokuhlela nokuphatha konke okusemandleni okuhlobene nofiso likaChief Director. Umuntu okhethwe uzotenzelwa ukunikeza izinkonzo zokwesekwa kolawulo kuChief Directorate. Nikeza izinkonzo zokwesekwa ngobumfihlo kumphathi okuhlanganisa nokuqondisa izinhlanganella zeChief Directorate, hlela ihlela lokhonso ngokuubonisana neChief Director., hlela ukudla kwabezinhlangano zedirectorate, nikeza ukuthatha amaminithi ngokuqinisekile nokuthi amaminithi abe khona ngasesikhathini., landela izinqumo ezithathwe kanye nezikhulu ezihlobene. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okulungile kwawo wonke amadokhumenti angena naphuma kanye nenefani yalowo munye umhlahlandlela. Hlola okuwukuhamba njalo okunikelwayo noma imibiko wenze amanothi futhi/noma iziphakamiso zoChief Director. Qinisekisa futhi unikele wonke amaziso okukhokha/odiyo/amadokhumenti wepetty cash kuChief Director ukuba asigcabe. Oda futhi ulawule izinto zokubhala namashemu wofiso. Landela ulwazi lwe-OPMS namabhiko e-Risk Reports. Yiba ngumnikazi wesiza sezimpahla esincane. Landela labo bangela abanye abanikazi bezimpahla besiza esincane ngeminikelo yabo. Hlela ukubhukwa kwamabhuluki kanye nezinhlahla zokuhamba nokuhlala kanye nezimali eziyisihlengo / izimangalo zeChief Directorate. Xhumana namabhuloki okuhamba ukwenza izinhlela zokuhamba. Thatha izimangalo zokuhamba nokuhlala zenzele iyunithi. Thatha yonke imali ekhokhelwayo evela kumisebenzi womphathi. Lawula ikhenda likaChief Director. Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi ongamukele ibhizinisi kumphathi. Ukuphatha ukwaziswa kwenyanga zonke, izimali kanye nama-odi. Qoqa imibiko etholwe kwezinye iziDirectorate ibe yilayini elilodwa lokubika ne-Directive on the Professionalisation of Human Resource Management and Development in Public Service.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wethuba: Isebe Lenkonzo Yonxibelelwano
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wethuba onika inkxaso yobungazili kunye nolawulo kwiofisi yoMlawuli oyiNtloko, ofuna idiploma okanye idigrhi ekulawulweni kweofisi kunye nelayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
xh.requirements: Abafakiselwa kufuneka babe ne-Diploma Yesizwe efanelekileyo (NQF level 6) okanye i-Degree (NQF level 7) ekulawulweni kweofisi, i-Office Assistant, isiqu sobuNobhalali nakulawulo / okanye nalomnye wuphi na umzi-mfuno wokuqeqesha oqwalaselwa yi-SAQA. Ukusebenza ngaphandle kweeyure eziqhelekileyo ziofisi. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
xh.duties: Umamkeli ongapheleleyo uza kuba nyule ekuyilenzeni nakulawuleni yonke imisebenzi enxulumene nofisi yoMlawuli oyiNtloko. Umamkeli uza kulindeleke ukunikela iinkonzo zenkxaso yolawulo kuBumba boMlawuli. Ukunika iinkonzo zenkxaso yobungazili kumlawuli eziquka ukulungisa indlela yemiqunguphelwe kwiBumba boMlawuli, ukuqulunqa inqubomgomo ngokubonisana noMlawuli oyiNtloko., ukulungela ukutya kwemiqunguphelwe yesebe, ukunika ukuthatha amagama ngokuchanekileyo nokufumaneka kwawo ngexesha elifanelekileyo., ukulandela izigqibo zemisebenzi nabasebenzi abafanelekileyo. Kuqinisekiswa ukugcina ngokuchanekileyo kwayo yonke imibhalo engenayo nethunyelwayo kunye noluhlu lwe-fayile ngamanye. Ukuphonononga iinkqubo zomhla lwemisebenzi okanye iingxelo zenziwa izalathiso okanye izindululo zoMlawuli oyiNtloko. Ukujonga kunye nokuthumela yonke imiyalezo yokuhlawula/ioda/imbali zemali encinci kuMlawuli oyiNtloko ukusayina. I-oda nolawulo lwesithathi sesikolo kunye nempahla yofisi. Ukulandela ulwazi malunga ne-OPMS kunye neeNgxelo zoMngcipheko. Ukukhonza njengomnyathi wempahla yesebe. Ukulandela kumanye abanembali bempahla yesebe ngemibhalo yabo. Ukulungela ukubhuka iindiza kunye noRhwebo loLwandle/Phakathi nokuHamba. Ukuxhumana nama-ajentsi wohambo lwelo ndlela ukulungelelisa iindlela zohambo. Ukucoca iinxowa zokuHamba nokuQhashumba zereyithile. Ukucoca yonke i-invoisi evela kumsebenzi womlawuli. Ukulawula i-dary yoMlawuli oyiNtloko. Ukunika inkonzo yobulumko bomamkeli kumlawuli. Ukulawula ipekhe malunga nayo yonke imali yamanyanga, ezimalini nakuloda. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo ezifunyanwe kwezinye iisebe zabala kwendlela enye yokubika ngokuQondisayo koBuchule bokuziphatha koLuntu kuLawulo nakuPhuhliswa kwiNkonzo kaRhuqo.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Business Development
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Business Development at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring a degree and five years' senior management experience in operations or manufacturing.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus A Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Engineering /Commerce/ Operations Management / Business Management / Inventory Management. A minimum of 5 years’ proven experience in an Operations / Manufacturing environment at a Senior Management Level (13). Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of the PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations and prescripts, cost accounting and business practices. Knowledge of business development practices. Knowledge of public service financial legislative frameworks. Knowledge of Corporate Governance (King Report). Travelling may be required. Valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Lead, oversee and manage printing orders and production stock control functions: Oversee the management of estimated production orders. Oversee the controlling and directing of the flow of orders from inception to delivery. Ensure strategic effective management of raw material and production stock management. Oversee and ensure the efficient management of the dispatching of finished goods. Oversee and manage the printed stock and sales: Ensure introduction of new products and services to improve existing relationships. Uphold regular engagements with internal and external contacts. Manage the identification of opportunities for distribution channels, services, and campaigns that will result in sales. Lead and oversee the strategic management of Key Accounts: Oversee the administration of Key Accounts in the National Departments and SOE/C market. Oversee the management of Key Accounts in the SADC Region. Ensuring the effective management of the safe storage and distribution/ selling of face value products. Overseeing the efficient managing of excellent customer care services. Oversee the management of storage, control and sale of stationery items to government institutions: Oversee the monitoring and controlling of the receipt, storage, and distribution of stationery stock. Ensure the safekeeping and proper inventory management of stationery items. Ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and inventory management standards. Ensure the preparation and submit inventory, sales, and stock performance reports. Address customer enquiries and resolve stationery supply related issues. Implement measures to improve storage efficiency, stock control, and customer service. Manage the Chief Directorate: Interpret the Branch’s business strategy, with special reference to how priority projects should be resourced and delivered in respect of the Chief Directorate. Lead the Chief Directorate in relation to the implementation of policy priorities. Develop systems and procedures to enable delivery of services by the Directorates. Take responsibility for the delivery of strategic outcomes as outlined in the estimates of national expenditure. Ensure the management and development of human resources.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsontwikkeling
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsontwikkeling by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, wat 'n graad en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring op senior vlak in bedrywighede of vervaardiging vereis.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 plus A Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Engineering /Commerce/ Operations Management / Business Management / Inventory Management. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se bewese ervaring in 'n Bedrywings-/Vervaardigingsomgewing op 'n Senior Bestuursvlak (13). Kennis van die Regulerende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens. Kennis van die PFMA, Finansiële Bestuur, Nasionale Tesourie Regulasies en voorskrifte, kosteboekhouding en besigheidspraktyke. Kennis van besigheidsontwikkelingspraktyke. Kennis van finansiële wetgewende raamwerke van die openbare diens. Kennis van Korporatiewe Bestuur (King-verslag). Reis mag vereis word. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Lei, hou toesig oor en bestuur drukbestellings en produksievoorraadbeheerfunksies: Hou toesig oor die bestuur van geraamde produksiebestellings. Hou toesig oor die beheer en rigting van die vloei van bestellings vanaf aanvang tot aflewering. Verseker strategiese effektiewe bestuur van grondstowwe en produksievoorraadbestuur. Hou toesig oor en verseker die doeltreffende bestuur van die versending van voltooide goedere. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die gedrukte voorraad en verkope: Verseker die bekendstelling van nuwe produkte en dienste om bestaande verhoudings te verbeter. Handhaaf gereelde kontak met interne en eksterne kontakte. Bestuur die identifisering van geleenthede vir verspreidingskanale, dienste en veldtogte wat tot verkope sal lei. Lei en hou toesig oor die strategiese bestuur van Sleutelrekeninge: Hou toesig oor die administrasie van Sleutelrekeninge in die Nasionale Departments en SOE/C mark. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van Sleutelrekeninge in die SADC-streek. Verseker die effektiewe bestuur van die veilige berging en verspreiding/verkoping van nominalewaarde-produkte. Hou toesig oor die doeltreffende bestuur van uitstekende kliersorgdienste. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van berging, beheer en verkoop van skryfbehoeftes aan regeringsinstellings: Hou toesig oor die monitering en beheer van die ontvangs, berging en verspreiding van skryfbehoeftes-voorraad. Verseker die veilige bewaring en behoorlike voorraadbestuur van skryfbehoeftes. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike beleide, prosedures en voorraadbestuursstandaarde. Verseker die voorbereiding en indiening van voorraad-, verkope- en voorraadprestasieverslae. Hanteer klien-navrae en los probleme rakende die voorsiening van skryfbehoeftes op. Implementeer maatreëls om bergingsdoeltreffendheid, voorraadbeheer en klierservice te verbeter. Bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat: Interpretieer die besigheidsstrategie van die Tak, met spesifieke verwysing na hoe prioriteitsprojekte gekapseël en gelewer moet word ten opsigte van die Hoofdirektoraat. Lei die Hoofdirektoraat met betrekking tot die implementering van beleidsprioriteite. Ontwikkel stelsels en prosedures om die lewering van dienste deur die Direktorate moontlik te maak. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir die lewering van strategiese uitkomste soos uiteengesit in die raming van nasionale besteding. Verseker die bestuur en ontwikkeling van menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umongameli Ohamba Phambili: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezabhizinisi
zu.summary: Umongameli Ohamba Phambili: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezabhizinisi e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, ofuna idigri nabezingu eminyakeni emihlanu yohlelo oluphezulu lokuphatha emsebenzini wokusebenza noma ukukhiqiza.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree (elingana nenani le-NQF level 7 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Engineering /Commerce/ Operations Management / Business Management / Inventory Management. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations and prescripts, cost accounting and business practices. Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwezabhizinisi. Ulwazi ngezendlulelo zomthetho zezimali zesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-Corporate Governance (King Report). Kungadingeka ukuhamba. Ilelisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
zu.duties: Qondisa, bheka phambili uphathe imiyalelo yokushicilela kanye nemisebenzi yokulawula isitokhwe sokukhiqiza: Bheka phambili ukuphatwa kwemiyalelo yokukhiqiza ecalculated. Bheka phambili ukulawulaokuquumba nemiyalelo kusukela ekuqalweni kuze kufike ekulethweni. Qinisekisa ukuphatwa okuyisimo-msebenzi ngokuhlakanipha kwemvelakuhle nokuphatwa kwesitokhwe sokukhiqiza. Bheka phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuphatwa ngempumelelo kokuthunyelwa kwemvelakuhle eqedileyo. Bheka phambili uphathe isitokhwe esishicilelwe kanye nentengiso: Qinisekisa ukuziswa kwezimvelakuhle nezinsiza ezintsha ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obukhona. Gcina izingxoxo ezivamile nabathintana nabo baphakathi naphandle. Phatha ukubona ithuba leziteshisi zokuhambisa, izinsiza, nakamaphayimende ezozoholela entengisweni. Qondisa bheka phambili ukuphatwa okuyisimo-msebenzi ngokuhlakanipha kweziKhumo Eziyinhloko: Bheka phambili ukuphatwa kweziKhumo Eziyinhloko kuma-National Departments nakumakkethi we-SOE/C. Bheka phambili ukuphatwa kweziKhumo Eziyinhloko esifundeni i-SADC. Qinisekisa ukuphatwa okuyisimo-msebenzi kwesigcinhishaja esikhuselekile nokuhambisa/ukuthengisa kwemvelakuhle ebenani elibonakalayo. Bheka phambili ukuphatwa ngempumelelo kwezinsiza ezingcono zomsindo womthengi. Bheka phambili ukuphatwa kwesigcinhishaja, ukulawula nokuthengiswa kwezimpahla zesikhungo kuzakhiwo zahuluminti: Bheka phambili ulawule ukwamukelwa, ukugcinwa, nokuhambiswa kwesitokhwe sezimpahla zokubhala. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okukhuselekile nokuphatwa okufanele kwesitokhwe sezimpahla zokubhala. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana namapulisi, izinqubo, kanye nezilinganiso zokulawula isitokhwe ezifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa nokuhambiswa kwemibiko yesitokhwe, yentengiso, kanye nokusebenza kwesitokhwe. Phendula imibuzo yomthengi uxazule izinkinga ezihlobene nokunikezwa kwezimpahla zokubhala. Faka izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwesigcinhishaja, ukulawula isitokhwe, kanye nesevisi yomthengi. Phatha iNkululeko Yolawulo: Humusha isimo-msebenzi sabhizinisi se-Branch, ngekukhombisa ukuthi amaphayimende abalulekileyo kufanele anikezwe izinsiza anikezwe kanjani ku-INkululeko Yolawulo. Qondisa iNkululeko Yolawulo ngokuqhathaniswa nokuqashwa kwabaphambili bepalamente. Yakha izimiso kanye nezinqubo ukuze kuqeduselwe ukulethwa kwezinsiza yiNkululeko Yolawulo. Thatha inkinga yokuletha iziphumelelo zokuqhakanjana njengoba kushiwo kwilinganiselo lokuchithwa kwesizwe. Qinisekisa ukuphatwa nokuthuthukiswa kwemvelakuhle yabantu.

xh.title: Um lawuli Omkhulu: Ukuphuhliswa kweShishini
xh.summary: Um lawuli Omkhulu: Ukuphuhliswa kweShishini e Government Printing Works e Pretoria, kufuneka abe n degree kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ebhalweni eliphakamileyo kumsebenzi okuyiyo noma ekwenziweni kwento.
xh.requirements: i Grade 12 kwakhona ne Degree (elingana n NQF level 7 njengokuqatshelwa yi SAQA) kwi Engineering /Commerce/ Operations Management / Business Management / Inventory Management. Amava aboniswayo angaphaya kweminyaka 5 kwindawo y Operations / Manufacturing kwinqanaba le Senior Management Level (13). Ulwazi nge Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi nge PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations namagqabaza, ukubala iindleko kunye nemisebenzi yeshishini. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuphuhliswa kweshishini. Ulwazi ngeemithetho ezimalini zolonikezelo lwaseburhuluneni. Ulwazi nge Corporate Governance (King Report). Kusenokufuneka kuhambahambe. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qhuba, hlola ulawule iodolo zoshicilelo kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo lwebhodi yemveliso: Hlola ulawulo leodolo ezibaliweyo zemveliso. Hlola ulawulo nokulawula ukujikeleza kweodolo ukusuka ekuqalweni de kufikele ekuthunyelweni. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusemgangathweni olulungele imveliso yamafutha nobushushu kunye nolawulo lwebhodi yemveliso. Hlola uqinisekise ulawulo olulungele ukuvelisa ukuhamba kwemveliso egqityiweyo. Hlola ulawule ibhodi yoshicilelo ethengisiwayo: Qinisekisa ukuziswa kweemveliso ezitsha neenkonzo ukuphucula ubudlelwane obukhoyo. GCina iintsebenziswana ezizezithi zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula ukuchonga ithuba lemikhobo yokuhambisa, iinkonzo, namanqaku othengiso aza kuvelisa urhwebo. Qhuda uhlule ulawulo olusesigqikweni se Key Accounts: Hlola ulawulo lwe Key Accounts kwi National Departments nakwisimophononco sika SOE/C. Hlola ulawulo lwe Key Accounts kummandla we SADC Region. Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungele ulondolazo nokuqhuba ngokhuselekileyo /ukuthengisa iimveliso ezixabisa ubuso. Ukuphatha ngokulungele ulawulo olugqithisileyo lweenkonzo zokukhathalela abathengi. Hlola ulawulo lwegumbi logcino, ulawulo nokuthengiswa kwezixhobo zokubhala kubuchule karhulumente: Hlola uqonde ulawulo lokuamkela, ukulondoloza, nokusatyalaliswa kwesitoko sezixhobo zokubhala. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko nolawulo olulungileyo lwesitoko sezixhobo zokubhala. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana neengqikhomba ezifanelekileyo, iindlela, kunye namagqabaza yolawulo lwebhodi. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo kwaye uthumele iimveliso zabalo ngebhodi, othengiso, kunye nemisebenzi. Phendula imibuzo yabathengi kwaye uxazule iingxaki ezinxulumene noku nexhwayo sezixhobo zokubhala. Zisa iindlela zokuphucula ukusebenza kwegumbi logcino, ulawulo lwebhodi, nkonzo yabathengi. Lawula i Chief Directorate: Tshata isu leshishini le Branch, ukuba kukhankanywe ngokukodwa indlela amaphojekothi abalulekileyo abefanele ukuba anikelwe imisebenzi kwaye anyuliswe ngokusesingeniso le Chief Directorate. Qhuda i Chief Directorate malunga nokuziswa kwamabala abalulekileyo emthethweni. Phepha izixhobo nendlela zokuze kwenzeke ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ngawo o Directorates. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikeni kwemigaqo ephambili njengoko kuchaziwe kwii-estimates zokusebenzisa koburhulumente. Qinisekisa ulawulo noluzoko lwphepha lochongo lwabantu.

jobs.title: Director: Strategic Sourcing and Asset Management
jobs.summary: Director role at Government Printing Works in Pretoria overseeing strategic sourcing, procurement services and asset management, requiring a degree and five years' senior SCM experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Supply Chain/ Purchasing/ Logistics Management/ Finance/ Public Management/ Public Administration. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle/senior level (Deputy Director) in a Supply Chain Management environment. CIPS certificate will be an added advantage. Valid Driver’s license. Working knowledge of the tender procedures. Added advantage: Estimating of printing work, proven knowledge of printing processes, equipment and paper, planning (estimating) and/or scheduling. Other: Willingness to travel. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of the Public Service Act. Knowledge of the PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations, prescripts, GRAP, and business practices. Knowledge of financial management, government budgeting processes, management accounting, revenue management, risk management, auditing, and forensic accounting. Knowledge of public service/ supply chain/ financial legislative frameworks. Knowledge of Corporate Governance (King Report).
jobs.duties: Manage sourcing and procurement services in the Department: Manage the accuracy, speed and efficiency in the procurement. Ensure that value for money, open and effective completion, ethics and fair dealing is adhered to. Ensure openness in the procurement process. Ensure continuous improvement in the efficiency of internal processes and systems. Ensure that adequate and timely information is provided to suppliers to enable them to participate in the procurement process. Ensure compliance with legislation in the submission. Ensure monitoring and full implementation of the approved procurement plan. Manage assets acquisition and disposal: Ensure the development of asset management and inventory control plans and the implementation thereof. Ensure the development, implementation and enforcement of proper asset managing control measures. Manage and monitor the effective and efficient physical verification of tangible and intangible assets. Manage and monitor the disposal of assets in line with all relative legislation regulations, prescripts and GPW policies and procedures. Coordinate the disposal committee, manage, investigate and report on all losses of assets. Ensure the preparation of complete and accurate financial disclosures in line with GRAP requirements. Manage inventory control services: Manage the development and enforcement of counting methodology. Daily and periodic counts are conducted and monitored. Effective reconciliation of monthly reports. Oversee and manage the developing, implementing of inventory control and asset management plans, enforce proper inventory and asset control measures. Oversee the performing of inventory control functions. Ensure that the monthly reconciliation to the general ledger is effectively managed: Manage the monthly and annual fixed asset reconciliation process. Resolve reconciliation discrepancies and make corrections. Certify the correction journal and review update of fixed asset register. Ensure the running of monthly depreciation on AX. Ensure the development of standard operating procedures and methodologies. Ensure that correct processes are implemented and followed to avoid audit findings. Manage financial compliance and prevent financial misconduct: Implement and monitor internal controls to prevent unauthorised, irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure. Ensure compliance with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Supply Chain Management prescripts, and organisational policies. Monitor financial transactions and expenditure to identify potential instances of financial misconduct and non-compliance. Manage the Directorate: Develop the operational plan for the Directorate and ensure its implementation. Allocate and manage resources at functional levels to ensure the delivery on set targets for the Directorate. Formulate, identify Policy shortfalls and necessary amendments. Conduct financial planning and account for allocated budget. Ensure adherence to policy and statutory directives relevant to the functional terrain of the Directorate. Monitor, evaluate and report on the performance of the directorate.

af.title: Direkteur: Strategiese Sourcing en Batebestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria wat toezig hou oor strategiese sourcing, verkrygingsdienste en batebestuur, waarvoor 'n graad en vyf jaar se senior SCM-ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Graad (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Toeskakelingsketting/Inkoping/Logistieke Bestuur/Finansies/Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorvlak (Adjunkdirekteur) in 'n Supply Chain Management-omgewing. SIPS-sertifikaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werkende kennis van die tenderprosedures. Bykomende voordeel: Skatting van drukwerk, bewese kennis van drukprosesse, toerusting en papier, beplanning (skatting) en/of skedulering. Ander: Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Kennis van die Regulerende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens. Kennis van die Openbare Dienswet. Kennis van die PFMA, Finansiële Bestuur, Nasionale Skatkisteregelings, voorskrifte, GRAP, en besigheidspraktyke. Kennis van finansiële bestuur, regeringsbegrotingsprosesse, bestuursrekeningkunde, inkomste bestuur, risikobestuur, ouditering, en forensiese rekeningkunde. Kennis van openbare diens/voorsieningsketting/finansiële wetgewende raamwerke. Kennis van Korporatiewe Bestuur (King-verslag).
af.duties: Bestuur sourcing- en verkrygingsdienste in die departement: Bestuur die akkuraatheid, spoed en doeltreffendheid in verkryging. Verseker dat waarde vir geld, oop en doeltreffende voltooiing, etiek en billike hantering nagekom word. Verseker openheid in die verkrygingsproses. Verseker deurlopende verbetering in die doeltreffendheid van interne prosesse en stelsels. Verseker dat voldoende en tydige inligting aan verskaffers verskaf word om hulle in staat te stel om aan die verkrygingsproses deel te neem. Verseker nakoming van wetgewing in die voorlegging. Verseker monitering en volledige implementering van die goedgekeurde verkrygingsplan. Bestuur bateverkryging en -verwydering: Verseker die ontwikkeling van batebestuurs- en voorraadbeheerplanne en die implementering daarvan. Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en afdwinging van behoorlike batebestuursbeheermaatreëls. Bestuur en monitor die effektiewe en doeltreffende fisiese verifikasiëring van tasbare en ontasbare bates. Bestuur en monitor die verwydering van bates in ooreenstemming met alle toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies, voorskrifte en GPW-beleide en prosedures. Koördineer die verwyderingskomitee, bestuur, ondersoek en rapporteer oor alle verliese van bates. Verseker die voorbereiding van volledige en akkurate finansiële openbaarmakings in ooreenstemming met GRAP-vereistes. Bestuur voorraadbeheerdienste: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en afdwinging van telmetodologie. Daaglikse en periodieke tellings word uitgevoer en gemonitor. Effektiewe rekonsiliasie van maandelikse verslae. Oorsien en bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van voorraadbeheer- en batebestuursplanne, en dwing behoorlike voorraad- en batebeheermaatreëls af. Oorsien die uitvoering van voorraadbeheerfunksies. Verseker dat die maandelikse rekonsiliasie met die algemene grootboek effektief bestuur word: Bestuur die maandelikse en jaarlikse vaste bate-rekonsiliasieproses. Los rekonsiliasieafwykings op en maak regstellings. Sertifiseer die regstellingsjoernaal en hersien die bywerking van die vaste bateregister. Verseker die loop van maandelikse afskrywing op AX. Verseur die ontwikkeling van standaard bedryfsprosedures en metodes. Verseker dat korrekte prosesse geïmplementeer en gevolg word om ouditbevindings te vermy. Bestuur finansiële nakoming en voorkom finansiële wangedrag: Implementeer en monitor interne beheermaatreëls om ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, nuttelose en vermorsende besteding te voorkom. Verseker nakoming van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Supply Chain Management voorskrifte, en organisatoriese beleide. Monitor finansiële transaksies en besteding om potensiële gevalle van finansiële wangedrag en nie-nakoming te identifiseer. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Ontwikkel die operasionele plan vir die Direktoraat en verseker die implementering daarvan. Allokeer en bestuur hulpbronne op funksionele vlakke om die lewering op gestelde teikens vir die Direktoraat te verseker. Formuleer, identifiseer beleidskortkominge en nodige wysigings. Voer finansiële beplanning uit en reken vir die toegekende begroting. Verseker nakoming van beleid en statutêre riglyne wat relevant is tot die funksionele terrein van die Direktoraat. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die prestasie van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukutholwa Okuhlelekile Kwezinsiza Nokuphathwa Kwezimpahla
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria sokuhlola ukutholwa okuhlelekile kwezinsiza, izinsiza zokuthenga kanye nokuphathwa kwezimpahla, okudinga idigri kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeziphiwo ezingaphezulu kulezo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree (elingana neninga le-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Supply Chain/ Purchasing/ Logistics Management/ Finance/ Public Management/ Public Administration. Okungenani ungamuhla eminyaka engu-5 wamava enzingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu (Deputy Director) emhlabeni we-Supply Chain Management. Isitifikedi se-CIPS sizoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi lokusebenza mayelana nezinqubo zetender. Inzuzo eyengeziwe: Ukulinganisa umsebenzi wokushicilela, ulwazi oluvelele ngokushicilela izinqubo, izinsiza nephepha, ukweluleka (ukulinganisa) kanye/noma ukuphehla. Okunye: Ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Ulwazi ngokusimama kwesakhiwo sokulawula kwesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, ukuphathwa kwezimali, Imitsetho ye-National Treasury, imibhalo, i-GRAP, kanye nezindlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimali, izinqubo zokwenza izabelo kahulumeni, ukubala imali yokuphathwa, ukuphathwa kwemali engenayo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukuhlolwa kwezimali, kanye nokubala imali yokuphenya. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo somthetho sesevisi yomphakathi/ isinto yohwebo/ yezimali. Ulwazi nge-Corporate Governance (King Report).
zu.duties: Phatha ukutholwa kanye nezinsiza zokuthenga e-Umnyangweni: Phatha ukunemba, isivinini kanye nekusasa ekuthengeni. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani lemali, ukwedlula okuvulekile nokuqinisekile, izimilo nokuhweba ngokubulungisa kuhlonishwa. Qinisekisa ukuvuleka kwesinqubo yokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo ekusaseni kwezinqubo nezinhlelo zangaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwethulwa ulwazi olwanele ngesikhathi esifanele kubanikezeli ukubavumela ukuthi bathathe inxaxhebe esinqubeni sokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho ekuhlolweni. Qinisekisa ukuqapha nokuphothula ukusetshenziswa kwenkqubo yokuthenga eyamukelekile. Phatha ukutholwa nokulahleka kwezimpahla: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha izimpahla nokulawula izinto ezisezandleni kanye nokuzisetshenziswa. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokuphoqelela kwezinyathelo zokulawula ezifanele zokuphatha izimpahla. Phatha futhi uqaphe ukuvivinywa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwezimpahla ezibonakalayo nezingeke zibonakale. Phatha futhi uqaphe ukulahleka kwezimpahla ngokuvumelana namawonke umthetho ohlobene, imithetho, imibhalo kanye nemigomo nezinqubo ze-GPW. Hlanganisa ikomidi yokulahleka izimpahla, phatha, phenya kanye nokubika ngawonke amashabiwe ezimpahla. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwezinkomba zezimali ezigcwele futhi ezinembile ngokuvumelana nezidingo ze-GRAP. Phatha izinsiza zokulawula izinto ezisezandleni: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphoqelelwa kwendlela yokubala. Ukubala nsuku zonke nangamazinga ahlukene kwenziwa futhi kuqashelwe. Ukulinganisa okusebenzayo kwezindawo zansuku zonke zenyanga. Buka futhi uphathe ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokulawula izinto ezisezandleni kanye nokuphathwa kwezimpahla, phoqelela izinyathelo ezifanele zokulawula izinto ezisezandleni nezimpahla. Buka ukwenziwa kwezinsiza zokulawula izinto ezisezandleni. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulinganiswa kwansuku zonke kwenyanga kuya ohwini jikelele kuphathwa ngempumelelo: Phatha inqubo yokulinganisa izimpahla ezingashintshi nsuku zonke nangonyaka zenyanga. Xinisa iziphazamisi zokulinganisa futhi ulungise. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa kwejanela lokulungisa futhi ubuyekeze ukubuyekezwa kohlu lwamafayela wezimpahla ezingashintshi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kokuncipha kwenyanga kwi-AX. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo namazinga okusebenza ajwayelekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi zisetshenziswa futhi zilandwa izinqubo ezifanele ukuze kugwamwe iziphumelo zokuhoLola. Phatha ukuthobela imithetho yezimali futhi uvimbele ukwenza okungalungile ngemali: Setsha futhi uqaphe izilawuli zangaphakathi ukuvimbele ukusetshenziswa okungagunyaziwe, okungalungile, okungaluboni qho kanye nokuphathelwa kabi nemali. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho ye-Treasury, imibhalo ye-Supply Chain Management, kanye nemigab yenhlangano. Qapha imikhuba yezimali nokusetshenziswa kwemali ukuze kutholwe izimo ezingaba khona zokwenza okungalungile ngemali nokungathobeli umthetho. Phatha i-Directorate: Thuthukisa inqubo yokuqasha i-Directorate futhi qinisekisa ukuzisetshenziswa kwayo. Hlela futhi uphathe izinsiza emazingeni abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiselwe ukufeza amaphakhi abekiwe we-Directorate. Hlela, khomba iziphelo zemigab kanye nokulungiswa okudingekayo. Yenza ukweluleka kwezimali futhi uzibale ngesabelo esinikiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigab kanye nemiyalo yomthetho ehlobene nendawo yabasebenzi ye-Directorate. Qapha, hlola futhi ube ngemidlalo yokuphumelela kwe-Directorate.

xh.title: Umphathi:okuKhetha nokuQondisa iMfuno kunye noLawulo lwempahla
xh.summary: Inkundla yomsebenzi womphathi kwiGovernment Printing Works ePretoria ejonge ukukhetha nokuqondisa imfuno, iinkonzo zokuthengisa nokufumana impahla, kwaye kufuneka idanga kunye neminye emihlanu yamava aphakamileyo kwindima yeSCM.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ekunye neDegree (elinganayo neNQF level 7 njengokuqatyiwe yiSAQA) kwiSupply Chain/Purchasing/Logistics Management/Finance/Public Management/Public Administration. Okungqingmgangatho wamava eminye emi-5 kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu (Deputy Director) kwindawo yeSupply Chain Management. Isatifikethi seCIPS siya kuba lusizo. iDriver's license esebenzayo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lweenkqubo zethenda. Enye iyonke: ulwazi lokulinganisa umsebenzi woshicilelo, ulwazi oluchaziweyo lweenkqubo zoshicilelo, izixhobo nephepha, ukuqamba iindlela (ukulinganisa) kwaye/nokumisela isikhathi. Okunye: ukulungelelana ukuhamba. Ulwazi lwePublic Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi lwePublic Service Act. Ulwazi lwePFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations, imigqatho, iGRAP, nendlela zokusetyenziswa kwoshishino. Ulwazi lolawulo lwemali, iinkqubo zokubhalisa amabhetsho karhulumente, i-management accounting, ulawulo lwentlawulo, ulawulo loyingozi, ukuhlola, kwaye i-forensic accounting. Ulwazi lwemigaqo-ngurhulumente/supply chain/iinkqubo zomthetho zemali. Ulwazi lweCorporate Governance (King Report).
xh.duties: Lawula ukukhetha nokuthenga iinkonzo kwiSebe: Lawula ukuqiniseka, isantya nembaco ekuthengiseni. Qinisekisa ukuba ixabiso lemali, ukhuphelo oluvulekileyo nolusebenzayo, i-ethics nokusingathwa ngokuchanekileyo kugcinwe. Qinisekisa ukuvuleka kwenkqubo yokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuphuculwa ngokuqhutywa kwemigaqo yangaphakathi nteenkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba inani elilingene nolungele ighleni lolwazi lunikelwa kubathengisi ukubenza bakwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kwenkqubo yokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nomthetho kungeniselo. Qinisekisa ulawulo nokuvisisisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo yokuthenga evunyiweyo. Lawula ukufumana nokulahla impahla: Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zolawulo lwempahla nokulawula iimpahla ezikwikhomityhini kwaye zisebenze. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenza nokugcinwa kweenkqubo ezichanekileyo zolawulo lwempahla. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuqinisekiswa ngokubanzi nangokusebenzayo impahla ethintekayo kunye nengathintekiyo. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukulahwa kwempahla ngokuvumelana nayo yonke imithetho, iimigaqo, imigqatho neenkqabo ze-GPW. Lungisanisa iqumrhu lokulahla, lawula, uphando kunye nokubika ngemiba yonke edezwa impahla. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kolwazi olugqibele lwezimali ngokuvumelana neenfuno zeGRAP. Lawula iinkonzo zolawulo lweempahla: Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokugcinwa kweenkqubo zokubala. Ukubala ngemihla ngemihla nangamaxesha athile kwenziwa kwaye kulawulwe. Uxolo olusebenzayo lweengxelo zenyanga. Qonda kwaye ulawule ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenza kweenkqubo zolawulo lweempahla, kwaye ugcine iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zolawulo. Qonda ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lweempahla. Qinisekisa ukuba uxolo lwenyanga kwijenarale ledger lulawulwa ngokusebenzayo: Lawula inkqubo yokuxolisa kwezimali ezisindisiweyo zenyanga nakonyaka. Solisa ukungavumelani kokuxolisa kwaye wenze izilungiso. Qinisekisa ijenarali yokulungisa kwaye uhlola ukuvuselelwa kwerekhodi lempahla ezisindisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuqhutywa kokuhla kweemali kusukwe ngokwe-AX nyanga zonke. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zokusebenza nokunceda. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zisetynziswa kwaye zilandelwa ukugwemisa iingxaki zokuhlola. Lawula ukuvumelana kwemali kwaye athintele ukungalawuleki kwezimali: Sebenzisa kwaye ulawule ulawulo lwangaphakathi ukuthintela ukuchithwa okungagunyazisiweyo, okungalunganga, okungenasixeko nokubakho kokuchithwa. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, imigaqo yeSupply Chain Management, nameenkcqo zorhulumente. Lawula iintengiselwano zemali nachitho malunga ukuqaphela iimeko ezinokubakhona zokungalawuleki kwemali nokungalawuleki. Lawula iDirectorate: Phuhlisa icebo lokusebenza leDirectorate kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenza kuso.abelu ngokweqondo uphelo imali kwaye ulawule kumgangatho weemsebenzi ukwenzela ukwenzela ukugcinwa kwezinto ezimisiweyo zeDirectorate. Qamba, qaphela iingxaki zemigaqo nemiselwe ezifunekayo. Qamba iindlela zokulungelelanisa i-bhajethi. Qonda ukulungelelana kwemigaqo nemiselwe yomthetho exhakene nendawo yemisebenzi leDirectorate. Lawula, hlola kwaye uchaze ngemisebenzi yeDirectorate.

jobs.title: Artisan Chief Grade A: Production
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan Grade A responsible for planning and coordinating printing production, overseeing binding and packaging processes at Government Printing Works in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship in Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding or Packaging, with an appropriate Printing Trade Test Certificate. Grade 12 and computer literacy will be an advantage. A minimum of 10 years' post-apprenticeship appropriate experience in the printing industry, of which at least 5 years must be in Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding or Packaging, and at least 3 years must be proven supervisory experience. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Specialised knowledge of binding, packaging and finishing processes and equipment is required. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Planning and coordinating production to meet quality, output, and turnaround targets. Overseeing automated, semi-automated and manual finishing, binding and packaging processes. Managing examination packaging, hard-cover binding, thread-sewn books, book-cover printing, collating, numbering, pasting, drilling, and stapling. Controlling wastage, protecting confidential and security products and verifying production and packaging quantities. Monitoring quality, investigating defects, implementing corrective actions, and ensuring compliance with ISO standards where applicable. Maintaining production records, analysing productivity trends, preparing reports, and approving completed batches for dispatch. Ensuring equipment is cleaned, calibrated, maintained, and repaired through preventative maintenance and Engineering support. Managing SHERQ and OHSA compliance, risk assessments, incident investigations, PPE use, and safety talks. Supervising staff, allocating work, monitoring performance, managing attendance and discipline, and conducting performance reviews. Training and developing learners, artisans, and printer assistants. Developing policies, strategies, production procedures, continuous improvement measures, and Standard Operating Procedures. Ensure effective and efficient production and process flow in the Division. Keep up to date with new developments in the functional area, ensuring optimum production in the Division. Develop policies and strategies. Review, implement and comply with production procedures and policies as required by GPW.

af.title: Hoofvakman Graad A: Produksie
af.summary: Hoofvakman Graad A verantwoordelik vir die beplanning en koördinering van drukproduksie, asook die toezig oor inbind- en verpakingsprosesse by Government Printing Works in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap in Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding of Packaging, met 'n toepaslike Printing Trade Test-sertifikaat. Graad 12 en rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na afloop van die vakleerlingskap in die drukbedryf, waarvan ten minste 5 jaar in Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding of Packaging moet wees, en ten minste 3 jaar moet bewese toesigervaring wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsondersoek te verkry. Gespesialiseerde kennis van inbind-, verpakings- en afwerkingsprosesse en toerusting word vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Beplanning en koördinering van produksie om gehalte-, uitset- en omsetdoelwitte te bereik. Toezig hou oor outomatiese, semi-outomatiese en handmatige afwerkings-, inbind- en verpakingsprosesse. Bestuur van eksamenverpakking, hardband-inbinding, ingegroede boeke, boekomslagdrukwerk, samestelling, nommering, plak, boren en stap. Beheer van vermorsing, beskerming van vertroulike en sekuriteitsprodukte, en verifikasie van produksie- en verpakingshoeveelhede. Monitering van gehalte, ondersoek van gebreke, implementering van korrektiewe maatreëls, en verseker van nakoming van ISO-standaarde waar van toepassing. Onderhou van produksierekords, analise van produktiwiteitstendense, opstel van verslae, en goedkeuring van voltooide lotte vir versending. Verseker dat toerusting skoongemaak, gekalibreer, onderhou en herstel word deur voorkomende onderhoud en Ingenieurswessonsteun. Bestuur van SHERQ- en OHSA-nakoming, risiko-assesserings, voorvalondersoeke, gebruik van PPE en veiligheidsgesprekke. Toezig hou oor personeel, toewysing van werk, monitering van prestasie, bestuur van bywoning en dissipline, en die voer van prestasie-evaluerings. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van leerders, vakmanne en drukkerassistent. Ontwikkeling van beleide, strategieë, produksieprosedures, maatreëls vir deurlopende verbetering en Standaardbedryfsprosedures. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende produksie- en prosesvloei in die Afdeling. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die funksionele area, en verseker optimale produksie in die Afdeling. Ontwikkel beleide en strategieë. Hersien, implementeer en voldoen aan produksieprosedures en -beleide soos deur GPW vereis.

zu.title: Umnengamusi we-Craft Grade A: Ukukhiqiza
zu.summary: UMnengamusi we-Craft Grade A onob责任 bokuhlela nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kokushicilela, nokubukeza inqubo yokubopha kanye nokupakisha e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma isidingo esilinganayo kanye ne-apprenticeship eqediwe kwi-Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding noma Packaging, nge-Certificate yokuhlolwa kwe-Printing Trade efanelekile. I-Grade 12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba ngumsa. okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yokuqashwa emumva kwe-apprenticeship okuhambisana nomsebenzi odingekayo ohhotela lokushicilela, okuyinto okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 kumele ibe yi-Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding noma Packaging, futhi okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 kumele kube uhlu lokuthola ukuxhunywa abantu ukuthola isikhundla ngokulawula abasebenzi abathize. Kumele akwazi ukuthola isiqinisekiso sokulondeka esithile. Kudingwa ulwazi olukhethekile ngeqoqo le-Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding, nokupakisha kanye nalokho ekusebenzisele ukwenza umsebenzi ohhotela. I-license yokushayela evumelekile izoba ngumsa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa ukuze kuhlangatshezwe ukuthola izinto ezinhle, ukukhiqiza, nokubuyisela emuva. Ukubuka inqubo ezihle ezicace kakhulu, okuyilowo ngayiye zingamsebenzi ohhotela kakhulu, i-Craft Bookbinding, Mechanised Bookbinding nezinye izinhlelo ezincane kakhulu. Ukuphatha ukupakisha kokuhlolwa, ukubopha izinto ezinkulu, izincwadi ezibhaliwe zokuhlolwa, ukubeka izinto ezincwajini zokubopha, ukubopha amabhuku, ukuhluza inani, ukubhala izinombolo, ukulungisa izinto ezincane, ukugqoka izinto, kanye nokunamathisela. Ukulawula ukungalungile kwemvelo, ukuvikela imikhiqizo ephathwa ngasese futhi ukuyivikela kwabezokuphepha, kanye nokuthi iqiniseke ukuthi imikhiqizo nezipakishi zinamanani afanele. Ukubheka ukuthi izinto zingconywa, ukuphenya izinto ezingahambisani, ukwenza izinyathelo zokuzivikela, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemiso ye-ISO lapho kufanele khona. Ukugcina izinto zokubhala ukukhiqizwa, ukuhlaziya ukuthi kwenzeke ini ekulawulweni kokuba khona komsebenzi, ukulungisa izincazelo, kanye nokuvumela amaqembu aqediwe ukuthi athunyelwe. Ukugcina isiqiniseko sokuthi izinto zisafanele futhi zisebenze, kanye nokuzilungisa ngokusebenzisa izinkomba zokuvikela noma ngokwamaphoyisa e-Engineering. Ukuphatha ukuhambisana kwe-SHERQ ne-OHSA, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi kubheke kakhulu izinto ezingaphanga emthethweni, ukuphenya izinswakama, ukusebenzisa i-PPE, kanye nezinkulumo ngokuphepha. Ukusebenzela abantu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bayayazi imisebenzi, nokubheka ukuthi bahamba kahle na, nokugcina izinga lokuzijwayeza nokuveza imisebenzi yabo, kanye nokwenza ukuthi bazibuze ngendlela abakwenza ngayo umsebenzi wabo. Ukuqeqesha futhi akhuse abafundi, abantu abangayazi imisebenzi, nabasiziwe ngokushicilela. Ukwenza izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, inqubo yokukhiqiza, izinto zokwenza kube lula ukusebenza, kanye nezinqubomgomo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukugcina ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kuyahamba kahle futhi kungavela izinkinga kule-Division. Ukugcina ukuthi usazi okusha ekubekeni kwemisebenzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kuhamba kahle kakhulu. Ukwenza izinqubomgomo kanye nezi-Hlanganisa. Ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa futhi ukuhambisana nemisebenzi yokukhiqiza kanye nezinqubomgomo njengoba kudingwa yi-GPW.

xh.title: I-Artisan Chief Grade A: Ukuveliswa
xh.summary: I-Artisan Chief Grade A echaphazela ukucazulula nokuqamba izicwangciso zokuveliswa kweepapasho, nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokudibanisa nokuqokelela kwisebe le-Government Printing Works ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 okanye isidanga esilinganayo kwaye udle ngokugqibela ukugqitywa kolwazi lokusebenza kwi-Craft Bookbinding, i-Mechanised Bookbinding okanye i-Packaging, kunye ne-Certificate efanelekileyo ye-Printing Trade Test. I-Grade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuya kuba luncedo. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokugqiba ukugqitywa kolwazi lolusebenza kwishishini lokuqapha iipapasho, apho ubuncinane kwakumele kube ngamava afanelekileyo ubuncinane kweminyaka engama-5 kwi-Craft Bookbinding, i-Mechanised Bookbinding okanye i-Packaging, kwaye ubuncinane kweminyaka engama-3 kumele ibe ngamava abonwayo bokulawula. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isiqinisekiso sokhuseleko esilungileyo. Kufunekayo ulwazi oluthe nkqo lwemisebenzi yasezandleni nolwemizobo ephathwayo yokudibanisa, ukuqokelela, neyokugqiba. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo kuya kuba ngaphezulu ngencedo.
xh.duties: Ukucazulula nokuqamba izicwangciso zokuveliswa ukuze kufezelwe iinjongo zobungakanani bempahla, iphungo, kunye nokuqhuba ngokukhawuleza. Ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zokugqiba ezenziweyo, ezenziwa ngaphakathi ngezicwangciso, nangokuzenzela, zokudibanisa nokuqokelela. Ukulawula ukuqokelela kwamapapasho, ukudibanisa iikhave ezityhidiyo, iincwadi ezidityaniswa ngamathrendi, ukuqapha iikhave zencwadi, ukudibanisa, ukubala, ukunamathisela, ukuqhuma, kunye nokudibanisa ngamapini. Ukulawula ukuphulwa kwempahla, ukukhusela iimveliso ezingabikho mfanekiso zokhuseleko, nokuqinisekisa amanani okuveliswa nokuqokelela. Ukuqwalasela ubungakanani, ukuphonononga iziphazamiso, ukusebenzisa iinyathelo zokulungisa, kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukuzigcina ngokomthetho we-ISO apho kufanelekileyo. Ukugcina iirekhodi zokuveliswa, ukuhlaziya iindlela zentsholongwane yamava abasebenzi, ukulungiselela iingxelo, nokuvumela amaqela aqediweyo okuthunyelwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zicoceki, zilinganisiwe, zigcinwe, kwaye zilungiswe ngokwemisebenzi yokuthintela imonakalo kunye nencedoyakwakho-msebenzi we-Engineering. Ukulawula ukuzigcina ngomthetho we-SHERQ nowe-OHSA, ukuqwalasela ukulinganisela ingozi, ukuphonononga iimeko ezingalunganga, ukusebenzisa i-PPE, kunye neendaba zokhuseleko. Ukulawula abasebenzi, ukwaba umsebenzi, ukuqwalasela inkqubo yabasebenzi, ukulawula ukubakho kunye nolawulo, nokuqhuba iinqobo ezinkulu zokukhangela inkqubo yabasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuqhutywa kwabafundi, bathandathu, kunye nabancedisi bokuqapha iipapasho. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo, iindlela zokuveliswa, iinkqubo zokuveliswa, iindlela zokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, kunye neenkqubo ezingagqibekanga zokuveliswa kwezicwangciso. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuveliswa ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo kwaye kuhamba ngokukhawuleza inkqubo yoqoqosho kwi-Division. Ukugcina ulwazi olutsha malunga nokuveliswa kwendawo yesabelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuveliswa kakuhle kwi-Division. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo. Ukuphonononga, ukusebenzisa, nokuqinisekisa ukuzigcina ngokwemithetho yamava okuqapha iindaba ezithunyelwa kwaye azisetyenziswa kakuhle, nangokwemigaqo yokwenza inkqubo yamava ekhethwayo nakuqoqosho njengoko kufuneka kwaye kulindeleke ngumthetho we-GPW.

jobs.title: Artisan Chief Grade A: Equipment Maintenance
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan sought to oversee equipment maintenance and repair at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring a trade test certificate and 10 years' post-apprenticeship experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in Mechanical (trade-tested fitter). Grade 12 will be an advantage. A minimum of 10 years' post-apprenticeship appropriate experience of which 3 years should be at Artisan Foreman level. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Specialised knowledge of processes and equipment. Understanding of all relevant human resources legislative framework, regulations and prescripts. Understanding of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, Skills Development Act. Understand the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. A valid driver's license is required.
jobs.duties: Ensure efficient maintenance and repair of all GPW equipment: Ensure the accurate analysis of equipment specifications and equipment capacity data and perform mathematical calculations to determine Reliability Centered Maintenance schedules. Schedule maintenance to previously established manufacturing sequences and lead times, taking into account the Maintenance Plan, production requirements and equipment requirements. Ensure the compiling and updating of the schedule to keep track and build an accurate history of each machine. Participate in the generating of an agreed Equipment Plan for an 8-week rolling horizon, ensuring maximum machine availability. Monitor the timely issuing of the equipment maintenance plans to Factory Managers. Perform root cause analyses on machine breakdowns and report thereon. Manage and control the status of work and backlog for work order submission to work order completion. Status may include waiting for planning, waiting parts, ready to schedule, scheduled, etc. Perform and monitor quality assurance ensuring that all maintenance and repair work is compliant with the standards set by GPW: Confer with department supervisors to determine status and quality of scheduled maintenance. Review factors that could affect the quality of maintenance/repair work and put mitigating measures in place if required. Monitor progress to track performance against the plan and to identify early warning signs. Prepare maintenance and repair reports. Develop and implement programs to improve Mean Time To Repair and Mean Time Between Failure and any other strategic maintenance aspect as instructed by GPW Management. Improve quality of maintenance work and reduce number of re-work jobs and complaints. Ensure the ideology of continuous improvement is applied to all facets of maintenance within span of control. Manage safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) in the Division: Comply with all OHSA safety requirements. Monitor and mitigate plant related safety risks. Ensure that SHERQ processes are adhered to. Participate in all SHERQ activities within GPW as and when required. Supervise, train, coach and develop staff in the Division: Oversee/monitor the training programmes in the Division. Allocate work to subordinates. Conduct quality assurance on work carried out by subordinates. Conduct performance assessment. Ensure compliance with GPW policies, procedures, and codes of conduct. Manage attendance, leave, and discipline in accordance with HR prescripts. Observe and participate in the development of policies and procedures: Manage the developing, review, implementing and complying with the relevant procedures and policies as required by GPW. Keep up to date with new developments in the functional area.
