af.title: Ambagsman Hoof Vlak A: Toerustingonderhoud
af.summary: Hoofambagsman gesoek om toerustingonderhoud en herstel by Government Printing Works in Pretoria te oorsien, wat 'n ambagsertifikaat en 10 jaar se na-leerlingskap ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide leerlingskap. Trade Test-sertifikaat in Meganies (ambagsgetoetste passer). Grade 12 sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike na-leerlingskap ervaring waarvan 3 jaar op Ambagsman Opsigtervlak moet wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklarans te verkry. Gespesialiseerde kennis van prosesse en toerusting. Begrip van alle tersaaklike menslike hulpbronne wetgewende raamwerke, regulasies en voorskrifte. Begrip van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) bestuursvereistes Wet, Skills Development Act. Begrip van die PFMA en Treasury Regulations. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Verseker doeltreffende onderhoud en herstel van alle GPW-toerusting: Verseker die akkurate analise van toerussingspesifikasies en toerustingkapasiteitsdata en voer wiskundige berekenings uit om Betroubaarheidsgesentreerde Onderhoudskedules te bepaal. Skeduleer onderhoud volgens vooraf vasgestelde vervaardigingsvolgorde en deurlooptye, met inagneming van die Onderhoudsplan, produksievereistes en toerustingvereistes. Verseker die opstel en bywerk van die skedule om tred te hou en 'n akkurate geskiedenis van elke masjien op te bou. Neem deel aan die opstel van 'n ooreengekome Toerustingsplan vir 'n 8-week rollende horison, wat maksimum masjienbeskikbaarheid verseker. Monitor die betydie uitreiking van die toerustingonderhoudsplanne aan Fabrieksbestuurders. Voer oorsaakanalises op masjienebreek uit en rapporteer daaroor. Bestuur en beheer die status van werk en agterstand vir werkorderversending tot werkordervoltooiing. Status kan wag op beplanning, wag op onderdele, gereed om te skeduleer, geskedeuleer, ens. insluit. Voer kwaliteitversekering uit en monitor dit om te verseker dat alle onderhouds- en herstelwerk aan die standaarde wat deur GPW gestel is, voldoen: Raadpleeg departementsopsigters om die status en kwaliteit van geskedeuleerde onderhoud te bepaal. Hersien faktore wat die kwaliteit van onderhouds/herstelwerk kan beïnvloed en plaas versagtingsmaatreëls indien nodig. Monitor vordering om prestasie teen die plan na te volg en vroeë waarskuwingstekens te identifiseer. Berei onderhouds- en herstelverslae voor. Ontwikkel en implementeer programme om Mean Time To Repair en Mean Time Between Failure en enige ander strategiese onderhoudsaspek soos deur GPW-bestuur aangedui te verbeter. Verbeter kwaliteit van onderhoudswerk en verminder aantal herwerk- en klagtes. Verseker dat die ideologie van deurlopende verbetering op alle fasette van onderhoud binne beheersbestek toegepas word. Bestuur veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en kwaliteit (SHERQ) in die Afdeling: Voldoen aan alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes. Monitor en versag aanlegverwante veiligheidsrisiko's. Verseker dat SHERQ-prosesse nagekom word. Neem deel aan alle SHERQ-aktiwiteite binne GPW soos wanneer vereis. Oorsien, tree op, begelei en ontwikkel personeel in die Afdeling: Oorsien/monitor die opleidingsprogramme in die Afdeling. Wijs werk aan ondergeskiktes toe. Voer kwaliteitversekering uit op werk deur ondergeskiktes gedoen. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit. Verseker nakoming van GPW-beleide, prosedures en gedragskodes. Bestuur bywoning, verlof en dissipline in ooreenstemming met HR-voorskrifte. Neem waar en neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van beleide en prosedures: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening, implementering en nakoming van die tersaaklike prosedures en beleide soos deur GPW vereis. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die funksionele area.

zu.title: I-Artisan Chief Izinga A: Ukugcina Izisetshenziswa
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Chief Artisan okuzobe egcina futhi alungisa izisetshenziswa e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, kudingeka ifakhalesi yokuhlolwa kobungcweti kanye neminyakaengu-10 yomlando emumva kokubambelela.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma izifundo ezingulingana kanye nokuphothulewa kokubambelela. Ifakhalesi yokuhlolwa kobungcweti kwe-Mechanical (umfaki ofakhiwe ukutholwa ubungcweti). I-Grade 12 izoba ngindlela. Kadingeka ubenomlando ongungenani iminyakaengu-10 emumva kokubambelela ofanele, okuyiminyakaengu-3 kuyo kufanele ibe sezingeni le-Artisan Foreman. Kudingeka ukuthi ukwazi ukuthola isiqiniseko sokuhlelwa ngokuphepha. Ulwazi olukhethekile ngenqubo nezisetshenziswa. Ukuqonda konke okuhlobene nesisekelo somthetho wamabalabala abantu, imithetho nemiyalelo. Ukuqonda umthetho we-Public Service Act, imithetho ye-Public Service Regulations, umthetho we-Labour Relations Act, umthetho we-Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements, kanye nomthetho we-Skills Development Act. Ukuqonda i-PFMA nemithetho ye-Treasury Regulations. Kudingeka ibe nelayisense evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokulungiswa okusebenza kahle kwayo yonke imishini ye-GPW: Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa okuchanekile kwezinkomba zemishini nedatha yamandla emishini bese wenza izibalo zamagama ukuze unqume icala lokugcina okuqinisekiswe ukuthembeka. Hlela ukugcinwa ngokulandelana kokukhiqiza okubekiwe ngaphambilini kanye nesikhathi sokuqedelela, ngokuqonda iMaphulani Yokugcina, izidingo zokukhiqiza nezidingo zemishini. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa nokubuyekezwa kwesikhathi ukuze ulandelwe futhi wakhe umlando onguchanekile wemishini ngayinye. Thatha inxaxheba ekudaleni iPhulani Lemishini elivunywe ngokomishini yesikhathi esiyamasontoengu-8 esihamba phambili, eqinisekisa ukutholakala okuphezulu kwemishini. Qaphela ukuphathwa ngasikhathi siphume isikhathi samaphulani okugcina imishini abaphathi beNkilishi. Yenza ukuhlolwa okuphakathi kwemibhalo yesizathu sokuphuka kwemishini bese ubika ngakho. Phatha futhi ulawule isimo somsebenzi kanye nomsebenzi odinga kwenziwe kusukela ekuthunyweni kuze kuqede ukwenziwa. Isimo singafaka ukulinda ukuhlelwa, ukulinda izingxenye, ukulungele ukuhlelwa, ukuhlelwa, njll. Yenza bese uqaphela ukuqinisekiswa kokuthembeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umsebenzi wokugcina nokulungisa uhambisana namazinga abekiwe yi-GPW: Khulumisana nabaphathi bomnyango ukuze unqume isimo nokuqinisekwa komsebenzi wokugcina ohleliwe. Buyeza ngamaphuzu angabuye aphawule ukuthembeka komsebenzi wokugcina/lungisa bese ubeka izinyathelo zokunciphisa uma kudingeka. Qaphela inqubo ukuze ulandelwe ukusebenza ngokomaphulani futhi ukuze ukhanyise izimpawu zokuqaphela ngokuqala. Hlela imibhalo yokuqinisekiswa yokugcina nokulungisa. Hlola futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuphucula i-Mean Time To Repair kanye ne-Mean Time Between Failure nanoma yisiphi esinye isiphoqi sokuqondana nokugcina njengoba inqunywe yi-GPW Management. Phekula ukuthembeka komsebenzi wokugcina futhi unciphise inani lomsebenzi ophindwa kanye nezikhalazo. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbono wokuphucula okuqhubekayo kusetshenziswa kuyo yonke imikhakha yokugcinwa engaphansi kolawulo. Lawula ukuphepha, impilo, imvelo, ingozi kanye nokuqinisekiswa (SHERQ) eSigabeni: Hambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokuphepha ze-OHSA. Qaphela bese unciphisa izingozi ezihlobene ne-nsimbi eziholela ekuphepheni. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo ye-SHERQ ilandelwa. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izenzo ze-SHERQ ngaphakathi kwe-GPW lapho kudingeka khona. Qondisa, holela, fundisa futhi uphucule abasebenzi eSigabeni: Buka/qaphela izinhlelo zokufundisa eSigabeni. Abela abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho umsebenzi. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ubuthembaka emsebenzweni owenziwe abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Yenza ukubikezela ukusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhanjwa ngemigomo, inqubo namakhodi ezokuziphatha ze-GPW. Phatha ukungikhona, ihevhu, kanye nodisi ngokusho imiyalelo ye-HR. Buka futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo kanye nenqubo: Lawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa, ukusebenzisa kanye nokuhambisana ngenqubo namaphulani ahlobene njengoba kudingwa yi-GPW. Gcina ukuthi ugqamile ngokuthuthuka okusha esikhundleni sokusebenza.

xh.title: I-Artisan Eyinhloko Inqanaba A: Ukulondolozo kweziqoshwa
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe i-Artisan Eyinhloko ekuya kuyilawula ukulondolozo nokulungisa iziqoshwa kwi-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, kwaye kufuna isatifikethi senqubo lovakwalwazi kunye neminyaka eyi-10 yamava emva kokuba ugqibe isikhosi sokufunda umsebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 okanye isifundo esilinganayo ngakumbi nokugqiba kwesikhosi sokufunda umsebenzi. Isatifikethi Senqubo lovakwalwazi ku-Mechanical (njengengcali evakwalwe khona). I-Grade 12 iya kuba lusawundo. Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi komlinganiselo weminyaka eyi-10 emva kwesikhosi sokufunda umsebenzi, apho iminyaka esi-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba le-Artisan Foreman. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isivumo esigqithisiweyo sokhuseleko. Ulwazi oluchaziweyo lweenkqubo neziqoshwa. Ukuqonda kwakho konke umthetho ohlelweyo wezabasebenzi, iimigaqo-nkqubo nezimiso ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqonda koMthetho wokuQhasha kaRhulumente, Iimigaqo-nkqubo zoRhulumente, uMthetho woBudlelwane boMsebenzi, uMthetho weNdalo, yeMpilo, yeKhuselo nokuLawula ngokweMilinganiselo (SHREQ), noMthetho woPhuhliso lwamakhono. Ukuqonda i-PFMA kunye neMigaqo-nkqubo yeTreasury. Ifuna ilayisenesi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulondolozwa nokulungiswa okusebenzayo kwayo onke amaqhinga e-GPW. Qinisekisa ukuhlaziywa okuchanekileyo kwezimvo zeqhinga nedatha yanokukwazi kwamagqabi uze wenze imithetho yemathematika ukuze umishe iNqanaba Lokulondoloza ngokwethembeka. Cwangcisa ukulondolozo ngokwemithetho yokwenza edlulisiweyo yamashishini namaxesha okuhamba phambili, unakele iCwangciso Lokulondoloza, iimfuno zokukhiqiza nedatha yamagqabizo. Qinisekisa ubhaliso nosahlaziywa kwecwangciso lokugcina umkhondo wakwayo ukwakha imbali echanekileyo yemveliso nganye. Thabatha inxaxheba ekuqokelelweni kweCwangciso laMagqabizo elivunyelweyo lonkeveki-8 ezayo, ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kwamagqabiza ngaphezulu. Qaphela ukuphiwa ngexesha elichanekileyo kwecwangciso lokulondolozwa kwamagqabizo kubaQhelengoba beShishini. Yenza uphononongo oluthe ngqo ngomthombo wokuwa kwamagqabiza uze uxelo ngokwako. Lawula ulawulo lwemo yomsebenzi nokubuyela emva kwemiqulu yomsebenzi ukusuka ekuhanjisweni kwemiqulu ukuya kwempumelelo. Imo ingaquka ukulinda iplan, ukuza kumagqabizo, ulungele ukucwangcisa, uqcwangcile, njl. Yenza uze ulawule ukuqinisekisa ukuthembeka ukuqinisekisa ukuba lonke umsebenzi wokulondolozwa nokuqamba uvumelana nezigqibo ezithiwe ngum-GPW. Phathelana neNkokeli zamacandlo ukumisela imo nethembeka yecwangciso elidlulisiweyo. Phawula izinto ezinokubashukumisa kubukhali bomsebenzi wokulondolozwa nokulungiswa uze ufake iinkqubo zokuthomalathisa xa kuyimfuneko. Qaphela intshukumo ukuze ulande ukuphumeza umthetho ukuze ubone iimpawu zexhala. Hlona imibiko yokulondolozwa nokulungiswa. Yakha uze usebenzise iinkqubo zokuphucula iXesha Eliqulunqwe lokulungisa nelithi phakathi kokuwa, kunye nakunye naluphi na ulwakhiwo lokulondoloza olusesinyeni njengoko kuhambiswe ngongantshunsho be-GPW. Phucula ubukhali bomsebenzi wokulondolozwa uze unciphise inani lamashishini okwenzwa kwakhona neengxaki. Qinisekisa ukuba umbono wokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo wamiselwa kuzo onke amacandlo okulondoloza aphakathi kolawulo. Lawula ukhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ingozi, nethembeka (i-SHERQ) kulo Candlo. Hambelana neemfuno zokhuseleko ze-OHSA ngokupheleleyo. Qaphela uze unciphise iingozi zokhuseleko ezinxulumene neshishini. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ze-SHERQ zilandelwa. Thabatha inxaxheba kuzo onke amashishini e-SHERQ aphakathi kwamagqabizo xa kusetyenziswa. Lawula, qeqesha, cocisa uze uphuhlise abasebenzi kulo Candlo. Lawula/qaphela iinkqubo zokuqeqesha kulo Candlo. Magqabiza umsebenzi kwabahambi ngaphantsi kwakho. Yenza ukuqinisekisa kwethembeka ngomsebenziwenziweyo ngabahambi ngaphantsi. Yenza ukulinganisa kokuphumeza. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana neengqiniso ezisesidleni, iinkqubo, namakhowudi e-GPW. Lawula ubukho, iholo, nolawulo njengoko kubekwe ngemigaqo-nkqubo ye-HR. Qaphela uze uthabathe inxaxheba ekuqhakambiseni iingqiniso nankqubo. Lawula ukuqhakamba, ulungiso, ukusebenzisa nokuvumelana neenkqubo nengqiniso ezifunekwa ngum-GPW. Ziqhelise nokugcina ulwazi lwentshukumo entsha kwindawo yakho yomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Artisan Foreman Grade A: ID Smart Card Personalisation
jobs.summary: Artisan Foreman sought to oversee smart ID card personalisation production, requiring a trade test certificate and five years' post-apprenticeship experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in an appropriate field. Grade 12 will be an added advantage. At least 5 years’ post-apprenticeship experience in the functional area. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Good knowledge of applicable processes and equipment. The incumbent must be willing and able to work rotating shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and night shifts, as required. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Ensure correct production of personalised smart ID card documents in the section, including card layout, data input, printing and encoding. Monitor and control the movement and work in progress, ensuring that work is done according to the required schedule regarding timelines and quantities. Conduct/monitor proper quality control on the personalised documents. Control the reduction of wastage and efficiency baseline rate in the Section. Monitor that all procedures and systems relating to the protection of high security printed matters are adhered to by all staff in the Section. Ensure effective quality control on personalised documents. Monitor that proper quality assurance of smart ID card personalisation and production are continuously and properly conducted in the Section. Troubleshoot problems, identify the root cause on issues in the personalisation process, assisting with the implementing of solutions to address the problem. Ensure that cleaning and maintenance of equipment are performed as expected and as scheduled. Maintain safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) in the Section. Assist with the monitoring of safety risks in the Section providing advice on possible risk mitigating measures that could be implemented. Supervise and develop staff including development of apprentices. Allocate tasks to Artisans and Printers’ Assistants. Ensure compliance with Treasury and GPW prescripts procedures and policies regarding procurement of goods. Participate in the review, implementation and compliance with production procedures and policies as required by GPW.

af.title: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A: ID Slimkaart Personalisering
af.summary: Ambagsman Voorman gesoek om personaliseringsproduksie van slim ID-kaarte toesig te hou, wat 'n ambagsman-sertifikaat en vyf jaar se post-leertyd-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide leerlingskap. Ambagsman-sertifikaat in 'n toepaslike veld. Graad 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ten minste 5 jaar se post-leertyd-ervaring in die funksionele area. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklaringsverslag te verkry. Goede kennis van toepaslike prosesse en toerusting. Die ampsdraer moet gewillig en in staat wees om wisselende skofte te werk, insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagskofte, soos vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verseker korrekte produksie van gepersonaliseerde slim ID-kaartdokumente in die afdeling, insluitend kaartuitleg, data-invoer, druk en kodering. Monitor en beheer die beweging en werk in uitvoering, en verseker dat werk gedoen word volgens die vereiste skedule ten opsigte van tydlyne en hoeveelhede. Voer/monitor behoorlike gehaltebeheer op die gepersonaliseerde dokumente uit. Beheer die vermindering van vermorsing en doeltreffendheidsbasislynkoers in die Afdeling. Monitor dat alle prosedures en stelsels wat verband hou met die beskerming van hoësekuriteitsdrukwerk deur alle personeel in die Afdeling nagekom word. Verseker effektiewe gehaltebeheer op gepersonaliseerde dokumente. Monitor dat behoorlike gehalteversekering van slim ID-kaart personalisering en produksie deurlopend en behoorlik in die Afdeling uitgevoer word. Los probleme op, identifiseer die oorsaak van kwessies in die personaliseringsproses, en help met die implementering van oplossings om die probleem aan te spreek. Verseker dat skoonmaak en onderhoud van toerusting uitgevoer word soos verwag en volgens skedule. Handhaaf veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ) in die Afdeling. Help met die monitering van veiligheidsrisiko's in die Afdeling en gee advies oor moontlike risikobeperkende maatreëls wat geimplementeer kan word. Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel, insluitend die ontwikkeling van leerlinge. Ken take toe aan Ambagsmanne en Drukkersassistentte. Verseker nakoming van Tesourie- en GPW-voorskrifprosedures en -beleid ten opsigte van die verkryging van goedere. Neem deel aan die hersiening, implementering en nakoming van produksieprosedures en -beleid soos deur GPW vereis.

zu.title: Artisan Foreman Grade A: ID Smart Card Personalisation
zu.summary: I-Artisan Foreman dayiswe ukulawula ukukhiqizwa kwe-smart ID card abhangayo, idinga isitifiketi sokuqeqeshwa ubungcweti kanye neminyaka engu-5 yokusebenza ngemva kokuqeqeshwa.
zu.requirements:
I-GRADE 10 noma isimfundo esilinganayo okuhlanganise ukufundela umsebenisi. 
Isitifiketi sokuhlolwa kobungcweti kumkhakha ofanele. 
I-GRADE 12 izoba yinenzuzo. 
Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yokusebenza ngemva kokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi enkundleni yokusebenza. 
Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa okuhle kokuphepha. 
Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezinqubo nezisetshenziswa ezifanele. 
Lowo ohlehlwe isikhundla kumele afune futhi akwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshana amashifthi, okuhlanganisa amasonto, izikhathi zikhethwa zimukelekile, futhi amashifthi ebusuku, njengoba kudingwa. 
Ilayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile izoba yinenzuzo.
zu.duties:
Qinisekisa ukukhiqizwa okulungile kwamadokhoda we-smart ID card abhangayo esigabeni, okuhlanganise isendlalelo sekhadi, ukufakwa kwemininingwane, ukuphrinta kanye nokukhoda. 
Londoloza ulawule ukunyakuliswa kanye nomsebenzi ogqamayo, uqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngokweshejuli edingwayo mayelana ngesikhathi nobukhulu bendaba. 
Holela/ulondoloze ukulawula kwephutha elingisele kwamadokhoda abhangayo. 
Lawula ukuncipha kokulahlekelwa kanye ngenani elisezingeni eliphakeme lokusebenza Esigabeni. 
Londoloze ukuthi zonke izinqubo namasistimu ahlobene nokuvikelwa kwezinto eziphathwa ngezinga eliphezulu lokuphepha ezihlanganisa bonke abasebenzi Esigabeni. 
Qinisekisa ukulawula kwephutha elingisele kwamadokhoda abhangayo. 
Londoloze ukuthi ukulawula kwephutha elingisele kokubhungana kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-smart ID card kwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo nangendlela efanele Esigabeni. 
应对Soluza izinkinga,qaphele imvelaphi yezinkinga esigabeni sokubhungana,usize ekusebeniseni izixazululi ekwenzeni izinkinga. 
Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusula kanye nokugcina kwesisetshenziswa kwenziwa njengoba kulindelekile nangokweshejuli. 
Gcina ukuphepha,ezempilo,indawo,ingozi kakhulu futhi umkhakha wezomphilo Esigabeni. 
usize ekulondolozeni izingozi zokuphepha Esigabeni unikeza izelulezo ngezindlela ezingase zisetshenziselwe ukunciphisa izingozi. 
Qaphsisise futhi atulate abasebenzi okuhlanganise nokuthuthukiswa kwabafundi. 
Aba mkhulu imisebenzi kubahlinzeki kanye nabasizi bobhahlihodi. 
Qinisekise ukuhambisana nezinqubo kanye namapholisi esiQenjana lesidleke kanye noGPW ekuthengeni izimpahla.

xh.title: INtloko yabaBugcisa iNqanaba le-A: Ukunikela iK Medi ikhadi le-ID ubuntu
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNtloko yabaBugcisa ukuba ilawule imveliso yobuntu bekhadi le-ID esecingo, kufuneka ibe nesatifikethi soVivinyo loBugcisa kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava emva kokubhalisa kwabafundi.
xh.requirements: Isikhululo seGraji 10 okanye izidanga ezilinganayo kwangaphezulu sokugqiba ukubhalisa kwabafundi. Isatifikethi soVivinyo lweMfundo kwindawo efanelekileyo. Isikhululo seGraji 12 siya kuba ngumvuzo ongezelelweyo. Ubuncinane ngeminyaka emi-5 yokugqiba isikhathi sabafundi.abefundiweyo kwindawo yomsebenzi. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isiqinisekiso esingathembakyo sokhuseleko. Ulwazi olululo olunxulumene neenkqubo nezixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Umntu oze kule ndawo kufuneka afune kwaye akwazi ukusebenza eshishini ezishukumayo, kuquka iintsuku zokuphumla, iintsuku zentsapho zamaphondo, kunye namashishini ebusuku, njengoko kufuneka. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egunyaziweyo iya kuba ngumvuzo ongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo kwemveliso yamaxwebhu ekhadi le-ID elinobuntu kule ndawo, kuquka ulungelelwaniso lwekhadi, ukungenisa iingcombolo, ukuprinta nokukhowuda. Lilinde ulawule intshukumo nomsebenzi ophelayo, uqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi wenziwa ngokwemizuzu yomgangatho malunga namaxesha namanani. Yenza/limde ukulawula ngokufanelekileyo ıkhwalithi yamaxwebhu anobuntu. Lawula ukuncitshiswa kokutshatyalaliswa kunye namanqanaba okusebenza kakuhle kule Ndawo. Limde ukuba zonke iinkqubo nezixhobo ezithunyelwe kukhuseleko lwamaxwebhu apapashwe ngokukhuselekileyo zithobwa ngabo bonke abasebenzi kule Ndawo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenzayo kwıkhwalithi kwamaxwebhu anobuntu. Limde ukuba ukukhangela ngokufanelekileyo ıkhwalithi yobuntu nobungcali ekupapashweni nekusetyenzweni kwekhadi le-ID kwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo ngokufanelekileyo kule Ndawo. Solula iingxaki, chonga imbangela yeenkqablo ezikwindlela yokunikela ubuntu, size ncedise ekusebenziseni izisombululo ukujongana nenkinga. Qinisekisa ukuba ukucoca nokugcinwa kwezixhobo kwenziwa njengoko kulindelekwe njengoko bijeduliwe. Gcina ukhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ingozi kunye nıkhwalithi (SHERQ) kule Ndawo. Nceda ekulindweni kweengozi zokhuseleko kule Ndawo ngokunika izindulo ngamanyathelo okunciphisa iingozi anokwenziwa. Lawule uphuhlise abasebenzi kuquka uphuhliso lwabafundi.abelana imisebenzi kubaBugcisa bese Ncedisa abaBhalisi beShishini. Qinisekisa ukutshatyalaliswa nemigaqo neenkqubo zeTreasury namagqabantshintshi e-GPW malunga nokuthengwa kwempahla. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqwalasela, ukusebenzisa nokutshatyalaliswa kweenkqubo nemigaqo yemveliso njengoko kufunwa yi-GPW.

jobs.title: Artisan Foreman Grade A: ID Craft Booklet Making
jobs.summary: Artisan Foreman to oversee ID craft booklet making at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring a trade test certificate and five years' post-apprenticeship experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in the appropriate field (applicable craft book binding/mechanized binding) Grade 12 will be an added advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. At least 5 years’ post apprenticeship experience in the functional area. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Order and prepare the required material for the process of ID document and booklet making. Oversee the quality assurance process of the raw material ordered and prepared, preventing the manufacturing of faulty booklets. Ensure that all stock movements are recorded and shortages are reported immediately. Ensure security measures are adhered to and all work is done according to schedules and production targets in the Section. Manufacture documents and booklets according to required specifications and standards. Oversee and control the production process ensuring adherence to all security protocols and ensuring ID document and passport booklets are manufactured efficiently. Ensure quality checking of printed matter before the assembling of the booklets. Assemble ID documents and Booklets in the correct order and ensure accurate cutting, folding, foiling and binding of the booklets. Control the movement of and work in progress in the Section ensuring that work is done according to specifications, quantity and timelines required. Control the reduction of wastage and efficiency baseline rate in the Section. Monitor that all procedures and systems relating to the protection of high security printed matters are adhered to by all staff in the Section. Enhance troubleshooting efficiently and effectively. Assist with the identifying of the root cause of problems or issues with the production process, as well as assisting with the implementing of solutions to address the problem. Maintain safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) in the Section. Assist with the monitoring of safety risks in the Section providing advice on possible risk mitigating measures that could be implemented. Supervise, train, coach and develop learners, artisans, and printers’ assistants in the Section.

af.title: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A: ID Handwerk Boekiesmaak
af.summary: Ambagsman Voorman om toesig te hou oor ID handwerk boekiesmaak by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, wat 'n ambagsmanstoetsertifikaat en vyf jaar se ervaring na vakleerlingskap vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap. Ambagsmanstoetsertifikaat in die toepaslike veld (toepaslike handwerk boekbindery/gemechaniseerde bindery) Graad 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring na vakleerlingskap in die funksionele area. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestel en berei die vereiste materiaal voor vir die proses van ID-dokument- en boekiesmaak. Hou toesig oor die gehalteversekeringsproses van die rou materiaal wat bestel en voorberei is, en voorkom die vervaardiging van foutiewe boekies. Verseker dat alle voorraadbewegings aangeteken word en tekorte onmiddellik gerapporteer word. Verseker dat aan veiligheidsmaatreëls voldoen word en dat alle werk volgens skedules en produksieteikens in die Afdeling gedoen word. Vervaardig dokumente en boekies volgens vereiste spesifikasies en standaarde. Hou toesig oor en beheer die produksieproses en verseker nakoming van alle veiligheidsprotokolle en verseker dat ID-dokument- en paspoortboekies doeltreffend vervaardig word. Verseker gehaltekontrole van gedrukte materiaal voor die samestelling van die boekies. Stel ID-dokumente en boekies in die korrekte volgorde saam en verseker akkurate sny, vou, foelie en binding van die boekies. Beheer die beweging van en werk in uitvoering in die Afdeling en verseker dat werk volgens spesifikasies, hoeveelheid en vereiste tydslyne gedoen word. Beheer die vermindering van vermorsing en doeltreffendheidsbasislynkoers in die Afdeling. Monitor dat alle prosedures en stelsels wat verband hou met die beskerming van hoëveiligheidsgedrukte materiaal deur alle personeel in die Afdeling nagekom word. Verbeter probleemoplossing doeltreffend en effektief. Bystand verleen met die identifisering van die oorsaak van probleme of kwessies met die produksieproses, asook bystand verleen met die implementering van oplossings om die probleem aan te spreek. Handhaaf veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ) in die Afdeling. Bystand verleen met die monitering van veiligheidsrisiko's in die Afdeling deur advies te verskaf oor moontlike risikobeperkingsmaatreëls wat geïmplementeer kan word. Superviseer, leer, afrig en ontwikkel leerders, ambagsmanne en drukkersassistente in die Afdeling.

zu.title: I Foreman yobuciko Izinga A: Ukwenza Incwadi yobuciko ye-ID
zu.summary: I Foreman yobuciko ukubhekisisa ukwenza izincwadi zobuciko ze-ID e Government Printing Works e Pretoria, edinga isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuciko kanye namafamu eminyaka yamava emva kwesikhathi sokufunda umsebenzi.
zu.requirements: I Grade 10 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye nokuphela kwesikhathi sokufunda umsebenzi. Isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuciko enkundleni efanelekile (okufanelekile ukubopha izincwadi zobuciko/ukubopha ngokomshini) i Grade 12 izoba ngelunga elingeziwe. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukubuyiselwa okuhle ngokokuvikela. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava emva kwesikhathi sokufunda umsebenzi endaweni yokusebenza. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba ngelunga elingeziwe.
zu.duties: Funa futhi ulungise izinto ezidingekayo zenqubo yokwenza amadokhumenti we-ID nezincwadi. Bhekisisa inqubo yokutholakala kokuhle kwezinto ezingolwandle ezitholwe futhi ezilungisiwe, nokuvikela ukukhiqizwa kwezincwadi ezinesiphazfanyi. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsuku zokunyakaza kwemitsetso zibhalwe kanti izinsuku ezingezona zibikwe ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlatshwe amasu okuvikela kanti nomsebenzi wonke wenziwa ngokohlelo kanye nezinto ezihlose ukukhiqizwa kulesigaba. Khiqiza amadokhumenti nezincwadi ngokwezici nezindinganiso ezidingekayo. Bhekisisa futhi ulawule inqubo yokukhiqiza kuqinisekiswa ukuthobela wonke amaphrothokholi okuvikela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amadokhumenti we-ID nezincwadi zepasipoti zikhiqizwa ngokusebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuhlola ukuhle kwezinto ezicushiwe ngaphambi kokuhlanganisa izincwadi. Hlanganisa amadokhumenti we-ID nezincwadi ngokulandelana okufanele futhi uqinisekise ukusika, ukugoqa, ukufaka ifoyela nokubopha izincwadi ngokunembile. Lawula ukunyakaza nomsebenzi oqhubekayo lesigaba uqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngokwezici, inani kanye nezinsuku ezidingekayo. Lawula ukuncitshiswa kwezinto ezingezona kanye nizinga lokusebenza kahle lesigaba. Buka ukuthi yonke izinqubo kanye namasistimu ahlobene nokuvikelwa kwezinto ezicushiwe ezivikelwe kakhulu zihlatshwe bonke abasebenzi lesigaba. Phucula ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokusebenza kahle nangokunembile. Siza ekubhaleni impimbolamntwana yezinkinga noma izinkinga zenqubo yokukhiqiza, kanye nokusiza ekusebenziseni izixazululo zokubhekana nenkinga. Gcina ukuphepha, impilo, imvelo, ingozi kanye nokuhle (SHERQ) lesigaba. Siza ekubukeni izingozi zokuphepha lesigaba unikeza izeluleko ngezinyathelo ezithi zingasetshenziswa ukunciphisa izingozi. Lawula, qeqesha, coacha futhi uthuthukise abafundi, ababuciko, kanye nabasizi bobushayela lesigaba.

xh.title: I-Nkosikazi Yobugcisa Isikhaka A: Ukuqamba Amabhukhu We-ID
xh.summary: INkosikazi Yobugcisa Isikhaku ukulawula ukuqamba amabhukhu we-ID e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, ifuna isatifikethi sesivivinyo sobugcisa nokuba nemyalezo yeminyaka emihlanu emva kokusebenza njengomfundi.
xh.requirements: Isigaba se-10 okanye isifundo esilinganayo kwaye seliqediwe ukumfunda lomsebenzi womandlalo, Isatifikethi Sovavanyo Lobugcisa kwelinye ibala elifanelekileyo, kwaye isigaba se-12 siza kuba yindlulo. Kufuneka akwazi ukufumana isiqinisekiso sokhuseleko esihle. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-5 yamava emva kwesifundo somsebenzi womandlalo kwelinye ibala lokusebenza. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba efanelekileyo siza kuba ngaphezulu.
xh.duties: Funa kwaye ulungise izinto ezifunekayo zenzele inkqubo yokusika nokwenza amabhukhu kwaye uqinisekise ukuba inkqubo yokulawula ukhathazo kwelinye ibala ngokunyuka. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abantu abaqhuba imisebenzi babhalwe kwaye amaxesha aze abe nokusabela ngokuthe ngqo. Qinisekisa izinto ezifunwa ngokomgaqo wokhuseleko nokuba yonke imisebenzi yenziwa ngokweenkqubo kwaye kube kukulingana neenkqubondlela zexesha nokuchongiweyo. Qamba amaxwebhu namabhukhu ngokweemfuno ezichaziweyo nezigaba. Lawula inkqubo yokuqeshwa uqinisekise ukuba kuye kubekho kwaye kwamkeleke ukuba amaxwebhu namabhukhu a-ID ayilwe ngokulinganayo. Qinisekisa ukukhangela ngokucokwazi ukhathazo lowayilo ngaphambi kokudibanisa amabhukhu. Dibanisa amaxwebhu namabhukhu ngokulandelana okuchanekileyo kwaye uqinisekise ukusika, ukugqithisa, nokusonga amabhukhu ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ukushiywa kwexesha nemisebenzi eqhubekayo kwelinye ibala qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yenziwa ngokweemfuno, ngobukhulu bexesha elifunekayo. Lawula ukunciphisa iindleko ezingekho nzuzo kwaye ulawule ukulingana kwemisebenzi ngokwekhalenda elinganayo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yabantu kwelinye ibala ilandelwa ngokomthetho wokhuseleko, impilo, indalo, iingozi, kwaye kukhathazo (SHERQ). Nceda nokusingathwa kweengozi kwelinye ibala nokuba yincomo ngeendlela ezinokuthi zisetyenziselwe ukunciphisa iingozi. Lawula, qeqesha, khulisa abafundi, abantu bombugcisa, kwaye abancedisi bomshicileli kwelinye ibala.

jobs.title: Artisan Foreman Grade A: Rubber Stamp Making
jobs.summary: Artisan Foreman Grade A sought at Government Printing Works in Pretoria to oversee rubber stamp manufacturing, requiring a completed apprenticeship, trade test certificate and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Completed apprenticeship and Trade Test Certificate in Electronic Origination plus Grade 10 or equivalent qualification. Grade 12 will be an added advantage, Knowledge and experience in CorelDraw and Microsoft Excel will be an advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance At least 5 years’ post-apprenticeship appropriate experience. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Design Stamps, operate stamp equipment, oversee, and maintain the manufacturing process for rubber stamps to ensure effective production output. Confirm client or internal requirements and specifications to ensure the production of accurate, fit-for-purpose rubber stamps. Develop, review and amend rubber stamp designs using appropriate design software or approved manual design methods. Prepare text, graphics and artwork for expo-sure onto stamp-making materials, including polymer or rubber plates. Supervise the team and ensure the continuous, safe and efficient operation of stamp-making machinery and related equipment. Monitor equipment performance to support continuous, safe and efficient production operations. Coordinate repairs or technical support with maintenance personnel where required. Implement and monitor quality assurance processes to ensure that rubber stamps meet required standards and specifications. Ensure that completed rubber stamps are prepared, labelled and packaged for dispatch in accordance with requirements. Recommend process improvements to enhance quality, reduce waste and improve production efficiency. Ensure that machines, tools and equipment are cleaned, maintained and kept in good working condition. Perform routine maintenance on machines and equipment in line with manufacturer requirements and operational procedures. Maintain records of equipment cleaning, maintenance, repairs and related costs where applicable. Support and participate in safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) initiatives within the section. Assist in corrective and preventative actions aimed at reducing operational risks and improving compliance. Participate in SHERQ inspections, awareness activities and continuous improvement initiatives within the section. Contribute to the training, coaching and development of staff within the section to enhance performance and capability. Allocate work, monitor performance and provide feedback to support effective delivery of section outputs. Assist in performance management of staff in accordance with applicable human resources policies.

af.title: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A: Rubberstempelvervaardiging
af.summary: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A gesoek by Government Printing Works in Pretoria om toezig te hou oor rubberstempelvervaardiging, waarvoor 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap, 'n vaktoetsertifikaat en vyf jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Voltooide vakleerlingskap en Vaktoetsertifikaat in Electronic Origination plus Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Graad 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees, Kennis en ervaring in CorelDraw en Microsoft Excel sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklaringsverslag te verkry Ten minste 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na afloop van die vakleerlingskap. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Ontwerp stempels, bedryf stempeltoerusting, hou toezig en onderhou die vervaardigingsproses vir rubberstempels om effektiewe produksie-uitset te verseker. Bevestig kliënt- of interne vereistes en spesifikasies om die vervaardiging van akkurate, doelmatige rubberstempels te verseker. Ontwikkel, hersien en wysig rubberstempelontwerpe met behulp van toepaslike ontwerp sagteware of goedgekeurde handmatige ontwerpmetodes. Berei teks, grafika en kunswerke voor vir blootstelling op stempelvervaardigingsmateriaal, insluitend polimeer- of rubberplate. Hou toezig oor die span en verseker die deurlopende, veilige en doeltreffende werking van stempelvervaardigingsmasjinerie en verwante toerusting. Monitor toerustingprestasie om deurlopende, veilige en doeltreffende produksiebedrywighede te ondersteun. Koördineer herstelwerk of tegniese ondersteuning met instandhoudingspersoneel waar nodig. Implementeer en monitor gehalteversekeringsprosesse om te verseker dat rubberstempels aan vereiste standaarde en spesifikasies voldoen. Verseker dat voltooide rubberstempels voorberei, geëtiketteer en verpak word vir versending in ooreenstemming met vereistes. Beveel prosesverbeterings aan om gehalte te verbeter, vermorsing te verminder en produksiedoeltreffendheid te verhoog. Verseker dat masjiene, gereedskap en toerusting skoongemaak, onderhou en in goeie werkende toestand gehou word. Voer roetine-instandhouding op masjiene en toerusting uit in ooreenstemming met vervaardigervereistes en operasionele prosedures. Hou rekords aan van toerustingreiniging, instandhouding, herstelwerk en verwante koste waar toepaslik. Ondersteun en neem deel aan veiligheids-, gesondheids-, omgewings-, risiko- en gehalte- (SHERQ) inisiatiewe binne die afdeling. Bystand verleen aan korrigerende en voorkomende maatreëls wat gemik is op die verminding van operasionele risiko's en die verbetering van nakoming. Neem deel aan SHERQ-inspeksies, bewustheidsaktiwiteite en deurlopende verbeteringsinisiatiewe binne die afdeling. Dra by tot die opleiding, afrigting en ontwikkeling van personeel binne die afdeling om prestasie en vermoë te verbeter. Wijs werk toe, monitor prestasie en verskaf terugvoer om effektiewe lewering van afdelingsuitsette te ondersteun. Bystand verleen aan prestasiebestuur van personeel in ooreenstemming met toepaslike menslike hulpbronbeleide.

zu.title: I-Artisan Foreman Grade A: Ukwenziwa Kwamasithampu EReshini
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Artisan Foreman Grade A e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria ukuba aphathe ukukhiqizwa kwamasithampu e-reshini, kudinga ukuba eqede isisebenziswa somthwesi, isitifikedi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kanye namaphuzu eminyaka yamapheshense eyisihlanu.
zu.requirements: Isisebenziswa somthwesi esiqediwe nesitifikedi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe ku-Electronic Origination kanye ne-Grade 10 noma isiqu esifanayo. I-Grade 12 izoba ukungeza okuhle, ulwazi namapheshense ku-CorelDraw kanye ku-Microsoft Excel kuzoba ukungeza okuhle. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukugunyazwa okuhle kwezokuphepha okungeneni okungenani eminyakeni eyisihlanu yamapheshense okufanele ngemva kokweseba ngomthwesi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba ukungeza okuhle.
zu.duties: Dizayina amasithampu, uphathe izinto zokwenza amasithampu, ulawule, futhi ugcinile inqubo yokukhiqizwa kwamasithampu e-reshini ukuze kuqiniseke ukukhiqizwa okusebenzayo. Qinisekisa izidingo nemininingwane yamakhasimende nangaphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukukhiqizwa kwamasithampu e-reshini aneqiniso afanele injongo. Buthula, hlola futhi ulungise imidizayini yamasithampu e-reshini usebenzisa isoftware efanele yokudizayina noma izindlela zokudizayina ngesandla ezamukelekile. Lungiselela umbhalo, imidwebo nobuciko bokuhlolela ezindaweni zokwenza amasithampu, okuhlanganisa amaphulethi we-polymer noma e-reshini. Qondise iqembu futhi uqiniseke ukusebenza okuqhubekayo, okuphephile nokusebenza kahle kwemishini yokwenza amasithampu nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Qapha ukusebenza kwemishini ukuze ukuseke ukukhiqizwa okuqhubekayo, okuphephile nokusebenza kahle. Hlela ukulungiswa noma ukwesekwa kobuchwepheshe nabasebenzi bolwelwesi lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenzisa futhi ulawule izinqubo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi amasithampu e-reshini ahambisana nemingqango nemininingwane edingwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasithampu e-reshini aqediwe alungiswe, abhalwe igama uphinde abekwe ukuthunyelwa ngokusho kwezidingo. Phakamisa izindlela zokuphucula inqubo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhwalithi, kuncishiswe ukupalaza futhi kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqizwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini, amathuluzi nezinto zokusebenza zihlanzekile, zigcinwe futhi zisezigabeni esihle sokusebenza. Yenza ukugcinwa okujwayelekile kwemishini nezinto zokusebenza ngokusho kwezidingo zomkhiqizi nezenqubo yokusebenza. Gcina irekhodi lokuhlanzwa, ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa kwemishini kanye nezindleko ezihlobene lapho kufanele khona. Sekela futhi uthathe inhlazo ekushayweni kwezinhlelo zokuphepha, ezempilo, zendawo,engoingozi nekhwalithi (SHERQ) ngaphakathi kundaba. Siza ezinye izenzo zokulungisa nokuqamba eziqondiswe ekunciphiseni ingozi yokusebenza nasekuthuthukiseni ukuhambisana. Thatha inhlazo ekubukeni izinhlelo zokuphepha (SHERQ), imisebenzi yokwandisa ulwazi kanye nokuqhubeka nokuphucula ngaphakathi kundaba. Nikeza ngokwelolwa, ukulekela nentuthuko yabasebenzi ngaphakathi kundaba ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kanye namakhono. Aba umsebenzi, qapha ukusebenza futhi unikeze impendulo ukuze ukuseke ukulethwa okusebenzayo kwemiphumela yendaba. Siza ekuphathebeni kokusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokusho nemithethongaphakathi yokuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu.

xh.title: I-Esnathi Foreman Inqanaba A: Ukwenza Iziphimbo zokuCaphula
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-Esnathi Foreman Inqanaba A kwiGovernment Printing Works ePretoria ukulawula ukwenziwa kweziphimbo zokucaphula, kufunelwa ukugqiba umfundo wobugcisa, isatifikethi senkcubeko yomsebenzi kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: Ukugqiba umfundo wobugcisa nesiPheqo sokuQinisekisa ukuQeqshwa kwi-Electronic Origination kananjalo neQadi lesi-10 okanye isiphumo esilinganayo. Iqadi lesi-12 luya kuba lusongo olungezelelweyo, ulwazi namava kwiCorelDraw kunye neMicrosoft Excel luya kuba lusonto olungezelelweyo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isikhululo esicotho sokhuseleko Okungenwa ubuncwane beminyaka engama-5 emva komfundo wobugcisa amava afanelekileyo. Ilayisensi yokushaya ibhayisikileyo esemthethweni iya kuba lusonto olungezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Kuyilwa iziphimbo zokucaphula, kusebenziswa izixhobo zokucaphula, kulawulwa, kugcinwa inkqubo yokwenza iziphimbo zokucaphula ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphuma kokukhiqiza okusebenzayo. Kiqinisekisa iimfuno kunye nemimiselo yabathengi okanye yangaphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukukhiqizwa kweziphimbo zokucaphula ezichanekileyo, ezifanelekileyo injongo. Kuphuhliswa, kuphononongwa kunye nokulungiswa okuyilo kweziphimbo zokucaphula kusetyenziswa isoftware yokuyila efanelekileyo okanye iindlela zokuyila ngesandla ezigunyazisiweyo. Kulungiselelwa umbhalo, iintshixho kunye noyilo lomsebenzi wocwangciso kwizinto ezisetyenziswa ekwenzeni iziphimbo, kuquka iipleyiti zepolyima okhugezi. Kulawulwa iqela kuqinisekwa ukuqhubekekayo, okukhuselekileyo nesebenzayo kweenjini zokwenza iziphimbo kunye nezixhobo ezinxulumene nazo. Kujolwa ukusebenza kwezixhobo ukuze kuxhaswe ukuqhubekeka, ukhuseleko nokukhiqiza okusebenzayo. Kuhlelwa izonzo okanye inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kunye nabasebenzi bolondolozo lapho kudingeka khona. Kusebenziswa kunye nokujolwa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba iziphimbo zokucaphula zihambelana nemigangatho kunye nemimiselo efunekayo. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iziphimbo zokucaphula ezigqityiweyo zilungiselelwe, zibhalwe igama kwaye zisongelwe zithunyelwe ngokwemfuno. Kwenziwa izindululo zokuphucula iinkqubo ukuze kuphuculwe umgangatho, kuncitshiswe imfucu kuphuculwe nokusebenza kukukhiqiza. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iimoto, izixhobo nezinto zokusebenza zicoceke, zilondoloze kwaye zigcinwe zisebenza kakuhle. Kwenziwa ukulondolozo okujwayelekileyo kwiimoto nasezixhobeni ngokwemfuno yomenzi weento kunye neenkqubo zokusebenza. Kugcinwa irekhodi lococo olwezixhobo, lolondolozo, olwezonzo kunye neendleko ezinxulumene nalapho kusebenza khona. Kuxhaswa kunye nokuthabatha inxaxheba kwimigaqo yokhuseleko, impilo, okusingqongileyo, ingozi nomgangatho iSHERQ kule candelo. Kuncedwa kumaniso okulungisa okuthintelayo nokuqhuba ukuthintela iingozi eziphantsi ezingcapheleiyo zokusebenza nokuphucula ukuhambelana. Kuthathwa inxaxheba kwiSHERQ ekuqwalaselweni, imisebenzi yokwandisa ulwazi nokuqhubekeka nokuphucula izindululo kule candelo. Kufakwa igalelo ekulelekeni, ekukhuthazeni nakuphuhliseni abasebenzi kule candelo ukuze kuphuculke ukusebenza namandla. Kwabiwa umsebenzi, kujolwa ukusebenza kunye nokunika uluvo lokuxhasa ukuphumeza ngokusebenzayo okukhutshwa ngule candelo. Kuncedwa ekulawulweni ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuhambelana neenkqubo zomthetho zabasebenzi ezifanelekayo.

jobs.title: Artisan Foreman: Equipment Maintenance Electrical
jobs.summary: Artisan Foreman needed at Government Printing Works in Pretoria to maintain and repair electrical equipment, requiring a trade test certificate and five years' post-apprenticeship experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in Electrical (trade tested electrician). Grade 12 will be an added advantage. At least 5 years’ post apprenticeship experience in Equipment and Service Maintenance. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Good knowledge of applicable processes and equipment. Understanding of all relevant human resources legislative framework, regulations and prescripts. Understanding of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, Skills Development Act. A valid driver's license is required.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective and efficient maintenance and repair of equipment: Assist with the accurate analysis of equipment specifications and equipment capacity data and perform mathematical calculations to determine Reliability Centered Maintenance schedules. Support the maintenance of previously established manufacturing sequences and lead times, considering the Maintenance Plan. Monitor the timely issuing of the equipment maintenance plans to Factory Managers. Ensure the escalating and expediting of operations that delay maintenance schedules and production, and alter schedules in collaboration with the Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Monitoring Division, to meet unforeseen circumstances. Conduct regular inspections of all GPW equipment as instructed by GPW management, to identify potential issues, malfunctions, or safety hazards. Establish and execute preventative maintenance programs to ensure the ongoing reliability and longevity of all GPW equipment. Perform and monitor quality assurance ensuring that all maintenance and repair work is compliant with the standards set by GPW: Confer with department/business unit supervisors to determine status and quality of scheduled maintenance. Prepare maintenance and repair reports. Assist in developing and implementing program to improve Mean Time To Repair and Mean Time Between Failure and any other strategic maintenance aspect as instructed by GPW Management. Participate in Safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) in the Division: Comply with all OHSA safety requirements. Monitor and mitigate plant related safety risks. Ensure that SHERQ processes are adhered to. Participate in all SHERQ activities within GPW as and when required. Supervise and develop staff: Participate in and monitor the training programmes in the Division. Conduct performance assessment: Manage attendance, leave, and discipline in accordance with HR prescripts. Observe and participate in the development of policies and procedures: Participate in the developing, review, implementing and complying with the relevant procedures and policies as required by GPW. Keep up to date with new developments in the functional area.
jobs.applications: Link: GPW 26/018
jobs.notes: All attachments for online application must include an application form Z83 and CV only combined, in PDF and as one attachment. NB: Picture/Snapshot, Zipped, IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Use the correct email address associated with the post. Failure to do so, your application will be disqualified. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initiated and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. The Department does not accept applications via fax. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The requirements for application of Senior Management Services (SMS) include the successful completion of a SMS Pre- entry programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School Government (NSG). Prior to appointment, a candidate should therefore have proof that they have registered for the Pre-Entry Certificate and have completed the course. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicants own expense. If you have not been contacted within eight (8) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. af.title: Ambagsman Voorman: Toerustingonderhoud Elektries
af.summary: Ambagsman Voorman benodig by Government Printing Works in Pretoria vir die onderhoud en herstel van elektriese toerusting, wat 'n ambagsertifikaat en vyf jaar se ervaring na leerlingskap vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide leerlingskap. Ambagsertifikaat in Elektries (ambagsgetoetste elektrisiën). Graad 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring na leerlingskap in Toerusting- en Diensonderhoud. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Goeie kennis van toepaslike prosesse en toerusting. Begrip van alle tersaaklike menslike hulpbronne-wetgewende raamwerke, regulasies en voorskrifte. Begrip van Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, Skills Development Act. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe onderhoud en herstel van toerusting: Bystand met die akkurate analise van toerustingsspesifikasies en toerustingkapasiteitsdata en voer wiskundige berekenings uit om BetroubaarheidsGesentreerde Onderhoudskedules te bepaal. Ondersteun die onderhoud van voorheen vasgestelde vervaardigingsreekse en leitye, met inagneming van die Onderhoudsplan. Monitor die tydige uitreiking van die toerustingonderhoudsplanne aan Fabrieksbestuurders. Verseker die eskalering en bespoediging van bedrywighede wat onderhoudskedules en produksie vertraag, en wysig skedules in samewerking met die Onderhoudsbeplanning, Skedulering en Moniteringsafdeling, om aan onvoorsiene omstandighede te voldoen. Voer gereelde inspeksies van alle GPW-toerusting soos deur GPW-bestuur aangedui uit, om potensiële probleme, wanfunksionering of veiligheidsgevare te identifiseer. Vestig en voer voorkomende onderhoudsprogramme uit om die deurlopende betroubaarheid en lewensduur van alle GPW-toerusting te verseker. Voer kwaliteitsversekering uit en monitor dit om te verseker dat alle onderhouds- en herstelwerk aan die standaarde wat deur GPW gestel is, voldoen: Raadpleeg departement/sake-eenheid toesighouers om die status en gehalte van geskeduleerde onderhoud te bepaal. Berei onderhouds- en herstelverslae voor. Bystand met die ontwikkeling en implementering van programme om Mean Time To Repair en Mean Time Between Failure en enige ander strategiese onderhoudsaspek soos deur GPW-bestuur aangedui te verbeter. Neem deel aan Veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en kwaliteit (SHERQ) in die Afdeling: Voldoen aan alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes. Monitor en vermig aanlegverwante veiligheidsrisiko's. Verseker dat SHERQ-prosesse nagekom word. Neem soos en wanneer vereis deel aan alle SHERQ-aktiwiteite binne GPW. Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel: Neem deel aan en monitor opleidingsprogramme in die Afdeling. Voer prestasie评估ing uit: Bestee bywoning, verlof en dissipline ooreenkomstig HR-voorskrifte. Neem kennis van en neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van beleide en prosedures: Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, hersiening, implementering en nakoming van die tersaaklike prosedures en beleide soos deur GPW vereis. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die funksionele gebied.

zu.title: I-Artisan Foreman: Ukugcina Izinto Zokusebenza Kagesi
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Artisan Foreman e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria ukuze kugcinwe kulungiswe izinto zokusebenza kagesi, kudingwa isitifikedi senhlolovo yobuchwepheshe kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohluvo lokusebenza ngemva kokuzijwayeza.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma izifundo ezingangayo kanye nokuzijwayeza okuqediwe. Isitifikedi Senhlolovo Yobuchwepheshe ku-Electrical (umuntu ohlolwe ohlinzeka ngesiminya kagesi). I-Grade 12 izoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yohluvo lokusebenza ngemva kokuzijwayeza ekugcineni nasekuhloleni izinto zokusebenza. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa okuhle kokuvikeleka. Ulwazi oluhle ngamaprothesi ahambisana nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuqonda zonke izixhumanisi zomthetho ezihlobene namabasebenzi, imitheshwana kanye nemiyalo. Ukuqonda umthetho wesevisi kahulumeni, imitheshwana yesevisi kahulumeni, umthetho wezomphatho, umthetho wezidingo zokuqonda, ukuphathwa kwe-Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ), nomthetho wezidingo zokuqonda. Kudingwa ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokulungiswa okusebenzayo kwezinto zokusebenza: Siza nokuhlaziya okunembile izinkomba zezinto zokusebenza kanye nedatha yamandla ezinto zokusebenza bese wenza izibalo ukuze unqume izikleli Zokugcina Okuqinisekisiwe. Sekela ukugcina okwakhiwe ngaphambili kokuqhubeka kokwenza nokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubukele iNqubo Yokugcina. Bheka ukuphiwa ngesikhathi seziqondiso zokugcina izinto zokusebenza kubaphathi Bezimbona. Qinisekisa ukwanda nokuqhuba imisebenzi ephazamisa izikleli zokugcina nokukhiqiza, bese uhlela kabusha izikleli ngokubambisana neNqubo Yokuhlela, Ukuhlela Isikhathi Nokubheka KwabaHleli, ukuze uhlangabezane nezimo ezingazange zibikezelwe. Yenza ukuphenya njalo konke izinto zokusebenza zika-GPW njengoba kuyalelwa yilawulo le-GPW, ukuze uhlole izinkinga ezingaba khona, ukungasebenzi kahle, noma imingcele yokuvikeleka. Suka wenze amaphulo okugcina okuzivikela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthembeka okuqhubekayo nobomi obude konke izinto zokusebenza zika-GPW. Yenza ubheke ukulingana komgangatho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke ukugcina nokulungiswa kuhambisana namazinga abekwe yi-GPW: Xoxa nosihlalo bomnyango/yesigaba senhlangano ukunquma isimo nomgangatho wokugcina okuhleliwe. Hlenga imibhalo yokugcina nokulungiswa. Siza ekwakheni nokuphoqa uhlelo ukuthuthukisa Isikhathi Esiphakathi Sokulungisa kanye Nesikhathi Esiphakathi Phakathi Kokwehla, nakunoma iyipipho enye indlela yokugcina ngokobuchwepheshe njengoba kuyalelwa yilawulo le-GPW. Hlanganyela ezokusiki, ekuqondeni ukuphila, emzileni, nasemgangathweni (SHERQ) esigabeni: Hambisana nawo wonke amadingo okuvikeleka we-OHSA. Bheka ususe imingcele yokuvikeleka ehlobene nesitshalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela ze-SHERQ zilandelwa. Hlanganyela kuyo yonke imisebenzi ye-SHERQ ngaphakathi kwa-GPW lapho kudingeka khona. Qapha uthuthukise abasebenzi: Hlanganyela bubeke amaphulo okudidiyela esigabeni. Yenza ukuhlola ukusebenza: Phatha ubukhona, ukuhamba kanye nesimo sokuziphatha ngokomthetho we-HR. Buka ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo nemicimbo: Hlanganyela ekwakheni, ukubuyeza, ukuphoqa nokuhambisana nemimiselo ephathelene nayo nezinqubomgomo njengoba kudingwa yi-GPW. Gcina ulwazi lwamuva nje ngemithuthukisi emhlabeni ohlobene nomsebenzi.

xh.title: Omane wabaBazi: Ukulungisa izixhobo zombane
xh.summary: Kufuneka omane wababazi kwi-Government Printing Works ePretoria ukugcina nokulungisa izixhobo zombane, kwaye kufuneka unabhaso lovavayo lwe-trade test kwaye unamashumi eminyaka emi-5 yokuba ngumkhotha-kakhulu.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 okanye izimvo ezingangayo ezongezelelweyo ngokubakho kwesiNgcazi sokuziphilisa nokuba ngumfundi we-apprenticeship. Isatifikethi se-Trade Test kwi-Electrical (njengomcholi-gquma ovuliweyo). I-Grade 12 iya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Apho ngaphezulu kwenyanga emi-5 yokuba ngumfundi we-apprenticeship kulungiselelo lwe-Equipment nakulungiselelo lwe-Service Maintenance. Kufuneka abe nethamsanqa lemvume yokungeniswa kwesixhobo esinombane. Ulwazi oluhle ngemichilo yokusebenza nangezixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqonda kwakho konke naqondo apho incwadiso yabasebenzi, imigaqo nemiqathango edibeneyo. Ukuqonda kwakhe kwe-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, ne-Skills Development Act. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokulungiswa kwezixhobo ngokusebenziseleko nangempumelelo: Sika ngesixhobo iinkcukacha ze-equipment specifications nantlu yobungakanani bezixhobo uze ukwenze imibalo yokumisela iReliability Centered Maintenance schedules. Sekela ukugcinwa kokulandelana kwezinto ezenziwayo ekuqhuba ngaphambili naxeshana alindelwe ukwenziwa, kuthathelwa ingqalelo iNqguqo yokugcina. Yiba nomdla wokwazisa iinkqubo zokugcinwa kwezixhobo kubaphathi be-Factory. Qinisekisa ukwandiswa nokushiya ngenkani imisebenzi ekubambe ixesha lokuqwalasela nokulungelelanisa imigqabo, kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo ngokubambisana ne-Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Monitoring Division, ukuze uhambelane nezigqibo ezingaqiqwanga. Yenza iindaba ezihlala zijolise kakhulu kuzo zonke izixhobo ze-GPW njengoko kuqatshiwe ngulawulo le-GPW, ukuze abone iingxaki ezingase zibangele, ukungasebenzi, okanye iingozi ezingabakho. Misela uze uphumeze iinkqubo zokuthintela iingozi ukuze uqinisekise ukuzinza nokuhlala isixhobo sisebenza isithuba eside kuzo zonke izixhobo ze-GPW. Yenza uze ulawule ukukholisa ngokugqibelela ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yokugcina nokulungisa ihambelana neendidi ezisiwe ngu-GPW: Thethathetha namaphini abasebenzi beproje (department/business unit) ukuze umisela isimo nangondleko yokugcina izinto ebesigqwesile. Lungiselela iindaba zokugcina nokulungisa izixhobo. Sika ncedo ekuyilweni nakuphumezelelweni kweenkqubo zokuphucula i-Mean Time To Repair ne-Mean Time Between Failure nakuyo nayiphi na enye indlela yokugcina ezibalulekileyo njengoko kuqatshiwe nguMdla we-GPW. Thatha inxaxheba kwi-Safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) kulo Mnyanya: Hambelana nezidingo zonke ze-OHSA Safety. Lawula uze unciphise iingozi ezibangelwa nzimbuzi. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ze-SHERQ zilandelwa. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo ze-SHERQ ngaphakathi kwi-GPW njengoko kudingeka. Lawula uze uphuhlise abantu: Thatha inxaxheba uze ulawule iinkqubo zolungiso kulo Mnyanya. Yenza ukulinganisa ngokusebenza: Lawula ukubakho, ukushiya, nolawulo ngokulandela imigaqo ye-HR. Qwalasela uthathe inxaxheba kuphuhliso lwemigaqo nolwemikhakha: Thatha inxaxheba ekuyilweni, ekuphononongweni, ekuphumezelelweni nakulandeleni imigaqo namakhulu amaqumrhu afanelekileyo njengoko kufunwa yi-GPW. Hlala ulwazi ngokuphuhliswa kwamathuba amasha kwindawo esetyenziswa.

jobs.title: Artisan (SPECIALISED) Sheet- FED Printing
jobs.summary: The Government Printing Works seeks a specialised sheet-fed printing artisan in Pretoria to produce high-volume printed documents, requiring a Trade Test Certificate and five years' post-apprenticeship experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding. Grade 12 will be an advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Minimum of 5 years post apprenticeship appropriate experience in Lithography Sheet- Fed Machine Minding in a printing production environment. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Render Sheet-Fed printing of high-volume documents. Provide support in the process of the production of high sheet-fed commercial printing that complies with the quality and standards required by the customer. Ensure quality control over the produced printed matter, ensuring accurate and high-quality printing and reduction of wastage. Identify proactive possible bottlenecks and apply continuous improvement measures to the production process, including investigating the implementation of World Class Manufacturing methodology. Plan, schedule and priorities the production workflow to meet client deadlines and quality standards. Optimize production processes to increase efficiency and reduce waste while maintaining high-quality standards. Administer quality control. Implement and enforce quality control procedures to ensure that printed materials meet client specifications and industry standards. Ensure regular machine maintenance. Ensure that the machine/equipment maintenance is incorporated in the planning of the Division’s production process to proactively prevent delays in the delivery of printed matters. Participate in the maintenance and repairs of sheet-fed printing presses and related equipment. Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions and coordinate repairs to minimize production disruptions. Provide support with training, coaching and developing staff in the Division. Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members based on their skills and experience. Provide support in training and guidance to employees on printing techniques, equipment operation and quality control procedures. Participate in safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHREQ) in the Division. Assess and mitigate planned related safety risks. Supervise and develop staff. Allocate and check work of staff as well as conduct performance reviews as per GPW policy.

af.title: Ambagsman (GESPECIALISEERD) Velvoer - FED Drukwerk
af.summary: Die Government Printing Works soek 'n gespecialiseerde velvoer-drukambagsman in Pretoria om hoëvolume gedrukte dokumente te produseer, waarvoor 'n Vaktoetsertifikaat en vyf jaar se ervaring na leerlingskap vereis word.
af.requirements: Grade 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide leerlingskap. Vaktoetsertifikaat in Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding. Grade 12 sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklarans te verkry. Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring na leerlingskap in Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding in 'n drukproduksie-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Lewer velvoer-drukwerk van hoëvolume dokumente. Verskaf ondersteuning in die proses van die produksie van hoë velvoer-kommersiële drukwerk wat voldoen aan die gehalte en standaarde wat deur die klant vereis word. Verseker gehaltebeheer oor die geproduseerde drukwerk, wat akkurate en hoëgehalte-drukwerk en die vermindering van vermorsing verseker. Identifiseer proaktiewe moontlike knelpunte en pas deurlopende verbeteringsmaatreëls toe op die produksieproses, insluitend die ondersoek van die implementering van World Class Manufacturing-metodologie. Beplan, skeduleer en prioriteer die produksiewerkvloei om kliënt sperdatums en gehaltestandaarde te haal. Optimaliseer produksieprosesse om doeltreffendheid te verhoog en vermorsing te verminder terwyl hoë gehaltestandaarde gehandhaaf word. Administreer gehaltebeheer. Implementeer en handhaaf gehaltebeheerprosedures om te verseker dat gedrukte materiaal aan kliëntspesifikasies en nywerheidsstandaarde voldoen. Verseker gereelde masjienonderhoud. Verseker dat masjien/toerustingonderhoud ingesluit word in die beplanning van die Divisie se produksieproses om proaktief vertragings in die aflewering van drukwerk te voorkom. Neem deel aan die onderhoud en herstel van velvoer-drukperse en verwante toerusting. Los toerustingwanfunksies op en koördineer herstelwerk om produksie-onderbrekings te minimaliseer. Verskaf ondersteuning met opleiding, afrigting en ontwikkeling van personeel in die Divisie. Wys take en verantwoordelikhede aan spanlede toe op grond van hul vaardighede en ervaring. Verskaf ondersteuning in opleiding en leiding aan werknemers oor druktegnieke, toerustingbedrywing en gehaltebeheerprosedures. Neem deel aan sekuriteit, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHREQ) in die Divisie. Assesseer en verminder beplande verwante sekuriteitsrisiko's. Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel. Allokeer en kontroleer werk van personeel asook voer prestasie-evaluerings uit volgens GPW-beleid.

zu.title: Ishumi Lemisebenzi (EKUQOTHULWA KHONA) Sheet- FED Printing
zu.summary: I-Government Printing Works ifuna ishumi lemisebenzi eliqothulwe ekuqoqweni kwamaphepha e-Pretoria ukukhiqiza amadokhenta aphrintiwe angenisa inani elikhulu, okudinga isitifikedi se-Trade Test nokutholakala kweminyaka emihlanu yokuqashwa ngemva kokufunda umsebenzi wekhabi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye nokwesedwa okuqediwe kokufunda umsebenzi wekhabi. Isitifikedi se-Trade Test ku-Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding. I-Grade 12 izoba ngusizo. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukulungiselelwa okuhle kokuvikeleka. Umkhathi weminyaka eyi-5 ngemva kokufunda umsebenzi wekhabi wokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile ku-Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding endaweni yokukhiqiza ukuprinta. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile izoba ngosizo olwengeziwe.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokuprinta kwe-Sheet-Fed kwamadokhenta angenisa inani elikhulu. Nikela ngokwesekela enqubweni yokukhiqiza ukuprinta kwezohwebo okuphakeme okwenziwe ngephepha elilodwa okuhambisana nekhwalithi nemigidingo efunwa umthengi. Qinisekisa ukulawula ikhwalithi kumagumbi aphrintiwe okukhiqiziwe, ukuqinisekisa ukuprinta okunembile nokunekhwalithi ephezulu kanye nokunciphisa ukuphonsa. Hlonza izikhawulezisi ezithweswe nthamvama ezibonakalayo futhi usebenzise izindlela zokuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo enkqubweni yokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa ukuphenya ukusetshenziswa kwe-World Class Manufacturing methodology. Hlela, dlulela futhi ukuqale ukubaluleka kwenqubo yokukhiqiza ukuze uhlangabezane nemikhawulo yomthengi nemigidingo yekhwalithi. Yenza ukuthi inqubo yokukhiqiza ibe yilesi esebenza kahle ukwandisa ukusebenza kahle futhi unciphe ukuphonsa ngenkathi ulondoloza imigidingo yekhwalithi ephezulu. Lawula ukulawulwa kokuhamba kwenqubo. Setha futhi uphoqelele izinqubo zokulawula ikhwalithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto eziphrintiwe zihlangabezana nezinkomba zomthengi kanye nemigidingo yembona. Qinisekisa ukulondolozwa kwesikhathi esijwayelekile kwemishini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulondolozwa kwemishini/izinto zokusebenza kufakwe ekuhlelweni kwenqubo yokukhiqiza yoMnyango ukuze kuqothulwe ngaphambilini ukubambezeleka ekulethweni kwamagumbi aphrintiwe. Thatha inxaxheba ekulondolozweni nasekulungisweni kwemishini yokuprinta e-Sheet-Fed kanye nezinto zokusebenza ezihlobene. Hlola ukungaluki kahle kwemishini futhi uhleba ukulungiswa ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphazamiseka kokukhiqiza. Nikela ngokwesekela ekufundiseni, ukwelulekeni nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi koMnyango. Abela abalaleli bemisebenzi nemitimela abaqeqeshiwe ngokusekelwa kukho nangokuhlangenwe nakho kwabo. Nikela ngokwesekela ekufundiseni nokuqondisa abasebenzi ngobuchwepheshe bokuprinta, ukusebenza kwemishini noma izinqubo zokulawula ikhwalithi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuvikelekweni, ezempilweni, emgilikhanyeni, ezingozini nasekhwalithi (SHREQ) koMnyango. Hlola futhi unciphise izingozi ezingaba khona ngokuvikeleka ezibhangqa. Qaphula futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Abela futhi uhlole umsebenzi wabasebenzi kanye nokwenza ukubuyekeza ukusebenza ngokuvumelana nenqubo ye-GPW.

xh.title: Umenzi wesandla (OCHUKIWEYO) Ushicilelo lweShiti-FED
xh.summary: I-Government Printing Works ifuna umenzi wesandla ochukiweyo woshicilelo lweshiti-FED ePretoria ukwenza imibhalo eshicilelweyo ngesixa esikhulu, kufuneka ifake isatifikedi se-Trade Test kunye neminye emihlanu yamava emva kwesikhathi sokungenwa kurhwebo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo ezongezelelwe kukugqitywa kwesikhathi sokungenwa kurhwebo. Isatifikedi se-Trade Test kwi-Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding. I-Grade 12 iya kuba lusizo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isikhululo sokhuseleko esihle. Ubuncinane beminye emihlanu yamava afanelekileyo emva kokungenwa kurhwebo kwi-Lithography Sheet-Fed Machine Minding kwindawo yokukhiqiza ushicilelo. Ilayisenesi yokuqeshisa esetshenzwayo emthethweni iya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Kwenza ushicilelo lweShiti-Fed lwemibhalo enesixa esikhulu. Kubonelela ngenkxaso kwindlela yokukhiqiza ushicilelo loshicilelo loshicilelo lwebhizinisi olunamaphepha amanininzi alingana namalinga nobuhlobo bokuqinisekiswa abafunwa ngumthengi. Kuqinisekisa ulawulo lokhakihla kwimveliso ekhishiweyo egqityiweyo, kuqinisekisa ushicilelo oluchanekileyo nolungangcalo kwaye kunciphisa ukutshatyalaliswa kwempahla. Kubonisa ngaphambili iindlela ezinokubakhona ezingela ukuphumelela kwenkqabo kwaye kusebenzise iziphakamiso zokuphucula ngokoluqo inkqabo yokukhiqiza, kuquka nokuqwalasela ukusebenzisa i-World Class Manufacturing methodology. Kucwangcisa, yahlulelisa kwaye kube nezinto ezibalulekileyo kumjikelo wemisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukuze kugqitywe ngemixesha ebekwe ngumxhasi nangamazinga okhakihla. Kuphucula iinkqabo zokukhiqiza ukwandisa ukusebenza kakuhle kwaye kunciphise ukutshatyalaliswa kwempahla ngelixa kugcinwa amaqondo aphezulu okhakihla. Kulawula ulawulo lokhakihla. Kusebenzisa kwaye kuqinisekisa iinkqabo zolawulo lokhakihla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izinto ezishiicilelwayo zihambelana neemfuno zamaxhhasi namazinga weshishini. Kuqinisekisa ukwakhiswa okungenamaphupha kwemichini. Kuqinisekisa ukuba ukwakhiswa kwemichini/impahla kufakwe kwindlela yokucwangcisa inkqabo yokukhiqiza kwi-Division ukuze kuqaliswe ngaphambili ukuthintela ukulibaziseka ekulekeni imibhalo egqityiweyo. Kuthatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni nokulungenisweni kweeshicilelo zamaphepha-FED nemichini edityanisiweyo. Kusombulula iingenelo zokungasebenzi kakuhle kwemichini kwaye kuququzelele ukulungiswa ukunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kokukhiqiza. Kubonelela ngenkxaso yokuzigulisa, ukuyala nokuphucula abasebenzi kwi-Division. Kawabela imisebenzi nawamanyathelo abaqeqeshi abaqeqeshi ngokusekelwe kulwazi lwabo. Kubonelela ngenkxaso yokuzigulisa nokuqeqesha abasebenzi kwindlela zoshicilelo, ukusebenza kwemichini neenkqabo zolawulo lokhakihla. Kuthabatha inxaxheba ekhuselekeni, empilweni, kwindalo, kwiingozi nolawulo (SHREQ) kwi-Division. Kubuye aziqhelanise nokunciphisa iingozi ezinxulumene nocwangciso. Kulawula kwaye kuphucule abasebenzi. Kabahlele kwaye ahlole imisebenzi yabasebenzi kanjalo nokuqwalasela ukwenza komzimba njengoko kumalunga ne-GPW policy.

af.title: Ambagsman (GESPESSIALISEERD): Produksie (HANDAMBAG Boekband /
af.summary: Die Government Printing Works in Pretoria soek 'n gespesialiseerde ambagsman in handboekbindery om afwerkingsprosesse te bestuur en werkvloei oor produksie-eenhede te koördineer.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap. Vaktoetsertifikaat in Printing, Craft Book Binding of Mechanised Binding. Graad 12 sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. ISO-ervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 5 jaar se na-vakleerlingskap toepaslike ervaring in Craft Book Binding of Mechanised Binding in 'n relevante drukkerijomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestuur van afwerkingsprosesse wat handboekbindery en gemeganiseerde bindprosesse insluit om aan kliëntvereistes en skedules te voldoen. Koördineer met Prepress, Press, Finishing en ander besigheids eenhede om gladde werkvloei en tydige voltooiing van projekte te verseker. Bestuur van handmatige binding en outomatiese of semi-outomatiese toerusting. Verseker van kwaliteitsversekering, uitvoer van kwaliteitskontroles, identifisering van defekte en implementering van regstellende maatreëls. Verskaf en beheer van produksiemateriaal, kontroleer van voorraad en rapporteer van tekorte. Onderhou en herstel binding-, afwerkings-, sny- en alle ander toerusting in die afdeling deur inspeksies, skoonmaak en geskeduleerde onderhoud. Ondersteun van SHERQ-vereistes, insluitend veiligheids-, gesondheids-, omgewings-, risiko- en kwaliteitinisiatiewe. Oplei, afrig, toesig hou en ontwikkel van personeel, insluitend die uitvoer van prestasie-evaluerings. Neem deel aan beleids- en strategieontwikkeling terwyl voldoening aan GPW-produksieprosedures verseker word. Neem waar, neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van beleide en strategieë asook die opdatering en indiening van produksiestatistieke en verslae daagliks, weekliks en maandeliks. Bind en afwerking van gedrukte en ongedrukte materiaal. Hou toesig oor, ontwikkel personeel en voer prestasie-evaluerings uit volgens GPW-beleid.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wesandla (OKUQONDISWE KUQOLO): Ukukhiqiza (Ukubopha Izincwadi ngobuciko /
