Isitifiketi se-Trade Test ekuPhapusheni, Ekubopheni Izincwadi ngobuciko noma Ekubopheni ngezinshicilelwi. I-Grade 12 kuzoba yinzuzo. Kufanele ukwazi ukuthola isiqinisekiso sokuvikeleka esinhle. Amava e-ISO kuzoba yinzuzo engezwe. Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 wangemuva kwe-apprenticeship amava afanele ekubopheni izincwadi ngobuciko noma ekubopheni ngezinshicilelwi endaweni yokuphapha ehlobene. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehlayisiwe kuzoba yinzuzo engezwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinqubo zokugqiba okubandakanya ukubopha izincwadi ngobuciko, izinqubo zokubopha ngezinshicilelwi ukuze kuhlangabezwe nezidingo zal Abathengi namashejuli. Ukuhleba nabasebenzi be-Prepress, be-Press, be-Finishing nanabanye ukwazi ukuthi kugeleze kahle umsebenzi futhi kuqedwe ngesikhathi. Ukuphatha ukubopha ngezandla nolwelwimi oluzenzakalayo noma oluhhalfa-oluzenzakalayo. Ukuqinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi, ukuhlola ikhwalithi, ukuthola iziphazekisi, nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokulungisa. Ukuthola nokuqaphela okokukhiqiza, ukuhlola isitoko nokubika ezingenela. Ukugcina nokulungisa ukubopha, ukugqiba, ukusika yonke eminye imishini kwicebe ngokuhlola, ukucoca futhi ngokwenziwa isipiliyoni njalo njalo. Ukusekela izidingo ze-SHERQ, okubandakanya izinhloso zokuphepha, ezempilo, zendalo,engozi neyekhwalithi. Ukufundisa, ukuqondisa, ukubuka futhi ukuthuthukisa abasebenzi, okubandakanya ukuhlola ukusebenza. Ukuthathana nxazonqamulaziKho: kulandisa(ngqo: nothatha)

xh.title: Isisebenzi seesiseko ngokungangeni kwigumbi lokwenza: Ukwenziwa komsebenzi (CRAFT Book Binding /
xh.summary: I Government Printing Works e Pretoria ifuna isisebenzi esizodwa kubucha bobugcisa bokubopha ukubopha izinto ezingezantsi ekubeni kubekho imisebenzi yokugqibela nokuzekeze ukungqina umsebenzi phakathi kwezinye iindawo ezikwisiseko esakhiwo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 okanye izidanga ezingaphezu kwezo ezifanayo ngesiqu esiqulunqwe ngomfundi one-expertise kwiziqu ezingamava, ezisuka kumsebenzi wokuqhutywa ngexesha elithileyo. Isatifikethi seTrade Test kwisicelo seprinta, ukubopha izicwetheqa okanye ukubopha ngemishini. I-Grade 12 iba ngowamkelelo kuluntu. Kubalulekile ukuba abe nerekhodi elihle lokhuseleko. Ulwazi kwi-ISO luya kuba lusanda ngamava. Iminyaka engu-5 isiphi sidlule kokungenisa kwabafundi abangenayo kwiziqu kubandakanya amava amnkeni ezingozi ngenkonzo kwindalo iphela yokubopha isicwetheq.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkqubo zokugqibela eziquka ukubopha izicwetheqa ngesandla, iinkqubo zokubopha ngemishini ukuze zihambelane neemfuno zabo nakwishedyuli yabathengi. Ukusebenzisana namaphondo e-Prepress, iPress, eFinishing namanye amaphondo omthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho ukuhamba kakuhle komsebenzi nokuphela kwamaxamaphefumlo ngexesha elichanekileyo. Ukulawula ukubopha ngesandla nempahla eqhuba ngokuzenzekelayo okanye ngokuzenzekela. Ukuqinisekisa izinga lobuchwepheshe, ukuwenza iingqinamba zokulinganisa, ukuqaphela iimpazamo, nokuzekeza iinyameko zokulungisa. Ukuza nokulawula izinto zokwenziwa, ukuhlola isitokhwe nokuxela ukungabikho. Ukugcina nokuqonda iimpazazo kubophelelo, ekuvalweni, ekusikeni nakuyo yonke eminye imishini kwicandela ngokwenziwa kweepontsho, ukucoca kunye nolondolozo olucwangciswe kwishedyuli. Ukuxhasa iimfuno ze-SHERQ, kuquka iziphithiphathi zokhuseleko, empilweni, endalo, engozi nakwingqwalasela. Ukuzisa, ukulunga, ukulawula nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi, kuquka nokwenza iingqinamba zokulinganisa inkqubo yemisebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwakhiwo lwemigaqo nolwamaqabiso ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zokwenziwa kwi-GPW. Kuqatshelwe, ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenziweni kwemigaqo namaqabiso, nangaphezulu kokulungisa noku fake iibalo zokwenziwa neemvoo nsuku zonke, ngeveki nangeyinyanga. Ukubopha nokugqibela izinto ezingashicilelwanga nyanzelekile. Ukulawula, ukuphuhlisa abasebenzi ukubakhokelela imigaqo yokuqwalasela inkqubo njengoko kushiwo kwimigaqo ye-GPW.

jobs.title: Chief Production Clerk: Travel and ID Document
jobs.summary: Chief Production Clerk managing travel and ID document distribution at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring Grade 12 and 3 years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Minimum of 3 years’ appropriate experience in the industry. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Knowledge of processes and equipment. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. The incumbent will be required to work rotating shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and night shifts, based on operational requirement. Extended working hours may be required. Ability to communicate with all levels of management. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Monitor the movement, work in progress, and distribution of documents: Plan and schedule the Section’s work to ensure the timely and correct distribution to the High Security Dispatch Division, the couriers and customers. Check that all the batches of documents sent from the Personalisation Section and Quality Control were received Coordinate and monitor production workflow, work-in- progress and the movement and distribution of high-security printed materials. Plan and schedule the Section’s activities to ensure the timely completion and correct distribution of documents to internal divisions, couriers and customers. Collaborate with relevant departments and business units, including design, prepress, printing, personalisation, quality control, finishing and dispatch, to facilitate the smooth flow and timely completion of production activities. Verify that all batches received from production sections and Quality Control are accurately recorded, securely transferred and signed for. Ensure the proper preparation of finished goods for dispatch, including the accurate application and verification of customer information, delivery addresses, waybills and supporting documentation. Expedite urgent documents, track outstanding or delayed jobs on production systems, and follow up to resolve production or distribution delays. Coordinate with internal departments, external parties, shipping companies and courier service providers to arrange transportation and ensure the accurate and timely delivery of printed materials. Monitor shipment progress, trace dispatched materials, follow up on proof of delivery, and address delivery discrepancies or delays. Process waybills, proof-of- delivery documentation, courier invoices and allocation notices. Maintain accurate records of finished goods transferred and distributed. Monitor and maintain inventory levels of printing materials, supplies and consumables, including paper, ink and other production-related items. Track usage, initiate replenishment where required, and maintain an organised inventory system to prevent shortages or excessive stock. Ensure that the Section and its employees are adequately equipped and resourced. Keep and manage accurate records, registers, statistics and correspondence. Use applicable digital systems and software to capture, organise, store, retrieve and report information efficiently. Maintain the Section’s filing system, incoming and outgoing correspondence registers, movement registers and signed handover documentation. Prepare basic letters, reports and other correspondence, respond to routine enquiries, and submit accurate reports within the prescribed timeframes. Manage safety, health, environment, risk and quality within the Section. Ensure compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, SHERQ requirements, security controls and all applicable GPW production policies and procedures. Ensure that all procedures and systems relating to the handling, movement, storage and protection of high-security printed materials are strictly observed. Provide administrative and logistical support to the Section. Administer leave, attendance, timesheets, overtime approvals, overtime claims, time corrections and personnel records. Maintain accurate leave and attendance registers and ensure that all supporting documentation is completed and submitted within the required timeframes. Facilitate the effective management of procurement, equipment, materials and facilities within the Section. Supervise and manage employees within the Section. Allocate, coordinate and monitor the work of staff and provide functional and technical guidance. Conduct performance reviews in accordance with GPW policies, promote teamwork, and apply disciplinary measures in accordance with applicable prescripts and procedures when necessary. Assist with the administration and coordination of staff training, coaching and development. Participate in the development, review and implementation of relevant policies, procedures and operational systems. Research and remain informed of technological developments, digital systems and emerging practices within the printing and distribution environment to support continuous improvement, operational efficiency and the maintenance of high-quality standards.

af.title: Hoofproduksieklerk: Reis- en ID-dokument
af.summary: Hoofproduksieklerk wat verspreiding van reis- en ID-dokumente by Government Printing Works in Pretoria bestuur, met Grade 12 en 3 jaar se relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Grade 12-sertifikaat. Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in die bedryf. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Kennis van prosesse en toerusting. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Die ampsdraer sal vereis word om roterende skofte te werk, insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagskofte, gebaseer op operasionele vereistes. Uitgebreide werksure mag vereis word. Vermoë om met alle vlakke van bestuur te kommunikeer. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Monitor die beweging, werk in vooruitgang en verspreiding van dokumente: Beplan en skeduleer die afdeling se werk om tydige en korrekte verspreiding aan die Hoëveiligheidsversendingsafdeling, die koeriers en kliënte te verseker. Kontroleer dat al die bondels dokumente wat vanaf die Persoonlikingsafdeling en Kwaliteitsbeheer gestuur is, ontvang is. Koördineer en monitor produksiewerkvloei, werk-in-vooruitgang en die beweging en verspreiding van hoëveiligheidsgedrukte materiaal. Beplan en skeduleer die afdeling se aktiwiteite om die tydige voltooiing en korrekte verspreiding van dokumente aan interne afdelings, koeriers en kliënte te verseker. Werk saam met relevante departemente en besigheidseenhede, insluitend ontwerp, pre-pers, drukwerk, personalisering, kwaliteitsbeheer, afwerking en versending, om die gladde vloei en tydige voltooiing van produksie-aktiwiteite te fasiliteer. Verifieer dat alle bondels wat van produksie-afdelings en Kwaliteitsbeheer ontvang is, akkuraat aangeteken, veilig oorgedra en vir geteken is. Verseker die behoorlike voorbereiding van voltooide goedere vir versending, insluitend die akkurate toepassing en verifikasie van kliëntinligting, afleweringsadresse, vragbriewe en ondersteunende dokumentasie. Bespoedig dringende dokumente, hou uitstaande of vertraagde take op produksiestelsels dop, en volg op om produksie- of verspreidingsvertragings op te los. Koördineer met interne departemente, eksterne partye, verskepingsmaatskappye en koeriersdiensverskaffers om vervoer te reël en akkurate en tydige aflewering van gedrukte materiaal te verseker. Monitor vordering van verskeping, spoor versende materiaal op, volg op op afleweringsbewyse, en hanteer afleweringsafwykings of vertragings. Verwerk vragbriewe, afleweringsbewysdokumentasie, koeriersfakture en toekenningkennisgewings. Onderhou akkurate rekords van voltooide goedere wat oorgedra en versprei is. Monitor en handhaaf voorraadvlakke van drukmateriaal, voorrade en verbruiksgoedere, insluitend papier, ink en ander produksieverwante items. Hou gebruik dop, inisieer aanvulling waar nodig, en handhaaf 'n georganiseerde voorraadstelsel om tekorte of oormatige voorraad te voorkom. Verseker dat die afdeling en sy werknemers toereikend toegerus en beman is. Hou en bestuur akkurate rekords, registers, statistieke en korrespondensie. Gebruik toepaslike digitale stelsels en sagteware om inligting doeltreffend vas te lê, te organiseer, te stoor, op te haal en te rapporteer. Handhaaf die afdeling se lêerstelsel, inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensieregisters, bewegingsregisters en getekende oorhandigingsdokumentasie. Berei basiese briewe, verslae en ander korrespondensie voor, reageer op roetine-navrae, en dien akkurate verslae binne die voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke in. Bestuur veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en kwaliteit binne die afdeling. Verseker nakoming van die Beroepsveiligheids- en Gesondheidswet, SHERQ-vereistes, veiligheidskontroles en alle toepaslike GPW-produksiebeleide en -prosedures. Verseker dat alle prosedures en stelsels rakende die hantering, beweging, berging en beskerming van hoëveiligheidsgedrukte materiaal streng nagekom word. Verskaf administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuning aan die afdeling. Administreer verlof, bywoning, tydstaatblaaie, oortydgoedkeurings, oortydeise, tydkorrekies en personeelrekords. Handhaaf akkurate verlof- en bywoningsregisters en verseker dat alle ondersteunende dokumentasie binne die vereiste tydraamwerke voltooi en ingedien word. Fasiliteer die effektiewe bestuur van verkryging, toerusting, materiaal en fasiliteite binne die afdeling. Ouloë en bestuur werknemers binne die afdeling. Wys toe, koördineer en monitor die werk van personeel en verskaf funksionele en tegniese leiding. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit ooreenkomstig GPW-beleide, bevorder spanwerk, en pas dissiplinêre maatreëls toe ooreenkomstig toepaslike voorskrifte en prosedures wanneer nodig. Bystand verleen met die administrasie en koördinasie van personeelopleiding, afrigting en ontwikkeling. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van relevante beleide, prosedures en operasionele stelsels. Doen navorsing en bly ingelig oor tegnologiese ontwikkelings, digitale stelsels en ontluikende praktyke binne die druk- en verspreidingsomgewing om deurlopende verbetering, operasionele doeltreffendheid en die handhawing van hoë gehalte-standaarde te ondersteun.

zu.title: I-Clerk Elikhulu Lemvelo: Ukuhamba namadokhumenti Ekhishini
zu.summary: I-Clerk Elikhulu Lemvelo eliphatha ukusatshalaliswa kwamadokhumenti okuhamba nasekhishini e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, elidinga i-Grade 12 neminyaka emi-3 yohlu lwemisebenzi ehambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. Okungenani eminyaka emi-3 yohlu lwemisebenzi oluhambisanayo emhlabeni wemisebenzi. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukusulwa okuhle ngokuvikeleko. Ulwazi ngezingqikithi zomsebenzi nemishini. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukusulwa okuhle ngokuvikeleko. Lowo othathwa kulesi sikhundla kuzofuneka asebenze izikhathi eziguquguqukayo, okuhlanganisa amasonto, izihlabelelo zikazwelonke, nezikhathi zasemini nasebusuku, ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zokusebenza. Kungase kudingeke ukusebenza amahora amanedlule. Ikono lokuxhumana namazinga onke abaphathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinzuzo ekungeyona ebalulekile.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukunyakaza, umsebenzi oya phambili, nokusatshalaliswa kwamadokhumenti: Cwangcisa futhi uhlele umsebenzi wesiHlu ukuze kuqiniseke ukusatshalaliswa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele ku-High Security Dispatch Division, kubathunyeli nakumakhaya. Hlola ukuthi wonke amaqoqo amadokhumenti athunyelwe ku-Personalisation Section naku-Quality Control amukelekile. Hlela futhi ulawule ukuphela komsebenzi wemvelo, umsebenzi oya phambili, kanye nokunyakaza nokusatshalaliswa kwemishini eshibhile epajiwe. Cwangcisa futhi uhlele izinhlela zesiHlu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugqitywa ngokushesha nokusatshalaliswa okufanele kwamadokhumenti emaphakethweni angaphakathi, kubathunyeli nakumakhaya. Sebenzisana neminyango ehambisanayo namayunithi ebhizinisi, okuhlanganisa ukwakha, ukulungiselela ngaphambi koshicilelo, ukushicilela, ukwenza okumuntu ngamunye, ukulawula ikhwalithi, ukugqitya nokuthumela, ukuze kuthuthuke ukuphela okuhambayo nokugqitywa ngokushesha kwezinhlelo zemvelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaqoqo amukelwe emaphakethweni emvelo naku-Quality Control abhalwe ngokunembile, adluliselwe ngokuphephile futhi asayinwe. Qinisekisa ukulungiselela okufanele kwemikhiqizo egqityiwe yokuthunyelwa, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa ngokunembile nokuhlolwa kolwazi lukamakhaya, amakheli okulethwa, amawayibhili namadokhumenti asekelayo. Sheshisa amadokhumenti abalulekile, landela imisebenzi ehlala ingaqedwa noma elibazise kumasistimu emvelo, ulandele ukuxazulula ukulibazisa komsebenzi noma ukusatshalaliswa. Hlela phakathi kweminyango engaphakathi, abantu bangaphandle, amakampani okuthumela kanye nabathunyeli besevisi ukuze kuhlelwe ukuthutha futhi kuqiniseke ukulethwa ngokunembile nangokushesha kwemishini eshibhile epajiwe. Qaphela inqubo yokuthumelwa, landa imishini ethunyelwe, landela ubufakazi bokulethwa, futhi uxazulule izinkinga noma ukulibazisa ekulethweni. Lungisa amawayibhili, amadokhumenti obufakazi bokulethwa, izikweletu zabathunyeli nezaziso zokwaba. Gcina amarekhodi anembile emikhiqizweni egqityiwe adluliselwe nasatshalaliswe. Qaphela futhi ugcine amazinga ezimpahla zemishini yokushicilela, izinsizakucash kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswayo, okuhlanganisa iphepha, ini nokunye okuhlobene nemvelo. Landa ukusetshenziswa, qala ukugcwalisa lapho kudingeka, futhi ugcine isistimu ezinhle zezimpahla ukuze kugwamenge ukushoda noma izimpahla ezingaphezu kwedingo. Qinisekisa ukuthi isiHlu nabasebenzi balo bahlinzekwe ngokwanele beswazi nemibhalo. Gcina futhi ulawule amarekhodi anembile, okubhalisiwe, izibalo nobuxhumaniso. Sebenzisa izistimu ezithintwayo namasofthiwe ehambisanayo ukuze ubambe, uhle, ugcine, ulande futhi unikeze imininingwane ngokusebenza kahle. Gcina isistimu yokugcina amafayili esiHlu, amarekhodi okuxhumana okungena naphephuka, okubhalisiwe ukuhamba kanye namadokhumenti okunikezana asayinwe. Lungeza amagwafa, izibalo nokunye ukuxhumana, phendula imibuzo evamile, futhi unikeze izibalo ezinembile ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Phatha ukuphepha, impilo, imvelo, ingozi nekhwalithi esiHlweni. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, izidingo ze-SHERQ, izilawuli zokuvikeleka kanye namapholisi namaphrosedhari ohlelo lonke lwemvelo e-Government Printing Works. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imiphumela futhi namasistimu ahlobene nokuphatha, ukuhamba, ukugcina nokuvikela imishini eshibhile epajiwe ilandelwa ngokuqinile. Nikeza usizo lwokuphatha futhi ongayena esiHlweni. Phatha ukushiya umsebenzi, ukubakho, amashidi esikhathi, ukuvunyelwa ukusebenza amahora angeziwe, izifiso zamahora angeziwe, ukulungisa isikhathi namarekhodi abantu. Gcina amarekhodi anembile okushiya umsebenzi nokubakho futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imibhalo esekelayo igqitywa inikezwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esidingekayo. Wenze ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokuqasha, imishini, izinto kanye namasakhiwo esiHlu. Qapha futhi ulawule abasebenzi esiHlweni. Abe, ahle futhi aqaphele umsebenzi babantu besebenza futhi anikeze inkombo ezisebenzayo neyobuchwepheshe. Yenza izibalo zokuqapha ukusebenza ngokuvumelana namapholisi e-Government Printing Works, akhuthaze ukusebenza njengeqembu, futhi faka izinyathelo zezihlomula zomthetho futhi ngokuvumelana nemithetho neziphethakalo ezihambisanayo uma kudingeka. Siza ekuphathweni nasekuhleleni ukwesekwa kwemfundu yabasebenzi, ukweseka nokuthuthuka kwabasebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni, ukubuyekezweni nokusetshenzisweni kwamapholisi ahambisanayo, imiphumela namasistimu okusebenzayo. Cwaninga futhi uhlale ulwazi ngokuthuthuka kobuchwepheshe, amasistimu ezithintwayo namasiko asanda kuvela emhlabeni woshicilelo nasemzabalazweni wokuthumela ukuze usekele ukuthuthuka okungapheli, ukusebenza kahle nokugcina amazinga aphakeme ekhwalithi.

xh.title: IJongwe Elikhulu Lemveliso: Izicwanga Zohambo Lemvizwe Namaxwebhu Obuqu
xh.summary: IJongwe Elikhulu Lemveliso elilawula uluhlu lwezicwanga zohambo lemvizwe namaxwebhu obuqu kwi-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, elifuna iGredyeshoni 12 kunye neminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelana nalomsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGredyeshoni 12. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava afanelekileyo kule ndalo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isibuyekezo esilungileyo sokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngamakhalisa ngezixhobo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isibuyekezo esilungileyo sokhuseleko. Umntu othathiweyo uya kufuneka ukusebenza iishifthi ezijikeleza, kuquka iintsuku zangaphakathi kweveki, iintsuku zolawulo, kunye neeshifthi zasebusuku, nxaxheba kwiimfuno zokusebenza. Iiyure ezongeziweyo zokusebenza zingase zifuneko. Ulawulo lokuxelelana nayo yonke inqanaba lokulawula. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba egqityiweyo iya kuba ngolonwabo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Qaphela intshaniselwa, umsebenzi oqhubekayo, noluhlu lwamaxwebhu: Cwangcisa usiba iimvisiswano zesebe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthunyelwa ngexesha elichanekileyo kwi-High Security Dispatch Division, kubathunyeli nakumthengi. Qinisekisa ukuba onke amaqela amaxwebhu athunyelwe kwicandelo le-Personalisation nolawulo lokhululo loyilo amkelwe Lungisa ukuqaphela umthambo wemveliso, umsebenzi oqhubekayo, intshaniselwa noluhlu lwamaxwebhu okhuseleko oluphakamileyo ocinyiweyo. Cwangcisa usiba iimisebenzi yesebe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugqitywa ngexesha elichanekileyo noluhlu oluchanekileyo lwamaxwebhu kumacandelo angaphakathi, kubathunyeli nakumthengi. Sebenzisana namasebe ahambelana nalo namayunithioshishino, kuquka uyilo, i-prepress, ukupeyinta, ukwenza umntu yiyo, ulawulo lokhululo, ukugqiba nokuthumela, ukuze kulungiselelwe ukujikeleka okuchanekileyo nokugqitywa ngexesha kwimisebenzi yemveliso. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke amaqela amkelwe kumacandelo emveliso nolawulo lokhululo loyilo abhalwe ngokuchanekileyo, adluliselwe ngokukhuselekileyo asayiniwe. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo oluchanekileyo lwemveliso egqityiweyo yokuthunyelwa, kuquka ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo ukuqinisekisa iinkcukacha zomthengi, iidilesi zokuhanjiswa, amaxwebhu okuthumela nolunye uxwebhu oluxhasa. Khawulezisa amaxwebhu aphephayo, landela imisebenzi engagqitywanga okanye elibhityileyo kumakhalisa emveliso, ulandele ukuze usombulule ukubhityela kokuyila okanye ukuthunyelwa. Lungisanisa namasebe angaphakathi, amaqela angaphandle, iinkampani zokuhanjisa nabahanjisi ukulungiselela ukuthutha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthunyelwa ngokuchanekileyo ngexesha kwamaxwebhu apiyiweyo. Qaphela inkqubela yokuthunyelwa, landela izinto ezithunyelwe, landela izibonakaliso zokuhanjiswa, ulungise iziphene zokuhanjiswa okanye ukubhityela. Sebenzisa amaxwebhu okuthumela, uxwebhu lwesibonakaliso sokufika, iinvoices zabahanjisi nezaziso zokwaba. Zama amaxwebhu achanekileyo emveliso egqityiweyo ethunyelwe naba zabiweyo. Qaphela ulondolazo lwamaxwebhu okuphucula, iindleko izinto nezinto ezidityaniswa, kuquka iphepha, woshi ezinye izinto ezinxulumenayo nemveliso. Landela ukusetyenziswa, qalisa ukuze kuzaliswe apho kufuneka, zigcine inkqubo echanekileyo yokulondoloza ukuze kuqatshelwe iindleko okanye iindleko ezingapheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba isicandelo nabaqeshi basonke balungiselelwe ngokwaneleyo nabalathwe ngemithi. Zama ulawulo oluchanekileyo lwamaxwebhu, iirejista, izibalo nolwazindlela lwamaxwebhu angenayo naphumlayo. Sebenzisa amakhalisa amagqubutho ukubamba, ukuhamba, ukugcina ukufumana nokubika iinkcukacha ngenkqubo ethi ngokuqinisekileyo. Zigcine inkqubo yesicandelo yokubeka iifayile, iirejista zamaxwebhu angenayo naphumlayo, iirejista zentshaniselwa naxwebhu okusayiniweyo lokunika. Lungelela iileta ezisisiseko, iingxelo nolunye uxwebhu, phendula imibuzo eqhelekileyo, uze ungenise iingxelo ezichanekileyo ngexesha elifunekayo. Lawula ukhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ingozi nomgangatho kwisicandelo. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela umthetho weMithetho yeMpilo yoKhuseleko, iimfuno ze-SHERQ, izindlela zokhuseleko nazo zonke iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi namakhalisa e-GPW. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iindlela namakhalisa angqamlelanayo nokuphatha, intshaniselwa, ukugcina nokukhusela izinto ezicinyiweyo zokhuseleko oluphakamileyo zilandelwa ngokuqinileyo. Nika isicandelo inkxaso yolawulo nokuhanjiswa. Lawula iikhenshini, ubukho, iiresithi zexesha, imvume yeyure ezongezelelweyo, iimfuno zokwenza eyure ezongezelelweyo, ukulungisa ixesha namaxwebhu abaqeshi. Gcina iirejista ezichanekileyo zeikhenshini nobukho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lonke uxwebhu oluxhasa lugqityiwe kungeniswa ngexesha elifunekayo. Khokelela ekulawuleni ngokuchanekileyo ukuthenga, izixhobo, izinto ezinamandla zokwenza umsebenzi ezakhiwo kwisicandelo. Buka ulawulo kwaye uphatha abaqeshi kwisicandelo. Yabelana, uhambelanise ulandele imisebenzi yabasebenzi unike imikhondo yemisebenzi netheknical. Yenza izibuko zemisebenzi ngokwabiwo kolawulo lwe-GPW, ukhuthaze ukusebenzisana, uze kubeka izohlwayo ngokwabiwo lwemithetho nendlela xa kufuneka. Nceda nolawulo lokulungelelanisa ukuqeqesha, ukulungisa nokuphuhlisa abaqeshi. Thatha inxaxheba ekudaleni, ukubuyekeza nokusebenzisa iindlela, izicwangciso namakhalisa angqamlelanayo. Qhuba uphando uze uhlale uyazi ngophuhliso lwamakhala ezixhobo, amakhalisa amagqubutho nendlela entsha yokusebenza kwimveliso noluhlu ukuze uxhase ukuphucula ngokungqina nokuphumeza iinkqubo nasekugcineni amanqanaba aphakamileyo obulungile.

Timely produce travel documents through the operating of the Booklet machines, ensure updated records and maintain statistics in the Section. Oversee and operate counting machine and ensure that required targets are counted accurately. Perforate documents and ensure that passport numbers are correctly perforated on data page. Check quality and standards during and after production on continuous basis. Clean and maintain equipment according to schedule, ensuring efficiency and continuous running thereof. Comply with OHSA requirements and ensure that SHERQ processes are adhered to. Provide inputs on processes and procedures. Guillotine production material, endpapers and visa sheets to perfect production standards.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Beeldperforasie
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A-pos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, wat reisdocumente produseer deur boekjie- en telmasjiene, waarvoor 'n drukkerij-vaktoetsertifikaat vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 10 en voltooiing van 'n toepaslike drukkerij-leerlingskap. Graad 12 sal 'n voordeel wees. Vaktoetsertifikaat in die drukkerijbedryf (spesiale produkdruk en afwerking). Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklarering te verkry. Geen ervaring vereis. Ervaring in die drukkerijbedryf sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestel en hou gespesifiseerde materiaal veilig. Reken alle voorraadbewegings en rapporteer tekorte. Produseer betyds reisdocumente deur die bedryf van die boekjiemasjiene, verseker opgedateerde rekords en handhaaf statistieke in die Afdeling. Hou toesig oor en bedryf telmasjien en verseker dat vereiste teikens akkuraat getel word. Perforeer dokumente en verseker dat paspoortnommers korrek op die databladsy geperforeer word. Verseker volmaakte beeldperforasie op die laaste Visumbladsy van paspoorte. Bied ondersteuning deur voorlopige gehalteversekering uit te voer. Kontroleer gehalte en standaarde tydens en na produksie op 'n deurlopende grondslag. Maak toerusting skoon en onderhou dit volgens skedule, en verseker doeltreffendheid en deurlopende werking daarvan. Voldoen aan OHSA-vereistes en verseker dat SHERQ-prosesse nagekom word. Verskaf insette oor prosesse en prosedures. Guillotineer produksiemateriaal, omslagblaaie en visumblare tot volmaakte produksiestandaarde.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wobuciko Wokukhiqiza Izinga A: Ukugqoba Isithombe
zu.summary: Indima Yomsebenzi Wobuciko Wokukhiqiza Izinga A e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, yokukhiqiza amadokhumenti okuhamba ngezinsetshenziswa zamashini e-booklet nokuqamba, kudinga isitifikedi sokuvivinywa kobuchwepheshe bokushicilela.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 kanye nokuphothulwa kokufundela isimiso sabafundi sokushicilela esifanelekile. I-Grade 12 izoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Isitifikedi Sokuvivinywa Kobuchwepheshe emkhakheni wokushicilela (ukushicilela imikhiqizo ekhethekile nokuyiqeda). Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukucaciswa okuhle ngokuphephile. Akukho mkhosi odingekayo. Umkhosi emkhakheni wokushicilela uzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ilayisensi evumelekile yomshayeli izoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe.
zu.duties: Funa bese ugcina ngokuphepha izinto ezishiwo. Bhala zonke izenzo zamasitoki bese ubika ezingekho. Khipha amadokhumenti okuhamba ngesikhathi ngokusebenzisa amashini e-Booklet, qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo zibuyekezwe bese ulondoloza izibalo Esigabeni. Buka bese usebenzisa umshini wokuqamba futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imigomo eidingekayo iqambe ngokunembile. Gqoba amadokhumenti futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amanombolo okuphasipothi agqotshwe ngokunembile ekhasini ledatha. Qinisekisa ukugqoba okuphelele kwesithombe ekhasini lokugcina le-Visa lamaphasipothi. Nikeza inkusezela ngokwenza ukugunyazwa kwangaphambi kobuningi bokhwalithi. Hlola ukhwalithi nemitsetho phakathi nangemva kokukhiqiza ngokuqhubekayo. Cwasha futhi ulondoloze izinsimbi ngokuhlela, uqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuphumelelayo nokuhamba ngokuqhubekayo. Landela izidingo ze-OHSA futhi uqinisekise ukuthi inqubo ye-SHERQ ilandelwa. Nikeza okokufaka ezinkundleni nasezinkondolweni. Qhaqha izinto zokukhiqiza, amakhasi okuqala namashidi e-visa ukufinyelela emazingeni okukhiqiza ayingcwele.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weNzimakazi eMveliso Inqanaba A: Ukutshixa isithombe
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wonzimakazi emveliso Inqanaba A kwiGovernment Printing Works ePretoria, ekwenziwa amagama okuhamba ngesikhathi ngokusebenzisa iimashini ze-booklet nezokubala, kufuneka ithothwe yesatifikethi sokuvavanya ulwazi lokushicilela.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 nokuphothulwa kokufundela olunjengoko kufanelekileyo ekushicileleni. I-Grade 12 iya kuba luncedo. Isatifikethi soVavanyo lweLwazi kumthambo woshicilelo (ukushicilela iimveliso ezikhethekileyo nokugqibelela). Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isigqibo sokhuseleko esiphumeleleyo. Akukho namanye amava afunekayo. Amava kumthambo woshicilelo aya kuba luncedo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo iya kuba luncedo.
xh.duties: Funa kwaye ugcine ngokhuseleko izinto ezeleziweyo. Qamba zonke iintshukumo zelifa kwaye uchaze ezingezwanga. Velisa ngexesha elifanelekileyo amagama okuhamba ngesikhathi ngokusebenzisa iimashini ze-Booklet, qinisekisa ukuba kuneerekhodi ezihlaziyiweyo kwaye ugcine izibalo kwicandelo. Qhuba kwaye usebenzise imashini yokubala kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iinjongo ezifunekayo zibalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Tshixa amaxwebhu kwaye uqinisekise ukuba amanani epaspoti atshixwe ngokuchanekileyo kwiphepha leedata. Qinisekisa ukutshixa isithombe ngokupheleleyo kwiphepha lokugqibela leVisa kwamapaspoti. Nikeza inkxaso ngokwenza uqinisekiso lomgangatho wangaphambili. Hlola umgangatho nezinga ngexesha kwaye emva komveliso ngokuqhubeka. Cocza kwaye ugcine izixhobo ngokwolojiso, uqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo nokugqhubeka kwayo. Thobela iimfuno ze-OHSA kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iinkqubo ze-SHERQ zilandelwa. Nikeza izimvo kwiinkqubo nendlela zokwenza. Qhawula izinto zomveliso, amaphepha okuqalisa namaphepha e-visa ukuya kwizinga elipheleleyo lomveliso.

jobs.summary: Artisan position at Government Printing Works in Pretoria for electrical services maintenance, requiring a completed apprenticeship and Electrical Trade Test Certificate.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 or equivalent qualification plus a completed apprenticeship. Trade Test Certificate in Electrical. Grade 12 will be an added advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. No experience required. Experience in printing industry will be an added advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Good knowledge of applicable processes and equipment. Understanding of all relevant human resources legislative framework, regulations, and prescripts. Understanding of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, Skills Development Act. Understand the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. A valid driver's license is required.
jobs.duties: Ensure and carry out efficient maintenance and repair of all equipment at GPW sites: Adhere to scheduled maintenance to previously established manufacturing sequences and lead times, as instructed by GPW. Keep to the schedule to track and build an accurate history of equipment maintenance, through completion of maintenance work orders. Escalate and expedite maintenance operations that delay production or pose a risk to health, safety and environment. Signing off work orders when completed and providing evidence to Supervisor. Assist machine agents or OEM should it so be required. Inspect all electrical equipment as per agreed timelines and manufactures instructions. Report any signs of shortcomings and damage immediately to Supervisor. Perform and monitor quality assurance ensuring that all maintenance and repair work is compliant with the standards set by GPW and other relevant authorities: Review factors that could affect the quality of maintenance/repair work and put corrective measures in place if required. Monitor progress to track performance against the plan and to identify early warning signs. Work order management: Get orders from the supervisor every morning and attend to required jobs as soon as possible. Engage requestor, artisan, or supervisor responsible for the machine. Fill in the work order completely after attending to the fault. Report back to the supervisor with a work order that is completed. Close the work order, order material, or escalate to agent or OEM through the supervisor. Administration functions: Submit written and verbal reports to supervisor as per agreed timelines. Management of one’s leave. Time and attendance management. Attend standing and ad-hoc meetings as and when required. Attend training, workshops, courses, and any intervention proposed by supervisor, management or GPW. Ensure Safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) in the Division: Always Adhere to health and safety prescripts during all phases of maintenance on site. Proper use of PPE. Do regular risk assessments to eliminate injuries or incidents to operators, artisans, and anyone around the machine. Full adherence to any safety, health and environmental policy implemented within GPW and its sites.

af.title: Ambagsman (PRODUKSIE): Elektriese Diensonderhoud
af.summary: Ambagsmanpos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria vir elektriese diensonderhoud, wat 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap en 'n Sertifikat van Ambagstoets in Elektries vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap. Sertifikat van Ambagstoets in Elektries. Grade 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Geen ervaring vereis. Ervaring in die druknywerheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. Goeie kennis van toepaslike prosesse en toerusting. Begrip van alle tersaaklike wetlike raamwerke, regulasies en voorskrifte vir menslike hulpbronne. Begrip van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, Skills Development Act. Begrip van die PFMA en Treasury Regulations. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Verseker en voer doeltreffende onderhoud en herstel van alle toerusting by GPW-terreine uit. Hou by geskeduleerde onderhoud volgens vooraf vasgestelde vervaardigingsreekse en levertyd, soos deur GPW aangedui. Hou by die skedule om 'n akkurate geskiedenis van toerustingonderhoud by te hou, deur die voltooiing van onderhoudswerkorders. Eskaleer en bespoedig onderhoudsbedrywighede wat produksie vertraag of 'n risiko vir gesondheid, veiligheid en omgewing inhou. Teken werkorders af wanneer voltooi en verskaf bewys aan die toesighouer. Bied bystand aan masjienagente of OEM indien vereis. Inspekteer alle elektriese toerusting volgens ooreengekome tydlyne en vervaardigerinstruksies. Rapporteer enige tekortkominge en skade onmiddellik aan die toesighouer. Voer gehaltversekering uit en monitor dit om te verseker dat alle onderhouds- en herstelwerk voldoen aan die standaarde wat deur GPW en ander tersaaklike owerhede gestel is. Hersien faktore wat die gehalte van onderhouds-/herstelwerk kan beïnvloed en plaas korrektiewe maatreëls in werking indien vereis. Monitor vordering om prestasie teen die plan op te spoor en vroeë waarskuwingstekens te identifiseer. Werkorderbestuur: Kry bestelle van die toesighouer elke oggend en tree so spoedig moontlik tot vereiste take toe. Raakplek versoeker, ambagsman of toesighouer wat vir die masjien verantwoordelik is. Vul die werkorder volledig in nadat die fout aangespreek is. Rapporteer terug aan die toesighouer met 'n voltooide werkorder. Sluit die werkorder, bestel materiaal of eskaleer na agent of OEM deur die toesighouer. Administratiewe funksies: Dien skriftelike en mondelinge verslae volgens ooreengekome tydlyne aan die toesighouer in. Bestuur van eie verlof. Tyd- en bywoningsbestuur. Bywoon van vaste en ad hoc vergaderings soos en wanneer vereis. Bywoon van opleiding, werkswinkels, kursusse en enige ingreep wat deur die toesighouer, bestuur of GPW voorgestel word. Verseker Veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ) in die afdeling: Hou te alle tye by gesondheids- en veiligheidsvoorskrifte tydens alle fases van onderhoud op die terrein. Behoorlike gebruik van PPE. Doen gereelde risikobevalings om beserings of voorvalle aan operateurs, ambagslui en enigiemand rondom die masjien te voorkom. Volledige nakoming van enige veiligheids-, gesondheids- en omgewingsbeleid wat binne GPW en sy terreine ingestel is.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wesandla (UKUQASHWA): Ukugcinwa kwezinsizakalo zobumdikiwe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wesandla e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria sokugcinwa kwezinsizakalo zobumdikiwe, esidinga ukuthi umuntu eqedele ukumatanisana neposi likhuni kagesi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma izifundo ezingangaleyo nokuba uphothule ukumatanisana. Isitifikathi sokuvivinywa kwesikhuni kagesi. I-Grade 12 izoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa okuhle kwezokuvikela. Akukho ngeminyaka yomsebenzi edingekayo. Ukuba nengqondo yomsebenzi emkhankathini wokushicilela kuzoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa okuhle kwezokuvikela. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezinqubo nezinto zokusebenza ezifanelekile. Ukuqonda yonke imigomo nomthetho ohlukene nemithethonkqubo yabasebenzi, imithethelo, nemiyalo. Ukuqonda umthetho wezinkonzo zikahulumeni, Imithetho yezinkonzo zikahulumeni, umthetho wezokuhlobana nomsebenzi, umthetho wezidingo zokuPhatha Izingozi, Izempilo, Imvelo, kanye nekhwalithi (SHREQ), kanye nomthetho weZisekelo Zakha amakhono. Ukuqonda i-PFMA kanye nemithetho yeTreasury. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Qiniseka futhi ungenze ngempumelelo ukugcinwa nokulungiswa kwazo zonke izinto zokusebenza emasiteshini e-GPW: Zithobele isikhathi esihlelwwe sokugcinwa kumasinkathi wokukhiqiza ohlezi hhayi esiwusandla ukubeka, njengalokho kufundiswa i-GPW. Landela isikhathi ukuze ulandele futhi ukwakhe umlando ongqikithi wezinto ezenziwa ukugcina, ngokuphothula amafomu okugcinwa yomsebenzi. Phakamisa futhi uphushize izinhlelo zokugcina ezibambezeze ukukhiqiza noma ezibe yingozi ezempilweni, ukuvikeleka, nasezimvelweni. Phusha igunya emafomu emisebenzi uma ewuphothulile futhi unike umfundisi osenhlonipho umbhalo. Siza abameli bezinsizakalo zamafamu noma abakwa-OEM lapho kudingeka khona. Hlola wonke umdiki wamabhasha njengakulesikhathi esivunyelwe nasemiyalweni yokukhiqiza. Bika ngaso sonke isikhathi nanoma yisiphi isikhawu noma ukulimala kumabhasha enkundla. Yenza futhi uhlole ukuthi umsebenzi wekhwalithi wenziwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umsebenzi wokugcina nokulungiswa uyahambisana namazinga abekwe i-GPW namanye amaphoyisa ahlobene: Buyeza izinto ezingase zichithe ikhwalithi yomsebenzi wokugcina nokulungisha bese ufaka izinyathelo zokulungisa uma kudingeka. Hlola inqubeko ukuze ulandele ukusebenza ngokweplani ukuze ubone ngaphambili okungase kuholele ezinkingeni. Ukuphathwa kwamafomu omsebenzi: Thola imiyalo kumfundisi osenhlonipho ekuseni kunke bese uyayifaka emisebenzi efunwa ngokushesha. Yalisabe umuntu ofundayo, umuntu wemisebenzi yesandla, noma omlingisi osenhlonipho ongumniki we-insiza. Gcwalisa ifomu lokusebenza ngokuphelele emva kokuyifaka kulesikhawu. Buyela kumfundisi osenhlonipho ngefomu lokusebenza eligcwalisiwe. Vala ifomu lomsebenzi, thumela izinsizakalo, noma umyalele kummeli noma i-OEM ngomfundisi osenhlonipho. Imisebenzi yokuphatha: Thumela imibhalo nemilomo yemibiko kumfundisi osenhlonipho ngakwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi sabantu sabo. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi nendlela yokuzikhethela. Zwa imihlanganonye futhi owayeyele njengalapho kudingeka khona. Hlala emafundweni, emahholweni, nakuzinkundla ezinconyiwe umfundisi osenhlonipho, ukuphathi, noma i-GPW. Qiniseka ukuvikeleka, izempilo, imvelo, ubungozi, nasekhwalithi (SHERQ) kwisebe: Zithobela ngaso sonke isikhathi imiyalo yezempilo nokuqinisekisa emaphathini wonke okuhlelwa wokugcina. Ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwamasentimba. Yenza ukubuyekeza kokuvikela ngaphambi kwesikhathi ukuthi ungabavimba abasebenzi bemifudvo, abantu bemisebenzi yesandla, kubantu bonke abaseduze ne-insiza. Ukuzithoba ngokupheleleyo yinoma yimuphi umthetho wezokuvikela, izempilo, nangemvelo osekela i-GPW namasiteshi.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi weVocyo (PRODUCTION): Ukugcinwa kweZoluncedo zeMbane
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzisi wevocyo kuGovernment Printing Works ePretoria ukugcinwa kwezoluncedo zembane, sifuna ukuba ugqibe ufundo lokwazi umsebenzi kwaye unesiQinisekiso seVocyo loLwazi kwiMbane.
xh.requirements: IGrade 10 okanye izifundo ezingangayo ezithatha inxaxheba kwaye kugqitywe ufundo lokwazi umsebenzi. Isatifikethi seVocyo loLwazi kwiMbane. IGrade 12 iya kuba yinxalenye ephucula umntu. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isikhululo esicotho esilungileyo sokhuseleko. Akukho ngqinelano ngenqanaba lemveliso esifunekayo. Ngqinelano ngenqanaba lemveliso kwishishini lokuprinta iya kuba yinxalenye ephucula umntu. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isikhululo esicotho esilungileyo sokhuseleko. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngenkqubo namacebo asetyenziswayo. Ukuqonda yonke imithetho yolawulo lweemisebenzi yabantu, iimigaqo kunye nemithetho elandelayo. Ukuqonda iPublic Service Act, iPublic Service Regulations, iLabour Relations Act, iSafety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, iSkills Development Act. Ukuqonda iPFMA kunye neTreasury Regulations. Kufuneka kube nepali yokulawula imoto.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa kwaye wenze ukugcinwa nokulungiswa ngokusebenza kakuhle kwayo yonke imigca eqela ezikhundleni zeGPW: Tsalela kumaxesha afunekayo ukugcinwa njengoko bekunjalo ngaphambili ekulandelaneni kwenziwa kweempahla naxesi lokuhamba njengoko alungiselelwe yiGPW. Gcina ishedyuli ukuze ulandele kwaye wakhe imbali eqinisekisiweyo yokugcinwa kwayo yonke imigca, ngokugqibezela ama-work order egciniweyo. Nyusa ngamazinga aphezulu kwaye ushukumise phambili iinkqubo zokugcinwa eziyisa izinga emva kwemveliso okanye ezingoyingo engcamangalweni lokhuseleko, impilo nendalo. Sayina ama-work order xa egqityiwe kwaye uze neqinisekiso kumlawuli. Nceda abamashini okanye i-OEM ukuba kuyimfuneko. Hlola yonke imigca yombane ngokwamaxesha ahleliweyo kwaye njengoko kuchazwe ngabakhi. Chaza ngoko nangoko kumlawuli nangaphezulu na nangantsomi nakuwo nawo onke aye aphawule. Yenza kwaye ulolandele ukuchonga ngokuphindaphinda ukuba yonke imisebenzi yokugcina nokulungisa ihambelana namagunya abekwe yiGPW nangamanye amagunya afanelekileyo: Ukuphonononga amacandelo angachuki kakhulu kwindidi yemisebenzi yokugcina/nokulungisa kwaye ubeke iindidi ezilungisa ekubakho aze aphinde kwingxelo yemiba engaqondanga. Ukulandela inkqubela phambili ukulandela ukusebenza ngokuchasana nenjongo yokubakho kwezifanekiso ezingase zibangele ingxaki. Ulawulo lwe-work order: Fumana iiodolo kumlawuli qho ekuseni kwaye uzibandakanye kumashishini afunekayo ngoko nangoko. Thetha nomceli, umsebenzisi wevocyo, okanye umlawuli ohliswe ngayo imowudla. Gwalisa i-work order ngokupheleleyo emva kokubamba ingxaki. Chaza ngemva kumlawuli nge-work order egqityiweyo. Vala i-work order, ucele izinto ezakhiwayo, okanye unyuse kumceli okanye i-OEM ngomlawuli. Imisebenzi yolawulo: Rhodesa iingxelo ezigqitywe ngokubhalisiweyo nezalula ilula njengoko kwamiselwe amaxesha. Ulawulo lwesikele semisebenzi. Ulawulo lwexesha nolungelo. Zibandakanye kwiindibano ezimiyo nezo kwesixhenxe xa kusetyenziswa. Zibandakanye ekuzonwabeni, kwindibano, kwizifundo, nakuyo nayiphi na enye into ecaleni kweliso ebizwe ngumlawuli, ngabaphathi okanye iGPW. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ubungozi, kwaye ichaneke (SHERQ) kuwo/Wo: Qho bathe ngqo kumagunya okhuseleko nempilo kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezikwindawo ekugcinwa kuyo. Ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwe-PPE. Yaza ngqo ithamsanqa kwiziganeko zokulinga ngokungangqalanga ukuba nangantsomi okanye kubangela iingozi. Ukulandelana ngokupheleleyo nakuyo nayiphi na iNkqubo yokhuseleko, impilo nendalo ebekwe yi-GPW kunye nezikhundla zayo.

Voer gehaltversekering uit en monitor dit om te verseker dat alle onderhouds- en herstelwerk voldoen aan die standaarde wat deur GPW en ander relevante owerhede gestel is: Hersien faktore wat die gehalte van onderhouds-/herstelwerk kan beïnvloed en plaas corrigerende maatreëls in plek indien vereis. Monitor vordering om prestasie teen die plan te volg en vroeë waarskuwingstekens te identifiseer. Verskaf insette om onderhouds- en herstelverslae voor te berei. Werkbestellingbestuur: a) Kry werkbestellings van die toesighouer elke oggend en woon die vereiste take so spoedig moontlik by. Raadpleeg versoeker, ambagsman of toesighouer verantwoordelik vir die masjien. Vul die werkbestelling volledig in nadat die fout bygewoon is. Rapporteer terug aan die toesighouer met 'n voltooide werkbestelling. Administratiewe funksies: Dien skriftelike en mondelingse verslae by die toesighouer in volgens ooreengekomme tydlyne. Bestuur van eie verlof. Tyd-en-bywoonbestuur. Woon vaste en ad hoc-vergaderings by soos en wanneer vereis. Woon opleiding, werkswinkels, kursusse en enige ingryping by wat deur toesighouer, bestuur of GPW voorgestel word. Verseker Veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ) in die afdeling: Hou altyd by gesondheids- en veiligheidsvoorskryfte gedurende alle fases van onderhoud op die terrein. Behoorlike gebruik van PPE. Doen gereelde risiko-assessments om beserings of voorvalle aan operateurs, ambagsmanne en enigiemand rondom die masjien te elimineer. Volledige nakoming van enige veiligheids-, gesondheids- en omgewingsbeleid wat binne GPW en sy terreine geïmplementeer is.

zu.title: Umndali (UKUKHIQIZA): Ukugcina Izinsiza Zomshini
zu.summary: Kudingeka umndali kwa Government Printing Works e Pretoria ukugcina futhi alungise izinsiza zokushicilela, okudinga ukufeza isifundo somsebenzi wesandla nokuqasha isitifikedi sokuhlola umsebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye nokufeza isifundo somsebenzi wesanduna. Isitifikedi sokuhlola umsebenzi kwimbonini yokushicilela. I-Grade 12 izoba yinzuzo. Akukho muntu odinga isipiliwo. Isipiliwo kwimboni yokushicilela sizoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola isitifikedi sokuvunyiwa ukhuseleko oluhle. Ulwazi oluhle ngemikhuba nezinsiza ezifanelekile. Ukuqonda umthetho we-Public Service Act, izimiso ze-Public Service Regulations, umthetho we-Labour Relations Act, umthetho wezidingo zokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ), kanye nomthetho we-Skills Development Act. Ukuqonda wonke umthetho wokuphepha obhekene nemisebenzi yabantu endaweni yokukhiqiza. Kudingeka ibe nelaisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qiniseka futhi wenze ukugcina okusebenzakalo kanye nokulungisa kwazo yonke insiza emasiteshini ka GPW; Babambelele ekugcineni okuhlelwanga ngokuhlenga kokukhiqiza okuseduze kanye nesikhathi sokuhlinzwa, njengoba kubekwe yi GPW. Landa umklamo ukuze ulandelwe futhi wakhe umlando ongembengo wokugcinwa kwezinsiza, ngokuphothula amafomu omsebenzi wokugcinsa. Phakamisa futhi sheshisa imisebenzi yokugcina eqamula ukukhiqiza noma ibeka engcupheni impilo, ukuphepha nendawo. Siza ekwenzeni ukuhlaziya izimbangela zemishini ephukile bese ukubika ngakho. Qiniseka ukulandela futhi ukuxoxa ngomklamo kulo lonke itholwazi: ukugcina, ukukhiqiza, izinsiza ezingaphandle, izitolo, kubunjulube. Nikela ngosizo kubamedi bomshini noma i-OEM uma kudingeke. Hlola zonke izinsiza zomshini njengoba kuhlelwe isikhathi nangemiyalo yabakhiqizi. Baka noma yisiphi isibonakaliso sezinkinga noshintsho olubi ngaso naxeshwa ku-Office Manager. Hlala ubuyekezayo ngemikhuba entsha endaweni yokusebenza. Yenza futhi ulawule ukutholwa kolwazi ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yokugcina nokuqamba ihambisana nemigomo ebekwe yi GPW kanye nabalawuli abafanelekile: Buka izinto ezithinta inani lomsebenzi wokugcina noma wokulungisa bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa uma kudingeka. Linganisa inqubo ukulandela ukubonakala kokwenza okumelene nomklamo futhi ukubone ekuqaleni ukubonakala kwezinkinga. Nikela ngombono ukuze ulungelelula imibiko yokugcina nokuqamba. Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi: a) Thatha imiyalo yomsebenzi ku-Office Manager ekuseni ngakunye unake imisebenzi edingekayo ngokushesha. Xoxa nocomelo, umndali, noma i-Office Manager obheke umshini. Gcwalisa ifomu lomsebenzi ngemva kokwenza isono. Buyela kwi-Office Manager ngefomu eligcwaliswe. Imisebenzi yocuCongo: Nikezela imibiko ebhaliwe neyokukhuluma ku-Office Manager ngokuhleliwe isikhathi. Ukulawula iholo lakho. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi nobungikhona. Hlangana nemihlangano eqhubekayo noma ezelwe isikhathi njengoba kudingeka. Hlangana nokugqingilwa, izinkomba, imiklamo, nalolunye ukuhlinzwa oluphakanyiswa i-Office Manager, ukuphathwa noma i-GPW. Qiniseka i-Safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) oClingeneni: Zonke izikhathi babambelela kumthetho wempilo nokuPhepha kuzo zonke izingxenye zokuGcina insiza esikhundleni. Ukusebenzisa i-PPE ngokuyini. Yenza uhlolojvo lomthelela njalo ukuze susa izilima noma izenzo kubahlinzi, aboCwayo, nalabo ababhekene nalo umshini. Ukubambelela okuqotho kunoma yisiphi isimiso esibekiwe ngokuphepha, impilo, nendawo ku-GPW nasemasiteshini aso.

xh.title: Umenzi wezandla (UKUDALISA): Ulondolozo lwezixhobo ezinamandla
xh.summary: Kufuneka umenzi wezandla kwi-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria ukulondoloza nokulungisa izixhobo zokudalisa, kwaye kufuneka abe negazesi lokuhlolelwa ulwazi nakwisatifikethi yovavanyo lobugcisa.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 10 okanye izifundo ezalinganayo kwaye igqitywe i-apprenticeship. Isatifikethi sovavanyo lobugcisa kumashishino okudalisa. I-Grade 12 iya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Akukho lwazi oludingwayo. Ulwazi kumashishino okudalisa luya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isithuba sokhuseleko esilungileyo. Ulwazi oluhle malunga neenkqubo nezixhobo ezifunekayo. Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHREQ) management requirements Act, i-Skills Development Act. Ukuqona zonke izifiso zokhuseleko ezibalulekileyo kubasebenzi kwindawo yokudalisa. Kufuneka kubekho ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa uze wenze ulondolozo nokulungiswa okusebenzayo kuzo zonke izixhobo kwiindawo ze-GPW. Landela ulondolizo olucwangcisiweyo ngokwemithetho yokudalisa eeyilelweyo kwangaphambili nemitheftho, njengokuqaliswa yi-GPW. Zinikela kwiejadulu ukuze ulandele uze wakhe imbali ngokuchanekileyo yolondolozo lwezixhobo, ngokuphelelisa amagridi omsebenzi wolondolozo. Phakamisa uze ukhawuleze imisebenzi yolondolizo elibaza ukudalisa okanye ibe yingozi empilweni, ekhuselekeni nakwindalo. Nceda ukuze wenze isahluko sabangela ukuhla kwezixhobo uze uxelo ngakumbi. Qinisekisa ukulandela nokuxela kwesijadulu kuzo zonke izibonelelo: ulondolozo, ukudalisa, iinkonzo ezingaphandle, izitolo, nopolungiso. Kusenokwafuneka ukuncedisa abaphathi bezixhobo okanye i-OEM. Hlola zonke izixhobo ezinamandla ngokwemithetho evunyeliweyo yexesha neyemiyalelo yomenzi. Xela ngantoni na iimpazamo nobungcolisi kwangoko kumlawuli. Zihlalishe kutsha kulwazi kwindawo esebenzayo. Wenze uze ulawule iso lokhuseleko lokuhlabathi ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke umsebenzi wolondolozo nokulungiswa ulandela iindlela ezibekiweyo yi-GPW nazo nezinye iindalo ezibalulekileyo. Phonononga iingongoma ezinokuchaphazela umgangatho womsebenzi wolondolozo/ukulungisa uze uze ubeka izigqibo zokulungisa ukuba kuyimfuneko. Landela inkqubela ukuze ubone ukusebenza ngokomceli-mngeni uze uqaphe iimpawu zexesha elize. Nikela ngezinto ezingenayo ukuze ulungise iingxelo zolondolozo nokulungisa. Ukulawula amagridi omsebenzi: a) Landa amagridi omsebenzi kumlawuli qondo ngemini uze ungenise kumsebenzi ofunekayo ngokukhawuleza. Thintana nomceli-mngeni, umenzi wezandla, okanye umlawuli onoxanduva lezixhobo. Gcwalisa igridi yomsebenzi ngokupheleleyo emva kokungenisa kweso. Xela umlawuli ngegridi yomsebenzi ephumelelliyo. Imisebenzi yolawulo: Nika iingxelo ezibhaliweyo nezalwavayo kumlawuli ngokwexesha elivunyelweyo. Ukuqamba iholo lomntu. Ukulawula ixesha nokubakho. Zithabathe iindibano ezime nangoko kunokubakho iindibano ezize ngokomceli-mngeni. Zithabathe iimfundo, iindibano, iimfundo ezize, nazo naziphi na iindlela eziphakamisiweyo kumlawuli, kulawulo okanye kwi-GPW. Qinisekisa i-Safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) kwisebe:hlala ulandela imiyalelo yempilo nokuqinisekiswa ngelixa zonke iinkqubo zolondolozo kwindawo. Ukusetyenziswa kolungelelwaniso kwi-PPE. Yenza i-Novavanyo lwengozi ngokujongo ukuze ususe iindaku okanye iingoca kubasebenzi, kubamenzi bezandla, kwaye nawo nauphi na ojikeleze isixhobo. Ukulandela ngokupheleleyo nayo nasiphi na inqikaba yokhuseleko, impilo nendalo eyilwe ngaphakathi kwi-GPW nakwindawo yayo.

Conduct quality assurance and control processes to ensure that finishing print products meet required standards and specifications. Process security-printed products in accordance with production specifications and customer requirements. Achieve production targets, ensuring that processing of print products is completed on time and in accordance to GPW standards and customer requirements. Clean and maintain machines and equipment according to schedule, ensuring the efficient and continuous running thereof. Participate in safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) initiatives in the section. Comply with all OHSA safety requirements, monitor and mitigate safety risks Monitor and mitigate safety risks. Complete daily production timesheets accurately and submit them on time as required.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Roll Collator
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A Roll Collator by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, wat 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap en Vaktoetsertifikaat in Gemeganiseerde Boekbindery vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n voltooide vakleerlingskap. Vaktoetsertifikaat in Gemeganiseerde Boekbindery. Graad 12 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Ervaring in die drukkerijbedryf sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bedryf Roll-Collator, Guillotine en ander Afwerkingstoerusting. Voer vereiste instandhouding uit en koördineer herstelwerk of tegniese ondersteuning met instandhoudingspersoneel waar nodig. Voer gehaltversekering- en kontroleprosesse uit om te verseker dat afgewerkte drukprodukte aan vereiste standaarde en spesifikasies voldoen. Verwerk sekuriteitsdrukprodukte in ooreenstemming met produksiespesifikasies en klantvereistes. Bereik produksiedoelwitte deur te verseker dat die verwerking van drukprodukte betyds en in ooreenstemming met GPW-standaarde en klantvereises voltooi word. Maak en onderhou masjiene en toerusting volgens skedule en verseker die doeltreffende en ononderbroke werking daarvan. Neem deel aan veiligheids-, gesondheids-, omgewings-, risiko- en gehalt- (SHERQ) inisiatiewe in die afdeling. Voldoen aan alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes, monitor en matig veiligheidsrisiko's af Monitor en matig veiligheidsrisiko's af. Vul daaglikse produksietydvelle akkuraat in en dien hulle betyds in soos vereis.

zu.summary: Umkhiqizi Wemisebenzi Yezandla Izinga A Umlungisi Wamaphepha e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, ofuna ukuthi umuntu asize isikole sabafundi kwezobuciko bokuqamba izincwadi futhi abe Nesitifiketi Sokuhlola Umsebenzi Wobuciko Bokubopha Izincwadi Ngeshini.

Isitifiketi Sokuhlola Umsebenzi Wobuciko Bokubopha Izincwadi Ngeshini. I-Grade 12 izoba yinzuzo ekungeyona efunwayo. Akukho mlomo ohlelwe ogwetshiwe. Ukuba nolwazi emkhakheni wokushicilela kuzoba yinzuzo ekungeyona efunwayo. Kufanele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa okuhle kokuvikeleka. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela izimoto lizoba yinzuzo ekungeyona efunwayo.

Kufanele wenze inqubo yokuqinisekisa futhi ulawule inani lokuphuma ukuze qiniseke ukuthi imikhiqizo esho ukuthi iphrintiwe ihlangabezana nezindinganimo nezinkomba ezidingekayo. Kufanele uhle amaphaphuphaphu okuqinisekiswa kokuvikeleka ngokuhambisana nezinkomba zokuqamba imikhiqizo nani nezidingo zabathengi. Kufanele ufinyelele imigomo yokuqamba imikhiqizo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqoqwa kwemikhiqizo esho ukuthi iphrintiwe kuqedwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi ngokuhambisana nezindinganimo ze-GPW nani nezidingo zabathengi. Kufanele uhlanze futhi unakekele amashini nezinye izinto ngokushiswa kwesikhathi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza kahle futhi zihamba phambili ngokungapheli. Kufanele uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kokuphepha, impilo, indawo, ingozi kakhulu nobuningi (SHERQ) emkhakheni. Kufanele ulandelane nazo zonke izidingo zokuphepha ze-OHSA, ulawule futhi unciphise izingozi zokuphepha Ulawule futhi unciphise izingozi zokuphepha. Kufanele ugcwalise amafomu okuqamba imikhiqizo nsuku zonke ngokunembile futhi uwahambise ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoko kudingekayo.

xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wesandla Wokuvelisa Inqanaba A Roll Collata kwi-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, sifuna ukugqiba kwesiquphe kunye neSatifikethi sokuvavwa kobugcisa kwiMechanized Bookbinding.

Kucubungula iimveliso ezishicilelweyo ngokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yokuvelisa iinxalenye neemfuno zabathengi. Kumamelana nayo yonke imfuno yokhuseleko ye-OHSA, ukulawula kunye nokunciphisa iingozi zokhuseleko, ukulawula kunye nokunciphisa iingozi zokhuseleko. jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade A: Examination Digital Printing
jobs.summary: Artisan Production Grade A position at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, involving the operation of digital printing equipment and finishing processes.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 and the completion of an appropriate printing apprenticeship in the printing industry (special products printing and finishing). Trade Test certificate in the printing industry. Grade 12 and computer literacy will be an advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.

Conduct quality assurance and control during the printing process on a continuous basis, ensuring text, images, and colour correctness. Assist with problem solving as and when required. Participate in safety, health, environment, risk, and quality (SHERQ) initiatives in the section. Ensure compliance with all OHSA safety requirements. Provide input on policies and procedures. af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Eksamen Digitale Drukwerk
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A pos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, behels die bedryf van digitale druktoerusting en afwerkingsprosesse.
af.requirements: Grade 10 en die voltooiing van 'n toepaslike drukkersleering in die drukkerijbedryf (spesiale produkdruk en afwerking). Ambagstoetsertifikaat in die drukkerijbedryf. Grade 12 en rekenvaardigheid sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarering te verkry. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bedryf die digitale druktoerusting met aanlyn en/of aflyn afwerkingsprosesse. Organiseer, beplan en allokeer drukgrondstowwe en ander hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met die produk wat gedruk moet word. Bereik produksieteikens en verseker dat drukwerk betyds en volgens GPW-standaarde en klantevereistes voltooi word. Druk klantebestellings volgens klantespesifikasies en vereistes. Voer deurlopende gehaltebeheer uit in ooreenstemming met bestaande standaardbedryfsprosedures. Los basiese tegniese en meganiese uitdagings op om gladde produksie met minder afskakeltyd te verseker. Voer gehalteversekering en -beheer gedurende die drukproses op 'n deurlopende basis uit en verseker korrektheid van teks, beelde en kleur. Bied bystand met probleemoplossing soos wanneer dit nodig is. Onderhou en maak masjiene en toerusting volgens skedule skoon en verseker doeltreffende en deurlopende werking daarvan. Verseker dat algemene huishoudelike take in die werksomgewing uitgevoer word. Neem deel aan veiligheids-, gesondheids-, omgewings-, risiko- en gehalte- (SHERQ) inisiatiewe in die afdeling. Verseker nakoming van alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes. Verskaf insette oor beleide en prosedures. Bied bystand met die uitvoer van toesigfunksies.

zu.title: Isiphakeli Sokukhiqiza Isigaba A: Ukuphrinta Ngokwesigaxa IzaKuhlola
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuqashwa komphathi wesigaba A kwisebe lokushicilela kahulumeni ePretoria, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinto zokuphrinta ngokwesigaxa kanye nomchakazo wokuphela komsebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 kanye nokugcwaliseka kwenqubo yokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi ekushicilelweni ngaphakathi kwemboni yokushicilela (ukushicilela izinto ezikhethekile kanye nokuphetha umsebenzi). Isitifiketi se-Trade Test kwimboni yokushicilela. I-Grade 12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola isitifiketi sokuvikeleka esihle. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehloniphekile yezimoto izoba yinzuzo engeziwe.
zu.duties: Phatha izinto zokuphrinta ngokwesigaxa ezisebenza kalayini noma ezingekho kalayini ekuphetheni umsebenzi. Hlela, cwaba, futhi wabelange izinto ezingezintshombo zokushicilela kanye nezinye izinsiza ngokweyoduza komkhiqizo ozophrintwa. Finyelela amaphuzu okukhiqiza, qinisekisa ukuthi ukushicilela kuqediwe ngasikhathi sokuqondile nangokwezidingo ze-GPW nezidingo zakhasimende. Phrinta izinto ezitholiwe kubahlinzeki ngokuhamba kwemithetho yezidingo zabo. Qhubeka wenza ukulawula ikhwalithi ngokuhamba kwemiyalelo eqhubekayo ejwayelekile. Xazulula izinkinga ezisezingeni eliphansi zobuchwepheshe nendezinto ezinogqayo ukuze uqiniseke ukukhiqiza okuhamba kahle ngaphandle kokuphumula isikhathi eside. Yenza isiqiniseko nokulawula ikhwalithi ngemvamisa ngesikhathi sokushicilela, qinisekisa ukuthi umbhalo, izithombe, kanye nemibala ilungile. Siza ekuxazululeni izinkinga lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi uhlanze izinto zokushicilela nemishini ngokohlelo, futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ziyasebenza ngokuqhubekayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yokugcina ihhoveli elisebenza kona iyenziwa. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo ayo ngokuphepha, empilweni, emndeni, ezingozini, nasekhwalithi (SHERQ) kwesiyingi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemiyalezo yonke yokuphepha ye-OHSA. Nikela ngezwi emigonqweni nasemiyalezeni. Siza ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuphatha abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi weMveliso ongaka A: Ukushicilelwa kwesiKhdivayisi ekuBhalweni kweeSihloko
xh.summary: Isithuba somSebenzisi weMveliso ongaka A kwiGovernment Printing Works ePretoria, esiquka nokuqhuba iisixhobo zokushicilela kwesikhdivayisi naneenkqubo zokugqiba.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 10 nokugqitywa kolwazi lomsebenzi olufanelekileyo lokushicilela kwishishini lokushicilela (ukushicilela iimveliso ezikhethekileyo nokugqiba). Isatifikethi seVavanyo lweVocelo kwishishini lokushicilela. I-Grade 12 nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuya kuba ngumonzakazo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isigqibo esihle sokhuseleko. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo kuya kuba ngumonzakazo olongeziweyo.
xh.duties: Qhuba iisixhobo zokushicilela kwesikhdivayisi ngenkqubo yokugqiba online kwaye/nangaphandle kwindlela. Hlela, cwenga, nabelane ngezinto ezingezintsulu zokushicilela nolunye usasazo ngokomthetho welifuqo eliya kushicilelwa. Fikelele kwiinjongo zemveliso, kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukushicilela kugqitywe ngexesha nangokweemizinga ze-GPW nemfuno zabathengi. Shicilela iiodolo zabathengi njengoko kuchazwe ngabathengi nangokwemfuno yabo. Yenza uqeqesho lomgangatho ngokuqhubekayo ngokwemigaqo yokuqhuba eqhelekileyo ekhoyo. Susa iingxaki ezisisiseko zenknikiyolo nezobuchwepheshe ukuyiqinisekisa ukuba imveliso ihamba ngokucofa ngaphantsi kwexesha elingasebenziyo. Qhuba uqinisekiso lomgangatho nolawulo ngexesha lenkqubo yokushicilela ngokuqhubekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukulunga kweefom, iimifuziselo, nombala. Siza ekusombululeni iingxaki naxa kufuneka. Gcina ucoze iisixhobo nendawo yokusebenza ngokwaluhlu kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ziyasebenza ngokuqhubekayo. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokugcina ihlathi ihleli yenziwa kwindawo yokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinethihiyeth zokhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ingozi, nomgangatho (SHERQ) kule candelo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela zonke iimfuno zokhuseleko ze-OHSA. Nikela nengcamango kwimigaqo nolawulo. Siza ekwenzeni imisebenzi yolawulo.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade A: Security Foiling and Inkjet
jobs.summary: Artisan Production Grade A role at Government Printing Works in Pretoria involving operating and maintaining foiling and inkjet numbering equipment for security documents.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 and the completion of an appropriate printing apprenticeship. Trade test certificate in the Mechanised Bookbinding (special products printing, foiling and inkjet numbering processes). Grade 12 and computer literacy will be an advantage. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. A valid driver's license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Set, adjust, operate, and maintain foiling and inkjet numbering equipment.as per the product requirement and standard operating procedures. Set up all jobs, maintenance, and repair, foiling, and inkjet numbering, sheeting, rewinding and perform quality checks. Ensure security documents are produced precisely, timely, and according to customer requirements. Safeguard and protect all security materials Ensure security foiling and inkjet numbering of printed material is undertaken as per predetermined work ticket specifications. Complete daily production timesheets accurately and perform quality checks to ensure finished products meet established quality standards and take necessary action for non-compliance. Clean and maintain machines and equipment according to schedule, ensuring the efficient and continuous running thereof. Perform/request general maintenance as needed. Ensure general housekeeping tasks are performed in the working environment. Ensure Safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) Management in the division and comply with all OHSA safety requirements as well as SHERQ processes Provide support in developing Policies and strategies. Record production activities on equipment as per production codes and ensure that daily production reports submitted accurately and on time as required.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Sekuriteitsfoiling en Inkjet
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A-pos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria wat die bedryf en onderhoud van foiling- en inkjetnommeringstoerusting vir sekuriteitsdokumente behels.
af.requirements: Graad 10 en die voltooiing van 'n toepaslike drukkersleerlingskap. Ambagskliptifikaat in Gemeganiseerde Boekbindery (spesiale produkdruk, foiling en inkjetnommeringsprosesse). Graad 12 en rekenvaardigheid sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklarings kan verkry. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Stel, pas, bedryf en onderhou foiling- en inkjetnommeringstoerusting in ooreenkomstig die produkvereiste en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Stel alle werk op, onderhoud en herstelwerk, foiling en inkjetnommering, bladsnys, terugrol en voer gehaltekontroles uit. Verseker dat sekuriteitsdokumente presies, betyds en volgens kliëntvereistes geproduseer word. Bewaar en beskerm alle sekuriteitsmateriaal. Verseker dat sekuriteitsfoiling en inkjetnommering van gedrukte materiaal uitgevoer word volgens voorafbepaalde werkkaartspesifikasies. Voltooi daaglikse produksietydstate akkuraat en voer gehaltekontroles uit om te verseker dat voltooide produkte aan gevestigde gehalt standaarde voldoen en onderneem nodige stappe vir nie-nakoming. Maak en onderhou masjiene en toerusting volgens skedule en verseker die doeltreffende en deurlopende werking daarvan. Voer versoek algemene onderhoud soos nodig uit. Verseker dat algemene huisvestingstake in die werksomgewing uitgevoer word. Verseker Veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ)-bestuur in die afdeling en voldoen aan alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes asook SHERQ-prosesse. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling van beleide en strategieë. Reken produksie-aktiwiteite op toerusting volgens produksiekodes en verseker dat daaglikse produksieverslae akkuraat en betyds ingedien word soos vereis.

zu.title: Umuntu Osebenza Ngezandla Okukhiwayo Izinga A: Ukupaka Ngokuvikelekile Nokudweba Nge-Inkjet
zu.summary: Isikhundla somuntu osebenza ngezandla okukhiwayo izinga A e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria esibandakanya ukusebenzisa nokugcina izinto zokupaka ngokuvikelekile nokudweba nge-inkjet zamadokhumenti avikelekile.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10 nokugcinwa kwenkosi yokuqashwa kokuqasha okufanelekile kokuprinta. Isitifiketi sesivivinyo sabasebenzi besandla ekubopheni izincwadi ngesistimu (ukuprinta izinto ezikhethekile, ukupaka ngokuvikelekile nokudweba nge-inkjet). I-Grade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo. Kufanele ukwazi ukuthola ukususwa okungavikelekile okuhle. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ezokushayela evumelekile izoba yenzuzo evediwe.
zu.duties: Hlela, lungisa, sebenzisa, futhi gcina izinto zokupaka ngokuvikelekile nokudweba nge-inkjet. njengoba kudingwa umkhiqizo nanjengendlela esemthethweni yokusebenza. Hlela yonke imisebenzi, ukugcina, ukulungisa, ukupaka ngokuvikelekile, nokudweba nge-inkjet, ukuqamba amakhasi, ukuqhuba kabusha futhi wenze ukuhlola ikhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti avikelekile akhiqizwa ngokucophelela, ngesikhathi, futhi ngokwezidingo zabathengi. Vikela futhi usondeze onke amagobolondo avikelekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukupaka ngokuvikelekile nokudweba nge-inkjet kwemateriali eprintiwe kwenziwa njengoba kudingwa isithifikethi somsebenzi esihleliwe. Qedela amafomu wesikhathi sikokukhiqizwa nsuku zonke ngokunembile futhi wenze ukuhlola ikhwalithi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo eqedile ihambisana namazinga ekhwalithi ahleliwe futhi uthathe izinyathelo ezingezandlelayo zokungahambisani. Hlanza futhi ugcine imishini nezinto zokusebenza njengoba kuhleliwe, ukuqinisekisa ukugeleza okuhle nokuhamba ngokungaphazamisi. Yenza/cela ukugcinywa okujwayelekile njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi evamile yokugcina indawo ihle yenziwa endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwe-Safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) kwesigaba futhi uhambisane nazo zonke izidingo zokuvikeleka ze-OHSA kanye namaphrocessi we-SHERQ. Nikeza inkxaso ekuqondiseni amapholisi noma izu. Bhala imisebenzi yokukhiqizwa kumishini njengoba kuhlukaniswe amakhodi wokukhiqizwa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imibiko yokukhiqizwa nsuku zonke ithunyelwa ngokunembile nangesikhathi njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Isithuba saba fundi bokukhula beMveliso: ukusika ngesikrwebo nokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani
xh.summary: Indima yesithuba saba fundi bokukhula beMveliso kwindawo yokuqamba epheleleyo kwindawo ezibhala ezeRipablika ePretoria esebenza ngokulawula nokusingatha okukhuselekileyo kwezixhobo zokusika ngesikrwebo kunye nezokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani.
xh.requirements: Unqamlezinkqubo kwaseKhohlwa thutiya lokuqala nelishumi kunye nokugqiba umsebenzi ohambelana naye weprinti. Isatifikethi sovavuyo lwemisebenzi kwindawo yokuqamba (ukuprinta izinto ezikhethekileyo, ukusika ngesikrwebo, kunye neendlela zokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani). Unqamlezinkqubo kwaseKhohlwa thutiya lokuqala nelishumi neshumi elibini kunye nokubakho kobuchule bokusebenza ngakhompyutha kuya kuba luluncedo. Kuya kufuneka ukuba ube nokukwazi ukufumana isiqinisekiso sokuvuleleka kwisiseko esikhuselekileyo. Ilayisensi yokushishisa egqityiweyo kuya kuba yingongoma ekhuthuzayo.
xh.duties: Misela, lungisa, usebenze, kwaye ugcine izixhobo zokusika ngesikrwebo nokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani.amalungiselelo emveliso kunye neendlela zokusebenza ezigqithisiyo. Misela yonke imisebenzi, ukugcinwa, nokusilwa, ukusika ngesikrwebo, kunye nokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani, ukusika amaphepha, ukuphinda kwaye uqale ukutshintsha isimo kwaye wenze ukujongwa ngomgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba amafafile ezo Khuseleko aveliswa ngokuchanekileyo, ngesixa elifanelekileyo, kwaye ngokwemfuno yabathengi. Zigcine kwaye zikhuselwe zonke izinto ezingabalulekileyo zokhuseleko Qinisekisa ukuba usika ngesikrwebo nokunamba ngenkishiva kulwathi lwamanani kwamaphepha abhaliweyo kwenziwa njengoko kumiswe ngokuqinisekileyo kwisatifikethi somsebenzi. Qedela amakhashe emihla ngemihla amaxesha okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ufunde ukujonga ukuba ngamgangatho ukuqinisekisa ukuba imveliso egqityiweyo ihambelana namazinga ogangatho omisweyo kwaye uthathe izigibo eziyimfuneko xa kungangeni kwisimo esifanayo. Cofa kwaye ugcine iimashini nezixhobo ngokwexesha, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zisebenza ngokusebenza okuqhubekayo. Yenza/ucele ukugcinwa okubanzi njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yokucoca indlu yenziwa kwindawo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukulawula koKhuseleko, impilo, imo, ingcaphepheko, nobomi bomgangatho (SHERQ) kwahlulo ngokuthobela zonke iimfuno zokhuseleko ezifana noMthetho woKhuseleko kwimeko yokusebenza nanye neendlela zika-SHERQ Nikeze inkxaso ekuyisekelweni kweenqamlezinkqubo kunye neendlela. Bhala iimveliso kwizixhobo njengoko kwimiwo yekhowudi yemveliso yomhla de qinisekisa ukuba iingxelo zemihla ngemihla zithunyelwa ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elipheleleyo njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Production Clerk: Image Enhancement
jobs.summary: Production clerk at Government Printing Works in Pretoria responsible for receiving and enhancing images using various software tools, with no prior experience required.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. No experience required. Knowledge of processes and equipment. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance. Must be able to obtain a positive security clearance.
jobs.duties: Receive and enhance images, signatures, edit and enhance it using various software tools. Check the images, inter alia, for colour correction, adjusting brightness and contrast, removing blemishes, and other enhancements to improve the overall visual quality of the image. Maintain an organized system for storing and retrieving image files, ensuring that files are properly named and labelled, and that they are stored in the correct location. Stay up to date with industry trends and new software or technologies that can improve the image enhancement process. Work with other members of the production team to ensure that images are produced in a timely and efficient manner, and that they meet the required quality ICAO standards. Monitor the workload. Compile detailed production sheet or work tickets from customer orders and other specifications as guides in product assembly or manufacturing. Clean and maintain machines and equipment’s. Ensure that machine maintenance on equipment is done according to the manufacturer’s requirements. Manage safety, health, environment, risk and quality (SHERQ) in the Division. Comply with all OHSA safety requirements. Monitor and mitigate plant related safety risks. Ensure that SHERQ processes are adhered to. Assist with the developing, review, implementing and complying with production procedures and policies as required by GPW.
