af.title: Produksieklerk: Beeldverbetering
af.summary: Produksieklerk by Government Printing Works in Pretoria verantwoordelik vir die ontvangs en verbetering van beelde met behulp van verskeie sagtewareinstrumente, met geen vorige ervaring vereis nie.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis van prosesse en toerusting. Moet 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarings kan verkry. Moet 'n positiewe veiligheidsklarings kan verkry.
af.duties: Ontvang en verbeter beelde, handtekeninge, redigeer en verbeter dit met behulp van verskeie sagtewareinstrumente. Kontroleer die beelde, onder andere, vir kleurkorreksie, die aanpassing van helderheid en kontras, die verwydering van vlekke en ander verbeterings om die algehele visuele kwaliteit van die beeld te verbeter. Handhaaf 'n georganiseerde stelsel vir die stoor en onttrek van beeldlêers, verseker dat lêers behoorlik benoem en geëtiketteer word, en dat hulle in die korrekte plek gestoor word. Bly op hoogte van bedryfstendense en nuwe sagteware of tegnologieë wat die beeldverbeteringsproses kan verbeter. Werk met ander lede van die produksiespan om te verseker dat beelde tydig en doeltreffend geproduseer word, en dat hulle aan die vereiste gehalte ICAO-standaarde voldoen. Monitor die werklas. Stel gedetailleerde produksielyste of werktickets saam uit klantbestellings en ander spesifikasies as riglyne in produkmontering of vervaardiging. Maak masjiene en toerusting skoon en onderhou dit. Verseker dat masjienonderhoud aan toerusting gedoen word volgens die vervaardiger se vereistes. Bestuur veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewing, risiko en gehalte (SHERQ) in die Afdeling. Voldoen aan alle OHSA-veiligheidsvereistes. Monitor en verminder aanlegverwante veiligheidsrisiko's. Verseker dat aan SHERQ-prosesse voldoen word. Bied bystand by die ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en voldoen aan produksieprosedures en -beleide soos deur GPW vereis.

zu.title: Umlobi Wokukhiqiza: Ukuphucula Izithombe
zu.summary: Umlobi wokukhiqiza e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria ongewele ukwamukela futhi aphucule izithombe esebenzisa izinto ezahlukene zokusebenza, kungadingi naluphi ulwazi ngaphambilini.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Se-Grade 12. Akukho ulwazi oludingekayo. Ulwazi ngemigudu nezinto zokusebenza. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa kokuqinileko kwezokuvikela. Kumele ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa kokuqinileko kwezokuvikela.
zu.duties: Amukele futhi uphucule izithombe, iziginqigi, uhleze futhi uphucule zisebenzisa izinto ezahlukene zokusebenza. Hlola izithombe, phakathi kwakunye, ukulungisa umbala, ukulungisa ukukhanya nokuphambana, ukususa iziphaziseho, nokunye ukuphucula ukuze kube khona izinga elihle lokubonwa kwesithombe sindalo. Gcina indlela ehleli kahle yokugcina nokuthola amafayela ezithombe, uqinisekise ukuthi amafayela anikwa amagama afanele futhi athunyelwe endaweni efanele. Ziba usuku nanamathrendi emkhakha kanye nesoftware entsha nobuchwepheshe obungaphucula inqubo yokuphucula izithombe. Sebenzisana namalungu amunye eqenjela lokukhiqiza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izithombe zikhiqizwa ngesikhathi nangendlela yokuqinisekisa, futhi zihambisana namazinga afunekayo we-ICAO. Qapha umthwalo wokusebenza. Hlaza futhi ugcine izimoto nezinto zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukugcinwa kwezinto zokusebenza kwenziwa ngokwesidingo somenzi. Phatha ukuphepha, impilo, indawo, ubungozi nanginga (SHERQ) kuDivision. Hambisana ngokuqinisekayo nezidingo zokuphepha ze-OHSA. Qapha futhi unciphise izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezihlobene nesitsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambiswana nemigudu ye-SHERQ. Siza ekuthuthukisweni, ukubuyekezeni, ukuphumelelisini nokuhambisana nemigudu kanye nemigomo yokukhiqiza njengoba kudingwa i-GPW.

xh.title: Umsebenzi woKulawula eNkonzweni: Ukuphucula uMfanekiso
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wolawulo kwiiGovernment Printing Works ePretoria onoxanduva lokwamkela nokuphucula iimfanekiso ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo zesoftware, akukho mava edingekayo ngaphambili.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi seGrade 12. Akukho mava edingekayo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nempahla. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isivumo sokhuseleko esithembekileyo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isivumo sokhuseleko esithembekileyo.
xh.duties: Amkela aze aphucule iimfanekiso, izigqibo, aze ahlele aphucule ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo zesoftware. Qwalasela iimfanekiso, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukulungisa imibala, ukulungelelanisa ukukhanya nokuchasana, ukususa iingxaki, nokuqhakamshela okunye ukuphucula ukubonakala ngokubanzi komgangatho womfanekiso. Gcina inkqubo exhcwathelweyo yokugcina nokubuyisela iifayile zemifanekiso, uqinisekisa ukuba iifayile zithiywe igama zize zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo, kwaye zigcinwindawo elungileyo. Zigqibelele ngeendaba zamanqanaba emhlabeni nesoftware entsha okanye iinkqubo ezinokuphucula inkqubo yokuphucula imifanekiso. Sebenzisana namalungu amnye eqembu lokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimfanekiso zenziwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle, nakuqinisekisa ukuba zihambelana nemigaqo efunekayo yemigangatho ye ICAO. Lilinge umthwalo wokusebenza. Hlenga ipepha elineenkcukacha lokusebenza okanye amatikiti omsebenzi kulandelo lwabathengi nakwezinye iinkcazelo njengabakhokeleli ekudibaniseni imveliso okanye ekwenzeni iiyure. Cima uze ulondoloze iimanqanaba nempatha. Qinisekisa ukuba ulondolulo lwemanqanaba kwimpahla lwenziwa ngokweemfuno zomenzi. Lawula ukhuseleko, impilo, indalo, ingozi nomgangatho (SHERQ) kwicandelo. Zithobe kuzo zonke iimfuno zokhuseleko ze OHSA. Lilinge uze uchaze iingozi ezinxulumene nisityalo zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo ze SHERQ zithobwa. Nceda ekuyila, ekuphonononga, ekusebenziseni nasekuzithobelweni iinkqubo namagqabazo okusebenza njengoko kufunwa yi GPW.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Administrative Support Services
jobs.summary: Administration Clerk providing administrative support services at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with no prior experience needed.

Track usage, initiate re-ordering when required, and maintain an organized inventory system. Maintain, update and manage records of production activities, including job specifications, client requirements, production schedules, inventory levels, and related information. Distribute printed documents and related correspondence to relevant stakeholders. Coordinate with courier or transport service providers to arrange deliveries and monitor delivery progress. Track and trace dispatched printed materials to support timely and accurate delivery. Communicate with delivery personnel, monitor shipment status, and assist in resolving delivery issues or delays. Administrative reporting and procedures. Compile up-to-date statistics and provide input for daily, weekly, or monthly reports as required. Support the ordering and maintenance of adequate material stock to ensure availability for continuous production.

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Administratiewe Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste by Government Printing Works in Pretoria verleen, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat benodig met geen voorafgaande ondervinding wat vereis word nie.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Geen ondervinding vereis nie. Begrip van relevante staatsdiensadministrasieraamwerke, GPW-beleide, sekuriteitsdrukprosedures en interne administratiewe voorskrifte. Moet in staat wees om 'n positiewe sekuriteitsklarans te verkry
af.duties: Assisteer die Hoofklerk met produksie-aktiwiteite en ondersteun vloeiende werksvloei binne die sekuriteitsdruk-omgewing. Skakel met ontwerp-, pers-, druk-, afwerkings- en ander relevante eenhede om die tydige voltooiing van werk te ondersteun. Volg gebruik na, stel herbestelling in werking wanneer nodig, en handhaaf 'n georganiseerde voorraadstelsel. Onderhou, werk opdateer en bestuur rekords van produksie-aktiwiteite, insluitend werkspesifikasies, kliëntvereistes, produksieskedules, voorraadvlakke en verwante inligting. Versprei gedrukte dokumente en verwante korrespondensie aan relevante belanghebbendes. Koördineer met koerier- of vervoerdiensverskaffers om aflewerings te reël en afleweringsvoortgang te monitor. Volg en tracer versende gedrukte materiaal om tydige en akkurate aflewering te ondersteun. Kommunikeer met afleweringspersoneel, monitor versendingstatus, en help om afleweringsprobleme of vertragings op te los. Administratiewe verslagdoening en prosedures. Stel op-datum-statistieke op en voer insette vir daaglikse, weeklikse of maandelikse verslae soos vereis. Ondersteun die bestelling en onderhoud van voldoende materiaalvoorraad om beskikbaarheid vir deurlopende produksie te verseker.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphatha: Amasevisi Okusekela Ezokuphatha
zu.summary: Clerk wezokuphatha ohlinzeka ngamasevisi okusekela ezokuphatha e Government Printing Works e Pretoria, ofuna isitifikedi se-Grade 12 ngaphandle kokuthi adingwe ngaso mnqamuzajoju.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12. Akukho mnqamuzajoju odingekayo. Ukuqonda izakhiwo ezihambisana nezokuphatha zensizakalo kahulumeni, izinqubomgomo ze-GPW, izindlela zokushicilela ngokuvikelekile, nezalelo zangaphakathi ezokuphatha. Kumele akwazi ukuthola isitifiketi sokuvikeleka esihle.
zu.duties: Siza i-Chief Clerk nemicimbi yokukhiqiza futhi useke ukuphumelelisa kwezomsebenzi endaweni yokushicilela ngokuvikelekile. Xhumana namayunithi okuklama, weshini, yokushicilela, yokugqiba, namanye amayunithi ahambisanayo ukuze useke ukuqedwa kwomsebenzi ngasikhathi. Landela ukusetshenziswa, qala uku-oda kabusha uma kudingeka, futhi gcine isistimu yezimpahla ehleliwe. Gcina, buyekeza futhi philise amarekhodi wemicimbi yokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa izici zomsebenzi, izidingo zakhasimende, izikhululo zokukhiqiza, amazinga ezimpahla, nomniningwane ohlobene naleso. Sabelisa amadokhumenti ashicilelwe nesixhumanisi ahambisanayo kubantu abahlobene. Hlanganyela nabahlinzeki besevisi yebhasikidi noma yokuhamba ukulungisa ukulethwa futhi ulande ukuphumelela kokulethwa. Landela futhi uhole amaphrinta athunyelwe ukuze useke ukulethwa ngasikhathi nangokuchanekile. Xhumana nabasebenzi bokuletha, landela isimo sokuthumela, futhi usize ekuxazululeni izinkinga noma izingabalaza zokuletha. Okokubika nezindlela ezokuphatha. Qamba izibalo ezibukekayo futhi nikeze okufakwayo emabhikini okubika kwansuku zonke, masonto, noma nyanga zonke njengoba kudingeka. Sekela uku-oda nokugcina isitoko sezinto esanele ukuze kuqiniseke ukutholakala kokukhiqiza okuqhubekayo.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Iinkonzo zoLuxe loLawulo
xh.summary: I-Clerk yolawulo ehlinzeka ngeenkonzo zoLuxe loLawulo e Government Printing Works e Pretoria, kufuneka ine-GRADE 12 certificate kwaye akukho phuhliso oludingekayo.
xh.requirements: i-GRADE 12 certificate. Akukho phuhliso ludingekayo. Ukuqonda iziseko ezibalulekileyo zolawulo lwesebe likarhulumnde, iinkqubo ze-GPW, iinkqubo zokushicilela ekhuselekileyo, nemithetho yangaphakathi yolawulo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukufumana isigqibo sokhuseleko esilungileyo
xh.duties: Ncedisa iChief Clerk ngemisebenzi yokukhiqiza nokuXhasa ukusasazwa komsesho ohamba kakuhle ngaphakathi kwindawo yokushicilela ekhuselekileyo. Phathiswana neyuniti yokuyila, ipress, yokushicilela, yokugqiba, nakwezinye iindawo ezibalulekileyo ukuze uxhase ukuqwalaselwa ngexesha elincinci lokwenza umsebenzi. Landela ukusetyenziswa, qala uku-oda kwakhona xa kudingeka, zigcine inkqubo ehlelweyo yokulondoloza. Yonke oku, hlaziya ulawule irekhodi zemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, kuquka iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, iimfuno zabathengi, iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa, iinqanaba zokulondoloza, nolwazi oluhambelanayo. Sasaza amaxwebhu ashicilelweyo neNqaku elihambelanayo kubathathi-nxaxheba abalulekileyo. Qhobosha ngeenkonzo zokuthumela ngenkosi kuphatho ukulungelelisa ukuthunyelwa kwaye ulandele inkqubo yokuThunyelwa. Landela uphawule ukuthunyelwa kwamaxwebhu ashicilelweyo ukuze uxhase ukuthunyelwa ngexesha elincinci nelichanekileyo. Thetha nabathunywa bemiThunyelo, landela isimo sokuthunyelwa, uncede ukusombulula iingxaki okanye iinkqubo zokuThunyelwa. Iingxelo zolawulo nezaNqonya. Qamba izibalo ezihlaziyiweyo unikeze ingeniselo lwamaxwebhu ansuku zonke, amabeeki, okanye nyanga njengoko kudingeka. Xhasa uku-oda nokulondoloza okwaneleyo kwempahla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka kokuqhubekayo ekukhiqizweni.

af.title: HRBeampte: Verlof- en Voordeeladministrasie
af.summary: HRBeampte by Government Printing Works in Pretoria om verlofprosesse en voordele met behulp van PERSAL te administreer, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n diploma in HR-bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Driejaar-diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, PERSAL-opleiding plus 1 - 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n verlof- en voordeeladministrasie-omgewing sal 'n voordeel wees. Begrip van alle relevante wetgewende raamwerke, regulasies en voorskrifte vir Menslike Hulpbronne.
af.duties: Administreer die verlofprosesse: Hersien alle tipes verlofaansoeke wat ontvang is en voer dit op PERSAL in. Verseker dat die verlofaansoeke in ooreenstemming met verlofbeleid en voorskrifte is. Identifiseer anomalieë en kommunikeer vereistes na die betrokke eenheid. Verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuning en verlofnavorsings: Hanteer alle navrae rakende verlofadministrasie. Onderhou gehalteverlofrekords. Voer verlofoudits uit wanneer vereis. Administreer PILIR-aansoekdienste: Ontvang en dien PILIR-aansoeke by SOMA in. Stel en onderhou 'n PILIR-register van aansoeke wat na SOMA gestuur is en voer SOMA-uitkomste in en reageer daarop. Administreer die bevorderings- en proeftydperkherbesienings. Rekordhouding: Werk data op die stelsel op en hou behoorlike rekords. Verseker op-datum-werknemerrekords. zu.summary: Ongosi we-HR e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria ukuphatha inqubo yenqulo nezinzuzo kusebenzisa i-PERSAL, kudingeka isitifiketi se-Grade 12 nesidiploma Sokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. Isidiploma seminyaka emithathu (esilingana ne-NQF level 6) Sokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza, ukuqeqeshwa kwe-PERSAL kahanye neminyaka engu-1 - 2 yomkhathi wokuhlangabezana kokuphathwa kwenqulo nezinzuzo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqonda konke okuhlobene nokuqondiswa ngokomthetho kokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza, imithetho nemiyalelo.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yenqulo: Hlola wonke ohlobo lwemibiko yenqulo etholiwe ibhalwe kwi-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuthi imibiko yenqulo ihambisana nomgomo nemiqulu yenqulo. Hlaziya amaphutha uxhume izidingo kwesigaba esihambisana. Nikeza ukusekela komphathelele jikelele futhi wazise ngemibuzo yenqulo: Hlolisisa yonke imibuzo ehlobene nokuphathwa kwenqulo. Gcina amarekhodi wenqulo ahle kahle.enza ukuhlolwa kwenqulo kusbukelwa sikhathi. Phatha izinkonzo zemibiko ye-PILIR: Thola futhi uhambise imibiko ye-PILIR ku-SOMA. Hlanganisa futhi ugcine irekhodi le-PILIR yemibiko ethunyelwe ku-SOMA bese ubhala futhi usebenzisa umphumela we-SOMA. Phatha izinzuzo zensizakusebenza: Phatha izikhundla kwi-PERSAL. Sebenzisa izinzuzo kanye nemibandela yesevisi njengokumiswa, ukushintshwa kwezindawo nosizo lokwelashwa. Sebenzisa ukuphela kweisevisi kwi-PERSAL. Phatha ukubukezwa kokukhushulwa kwezikhundla kanye nesikhathi sokuzama. Ukugcina amarekhodi: Hlaziya idatha kusistimu bese ugcina amarekhodi ahle kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi abasebenzi ahlala njalo avusekile. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphathwa komphathelele jikelele: Nikeza ukusekela ngomphathelele ngesikhathi sezinhlelo ezihlobene nezinzuzo zesevisi, phendula imibuzo ehlobene nezinzuzo ezikhokhelwayo zabasebenzi nemibandela. Phatha imvume yokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile kwi-PERSAL. Bhala imibhalo ethunyelwa kubasebenzi.

xh.title: ISikhululi Sezabasebenzi: Ulawulo Lwamalungelo Nemisebenzi
xh.summary: ISikhululi Sezabasebenzi e Government Printing Works e Pretoria ukulawula iinkqubo zamalungelo nemisebenzi kusetyenziswa i PERSAL, kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi se Grade 12 nediploma yoLawulo Lezabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12. Idiploma yeminyaka emithathu (elingana nangangoku kwi NQF level 6) kwiLawulo Lezabantu, uQeqesho lwe PERSAL kunye nenkonzo yeminyaka 1 - 2 kwendawo yoLawulo Lwamalungelo Nemisebenzi kuya kuba lusizo. Ukuqonda kwakho nawuphi na umthetho ochazwe ngomthetho wezabasebenzi, umthetho ophawulwayo nemigaqo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo zamalungelo: Phonononla zonke iintlobo zezenzo zamalungelo ezifunyenwe zize zibhalwe kwi PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo zamalungelo zihambelana nomthetho namigaqo. Phawula iingxaki uze uxelele iimfuno kwindima ephathwayo. Nikezela ngoncedo lolawulo jikelele nemibuzo engamalungelo: Joya yonke imibuzo enxulumene nolawulo lwamalungelo. Gcina irekhodi elilungileyo lamalungelo. Yenza uvavanyo lwamalungelo xa kufuneka. Lawula iinkonzo zezicelo ze PILIR: Thola uze unike izicelo ze PILIR ku SOMA. Hlaza uze ugcinge irejista ye PILIR yezicelo ezithunyelwa ku SOMA uze ubhale uze wenza isiphumo se SOMA. Qhuba imisebenzi yamalungelo abasebenzi: Qhuba izikhethwa kwi PERSAL. Zisebenzise imisebenzi nemigaqo efana nemivuzo engasemthethweni, ukuhlala kunye nancedo lwezempilo. Zisebenzise ukuqhawula inkonzo kwi PERSAL. Lawula ukujongwa kokuqhubela phambili nesiqendu. Igciniwe kwirekhodi: Hlaziya idatha kwinkqubo uze ugcinge irekhodi elungileyo. Qinisekisa irekhodi yabasebenzi ehlelijweyo. Nikezela iinkonzo zolawulo jikelele: Nikezela ngenkxaso yolawulo phakathi kweeprojekthi eziphuma kumalungelo, phendula imibuzo enxulumene namalungelo abasebenzi ahlawulewayo namaxa. Qhuba igunya loqeqesho lwexesha elidlulileyo kwi PERSAL. Lalisha unxibelelwano nabasebenzi.

jobs.title: HR Officer: Organisational Development and Change
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum (Level 05), plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: HR Officer role at Government Printing Works in Pretoria providing organisational development and change management admin support, requiring a Diploma and relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate. Three-year Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) in Work- study / Management Services / Operations Management / Production Management/ Industrial and organisational Psychology, PERSAL Training plus 1 - 2 years’ experience in Organisational Development and Change Management environment will be an added advantage. Understanding of all relevant Human Resources legislative framework, regulation and prescripts.
jobs.duties: Provision of admin support during organisational structure investigation: Provide admin support during Branch consultations. Assist with implementation of the design, development, maintenance and review of the functional organisational structure. Compile draft work-study memos, letters and relevant OD reports. Update and maintain the organisational structure upon the approval of the submissions. Implement the organisational structure and the alignment on PERSAL. Facilitate and develop job descriptions: Identify unsigned/ outdated job descriptions. Consult with the relevant manager on the development of the job description. Draft and update job descriptions in line with organisational structure and relevant legislation where required. Keep and update a database of all job descriptions within the GPW. Provide support during job evaluation processes. Present/ submit the job evaluation packs for quality assurance. Provide secretariat support for job evaluation panel. Update and maintain the alignment of organisational structure with post establishment: Provide PERSAL establishment maintenance support Provide support during implementation of OD related projects. Change Management: Assist with coordination of Change Management meetings. Draft documents related to Change Management decisions. Ensure proper filing of OD related records.

af.title: HR-beampte: Organisatoriese Ontwikkeling en Verandering
af.summary: HR-beampte-pos by Government Printing Works in Pretoria wat administratiewe ondersteuning vir organisatoriese ontwikkeling en veranderingsbestuur bied, 'n Diploma en relevante ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Driejaar-Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 6) in Werkstudie / Bestuursdienste / Bedryfsbestuur / Produksiebestuur / Bedryfs- en organisatoriese sielkunde, PERSAL-opleiding plus 1 - 2 jaar se ondervinding in 'n omgewing vir Organisatoriese Ontwikkeling en Veranderingsbestuur sal 'n voordeel wees. Begrip van alle relevante wetlike raamwerke, regulasies en voorskrifte vir Menslike Hulpbronne.
af.duties: Verskaffing van administratiewe ondersteuning tydens ondersoek na die organisatoriese struktuur: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning tydens tak-konsultasies. Bied bystand met die toepassing van die ontwerp, ontwikkeling, instandhouding en hersiening van die funksionele organisatoriese struktuur. Stel konsep-werkstudie-memos, briewe en relevante OO-verslae op. Dateer die organisatoriese struktuur op en onderhou dit na goedkeuring van die voorleggings. Pas die organisatoriese struktuur en die belyning op PERSAL toe. Fasiliteer en ontwikkel funksiebeskrywings: Identifiseer ongetekende/verouderde funksiebeskrywings. Oorleg met die relevante bestuurder oor die ontwikkeling van die funksiebeskrywing. Stel funksiebeskrywings op en dateer dit op in ooreenstemming met die organisatoriese struktuur en relevante wetgewing waar vereis. Hou 'n databasis van alle funksiebeskrywings binne die GPW op en dateer dit op. Verskaf ondersteuning tydens prosesse vir funksie-evaluering. Dien funksie-evalueringspakkette vir gehalteversekering voor. Verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning vir die funksie-evalueringspaneel. Dateer die belyning van die organisatoriese struktuur met die pos se instelling op en onderhou dit: Verskaf ondersteuning vir die instandhouding van die PERSAL-instelling. Verskaf ondersteuning tydens die toepassing van OO-verwante projekte. Veranderingsbestuur: Bied bystand met die koördinering van veranderingsbestuursvergaderings. Stel dokumente op met betrekking tot veranderingsbestuursbesluite. Verseker behoorlike liassering van OO-verwante rekords.

zu.title: Umphathi we-HR: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo kanye Nokushintsha
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi we-HR e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria esinikeza ukwesekwa kwabaphathi ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo nasekulawuleni izehlulelo zokushintsha, esifuna i-Diploma namava ahambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (efana namazinga e-NQF 6) ku-Work-study / Management Services / Operations Management / Production Management / Industrial and organisational Psychology, ukuqeqeshwa kwe-PERSAL okuhlanganayo namava angu-1 - 2 emzileni wokuThuthukiswa kwezinhlelo noKulawula izehlulelo zokushintsha kuzoba yinzuzo. Kuqondeke wonke umthetho ohlobene nemisebenzi yabaSebenzi, imithetho namaphothifolo.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwabaphathi ngesikhathi kohlelo lwezinhlelo lutholwa oluphenywa: Unikeze ukwesekwa kwabaphathi ngesikhathi kubonisana i-Branch. Usize ekusetshenzisweni kokwakhiwa, kokuthuthukiswa, kokugcinwa nokubukeka kohlelo lwezinhlebo olusebenzayo. Uqhube amamemo okusebenza, amagama namaphothifolo ahambene no-OD abhalwa ngesandla. Ubuyekeze ugcinde uhlelo lwezinhlebo lapho kemukele izicelo. Usethenze uhlelo lwezinhlebo kanye nokuqondanisa ku-PERSAL. Uhole futhi ukuthuthukisa izincazelo zemisebenzi: Uthole izincazelo zemisebenzi ezingabhalwanga ngaphansi noma ezindala. Ubonisane nomphathi ohlobene ekuthuthukisweni kwencazelo yomsebenzi. Uqaqe futhi ubuyekeze izincazelo zemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nohlelo lwezinhlebo nomthetho ohlobene lapho kudingeka. Ugcinde ubuyekeze idathabhesi yazo zonke izincazelo zemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-GPW. Unikeze ukwesekwa ngesikhathi kwenqubo yokuhlola imisebenzi. Uthi engqamuzweni unikeze amaphakethe okuhlola imisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe khululeka. Unikeze ukwesekwa komlobi wezokuhluza iphaneli yokuhlola imisebenzi. Ubuyekeze futhi ugcinde ukuqondanisa kohlelo lwezinhlebo nezikhundla ezibalulekayo: Unikeze ukwesekwa kokuqondanisa i-PERSAL. Unikeze ukwesekwa ngesikhathi kusetshenziswa imiklamo ehlobene no-OD. UKulawula izehlulelo zokushintsha: Usize ekuhlelweni kokuhlangana kweze-zokushintsha izehlulelo. Uqaqe amadokhumenti ahlobene nokuquma izehlulelo zokushintsha. Uqinisekise ukulondolozwa kwemibhalo ehlobene no-OD ekugcineni.

xh.title: ISikhulu seZabasebenzi: Ukuziphilisa Koluntu nokuTshintsha
xh.summary: Indima yesikhulu sezabasebenzi kwi-Government Printing Works ePretoria ethi inike inkxaso yolawulo ekuziphiliseni koluntu nasekuqwalaselweni kokutshintsha, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma namava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12. I-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (elingana neNQF level 6) kwi-Work- study / Management Services / Operations Management / Production Management/ Industrial and organisational Psychology, uqeqesho lwe-PERSAL kunye neminyaka 1 - 2 yamava kwimeko yokuZiphilisa Koluntu nokuLawulwa koTshintsho kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo. Ukuqonda koongoqoqo lowulothetho wezabiwo zabasebenzi onke ahambelanayo, imithetho nemiyalelo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkxaso yolawulo ngelixa kusenziwa uphando lolwakhiwo loluntu: Nikela inkxaso yolawulo ngelixa kubakho iingxoxo zeBranji. Yunceda ekusebenziseni ukuyila, ukuphuhlisa, ukugcina nokuqwalasela kwakhona ulwakhiwo loluntu olusebenzayo. Lungelelanisa imemo yolwakhiwo loluntu, iileta nangaphezulu iirapotho ezahambelanayo ne-OD. Hlaziya ugcine ulwakhiwo loluntu emva kokuvunywa kwezicelo. Sebenzisa ulwakhiwo loluntu nolungelelwaniso kwi-PERSAL. Qhuba uphuhlise iinkcazelo zemisebenzi: Qaphela iinkcazelo zemisebenzi ezingasayiniwayo/ezindala. Xoxa nomphathi ohambelanayo ngokuphuhlisa inkcaciso yomsebenzi. Qamba uhlaziye iinkcazelo zemisebenzi ngokwemigaqo yolwakhiwo loluntu nangaphezulu umthetho apho kufunekileyo. Gcina uhlaziye idathabheysi yazo zonke iinkcazelo zemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwi-GPW. Nikela inkxaso ngelixa kusenziwa iinkqubo zokuqwalasela imisebenzi. Bonisa/ungenisa iipakhu zokuqwalasela imisebenzi ukuqinisekisa umgangatho. Nikela inkxaso yesikela njengomongameli webhodi yokuqwalasela imisebenzi. Hlaziya ugcine ulungelelwaniso lolwakhiwo loluntu nolwakhiwo lweesithuba: Nikela inkxaso yokugcinwa kolwakhiwo lwe-PERSAL. Nikela inkxaso ngelixa kusebenziswa iiprojekthi ezihambelanayo ne-OD. uLawulo loTshintsho: Yunceda ekulungelelaniseni iindibano zoLawulo loTshintsho. Qamba amaxwebhu ahambelanayo nezigqibo zoLawulo loTshintsho. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuchanekileyo kweenkqubo ezihambelanayo ne-OD.

jobs.title: Deputy Director Evaluation and Learning: Jobs Fund
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Evaluation and Learning at the Jobs Fund in Pretoria, requiring a degree and 6-8 years of M&E experience in development programmes.
jobs.requirements: A degree (NQF 7) in M&E, Development, Public Administration, Economics or other related field. Honours or Master’s degrees in M&E, social sciences or equivalent experience and education would be advantageous. Training or certification in statistics and quantitative measurements would be advantageous. Minimum 6-8 years experience in monitoring, measurement and evaluation of development programmes/projects; conducting evaluations and writing evaluation reports, at least 2 years at management level. Experience capturing both good practices and lessons learned, in a variety of approaches (e.g. end of the project evaluation, special studies); Experience in project design and evaluation; Experience in research, policy analysis and evaluation of donor-funded projects; Experience of Donor Communities and Development of Enterprise Standards; Experience in the preparation of evaluation reports for different audiences – technical, management, government, donors and other stakeholders; Experience in application of leading qualitative and quantitative data collection, analysis and reporting tools; Experience in managing projects with multiple stakeholders; Excellent report-writing skills.
jobs.duties: Evaluation and Support: Execute the Jobs Fund Evaluation Framework and Learning Agenda. Support the evaluation of projects and extract learnings from the Jobs Fund portfolio. Provide the inputs to Terms of Reference for evaluations and manage the service provider selection process. Manage the service providers secured to carry out project-level evaluations. Provide inputs into the design of baseline assessments, formative evaluations, mid-term evaluations and summative evaluations for projects. Support partners in the development of results chains for their projects. Plan for, design and conduct formative, process and summative evaluations. Utilise evaluation results to improve project roll-out, and to appraise new projects. Promote and Enhance Learning: Analyse and synthesise findings from project evaluations. Support awareness sessions with partners on evaluations, results-based management and project close-outs. Perform benchmarking and learning exercises on job creation, sustainability and systemic change. Document feedback on learnings from case studies, reviews, project close-out reports and other related factors. Engage in activities related to the synthesis and dissemination of lessons learned by the Jobs Fund. Support evaluation outputs and facilitate the implementation of recommendations from evaluations. Client Engagement: Liaise and engage with stakeholders on learning and evaluation at the project level and Jobs Fund level. Providing support to Jobs Fund Partners to ensure post-Jobs Fund success. Appraise the Project Implementation Monitoring Plans and Theory of Change of new project applications. Advise on the use of job proxies when required. Evaluation and Learning Framework: Support the JF in meeting evaluation and learning targets. Support the development of a learning framework with each business unit in the Jobs Fund. Provide technical support to project managers and the Communications Unit to develop and document compelling outcome and impact success stories, and to foster institutionalisation and internalisation of learning processes. Contribute to the training of project managers and partners on evaluation methodologies. Management of Data and Systems: Identify opportunities to optimise the Job Fund’s collection, use, and management of data. Support the training for Jobs Fund staff on the use of systems and effective data collection, use, and visualisation. Simplify complex systems and processes into user-friendly guidance for staff. Collaborate with the grants management system (GMS) team and unit staff on broader system enhancements. Data Analysis, Research and Learning: Provide technical support to short- and long-term research, analysis, and information gathering assignments in support of evaluation and learning efforts. Manage, analyse, and effectively visualise large and complex data sets. Coordinate and respond to internal and external requests for data and data analysis. Support the synthesis of Jobs Fund knowledge, knowledge dissemination and active engagement of wider market players. Support the systematic recording of the social impact of Jobs Fund projects. JFPs already report social impact through narratives in quarterly reporting. Monitoring and Evaluation System: Execute the overall framework of the monitoring and evaluation activities. Assess the validity of monitoring and evaluation data through regular and ad-hoc review of activities. Draft, revise and update tools and data collection procedures (e.g. logical framework, project performance tracking, indicators, data flow chart, M&E manuals). Support the Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting and Learning Lead in defining and implementing key project performance indicators (KPI) as well as monitoring them throughout the duration of projects.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur Evaluering en Leer: Jobs Fund
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Evaluering en Leer by die Jobs Fund in Pretoria, wat 'n graad en 6-8 jaar se M&E-ervaring in ontwikkelingsprogramme vereis.
af.requirements: A degree (NQF 7) in M&E, Development, Public Administration, Economics or other related field. Honours or Master's degrees in M&E, social sciences or equivalent experience and education would be advantageous. Training or certification in statistics and quantitative measurements would be advantageous. Minimum 6-8 years experience in monitoring, measurement and evaluation of development programmes/projects; conducting evaluations and writing evaluation reports, at least 2 years at management level. Experience capturing both good practices and lessons learned, in a variety of approaches (e.g. end of the project evaluation, special studies); Experience in project design and evaluation; Experience in research, policy analysis and evaluation of donor-funded projects; Experience of Donor Communities and Development of Enterprise Standards; Experience in the preparation of evaluation reports for different audiences – technical, management, government, donors and other stakeholders; Experience in application of leading qualitative and quantitative data collection, analysis and reporting tools; Experience in managing projects with multiple stakeholders; Excellent report-writing skills.
af.duties: Evaluering en Ondersteuning: Voer die Jobs Fund Evaluasieraamwerk en Leeragenda uit. Ondersteun die evaluering van projekte en onttrek lesse uit die Jobs Fund-portefeulje. Verskaf insette tot die Terme van Verwysing vir evaluerings en bestuur die diensverskaffer-seleksieproses. Bestuur die diensverskaffers wat verkry is om projekvlak-evaluerings uit te voer. Verskaf insette tot die ontwerp van basislynassessering, formatiewe evaluerings, midtermyn-evaluerings en summatiewe evaluerings vir projekte. Ondersteun vennote in die ontwikkeling van resultaatkettings vir hul projekte. Beplan, ontwerp en voer formatiewe, proses- en summatiewe evaluerings uit. Gebruik evaluasieresultate om projek-uitrol te verbeter, en om nuwe projekte te waardeer. Bevorder en verbeter leer: Analiseer en sintetiseer bevindings uit projektevaluerings. Ondersteun bewusmakingsessies met vennote oor evaluerings, resultaatgebaseerde bestuur en projekafsluitings. Voer normbepalings- en leeroefeninge uit oor werkskepping, volhoubaarheid en stelselmatige verandering. Dokumenteer terugvoer oor lesse uit gevallestudies, hersienings, projekafsluitingsverslae en ander verwante faktore. Neem deel aan aktiwiteite verbandhoudende met die sintese en verspreiding van lesse geleer deur die Jobs Fund. Ondersteun evaluasie-uitsette en fasiliteer die implementering van aanbevelings uit evaluerings. Klientebetrokkenheid: Skakel en engageer met belanghebbendes oor leer en evaluering op projekvlak en Jobs Fund-vlak. Verskaf ondersteuning aan Jobs Fund-vennote om sukses na die Jobs Fund te verseker. Waardeer die Projekimplementering Moniteringsplanne en Teorie van Verandering van nuwe projektoepassings. Adviseer oor die gebruik van werkvervangers when required. Evaluering en Leerraamwerk: Ondersteun die JF om evaluering en leerdoelwitte te bereik. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van 'n leerraamwerk met elke besigheids-eenheid in die Jobs Fund. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan projekbestuurders en die Kommunikasie-eenheid om oortuigende uitkoms- en impak-suksesverhale te ontwikkel en te dokumenteer, en om die institusionalisering en internalisering van leerprosesse te bevorder. Dra by tot die opleiding van projekbestuurders en vennote oor evaluasiemetodes. Bestuur van Data en Stelsels: Identifiseer geleenthede om die Jobs Fund se versameling, gebruik en bestuur van data te optimaliseer. Ondersteun die opleiding van Jobs Fund-personeel oor die gebruik van stelsels en effektiewe dataversameling, gebruik en visualisering. Vereenvoudig komplekse stelsels en prosesse tot gebruikersvriendelike riglyne vir personeel. Werk saam met die toekkebestuurstelsel (GMS)-span en eenheidspersoneel oor breër stelselverbeterings. Data-analise, Navorsing en Leer: Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan kort- en langtermyn-navorsings-, analise- en inligtingsversamelingsopdragte ter ondersteuning van evaluerings- en leerpogings. Bestuur, analiseer en visualiseer effektief groot en komplekse datastelle. Koördineer en reageer op interne en eksterne versoeke om data en data-analise. Ondersteun die sintese van Jobs Fund-kennis, kennisverspreiding en aktiewe betrokkenheid van wyer markspelers. Ondersteun die stelselmatige optekening van die sosiale impak van Jobs Fund-projekte. JFPs rapporteer reeds sosiale impak deur vertellings in kwartaalverslae. Moniterings- en Evalueringstelsel: Voer die algehele raamwerk van die moniterings- en evalueringsaktiwiteite uit. Assess die geldigheid van moniterings- en evalueringsdata deur gereelde en ad hoc hersiening van aktiwiteite. Opstel, hersien en werk gereedskappe en dataversamelingsprosedures by (bv. logiese raamwerk, projekprestasie-opvolging, aanwysers, datavloeidiagram, M&E-handleidings). Ondersteun die Moniterings-, Evaluering-, Verslagdoenings- en Leier in die definieer en implementeer van sleutel projekprestasie-aanwysers (KPI) sowel as die monitering daarvan deur die loop van projekte.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela-Mfundi Sezokuhlola Nokufunda: i-Jobs Fund
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela-Mfundi Sezokuhlola Nokufunda ku-Jobs Fund ePretoria, sidinga iziqu neminyaka yoku-6-8 yokuhlola nokubheka izinhlelo zentuthuko.
zu.requirements: Iziqu (NQF 7) kokuhlola nokubheka, Ezentuthuko, Eziphathwa kahulumeni, Izoqoqosho noma enye indlela ephathelene nakho. Iziqu ze-Honours noma i-Master's kokuhlola nokubheka, izifundo zomphakathi noma okuhlobene nokuhlola nokufunda kungase kubonele. Ukuqeqeshwa noma isitifiketi kuzibalo nezilinganiso ezinani kungase kubonele. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6-8 yokuhlola, ukulinganisa nokuhlola izinhlelo/izinhlelo zentuthuko; ukuqamba izinhlela zokuqondisa nokubhala imibiko yokuqondisa, okungenani iminyaka engu-2 ezingeni lolawulo. Okuhlangabezayo kukho ukuthwebula izindlela ezinhle nezifundo eziye zafundwa, kuzindlela ezahlukahlukene (isb. ukuhlola esipheleni senhlela, izifundo ezikhethekile); Okuhlangabezayo kukho ukudizayina nokuhlola amaphrojekthi; Okuhlangabezayo kukho ucwaningo, ukuhlaziya izinqubomgomo nokuhlola amaphrojekthi axhaswa ngabezimali; Okuhlangabezayo nokumazi umphakathi wabezimali kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindinganiso zentuthuko; Okuhlangabezayo kulungiselelo kwemibiko yokuhlola kubaphathi abahlukene – abanobuchwepheshe, abaphathi, uhulumeni, abanikela bemali namanye abahlanganyeli; Okuhlangabezayo ekusetshenzisweni kwamathuluzi ahamba phambili okuqoqa, ukuhlaziya nokubika idatha ekhwalithathi nakuquantity; Okuhlangabezayo ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi anabahlanganyeli abaningi; Amakhono aphezulu okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola Nokusekela: Phumeza i-Jobs Fund Evaluation Framework nokuhamba phambili kokufunda. Sekela ukuhlola amaphrojekthi futhi ukhiphe izifundo kusuka ohlwini lwamaphrojekthi e-Jobs Fund. Nikeza izinto ezingenisa kwamagama okuqondisa ukuhlola uphathe inqubo yokukhethwa bemenzi-womsebenzi. Phatha abanikela besebenzi abatholiwe ukuba benze ukuhlola kwamaphrojekthi ezingeni eliphansi. Nikeza izinto ezingenisa ekudizayineni kokuhlola kokuqala, ukuhlola kwakho midwayana, ukuhlola phakathi kwesikhathi nokuhlola esipheleni samaphrojekthi. Sekela abahlanganyeli ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto ezenza imiphumela yamaphrojekthi abo. Hlela, diza futhi wenze ukuhlola kokuthoma kwakho, inqubo nokuhlola esipheleni. Sebenzisa imiphumela yokuhlola ukuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi, nokuhlola amaphrojekthi amasha. Khuthaza Futhi Ukuthuthukisa Ukufunda: Hlaziya futhi uhlanganise iziphumelo ezisuka ekuhloleni kwamaphrojekthi. Sekela izikhathi zokwazisa abahlanganyeli ngokuhlola, ukuphathwa ngemiphumela kanye nokuvalwa kwamaphrojekthi. Yenza ukuqhathanisa nokuzivocavoca kokufunda ngokudala imisebenzi, ukugcina futhi okushintsha isimiso. Qamba imibiko yemiphumela yokufunda ezifundeni zamaphrojekthi, ukuhlola imibiko, imibiko yokuvala amaphrojekthi kanye nezinye izinto ezihlobene nakho. Zibandakanya ezintweni ezihlobene nokuhlanganisa nokusabalalisa izifundo eziye zafundwa i-Jobs Fund. Sekela imiphumela yokuhlola futhi uthuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwezinkomba eziye zaphakanyiswa ekuhloeni. Ukuhlangana Nodadewabo: Xhumana futhi uthinte abahlanganyeli ngokufunda nokuhlola ezingeni lamaphrojekthi nasezingeni le-Jobs Fund. Nikeza inkhuleleko kubahlanganyeli be-Jobs Fund Fund ukuze kuqiniseke impumelelo ngemva kwe-Jobs Fund. Hlola amaphrojekthi okuqondisa isiqondiso sokubheka nokwenza umthethosisekelo wezinto ezintsha zezicelo zamaphrojekthi. Luleka ekusetshenzisweni kwezinkomba zomsebenzi uma kudingeka. Ukuhlola Nokufunda Uhlelo: Sekela i-JF ekuhlanganiseni izinhloso zokuhlola nokufunda. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kohlaka lokufunda kunoma yiluphi ukuphathwa kolunye uhlangothi ku-Jobs Fund. Nikeza inkhuleleko yobuchwepheshe kubaphathi bamaphrojekthi kanye nokuqoqwa kokuxhumana ukwakha nokubhala izindaba ezikhutshaziwe ngempumelelo, futhi ukhuthaze ukufakwa kanye nokuthathwa njengengxenye yezinkinga zokufunda. Yifa ekuletheni abaphathi bamaphrojekthi kanye nabahlanganyeli ngendlela zokuqondisa. Ukuphatha Idatha Nezimiso: Thola ithuba lokulungiselela i-Jobs Fund Fund ekuthathweni, ekusetshenzisweni, nasokuphathweni kwedatha. Sekela ukuqeqesha abasebenzi be-Jobs Fund Fund ekusetshenzisweni kwamaphrojekthi kanye nokuqoqa idatha ngempumelelo, ukuyisebenzisa, futhi ukubonisa. Yenza lula izimiso ezinzima nezinkinga zibe lolula ukuzisebenzela kubasebenzi. Sebenzisana kakhulu nabanikela bokuqoqwa lwemibilo (GMS) kanye nabasebenzi kolunye uhlangothi ekuthuthukisweni kwesimiso sonke. Ukuhlaziya Idatha, Ucwaningo Nokufunda: Nikeza inkhuleleko yobuchwepheshe kuwo wonke amaphrojekthi amafuphi nade amude ucwaningo, ukuhlaziya, nokuqoqa imibiko yocwaningo. Phatha, hlaziya, futhi uqhathanise idatha enkulu enezinkinga ezinkulu. Hlela futhi uphendule izicelo zangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthola nokuqhathanisa kwedatha. Sekela ukubumba ulwazi olucishe lwakha i-Jobs Fund, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, futhi ukhuthaze naba dilika bomthombo abakhululekile ukuba basebenze. Sekela ukurekhoda ngemfanelo imiphumela yomphakathi yamaphrojekthi e-Jobs Fund. Abahlanganyeli be-JFP basiveze imiphumela ngokubhala imibiko yaso sonke isikhathi esinye. Isimiso Sokuqondisa Nokuhlola: Phetha wonke uhlaka lwezinto zokuqondisa nokuhlola. Hlola ukwaziswa kokubheka nokuhlola idatha ngokuqondisa nangokuhlola okungahleliwe noma okuhlakanipha izinto. Bala, lungisa futhi ubuyekezise amathuluzi kanye nenqubo yokuthatha idatha (isb.uhlaka lwezinto, ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi, izinkomba, iphilo lokuhamba kwedatha, imanuwali yokuqondisa nokubheka). Sekela ukuqondisa, ukuhlola, ukubika nokufunda okuhamba phambili ekuchazeni nokusebenzisa izinkomba ezibalulekile zamaphrojekthi ezinkomba (KPI) kanye nokuqondisa okuhamba phambili okungamaphrojekthi wonke isikhathi.

xh.title: iSekela Mongamadi Wokuqwalasela Nokufunda: iNtlekele yeMisebenzi
xh.summary: iSekela Mongamadi Wokuqwalasela Nokufunda kwiNtlekele yeMisebenzi ePretoria, ifuna isidanga kunye neminyaka engama-6-8 yamava okuQwalasela noQeqesho kumacandu aphuhliswa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga (NQF 7) kwikuQwalasela noQeqesho, uPhuhliso, uLawulo lukaZwelonke, iZoqoqosho okanye elinye igaba elinxulumene nalo. Isidanga seBachelori yeMastersi kwikuQwalasela noQeqesho, izayensi ezintsonkothi okanye amava abalinganayo nemfundo kubakho nzuzo. Uqeqesho okanye isatifikethi kwizibalo nokulinganisa ngobungakanani kubakho nzuzo. Uqwalaselo okungaluncedayo lweminyaka engama-6-8 ekuphatheni, ukulinganiseni nokuqwalaselwa kumacandu amaphuhlisa/amanxaxheba; ukwenza iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokubhala iingxelo zokuqwalasela, ubuncinane eminyaka engama-2 kwinqanaba lobulungu. Amava okubamba amava amhle nezifundo eziyifunyenweyo, kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo (umz. ukuqwalasela ekupheleni konxaxheba, izifundo ezikhethekileyo); Amava ekwakheni kunye nokuqwalasela amaxhaxha; Amava kuphando, ukuhlalutywa kweenkqubo nokuqwalasela amaxhaxha axhaswa ngemibonekelo; Amava kumabonelela boMnikazi-bavelwano kakuqaliswa kweziNgqibamathiriyeli zeShishino; Amava okulungiselela iingxelo zokuqwalasela abaphulaphuli abahlukeneyo – abanobuchule, abalawuli, urhulumente, abanikeli-bavelwano nabanye abathathi nxaxheba; Amava ekusebenziseni izixhobo eziphambili zokuqokelela, ukuhlalutya nokubhala iingxelo ngobungakanani nangobungangamaxhosa; Amava ekuphatheni amaxhaxha anabathathi nxaxheba abahlukeneyo; Amakhono amaben come wokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela noXhaso: Phumeza iNkqubo yokuQwalasela yeNtlekele yeMisebenzi kunye neNkqubo yoKufunda. Xhasa ukuqwalaselwa kwamaxhaxha kwaye udidiye iifundo ezithathwa kwindlu yamaxhaxha yeNtlekele yeMisebenzi. Nikela ngezipho kwiMigaqo yoBomi yeemisebenzi yokuqwalasela ulawule inkqubo yokukhetha ababoneleli benkonzo. Lawula ababoneleli benkonzo abathathiweyo ukuba bagcine ukuqwalasela kwinqanaba lexhaxha. Nikela ngezipho ekwakheni ukulinganisela ngokwesiseko, ukuqwalasela okusekwa kwindalo, ukuqwalasela phakathi kwexesha nokuqwalasela ekupheleni kwamaxhaxha. Xhasa abahlobo ekuphuhliseni amachaining imiphumo yamaxhaxha abo. Cwangcisa, yakhe uze wenze ukuqwalasela okusekwa kwindalo, yenqubo nangokuphela. Sebenzisa iziphumo zokuqwalasela ukuphucula ukusasazwa kwamaxhaxha, nokuqwalasela amaxhaxha amatsha. Khuthaza uze uphucule ukuFunda: Hlalutya udityaniswe iziphumo ezithathwa kuqwalaselo lwamaxhaxha. Xhasa iindlela zokuvakalisa ngabahlobo ngokuqwalasela, ulawulo olusekwe kumiphumo nokuvalwa kwamaxhaxha. Yenza ukuqwalasela ngokobungakanani nokuzilolonga iifundo ekudalweni kwamasebenzi, ukuzinza nenguquko yenkqubo. Qamba iingxelo ngeempendulo ngamava athathwa kumacandwana okufunda, izihloko, iingxelo zokuvala amaxhaxha nanye iimiba ezinxulumene nazo. Thatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi enxulumene nodityaniso nokusasazwa kwezifundo ezenziweyo zifunyanwe yiNtlekele yeMisebenzi. Xhasa iziphumo zokuqwalasela uze uncike ukusebenzisa iingcebiso ezithathwa kuqwalaselo. Unxibelelwano noMthathi nxaxheba: Qhagamshelana uthathe inxaxheba ngenxulumene nabathathi nxaxheba ngokufunda nokuqwalasela kwinqanaba lexhaxha naseNtlekele yeMisebenzi. Nikela ngenkxaso kubahlobo beNtlekele yeMisebenzi ukuqinisekisa impumelelo eya kuba ngaphaya kweNtlekele yeMisebenzi. Qwalasela iNkqubo yoQwalaselo lokusetyenziswa ngokwenza kwamaxhaxha kwaye usebenzise inqanaba elinguTshintsho lokuQonda yokuqwalasela abantu abafaka isicelo samaxhaxha amatsha. Lelule ngokusetyenziswa kweziphamsidiki zamasebenzi xa kufuneka. iNkqubo yoBuntu bokuHlengahlengisa nokuSebenzisa iSiseko: Xhasa inkqubo elungelelanisa ukuba ihambelane nokusengamela iinkqubo zokusebenzisa koluntu nakuphuhliso lwentsaro enkulu. Xhasa inkqubo yokugcina inqanaba lokwenza imisebenzi ngabazali bamaphulo eNtlekele yeMisebenzi. Nikela ngexabiso elisisiseko kumalungu abaphathi weNtlekele nokuqhuba imisebenzi yabathethi ngokusetyenziswa kwesixhobo. Phucula uLawulo lweMnikezelo yemininingwane, nokusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esisesikweni. Sika iinkqubo ezintsonkothiyo ukuze zibe lula kumacandu alungelelanisa iinkqubo. Nikela ngexabiso elipheleleyo kwizigqibo eziphakamileyo eziyimiqondiso yokuyalela inkqubo yolawulo ngokwemixholo esetyenziswa. Sike ukuqwalasela nokutshintsha iinkqubo zolawulo ngokusebenzisa isixhobo esikhethiweyo. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa kwemimiselo enguManyano lweManyano noQeqesho lwentsaro yabasebenzi ngokobuntlola bexesha elidibana nayo. Yenza amaxhaxha abonelele abalawuli baweNtlekele ngokwemithetho esetyenziswa ngokwexesha eliphezulu lokuphucula iNkqubo elungelelanisa iinkqubo zokusebenzisa inkqubo yonkqubo. Nikela ngamava amakhulu phezu kokuphucula inkqubo yabasebenzi bakaQoqo. Xhasa inkqubo yokulunga ngokwemisebenzi elungele uluntu nokuqwalasela imisebenzi yokubakho komlinganiswa wobuchule ebalulekileyo. Gcina ulungelelwaniso ngokwamasetyenziswa phakathi kweminikelo yokwenza imisebenzi ngabathethi namaphulo amaxhaxha abakho namaphulo abakho ngokutsha kwaye ufunde inkqubo yokuqwalasela kwaye uqwalasele imisebenzi yokuqwalasela nokusebenzisa amaxhaxha. Hlengahlengisa uLawulo lweMniningwane kwaye ulungise iNkqubo: Phawula okuqwalaselwa kwamaxhaxha alawulwa nguwo onke amanqanaba oluLawulo. Qwalasela ngokwamava amakhulu eNkqubo yoluntu iSebe ngokusebenzisa inkqubo ehamba phambili ekukhethweni nasekusebenziseni ukulunga kwamanye amaxhaxha esebenza kwindalo elungileyo yokumiswa kwaxa. Tsala, ulungise uze ugcine ngokusetyenziswa ngokulungiselela amaxhaxha kuQoqo lukaQoqo ngakumbi naqoqo. Nikela ngexabiso ekusingeni iinkqubo zolawulo. Qwalasela isiseko sokusebenza ngokuchaziweyo kweNkqubo yeNtlangano yokusebenza ngokuqwalasela nokwazi izigqibo ngokukhawuleza kwaye ulawule inkqubo yokulunga ngokusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo.

I-3–5 yeminyaka yamava ahambelana nendalo kwisikolo samabanga aphakamileyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela enyanisweni. Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint). af.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/STD 10 of NCV level 4, saam met 'n erkende National Diploma (NQF level 7)/Degree in Project Management of ekwivalente kwalifikasies met Entrepreneurs, Communications and Technology; Honours sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring in 'n Project Management- of opvoedkundige omgewing. 'n Minimum van drie tot vyf jaar se toesigervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en begrip van vennootskaponwikkeling, bemarking en entrepreneurskapsinsig, finansiële bestuur, Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, besigheidsbeplanning, haalbaarheidsanalise, administratiewe verslagdoeningsprosesse en rekenaarvaardighede. Gevorderde vaardighede in onderhandeling, kommunikasie, projektbestuur, beplanning, organisering, analitiese denke en kliëntgerigtheid.

Fasiliteer die vestiging en versterking van vennootskappe met die bedryf, die regering en relevante organisasies. Identifiseer geleenthede vir inkomste-generering en werkgeïntegreerde leer. zu.summary: Umddedeli Wezikhundla: Ubufelwa Iziqu Ngokubambisana Nokuxhumanana Central Johannesburg TVET College, onegunya lokusebenza nezamaciko omphakathi, kwezinkampani kanye nentuthuko yezinhlelo zokuziphilisa abantu.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/STD 10 noma NCV level 4, kanye Nediploma Yesizwe (NQF level 7)/I-degree ekuqashelwayo Project Management noma iziqu ezingahlobene nalokhu ezibheke abaphathi bemisebenzi, ukuxhumana nobuchwepheshe; u-Honours uzoba yithamsanqa. Okungenani uneminyaka engu-3-5 yohlelo lokusebenza Project Management noma endaweni yemfundo. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha kuya kweyihlanu yohlelo lokusebenza njengomphathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwakhiwa kobuhlobo, ukuthengisa noma ukuqonda ukuziphilisa, ukuphathwa kwezimali, Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, ukuclela amabhizinisi, ukuhlaziya okuzenza, izinqubo zokubika ngokuphathwa kwezinto ezibhalwayo kanye namakhono ekhompuyutha. Amakhono aphakeme ekuxoxiswaneni ngokwezimali, ekuxhumeni, ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi, ekucleleni, ekuhlelweni, ekuqondeni okuhlaziwayo kanye nokubheka ngokwezimeli.
zu.duties: Ukwakha kanye nokugcina isisekelo sedatha yabahlobo bangempela, abamaciko kanye namabhizinisi asendaweni. Uncede abafundi ukuthi basungule amabhizinisi, kube nokuba nolwazi namakhono ekuziphiliseni. UKuba yingxenye kwamafolamu amabhizinisi nokuthola amaphrojekthi namathuba okusebenza ndawonye. Ukucubungula uthole izinketho zokuziphilisa kanye nokufunda ngokusebenza ohlelweni lokuziphilisa. Yilawula ukulethwa kwamathenda, amacebo ezingcezu zemali nemibiko ku-DHET nakubanye abamaciko. Lawula izindinganiso zahulumende wedolobha kanye nasendawo ulondoloze ishejuli yamaphrojekthi ahlobene nalokhu. Qedela izifundo zokuzenza, hlela amabhajethi wezimali kwayo yiliphepha izivumelwano ngohlelo loqashi. Sekela izinqubo zeSETA nokuqinisekiswa, okuhlanganisa nokuvunywa kwezinhlelo ezisha. Qaphela ukubekwa kwabafundi kumabhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngamandla WIL. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwemali, kwezobuntu nezinye izibalo kuleminyango eqhubekayo.

Ukufumana amava ambalwa nge-3-5 emisebenzini yeProject Management okanye kwendalo yemfundo. Ukuba namava ambalwa ngeentsuku ezintathu ukuya kwezihlanu kulawulo lwabasebenzi. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphuhliswa kokuqhagamshelana, ukuthengisa nokuqonda urhwebo, ulawulo lweemali, i-Public Service Act, i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, ucwangciso lwerhwebo, ukuhlola ubungcono, iinkqubo zokubika izinto zolawulo kunye nezakhono zekhompyutha. Izakhono ezithuthuziyo ekuxoxweni ngemigaqo, unxibelelwano, i-project management, uqcwanqolo, ukuqamba, ukucinga ngokuhlola nokuqwalasela umthengi.
xh.duties: Ukwakha kwaye ugcine idatabase yabahlanganiseyo, abathintekayo neentshishini zasedolophini. Uncede umfundi uqalise urhwebo, ube nezakhono nolwazi kumashishini abakha amashishini. Thatha inxaxheba kumaziko orthwebo uze ubone amathuba emisebenzi nokubambisana. Bhala iiprojethi ezithi zibonelele, iimeko zerhwebo kwaye ucwangcise iinkqubo zokuphuhliswa kweenjongo ezidityanisweyo. Khuthaza ukuqaliswa kokusebenzisana namandla orthwebo, urhwebo noorhulumente. Bhala amathuba emisebenzi emikhulu ekusebenziseni ulwazi nalawo abathunyelwa kumsebenzi. Lawula itholakalo leeproposer ezithunyelwa, iifunding proposals neengxelo ezithunyelwa kwi-DHET nakubathintekayo. Lawula urhwebo noorhulumente basekuhlaleni uze ugcine uluhlu lwamathuba aligned namathuba. Yenza iingxelo ezifana nemveliso nenzuzo, ucwangcise imali yethuba kwaye uxoxe ngemigaqo yamandla okukhonza. Xhasa inkqubo yobhaliso kwiSETA, kuquka ukuqinisekiswa kohlelo olutsha. Qwalasela ukubhaliswa kwamathuba emisebenzi yokusebenzisa izakhono kunye nokuqhuba iinkqubo zokusebenzisa ulwazi (WIL) kuqinisekise ulawulo oluvela kwentshishini, emzantsi nakumathuba amaninzi.

Stel die studentestelsel op vir registrasie van studente en verseker geldigheid en betroubaarheid. Onderhou die ADAPTIT, studentestelsel en ander verwante stelsels. Monitor vaslegging, gehaltebeheer, validasie, voer prosedure uit, skep lêer en verseker dat inskrywings na DHET-hoofkantoor gestuur word. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne. zu.title: Osiza-Abaphathi: Ukubhaliswa Komfundi Nokuphathwa
zu.summary: Phatha ukubhaliswa komfundi nedatha ye-TVET MIS e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, kudinga idiploma ehlobene ne-IT nenkampani ebalulekile.
zu.requirements: Umntu othweswe isiqu kufanele abe ne-Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). National Diploma (NQF level7)/ Degree in Information Management, Computing noma isiqu esihlobene e-Information Technology and communication (IT/ICT), i-Honours degree/Post graduate diploma e-Information Communication Technology izoba ngelonge. Umphakeli kufanele abe nokuhlanganiseleka okungu-three (3) kuya kugu-five (5) iminyaka yamava ezingeni lokuqonda esikhundweni seholo level 8 e-Information Technology noma naluphi ulwazi oluhlobene. Ulwazi ngemithetho nendawo yokuphathwa kwezomthetho ye-TVET Colleges okuhlanganisa ulwazi ngohlelo lwe-TVETMIS, izidingo zokuvela kwemibiko yonyaka ngamayunivesithi we-Higher Education Institutions. Ulwazi nakuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokuhumusha ukuphathwa kohlelo, ADAPTIT, COLTECH, data warehouse namaphuzu we-IT. Izindlela zokuphathwa, ukuhlela nokuhleleka, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nobantu kanye nokuba nesibindi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, ukubuka iqhaza ekubukeni iqhaza, ukuhlela nokuhleleka nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ake abe namagugu okuthi, ukugxila emsebenzini wabathengi, ukuzipatha kahle, ukuzibophezela, ukuba proaktif kanye nokuzigcina.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwe-TVET MIS, ukuthwebula nokukhipha idatha yasekolishi. Misela uhlelo lokuze kube sehlukanweni lokubhaliswa kanye nokusekelwa kwenqubo. Lawula izinga ledatha ethathiwe ubike uma kukhona amaphutha. Gcina uhlelo lwe-TVETMIS lukolishi. Phatha idatha yomfundi. Sebenzisa izinto ezahlukene, khipha idatha ukuze kwenziwe imibiko yezibalo. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wesevisi ngokuphathelene nokuthuthuka kanye nezicelo zosizo. Gcina idatha yokubhaliswa komfundi. Hlela imibiko kubaphathi, Thumela imibiko yenyanga ngamunyaka ngeziqu & learnership. Hlela, buka izibalo zezivivinyo zezifundo zabafundi nezabasebenzi bakolishi bese uthumela imibiko njalo kwikota kubaphathi naku-DHET. Hlela imibiko yenyanga, yekota kanye yonyaka njengoba kucelwe. Gcina, thwebula futhi qinisa okufakiwe ohlelweni lwe-ITS student namanye amasistimu ahlobene. Misela uhlelo lomfundi ukubhaliswa kwabafundi uqinisekise ukuzethemba nokuqiniseka. Gcina uhlelo lwe-ADAPTIT, lomfundi namanye amasistimu ahlobene. Buka ukuthwebula, ukulawula izinga, ukuqinisekisa, qamba inqubo, yakha ifayela uqinisekise ukuthi okufakiwe kuthunyelwa ehhovisi elikhulu le-DHET. Uphathwa kwemithombo yabantu, ehlabathini nyezimali. Nikeza isevisi yokuphathwa kubasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kwesivumelwano ngemisebenzi yabo bonke abasebenzi unitini. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

Ukuba nengqiqo ezilandelayo, ukugxila kwisebe labathengi, inkathazo, izithembu, ukuba mdla ngaphambili nokuzithoba.
xh.duties: Ukuphathwa kwe-TVET MIS, ukuthatha nokuvelisa idatha lezo ziko. Misela isixokelelwano kulungele ukuwisa amagama ayo axhasa ezinye iinkqubo. Lawula umgangatho wedatha ethathiweyo uze uxe ngesiphithiphithi. Sigcina isixokelelwano se-TVETMIS sesiko. Phatha idatha yomfundi. Sebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo, khupha idatha ukuze ululele ukubika ngokwabantu. Thintana nomboneleli wesebe mayela nonyuso nemibuzo yoncedo. Gcina idatha ngobhaliso lwabafundi. Qulunqa iingxelo kubalawuli, Nika ingxelo nyanga zonke ngamakhono abafundi & ngenyanga. Qulunqa, qwalasela izibalo zovavabo lwemfundo nabasebenzi lesi ziko uze uze u nikwe iingxelo ngenyanga namaxesha amane kubalawuli nase-DHET. Qulunqa iingxelo nyanga zonke, zamaxesha amane nezonyaka njengoko eceliwe. Gcina, thata ukuqinisekisa okuthathiweyo kwi-ITS yomfundi nakwezinye iinkqubo ezahambelanayo. Misela isixokelelwano sabafundi ngokuwisa amagama abafundi ukuze uqiniseke isiqinisekiso nokuthembeka. Gcina i-ADAPTIT, isixokelelwano sabafundi nakwezinye iinkqubo ezahambelanayo. Qwalasela ukuthathwa, ulawulo lwengangatho, ukuqinisekisa, qhuba inkqubo, dala ifayile ukuqinisekisa ukuba okufakwayo kuthunyelwa e-DHET head office. Ukuphathwa kweemithombo yabantu, ezoMzimba nezoMali. Nikeza inkonzo yolawulo kubasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugqitywa kwezivumelwano zomsebenzi ngawo onke amaphulo. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos by Central Johannesburg TVET College wat toesig hou oor fasiliteite- en rekordbestuur, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad vereis, asook drie tot vyf jaar se ervaring.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kantoorbestuurder (KANTOOR van die Hoof)
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Kantoorbestuurder wat uitvoerende en sekretariële ondersteuning by die Kantoor van die Hoof van Central Johannesburg TVET College verleen.
af.requirements: Matriek of gelykwaardig. Erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie/Openbare Bestuur, Regte, Sosiale Wetenskappe of verwante kwalifikasies. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling van beleide/implementeringsstrategieë. Praktiese ervaring in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie/Openbare bestuur. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike veld/velde sal 'n voordeel wees. 3-5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Kennis van Openbare Dienste-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die hoër onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Begrip van kostesentrumbegroting, bestedings- en kontantvloeibestuur, die Wet op Indiensneemregbillikheid, Regulasies vir die Openbare Diens en die Wet op die Openbare Diens, die Wet op Arbeidsverhoudinge en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe/uitvoerende ondersteuningsdienste in die kantoor van die hoof. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die College Council, Council Committees, Academic Board, Senior Management en ander eksterne belanghebbendes. Verskaf strategiese bestuurs-, moniterings- en evalueringsdienste. Hou toesig oor en handhaaf logistiek binne die kantoor van die hoof. Koördineer die versiering, uitleg, voedselvoorsiening, uitnodigings en mediaprotokolvereistes vir funksies wat deur die college aangebied word. Handhaaf voorraad van standaardvorms en skryfbehoeftes. Verseker voltooiing van prestasieooreenkomste deur alle werknemers in die eenheid. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.requirements: Matric noma okulingana nayo. National Diploma evunyiwe (NQF6) ku-Office Management and Technology/Public Management, Law, Social Science noma iziqu eziyinhlobo. Isipiliyoni ekwakheni izinqubomgomo/amasu okuphatha. Isipiliyono esiphathekayo ku-Office Management and Technology/Public management. Isiqu se-post graduate emkhakheni ohlobene sizoba yinzuzo. 3-5 years isipiliyoni esihlobene emkhakheni we-administration. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqubomgomo ye-Public Service. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda umkhakha we-Higher Education kuzongeza inzuzo. Ukuqonda Cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management, Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act kwaye naluphi na omnye umthetho ohlobene. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.

Nikeza inkxaso yesikhungo kwi-College Council, Council Committees, Academic Board, Senior Management kwaye kubantu balabo ngaphandle. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuphathwa ngobuchule, ukuqapha nokuhlola. Hlela onke ama-Academic Board nama-Academic Board committees. Hlela kwaye uxhase ukuhlanganyela ekulolongeni. Xhumanisa i-décor, isakhiwo, inkonzo yokutya, imemo nemithetho yabezindaba ezidingwa emikhosini ebanjwe yi-college. Gcina isitokwe samafomu ajwayelekile nesikulwazi. Buthula izinhlelo zomhlangano bhalwe imizuzu yomhlangano we-college kwaye ibe yi-forum Records Management. Ukuphathwa kwayo yonke iminikelo yabantu, mali kwaye namanye amakhono e-unit. Qinisekisa ukugqitywa kwezivumelwanano zokusenbenzela yonke imisebenzi e-unit. Ukuqapha abantu benza imisebenzi.

xh.title: Um lawuli oncedo: Umphathi weOfisi (IOFISI yoMphathi)
xh.summary: Um lawuli oncedo: Umphathi weOfisi onika inkxaso ebhalwe ngaphantsi nesele nasekweni izicwangciso kwiOfisi yoMphathi kwiCentral Johannesburg TVET College.
xh.requirements: Matric okanye efanayo. National Diploma (NQF6) evunyiweyo kwi-Office Management and Technology/Public Management, Law, Social Science okanye izifundo ezidityanisiweyo. Amava ekuphuhliseni iinkqubomgama/iindlela zokuziphumeza. Amava abo bokusebenza kwi-Office Management and Technology/Public management. Isidanga esiphezulu sesifundo kwindawo echwayo siza kuba lusizo. Iiminyaka ezingama-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi ngemithetho natoonke iinkqubomgama ze-Public Service. Ulwazi beka PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula i-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda kwicandelo le-Higher Education kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ukuqonda ukulawula imbalela ye-Cost centre, ukuchithwa kwemali nokulawula ukuhamba kwemali, Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, nantoni na enye imithetho ehambelanayo. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushuka esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngolawulo/inkxaso ekusebenziseni kofisi lomphathi. Kubonelele ngenkxaso ekusebenzeleni kwi-College Council, Council Committees, Academic Board, Senior Management nakuwo onke amanye amahlathi angaphandle. Kubonelele ngolawulo olucwangcisiweyo, okuqwalaselwa kwaye nalokugqokelelwa kweenkonzo. Kulawule kwaye kugcine izinto ezisetyenziswa kofisi lomphathi. Kucwangcise onke amagqabantshintshi (Sub-committee, Council, EXCO nalawo angaphandle). Kucwangcise onke i-Academic Board namacandelo ayo. Kulungiselele kwaye kunike inkxaso ekusingathweniokoluleleko. Kuhambelanise izihombiso, ulungelelwaniso, iinkonzo zokutya, izimemo nemithetho yabaphethi kumasebe aphethwe yikholeji. Kugcine isigcina seefomu eziqhelekileyo nezo pateni. Kuzobe iinkqubo zokubhala i-agenda namaminathi kumagqabantshintshi nekwaye ibe nguMlawuli weerekhodi kolwazi. Ukulawula onke amathambo, iimali nayo yonke eminye imithombo yecandelo. Kuqinisekise ukugqitywa kwezivumelwano zokusebenza ngabo bonke abasebenzi kwicandelo. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Marketing and Communication
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Marketing and Communication at Central Johannesburg TVET College central office, requiring a degree in marketing or communications and five years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric/NC(V) Level 4 plus an accredited 3-years Degree / Diploma Marketing / Corporate Communication / Public Relations / Journalism or a related field qualification. A minimum of five (5) years of functional experience in Marketing with at least 3 – 5 years supervisory experience in relevant field. A Valid code 08 driver’s License. Graphic Design knowledge will be an added advantage. Willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively. Competencies: Strategic execution. Understanding of the importance of brand guidelines & applying them across a range of channels. Knowledge and understanding of stakeholder management. Knowledge and understanding of digital marketing. Knowledge of events management. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen eye for detail. A good understanding and knowledge of college administrative policies, procedures, and planning. Website and Social Media experience. Ability to effectively communicate in at least two of the three official languages of the Western Cape. Demonstrated experience in managing marketing budgets and ability to implement cost saving measures and strict adherence to Government Procurement Policies and Procedures. Skills: Administrative. Good interpersonal relations. Project Management. Planning and organizing. Report Writing. Excellent verbal and written communication skills at all levels of an organisation. Self-Management. Campaign management. Negotiation. People management. Client orientation and customer focus. Research Skills. Problem solving.
jobs.duties: Compile, develop marketing strategies. Coordinate and planning all marketing and communication strategies, budget, projects and events in line with government and college administrative policies, procedures and planning. Develop and implement comprehensive communication plans to promote the college’s programs and events. Engage and create informative content for press releases, articles, social media, website updates and other communication platforms. Manage media relations, responding to social media inquiries. Monitor media coverage & provide regular reports and analysis to senior management. Manage social media pages and generate reports for senior management. Coordinate public awareness campaigns and outreach activities to increase public understanding of TVET programs and initiatives. Support internal communication efforts to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with organisational goals. Manage all events including exhibition participation, official functions and special marketing events. Ensure the provision of photographic services at events and drafting articles. Manage the marketing of the college through branding at these events. Stay up to date with industry trends, best practices and emerging marketing technologies to continually enhance the college’s marketing strategies. Conduct Customer Satisfaction Surveys internally and externally and compile individual reports for follow-up. Responsible for College website.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bemarking en Kommunikasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Bemarking en Kommunikasie by Central Johannesburg TVET College se sentrale kantoor, wat 'n graad in bemarking of kommunikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric/NC(V) Level 4 plus 'n geakkrediteerde 3-jaar graad / diploma in Bemarking / Korporatiewe Kommunikasie / Openbare Betrekkinge / Joernalistiek of 'n verwante vakgebiedkwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Bemarking met ten minste 3 – 5 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n relevante veld. 'n Geldige kode 08 bestuurslisensie. Grafiese ontwerpkennis sal 'n byvoordeel wees. Bereidheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en uitgebreid te reis. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese uitvoering. Begrip van die belangrikheid van handelsmerkriglyne en die toepassing daarvan oor 'n verskeidenheid kanale. Kennis en begrip van belanghebbende-bestuur. Kennis en begrip van digitale bemarking. Kennis van geleentheidsbestuur. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede met 'n skerp oog vir detail. 'n Goeie begrip en kennis van kollege-administratiewe beleide, prosedures en beplanning. Webwerf- en sosiale media-ervaring. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Wes-Kaap. Agetoonde ervaring in die bestuur van bemarkingsbegrotings en vermoë om kostebesparingsmaatreëls te implementeer en streng nakoming van Regeringsinkoopbeleide en -prosedures. Vaardighede: Administratief. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Projekbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Verslagskrywing. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede op alle vlakke van 'n organisasie. Selfbestuur. Veldtogbestuur. Onderhandeling. Mensebestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Navorsingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Stel bemarkingstrategieë op en ontwikkel dit. Koördineer en beplan alle bemarkings- en kommunikasie-strategieë, begrotings, projekte en geleenthede in ooreenstemming met regerings- en kollege-administratiewe beleide, prosedures en beplanning. Ontwikkel en implementeer omvattende kommunikasieplanne om die kollege se programme en geleenthede te bevorder. Betrek en skep informatiewe inhoud vir persverklarings, artikels, sosiale media, webwerf-opdaterings en ander kommunikasieplatforms. Bestuur mediabetrekkinge en reageer op navrae oor sosiale media. Monitor mediadekking en verskaf gereelde verslae en ontleding aan seniorbestuur. Bestuur sosiale media-bladsye en genereer verslae vir seniorbestuur. Koördineer openbare bewustheidsveldtogte en uitreikaktiwiteite om openbare begrip van TVET-programme en inisiatiewe te verhoog. Ondersteun interne kommunikasiepogings om boodskapkonsekwentheid en belyning met organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur alle geleenthede, insluitend uitstallingdeelname, amptelike funksies en spesiale bemarkingsgeleenthede. Verseker die verskaffing van fotografiese dienste by geleenthede en die opstel van artikels. Bestuur die bemarking van die kollege deur handelsmerke by hierdie geleenthede te plaas. Bly op hoogte van bedryfstendense, beste praktyke en ontluikende bemarkingstegnologieë om die kollege se bemarkingstrategieë voortdurend te verbeter. Voer kliënttevredenheidsopnames intern en ekstern uit en stel individuele verslae op vir opvolg. Verantwoordelik vir die kollege se webwerf.

zu.title: I-Assistant Director: Marketing and Communication
zu.summary: I-Assistant Director: Marketing and Communication ehhovisi likahulumende lase-Central Johannesburg TVET College, edinga ibhavu ku-Marketing noma kwezokuxhumana kanye namava eminyakeni eyihlanu ewusizo.
zu.requirements: I-Matric/NC(V) Level 4 kanye nedigri/i-diploma esemthethweni seminyaka engu-3 kwe-Marketing/i-Corporate Communication/i-Public Relations/i-Journalism noma izifundo ezithile eziqhamene nalokho. Okuncane eminyakeni eyisihlanu (5) yokusebenza ngomsebenzi othize kwi-Marketing okanye eminyakeni eyi-3 – 5 okuphathi kwabasebenzi ngomsebenzi ohlotshaniswa nalokho. I-License yokushayela ekhasi 08 esemthethweni. Ulwazi lwe-Graphic Design luzobe lusizo. ukubekezela ekubeni ukusebenza amahora angenasikhathi futhi uhambe kude. Amakhono: ukusebenzisa isu ngendlela esebenzayo. Ukuqonda ubaluleka komthetho phansi kwamaphawu futhi ukuwusebenzisa ezinkundleni ezahlukene. Ulwazi noqonde ukuphathwa kwabaholelekile. Ulwazi noqonde kokumaketha kwedijithali. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwemicimbi. Amakhono aphelele okubhala nokuqamba athanda imininingwane. Ukuqonda okuhle nokuba nolwazi ngamapholisi, izinqubo, kanye nohlelo lwalowo olusebenza kwezokuphathwa. Ulwazi lwezinkundla zokuxhumana komphakathi kanye newebhusayithi. Ukuba nokuhlala kwabantu ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezithize ukuthi uziphathe kahle futhi ukhulume kakhulu ngolimi kuleyo ndawo. Amakhono: ukuphathwa kokubhalisa kwezinto ngomsebenzi ongakasebenza kahle.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa futhi uthuthukise izindlela zokumaketha. Lungelela futhi uhlele zonke izindlela zokumaketha nokuxhumana, umalebgethe, amaphrojekthi kanye nemicimbi ngokuhambisana namapholisi ohulumende nakwakolishi, izinqubo kanye nohlelo. Bese futhi usebenzise izindlela ezibanzi zokuxhumana ukuze ukhuthaze izinhlelo kanye nemicimbi yekolishi. Zibandakanye futhi udale okwaziswayo okuneqlaza okuphumela ezindabeni, izihloko, kwezokuxhumana komphakathi, uthutho lwesixhumanisi kanye nezinye izinkundla zokuxhumana. Phatha izinxibelelwano nezindaba zikamphathimidiya, uphendule imibuzo kwezokuxhumana komphakathi. Qapha ukubalwa kwezindaba zigcine umbiko futhi wenuze abaphathi abaphezulu njalo. Phatha amakhasi okuxhumana komphakathi futhi udale imibuzo yomphakathi abaphathi abaphezulu. Lungelela izimpi zemfundo ebalulekile futhi uthuthukise imisebenzi ehlose ukukhulisa ulwazi lwabaphakathi mayelana nezinhlelo ze-TVET nokuqhuba kwazo. Sekela imizamo yoxhumo yangaphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi umyalezo uyafana futhi uhambisana namaphuzu enhlangayo. Phatha wonke umcimbi ohlanganisa ukubamba iqhaza emikhosini yokuveza, imisebenzi esemthethweni futhi nemicimbi ekhethekile yokumaketha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa amansevisi wokuthwebula izithombe emicimibeni futhi kubhalwe izihloko. Phatha ukumakethwa kwekolishi ngokusebenzisa uphawu kulawa micimbi. Gcina ulwazi olusha ngamathrendi emboni, izindlela ezinhle kakhulu futhi namatekinoloji amasha ukuzuza izindlela zokumaketha kolishi ngokupheleleyo. Yenza imibuzo yokuthola ukwenzeka kwesidingo maphakathi nangaphandle futhi uqhubeke nomthelela wokuqinisekiswa okulandelayo. Phethe isixhumanisi sekolishi.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkulumbuso: ukuMagazina nokuNxibelelana
xh.summary: Umncedi weNkulumbuso: ukuMagazina nokuNxibelelana kwindlu enkulu yesebe le Central Johannesburg TVET College, ifuna isidanga kwimizobo yokugudlisa okanye ekuNxibelelaneni kunye neminye emihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Matric/NC(V) Level 4 kunye ne-Degree / Diploma evunyiweyo yeminyaka esi-3 kokuMagazina / i-Corporate Communication / i-Public Relations / uTshutsho lwamava okanye isifanekiso-magazina esikhundleni. Ubuncinane beminyaka esi-5 yamava asebenzayo kokuMagazina kunye nobuncinane beminyaka esi-3 – 5 yamava olawulayo kwindawo ehambelanayo. I-License yokushayela ikhodi 08 esebenzayo. Ulwazi nge-Graphic Design kuya kuba ngaphezulu. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezingajeloqo kwaye uhambe kakhulu. Iakhoni ezisebenzayo: ukuZaliseka ngokweenkcukacha. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kweekhadi ezilawula uphawu kunye nokuzisebenzisa kwizindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula abanomdla. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugudlisa okuse-intanethi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula iintshukumo. Amandla amakhodi nokuNxibelelana ngemilo ngesandi nangokubhalweyo anomdla omkhulu kwiinkcukacha. Ukuqonda okulungileyo nokwazi iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo kunye necandelo lokucwangcisa kwikholeji. Amanqanaba obugcisa obuqhagamshela kunye namava aze ahambe nokuNxibelelana ngesandi kwindawo ezintathu ngesiNtu saseNtshona. Amanqanaba amabali oNxibelelano kunye nokuLawula urhwebo lokugudlisa nokusetyenziswa kweendlela ezongeza ixabiso namava nokuLandelana ngokuqinisekileyo iinkqubo ze-Nkqubo yokuThenga kahulumende kunye neeNkqubo. Amandla: oLawulweni. Ukuqonda nokuhlobana ngokwakho. uLawulo loMsebenzi wokuQhagamshela. uCwangciso nokuhlela. ukuBhala ngokubika. Amandla amakhodi ekubhaleni nokuNxibelelana esinwadi nasekubaleni amanqanaba onke kubuntu bobuchule. uLawulo lwakho. uLawulo lokuQhagamshela. ukuNxibelelana nokucinga. uLawulo bubantu. uKhetho lomthengi nokuqonda isimo sabathengi. uPhando. ukuBa sisombululu.
xh.duties: Qamba, cwangcisa iindlela zokugudlisa. Linganisa nokucwangcisa zonke iindlela zokugudlisa nokuNxibelelana, ubuncwobe, amaprojekthi nokuQhagamshela ngokwemigaqo yokurhweba nolawulo lwekholeji, iinkqubo, iinkqubo kunye nokuQhagamshela. Cwangcisa nokusebenzisa iindlela ezigqithiselayo zokuNxibelelana ekuKhuthazeni iinkqubo zekholeji nokuQhagamshela. Xhamla kwaye uqambe okuqulathayo okunolwazi ngamaphepha okushicilelwa, amanqaku, oonxibelelwano obugcisa, oonxibelelwano bekhompyutha nakuNxibelelana kolunye uhlobo. Lawula ubudlelwane obubekiweyo, nokuPhendula kwakuNxibelelana koluntu. Qaphela iindaba ezibhaliweyo kwaye unike imibongo eqhelekileyo kwaye uhlalutye kubaphathi abakhulu. Lawula oonxibelelwano bekhompyutha kwaye uqambe imibongo kubaphathi abakhulu. Linganisa iinkqubo zokuQonda koluntu nokuQhagamshela ukwandisa ukuqonda koluntu ngeenkqubo ze-TVET nokuQhagamshela. Nceda ngeenkcukacha zobugcisa ngamandla oonxibelelwano ekuNxibelelana nokuQhagamshela ukuze kuqikelelwe ukungathathi hlangothi kolwazi ngokombono weenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula onke amanqanaba okuQhagamshela aquka ukuthatha inxaxheba ekubonisweni, izikhundla ezisemthethweni nakumanqanaba amakhulu. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngezixhobo zobugcisa bokuthatha iifoto eziguqulwayo kwaye alungelelwaniswe namanqaku eqambiweyo. Lawula ukugudliswa kwekholeji ngokuthi ibe nemibhalo yokumela iinkqubo ekuQhagamsheleni. Hlala ukwindawo ethile yamava wobugcisa, iinkqubo ezilungileyo nobugcisa bakusenokwenzela ekuQhagamshela kwamela iindlela ezintsha zokuQhagamshela ze-TVET ekuQhagamsheleni. Yenza iisampulu eziguqulwayo koluntu olusebenza ngaphakathi ngokwemigaqo yekholeji efunwa kukhetho lommandla wokuQhagamshela kwendawo ethile. Lawula iindlela zokuQhagamshela ezahlukeneyo njengoko ekuqalisweni, izinto ezifunwa ngokomthetho kunye nokuQhagamshela okukhulu. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngezixhobo zokuqamba iifoto kumanqanaba okuQhagamshela nokubhala amanqaku. Lawula ukugudlisa koluntu ekholejini ngokumisela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikumagazini. Hlala ufumana iindaba ezintsha malunga nemigangatho yamashishini, iindlela ezilungileyo nobugcisa bokugudlisa obusavela ukuze uqhube ekuphuculeni iindlela zokugudlisa zeKholeji. Yenza iisampulu zokuQonda okulinganiselwa kwindawo esemthethweni nangaphandle kokulawulwa ibumba ngokwakho nokwakheka koluntu oluHamba phambili kwindawo yakho. Lawula onke amanqanaba okuQhagamshela aquka ukuthatha inxaxheba ekubonisweni kwamaphiko, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nokuQhagamshela amanqanaba amakhulu. Lawula oonxibelelwano be-Wesite yeKholeji.
