af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde by Central Johannesburg TVET College, vereis 'n diploma in Finansiële Bestuur en drie tot vyf jaar se toesigervaring in finansies.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/STD 10 of NCV level 4 en 'n erkende drie (3) National Diploma (NQF 6) in Financial Management of verwante kwalifikasie. Three to five years’ werkervaring in die Finance-afdeling. Kennis van PSET and CET Act. 'n Minimum van drie tot vyf jaar se toesigervaring. Begrip van PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act. Kennis van die National Student Financial Aid Scheme en verwante wetgewing. En finansiële bestuurstelsels. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office is noodsaaklik. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van PSET and CET Act. Kennis en begrip van PFMA. Kennis van Treasury Regulations en Public Service Act. Labour Relations Act, Skills Development Act, National Students Aid Scheme en verwante wetgewing. Kennis van finansiële bestuurstelsels. Administratiewe, beplanning en organiseringsvaardighede. Finansiële bestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Analities. Kliëntgerig. Projekbestuur. Spanleierskap en mensebestuur.
af.duties: Begrotingsvoorbereiding. Implementering, monitering en beheer. Berei jaarlikse finansiële state voor. Insameling en opname van inkomste - Kassier, bankdienste en elektroniese betalings, skuldbestuur, monitering en verslagdoening oor inkomste. Uitgawes - vergoeding van werknemers en goedere en dienste. Oordrae en subsidieë. Verslagdoening jaar- en maand-eindsluitingsprosesse en -prosedures. Hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n doeltreffende finansiële rekeningkundediens te verseker. Skakel met ouditeure (intern en ekstern).

zu.title: Umncedisi Wezikhulu: I-Financial Accounting
zu.summary: Umncedisi Wezikhulu: I-Financial Accounting e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, ephethe i-diploma kwi-Financial Management neminyaka emithathu kuya kuhlanu yemfundo yokuqaphela kwezimali.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/STD 10 noma i-NCV level 4 ne-diploma yezwe ezinhlanu (3) (NQF 6) e-Financial Management noma iziqu ezihlobene nalo. Iminyaka emithathu kuya kuhlanu yemisebenzi eseccweni le-Finance. Ukuqonda i-PSET ne-CET Act. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu kuya kuhlanu yemfundo yokuphatha. Ukuqonda i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Skills Development Act, i-Public Service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act. Ukuqonda i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Futhi amasistimu okuphatha izimali. I-driver's license evumelekile nokuqonda amakhompyutha (i-MS Office iyadingeka. Amandla: Ukuqonda i-PSET ne-CET Act. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA. Ulwazi le-Treasury Regulations ne-Public Service Act. I-Labour Relations Act, i-Skills Development Act, i-National Students Aid Scheme nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Ulwazi lwamasistimu okuphatha izimali. Ukulawula, ukuletha kanye Nokuhlela. I-Financial Management. UkuBhala Imibiko. Ukuthintana noNdaba nabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqonda amakhompyutha. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuqonda Abathengi. Ukuphatha Amaphrojekthi. Ukukhokela iqembu nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukulungiselela Ibajeti. Ukusetshenziswa, Ukuqapha nokuLawula. Ukulungiselela Izitatimende Zezimali Zangonyaka Ukuqoqa nokubhala ngemali engenayo- Ikhishiya, Isevisi Yebhange nokuKhwelwa kwezimali ngamakhompyutha, Ukuphatha Izikweletu, Ukuqapha nokubika ngenani engenayo Ukushiswa kwezimali-Imbuyiso yabasebenzi & Izimpahla nesevisi. Ukudlulisela nokuNika usizo. Ukubika unyaka nokuvala inyanga kule minyaka yonke kanye ne nkambiso. Ukugada abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke isisekelo esisebenzayo se-Financial accounting. Ukuxhumana nosolwazi (bangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle)

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkosana: ukuBala ngeMali
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkosana: ukuBala ngeMali kwiKholeji ye-TVET yaseCentral Johannesburg, ifuna idiploma kwiLawulo lweMali nephondo lelwimi lonyaka othathu ukuya kweshumi elinesihlanu lemfundo yokuqaphela imali.
xh.requirements: IseStamende seSizwe seDiploma/IBanga le-12/STD 10 okanye i-NCV level 4 nidiploma yeSizwe (3) ebalulekileyo (NQF 6) kwiLawulo lweMali okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nalo. Imfundo yamashumi amathathu ukuya kwamashumi amahlanu eminyaka kwisebe leMali. Ulwazi ngePSET kunye neCET Act. Iminyaka emithathu ukuya kwemihlanu yamava abaphathi. Ukuqonda iPFMA, iTreasury Regulations, iSkills Development Act, iPublic Service Regulations kunye nePublic Service Act, iLabour Relations Act. Ulwazi ngeNational Student Financial Aid Scheme nemithetho ehambisanayo. Nakwinkqubo yolawulo lwemali. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni nokuQonda iKhompyutha (i-MS Office iyimfuneko. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngePSET kunye neCET Act. Ulwazi nokuqonda iPFMA. Ulwazi ngeTreasury Regulations kunye nePublic Service Act. ILabour Relations Act, iSkills Development Act, iNational Students Aid Scheme nakunye nemithetho ehambisanayo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yolawulo lwemali. Ulawulo, ukuCwangcisa nokuQamba. ULawulo lweMali. ukuBala ngemibiko. UNxibelelwano nakhona amakhono okuHloboyedwa. Isixazululu. ukuQonda iKhompyutha. Ukwahlula-hlula. ukuMiselwa kumXhasi. ULawulo loMsebenzi. intshayelelo yeqela nakuLawulo abantu.
xh.duties: UkuQekelela uMvuzo. ukuZiswa, ukuQaphela nokuLawula. Luqulunqe iinkqubo zeMali zeNyanga zonke ukuQokelela nokuBhala urhuluko ngemali- uKhasha amanxweme, iinkqubo zoVimbelo neNkqubo yokuHlawulela ngeKhompyutha, uLawulo lamava, ukuQaphela nokuBika ngentswalo eRhulwini eNyameni-ngaphandle kokuhlawulelwa abasebenzi & nezinto neenkonzo. Iinkqubo zoVimela kunye nezibonelelo. ukuBiza ngokweminyaka yonke kwaye iqwalaselwe iinkqubo zangaminyaka nakuminyaka yonke iqhawuka. Qaphela kwaye ulawule abantu abalawula imali. uNxibelelwano nabaphuli-bhaliyo (abangaphakathi nakwabaphandle).

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management and
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Management at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a relevant diploma and 3-5 years supervisory HR experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification of three (3) years (National Diploma NQF Level 6) in Human Resource Management / Development / Public Administration/Public Management as recognised by SAQA. PERSAL certificates will be an added advantage. 3-5 years supervisory experience in Human Resource Management environment/ related field. Public Services legislations and policies related to Human Resource Management. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. PERSAL and Job Evaluation. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license. DUTIES Provide Human Resource Management and Administration services: Render conditions of services (Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on duty, Long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pensions, transfers, allowances etc). Manage and plan the recruitment and selection processes as per departmental delegation (advert, shortlisting, interviews, security vetting, competency test, reference check, verification of qualifications) are coordinated within the stipulated timelines. Management of HR Personnel records. Provide secretariat functions at the college implementation committee (CIC). Chair college PILIR committee to ensure that incapacity matters are dealt with timeously. Provide Human Resource Development services: Manage Bursaries administration process. Render Internship and Work Integrated Learning (WIL). Conduct Induction and orientation programmes. Coordinate and facilitate the Training interventions. Develop and implement Workplace Skills Plan (WSP). Administration of Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) and Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Coordinate and facilitate Organisational Development services: Coordinate the design, review and implementation of the college organisational structure. Facilitate the development of Job Descriptions. Coordinate the Job Evaluation of posts/jobs and submit to Head Office. Conduct work-study and business process re-engineering. Facilitate change management and organisational transformation services. Coordinate and facilitate Human Resource Planning (HRP) and Employment Equity (EE) services: Assess EE profile of the college and ensure that targets are met. Represent the college in the DHET and Regional EE forums. Ensure that EE targets and milestones are tracked and reported. Represent the college at the regional corporate forum and deal with fundamental HR matters. HRRC: Plan, prepare and present key HR metrics and developments at the HRRC. Uphold HR governance and ensure HR risks are mitigated. Provide Employee Health and Wellness (EHW) services: Implement wellness programmes and service for the college. Coordinate and manage HIV, AIDS, STI and TB services. Coordinate and manage health productivity programmes. Implement health and safety working environment programmes. Promotion of sport activities to encourage physical fitness and healthy lifestyle. Management of all resources of the unit: Allocate duties and do quality control of the work delivered by supervisees. Advice and lead supervisees about all aspects of the work. Manage leave of staff. Manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees. Ensure that all supervisees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Develop, implement, and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning. Address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940.
jobs.applications: Email to asdhrmd@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will Not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Note: EE Target African male, African female, White male, White female, Coloured Male, Coloured female and Indian female.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die sentrale kantoor van die Department of Higher Education and Training, wat 'n relevante diploma en 3-5 jaar toesighoudende HR-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie van drie (3) jaar (Nasionale Diploma NQF Level 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / -ontwikkeling / Publieke Administrasie/Publieke Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. PERSAL-sertifikate sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 3-5 jaar toesighoudende ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing/verwante veld. Openbare dienswetgewing en beleide verwant aan Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Kennis en begrip van die TVET-/CET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. PERSAL en Werkevaluering. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. PLIGTE Verskaf Menslike Hulpbronbestuurs- en Administrasiedienste: Verskaf dienste aangaande diensvoorwaardes (verlof, behuising, medies, besering op diens, erkenning vir langdiens, oortyd, herverplasing, pensioene, oorplasings, toelaes ens.). Bestuur en beplan die werwings- en keuringsprosesse volgens departementele delegasie (advertensie, kortlyssamestelling, onderhoude, sekuriteitsondersoek, bevoegdheidstoets, verwysingsnavrae, verifikasie van kwalifikasies) word binne die voorgeskrewe tydlyne gekoördineer. Bestuur van HR-personeelrekords. Verskaf sekretariaatsfunksies by die kollege-implementeringskomitee (CIC). Voer sitting van die kollege se PILIR-komitee om te verseker dat onvermoësaangeleenthede tydig hanteer word. Verskaf Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsdienste: Bestuur die administrasieproses van beurse. Verskaf Internskap en Work Integrated Learning (WIL). Voer induksie- en oriënteringsprogramme uit. Koördineer en fasiliteer opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en implementeer Workplace Skills Plan (WSP). Administrasie van Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) en Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Koördineer en fasiliteer Organisasieontwikkelingsdienste: Koördineer die ontwerp, hersiening en implementering van die kollege se organisasiestruktuur. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van Werksbeskrywings. Koördineer die Werkevaluering van poste/werk en stuur voor na Head Office. Voer werksstudie en besigheidsproes-heringenjieurswerk uit. Fasiliteer veranderingsbestuur en organisasietransformasiedienste. Koördineer en fasiliteer Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning (HRP) en Indiensnemegelykheid (EE) dienste: Evalueer die EE-profiel van die kollege en verseker dat teikens bereik word. Verteenwoordig die kollege in die DHET en streek-EE-forums. Verseker dat EE-teikens en mylpale nagegaan en gerapporteer word. Verteenwoordig die kollege by die streekkorporatiewe forum en hanteer fundamentele HR-aangeleenthede. HRRC: Beplan, berei voor en bied sleutel HR-metrieke en -ontwikkelings by die HRRC aan. Handhaaf HR-goewernance en verseker dat HR-risiko's verminder word. Verskaf Werknemer-Gesondheids- en Welsyns- (EHW) dienste: Implementeer welsynsprogramme en -dienste vir die kollege. Koördineer en bestuur MIV-, VIGS-, SOI- en TB-dienste. Koördineer en bestuur gesondheidsproduktiwiteitsprogramme. Implementeer programme vir 'n gesonde en veilige werksomgewing. Bevordering van sportaktiwiteite om fisieke fiksheid en 'n gesonde leefstyl aan te moedig. Bestuur van alle hulpbronne van die eenheid: Wiens take toe en doen gehaltebeheer van die werk wat deur ondergeskiktes gelewer word. Adviseer en lei ondergeskiktes oor alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur verlof van personeel. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van ondergeskiktes. Verseker dat alle ondergeskiktes opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en -prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker. Hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bates.toewysing en -beheer.

zu.title: Umphathi ongenelelayo: Ukuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi kanye no
zu.summary: Umphathi ongenelelayo wekuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna idiploma ehambisana nalokhu kanye neminyaka engu-3-5 yohlelo lokuhlola abasebenzi kwe-HR.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esingaphansi kweziqu ezingaba njalo ezingamakhulu amathathu (3) eminyaka (National Diploma NQF Level 6) kwiHuman Resource Management / Development / Public Administration/Public Management njengoba setshunyiwe yi-SAQA. Izitifikedi ze-PERSAL zizoba yinzuzo ephathekayo. Iminyaka engu-3-5 yohlelo lokuhlola abasebenzi kwindawo yokuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi / ensimini ehlobene nalesi. Imithetho kanye nomgomulo wobumbano lwezinkonzo kahulumeni ohlobene nokuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngokuphathwa kwe-TVET/ CET. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngobunjiniyela be-Higher Education. I-PERSAL kanye nokuqashwa kwezikhundla. Ukubhala nokuqonda ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. IMISEBENZI Nikela ngemisebenzi yokuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi nokuphathwa kwabasebenzi: Phatha izimo zokusebenza (Ikhefu, Ezokuhlala, Ezesibhedlela, Ikuhlomule kumsebenzi, Ukuqashwa kwenkonzo yasekhaya, Ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwebanga, Ukushintshwa kwendawo, Izimali zokuphumula, Ukudluliswa kwabasebenzi, Izimali ezongeziwe, njll). Phatha futhi uhlele inqubo yokuthunywa nokukhetwa kwabasebenzi njengokwesabelo somnyango (ukukhangisa, ukubhalisa abangaphandle kwekhosi, ama-interview, ukuhlola izinsiza zokuvikela, ukuhlola ikhono, ukuhlola izinkomba, ukuqinisekisa iziqu) kuqoqwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ukuphathwa kwerekhodi labasebenzi be-HR. Nikela ngemisebenzi yesikhathi ehhovisi lekomidi le-college implementation committee (CIC). Busa ikomidi le-college PILIR ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindaba zokungakwazi ukusebenza ziphathwe ngesikhathi. Nikela ngemisebenzi yokuphathwa kweNgcuva yabaSebenzi ephuhliwe: Phatha inqubo yokuphathwa kwezibursari. Nikela ngenkathi yokufundela emsebenzini nokufunda okuhlanganisiwe emsebenzini (WIL). Yenza izinhlelo zokwazisa futhi zokuqondisa. Hlela futhi unike amandla izinhlela zokuqeqesha. Bumba futhi usebenzise i-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP). Ukuphathwa kwe-Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) kanye ne-Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Hlela futhi unike amandla imisebenzi yokuphathwa kobunjiniyela bomphakathi: Hlela ukwakhiwa, ukuhlola kanye nokusebenzisa inqubo yendawo yokuphathwa kwesikhungo. Nikela amandla ekubumbeni incazelo yomsebenzi. Hlela ukuqashwa kwezikhundla/kwezinsiza zomsebenzi futhi uzithumele ehhovisi elikhulu. Yenza isifundo somsebenzi kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwenqubo yomsebenzi. Nikela amandla ekuphathweni koshintsho kanye noshintsho lwendawo yokusebenzela. Hlela futhi unike amandla imisebenzi yokuhlela iNgcuva yabaSebenzi (HRP) kanye nokulingana kokusebenzela (EE): Hlola incazelo ye-EE yesikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhloso zifinyelelwa. Mela isikhungo kwi-DHET kanye namafomu e-EE wesifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhloso kanye nezinkomba ze-EE zilandelwa futhi zibikwe. Mela isikhungo efomini le-corporate lesifundazwe futhi uphathwe ngemibuzo ephathekayo ye-HR. HRRC: Hlela, lungelela futhi unike amandla ukubala okubalulekile kwe-HR kanye nentuthuko efomini le-HRRC. Gcina ukuphathwa kwe-HR futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izengozi ze-HR zingitshazwa. Nikela ngemisebenzi yezempilo kanye nenzuzo yomsebenzi (EHW): Sebenzisa izinhlela kanye namasevisi ezempilo kuleso sikhungo. Hlela futhi phatha amasevisi e-HIV, AIDS, STI kanye ne-TB. Hlela futhi phatha izinhlela zokukhiqiza ezempilo. Sebenzisa izinhlela zendawo yokusebenza ephephile yezempilo. Khuthaza imisebenzi yezemidlalo ukuze kugqugyutshwe ukuzilolonga umzimba kanye nepilo elihle. Ukuphathwa kwayo yonke imininingwane yendawo: Yabelana ngemisebenzi futhi ulawulekhwalithi yomsebenzi ophathwe ngabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Nikeza izeluleko futhi uhola abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho ngazo zonke izinto zomsebenzi. Phatha ukuyeka ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Phatha ukusebenza, ukuziphatha kanye nokuqondiswa kwabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho bafundiswa futhi baphuhliwe ukuze bakwazi ukuqamba umsebenzi wekhwalithi efunekayo ngokusebenza ngokugculisayo nangempumelelo. Bumba, sebenzisa futhi ulawule izinhlelo zemisebenzi kanye nizinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngokusebenza ngokugculisayo nangempumelelo. Phendula imibuzo futhi unike izeluleko kanye nokuqondisa ngokusabalaliswa kanye nokuqondisa kwemininingwane.

xh.title: Talente yokubonelela ulwazi loPhatho lweManqabinza
xh.summary: Talente yokubonelela ulwazi loPhatho lweManqabinza kwisikhululo sisebe seNdzimo yeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, sifuna iNkomase nomyaka o-3-5 wobugcisa.
xh.requirements: Ithiyitshala yabaphakhami bedigri yeminyaka emithathu (3) (iNational Diploma NQF Level 6) kwilwazi loPhatho lweManqabinza / Ukusentswa / uPhatho lweNkundla konke njengemvunywa yiSAQA. Iifitshisi zePERSAL ziya kuba yintsingiselo engeyoyona. Unyaka o-3-5 wobugcisa bobulungiseleli kwindawo yolwazi loPhatho lweManqabinza / kwimbona echanekileyo. Iindaba zomthetho neenkqubo zolwazi loPhatho lweManqabinza. Ukwazi nokuguqula ulwazi lwe-TVET / i-CET. Ukwazi nokuguqula ulwazi lwe-visa lweNdzimo yeMfundo ePhakamileyo. I-PERSAL nokubandakanya iNkundla zeBaphakathi. Ukwazi ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo sophuhliso. Ilayisensi yomqhubi esemthethweni. IMISEBENzi ukuthotha iinkonzo zoPhatho lweManqabinza nolwazi loPhatho lweNkundla: phathisa imiceli yeenkonzo (iNkomase, Izindlu, iNdokotha, iNkosana ngaphezulu kweminyaka emi-3, ukuguquguquka, iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo, ukudluliselwa, iinzuzo, iinkonzo ezongezelelweyo). Yahlule nokuphanga imisebenzi yokubiza nokukhethwa njengoko kumiselwe kwisebe (ukubhengeza, ukugcina amagama, iNkomase, iNkomase yokukhangela iintsomi, ukuhlola ukuzibophelela, ukuhlola isifanekiso, ukunika isifanekiso, ukuqinisekisa iindigri) ngaphakathi kweenkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Ukwahlula nokuphanga imisebenzi yeNkomase yeBaphakathi. Ukubonelela iinkonzo zokhuseleko kwiiNkomase zeNkomase yokulawula iNkomase (iNkomase). Ukuyalela iNkomase yeNkomase yokwenza iNkomase yokusebenzisa iintsizi nangexesha. Ukuthotha iinkonzo zoPhatho lweManqabinza nolwazi: Phanga imisebenzi yeBaphakathi. Phathisa iNkomase nolwazi loPhatho lweNkomase (iNkomase). Yenza iNkomase nokubonelela. Linganisa nokuphanga imisebenzi yokulungiselela. Yakhe nokuphatha iNkomase yokuQinisekisa iNkomase (WSP). UPhatho lweNkomase yokulungiselela iNkomase (PMDS) nolwazi loQinisekiso iNkomase (iQMS). Khokela nokuphanga imisebenzi yokulungiselela iNkomase (iNkomase): Khokela iNkomase, ukubuyekeza nokusebenzisa iNkomase yokuqinisekisa iNkomase. Phathisa ukuphanga iNkomase. Khokela iNkomase yokuqinisekisa iNkomase yemisebenzi nokuze kuthunyelwe kwiNkomase. Yenza iNkomase nokuphanga imisebenzi yokulungiselela. Phathisa iNkomase nokuphanga iNkomase. Khokela nokuphanga imisebenzi yoPhatho lweNkomase (HRP) nolwazi (EE): Linganisa iNkomase yeNkomase yekholeji ukuqinisekisa ukuba iNkomase ifunekayo. Sentsa iNkomase kwiNkomase yekholeji kwiNkomase. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Information Technology
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Information Technology at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a diploma or degree in IT plus supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Incumbent should have senior Certificate/Grade12 or NCV Certificate (level 4) plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Information Technology/computer science or a relevant qualification. A minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in the Information Technology environment of which 3 years should be on a supervisory level. Must have a valid driver’s license. Must be computer literate. Competencies, Knowledge, and Skills: Knowledge of the TVET sector regulations and legislative framework. Knowledge of computer hardware, software, and programmes. Knowledge and understanding of Corporate ICT principles, ICT policies and relevant legislation, prescripts and regulations governing the TVET and Public Service sector. Should have strong administrative, planning, organising, report writing, project management, problem solving and people management skills, financial management, communication and interpersonal, planning and organising and team leadership.
jobs.duties: Development, review and monitor the implementation of information communication technology (ICT) policies: Conduct research regarding provincial and national policy framework and legislation. Conduct workshops and awareness of all new ICT policies. Ensure that appropriate policies and processes are put in place for risk management. Information system management: Administer and monitor IT security and electronic access, establish systems to safeguard hardware and data, Perform system backup. Network Management and Maintenance: Research and develop specifications for Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) technologies, Procure LAN and WAN technologies, Distribute LAN and WAN access to staff and students according to the college policy and needs, Set-up, manage and maintain LAN, WAN, email, and internet connections in the college, Troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting all ICT related issues. ICT software and hardware maintenance: Research and develop plans for software and hardware products required technologies and system which enables the colleges core business, support functions and programs, Advice on procurement of college software and hardware according to the college’s needs, distribute software and hardware for use by students and staff according to college’s needs, Maintain and monitor software and hardware systems, report on redundant hardware and software and advise on updating, Manage all licensing of software that the college is using and ensure that they are valid and appropriate. Provisions of intranet and networks services: assist with the procurement of intranet and internet product and services according to the college’s needs, ensure access of intranet and internet in the college, ensure that the college website is continuously updated with current information. Management of human, Financial and other resources of the unit.
jobs.applications: Applications must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za. Please quote the relevant reference number for each post in the email subject line to ensure easy identification and tracking.
jobs.notes: Goldfields TVET College invites suitable candidates to apply for the following external college vacancy: Free State province. Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor, vereis 'n diploma of graad in IT plus toesigervaring.
af.requirements: Die persoon moet 'n senior sertifikaat/Grade12 of NCV-sertifikaat (vlak 4) hê plus 'n erkende 3-jaar nasionale diploma of baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Inligtingstegnologie/rekenaarwetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar se relevante werkervaring in die Inligtingstegnologie-omgewing waarvan 3 jaar op 'n toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Bevoegdhede, kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die TVET-sektor se regulasies en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis van rekenaarhardeware, sagteware en programme. Kennis en begrip van korporatiewe ICT-beginsels, ICT-beleide en relevante wetgewing, voorskrifte en regulasies wat die TVET- en openbare dienssektor beheer. Moet sterk administratiewe, beplannings-, organiserings-, verslagskrywings-, projekbestuurs-, probleemoplossings- en menslikebestuursvaardighede, asook finansiële bestuur, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisering, en spanleierskap hê.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van inligtings- en kommunikasietegnologie (ICT)-beleide: Doen navorsing oor provinsiale en nasionale beleidsraamwerk en wetgewing. Hou werkswinkels en skep bewustheid van alle nuwe ICT-beleide. Verseker dat toepaslike beleide en prosesse vir risikobestuur in plek gestel word. Inligtingstelselbestuur: Administreer en moniteer IT-sekuriteit en elektroniese toegang, stel stelsels op om hardeware en data te beskerm, voer stelselrugsteun uit. Netwerkbestuur en onderhoud: Doen navorsing en ontwikkel spesifikasies vir Local Area Network (LAN) en Wide Area Network (WAN)-tegnologieë, verkry LAN- en WAN-tegnologieë, verskaf LAN- en WAN-toegang aan personeel en studente ooreenkomstig die kollegebeleid en -behoeftes, stel op, bestuur en onderhou LAN-, WAN-, e-pos- en internetverbindinge in die kollege, probleemoplossing, oplossing en dokumentering van alle ICT-verwante kwessies. ICT-sagteware en hardeware-onderhoud: Doen navorsing en ontwikkel planne vir sagteware- en hardewareprodukte, vereiste tegnologieë en stelsels wat die kollege se kernbesigheid, ondersteuningsfunksies en programme moontlik maak, gee advies oor verkryging van kollege-sagteware en -hardeware volgens die kollege se behoeftes, versprei sagteware en hardeware vir gebruik deur studente en personeel volgens die kollege se behoeftes, onderhou en moniteer sagteware- en hardewarestelsels, rapporteer oor overtollige hardeware en sagteware en gee advies oor opgradering, bestuur alle lisensies van sagteware wat die kollege gebruik en verseker dat dit geldig en toepaslik is. Verskaffing van intranet- en netwerkdienste: help met die verkryging van intranet- en internetprodukte en -dienste volgens die kollege se behoeftes, verseker toegang tot intranet en internet in die kollege, verseker dat die kollege se webwerf voortdurend met huidige inligting opgedateer word. Bestuur van menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid.

zu.title: Ongeneleli Ohola Izinga: Itheknolojia yolwazi
zu.summary: Ongeneleli Ohola Izinga: Itheknolojia yolwazi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, edinga idiploma noma iziqu kwi-IT kanye nolwazi lokuphatha abantu.
zu.requirements: Umuntu othathwe kulesi sikhundla kufanele abe ne-senior Certificate/Grade12 noma i-NCV Certificate (level 4) kanye ne-National Diploma yeminyaka eyi-3 evunyiwe noma i-Bachelor's degree (NQF Level 7) ku-Information Technology/computer science noma isiqu esifanele. Ukuze athole ulwazi lokusebenza olufanele emkhakheni we-Information Technology, kudinga ukuba alandelwe iminyaka engu-3 kuya kwayi-5, okuyi-3 kuyo kufanele abe ubephethe abantu. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Kumele azi ukusebenza ngokwakhompyutha. Ikhono, ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinkomba zesigaba se-TVET. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha, izinhlelo zekhompyutha namaphrohramu. Ulwazi nokuqonda izimiso ze-Corporate ICT, izinqumela ezimali ze-ICT kanye nemithetho, izinkomba kanye nezimiso ezibusayo esigabeni se-TVET nasezikhungweni zosebenze lolu. Kumele abe namakhono amahle okubusa, okuhlela, okuhlela izinto, okubhala imibiko, okuphatha amaphrojekthi, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuphatha abantu, okulawula imali, okukhuluma nabantu, okuhlela nokuhlanganisa, kanye nokubusa iqembu.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza futhi kugadle ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumela ezimali zetheknolojia yolwazi nokuxhumana (ICT): Yenza ucwaningo ngohlelo lwezinqumela ezimali kanye nemithetho yezwe nesifundazwe. Yenza amawokshophu futhi ulule ngazo zonke izinqumela ezimali ezisha ze-ICT. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinqumela ezimali kanye nama-prosesi afanele abekwe endaweni yokulawula ingozi. Ukulawula izinhlelo yolwazi: Lawula futhi ulandele ukuvikeleka kwe-IT kanye nokungena kwe-elekthronikhi, miso izinhlelo ukuvikela ihadiwe kanye nedatha, Yenza isipele se-system. Ukulawula futhi kugcinwe inethiwekhi: Yenza ucwaningo futhi uthuthukise izinkomba zobuchwepheshe be-Local Area Network (LAN) kanye ne-Wide Area Network (WAN), Thenga ubuchwepheshe be-LAN ne-WAN, Yabelana nokungena kwi-LAN ne-WAN kubasebenzi nabafundi ngokusho inqumela emali kanye nezidingo zesikole, Misela, ulawule futhi ugcine i-LAN, i-WAN, i-email, kanye nokuxhumana komakhalekhukhwini esikoleni, Ukulungisa, ukuxazulula, futhi ubhale yonke izinkinga ezihlobene ne-ICT. Ukugcinwa kwe-software ne-hardware ye-ICT: Yenza ucwaningo futhi uthuthukise izinhlelo ze-software kanye namaphrohramu e-hardware abadingayo ubuchwepheshe kanye nenhlelo ekwenzela ukuba isikole singasebenza ngempumelelo, ixhasa imisebenzi namaphrohramu, Lule ngokuthenga i-software ne-hardware yesikole ngokwezidingo zesikole, yabelana nge-software ne-hardware ukuba abafundi nabasebenzi bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ngokwezidingo zesikole, Gcina futhi ulandele izinhlelo ze-software ne-hardware, yale ngohadiwe kanye ne-software engasadingekile futhi ulule ngokuyibuyekeza, Lawula yonke imali yokugunyaza i-software esikole esiyisebenzisayo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ivumelekile futhi ifanele. Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ze-intranet kanye ne-inthanethi: Siza ngokuthenga imikhiqizo nezinsiza ze-intranet kanye ne-inthanethi ngokwezidingo zesikole, qinisekisa ukungena kwe-intranet noma inthanethi esikoleni, qinisekisa ukuthi i-website yesikole ihlala ibuyekeziwe ngolwazi lwamanje. Ukulawula abantu, imali kanye nezinye izinsiza yeqoqo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkamela: Iteknoloji yolwazi
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkamela: Iteknoloji yolwazi kwindawo ekuqongqwelweni kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuqeqesha, elifuna idiploma okanye idigri kwi-IT kanjalo namava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Umntu othathayo kufuneka abe ne-Senior Certificate/Grade12 okanye isatifikethi se-NCV (level 4) kanjalo ne-National Diploma yeminyaka eli-3 evunyiweyo okanye idigri ye-Bachelor’s (NQF Level 7) kwi-Information Technology/computer science okanye izifundo ezifaneleyo. Iimvo zonyaka ezili-3 ukuya kweli-5 zemisebenzi ehambelana nendawo ye-Information Technology apho kwakunyaka amava ali-3 ekubeni ngokulawula. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iikhompetensi, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nemithethonqophiso lwesigaba se-TVET. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha ezinguxa, isoftware, nanenkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwemigaqonkqubo ye-Corporate ICT, iinkqubo zemigaqo ye-ICT namathetho, izalathiso, namagunyaziso aphathelene ne-TVET nesebe loLuntu. Kufuneka abe namakhono amakhulu oqoqosho, olungelelwaniso, lokuqamba iingxelo, lolawulo lweenjongo, ukuxazulula iingxaki, nolawulo labantu, ulawulo lweziyobezo, unxibelelwano nabantu abangaboni bala, ulungelelwaniso nokuqamba, nokuhanjiswa kwakwinqanaba.
xh.duties: Uphuhliso, ukuhlola, nokuphanda ukuze kusetyenziswe iinkqubo zemigaqonkqubo yokuquka ulwazi ngekhompyutha (ICT): Yenza uphando ngemigaqonkqubo namathetho karhulumbe welit haba namazwe. Yiza iinkqubo zokuzincazela nolwazi ngazo zonke iinkqubo zemigaqo ze-ICT ezingathathi hlangothi. Qinisekisa ukuba kubekho iinkqubo zemigaqonkqubo neenqobo ezibekelwa ulawulo loyingo. Ulawulo lwenkqubo yolwazi: Lawula uphande ukhuseleko lwe-IT nangena ngekhompyutha, misa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko kwezinguxa nedatha, Yenza ibhaphu yenkqubo. Ulawulo lweNethiwekhi nokuYigcina: Yenza uphando uphuhlise iinkcazelo zobugcagca bemvelaphi ye-LAN nobugcagca besiNginqini, Thenga iinkqubo zenguqulo ye-LAN ne-WAN, Yahlula i-LAN nabanikezela abasebenzi nabaFundi ngokwemigaqo nezidingo zekholeji, Misela, ulawule, ugcine i-LAN, i-WAN, i-email, uqhagamshelo olukwi-intanethi nakulekholeji, Uphawula izinto ezibangela iingxaki, uzixazulule, uzibhale kuyo yonke ezo zinxulumene ne-ICT. Ukugcinwa kwe-ICT isoftware nenguxa: Yenza uphando uphuhlise iindlela ze-software nenguxa yemveliso ezidingwa ngokwexabiso ngenkqubo ezeza kusebenzisa iinkqubo eziphambili zekholeji, imisebenzi yoncedo, iinkqubo, Nikeza ngengcebiso ngokuthengwa kwe-software nenguxa yekholeji ngokwezidingo zekholeji, yahlula i-software nenguxa abayisebenzisayo abaFundi nabasebenzi ngokwezidingo zekholeji, Gcina uphande iinkqubo ze-software nenguxa, wenze iingxelo ngeenguxa ne-software ezikwizingozi ezingasetyenziswa ungene ngengcebiso yokutshintsha, Lawula yonke ilayisensi ye-software esebenziswa lekholeji uqinisekise ukuba ziyinyaniso nefanelekile. Iinkonzo ze-intranethi nangenethiwekhi: nceda ngokuthengwa kweekonzo zemveliso ye-intranethi nakwi-intanethi ngokwezidingo zekholeji, qinisekisa ukungena kwi-intranethi nase-intanethi nakulekholeji, qinisekisa ukuba iwebsite yekholeji ihlaziya ngokuqhubeka idatha yangoku. Ulawulo lwebantu, lemali, ngezinye izinto ezikwicebo lakho.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Facilities Management and Records

jobs.summary: Assistant Director oversees facilities management, building maintenance, office accommodation, and records at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office.
jobs.requirements: Incumbent should have senior Certificate/Grade12 or NCV Certificate (level 4) plus a recognised 3-years National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or Bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Building Management, Safety Management / Construction Management / Property Management. 3-5 years of experience in Properties Management or Facilities Management, SHERQ and OHS environment of which three years must at supervisory level. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Immovable Asset Management System, Telephone Management System, Fire Control System and Facilities Management System. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and related regulations. Financial management skill, report writing skills, problem solving, Project management and leadership skills. Ability to work well under pressure. Computer literacy. Sound analytical with good communication skills verbal and written.
jobs.duties: Oversee maintenance of building and premises: Compile maintenance plan regarding machinery, tools, and equipment, monitor the implementation of the maintenance plan. Ensure provision of office accommodation and parking services, optimise the utilisation of space in building and land, responsible for optimal space planning and full building maintenance, facilitate and ensure awareness workshops of policies and procedure manuals relating to facilities management, identify potential risk hazard in the building, ensure the provision of cleaning services, ensure proper signage in and around the buildings of the institution to minimise safety risk. Ensure compliance to SHERQ AND OHS AC: develop and implement policies related to SHERQ and OHS, Conduct OHS awareness programmes, assist with information regarding health and safety matters, develop the college emergency evacuation plan, conduct safety audit in all the premises, identify potential health and safety hazards, ensure that the OHS committee is established and active, develop quality assurance and SHERQ policies, investigate health and safety related complains, ensure that all workshops at the college comply to statutory requirements, ensure formation/appointment and training of safety representatives and first aiders at all college sites, reporting and coordination OF all IOD’S. Oversee Fleet management: develop and implement fleet management policies, ensure and monitor the cleanliness and maintenance of vehicles, ensure control, supervision and authorisation of all official usage of all college vehicles, ensure warranty management, maintenance, insurance, and licensing of vehicles, ensure the monitoring of appropriate license of drivers of vehicles, ensure monitoring of logs books, ensure the monitoring of compliance with the procedure to be followed in the case of an accident, ensure the monitoring of parking of the vehicles. Maintain the physical security functions including key control, personnel, document and surveillance security: develop. Review and monitor the implementation of security policy, ensure provision of technical security services, responsible for security and access control at facilities, monitor and upgrade the access control system of the college, conduct preliminary theft investigation, develop and maintain security training capacity for the college, ensure proper control procedure and monitoring of the electronic security system, ensure adherence to contractors SLA on site such as security, garden services etc. record management, management of all human, financial and other resources of the unit.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Fasiliteitebestuur en Rekords
af.summary: Die Assistentdirekteur hou toesig oor fasiliteitebestuur, gebouonderhoud, kantoorgeriewe en rekords by die sentrale kantoor van the Department of Higher Education and Training.
af.requirements: Die ampsdraer moet 'n Senior Certificate/Grade12 of NCV-sertifikaat (vlak 4) hê plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) of 'n Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Boukunde-bestuur, Veiligheidsbestuur / Konstruksiebestuur / Eiendomsbestuur. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Eiendomsbestuur of Fasiliteitebestuur, SHERQ en OHS-omgewing waarvan drie jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Public Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Immovable Asset Management System, Telephone Management System, Fire Control System en Facilities Management System. Kennis van Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 en verwante regulasies. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, probleemoplossing, projektebestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Vermoë om goed onder druk te werk. Rekenvaardigheid. Goeie analitiese vermoë met goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor onderhoud van geboue en persele: Stel 'n onderhoudsplan op ten opsigte van masjinerie, gereedskap en toerusting, monitor die implementering van die onderhoudsplan. Verseker die voorsiening van kantoorgeriewe en parkeerdienste, optimeer die benutting van ruimte in geboue en grond, verantwoordelik vir optimale ruimtebeplanning en volledige gebouonderhoud, fasiliteer en verseer bewusmakingswerkswinkels oor beleide en prosedurehandleidings rakende fasiliteitebestuur, identifiseer potensiële risikogevare in die gebou, verseker die voorsiening van skoonmaakdienste, verseker behoorlike bordrype binne en om die geboue van die instelling om veiligheidsrisiko tot die minimum te beperk. Verseker nakoming van SHERQ EN OHS AC: ontwikkel en implementeer beleide verwant aan SHERQ en OHS, Voer OHS-bewusmakingsprogramme uit, help met inligting rakende gesondheids- en veiligheidsake, ontwikkel die noodontroeeringsplan van die kollege, voer veiligheidsondervindings in al die persele uit, identifiseer potensiële gesondheids- en veiligheidsgevare, verseker dat die OHS-komitee gevestig en aktief is, ontwikkel gehalteversekering- en SHERQ-beleide, ondersoek gesondheids- en veiligheidsverwante klagtes, verseker dat alle werkswinkels by die kollege aan statutêre vereistes voldoen, verseer die vorming/benoeming en opleiding van veiligheidsverteenwoordigers en noodhulpverleners by alle kollege-terreine, verslagdoening en koördinering VAN alle IOD'S. Hou toesig oor vlootbestuur: ontwikkel en implementeer vlootbestuursbeleid, verseker en monitor die skoonheid en onderhoud van voertuie, verseer beheer, toesig en magtiging van alle amptelike gebruik van alle kollege-voertuie, verseer waarborgebestuur, onderhoud, versekering en lisensiëring van voertuie, verseer die monitering van toepaslike lisensies van bestuurders van voertuie, verseer monitering van logboeke, verseer die monitering van nakoming van die prosedure wat gevolg moet word in die geval van 'n ongeluk, verseer die monitering van die parkering van die voertuie. Onderhou die fisiese sekuriteitsfunksies insluitend sleutelbeheer, personeel-, dokument- en waarnemingssekuriteit: ontwikkel. Hersien en monitor die implementering van sekuriteitsbeleid, verseker die voorsiening van tegniese sekuriteitsdienste, verantwoordelik vir sekuriteit en toegangsbeheer by fasiliteite, monitor en gradeer die toegangsbeheerstelsel van die kollege op, voer voorlopige diefstalondersoeke uit, ontwikkel en onderhou sekuriteitsopleidingskapasiteit vir die kollege, verseer behoorlike beheerprosedures en monitering van die elektroniese sekuriteitsisteem, verseer nakoming van kontrakteurs se SLA op die terrein soos sekuriteit, tuindiens ens. rekordbestuur, bestuur van alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid.

zu.title: Assistant Director: Facilities Management and Records
zu.summary: On gumati wezikhundla ophatha ukulawulwa kwezikhungla, ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo, isikhungla sohhovisi, namaphayiphu e-Department of Higher Education and Training esikhungleni esikhulu.
zu.requirements: Umbeki kufanele abe ne-Certificate/Grade12 ephezulu noma i-NCV Certificate (level 4) kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) eyaziwayo yeminyaka emi-3 noma i-Bachelor's degree (NQF Level 7) kwi-Building Management, Safety Management / Construction Management / Property Management. 3-5 iminyaka yamava kwi-Properties Management noma kwi-Facilities Management, SHERQ kanye nendawo ye-OHS lapho iminyaka emithathu kufanele ibe kwelinga lokuphatha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Act and Regulations, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, Immovable Asset Management System, Telephone Management System, Fire Control System kanye ne-Facilities Management System. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 kanye nemithetho ehlobene nayo. ikhono lokuphathwa kwezimali, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namakhono okuba ngumholi. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphansi koxinzelelo. ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlaziywa okuhle kakhulu ngamakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwayo.
zu.duties: Qapha ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo nezindawo: Hlela uhlelo lokugcinwa ngemishini, izithombe, namathuluzi, hlola ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokugcinwa. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwesikhungla sohlelo lohhovisi namasevisi okupaka, bandezeka ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala ezakhiweni nasemhlabeni, ube nomdlandla wokuhlela isikhala ngokufanele nokugcinwa okuphelele kwezakhiwo, qeqesha futhi uqinisekise izikole zokwazisa ngezinqubomgomo nemicimbe yemiyalelo ehlobene nokulawulwa kwezikhungla, thola izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezakhiweni, qinisekise ukunikezwa kwamasevisi okucwasha, qinisekisa ukubhalwa kwemibhalo ngokufanele ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezakhiwo zesikhungla ukunciphisa ingozi yokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwe-SHERQ NE-OHS AC: uthuthukise futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo ezihlobene ne-SHERQ ne-OHS, Yenza izinhlelo zokwazisa nge-OHS, siza ngolwazi ngemithombo yokugcina empilweni nasekhuselekweni, uthuthukise uhlelo lokuphuma ngokuphuthumayo kwesikhungla semfundo, yenza ukuhlola ukhuseleko kuzo zonke izindawo, thola izingozi ezingase zibe khona empilweni nasekhuselekweni, qinisekise ukuthi ikomidi ye-OHS isungulwe futhi iyasebenza, uthuthukise izinqubomgomo zekhwalithi ne-SHERQ, phenya izikhalazo ezihlobene nenempilo nokhuseleko, qinisekise ukuthi zonke izinkundla zemisebenzi esikhungleni zemfundo zilandela izidingo zomthetho, qinisekise ukwakhiwa/ukubekwa kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabamele ukhuseleko nabasizi abaphambili kuzo zonke izindawo zesikhungla semfundo, umbiko nokuqondisa KWEZONKE I-IOD'S. Qapha ukulawulwa kwezimoto: uthuthukise futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zokulawula izimoto, qinisekise futhi uhloliswe ukuhlanzwa nokugcinwa kwezimoto, qinisekise ukulawula, ukuphathwa kanye negunya lokusetshenziswa ngokusemthethweni kwezimoto zonke zesikhungla semfundo, qinisekise ukuphathwa kwegwaranti, ukugcinwa, inshurensi, kanye nokugunyazwa kwezimoto, qinisekise ukulandelwa kohlelo lokugunyazwa abashayeli bezimoto, qinisekise ukulawulwa kwezincwadi zokungena, qinisekise ukulawulwa kokulandelwa kohlelo uma kuba nenhlazo, qinisekise ukulawulwa kokupaka kwezimoto. Gcina imisebenzi yokhuseleko lwasemzimbeni okuhlanganisa ukulawula okhiye, izisebenzi, imibhalo nokhuseleko lokuqapha: uthuthukise. Phinda ubuke futhi uqapse ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokhuseleko, qinisekise ukunikezwa kwamasevisi okhuseleko olusezingeni lenzululwazi, ube nomdlandla nokhuseleko nolawulo lokungena ezikhunglweni, hlola futhi uthuthukise uhlelo lolawulo lokungena lesikhungla semfundo, yenza iphenyo lokuqala lokweba, uthuthukise futhi ulondoloze ikhono lokhoqeqesha ukhuseleko lesikhungla semfundo, qinisekisa inqubo yokulawula ngokufanele nokuphathwa kohlelo lokhuseleko lwesikhombo, qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwe-SLA yabalimi besivumelwano endaweni njengokhuseleko, amasevisi esonto njll. ukulawulwa kwemibhalo, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo ezisonke zomuntu, ezezimali nezinye zeyunithi.

xh.title: Isekela Mlawuli: Ukulawulwa Kweziseko Kunye Neerekhodi
xh.summary: Isekela Mlawuli ulawula ukulawulwa kweziseko, ukunakekelwa kwezakhiwo, izindlu zolulo lolusebenzo, kunye neerekhodi kwindlu yokomabhalo ye Department of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Kufunke abaphumelele izatifikethi esemthethweni/Grade12 okanye isatifikethi seNCV (level 4) ezongezwe idiploma yeqela lesizwe evunyiweyo yeminyaka esi-3 (NQF Level 6) okanye idigra yebachelor (NQF Level 7) kwiBuilding Management, Safety Management / Construction Management / Property Management. 3-5 years of experience in Properties Management or Facilities Management, SHERQ and OHS environment of which three years must at supervisory level. Ilayisensi yokushaya ibhayisikili esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngePublic Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Immovable Asset Management System, Telephone Management System, Fire Control System and Facilities Management System. Ulwazi ngeOccupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 nangemigaqo edibanayo nayo. Ikhono lolawulo lweemali, amakhono obhalo lweengxelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ulawulo lweprojekthi namakhono okubekisa ngaphambili. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle phantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuchanekileyo kwesimo ngokwesibalo nolwazi oluhle lokunxibelelwana ngokuthetha nangokubhala.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunakekelwa kwezakhiwo nendawo: Lungelelanisa icebo lokunakekelwa malunga nemishini, izixhobo, nezinto zokusebenza, lilinde ukusebenza kwayo. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezindlu zolulo lolusebenzi konke nesevisi yokupaka, yondise ukusetyenziswa kwendawo kumazakhiwo nalomhlaba, ube nawo umdla wokulungelelanisa indawo ngokwesilinganiselo nakunakekelwa okupheleleyo kwakho konke okwakhiwe, qinisekisa ubomi bokukhwaza komthetho nokuqonda kwemigaqo yabasebenzi namabhali emigaqo ngokulawulwa kweziseko, chonga iingozi ezinokubakho kumazakhiwo, qinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwenkxaso yokucoca, qinisekisa iimpawu ezichanekileyo ngaphakathi nakunqamlezwa kwakho nawuphi na na kwindlu yolulo kwindlu yokomabhalo kwaye zibe zithile. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iSHERQ AND OHS AC: lungelelanise kwaye usebenzise imigaqo ngeSHERQ and OHS, yenze iinkqubo zokukhwaza iOHS, ncede ngolwazi ngemiba yempilo nakho kukhuseleko, lungelelanise icebo lokubalekela kolubhuku, lungelelanise isikolo, qalisa isikolo sokukhangelwa kolubhuku kwezindlu zolulo lolusebenzo, chonga iingozi ezinokubakho ngokwempilo nakho kukhuseleko, qinisekisa ukuba ikomiti yeOHS imiselwe kwaye iyasebenza, lungelelanise imigaqo yokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko ngeSHERQ, phenya iingxaki ezinxulumene nempilo nakho kukhuseleko, qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo zokusebenza kweendlu zolulo kwindlu yolulo zithobela imilinganiselo yomthetho, qinisekisa ukuqunjwa/kumiswa nokugqitywa kokulungelelanisa iMisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko, kunye nokwenza isikolo sokukhwaza, qinisekisa ukuba kugqitywe isikolo sokumiselwa kwabameli bokuqinisekisa nokulunga iindawo zokuqala zonke iindawo zesikolo, ukubika nokulawula yonke iIOD'S. Lawula ukulawulwa koluhlu lwamakhuselo: lungelelanise kwaye usebenzise imigaqo yolawulo lwamakhuselo, qinisekisa kwaye ulinde ukucwatywa nokunakekelwa kwemoto, qinisekisa ulawulo, ukumakiswa nokugunyaziswa kokusetyenziswa ngokusesikweni kwayo yonke imoto yamakhuselo, qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwesiqinisekiso sokusebenza, ukunakekelwa, inkomolo, nayi nayiphi na imali yamakhuselo, qinisekisa ukuba abashayi bemoto banamakhadi okushaya abasesikweni, qinisekisa ukulindwa kwesikolo, qinisekisa ukulindwa kokuthobela komgaqo wokuqalwa xa kubakho isiganeko, qinisekisa ukulindwa kwendawo yokupaka imoto.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Marketing and Communication Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Marketing and Communication Services at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and 3 to 5 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Incumbent should have senior Certificate/Grade12 or NCV Certificate (level 4) plus 3-years National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or Bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Marketing / Communication / Public Relations / Journalism or relevant field qualification. A minimum of 3 – 5 years supervisory experience in communication environment related field. A Valid driver’s License. Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET colleges including knowledge of annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education institutions. Knowledge and understanding of the monitoring of performance management development system. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector, especially the policies and legislation. Communication and interpersonal, Problem-Solving Skills. Team leadership skill, people management financial, Project Management., Planning and organizing. Report Writing. Excellent verbal and written communication skills at all levels of an organisation, People management. Client orientation and customer focus. Research Skills. Problem solving.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate marketing, promotion and branding: develop and manage college brand identity, manage all college signage and document branding (letterhead, certificate etc.). formulate and ensure implementation of the college branding strategy. Develop and produce college publication, i.e banners, information brochures, annual reports, pamphlet and programme information. Manage public relation and media liaison services: Manage all media and general community liaison and communications, manage all college events including exhibitions participation, prize giving, official functions and special marketing events, coordinate of media queries and responses as when required. Tracking all the positive and negative stories on the college including forwarding these to the relevant managers. Regularly communication college camping on social media and online communication. Regularly maintain the content, design and layout of the college website. Coordinate college event and provide communication administrative support. Provide photographic services and write stories for the colleges: draft articles for the department/college’s electronic newsletter, take pictures at the event that will make part of the article, marketing the department through branding at these events, Sub-editor to the monthly electronic newsletter, gather all articles from colleagues and colleges activities, submit articles for compilation, verify and forward for approval. Management of human, financial and other resources of the unit: render management service to the staff, manage the development and performance of the staff, manage the performance agreement of the staff.
jobs.applications: Applications must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za. Please quote the relevant reference number for each post in the email subject line to ensure easy identification and tracking.
jobs.notes: Goldfields TVET College invites suitable candidates to apply for the following external college vacancy: Free State province. A completed New Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection. Panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability. Goldfields College is an equal opportunity employer

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Bemarkings- en Kommunikasiedienste
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Bemarkings- en Kommunikasiedienste by die sentrale kantoor van die Department of Higher Education and Training, wat 'n toepaslike diploma of graad en 3 tot 5 jaar toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Die ampsdraer moet 'n senior sertifikaat/Grade 12 of 'n NCV-sertifikaat (vlak 4) plus 'n 3-jarige nasionale diploma (NQF-vlak 6) of 'n baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Bemarking/Kommunikasie/Public Relations/Journalisme of 'n toepaslike veldkwalifikasie hê. 'n Minimum van 3 – 5 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n kommunikasie-omgewing-verwante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van beleide en die bestuursomgewing van TVET-kolleges, insluitend kennis van die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur die Higher Education-instellings. Kennis en begrip van die monitering van die prestasiebestuurnontwikkelingstelsel. Kennis en begrip van die TVET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die Higher Education-sektor, veral die beleide en wetgewing. Kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike, probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Spanleierskapsvaardigheid, personeelbestuur, finansiële, projektbestuur., beplanning en organisering. Verslagskrywing. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede op alle vlakke van 'n organisasie, personeelbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Navorsingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer bemarking, bevordering en handelsmerk: ontwikkel en bestuur die handelsmerkidentiteit van die kollege, bestuur alle kollege-borduurwerk en dokumenthandelsmerke (briefhoof, sertifikaat ens.). formuleer en verseker implementering van die kollege se handelsmerkbestrategie. Ontwikkel en vervaardig kollege-publikasies, d.w.s. baniere, inligtingsbrosjures, jaarverslae, pamflette en programinligting. Bestuur openbare betrekkinge en mediakoppelingsdienste: bestuur alle media en algemene gemeenskapskoppeling en kommunikasie, bestuur alle kollege-gebeure insluitend tentoonstellingsdeelname, prysuitdelings, amptelike funksies en spesiale bemarkingsgebeure, koördineer media-navrae en -antwoorde soos wanneer dit vereis word. Spoor alle positiewe en negatiewe stories oor die kollege op, insluitend om dit na die betrokke bestuurders te stuur. Kommunikeer gereeld kollege-veldtogte op sosiale media en aanlynkommunikasie. Onderhou gereeld die inhoud, ontwerp en uitleg van die kollege se webwerf. Koördineer kollege-gebeure en verskaf kommunikasie-administratiewe ondersteuning. Verskaf fotografiese dienste en skryf stories vir die kolleges: skryf artikels vir die departement/kollege se elektroniese nuusbrief, neem foto's by die geleentheid wat deel van die artikel sal uitmaak, bemark die departement deur handelsmerke by hierdie geleenthede, subredakteur van die maandelikse elektroniese nuusbrief, versamel alle artikels van kollegas en kollege-aktiwiteite, dien artikels in vir samestelling, verifieer en stuur dit deur vir goedkeuring. Bestuur van menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid: lewer bestuursdienste aan die personeel, bestuur die ontwikkeling en prestasie van die personeel, bestuur die prestasieooreenkoms van die personeel.

zu.title: Umphathi Ongezilwezi: Amasevisi Okuthengisa NokuXhumana
zu.summary: Umphathi Ongezilwezi wamasevisi okuthengisa nokuxhumana ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokhu kanye namava eminyaka yoku-3 kuya kwayi-5 ekubeni ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: Umuntu okhethekayo kufanele abe ne-Senior Certificate/Grade12 noma isitifikedi se-NCV (level 4) kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) yeminyaka eyi-3 noma iziqu ze-Bachelor's (NQF Level 7) ku-Marketing / Communication / Public Relations / Journalism noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukube ngumphathi okungenani ungamava eminyaka eyi-3 – 5 endaweni yokuxhumana noma endaweni ehambisana nalokho. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemigomo nendawo yokuphatha amakolishi e-TVET kubandakanya ulwazi ngezingako zabika zonyaka ezidingwa izikhungo ze-Higher Education. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuqaphela i-performance management development system. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuphathwa kwe-TVET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngesigaba se-Higher Education, ikakhulukazi imigomo nomthetho. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokubamba iqembu, ukuphatha abantu, ezezimali, nokuphatha amaphrojekthi., ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukwabhuka imibiko. Amakhono aphakeme okukhuluma nokubhuka ngomlomo nangokubhala emazingeni wonke esikhungweni, ukuphatha abantu. Ukuqondiswa kuklayenti nokugxila kumaklayenti. Amakhono okucwaninga. Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Eziphatha futhi ohlela ukuthengisa, ukukhangisa kanye nomqondo wokubhalisa:uthuthukise futhi uphathe umqondo wobhaliso lukakholishi, uphathe wonke amashisho namadokhumenti wekolishi (letaheda, izitifikedi njll.). udweba futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa komqondo wokubhalisa kukholishi. Uthuthakise futhi ukhiqize okushicilelwe kukholishi, okungamabhemula, amaphamphleti wolwazi, imibiko yonyaka, amaphamphleti kanye nolwazi lwemiholo. Eziphatha ubudlelwano koluntu nesevisi zokuXhumana namathuluzi: Eziphatha bonke abaxhumana namathuluzi nendawo yomphakathi jikelele, eziphatha wonke imicimbi yasekolishi kubandakanya ukubamba iqhaza kumabonakude, ukubakhethwa, imicimbi esemthethweni namasevisi okuthengisa okukhethekile, ohlela imibuzo yamathuluzi kanye nemibuzo njengoba kudingeka. Ukulandela yonke izindaba ezinhle nabezinhla ngokholishi kubandakanya nokuzidlulisela kubaphathi abahambisanayo. Ngokuvamile ukuthuthukisa imicimbi yokuthengisa kukholishi emaxhoxhini nasokuXhumana nge-inthanethi. Ngokuvamile ugcina okokuqulunqwa, ukwakheka kanye nokubhalwa kwayo iwebsite yasekolishi. Ohlela imicimbi kukholishi futhi uhlinzeke ngokusebenzise imibhalo. Ukunika abantu amasevisi okuthatha izithombe nokubhala izindaba zamakholishi: ukudweba amaphilaphila idipathimendhi/ikholishi yethebula yezindaba zamakhompyutha, ukuthatha izithombe emcimbini ezoYingxenye yephilaphila, ukuthengisa idipathimendhi ngokubhalisa kumamicimbi, ukuba ngumhleli ongezilwezi yethhebula yamakhompyutha yenyanga,okuqoqa wonke amaphilaphila abasebenzi nasemicimbini yamakholishi, ukuzinikela amaphilaphu ukuba ahlanganiswe, aqinisekiswe futhi athunyelwe ukuvunyelwa. Ukuphatha izinsizakusebenza kanye nezinye izinsiza ezesabathuli zaleliyunti: ukunika izinsiza Ukuphatha abasebenzi, ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenza ngokuphumelelayo kubasebenzi, ukuphatha ngezivumelwano mayelana nokusebenza kubasebenzi.

xh.title: Umyezo weNkqubo kaGqirha weSondlo: Iinkonzo zeNkundla yolwazi loothetho Isebe lemali, konke okunye
xh.summary: Umsebenzikazi weNqanaba lokuLawula iMarketing, ulawulo lweQela ekuyilweni kweVangada yolwimi uluntu neKhomishani eya kutshalwa kwesi sixeko esilawulayo se-National department of Higher Education and Training, kufuneka afumane isidanga okanye izidanga ezikumgangatho onqamlezileyo neyomsebenzi ongqa-3 kwize-5 yamava okulawula abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Mmsebenzikazi makafumene isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu/Grade12 okanye isatifikethi seNCV (level 4) kwaye anesidanga se-3-years National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye iBachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) kwi-Marketing / Communication / Public Relations / Journalism okanye ngesidanga esingqamana nalo. Iminimam ye-3 – 5 years yamava okulawula kwindalo ekunxibelelaneni phantsi kothotho olusemgangathweni. I-License esemthethweni yokushayela. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yemigaqo nendalo kolawulo Isebe lemali, konke okunye. Ulwazi noluvo Isebe lemali, konke okunye nolwandiso Isebe lemali, konke okunye
xh.duties: Imisebenzi ikubalawule nokuhambelanisa ukuthengisa, ukuphakamisa nokuqamba uphawu: yenza ulawulo lwephawu lesikhungo, balawule zonke iindlela zokubonisa uphawu zesikhungo kunye nokuchaza amaxwebhu (iintloko zeleta, iisatifikethi, njl). Yenza icebo eliqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-strategy yokuqamba uphawu yesikhungo. Yenze kwaye uvelise izinto ezishicilelwayo zesikhungo, oko kukuthi iibhena, iibhrosh ezinolwazi, iingxelo zonyaka, amapamflet nolwazi lweenkqubo. Balawule unkonzo zabantu kuqoqosho lomphakathi kunye nophatho lwabantu kwabantu basezindwendweni: Balawule lonke ungenelelo ophatho lwabantu basezindwendweni noluntu olujoliswe kuso kunye nolonwabo lwabantu, balawule zonke iinkqubo zesikhungo kuquka inxaxheba kwindlela ezibonwayo, ukwabelana kwamabhaso, imisebenzi esemthethweni nannxaxheba ethile ekuthengiseni, hambelanisa imibuzo yabantu basezindwendweni kwaye uphendule xa kufuneka. Landela zonke iindaba ezilungileyo nezimbi ngesikhungo kuquka nokuzithumela kubalawuli abafanelekileyo. Ngokungqungqumbela yenza iindaba ngekhonkco lamazwi asekelwe kwi-intanethi nakwezinye iindlela zokunxibelelanisa ezingqamweni. Ngokungqungqumbela yondle okuqulethwayo, uyilo kunye nokumiswa kwendawo ye-intanethi yesikhungo. Hambelanisa iinkqubo zesikhungo kwaye uze unike unkonzo yolawulo ekunxibelelaneni. Yenza unkonzo yokuthatha iifoto kwaye ubhale iindaba zesikhungo: bhala iindaba abazakuba ngxedu yeendaba zamazwi ezwelonke ze/isebe/isikhungo, thatha iifoto kwinkqubo ezakwenza inxalenye yendaba, uthengise isebe ngokuqamba uphawu kwezi nkqubo, ube ngumhleli oncedisayo weendaba zamazwi ezwelonke ezentathelo nyanga, qokelela zonke iindaba kubahlobo kunye nemisebenzi yamakhampasi, zemela iindaba elungelelanisweni, qinisekisa kwaye uze uzithumele kwabambelelwa. Ulawulo olubanzi Isebe lemali, konke okunye. Kule nkqubo yonke
