jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to oversee budget preparation, financial statements and expenditure control at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office.
jobs.requirements: Incumbent should have senior Certificate/Grade12 or NCV Certificate (level 4) plus a recognised 3-years National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or Bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Financial Management or related qualification, minimum of 3-5 years’ experience at supervisory level in financial accounting environment, Valid driver’s license, Proficient in Microsoft Office, Knowledge of PSET and CET Act, Knowledge and understanding PFMA, Knowledge and understanding Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Knowledge of Financial Management Systems (SAGE, Coltech and BAS), Valid driver’s license. Competencies: Knowledge of PSET and CET Act., Knowledge and understanding Treasury Regulations Skills Development Act, knowledge of the National Student Financial Aid Scheme and related legislation. Report witing skills, financial management skill, problem solving and leadership, ability to work under pressure with strict deadline.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and oversee budget preparation, implementation, monitoring and expenditure control. preparation of Annual Financial Statements and the month-end and year-end financial closure processes. Review and analyse expenditure reports, distribute to budget holders and obtain inputs on expenditure status. Oversee and monitor monthly bank, creditors reconciliations. Oversee the accurate allocation of monies received. Ensure that Asset Register is aligned with the Geneal Ledger. Ensure stock (inventory) is accurately accounted for in line with accounting system. Ensure correct audit assertions of all transactions. Liaise with internal and external auditors and ensure compliance with audit requirements. Supervise employee to ensure an effective financial accounting service. Manage the operational processes, resources and procedures associated with the financial accounting functions. Management of human, financial and other resources of the unit: render management service to the staff, manage the development and performance of the staff, manage the performance agreement of the staff.
jobs.applications: Applications must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za. Please quote the relevant reference number for each post in the email subject line to ensure easy identification and tracking.
jobs.notes: Goldfields TVET College invites suitable candidates to apply for the following external college vacancy: Free State province. A completed New Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection. Panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability. Goldfields College is an equal opportunity employer.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om begrotingsvoorbereiding, finansiële state en uitgawekontrole by die Department of Higher Education and Training se hoofkantoor te bestuur.
af.requirements: Die ampsbekleer moet 'n senior Certificate/Grade12 of NCV Certificate (level 4) plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) of Bachelor's degree (NQF Level 7) in Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie hê, minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak in 'n finansiële rekeningkundige omgewing, geldige bestuurderslisensie, vaardig in Microsoft Office, kennis van PSET en CET Act, kennis en begrip van PFMA, kennis en begrip van Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, kennis van Finansiële Bestuurstelsels (SAGE, Coltech en BAS), geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van PSET en CET Act., kennis en begrip van Tesourie-regulasies Skills Development Act, kennis van die National Student Financial Aid Scheme en verwante wetgewing. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede, finansiële bestuursvaardighede, probleemoplossing en leierskap, vermoë om onder druk met streng sperdatums te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur begrotingsvoorbereiding, implementering, monitering en uitgawekontrole. Voorbereiding van Jaarlikse Finansiële State en die maandeinde en jaareinde finansiële afsluitingsprosesse. Hersien en ontleed uitgawerverslae, versprei dit aan begrotingshouers en verkry insette oor uitgawestatus. Bestuur en monitor maandelikse bank- en skuldeisersrekenings. Bestuur die akkurate toewysing van ontvanggehalte geld. Verseker dat die bate-register met die Algemene Grootboek in lyn is. Verseker dat voorraad (inventaris) akkuraat verantwoord word in ooreenstemming met die rekeningkundige stelsel. Verseker korrekte ouditbewering van alle transaksies. Skakel met interne en eksterne ouditeure en verseker nakoming van ouditvereistes. Hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n doeltreffende finansiële rekeningkundige diens te verseker. Bestuur die operasionele prosesse, hulpbronne en prosedures wat met die finansiële rekeningkundige funksies verband hou. Bestuur van menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid: verskaf bestuursdienste aan die personeel, bestuur die ontwikkeling en prestasie van die personeel, bestuur die prestasie-ooreenkomste van die personeel.

zu.title: Umncedisi weDirector: Ezezimali Ezinembile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedisi weDirector okulekelela ukulungiselela isabelo somali, izinkomba zezimali kanye nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ohhovisi likahulumende lweDepartment of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Umphathi kufanele abe nesitifiketi samatikulu/Grade12 noma isitifiketi seNCV (level 4) kanye neNational Diploma (NQF Level 6) yeminyaka engu-3 esemtholakalwe noma idigri yeBachelor’s (NQF Level 7) kwi-Financial Management noma iziqu ezihlobene, okungenani ungamuceba eminyakeni engu-3-5 ngokuhlangenwe nakho ohlangothini lolawulo ohlweni lwezimali ezinembile, ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ukuba nolwazi kuMicrosoft Office, ulwazi ngawo mthetho wePSET and CET Act, ulwazi nokugqonda umthetho wePFMA, ulwazi nokugqonda imithetho yeTreasury Regulations. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesebenzamo kazwelonke kanye noMthetho wesebenzamo kazwelonke, ulwazi ngamasistimu eFinancial Management Systems (SAGE, Coltech and BAS), ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukukghonza: Ulwazi ngawo mthetho wePSET and CET Act., ulwazi nokugqonda imithetho yeTreasury Regulations Skills Development Act, ulwazi nge-National Student Financial Aid Scheme kanye nomthetho ohlobene nakho. Amakhono ekuhlola nokubika, ikhono lokuphatha izimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuba ngumholi, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezeleka ngemikhawu eminyaka ethe ngqo.
zu.duties: Bumbisana futhi ulekele ukulungiselela isabelo somali, ukuqalisa, ukubheka kanye nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali. ukulungiselelwa kwe-Annual Financial Statements kanye nama-prosesi okuvala izimali ekupheleni kwenyanga kanye nasekupheleni konyaka. Hlola futhi uhlaziye amabhiki ogochwe imali, awabelwe abanikabelo bemali futhi uthole izinkulumo ngemo yegochwe imali. Lekelela futhi ubheke ukulingana kwe-mpahla kanye nabakhokhela njalo ngenyanga. Lekelela ukwaba ngokunembile imali etholiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Asset Register ihambisana ne-General Ledger. Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla esitokhweni ihlalwa ngokunembile kuhambisana nesistimu yokubala imali. Qinisekisa izinkomba ezidluliselwa kwi-audit ezinganembile zonke izinkulumo. Xhumana nabahleli be-audit bangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo ze-audit. Lawula abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe isevisi yezimali ezinembile. Phatha amaprosesi okusebenza, imithombo kanye nemithelela ehlobene nemisebenzi yezimali ezinembile. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu, yemali kanye yezinye emnyangweni: nikeza isevisi yokuphatha abasebenzi, phatha ukuthuthuka kanye nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi, phatha isivumelwano sokuqashwa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSikhulu: I-Financial Accounting
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumncedisi weSikhulu ukuze alawule ukulungiselelwa kwesikhwendu, iinkcazelo zemali nakulawulwa kweakarhulimbo kwindawu ephakathi yesebe leNqanaba leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: Makabe nosatifikate ephezulu/Grade12 okanye isatifikate se-NCV (level 4) kunye nesidanga sikawonke-wonke sezizwe i-3-years National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye i-Bachelor's degree (NQF Level 7) kwinkqubo ye-Financial Management okanye ngesimaphambili esinxulumeneyo, nabeminyaka yamava angu-3-5 esebenza njengesikhulu esilawulayo kwimeko ye-financial accounting, Makabe nelayisensi yokuqhuba egunya elisebenzayo, Makaba lulele kwiMicrosoft Office, Akwazi ukuyiqonda i-PSET ne-CET Act, Akwazi wayiqonda i-PFMA, Akwazi wayiqonda iTreasury Regulations. Akwazi iPublic Service Regulations nePublic Service Act, Akwazi iinkqubo ze-Financial Management Systems (SAGE, Coltech and BAS), Makabe nelayisensi yokuqhuba egunya elisebenzayo. Iikhompetensi: Akwazi i-PSET ne-CET Act., Akwazi wayiqonda iTreasury Regulations neSkills Development Act, akwazi i-National Student Financial Aid Scheme nalomthetho onxulumene nayo. Akwazi ukubala iiripoti, akwazi ukulawula imali, ukusombulula iingxaki nolawula, akwazi ukusebenza ngantsokothelo ngokutshixha iimitha yexesha.
xh.duties: Qhagamshela ulawule ukulungiselelwa kwesikhwendu, ukusebenza kwaso, ukumonitora nakulawulwa kweakarhulimbo. ukulungiselela iinkcazelo zemali zonke ngonyaka nakwindlela yokuphela kwenyanga nakonyaka ze-financial closure. Phonononga uhlalutyo lweekharhulimbo, zabelwe kubathi bakhwebu baze afumane izimvo malunga nemo yekarhulimbo. Lawula uze umonitore ukuvumelaniswa kwangenyanga kwabhanki, abanikelayo. Lawula ukwaba ngokuchanekileyo kwemali efumeniweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba i-Asset Register idibene ne-Geneal Ledger. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezikhoyo (i-inventory) zibalwa ngokuchanekileyo ngokwesiseko seenkqubo zokubala. Qinisekisa izigqibo ezichanekileyo zokujonga zonke iinkqubo zotyalo mali. Qedana nabajongi bendlu nangaphandle uze uqinisekise ukuzithoba kwiimfuno zokuqwalasela. Lawula abasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise inkonzo echanekileyo ye-financial accounting. Lawula iinkqubo, izixhobo neendlela ezinxulumene nemisebenzi ye-financial accounting. Ulawulo lwabantu, kwemali nakwezinye izixhobo zeqela: nikeza inkonzo yonqumaniso kubasebenzi, lawula ukuphuhliswa nakusebenza kwabasebenzi, lawula isivumelwano sokusebenza sabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior Internal Auditor at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a diploma or degree in internal audit or accounting and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or National Certificate: Vocational (NCV) Level 4. An appropriate three (3) years Diploma / Degree in Internal Audit / Accounting / Commerce. A minimum of three (03) years’ experience within the Internal Audit environment. IIASA Membership will be added as an advantage. Essential skills will include the following: Knowledge of International Standard for the Professional Practice of Internal Audit Approaches/Departmental policies/circulars/instructions/frameworks. National guidelines/Acts/ Regulations/Internal Audit methodology/Internal Audit Charter. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
jobs.duties: Perform planning of internal audit assignments. Perform execution of internal audit assignments. Report audit results. Perform all administrative related functions.
jobs.enquiries: All enquiries should be directed to Ms Makondo AT /Ms Ramuzwila HN /Ms Mukhoro M/ Mr Muthige M Tel No: (015) 963 7091/ 7070 /7066/7095 respectively.
jobs.applications: Your application must clearly quote the correct job reference number and can either be posted to Human Resources Management, Vhembe TVET College, Private Bag X2136, Sibasa, 0970, Alternatively, applications may be send to Hr.applications@vhembecollege.edu.za or hand-delivered to the Central Office, Site 203, Unit A, Sibasa.
jobs.notes: To apply, please submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae highlighting your relevant qualifications, experience, and at least two contactable references along with a completed, signed Z83 application form (2021 version), which is available from any public service department. While certified copies of your qualifications and supporting documents are only required on or before the interview date, please note that late submissions will not be considered, and the college reserves the right to withdraw any post at any stage. Vhembe TVET College is an equal opportunity employer operating across four local municipalities that actively encourages applications from persons with disabilities. Due to high volumes, communication is limited to shortlisted candidates; therefore, if you do not receive feedback within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful, keeping in mind that final selection is subject to background vetting, credentials verification, and financial disclosure checks. af.title: Senior Interne Ouditeure
af.summary: Senior Interne Ouditeure by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor, wat 'n diploma of graad in interne oudit of rekenkunde vereis asook drie jaar se tersaaklike ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) of National Certificate: Vocational (NCV) Level 4. 'n Toepaslike drie (3)-jaar Diploma / Graad in Interne Oudit / Rekenkunde / Handel. 'n Minimum van drie (03) jaar se ervaring binne die Interne Oudit-omgewing. IIASA-lidmaatskap sal as 'n voordeel beskou word. Noodsaaklike vaardighede sluit die volgende in: Kennis van International Standard for the Professional Practice of Internal Audit Approaches/Departementele beleide/omsendbriewe/instruksies-raamwerke. Nasionale riglyne/Wette/Regulasies/Interne Oudit-metodologie/Interne Oudit-handves. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook).
af.duties: Voer beplanning van interne oudit-opdragte uit. Voer uitvoering van interne oudit-opdragte uit. Rapporteer ouditresultate. Voer alle administratiewe verwante funksies uit.

zu.title: Omfundi Wangaphakathi Ophakeme
zu.summary: Omfundi Wangaphakathi Ophakeme ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna idiploma noma idigri ezokuhlola okwangaphakathi noma ezabalo kanye namafemu eminyaka emithathu okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Sezwe Esiphakeme (Izinga 12) noma Isitifikedi Sezwe: Izenzakalo (NCV) Izinga 4. Idiploma / Idigri eminyaka emithathu (3) ehambisana nokuhlola okwangaphakathi / Ezabalo / Ezentengiso. Okungenani amafemu eminyaka emithathu (03) okuhlangenwe nakho ngaphakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola okwangaphakathi. Ilungu le-IIASA lizobe yinzuzo. Amakhono abalulekile afaka okulandelayo: Ulwazi lwesimo samazwe ngomhlola wokuqheliswayo komsebenzi wokuhlola okwangaphakathi / Izinqubo zomnyango / Izaziso / imiyalo / okwakhiwayo. Izinkomba zezwe / Iziqu / Izilawulo / Indlela yokuhlola okwangaphakathi / Isibambiso Sokuhlola Okwangaphakathi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Yenza isicwangciso sezinkalo zokuhlola okwangaphakathi. Yenza ukuqedwa kwezinkalo zokuhlola okwangaphakathi. Cabangela iziphumo zokuhlola. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nokulawula.

xh.title: Umngenisi Ophakamileyo Wangaphakathi
xh.summary: Umngenisi Ophakamileyo Wangaphakathi ohlalonweni ngokusentsimini kwi Department of Higher Education and Training, efuna idiploma okanye idigri ekungeniseni ngaphakathi okanye ekubaleni kwemali kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Soswazi Siqu ezingeni leNqanaba lesi-12 okanye Isatifikethi Sezwe: Umsebenzi Wamava (NCV) Level 4. Idiploma / Idigri eyiyo yeminyaka emithathu (3) Ekungeniseni Ngaphakathi / Ekubaleni Kwemali / Kurhwebo. Amava amabalisa amathathu (03) kumvelaphi wokungenisa ngaphakathi. Iilungu elithi lisebenze kwi-IIASA liza kubakho njengentsengo. Amaphepha ekhono asemcindebeni aza kuquka oku latshulwe apha: Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi eMazwe Ngamazwe ngokuSebenza ngamandla okungenisa ngaphakathi / iimphatho zesebe / iindululo / imiyalelo / iinkqubo. Iikhwaya eziphathwayo ngezwe / uMthetho / Iimthetho / Indlela yokungenisa ngaphakathi / INqwangqaselo Lokungenisa Ngaphakathi. Ukufunda nokuqonda ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Yenza icebo lokungenisa ngaphakathi kumisebenzi abayiwe kuyo. Yenza ukusetyenziswa kokungenisa ngaphakathi kumisebenzi abayiwe kuyo. Dwelisa iziphumo zokungenisa ngaphakathi. Yenza yonke imisebenzi edibene nolawulo.

jobs.title: Senior Administration Officer: Office of the Principal
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior Administration Officer needed at the Office of the Principal to manage administrative operations, drafting submissions and reports.
jobs.requirements: Matric certificate/NCV L4 plus a National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Public Management/Public Administration/Management Assistant as recognized by SAQA with a minimum of three to five (3-5) years’ appropriate experience in a PSET Administration Environment. The incumbent must also be computer literate and have a valid driver’s license. Extensive knowledge of various filing systems. Knowledge of Office Administration methodologies. Knowledge and understanding of departmental legislation and Prescripts. Knowledge of the Continuing Education and Training Act. Required skills and competencies: Analytical thinking, Planning and organising, Problem Solving, Financial Administration, Interpersonal Skill, Customer Focus, Office Administration, MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Multi-Tasking, Teamwork, Time Management, Good verbal and written skills, Communication skills, Honesty, integrity, and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidates will be responsible for, among other things, the following specific tasks: implementing the administrative operations of the office. Perform general administrative activities in support of the Office. Draft submissions, reports, memorandums, and minutes for the Office. Conduct records and document management both manually and electronically. Provide support in completing and processing subsistence claims. Keep track of all incoming work and ensure that all deadlines are met. Liaise with all stakeholders relevant to the office. Administer leave arrangements. Assist in the provision of monitoring and evaluation services; assist in coordinating demand planning within the Office. Monitor expenditure and coordinate the capacitation of the Office in line with the College-approved training plan. Type correspondence as and when required. Coordinate audit requirements within the Office and serve as the first point of contact between the Office of the Principal and other stakeholders.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940.
jobs.applications: Email to senioradminofficer@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Note: EE Target African male, African female, White male, White female, Coloured Male, Coloured female and Indian female.

af.title: Senior Administrasiebeampte: Kantoor van die Prinsipaal
af.summary: Senior Administrasiebeampte benodig by die Kantoor van die Prinsipaal om administratiewe bedrywighede te bestuur, asook voorleggings en verslae op te stel.
af.requirements: Matriks-sertifikaat/NCV L4 plus 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) in Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie/Bestuursassistent soos deur SAQA erken met 'n minimum van drie tot vyf (3-5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring in 'n PSET Administratiewe Omgewing. Die ampsdraer moet ook rekenaarvaardig wees en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Uitgebreide kennis van verskeie lêerstelsels. Kennis van Kantooradministrasie-metodologieë. Kennis en begrip van departementele wetgewing en Voorskrifte. Kennis van die Wet op Voortgesette Onderwys en Opleiding. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Analitiese denke, Beplanning en organisering, Probleemoplossing, Finansiële Administrasie, Tussenmenslike vaardighede, Klantefokus, Kantooradministrasie, MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Multitaakverrigting, Spanwerk, Tydbestuur, Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike vaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede, Eerlikheid, integriteit en Verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: implementering van die administratiewe bedrywighede van die kantoor. Voer algemene administratiewe take ter ondersteuning van die Kantoor uit. Opstel van voorleggings, verslae, memorandum en notule vir die Kantoor. Voer rekord- en dokumentbestuur both handmatig en elektronies uit. Verskaf ondersteuning met die invul en verwerking van bestaansklaims. Hou tred met alle inkomende werk en verseker dat alle sperdatums nagekom word. Skakel met alle belanghebbendes wat vir die kantoor relevant is. Administreer verlofreëlings. Bied bystand met die verskaffing van moniterings- en evalueringsdienste; bied bystand met die koördinering van vraagbeplanning binne die Kantoor. Moniteer uitgawes en koördineer die kapasitering van die Kantoor in ooreenstemming met die Kollege-goedgekeurde opleidingsplan. Tik korrespondensie soos en wanneer nodig. Koördineer ouditvereistes binne die Kantoor en tree op as die eerste kontakpunt tussen die Kantoor van die Prinsipaal en ander belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohleliwo Ophakeme: Ihhovisi likaMongameli
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Ohleliwo Ophakeme ehhovisi likaMongameli ukuphatha imisebenzi yohlelo, ukubhala izinzelwane nezibiko.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/NCV L4 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe (izinga le-NQF 6) ku-Public Management/Public Administration/Management Assistant njengokuvunyelwe yi-SAQA, okuhambisana nokuhlolwa kweziqu, nokuba nobuchule obungu-(3-5) iminyaka ohlelweni lolwazi olwanele eMgunyazweni Ohleliwo PSET. Umemukile kufanele futhi akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha abe nelayisensi yokuqasha eholisayo. Ukuqonda okujulile ngamahlelohlelo ahlukahlukene okulondoloza izinkinga ezibhaliwe. Ulwazi ngendlela zokuphatha ihhovisi. Ulwazi nokuzuva ngomthetho kanye nemigomo yomnyango. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Continuing Education and Training Act. Izindlela kanye namandla adingekayo: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuqashwa kwezimali, ukusebenzisana kanye nabanye, ukugxila ekusebenzeleni iklayenti, ukuqashwa kwehhovisi, i-MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), ukwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukusebenza nqwabe, ukulawula isikhathi, amandla ahle ngomlomo nakubhalwayo, amandla okuxhumana, ukwethembeka, ukuzethemba kanye nokuqedela izinto ngokwanele.
zu.duties: Ophumelele kuzoba nezinye izibopho, phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo: ukuphatha imisebenzi yohlelo yehhovisi. Ukwenza imisebenzi yohlelo ngokwesayensi nangokomthetho. Ukubhala izinzelwane, izibiko, amamemorandamu, kanye nemizuzu yehhovisi. Ukulondoloza kanye nokulawula imibhalo nangokubhaliwe nakusekhaya. Ukusiza ekugcwaliseni nasekuthunyelweni izinkokhelo zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukulandela konke okungena abantu bagqamisa, kuqinisekiswe ukuba wonke amasikhathi adingekayo ahlangatswe. Ukuxhumana nabo bonke abathintekile ngale hhovisi. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zokuqasha. Ukusiza ekunikezeni amandla okubheka kanye nokuhlola imisebenzi kwehhovisi; ukusiza ekubumbeni izinhlelo ezingaphezu kwehhovisi. Ukugada izinkomba-mali kanye nokuxhumanisa ukwakhiwa kwehhovisi ngokuhambisana nanhleso eqinisekisiwe Kolishi. Ukubhala izincwadi ezingekho ezandleni uma kudingeka. Ukuxhumanisa izidingo zokuqinisekiswa ngaphakathi kwehhovisi nokuba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwehhovisi likaMongameli nabalawuli abangenwe emigwaqweni.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu woMlawulo: Isebe leSikhululo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umphathi omkhulu woMlawulo kwiSebe leSikhululo ukuze alawule izicelo zoMlawulo, ukulungisa iingeniselo neengxelo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/NCV L4 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe (inqanaba leNQF 6) kuLawulo lwaseZikorahlwe/Lawulo loMlawulo loLuntu oNjengelawuliweyo nguSAQA onamava afanelekileyo angaphezulu kweenyanga ezintathu ukuya kwezihlanu (3-5) kwindawo yoMlawulo kwiPSE. I-ncumbent kufuneka azi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ekhoyo ilayisensi yokushayela. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nezindlela ezahlukeneyo zokugcina iifayile. Ulwazi ngendlela yoMlawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yesebe neNgxelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho weMfundo eQhubekayo. Ikhono namandla afunekayo: Ukucinga ngokuhlaziya, uLungiso nokuhlela, ukuzoba iingxaki, uLawulo lweMali, ikhono Lokulingana, uKumila kweQhawe, uLawulo lweNkundla, i-MS Office (i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint), ukwenza izinto ezininzi ngexesha elinye, ukusebenza njengodibada, uLawulo lwexesha, ikhono elilungileyo lokuthetha noku弥陀, ikhono lokuziphatha, uQinisekiso, uKholelwa, nokubamba iqondo.
xh.duties: Oogqatswa abaphumeleleyo baya kuba nawo oMsebenzi olandelayo: ukuphumeza izicelo zoMlawulo kwesebe lenkundla. Ukwenza imisebenzi yoMlawulo jikelele yokuxhasa iSebe lenkundla. Ukulungisa iingeniselo, iingxelo, iimemorandam, neqondo leminyuzi ukuyinkundla. Ukwenza ulawulo lwegama nethebhu zombini ngokwenza ngokwakhoyo nakwisekhompyutha. Ukunikela inkxaso ekugqibeleni nokusesekenzi izigqibo ezimali yokwakha. Ukuhlala ukhangelela wonke umsebenzi ongenayo uqinisekise ukuba yonke iindlela zexesha zihlutywa. Ukuvakalisa ngazo zonke iindawo ezilungileyo kwisebe. Ukulawula iindlela zokuhamba. Ukuncedisa ekunikezeni iinkxaso zokuqonda nemisebenzi yokuxhasa; ukuncedisa ekuhleleni iindlela ezingekayo kwindawo. Ukulawula iindlela zokuca ekulawuleni isikhululo ngokwemithetho yesikhululo. Ukubhala iindaba naxa zifuneka. Ukuvakalisa iindlela zokulawula iSebe lenkundla nokuba ngumvango wokuqala phakathi kweSebe leSikhululo nabanjiwane bayo.

jobs.title: Student Liaison Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Student Liaison Officer at Tosa campus providing welfare and academic support to students, requiring a diploma or degree in social science, psychology or education with 2-3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or NCV Level 4. A recognised National Diploma/ Degree in social science / psychology/ education or equivalent relevant qualification, 2-3 years’ experience in student support services education/ teaching and learning environment or related field, Proven knowledge of Public Sector, Knowledge of TVET environment, Proven Knowledge of Psychology practice, Teaching background, Public Service legislative framework such Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, PFMA, Treasury Regulation, Batho Pele principles. Excellent verbal and communication skills, Interpersonal relations, problem solving and analyst, planning, organising and execution, listening skills, report writing and administrative skills, Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work under pressure, ability to work in a team and independently. Good computer literacy (MS Word and Excel). Willingness to travel and work extra hours. A valid driver’s licence is essential as traveling and extended working hours may be required.
jobs.duties: Provide welfare support to students by liaising between stakeholders/persons. Prepare weekly and monthly reports. Assist students as and when required. Assist with academic support plan for identified students. Attend to any student accommodation needs. Ensure that there is continuous awareness of health and wellness.: Promote physical wellness and mental health. Guide students to make the right decision and improve their performance, ensure that there is continuous awareness and level of knowledge in HIV/AIDS to students. Address socio-economic student matters appropriately including substance and others. Promote regular attendance of students and monitor attendance register: Conduct home visits when necessary and interview/counsel students, staff families and other relevant stakeholders in order to identify contributing factors associated with low attendance concerns. Support students and families by establishing and delivering absence reduction programmes.
jobs.applications: Applications must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za Please quote the relevant reference number for each post in the email subject line to ensure easy identification and tracking.
jobs.notes: Goldfields TVET College invites suitable candidates to apply for the following external college vacancy: Free State province. A completed New Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection. Panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability. Goldfields College is an equal opportunity employer.

af.title: Studenteskakelbeampte
af.summary: Studenteskakelbeampte by Tosa-kampus wat welsyns- en akademiese ondersteuning aan studente verskaf, 'n diploma of graad in sosiale wetenskappe, sielkunde of opvoedkunde vereis met 2-3 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: A National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) of NCV Level 4. 'n Erkende National Diploma/ Degree in sosiale wetenskappe/ sielkunde/ opvoedkunde of 'n ekwivalente tersaaklike kwalifikasie, 2-3 jaar se ervaring in studentondersteuningsdienste opvoedkundige/ onderrig en leeromgewing of verwante veld, Bewese kennis van die Publieke Sektor, Kennis van die TVET-omgewing, Bewese kennis van sielkunde-praktyk, Onderwysagtergrond, Publieke Diens wetgewende raamwerk soos Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, PFMA, Treasury Regulation, Batho Pele-beginsels. Voortreflike verbale en kommunikasievaardighede, interpersoonlike betrekkinge, probleemoplossing en analise, beplanning, organisering en uitvoering, luistervaardighede, verslagskrywing en administratiewe vaardighede, goeie skriftelike en verbale kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoe om onder druk te werk, vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Goede rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word en Excel). Bereidheid om te reis en buitegewone ure te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderlisensie is noodsaaklik aangesien reis en uitgbreide werksure benodig kan word.
af.duties: Verskaf welsynsondersteuning aan studente deur tussen skakels/persone te tree. Berei weeklikse en maandelikse verslae voor. Help studente soos en wanneer nodig. Help met die akademiese ondersteuningsplan vir geïdentifiseerde studente. Skenk aandag aan enige behoeftes rakende studentakkommodasie. Verseker dat daar deurlopende bewustheid van gesondheid en welstand is.: Bevorder fisieke welstand en geestesgesondheid. Begelei studente om die regte besluite te neem en hul prestasie te verbeter, verseker dat daar deurlopende bewustheid en vlak van kennis rakende MIV/VIGS onder studente is. Hanteer sosio-ekonomiese studenteaangeleenthede toepaslik, insluitend middelmiewe en andere. Bevowel gereeldige bywoning van studente en monitor die bywoningsregister: Voer tuisbesoeke uit wanneer nodig en onderhou/berade studente, personeelfamilies en ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes om bydraende faktore wat met lae bywoning verband hou, te identifiseer. Ondersteun studente en families deur afwesigheidsvermindingsprogramme vas te stel en uit te voer.

zu.title: Inkantili Yabafundi
zu.summary: Inkantili Yabafundi esikhungweni sat Tosa campus edlalela indima ekunikeleni abafundi inkxaso ngokwemibandzela yempilo yabo nangemfundo, edinga idiploma noma idigri kumkhakha wesayensi yomphakathi, izifundo zengqondo noma emfundo ehlangan namava eminyaka eyi-2-3.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) noma i-NCV Level 4. Idiploma yezwe/ Idigri ekutholenwe ibhekephansi kumkhakha wesayensi yomphakathi/ izifundo zengqondo/ emfundo noma izifundo ezingangenyiwa ezihlobene nokuthile, namava eminyaka eyi-2-3 kule minyakazo yenkxaso yabafundi emfundo/ ukufundisa kanye nendawo yokufunda noma nakunoma yikuphi okuhlobene nakhona. Ulwazi olungathandekiyo lomkhakha kahulumeni womphakathi. Ulwazi nendawo ye-TVET. Ulwazi olungathandekiyo ngenqubo yezifundo zengqondo. Isizinda sokufundisa. Uhlelo lomthethosisekelo lomkhakha kahulumeni womphakathi njengoko kuhlelwe nguMthetho kahulumeni womphakathi, Izimiso zokahulumeni womphakathi, i-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Treasury, nezimiso zika-Batho Pele. Amakhono aphezulu okukhuluma nokuchaza. Ukuhlobana kwabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukuhlela kanye nokwenza, amakhono okuzwa, ukubhala imibiko namakhono okuphatha okubhaliweyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini kanye nokusebenza ngabanye. Ulwazi oluhle kwekhompyutha (MS Word and Excel). Ukuzithoba ekuhambahambeni nokusebenza kwamahora amaningi. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile iyadingeka njengoba kungadingeka ukuhambahamba nokusebenza kwamahora amaningi.
zu.duties: Nika abafundi inkxaso ngokwemibandzela ngokuhlanganisa izithakamazako/bantu. Lungise imibiko yamasonto njalo ngenyanga. Siza abafundi noma kunini lapho kudingeka khona. Siza ngeplani yenkxaso yemfundo yalabo abafundi abakhethiweyo. Qaphela izidingo zokuhlala kwabafundi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kube khona ukwaziswa ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nezempilo nangempilo yengqondo: Khuthaza impilo yomzimba nengqondo. Hollyisa abafundi ukuthi bathathe izinqumo ezifanele bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kube khona ukwaziswa ngokuqhubekayo nangazinga lolwazi nge-HIV/AIDS kubafundi. Phathela ngokufanele izindaba zabafundi ezingokomnotho nosebentweni kuhlanganise izinto ezibandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nakunoma yini okunye. Khuthaza ukuya njalo kwabafundi emfundweni futhi qaphela irekhodi lokuya emfundweni: Yenza ukuvakashela emakhaya lapho kudingeka khona futhi xoxa/nikeza abafundi, imindeni yabasebenzi kanye nalabo abanye abahlobene naleso simo izixazululo ukuze kutholakale izinto ezenza abafundi bangayi emfundweni njalo. Yenza inkxaso abafundeni nemindenini ngokusungula futhi uhlele izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukungayi emfundweni. Yenza ukuvakashela emakhaya lapho kudingeka khona, futhi xoxisane/nikeza ngamalebe abafundi, imindeni yabasebenzi kanye nalabo abangekeyo bahlukene nendima enkulu kule minyakazo ehlobene nokungayi kwesikole kwabafundi.

xh.title: ISikhokelo sabafundi
xh.summary: ISikhokelo sabafundi kummandla we-Tosa campus sinika inkxaso yentlalontle nenyani zezemfundo kwabafundi, sifuna idiploma okanye inqanaba lemfuno kumazwe ngamazwe, kwipsikholoji okanye kwemfundo kunye noluhlu lweminyaka engama-2-3 yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seZiko sikaRhulumente (iGrade 12) okanye i-NCV Level 4. Idiploma/Inqanaba lemfuno eliqinisekisiweyo kwizayensi yentlangano / ipsikholoji / imfundo okanye isifanekiselo esihambelanayo, 2-3 years’ experience kwiinkxaso zemfundo kwabafundi ukufundisa / kwindalo yokufunda nokufundisa okanye kwelinye igcala, ulwazi olubonwayo ngukaRhulumente, ulwazi ngendalo ye-TVET, ulwazi olubonwayo ngokwenziwa kwepsikholoji, isibungo sokufundisa, inkqubo yomthetho yeNkonzo kaRhulumente efana noMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, IiZigqibo zeNkonzo kaRhulumente, i-PFMA, IiZigqibo zeSikhundla, iinkqubo zeBatho Pele. Amandla amakhulu okuthetha nokunxibelelwana, iziqu zophatho lwabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqamba iindlela, uqwalaselo, ucwangciso, ukuhlelwa kwemisebenzi nokuzenza, amandla okumamela, ukubhala iingxelo namandla okulawula, amandla amakhulu okubhala nokuthetha. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, amandla okusebenza nqanaba nabantu nokusebenza ngedwa. Ulwazi oluhle lwekhompyutha (i-MS Word ne-Excel). Ukuzimisela okuhamela nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iyimfuno kuba okuhamela nakuqhuba iiyure ezongezelelweyo kungadingeka.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yentlalontle kwabafundi ngokuthatha inxaxheba phakathi kwabathathi-nxaxheba/bantu. Lungiselela iingxelo zangaphakathi ngenyanga. Nceda abafundi njengoko kudingeka. Nceda ngocwangciso lenkxaso yemfundo kwabafundi abachongiweyo. Qwalasela nayiphi na imfuno yokuhlala kwabafundi. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ulwazi oluqhubekayo ngempilo nokuhle.: Khuthaza impilo yomzimba nempilo engqondweni. Qondisa abafundi ukwenza izigqibo ezifanelekileyo n ukuphucula ukusebenza kwabo, qinisekisa ukuba kukho ulwazi oluqhubekayo n inqanaba lolwazi kwiHIV/AIDS kwabafundi. Phathela ngokufanelekileyo iindaba zabafundi ezinzima nentlalo ezibandakanya iziyobisi nezinye. Khuthaza ukubakho rhoqo kwabafundi uze ulawule irejista yokubakho: Yenza iindwendwe zasekhaya xa kufuneka uze ucocisela nabafundi, usapho lwabasebenzi nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba abalulekileyo ukuze uchonge iimeko ezinomnxeba ekubeni ngekho rhoqo. Nceda abafundi nusapho ngokuseka nokuvelisa iinkqubo zokunciphisa ukungekho rhoqo.

jobs.title: HR Practitioner
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: HR Practitioner at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office handling conditions of service, remuneration, recruitment and selection at salary level 7.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management, Public Management, Labour Relations, or equivalent qualification. At least 2-3 years in Human Resource Management / Labour Relations environment or related field, valid driver’s licence, introduction to PERSAL Certificate. Experience in the TVET sector will be an added advantage. Knowledge and understating of the application of Public Service legislative framework (PSA, PFMA, LRA, PSR etc.). Extensive knowledge and understand of human resource prescripts and practice. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector.
jobs.duties: Render conditions of services and remuneration of employees (leave, housing, medical, injury on duty, long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pension, allowances, PILIR etc.). Implement termination of services. Render Recruitment and Selection services in line with the Departmental policy and delegation (Advertisements, appointments, transfers, verification of qualifications, secretariat functions at interviews, absorptions, probation periods etc.). Supervisor human resources / staff.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940.
jobs.applications: Email to hrpractitioner@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful.: Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Note: EE Target African male, African female, White male, White female, Coloured Male, Coloured female and Indian female.

af.title: HR-praktisyn
af.summary: HR-praktisyn by die sentrale kantoor van die Department of Higher Education and Training wat diensvoorwaardes, vergoeding, werwing en keuring hanteer op salarisvlak 7.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Publieke Bestuur, Arbeidsverhoudinge, of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste 2-3 jaar in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Arbeidsverhoudinge-omgewing of verwante veld, geldige bestuurslisensie, inleiding tot PERSAL-sertifikaat. Ervaring in die TVET-sektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van die toepassing van die Openbare Diens-wetgewende raamwerk (PSA, PFMA, LRA, PSR ens.). Uitgebreide kennis en begrip van menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte en -praktyk. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor.
af.duties: Verskaf diensvoorwaardes en vergoeding van werknemers (verlof, behuising, medies, besering op diens, erkenning vir lang diens, oortyd, herverplasing, pensioen, toelaes, PILIR ens.). Implementeer beëindiging van dienste. Verskaf Werwing en Keuring-dienste in ooreenstemming met die departementele beleid en delegasie (Advertensies, aanstellings, oorplasings, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, sekretariaatsfunksies by onderhoude, absorpsies, proefperiodes ens.). Bestuur menslike hulpbronne / personeel.

zu.title: Umuntu osebenza ngamaphuzu wobuntu (HR Practitioner)
zu.summary: Umuntu osebenza ngamaphuzu zobuntu e-Department of Higher Education and Training ohlalenko okuphakathi, ephatha izimo zesevisi, inkokhelo, ukubungaza abasebenzi nokukhethwa kubungaza kuhlezi kahle esiya kwabo banganikeza iholo elingu-level 7.
zu.requirements: I-diploma yezwe elididiye (NQF 6) kumabizo abantu, abantu basezikhungweni zomphakathi, izivumelwano zomsebenzi, noma ukuhlola okulinganayo owenziwe; okokungenwa okuthize. Ukuze uthole le ndawo kudingeka ubenamava okungenani iminyaka engu-2-3 kwindawo yokuphathwa komuntu / izivumelwano zomsebenzi noma endaweni efanayo, kanti kudingeka ube nawo amakhasi okushayela obhalisiwe kanye neqiniso lokwaziswa mayelana PERSAL. Ukuba namava esimweni se-TVET kuyoba yithuba elihle kakhulu. Ukwazi futhi ukuqonda isimiso somthetho osetshenziswa ohlelweni lwesevisi yomphakathi (i-PSA, i-PFMA, i-LRA, i-PSR njll.). Ukwazi futhi ulungele ukuphatha imitshovo yamabizo abantu nokukwazi nokuyisebenzisa kalula. Ukwazi futhi ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ukwazi futhi ukuqonda indandatho yamaphuzu obuntu oluphakeme.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi ehambisana nemibandela yesevisi kanye nenkokhelo yabasebenzi (ukushiya umsebenzi, ukuhlala ezindlini, ukwelashwa, ukulimala ngisho nangaphansi kokuqeqeshwa, ukubhaliswa kobude obude, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi, ukuhamba, i-pension, izibonelelo, i-PILIR njll.). Phatha ukupheliswa kwemisebenzi. Nikela ngemisebenzi yokubungaza nokukhetha abantu ngokuhambisana nomthetho nemigomo yomnyango nokwabelwa kobungaza (Ukubiza abantu abaningi ngalolu hlobo, ukumiswa komsebenzi, ukuqhubeka komsebenzi, ukuqinisekiswa kwemfuno yemfundo, imisebenzi yesikhwama ebandakanya ukuxoxa nabantu, ukufakwa komuntu, isikhathi sokuzama ukusebenza njll.). Qapha abantu abaqeqeshiwe kumabizo / abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi we-HR
xh.summary: Umsebenzi we-HR kwindawo ephakathi yoMnyango we-Higher Education and Training uphatha iimeko zomsebenzi, intlawulo, ukubhalisa nokhetho ngelinqanaba lomvuzo lesi-7.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma efanelekileyo (NQF 6) kwi-Human Resource Management, i-Public Management, i-Labour Relations, okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Okanye ixesha elingezantsi elingesi-2-3 kwimeko ye-Human Resource Management / Labour Relations okwelinye igaba elifanayo, ilayiseni yokuqhuba esebenzayo, isatifiketi yokuqalisa kwi-PERSAL. Amava kwicala le-TVET kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusebenzisa inkqubo yomthetho woLuntu (PSA, PFMA, LRA, PSR njl.njl.). Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda amagazethi namalungiselelo abantu. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET/ CET Administration. Ulwazi nokuqonda le candelo le-Higher Education.
xh.duties: Phathisa iimeko zomsebenzi nentlawulo yabasebenzi (ikhefu, indlu, yezonyango, umonakalo ngelixa usebenza, ukuvunywa kwenkonzo ende, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, ukuhlala kwendlalo, ipenshini, izibonelelo, i-PILIR njl.njl.). Phumeza isiphelo seenkonzo. Phathisa iinkonzo zokuBhalisa noKhetho ngokuhlana nenkqubo yesebe neligunyaziso (Izikhangazo, iinkomfa, ukuqhwesela, ukuqinisekisa izidanga, imisebenzi yobungqiki kwiingxoxo, ukuthathwa kwangaphakathi, iipesenti zokuqala njl.njl.). Lawula abantu / abasebenzi.

jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. jobs.summary: Bursary clerk at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, assisting students with NSFAS and financial-aid applications.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate three (3) years Diploma / Degree in Financial Management / Public Management / Business Management; or a related field. At least a minimum of one to two years relevant experience in bursary, student financial aid. Knowledge of NSFAS bursary processes and requirements. TVET College bursary rules and guidelines. Student financial aid administration. Basic financial administration. Data capturing and record keeping. Computer literacy, particularly MS Word and Excel. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Good organizational and administrative skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Accuracy and attention to detail. Good customer-service skills when dealing with students and parents. High level of integrity and confidentiality because the clerk handles students' personal and financial information. Knowledge of relevant college systems, such as the student administration/financial system and NSFAS online systems, would be advantageous. Driver’s license will be added as an advantage.

Identify missing or incorrect documentation and advise students accordingly. Assist students with NSFAS application queries. Capture and update student information on the relevant system. Follow up on outstanding applications and supporting documents. Assist with the administration of NSFAS applications. Capture and verify NSFAS applicant information. Monitor the status of applications. Assist students with NSFAS queries and appeals. Ensure that college records correspond with NSFAS information. Assist with the submission and reconciliation of required information to NSFAS. Assist with the administration of approved student allowances. Verify information required for accommodation and travel allowances. Assist with accommodation-related documentation and verification. Check student attendance information where attendance is a requirement for allowances. Assist with processing or allocating approved bursary funds. Follow up on outstanding allowance payments. Maintain accurate bursary files and student financial-aid records. Capture and update bursary information on the college system. Prepare statistics and reports on applications, approvals, rejections and allowances. Reconcile bursary information and student accounts where required. Ensure documents are properly filed and available for audits. Assist internal and external auditors with bursary-related information. Respond to enquiries from students, parents and other stakeholders. Explain bursary requirements and procedures to students. Provide assistance during registration and orientation. Conduct bursary/financial-aid awareness sessions. Refer complex financial-aid matters to the appropriate supervisor or NSFAS.
