af.title: Beursklerk
af.summary: Beursklerk by die sentrale kantoor van die Department of Higher Education and Training, wat studente behulpsaam is met NSFAS- en finansiële hulpaansoeke.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate. 'n Geskikte drie (3)-jaar Diploma / Graad in Finansiële Bestuur / Openbare Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur; of 'n verwante veld. Ten minste een tot twee jaar se relevante ervaring in beurse en studente-finansiële hulp. Kennis van NSFAS-beursprosesse en -vereistes. TVET-kollege-beursreëls en -riglyne. Administrasie van studente-finansiële hulp. Basiese finansiële administrasie. Datavaslegging en rekordhouding. Rekenaarvaardigheid, veral MS Word en Excel. Goeie kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese en administratiewe vaardighede. Vermoe om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Akkuraatheid en oog vir detail. Goeie kliëntediensvaardighede wanneer daar met studente en ouers gepraat word. Hoë vlak van integriteit en vertroulikheid aangesien die klerk studente se persoonlike en finansiële inligting hanteer. Kennis van relevante kollegestelsels, soos die studentadministrasie-/finansiële stelsel en NSFAS-aanlynstelsels, sal voordelig wees. Bestuurslisensie sal as 'n voordeel bygevoeg word.
af.duties: Nuwe en terugkerende studente behulpsaam wees met beurs-/finansiële hulpaansoeke. Beursaansoeke ontvang, nagaan en vaslê. Ondersteunende dokumente wat deur studente ingedien is, verifieer. Ontbrekende of onjuiste dokumentasie identifiseer en studente dienooreenkomstig adviseer. Studente behulpsaam wees met navrae oor NSFAS-aansoeke. Studenteinligting op die relevante stelsel vaslê en opdateer. Opvolg doen op uitstaande aansoeke en ondersteunende dokumente. Behulpsaam wees met die administrasie van NSFAS-aansoeke. NSFAS-aansoekerinligting vaslê en verifieer. Die status van aansoeke monitor. Studente behulpsaam wees met NSFAS-navrae en -appèlle. Verseker dat kollegerekords ooreenstem met NSFAS-inligting. Behulpsaam wees met die indiening en rekonsiliasie van vereiste inligting aan NSFAS. Behulpsaam wees met die administrasie van goedgekeurde studentetoelaes. Inligting wat vir akkommodasie- en reistoelaes vereis word, verifieer. Behulpsaam wees met akkommodasie-verwante dokumentasie en verifikasie. Studentbywoningsinligting nagaan waar bywoning 'n vereiste vir toelaes is. Behulpsaam wees met die verwerking of toewysing van goedgekeurde beursfondse. Opvolg doen op uitstaande toelaagbetalings. Akkurate beurslêers en rekords van studente-finansiële hulp handhaaf. Beursinligting op die kollegestelsel vaslê en opdateer. Statistiek en verslae oor aansoeke, goedkeurings, afwysings en toelaes voorberei. Beursinligting en studenterekeninge waar nodig rekonsilieer. Verseker dat dokumente behoorlik geberg en beskikbaar vir oudite is. Interne en eksterne ouditeurs behulpsaam wees met beurs-verwante inligting. Op navrae van studente, ouers en ander belanghebbendes antwoord. Beursvereistes en -prosedures aan studente verduidelik. Bystand verleen tydens registrasie en oriëntasie. Bewustheidsessies oor beurse/finansiële hulp aanbied. Komplekse finansiële hulpsake na die toepaslike toesighouer of NSFAS verwys.

zu.title: Umlobi wezibursari
zu.summary: Umlobi wezibursari ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, osize abafundi ngemibhalo ye-NSFAS nezinye izinhlelo zosizo lwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4. I-Diploma / Degree emayelana nayo yangeminyaka emithathu (3) ku-Financial Management / Public Management / Business Management; noma endaweni ehlobene kakhulo. Okungenani ubulumo obuncane bomnyaka owodwa kuya kwawomabili kokusebenza ngokuhlobene nezibursari nokesosizo lwezimali zabafundi. Ulwazi ngamamodelo nezidingo zezibursari ze-NSFAS. Izimiso nezinqondiso zezibursari kuma-TVET College. Ukuphatwa kokesosizo lwezimali zabafundi. Ukuphatwa okuyisisekelo kwezimali. Ukufaka izilulu futhi kugcinwe izinkomba. Ukubazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ikakhulukazi i-MS Word ne-Excel. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuba nobudlelwano. Amakhono amahle okuhlela nokuphatha. Ikono lokusebenza phansi kwegcinshwa futhi ugcine isikhathi esimisiwe. Ukuzenzela kuhle futhi kuqaphelisisele imininingwane. Amakhono amahle okukhonza izivakashi una busebenza nabafundi nabothisha. Izinga eliphezulu lokuzithiba nokugcina imfihlo ngoba lo mlobi uphatha imininingwane yabantu nabafundi. Ulwazi ngamasistimu ahlobene nakweso sethu, njengesistimu sokuphathwa kwezimali zabafundi nasemasistimu e-ayini ye-NSFAS, kungaba lusizo. Ifayini lokushayela izimoto izobe lusizo.
zu.duties: Usize abafundi abasha nalabo ababuyayo ngemibhalo yezibursari/kesosizo lwezimali. Wamukela, uhlole futhi ufake imibhalo yezibursari. Uqinisekise imibhalo elandelwayo ethunyelwe abafundi. Uthole imibhalo engekho noma engalungile bese uyeluleka abafundi. Usize abafundi ngemibuzo emayelana nezibhalo ze-NSFAS. Ufake futhi uvuselele imininingwane yabafundi kwesisitimu esihlobene. Ulandele imibhalo ebekehlule kanye nezinkomba ezingekho. Usize ekuphathweni kwemibhalo ye-NSFAS. Ufake futhi uqinisekise imininingwane yomuntu othumile isibhalo se-NSFAS. Uqaphele isimo seemibhalo. Usize abafundi ngemibuzo nezikhalo ngemibhalo ye-NSFAS. Uqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane kweso sethu iyahambisana neyase-NSFAS. Usize ekuthumeleni nasekukhombiseni imininingwane edingayo kwi-NSFAS. Usize ekuphathweni kwemalinikwa abafundi abamukelekile. Uqinisekise imininingwane efunwa ukwenzela imalinikwa okuyonke imali yokuhamba. Usize ngemibhalu ehlobene nokuhlaliswa nokuqinisekiswa. Uhlole imininingwane yokungihamba kwezikhungo lapho kudingeka khona ukwenzela imalinikwa. Usize ekulungiseni noma ekaneni imali yezibursari. Ulandela imali ebekehlule yonke. Ugcinimise imifana yezibursari izibhalo kesosizo lwezimali zabafundi. Ufake futhi uvuselele imininingwane yezibursari kweso sethu. Ulungele izibalo nemibhalo ngemibhalo, abamukelekile, abasabalele kanye nalinikwa. Ukhalaza imininingwane yezibursari kanye namakhawunti abafundi lapho kudingeka khona. Uqinisekise imibhalo igcwe selibhalwe futhi yatholakala ukwenzela izikhwamvu. Usize abahloli bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngemibhalu ehlobene nezibursari. Uphendula imibuzo evela kwabafundi, ngabe busekelwe nasezinye izindawo. Uchaza imibhalo nendlela ezisunguliwe yezibursari abafundi. Unikeza usizo ngesikhathi sokungena nokwethulwa kuso sethu. Yenza izinkulumo zokwazisa ngezibursari/kesosizo lwezimali. Uthumela izindaba ezinkulu zezimali kumphathi ohlelo noma ku-NSFAS.

xh.title: Umlawuli weBursari
xh.summary: Umlawuli webursari kwindawo enkulu yesebe leDepartment of Higher Education and Training, unceda abafundi ngeNFAS kunye nokuSetyenziswa kwezoMabo-mali.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate. Isidanga se-Diploma / Degree seminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Financial Management / Public Management / Business Management; okanye kwelinye icandelo elinxulumene nalo. Ubuncinane bamava eminyaka elisi-1 kuye kweli-2 kumsebenzi ongqinelanayo kubursari,Uncedo lweemali zabafundi. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zemigaqo yebursari yeNFAS kunye neemfuno. Iingqiqobo zamagazethi kunye neenkeliso zebursari zeTVET College. Ulawulo luncedo lweemali zabafundi. Ulawulo olusesiseko lweemali. Ukufaka iingcombolo kwichibi nokugcina irekhodi. Ukuba lilisebenzisi lekhompyutha, ngakumbi i-MS Word ne-Excel. Amakhono amabalwe kukunxibelelwana nabantu. Amakhone amahle okuqamba nokulawula. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugqiba umsebenzi kwixesha elichaziweyo. Ukuchaneka nokunaka iinkcukacha. Amakhono amahle osebenza ngabathengi xa kusetyenziswa nabafundi nabazali. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuzithembela nokugcina iimfihlo kuba lo mlawuli uphatha iinkcukacha zabafundi ezimfihlo kunye nezo malini. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezinxulumene namakolishi, njengenkqubo yolawulo labafundi/yeemali kunye neenkqubo ze-NSFAS ezikwi-intanethi, kuya kuba lusizo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba iya kuthathwa njengentsengakalo.
xh.duties: Ukunceda abafundi abasha nabo babuyayo ngeenkonzo zokuSetyenziswa kwe-Bursari/ncedo lweemali. Ukumkela, ukuphonononga nokubeka iinkonzo zebursari. Ukuqinisekisa amaxwebhu axhasayo anikiweyo ngumfundi. Ukufumanisa amaxwebhu alahlekileyo okanye alunganga kunye nokucesa abafundi ngokwako. Ukunceda abafundi ngeemibuzo ngeenkonzo ze-NSFAS. Ukubeka nokuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabafundi kwinkqubo echanekileyo. Ukulandela iinkonzo ezingagqitywanga namaxwebhu axhasayo. Ukunceda nokuLawula iinkonzo ze-NSFAS. Ukubeka nokugqinisekisa iinkcukacha zabafundi abafaka isicelo kwi-NSFAS. Ukuqwalasela isimo seenkonzo. Ukunceda abafundi ngeemibuzo kunye neenkcukacha zokuxhaswa kwe-NSFAS. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amarekhodi ekolishi ahambelana nolwazi lwe-NSFAS. Ukunceda ukungenisa nokuvumelanisa ulwazi olufunekayo kwi-NSFAS. Ukunceda nokuLawula onke amaxabiso abafundi oKugunyazisiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ulwazi olufunekayo ngamaxabiso yonke indlu nokuhamba. Ukunceda ngamaxwebhu ahlobene nendawo yokuhlala nokuyaqinisekisa. Ukujonga iinkcukacha zobukho babafundi kwindawo ebekwe njengemfuno yamaxabiso. Ukunceda ngokuqhuba okanye ukwaba imali yebursari egunyaziweyo. Ukulandela amaxabiso angahlawulanga. Ukugcina iifayile ezichanekileyo zebursari kunye namarekhodi encedwana leemali zabafundi. Ukubeka nokuhlaziya iinkcukacha zebursari kwinkqubo yekolishi. Ukuqamba iibalo neengxelo ngeenkonzo, oKugunyaziswa,okuGxothwa kunye namaxabiso. Ukuvumelanisa ulwazi lwebursari kunye namanani abafundi kwindawo efunekayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu afakwe kakuhle kwaye afumaneka okuvavanyo. Ukunceda oovavanyo bangaphakathi kunye nabangaphandle ngeenkukacha ezinxulumene neBursari. Ukuphendula imibuzo evela kubafundi, abazali nakwelinye ilungu. Ukucacisa iimfuno kunye neenkqubo zebursari abafundi. Ukunika inkxaso ngexesha lokubhalisa nokwaziswa. Ukuqhuba iinkonzo zokwazisa ngokuSetyenziswa kwe-Bursari/ncedo lweemali. Ukuthumela iinkalo zencedo lweemali ezinzima kulawuli olufanelekileyo okanye kwi-NSFAS.

jobs.title: Project Administrator: National Skills Fund (NSF)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05), plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: Provide administrative support for National Skills Fund project lifecycle phases, including report compilation and office management at the central office.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate, an appropriate three (3) years Diploma/ Degree Business Management / Office Management / Public Administration / Public Management. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a relevant NSF or skills development field experience in training environment (artisan development, apprenticeship, leadership and skills development). Computer literate, project management certificate will be an added advantage. Valid driver’s license and must be willing to travel.
jobs.duties: Rendering administrative support services during the NSF project design, implementation and close out phases. Collate and compile reports, e.g. progress, monthly and quarterly NSF reports. Office Management, including meeting scheduling, drafting agendas, minutes taking, filing and maintaining students contractual and attendance records. Processing of stipend claim for learners, service providers, facilitators assessors and moderators. Prepare logistics and travel arrangements and claims. Register/uploading Learners on the College and NSF Learner system, etc. ensure that the project documentation specification is compiled with site monitoring tools. Take part in project site visits and ensure spot checks on all NSF related projects. Liaise with sector stakeholders and finance section on project matters. Liaises with internal and external auditors and coordinate activities leading to audits management as per audit plan. Record and update register of incoming and outgoing correspondence in the NSF Unit. Provide personnel administrative support to the project manager including leave, planning and reporting. Perform an ad hoc administration duty provided by NSF Manager.
jobs.enquiries: All enquiries should be directed to Ms Makondo AT /Ms Ramuzwila HN /Ms Mukhoro M/ Mr Muthige M Tel No: (015) 963 7091/ 7070 /7066/7095 respectively.
jobs.applications: Your application must clearly quote the correct job reference number and can either be posted to Human Resources Management, Vhembe TVET College, Private Bag X2136, Sibasa, 0970, Alternatively, applications may be send to Hr.applications@vhembecollege.edu.za or hand-delivered to the Central Office, Site 203, Unit A, Sibasa.
jobs.notes: To apply, please submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae highlighting your relevant qualifications, experience, and at least two contactable references along with a completed, signed Z83 application form (2021 version), which is available from any public service department. While certified copies of your qualifications and supporting documents are only required on or before the interview date, please note that late submissions will not be considered, and the college reserves the right to withdraw any post at any stage. Vhembe TVET College is an equal opportunity employer operating across four local municipalities that actively encourages applications from persons with disabilities. Due to high volumes, communication is limited to shortlisted candidates; therefore, if you do not receive feedback within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful, keeping in mind that final selection is subject to background vetting, credentials verification, and financial disclosure checks. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Vhembe TVET College is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. applications are invited from suitably qualified and knowledgeable candidates for appointment for the following positions.

af.title: Projekadministrateur: National Skills Fund (NSF)
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir lewensiklusfases van National Skills Fund-projekte, insluitend die samestelling van verslae en kantoorbestuur by die sentrale kantoor.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate, 'n toepaslike drie (3) jaar Diploma/ Degree Business Management / Office Management / Public Administration / Public Management. Minimum van 2 jaar ervaring in 'n toepaslike NSF- of vaardigheidsontwikkelingsveld met ervaring in 'n opleidingsomgewing (vakmanontwikkeling, leerlingskap, leierskap en vaardigheidsontwikkeling). Rekenaarvaardig, 'n projekbestuursertifikaat sal 'n voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie en moet bereid wees om te reis.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste tydens die NSF-projekontwerp-, implementering- en afsluitingsfases. Versamel en stel verslae op, bv. vorderings-, maandelikse en kwartlikse NSF-verslae. Kantoorbestuur, insluitend die skedulering van vergaderings, die opstel van agenda's, die neem van notules, lêerwerk en die handhawing van kontraktuele en bywoningsrekords van studente. Verwerk toelaai-eise vir leerders, diensverskaffers, fasiliteerders, assesseerders en moderators. Berei logistiek en reërelings en eise voor. Registreer/laai Leerders op die College- en NSF Learner-stelsel, ens. verseker dat die projekdokumentasiespesifikasie met werfmoniteringsinstrumente opgestel word. Neem deel aan projekwerfbesoeke en voer steekproewe uit op alle NSF-verwante projekte. Skakel met sektorbelanghebendes en die finansiesafdeling oor projekaangeleenthede. Skakel met interne en eksterne ouditeure en koördineer aktiwiteite wat tot ouditbestuur lei volgens die ouditplan. Neem op en dateer die register van inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie in die NSF-eenheid. Verskaf personeeladministratiewe ondersteuning aan die projekbestuurder, insluitend verlof, beplanning en verslagdoening. Voer 'n ad hoc administratiewe plig uit soos deur die NSF-bestuurder verskaf.

zu.title: Umphathi Wephrojekthi: National Skills Fund (NSF)
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yokuphathwa kwezokubhalisa kuphila kwephrojekthi yamaphases e-National Skills Fund, okuhlanganza ukuhlanganisa imibiko nokuphathwa kwehhovisi esikhungweni esikhulu.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 Certificate, idiploma/ idigri ezifanele kwezamabhizinisi eziyiminyaka emithathu (3) / Ukuphathwa Kwehhovisi / Ukuphathwa Kwawonke Wonke / Ukuphathwa Kwawonke Wonke. Isipilingo seminyaka emi-2 kuleyo nsimu efanayo ye-NSF noma isipilingo ensimini ekhuthazwa amakhono emhlabeni wokusebenza (ukuthuthukisa izandazo zomsebenzi, isipilingo sekhono, ukulandlela kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, isitifikedi sokuphathwa kwephrojekthi sizoba ngumswakama. Ulayisense wokuqasha osemthethweni kanye nokuthanda ukugibela. Ivalid driver's license kanti kufanele athande ukugibela isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Unike inkxaso ezokuphathwa kwezokubhalisa ngesikhathi semaphases womklamo, ukuphatha nokuvalelwa ngaphandle kophando lwephrojekthi ye-NSF. Qoqa futhi uhlanganye imibiko, njengemibiko yethuthuko, yanyanga zonke kanye neyikota yamabiko e-NSF. Ukuphathwa Kwehhovisi, okuhlanganisa ukumisa ithuba lomhlangano, ukuhlaya ihlelo lokhetho, ukuthatha imizuzu yokubhalisa, ukugcina amafayela kanye nokulondolosa izinkokhelo zamafayela abafundi namarekhodi wokubakhona. Ukucubungula izindleko zokufakwa kwamakhono ezibhekene nabafundi, abanikezinkxaso, abahlule kanye nabavivinyi. Hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba kwezokuthutha futhi uhlele izindleko zokuhamba. Bhalisa/faka abafundi kusistim yabafundi ye-College kanye ne-NSF, njll. qiniseka ukuthi imibhalo yokwenza iphrojekthi ihlanganiswe ngamathuluzi okubuka isiza. Thatha inxaxheba ekubukeni iziza zephrojekthi futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kwenziwa ukuhlola kwansuku zonke kuzo zonke izinhloba zamaphrojekthi e-NSF. Xhumana nezakhamuzi zendawo kanye nesebe lezezimali kumaphrojekthi. Xhumana nabahloli bangaphakathi kanye nabezomphakathi futhi uhlele izinkalo eziholela ekuphathweni kwezokuhlola ngokwehlelo lokuhlola. Bhala futhi uvuselele irekhodi lezinto ezingena naseziphuma kwi-NSF Unit. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwezabantu umphathi wephrojekthi okuhlanganisa ukubhalisa, ukuhlela kanye nokubika. Yenza imisebenzi eshuthe ngesikhathi esithile ebanjwa ngumphathi we-NSF.

xh.title: Mlawuli woMsebenzi: National Skills Fund (NSF)
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kumaxesha onke obomi bomsebenzi weqela le-National Skills Fund, kuquka ukuqokelela iingxelo nolawulo lwe-ofisi kwiziko eliphambili.
xh.requirements: Igrade 12 / Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo/ Isatifikethi se-NCV Level 4, idiploma/ degree ezifanelekileyo yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Business Management / Office Management / Public Administration / Public Management. Amanqanaba amabini (2) ambalwa amava ohlobo olufanelekileyo kwi-NSF okanye kwinkalo yophuhliso lwamakhono amava kwendawo yokuqeqesha (uphuhliso lwabazali bobugcisa, umfundo wabafundi abangagenanga kwisikolo, intsimbi nophuhliso lwamakhono). Ukuba nalwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, isatifikethi sokuqulunqa umsebenzi siza kuba lusizo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni kwaye kufuneka ube lukhululekile ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Kunikela iinkonzo zonke zemisebenzi yolawulo ngelixa lendlula kumaxesha onke obomi bomsebenzi weqela le-NSF, kuqokelelwa iingxelo ezinjengamaxa onke abo, nyanga nonyaka wezixelo ze-NSF. Lawulo leziko, kuquka ukumisela iintlanganiso, ukulunga iinhlobo zomsebenzi, ukubhala iingxelo zentlanganiso, uku gcina iifayile nokugcina iirekhedi zomvuzo namaxesha okuza abafundi abangenisa izaziso namaxa onke esikolo. Ulungiselelo lwezifundo nokuqhuba iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqhuba iimviwo zabafundi, baze bathunyelwe kwindawo yokulawula amaxa onke abo nokwenza imisebenzi eqeqeshwa ngokutsha ngokwesigqibo sokulinganiselwa kwabanye abantu. Thatha inxaxheba kwizindwendwe zomsebenzi kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kuye kwenziwe ukukhangela ngokuthe ngqo kuyo yonke imisebenzi ehambelana ne-NSF. Thethathana nabantu abangaphandle kwaye ulawule imisebenzi ehambelana nezenzo zokuqonda imali eqokelelwe kwiprojekthi. Thethathana nabakhangeli iii-oda bhangaphakathi nangaphandle uze ulawule imisebenzi eholisa ukulawula ukukhangela ii-oda njengoko kucwelwe kwisicwangciso sokukhangela ii-oda. Qamba uze uhlaziye irekhodi yemivo ekungeni nasekuphumeni kwindawo leyo eqeqesha i-NSF. Nikela inkxaso yolawulo kwabasebenzi kumlawuli wemisebenzi kuquka amalungiselelo, ukuqulunqa nokunikela iingxelo. Yenza omnye umsebenzi wolawulo onikelwa ngumlawuli we-NSF.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Receptionist needed to manage switchboard operations and provide clerical support at a higher education campus.
jobs.requirements: Matric certificate or NC(V) Level 4 certificate in Office Administration, N6 Certificate or Diploma/Degree in Office Administration. At least two (2) years’ work experience/exposure as a switchboard operator or as a receptionist. Excellent communication skills, interpersonal relations, client focus and innovative thinking. Ability to work under pressure with little or no supervision. Adherence to Batho Pele principles, telephone etiquette, good interpersonal relations. Computer Literacy (knowledge of MS packages).
jobs.duties: Responsible for the campus reception. Control switchboard operations by making / receiving and forwarding calls. Provide clerical support. Manage / control the photocopy machines. Distribute correspondence to the relevant officials. Manage and administer requests for stationery and keep proper record thereof. Render general administrative support services to the campus including typing of documents. Electronic and manual filling. Data capturing and binding. Participation in overall college record management. Stock taking where required. Relief services in the offices of managers. Circulation and updating of emergency procedures and numbers.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940.
jobs.applications: Email to receptionist@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Note: EE Target African male, African female, White male, White female, Coloured Male, Coloured female and Indian female.

af.title: Receptionis
af.summary: Receptionis benodig om skakelbordbedrywighede te bestuur en klerklike ondersteuning by 'n hoër-onderwyskampus te bied.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat of NC(V) Level 4-sertifikaat in Office Administration, N6-sertifikaat of Diploma/Degree in Office Administration. Ten minste twee (2) jaar se werkervaring/blootstelling as 'n skakelbordoperateur of as 'n receptionis. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, interpersoonlike verhoudings, kliëntfokus en innoverende denke. Vermoë om onder druk met min of geen toesig te werk. Nalewing van Batho Pele-beginsels, telefoonetiket, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Rekenaarvaardigheid (kennis van MS-pakette).
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die kampusresepsie. Beheer skakelbordbedrywighede deur oproepe te maak / te ontvang en deur te skakel. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning. Bestuur / beheer die fotokopieermasjiene. Versprei korrespondensie aan die betrokke amptenare. Bestuur en administreer versoeke vir skryfbehoeftes en hou behoorlike rekord daarvan. Lewer algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die kampus insluitend die tik van dokumente. Elektroniese en handmatige invul. Datavaslegging en inbind. Deelname aan algehele kollegerekordbestuur. Voorraadopname waar vereis. Verligtingsdienste in die kantore van bestuurders. Sirkulasie en opdatering van noodprosedures en -nommers.

zu.title: Umamukeli
zu.summary: Kudingeka umamukeli ongaphatha ukusebenza kwebhodi lokushintsha futhi anike inkxaso yomsebenzi kahlelo ohlinzekeni emnyangweni wezemfundo ephakeme.
zu.requirements: Isitifikathi se-Matric noma isitifikathi se-NC(V) Level 4 kwi-Office Administration, isitifikathi se-N6 noma i-Diploma/Degree kwi-Office Administration. Okungenani amawola amabili (2) enhlokodvani/okuhlola impilo yokuba ngumsebenzisi webhodi lokushintsha noma njengomamukeli. Amafomu aphelele okuxhumana, izindaba zabantu, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokucabanga ngendlela entsha. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi ngaphandle kokulawulwa noma ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso esincane sokulawulwa. Ukulandela imigomo ka-Batho Pele, izindlela ezinhle zokuxhumana ngocingo, kanye nezindaba ezinhle zabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (ulwazi lwemaphakheji e-MS).
zu.duties: Uxhumeke ekubeni ungasiya emnyangweni wezemfundo ephakeme. Lawula ukusebenza kwebhodi lokushintsha ngokwenza/ukuthola nokudlulisela amakholi. Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi kahlelo. Phatha/lawula imishini yokushicilela. Yaba inxibelelwano kubasebenzi abahambisana naleso sikhundla. Phatha futhi uhlole izicelo zensiza yokubhala futhi ugcine irekhodi elihle ngawo. Nikeza izinsiza zokusebenza kahlelo okuyisisekelo ohlinzekeni ohlinzeka nokuqhathanisa kwayo, okuhlanganisa ukuthayipha amadokhumenti. Ukugcwaliswa kabhethri kanye ne-PC sokugcwalisa ngokwesandla. Ukuthola imininingwane kanye nokubhukuda. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwerekhodi yonke yasekolishi. Ukuthathwa kwesithi lapho kudingeka khona. Izinkonzo zokwesekela kumahhovisi abaphathi. Ukusakaza kanye nokuhlazi imigomo nezinombolo zezimo eziphuthumayo.

xh.title: Umamkeli wamntu oqhumayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umamkeli wamntu oqhumayo ukulawula izinto zenkonzo yefowuni yentshiso kwaye anike inkxaso yemisebenzi yebhuro kwisiko samabanga aphezulu eemfundo.
xh.requirements: Isatifiketi samatikiti eMatric okanye isatifiketi seNC(V) Level 4 kulawulo lofisi, Isatifiketi seN6 okanye I-Diploma/I-Degree kulawulo lofisi. Ubuncinane amashumi amabini (2) iminyaka yamava / ukwaziswa komsebenzi njengomsebenzi wofowuni yentshiso okanye njengomamkeli. Amakhono amabalulekileyo enkomakhaya, iindibaniselwano zomntu nomntu, ukugxila kumthengi nokuqonda ngokweenzA ezitsha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi komxinwa ngesaphetha okanye ngaphandle kolawulo. Ukuzinikela kumagunya kaBatho Pele, isithethe sefowuni, iindibaniselwano ezilungele umntu nomntu. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (ulwazi lweempakinthi zeMS).
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokwamkela abantu kwisiko. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zefowuni yentshiso ngokwenza / nokwamkela nokudlulisela iifowuni. Inkxaso yemisebenzi yebhuro. Ulawulo / ulawulo lwezikitshi zokutsala iikopi. Ukusasaza ibhokisi kubaphathi abahambelana nayo. Ulawulo nokulawula iifom zokucela izixhobo zokubhala nokugcina irekhodi elifanelekileyo. Inkonzo yonke inkxaso yolawulo kwisiko kuquka nokuthayipha amaxwebhu. Ukugcwalisa ngemoyilo nangokusuka. Ukuthatha idatha nokunqamla. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kulawulo lwerekhodi lekoliji jikelele. Ukubala iitokhise apho kufuneka khona. Iinkonzo zokukhululeka kwiifayili zabaphathi. Ukusasaza nokuhlaziya iindlela kunye neenombolo zomngxuma.

jobs.title: Data Capturers
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Pretoria Campus Ref No: TNC/PC/26-10/6 Mamelodi Campus Ref No: TNC/MC/26-10/7 Rosslyn Campus Ref No: TNC/RC/26-10/8 Soshanguve South Campus Ref No: TNC/SSC/26/-10/9 Soshanguve North Campus Ref No: TNC/SNC/26-10/10 Temba Campus Ref No: TNC /TC/26-10/11
jobs.summary: Data Capturers needed across multiple TSC campuses to capture student registration and marks data into the ITS system, requiring a diploma in office administration and 18 months' experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate or equivalent plus an appropriate National Diploma in Management Assistant/Office Administration or any relevant field. 18 months experience in student administration. Provide administrative support to the Head of Department by capturing student marks, weekly attendance etc. into the ITS system. Verify query missing data errors observed during data entry. Review and validate all data from records. Submit data, Make regular backups of data. Update registers and statistics. Keep and maintain records and files. Ensure records are properly sorted and secured. Provide information to faculties/divisions as and when required.

af.title: Data Capturers
af.summary: Data Capturers benodig by verskeie TSC-kampusse om studenteregistrasie- en puntdata in die ITS-stelsel in te voer, met 'n diploma in kantooradministrasie en 18 maande se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate of ekwivalent plus 'n toepaslike National Diploma in Management Assistant/Office Administration of enige relevante veld. 18 maande ervaring in studentadministrasie. Kennis van rekenaardeware, sagteware en programme. Praktiese kennis van die Adapt IT [ITS] stelsel.
af.duties: Voer studente se registrasiedata van beskikbare rekords in die ITS-stelsel in. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Head of Department deur studentepunte, weeklikse bywoning ens. in die ITS-stelsel in te voer. Verifieer en soek ontbrekende datafoute wat tydens data-inskrywing opgemerk is. Hersien en valideer alle data uit rekords. Dien data in, Maak gereelde rugsteune van data. Werk registers en statistiek by. Hou en onderhou rekords en lêers. Verseker dat rekords behoorlik gesorteer en beveilig is. Verskaf inligting aan fakulteite/afdelings soos wanneer benodig.

zu.title: Ababambi Bemininingwane
zu.summary: Ababambi bemininingwane badingwa kumakhasi amanengi e-TSC ukuze babambe imininingwane yokubhaliswa kwabafundi kanye namamashi uhlelo lwe-ITS, kudingeka idiploma ekuphathweni kohlelo kanye nokuhlakanipha okungamaviki angu-18.
zu.requirements: Isitifikhethi se-Higher Certificate noma okulinganayo kahle kanye ne-National Diploma efanelekile kokuphathwa komsizebenzi/okuphathwa kohlelo noma noma yiphi inkambu ehambisana nalokho. 18 amasontwe okuhlakanipha ekuphathweni kwabafundi. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza kanye namaphrogramu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngohlelo i-Adapt IT [ITS].
zu.duties: Bamba imininingwane yokubhaliswa kwabafundi kuhlelo i-ITS kusuka kumarekhodi atholakalayo. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo kuHlelo loMnyango ngokubamba amamashi abafundi, ukubikhona njalo ngeviki, njll. Kuhlelo i-ITS. Hlolisisa iphutha lemininingwane edingekayo elibonwa ngesikhathi kubhaliwa imininingwane. Hlola futhi qinisekisa yonke imininingwane evela kumarekhodi. Thumela imininingwane, Yenza okuthunyelayo okuvamile kwemininingwane. Jabulela amakhasi kanye nezibalo. Gcina futhi zigcinwe kumarekhodi kanye namafayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi ahlelwe ngendlela efanele futhi avikelekile. Nikeza imininingwane emakilasini/izigabeni noma nini lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: AbaBambi Beenkcukacha
xh.summary: Kufuneka ababambi beenkcukacha kumaziko amaninzi e-TSC ukubaza iinkcukacha zokubhalisa kwabafundi nedayatha yamaphakamdwe kwindlela yokuqulunqa i-ITS, kwaye kufuneka kube khona idiploma kulawulo le-ofisi kunye namava angengozi ewunyaka neshumi ungamabini (18).
xh.requirements: Isatifikethse Seniors okanye esilinganayo ngaphezulu kwesidiploma sikaWumbi kwinkalo yoMncedisi wolawulo/woLawulo lwe-Ofisi okupa nkalo ethize. 18 amava abayi-18 ngenyanga kulawulo labafundi. Ulwazi ngemashini yekhompyutha, isoftware nangona inkqubo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ngeenkqubo ye-Adapt IT [ITS].
xh.duties: Baza iinkcukacha zokubhalisa kwabafundi kwindlela yokuqulunqa i-ITS apha kwizigqibo ezikhoyo. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo kuNtloko yeSebe ngokubaza amaphakamdwe abafundi, ubungabakho bemveku ngemveku nokunye kwindlela yokuqulunqa i-ITS. Qinisekisa uphando iimpazamo zenkcukacha ezithileyo eziphawulwe ngelixa kubazwa idayatha. Phawula ukuqinisekisa yonke idayatha evela kumagama. Thumela idayatha, Yenza ngezixhobo ezizimeleyo ngezigqibo zedayatha. Hlaziya amagama elwazi. Gcina ulondakazo lwamagama kunye namafayile. Qinisekisa ukuba amagama ahlelwe ngokuchanekileyo alondoloze ngokukhuselekileyo. Nikeza iinkcukacha kumagunya/izahlulo naxa kufuneka.

af.duties: Bestuur ligte en middelswaar motorvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items (pos en dokumente) te lewer. zu.title: Ushayela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosodayiva eDepartment of Higher Education and Training e-Soshanguve North esifuna isifundo se-Grade 10, ilayisensi yesigaba sama-10 ene-PDP kanye neminyaka eyisinyatho kuya kubili yemisebenzi yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Isifundo se-Grade 10/ standard 8 kanye nesicardbho samahora esivela esigabeni sama-10 samadayiva esinamalungelo okushayela i-PDP. Okungenani ungwako osengxenyeni yama-1-2 weminyaka yemisebenzi efanele yokushayela izinto, Qhuba izimoto ezincane nezizezingxenye ezithula ukuthwala abagibeli nokuletha ezinye izinto (uposo namadokhumenti) inani elibhalwe ngezinto ezinikelwa.
zu.duties: Qhuba izimoto ezincane nezezingxenye ezithuluthu ukuze uthwale abagibeli nokuletha ezinye izinto (uposo namadokhumenti). Yenza ukugcinwa okujwayelekile kwesimoto enikeziwe ubike ngokushesha izinkinga ezikhona. Gcwalise yonke imirekhodi namabhuku okubhalayo abadingekayo abalulelwile mayelana nesimoto nokuhlinzela kwempahla. Nikela nesevisi yokusekela emahhovisi/ukuthumela imiyalezo ebantfeni ohlelweni lwalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa okulandelayo: Siza egunyenini. Khipha okufakiwe futhi usefeshe amadokhumenti. Qoqa futhi uylethe amadokhumenti nezinye izinto ezingeyana emnyangweni.

xh.title: Umqhubi

xh.requirements: Isigaba seGrade 10/ standard 8 nelayisenisi yabashuki yekhodi 10 enePDP. xh.duties: Qhuba imoto ezincinci nangaphakathi ukuthutha abagqithisi kwaye uze udlela ezinye izinto (iposi namaxwebhu). Yenza ukunakekelwa ngokwesiko kwimoto enikiweyo kwaye uchaze ngexeshana iziphazekisi. Gqiba zonke iirekhedi neelog ezifunekayo kwaye ezimisiweyo malunga nomoto nangendlela ezinto eziphathwa ngayo. Nikeza inkonzo yoxhaso lokubhala/ukuthumela iimiyalezo kwindlu ofanele kuyo. Oku kubandakanya, phakathi kwezinye izinto, oku kulandelayo: Nceda kwirejistri. Kopa kwaye uthumele ngefeksi amaxwebhu. Qokelele kwaye uze udlele amaxwebhu nezinto ezinxulumene nazo kwisebe.

jobs.requirements: Basic knowledge and hands-on experience in maintenance tasks such as electrical, plumbing, carpentry, and air conditioning. Ability to perform routine repair and upkeep tasks independently. Experience in managing and securing access through effective key control. Ability to supervise and coordinate with on-site security personnel. 24/7 On-Site Presence: Must be consistently available and present on the college premises. Capable of identifying, assessing, and responding to on-site risks and threats. Knowledge of conducting regular inspections of campus facilities to ensure safety and functionality. Willingness to work extra hours, including weekends and during special college events, when required. Good verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact professionally with staff and students. Strong troubleshooting abilities with a focus on offering practical, timely solutions. Experience in gardening, landscaping, or cleaning is an advantage. Ability to remain calm and effective in urgent or high-stress situations. Valid Driver’s License: A current and valid driver’s license is mandatory.
jobs.duties: Conduct regular inspections of buildings, fencing, doors, and other structural elements. Identify and report maintenance needs promptly. Perform general maintenance, including plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and minor repairs. Ensure all facilities remain in safe and functional condition. Unlock and open all offices, classrooms, workshops, and laboratories at designated times. Secure all windows, doors, air conditioners, gas heaters, and gates after use. Responsible for the safekeeping, distribution, and allocation of all campus keys. Perform basic repairs such as fixing broken windows, doors, leaks, ceilings, and ablution facilities. Assist with cleaning of facilities when necessary. Perform gardening, landscaping, and sweeping tasks to maintain the campus's appearance. Review and analyses the Security Occurrence Book daily. Identify and report any risks or threats to management without delay. Complete daily, weekly, and monthly reports on campus conditions for management. Provide timely feedback on all maintenance and security matters. Carry out any additional duties as delegated by the Supervisor. Maintain flexibility in performing a wide range of tasks as required. Ensure all responsibilities are executed efficiently and within set timelines. Be willing to undergo continuous training and development. Attend and run meetings

af.title: Handwerkman
af.summary: Handwerkman benodig by Temba Campus om algemene instandhouding uit te voer, insluitend loodgieterswerk, elektriese werk en skrynwerk, met 24/7 ter-plaatse teenwoordigheid wat vereis word.
af.requirements: Basiese kennis en praktiese ervaring in instandhoudingstake soos elektriese werk, loodgieterswerk, skrynwerk en lugreëling. Vermoë om roetineherstel- en onderhoudstake onafhanklik uit te voer. Ervaring in die bestuur en beveiliging van toegang deur doeltreffende sleutelbeheer. Vermoë om ter-plaatse sekuriteitspersoneel te toesig te hou en mee te koördineer. 24/7 Ter-plaats Teenwoordigheid: Moet konsekwent beskikbaar en teenwoordig wees op die kollegeperseel. In staat wees om ter-plaatse risiko's en bedreigings te identifiseer, te assesseer en daarop te reageer. Kennis van die uitvoer van gereelde inspeksies van kampusfasiliteite om veiligheid en funksionaliteit te verseker. Bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk, insluitend naweke en tydens spesiale kollege-geleenthede, wanneer vereis. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; vermoë om professioneel met personeel en studente te kommunikeer. Sterke probleemoplossingsvermoëns met 'n fokus op die bied van praktiese, tydige oplossings. Ervaring in tuinmaak, landskapsontwerp of skoonmaak is 'n voordeel. Vermoë om kalm en doeltreffend te bly in dringende of hoëdruksituasies. Geldige Bestuurderslisensie: 'n Huidige en geldige bestuurderslisensie is verpligtend.
af.duties: Voer gereelde inspeksies van geboue, omheining, deure en ander strukturele elemente uit. Identifiseer en rapporteer instandhoudingsbehoeites onverwyd. Voer algemene instandhouding uit, insluitend loodgieterswerk, elektriese werk, skrynwerk en klein herstelwerk. Verseker dat alle fasiliteite in 'n veilige en funksionele toestand bly. Ontsluit en maak alle kantore, klaskamers, werkswinkels en laboratoriums op gespesifiseerde tye oop. Sekureer alle vensters, deure, lugverkoelders, gasverwarmers en hekke na gebruik. Verantwoordelik vir die veilige bewaring, verspreiding en toekenning van alle kampus-sleutels. Voer basiese herstelwerk uit soos die herstel van gebreekte vensters, deure, lekkasies, plafonne en sanitêre fasiliteite. Bied bystand met skoonmaak van fasiliteite wanneer nodig. Voer tuinmaak-, landskapsontwerp- en vee-take uit om die voorkoms van die kampus te handhaaf. Hersien en ontleed die Sekuriteitsvoorvalboek daagliks. Identifiseer en rapporteer enige risiko's of bedreigings aan bestuur sonder vertraging. Voltooi daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse verslae oor klagtoestande vir bestuur. Verskaf tydige terugvoer oor alle instandhoudings- en sekuriteitsake. Voer enige addisionele pligte uit soos deur die toesighouer gedelegeer. Handhaaf buigsaamheid in die uitvoer van 'n wye reeks take soos vereis. Verseker dat alle verantwoordelikhede doeltreffend en binne vasgestelde tydlyne uitgevoer word. Wees bereid om deurlopende opleiding en ontwikkeling te ondergaan. Woon by en hou vergaderings

zu.title: Handyman
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu osuke athathe isikhundla sokuba ngu-Handyman e-Temba Campus ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokugcina izinto ibukeka kahle, okuhlanganisa amayiva, kagesi, nendaba yocundo, kanti kudingeka abe khona endaweni yokusebenza amahora angu-24/7.
zu.requirements: Ukulwazi okuyisisekelo noma isipiliyoni socingo lwezandla kumsebenzi wokulungisa njengokulungisa kagesi, ukuphatha amanzi, ucundo lwensimbi, kanye nokuqediswa komoya. Ukuthwala ukulungisa okujwayelekile nokugcina izinto zisuse imali efanayo ngokuzimele. Isipiliyoni ekuphatheni nasekuqinisekiseni ukungena ngendlela ephumelelayo ngokulawula amakhikhithi. Ukuthwala ukubuka nokuqasha ngomphathi abakwazi ukuphepha kanye nabasebenzi abasiza ukuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuba khona kwezinsuku zonke nasebusuku: kufanele ube khona futhi ubonakale njalo enkampusi. Ukukwazi ukuhlola, ukubeka isibalo, nokuphendula kubungozi nasezinsongeni ezikwindaweni yokusebenza. Ulwazi lokuqhuba izinhlelo zokuhlola izinto ezindaweni yekhampasi njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokusebenza. Ukuzethemba ekusebenzeni amahora amaningi, okuhlanganisa amasonto naphakathi kwezinkumbulo zikamanyuvesi, uma kudingeka. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala; ukukwazi ukuxhumana ngobungcweti nabasebenzi nabalwazi. Amakhono amakhulu okuxazulula izinkinga nokuzinikezela ekunikeni izixazululo ezisetshenziswa kalula futhi ngesikhathi. Isipiliyoni ekuhlalweni kwezintaba, ukwenza indawo ibe muhle, noma ekucoheni kuyithuba. Ukukwazi ukuhlala uzolile futhi usebenze kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo noma ezinobungozi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba evunyiwe: ilayisensi yokuqhuba yamanje nevunyiwe iyisidingo.
zu.duties: Hlola njalo izakhiwo, izingodo, amanye amaphaneli ezinhlangothi, nezinye izakhiwo. Hlola futhi ubike izidingo zokulungiswa ngokushesha. Yenza ukulungiswa okujwayelekile, okuhlanganisa amayiva, kagesi, ucundo lwensimbi, nokulungisa okuncane. Qiniseka ukuthi wonke amasiteshi ahlale ephephile futhi asebenze kahle. Vula wonke amahhovisi, amakilasi, amawokshopo, namalaborothari ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Vala wonke amafasitela, amasango, ama-air conditioner, ama-heater wesigesi, namasango emuva kokusetshenziswa. Hlala uphephile ukugcina, ukwahlukanisa, nokuba nodumo kwazo zonke izijubane zesiteshi. Yenza ukulungiswa okuyisisekelo njengokulungisa amafasitela aphukile, amasango, ukukhweza, amaphaneli ezinhlangothi, neziteshi zokuhlanzwa. Siza nokuhlamba amasiteshi uma kunesidingo. Yenza imisebenzi yesimo sezulu, ukwakhiwa kwebhulogi, nokuhlanza ukuze ugcine ukubukeka kwesiteshi. Buka futhi uhlaziye i-Security Occurrence Book nsuku zonke. Hlola futhi ubike noma yikuphi ukuphahlazeka noma engozini komunye umphathi ngaphandle kokubambezezwa. Qedela imibiko yansuku zonke, yamasonto, nenyanga ngemimo yesiteshi kubaphathi. Nikeza imibono yansuku zonke ngayo yonke imisebenzi yokulungiswa nokuphepha. Yiza nalémina yemisebenzi eyengeziwe njengoba ethunyelwe umphathi. Gcina ukuguquguquka ekwenzeni inhlobo yemisebenzi ehlukene njengoba kudingeka. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yenziwa ngokushesha futhi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Zibe nokuthanda ukuba nesifundo esihlala sikhula futhi sithuthuke. Hamba futhi uphathamise izinkumsha

xh.title: Umsebenzisi wezandla
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzisi wezandla kwiTemba Campus ukwenza imisebenzi ejikeleze yolungiselwa ehlanganisa ulwelo lamanzi, kagesi nobugcisa bezandla, nokuvela kwindawo yonke ixesha 24/7.
xh.requirements: Ulwazi olusisiseko nolunamava lokusebenza ngezandla kumasebe olungiselwa afana nekagesi, ulwelo lamanzi, ubugcisa bezandla, nokuqhwesha umoya opholileyo. Ikhamelo lokwenza imisebenzi evamile yolungisa nokugcina izinto ngokuzimeleyo. Amava ekulawuleni nokhuseleko lokufikelela ngokusebenzisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezitshixo. Ikhamelo lokulawula nokusebenzisana nabasebenzi bokhuseleko abasesixenyeni. Ukuvela Kwonke Ixesha 24/7: Kufuneka ukhona aze abekho esikolweni ngalo lonke ixesha. Ikhamelo lokuchonga, ukuhlola, bese ungomela kwiingozi ezisesixenyeni namagoso. Ulwazi ngokuqhelana nokuhlola iziseko zekhampasi ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko nokusebenza. Ukulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo, kuquka iintsuku zeveki nangexesha leziganeko ezikhethekeyo zesikolo, xa kufuneka. Amakhono amabaluhlumisa asebenzayo abukhali nabhaliweyo; ikhamelo lokuchazana ngobuchwepheshe nabasebenzi nabanini bayo. Amakhono amangamso okusombulula iingxaki egxile ekunikeleni ngeezisombululo ezisebenzayo nangexesha. Amava kulimo, ukulungisa indawo, nokucoca luhlaza. Ikhamelookuhlala uzolile, usebenze ngokuchanekileyo kumaxa oxela okunengxaki. Ilayiseni Yokushayela Esebenzayo: Ilayiseni yokushayela esebenzayo yangoku iyayinyanzeliswa.
xh.duties: Qhubeleka nokuqhelana nokuhlola izakhiwo, okuvala iindonga, amanye amagunya, ngezinye iindawo ezakhiweyo. Chonga baze uxela iimfuno zolungiselwa ngexesha. Yenza imisebenzi ejikeleze yolungiselwa, ehlanganisa ulwelo lamanzi, kagesi, ubugcisa bezandla, nezinye izilungiso ezincinci. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iindawo zihlala zikhuselekile kwaye zisebenza. Vula yonke amagumbi omsebenzi, iiklasi, iindawo zokusebenza, namarari yophando ngemixholo ebaluliweyo. Vala yonke iifestile, amagunya, iziqhawuni zamakholoyi epholileyo, abasizi bomlilo, namagunya emva kokusetyenziswa. Ngenye iindwendwe ngokukhuseleka nokusasaza nokwaba onke amagunya ekhampasi. Yenza izilungiso ezisisiseko ezifana nokulungisa iifestile eziqhekeziyo, amagunya, ukukhaba, amaphaphu, kwaye zihlale zicoce. Nceda ngokucoca iindawo xa kuyimfuneko. Yenza imisebenzi yolimo, yokulungisa indawo, nokugqumamela ukuze ugcine ukubonakala kwakhampasi. Jonga baze uhlalutye iNqaku leengozi zokuKhuseleko nsuku zonke. Chonga baze uxela nayiphi na ingozi okanye isoyikiyo kulawulo ngaphandle kokulibazisa. Qedela iingxelo zemihla ngemihla, ngeveki, ngenyanga ngemigangatho yekhampasi kulawulo. Nikela ngencazelo ngexesha kumaxa oxela ngolungiselwa namagoso okhuseleko. Phatha nakuphi na imisebenzi engezongezwa nguMlawuli. Gcina ukuguquguquka ekwenzeni uhlu olubalulekileyo lomsebenzi njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yenziwa ngokusebenza kakuhle ngaphakathi kwamaxesha abekiweyo. Zilungele ukuphuma kwesikolo ngokuqhuba nokuzidela ukuqeqeshwa nokuvela. Ziba baze uzobe namadla kwiindibano

jobs.title: Photocopier
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Operate photocopier machines, provide counter services and perform document scanning, binding and laminating at Temba and Pretoria campuses.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10/ Basic Education, No experience required, Knowledge of facilities policies, Good interpersonal skills, Basic communication written and verbal skills, Computer literacy and ability to work independently and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Operate the photocopier machines: Make photocopies for staff. Report any malfunctioning of photocopier machines. Keep records of photocopier machine activities. Scanning of documents. Binding and laminating of documents. Provide counter services: Receive the request form and documents. Contact clients when documents are ready. Update the index. Attend to counter queries. Perform minor maintenance on the photocopier machine: Arrange for the servicing of and repair to the machines. Undertake the general maintenance and cleaning of the machines. Make requisition for photocopying materials: Ensure that photocopying materials and equipment’s are stored away securely. Arrange for the re-ordering of copy papers, staples and toners.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940.
jobs.applications: Email to photocopier@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Note: EE Target African male, African female, Coloured male, Coloured female, White male, Indian male and White female.

af.title: Fotokopieerder
af.summary: Bedryf fotokopieermasjiene, verskaf toonbankdienste en voer dokumentskandering, inbind en lamineer uit by Temba- en Pretoria-kamperse.
af.requirements: Grade 10/ Basiese Onderwys; Geen ervaring word vereis nie; Kennis van fasiliteitsbeleid; Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede; Basiese kommunikasie- vaardighede geskryf en mondeling; Rekenaarvaardigheid en vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Bedryf die fotokopieermasjiene: Maak fotokopieë vir personeel. Rapporteer enige wanfunksionering van fotokopieermasjiene. Hou rekords van fotokopieermasjienaktiwiteite. Skandering van dokumente. Inbind en lamineer van dokumente. Verskaf toonbankdienste: Ontvang die aanvraagvorm en dokumente. Kontak kliënte wanneer dokumente gereed is. Dateer die indeks op. Hanteer toonbanknavrae. Voer geringe onderhoud op die fotokopieermasjien uit: Reël die onderhoud en herstel van die masjiene. Onderneem die algemene onderhoud en skoonmaak van die masjiene. Doen aanvraag vir fotokopiëringsmateriaal: Verseker dat fotokopiëringsmateriaal en toerusting veilig weggestoor word. Reël die herbestelling van kopieerpapier, niepenne en toners.

zu.title: Umshini wokushaja amakhophi
zu.summary: Usebenzise imishini yokushaja amakhophi, unikeze izinsiza zedeski wenze ukuskena kwamadokhumenti, ukubopha nokuhlambisa amaplastiki emakhophi emakhasini eTemba nasePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10/ Basic Education, Akukho mplilo efunekayo, Ulwazi ngemigomo yezinsiza, Amakhono amahle abantu, Amakhono abhalwayo nesilulumagama asisekelo, Ukubuka okuzenzakalelayo kwekhompyutha nokuqwabelana kokusebenza ngodwa naphansi kokucindezela.
zu.duties: Sebenzisa imishini yokushaja amakhophi: Yenza amakhophi abasebenzi. Bika noma yikuphi ukungalisebenzi kahle kwemishini yokushaja amakhophi. Gcina irekhodi lemisebenzi yemishini yokushaja amakhophi. Ukuskena kwamadokhumenti. Ukubopha nokuhlambisa amaplastiki emakhophi amadokhumenti. Nikeza izinsiza zedeski: Yamukela ifomu yesicelo namadokhumenti. Thintana nabathengi lapho amadokhumenti eseziwo. Buyekeza inkomba. Phendula imibuzo yedeski. Yenza okulondolozayo okuncane kwishini lokushaja amakhophi: Hlela ukukhonza nokulungiswa kwemishini. Zenza ukulondolozwa okujwayelekile nokucushwa kwemishini. Yenza isicelo sezinto zokushaja amakhophi: Qiniseka ukuthi izinto zokushaja amakhophi nezokusebenza zibekwe khona ngokuphepha. Hlela ukulandelela ibhanti yamaphepha amakhophi, ukubopha amatoni.

xh.title: Umshicileli weefotothayi
xh.summary: Ukusebenza ngamashishini okufotothayi, ukunika iinkonzo zesixhobo sokwamkela nasekwenza iskena yamaxwebhu, ukubopha nokudibanisa amaxwebhu kumaziko asezisa eTemba nasePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-Graji 10/ Imfundo yeQobo, Akukho nolunye uluhlu lwezemfundo lufunekayo, Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zamaziko, Amakhono amabalise ahle ngabantu, Amakhonyo abhalo okusebenzisa isandla nawe anokuwothula, Ulwazi lweenkqubo zekhompyutha nendlela yokusebenza nge-Computer.
xh.duties: Sebenzisa amashishini okufotothayi: Yenza iifotothayi abantu basebenzayo. Yika naxa amashishini okufotothayi engasebenzi. Gcina uluhlu lwezikhundla ezenziwayo zamashishini okufotothayi. Iskena yamaxwebhu. Ukubopha noku. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezifunekayo zikho nokulungiselela ezinye iinkonzo namashishini okufotothayi: Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezisetyenziswayo nemishini ziswele ngokuchanekileyo. Lungisa iinkonzo namashishini okufotothayi: Zama ukulungisa izinto ezincinane nokuqhotsa izinto ezingangowekhompyutha. Yenza izinto ezifunekayo ngokulawula ukuhlala kwezakhiwo ezikhoyo nezinto ezenziwa ngokutsha. Sebenzisa izinto ezikumgangatho ophezulu: Qinisekisa ukuba izinto zisetyenziswa ngokulawulwa kwaye zikwaziswa ukuba zizingenwa ngokukhawuleza nangokukhuselekileyo.

jobs.title: General Worker
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R144 024 – R169 656 per annum (Level 02), plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: General worker at Makhado Satellite Shingwedzi Campus responsible for grounds maintenance, cleaning pathways and disposing of litter and garden waste.
jobs.requirements: Abet Level 4/Grade 10. Must be able to read and write. (Cleaning training certificate will serve as an advantage). Additional Requirements: 6 months experience working as a cleaner will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Cut and maintain grass and lawns. Trim hedges, trees and shrubs. Remove weeds, leaves, branches and other garden debris. Maintain flower beds and landscaped areas. Sweep and clean pathways, and parking areas. Collect and dispose of litter and garden waste. Keep entrances and surrounding areas neat and presentable. Plant flowers, trees, grass and other plants. Water and fertilize plants and lawns. Prune trees and shrubs when necessary. Assist with maintaining irrigation systems. Operate and maintain basic gardening equipment such as lawnmowers, brush cutters, wheelbarrows and other hand tools. Clean and store equipment properly after use. Report damaged or faulty equipment to the supervisor. Report damaged infrastructure, blocked drains, leaking pipes and other faults. Identify and report hazards on the college grounds. Ensure that pathways and entrances are free from obstructions. Assist in preparing outdoor areas for college events, meetings and functions. Arrange and move outdoor furniture and equipment where required. Clean the grounds after events. Assist maintenance staff and other Corporate Services personnel when required. Load, unload and move materials and equipment. Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: All enquiries should be directed to Ms Makondo AT /Ms Ramuzwila HN /Ms Mukhoro M/ Mr Muthige M Tel No: (015) 963 7091/ 7070 /7066/7095 respectively.
jobs.applications: Your application must clearly quote the correct job reference number and can either be posted to Human Resources Management, Vhembe TVET College, Private Bag X2136, Sibasa, 0970, Alternatively, applications may be send to Hr.applications@vhembecollege.edu.za or hand-delivered to the Central Office, Site 203, Unit A, Sibasa.
jobs.notes: To apply, please submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae highlighting your relevant qualifications, experience, and at least two contactable references along with a completed, signed Z83 application form (2021 version), which is available from any public service department. While certified copies of your qualifications and supporting documents are only required on or before the interview date, please note that late submissions will not be considered, and the college reserves the right to withdraw any post at any stage. Vhembe TVET College is an equal opportunity employer operating across four local municipalities that actively encourages applications from persons with disabilities. Due to high volumes, communication is limited to shortlisted candidates; therefore, if you do not receive feedback within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful, keeping in mind that final selection is subject to background vetting, credentials verification, and financial disclosure checks. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Vhembe TVET College is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. applications are invited from suitably qualified and knowledgeable candidates for appointment for the following positions.

af.title: Algemene Werkers
af.summary: Algemene werker by Makhado Satelliet Shingwedzi-kampus verantwoordelik vir gronderhoud, skoonmaak van voetpaaie en wegdoen van rommel en tuinafval.
af.requirements: Abet Vlak 4/Grade 10. Moet kan lees en skryf. ('n Skoonmaak-opleidingsertifikaat sal 'n voordeel wees). Addisionele vereistes: 6 maande ervaring as skoonmaker sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Sny en onderhou gras en grasperke. Snoei heinings, bome en struike. Verwyder onkruid, blare, takke en ander tuin-afval. Onderhou blombeddings enlandskapsterreine. Vee en skoonmaak voetpaaie en parkeerareas. Versamel en doen weg met rommel en tuinafval. Hou ingange en omliggende areas netjies en presentabel. Plant blomme, bome, gras en ander plante. Besproei en bemest plante en grasperke. Snoei bome en struike wanneer nodig. Help met die onderhoud van besproeiingstelsels. Bedryf en onderhou basiese tuinmaaktoerusting soos grasmaaiers, bosnoeiers, kruiwaens en ander handgereedskap. Skoonmaak en bêre toerusting behoorlik na gebruik. Rapporteer beskadigde of foutiewe toerusting aan die toesighouer. Rapporteer beskadigde infrastruktuur, verstopte dreine, lekkende pype en ander foute. Identifiseer en rapporteer gevare op die kollekgronde. Verseker dat voetpaaie en ingange vry is van obstakels. Help met die voorbereiding van buitelugterrestine vir kollekgebeure, vergaderings en funksies. Rangskik en skuif buitemeubels en toerusting waar nodig. Maak die terreine skoon na gebeure. Help onderhoudspersoneel en ander Korporatiewe Dienste-personeel wanneer nodig. Laai, laai af en skuif materiaal en toerusting. Verrig enige ander redelike pligte deur die toesighouer toegeken.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
zu.summary: Umsebenzi jikelele eMakhado Satellite Shingwedzi Campus ongumgxeki wokulondoloza indawo, ukuhlanza izindlela kanye nokulahla izintswelo nemfucuze yensimu.
zu.requirements: Abet Level 4/Grade 10. Kumele ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. (Isitifiketi sokugqoza sizokuba inhlokomo yenhle). Izidingo Ezengeziwe: Amasu angu 6 okusebenza njengomsusi kuzokuba inhlokomo yenhle.
zu.duties: Sika ulwandlalo futhi ulondoloze insimu. Cima izihlahla ezincane, izihlahla kanye nezihlahla ezincane ezincishisiwe. Susa izitshalo ezingezile, amaqablango, amagatsha kanye nemfucuze yensimu. Londoloza amabhedi ezimbali kanye nezindawo ezihlotshanisiwe. Hlanzela futhi ucoce izindlela kanye nezindawo zokupaka. Qoqa ulahle izintswelo nemfucuze yensimu. Gcina izinkalo kanye nezindawo ezizungezile zicocekile futhi zibukeka kahle. Tshala izimbali, izihlahla, insimu kanye nezinye izitshalo. Chela futhi udle izitshalo nolwandlalo. Sika izihlahla kanye nezihlahla ezincane uma kunesidingo. Siza ukulondoloza izinhlelo zokuchelela. Sebenzisa futhi ulondoloze izinto zensimi eziyisisekelo ezinjengamasika insimu, abasiki besihlahla, amawhilibhaka kanye nezinye izinto zokusika. Hlanza futhi ugcine izinto kahle emva kokuzisebenzisa. Memezela izinto eziqubiwe noma ezingasebenzi kahle kumlawuli. Memezela izakhiwo eziqubiwe, izingxaruba ezivaliwe, izingxenye ezivuza kanyenezinye iziphazamiso. Hlola futhi umemezele izingozi enkampusini. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela kanye nezinkalo azinazo izinto eziphazamisayo. Siza ukulungisa izindawo zangaphandle zemihlangano enkampusini, izehlakalo kanye nemisebenzi. Hlela futhi uhambise ifenitsha yasekhaya nezinto ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Hlanza indawo ngaphandle emva kwezehlakalo. Sisa abasebenzi bolondolozo kanye nabanye abantu beNkonzo yenkampani uma kudingeka. Layisha, kwesabisa futhi uhambise izinto nezimayini. Yenza noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ethunyelwe ngumlawuli.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Ohamba Phambili
xh.summary: Umsebenzi ohamba phambili kwi-Makhado Satellite Shingwedzi Campus onoxanduva lokugcina iindawo, ukucoca iindela nokulahla undoyi nokusuka esigodini.
xh.requirements: Abet Level 4/Grade 10. Makabe nakho isiphako sokufunda nokubhala. (Isatifikethi sokholo ekubeni结节i-training siza kuba lusizo). Iimfuno ezongezelelweyo: ukuba nakho iinyanga ezingama-6 zesipilo sokusebenza njengomcoci siza kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Sika ugqatshe uzinze. Lahlaze iihedji, amakhaka namagqabi amancinci. Susa izitya, amagqabi, iindlebe neminye imfucu yesixobo. Gcina iindawo zentengentengi kwindalo nezixobo ezilahliweyo. Sula kwaye ucoce iindela, iindawo zoku-parka. Qokelela ulahle undoyi nesixobo esingegqabi. Gcina amaziko azele nemimandla ejikelezileyo ihle ikhangeleka. Tyala iintyatyambo, amakhaka, iindalo nezityalo ezinye. Khupha igazi elingethi tyala amakhaka. Tyala amakhaka nezityalo xa kuyimfuneko. Sika ugqatshe namakhaka iminye xa kuyimfuneko. Nceda ekugcineni izixhobo zokuvuthaza. Sebenzisa kwaye ugcine izixhobo ezisisiseko zokuzilima njengamakhaka asikiyo, izixhobo zokusika, amaqhosha ezinyawo nezinye izixhobo zokuqamba. Coca kwaye ugcine izixhobo kakuhle emva kokusetyenziswa. Xela isixhobo esonakeleyo okanye esingasebenzayo kumlawuli. Xela izixhobo ezonakeleyo, iindlwana ezivaliweyo, iindlwana ezibuyela kwaye nezinye iimpazamo. Qaphula kwaye uxele izixhobo ezinobungozi ezindaweni zethu ezingahlaziyiyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindela namaziko akananto ezithiyelayo. Nceda ekulungiseni iindawo zangaphandle zemisebenzi yethu, kwindlu kunye nokubakwa. Hlela kwaye ushukumise izinto ezibhacileyo nemikhosi apho kufuneka. Coca iindawo emva kwemisebenzi. Nceda abasebenzi bolulungiselwe kunye nabasebenzi abavela kwi-Corporate Services xa kuyimfuneko. Faka, khupha kwaye ushukumise izinto nemikhosi. Yiba nesipilo sokwenza iminye imisebenzi eqondiweyo eyalelwa ngumlawuli.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Warehouse Management
jobs.centre: Branch: Finance and Supply Chain Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), An all-inclusive salary package
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Warehouse Management in the Department of Home Affairs Finance and Supply Chain Management branch, overseeing requisitions, audit standards and warehouse operations.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Supply Chain Management/Logistics Management/Purchasing Management/Public Management at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA is required. Three (3) years experience in an Assistant Director/Junior Management level at Warehousing Management environment is required. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations Act. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Understanding of departmental legislation as well as Human Resources legislation and prescripts. Knowledge of the National Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Knowledge in LOGIS System Controller. Knowledge of the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA). Knowledge of Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE). Knowledge of the Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation. Client orientation and customer focus. People management and empowerment. Demand and Acquisition Strategy. Programme and project management. Change management Purchasing management. Decision making. Purchasing and cost control. Warehouse Management. Business Report Writing. Influencing and Networking. Problem solving and analysis. Presentation Skills. Interpersonal Skills. Communication Skills. Planning and Organising Skills. Computer literacy Skills. Decision Making Skills. Negotiation Skills. Numerical skills. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Ensure that all requisitions are complete and accurate. Advice business units to address trends in non compliance and errors on requisitions. Monitor adherence to audit standards within warehouse operations and represent the warehousing function in compliance and risk management forums. Uphold quality assurance, risk mitigation, and operational standards across all warehousing activities, including inventory control, storage, and dispatch. Identify and address potential risks related to warehousing processes, systems, and infrastructure to ensure business continuity and regulatory compliance. Coordinate and implement the warehousing management within the Department. Develop and implementation of policy and procedure, directive acts and regulations. Establish, maintain and ensure a good working relationship with the department and relevant stakeholders. Implement effective risk and compliance in line with the relevant legislative prescripts. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Head Office: Ms N Mnisi Tel No: (012) 406 4238
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za or financerecruitment@dha.gov.za
jobs.notes: Must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za, or sent to one of the addresses specified at the bottom of the relevant post, on or before the closing date; accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of at least two contactable employment references (as recent as possible)); as well as relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, regardless of online, email or manual submission. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Selection: Shortlisted candidates – will also be required to submit a copy of their ID document, a valid driver’s license (if specified as a job requirement), relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, and Acting letters as directed. Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s), are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA);Unless otherwise indicated, correspondence between the Department and candidates generally will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Personal information submitted will be processed solely for recruitment purposes, retained where required for audit, and safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure, except where legally required. Submission of an application constitutes consent to such processing. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Pakhuisbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Pakhuisbestuur in die Department of Home Affairs Finance and Supply Chain Management-tak, wat toevalsaanvrae, ouditstandaarde en pakhuisbedrywighede oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Supply Chain Management/Logistics Management/Purchasing Management/Public Management op NQF-vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken, word vereis. Drie (3) jaar ervaring op 'n Assistentdirekteur/Juniorbestuursvlak in 'n Pakhuisbestuursomgewing word vereis. Kennis van die Public Service Regulations Act. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Begrip van departementele wetgewing asook Menslike Hulpbronne-wetgewing en voorskrifte. Kennis van die National Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Kennis van die LOGIS System Controller.
