zu.title: Inkanyezi Yokuvikela
zu.summary: Isikhundla senkanyezi yokuvikela esikhungweni se-Department of Home Affairs Counter Corruption and Security Services esidinga i-Grade 12 nesitifiketi se-PSIRA Grade C.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 National Senior Certificate ezingeni le-NQF level 4 njengoba kuhlonzwa i-SAQA. Ikilasi eliyisisekelo lenkanyezi yokuvikela, i-Grade C. Imfundo nokugadatshulwa okuyisisekelo. Isitifiketi se-PSIRA Grade C sidingwa Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ulwazi nge-Minimum Information Security standards (MISS). Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-National Intelligence Strategy Act. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Protection of Information Act. Ukuqonda izindlela zophando nemikhakha yawo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Control of Access to Public Premises and vehicle. Ulwazi ngomthetho womnyango kanye nomthetho kanye nemiyalo ye-Human Resources. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Criminal Procedure Act of 1977 njengoba ulungisiwe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Protection of Personal Information Act no 4 of 2013 njengoba ulungisiwe. Kudingeka ukusebenza ngamashiftha. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba nokusebenza amahora amade. Amandla namakhono adingekayo: Ukugxila kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathi abantu nokunika amandla. Inovethi yokuletha isevisi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kuhlelo nomphakathi wohlelo. Ukuphathwa nokuxazulula izingxabano. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa izingodo zamanje. Amandla okubamba inkundla. Amakhano okuxhumana. Amandla obuchwepheshe. Unxibelelwano. Amakhano ukuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Amakhano okubuzwa imibuzo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uthando lwesizwe, ukuqotho, ukuzethemba nokubheka idatha yemali.
zu.duties: Ophumelelayo uzobe enezindima ezilandelayo: Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha enkundleni nakwakhiwo ngokuhamba ihola, ukuze kutholwe izingozi zomlilo, izinto ezingangabazi namaphakethe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahbo kanye nezinto ezigcinwayo zingaphumi noma zingangenile endaweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Ukuphatha igumbi lokulawula. Ukugadisa i-(CCTV) close circuit television. Ukuphatha okhiye. Ukubika impahla yokuvikela ephukile. Ukuphathwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi yegumbi lokulawula: ukulawula okhiye, ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo, abavakashi nabathengisi kanye namarekhodi. Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo kwindawo yokuqala yokungena ngokwezinqumo. Ukusebenzisa inkambu yesimo esiphuthumayo uma kuwukuthi sikhona isimo esiphuthumayo.

xh.title: Iofisa wokuKhuseleko
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMOfisa wokuKhuseleko kwisebe le-Department of Home Affairs Counter Corruption and Security Services elifuna iGrade 12 nokuqinisekiswa kwe-PSIRA Grade C.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 National Senior Certificate kwinqanaba le-NQF level 4 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isifundo esisisiseko sikaMofisa wokuKhuseleko, iGrade C. Imfundo nokuqeqeshwa okusisisiseko. Kufuneka ibe khona i-PSIRA Grade C Certificate Ulwazi nokuqonda kweNkqubo eLawulayo yoLuntu LwaseNzonzonbeni. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) nemiGaqo yalamano. Ulwazi lweMinimum Information Security standards (MISS). Ulwazi lweNational Intelligence Strategy Act. Ulwazi lweProtection of Information Act. Ukuqonda iindlela nendlela entengiso yokuphonononga. Ulwazi lweControl of Access to Public Premises and vehicle Act. Ulwazi ngomthetho wesebe nakumthetho nemiGaqo yeZabasebenzi. Ulwazi lweCriminal Procedure Act of 1977 njengoko lulungisiwe. Ulwazi lweProtection of Personal Information Act no 4 of 2013 njengoko lulungisiwe. Kufuneka kusebenze ushintsho lwebhulu. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Amandla nokuqonda okufunwayo: Ukuqwalasela umthengi nogqaliselo kumthengi. Ukuqulunqa nabaphathi abantu nokuBa amandla. Iingqamano ezintsha zokuNikezela iNkonzo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki. UkuLawula nokuCwangcisa iiNkqubo neeProjekthi. UkuLawula noXazululo lweNxaxheba. Ukuhlanganisa nokuCwangcisa. Amandla okuzaliselela iimigqaliselo. Amandla okuBumba. Amandla oThintana nabantu. Amandla okuzama. Unxibelelwano. Amandla okuHlola. Ukwenza iigqibo. AmandlaokuBuza. Ukuzazi kweKhompyutha. Uthando lweZwe, uQinisekileko, uQotho noNxibelelhano.
xh.duties: Omele baye bazuze baza bachatheleke ngokusebenza oku landelayo: Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lokungena. Ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko kwisakhiwo nakwindawo ngokwenziwa kwezihloko zokujikeleza, ukuqapha iingozi zomlilo, izinto ezikrwelekiyezi nemiqulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izixhobo nendawo yokugcinazingaphandle noma zingangenanga ndawo ngaphandle kwesigunyaziso. UkuLawula igumbi lolawulo. Ukuqapha i-(CCTV) close circuit television. Ukuphatha okutshixho. Ukuba nxaxheba ngemiba yoxhobo olungalunganga lokhuseleko. UkuLawula zonke iinkqubo zegumbi lolawulo: ulawulo lokuqhotsa, ulawulo lweziganeko, iindwendwe nabathangi abakha inkqubo. Ukuphatha amaxwebhu kwindawo yokungena ngokwemigaqo. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezima ndawonye kwimeko esidiniyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions
jobs.centre: Pretoria: Head Office Ref No: Recruit 2026/347 Durban Ref No: Recruit 2026/348 (Re-advert)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions positions at the NPA Head Office in Pretoria and Durban, requiring an LLB and 10 years' legal experience in criminal litigation.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least 10 years' post qualification legal experience in criminal law litigation. (Regional and/or High court experience will be an advantage). Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Admission as an Attorney/Advocate is a pre-requisite. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good advocacy and legal drafting skills. Extensive knowledge of the Criminal Procedure Act and gender-based violence legislation. (Completed GBVF training courses). Demonstrable Knowledge and expertise of the GBVF mandate of the SOCA unit in the areas of Domestic Violence, Sexual Offences, Child Justice, Maintenance, Trafficking in Persons & all other GBV matters generally is required. Good interpersonal, analytical, presentation and communication skills. Seven (7) years middle management experience which includes administration and Project management skills. Knowledge and application of GBV legislation, regulations and policies. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and financial management skills. Good planning skills, including administrative, organizational and Project management skills. Skills in public awareness initiatives and stakeholder management. Skills in research, development and presentation of training material in related fields. Knowledge of strategic planning and operational implementation of initiatives. Good verbal, communication and presentation skills. Knowledge of the Labour Relations Act and disciplinary process. Knowledge of international legislation and protocols will be added advantage, and the candidate must be prepared and able to travel extensively. Positive Security Clearance. Computer Literacy and knowledge of programs in Ms Word & Teams, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint is mandatory. A Valid driver's licence.
jobs.duties: Manage the portfolios assigned by the Special Director. Liaison and management of relevant stakeholders. Manage, train and guide SOCA cluster managers, prosecutors and stakeholders in respect of all matters relating to the SOCA mandate. Provide prosecutor guided investigations and prosecute cases when requested to do so by the Special Director. Study case dockets and other documents relating to SOCA mandate, representations and to make and review decisions with regard to the institution of criminal proceedings. Prepare cases for court, appear in appeals and reviews on the instruction of the SDPP. Prepare legal opinions. Strategically lead and implement the strategies of the unit and ensure operational implementation. Oversee resources and align them to strategic objectives. Development, performance management and assessment of staff members. Deal with representations and complaints. Ensure that a high standard of professional work is being carried out. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice system. Initiate and coordinate public awareness campaigns and related training sessions. Assist in budget planning and donor funding management. Represent the NPA on SOCA mandate related matters with the media or any other platform on request of the SDPP. Quality control of statistics and performance management in relation to SOCA mandate. Compile reports as and when requested or required by the SOCA mandate for submission. Ensure good governance and compliance. Perform any other task the SDPP deems to be necessary
jobs.applications: Pretoria: Head Office e mail: Recruit2026347@npa.gov.za; Durban e mail: Recruit2026348@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre- entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS. The full details can be sourced from the link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolging
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolging posisies by die NPA-hoofkantoor in Pretoria en Durban, wat 'n LLB en 10 jaar se regsonderervaring in strafregtelike litigasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende vervolgers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste 10 jaar se postkwalifikasie regsonderervaring in strafreglitigasie. (Streek- en/of Hooggeregshofervaring sal 'n voordeel wees). Verskyningsreg soos oorweeg in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Toelating as 'n Prokureur/Advokaat is 'n voorvereiste. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goie pleit- en regsdraftvaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van die Strafproseswet en wetgewing oor geslagsgebaseerde geweld. (Voltooide GBVF-opleidingskursusse). Aantoonbare kennis en kundigheid van die GBVF-mandaat van die SOCA-eenheid in die areas van Huishoudelike Geweld, Seksmisdrywe, Kinderjustisie, Onderhoud, Mensehandel & alle ander GBV-aangeleenthede oor die algemeen word vereis. Goie interpersoonlike, analitiese, aanbiedings- en kommunikasievaardighede. Sewe (7) jaar se middelbestuurservaring wat administrasie- en projeksbestuursvaardighede insluit. Kennis en toepassing van GBV-wetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Kennis van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA) en finansiesbestuursvaardighede. Goie beplanningsvaardighede, insluitend administratiewe, organisatoriese en projeksbestuursvaardighede. Vaardighede in openbare bewustheidsinisiatiewe en belanghebbendebestuur. Vaardighede in navorsing, ontwikkeling en aanbieding van opleidingsmateriaal in verwante velde. Kennis van strategiese beplanning en operasionele implementering van inisiatiewe. Goie mondelinge, kommunikasie- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Kennis van die Arbeidsverhoudingswet en dissiplinêre proses. Kennis van internasionale wetgewing en protokolle sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees, en die kandidaat moet bereid en in staat wees om uitgebreid te reis. Positiewe veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaargeletterdheid en kennis van programme in Ms Word & Teams, Excel, Outlook en PowerPoint is verpligtend. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die portefeuljes toegeken deur die Spesiale Direkteur. Skakeling en bestuur van tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Bestuur, lei en gee leiding aan SOCA-trosbestuurders, vervolgers en belanghebbendes ten opsigte van alle aangeleenthede wat verband hou met die SOCA-mandaat. Verskaf vervolgergeleide ondersoeke en vervolg sake wanneer versoek deur die Spesiale Direkteur. Bestudeer saakdossiers en ander dokumente wat verband hou met die SOCA-mandaat, vertoë en neem en hersien beslisse met betrekking tot die instelling van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Berei sake vir die hof voor, verskyn in appèlle en hersienings op instruksie van die SDPP. Berei regsmenings voor. Strategiese leiding en implementering van die strategieë van die eenheid en verseker operasionele implementering. Toesig oor hulpbronne en belyn dit met strategiese doelwitte. Ontwikkeling, prestasiebestuur en assessering van personeellede. Hanteer vertoë en klagtes. Verseker dat 'n hoë standaard van professionele werk uitgevoer word. Bevorder vennoot-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel. Inisiëer en koördineer openbare bewustheidsveldtogte en verwante opleidsessies. Bied hulp met begrotingsbeplanning en skenkerfondsbestuur. Verteenwoordig die NPA oor SOCA-mandaatverwante aangeleenthede met die media of enige ander platform op versoek van die SDPP. Kwaliteitsbeheer van statistieke en prestasiebestuur in verband met die SOCA-mandaat. Stel verslae op soos wanneer versoek of vereis deur die SOCA-mandaat vir indiening. Verseker goeie bestuur en nakoming. Voer enige ander taak uit wat die SDPP nodig ag

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezomthetho Esibhekene Nemitholo
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions e-NPA Head Office e-Pretoria nase-Durban, kudingeka i-LLB neminyaka engu-10 yohlu olusemthethweni oluhlotshaniswa nezinkantolo zezecala.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kube ngabathwebuli abafuna ukuthuthukiswa noma ngasiphi isitifiketi esifanele semithetho. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yokuthola isitifiketi, emisebenzini yomthetho wezocala. (Okuhle ukuba noluhlu lokusebenza kuma-Regional Court kanye/noma ama-High Court). Ilungelo lokubonakala enkantolo njengokuvezwa ngumthetho u-Act 32 ka-1998, isigaba 25(2). Ukungenwa njengommeli (Attorney/Advocate) kuyisidingo. Ukukwazi ukubonakala ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobumele obuzayo futhi ngokwethembeka. Amakhono amahle okumela abantu enkantolo kanye nokuqamba amadokhumenti omthetho. Ukwazi kahle i-Criminal Procedure Act kanye nomthetho ohlotshaniswa nodlame olusekelwe ubulili. (Owesifazane okuzalanayo athole izifundo ze-GBVF). Kudingeka ukuba nokwazi nobuhlakani bemandla ye-GBVF yeqoqo le-SOCA, ezindaweni ezifana noDlame Lwasekhaya, Izono Ezihlotshaniswa Nobulili, Umthetho Wezinsizwa, Imsoco, Ukuthengiswa Kwabantu kanye nayo yonke imikhakha elawula udlame olusekelwe ubulili. Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu, okuhlaziya, okwethula kanye nokuxhumana. Iminyaka eyisikhombisa (7) yamakhono aphakathi okuphatha, ehlanganisa ukuphathwa kwemibhalo namaphulo. Ukwazi nokusebenzisa umthetho we-GBV, imithesho namapholisi. Ukuzazi i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) namakhono okuphatha imali. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ehlanganisa okuphathwa kwemibhalo, inhlekelele nokuphathwa kwamaphulo. Amakhono okukhuthaza ulwazi oluwumphakathi nokuphatha izinduna eziyisisekelo. Amakhono ocwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa nokwethulwa kwemateriali yesifundo ezindaweni ezihlotshaniswa. Ukuzazi okuhle kwezokusinda okuhlelekile nokusetshenziswa kwenhlekelele ezweni. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma, ukuxhumana kanye nokwethula. Ukuzazi umthetho wezabasebenzi nenqubo yezidakelwa yimicimbi. Ukuzazi imithetho nemithelela yamanye amazwe kuzokuba ngokuhamba kahle, futhi okufunekayo ukuba umkhandeli alungele futhi akwazi ukuhamba kakhulu. Ukusesa kwakhe konke okuhlobene nokuphathwa kwesikhashana. Ukuzazi ukusebenza ngokwegumbi lemikhiqizo nakwamaphrogremu njengo-MS Word kanye nama-Teams, i-Excel, i-Outlook kanye ne-PowerPoint kuyisidingo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Kuqhutshwe amaphothifoliya anikezwe ngu-Special Director. Ukuhlangana nokuphatha izinduna eziyisisekelo. Ukuphatha, ukufundisa nokuhola abaphathi be-cluster ye-SOCA, abathwebuli nezinduna ezifanele ngesikhathi esihlobene nayo yonke imikhakha efana nemicimbi ye-SOCA. Ukunikezwa isiqondiso kubaphenyi-basezicaleni kanye nokususa izicala uma kucelwa ukuthi kube njalo yi-Special Director. Ukuqeqesha izinqubo kanye nokuthola izinqumungumu namanye amadokhumenti ahlobene nemicimbi ye-SOCA, kanye nokwenza futhi uhlole izinqumo ngokuhlotshaniswa nesekelwa senkantolo yezecala. Ulungiselele izicala enkantolo, usebenze ecaleni lezobuyekezo noma izinkantolo uma kushiwo ngu-SDPP. Lungiselela imibono yomthetho. Ukukhokela ngokuhlakanipha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zeqoqo ukuqinisekisa isetshenziswa. Ukuqapha amaphulinensi futhi uzihambise ngendlela ehambisana nohlelo. Ukuphatha nokubona imisebenzi yabasebenzi kanye nokuhlolisisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ukubhekana nezinkulumo nezikhalazo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa umsebenzi ohamba ngemithetho yezobungcweti. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlangana nomakhelwane, ukuxhumeka nomphakathi kanye nokwanelisa izithako ezingamaphakathi emisebenzi. Ukwenza futhi uhlele izinkundla zokwazisa umphakathi kanye nezifundo ezihlobene. Ukusiza ekwenzeni ukuqaliswa kohlelo bokuphathwa kwemali nokuphathwa kwemali efinyezelwe. Ukumela i-NPA ezindaweni ezihlobene nemikhakha ye-SOCA kumanethiwekhi noma kunoma isiphi isikhundla uma kucelwa ngu-SDPP. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezibhalwa zihamba ngomthetho kanye nokuphathwa kwenqubo yokwenza umsebenzi ngokuhambisana nemikhakha ye-SOCA. Ukwakha amagatsha nemibiko uma kucelwa noma kudingeka ngumthetho we-SOCA. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhleleke nguhlelo futhi kuhambisana nolunye uhlelo. Ukwenza nomunye umsebenzi uma ethathwa njengowokwenzeka yi-SDPP

xh.title: Isekabaphathiswa Bokuqondisa Kwezetyholo
xh.summary: Izithuba zesekabaphathiswa Bokuqondisa Kwezetyholo kwiNtloko ye NPA ePretoria naseDurban, ezifuna i-LLB neminyaka eli-10 yamava obugila kwicala lecala lokwenza ityholo.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavakalisi abasebenzayo abafuna ukuphakanyiswa kulo naliphi na igunya elifanelekileyo lomthetho. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 yamava obugila emva kokufumana igunya kwicala lokwenza izityholo ngomthetho. (Amava eNkundla yeNganging nayo/iNkundla ePhakamileyo kuya kuba lusizo). Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyisiwe kwicandelo lesi-25(2) loMthetho we NPA, ongama-32 ka-1998. Ukwamkelwa njengommeli/mbeki ngumfuno ephambili. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobungcali, ngokubekileyo nangokwethemba. Amakhono amahle okuba yimbeki nokubhala okusemthethweni. Ulwazi olubanzi ngoMthetho woNgeniso lweziTyholo nalomthetho wendlela ezithi zibangelwa ngokohlulwa kwabantu ngokwesini. (Iinkcukacha zokuzilolonga nge-GBVF ezigqityiweyo). Kufuneka kube khona ulwazi olubonakalayo nangamava ngomsebenzi we-GBVF weyanzulwazi ye-SOCA kumacala obudlalo olunyumbulayo, iingcaphephe zocansi, urhulumente wezantwana, imbuyiselo, urhweba ngabantu nayo yonke eminye imicimba ye-GBV ngokubanzi. Amakhono amahle okuhlophelwa, okuhlalutywa, okubonisa nokunxibelelana nabantu. Iminyaka elixhenye (7) yamava okulawulwa abaphathi abalingana apho kuquka ukulawula izinto nendlela yokulawula amaprojekh. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa umthetho we-GBV, imigaqo nemithetho yohlengahlengiso. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA) nangamakhono okulawula imali. Amakhono amahle okucwangcisa, kuquka okulawula izinto, okuhlela nendlela yokulawula amaprojekh. Amakhono okwenza ulwazi oluvela kumphakathi nokuLawula abathathi-nxaxheba. Amakhono ekuphonononga, ukuphuhliswa nokubonisa izixhobo zokuzilolonga kumacala ahlobene. Ulwazi ngokucwangcisa ngokwezicwangciso nokuqaliswa ngokusebenza kweenkqubo. Amakhono amahle ethetho, unxibelelwano nokubonisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho weziQendu zoBuseko kunye nenkqubo yohlangothi. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezizwe nakumigaqo kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo, kwaye kufuneka umginki alungele kwaye akwazi ukuhamba kakhulu. Isazindulezo esilungileyo sokhuseleko. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqonda iinkqubo kwi-Ms Word & Teams, Excel, Outlook ne-PowerPoint ngumfuno. Ilayisensi yokushayela evakalayo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkundla ezinikiweyo nguMqondisa oBalulekileyo. Unxibelelwano nokuLawula abathathi-nxaxheba abahlobene. Lawula, qeqesha kulungelelanise abaphathi besebe ye-SOCA, abavakalisi nabathathi-nxaxheba ngokwemisebenzi yonke enxulumene nomthetho wakwa-SOCA. Nikela nokuqondisa kuphando kwabavakalisi kwaye uze ubeke iicala xa nisabelwa njalo nguMqondisa oBalulekileyo. Funda iifolda zezicala namaxwebhu amanye anxulumene nomthetho wakwa-SOCA, okumele wenze utshutsho kwaye uphonononge izigqibo ezinxulumene nokwenza inkqubo yezityholo. Lungiselela iicala yenkundla, bonakale kwiingxelo nokuphononongwa ngokomyalelo ka-SDPP. Lungiselela iingcali ngomthetho. Qonda ngakumbi ukuze uyisebenzise iindlela ze-yanzulwazi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokwezicwangciso. Qwalasela izibonelelo kwaye uzihambanise neenjongo eziphambili. Uphuhliso, ukulawula ukusebenza nokulinganisa amalungu esabe. Jongana neengxelo nezikhulumi. Qinisekisa ukuba kusebenza ngomgangatho ophezulu wobugca. Khuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabalinganiseli, inxaxheba loluntu nokuqhwesha abathengi ngokubambisana nabalinganiseli kwindlela yocala. Qalisa kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo zokwenza ulwazi oluvela kumphakathi neeseshoni zokuzilolonga ezinxulumene. Nceda kucwangcisa umgxwama kwaye ulawule imali enikelwa ngamanywuli. Mela i-NPA kwimisebenzi enxulumene nomthetho wakwa-SOCA kwiminyhadala nayo nayiphi na indawo ngenkelo ka-SDPP. Ukulawula umgangatho wolwazi ngemilinganiselo yemisebenzi ngokwemithetho yakwa-SOCA. Hlengahlengisa iingxelo naxa kufunwa naxa kufunwa ngumthetho wakwa-SOCA ukuze zingeniswe. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluhle nokuzithoba. Yenza naliphi na elinye igqiza i-SDPP elikuthathayo njengalokubalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions
jobs.summary: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria, requiring an LLB and ten years' litigation experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least ten (10) years’ post qualification experience in civil and/or criminal litigation. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Admission as an Attorney/Advocate will be an added advantage. Good advocacy and legal drafting skills. Knowledge of civil and/or criminal procedure. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Good interpersonal, analytical, presentation and communication skills. Computer skills. Able to work extended hours. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To guide investigations and conduct prosecutions of identified cases. To exercise oversight on any decision to prosecute, and to give any necessary advice and report to the Head of the SCCU. To ensure that decisions to prosecute or not prosecute comply with all relevant legal prescripts, the Constitution, and all applicable policies, procedures and directive. To provide high level and well researched opinions and reports to the Head of the SCCU. To manage and direct governance and operations in the SCCU. To monitor and review strategy and operations. To provide enterprise performance reports. To liaise with regional offices and arrange meetings in this regard. To render professional advice to the Head of the SCCU, as required. To ensure that plans are in place to promote good stakeholder and partner engagement. To ensure that the national strategy and annual plan of the SCCU are developed and implemented. To monitor delivery of the regional offices in line with the strategy and plan. In order to ensure that the regional offices meet targets, to continuously analyse, review and monitor operational performance of the offices in order, inter alia, to identify and operational deficiencies and to monitor the achievement of strategic objectives and annual targets. To develop any performance or delivery improvement plans or make such interventions as circumstances may require. To oversee the development and implementation of appropriate employee performance management systems. To initiate and implement training initiative by establishing training needs both at national and regional levels. To meet with relevant stakeholders on a regular basis in order to effectively execute the mandate of SCCU

af.title: Onderdirekteur van Openbare Vervolging
af.summary: Onderdirekteur van Openbare Vervolging by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria, wat 'n LLB en tien jaar se litigasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende vervolgers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regsgraad. Ten minste tien (10) jaar se postkwalifikasie-ervaring in siviele en/of kriminele litigasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Toelating as 'n prokureur/advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goed ontwikkelde pleit- en regsdieningsvaardighede. Kennis van siviele en/of kriminele prosedure. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Goeie interpersoonlike, analitiese, aanbiedings- en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. In staat om verlengde ure te werk. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om ondersoeke te lei en vervolgings van geïdentifiseerde sake uit te voer. Om toesig te hou oor enige besluit om te vervolg, en om enige nodige advies te gee en verslag te doen aan die Hoof van die SCCU. Om te verseker dat besluite om te vervolg of nie te vervolg nie aan alle relevante regsvoorskrifte, die Grondwet, en alle toepaslike beleide, prosedures en richtlyne voldoen. Om hoëvlak en goed nagevorsde menings en verslae aan die Hoof van die SCCU te verskaf. Om bestuur en bedrywighede in die SCCU te bestuur en te rig. Om strategie en bedrywighede te monitor en te hersien. Om ondernemingsprestasieverslae te verskaf. Om met streekskantore te skakel en in hierdie verband vergaderings te reël. Om professionele advies aan die Hoof van die SCCU te verskaf, soos vereis. Om te verseker dat planne in plek is om goeie belanghebbende- en vennootbetrokkenheid te bevorder. Om te verseker dat die nasionale strategie en jaarplan van die SCCU ontwikkel en geïmplementeer word. Om lewering van die streekskantore in ooreenstemming met die strategie en plan te monitor. Ten einde te verseker dat die streekskanture teikens bereik, om bedrywige prestasie van die kantore deurlopend te ontleed, te hersien en te monitor om, onder andere, operasionele tekortkomings te identifiseer en om die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en jaarlikse teikens te monitor. Om enige prestasie- of leweringsverbeteringsplanne te ontwikkel of sodanige ingrypings te maak soos omstandighede mag vereis. Om die ontwikkeling en implementering van toepaslike werknemerprestasiebestuurstelsels toe te sien. Om opleidingsinisiatiewe te inisieer en te implementeer deur opleidingsbehoeftes beide op nasionale en streeksvlak vas te stel. Om op 'n gereelde basis met relevante belanghebbendes te vergader om die mandaat van SCCU doeltreffend uit te voer.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esibiyo Esihleziye Esiphethe Icala Lentela
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esibiyo Esihleziye Esiphethe Icala Lentela e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pretoria, esidinga i-LLB naluhlu lweminyaka eyishumi olwemisebenzi yokushiswa izinkantolo.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubaholi bamacala abafuna ukuthuthela ezikhundleni, noma yikuphi ukugqamuka okufanele kwesimo somthetho. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhlolwa emva kokugqamuka kokuqashwa emisebenzini yezinkantolo zomthetho wesintu futhi noma nobugebengu. Ukugqama okubonakalayo ekusebenzeni Kodwa, Ngobungcweti, Ngobophendula futhi Ngesithembile. Ukungena njengommeli kuzoba ngokunye okungeza inzuzo. Amakhono amahle okumela kanti futhi nokubhala imibhalo yomthetho. Ulwazi mayelana nenkqubo yomthetho wesintu futhi noma nobugebengu. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengokuqaniswe kumugqa we-25(2) womthetho we-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu, okuhlaziya, okwethula futhi okuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza amahora angethuli. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa iziphondo futhi uqhele icala lokuhola ezinkantolo amacala abaluliwe. Ukuqondisa ukuthi kunjani noma yisiphi isinqumo sokuhola icala, futhi ukupha noma yiphi inceku edingekayo futhi ukubika kuHlelo le-SCCU. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo zokuqamba icala noma ukungaqambi zihambisana nazo zonke izinkomba zomthetho ezihambisanayo, uMthethosisekelo, futhi yonke imigomo, izinqubo nezinkomba eziyasebenza. Ukunikela ngemiqondo nemibiko ezingeni eliphezulu nokuqashelwa kahle kuHlelo le-SCCU. Ukuphatha futhi uqondise isibusiso nezimiso zokusebenza e-SCCU. Ukuqapha futhi uhlole isu nezimiso zokusebenza. Ukunikela ngemibiko yokwenza komkhakha. Ukuxhumana namahhovisi angingangunda bese uhlela imihlangano ngalolu hlobo. Ukunikela ngeluleko lobungcweti kuHlelo le-SCCU, njengoba kudingekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ukuxhumana kahle nabaphathi kanti nalo abadluli bafuna ukuthuthela ezikhundleni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isu lesizwe kanti nenhlelelo yonyaka ye-SCCU yakhiwe futhi isetshenziswa. Ukuqapha ukulethwa kwamahhovisi angingangunda ngokuqondana nesisu kanti nenhlelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amahhovisi angingangunda afinyelela okuhlosiwe, ukuhlaziya ngokuphithithelela, uhlole futhi uqaphe ukusebenza kwamahhovisi, phakathi kokunye, ukuthola nokusebenza okuphuthumayo futhi ukuqapha ukufinyelelwa kwemigomo yohlelo emkhulu kanti nalokuhlosiwe konyaka. Ukuthola noma yikuphi ukwenza okungalungile futhi ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zenze ngcono ngalolu hlobo noma ukwenza ukungenelela njengoba izimo zingadli. Ukusasaza ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezifanele zokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuqala nokwenza izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ngokusungela izidingo zokuqeqesha kokubili kuleveli yezizwe kanti kanye namahhovisi anginganguda. Ukuhlangana nala baphathi abahambisanayo ngesikhathi esijwayelekile ukuze kwenziwe ngokusebenza kahle umthetho we-SCCU.

xh.title: Umbhala-manga oNgcwele weSizwe
xh.summary: Isithuba somSekela-Mlawuli Wabaqhengqulayo Bantu wonke kwi National Prosecuting Authority e Pretoria, kufuneka kubekho LLB kunye namashumi (10) iminyaka yamava wokuba sisengu.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ze LLB. Kwabasabela njengabanjululi abafuna ukuziswa kwakhona nangaphezulu naziphi na izidanga zomthetho ezifanelekileyo.Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kwezidanga ekugxekweni naxa kusolwa urhulumente nokwatyholwa urhulumente, okanye esinye kwezi.Ubukhosi obubonakalayo ekuziphatheni ngokuzimela, ngobungcali, ngokuzibophelela ngokunika iingxelo, nangokuthembeka.Kubakho lulwazi lokuba nguFakazi weNgcaciso okanye nguMmeli, makube ngowongezelelweko.Amaziko alungelelanisweyo okulwa unyatyheliso nokuqamba amaxwebhu omtetho.Ulwazi lomthetho wokuqhuba amacala karhulumente nokwatyholwa urhulumente, okanye esinye kwezi.Amalinge lokubakho kuwo nanjani na iziko lokubonakala njengoko kucetywe kwisiqendu 25(2) seNqaku le-NPA, se 32 ka 1998.Amaziko amakhulu okuvakalisa iingcamango nokuchaza ngokuhlaziya, nokubonakalisa, nakokunxibelelanisa kwaye nokuqonda.Amaziko okusebenzisa iikhompyutha.Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezininzi.Ilfayivisi yelayisensi yokushayela egunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukukhokela uphando kwaye uqhube imigqwasho yamacala afunyenweyo. Ukwenza ulawulo kwalo naliphi na isigqibo sokugxekwa urhulumente, kwaye unikeze naziphi iingcebiso eziyimfuneko kwaye uchaze kuntlhongo wokulawulo we-SCCU. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iigqibo lokugxekwa urhulumente okanye ukungagxekwa urhulumente zihambelana nayo yonke imigaqo yomthetho, uMgaqo-siseko, nayo yonke iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezikhokelo ezifanelekileyo. Ukunika iingcebiso namaxwebhu angenazinga eliphezulu kwaye eliqondisiweyo kuNtlhongo we-SCCU. Ukulawula kwaye uqonde iziseko zolawulo nokusebenza kwi-SCCU. Ukujonga kwaye uhlaziye iindlela zokusebenza nokusebenza. Ukunika iingxelo zokusebenza kwishishini. Ukunxibelelana neeofisi zamasithili kwaye ugcobe iindibana ngalolu hlobo. Ukunika iingcebiso zobugcisa kuNtlhongo we-SCCU, njengoko kufuneka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iindlela zokuzaqumba ngokuchanekileyo nabantu abahlangeneyo kumashishini. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindlela zokuzaqumba ezizinga zikamasithili kunye nezicwangciso zonyaka we-SCCU zenziwa kwaye zisetenziswa. Ukuqonda kwaye ubukele ukuhamba kolawulo lwe-ofisi zamasithili ngokwale ndlela nesicwangciso. Ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuba i-ofisi zamasithili zifikelela kwiinjongo, uhlaziya ngokuhlala, ubukele kwaye ulawule inkqubo yemisebenzi yale i-ofisi ukuze, phakathi kwabanye, ukwazi kwaye ugqibe zonke iingxaki ezingekoyo, kwaye ubukele ukufezwa kweenjongo ezingundoqo nazo zonke iinjongo zonyaka. Ukwenza naziphi iindlela zokuzikhushulela ukwenza izinto ngcono, okanye ukuthatha iinyathelo njengoko ziinkqubela ezifuneka. Ukulawula ukwenza nokusebenza kwendlela yokuphatha abasebenzi. Ukuqalisa kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuqeqesha ngokumila iingcinga zokuqeqesha kokuzizinga zendalo nakumasithili. Ukuhlangana kwabantu abahlangeneyo rhoqo ukuze kuze kubekho inkqubo yokuqhutywa komthetho we-SCCU.

af.title: Streeks hoof
af.summary: Streeks hoof vir die getuiebeskermingsprogram in Durban, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in 'n strafregtelike omgeving vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 in Regte / Internasionale Betrekkinge / Militêr / Polisie / Politieke Wetenskap of gelykwaardig soos deur SAQA erken. Nyukela-sertifikaat (Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Bestuursdiens van die skool van Regering). Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n regstoepassing / strafregtelike omgeving. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Hoë vlak van begrip van en bevoegdheid in persoonbeskerming. Bevoegdheid in ten minste twee (2) amptelike tale, waarvan een (1) Engels moet wees (veeltaligheidsvaardighede sal voordelig wees). Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Beplannings-, organisatoriese en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Hoë vlak van sensitiwiteit teenoor mensebestuur. Kennis van die Witness Protection Act, 112 of 1998, die Grondwet van die RSA. Gesonde interpersoonlike verhoudings. Konflikbestuur en konflikoplossing. Onderhandelings- en analitiese vaardighede. Hoë vlak van toewyding. Vermoë om logies te dink en hoë vlak van empatie. Gesonde kennis van die Minimum-Security Information Standards. Gesonde kennis van die leiding en beplanning van operasies. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereid om sekuriteitsklarering te ondergaan.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer die verskaffing van provinsiale operasionele en strategiese ondersteuning vir die getuiebeskermingsprogram. Bestuur en koördineer die assessering vir toelating van getuies tot die getuiebeskermingsprogram. Administreer die prosesse vir die OWP. Bestuur belanghebbende verhoudings. Generiese bestuursfunksies.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kuMthetho / Ezenhlangothi Zomhlaba Jikelele / Ezempi / Ezepoyisa / Ezopolitiki noma okulinganayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Isitifedikheti se-Nyukela (Isitifedikheti sokungena ku-Senior Management Service esikoleni sezeNkulumoMbuso). Okungenani eminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ezingeni lokuphathi emaphakathi/phezulu emkhakheni wokuphoqa umthetho / wezobulungiswa obuyicala. Ukuba nenkhethelo yokuzenzela, ngobungcwathi, ukubekezela kanye nokwethembeka okubonakalayo. Ukuqonda okuphezulu kanye nenkhethelo ekuvikeleni abantu. Inkhethelo okungenani kuleyili-nginxnye (2) zezilimi ezisemthethweni, okunye (1) kubaphi kumele kungesiNgisi (amakhono okukhuluma izilimi eziningi kuzoba ngumsizo). Amakhono okuxhumana (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo). Amakhono okuhlela, okuhlelabuhlelo kanye nokuphatha imali. Ukuzwelana okuphezulu ekuphatheni abantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho i-Witness Protection Act, 112 of 1998, nomthethosisekelo we-RSA. Ukuhlobana kahle nabantu. Ukuphatha ukungqubuzana kanye nokuxazulula ukungqubuzana. Amakhono okuxoxisana nokuhlaziya. Inkingo yokuzibophezela okuphezulu. Ikono lokucabanga ngokulandelana kanye nokuvezwa okuphezulu. Kumele ube selokhu uhamba kakhulu, ngisho nangemva kemahora. Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho we-Public Service Act kanye Nemithetho Yokuqondisa. Ulwazi oluhle ngenqubomgomo ye-National Crime Prevention strategy. Ulwazi oluhle ngezilinganiso ze-Minimum-Security Information Standards. Ulwazi oluhle lokuhola nokuhlela imisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukwenza isilinganiso sokuphephwa.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlolele ukunikezwa kokusekela imisebenzi yomphakathi kanye nezobuchule ohlelweni lokuvikela ofakazi. Phatha futhi uhlolele ukulinganiselwa kokungena kubafakazi ohlelweni lokuvikela ofakazi. Phatha izinqubo ze-OWP. Phatha ubudlelwano nabalingani. Imisebenzi ejiyane yokuphatha.

xh.title: Isikhulu sengingqi
xh.summary: Isikhulu sengingqi senkqubo yokhuseleko babongi eDurban, sifuna isifundo seenqanaba NQF level 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu yokusebenza njengomphathi oyintloko kwindawo yolawulo lobugcisa bokugweba ecaleni kolwaphulo-mthetho.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangabuchule obulingana nesiya kwinqanaba le-7 kumanqaku e-NQF kwiNqobo yokusemthethweni / Ezomazwe / Esendaweni yamabandla ekulwela inkxaso ekulawulweni kwelinye ilizwe / Ezepolisi / Ezenzululwazi ezizezopolitiko okanye nangaphezulu kokufana nalokho njengoko kuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Isatifikethi seNyukela (Isatifikethi sokuungenisa kwiNkonzo yoBaphathi abaBakhulu kwiSikolo saBaphathi). Kufunke abe namava amabali alinganiselwa kwiminyaka elisha (5) ebedlula kwindawo abe ngumphathi ophakathi/wonobhala kwindawo ekusebenzela oovimba bakho nakulawulo Iulwaphulo-mthetho. Isakhono esibonakalayo kumalungiselelo okuqhuba ngokuzimeleyo, ngokungathembekiyo, ngokubakho nxaxheba nokuthembeka. Iqondo eliphakamileyo lokusikwa nokunxibelelwana nge-nto yonke imicimbi ngokumayela nokugcina abantu. Isakhono ngaphezulu kweelwimi ezisemthethweni ezimbini (2), enye (1) emaYalweni okuthi ngamnye amalungiselelo abantu ababili, iyakuthanda isixhobo sami sokuqonda isininzi seelwimi seBhayibhile, kodwa ekubeni isakhono esisezantsi kunye nesixhobo sokuvakalisa ngolwimi lwesiNgesi) eSizwe). Isakhono sokwenza inkqubo, ukuqamba nokuqwalasela ngokwezimali. Iqondo elikhuselekileyo lokulinganisa imicimbi yokusebenza koluntu. Ulwazi lokuqonda nokusika komthetho weNkqubo yokukhuselwa kwiNgqungquthela yamagosa elungiselela ukuba bafakwe kwindawo bengabongi kumthetho we-Witness Protection Act, 112 ka-1998, iNqumbo yeRiphablikhi yeSizwe jikelele e-RSA. Uqhagamshelwano oluhle lokusebenza koluntu ntoni na kunye nabasebenzi. Ulwazi lokubeka kwindawo ngokusesikweni nakwindawo ekude. Ulwazi lokuphatha iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nokwenza izigqibo ngokomthetho. Isikhohlakalo. Ukuba nokulungelelanisa nokuhamba ehamba ngenxa yokwenza iinkqubo zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Lawula, lungiselela, yondle kwaye uphathe ngokwenza inkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilungele ukwakhiwa koluntu kunye novimba weendaba ezilungeleleneyo ngokomthetho ekuqwalaselweni koluntu Iinkqubo ezimalunga nokukhuselwa koluntu. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezimalunga nokwamkelwa koluntu kunye nokuqwalaselwa koluntu Iinkqubo ezibeka kwindawo ekubakho kudidi Iuluntu.

jobs.title: Senior State Advocate
jobs.salary_text: R1 242 915 – R1 934 208 per annum (LP-9), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: Senior State Advocate needed at the NPA in Gqeberha to conduct criminal proceedings and represent the State in all courts.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least eight (8) years post qualification legal experience in civil and/or criminal litigation. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Five (5) years’ experience in legal practice will be an added advantage. Ability to act independently. Experience or knowledge in environmental cases will be an added advantage. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Decision making ability. Computer literacy and knowledge of programs in MS Office. The incumbent will be required to travel within the region. A valid drivers license.
jobs.duties: Study case dockets. Decide on the institution of and conduct criminal proceedings. Draft charge sheets, indictments and other court documents. Represent the State in all courts. Prepare cases for court, including the acquisition of additional evidence and draft charge sheets, indictments and court documents. Present the State’s case in court, lead and cross examine witnesses, address the court on, inter alia, conviction and sentence. Attend to representations, prepare opinions and head of arguments and argue cases in appropriate court. Appear in court in motion application pertaining to criminal matters and in general conduct prosecution on behalf of the state. Perform all duties related thereto in accordance with the code of conduct policy and directives of the NPA. Ensure accurate statistics and good governance. Mentor and coach junior staff (Prosecutors/Advocates) and quality check their work. Provide appropriate guidance and direction and issue proper instructions to Advocates/Prosecutors/SAPS/DPCI on all aspects of work. Participate in the performance assessment of staff being mentored. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice system.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026350@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre- entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS. The full details can be sourced from the link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Staatsadvokaat
af.summary: Senior Staatsadvokaat benodig by die NPA in Gqeberha om strafregtelike verrigtinge te voer en die Staat in alle howe te verteenwoordig.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se regservaring na kwalifikasie in siviele en/of strafregtelike litigasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in regspraktyk sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vermoë om onafhanklik op te tree. Ervaring of kennis van omgewingsake sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Sterke interpersoonlike en Kommunikasievaardighede. Besluitnemingsvermoë. Rekenaarvaardigheid en kennis van programme in MS Office. Die ampsdraer sal binne die streek moet reis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en voer strafregtelike verrigtinge. Opstel van klagstate, aanklagtes en ander hofdokumente. Verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Berei sake vir die hof voor, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende bewyse en opstel van klagstate, aanklagtes en hofdokumente. Hou die Staat se saak in die hof, lei en kruisondersoek getuies, spreek die hof toe oor, onder andere, skuldigbevinding en vonnis. Behartig vertoë, berei menings en hoof van argumente voor en voer sake in die toepaslike hof. Verskyn in die hof in motiesake wat op strafregtelike ake betrekking het en voer in die algemeen vervolging namens die staat uit. Voer alle daarmee verbandhoudende pligte uit ooreenkomstig die gedragskodebeleid en riglyne van die NPA. Verseker akkurate statistieke en goeie bestuur. Mentor en afrig junior personeel (Aanklaers/Advokate) en doen kwaliteitskontrole op hul werk. Verskaf toepaslike leiding en rigting en gee behoorlike opdragte aan Advokate/Aanklaers/SAPS/DPCI oor alle aspekte van die werk. Neem deel aan die prestasie-assessering van personeel wat gementor word. Bevorder vennootskapsintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Umeluleki Ophakemei Wezwe
zu.summary: Kufuneka umeluleki ophakemei wezwe e-NPA e-Gqeberha ukuze abambe izinqamela ezizoni futhi amele izwe kuzonke izinkantolo.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli bendaba abayifunayo inkwesabo, noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele somthetho. Okungenani iminyaka eyisishiyagalombolo (8) yokuhlolwa kweminyaka yokuhlolwa komthetho ezingxoxweni zomthetho zesilulumuntu noma izono. Ukugqama okubonakalayo ekusebenzeni ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuningwe futhi ngesithunzi. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kuchaziwe esigatshaneni se-25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yokuhlolwa ezingxoxweni zomthetho izongeza amandla. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele. Ukuhlolwa noma ulwazi ezindabeni zomhlaba kuzongeza amandla. Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana nabantu nokucwasimila. Ikhono lokuthatha izinqumo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nolwaziwezinhlelo ze-MS Office. Umsuli uzodinga ukuhamba endaweni. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Funda amafayela ezindaba. Zimisela isuqalo kanye nokubamba izinqamela ezizoni. Bhala amakhasi ezitshela, izinkomba kanye namanye amadokhumenti enkantolo. Mele izwe kuzonke izinkantolo. Lungiselela izindaba zenkantolo, okuhlanganisa ukuqoqa iziqiniseko ezingezandlela nokubhala amakhasi ezitshela, izinkomba kanye namadokhumenti enkantolo. Tshela indaba yenkantolo enkantolo, khokhela futhi nibuze ubufakisi, ukhulume lenkantolo, phakathi kokunye, ngokuqinisekiswa nesiselayo. Yiba nezinkomba, lungiselela izincomo kanye nezihloko zezinkulumo ubuye uzixoxe izindaba enkantolo efanelekile. Bonakala enkantolo ezithandweni zenkantolo ezihlobene nezindaba zezono ubuye ngokujwayelekile uqhubise ukumelana ngobuhlaluse benkantolo bozwe. Yenza konke umsebenzi ongahlobene nakho ngokulandelwa komthetho wokuziphatha nomyalo we-NPA. Qinisekisa izibalo ezifanele kanye nolawulo oluhle. Yekisela futhi uhlinze ngemfundvo abahola abasha (Abavuli bendaba/Abameluleki) futhi uhlolele ikhwalithi umsebenzi wabo. Nikeza isiqondiso esifanele futhi nalapha kuhamba khona uphinde unike umyalo oqondile kubameluleki/Abavuli bendaba/SAPS/DPCI ngazo zonke izinkalo zomsebenzi. Thatha inhlalothu ekuhlolweni kokusebenza abantu abayisisekelo bokuqeqeshwa. Khuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlangano, ubandakanywa komphakathi kanye nolonaka labakhonza ngokubambisana nabahlanganyeni bemiso yezweyezono.

xh.title: Ummeli oPhakamileyo woMbuso
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uMmeli oPhakamileyo woMbuso kwi-NPA eGqeberha ukuze aphathe iinkqubo zobugculeko azame ukumela uMbuso kuzo zonke iinkundla.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kwiilungisa ezikhangelayo ukuphakamiswa naziphi na izifundo ezifanelekileyo zemithetho. Ubuncinanei (8) iminyaka yamava emthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga kwigxelo labantu ngabanye naxa kusenyenzelwa kwezomthetho. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubekiwainxaxheba nakwizinzo. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kuchazwa kumacandelo 25(2) e-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kukusebenza komthetho iya kuba yomelelo ongongeziyo. Ulwazi lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo. Amava okanye ulwazi kwiimeko zemilingo iya kuba yomelelo ongongeziyo. Amandla amakhulu okusebenza nabantu nokuziphatha. Amandla okuthatha izigqibo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemveliso nolwazi lweenkqubo kwi-MS Office. Umntu oze kukhethwa kuya kufuneka ahambe ngaphakathi kwesithili. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa enesibusiso.
xh.duties: Funda iifolda zamacala. Thatha isigqibo ngokuqaliswa nokuphatha kweenkqubo zobufculeko. Bhala amaphepha ezigwebo, izalathiso nokunye okubhalwe ngeenkundla. Mela uMbuso kuzo zonke iinkundla. Lungisa amacela ixundla, kuquka nokufumana ubungqina obongezelelweyo nokubhala amaphepha ezigwebo, izalathiso namaphepha eze nkundla. Yalelisa ibali loMbuso enkundleni, qamba kwaye ubuze iingxamngam ngaxa mbini, thetha nenkundla ngesigqibo nokuwolula umhlathi. Zibandakanye kumagqabantshintshi, lungelelisa iinkcukacha zamabali neentloko zengxoxo yoxolo uze uzichaze iimeko kwindl ekufanelekileyo. Bonakala enkundleni kwizicelo ezihamba kwizicwangciso ezingelamacala obugculeko kwaye ngokubanzi uqhele inkohlakalo ihlawulela uMbuso. Yenza yonke imisebenzi edityaniswe nayo ngokwemigaqo yekhowudi yokuziphatha nemigaqo ye-NPA. Qinisekisa izibalo ezichanekileyo nolawulo oluhle. Ukhokele ngenyameko abasebenzi abasesezantsi (Abagcinikeli/oMmeli) uze uhlole umsebenzi wabo. Nikezela icebiso elifanelekileyo nolondolozo uze unike iinkqobo ezifanelekileyo koMmeli/Abagcinikeli/SAPS/DPCI kuzo zonke iinkalo zomsebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqokelelwa kolwazi ngokumiselwa kwabasebenzi abakhokelwayo. Khuthaza ukudityaniswa kwababambisene, ukubandakanyeka komphakathi nokwaneliseka kumthengi ngokubambisana nabalingani kwinkqubo yocala lolweldo.

Behandel voorleggings, berei menings en hoof van argumente voor en voer sake in die toepaslike hof aan. Verskyn in die hof in motieverwysings wat op strafregtelike aake betrekking het en voer in die algemeen vervolging namens die staat uit. Verrig alle pligte wat daarmee verband hou in ooreenstemming met die gedragskode-beleid en riglyne van die NPA. Verseker akkurate statistieke en goeie bestuur. Mentor en afrig junior personeel (Aanklaers/Advokate) en doen kwaliteitskontrole op hul werk. Verskaf toepaslike leiding en rigting en gee behoorlike opdragte aan Advokate/Aanklaers/SAPS/DPCI oor alle aspekte van die werk. Neem deel aan die prestasie-evaluering van personeel wat gementor word. Bevorder vennootintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Umneli Osemthethweni Ohlakaniphileyo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umneli Osemthethweni Ohlakaniphileyo ePretoria ukuze aphathe izinqamulelo zezocala abuye amele izwe nakuzo zonke inkantolo, kudingeka i-LLB kanye nohlu lokuqasha olungenaphansi kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili olusebenzele imithetho.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli babebahambele abafuna ukuthuthukiswa noma yisiphi isiqinisekiso esifanele sezomthetho. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili (8) yohlu lokusebenza emthethweni emva kokuqashwa ekwezisweni zezomthetho kanye/noma ezocaleni. Isikhathi esibonakalayo sokuzikhethela ukusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobunye kanye nokuqinisekisa. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangelwa kwisekhenshi 25(2) ye-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Eminyakeni eyihlanu (5) yohlu lokusebenza emthethweni kuzoba yinzuzo. Isikhathi sokuzebenza ngokuzimela. Uluhlakaz olu ololwazi ezinqamulelweni zemvelo kuzoba yinzuzo. Izikhathi ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu nobukhulu bokuxhumanisa. Isikhathi sokwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nolwazi hlelo lokusebenza i-MS Office. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Funda iyonke imibhalo yamacala. Thatha isinqumo sokuqala nokuphatha izinqamulelo zezocala. Bhala amaphepha ezikhalazo, izinkomba kanye namanye amaphepha enkantolo. Mele izwe nakuzo zonke inkantolo. Lungiselela amacela enkantolo, okuhlanganisa ukuthola iziqinisekiso ezengeziwe kanye nokubhala amaphepha ezikhalazo, izinkomba namaphepha enkantolo. Nikezela ngecala lezwe enkantolo, tata futhi uzehlule abafakazwa, khuluma enkantolo mayelana, phakathi kweminye, ukugunyazwa kanye nesigwebo. Yeka izinkulumo, hlela izinkulumo-zemibono kanye nezinhloko zezinkulumo-zezimali bese ukhishela inkantolo ekuqalweni. Bonakala enkantolo ezinhlelweni zezicelo ezihlobene nezicala ngokujwayelekile uphathe isibopho ngokuziphendulela ngokomthetho futhi ngokulandelwa komthetho wezomthetho wezinkambiso ye-NPA. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezilinganiswe ngokuthile zifanele kanti futhi uhulumeni uqhube kahle. Qondisa futhi ufunde abasebenzi abancane (Abavukeli/Abameli) bese uhlolela emisebenzi yabo ukuze ubone ukuthi iyakwenzeka yini ngokuthile. Nikeza ngezinkombandlela ezifanele nezindlela zokuba ngcono ukhulume ngeziqondiso ezingefanele kubavukeli/abamelini/SAPS/DPCI kuzo zonke izinto zomsebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqoqweni kokuqashwa komsebenzi abantu abafundiswa. Xhasa ukwaziswa kwabashayeleni, ukubandakanywa komphakathi kanye nothizi lwemikhasimende kubashayelene nabashayeleni kule nkqubo yomthetho wezicala.

xh.title: Ummapethi Wongamvacanthi Ophakamileyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMmapethi Wongamvacanthi Ophakamileyo ePretoria ukuze aqhube izigaba zezono aneemele uRhulumente kuwo onke amajelo, kwaye kufuneka ane-LLB nobuntlobo bonyaka osibhozo ngamaphondo ubuncinane wobugcisa bomthetho.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kumavakalishi abele ezisebenzayo abafuna ukuphakanyiswa naziphi na izidanga ezifanelekileyo zomthetho. Ubuntlobo bonyaka osibhozo (8) ubuncinane emva kokufumana isidanga bomthetho ekuguquguqukeni komthetho zabahlobo naba sona isono. Ukuchazwa ngokucacileyo amandla okusebenza Ngokuzimela, Ngunomtshato, Enoxabiseko nokuNyanisekileyo. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyiswe kumagatya angama-25(2) eNPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Amashumi amahlanu (5) unyaka wamava emsebenzini womthetho uya kuba lusizo ngakumbi. Amandla okusebenza ngokuzimela. Amaxhala okukwazi okanye ulwazi malunga nezigaba zendalo uya kuba lusizo ngakumbi. Amandla angaphezulu okuziqhelanisa nabantu nakuxabela. Amandla okuthatha izigqibo. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi lweenkqubo kwi-MS Office. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Funda iifayile zamacala. Thatha isigqibo nokuqaliswa nok ukuqhube amacala obugcisa bobugcisa bobuxoki. Bhala amaphepha ezigqibo, izalathiso nezinye iifayile zajelo. Mela uRhulumente kuwo onke amajelo. Lungisa amacala ajelo, kuquka ukufumana iimbekisimbeki ezongeziweyo nokubhala amaphepha ezigqibo, izalathiso neefayile zajelo. Bonisa isigaba soRhulumente ejelo, qamba imibuzo kwaye uze nephule iingxaki ezibonakalayo, thenetha ijelo malunga, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unyanzeliso nesisigqibo. Zonwabela iimeko zokumela, lungisa iinkcukacha zemibono nezihloko zeengxoxo uze uphawule amacala kwijelo elifanelekileyo. Bonakala ejelo ekuqaliseni izicelo ezihambelana nezindaba zobugcisa bobuxoki nakukuphakathi koqhube amacala abo buxoki ngerhabxo loRhulumente. Zenza yonke imisebenzi ehambelana nayo ngokuvumelana nenkqubo yekhowudi yokuziphatha neengqwelisimo ze-NPA. Qinisekisa izibalo ezichanekileyo nolawulo olulungileyo. Qondisa kwaye ucoche abantu abangaphantsi kwakho (AbaVakalishi/OoMmapethi) kwaye ukuhlola umsebenzi wabo. Nikela inkqubo elifanelekileyo nolondolozo kwaye uze unike imiyalelo echanekileyo kuMmapethi/AbaVakalishi/SAPS/DPCI kuzo zonke iindawo zomsebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqwalaselwa kokuqaliswa komsebenzi kwabantu abaqondiswayo. Khuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabalingana, ungenelelo loluntu nakwaneliseko kwixhasimthetho ngokusebenzisana nabalingane kunkqubo yomthetho wobuxoki.

jobs.title: Senior State Advocate (TRC)
jobs.salary_text: R1 242 915 – R1 934 208 per annum (LP-9), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: Senior State Advocate position at the NPA in Kimberley, requiring an LLB and eight years of criminal litigation experience to handle TRC-related matters.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion of any appropriate legal qualification. At least eight (8) years’ post qualification legal experience, in criminal litigation. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is required. Experience with MS Teams and Power BI will be an advantage. Ability to act independently without constant supervision. Must have good administrative skills. Able to work under pressure, which may involve long hours. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Adaptability, communication and teamwork are also required in respect of working with other role-players. Knowledge and experience in TRC matters will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Study the recommendations of the TRC (including relevant volumes of the TRC and its final report, related articles, video clips and records and all exhibits and documents handed in at the hearings, trials, inquests, proceedings), pertaining to allocated TRC matters. Consider the recommendations of the TRC and related matters. Provide guidance to dedicated TRC investigating officers. Drafting documents pertaining to access to crime scenes, court documents, documents and exhibits in possession of other state departments, universities, non- governmental organizations and other assistance as may be required by investigators. Conduct research, drafting of legal documents and attend to representations arising out of TRC matters. Make legal decisions in accordance with the law, policies and justice. Assist with the preparation of charge sheets/indictments where applicable. Co-operate and engage with all relevant stakeholders and colleagues pertaining to TRC matters. Make legal decisions in accordance with the law, NPA prosecution policies and directives. Also conduct research, prepare reports, and draft legal opinions, policies, legislation, and other legal documents. Participate in and represent the NPA in stakeholder engagements, meetings and projects. Monitor, analyze and report on performance information and statistics. Assist with the development of strategic, operational and implementation plans. Identify and resolve challenges affecting the performance of the NPA.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026368@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre- entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS. The full details can be sourced from the link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Staatsadvokaat (WVK)
af.summary: Senior Staatsadvokaat-pos by die NPA in Kimberley, waar 'n LLB en agt jaar se kriminele litigasie-ervaring vereis word om WVK-verwante sake te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regsgehalte. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se postkwalifikasie-regsonderwysing, in kriminele litigasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Verskyningsreg soos beoog in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Vaardigheid in MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint word vereis. Ervaring met MS Teams en Power BI sal 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree. Moet goeie administratiewe vaardighede hê. In staat om onder druk te werk, wat lang ure kan behels. Uitstekende analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Aanpasbaarheid, kommunikasie en spanwerk word ook vereis met betrekking tot samewerking met ander rolspelers. Kennis en ervaring in WVK-sake sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestudeer die aanbevelings van die WVK (insluitend toepaslike volumes van die WVK en sy finale verslag, verwante artikels, videoklipse en rekords en alle vertoonstukke en dokumente by die verhore, verhore, ondersoeke, verrigtinge ingedien), rakende toegewysde WVK-sake. Oorweeg die aanbevelings van die WVK en verwante sake. Verskaf leiding aan toegewyde WVK-ondersoekbeamptes. Opstel van dokumente rakende toegang tot misdaadtonele, hofdokumente, dokumente en vertoonstukke in die besit van ander staatsdepartemente, universiteite, nie-regeringsorganisasies en ander bystand soos deur ondersoekers vereis. Doen navorsing, opstel van regsdokumente en tree vertoeë na vore wat uit WVK-sake voortspruit. Neem regsbeslissings in ooreenstemming met die reg, beleide en justisie. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding van klagstate/aanklagbriewe waar van toepassing. Samewerk en in gesprek tree met alle toepaslike belanghebbendes en kollegas rakende WVK-sake. Neem regsbeslissings in ooreenstemming met die reg, NPA-vervolgingsbeleid en -riglyne. Doen ook navorsing, berei verslae voor, en stel regsmenings, beleide, wetgewing en ander regsdokumente op. Neem deel aan en verteenwoordig die NPA in belanghebbendesbetrekkinge, vergaderings en projekte. Monitor, analiseer en rapporteer oor prestasie-inligting en statistieke. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van strategiese, operasionele en implementeringsplanne. Identifiseer en los uitdagings op wat die prestasie van die NPA beïnvloed.

zu.title: Umlawuli Ophakeme Wobuzwe (TRC)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlawuli ophakeme wobuzwe kwi-NPA eKimberley, sifuna i-LLB kanye namakhulu ayisishiyagalombye eminyaka yokuqonda ukulwa amacala ukuphatha izindaba ezihlobene ne-TRC.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubahwebi bamacala abafuna ukuthuthukiswa noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele somthetho. Okungenani amakhulu ayisishiyagalombye (8) eminyaka yokuhlonipha isidingo semfundo yomthetho, ekulweni amacala obugebengu. Ukuziqhayisa ngamandla okusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobuphendulayo futhi ngesithunzi. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangwa kwisiqephu 25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Ukuhlakanipha ekusebenziseni i-MS Word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint kudingeka. Okokuhlangenwe nakho i-MS Teams kanye ne-Power BI kuzoba yilungelo. Ikhono lokuzimela nokusebenza ngaphandle kokulawulwa njalo. Kumele kube nokuhlakanipha ekubhalweni nasekulawulweni kwemisebenzi. Ukuba nesandla ekusebenzeni ngaphansi kwegxihu, okungafaka amahora amade. Ukuziqhayisa ngokuhlukanisa izinto nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzivumelanisa, ukuxhumana nokusebenza njengeqembu kuyadingeka futhi ekusebenzeni nalabo abanye abadlala indima. Ulwazi nakuqonda izindaba ze-TRC kuzoba yilungelo elengeziwe.
zu.duties: Funda izincomo ze-TRC (ehlanganisa amavolumu ahambisanayo we-TRC nekuletho lagqamile, izihloko ezihambisanayo, amavidyo namarekhodi, kanye nazo zonke izibonakaliso namadokhumenti anikelwe ezivivinyweni, ekuqondweni izehlakalo, ezivivinyweni, kwezinye izehlakalo), ezihlobene nezindaba ze-TRC ezinikelwe kumuntu. Cabangela izincomo ze-TRC nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nalokho. Nikeza umholo kabezobuciko base-TRC ababekelwe eceleni. Bhalisa amadokhumenti ahlobene nokufinyelela ezindaweni zobugebengu, amadokhumenti enkantolo, amadokhumenti nezibonakaliso ezisandleni sabanye omanyango kahulumeni, amayunivesithi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kahulumenu kanye nanoma yisiphi esinye isizo esingadingwa abaphenyi. Yenza ucwaningo, bhalisa amadokhumenti omthetho uphathwe ngemisebenzi ehlobene nezindaba ze-TRC. Thatha izinqumo zomthetho ngokuvumelana nomthetho, izinqubomgomo nobulungiswa. Siza ekulungiseni amakhasi okusolwa/izincazelo zamacala lapho kufanele khona. Sebenzisana futhi uxhumane nabo bonke abahlanganyeli abahlobene kanye nabasebenzi ngezendaba ze-TRC. Thatha izinqumo zomthetho ngokuvumelana nomthetho, izinqubomgomo zokushwabanisa ze-NPA kanye nezimiso. Futhi yenza ucwaningo, lukethe amabhiko, uphinde ubhalise izincazelo zomthetho, izinqubomgomo, umthetho, kanye namanye amadokhumenti omthetho. Ngenza futhi umele i-NPA ekuxhumeni nabahlanganyeli, emihlanganweni nasemigqeni. Qapha, hlaziya uphondo ulusolulule ngolwazi olubalwayo nangamastatistiki. Siza ekwakheni amaphulani ahlakaniphile, abaluleke ukusebenza kanye nokuphumelelisa. Chaza uphondo usolve izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza kwe-NPA.

xh.title: Ulawuli-Mbuso Ophakamileyo (TRC)
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumLawuli-Mbuso Ophakamileyo kwi-NPA eKimberley, esifuna i-LLB nephuma-lwazi lamashumi ahlukeneyo emisebenzini yocalulo lwecala ukuba uphathe izinto ezinxulumene ne-TRC.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kumanoxheli abakhonzayo abafuna ukuyiswa kwesikhundla nayo nayiphi na ifanelekileyo igqibo lokusebenza kolwethulo. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka yethoba (8) yolwazi lolwethulo emva kokufumana igqibo, kwicalulo lwecala. Ubuchule obubonakalayo ekusebenzeni kodwa, ngobuchule, ngobubebe nokwethembeka. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengakwisigaba 25(2) seNqamleshwa ye-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Kufuneka kubekho buchule ekusebenziseni i-MS Word, Excel, nepowerPoint. Iphuma-lwazi ekusebenziseni i-MS Teams ne-Power BI kuya kuba yingenelo. Ikho nzima ukuzithathela izigqibo ngaphandle kolawulo olusolokolukho. Kufuneka kubekho iziklilo ezilungileyo zolawulo. Ukuba nokho nzima ukusebenza ngocinezelo, oko kunokubandakanya iiyure ezinde. Ubuchule obugqibeleleyo bokuhlola nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuziqhelanisa, ukunxibelelana nokusebenza ngokubambisana nakweyiphi na kuxhomekeka ekusebenzeni nabanye abadlali indima. Ulwazi nolphuma-lwazi kweziboxeko ezingomzila we-TRC kuya kuba yingenelo.
xh.duties: Ukufunda izindululo ze-TRC (kuquka iivolumu ezinxulumene ne-TRC nesiSigqibo sayo sokugqibela, iingxelo ezinxulumene nayo, amavidyo neerekhodi yonke imiboniso namaxwebhu anikelwe ezindulweni, iicala, uphando, iinkqubo), ezinxulumene neziboxeko ezingomzila we-TRC ezabelwezona. Ukucinga izindululo ze-TRC n ezinye izinto ezinxulumene nazo. Ukunika inkqubo kabalawuli-baphandi abagqithiswe kwe-TRC. Ukubhala amaxwebhu anexWulu ngendlela yokungena kwindawo yocalulo, amaxwebhu enkundla, amaxebhu namaxwebhu abonakalayo entweni kolunye ulawulo-basebe, iyunivesithi, iimbumba-mvuzo kwaye nokwenza ezinye izixhobo ezinokufunwa ngabalawuli-baphandi. Ukwenza uphando, ukubhala amaxwebhu olwethulo kwaye uphendle izimboniso ezivela kweziboxeko ezingomzila we-TRC. Ukwenza izigqibo zolwethulo ngokomthetho, iinkqubo kwaye zolungelo. Ukunceda ekulungiseleleni amaxwebhu okutyhila iingxaki/amacala apho kufanelekileyo. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nokunxibelelana nabo bonke abathintekayo nabasebenzi nabo ngokwamaxesha ezinto ezinxulumene ne-TRC. Ukwenza izigqibo zolwethulo ngokomthetho, iinkqubo nezikhokelo zokulawula iicala ze-NPA. Ukwenza uphando, ukulungiselela iingxelo, kwaye ukubhala iingcamachi zolwethulo, iinkqubo, umthetho, namanye amaxwebhu olwethulo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba nokumela i-NPA kumanyano-nxibelelwano, kwindibano nakumapojekthi. Ukujonga, ukuhlola kwaye wenze ingxelo ngenkcazelo yokusebenza namanani. Ukunceda ekuthuthukweni kweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo, ezisebenzayo nokuzisebenzisa. Ukufumana kwaye usombulule iingxaki ezichaphazela ukusebenza kwe-NPA.

jobs.title: Regional Court Control Prosecutor
jobs.salary_text: R1 074 222 - R1 742 772 per annum (Level SU-3), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: Regional Court Control Prosecutor needed in Upington to manage and train prosecutors, conduct criminal proceedings and handle maintenance and inquest matters.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least six (6) years post qualification legal experience. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good management skills. Must have the ability to act independently or within minimum supervision. Proficiency in prosecuting /litigation, guiding investigation and giving instructions in complex or more difficult common law and statutory offences in Regional and District Court. Draft complex charge sheets and complex court documents. Good management skills. Must manage, give guidance and train prosecutors.
jobs.duties: Manage, train and give guidance to and train prosecutors. Study case dockets, decide on the institution of and conduct criminal proceedings. Maintenance matters and inquest of a general and more advanced nature in the Regional and District Court. Prepare cases for court and draft charge sheets and other proceedings for court. Present and assist prosecutors to present the State’s case in court, to lead witnesses, cross examine and address the court on inter alia, conviction and sentence, and in general to conduct prosecutions on behalf of the State. Perform all duties related thereto in accordance with the code of conduct, policy and directives of the NPA. Assist the Senior Public Prosecutor with the performance assessment of staff. Perform general administrative duties of the office. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice system.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026365@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted).
