af.title: Regionale Hof Beheer-aanklaer
af.summary: Regionale Hof Beheer-aanklaer benodig in Upington om aanklaers te bestuur en op te lei, strafregterlike verrigtinge te voer en onderhouds- en doodsondersoeke te hanteer.
af.requirements: n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regsgrondslag. Ten minste ses (6) seervaring na kwalifikasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goie bestuursvaardighede. Moet die vermoë hê om onafhanklik of met minimale toesig op te tree. Vaardigheid in aanklag/litisasie, die aanleiding van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in komplekse of moeiliker gemene reg en statutêre oortredings in die Regionale en Distrikshof. Ontwerp komplekse klagbriewe en komplekse hofdokumente. Goie bestuursvaardighede. Moet aanklaers bestuur, leiding gee en oplei.
af.duties: Bestuur, lei en gee leiding aan en lei aanklaers op. Bestudeer saakdossiers, besluit oor die instelling van en voer strafregterlike verrigtinge. Onderhoudsake en doodsondersoeke van algemene en meer gevorderde aard in die Regionale en Distrikshof. Berei sake voor vir die hof en ontwerp klagbriewe en ander verrigtinge vir die hof. Dien die Staat se saak in die hof voor en help aanklaers om dit te doen, om getuies te ondervra, kruis te ondervra en die hof toe te spreek oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en vonnis, en in die algemeen om namens die Staat aanklagte te voer. Verrig alle pligte wat daarmee verband hou in ooreenstemming met die gedragskode, beleid en riglyne van die NPA. Help die Senior Openbare Aanklaer met die prestasie-evaluering van personeel. Verrig algemene administratiewe pligte van die kantoor. Bevorder vennootintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredeheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregspleegstelsel.

zu.title: Umvinjwe Wokuqaphela Inkantolo Yangesifunda
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMvinjwe Wokuqaphela Inkantolo Yangesifunda e-Upington ukuphatha nokuhlela abavinjwe, ukwenza izinkantolo eziphathelene nobugebengu kanye nokuphatha izindaba zokugcinwa kwezimali nokupeywa kwamacala okubulala.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-LLB. Kubavinjwe abafuna ukuthuthuka noma yikuphi ukufaneleka ngokomthetho okuhambisana naleso sikhundla. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisithupha (6) okuhlotshaniswa namva kokuqokobha ulwazi ngomthetho. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobumnene kanye nokwethembeleka. Izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele noma ngaphansi kolawulo oluncane. Ukukhono ekubambekeni / ekulweni izigwegweli, ekukhokhelweni ukuphenya kanye nokunikela imiyalo ezindabeni ezingenzekile kalula noma ezinzima kangaphezulu ngomthetho jikelele kanye namacala enziwa ngomthetho eNkantoleni Yangesifunda naseNkantoleni Yomakhaya. Ukubhala amafomu amabinzima amacala kanye namadokhumenti enkantolo abinzima. Izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha. Kumele ukuphathe, ukukhokhele kanye nokuhlele abavinjwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukuhlela, ukukhokhela kanye nokuhlela abavinjwe. Ukufunda amafomuamacala, ukugqiba ukuziswa kwenkantolo kanye nokwenza izinkantolo eziphathelene nobugebengu. Izindaba zokugcinwa kwezimali nokuphathwa kwamacala okubulala kwejikelele kanye namandla eNkantoleni Yangesifunda naseNkantoleni Yomakhaya. Ulungiselela amacala enkantolo ubhale amafomu amacala nemicimbe yamanye enkantolo. Ukumela futhi usize abavinjwe ukumela isimo senkantolo senarha enkantolo, ukubuza abafakazi, ukuphenya kanye nokukhuluma enkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa kohlangothi kanye nokujeziswa, ngokujwayelekile ukwenza ukubambe kohlangothi benarha. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngokomyalo wokuziphatha, inqubomgomo kanye nemiyalo ye-NPA. Usize uMvinjwe Womphakathi Omkhulu ngokuqashwa komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo ebhilidi. Ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana nabashwarenza, ukuzibandakanya komphakathi kanye nokwaneliseka kwabathengi kuhlanganyelo nabalingani kusimiso sokulalela amacala bobugebengu.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezabambelela Wenkundla Yezifunda
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi Wezabambelela Wenkundla Yezifunda e-Upington ukuze alawule akholele nakwaye afundise izabambelela, achithe inkqubo yeenkohlakano aze ajongane neemiba zokuxhasa nezokuphonononga izifo ezifunyenwe ukuba ezakudala.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kwizabambelela ezikhonzayo ezifuna ukuziswa phambili naziphi na izifundo ezifanelekileyo zomthetho. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elishumi elithandathu (6) yamava angemva kokufumana izifundo zomthetho. Ukuzithembisa ngokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubekiweyo nangokuthembeka. Amakhono amabalwe yokulawula. Makabe nakho isakhono sokusebenza ngokuzimela okanye ngokuqwalasela encinci. Ukuziphatha kakuhle ekuguquleni icala / ekulweni ngecala, ekukhokeleni uphando nokunikela iimiyalelo kwiinkohlakano ezinzima okanye ezibucayi zomthetho oqhelekileyo nezomthetho oluqulunqwe yiNkundla Yezifunda nayo yoMmandla. Ukubhala ipepa elinezigqibo ezinzima namaxwebhu enkundla anzima. Amakhono amabalwe yokulawula. Makalawule, akhokele afundise izabambelela.
xh.duties: Ukulawula, ukufundisa nokukhokela nakwaye ukufundisa izabambelela. Ukuphonononga iifolda zeecal aze athathe isigqibo sokuyala ngokuchitheka kwaye achithe inkqubo yeenkohlakano. Iimiba yokuxhasa nokuphonononga iifo ezingamva ngokubanzi nangaphezulu kwiNkundla Yezifunda nakuyo yoMmandla. Ulungiselele iingozi zenkundla aze abhale ipepa lezigqibo namaxwebhu amanye enkundla. Mze axele aze ancede izabambelela ekuchazeni icala loRhwebo enkundleni, ukuyisa iingxaki, ukuba umbuzo ongqamano nexesha elide nokuthetha ngenkundla phakathi kokunye, ngokuqinisekiswa ngesohlwayo, nakuyo jikelele ukuchitha iingozi ngenothwebo. Asenze onke amasebenzi ahlongezeleyo ngokwemigaqo yokuziphatha, iinkqubo neenyaleko ze-NPA. Ancede uMphathi Wezamambelela Ombalwa nokuhlola ukwenza kwabasebenzi. Enze imisebenzi ejolijolio yokulawula ihhovisi. Akhuthaze ukudityaniswa kwabahlobo, ukuzibandakanya komthakathi kwaye onwabe ngokwaneliseka kwabathengi ekubudlelwaneni nabahlobo kwinkqubo yocala lobugcisa bokwenza umthetho.

af.summary: Die National Prosecuting Authority in Cape Town soek 'n Staatsadvokaat om as Prokureur vir die Asset Forfeiture Unit op te tree en siviele litigasie oor howe te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regsgraaad. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar postkwalifikasie regservaring. af.duties: Tree as Prokureur vir die Asset Forfeiture Unit op. Voer take uit wat by wet deur Prokureurs uitgevoer moet word. jobs.salary_text: R970 221 - R1 600 893 per annum (Level LP- 7 to LP-8), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: State Advocate position at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria requiring an LLB and five years' post-qualification legal experience to conduct criminal proceedings.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. At least five (5) years’ post qualification legal experience. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Well-developed skills in legal research and legal drafting. Good knowledge of civil and/or criminal procedure. Proficiency in prosecution/litigation, competency in guiding investigations, drafting charge sheets, indictments and court documents and dealing with representations. Knowledge of and skills in general prosecution. High level of proficiency in prosecuting/litigation and presenting/arguing cases in court. Experience in guiding criminal investigations and giving instructions in law and statutory offences. Interpersonal skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.
jobs.duties: Study and guide the investigations in case dockets. Decide on the institution of and conduct criminal proceedings. Draft charge sheets, indictments and other court documents. Represent the State in all courts. Prepare a case for court, including the acquisition of additional evidence and draft charge sheets and indictments. Present the State’s case in court, lead and cross examine witnesses, address the court on, inter alia, conviction and sentence, study appeal and reviews. Attend to representations, prepare opinions and heads of arguments and argue cases in the appropriate court. Appear in court in motion application pertaining to criminal matters and in general conduct prosecution on behalf of the state. Perform all duties related thereto in accordance with the code of conduct policy and directives of the NPA. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice system

af.title: Staatsadvokaat
af.summary: Staatsadvokaatpos by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria wat 'n LLB en vyf jaar se post-kwalifikasieregterlike ervaring vereis om strafregtelike verrigtinge te voer.
af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige geskikte regterlike kwalifikasie. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se post-kwalifikasieregterlike ervaring. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsdienste. Goeie kennis van siviele en/of strafregtelike prosedure. Bedrevenheid in vervolging/litigasie, bevoegdheid in die begeleiding van ondersoeke, die opstel van klagstate, aanklagte en hofdokumente en die hantering van vertoë. Kennis van en vaardighede in algemene vervolging. 'n Hoë vlak van bedrevenheid in vervolging/litigasie en die voorlegging/voer van sake in die hof. Ervaring in die begeleiding van strafregtelike ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in reg en statutêre oortredings. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik met minimum toesig te werk.
af.duties: Bestudeer en begelei ondersoeke in saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en voer strafregtelike verrigtinge. Stel klagstate, aanklagte en ander hofdokumente op. Verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Berei 'n saak voor vir die hof, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende getuienis en die opstel van klagstate en aanklagte. Voor die Staat se saak in die hof, ondervra en kruisondervra getuies, spreek die hof toe oor, onder andere, skuldigbevinding en vonnis, bestudeer appèlle en hersienings. Hanteer vertoë, berei menings en skriflike argumente voor en voer sake in die toepaslike hof. Verskyn in die hof in motieverwysingsaansoeke rakende strafregtelike aangeleenthede en voer in die algemeen vervolging namens die staat uit. Voer alle daarmee verbandhoudende pligte uit ooreenkomstig die gedragskodebeleid en richtlyne van die NPA. Bevorder vennote-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en klantetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Mmeli womphakathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngummeli womphakathi esimnyangweni wokugcina izinkambiso zamacala eNasionale Pretoria, sidinga i-LLB kanye namava eminyaka eyisihlanu yokuba ngummeli womthetho ukuze kwenziwe izinkambiso zamacala abakhweletiswa.
zu.requirements: Izinhlobo eziseduze zokufunda umthetho ze-African: Isidingo sokuba ngumuntu onelayisense yokuba ngummeli osemthethweni (LLB) kanye nokuba ngummeli wemithetho. ukuba ngummeli onelayisense yokuba ngabaqinisekisi bomthetho, kunoma isiphi isifundo esifanele somthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangwa esigabeni 25(2) somthetho we-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Okungenani iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yokuba ngummeli wemthetho noma onelayisense yokuba ngummeli. Ukubekezela okubonakala ekuzibuseka ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuzwe nokuba nethonya. Amasu acgwele ekutholeni imininingwane yomthetho nakubhalweni imithetho. Ukuqonda okuhle ngemithethonkambiso yomphakathi noma yomthetho. Amasu okwazi ukuqonda imithethonkambiso yokubeka icala, amandla okubhala amakhasheeti edolobha, imiyalo yokuthula kanye nokuthula amathambo. Isiko elingabangenela ngolwazi ngemithetho elikhuthaza amacala namathuba abayibona. Iqinisekiso lokuba ngummeli oqinisekisiwe ekubhali, ekuqondeni nokuphika amacala enkundleni yamakhosi emaphakathi. Ukubekezela ekubukeni izindawo ezibhedu, ukubhala izikhangiso sokubeka amacala, kanye nokusebenzisa imithetho mayelana namaphuzu abucayi. Ukubekezela kokubona abantu abangena enkundleni yamakhos' abaphakathi. Amabekehle angaqinisekisa abafundisi.
zu.duties: Funda futhi uholele iziphithiphithi ezikudoshilokho yokaphela lamacala. Gcina isinqumo sokungqamula nokwenza izinkambiso ezimalwa ngomthetho. Bhala amakhasheeti okwenzayo okwenziwe ngomthetho, amaphepha okwaluleka ngamacala amakhulu kanye namanye amadokhumenti edolobha. Mela umbuso emakhotho wonke. Lungiselela icala eliya enkundleni yamacala, okubandakanya ukuthola ithuba lemibango yokaphela nevesitigedhi yokuxhasa ngesikhundla sokwenza okwenziwe ngomthetho. Phakamisa icala likamongamoni enkundleni yamacala, humusha umbuzo kanye nomuntu enikeza ubufakazi, gqamisa amanhlamvu emakhotho mayelana nokuvuma ukuyalwa kwefamu nokugxekwa kwesimangaliso, bese ufunda isinikelo esiphoziso sokugxeka kabuhlungu nokuye kwaqinisekiswa. Yala izinkambiso ezikhambisa amacala, lungelelisa izinkulumo nemibono engqondweni kanye nezindlela zokuphikisa, bese uphikisela amacala enkundleni yamacala eyiyo. Ebenza enkundleni yamacala ezindlekweni zokusukeza izinto mayelana namacala abakhweletiswa, ngokuyinhloko ubhekene nokubhala amaphoyisa abakhwenywa ngokomthetho nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho namacala ohlamvu. Yenza imisebenzi yonke ehambisana nekhodi yokuziphatha, umthetho-sisekelo nemiyalo yeNPA. Khuthaza ukubumbanisa abangenelanga inxushumba, ukubandakanya komphakathi nokwanelisa izidingo zabathengi kanye nabadlali beqembu elalungisa amacala abakhweletiswa kwindlu yokwahlulela.

xh.title: Advocate wesiWe
xh.summary: Isithuba soGqwe wesiWe sakwi-National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria esifuna i-LLB neminyaka emihlanu yamava obugqwe obungaphaya kokufumana isidanga sokwenza iinkqubo zotyholo.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kumatyala abakhoyo abafuna ukuphakanyiselwa nabafuna nabafuna abanabuqhawe boburhalwithelifu obufanelekileyo. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetywa kwicandelo 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka 1998. Ubuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava obuchule emthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga. Ubuchule obubonakalayo ekuziphatheni ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokuziphendulela nangokwethenjwa. Amakhono abhala ngokuchanekileyo ekuphandeni nokubhala iinkqubo zomthetho. Ulwazi oluhle lwenkqubo yobulumko nobugwetsha bobulumko. Ukuzinza ekwenzeni umsebenzi wotyholo/inkqubo yetyholo, ukuzinza ekukhokeleni iindwendwe ezingangenwa tyhala, ekubhalweni kwezityholo, isiqinisekiso sobugwetsha namaxwebhu enkundla nokusebenza nezinto ezibekiweyo. Ulwazi nakhono ekugqwetheni ngokubanzi. Inqanaba eliphezulu lobugqwethi ekugqwetheni/ukwenza iityholo nakuboniseni/ukuxoxa amacala enkundleni. Abasebenzayo ababaleleyo ekukhokeleni iindwendwe zesigwegwsha nogunyazisa ngomthetho nangeminye yemithetho yemicimbi yolwaphulo-mthetho. Amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu. Amakhono okunxibelelana ngokubhala nangokuthetha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela ngaphandle kolawulo oluncinci.
xh.duties: Funda kwaye ukhokelele iindwendwe kwifolda zecalatha. Thatha isigqibo sokuseka kunye nokwenza iinkqubo zobugwetsha. Bhala amaxwebhu okutyikitywa izityholo, iziqinisekiso sobugwetsha naxa Aphinyelwe kwiinkundla. Mela uRhulumente kuzo zonke iinkundla. Lungiselela icala lekundla, kuquka ukufumana ubungqina obongezelelweyo kunye nokubhala amaxwebhu okutyikitywa izityholo nesisiqinisekiso sobugwetsha. Bonisa icala loRhulumente enkundleni, khokhela kwaye ubuze iingxaki iingqina, vakkundla ngokuzibandakanya, ngokutsho kwantoni-ke, ngesigwebo nesohlwayo, funda iingxoxo zokurhoxiswa kwesigqibo kunye nokuphononwa kwezinto. Zibandakanye ekubalweni kwezinto ezichaziweyo, lungiselela iimvo kunye neentloko zezizathu kwaye uxele iingcali enkundleni efanelekileyo. Bonakalisa inkundla kwizicelo ezithunyelwayo ezithintela izinto zobugwetsha kwaye ngokubanzi wenze ubugwetsha ngokomcelwe kurhulumente. Zenza yonke imisebenzi enxulumene nayo ngokuvumelana nendlela yokuziphatha nemimiselo ye-NPA. Khuthaza unxibelelwano kumfutho zibandakanya nomphakathi kunye nokwaneliseka kumthengi ngokusebenzisana nabahlobo kwinkqubo yobulungisa bobugwetsha

jobs.title: State Advocate
jobs.salary_text: R970 221 - R1 600 893 per annum (Level LP- 7 to LP-8), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: State Advocate sought by the National Prosecuting Authority in Bloemfontein to conduct criminal prosecutions and represent the State in all courts.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. At least five (5) years’ post qualification legal experience. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Well-developed skills in legal research and legal drafting. Good knowledge of civil and/or criminal procedure. Proficiency in prosecution/litigation, competency in guiding investigations, drafting charge sheets, indictments and court documents and dealing with representations. Knowledge of and skills in general prosecution. High level of proficiency in prosecuting/litigation and presenting/arguing cases in court. Extensive prosecutorial or litigation experience with regards to common law offences such as fraud, theft, forgery and uttering, commercial crimes and related matters. Proficiency in prosecuting/litigation, guiding investigations in complex or more difficult matters, including commercial matters. Drafting charge sheets, including indictments and court documents, dealing with representations. Financial or accounting background and knowledge of Company law will be an added advantage. General computer literacy and knowledge of programs in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Ability to act independently without supervision and manage court and case flow management independently. Excellent administrative skills. Interpersonal skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.
jobs.duties: Study case dockets. Decide on the institution of prosecution and conduct criminal proceedings. Draft charge sheets, indictments and other court documents. Represent the State in all courts. Prepare cases for court, including the acquisition of additional evidence, lead and cross examine witnesses, address the court on inter alia, conviction and sentence. Study appeals and reviews, attend to representations, prepare opinions and heads of arguments. Conduct prosecution of serious, complex and organised commercial crime and corruption matters. Appear in court in motion applications pertaining to criminal matters and in general conduct prosecution on behalf of the state.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026371@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre- entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS. The full details can be sourced from the link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. af.title: Staatsaanklaer
af.summary: Die National Prosecuting Authority in Bloemfontein soek 'n Staatsaanklaer om strafregtelike vervolgings te voer en die Staat in alle howe te verteenwoordig.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se na-kwalifikasie regservaring. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsdrafting. Goeie kennis van siviele en/of strafregtelike prosedure. Begaantheid in vervolging/litigasie, bevoegdheid in die begeleiding van ondersoeke, opstel van klagstate, aanklagte en hofdokumente en die hantering van vertoe. Kennis van en vaardighede in algemene vervolging. Hoë vlak van bevoegdheid in vervolging/litigasie en die voorlegging/argumentering van sake in die hof. Uitgebreide vervolgings- of litigasie-ervaring met betrekking tot gemene-reg misdrywe soos bedrog, diefstal, vervalsing en uitreiking, kommersiële misdade en verwante aangeleenthede. Begaantheid in vervolging/litigasie, begeleiding van ondersoeke in komplekse of moeiliker sake, insluitend kommersiële sake. Opstel van klagstate, insluitend aanklagte en hofdokumente, hantering van vertoe. 'n Finansiële of rekenkundige agtergrond en kennis van Maatskappywet sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Algemene rekenaargeletterdheid en kennis van programme in MS Word, Excel, Outlook en PowerPoint. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder toesig op te tree en hof- en saakvloeibestuur onafhanklik te bestuur. Uitstekende administratiewe vaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik met minimum toesig te werk.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van vervolging en voer strafregtelike verrigtinge. Opstel van klagstate, aanklagte en ander hofdokumente. Verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Berei sake vir die hof voor, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende getuienis, hoof en kruisondervraging van getuies, en rig die hof oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en vonnis. Bestudeer appèlle en hersienings, behandel vertoe, bereie menings en hoof van argumente voor. Voer vervolging van ernstige, komplekse en georganiseerde kommersiële misdaad en korrupsiesake. Verskyn in die hof in motiveringstoepassings rakende strafregtelike sake en voer in die algemeen vervolging namens die Staat uit.

zu.title: Sikhalamba Sezomthetho
zu.summary: I-National Prosecuting Authority ifuna uSikhalamba Sezomthetho eBloemfontein ukuze athathe izinqumo ezibhekene nobugebengu futhi amele izwe emazinkantulini wonke.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubaholi abakhonzayo abafuna ukuthuthela phambili noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele sezomthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakula njengokuvezwa esigabeni se-25(2) somthetho we-NPA, i-32 ka-1998. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlola emthethweni ngemva kokuthola isifundo. Ukugonda okubonakalayo ekuziphatheni bokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ekuhanabiseni izibopho nangokwethembeka. Amakhono aphanuke kahulu ocwaningweni lomthetho nasekulungenisweni kwemibhalo yomthetho. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqubo zomthetho zomphakathi kanye/noma zezobugebengu. Ukubekezeli ekuthunjweni izinqubo/kumanzinkantulu, ukugonda ekuqondiseni ukuhlolwa, ekulungenisweni kwemibhalo yamacala, izinkomba kanye namaphepha ezinkantulu nasekuphatheni izinjongo. Ukuqonda nakhono ekugcineni izinqubo jikelele. Izinga eliphakeme lokubekezeli ekuthunjweni izinqubo/kumanzinkantulu nakubukeni/phenulisweni amacala enkantulu. Isipiliyingi esikhulu sokushaja izinqobo/nkantulu ngokuqondene nezono zomthetho jikelele njengobuqambi, ukweba, ukwenza amaphepha amanga nokuphawula, izono zentengiselwano kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nazo. Ukubekezeli ekuthunjweni izinqubo/kumanzinkantulu, ukuqondisa ukuhlolwa kwezindaba ezinzima noma ezibucayi, okuhlanganisa izindaba zentengiselwano. Ukulungisa amaphepha okushaja izono, okuhlanganisa izinkomba namaphepha ezinkantulu, nokuphatha izinjongo. Isimu sezimali noma izibalo kanye nokuqonda komthetho Wezinkampani kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ukubhalisele okuwumcumo jikelele kwekhompyutha nokuqonda amaprogramhi e-MS Word, Excel, Outlook kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimele ngaphandle kwalabo ababhekisisayo futhi uphathe inkantulu kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhambakuqhubekangaphandle kwasihlalo. Amakhono abalulekile okuphathwa kwebhalansi. Iziqu zokuxhumana. Iziqu zokuxhumana ngemibhalo nasemlondeni. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele ngesihlalo esincane.
zu.duties: Funda amafayela amacala. Thatha isinqumo nokuqaliswa kokushaja amacala uqhube izinqubo zezobugebengu. Lungisa amaphepha okushaja izono, izinkomba namanye amaphepha ezinkantulu. Mela izwe emazinkantulini wonke. Lungise amacala enkantulu, okuhlanganisa ukuthola izibonakaliso ezingeziwe, bubuza futhi uhlule ngaphambili abafakizelwa, ukhulume nenkantulu phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngokuquguzelwa nesisijuliso. Funda iziyalezo zokuzeza nezokubuyekeza, uphathise izinjongo, lungise izibono namaphepha ezingxabano. Qhuba ukushaja izono ezinzima, ezibucayi nezinhlelwe zezono zentengiselwano kanye nenkohlakalo. Bonakale enkantulini ezicelweni zokunyakaza ezihlobene nezindaba zezobugebengu futhi jikelele qhuba ukushaja amacala ngenkathalo yezwe.

xh.title: Umlo wombuso
xh.summary: Umlo wombuso ofunwa ngu-National Prosecuting Authority eBloemfontein ukuze enze ukwalathwa kwezobugewala kwaye amele umbuso kuzo zonke iinkundla.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kumanlweli boluleko abafuna ukuphakanyiswa kwindima, nawuphi na umgangatho ofaneleyo wemithetho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucatshulwa kwicandelo 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ubuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava wobugewala emva kokufumana isidanga. Ubuchule obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokwenza iimplyanto nangokuzinika isithembiso. Amakhono aphuhliweyo kuphando lwemithetho nasekulungiseni amaxwebhu emithetho. Ulwazi oluhle lenkqubo yomthetho wenginginya nakwamazwe. Ukuziphatha kahle ekulawuleni iindaba zecaleni, amakhono okukhokela uphando, ukulungisa amaxwebhu etyala, izaziso zetyala namaxwebhu enkundla nokusingatha iimbuyekezo. Ulwazi namakhono ekulawuleni iindaba ezibalulekileyo. Inqanaba eliphezulu lobugewala ekulawuleni iindaba ezibalulekileyo nasekubetheni/kuxoxweni iindaba enkundleni. Amava amaninzi obugewala nakwezecaleni malunga neenxocho zomthetho jikelele ezinjengenkohlakalo, ukweba, ukwenza amaxwebhu angamnyama nokuzithula, iimeko ezizonke nentengiso nakwezinye iindaba ezinxulumene nazo. Ubuchule ekwalatheni iindaba/ekubetheni iindaba enkundleni, ukukhokela uphando kwiindaba ezibucentshisiweyo okanye ezinzima kakhulu, kuquka neendaba zentengiso. Ukulungisa amaxwebhu etyala, kuquka izaziso zetyala namaxwebhu enkundla, nokusingatha iimbuyekezo. Imbale yemali okanye isikolo samaxwebhu ezezimali nolwazi loMthetho weShishini kuya kuba yingozi engeyonto. Ulwazi olubanzi lwakhompyutha jikelele nolwazi lweenkqubo kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook ne-PowerPoint. Ikakhulu ukuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo ngaphandle kolawulo lokubaqaphela nokulawula inkundla nokulawula ukusasaza kweendaba ngokuzimeleyo. Amakhono amabaluhlaza awholelayo omlindwendwendwa wokulawula inkqubo ebalulekileyo nezinto. Amakhono okubonakalisa nokuthetha nokubhala. Ukuzinceda ngokuzimela ngakumbi ukuze ukwazi ukubeka umxholo ngokubanzi ongahluzwa ngalo ekubeni usebenza ngaphandle kolawulo osezantsi.
xh.duties: Funda iifolda zecala. Gqiba ngokuqalisa kobugewala kwaye uqhube iinkqubo zamacala obugewala. Lungisa amaxwebhu etyala, izaziso zetyala namanye amaxwebhu enkundla. Yala umbuso kuzo zonke iinkundla. Lungisa iindaba zenkundla, kuquka nokuqokelela iindaba ezongezelelweyo, ukuqamba iingxoxo nokuqhatha ubungqina bezithengi, wongeze ngoko kundlu nasekugqibeleni kwecala. Funda iingxoxo kunye neenkqubo zekhadi lesaziso, kwangaxa ethanda naxa engathandi komceli-mangalelo ukunika iimvakalelo ezahlukeneyo kumacala akhangeliweyo. Yala ubugewala kwamaxesha afana noluvo lokubuza iingxoxo nokuqokelela izaziso nokuqokelela amaxwebhu athileyo angathunyelwa enkundleni. Ziphendule ekhaya ekuphathweni kwezindaba ezahlukeneyo kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo apho sisebenza khona kunxulumene nendalo yemicimbi yezoncedo lwezimali.

jobs.title: State Advocate
jobs.salary_text: R970 221 - R1 600 893 per annum (Level LP- 7 to LP-8), (Total Cost Package)
jobs.summary: State Advocate position at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria requiring an LLB, right of appearance, and five years' post-qualification legal experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. At least five (5) years’ post qualification legal experience. At least five (5) years in legal practice will be an added advantage. Financial or accounting background an advantage. Experience in litigation offences in terms of POCA, Companies Act, PRECCA, PFMA and FICA necessary. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Extensive prosecutorial or litigation experience with regard to common law offences such as fraud, theft, forgery and uttering, commercial crimes and related matters. Proficiency in prosecuting/litigation, guiding investigations in complex or more difficult matters, including commercial matters. Drafting charge sheets, indictments and court documents, dealing with representations. Valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Study case dockets, make assessments thereof and decide on the institution of prosecution. Deal with any representations. Guide investigations in complex or more difficult tax matters, including commercial matters. Prosecutor led investigations (PLI). Prepare cases for court, including the acquisition of additional evidence and draft charge sheets, indictments and court documents. Present the State’s case in court, lead and cross examine witnesses, address the court on inter alia, conviction and sentence. Manage court and case flow management of cases independently. Study and deal with appeals and reviews. Prepare opinions and heads of argument for complex matters and argue cases in the appropriate court. Appear in court in motion application pertaining to criminal matters and general conduct prosecutions on behalf of the state. Mentor and guide investigating officers, prosecutors and stakeholders. Assist in high profile matters or matters where an increased risk element is present. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in criminal justice system independently without supervision and manage court and case flow management independently.

af.title: Staatsadvokaat
af.summary: Pos as Staatsadvokaat by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria wat 'n LLB, verskyningsreg en vyf jaar se postkwalifikasie regsonderwerp vereis.
af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Reg van verskyning soos oorweeg in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se postkwalifikasie regsonderwerp. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar in regspraktyk sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Finansiële of rekenkundige agtergrond 'n voordeel. Onderwerp in litigasie-oortredings ingevolge POCA, Companies Act, PRECCA, PFMA en FICA nodig. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Uitgebreide aanklaers- of litigasie-ervaring met betrekking tot algemene-reg-oortredings soos bedrog, diefstal, vervalsing en uitreik, kommersiële misdade en verwante aangeleenthede. Bedrewe in aanklag/litigasie, die lei van ondersoeke in komplekse of meer moeilike aangeleenthede, insluitend kommersiële aangeleenthede. Opstel van klagstate, klagskrifte en hofdokumente, hantering van vertoë. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers, doen assesserings daarvan en besluit oor die instelling van vervolging. Hanteer enige vertoë. Lei ondersoeke in komplekse of meer moeilike belastingaangeleenthede, insluitend kommersiële aangeleenthede. Aanklaer-geleide ondersoeke (PLI). Berei sake vir die hof voor, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende bewyse en die opstel van klagstate, klagskrifte en hofdokumente. Dien die Staat se saak in die hof voor, ondervra en kruisondervra getuies, spreek die hof oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en vonnis. Bestuur hof- en saakvloei-bestuur van sake onafhanklik. Bestudeer en hanteer appèlle en hersieninge. Berei menings en hoofde van argument vir komplekse aangeleenthede voor en voer sake in die toepaslike hof aan. Verskyn in die hof in mosie-aansoeke rakende strafregtelike aangeleenthede en voer algemene geleidelike vervolgings namens die staat uit. Mentor en lei ondersoekbeamptes, aanklaers en belanghebbendes. Bied hulp in hoëprofielaangeleenthede of aangeleenthede waar 'n verhoogde risikofaktor teenwoordig is. Bevorder vennoot-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel onafhanklik sonder toesig en bestuur hof- en saakvloei-bestuur onafhanklik.

zu.title: Umzeluleki weSifundazwe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somzeluleki wesifundazwe e-National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria esidinga i-LLB, ilungelo lokubonakala enkantolo, kanye neminyaka emihlanu yomhlalaphansi emsebenzini wokuqondiswa komthetho.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubaholi abakhonzayo abafuna ukuthuthukiswa noma ngumuphi umthetho ophathekayo obuntu. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangwa esigabeni 25(2) soMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yomhlalaphansi emsebenzini wokuqondiswa komthetho. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) kokuziphatha komthetho kuzoba ngandlela thadu. Isizinda sezimali noma ezibalo kuzoba ngandlela thadu. Ukuhlola ngenzamo ezenziwayo ngokusho kwa-POCA, Companies Act, PRECCA, PFMA kanye ne-FICA kudingeka. Ubuchophesisi obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngokubheka phansi kanye nokwethembeka. Ukuhlola noma ulwazi olude ekugcineni umthetho ngokuqondene nemacala aqondiswa ngaphansi komthetho jikelele njengobhedabheda, ukweba, ukwenza amaphepha abampethu nokubhenya, amacala ezohwebo kanye neminingwane ephathelene nalawo. Ubuchwepheshe ekugcineni umthetho/ekulweni amacala, ekuholeni ukuhlola emacaleni aqinile noma anzima kakhulu, okuhlanganisa amacala ezohwebo. Ukulungisa amaphepha amacala, izinkomba kanye amaphepha enkantolo, kanye nokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Amalayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukufunda amafayelaamacala, ahlaziwe nawo kanye nokuthatha isinqumo ngokuqalwa kokugcwalisa isinyathelo sokushaja. Ukuphatha noma yimiphi imibhalo. Ukuholisa ukuhlola ezindabeni zentela ezinzima noma ezibucayi, okuhlanganisa izindaba zorwebo. Ukuhlola okuholwa ngumgcinimacala (PLI). Ulungisa amacela enkantolo, okuhlanganisa ukuthola ubufakela obungezwe kanye nokulungisa amaphepha amacala, izinkomba namaphepha enkantolo. Ukumela icala lesifundazwe enkantolo, ukuhola futhi ubuze abafakazi, ukuthatha inkantolo njengesinye isabelo, ngokuqukfwa nokubekwa icala. Ukuphatha ukugeleza kwenkantolo namacala ngokuzimele. Ukufunda futhi uphathe izithintelo kanye nokubuyekezwa. Ukulungisa izinkomba noma amahedisi enkulumo-mpikiswano emacaleni anzima futhi uphikise amacala enkantolo efanele. Ukubonakala enkantolo ezicelweni zesinyathelo ezihlobene namacala obugebengu kanye nokwenza imigcinimacala yonke ngokomthetho emele isifundazwe. Ukugcina futhi uhole abaholi bamaphoyisa, abagcinimacala kanye nabalunga. Ukusiza ezindabeni ezibucayi noma ezinkulu lapho kunamathuba okuba khona komngcozamtha. Ukukhuthaza ukwakheka kwezinyanga, ukubandakanya komphakathi kanye nokuqabisa abathengi kanye nezinyanga kwinkambiso yocala lobugebengu kuzimele ngaphandle kokubukiwe futhi uphathe ukugeleza kwenkantolo kanye nezinkambiso zamacala uzimele.

xh.title: Ummeli weSizwe
xh.summary: Isikhundla sommeli wesizwe kwi-National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria esifuna i-LLB, ilungelo lokubonakala, namashumi eminyaka emihlanu yeminyaka yamava okusemthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kummeli bobikela abafuna ukuphakanyiswa naziphi na izidanga ezifanelekileyo zemthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucatshulwa kwisebe 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ubuncinane eminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava okusemthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga. Ubuncinane eminyaka emihlanu (5) kwenkqubo yomthetho kuya kuba ngalungelo elongezelelweyo. Isingeniso sezimali okanye esokubala ngemali luncedo. Amava ekugwebeni izenzo ezingezonyanzo ngokwemi-POCA, Companies Act, PRECCA, PFMA ne-FICA afunekayo. Ulwazi lokuziphatha okubonakalayo ekusebenzeni Ngokuzimeleyo, Ngobungcali, Ngokubekiweyo nangokuQinisekileyo. Amava amaninzi ekugweba okanye ekugweba ngemithetho yonke ngezenzo ezinjengobumdla, ukweba, ukudiba nokudalulwa, iwebula kolwazi kunye nokubuyisa izinto ezidityaniswa nayo. Ulwazi ekugwebeni/ekulweni ngokomthetho, ekukhulatheni ukuphonononga kwezinto ezinzima okanye ezibucayi, kuquka nezomgunyathi. Ukulunga amaphepha ezityholo, izityholo ezilandelelanayo namaxwebhu othunyelwa enkundla, nokuphatha okuqondiswa kundwendwe. Ilayiseni elisebenzayo lokushayela.
xh.duties: Ukuphonononga iifayilel zezenzo, ukwenza isiqondo ngazo nokuqesha isigqibo ngokuqaliswa kogwebo. Ukuphatha naziphi na izimemo. Ukuqhatha iindaba zophando kwezinto ezinzima okanye ezibucayi zentlawulo, kuquka nezomgunyathi. Uphononongo oluqhutywa ngumgwebi (PLI). Ukuhamba iinkqubo ezenkelwa enkundla, kuquka nokufumana izibonakaliso ezingezandle nekuqamba amaphepha ezityholo, izityholo ezilandelelanayo namaxwebhu othunyelwa enkundla. Ukubonisa icala lesizwe enkundla, ukuqhatha nokubuza iingqina ngokubuyela ngemva, nokuthetha enkundla ngezenzo ezibandakanya ukumiselwa kwetyholo nokuqwalaselwa. Ukulawula ulawulo lwenkundla nokuqhatha iinkqubo zeenkqubo zendawo ngokuzimeleyo. Ukuphonononga nokuphatha izigqibo nokuqhathaniswa. Ukulungela izimemo kunye neengcamango ngeendaba ezinzima nokuchaza icala enkundla efanelekileyo. Ukubonakala enkundla kumcelise-mvuzo ngomthetho wezenzo zobucala nokulawula iingxatsho ngokomthetho ngokwelixa lelikhaya eliQela. Ukuyalela nokuyila abaphandi, abagwebi namathuba ahlangene. Ukunceda kwiindaba eziphawulwayo okanye ezingozela zikho ingozi ekhulayo. Ukukhuthaza intsebenziswano namabanga, ukubandakanywa kommmoni kwaye ukwanelisa iingcali kolawulo lwenuxolo ngokuzimeleyo ngaphandle kolawulo nokulawula iindlela zebhulorho nokuqhatha iinkqubo ngokuzimeleyo.

af.title: Streekhofaanklaer
af.summary: Die Nasionale Aanklaagsgesag soek streekhofaanklaers met 'n LLB en vier jaar se regsertvaring om strafregtelike verrigtinge in Butterworth en Upington te behartig.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste vier (4) jaar se regsertvaring na kwalifikasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Die ampsdraer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik of met minimum toesig op te tree. Ervaring in die begeleiding van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in regs- en statutêre oortredings in die streekhof. Goie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goie analitiese vaardighede. Goie aanbiedingsvaardighede. Goie projekbestuursvaardighede. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en die voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Stel aanklagstatings en ander dokumente op en verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Lei getuies, kruisondervra en rig die hof onder andere oor skuldigbevinding en vonnis en in die algemeen om vervolgings namens die Staat te behartig. Voer algemene administratiewe pligte van die kantoor uit. Bevorder vennootintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel. Voer alle verwante pligte uit ooreenkomstig die Gedragskode, Beleid en Riglyne van die Nasionale Aanklaagsgesag.

zu.title: Umveledi Wenkantolo Yendawo
zu.summary: I-National Prosecuting Authority ifuna abamveledi benkantolo yendawo abane-LLB naneminyaka emine yesipiliyoni sezomthetho ukuze baqhuba izinqumo ezibhekene nobugebengu eButterworth naseUpington.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubamveledi abasebenzayo abafuna ukuthuthela phambili noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele sezomthetho. Okungenani amane (4) iminyaka yesipiliyoni sezomthetho ngemuva kokuqeqeshwa. Ukukwazi ukubonakala ngokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuncwema nokwazi ukuzethemba. Lowo othathwe kulesi sikhundla kumele akwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele noma ngokuqashelwa okuncane. Isipiliyono sokuhola iziphoqi eziphathelene nephenyo nokunikeza imiyalo ezintweni ezibhekene nomthetho nezono ezisemthethweni enkantoleni yendawo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono amahle okuhlaziya. Amakhono amahle okubukhombisa. Amakhono amahle okuphatha amaphrojekhi. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Funda amafayela ezimoto. Gqoka isinqumbo somthetho futhi uqhibe izinqumo ezibhekene nobugebengu. Bhala amakhasi okwesolo namanye amadokhumenti futhi umele iSifundazwe kuzo zonke iinkantolo. Hola ofakazi, babuze imibuzo bese ukhuluma nenkantolo phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngokuqinisekiswa nesigwebo futhi ngokuvamile uqhibe iziphithiphathi ngokwesifundazwe.enza imisebenzi yezokuphathwa kahle yenhlanganiso. Khuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabalingana, ukubandakanywa komphakathi nesethemba labathengi kanye nabalungana kusohlelo lwezomthetho ezibhekene nobugebengu. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nalokho ngokuvumelana nekhodi yokuziphatha, iNqubomgomo, kanye neziyalezo ze-National Prosecuting Authority.

Amaphakheka amalungile okubonisa. Amaphakheka amalungile abaluleko. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egqityiweyo.
xh.duties: Funda iifoldana zendaba. Gatela isiggqibo sokusekwa nokuhamba iinkalo ezihlawulwa umthetho. Bhala iiphepha zamacala namaxwebhu amanye kwaye umzele iSizwe kuzo zonke iinkundla. Qonda ngamanganga, phendula ngesalathiso kwaye uthethe nenkundla phakathi kokunye, ngoxhomeleko lwegunya nengxelo yembuyezo kwaye ngokubanzi ukwenza imisebenzi yabachumeli ngenkathazo likaSizwe. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo olubanzi yetha. Phakamisa uqhagamshelo labahlobo, inkathazo lethu yokubandakanyeka kweenthendamphathiswa kwayeanelisa abathengi ngokudibana nabahlobo kurhulumente wokulwa nobukrakra emthethweni. Zonke imisebenzi ehdlelana nale kufuneka yenziwe ngokwemithetho yokuPhehlekokoko, iNkqubo yoBulumko neeNtsika zeNkqubo eNational Prosecuting Authority.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: HR Planning and Equity
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (MMS Level 11), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for HR Planning and Equity at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria, requiring a degree and five years of HR experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B Degree (NQF 7) or Three (3) year Diploma (NQF 6). Minimum five years’ experience working in Human Resources of which three must be specific experience in the Human Resources Strategies, Employment Equity and Diversity Management Programs. A minimum of three years of experience in staff management. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Working knowledge of Human Resources Planning and Employment Equity processes and government requirements. Thorough understanding of Human Resource Practices in general. Knowledge of the applicable legislation and prescripts in the public service would be an added advantage. Research, presentation and facilitation skills. Good managerial, report writing and communication skills. Analysis and problem-solving skills. Project management. Advanced computer skills. Valid driver’s license is a requirement.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the process of development and implementation of the Human Resources Plan/ Strategy. Conduct research and surveys on labour matters. Develop and review Human Resources Policies and strategies. Analyse human resource information and provide advise and support to management on human resources matters. Guide and lead the process of the development and implementation of the Employment Equity Plan which also include management of disability, gender and diversity in the workplace. Coordinate the implementation of Regional Employment Equity Plans. Promote advocacy on EE programmes including disability in the workplace. Develop strategies to promote and enhance Employment Equity programmes. Facilitate, monitor and report on EE plans and strategy. Participate in the implementation of diversity management interventions. Participate in the implementation of programmes that highlight gender issues and ensure reporting on gender mainstreaming. Manage a team of practitioners responsible for the Human Resources Plan, Employment Equity and other related programmes.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: HR-beplanning en Gelykheid
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir HR-beplanning en Gelykheid by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria, wat 'n graad en vyf jaar se HR-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad (NQF 7) of 'n Drie (3)-jaar Diploma (NQF 6). Minimum van vyf jaar se ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronne waarvan drie jaar spesifieke ervaring in Menslike Hulpbron-strategieë, Indiensneemgelykheid en Diversiteitsbestuurprogramme moet wees. 'n Minimum van drie jaar se ervaring in personeelbestuur. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Werkende kennis van Menslike Hulpbron-beplanning en Indiensneemgelykheidsprosesse en regeringsvereistes. Deeglike begrip van Menslike Hulpbron-praktyke in die algemeen. Kennis van die toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte in die staatsdiens sal 'n voordeel wees. Navorsings-, aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Goed bestuurs-, verslagskryf- en kommunikasievaardighede. Analise- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Projekbestuur. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie is 'n vereiste.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die proses van ontwikkeling en implementering van die Menslike Hulpbron-plan/Strategie. Voer navorsing en opnames oor arbeidsaangeleenthede uit. Ontwikkel en hersien Menslike Hulpbron-beleide en -strategieë. Analiseer menslike hulpbroninligting en verskaf advies en ondersteuning aan bestuur oor menslike hulpbronaangeleenthede. Lei en stuur die proses van die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Indiensneemgelykheidsplan wat ook die bestuur van gestremdheid, geslag en diversiteit in die werkplek insluit. Koördineer die implementering van Streeksindiensneemgelykheidsplanne. Bevoorstaan voorligting oor EE-programme insluitend gestremdheid in die werkplek. Ontwikkel strategieë om Indiensneemgelykheidsprogramme te bevorder en te verbeter. Fasiliteer, monitor en rapporteer oor EE-planne en -strategie. Neem deel aan die implementering van diversiteitsbestuuringrypings. Neem deel aan die implementering van programme wat geslagskwessies beklemtoon en verseker verslagdoening oor geslagshoofstroom. Bestuur 'n span praktisyne wat verantwoordelik is vir die Menslike Hulpbron-plan, Indiensneemgelykheid en ander verwante programme.

zu.title: Usomlondolozi: Ukuhlela kwe-HR nokuzeKulingana
zu.summary: Usomlondolozi we-HR Planning and Equity National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria, ofuna iziqu kanye neminyaka emihlanu yesipilinge se-HR.
zu.requirements: I-B Degree (NQF 7) efanelekile noma i-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6). Isipilinge seminyaka yokuqashwa emihlanu esebenza kwi-Human Resources okuyiphi emithathu kumele ibe isipilinge esithile kumanqamu e-Human Resources, Employment Equity kanye namaprojekthi wokuphathwa kobunjalo obuhlukene. Isipilinge esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu sokuphatha abasebenzi. Ukukwazi ukubonakalisa amandla okusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobumnini kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthembeka. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuHlela kwe-Human Resources kanye nokuzeKulingana emsebenzini kanye nezidingo zahulumeni. Ukuqonda kabanzi izindlela ezenziwa ngayo i-Human Resource ngokujwayelekile. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nemibhalo ebuzwayo ohulumeni wabantu kungase kubone udumo. Amakhono okuphenya, okwethula kanye nokukhulumisa phambilili. Amakhono omphathi ahle, okubhala okuphawulwayo kanye nokuxhumana. Amakhono okuHlaziya kanye nokuxazula izinkinga. Ukuphatha amaprojekthi. Amakhano ekhompyutha aphezulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo isidingo.
zu.duties: Goqqa inqubo yokuqamba nokusetshenziswa komquluokuHlela kwe-Human Resources/ amasu. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nezibingelelo ngemibandela yabasebenzi. Qamba futhi ubuyekeze izinqubomgomo kanye namasu e-Human Resources. Hlaziya ulwazi lwethemba eliphathekayo bese unikeza izeluleko kanye nokwesekela abaphathi ngemibandela yethemba eliphathekayo. Qondisa futhi uhole inqubo yokuqamba nokusetshenziswa komquluokuzeKulingana emsebenzini okufaka phakathi ukuphathwa kokukhulelwa, ubulili kanye nobuhlukahlukene endaweni yokusebenza. Hlezelelisa ukusetshenziswa kwemiqulu yokuzeKulingana yendawo. Khuthaza ukulekelela amaprojekthi we-EE okuhlanganisa nokukhulelwa kumsebenzi. Qamba amasu okukhuthaza futhi ukwenza ngcono amaprojekthi abakho-mlando azeKulingana emsebenzini. Goqqa, ulawule futhi ubeke inqikithi ngomqulu nangamasu we-EE. Yiba yingxenye yokusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuphatha ubuhlukahlukene. Yiba yingxenye yokusetshenziswa kwamaprojekthi aveza izinkinga zobulili bese uqinisekisa ukubika ngokuqondile okuhlobene nobulili. Phatha iqembu labasebenzi abayikho abayiphathi i-Human Resources Plan, Employment Equity kanye nananye amaprojekthi ahlobene nawo.

xh.title: I-Athumba Wengqondo: Uqeqesho lwe-HR kunye noLungelelano
xh.summary: I-Athumba Wengqondo woQeqesho lwe-HR kunye noLungelelano e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pretoria, efunayo idigri kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava oqeqesho lwe-HR.
xh.requirements: IDigri elungileyo ye-B (NQF 7) okanye iDiploma yamakhulu amathathu (3) eminyaka (NQF 6). Amanqanaba amabalwe iminyaka yamava kumsebenzi wabasebenzi apho amathathu kufuneka abe namava athile kwiNkqubo zoQeqesho lwe-HR, uLungelelano lwabasebenzi nokuLawulwa kweNtsalganiselo. Inqanaba elincinci leminyaka emithathu yamava ekulawulweni kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngochungechunge, ngokuxhamla kwaye ngenkqikithi. Ulwazi lokusebenza malunga neNkqubo yoQeqesho lwe-HR kunye neenkqubo zoLungelelano lwabasebenzi nemi funo karhulumente. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo koQeqesho lwe-HR ngokubanzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemiyalelo esebenzayo kurhulumente kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amakhono ophando, okubonisa nokuqhuba iindaba. Amakhono obuntu bomlawuli, okubhala iingxelo nokuquculula. Amakhono okuqhathanisa nokuqonda isixakaxaki. Ulawulo lweenkqubo. Amakhono aphakamileyo ekhompyutha. Ilayiseni yokushayela esebenzayo iyimfuno.
xh.duties: Qhuba inkqubo yokuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iNkqubo/Isicwangciso se-HR. Yenza uphando nophando ngemiba yabasebenzi. Phuhlisa kuze kwahloliswe iNkqubo kunye neendla eziluncedisa iNkqubo ye-HR. Qhathanisa ulwazi lwabasebenzi unikezelwe ngemigaqo nolawulo lwe-HR. Gada qhuba inkqubo yokuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLungelelano lwabasebenzi equka ulawulo lwesidayibili, ohlwo nentsalga emsebenzini. Lungelanisa ukusebenzisa amaFomula esiLungelelano ngokwendawo. Phakamisa inkuthazo kweenkqubo zoLungelelano zethathwe ngaphakathi na phandle kokulingana nokubakho kweentsaba emsebenzini. Phuhlisa iindlela zokugcina nokuphucula iinkqubo zoLungelelano. Qhube, qwalasele unike iingxelo ezimalunga neenkqubo kunye neziphithiphithi. Zibandakanye ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zokuthintela ngokulawula ingqaquko. Zibandakanye ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezikhuthaza isini nokuqinisekisa iingxelo ngokulinganisa ngokwesini. Lawula iqela labantu abasebenzayo kwindawo yokwenza iNkqubo ye-HR, uLungelelano lwabasebenzi nezinye iinkqubo eziye zihlotyane nazo.

af.title: Finansiële Ondersoeker
af.summary: Finansiële Ondersoeker by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria, vereis 'n graad of diploma in forensiese ondersoek en drie jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad (NQF Vlak 7) of NQF vlak 6 erkende drie (3) jaar Diploma in Forensic Investigation, Forensic Auditing, Criminal Investigation, Policing of ekwivalent. Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in finansiële ondersoek in 'n regs-/ondersoek-/finansiële omgewing in rolle verbonde aan ondersoeke, finansiële misdaad, finansiële ontleding, forensiese rekenkunde of nakoming. Beroepsopleiding in Forensic Investigation, Forensic Auditing, Regte of enige ander gespesialiseerde kursusse in finansiële ondersoek. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Uitmuntende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, innoverend en proaktief. Algemene bestuur en projekbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Menslike bestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntediens en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasievaardighede. Beplanning en prioritisering. Navorsingsvaardighede en administratiewe vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Voer saakbeplanning uit. Voer finansiële ondersoek uit. Voer spesiale operasies uit ooreenkomstig die bepalings van relevante wetgewing. Skenk aandag aan belanghebbende-betrokkenheid met betrekking tot finansiële ondersoeke. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning met betrekking tot saakbestuur.

zu.title: Umphenyi wezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuphenya kwezimali e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pretoria, sidinga i-degree noma i-diploma kwi-forensic investigation kanye neminyaka emithathu yokuhlangabezana okuhlobene.
zu.requirements: I-B Degree (NQF Level 7) efanele noma i-Diploma yeminyaka eyi-three (3) evunyiweyo yasema-NQF level 6 kwi-Forensic Investigation, i-Forensic Auditing, i-Criminal Investigation, i-Policing noma okufanayo. Okungenani iminyaka ithathu (3) yokuhlangabezana kokuphenya kwezimali kwindawo yomthetho/ukuphenya/yezimali kumisebenzi ehambisana nokuphenya, ubugebengu bezimali, ukuhlaziya imali, i-forensic accounting noma ukuvumelana. Ukuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzi kwi-Forensic Investigation, i-Forensic Auditing, umthetho noma noma iyiphi na inkhoso ekhethekile yokuphenya kwezimali. Ukuze ukwazi ukubonisa ukufaneleka ngokusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngokubeke ithile nokuthembeka. Ubuciko bokubhala nokukhuluma obuvelele, bukatsha futhi buqhube phambili. Amakhono e-Project management nolawulelo jikelele. Ukukwazi ukwenza uhlelo futhi uqonde. Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa. Inkonzo abathile nokusabelwa. Amakhono eNkulumompikiswano. Ukwenza uhlelo bese upheka izinhloko ngokubaluleka. Amakhono okucwaninga kanye namakhono oLawulelo. I-driver's license esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Yenza iplani yamacala. Phatha ukuphenya kwezimali. Qedela imisebenzi ekhethekile ngokuhambisana nemigogo yomthetho othintekayo. Jongana nokubamba iqhaza kwezimali ezihambisana nokuphenya kwezimali. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulelo mayelana nokuphatwa kwamacala.

xh.title: Isiphokondi sezimali
xh.summary: Isiphokondi sezimali kwi-National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria, sifuna inqaku okanye idiploma ekuphenyweni kwezobugcisa kwaye sifune iminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-Degree (NQF Level 7) okanye i-NQF level 6 idiploma ezaziwayo yeminyaka emithathu (3) ekuphenyweni kwezobugcisa, ekuqwalaseleni izimali ngobugcisa, ephenyweni kwezobugebengu, ekupoliseni okanye ekuqheleleni. Iqela elincinci leminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ekuqwalaseleni izimali kwimeko yomthetho/ekuphenyweni/ezimali kumagunya ahambelana nophando, nebhunga lezimali, nanalizi yezimali, nge-forensic accounting okanye ngokuzithobela. Uqeqesho lomsebenzi ekuphenyweni kwezobugcisa, ekuqwalaseleni izimali ngobugcisa, komthetho okanye nakuphi na amanye amakosi abhalwe ngokulinganayo oqwalasela izimali. Ukuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobungcali, ngokuziphendula nangokwamkelwa njengoko kubonakala. Amakhono am aphuhlileyo ebhalwe nasekuthetheni, angabakho iingcamango nangamaphupha aphambili. Amakhono obulungu bolawulo jikelele nolawulo lomzekelo. Ikhono lokuqonda iindlela ezisentla nokuba ngumlawuli. Ulawulo lwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo. Iinkonzo zabathengi noku-phendula. Amakhono onxibelelwano. Ukucwangcisa nokubeka izinto ngokwendalo. Amakhono ophando namakhono olawulo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Yenza ulwakhiwo lwecala. Yenza uphando lwezimali. Zenza iziseko ezizezelo ngokweemiralo yomthetho ochanekileyo. Ziphendule kwinxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba ngokuphathelene nophando lwezimali. Zeza ngenkxaso yolawulo ngokuphathelene nokulawula iicala.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Administration and Support
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria to provide administrative and coordination support to multiple prosecution service components.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B - degree (NQF level 7) or Three (3) year Diploma (NQF level 6) in Administration or equivalent qualification. Minimum three (3) years ‘experience. At least three (3) years’ supervisory experience in the related field. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. The successful candidate must demonstrate sound experience in supervision, team coordination, stakeholder liaison and the drafting of high-quality official correspondence. Knowledge of the NPA Act, the Public Service Act and Regulations, the PFMA and applicable public service prescripts is essential. The position requires a proactive, disciplined and service-oriented professional with excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong presentation ability, sound judgement, attention to detail and the capacity to manage competing priorities under pressure. The candidate must be computer literate, reliable, well organised, able to work efficiently in a team environment and capable of engaging professionally with diverse internal, interdepartmental and international stakeholders. Knowledge in administration and general functions.
jobs.duties: Provide high-level administrative, coordination and operational support to the international Cooperation Component, The Money Laundering Desk, the REPS Component and where required, other components within the National Prosecution Service. Support the Head of the Component and relevant functional areas in coordinating strategic interdepartmental and inter-agency engagements, preparing reports, tracking deliverables and ensuring effective follow through on decisions taken. Supervise and guide administrative staff to ensure efficient office operations, quality service delivery and compliance with applicable policies and prescripts. Coordinate official visits by representatives of foreign States and international bodies including logistical arrangements, stakeholder liaison and related administrative support. Perform functions linked to mutual legal assistance, extradition, money laundering coordination and related prosecutorial support processes, including meeting coordination, documentation management and follow-upon action items. Facilitate the organisation of training initiatives, stakeholder engagements and official travel arrangements linked to international cooperation, money laundering matters and REPS-related functions. Oversee and support the timely execution of supply chain management and human resource administration processes while promoting accountability, responsiveness and professionalism across the supported components.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Administrasie en Ondersteuning
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pretoria om administratiewe en koördineringsondersteuning aan verskeie vervolgingsdienskomponente te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Gepaste B-graad (NQF level 7) of Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF level 6) in Administrasie of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum drie (3) jaar ervaring. Ten minste drie (3) jaar toesigervaring in die verwante veld. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet goeie ervaring in toesig, spankoördinering, belanghebbende-skakeling en die opstel van hoëgehalte amptelike korrespondensie toon. Kennis van die NPA Act, die Public Service Act and Regulations, die PFMA en toepaslike openbare diens voorskrifte is noodsaaklik. Die pos vereis 'n proaktiewe, gedissiplineerde en diensgerigte professionele persoon met uitstekende mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, sterk aanbiedingsvermoë, goeie oordeel, aandag aan besonderhede en die vermoë om mededingende prioriteite onder druk te bestuur. Die kandidaat moet rekenaargeletterd wees, betroubaar, goed georganiseerd, in staat om doeltreffend in 'n spanomgewing te werk en in staat om professioneel met uiteenlopende interne, interdepartementale en internasionale belanghebbendes te skakel. Kennis in administrasie en algemene funksies.
af.duties: Verskaf hoëvlak administratiewe, koördinerings- en operasionele ondersteuning aan die international Cooperation Component, The Money Laundering Desk, die REPS Component en waar nodig, ander komponente binne die National Prosecution Service. Ondersteun die Hoof van die Komponent en relevante funksionele areas in die koördinering van strategiese interdepartementale en interagentskapsbetrekkinge, die voorbereiding van verslae, die naspoor van lewerbare uitkomste en die versekering van doeltreffende opvolg op geneemde besluite. Oorsien en lei administratiewe personeel om doeltreffende kantoorbedrywighede, gehalte dienslewering en nakoming van toepaslike beleide en voorskrifte te verseker. Koördineer amptelike besoeke deur verteenwoordigers van vreemde state en internasionale liggame, insluitend logistieke reëlings, belanghebbende-skakeling en verwante administratiewe ondersteuning. Voer funksies uit wat verband hou met wedersydse regshulp, uitlewering, geldwassingskoördinering en verwante vervolgingsondersteuningsprosesse, insluitend vergaderkoördinering, dokumentasiebestuur en opvolg van aksiepunte. Fasiliteer die organisering van opleidingsinisiatiewe, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en amptelike reëlings wat verband hou met internasionale samewerking, geldwassingsake en REPS-verwante funksies. Oorsien en ondersteun die tydige uitvoering van voorsieningskettingbestuur en menslikehulpbronadministrasieprosesse terwyl verantwoordelikheid, reaksievermoë en professionaliteit oor die ondersteunde komponente bevorder word.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezikhundla: Izenzululwazi Nokusekelwa
zu.summary: Udingwa umncedi wezikhundla e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pretoria ukuze unikeze isekelo sezinzulu kwezokubhaliswa nokuhlanganisa ezin hlangothi ezahlukene zezinkonzo zokugxuma.
zu.requirements: I-degree elungele (NQF level 7) noma i-Diploma yamashumi amathathu (3) eminyaka (NQF level 6) kuzokubhaliswa noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Okungenani isipiliyoni seminyaka emithathu (3). Okungenani isipiliyono sobukhosi seminyaka emithathu (3) kwikhondo elihlobene. Ukukwazi ukuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuzayo futhi nobungcweti obubonakalayo. Umuntu ophumelelayo kufanele abonise isipiliyono esihle ekubuseni, ekuhlanganiseni iqembu, ekuxhumaneni nabahlanganyeli nasekuhleni izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhalipha. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-NPA, umthetho kanye nezimiso zenkonzo yomphakathi, i-PFMA kanye nemiyalo yomphakathi ephathelene lapho kubalulekile. Lesi sikhundla sifuna umuntu ongakha phambili, ohlelwe kanye nongazinikela ngokwenza izinkonzo ofana khona khulu, onawo amakhono aphezulu okukhuluma noku bhala nokubhala, amandla aphezulu okubonakalisa, isipho sosizo sokwahlulela, ukuqaphela imininingwane kanye namandla okuphatha izidingo ezincintisana ngaphansi kwe ndi. Umuntu ophakanyiswayo kufunkelelwa ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, aqinisekile, ahlele kahle, akwazi ukusebenza ngempumelelo endaweni yamakhasimende kanye nokuqhakambisa ukubamba nzulu ezahlukene, ezingaphakathi, phakathi kweminyango kanye namahlebehlangothi amaphesheya.
zu.duties: Nika isekelo sezokubhaliswa ezingeni eliphezulu, sokuhlanganisa kanye nokusebenza esimweni sokusebenza esinamakhasimende amahlebehlangothi, i-Money Laundering Desk, amakhasimende e-REPS nakuba lapho kudingeka khona, amanye amakhasimende aphakathi kwamahlebehlangothi e-National Prosecution Service. Sekela ihhova likahulumeni welunga kanye namayunithi ahlobene ekubuseni ezinkimbinkimbi ezihlanganisa amanyango namahlebehlangothi, ekulungiseni imibiko, ekulandelaneni ukuphumelela nokuvumelaniswa kwemibhalo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kokuqinisekiswa kwesigqibo esithathiwe. Qondisa futhi uhlele abasebenzi bezokubhaliswa ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza kwehhovisi ngokuphumelelayo, izinkonzo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka kanye nokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho. Hlanganisa ukuvakashelwa ngokusemthethweni ngamalunga amanye amazwe namahlebehlangothi aphesheya okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlela kwezinsiza, ukuhamba kwabantu nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli kanye nesekelo sezokubhaliswa. Yenza imisebenzi ehambisana nokwesekwa ngokomthetho kwamanye amazwe, ukudluliselwa kwamalungelo, ukuhlanganiswa kwemali exhunyiwe kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwenkqubo yokugxuma okuhlangene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa, ukuhlela kanye nokulandela imigomo yokuqala. Hlinzeka ngokuhlela ukuvakashelwa kwamakhasimende, ukuhamba kwabantu nasekuhleni imibhalo ehlobene nokusebenza kwamanye amazwe, imayunithi yokuphatha imali yamanye amazwe kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene namakhasimende e-REPS. Buka futhi useke ngokushesha ukuphathwa kwenkqubo yokuhlinzeka ngamahlebehlangothi kanye nezokubhaliswa kwezenkolodo ukuze kuqhakambiswe ukuphumelela, ukuziphendula kanye nobukhosi emakhasimende asekeliwe.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQonda: Ulawulo nokuNxhunywa
xh.summary: Kufuneka iQonda elingumncedisi kwi-National Prosecuting Authority ePretoria ukunika inkxaso yolawulo nokuqwalasela kwimicimbi emininzi yesebe lenkonzo yokuziphatha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile se-B (NQF level 7) okanye iDiploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF level 6) kwi-Administration okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Eminyaka elithoba (3) yamava nangaphezulu. Ubuncinane iminyaka elithoba (3) yamava okulawula kwilizwe elinxulumene nalo msebenzi. Ukuzikhangelisa ngokuzenzela, ngobungcali, ngobuninzi bokuxelwa nangokwaziseka. Umphumeleli makabe nokuziphatha okusesikhathini ekulawuleni, ekwenzeni iqela lisebenze ngokubambisana, ekunxulumeni nabantu basemthethweni nakubhalweni kwamagama alungileyo anesidima. Kuqakathekile ukuba akwazi i-NPA Act, i-Public Service Act nemigaqo, i-PFMA namagazethi olawulo asetyenziswayo kuluntu. Esi sithuba sifuna umuntu oqhuba phambili, othingshelweyo, onesiphithiphithi sekonzo onobuchule bokuthetha nokubhala, onamandla okubonisa, onesigqibo esilula, onomdla kwimicutshe kwaye unako ukulawula imisebenzi ephikisanayo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Umphumeleli makabe nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, athembekile, ahlele kakuhle, akwazi ukusebenza ngokusebenza ngenkqubo eqweni kwaye akwazi ukuziphatha ngobungcali nomntu wonke ongaphakathi, ongaphakathi kwesebe nongaphezu kwamazwe. Ulwazi lolawulo nolunye ulusebenzo.
xh.duties: Kukunikwa inkxaso yolawulo nokuqwalaselwa kwemisebenzi ephezulu kuluntu olusebenzisana namazwe, i-The Money Laundering Desk, i-REPS Component naphi na kwezinye iindawo ezikwi-National Prosecution Service. Kukunikwa inkxaso kuNtloko weluntu kunye namanye amacandelo omlinganiselo ekwenzeni iindibano ezibalulekileyo phakathi kwezinye iintlanga, kulungiselelwa amabali, kulandelelwa imisebenzi nokwenziwa okucace ukuba kusuke kwenziwa into. Kukulawulwa nokukhuthazwa abasebenzi bolawulo ukuze kusebenze kahle ihhotyela, kubekho inkonzo yolwazi kwaye kuthobele imigaqo nayiphi na imigaqo-nkqubo. Kukuqwalaselwa kweendibano zabantu belizwe langesi thuba namanye amanqanaba aphakathi kwamazwe ngokulungiselela okusesikweni, ukunxibelelana noluntu nakunye inkxaso yolawulo. Kukwenziwa imisebenzi enxulumene nencedo ngokomthetho olungamkelwayo, ukubuyiswa kwamaxa, ukulawulwa kobutyobo bomali nakunye inkxabo yokuziphatha, kuqwalaselwe iindibano, ulawulo lwamagama nakulandelelwa oko kuxeliweyo. Kukulungelelwa ukulungelelwa kolwazi, ukunxibelelana noluntu nendlela zokuhamba ezinxulumene nokusebenzisana namazwe, izinto zobutyobo bomali nakumasebenzi e-REPS. Kukuqwalaselwa nokukhusela ukuba kusuke kwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo inkqubo yolawulo lwe-supply chain management nolawulo lwabantu kwaye kukhuthazwa ubuninzi bokuxelwa, ukuphendula nobungcali kulo lonke uluntu olunikwa inkxaso.

At least three (3) years functional / technical experience in the field of Human Resource Management (HR Planning or Strategies, Employment Equity/Diversity). Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. In depth knowledge of human resource management processes and systems including PERSAL. Understanding of Human Resource Management Methodologies, Principles and Strategies. Understanding of employment legislation within the Public Service, i.e, Public Service Act and Regulations, Employment Equity Act and Regulations, Labour Relations Act. Experience in Programme/Project Management. Quality Assurance. Experience in Stakeholder or Client Relations. Ability to work independently. A valid driver’s licence.

Coordinate Human Resource Audits and Perform Human Resource Report reconciliations. Facilitate the collection of data for Employment Equity (EE) planning and participate in the development, implementation and reporting processes. Coordinate the development of the Annual Operational Plan for the Human Resource Management & Development Unit and the reporting thereof. Implement human resource planning strategies and processes. Coordinate and facilitate reporting on Employment Equity Targets. Coordinate HR Information and compile reports. Facilitate the development and implementation of MTEF HR Plan and implementation thereof. Provide HR planning and monitoring services by developing policies and monitoring consistent compliance with prescripts. Facilitate HR forecasting in line with organizational strategy. Develop and maintain HR data bank for analysis, standard and ad-hoc statistical reports. Render workforce planning advisory and support services. Conduct research and provide recommendations to inform organizational capacity requirements. Conduct benchmark with various institutions for human resource best practices. Provide the secretariat and administrative support to the Human Resource Planning, Human Resource Transformation and other Consultative Fora in the organization. Participate in different Transformation Unit projects and events.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning
af.summary: Bestuur HR-beplanningsprosesse, ontwikkel HR-planne en koördineer HR-oudits by die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag Hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte B-graad (NQF vlak 7) of Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF vlak 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Administrasie of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste drie (3) jaar funksionele / tegniese ervaring in die veld van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur (HR-beplanning of -strategieë, Indiensnemingsgelykheid/Diversiteit). Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Diepgaande kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuursprosesse en -stelsels insluitend PERSAL. Ontwikkel 'n HR-plan en aanpassing wanneer nodig; Fasiliteer navorsing of opnames oor arbeidsmagverwante aangeleenthede. Koördineer Menslike Hulpbron-oudits en voer Menslike Hulpbron-verslagafstemming uit. Fasiliteer die versameling van data vir Indiensnemingsgelykheids-(EE-)beplanning en neem deel aan die ontwikkelings-, implementerings- en verslagdoeningsprosesse.
