zu.title: Umncedisi weDoli: Ukuhlelwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu
zu.summary: Phatha inqubo yokuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu, lukela izinhlelo ezintsha, futhi uhlele ukuhlola izinsiza zabantu eHHhovisi Elikhulu le-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-degree elifanele (NQF level 7) noma i-Diploma lonyaka othathu (3) (NQF level 6) kokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu, uKuphathwa noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Ukwaziswa okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) ngokusebenza / ubuchwepheshe ekundeni kokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu (Ukuhlelwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu noma Izindlela, Ukulingana Kokwesitya/Ukubakho Kokuhlukahluka). Ukukwazi ukubonisa ukuzibophezela ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobubele nokwethembeka. Ukuqonda ngokujulile izinqubo nezinhlelo zokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu kubandakanya i-PERSAL. Ukuqonda izindlela, imigomo nezindlela zokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Ukuqonda umthetho wokwesitya kazwelonke emsebenzini kahulumeni, i.e, i-Public Service Act nezilawulo zayo, i-Employment Equity Act nezilawulo zayo, i-Labour Relations Act. Ukwaziswa ekuphathweni kweNhlelo/Umklamo. Ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokulingana kokuhlolwa. Ukwaziswa ekuhlotshaneni nabathintekayo noma abakhasimende. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi uphathe izinqubo nokulawula ukuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Cakula inqubo yokuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu futhi ulungise lapho kunesidingo; Phatha ucwaningo noma izibalo ezihlobene nomsebenzi wamandla abasebenzi. Hlela ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza zabantu futhi wenze ukuqondanisa kwezibambo ezingezinsiza zabantu. Phatha ukuqoqwa kolwazi ukuze kuhlelwe i-Employment Equity (EE) futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekucakulweni, ukusetshenzisweni nakwenziweni kwezibambo. Hlela ukucakula i-Annual Operational Plan yeNqubo yokuphathwa Nokuhlakuliswa Kwezinsiza Zabantu nokubika ngayo. Setshenzisa izindlela nezinqubo zokuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Hlela futhi uphathe ukubikwa ngemigomo yamakhibhoni e-Employment Equity. Hlela ulwazi olumayelana nezinsiza zabantu futhi uhlele izibambo. Phatha ukucakula nokusetshenziswa kohlaka lwe-MTEF HR Plan nokusetshenziswa kwalo. Nikeza izinsiza zokuqhathanisa nokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi ngokucakula imigayo nokulawula ukuzigqatsa ngokungaguqukiyo nemigomosi. Phatha ukubikezelwa kwezinsiza zabantu ngokuhambisana nendlela enkulu yenhlangano. Cakula futhi ulondoloze idatha yezinsiza zabantu ukuze kuqoqwe ngokuhlaziya, ngokuqgontiwa nakuhlelwa izibambo ezingavamile kanti futhi nasezimeni eziguqulayo. Nikeza izeluleko ngokuhlelwa abasebenzi futhi usize ngokusebenza. Yenza ucwaningo futhi unikeze izindulela eziyisileke ukuzazi izidingo zamandla enhlangano. Hola izinkomba ngasezinyathelweni ukuthola izindlela ezingcono kakhulu ezindaweni ezihlukene. Nikeza inkundla ngesekela esibusweni kuhlelo lohlelo kwezinsiza zokuhlelwa, ezinguqulweni zamandla abantu nokwelinye i-Fora eLusizeni ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Thatha inxaxheba kwizinhlelo nezinkundla ezihlukahlukene zoMnyango Wezinguqulo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: uLungelelwaniso lweZabasebenzi
xh.summary: Phatha iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso lwezabasebenzi, phuhlisa iindawo zolungelelwaniso lwezabasebenzi, kwaye uhlele ukuhlolwa kwezabasebenzi kwiNdlu enkulu yeNkulumbuso yoMmeli kaBukhosi ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo B - (NQF level 7) okanye iDiploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF level 6) kuLawulo lweZabasebenzi, uluLawulo okanye isigaba esilinganayo. Bonke ubuncinane iimveliso zeminyaka emithathu (3) zokusebenza / isipiliwu esisezantsini kwinkundla yoLawulo lweZabasebenzi (iNqubo yoLungelelwaniso okanye amacebiso, uLungelelwaniso lwabasebenzi/Inkxalabo). Ubungakanani obubonakalayo bokuziphatha Ngabodwa, ngobugcisa, konokuxhaswa ngenethemba. Ulwazi olunzulu ngenkqubo nezicwangciso zolawulo lwabasebenzi kuquka i-PERSAL. Ukuqonda iindlela, amagunya amaninzi namacebiso oLawulo lweZabasebenzi. Ukuqonda umthetho wokubakwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi koNkonzo lokuZweni, oko kukuthi, uMthetho woNkonzo noMthetho weziKhululo, uMthetho woLungelelwaniso lwabasebenzi noMthetho weziKhululo, uMthetho weNxululano yabaSebenzi. Isipiliwu kuLawulo lweNkqubo/amaPhojekthi. uQinisekiso lomgangatho. Isipiliwu kuNxibelelwano namaHlombe okanye oThengi. Ulwazi lokuzinikela ngabodwa. Ilayisense yomqhubi esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Hlela uphatha iNqubo zoLungelelwaniso lweZabasebenzi nokuLawula. Phuhlisa icebo loLungelelwaniso lwabaSebenzi kwaye ulungise xa kudingeka; Yenza iphondo lezinto zokulinganisa okanye imibuzo ngeembona ezimalunga namabakada abasebenzi. Hlela ukuQondaniswa kwezabaSebenzi kwaye uQondise izibongozo ngokubakwa kwabaSebenzi. Yenza ukuqokelelwa kwezibalo zoLungelelwaniso lwabaSebenzi (EE) ukuya kwicebo kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwizinxaxheba, ukuSetyenziswa nokubika. Hlela ukusetyenziswa kweNkqubo yoNyaka woLawulo lweNqubo yeYunithi yoLawulo noVuselelo lweZabasebenzi nokuBika ngayo. Zisebenzisa iindlela nqubo zolungelelwaniso lwabasebenzi. Hlela uphuhlise ukuBika ngeziNhloso zoLungelelwaniso lwabaSebenzi. Hlela iNkcazelo ngeZabasebenzi kwaye uqokele iinkcazelo. Yenza iphondo lokuqonda nokusetyenziswa kweNkqubo ka-MTEF nokuQondaniswa kwayo. Yazi iinkonzo zolungelelwaniso nokuqwalasela ngokuphuhlisa iinkqubo nokuqwalasela ukuze kuhambelane nemithetho. Yenza uLungelelwaniso lokuQikelela ngokwamaqondo enkampani. Phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze idatha yamabhengi eZabasebenzi yahlalutyo, iingxelo ezingangqamanga nezongezelelweyo ezibalela ngokwesibalo. Yazi iinkonzo zokuNika icebiso nokuNxibelelana ngeNqubo yoQwalaselo lwabaSebenzi. Yenza izifundo kwaye unike iingcebiso eziza kuxhasa iimfuno zomthamo wenkampani. Qondanisa ngeziko lezihloahlombe ngokwamagunya amaninzi amnyni oLawulo lweZabasebenzi. Nikeza inkxaso ngokubhaliswa nolawulo oluncinci kwiNqubo yoLungelelwaniso lweZabasebenzi, uGuqulo lweZabasebenzi nakuwo onke amaFora eNgingqi enkampani. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphojekthi neziganeko ezahlukeneyo zeYunithi yoGuqulo.

jobs.title: Human Resources Clerk: Supervisor
jobs.centre: DPP: Makhanda (Grahamstown) Ref No: Recruit 2026/358 DPP: Kimberley Ref No: Recruit 2026/359
jobs.summary: Human Resources Clerk supervisor positions at the National Prosecuting Authority in Makhanda and Kimberley, requiring a degree or diploma with two years of HR experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B degree (NQF level 7) or Three (3) year Diploma (NQF level 6). Minimum two (2) years’ relevant experience in Human Resources Administration. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Working knowledge of PERSAL. Knowledge of legislation and regulations pertaining to public service administration, specifically: the Public Service Act and Regulations, NPA Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act. Knowledge of HR information management. Computer literacy in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Excellent administrative skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Good planning and organizing skills. Problem solving skills. Sound co- ordination, administrative skills.
jobs.duties: Administer recruitment and selection. Preside as an HR rep for shortlisting and interviews. Prepare appointment memorandum. Administer the implementation of service benefits. Ensure processing of leave on PERSAL. Approve transactions on PERSAL. Conduct leave inspections and compile report. Processing of performance rewards (pay progression and grade progression). Implementation of labour relations awards. Implementation of salary structures and updating of personnel information. Process resettlement benefits. Process recognition of long service. Process housing allowance. Process internal transfers. Oversee leave implementation and staff terminations. Process injury on duty. Monitor the processing of salary adjustment. Implementation of job evaluation results. Oversee all Human Resources Administration functions. Supervise staff in the relevant section. Implement and ensure compliance with policies and procedures.

af.title: Personeelklerk: Toesighouer
af.summary: Personeelklerk-toesighouerposisies by die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag in Makhanda en Kimberley, wat 'n graad of diploma met twee jaar se ondervinding in menslike hulpbronne vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad (NQF-vlak 7) of 'n Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF-vlak 6). Minimum twee (2) jaar se relevante ondervinding in Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Werkende kennis van PERSAL. Kennis van wetgewing en regulasies wat op openbare diensadministrasie van toepassing is, spesifiek: die Openbare Dienswet en Regulasies, NPA-wet, Basiese Voorwaardes van Dienswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Indiensneemingsgelykheidswet, Vaardigheidsontwikkelingswet. Kennis van inligtingsbestuur van menslike hulpbronne. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, Excel, Outlook en PowerPoint. Uitstekende administratiewe vaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Deeglike koördinasie- en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.duties: Administreer werwing en seleksie. Tree as HR-vertegenwoordiger by kortlyssamestelling en onderhoude op. Berei aanstellingsmemorandum voor. Administreer die implementering van diensvoordele. Verseker verwerking van verlof op PERSAL. Keur transaksies op PERSAL goed. Voer verlofinspeksies uit en stel verslag op. Verwerking van prestasietoekenning (salarisprogressie en graadprogressie). Implementering van arbeidsverhoudingstoekennings. Implementering van salarisstrukture en opdatering van personeelinligting. Verwerk hervestigingsvoordele. Verbeelding van erkenning vir langdiens. Verbeelding van behuisingsuitkering. Verbeelding van interne oorplasings. Hou toesig oor verlof-implementering en personeelbeëindigings. Verbeelding van besering in diens. Monitor die verwerking van salarisaanpassing. Implementering van werkevaluasieresultate. Hou toesig oor alle Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie-funksies. Toesig hou oor personeel in die toepaslike afdeling. Implementeer en verseker nakoming van beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Iklerki ezomunthu: Umphathi
zu.summary: Izikhundla sabaphathi beziklerki bezomunthu e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Makhanda nase-Kimberley, esifuna iziqu noma idiploma okuphezelelwe iminyaka emibili yomsebenzi wezomunthu.
zu.requirements: I-degree elungile (NQF level 7) noma i-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF level 6). Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yomhlalaphiyi kokuhlobene nokuqashwa kwezabasebenzi ezomunthu. Ukukhombisa ikhono lokusebenza kodwa, ngobungcweti, ngobusethu nangokuqotho. Ulwazi lokusebenza nge-PERSAL. Ulwazi lomthetho nemithesho ehlobene nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi basezikhungweni zikahulumeni, ikakhulukazi: u-Mthetho kanye nemithesho yesevisi yikahulumeni, u-Mthetho we-NPA, u-Mthetho we-Basic Conditions of Employment, u-Mthetho we-Labour Relations, u-Mthetho we-Employment Equity, u-Mthetho we-Skills Development. Ulwazi lokuqashwa kolwazi lwezomunthu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-MS Word, Excel, Outlook, ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono aphezulu oluqashwa. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuKhipha amagama. Amakhono amahle okuhlela nokuhlela. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono aphezulu okuqhubekeka nokulawula izinto.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuqashwa nokuKhethwa. Ukuba ngumeluleki wezomunthu ekuthpheni nasekuhloleni abantu. UkuKwelisa imemo yokuhlinzwa ngesikhundla. Ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinzuzo zomsebenzi. UkuQinisekisa ukuphathwa kwevela e-PERSAL. UkuVuma izinhlela e-PERSAL. Ukwenza izilinganiso zevela ukwenze umbiko. Ukuphatha imikhomelo yentengo (ukunyuka kwehholo nokuNqamula ngezinga). Ukusetshenziswa kwemiklomelo yomabutho. Ukuphatha izakhiwo ze-Randi nokushintsha izinkomba zomuntu. UkuSetshenziswa kwesikhundla. UkuQashwa kokuqashwa kwethuba. Ukuphatha imali yendlu. UkuSetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuKleliswa. UkuHlela ukusetshenziswa kwevela nokuqeda kwabasebenzi. Ukuqasha izinkinga kumsebenzi. Ukwenza umbiko ngemali yokulungisa. Ukuphatha imiklomelo yokubuyekeza. UkuBeka ukubukeka kwezinhlelo zokuhlela. UkuHlelela zonke izinhlelo zokuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha abantu esigabeni. Ukwenza futhi uQinisekise ukulandelwa kwezinqumo nemithelelo yomsebenzi.

xh.summary: Izithuba zomkhweli weClerk yoBucwengwa babantu kwi-National Prosecuting Authority e-Makhanda nase-Kimberley, difuna isidanga okanye idiploma eneminyaka emibini yamava kwoBucwengwa babantu.

Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcalu, ngokubathathela nxaxheba nangokwesigqibo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusebenzisa i-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nangemimiselo echotswe kuLawulo yoluntu lukarhulumente, ngokukodwa: isi-Act se-Public Service nemiMiselo yaso, isi-Act se-NPA, isi-Act se-Basic Conditions of Employment, isi-Act se-Labour Relations, isi-Act se-Employment Equity, nesi-Act se-Skills Development. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwamaxhoba oBucwengwa babantu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook, naku-PowerPoint. Amakhono aphezulu oLawulo. Amakhono amabalweni okubhala nokuthetha. Amakhono okucinga nokulungiselela. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono alungileyo okuhambelana nolawulo.
xh.duties: Lawula ubhaliso nentseto. Yiba ngumuntu wee-HR kwirekhodi nase kuluntu olutsha njengoko kubekwe. Lungiselela isiNqanaba somsebenzi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwezenzo ngokusisonga ngokwemisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthungathwa kwesikhundla kwi-PERSAL. Vumela imisebenzi nomyalezo ngokusetyenziswa kwe-PERSAL. Yenza iindwendwe ngokutya kwexesha kwaye udidiye iireports. Ukuthungathwa kweembuyekezo zobukhosi (i-pay progression naku-grade progression). Ukusetyenziswa kweembuyekezo ezixhwele ku Labour Relations. Ukusetyenziswa kweendlela zomvuzo nokuNikela ngolwazi kubasebenzi. Thungatha iindlela zokuphela komsebenzi. Thungatha iinkqubo zokuqatshelwa kobukhosi. Thungatha iindlela zokuphathwa kweendlu. Thungatha iindlela zokugqibela ngaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweinkqubo yokutya kwexesha kwaye ubhale iinguquko ezingagqibekanga. Thungatha iinkqubo zokulimala ngelixa kusebenza. Lilise ukuthungathwa kweembuyekezo zomvuzo. Ukusetyenziswa kweempendulo ze- HR Administration. Lawula yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha ngokweenkqubo zabantu oBucwengwa. Beka abasebenzi apha ekubeni bangabakhweli babantu. Setyenzise nokuQinisekisa ukuzaliseka kwemigaqo nokuLawulwa kwemisebenzi.

af.title: Hofvoorbereidingsbeampte
af.summary: Die Nasionale Aanklaaggesag soek 'n Hofvoorbereidingsbeampte in Bloemfontein om sorg en ondersteuning aan slagoffers en getuies binne die hofomgewing te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte B-graad (NQF level 7) of Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF level 6) in Sosiale Wetenskappe/Gedragsstudies of gelykwaardig. Ten minste een (1) jaar werkervaring wat ervaring tydens opleiding ingesluit. Toonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Deeglike koördinasie- en beradingervaring. Vermoë om goed met kinders te werk. Kennis van die Strafregsplegingstelsel. Uitstekende administratiewe vaardighede, goeie kommunikasievaardighede en probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bied holistiese en geïntegreerde sorg aan slagoffers van misdaad, kliënte en getuies binne die hofomgewing. Voorkom sekondêre traumatisering deur 'n veilige en beveiligde omgewing te bied waarin getuig kan word. Implementeer hofvoorbereiding vir kinders en volwasse slagoffers van misdaad, kliënte en getuies en voer alle ander pligte in verband daarmee uit. Skakel met en doen verslag aan die Aanklaer/Bestuurder. Voer alle pligte uit ooreenkomstig algemeen aanvaarde hofvoorbereidingstegniek.

zu.title: Inkulu YokuLungiselela Iinkomishi
zu.summary: I-National Prosecuting Authority ifuna uNkululeko WokuLungiselela Iinkomishi eBloemfontein ukuze anikeze ukunakekelwa nokusekela abayobe bahlonziwe abayobe befakwe izikhalazo nami ngaphakathi kwesikhungo senkomishi.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele se-B Degree (NQF level 7) noma i-Diploma yeminyaka eyi-Three (3) (NQF level 6) kwi-Social Science/Behavioural Studies noma okulingana naleyo. Amave alungelelaniswa nokuwelula. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle nabantwana. Ulwazi nge-Criminal Justice System. Ikhono elilodwa lokulawula, izilulumagama ezilodwa nokusombulula iingxaki.
zu.duties: Nika ukunakekelwa okubandakanyeke nangaphezu koko abayobe bahlonziwe kwimaxeba, abathengi kwaye ngabafakwe izikhalazo abayobe befakwe izikhalazo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo senkomishi. Thintela ukulingana ngokwesibini ngokunika isikhundla esikhuselweyo nesizinzileyo apho baya kubakho bafakwe izikhalazo. Zenze iNkqubo yokuLungiselela iinkomishi kubantwana nakuqinisekiswa ngokuchanekileyo abafakwe izikhalazo abayobe bahlonziwe abayobe befakwe izikhalazo, abathengi kwaye ngabafakwe izikhalazo kwaye wenze yonke imisebenzi eminye ehambelana naleyo. Goeie kennis van regeringsprogramme, projektebestuur en koördinasievaardighede, kliëntgerig en op die klient gefokus. Kommunikasievaardighede en rekenaargeletterdheid. zu.title: Mogedi Wezokuxhumana (MULTIMEDIA)
zu.summary: Umogedi wezokuxhumana wemultimedia eNational Prosecuting Authority Head Office ePretoria, okhiqiza futhi ahlele okuqukethwe kwamafoto namavidiyo.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ebanzi (NQF 7) noma i-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF Level 6) kwi-Multimedia, i-Digital Media Design, i-Digital Marketing, i-Communication, i-Public Relations noma enye indlela ehlobene nayo njengoba kuhlonishwe yi-SAQA. Ukwazi okuncane eminyakeni emibili (2) okuhlobene nokukhiqizwa kwemultimedia / ukudalwa kokuqukethwe okwdijithali. I-Driver's Licence esebenzayo. Ukuze kube khona ukuqashelwa kokusebenza njengo-Multimedia Specialist, i-Multimedia Officer, i-Digital Content Creator noma esinye isikhundla esifanayo. Ukubonakala kokuqhuba ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobumniningwane nokwethemba. Ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi uhlangabezane nesikhathi esibekiwe nsuku zonke. Ukuthembeka, kanye namageyiga oxhumana nabantu nokusebenza njengomqanjana. Ukulawula isikhathi nokulawula izinguquko. Ukuqonda kahle izinhlelo zahulumeni, ukulawula izinhlela nokuhlela izinto, ukugxila kumthengi nokugxila ekwenzeni umthengi ajabule. Amageyiga wezokuxhumana nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubekezela kwi-Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator), i-Apple Mac OS, i-DaVinci Resolve, i-Canva kanye ne-Microsoft Office Suite. Ukuqonda ngobuchwepheshe okuqinile kwamateknoloji emultimedia, amapulatifomu wadijithali, nempahla yokukhiqiza. Ukuqashelwa kokusebenza kwamavidiyo, ukuthatha amafoto, ukuhlela amavidiyo, ukwakhiwa kwemidwebo yadijithali nokukhiqizwa kokuqukethwe okwdijithali. Ikhono lokusebenzisa amakhamera e-DSLR/SLR aphantshi, amakhamera amavidiyo, impahla yomsindo, impahla yokukhanyisa kanye nezinye izinto zokukhiqiza imultimedia. Ukuqashelwa kokuphatha imicimbi esixubeneyo nokusakaza ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuqashelwa kokuthatha, ukukhetha, ukuhlela, ukuthuthukisa nokulondoloza amafoto namavidiyo aphantsi. Ukuqonda nokusebenza ekulawulweni kwamapulatifomu wadijithali, okuhlanganisa iwebhusayithi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, i-intranet kanye ne-Viva Engage. Ukuqashelwa ekushayweni kwesibongo, ekuqondiseni imicimbi, nakokuthuthukiswa nokukhiqizwa kokuqukethwe. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza ithuba eliguquguqukayo uma kudingeka. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngempahla ezindayo okuhlanganisa amatripodi, amakhebhelu, ukukhanya kanye nempahla yokupodikhasi.
zu.duties: Ukukhiqiza okuqukethwe kwamafoto namavidiyo okunesibindi sabantu abahlukene. Ukukhiqiza futhi uhlele okuqukethwe kwamafoto namavidiyo okkhwalithi ephezulu kubantu abahlukene kusetshenziswa i-Adobe Creative Suite kanye nobunye ubucwaningo obuhlobene. Ukusebenzisa indlela yokuxoxa ngokubonakalayo, okuhlanganisa ukuphila kwamaphathi nokudweba amafomu, kuzinkundla ezahlukene zemultimedia. Ukucabanga, ukuhlela, futhi uphathe izinhlela zemultimedia kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekupheleni. Ukwenza amafoto namavidiyo aphantsi. Ukubonisa okuqukethwe ngendlela ephumelelayo futhi usebenziswe nabanye, kubonakalisa amageyiga amakhulu wezokuxhumana nokuzwa. Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokunyansa nokunaka imininingwane kuyo yonke imiphumela.

xh.title: Iofisa Wezothutho (MULTIMEDIA)
xh.summary: Iofisa wezothutho kwiNational Prosecuting Authority Head Office ePretoria, ovelisa ahlela imixholo yamafoto neemvelo.
xh.requirements: I-degree elifanelekileyo (NQF 7) okanye i-Diploma yaseLwazwe (NQF Level 6) leminyaka emithathu (3) kwiMultimedia, Digital Media Design, Digital Marketing, Communication, Public Relations okanye indawo enxulumene nayo njengoko kusikwa ngayo yiSAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angaphezulu kweminyaka emibili (2) ekubumbeni izithuthi / ekudaleni imixholo yedijithali. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amava obusebenzo abonisiweyo njengoMultimedia Specialist, Multimedia Officer, Digital Content Creator okanye indima efanayo. Ulwazi olubonakalisekayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngenkathalo nangokuzithemba. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye uhlale uhlangabezana nemigaqo yemini yonke ngemini. Uthembekile, unobuchule bokuxhumanisa nabantu nokusebenza ngezinye. Ukulawula ixesha nokulawula utshintsho. Ulwazi olululu lwamacebo karhulumente, ukulawula iiprojekthi namakhono okuhlela, ukugxila kumaxhwebelekazi kwaye ugxile kumaxhwebelekazi. Amakhono othetho nobugcisa bokusebenza ngakumbi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iAdobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator), iApple Mac OS, iDaVinci Resolve, iCanva neMicrosoft Office Suite. Ulwazi olunamandla lobuchule bezithuthi, iiplatformi zedijithali, nempahla yokubumba. Amava kwivideyografi, kwifotografi, ekulaleni amavidiyo, ekuyilweni iigrafu nasekudaleni imixholo yedijithali. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iikam ezibusiweyo zeDSLR/SLR, iikam zefayida, iimpahla zesandi, iimpahla zokukhanya nezinye izixhobo ezinxulumene nokubumba izithuthi. Amava ekulawulenii amacelo ahlanganisiweyo nasekusasazeni ngokuphila. Amava ekuthatheni, ekukhetheni, ekulaleni, ekuphuculeni nasekugcineni amafoto namavidiyo abungcali. Ulwazi namava ekulawuleni iiplatformi zedijithali, kuquka iwebhusayithi, iindaba, i-intranet neViva Engage. Amava ekuyileni iimpahla, ekulawuleni amacelo, nasekudaleni nokubumba imixholo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure eziguquguqukayo xa kufuneka. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza nempahla enzima kuquka iithripodhi, iikhebhu, ukukhanya nempahla yepodkasting.
xh.duties: Ukuvelisa imixholo yamafoto neefayida ethandwayo kumaxhwebelekazi ahlukahlukeneyo. Ukuvelisa ahlela imixholo yamafoto neefayida eyiphotograph nezobungcali kumaxhwebelekazi ahlukahlukeneyo ukusebenzisa iAdobe Creative Suite nesoftware ezinye ezinxulumene. Ukusebenzisa ukudibana okubonwayo ngemifanekiso, kuquka ukunyuka okusisiseko nokuyila iigrafu, kwiiplatformi ezahlukahlukeneyo zezithuthi. Ukuca, ukuhlela, ukulawula iiprojekthi zezithuthi ukusuka kwinguqo ukuya kokuhanjiswa. Ukwenza ifotografi neseyidiografi yobungcali. Ukubonisa imixholo ngokusebenzayo kwaye udibane nabathinti nabanomdla, ubonise amakhono amaninzi othetho nokulalela. Ukugcina amanqanaba aphezulu ekuchanekeni ngenyamelwano ekunxulumene nayo yonke imveliso.

Okungenani amava eminyakeni emi-2 kumkhakha wezokuxhumana. Isiqu esibonakalayo sokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuzima nangokwesithunzi. Ulwazi oluyisiseko ngezomthetho nezilawula ezithinta ikakhululu kwenkulisa kahulumeni, ikakhululu: i-Public Service Act and Regulations, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-NPA Act, i-Access to information Act, iziqondiso ze-DPSA. Ulwazi ngomphakathi kahulumeni, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle, izikhasana ezindidlululwayo, ukukhangisa nokuyiqamba, ukubhala izindaba, ukuphatha kabusha nokuhlolisisa. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo kanye nendlela zenziwa ngayo izinto ku-NPA. Izindlela zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha: i-MS Office Suite, i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-Outlook, i-PowerPoint, i-MS Project. Ukulungisa izinto, ukuphatha imiklamo, ukuhlazulula nokuhlola izinqubomgomo, ukukhokhela kwezinye izinkampani, ikholo yokuthatha izinqumo, ikholo yokuhlaziula inkinga nokuxazulula, ubudlelwano kumuntu nakumuntu, izindlela zokuxhumana (ezikhaso nangomlomo). Amasimu okubhala izibali esihle kakhulu. Ikholo yokuhlola kwezikhungo noma ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukuphatha ukungabani kwemibono, iplani yokwenza izinto, ukufunda izinto ezingakenziwa, ukubukhonza nokuhola izingqungqulu.
zu.duties: Nika inkinga yezokuxhumana ukwesekwa esiNgangeni. Siza ngemibuzo yabezindaba esiNgangeni. Bhala futhi ukuqamba amazwi abekezelwe abezindaba ukuze avunyelwe. Xhuma imibuzo yabezindaba usize ngempendulo. Nike izindlela zokuxhumana ngomshini ongayena imiyalelo kanye nokuqamba izinto. Ukuphathwa kwezikhashana, ukufundiswa komphakathi nokwazi. Nike ukwesekwa ngokuxhumana emayunithi zebhizinisi zesigaba nakubaphathi bokulunga kwezinkampani. Yisa izidingo eziyisicefe e-Khasho ngokubeka izindatshana ngokuphathwa ngaphansi kwesikhathi esingenamtholula. Khuluma ngokuhamba kahle ngamaphuzu okusebenza emibonweni yamathuluzi abekezelwe ukugcina abasebenzi bakwazi okuqhubekayo. Siza abantu abadlula ibanga elingeni phakathi njengoba kuyisikhungo sezohlelo, i-EWP, i-IMU, i-HR kanye nokuholisana ngezehlo ezakha umphakathi futhi namahlelo azobe ehlezi lapho ngaphandle. Bonisa ulwazi olukhulu futhi usebenzane nenhlangano isuke ibonakale ibamba isixhumi esihle sokuxhumana nokuqonda. Gcina amaphuzu okucophelela nokuxhumana okusebenza ngokufanayo yonke imisebenzi.

xh.title: Iofisa wokunxibelelana
xh.summary: Iofisa wokunxibelelana kwi-National Prosecuting Authority e-Gqeberha ofuna idigri okanye idiploma kwindalo yokunxibelelana okanye njalo kwelasebenzi ngamava eminyaka mibini efanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-B Degree (NQF 7) efanelekileyo okanye iDiploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6) kwelasebenzi le-Communications / Public Relations / Journalism / Media Studies okanye okulinganayo. Amava amabalwa (2) eminyaka kwindalo yokunxibelelana. Ukuchazwa kukwazi ukusebenza kodwa, ngokubambelelayo, ngokunyaniseka nangokuqonda. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemithetho nezicwangciso ezimali nemithetho yesebenza lolwazi olufanelekileyo kwinkqubo yophando yolonwabo, ngokukodwa: isiNgqangqthu somthetho nokusebenza koluntu, imithetho yaqanjwa ngokweenkonzo, imithetho yalawulo lemali yaseburhulumente, isiNgqangqthu sika-NPA, imithetho yoxhwitho, izalathiso ze-DPSA. Ulwazi ngoluntu, ulwazi olubambe ukusebenza ngokwahlukeneyo, uqhagamshelano lwangaphakathi nangaphandle, iintshatsho zokwazisa, ukuziphakamisa nokubakhanya, ukubhala iindaba, ukuhlola nokulungisa amaphutha. Ulwazi ngokuqonda i-NPA kwaye nendlela yokwenza izinto. Amakhono ekhompyutha: i-MS Office Suite, i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-Outlook, i-PowerPoint, i-MS Project. Ukulungisa, ulawulo lweenkqubo, uqwalaselwa nokwenziwa kweenkqubo, amakhono okulawula abantu, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, uqwalaselwa nokusombulula iingxaki, ubudlelwane nabantu, amakhono okunxibelelana (ngomlomo nangesibhaxu). Amakhono apheleleyo okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono olawulo ixesha nangokwenza izinto. Ukulawula iingxabano, ukuqamba, ukucinga, okubamba iqondo nokuqhuba.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yokunxibelelana kwindawo. Nceda ngemibuzo yabezindalo kule ndawo. Qamba ubhale izitatimende zabezindalo ukuvunywa. Phatha imibuzo yabezindalo uncedise nempendulo. Nikezela ngesiquknadi sikunxibelelana nakwifayikilethi. Ulawulo lweziganeko, ufundo koluntu nokuqaphela. Nikezela inkxaso yokunxibelelana kumagosa aphila kwesithili kwaye ngamagosa aburhulumente abanemvelaphi. Yemka ngokuchanekileyo ukubuyisa izinto kwiKhasho ngokubhala iindatsho ngokusesikweni nangokuqina. Yenza iinkcukacha ngokusebenzise kwazo zonke iindawo ezikunxibelelanweni langaphakathi ukugcina abasebenzi bahlaziywe. Nikezela inkxabo kubathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi njengaseBhulweni leNqongo, i-EWP, i-IMU, i-HR nabalu vo njengenxaxheba kumaxesha oovimba beziganeko nongakhenkethsi bobakho nangaphandle. Bonisa izinto ngokuchanekileyo udibene nabathathi-nxaxheba ubonise amakhono amakhulu okunxibelelana nokulalela. Gcina inqanaba eliphezulu lokunyaniseka nokuchaza kakuhle ngakuzo zonke iinkcukacha ezikhutshiweyo.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerk
jobs.summary: Administrative Clerk providing administrative support at the National Prosecuting Authority office in Mthatha, requiring Grade 12 and computer literacy.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Sound planning and organizing skills, written and verbal communication. General computer literacy skills and knowledge in programs MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint and Outlook. Good people skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to act independently.
jobs.duties: Provide high-quality administrative support to the office. Design and keep a well-organized administrative system for the office. Execute a wide variety of administrative tasks. Draft correspondence to the members of the public, other organisations and State departments. Liaise with corporate services with all matters pertaining to the administrative functioning of the office. Provide administrative support to the legal staff, pertaining to finance, logistical and human resources. Deliver mails, photocopying, faxing, receiving and dispatching documents. Provide court administration services. Assist with the efficient management of court rolls. Submit monthly reports and statistics. Provide case records services.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026362@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre- entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS. The full details can be sourced from the link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk wat administratiewe ondersteuning by die National Prosecuting Authority-kantoor in Mthatha bied, waarvoor Graad 12 en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardig. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Sterk beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, skriftelike en verbale kommunikasie. Algemene rekenaarvaardighede en kennis van programme MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint en Outlook. Goeie mensevaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf hoëgehalte administratiewe ondersteuning aan die kantoor. Ontwerp en onderhou 'n goed georganiseerde administratiewe stelsel vir die kantoor. Voer 'n wye verskeidenheid administratiewe take uit. Opstellen van korrespondensie aan lede van die publiek, ander organisasies en Staatsdepartemente. Skakel met korporatiewe dienste oor alle aangeleenthede rakende die administratiewe funksionering van die kantoor. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die regsgeünardeerde personeel, rakende finansies, logistiek en menslike hulpbronne. Lewer pos, fotokopieer, faks, ontvang en stuur dokumente. Verskaf hofadministrasiedienste. Bied hulp met die doeltreffende bestuur van hofrole. Dien maandelikse verslae en statistieke in. Verskaf saaklêerdienste.

zu.title: Mogwedi Wezokuphatha
zu.summary: Mogwedi Wezokuphatha ohlinzeka ngesekela ezokuphatha ehhovisi le-National Prosecuting Authority e-Mthatha, ofuna ibanga le-12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-12 noma okulinganayo. Amandla abonakalayo okuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobubele nokwethembeka. Amandla ahleliwe ohlela nokuhlela, ukuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma. Amandla ajwayelekile okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nakwizinjiniyela ezinjengo-MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Amandla kahle abantu. Amandla aqinile okuxhumana nabantu nakwamanye. Amandla okuziphatha ngokuzimele.
zu.duties: Nikeza isekela elinominga lezokuphatha ehhovisi. Hlela futhi igcine isimiso ezokuphatha esihleliwe sehhovisi. Qedela inani elikhulu lemisebenzi ezokuphatha. Bhalisa izincwadi ezibhalwa kubantu besidlule, emabuthini nasemazweni. Xhumana namasevisi enkampani kuyo yonke imicabango ethinta ukusebenza kwamahhovisi ezokuphatha. Nikeza isekela ezokuphatha emabarholweni abantu bomthetho, kwezimali, nasezabasebenzi. Thumela iposi, kopa amaphepha, faxa, wamukele futhi uthumele amaphepha. Nikeza amasevisi okuphatha enkantolo. Siza ekuphatheni kakhulu kwamakhasimende enkantolo. Hletha izibalo zeminyuzi nezibalo. Nikeza amasevisi amaphepha ecaleni.

xh.title: Mohlankedi wa Tshebeletso
xh.summary: Mohlankedi wa Tshebeletso o fanang ka tshebeletso ya tshebeletso Ofising ya Taolo ya Bosetšhaba Mthatha, a hloka Grade 12 le tsebo ya khomphuta.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 kapa e lekaneng. Bokhoni ba bontšang ho sebetsa ka Boipuso, ka Boikemisetso, ka Boikarabello le ka Tumello. Bokhoni bo botle ba ho rera le ho hlophisa, puo e ngotsweng le ya molomo. Tsebo ya kakaretso ya khomphuta le tsebo ya mananeo a MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint le Outlook. Bokhoni ba ho sebetsana le batho. Bokhoni bo matla ba ho sebetsana le batho le bofumanedi ba puo. Bokhoni ba ho sebetsa ka boipuso.
xh.duties: Fana ka tshebeletso ya tshebeletso ya boleng bo holimo ofising. Rola le ho bolola mokgwa wa tshebeletso o hlophisitsweng hantle wa ofisi. Phethahatsa mehuta e fapa-fapaneng ya mesebetsi ya tshebeletso. Ngola mangolo ho bang ba lefatshe, mekgatlo e meng le Masebebe a Puso. Kopana le ditirelo tsa khoebo dithaba tsohle tse amanang le ho sebetsa ha tshebeletso ya ofisi. Fana ka tshebeletso ya tshebeletso ho basebetsi ba molao, e amanang le ditjhelete, di-logistical le didiriswa tsa batho. Fana ka ditlhahiso, ho etsa di-copy, ho fax, ho amukela le ho romela ditokomane. Fana ka ditirelo taolo ya khotla. Thusa ho taolo e sebetsang ya di-roll tsa khotla. Fana ka ditlaleho tsa khoeli le dipalopalo. Fana ka ditirelo tsa direkoto tsa kgetsu.

zu.title: Umlobi Wemisebenzi Yenhlangano
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umlobi Wemisebenzi Yenhlangano e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Mbombela ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yenhlangano, ukwakhelela izinhlela zenhlangano kanye nokubhala izincwadi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. Ikhono elibonakalayo lokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuhlakani kanye nokwethembeka. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuhlelela okuhle, ikhono lokuxhumana nokubhala elisetshenziswa ngomlomo. Ikhono elijwayelekilelekho lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nolwazi kumaphrogremu njenge-MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Ikhono elihle lokusebenzana nabantu. Ikhono elikhulu lokuxhumana nomunye umuntu kanye nokucommunicate. Ikhono lokusebenza ngodidi lwakho.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yenhlangano yemgangatho ephezulu kule nhlangano. Yakha ulondoloze uhlelo lwemisebenzi yenhlangano oluhlelwela kahle le nhlangano. Zenza izinhlobo eziningi zemisebenzi yenhlangano. Bhala izincwadi ezibhekise kumuntu ohulumendeni, ezinye izinhlangano neminyango kahulumeni. Xhumana noMnyango wezabalazo kumayelana nayo yonke imibuzo ehlobene nokuqhuba komsitingo wezinto zenhlangano. Nikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yenhlangano kubasebenzi bomthetho, ehlobene nezimali, izinsiza nemisebenzi yabantu. Yenza ukulethwa kwezaposi, ukwenza amakhophi, ukufakisa ngefeksi, ukwamukela nokuthumela izixuku (ngokuqhathaniswa nangaphandle). Nikeza amasevisi obumphathi benkantolo. Siza ekuphatheni okuhle kwezinhlu zenkantolo. Lungeza umbiko wenyanga kanye nokuqoqwa kwezibalo.

xh.title: Umsekeli weenkqubo zolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umsekeli weenkqubo zolawulo e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Mbombela ukubonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo, ukuyila iinkqubo zofiso nokubhala unxibelelwano.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 okanye efanayo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcali, ngobuxanduva nangokwaziseka. Ikhono eliqinileyo lokucwangcisa nokuqamba izinto, nokuxelela ngesandi nakubhalwe. Ikhono eliqhelekileyo lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi kwiinkqubo ezinjenge-MS Word; i-Excel; i-PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Ikhono elilo kwimisebenzi nabantu. Iikhono ezinqamlezile zoxibelelwano nabantu nakunxibelelwano. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimele.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo elungileyo kwofiso. Yila zigcine inkqubo yolawulo ehleliyo kahle kwofiso. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo eyahlukahlukenyo. Bhala unxibelelwano kuwo onke amalungu oluntu, iindawo ezizeyongeniso namasebe kaRhulumente. Qhagamshela nokulawula zonke izinto ezithintela ukusebenza kolawulo kwofiso. Bonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo kumalungu omthetho, ephathelene nezimali, izinto zokuhamba nabantu. Hamba uyihambise iposi, uyikopishe, uyithumele nge-fax, wamkele wathumele amaxwebhu (ngekhompyutha nangaphandle kwayo). Bonelela iinkonzo zolawulo zovenkile. Nceda ekuphathweni okusebenzayo kweenkqubo zamacala zivenkile. Hlela iingxelo zenyanga nezibalo.

jobs.title: Director: Performance and Financial Audit
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Director of Performance and Financial Audit at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, requiring a degree with auditing, Nyukela certificate and five years' managerial audit experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma with Auditing as a subject (NQF Level 7) and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle / senior managerial level in Financial Audit and Performance Audit. Membership of the Institute of Internal Auditors is recommended. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Project management best practice. The Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Risk based Performance Audit and Financial Audit methodologies and procedures. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Interviewing. Analytical and problem- solving ability. Staff and interpersonal relations. Project management. Computer literacy. Business process analysis. Risk and control assessment. Analytical thinking. Work under pressure and meet deadlines.

af.title: Direkteur: Prestasie- en Finansiële Oudit
af.summary: Direkteur van Prestasie- en Finansiële Oudit by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, wat 'n graad met oudit, 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat en vyf jaar se bestuurlike ouditervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad of Gevorderde Diploma met Oudit as 'n vak (NQF Level 7) besit, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingehandig moet word. Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in Finansiële Oudit en Prestasie-Oudit. Lidmaatskap van die Institute of Internal Auditors word aanbeveel. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Best practice in projeksbestuur. The Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Risk based Performance Audit and Financial Audit methodologies and procedures. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Onderhoude voer. Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Personeel- en interpersoonlike betrekkinge. Projeksbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Besigheidsprosesanalise. Risiko- en beheerassessering. Analitiese denke. Onder druk werk en sperdatums nakom.
af.duties: Stel jaarliks die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se strategiese en operasionele plan op in ooreenstemming met die Chief Directorate se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures. Stel die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se operasionele plan teen April elke jaar op. Bestuur die opstel van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se operasionele en prosesrisikoregisterteens teen April elke jaar. Stel die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se gedeelte van die strategiese 3-jaar rolpland en jaarlikse interne ouditplanne teen April elke jaar op. Koördineer met ander interne en eksterne diensversekeringsverskaffers om behoorlike risikodekking te verseker en duplikasie van moeite te minimeer. Bestuur die implementering van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se strategiese en operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met die Chief Directorate se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis. Bestuur die bereiking van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se operasionele plan-doelwitte op 'n deurlopende basis en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering aan die Chief Audit Executive. Bestuur die bereiking van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se risikoregister-aksieplanne op 'n deurlopende basis en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering aan die Chief Audit Executive. Bestuur die bereiking van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se risikoregister-aksieplanne op 'n deurlopende basis en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering aan die Chief Audit Executive. Bestuur die bereiking van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se gedeelte van die interne oudit se strategiese 3-jaar rolpland en jaarlikse interne ouditplanne se lewerings op 'n deurlopende basis en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering aan die Chief Audit Executive. Bestuur die implementering van die Performance and Financial Audit Internal Audit Reports se aksieplanne deur lykbestuur op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die versoeke om vorderingsverslae van lykbestuur oor die implementering van alle tersaaklike aksieplanne oor alle Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se interne ouditverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Analiseer die lykbestuur se status van implementering van aksieplanne van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se interne ouditverslae en verduidelik die statusse met lykbestuurders op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die voorbereiding van vorderingsverslae oor die implementering van bestuursaksieplanne van die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se interne ouditverslag-aanbiedings aan die Audit Committee en Director- General op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se algemene nakoming van die International Institute of Internal Auditors se standaarde op 'n deurlopende basis. Voer kwaliteitsversekerings hersienings uit op die beplannings-, uitvoerings-, verslagdoenings- en sluitingsfases se lewerings van alle Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se ouditprojekte in ooreenstemming met die Internal Audit Methodology en die International Institute of Internal Auditor se standaarde op 'n deurlopende basis. Neem deel aan die Annual Internal Quality Assessment Review en die vyfjaarlikse eksterne kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening en implementeer die aksieplanne van die verslae teen die vasgestelde teiken-datums. Bestuur die staatmaking van die Auditor-General of South Africa op die werk verrig en verslae uitgereik deur die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate maandeliks en doen jaarliks verslag oor vordering aan die Audit Committee en die Director-General. Bestuur die Performance and Financial Audit Directorate se hulpbronne. Bestuur menslike, logistieke en finansiële hulpbronne wat aan hierdie pos toegewys is op 'n deurlopende basis in ooreenstemming met departementele voorskrifte.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukubheka Ngemibekephu Nokuhlolwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokubheka Ngemibekephu Nokuhlolwa Kwezimali eDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ezinokubheka ngemibekephu, isitifiketi seNyukela kanye neminye emihlanu yokuqondisa ukubheka ngemibekephu.

Ubulwe bokungenisa izinto emkhakheni wezimali kanye nokubheka ngemibekephu eminye engu-5 enkundleni yabaphathi abaphakathi / abaphezulu ekubhekeni Ngemibekephu Kwezimali Nokubheka Ngemibekephu Ngemibekephu. Izilinganiso ze-Institute of Internal Auditors. Izindlela nezinqubo zokuBheka Ngemibekephu Ngemibekephu okusemsoco nokuhlolwa kwezimali. Ubudlelwano bomuntu nabantu basezikhundleni nabangane bomsebenzi. Ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuhlaziya izinqubo zebhizinisi. Ukubheka ukuba khona kwezingozi nokuzilawula. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukusebenza ngocindezeli kanye nokugcwalisa izikhathi ezibekiwe.

xh.title: Abaphathi: Performance and Financial Audit
xh.summary: Umfundi we Performance and Financial Audit kwisebe le Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria, efunesidinqika kunye noqeqesho lokuhlola, isatifikethi se Nyukela neminyaka emihlanu yamava abaphathi abahlolyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno eziphakamileyo: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kwaye babe ne Bachelor’s Degree okanye i Advanced Degree ekwi Auditing njengesifundo (NQF Level 7) kwaye nenatifikethi le Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) elicelwe phambi kokwamkelwa. Ubuncinane i 5 yeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi neliphezulu labaphathi kwi Financial Audit ne Performance Audit. Iinkqubela kwiziko labaqinisekisi bemingcele yangaphakathi zicebisa ukuba kubekho ilungelo. Ifayili yedrayiva esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinto eziphakamileyo zolawulo lwezi projekthi. I Standards zesiko labaqinisekisi bemingcele yangaphakathi. Iindlela nenqubo ze Risk based Performance Audit ne Financial Audit. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (lwemilomo nolubhaliweyo). Iintervyu. Ikhono lokuhlalanywa nokusombulula iingxaki. Amamakadwa nobudlelwane phakathi kwebakha. Ulawulo lwezi projekthi. Ulwazi lwengxowonqongo. Ukuhlalanywa kwenqubo yeshishini. Iqondo lokuba nayidatha nokulawulwa kwayo. Ukucinga okuyiyoyilahlalwa. Ukusebenza ngoxhuzwakrazu nokuphumeza iimihla yokuhela.
xh.duties: Hlela icebo lokusebenza elinenqanaba nelamasiko le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngokwamagqabantela wolawulo oluthathu ngokwemigaqo yekhwalithi, iindlela ezisetyenziswa, iinkqubo namagqabantela ngonyaka. Hlela icebo lokusebenza elamasiko le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngo-April ngamnye. Lawula ukuhlelwa kwezarejista ezithintwa nokusebenza kwelingo likwingqungqwe le Performance and Financial Audit ngo-April ngamnye. Hlela iqela le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit kwi strategic 3- year rolling namaza wangaphakathi ngamnye ngo-April ngamnye. Qamba kunye nabanye bakuqinisekisa inkonzo ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwelingo kwaye kuncitshiswe okuphindaphindwayo. Lawula ukusebenza kwe strategic namaza asebenza e Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngokwemigaqo yekhwalithi, iindlela ezisetyenziswa, iinkqubo namagqabantela ngokusukelela. Lawula ukufezwa kwemigangatho yamaza asebenza e Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngokusukelela kwaye ucocisele inkqubela kwi Chief Audit Executive nyanga ngamnye. Lawula ukufezwa kwezenzo zokubeka ilungiselelo kwizarejista zelingo le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngokusukelela kwaye ucocisele inkqubela kwi Chief Audit Executive nyanga ngamnye. Lawula ukufezwa kwezenzo zokubeka ilungiselelo kwizarejista zelingo le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit ngokusukelela kwaye ucocisele inkqubela kwi Chief Audit Executive nyanga ngamnye. Lawula ukufezwa kwezenzo ezikwicala le Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit kwe strategic 3-year rolling namaza wangaphakathi ngokusukelela kwaye ucocisele inkqubela kwi Chief Audit Executive nyanga ngamnye. Lawula ukusebenza kwe Performance and Financial Audit Internal Audit Reports’ Action Plans ngabaphathi bemigca ngokweshumi elithathu lenyaka. Lawula iimfuno ezivela kubaphathi bemigca zamagqabo athintelwa kukusetyenziswa kwezenzo zonke ezikwigqabantela elifanelekileyo kwizingxelo zonke ze Performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s internal audit kweshumi elithathu lenyaka. Ngokomchazwe wenkqubela phambi kwabaphathi bemigca kuqinisekiswe ukuba iqondo kuphunywa kwezenzo ezihlongwe kwizingxelo ze Performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s internal audit kwaye kucace iqondo ngabaphathi bemigca ngokweshumi elithathu lenyaka. Lawula ulungiselelo lwamagqabo athintelwa kukusetyenziswa kwezenzo zabaphathi kumagqabaliso ezikwingqungqwe le Performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s internal audit azelelawo kwi Audit Committee ne Director- General ngokweshumi elithathu lenyaka. Lawula ukuthobela kwamasiko e Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit kumagqabantela aphakamileyo e International Institute of Internal Auditors’ Standards ngokusukelela. Yenza ukuphonononga kwikhwalithi yokuqinisekisa ngakwicebo lokuhlela, ukuphumeza, okubalisa nemva kwemivalo yamagqabaliso emisebenzi yamakhomityi ye Performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s audit ngokuthobela ku Internal Audit Methodology namagqabantela e International Institute of Internal Auditor’s Standards ngokusukelela. Thatha inxaxheba kwi Annual Internal Quality Assessment Review nakwizimo zangaphandle eziphonononga khwalithi emva kweminyaka emihlanu kwaye usebenzise i Action Plans kwimibiko ngemihla eqhelisweyo. Lawula ukuthembela komsebenzi we Auditor-General of South Africa kwisixeko esenziweyo namagqabaliso abhaliweyo eziqinisekiswe ngumphathi we Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit nyanga ngamnye kwaye ucocisele inkqubela kwi Audit Committee ne Director-General ngamnyaka. Lawula izixhobo ze Directorate ye Performance and Financial Audit. Lawula izixhobo zamadoda, amathuba nemali ezingeniselwe kule nqanaba ngokusukelela ngokwamagqabantela esebe.

jobs.salary_text: R573 552 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with the OSD requirements)
jobs.summary: Control survey technician position in Mowbray requiring a National Diploma in Survey, SAGC registration, and six years' post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Survey Technician / Surveyor. Minimum of 6 years post qualification technical (survey / cartography) experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: The Constitution. Good governance and Batho Pele Principles. Labour and Employment Legislation. Public Service Regulations. Public Financial Management Act. Land Survey Act. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act. National Geomatics Information (NGI) standards and procedures. Programme and project management. Survey, legal and operational compliance. Survey operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Survey design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided survey applications. Creating high performance culture. Technical consulting. Survey and professional judgement. Job related skills: Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis. Decision-making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Computer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation and conflict resolution.
jobs.duties: Survey design and analysis effectiveness. Perform final reviews and approvals or audits on new survey applications according to set standards and design principles or theory. Co-ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Maintain survey operational effectiveness. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set survey maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect survey services. Provide financial management service. To ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) objectives within the survey environment / services. Manage the operational survey project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial added value of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles. Allocate, monitor, control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Provide governance services. Allocate, monitor and control resources. Compiles risk logs (databases) and manages significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirement. Provide technical consulting services for the operation of survey related matters to minimise possible survey risks. Manages and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Render people management services. Direct the development motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of survey services according to organisational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

af.title: Beheer-opmetingt tegnikus
af.summary: Beheer-opmetingt tegnikuspos in Mowbray wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting, SAGC-registrasie en ses jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting of Kartografie (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Survey Technician / Surveyor. Minimum van 6 jaar post-kwalifikasie tegniese (opmeting / kartografie) ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Die Grondwet. Goeie bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Arbeids- en indiensnemingswetgewing. Openbare Diensregulasies. Public Financial Management Act. Land Survey Act. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act. National Geomatics Information (NGI)-standaarde en prosedures. Program- en projekbestuur. Opmeting, regs- en operasionele nakoming. Opmeting operasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Mobiele toerusting-bedryfsvaardighede. Opmeting-ontwerp en -analise-kennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsulting. Opmeting en professionele oordeel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Rekenaarfokus en -reaksie. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing.
af.duties: Doeltreffendheid van opmeting-ontwerp en -analise. Voer finale hersienings en goedkeurings of oudits uit op nuwe opmetingstoepassings volgens vasgestelde standaarde en ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie. Koördineer ontwerpspogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Handhaaf operasionele doeltreffendheid van opmeting. Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel opmeting-onderhoudstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte. Monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om opmetingsdienste te rig of te herlei. Verskaf finansiële bestuursdiens. Om die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse te verseker om die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF)-doelwitte binne die opmeting-omgewing / -dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele opmeting-projekportefeulje vir die operasie om doeltreffende hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële toegevoegde waarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die opstel van innuvasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Lui, monitor en beheer besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Verskaf goeweransiedienste. Lui, monitor en beheer hulpbronne. Stel risikologs (databasisse) op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereiste. Verskaf tegniese konsultingsdienste vir die operasie van opmetingverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike opmetingsrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdeling-inisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om doeltreffende kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Lewer mensebestuursdienste. Stuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van opmetingsdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde vas te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Ithhiniyikhi Yokuhlola Ukuqashwa Kwezokulawula
zu.summary: Isikhundla sethhiniyikhi yokuqashwa kwezokulawula eMowbray esidinga i-Diploma Yezwe kuleminyaka yezinhlaka eSAGC, futhi iminyaka eyisithupha yokuhlolwa okuhole kwakhona emuva kokugqoka ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa eminyakeni yesine.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe kuleminyaka yesine (NQF Level 6) noma isikhundla esingalingani namanye. Ukubhaliswa okuyigugu kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengoba ithhiniyikhi / umhloli weliminaka. Okuncane kumnyaka wokuhlolwa okuhole kwakhona eminyakeni eyisithupha (is survey / cartography) kokuhlolwa okuhole eminyakeni yesithupha. Ikhadi lokushayela elivunyiwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: UMthethosisekelo. Ukuphathwa kahle kanye Nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. UMthetho Wabasebenzi Nokusebenza. Imithetho yezimpahla zenkundla. Umthetho we-Public Financial Management Act. Umthetho we-Land Survey Act. Umthetho we-Spatial Data Infrastructure Act. Amagunya kanye nenqubo ye-National Geomatics Information (NGI). Ukuqashwa kokuqashwa kwamabhodi kanye nokuqashwa kwentengo. Ukuqashwa kokuqashwa kokuqashwa nokusebenza okuhlelekile. Ukuqashwa komlomo kwe-Survey Operational. Ulwazi lokuqashwa lwamathuluzi. Ulwazi lokugcina amathuluzi namakhompyutha. Amathuluzi okusebenzisa amathuluzi e-Mobile Equipment. Ulwazi lokuqashwa nokuhlaziya is survey. Ukuqashwa nokuthuthukiswa. Amabhodi e-Computer-aided survey. Ukwakha isiko lokusebenza ngamandla. Ukuqashwa okusezingeni elikhulu. Isibalo nokugwinya ekusebenzeni komntu. Amandla okuhlela kokuqashwa kwe-team. Ukuxhumana. Ukusebenzisa imali. Ukuzetha ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha. Ukuziphendula (ngomlomo nangolunye). Ukusebenza kahle ngekhompyutha. Abantu abakwazi ukubala. Ukucabanga nokuhlela. Ukulawula ingxabano. Ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izinkinga ezinkulu ezinkulu.
zu.duties: Ukusebenza kahle komsebenzi wokuqashwa nokuhlaziya isigaba. Ukwenza izibuyekezo eziphelele kanye nokuvuma noma ukuqashwa ezicelweni ezintsha zokuqashwa ngokomthetho wezindinganiso nemigomo yokuqashwa noma inqubo. Ukulungiselela imizamo yokuqashwa kanye nokuhlanganisa kuzo zonke izigaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa okuphelele namathuluzi aje namanje. Ukugcina amandla okuqashwa emsebenzini. Ukulawula ukusetshenziswa komsebenzi wokugcina ibhodi, amasystem nezinsizakalo. Ukumisela imilinganiselo yokugcina ibhodi, imilinganiselo nemigomo yezinsizakalo ngokuhloswe yinhlangano. Ukugada ukusebenza kahle kokuqashwa ngokuhloswe yinhlangano ukuze kuqondwe noma kushintshwe izinsizakalo zokuqashwa. Ukunika insiza yokulawula imali. Ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala nokulawula imali ukuze kuqedwe imigomo ye-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) ngaphakathi kwesimo / izinsizakalo zokuqashwa. Ukulawula ibhodi lephrojekthi yokusebenza kwe-portfolio yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ngokuhloswe yinhlangano nemigomo. Ukulawula ukwenzeka kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi ahlobene nendikimba. Ukubumba ukwakheka kokubumba ngokuhloswe yinhlangano ukunika igciwane, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza kwayo. Ukumisela imigomo yokwenza amaphrojekthi noma ukuthengisa, nokulawula ukusebenza kahle kokugcina ibhodi emsebenzini. Ukubeka, ukulawula ukusebenza kwamaphrojekthi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esiqinisekisiwe ukulawula ukusebenza kwamaphrojekthi namaphrojekthi. Ukunika amandla amakhulu ngokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi nokusebenza kahle kwawo. Ukubumba ukubuyekeza amaphrojekthi ahlobene namaphrojekthi namaphrojekthi e-National Geomatics Information (NGI). Ukuletha isibuyelezo sabantu. Ukubeka abantu, ukugada nokuqaphela izinto ezilungele ukwenziwa noma ukugqama izidingo zabantu. Ukugcina ibhodi labantu. Ukuhlongoza izigaba ngokwezinhlelo ze-Surveyor-General's izinkomba (isigaba sohlobo lwezincwadi) nokugcina izinkomba (imibhalo) ngokwezinkomba ezinkulu. Ukubuyela emuva ngokuphelele emsebenzini wokulawula ibhodi. Ukugcina ibhodi lokwenza isibuyelezo kanye nokusebenza ngokomthetho nezinga lokumisela ibhodi ukubuyekeza imigomo yenhlangano. Ukulawula abantu abancane ngokubeka nokulawula imigomo yabo yokusebenza ngokwemigomo ye-Performance yabo ukulawula imigomo yenhlangano.

xh.title: Tekhnikieni woNzulu-lwazi loLawulo
xh.summary: Isithuba setekhnikieni wonzulu-lwazi wolawulo kwi-Mowbray esifuna iDiploma yaseSizwe kuZeko, uBhaliso kwi-SAGC, namashumi amathandathu eminyaka yamava emva kokugqiba izifundo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafake isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifiketi yeGrade 12 kunye neDiploma yaseSizwe kwiZeko okanye iKhathografi (NQF Level 6) okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezinxulumene nazo. Ubhaliso obuzima kwiSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengobaTekhnikieni woZeko / uMzeki. Ubuncinci beminyaka engama-6 yamava obuchwephesha (uzeko / ukhathografi) emva kokugqiba izifundo. Ilayiseni yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluxulumene nomsebenzi: uMthethosiseko. Ulawulo olulungileyo kunye neMigaqo yeBatho Pele. uMthetho woMsebenzi noQasho. iMigaqo yoLuntu lweLungelo loWiso-lwazi weSizwe (NGI) izitandanardi kunye neenkqubo. uLawulo lweenkqubo kunye namaphulo. uZeko, umthetho kwaye ulwabiwo-lwazi olusemthethweni. Unxibelelwano lwezinto ezizima ngokusebenza kwezeko. Ulwazi namakhono amaNqamlezantya. amakhono nolwazi lokuNginjwa. amakhono okusebenzisa izixhobo ezihamba. Ulwazi lokuYila nokuhlalutya iZeko. uPhando nokuPhuhliswa. izicelo zekhompyutha ezinceda kuzeko. ukuDala inkqubo yenkqubo esebenzayo ngamandla. uBulelembuobuchwepheshe. uZeko kunye nesigqibo seGosa elisebenzayo. Aakhono axhumene nomsebenzi: ikhono eQhubela phambili nokuBeka phambili. ukuSengumba ingxaki kwaye kuHlalutye. ukuThatha isigqibo. ukuBeka phambili iqela. ukuDala. uLawulo lweMali. ukuNxibelela ngekhompyutha nokuPhendula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nokubhaliweyo). ulwazi lokusebenzisa iKhompyutha. uLawulo labantu. uCwangciso nokuLungelelanisa. uLawulo lwe ngxoxo. ukuXoxwa nokuSulwa kwengxoxo.
xh.duties: UkuSebenza koluyilo kwezeko nokuHlalutya. ukuYenza ukuphonononga okugqibeleleyo namagunyaziso okanye iindlela ezibhalwe phantsi kwezicelo ezintsha zezeko ngokwemilinganiselo eCwangcisiweyo nemiNqamlezo yokuyila okanye inzululwazi. ukuQamba amaNqamlezantya eNkqubo yokuyila kwizinto ukusuka kumacandelo ukuya kwelinye ukuzinika isiqiniseko sokuNgena kolunye ukuze kuNgeniswe nexeshaelifanelekileyo ukuya kwisixa ngaphakathi kobuChwephesha ngokwamaxa. ukuGcina uSebenza oluSebenzayo oluyilo lwezoko. uLawulo lokuLawula kuwo wonke amacandelo ahlukeneyo ukukhusela amava akho ngqo ngokwemigaqo yokuyila nokuQamba amanyathelo okuQamba iNkqubo yokuSebenza okokuBalulekileyo kuyo yonke imiSebenzi yokusebenza kwenkqubo yamava angangatshintshelelo. uLawulo oluBalulekileyo nokuba yindalo nokusebenza okukhawulezayo nokuGcina isimo seNkqubo kwaye uYale iMfuneko yokuLawulwa kweNkqubo yokoyikelelo ngakumbi. uLawulo oluNgqinelana nemigqaniselo yokuLawulwa kwaye kuQukunde uSetyenziso olubonakalisa amaNqamlezantya aQonda ngokumhla okukhawulezileyo. uLawulo lwamava endaweni yokusebenza yokwenza uQhagamshelwano olupheleleyo lokuGcina isimo seNkqubo namava okulungele iMiba. uLawulo oluGqiba iNdlela yokuQamba iNkqubo ezizima ekubeni nabakhali kwezinto oKuQonda indlela yeNkqubo. uLawulo oluLawula iNkqubo yokuThathwa kwezigqibo ezisezantsi. uLawulo oluLawula kubakho iNdlela yokuLawula iMiba nokuGcina amava akho nangobuchwepheshe. uLawulo oluLawula kwaye uSasaze ulwazi ngokubakho kolunye uQeqesho kunye nokuThunyelwa ngaphandle kokuQonda uBomi obungazange ebe bungazange. uLawulo oluLawula iNkqubo yokuHlola ulwazi oluvela kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nokuba ngumuntu oQeqeshwe kakhulu ukuba akwazi ukuSebenzela kwelinye icandelo. uLawulo oluLawula iNkqubo yokuQeqesha abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho ukuze baKhuseleke kwaye baBambe ngokumila okuFanelekileyo kwalo msebenzi. uLawulo oluLawula iNkqubo yokugcina ulwazi lubalele kwaye luQondwe ngokucwangciso nokulunga kwexesha elizayo.
