Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op 'n toesigvlak in 'n verkrygingsbestuursomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die volgende: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Voorsieningskettingbestuursraamwerk. Tesourie-regulasies. Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Departementele SCM-prosedures en beleid. Werksverwante vaardighede: Leierskap en bestuursvermoë. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Projekbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en aanbieding. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur en implementering van standaard bedryfsprosedures in die Kwotasie-eenheid. Ontwikkel en implementeer broneringsstrategieë. Verseker nakoming van Voorsieningskettingbestuur-delegasie en beleid. Verskaf opleiding vir personeel van die afdeling wanneer nodig. Monitor interne beheermaatreëls om nakoming van beleide en prosedures van die departement te verseker. Bestuur kwotasie-eenheidadministrasie. Dra by tot data-insameling en ontleding van kategorieë verskaffers. Identifiseer industrie-fragmentasie en sleutelverskaffers. Identifiseer toepaslike finansiële indekse vir die klassifikasie van verskaffers en goedere. Koördineer die bied- en kwotasiebestuursproses met die National Treasury-rapportering oor afwykings. Voer 'n kontrakadministrasieproses uit vir die broning van Bied- en Vraagbestuur. Voer RFX / Veiling uit en ontwikkel versoek om voorstelle vir verbeterde broning. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor prestasiemaatstawwe wat waarde en vinnige verskafferreaksies aandui. Ontwikkel, volg en rapporteer besparings, bestedingsnakomings en afwykings, en eskaleer terugvoer aan belanghebbendes. Ontwikkel finansiële basis vir onderhandeling met belanghebbendes Navorsing en Markanalise. Navors en ontleed mark- en industriedata vir die identifisering van besigheidsleemtes en geleenthede vir uitbreiding. Identifiseer industrietendense deur bakenmerkwerk en navorsing van die beste praktyke met ander departemente en die breër besigheid. Raadpleeg belanghebbendes en bepaal die verschillende vergelykbare verskaffer-spesifieke diensaanbiedings en vereistes gebaseer op die breër nasionale besigheidsplanne. Voer bestedingsontledings en bakenmerkwerk uit op huidige en toekomstige prysindekse. Definieer huidige en potensiële verskaffingsbasis en identifiseer toekomstige nuwe intreders in die mark Bied- en Vraagbestuur. Verskaf bestuursinligting, statistieke en verslagdoening oor kwotasies. Stel geloofwaardige bie-evalueringsverslae op en bied dit aan die National Bid Adjudication Committee. Dateer die kwotasieregister gereeld op.

zu.title: Umncedisi weNduna: Ukuphathwa kokuTholwa kwemikhiqizo
zu.summary: Umncedisi weNduna obheke ukutholwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nenqubo yokuthenga, okuhlanganisa izindlela zokuthola imikhiqizo kanye nokuziphatha ngokomthetho, eKuphathweni kokuBuyiswa kwomhlaba kokuThuthukiswa kwamaphandle ambuso.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungezona ngaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesiKhethwa sikaHlezi lokuphela (Grade 12) kanye neDiploma yezwe eNqumweni loBuchwepheshe kokuLawulwa kweMali / I-Logistics / ukuLawulwa kokuThenga / ukuLawulwa kwoMkhakha wokuHlinzeka (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezihlobene ezilinganayo. Okungenani unyaka we-3 wobudala bokuhlangabezana ngesikhundla somphathi esimqondweni wokutholwa kwemikhiqizo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: uMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali yokuQashwa komunye (PFMA). Isakhkozo sokuLawulwa koMkhakha wokuHlinzeka. IziNgqungquthela zokuGcina imali. Amandla okuNyusa iNqubo yamakhono okushintsha isimo sezomnotho sabantu abansundu. uMthetho wesakhiwo samapholisi okuthandaza ngokukhetha (PPPFA). Izingaqo kanye nenqubo ye-SCM yomnyango. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amandla okuHola kanye nokulawula. Ukubhala nokuqonda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ukuLawulwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala) kanye nokwethula. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Ukulawula futhi ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yezindlela eziyisisekelo zokusebenza eYunithini yokuthenga. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuthola imikhiqizo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela ukwabelwa kwabathungi emkhakheni weNqubo yokuHlinzeka, nokuhambisana namapholisi, kanye nemiyalo yomnyango kanye nayo yonke imigomo yomnyango, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpilo ezinhle zomphakathi zisasebenza ngaphakathi kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zikanjini-nje. Ukuphathwa kokuHlinzeka ngokubikezela okuhlangeneyo kwezimali ezidingekayo kanye nokulawula iminikelo nemithelela ekuthengeni, ukuthengisa nokuhlolwa kwemikhiqizo ezweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuletha ukutholwa kwamakhono ekutheni imikhiqizo kanye nezinsiza kungaqondiswa kahle emkhakheni ngokubhukuda kubaluleke kakhulu ngokuba kusebenze khona iminikelo yezimali ekubukeni imikhiqizo kanye nezinyathelo zokuyifunda kwezezimali ezisizayo ekuqoqweni. Ukwenza isibonelo sokuqoqa imininingwane ngokubhukuda emkhakheni wokutholwa kwemikhiqizo, ngokuthola nendlela yokuziphendulela ngokutholwa okukhulu kwezinhlelo ezikwazi ukuthola ukuthuthukiswa kwentengo ekuqinisekiswa kwezezimali ekubukeni imikhiqizo kanye nokuzibophezela ekulawulweni kokuthola izimali ezisetshenziswa ngokwemithetho ekuphathwa kwamagumbi amaningi njengengxenye yokutholwa kwamakhono amakhulu kwezinye izinsizakalo. Ukwenza ukutholakala kwesikhungo ekunikezelwa amandla okuqinisekisa amandla okusebenzisa imali edlula esedangeni ukulawula imikhiqizo nokutholakala kwezinkonza kanye nezinsizakalo ekubukeni okuphakeme. Ukulungiselela imigomo yamakhono ekugxilwe kuyo imisebenzi yokusebenza ngokutholakala kwemali kanye nokuqinisekisa amandla okuletha imininingwane ekuqoqweni kanye nokuqoqa imibiko ekutholweni, ukutholakala nokuhlolwa kwemikhiqizo mayelana nokwenza imali etshaliwe ekunikezweni amakhono obuchwepheshe ekuqinisweni lokutholakala kwezimali esikhundleni sokusebenzisa izindleko kakhulu. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokubhalisa iminikelo. Ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo mayelana nokuqinisekiswa kokulandelwa kwemikhiqizo ehambisana namapholisi kanye nemiyalo yomnyango kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokwaziswa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuthuthukisa izidingo zokuqinisekiswa kwezimali kubantu abakhethwa ukuba babe yingxenye yale minikelo ngokwenza imizamo yokulandela ukutholakala kwemikhiqizo kanye nokuthola ukugqamisa okungenza isisekelo sokutholwa kwezinhlelo ezinhle nezinye izinselele. Ukupha imfundo yabasebenzi besebe uma kudingeka. Ukulawula izinsiza zolawulo zangaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuziphatha okuhambisana namapholisi nemithefana yokutholwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nokuba khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ezweni. Ukulawula imisebenzi yebhodi yegumbi lokuthengisa. Ukusekela ukuqoqa imininingwane kanye nokuqoqa kwenhlukaniswa kwabahlinzeka. Ukubona ukubhukuda phakathi kobuchwepheshe nokutholakala kwamakhono. Ukubona ukuthi kuyini imikhakha yokutholwa kwezimali ezihlolwa okufanele zisetshenziswe emkhakheni wokutholwa kwezimali ezihlolwa, kanye nokutholwa kwentengo ezinhle eziyisisekelo sokungenelela nokutholwa kwezinsiza kanye nokubika kubantu abakhethiwe. Ukwenza isikhathi esihle sokuhlola imikhiqizo nokuyibuka ukuthi ikhona na imikhakha yokuthola amakhono amakhulu ezinsizakalo namakhono okuziphilisa kanye nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nabathengi. Ukubuka iminikelo yabahlinzeka namathemu ezimali ezingabizi ngokweqile ukutholwa kwezimali ezinhle nokutholwa kwenzuzo ngokulawula izinsizakalo zokutholakala kwamathuba okuthola amandla okudlula okubukwa njengendlela yokusebenzela izinsizakalo. Ukubuka ukuthi kuyini na izinsizakalo zokutholwa kwamakhono ezinhle ezizokwenziwa futhi zitholakale kubantu abadinga amakhono okuphila ngokutholakala kwemali ekuqineni ukulawula izinsiza ezitholakala ngokwemali ekuqinisekisweni lokutholwa kwezimali ezingekho ezweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukutholwa kokuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa kwezimali kwezinye izindawo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa kwezimali kanye nokutholwa kwentengo ezinhle ezitholakala ezweni ngokutholakala kwabahlinzekiweyo abahle. Ukutholakala kwentengo ezinhle ekutheni imikhiqizo ekuqineni kwezimali ezisizayo. Ukuqoqa imininingwane yabahlinzeki abasebenzayo. Ukubika emqondweni wezinsizakalo ezifana nokutholakala kwamathuba amaningi nenhlangano yamakhono. Ukubuka kwezezimali namathuba amaningi wokuba khona emikhakheni yokutholwa kwamakhono. Ukuba khona ngokusemthethweni kolwazi ngokuthi ngabe kuyini na ukutholakala kwezinhlelo ezinhle. Ukuqoqa imininingwane emayelana nokutholwa kwamakhono nezinsiza. Ukubika emqondweni wezinsizakalo ezinhle ezikuqineni ukuba khona emkhakheni.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQhosa: uLawulo loKwaziswa
xh.summary: Umncedisi weQhosa uphatha iinkqubo zokwaziswa nokuthenga, kuquka iindlela zokufumana izinto nokuzithengisa nokuthobela imigaqo, kwiSebe loWazi loLutsha nokuPuhlisa iindawo zasaphandle.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezifunekayo: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neQeza lesiGredy 12 nesiDiploma seSizwe koLawulo leeMali / lezoKuhamba-hamba kwezinto / loLawulo lokuthenga / loLawulo loQongo olusesantoni (NQF Level 6) okanye isimangalo esifanayo. Kufuneka abe nokulinganiselwa kweminyaka engama-3 yamava kwinqanaba lokulawula kwimeko yelawulo lokwaziswa. Ifayidilizi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kumsebenzi: Ulwazi ngalolu ngezantsi: umThetho woLawulo lweMali zeSidlanga (PFMA). Isakhelo soLawulo loQongo olusesantoni. Izele zokuLawula zeNgxowa mali. UkuQinisekiswa koQoqoLwazi ngoBuntsimbi babaMnyama nokuNika amandla. umThetho weSakhelo soKukhetha nokuThenga (PPPFA). Iinkqubo nemigaqo ye-SCM yesebe. Amakhono asebenzayo kumsebenzi: Ikhono lokulawula nengqondo. Ukuba nokulunga kwiKhompyutha. uLawulo lamaPhojekthi. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo) nokubonisa. Ikhono lokusebenza eqalisweni labantu.
xh.duties: Lawula futhi usebenzise iinkqubo ezisesantoni ezisezinzileyo zokusebenza kwiYunithi yeNqondo nokuqatshelwa kwezinto eziyayingaqondiyo ezithengwayo. Yila uphinde usebenzise iindlela zokufumana izinto ezithengwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela ukunikwa amandla noQongo olusesantoni nemigaqo yalo. Nikeza ufundo kubasebenzi beqela xa kudingeka. Qaphela iindlela zolawulo langaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza nemigaqo nemiqulu yesebe. Lawula izibhalo zokulawula iYunithi yeNqondo nokuqatshelwa kwezinto eziyayingaqondiyo ezithengwayo. Sungula ulwazi oluqokelelwe kwaye uhlalutye uluhlu lwezintsana. Chaza ukuqhutshwa kwamasiko woluhlu, uhlovo oluthile lwentshanekaxa nentshona yoluhlu. Chaza amanani amakhulu oluLwazi oluBekiweyo oluXholiweyo ngengqamano yoluhlu lokuhamba kwezinto kunye nemali echaziweyo. Hlaziya ukuqhutshelwa koluhlu phakathi phakathi nokudityaniswa koluhlu lokwenza iinkonzo namazwe onke okubika ngokutshintsha-tshintsha. Yila inkqubo yoyilo kuhlelo lokusebenzisa imali ezele ngokuphazamiseka yoluhlu oluseGoli. Hlaziya ngokuhamba kwexesha iindawo ezize iNqondo nokuqatshelwa kwezinto eziyayingaqondiyo ezithengwayo ezifuna kuhlelo lokunikezwa ngokusesikweni sezwi iNqondo futhi zibe nokulinganiselwa kweemeko ezize iNqondo ezicebileyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Administration at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Cape Town, overseeing HR prescripts, employee benefits and service terminations.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Human Resources Management / Labour Relations / Human Resource Development / Public Administration / Public Management (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at supervisory management in human resource management. PERSAL Personnel Certificate, PERSAL Leave Administration Certificate. Knowledge and experience in pension administration. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Job related skills: Analytical thinking. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Report writing ability. Problem solving ability.
jobs.duties: Implement and monitor human resources prescripts. Implement human resource management resolutions. Keep employees well informed on new developments of human resource prescripts. Monitor employee benefits and conditions of service. Oversee processing of service terminations timeously. Check and ensure correct completion / submission of pension forms including nomination forms. Keep and maintain a database for submitted cases to Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Follow-up on all outstanding pension claims with GEPF. Assist deceased employee’s family to claim funeral benefit from GEPF. Identify, draw and keep annual list of all employees due to retirement. Make payment follow-ups and attend to pension queries. Provide feedback to pension beneficiaries. Recover all liabilities from pension proceeds. Coordinate or conduct service benefits workshops. Ensure compliance with the relevant prescripts when processing allowances. Ensure correct implementation of allowances on PERSAL e.g. housing acting etc. Approve leave transactions and ensure that correct codes are used. Ensure that leave applications comply with policies and prescripts. Ensure submission of leave plans and adherence thereof. Verify correctness of incapacity applications and ensure timeous submission to the Health Risk Manager. Liaise with the Health Risk Manager regarding submitted incapacity applications. Implement decision. Verify over granted leave prior to service termination of officials. Check and verify leave gratuity / discounting calculations and ensure correctness. Conduct workshops / induction on leave. Conduct leave audits. Facilitate and implement performance management, training and development. Check the database of Personal Development Plans (PDP’s). Consolidate provincial inputs of Workplace Skills Plans (WSP) which addresses skills requirements. Check compliance of submissions of employees requiring training. Coordinate provincial training and development activities. Consolidate training statistics. Approve Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) documents on PERSAL. Ensure that EPMS statistics is updated and submitted weekly. Arrange moderating committee (MC) meetings. Check and quality assure MC outcome letters. Compile memo for approval of performance rewards. Approve / authorise the implemented performance rewards. Register System Change Control (SCC) to correct service records of employees after payment of pay progression. Do arrangements to process payments of employees who terminated service with the Department. Arrange meetings to discuss dissatisfaction cases. Monitor and implement recruitment and selection. Check funded and vacant posts on PERSAL. Verify submission and supporting documents for advertisement. Ensure that employment equity targets are updated. Monitor adherence to recruitment and selection plans. Check minutes and proceedings after the shortlisting process. Check submission for selection of suitable candidates. Confirm security screening and qualification screening results. Ensure that posts are filled within the prescribed period. Approve appointments, transfers, translation on PERSAL. Ensure that officials are correctly placed on PERSAL. Facilitate and monitor employee relations processes. Monitor disciplinary cases submitted for compliance with prescribed timeframes. Check progress on the resolution of cases with National Office. Assist with the implementation of sanctions. Monitor compilation statistics on disciplinary cases submitted. Facilitate meetings with organised labour. Provide advice on grievances, misconduct and discipline matters. Implement the disciplinary hearing sanctions. Facilitate the resolution of grievances within the prescribed period.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post330@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. Applicants are advised that the salary for Receptionist is R201 093 per annum (Level 04). The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Cape Town, wat toesig hou oor HR-voorskrifte, werknemervoordele en diensbeëindigings.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Arbeidsverhoudinge / Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in toesighoudende bestuur in menslike hulpbronbestuur. PERSAL Personeelsertifikaat, PERSAL Verlofadministrasie-sertifikaat. Kennis en ervaring in pensioenadministrasie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC)-resolusies. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analitiese denke. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenvaardigheid. Verslagskryfvermoë. Probleemoplossingsvermoë.
af.duties: Implementeer en monitor menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Implementeer menslike hulpbronbestuursresolusies. Hou werknemers goed ingelig oor nuwe ontwikkelings van menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Monitor werknemervoordele en diensvoorwaardes. Hou toesig oor die tydige verwerking van diensbeëindigings. Kontroleer en verseker korrekte invulling / indiening van pensioenvorms insluitend nominasievorms. Hou en onderhou 'n databasis vir ingediende sake by die Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Volg alle uitstaande pensioeneise by GEPF op. Help die oorlede werknemer se familie om begrafnisvoordele by GEPF te eis. Identifiseer, trek en hou 'n jaarlikse lys van alle werknemers wat met aftrede moet gaan. Doen betalingsopvolgings en hanteer pensioennavrae. Verskaf terugvoer aan pensioenbegunstigdes. Herwin alle aanspreeklikhede uit pensioenopbrengste. Koördineer of voer diensvoordeelwerkswinkels uit. Verseker nakoming van die relevante voorskrifte by die verwerking van toelaes. Verseer korrekte implementering van toelaes op PERSAL bv. behuising, waarneming, ens. Keur verloftransaksies goed en verseker dat korrekte kodes gebruik word. Verseker dat verlofaansoeke aan beleide en voorskrifte voldoen. Verseker indiening van verlofplanne en nakoming daarvan. Verifieer korrektheid van ongeskiktheidsaansoeke en verseer tydige indiening by die Health Risk Manager. Skakel met die Health Risk Manager oor ingediende ongeskiktheidsaansoeke. Implementeer besluit. Verifieer oortollige verlof voor diensbeëindiging van amptenare. Kontroleer en verifieer verlofgratifikasie / afboekingsberekenings en verseker korrektheid. Voer werkswinkels / oriëntering oor verlof uit. Voer verlofoudits uit. Fasiliteer en implementeer prestasiebestuur, opleiding en ontwikkeling. Kontroleer die databasis van Personal Development Plans (PDP's). Konsolideer provinsiale insette van Workplace Skills Plans (WSP) wat vaardigheidsvereistes aanspreek. Kontroleer nakoming van indienings van werknemers wat opleiding benodig. Koördineer provinsiale opleidings- en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Konsolideer opleidingsstatistiek. Keur Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS)-dokumente op PERSAL goed. Verseker dat EPMS-statistiek opgedateer en weekliks ingediend word. Reël modereringskomitee (MC)-vergaderings. Kontroleer en verseer kwaliteit van MC-uitslaebriewe. Stel memo op vir goedkeuring van prestasiebelonings. Keur / magtig die geïmplementeerde prestasiebelonings goed. Registreer System Change Control (SCC) om diensrekords van werknemers na betaling van salarisprogressie reg te stel. Maak reëlings om betalings van werknemers wat diens by die Departement beëindig het, te verwerk. Reël vergaderings om ontevredenheidsake te bespreek. Monitor en implementeer werwing en seleksie. Kontroleer befondsde en vakante poste op PERSAL. Verifieer indiening en steundokumente vir advertensies. Verseker dat indiensnemingsgelykheidsteikens opgedateer word. Monitor nakoming van werwing- en seleksieplanne. Kontroleer notules en verrigtinge na die kortlyssproses. Kontroleer indiening vir seleksie van geskikte kandidate. Bevestig sekuriteitsveiligheidskontrole en kwalifikasieontledingsresultate. Verseer dat poste binne die voorgeskrewe tydperk gevul word. Keur aanstellings, oorplasing, vertaling op PERSAL goed. Verseer dat amptenare korrek op PERSAL geplaas word. Fasiliteer en monitor werknemerverhoudingsprosesse. Monitor dissiplinêre sake wat ingediend word vir nakoming van voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Kontroleer vordering oor die resolusie van sake met National Office. Help met die implementering van sanksies. Monitor samestelling van statistiek oor ingediende dissiplinêre sake. Fasiliteer vergaderings met georganiseerde arbeid. Verskaf advies oor klagtes, wangedrag en dissipline-aangeleenthede. Implementeer die dissiplinêre verhoorsanksies. Fasiliteer die resolusie van klagtes binne die voorgeskrewe tydperk.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezinhloko: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umncedi Wezinhloko wokuphathwa kwabasebenzi eKhomishini Yezwe Nokuthuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi eCape Town, eqapha imiyalo yabasebenzi, izinzuzo zomsebenzi kanye nokuphela kwenkonzo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenakunganwa: Abafakela izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe kwiPhathi Labasebenzi / Ubudlelwano Bolunye / Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi / Ukuphathwa Kwezithombe / Ukuphathwa Kolunye (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezifanayo ezilinganayo. Ubuncane eminyakeni engu-3 yamava enkomeni yokuphatha kumqondo wokuphatha abasebenzi. PERSAL Personnel Certificate, PERSAL Leave Administration Certificate. Ulwazi namava ekuphatheni imali yokuphumela esikhundleni. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikakhulu lokubhala imibiko. Ikakhulu lokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qamba futhi ulawule imiyalo yokuphatha abasebenzi. Qamba iminqumo yokuphatha abasebenzi. Gcina abasebenzi bezwisise ngokuthuthuka okusha kwemiyalo yokuphatha abasebenzi. Qapha izinzuzo zomsebenzi kanye nezimo zokusebenza. Lawula ukucutshungulwa okusheshisayo kokuphela kwenkonzo. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukugcwaliswa / ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu okuphumela esikhundleni kuhlanganise namafomu okukhethwa. Gcina futhi ulawule idathabhesi yamacala ethunyelwe kuGovernment Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Landela konke okufanele kutholakale ngemali yokuphumela esikhundleni ne-GEPF. Siza umndeni womsebenzi oshonile ukuthi acela inzuzo yokngcwaba ku-GEPF. Hlola, hipha futhi ugcine uhlu lonyaka lwabasebenzi bonke abayofaka umhlala. Landela imali ekhokhiwe futhi uphendule imibuzo yemali yokuphumela esikhundleni. Nikeza umbiko abazuza imali yokuphumela esikhundleni. Buyisisa konke okufanele kubekhokhwe esikhwameni kumali yokuphumela esikhundleni. Hlela noma wenze izinkomfa zenzuzo zokusebenza. Qiniseka ukuthi kuhlonishwa imiyalo ehlobene lapho kucutshungulwa izimali ezongwayo. Qiniseka ukuthi kusetshenziswa kanye imali ezongayo ku-PERSAL isb. izindlu ezingabhalwa igama etc. Emukela izinkqubo zekhefu futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa amakhodi afanele. Qiniseka ukuthi izicelo zekhefu zilandela imithetho nemiyalo. Qiniseka ukuthunyelwa kwezinhlelo zekhefu futhi kulandelwe. Hlola ukulunga kwezicelo zokungalunga ekubeni nokuthunyelwa okusheshisayo ku-Health Risk Manager. Xhumana ne-Health Risk Manager ngalezicelo ezithunyelwe zokungalunga. Qamba isinqumo. Hlola ikhefu elinikeziwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenkonzo yabasebenzi. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukuthi imali yekhefu / izibalo zokuqinisekisa zilungile. Yenza izinkomfa / isingeniso ngomqondo wekhefu. Yenza ukuhlolwa komqondo wekhefu. Hlela futhi uqeqeshe ukuphatha ukusebenza, ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa. Hlola idathabhesi yezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Komuntu (PDPs). Hlanganisa okungenayo okwomphakathi kwezinhlelo Zamakhono Ezindawo (WSP) ahlangabezela nezidingo zamakhono. Hlola ukuthi kuhlonishwa yini ukuthunyelwa kwabasebenzi abadinga ukuqeqeshwa. Hlela izenzo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kummandla. Hlanganisa izibalo zokuqeqeshwa. Emukela amadokhenda e-Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) ku-PERSAL. Qiniseka ukuthi izibalo ze-EPMS zibuyekezwa futhi zithunyelwe masonto onke. Hlela izinkomfa zeqembu lokulinganisa (MC). Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izibalo zomphumela we-MC zinhle. Qamba imemo yokuqinisekiswa kokuzuzwa ngokusebenza. Emukela / qinisekisa izinkokhelo ezoiswa ngokusebenza. Bhalisa i-System Change Control (SCC) ukulungisa irekhodi lenkonzo yomsebenzi emva kokukhokhelwa inkokhelo yokuqhubeke. Yezela izinhlelo zokucutshungula izinkokhelo zabasebenzi abaphetha inkonzo neKhomishini. Hlela izinkomfa ukuxoxa ngamacala okungathandiwe. Qapha futhi uqeqeshe ukubuyiswa nokukhethwa. Hlola izikhundla ezikhokhelwayo nezize ezingenalutho ku-PERSAL. Hlola ukuthunyelwa nemadokhenda okuxhaso okuzoshicilelwa. Qiniseka ukuthi imigomo yokulingana emsebenzini ibuyekeziwe. Qapha ukuthi kulandelwe yini izinhlelo zokubuyisa nokukhethwa. Hlola imizuzu kanye nokuqhubeka emva kwesinqumo sokungamukela. Hlola ukuthunyelwa kokukhethwa kwabafakelwe izicelo abafanele. Qinisekisa imiphumela yokuhlola ukuvikeleka nokuhlola izifundo. Qiniseka ukuthi izikhundla zigcwaliswa esikhatheni esimisiwe. Emukela ukubhaliswa, ukudluliselwa, ukuguqulwa ku-PERSAL. Qiniseka ukuthi abasebenzi babekwa kafanele ku-PERSAL. Hlela futhi uqapha inqubo yezinkinga zabasebenzi. Qapha amacala okuhlwayo athunyelwe ukuthi ahlonipha izikhathi ezimisiwe. Hlola inqobo ekuxazululweni kwamacasa neKhomishini Yezwe. Sisa ekwenzeni izinkohliso. Qapha ukwenza kwezibalo ngamacala okuhlwayo athunyelwe. Hlela izinkomfa nabasebenzi bahle besebenza. Nikeza izeluleko ngokungalengwa, okungalungile kanye nezinkinga zesisulu. Qamba isinqumo sokuzwa isicano. Hlela ukuxazululwa kwamacala ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esimisiwe.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba eliphezulu: uLawulo lweSebe labantu
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNqanaba eliphezulu woLawulo lweSebe labantu kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development eCape Town, elibukelela imithetho ye-HR, izibonelelo zabasebenzi nokuqhelana nokuphela kwenkonzo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikathi seQela le-12 kunye neDiploma yeSizwe kuLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaNtu / uQhagamshelwano loMsebenzi / uPhuhliso lweMisebenzi yabaNtu / uLawulo lwakuLuntu / uLawulo lweNkonzo yangasese (NQF Level 6) okanye izifundo ezimalana nazo. Iminyaka engu-3 yamava kwilabo ephethe abasebenzi kulawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Isatifikathi sobasebenzi bePERSAL, Isatifikathi soLawulo lweNgezo yePERSAL. Ulwazi namava kulawulo le-pension. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: I-Employment Equity Act. I-Public Service Regulations. I-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. I-Public Service Act. I-Skills Development Act. I-Labour Relations Act. Izigqibo ze-Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC). I-Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). I-Public Finance Management Act. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi lwenkangeleko nokubhalwayo). Ukusebenza kwikhompyutha. Amandla okubala iingxelo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Zalise ulandele imithetho yolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Zalise izigqibo lolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Gcina abasebenzi bete ngolwazi malunga nophuhliso olutsha lwemithetho yolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Landula izibonelelo zabasebenzi nemiqathango yenkonzo. Qwalasela ukucutshungulwa kokuphela kweenkonzo ngexesha. Hlola ukuqinisekisa ukugqibezela / ukuhanjiswa kweefomu ze-pension kuquka iifomu zokukhetha. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lwebhanki yolwazi lezemisebenzi ezihanjisiweyo kwi-Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Landela zonke iingxelo ze-pension ezingaxhunyiweyo kwi-GEPF. Nceda usapho lomsebenzi ofileyo ukuba aze nengxelo yemfuno yembuyezo yokuziinkonzo zemveli kwi-GEPF. Zibone, zitsho ugcine uluhlu lwonyaka lwabasebenzi bonke abakufuphi nokuhla kumsebenzi. Landela imbuyezo yeentengiso kwaye uphendule imibuzo nge-pension. Nikela impendulo kubaphi be-pension. Phindisa zonke izikwere kumvuzo we-pension. Lungelelanisa okanye yenze iindibano zezibonelelo zenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho echanekileyo xa kucutshungulwa iindleko zongezo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza okuchanekileyo kwezongezo kwiPERSAL umzekelo izindlu, ukubamba isikhundla njl.nj. Vuma iintengiso zongezo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba amakhowudi achanekileyo asetyenziswe. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo zongezo zithobela iingqungquthela nemithetho. Qinisekisa ukuhanjiswa kweendlela ze-leave kunye nokuzigcina kuzo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwezicelo zokungabi nako ukuze zihanjiswe nguMphathi woMngcipheko woMzimba ngexesha. Thintana noMphathi woMngcipheko woMzimba ngaphezulu ngezicelo zokungabi nako ezihanjisiweyo. Zalise isigqibo. Hlola i-leave enikwe ngaphezulu ngaphambi kokuphela kwenkonzo babaphathi. Hlola ukuqinisekisa ukubalwa kwembuyezo / ukuthotywa kwe-leave kwaye uqinisekise ukuchaneka. Yenza iindibano / isaziso ngongezo. Yenza ukuhlola i-leave. Qhubisa kwaye uyalise ulawulo lokusebenza, training nokuphuhlisa. Hlola idatha yamaxwebhu e-Personal Development Plans (PDP's). Dibanisa iingcalo zephondo kwi-Workplace Skills Plans (WSP) ezigqiba iimfuno zamakhono. Hlola ukuthobela kokuhambiswa kwabasebenzi abafuna training. Lungelelanisa imisebenzi yetraining yokuphuhlisa yephondo. Dibanisa iisitathistikhi zetraining. Vuma amaxwebhu e-Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) kwiPERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuba iisitathistikhi ze-EPMS zihlaziywa kwaye zihanjiswe ngeveki. Hlela iindibano zekomiti yokulinganisa (MC). Hlola ukuqinisekisa umgangatho weleta zemveliso ye-MC. Hlola imemo yokuqinisekisa imivuzo yokuqhelana nokusebenza. Vuma / gunyazisa imivuzo eqhelene nokusebenza. Bhalisa i-System Change Control (SCC) ukulungisa iirekhodi zenkonzo zabasebenzi emva kokuhlawula inkqubo yenyuso yemivuzo. Yenza izicwangciso zokuhlawula imivuzo yabasebenzi abaye baphela inkonzo nesebe. Hlela iindibano zokuxoxwa ngemimeko yokungavumi. Landula kwaye ulalise ukuthunyelwa nokukhethwa kwabasebenzi. Hlola iiposti ezinxutyiweyo nezize kwiPERSAL. Hlola ukuhanjiswa negcwaliswyo lwasemva lwamaxwebhu wokuvezwa kwabakwangomso. Qinisekisa ukuba iinjongo zoqoqosho zabasebenzi zihlaziywe. Qwalasela ukuthobela kweenqubo zokuthunyelwa nokukhethwa kwabakwangomso. Hlola imizuzu noluhambo emva kwenkqubo yokubeka abantu kuluhlu. Hlola ukuhanjiswa ngokukhethwa kwabafanelekileyo. Qinisekisa iziphumo zokuhlolwa kokhuseleko kwaye uqinisekise iziphumo zokuhlolwa kwemfundo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiposti zigcwaliswa kwelixesha elichaziweyo. Vuma ukubekwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhunjiswa, ukuqotywa kwiPERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuba abaphathi babekwe ngokuchanekileyo kwiPERSAL. Qhubisa ulandule iinkqubo zoqhagamshelwano babasebenzi. Qwalasela iimeko zolwahlulo ezihanjisiweyo ukuthobela iixelu elichaziweyo. Hlola inkqubela ekusombululweni kweemeko kunye ne-National Office. Nceda ekuphumezeni izohlwayo. Landula ukuqulunqa iisitathistikhi ngeemeko zolwahlulo ezihanjisiweyo. Yenza iindibano kwindalo yabantu abaqhuba imisebenzi. Nikela ingcebiso kwingxaki, ukwenza okungalunganga nokulawula iimeko zolwahlulo. Zalise izohlwayo ze-engxoxo yolwahlulo. Yenza ukusombululwa kweengxaki kwixesha elichaziweyo.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer sought to coordinate NARYSEC recruitment and participant administration support in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in one of the following: Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Management Assistant or relevant equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years' relevant administrative experience in programme administration, project administration or public sector administration. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC) policies. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. PERSAL administration. Records Management and National Archives legislation. Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Government administrative procedures. Microsoft Office applications. Job related skills: Administrative management. Records and information management. Report writing. Minute taking. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office) Planning and organising. Communication (written and verbal). Interpersonal relations. Problem solving Analytical thinking Coordination and facilitation. Time management. Customer service. Document management.
jobs.duties: Coordinate administrative support for NARYSEC recruitment and participant administration. Coordinate administrative and logistical support for recruitment, screening, shortlisting. interviews, participant verification and induction processes in accordance with approved NARYSEC Standard Operating Procedures. Prepare recruitment documentation, interview packs. attendance registers and related administrative records. Verify participant application documents and maintain recruitment databases and participant records. Prepare participant appointment, registration and contractual documentation. Administer participant movements, including appointments, transfers. resignations, terminations, stipend deductions and related Human Resource documentation. Respond to participant administrative enquiries and provide programme support services. Accompany participants during approved programme activities where required. Provide administrative support for Provincial Programme Implementation. Prepare official correspondence, submissions, memorandum. reports and other programme documentation. Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas. compile minutes and maintain records of decisions. Maintain participant files. attendance records and programme documentation throughout the programme lifecycle. Coordinate and quality assure. participant payroll and PERSAL certification documentation prior to submission. Maintain records relating to community service, skills development and participant progression. Coordinate stakeholder communication and maintain administrative records relating to programme implementation. Perform general administrative support functions to facilitate effective programme delivery. Provide administrative support for financial planning, budgeting and reporting, including the compilation and monitoring of the Directorate Management Plan (DMP), Procurement Plan and financial reports. Coordinate the procurement of goods and services in accordance with the approved DMP, Procurement Plan and departmental procurement procedures. Maintain the invoice register, track payments with Finance and follow up on outstanding invoices. Coordinate Information Management and Programme Reporting. Compile participant statistics and monthly, quarterly and annual programme performance reports. Compile information required for the Annual Performance Plan (APP), Integrated Operational Plan (IOP) and other management reporting requirements. Maintain programme information systems and databases, including extracting and analysing NIMS reports. Maintain Portfolio of Evidence and supporting documentation for programme implementation. Maintain participant filing systems and records in accordance with departmental records management policies. Monitor the completeness, accuracy and integrity of programme information and supporting documents. Prepare management information and statistical reports for Provincial and National Office. Coordinate Travel, Logistics and Programme Support Services. Coordinate travel, transport and accommodation arrangements for programme activities and maintain related administrative records. Prepare travel, accommodation and conference submissions with supporting documentation. Liaise with Supply Chain Management and service providers regarding logistical arrangements for programme activities. Coordinate logistical arrangements for recruitment, interviews, medical screening, training, community service, graduation ceremonies and stakeholder meetings. Maintain travel, accommodation and logistics registers. Provide logistical support during official NARYSEC events and activities.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 524 Stanza Bopape and Steve Biko Street, Suncardia Building, 6th Floor, Arcadia, 0002 or by email to Post326@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The position of Receptionist with Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/293 for the Directorate: Financial and Supply Chain Management Services: Limpopo (Polokwane) that was advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 38 dated 23 October 2026 has reference. Applicants are advised that the salary for Receptionist is R201 093 per annum (Level 04). The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte gesoek om NARYSEC-werwing en deelnemeradministrasie-ondersteuning in Pretoria te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in een van die volgende hê: Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Besigheidsadministrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie / Bestuursassistent of 'n toepaslike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike administratiewe ervaring in programadministrasie, projekadministrasie of openbare-sektoradministrasie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Nasionale Landelike Jeugdienskorps (NARYSEC) beleide. Openbaredienswet. Openbarediensregulasies. Openbare Finansi Bestuurswet (PFMA). Tesourie Regulasies. PERSAL-administrasie. Rekordbestuur en Nasionale Argiewe-wetgewing. Wet op Beskerming van Persoonlike Inligting (POPIA). Regeringsadministratiewe prosedures. Microsoft Office-toepassings. Werksverwante vaardighede: Administratiewe bestuur. Rekord- en inligtingsbestuur. Verslagskrywing. Notule neem. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office) Beplanning en organisering. Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings). Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Probleemoplossing Analitiese denke Koördinering en fasilitering. Tydbestuur. Kliëntediens. Dokumentbestuur.
af.duties: Koördineer administratiewe ondersteuning vir NARYSEC-werwing en deelnemeradministrasie. Koördineer administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuning vir werwing, sif, kortlys. onderhoude, deelnemerverifikasie en induksieprosesse in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde NARYSEC Standaard Bedryfsprosedures. Berei werwingdokumentasie, onderhoudpakkette voor. bywoningsregisters en verwante administratiewe rekords. Verifieer deelnemer aansoekdokumente en hou werwingdatabasisse en deelnemerrekords by. Berei deelnemer-aanstelling, registrasie en kontraktuele dokumentasie voor. Administreer deelnemerbewegings, insluitend aanstellings, oorpligtings. bedankings, beëindigings, toelaagaftrekkings en verwante Menslike Hulpbrondokumentasie. Reageer op deelnemer administratiewe navrae en verskaf programondersteuningsdienste. Vergesel deelnemers tydens goedgekeurde programaktiwiteite waar nodig. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir Provinciale Programimplementering. Berei amptelike korrespondensie, voorleggings, memorandums. verslae en ander programdokumentasie voor. Koördineer vergaderings, berei agenda's voor. stel notule op en hou rekords van besluite. Hou deelnemerlêers by. bywoningsrekords en programdokumentasie deur die programlewensiklus. Koördineer en verseker gehalte. deelnemer-loonstaat en PERSAL-sertifiseringsdokumentasie voor indiening. Hou rekords aangaande gemeenskapsdiens, vaardigheidsontwikkeling en deelnemerontwikkeling. Koördineer belanghebbendekommunikasie en hou administratiewe rekords aangaande programimplementering. Voer algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies uit om effektiewe programlewering te fasiliteer. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir finansiële beplanning, begroting en verslagdoening, insluitend die samestelling en monitering van die Direktoraatbestuursplan (DMP), Inkoopplan en finansiële verslae. Koördineer die verkryging van goedere en dienste in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde DMP, Inkoopplan en departementele inkoopprosedures. Hou die fakture-register by, spoor betalings met Finansies na en volg uitstaande fakture na. Koördineer Inligtingsbestuur en Programverslagdoening. Stel deelnemerstatistieke en maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse programprestasieverslae op. Stel inligting op wat vereis word vir die Jaarlikse Prestasieplan (APP), Geïntegreerde Operasionele Plan (IOP) en ander bestuursverslagdoeningsvereistes. Hou programinligtingstelsels en databasisse by, insluitend die onttrekking en ontleding van NIMS-verslae. Hou Portefeulje van Bewyse en ondersteunende dokumentasie vir programimplementering. Hou deelnemerlêerstelsels en rekords in ooreenstemming met departementele rekordbestuursbeleid. Monitor die volledigheid, akkuraatheid en integriteit van programinligting en ondersteunende dokumente. Berei bestuursinligting en statistiese verslae vir Provinciale en Nasionale Kantoor. Koördineer Reis, Logistiek en Programondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer reis-, vervoer- en akkommodasie-reëlings vir programaktiwiteite en hou verwante administratiewe rekords. Berei reis-, akkommodasie- en konferensievoorleggings met ondersteunende dokumentasie. Skakel met Voorsieningskettingbestuur en diensverskaffers aangaende logistieke reëlings vir programaktiwiteite. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir werwing, onderhoude, mediese sifting, opleiding, gemeenskapsdiens, gradeplegtighede en belanghebbendevergaderings. Hou reis-, akkommodasie- en logistiekregisters. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning tydens amptelike NARYSEC-geleenthede en aktiwiteite.

zu.title: Inkulu Yesikhulu Soqoqosho
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkulu Yesikhulu Soqoqosho ekuzohlela ukubuthwa kwabavolontiya be-NARYSEC kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) komunye walokhu: Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Management Assistant noma izifundo ezingabalinganiselwa ezihambisana nalokhu. Kudingeka abanezinhlelo ezingezincane zokusebenza kweminyaka engu-3 enkundeni yenzululwazi noma ekwazindleko zobungcweti, noma enkundla kazwelonke. Kudingeka abanelesi bokuqasha abakhona. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinkambiso ze-National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC). Public Service Act. Isimiso sePublic Service Regulations. Umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Isimiso se-Treasury Regulations. Ukusingathwa kwe-PERSAL. Ukuphathwa kokuqoshwa kanye nomthetho we-National Archives. Umthetho we-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Izinqubo zokuphathwa kolunye lulimi kahulumeni. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa zomnqondo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kolunye lulimi. Ukuphathwa kokuqoshwa kanye nolwazi. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuthatha amaminithi. Ukuzazi khompyutha (Microsoft Office). Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe kanye nokukhulunywa). Izibopho zomuntu nomuntu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukucabanga ngesibonelo. Ukuhlanganisa nokweluleka. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Isevisi yamakhasimende. Ukuphathwa kokuqoshwa.
zu.duties: Hlela ukusekela kolunye lulimi ekubuthweni kwabavolontiya be-NARYSEC nasekuphathweni kwabathathi nxaxheba. Hlela ukusekela kolunye lulimi kanye nezinsiza zokuhlela ekubuthweni, ukuhlola, ukukhethwa. ukuxoxisana, ukuqinisekiswa kwabathathi nxaxheba kanye nezinqubo zokungena ngokuhambisana nezinqubo ezemukelekile ze-NARYSEC Standard Operating Procedures. Lungiselela amadokhumenti okubutha, amaphakethe okuxoxisana. amarejista obukhona kanye nokuqoshwa kolunye lulimi okuhlobene nalokhu. Qinisekisa amadokhumenti okusesicelweni sabathathi nxaxheba futhi ugcine iziqu data zokubutha kanye nokuqoshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba. Lungiselela ukumiswa kwabathathi nxaxheba, ukubhalisa kanye namadokhumenti wesivumelwano. Phatha ukunyakaza kwabathathi nxaxheba, okuhlanganisa ukumiswa, ukudluliswa. ukuyeka, ukuphela, ukususwa kwezimali ezikhokhelwayo kanye namadokhumenti ahlobene nokusebenza kwabantu. Phendula imibuzo yolunye lulimi yabathathi nxaxheba futhi unikeze isevisi yokuqeqesha. Hamba nabathathi nxaxheba ngesikhathi sezinhlelo zokusebenza ezemukelekile lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza ukusekela kolunye lulimi okuhlobene nokuphathwa kweNqubo yeNyakatho. Lungiselela ukuxhumana okusemthethweni, iziphakamiso, imemorandakhulu. imibiko kanye nalelo ndinyana elithile. Hlela izinkomishi, lungiselela izinhlelo zokuqala. qoqa amaminithi futhi ugcine ukwenza izinkulumo-zomthetho. Gcina amafayela abathathi nxaxheba. amarejista abakhona kanye namadokhumenti ohlelo kuyo yonke inqubo yokusebenza. Hlela futhi qinisekisa. amadokhumenti esiholo sabathathi nxaxheba nokuqinisekiswa kwe-PERSAL ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Gcina okuqoshiwe okuhlobene nesevisi yomphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezakhono kanye nokuqhubela phambili kwabathathi nxaxheba. Hlela ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli futhi ugcine ukuphathwa kolunye lulimi okuhlobene nokwenziwa kwenqubo. Yenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke yokusekela kolunye lulimi ukwenza lula ukulethwa kwenqubo ngempumelelo. Nikeza ukusekela kolunye lulimi ekuhlelweni kwemali, ukwakheka kwebhajeti nokubika, okuhlanganisa ukuqoqwa kanye nokuhlola i-Directorate Management Plan (DMP), i-Procurement Plan namabhange emali. Hlela ukuthengwa kwezimpahla kanye nesevisi ngokuhambisana ne-DMP evunyiwe, i-Procurement Plan kanye nezinqubo zokuthenga zomnyango. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwamabhange, ulandele izinkokhelo ne-Mali futhi ulandele amabhange angakhokhiwe. Hlela ukuphathwa kolwazi nokubika kwenqubo. Qoqa izibalo zabathathi nxaxheba namabhange amnyanga, kodlule kanye nonyaka wezinhlelo zokusebenza. Qoqa ulwazi oludingekayo i-Annual Performance Plan (APP), i-Integrated Operational Plan (IOP) kanye nezinye izidingo zokuqondiswa ezidinga ukubikwa. Gcina izinhlelo zolwazi nenqubo namakhompyutha, okuhlanganisa ukukhipha nokuhlaziya amabhange e-NIMS. Gcina i-Portfolio of Evidence kanye namadokhumenti okusekela ekwenziweni kwenqubo. Gcina izinhlelo zokuqoshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba nokuqoshwa ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuqoshwa komnyango. Hlola ukuphela, ukuqinisekiswa kanye nokuzipatha kwamaphoyinti oovakashisi kanye namadokhumenti okusekela. Lungiselela ukwenziwa kolunye lulimi namabhange ngezibalo kanye nezinkomishi zaseNyakatho nakomZwe. Hlela ukuhamba, amasevisi nokusekela kwenqubo. Hlela ukuhamba, ukuhamba ngesithuthi kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izinkambiso zokusebenza futhi ugcine okuqoshiwe okuhlobene nalokhu. Lungiselela ukuhamba, ukuxhumana namabhange nezinkomishi ngezithombe zokusekela. Xhumana ne-Supply Chain Management kanye nabahanisi ngokuhlobene nezinhlelo zokuqoqa izimpahla zezinhlelo zokusebenza. Hlela izinhlelo zokuqoqa izimpahla zokubutha, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlolwa kokugula, ukuqeqeshwa, isevisi yomphakathi, imikhosi yokuthola iziqu kanye nezinkomishi zabahlanganyeli. Gcina ukuhamba, ukuxhumana kanye namarejista okuqamba. Nikeza ukusekela ngokuphathekayo ngesikhathi sezinkomishi nezenzo eziphathwa ngokusemthethweni ze-NARYSEC.

xh.title: Ofisa oyintloko wolawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneki abantu abanamaphandle abanomdla ekusebenzeleni abathandi kwi-NARYSEC, bathathe inkxaso yolawulo yabathandi nabathathi nxaxheba bakaRhulumente kwindawo yokusebenza ePretoria.
xh.requirements:
Iimfuno ekufuneka zibekwe phambi komsebenzi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesidanga se-Grade 12 kunye neNQF Level 6 kwelinye kweziLandonga ezilandelayo: Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Management Assistant okanye isidanga esingekho ngqo ngokomgangatho kodwa sithintelwe kumthetho.
Kufuneka ube neminyaka emi-3 ubudala ubuchule kwindawo ethile yolawulo, kwindawo yamaphrojekthi okanye kwinkqubo yolawulo lwentlalo.
Kufuneka ube ne licence yokushayela egunyazisiweyo.
Ulwazi olusembeki nasemsebenzini: Iindlela zomthetho zeNational Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC).
Umthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente.
Iindlela zomthetho ezinqwenela ukuzinza okunamandla.
Umthetho weNkonzo yezeMali (PFMA).
Iindlela zemithetho yoqwalaselo leeRiphabhliki.
Ulawulo lwePERSAL.
Ulawulo lokuqokelelwa kolwazi kunye noMthetho woQokelelo lwamazwe ngaRhulumente.
Umthetho wokuKhuselwa koLwazi oluNgcaliweyo (POPIA).
Iindlela zokwenza izinto ezikwinxulumeba kaRhulumente.
Iindlela zokusebenzisa iMicrosoft Office.
Amakhono ahlukeneyo afanelekileyo emsebenzini: Ulawulo lwezixhobo zolawulo.
Ulawulo lokuqokelelwa kolwazi.
Ukwabhala iingxelo.
Ukubhala iinkangeleko.
Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha (Microsoft Office).
Ukulungiselela nokuqamba.
Unxibelelwano (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo).
Iingxaki zomntu nomntu.
Ukusombulula iingxaki.
Ukuqonda okukhawulezileyo.
Ukulungelelanisa nokuqukuqelwa.
Ulawulo lwexesha.
Inkonzo yabakhenkethi.
Ulawulo lwamaxwebhu.
xh.duties:
Lungelanisa inkxaso yolawulo yokuqokelela nokuqokelela abathanda ngokusemthethweni nabahlala njengabathathi nxaxheba kwiNARYSEC nokulawulwa kwabo.
Lungelanisa inkxaso yolawulo nokuqokelelwa kwemisebenzi, ukwenza izinto ngokwesigqibo, ukudwelisa amagama abafanelekileyo, iintervyu, ukuqinisekisa amaxwebhu abathathi nxaxheba nokuqaliswa kwabathathi nxaxheba ngokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo yokusebenza yeNARYSEC.
Bhala amaxwebhu okuthatha abathandi, amaphakheji ezintervyu, amarejista okuza kwangaphakathi, namarekhodi ezintlobo zawo.
Qinisekisa amaxwebhu esicelo sabathathi nxaxheba, ngaphezu koko ugcine amadatha abathandi kunye namarekhodi abathathi nxaxheba.
Bhala amaxwebhu okubekwa abathathi nxaxheba, okubhaliswa kunye namaxwebhu esivumelwano.
Lawula ukushuka kwindawo abathathi nxaxheba bayiyo, kuquka ukubekwa, ukusuka kwelinye igunya elalilingana neli kwindawo yokusebenza, ukuyeka, ukupheliswa kwesivumelwano, ukutsalwa komyezo, naxa ehambelana namaxwebhu eSixhumanisi sabantu.
Phendula imibuzo yolawulo abathathi nxaxheba yibuza yaye uninike inkxaso yohlelo.
Hambisa abathathi nxaxheba njengoko kufunekayo kwimisebenzi exhunyiweyo yesixhobo sabo.
Unike inkxaso yolawulo ekuqokelelwa nakuqwalaswa kohlelo lwalo mmandi.
Bhala amanqaku afanelekileyo esixhobo sabo, iingxelo zomphakathi, zamemorandamu.
Lungelanisa iintshungama, bhala olu lwamathings.
Bhala iinkangeleko zamagatya ekhaya eguqukayo angenam.
Lungelanisa abathathi nxaxheba ngamanyathelo abo.
Bhala amaxwebhu abalulekileyo amabhalo ezinto ezikwiqondo lenqanaba elithile, ngokuxhomekeke kwelinye inqanaba xa kunjalo.
Qinisekisa ukwagqibekileyo kolawulo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwenza ngemithetho yabathandi, amaqela eNARYSEC.
Qwalasela amaxwebhu oovimba abathathi nxaxheba ngokukhokela amanyathelo abo abathathi nxaxheba, nangaphezu koko iqinisekise ukuba uyakwazi ukuyichaza iNARYSEC ukuba ngokukhokelayo ibone imisebenzi yawo yonke imihla ngemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo ekwisenkantolo.

jobs.title: Senior Project Officer: Strategic Land Acquisition
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Project Officer needed to implement strategic land acquisition for the State in the Northern Cape, requiring a relevant diploma and two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Agricultural Studies / Agricultural Economics / Development Studies / Town and Regional Planning / Public Administration / Social Sciences / Public Management / Real Estate / Property Management or related equivalent qualification. A valid driver’s licence. Minimum of 2 years’ relevant experience. Job related knowledge: Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 as amended. Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. Restitution of Land Rights Act, 22 of 1994. Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 as amended. State Land Lease and Disposal policy. Beneficiary Selection and Land Allocation Policy. Knowledge of post settlement support programmes. Knowledge of Agrarian Transformation as well as key priorities of government, Knowledge of Comprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Land Reform Prescripts and other relevant departmental prescripts. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Negotiation and conflict resolution. Computer literacy. Stakeholder relations. Facilitation / coordination and presentation. Financial management. Project management. Interpersonal relations. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Implement the acquisition of strategically located land aligned to the national imperatives. Identify strategically located land suitable for acquisition by the State in consultation with relevant stakeholders. Create and maintain project register of land for acquisition by the State. Facilitate mapping and overlaying of the identified land with key commodities and national imperatives. Facilitate the assessment and valuation of identified properties. Update of projects in terms of the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) requirements. Support the selection of suitable candidates and allocation of land. Compile the database of all land allocation applications received. Render support in the beneficiary selection and land allocation processes in the district. Prepare documents for selection committees’ consideration of land allocation application. Link selected beneficiaries to relevant training unit. Facilitate the handover of allocated land to the beneficiary. Ensure that the land allocation process is compliant to the Beneficiary Selection Policy. Support land allocation within the district. Implement land acquisition and allocation project cycle. Implement land acquisition procedures within relevant policy and programme guidelines. Liaise with relevant role-players / stakeholders with regards to land acquisition projects support requirements. Develop the land application system / database. Capture applications into the land application system / database. Compile project information report to relevant approval structures and departmental management.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Magistrate Court Building, 6th floor, Knight Street, Corner of Stead Street, Kimberley, 8300 or by email to Post331@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination.
