af.title: Senior Projekbeampte: Strategiese Grondverkryging
af.summary: Senior Projekbeampte benodig om strategiese grondverkryging vir die Staat in die Northern Cape te implementeer, wat 'n relevante diploma en twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Landboustudies / Landbou-ekonomie / Ontwikkelingstudies / Stads- en Streekbeplanning / Openbare administrasie / Sosiale wetenskappe / Openbare bestuur / Vastgoed / Eiendomsbestuur of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Minimum van 2 jaar se relevante ervaring. Werksverwante kennis: Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 soos gewysig. Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. Restitution of Land Rights Act, 22 of 1994. Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 soos gewysig. State Land Lease and Disposal-beleid. Beneficiary Selection and Land Allocation-beleid. Kennis van post-vestigingsondersteuningsprogramme. Kennis van Agrariese Transformasie asook sleutelprioriteite van die regering. Kennis van Comprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Grondhervormingsvoorskifte en ander relevante departementele voorskifte. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Belanghebbenderelaties. Fasilitering / koördinering en aanbieding. Finansiële bestuur. Projektebestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Implementeer die verkryging van strategies geleë grond in ooreenstemming met die nasionale imperatiewe. Identifiseer strategies geleë grond wat geskik is vir verkryging deur die Staat in oorleg met relevante belanghebbendes. Skep en onderhou 'n projekregister van grond vir verkryging deur die Staat. Fasiliteer die kartering en oorleg van die geïdentifiseerde grond met sleutelkommoditeite en nasionale imperatiewe. Fasiliteer die assessering en waardering van geïdentifiseerde eiendomme. Opdatering van projekte volgens die Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) vereistes. Ondersteun die keuse van geskikte kandidate en toewysing van grond. Stel die databasis op van alle grondtoewysingsaansoeke wat ontvang is. Verskaf ondersteuning in die begunstigdekeuse- en grondtoewysingsprosesse in die distrik. Berei dokumente voor vir keusekomitees se oorweging van grondtoewysingsaansoeke. Koppel geselekteerde begunstigdes aan die relevante opleidingseenheid. Fasiliteer die oorhandiging van toegewysde grond aan die begunstigde. Verseker dat die grondtoewysingsproses voldoen aan die Beneficiary Selection-beleid. Ondersteun grondtoewysing binne die distrik. Implementeer die grondverkrygings- en toewysingsprojeksiklus. Implementeer grondverkrygingsprosedures binne relevante beleids- en programriglyne. Skakel met relevante rolspelers / belanghebbendes met betrekking tot grondverkrygingsprojekte se ondersteuningsvereistes. Ontwikkel die grondaansoekstelsel / databasis. Voer aansoeke in die grondaansoekstelsel / databasis in. Stel 'n projeginligtingsverslag op vir relevante goedkeuringsstrukture en departementele bestuur.

zu.title: Isembe Sezinhlelo Eziphakeme: Ukutholwa Kwendawo Engaqambiwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka isembe sezinhlelo eziphakeme ukuphatha ukutholwa kwendawo engaqambiwe uma kutholakala izwe (State) kule Northern Cape, kudinga idiploma ehambisana nalokhu neminyaka emibili yohlelo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izinto kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 futhi benze idiploma yezwe (National Diploma) kumaphilo ezolimo / Amaphilo wezimo zezolimo / Izifundo zentuthuko / Ezenza indawo nendawo (Town and Regional Planning) / Eziphathwa emphakathini (Public Administration) / Ezenza isayensi emphakathini / Eziphathwa emphakathini (Public Management) / Izakhiwo nensimbi (Real Estate) / Eziphathwa kumakhaya (Property Management) noma iziqu ezingabuye ngalezo ezingaphezu kwequleko. Ilandawuzi (driver's licence) esemthethweni. Uminyaka ongaphansi kwe-2 yamava ahambisana nomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluseduzelwe nomsebenzi: Indawo yokulungisa amaphuzu (Land Reform): Umthetho Wokunikwa Kwendawo Nokusiza 126 we-1993 njengoba uguquliwe. Umthetho Wabakhi Basezandla, 3 we-1996. Umthetho Wokubuyiselwa Kwamalungelo Endawo, 22 we-1994. Umthetho Wokubamba Isikhundla Esikhululekile, 62 we-1997 njengoba uguquliwe. Inqubomgomo Yokugcinwa Nokuxazulwa Kweswe LwaSizwe. Inqubomgomo Yokukhethwa Kwabatholi Bendawo Nokwabiwa Kwendlu. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwesikhundla sokusekelwa komsebenzi. Ulwazi lokuGuqula Izinto Zolimo (Agrarian Transformation) kanye nezinkomba eziphakeme zombuso, Ulwazi lwezinhlelo eZiqandele Ukutholwa Komphakathi Osemakhaya (CRDP). Imiyalo Yokulungisa Indawo (Land Reform Prescripts) kanye nemiyalo yomnyango ebandakanyekayo. Amandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izingxabano. Ukusebenzisana noma- ungazi nokubhala ngekhompyutha. Ubudlelwano nabalawuli bokuqashwa. Ikhono lokubungaza / ukuhlelela kanye nokubhala izimemo. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphatha imisebenzi. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuzethaba ekuhambeni endaweni ezinkanyeliwe.
zu.duties: Phatha ukutholwa kwendlu etholakala ngendlela eziphatha amaphuzu omphakathi. Thola indawo etholakala ngendlela eqondile ema kuthathwe yileSizwe ngokubonisana nabantu abahambisana nalokhu. Dala futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lezinhlela zendawo ezingathathwa yiSizwe. Phathisele ukudweba nokubeka phezulu izindawo ezitholakele kanye nezinto eziphakeme zezwe. Phathisele ukuhlola nokulinganisa izindawo ezitholakele. Buyisa phezulu izinhlelo ngokusekelwe kwesidingo se-Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Sekela ukukhethwa kwabantu abafanele kanye nokwabelwa kwendlu. Qoqa idatha yayo yonke imibhalo yokwabelwa kwendlu etholakele. Nikeza isikalo sokukhethwa kwabatholi kanye nokuqalisa inqubo yokwabelwa kwendlu kwisifunda. Lungelela amaphepha komkhozo wokucatshangelwa kwesikolelabavoti sokwabelwa kwendlu. Hlanganisa abatholi abakhethiwe nendawo ezifundisayo ehambisana nalokhu. Phathisele ukunikelwa kwendlu ebeciwe kumtholi. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yokwabelwa kwendlu ihambisana nendaba yokuKhethwa Kwabatholi. Sekela ukwabelwa kwendlu kwisifunda. Phatha inqubo yokutholwa nokwabelwa kwendlu. Phatha imigidingo yokutholwa kwendlu ngesifundelo esingaqambiwe nangohlela. Xhumana nabantu abahambisana nalokhu / ngalezi zinhlela zokutholwa kwendlu. Buka ukuthi kudingwa imithombo yabo. Lungiselela isistimu / idatha yokutholwa kwendlu. Faka imibhalo kwisistimu / idatha yokutholwa kwendlu. Hlanganisa umbiko wolwazi lwezinhlela kwizakhiwo ezivumayo kanye nabanakekela abakuleminyango yezindlu.

xh.title: Isebe eliphezulu lomntu ohlela umsebenzi: Ukuqhutywa koluntu komhlaba ngokuceba
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho isebe eliphezulu lomntu ohlela umsebenzi ukuphumeza ukuqhutywa koluntu komhlaba ngokuceba kuRhwebo lwaseNorthern Cape, kufuneka kubekho izatifikethi ezifanelekileyo neminyaka emi-2 yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nedayari yama-12 kwaye babe neDiploma yaseNzululwazi yezolimo / izoqoqosho zezolimo / izifundo zophuhliso / ukuhlelwa kwendawo nodolophu / ukulawulwa koluntu / nzululwazi zenxulumano / ukulawulwa koluntu / ukuthengiswa kwakho nentengiso yamabhanti / ulawulo lwezinto okanye isifanekiso esifanayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-2 yamava ahambelanayo. Ulwazi oluhambelanayo nomsebenzi: Urhwebo lomhlaba: Ulwazi lokunika umhlaba uncedo nesenzo seMthetho we-126 ka-1993 njengoko ulungisiwe. UMthetho wabaqeshi basebenzi, u-3 ka-1996. UMthetho wokubuyiselwa koluntu amalungelo omhlaba, u-22 ka-1994. UMthetho wokwandiswa koluntu nokuqinisekiswa kwabahlali, u-62 ka-1997 njengoko ulungisiwe. INkulumbuso yokurhweba nolawulo komhlaba koluntu. Inkulumbuso yokukhethwa kwabaxhamli nakwabelwa komhlaba. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuxhasa abantu emva kokumiswa kwabo. Ulwazi lokuguqula izwe libe nzulu kolimo nakuqonda iindaba ezibalulekileyo kurhulumente, Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoPhuhliso oZithungu eziPheleleyo (CRDP). Imigaqo yokuqhutywa koluntu nominye imigaqo esebe ahambelanayo. Amakhono ahambelanayo nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi nangezibhalo). Ukuxoxisana nokuzalisa iingxabano. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwiikhompyutha. Unxibelelwano nabantu abathintekayo. Ukwenza / ulungiselwano nokuhlanganisa. Ukulawula ngemali. Ukulawula umsebenzi. Unxibelelwano nabantu. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Phuma isa kokuqhutywa koluntu komhlaba okubekwe nzulu kwindawo ezibalulekileyo kwelizwe. Phuma izazise izithuba zomhlaba ezibekwe nzulu kwindawo ezifanelekileyo ukuba kuqhutywe luluntu emvumweni nabantu abahambelanayo. Yaza ulugcine irekhodi lomsebenzi womhlaba okuqhutywa luluntu. Yenza ukuba kwenzeke ukuzoba nokumisela komhlaba okutsunyiweyo ngaphezulu kwezinto ezibalulekileyo neendaba ezibalulekileyo kwelizwe. Yenza ukuba kwenzeke ukuphonononga nokubeka ixabiso kwizinto ezitsunyiweyo. Hlaziya iiprojekthi ngokwemfuno zeOfisi yoLawulo loMsebenzi woQhagamshelo (EPMO). Nxibelelanisa ukukhethwa kwabafanelekileyo nokwabelwa komhlaba. Qamba idatabase yeenkqubo zonke zamafomu okwabelwa komhlaba afunyenweyo. Nikela ngenkxaso ekukhethweni kwabaxhamli nasekuqhubeni inkqubo yokwabelwa komhlaba kwisithili. Lungisa amaxwebhu ukuba ahlolwe ngamakomiti ekukhethweni kwe nkqubo yokwabelwa komhlaba. Qhaqahfisa abakhethwayo kwicandelo lemfundo elihambelanayo. Yenza ukuba kwenzeke ukunikwa komhlaba okwabeliweyo kumaxhamli. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yokwabelwa komhlaba ihambisana noNkulumbuso wokuKhethwa kwabaXhamli. Nxibelelanisa nokuwabelwa komhlaba ngaphakathi kwesithili. Phuma isa kokuqhutywa koluntu nokuwabelwa komhlaba kwisikelo sophuhliso. Phuma isa kunikezelo lweenkqubo zokuqhutywa koluntu ngaphakathi kwemigaqo neenkqubo ezihambelanayo. Xhumana nabantu abahambelanayo / abathintekayo malunga neenkxaso ezifunekayo kwii projekthi zokuqhutywa koluntu. Phuhlisa inkqubo / idatabase yamafomu womhlaba. Faka amafomu kwinkqubo / idatabase yamafomu womhlaba. Qamba ingxelo yamaxwebhu eprojekthi ezibekiweyo kumagunyazisi ahambelanayo nasebalawulweni basebe.

jobs.title: Senior Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Cadastral Officer needed in Pietermaritzburg to capture and maintain cadastral survey data, requiring a Geomatics qualification and at least three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 3 years geomatics post qualification experience in a Geomatics / Cadastral survey environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Analysing and report writing. Interpersonal relations. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Presentation and /attributes: Confidentiality, fairness, respect and honesty.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain and electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principle and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amend, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1st Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street (formerly known as Loop Street), Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or by email to Post328@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. af.title: Senior Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Senior Kadastrale Beampte word in Pietermaritzburg benodig om kadastrale opmetingsdata vas te lê en te onderhou, met 'n Geomatics-kwalifikasie en ten minste drie jaar se relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Minimum van 3 jaar geomatics ervaring na kwalifikasie in 'n Geomatics / kadastrale opmetingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geographical Information Systems-sagteware en grondbeginsels. Kennis van Surveyor-General's Office se standaardbedryfsprosedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opmetings. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analise en verslagskrywing. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenvaardigheid. Voorlegging en /eienskappe: Konfidensialiteit, billikheid, respek en eerlikheid.
af.duties: Vas lê, onderhou en werk alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vas lê alfa-en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingediente kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) en onderneem wiskundige konsekwensiekontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landpercele. Werk kadastrale opmetingsdatabasisse by deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vas lê en verifieer eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente. Behandel ingewikkelde onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente ooreenkomstig die wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit op wettige opdrag. Trek af, kanselleer en onderskryf kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpercele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Behandel komplekse wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggekeerde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanwysings van nuut ingediente voorleggings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opmetingsrekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titelplanne uit. Werk die aantekenvelle by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperceel. Navors en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en externe kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting op en verskaf dit aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfotografie, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) ooreenkomstig ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing na kadastrale opmetingsinligting met betrekking tot landperceelgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Vas lê, onderhou en werk ruimtelike data met eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vas lê nuut ingediente dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, werk by en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Ondersoek moontlike bronne van foute indien oorvleuelings bespeur word en spreek foute toepaslik aan. Gebruik kadastrale opmetingsberekeningsbeginsel en ander wettige databronne om die gehalte van landperceelgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, onderskrywing of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (gewysigde, onderskrew of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bedrywighede uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerde beelddatabasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Ofela Omkhulu WezobuKadastre
zu.summary: Kudingeka Ofela Omkhulu WezobuKadastre ePietermaritzburg ukuze abambe futhi agcine idatha yokuhlola isikadastre, kudingeka iziqu ze-Geomatics nokungenani izinhathi ezingingu-3 zemfundo ehlobene nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwazo: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Kumele kube nokungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yemfundo yokusebenza kwezobuKadastre emva kokuthola iziqu endaweni yezobuKadastre / ukuhlola isikadastre. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nge-Geographical Information Systems Software nezesisekelo sayo. Ulwazi nge-Surveyor-General's Office Standard Operating Procedures kanye namaprothesi. Ulwazi ngokuHlolwa kukaKadastre. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko. Izimbangi zabantu. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ukubukisa kanye nezibaluli: Ukugcina imfihlo, ukulunga, inhlonipho kanye noqotho.
zu.duties: Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze idatha yamagama nezinamba yamadokhumenti obuKadastre ahlukile kanye nalawo akhiqizwe kabanzi. Bumba ulwazi lwamagama nezinamba kwamadokhumenti obuKadastre amusha okuthunyelwe (ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi) futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kokuqonda kwezibalo kanye nokuqinisekisa idatha yamaphasi omhlaba amusha abhekiselwe kuso. Buyekeza osimidieni bokuhlola isikadastre ngokungeza noma ukulungisa yonke imibhalo emigunyaziwe (ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi) ukuze kugcinwe indawo yamagama nezinamba yagesibankweli. Bamba futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti obuKadastre esikhathi esidlule ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi. Yeba ukugcinwa okuyinkimbinkimbi kwamadokhumenti obuKadastre ngokuvumelana namaprothesi omthetho. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti obuKadastre ngokuqweliswa okusemthethweni. Khisha, khansela futhi ugqamise amadokhumenti obuKadastre anamaphasi omhlaba abhalisiwe, izikweletu noma izinkonzo. Yeba ekulungenisweni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwamadokhumenti obuKadastre avunyelwe futhi abhalisiwe. Faka yonke imibhalo yobuKadastre esanda kuvunywa kwindawo yokugcina. Khishwa futhi unikeze amarekhodi obuKadastre. Biza kabusha amarekhodi obuKadastre abuyiswe. Lokisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi obuKadastre esimeni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezenhlaka kwamadokhumenti obuKadastre ahlukile kanye nalawo akhiqizwe kabanzi. Hlola izinkomba zokwabiwe okuthunyelwe okusha. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezenhlaka kwamadayakhamu ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi kanye namaphulani jikelele. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezenhlaka kwamarekhodi obuKadastre. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezenhlaka kwamaphulani abe nhlobo-ngemuva ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi. Buyekeza amashidi okubhala ngokungeza yonke iphasi lomhlaba lobuKadastre elivunyelwe. Cwaninga futhi unikeze ulwazi lobuKadastre kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Buyisela futhi unikeze ulwazi lobuKadastre kubathengi. Nikeze izithombe zomoya, izithombe ezilungiwe kanye namaphulani e-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokuvumelana nezivumelano ezingeni konkezo ezibhaliwe. Yenza ucwaningo oluyisisekelo ngaphezulu kolwazi bokuhlola isikadastre olumayelana namagunjana omhlaba kubathengi nasekuBunjweni Komhlaba. Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze idatha yesikhawu namadokhumenti obuKadastre ahlukile nakhiqizwe kabanzi. Bamba imibhalo esanda kuthunyelwa ukuthola ukuthi ngabe kunaphepha kwesikhawu ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Yengeze idatha, ubuyekeze futhi ugcine isethi yedatha echanekile yolwazi sesikhawu sobuKadastre, okuhlanganisa ukungeza kanye nokubuyekeza idatha yesikhathi esedlule. Cwaninga imithombo yamaphutha ekhona uma kutholakala ukuphepha futhi ulungise amaphutha ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisa imithetho yokubala yokuHlolwa kukaKadastre kanye namanye amaphuzu aphephile ulwazi ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yolwazi lwamagunjana omhlaba. Skena yonke imibhalo yobuKadastre lapho ivunywa, ilungiwa, igqamiswa noma ikhishwa futhi wenze ukuhlola ikhwalithi. Skena imibhalo yobuKadastre esanda kuvunywa. Skena kabusha yonke imibhalo yobuKadastre ebuyekeziwe (elungiwe, egqamisiwe noma ekhishiwe). Xhumanisa izithombe eskeni ezibekiwe nedatha yamagama nezinamba. Yenza imisebenzi futhi uhlola ikhwalithi ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi osimidieni bezithombe eziskeni bamacishelo futhi achanekile.

xh.title: Isebe Eliphezulu lezoMbhalo ze-Cadastral
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iSebe Eliphezulu lezoMbhalo ze-Cadastral ePietermaritzburg ukugcina nokuhlala kwelithuba idatha yoswenko lwe-cadastral, kufunelwe izifundo ze-Geomatics nokuba nokuba nobomi obungenaphantsi kweeminyaka ezintathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka izicelo kufunekiba nesiQinisekiso seQela lesi-12 nesiQinisekiso seSizwe kwi-Geomatics okanye isiQinisekiso soMphathi woSwenko (NQF Level 5). Ukwahlulela phantsi kweeminyaka ezintathu zolwazi oluchwetheziweyo kumakhaya e-Geomatics okanye uswenko lwe-cadastral. Ilayisensi yokushuka esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngesoftware ye-Geographical Information Systems neemfuno eziphambili. Ulwazi ngezaMashumi-manyathelo aZikwendalo eKamva le-Surveyor-General neenkqubo. Ulwazi ngezoSwenko ze-Cadastral. Ikhono elihambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuhlalutya nokubhala iingxelo. Iintsapho phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi lwenkomfa nelubhalwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ibono nemiqathango: Iimfihlelo, ubuntu obulinganayo, inhlonipho nokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Gcina, hlala ulihlengilele uze uvuselele idatha yamanani nakooyinokoobuki bemiqathabo ye-cadastral elula nelandlabatha. Gcina ulwazi lwamanani nakooyinokoobuki kwimibhalo entsha yomqathabo we-cadastral (elula nelandlabatha) uze wenze ukuphonononga ngokuthe ngqo kwimithetho yamanani nokqinisekiswa kwedatha yamaphepha amasha obuhlaza. Vuselela iisiseko zedatha zoswenko lwe-cadastral ngokongeza okanye ukulungisa umyalezo ngamnye ovunyiweyo (elula nelandlabatha) ukuze uhlale uligcinile kwindlu yokugcina idatha yamanani nakooyinokoobuki. Gcina uze uqinisekise imibhalo yamaxa akanjalo yomqathabo we-cadastral elula nelandlabatha. Jongana nokuhlala kulungiselelo okudityanisiweyo kwemibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral ngokwemithetho. Yenza ukuyityikitya okanye ukurhoxisa imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral ngomyalelo osemthethweni. Tyikitya, rhoxisa uze ufake iimfihlelo kwimibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral enamaphepha obuhlaza abhalisiweyo, izikole okanye iinkonzo. Jongana nokulungiswa okudityanisiweyo kwemibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral evunyiweyo nesebhalisiweyo. Faka zonke imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral evunyiweyo ntsha kwelondolozo. Khupha uze unikeze imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral. Buyisela kwelondolozo imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral ebuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral isebenziseka ngokulungele. Yenza ukuphonononga ngemigaqo obuchwetheziweyo bemibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral elula nelandlabatha. Hlola amagama abanikeli bentsha abanikeileyo. Yenza ukuphonononga ngobuchwethezi obulula nelandlabatha kwemiqathabo neendawo zenkqubo. Yenza ukuphonononga ngobuchwethezi kwimibhalo yoswenko. Yenza ukuphonononga ngobuchwethezi kwemiqathabo elula nelandlabatha yeecandelo zemithetho yesiqendu. Vuselela amaphepha okuhlelwa ngokongeza ngamnye umqulu wamaphepa obuhlaza ovunyiweyo. Phanda uze unike idatha yomqathabo we-cadastral kumaxhwele angaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha uze unike idatha yomqathabo we-cadastral kumaxhwele. Nikeza iifoto zomoya, iifoto ezingqamileyo neendawo ezicwangcisiweyo ukusuka kwi-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokweluswekwesivumelwano kwizinzo. Yenza uphando olusisiseko kolumvo lolwazi lwoswenko lwe-cadastral olunamanqamlezo obuhlaza ngabaxhwele nangenkqubo yoLwazi loBuhlaza bosahluko. Gcina, hlala ulihlengile uze uvuselele idatha yendawo nemiqathabo yomqathabo we-cadastral elula nelandlabatha. Gcina imibhalo entsha enikiweyo ukunika isigqibo ukuba zikhona iindawo ezibambene ngqo phambi kokuvunywa. Yongeza idatha, vuselele uze uhlale uligcine iqotho iqotho uludidi lwedatha yolwazi olwenziwe ngendawo efanayo, kuquka ukongeza nokuqinisekisa idatha yamaxa akanjalo. Phanda iimvelaphi ezinokubangela iimpazamo zithi zitholakele uze uzilungise ngendlela efanelekileyo. Sebenzisa imigaqo yokubala kwoswenko lwe-cadastral nezinye iindidi ezinemigaqo yedatha ukuphucula ulwazi lweenqamlezo zamaphepa obuhlaza. Skena zonke imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral xa ivunyiwe, ilungisiwe, inamaqinisekiso okanye ixutshiwe uze uwenze ukulinganisa ngokwemigaqo. Skena imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral evunyiweyo ntsha. Skena ngokutsha imibhalo yomqathabo we-cadastral ehlaziyweyo (elungisiweyo, enamaqinisekiso okanye exutshiweyo). Cocabanisa iifoto ezigciniweyo eziskeniweyo kwidatha yamanani nakooyinokoobuki. Yenza iinkqubo uze uqinisekise ukulinganisa ngokwemigaqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iisiseko zedatha zeefoto eziskeniweyo zicocekile zize ziqotho.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to the Director, including managing calls, diary appointments and typing documents in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate or relevant equivalent. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Receive, records and distributes all incoming and outgoing documents. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. Study the relevant public service and the departmental prescripts / policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Keep abreast with the procedures and process that apply in the office of the senior manager.

af.title: Sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan die Direkteur, insluitend die bestuur van oproepe, dagboekafsprake en die tik van dokumente in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of relevante eweknie. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.). Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie telefoonetiket. Klank organisatoriese vermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële / ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe aan en verwys die oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke senior bestuurder bedoel is nie. Druk afsprake en gebeurtenisse in die dagboek aan. Tik dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantoortoerusting bv. rekenaars en fotostaatmasjiene. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die senior bestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer relevante dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die senior bestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers uit, reël verkwikkings en stel skedules vir vergaderings en gebeurtenisse op. Verwerk die reis- en verblyfksamings vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die senior bestuurder. Neem basiese notule van vergaderings van die senior bestuurder waar nodig. Opstel roetine-korrespondensie en verslae. Doen lêerwerk van dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekeninge. Neem aan, teken op en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Hanteer die verkryging van standaardartikels soos skryfbehoeftes, verkwikkings ens. Versamel alle relevante dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte met betrekking tot verlyde / beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op haar / sy werksomgewing om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die senior bestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die relevante staatsdiens- en departementele verlyde / beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou treding met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die senior bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Nikela ngokwesekwa ngomsebenzi wokubhala nokwamukela abanjiniyela kumdidiyelwa, okuhlanganisa nokuphatha amakhol, izinsuku ezibhaliwe kumlandvo wemisebenzi kanye nokuthayipha amadokhumenti e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma okulingana nakho okuhlobene. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwesikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njll.). Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Isiko elihle lokukhuluma futhi. Ikhono elihle lokubumba. Amandla ahle okusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwesikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abangezingeni elihlukile kanye nabalabakibo abahlukeneko (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa). Ikhono lokuziphathe ngobuhlakani nokubhamba ngokulingene.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzo yokesekwa ngomsebenzi wokubhala / yokuwamukela abanjiniyela kumdidiyelwa. Wamukele amakhol omakhalekhule futhi uqedelele amakhol komunye wabantu abafanele uma engabeki eya kumphathi ophakeme ohlobene nakho. Bhala izinsuku nemikhuba emlandvo wemisebenzi. Thayipha amadokhumenti komphathi ophakeme nakunabanye basebenza ehhovisi. Phephenisa izinsiza zohhovisi isb. izikhompyutha nezimoto zokushumayela amakhophi. Nikeza inkonzo yokesekwa emisebenzini yomsebenzi kumphathi ophakeme. Xhumana nabezinkampani zokuhamba ukuze uhlelele ukuhamba. Hlola izinhlelo lapho amadokhumenti afanele etholwa. Hlela imihlangano nemikhuba komphathi ophakeme nakubasebenzi ehhovisi. Thola izindawo zokuhlangana, mema abantu abafanele, hlela ukudla futhi uhlele isikhathi semihlangano nemikhuba. Phatha izinsimba zokuhamba nokusekelwa ehhovisi. Phatha zonke izikweletu eziphuma emisebenzini yomphathi ophakeme. Bhala imizuzu yomhlangano yomphathi ophakeme lapho kudingeka khona. Bhala izincwadi nemibiko evamile. Gcina amadokhumenti komphathi ophakeme nasehhovisi lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha izinto ezifana namarekhodi okuhamba kanye ne-akhawunti zomakhalekhule. Wamukela, bhala futhi uhambise wonke amadokhumenti angaphakathi nawaphandle. Phatha ukuthenga izinto eziyisisekelo ezifana nempahla yokubhala, ukudla, njll. Qoqa wonke amadokhumenti afanele ukuze umdidiyelwa akwazi ukuhlohlela imihlangano. Gcina ulwazi lwesikhathi ngemithetho / izinkambiso namagugu okusebenza kuyena / yena ukuze aqiniseke ukwesekwa okusebenzayo nokuqinisekileyo komphathi ophakeme. Fundisisa imithetho yangoMphakathi kanye nemithetho yesiHhovisi / izinkambiso namanye amadokhumenti ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi bayayiqonda ngokufaneleko insi yomthetho. Gcina ulwazi ngemigudu nemithefana esebovele kuhhovisi komphathi ophakeme.

xh.title: Unobhala
xh.summary: Kubonelelwe inkxaso yobhala nendlela yokwamkela abantu kuMlawuli, kuquka ukulawula amafowuni, izigqibo zekhalenda kwaye kuthayiphiwe amaxwebhu ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisisiseko: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 okwa singuguqulelo elifaneleyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njl.). Iakhono ezahambelana nomsebenzi: Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha efowunini. Ikhono elinzulu lokuhlela izinto. Iakhono elilungileyo lokusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokunxibelelwana kakuhle nabantu abakumazwela amanqanaba ahlukeneyo nendawo evela kuyo (kokubhalwayo nakokuthethwayo). Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobubele nokugcina imfihlelo.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwa inkxaso yobhala nendlela yokwamkela abantu kuMlawuli. Kwamkelwa amafowuni aze adluliselwe kubantu abafanelekileyo ukuba engenzelwanga lo mlawuli ophakamileyo. Kubhalwa izigqibo nezemiganxa ekhalendeni. Kuthayiphwa amaxwebhu kulawule ophakamileyo nakwabanye basebenzi kwindawo yolusebenzo. Kusetyenziswa izixhobo zofise njengekhompyutha nabinzamakhasi. Kubonelelwa inkxaso yomsebenzi woloo mlawuli ophakamileyo. Kunxibelelwa neeenkokheli zohambo ukuze kwenziwe izigqibo zohambo. Kusengamlindwe izigqibo xa kufikwa namaxwebhu afanelekileyo. Kulungiselelwa iindibano nezemiganxa kulawule ophakamileyo nakubasebenzi kwindawo yolusebenzo. Kuchongwa iindawo, bemanywa abantu abafanelekileyo, kulungiselelwa iziselo kwaye kumiselwa iinkqubo zexesha leendibano nezemiganxa. Kucutshungwa iinkalazo zohambo nezondlo zendawo yolusebenzo. Kucutshungwa onke amanxuva avela kumisebenzi yaloo mlawuli ophakamileyo. Kubhalwa imizuzu yeenkqubo yendibano zaloo mlawuli ophakamileyo xa kufuneka. Kubhalwa iindaba ezithi ngamaxesha nemiqulu eqhelekileyo. Kugcinwa amaxwebhu kulawule ophakamileyo nase ndaweni yolusebenzo xa kuyimfuneko. Kulawulwa izinto ezinjengokubhalwa kweenkokhelo zokuhamba ngeyonke ihora kunye ne-akhawunti zefowuni. Kwamkelwa, kubhalwa kwaye kusasazwa onke amaxwebhu angenayo nayaphumayo. Kuphathwa ukuthengwa kwemizekelo eqhelekileyo njengezixhobo zokubhala, iziselo njl. Kutsalwa onke amaxwebhu afanelekileyo ukwenza ukuba uMlawuli akwazi ukuqwalasela iindibano. Kugcinwa kusafihlwelelwa ngemimiselo / iinkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kwindawo yakhe yokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkxaso ephumelelayo nesebenzayo kuloo mlawuli ophakamileyo. Kufundwa imimiselo / iinkqubo koluntu lonke nakwisebe kwaye namaxwebhu amaninzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba uyiloqondo ekusebenzeni kwayo. Kugcinwa kusafihlwelelwa ngeenkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kwindawo yolawulo yaloo mlawuli ophakamileyo.

af.title: Hulppediensbeampte
af.summary: Hulppediensbeampte benodig in Pretoria om kadastrale dokumente te verwerk en te administreer, met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en rekenaarvaardigheid as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Geen ervaring vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese begrip van kaarte en kadastrale dokumente. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarsagteware. Goeie organisasie. Bo gemiddelde aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Verwerk dokumente vir kadastrale vereistes. Ontvang en registreer diagramme, algemene planne, seksietitels en opnamerekords. Reproduseer kadastrale dokumente vir die registrasiekopieë. Administreer kadastrale dokumente. Maak 'dummy trips' en 'mark out'-borde vir alle dokumentkluisies. Verseker dat uitgedunde hangstroke vervang word en beskadigde dokumente herstel word. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal dokumente op en lewer dokumente wat aangevra word deur personeel by die lessenaars en openbare toonbanke namens eksterne kliënte. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan eksterne kliënte. Vang kadastrale data in. Vang alfa-numeriese data van kadastrale dokumente in die databasis in. Korrigeer ingevoerde foute/ weglatings in data wanneer versoek. Skandeer kadastrale dokumente. Skandeer alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Skenk aandag aan alle versoeke en projekte vir herskanderings, ontbrekende beelde, Client Service Centre en ander afdelings. Argiveer kadastrale dokumente. Berei voor en lê al hierdie dokumente in hul onderskeie dokumentkluisies. Voer 'n ewekansige ondersoek uit van die stand van lê asook die stand van dokumente. Argiveer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente en vul ou dokumente aan. Plaas 'mark out'-borde en 'dummy trips' in die plek van uitgehaalde dokumente.

zu.title: Inkulu Yezinkonzo Ezengeziwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkulu Yezinkonzo Ezengeziwe ePretoria ukuthi iqhube futhi iphathe amadokhumenti e-cadastral, idinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Akukho mkhuleko odingekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngamemeshi namadokhumenti e-cadastral. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile nokubhalwayo). Isofthiwe yekhompyutha. Ukuhlela okuhle. Ukuqashelwa kwemininingwane ngaphezu kwesilinganiselo.
zu.duties: Qhuba amadokhumenti ngezidingo e-cadastral. Yamukela futhi ubhalise ama-diagrams, amaphulani jikelele, ama-sectional title namarekhodi wesurvey. Phinda kwakha amadokhumenti e-cadastral amakhophi wobhaliso. Phatha amadokhumenti e-cadastral. Yenza ‘amatripu amadayimani’ namabhodi okuphawula kuzo zonke izikhwama zamadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi izintambo ezidandaliwe zibuyiswa, futhi amadokhumenti alimele alungiswe. Nikeza ulwazi lwecadastral kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khuphula futhi uhlele amadokhumenti abizwe abasebenzi emawindi kanye nomphakathi ngokomthengi angaphandle. Nikeza ulwazi lwecadastral kubathengi bangaphandle. Faka idatha ye-cadastral. Faka idatha ye-alpha-numeric kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral esigungeni sedatha. Lungisa amaphutha/okushiwe okungalungile kudatha uma kucelwa. Sika amadokhumenti e-cadastral. Sika wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral avunyelwe amasha. Yenzise wonke amacelo namaphrojekthi okusika kabusha, izithombe ezilahlekile, i-Client Service Centre nezinye izigaba. Gcina amadokhumenti e-cadastral. Lungisa futhi ufake wonke la madokhumenti ezikhwana zabo zamadokhumenti. Yenza ukubuyekezwa okungalindelwe kwesimo sokufaka amadokhumenti kanye nesimo samadokhumenti. Gcina amadokhumenti e-cadastral avunyelwe amasha futhi ugcwalise kabusha amadokhumenti amadala. Faka amabhodi okuphawula namatripu amadayimani endaweni yamadokhumenti akhishiwe.

xh.title: Iofisa Yesebe Lonzima
xh.summary: Kufuneka iofisa yesebe lonzima ePretoria ukwenza izigqibo kwaye iphathe amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba, kufuneka iqinisekiswe ngeqondo lemfundo lesiNdimu 12 nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi samabanga ali-12. Akukho nqathi yomsebenzi efunekayo. Ulwazi oluxhumanene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okusisiqendu ngamakhulu necandelo loyilo lomhlaba. Amakhono axhumanene nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo). Isofthiwe ye khompyutha. Ukuqamba izicwangciso ngokuchanekileyo. Ukunaka iinkcukacha ngaphezu kwamana ajikelezileyo.
xh.duties: Qhuba amaxwebhu ngeemfuno zemimiselo yomhlaba. Yamkela uze ubhalise izachazimagama, iiplani eziqhelekileyo, iibizo zamacandelo namarekhodi okulinganisa umhlaba. Yenza ngokutsha amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba ukwenza iikopi zabhalo. Phatha amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba. Yenza ‘iindwendwe ezize’ nemaphwele ‘awaphawulayo’ kubo bonke amagumbiamaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba amasuntswana amdaka abekelwe indawo athatyathelwa ngamantsha, amaxwebhu alimelewo alungiswe. Nikezela ngenkcazelo yemimiselo yomhlaba kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha uze uhambise amaxwebhu afunwa ngabasebenzi bokuvula iifestile kumacala olangage kunye nabantu bemihla ngemihla ngokomthetho wabathengi abangaphandle. Khuphela inkcazelo yemimiselo yomhlaba kubathengi abangaphandle. Bhala idatha zemimiselo yomhlaba. Faka idatha ngamanani namagama ukusuka kumaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba kwisiseko sedatha. Lungisa iimpazamo ezingekhoyo ezibhaliweyo kwidatha xa kuceliwa. Skeni amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba. Skeni onke amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba avunywe kutsha. Phathiswa zonke izicelo neeprojekthi zokuskeni ngokutsha, iimifanekiso ephilayo, Iseko Lesebe Labathengi kunye nolunye uwoleko. Gcina amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba. Lokela uze ufake onke la maxwebhu kumagumbiamaxwebhu awo. Yenza ukuvavanywa ngokungakhethiyo ngohlobo lokugcina amaxwebhu nokubakho kwamaxwebhu. Gcina amaxwebhu ezicwangciso zomhlaba esevunyiwe kutsha uze ugcabisela ngokutsha amaxwebhu amadala. Faka imaphwele okuphawula nazo iindwendwe ezize endaweni yamaxwebhu akhutshiweyo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk (LABOUR Tenants)
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum (Level 05), (Plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk (Level 05) required by the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mbombela, Mpumalanga; Grade 12 certificate essential.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related skills: Good communication (verbal and written). Planning and organisation. Computer literacy. Interpersonal relations. Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Render general clerical support services. Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data (line function). Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents / packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filling system for the component. Type letters and / or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Taking and drafting of minutes. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the component. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Obtain quotations and complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register of the component. Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component. Maintain a leave register for the component. Keep and maintain personnel records in the component. Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in the component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 17 Van Rensburg Street, 7th Floor Bateleur Building, Mbombela, 1200 or by email to Post332@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. Applicants are advised that the salary for Receptionist is R201 093 per annum (Level 04). The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administrasieklerk (ARBEDERS Huurders)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk (Vlak 05) word benodig deur die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mbombela, Mpumalanga; Graad 12-sertifikaat is noodsaaklik.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat hê. Werkverwante vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verstrek algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Rekord, organiseer, berg, vang en haal korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie). Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostate en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente / pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel van die komponent. Tik briewe en / of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Neem en opstel van notules. Verskaf voorsieningskettingklerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Kry kwotasies en vul verkrygingsvorms in vir die aankoop van standaard kantoorartikels. Beheer kantoorstasievoorraad. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf personeeladministrasieklerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Vang en werk uitgawes in die komponent by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reisaansprake van amptenare en dien by bestuurder in vir goedkeuring. Hanteer telefoonrekeninge en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Iklerki Kolawulo (ABASEBENZI Abahashiwe)
zu.summary: Iklerki kolawulo (Izinga 05) kudingwa nguDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development eMbombela, Mpumalanga; Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 siyadingeka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenakuncishwa: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifikedi se-Grade 12. Izikhombi eziqhathaniswa nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngokwenyanga nokubhalwayo). Ukuletha kanye nokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Izindlela zokuziphathisa kubantu. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo. Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka bese ukhipha imibhalo nokwaziswa (umsebenzi ohlobene). Buyekeza izinkomba kanye namanani. Phatha imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakholo bese wamukela nomauthumela amafeksi. Sabelisa amadokhumenti / amaphakethe kubahlaleli abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina bese ulondoloza inkqubo yokugcina amafayela yeqoqo. Bhala izincwadi bese / noma eminye imibhalo uma kudingeka. Gcina bese ulondoloza inkomba yamadokhumenti angena bese aphuma eqoqweni. Ukuthatha kanye nokubhala imizuzu. Nikela ngemisebenzi yolawulo yenqwaba yokuhlinzeka eqoqweni. Xhumana nabahlaleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokutholakala kwezimpahla kanye namasevisi. Thola izinhlamula bese ugcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezingezanjengomsebenzi wezohhovu. Lawula isitokhwe sezinsiza zohhovu. Gcina bese ulondoloza inkomba yempahla yeqoqo. Nikela ngemisebenzi yolawulo bolawulo babasebenzi eqoqweni. Londoloza inkomba yokulalela eqoqweni. Gcina bese ulondoloza imibhalo yabasebenzi eqoqweni. Gcina bese ulondoloza inkomba yobukhona eqoqweni. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Nikela ngemisebenzi yolawulo bezimali eqoqweni. Faka bese ubuyekeza izinkokheli eqoqweni. Hlola ukuziphendukela kwezimali zokuhamba nabasebenzi bese uwathumela kumanjala wokuqinisekisa. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni kanye nemali encane eqoqweni.

xh.title: Clerk woLawulo (ABASEBENZI ABABHENGAYO)
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Clerk wolawulo (Inqanaba 05) kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development eMbombela, Mpumalanga; Isatifikedi sesiQithi se-12 sibalulekile.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babene-Satifikedi sesiQithi se-12. Amakhono ahlobene nesimo: Unxibelelwano oluhle (ngomlomo nangobhalo). Ukuqamba iplani nokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zolawulo ezizeziqu ezenzwayo. Qamba, hlela, gcina, tsala ugcinwe naphakathi ulwazi nemibhalo (umsebenzi woluhlu). Hlaziya oluqhelanayo ngezibalo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi ezifanisiweyo wagcine okanye uthumele ama-fax. Sazisa amaxwebhu / amaphakethe kwabahluki-mbeko abahlukeneyo njengoko kuyimfuno. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lwenkqubo yokuzalisa amaxwebhu kwelinye icala. Bhala iileta nokuba / okanye omnye umbhalo xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina ulungelelwaniso loluqhelanayo lweendatshana ezizingenayo naphuma kwelinye icala. Ukuqhula umbhalo weendatshana nokubhala iinkomfa. Nikeza inkonzo zolawulo zointsinganiselo zesithuba kwelinye icala. Qhagamshela nabahluki-mbeko bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuhambelana nokuzelelwa kwezinto nesezinkonzo. Khupha iindleko zigqityiweyo uze uzalise iifomu zokuzelelwa zokuthenga izinto zofisi ezenzwa ngokwesiqhelo. Lawula isitokhwe sezinto zofisi. Gcina ulungelelwaniso loluqhelanayo lweempahma kwelinye icala. Nikeza inkonzo zolawulo zolawulo lwabasebenzi kwelinye icala. Hlaziya oluqhelanayo loluxesho lokushiya umsebenzi kwelinye icala. Gcina amarekhodi abasebenzi kwelinye icala. Gcina oluqhelanayo lobukho kwelinye icala. Hlela unyuso lwezithuthi nendawo yokuhlala. Nikeza inkonzo zolawulo zezimali kwelinye icala. Tsala uze uhlonze iindleko kwelinye icala. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka iindleko zokusinda nokuhamba zabasebenzi uze uzenikeze kumphathi ukuze azamke. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni nezimali ezincinci kwelinye icala.

jobs.title: Director: Administration and Governance Support Service
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 – R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package), consisting of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Director role in the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand providing administration and governance support, requiring an LLB and middle or senior management experience in legal administration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Bachelor of Laws or related legal qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a Middle / Senior Management level, of which at least three (3) years’ must have been in the field of Legal Administration. A valid driver’s license. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG), prior to the appointment. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Extensive knowledge and experience in Parliamentary operations. Knowledge of Legislative Framework, Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF). Understanding of Treasury and PFMA Regulations. Government legislation. Monitoring and evaluation methods. Legislative drafting. NDP- National Development Plan. Knowledge of government systems and structures. Knowledge of relevant legislations and prescripts. Problem solving skills. Verbal and written communication skills. Analytical skills. Negotiation skills, People and diversity management skills. Strategic and analytical skills. Sound financial management skills. Presentation skills. Research skills. Planning and organizing skills, Computer literacy, (MS Office). Personal Attributes: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovation, Problem solving and analysis, People Management and Empowerment, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Honesty and Integrity, Communication. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements.
jobs.duties: Manage the administrative support to the Secretary General pertaining to compliance function, legal and general research and portfolio committee programme. Manage research and draft advisories whilst instituting proper record management, knowledge systems, policies and procedures. Liaise with other government departments and agencies to ensure smooth intergovernmental cooperation and information sharing. Manage coordination of matters emanating from Parliament’s participation for inter-governmental relations, Judiciary events and programmes. Manage the Directorate. ENQUIRIES Technical Related and HR Enquiries: Mr SW Mekoa Tel No: (010) 493 2500
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/148/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. OTHER POSTS All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za        / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Administrasie en Bystandsdienste vir Goewerneance
af.summary: Direkteurspos in die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Midrand wat administratiewe en goewerneance-ondersteuning bied, met die vereiste van 'n LLB en bestuurservaring op middel- of seniorvlak in regsadministrasie.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Baccalaureus in die Regte of 'n verwante regskwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n Bestuursvlak op middel- / seniorvlak, waarvan ten minste drie (3) jaar in die veld van Regsadministrasie moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Openbare Diens Voor-toetreeprogram soos onderskryf deur die Nasionale Skool van Regering (NSG), voor die aanstelling. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika. Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in Parlementêre bedrywighede. Kennis van die Wetgewende Raamwerk, Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF). Begrip van Tesourie- en PFMA-regulasies. Regeringswetgewing. Monitering en evalueringsmetodes. Wetgewende opstel. NDP- Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Kennis van regeringstelsels en -strukture. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewings en voorskrifte. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Menslike en diversiteitsbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese en analitiese vaardighede. Soliede finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid, (MS Office). Persoonlike eienskappe: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Kennisbestuur, Dienslewering-innovasie, Probleemoplossing en analise, Menslike bestuur en bemagtiging, Kliëntgerigtheid en klikedekenfokus, Eerlikheid en integriteit, Kommunikasie. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n voor-toetreep praktiese oefening as deel van die assesseringsmetode onderneem om die kandidaat se geskiktheid gebaseer op die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal.
af.duties: Bestuur die administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Sekretaris-Generaal met betrekking tot die nakomingsfunksie, regsonderzoek en portefeuljekomiteeprogram. Bestuur navorsing en opstel van adviese terwyl behoorlike rekordbestuur, kennistelsels, beleide en prosedures ingestel word. Skakel met ander regeringsdepartemente en agentskappe om vlotte interregeringsamewerking en inligtingsdeling te verseker. Bestuur die koördinering van sake voortspruitend uit die Parlement se deelname vir interregeringsverhoudinge, Regbank-gebeurtenisse en programme. Bestuur die Direktoraat. zu.title: Umongameli: Isevisi Yokuxhasa Kolawulo Nokuphathwa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli eOffice of the Chief Justice e-Midrand esinikeza ukuxhaswa kolawulo nokuphathwa, esidinga i-LLB nempilo yokusebenza enkundleni yokuphatha noma ezingeni eliphezulu ekuphathweni kwezomthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe ne-Bachelor of Laws noma izifundo ezihlobene nomthetho ezingeni le-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba nokuhlala okungu- five (5) iminyaka ezingeni Lokuqondiswa Phakathi / EsiQondiswa Eziphezulu, okokufa okungenani amathatu (3) iminyaka kufanele kube kundlulo yokuLawula Izomthetho. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Pre-entry Programme njengokuqashiwe yi-National School of Government (NSG), ngaphambi kokugqashwa. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Ulwazi olubanzi nempilo yokusebenza kumisebenzi ye-Parliament. Ulwazi nge-Legislative Framework, i-Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF). Ukuqonda ngomthetho we-Treasury nemithetho ye-PFMA. Umthetho kahulumeni. Izindlela zokuqaphela nokuhlolwa. Ukubhala komthetho. I-NDP- National Development Plan. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo nezakhiwo zahulumeni. Ulwazi ngomthetho ochaziweyo nezibhalo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Amakhono okuhlola. Amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuphatha abantu nobuhlukahlukene. Amakhono okucabanga ngokuhlela nangokuhlola. Amakhono amaqinwe okuphatha imali. Amakhono okubonisa. Amakhono ocwaningo. Amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, i-(MS Office). Izici zobuntu: Ikhono lokuhlela nokuqhola, ukuphatha amaphrogramu namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha ulwazi, ints喻aisa yokuletha izinto ezintsha ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo, ukuxazulula nokuhlola izinkinga, ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla, ukugxila kumthengi nokuqonda izidingo zabathengi, ukuqotho nokuzithiba, ukuxhumana. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bazothatha isenzo esisebenzayo sokuqala ngaphambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komuntu ngokusekelwe ezidingweni ezithile nezenza wonke isikhundla.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuxhaswa kolawulo kwi-Secretary General ngokubhekene nomsebenzi wokuqathaniswa, ucwaningo lomthetho noluvamile neprogramu yoxhaso. Phatha ucwaningo ubhale izeluleko ngenkathi umisa ukuphatwa kwezifundo ezilondolozwayo, izinhlelo zolwazi, izinqubomgomo nezindlela. Xhumana neminyango yahulumeni namanye amasikhosi ukuze kuqiniseke ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwahulumeni nokwabelana ngolwazi. Phatha ukuhlanganisa izinto eziphuma kunkomfanelo yokuqondiswa phakathi kwahulumeni, nemigwaqo yamaphathi khaya ukulawula izindaba, kanye nezinhlelo nobuchule bokulawula imisebenzi nobuchule bokulawula imisebenzi yocwaningo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo nobuchule obusebenzayo. Iimfuno ezincinci zeminyaka emihlanu (5) yokusingatha kwinqanaba lokulawula eliphakathi / eliphezulu, apho kwakunene iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibikwindawo yolawulo lomthetho. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukugqibela okuphumeleleyo kwenkqubo ye-Nyukela Public Service Pre-entry Programme njengoko kukhuthazwe yi-National School of Government (NSG), ngaphambi kokumiswa. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi lwe-Constitution yeRiphablikhi yaseSouth Africa. Ulwazi olubanzi noluvakalelwayo kumsebenzi weParliament. Ulwazi lwe-Legislative Framework, Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF). Ukuqonda ngemigaqo ye-Treasury ne-PFMA Regulations. Umthetho wurhulumente. Iindlela zokuqonda nokuqinisekisa. Ukubhala komthetho. I-NDP- National Development Plan. Ulwazi lweenkqubo neendlela zurhulumente. Ulwazi ngomthetho onxulumene nemictho. Izakhono zokusombulula iingxaki. Izakhono zokuxoxa nokuqamba ngeenkcukacha zobhalo nezethu. Izakhono zohlalutyo. Izakhono zokucinga ngokusesikweni, izakhono zokuLawula abantu nokwahlukahluka. Izakhono ezibalulekileyo nezohlalutyo. Izakhono ezithembekileyo zolawulo lemali. Izakhono zokuqhutywa koluntu. Izakhono zokuphonononga. Izakhono zocwangciso nokuhlela, Ulwazi ngemikhondo yekhompyutha, (MS Office). Iimpawu zobuntu: Ikhono nolawulo olunamandla, Ulawulo lwenkqubo neshedi, Ulawulo lweMali, Ulawulo loguqulo, Ulawulo loLwazi, Intsingiselo yokuhambisa iinkonzo, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda, Ulawulo lweNtshukumo kaBantu, Uqwalaselo kubathengi, Inyaniso nokuzithembisa, Unxibelelwano. Onke amacandelo amiselweyo aya kwenza isicatshulwa esingangenanga ngaphambi kokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinga ukumisela ukuba umntu uyamfanelwa isithuba ngakumbi ngokusekelwe kwimfuno yayo yobuchwepheshe nengamava.
xh.duties: Lawula inkxaso yolawulo kuSekretarisi Jikelele ngokubhekisele kumsebenzi wokuvumelana nomthetho, uphando lomthetho nolubanzi, nenkqubo yekomiti. Lawula uphando yize ubhale iingcebiso ngelixa usungula ulawulo olulungele iirekhodi, iinkqubo zolwazi, iinkqubo neemigaqo. Qhagamshelana namanye amasebe urhulumente nee-agensi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenzisana okulula phakathi kurhulumente nokuveliselana ulwazi. Lawula ukuqhutywa kwezinto eziphuma kumanyano lweParliament kumazwe kurhulumente, iiganekiso zabaBeki bomthetho neenkqubo. Lawula iNqanaba.
