jobs.title: Administrative Officer
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer needed at the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town to oversee court recording systems and train administration clerks.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Public Management/ Administration or an equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added ad. Skills: Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), time management, problem solving, planning and organising. Along with the following attributes: flexible, self-driven, motivated, ability to work under pressure, accuracy and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Ensure good quality recording of court proceedings by training newly appointed Administration Clerks (DCRS) on technical and administration aspects of operating the court recording machine, ensuring that tests are run on all court recording machines every morning before court sittings to check the microphone status and sound quality, ensure that all DCRS clerks are seated in court 15 minutes before court proceedings, troubleshoot reported technical problems on court recording machines to resolve or confirm the reported problem, log calls to helpdesk for Court Recording Machine problems that cannot be resolved by troubleshoot, ensure that all clerks utilize headphones throughout court proceedings and they playback recordings at intervals to monitor quality of the audio, ensure court recordings are backed-up and filed systematically by facilitating transcription of Judgments for the purpose of backup, ensure digital and physical court recordings (CD’s and Transcriptions) are marked clearly with case details and parties’ details, file physical court recordings(CD’s and Transcriptions) in an access controlled strong room and in a systematic manner, ensure that CRT system uploads court recordings to the local server, ensure Admin Clerks (DCRS) download court recordings to CD’s or USB’s, facilitate the transcription services within the court by retrieve cases upon receipt of written request for transcriptions, update the transcription register before court recordings are sent to the transcriber and after the transcribed records are received, test court recording for audibility before sending it to the transcriber, ensure the transcriber meets the turnaround time and implement penalties when the transcriber fails to comply with the SLA, liaise with the requester upon receipt of transcribed records, follow-up invoices with the transcriber and ensure they are paid within 30 days, supervise and develop staff by ensuring general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, ensure that officials adhere to proper mannerisms when in the courtroom by refraining from using their cellphones in court as this can interfere with the quality of the recording, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance agreements for the section and assessing staff half yearly and annually, conduct and discipline of employees, ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning, address enquires and provide advise and guidance on asset allocation and control, ensure the assets in the office and all equipment is accounted for and that all assets correspond with the custodian and location. Perform any other relevant administrative support functions to the Judiciary, Court Manager and Supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032 HR Related Enquiries: Ms N Chwethiso Tel No: (021) 480 2411
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/149/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za        / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte word benodig by die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town om hofopnamesisteme te bestuur en administrasieklerke op te lei.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Vaardighede: Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), tydbestuur, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: buigsaam, selfgedrewe, gemotiveerd, vermoë om onder druk te werk, akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Verseker goeie gehalte-opname van hofverrigtinge deur nuutbenoemde Administrasieklerke (DCRS) op te lei oor tegniese en administratiewe aspekte van die bedryf van die hofopnamemasjien, verseker dat toetse elke oggend voor hofsittings op alle hofopnamemasjiene gedoen word om die mikrofoonstatus en klankgehalte na te gaan, verseker dat alle DCRS-klerks 15 minute voor hofverrigtinge in die hof sit, los aangemelde tegniese probleme op hofopnamemasjiene op of bevestig die aangemelde probleem, log oproepe na die helpdesk vir Hofopnamemasjienprobleme wat nie deur probleemoplossing opgelos kan word nie, verseker dat alle klerke deurlopend gedurende hofverrigtinge oorfone gebruik en dat hulle opnames by tussenposes terugspeel om die klankgehalte te monitor, verseker dat hofopnames sistematies gerugsteun en geberg word deur die transkripsie van Vonnisse vir rugsteundoeleindiges te fasiliteer, verseker dat digitale en fisiese hofopnames (CD's en Transkripsies) duidelik met saakbesonderhede en partye se besonderhede gemerk word, berg fisiese hofopnames (CD's en Transkripsies) in 'n toegangbeheerde sterkkamer en op 'n sistematiese wyse, verseker dat die CRT-stelsel hofopnames na die plaaslike bediener oplaai, verseker Admin-klerke (DCRS) laai hofopnames na CD's of USB's af, fasiliteer die transkripsiediens binne die hof deur sake te haal by ontvangs van skriftelike versoeke vir transkripsies, werk die transkripsieregister by voordat hofopnames na die transkribeerder gestuur word en nadat die getranskribeerde rekords ontvang is, toets hofopnames vir hoorbaarheid voordat dit na die transkribeerder gestuur word, verseker die transkribeerder haal die draaityd en implementeer strawwe wanneer die transkribeerder nie aan die SLA voldoen nie, skakel met die versoeker by ontvangs van getranskribeerde rekords, volg fakture op by die transkribeerder en verseker dit word binne 30 dae betaal, hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel deur algemene toesig oor werknemers te verseker, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, verseker dat amptenare by behoorlike maniere hou wanneer hulle in die hofsaal is deur te weerhou daarvan om hul selfone in die hof te gebruik aangesien dit die gehalte van die opname kan beïnvloed, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasieooreenkomste vir die afdeling en assesseer personeel halfjaarliks en jaarliks, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers, verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werksisteme en -prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker, hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bateseining en -beheer, verseker dat die bates in die kantoor en alle toerusting verreken is en dat alle bates ooreenstem met die bewaarder en ligging. Voer enige ander relevante administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies uit vir die Regbank, Hofbestuurder en Toesighouer.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokuqashwa
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhundla Somphathi Wokuqashwa eWestern Cape High Court eCape Town ukuba alawule izinhlelo zokurekhoda enkantolo kanye nokuqeqesha abakhi bomphathi.
zu.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufanele babe ne-Diploma Yezwe eNqubenweni Yezempilo/ Ukuqashwa noma iziqu ezilinganayo eziku-NQF level six (6) anamakhredithi angu-360 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisensi yokuqashwa eqinisekisiwe izoba usizo oluqhamuka. Ikhono: Ukuba nokubona kahle ikhompuyutha (MS Office), ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqashiwe), ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Kanye nezici ezilandelayo: ukuguquguquka, ukuziqasha, ukuqashwa, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga elikhulu, ukufana kanye nanokunaka imininingwane.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukurekhodwa kokuqeqeshiwe kwezinqumo zenkantolo ngokuqeqesha abakhi bokuqashwa abasha bomphathi (DCRS) ngamacimbana obuchwepheshe nobuphathi bokusebenzisa imishini yokurekhoda inkantolo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlolwa zonke imishini zokurekhoda inkantolo ekuseni ngaphambi kokuhla kwenkantolo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo sezincwadi ezibhaliwe kanye nengqondo yezwi, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abakhi bokuqashwa be-DCRS bahlala enkantolo 15 amaminithi ngaphambi kokuqala kwezinqumo zenkantolo, uxazulula izinkinga ezibikwe ngobuchwepheshe ezimishinini zokurekhoda inkantolo ukuze kuxazululwe noma kuqinisekiswe inkinga ebikiwe, biza ideski losizo mayelana nezinkinga zeMshini Wokurekhoda Inkantolo ezingenakuxazululwa ngokuXazulula inkinga, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abakhi bakuqasha bamaphonsi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sezinqumo zenkantolo futhi bayayidlala futhi imiqulu ngesikhathi ngesikhathi ukuze kuhlolwe izinga lomsindo, qinisekisa ukuthi imiqulu yenkantolo igcinwa ngokuphephile futhi yahlelwa ngokuhamba kwesimiso ngokuqeqesha ukubhalwa kwezinqumo ngenjongo yokugcina ngokuphephile, qinisekisa ukuthi imiqulu yedijithali nengokomzimba yenkantolo (Ama-CD kanye Nokuqopha) iphawulwe ngokusobala ngedatha yecalaka kanye nedatha yamacala, gcina imiqulu yenkantolo engokomzimba (Ama-CD kanye Nokuqopha) endlini egqamiswayo elawulwa ukungena ngemvume nangendlela ehleliwe, qinisekisa ukuthi isistimu ye-CRT layisha imiqulu yenkantolo kwiseva yaseduze, qinisekisa ukuthi abakhi bomphathi (DCRS) layisha imiqulu yenkantolo kuma-CD noma kuma-USB, qeqesha izinkonzo zokuqopha ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ngokuthola izinkomba uma sekufikelwe isicelo esibhaliwe sokufaka izwi eliqoshiwe, qinisekisa ukuthi umqulu wokuqopha uphephile ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa komqopi wezwi eliqoshiwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwawo, hola isibhalo salo ngasemuva kokuthunyelwa kwawo futhi aluhole ngasemuva kokufika kwawo ongqongqoshe, hola izinga lomsindo womqulu wokuqopha ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa kumqopi wezwi eliqoshiwe, qinisekisa ukuthi umqopi wezwi eliqoshiwe uhambisana nesikhathi esihlongozwayo futhi faka izigwebo uma ehluleka ukuhambisana ne-SLA, axhumane nesicelo uma kufika umbhalo oqoshiwe oqediwe, landela amafomu okuhola nomqoshi kanye nokutholwa kokuhola phakathi kwama-30 amasuku, qaphisise kanye nokuqeqesha izisebenzi ukuze kuba khona ukuqaphisisa ngokujwayelekile izisebenzi, abela imisebenzi kanye nokwenza ukulawula izinga leminikelo yezisebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zihambisana nemikhuba ehle njengoba zisebenza enkantolo ngokuziqeda ekubameni amafomu enkantolo njengoba lokho kungase kwehlise izinga lomsindo, lawula ukunikelwa kwesikhathi sabakhi bokuqashwa, qondisa kanye nokuqeqesha ngenhloso yokuba bazi kabanzi ngemisebenzi yabo, lawula izingqungqulu zokusuka enkantolo futhi uhlole izisebenzi ngo-X wayeka u-X, hola izingxoxo kanye nosuku lokuphothula isigaba, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abakhi bokuqashwa baqeqeshwe baphile bazi ukusebenza kahle ukwenza imisebenzi edingekayo, hlela, faka kusebenze kanye nokuhola ukusebenza kwesistimu nezinqubo ukuze kuhlelwe ukusebenza kahle, qinisekisa imibuzo, ifake izinkomba, kanye nezikhangiso ngemali abayikhokhisile nendlela yokusebenza kwemali efunwa, qinisekisa ukuthi impahla ehhotela kanye nokuqashwa komshini wonke kubalwe kahle futhi uhambisana nemigomo yomgciniohlabathi nendawo abakuyo. Wenze noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ephathelene nokuqashwa komsebenzi njengomphathi ohlukene nezisebenzi, kanye noMphathi Wenkantolo.

xh.title: IOfisi Ejongene Nemisebenzi Yolawulo
xh.summary: Kfunwa iOfisi Ejongene Nemisebenzi Yolawulo kwi Western Cape High Court eCape Town ukuba iqhube iinkqubo zokurekhoda iinkqubo zangenkundla kwaye ilatise omanathi bolawulo.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nenqanaba lesidanga kwiNqanaba leSazenza kwiLawulo loLuntu/ uLawulo okanye izifundo ezingundothoyo kwinqanaba le-NQF level six (6) nge-credits ezingama-360 njengokuvunyiwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisenisi yokuqesha elisebenzayo kuya kuba lusixhaso. Amakhono: Anamakhono ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Office), kunxibelelwano (elibhalwayo nanelothethwayo), ekulawulen ixesha, ekuxazululeni iingxaki, nakuqamba ngokulungelelanisa. Kunye noluhlu lweempawu zilandelayo: igalelo, uzifakelela phambili, nomdla wokwenza, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuchaneka nokunaka iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa irekhodi elilungile lenkqubo zangenkundla ngokulatisha omanathi bolawulo abasanda kunikwa isithuba (DCRS) ngemicimbi yobuchwepheshe nolawulo ekusebenziseni ithemu yokurekhoda xh.requirements: Umfuni kufuneka abe nestshatshati se-Grade 12 okanye izifundo ezingokoqobo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengoko evunywa yi-SAQA. Akukho ndiphi efunekayo. For example, clients such as Auditors and HR practitioners, process documents for archiving and/ disposal, conduct electronic scanning of files, sort and package files for archives and distribution, compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor and keep records for archived documents.

af.title: Registrateurklerk
af.summary: Registrateurklerk benodig by die KwaZulu-Natal Hooggeregshof in Pietermaritzburg om korrespondensie, posregistrasie en liasering te hanteer, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat vereis sonder vorige ervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad twaalf (12)-sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) beskik soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring vereis nie. 'n Relevante kwalifikasie in die veld sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Begrip van die Nasionale Argiewe-wet en Regulasies, begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer, kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, begrip van die werk in die registratuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike betrekkinge, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), numeries, tydbestuur, beplanning, organisasie en verslagskryfvaardighede.
af.duties: Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang, sorteer, registreer en stuur pos, verspreid kennisgewings oor registratuuraangeleenthede, registreer ontvangs lêers en beskermingsrekords en verseker korrekte invul, maak seker dat die stoorkamer gesluit is om toegang te beperk, vervang uitgeskeurde registers, hou geslote registers veilig in die argiefstoorkamer, lewer 'n doeltreffende invul- en rekordbestuursdiens, open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/bêre, traceer (handmatig) en onttrek dokumente en lêers, verseker dat die inligting binne die persoonlike lêer ooreenkomstig ingevul is, voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers, handhou veilige bewaring en beskerming van lêers en rekords, benoem lêers netjies vir maklike onttrekking, reël en verpak lêers vir argief en verspreiding, verseker dat daar genoegsame ruimte vir invul in die stoorkamer is om verkeerde invul van dokumente te voorkom, registreer alle lêers wat deur relevante kliënte aangevra word. Byvoorbeeld, kliënte soos Ouditeure en HR-praktisyne, prosesseer dokumente vir argivering en/of vernietiging, voer elektroniese skandering van lêers uit, sorteer en verpak lêers vir argief en verspreiding, stel 'n lys op van dokumente wat gearchiveer moet word en dien dit by die toesighouer in en hou rekords vir gearchiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Umsekeli Weregistri
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsekeli weregistri eKwaZulu-Natal High Court ePietermaritzburg ukuphatha ukuxhumana okushaywe ngebhosi, ukubhalisa kwegadli kanye nokufaka ezibambele, kudingeka isitifiketi se-Grade 12 ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nokuhlola ngaphambilini.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade twelve (12) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Akukho hlola oludingekayo. Iziqu ezihambisanayo emkhakheni zizoba yin advantage. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda i-National Archives Act kanye nezinqubo zayo, ukuqonda umthethosisekelo ohlela ukusebenza kwesezinkundleni zomphakathi, ulwazi ngemigomo yokugcina nokubuyisela imibhalo ngokuya ngendawo yokusebenza, ukuqonda umsebenzi weregistri kanye nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Ukubekezela ekuxhumeni (okushiwayo nokubhaliwe), emihlobanweni yabantu, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-MS Office), kwamanani, ekuphateni isikhathi, ekwelapheni, ekuhlelelweni kanye nakhono ebhalweni lamabhali.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuxhumana okungena nokuphuma. Yamukela, hlela, bhalisa uthumele igaguli, abeke izaziso mayelana nezindaba zeregistri, bhalise amafayela okwamukelwe futhi uvikele amabhali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcwaliswa okufanele, qiniseka ukuthi igumbi lokugcina lilivaliwe ukuze kunqandwe ukungena, buyisela izincwadi ezibhaliwe zokubhalisa, gcine izincwadi ezivaliwe zokubhalisa zivikeleke egumbini lokugcina izinto zangokomlando, nikeza insiza efanele yokugcwalisa kanye nokuphatha amabhali, vula futhi uvale amafayela ngokwesimiso sokuhlukanisa amabhali. Faka /gcina, landa (ngomile) futhi ubuyisele amabhali namafayela, qiniseka ukuthi ulwazi olusefayeleni lakho lobuqu lufakwe ngendlela efanele, gcwalisa amakhadi okubhalisa wonke amafayela, gcine ukuvikeleka nokukhuselwa kwamafayela namabhali, phawula amafayela ngokuhlanzekile ukuze kube lula ukuwabuyisela, hlela futhi uthungathe amafayela okuya kwi-archives nasekuhonweni, qiniseka ukuthi kunasikhathi esanele sokugcwalisa egumbini lokugcina ukuze kunqandwe ukugcwalisa okungalungile kwamabhali, bhalisa wonke amafayela aceliwe abathintekayo. Isibonelo, abathintekayo njengama-Auditor kanye nabasebenzi be-HR, hlela amabhali okuya kwi-arching kanye/noma ukulahlwa, yenze isikani samabhali ngekhompuyutha, hlela futhi uthungathe amafayela okuya kwi-archives nasekuhonweni, hlela uhlu lwamabhali okuya kwi-archives uwunikeze ongqangi futhi ugcine amabhali okuya kwi-archives.

xh.title: Umsekikadi weRegistry
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumsekikadi weRegistry kwiKhotho Ephakamileyo yaseKwaZulu-Natal ePietermaritzburg ukugqithisa kunye nokubhalisa imibhalo neposi, kwaye kufuneka abe neNqanaba le-12 ngaphandle kokuba namava angaphambili.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seNqanaba leshumi elinesibini (12) okanye isifundo esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF lesine (4) njengoko qatshelwa yiSAQA. Akukho malunga novamadinga. Isifundo esifanelekileyo kwinkalo siza kuba ngumda olongezelelweyo ulumko. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda umthetho weNational Archives kunye noMthetho wokuLawula, ukuqonda ingqungquthela yomthetho elawula inkonzo yaseburhulumenthe, ulwazi lwendlela zokugcina nokuzelelana kolwazi ngokwezi zinto zendalo yokusebenza, ukuqonda umsebenzi kwindlu yokugcina iifayili kunye neemPela zikaBatho Pele. Ukuba nelumbo kwinkcukacha (kubhalwe nasekuqatywayo), ukuxhumana nabantu, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), izibalo, ulawulo lwexesha, ukuqamba, ukuhlela kwaye ubhale iingxelo.
xh.duties: Phatha imibhalo eya naphuma. Yamkela, hlela, bhalise kwaye uthumele iposi, yahlula izaziso ezimalunga nendlu yokugcina iifayili, qamba iifayili ezamkeliweyo zigcinwe kulawulo lwamarekhodi, qinisekisa ukuba kugciniwe ngokuchanekileyo, qinisekisa ukuba indlu yokugcina itshixiwe ukusikisa ukufikelela, tshintsha oovamakayitshixiweyo bokuqamba, gcina oovamakayitshixiweyo basezweni kwindlu yokugcina iifayili ezizeze, yemba inkonzo ebalaseleyo yokugciniwa nokuqatshwa kolwazi, vula kwaye uvale iifayili ngokweNdlela yokuqatshwa kwamarekhodi. Umzekelo, abathengi abanjengabaBalundi nabasebenzi beHR, cedula amaxwebhu okuzezelwa kwaye/okanye okutshatayo,enza ukuskena ngekhompyutha kwamafayili, hlela kwaye udityanise iifayili zilandwe zithunyelwe, hlela uludwe lwamaxwebhu azezelwayo alungele uncome kuwo omlawuli kwaye ugcine amarekhodi amaxwebhu azizezelwe kwindlu yokugcina.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.

Skilled in communication (written and verbal), computer literacy (MS Office), interpersonal relations, planning and organisational. Along with following attributes: Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, attention to detail, work under pressure and teamwork
jobs.duties: Support the Development of sourcing strategy, support collation information for Demand Management Plans and Procurement Plans, support in the development of the specifications/Terms of reference, support the compiling of tender, quotations and specifications, assisting in conducting bids and closing of bids, provide secretariat support for Bid Specification and Bid Evaluation committee, assist with preparation of documents to the relevant committees, maintaining of filling system for awarded bids, ensure that bid register is up to date and support the SCM reporting on procurement
jobs.enquiries: Technical related enquiries: Ms NB Ntimande Tel No: (010) 493 2601 HR related enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/161/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk gesoek deur die Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand om bronbemiddelingsstrategieë, vraagbestuursplanne, tenderopstelling en bodprosesse te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad twaalf (12)-sertifikaat hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Openbare Diensbeleidraamwerke, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), BBB-EE-regulasies, Tesourie-regulasies en Voorsieningskettingregulasies. Vaardig in kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), interpersoonlike verhoudinge, beplanning en organisatories. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, sperdatums na te kom, aandag aan besonderhede, onder druk te werk en spanwerk
af.duties: Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van bronbemiddelingsstrategie, ondersteun die versameling van inligting vir Vraagbestuursplanne en Aankoopplanne, ondersteun in die ontwikkeling van die spesifikasies/Terms of reference, ondersteun die opstel van tender, kwotasies en spesifikasies, help met die uitvoer van bieë en sluiting van bieë, verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning vir Bodspesifikasie- en Bode evalueringskomitee, help met die voorbereiding van dokumente vir die tersaaklike komitees, handhaaf van die invulsisteem vir toegekende bieë, verseker dat bodregister op datum is en ondersteun die SCM-verslagdoening oor aankope

zu.title: Umhleli Weqela Lezinsiza
zu.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand ifuna uMhleli Weqela Lezinsiza ukuba axhase izinhlela zokuthola izinsiza, izindlela zokulawula izidingo, ukuhlanganisa amatender kanye namaphrocessi okubiza.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izifundo kufanele babe nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Grade twelve (12). Akukho mkhawulo wamava ofunekayo. Ilayisense yokuqasha ehleliwe kuzoba yinzuzo ehambisana nalokhu. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Policy Frameworks, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho ye-BBB-EE, i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Supply Chain Regulations. Unolwazi lokuxhumana (okubhalisiwe nakukhulumayo), ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-MS Office), ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto. Kuhambisana nale mininingwane elandelayo: Ikono lokusebenza wedwa, ukuhlangabezana namajubane, ukunaka imininingwane, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinshi kanye nokusebenza njengeqela.
zu.duties: Xhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlela yokuthola izinsiza. Xhasa ukuqoqa ulwazi lwe-Demand Management Plans kanye ne-Procurement Plans. Xhasa ekuthuthukiseni izinkomba/Izinkulumo zeminingwane. Xhasa ukuhlanganisa amatender, izinkomba kanye nemininingwane. Siza ekwenzeni amabidi nokuvalela kwamabidi. Nikeza inkxaso yesikhulumi kwi-Bid Specification kanye ne-Bid Evaluation committee. Siza nokulungiselela kwemibhalo kumakomiti ahambisanayo. Gcina indlela yokugcina emibhaleni yamabidi anikeziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi irejista yamabidi ihlale ibuyekezwe. Xhasa ukubika kwe-SCM mayelana nokuqasha izinto.

xh.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand ifuna uMlondolozi we-Supply Chain ukuze axhase izicwangciso zokuziphendula, iplani zolawulo lwemfuno, ukuqokelelwa kwengxelo yokuthengiselana kwaye axhase iinkqubo zemigca ethengiselwanayo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethe se-Grade twelve (12). Akukho ngaphezu kwamava alingwayo afunekayo. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa eyasebenzayo iya kuba ngelinye lawona malunga onyukela. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Policy Frameworks, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-BBB-EE regulations, i-Treasury Regulations nakuLawulo lwe-Supply Chain. Ukhethwe kwindalo yokuthetha nokubhala, ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ukuqhathanisa kwabathintana nabantu, ulungelelwaniso nokuqulunqa. Kananjalo ngeempawu elandelayo: Ikakhulu lokusebenza kodwa, ukugqiba umsebenzi ngexesha, ukunaka iinkcukacha, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokusebenza njengodidi
xh.duties: Xhasa ukuqulunqwa kwezicwangciso zokuziphendula, xhasa ukuqokelelwa kolwazi kwi-Demand Management Plans nakuqulunqwa kwe-Procurement Plans, xhasa ekuxhaseni ukubhaliswa okuchazwe ngokomthetho/i-Terms of reference, xhasa ukubhaliswa kwemigca ethengiselwanayo, izinconelo nezicwangciso, size uncedise ekuphuhlisweni nokuvalwa kwemigca ethengiselwanayo, nikezela inkxaso yokuqulunqa i-Bid Specification kunye nekomiti elungelelanisa imigca ethengiselwanayo, nceda kulungiselela ooxwebhu abaya kumakomiti afanelekileyo, gcina inkqubo yokugcina iifayili zemigca ethengiselwanayo ephumelelileyo, qinisekisa ukuba irejista yemigca ethengiselwanayo iyatya ngokufikelela ixesha, size uxhase inkcazelo ngenkqubo yokuthenga

af.title: Tikster
af.summary: Tikster benodig by die Eastern Cape High Court in Gqeberha om hofbevele, appèlle, hersienings en verwante regsdokumente te tik, met Graad 12 en 'n tikspoed van 35 wpm as vereistes.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken besit. Geen ervering vereis. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Openbare Dienste-wetgewing. Preskripte en Regulasies. Bedreven in 'n tikspoed van ten minste 35 woorde per minuut (wpm), rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), navorsing, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), probleemoplossing en tydbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: kreatiewe denke, akkuraatheid, aandag aan besonderhede en vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Tik hofbevele en tersaaklike hofdokumente in ooreenstemming met die goedkeuring op die voorkant van die hoflêer, tik appèlle, hersienings, memorandums, verslae, notule, sirkulêre, kennisse van sitplasing, getuieverklarings en belastingmeester-verslae, tik Rule 6(12)-bevele en maak dit beskikbaar ooreenkomstig die reël, verseker dat bevele in die korrekte formaat getik en aan die Registrateur vir nagaan verskaf word, verseker dat korreksies aan bevele gedoen word in ooreenstemming met die Registrateur se opdrag, verseker dat alle verkeerde hofbevele en hofdokumente aan die toesighouer gerapporteer word, maak wysigings aan vonnisse soos deur regters versoek/opdrag, oudit die formaat van vonnis en tik dringende aansoeke, sorteer en versprei inkomende en uitgaande lêers, berei versoeke van die Regsprofessie en publiek voor, stel termynrolle vir elke hoftermyn op in ooreenstemming met die geproklameerde termyne, tik teengeweerde en onteengeweerde motion court-rol ooreenkomstig die vereiste formaat en voer die regters se name in, tik aanvullende rolle, kommunikeer die rol na Registrateurs en die Judge Presidents Office, verseker opeenvolgende nommering en dat lêers gekategoriseer word, verskaf Prokureurs se inskrywingsbevele aan die Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, kommunikeer hofrolle na belanghebbendes deur middel van e-pos, ontwikkel en onderhou die hofrolle-register, teken werk in die register vir maandelikse statistieke en verseker dat afskrifte van egskeidingsbevele na Home Affairs Head Office gestuur word.

zu.title: Umlobi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi e-Eastern Cape High Court eGqeberha ukugaletha izimemezelo zenkantolo, izinyathelo zokuphikisana, ukuhlola futhi ezinye izixhumanisi ezihlobene nomthetho, okudinga ibhodi le-Grade 12 kanye nesivinini sokugaletha esingu-35 wpm.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade twelve (12) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengoba kuhlonishwe yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhankaso ofunekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Public Services Legislation. Prescripts and Regulations. Unelakhono lokugaletha ngesivinini esingaphezulu kuka-35 words per minute (wpm), ukwaziswa ngamakhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ucwaningo, ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala), ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Kanye nalezimpawu ezilandelayo: ukucabanga ngokubumbulwa, ukunemba,ukuqaphela imininingwane kanye nenkosazana yokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga.
zu.duties: Galetha izimemezelo zenkantolo namaxxeshana enkantolo ahambisana nesiqinisekiso phambi kwefayela lenkantolo, galetha izinyathelo zokuphikisana, ukuhlola, okhokho, izinkalo, imizuzu, iziyashisa, izaziso zokuhiwa, izinkulumo zofakazi namaphuzu wokulawula. Galetha izimemezelo ze-Rule 6(12) futhi zenze zitholakale ngokomthetho. Qiniseka ukuthi izimemezelo zibhalwe endleleni efanele futhi zinikezwe ku-Registrar ukuze aqaphe. Qiniseka ukuthi ukulungiswa kwememezelo kwenziwe ngokomyalo ka-Registrar. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke imimezelo yekantolo engalungile namaxeshana enkantolo abikwa kumphathi. Yenza izinguquko ezinkantolo njengoba bacela/bepho ngalo amajaji. Hlola isakhiwo senkantolo futhi galetha izicelo eziphuthumayo. Hlathanisa futhi wabel imafayela ezingena naphuma. Phendula izicelo ezivela kwindandoya yomthetho nakwintalo. Bhala amathemu ahamba kuleso themu lenkantolo ngokuhambisana namathemu abhaliwe kwi-Gazetted. Galetha ukungenwa nokungangenwa kothafa wethafa yamagama abajaji, futhi galetha imikhankaso enezikunqamela, yenzisana nabaphathi bethafa namahhovisi kaMongameli weNkantolo. Qiniseka ukubala ngokulandelana nokuthi amafayela aqoqaniswe. Nikezela abaqambi izitifikedi sobuzwe kuwo womnyango. Thumela amagama ethafa nabantu abahambisanisana nawo ngekhalembu, sumbatha futhi ulondoloze izitifikedi sabajaji. Bhala umsebenzi okubhalisela izibalo zanyanga zonke, qinisekiswa ukutsatshelwa isampula yamafayela abe behla behla.

xh.title: Umthayipha
xh.summary: Kufuneka umthayipha kwi-Eastern Cape High Court eGqeberha ukuthayipha iimiyalelo zekhotiyo, iibANGO ezichasene nezigwebo, ukuphonononga kwezigwebo namaxwebhu amthetho ahambelanayo, kwaye kufuneka abe neGrade 12 ngesantya sokuthayipa esingu-35 wpm.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethke seGrade twelve (12) okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF elingu-four (4) njengoko kunikwa isiqinisekiso ngumnikelo we-SAQA. Akukho naluphi na uluhlu loluvo olufunekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yoLuntu. Imigaqoyo nezeLiso. Ukuba nobuganga ekuthayipheni ngokwesantya esingaphantsi kwe-35 amagama ngomzuzu (wpm), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukuphonononga, ukunxibelelwana (ngolwimi oluthethwayo nolubhaliweyo), ukusombulula iingxaki nokulawula ixesha. kunye nokuqwalasela oku kulandelayo: ukucinga ngokobomi, ukuchaneka, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha nokuqhwesha ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Thayipha imiyalelo yekhotiyo namaxwebhu ahambelanayo nekhotiyo ngokweendlebe zelifayile yekhotiyo, thayipha iibango ezichasene nezigwebo, ukuphonononga iingxoxo ezichasene nezigwebo, iimemorandam, iingxelo, imizuzu, iimemo ezijikelezayo, izaziso zokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo, iinkcazelo zengqina neengxelo zomphathi we-randi wamagonyamthetho, thatha isigqibo ngemiyalelo ye-Rule 6(12) nize yenzeke ngokomthetho othile, qinisekisa ukuba imiyalelo ithayiphwe ngolwakhiwo oluchanekileyo nize inikezelwe kuMqikqela wokuqinisekisa, qinisekisa ukuba iinguquko kumiyalelo yenziwa ngokwemiyalelo kaMqikqela, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imiyalelo yekhotiyo engachanekanga namaxwebhu ekhotiyo ixelwa kumphathi, yenza iinguqu ezigwebini njengoko bekufunwa/kuqathiwe ngoomajitha, phonononga ulwakhiwo lwesigwebo uthayiphe izicelo ezibuthaka, hlela ukuhamba kwamafayile abakho angena naphuma, ngena izicelo ezivela kubantu bomthetho nakwizigidi sabantu, bhala izithuba ze-rol yexesha lehora ngalinye ngokwezi zithuba ezikhankanyiweyo kulawulo, thatha isigqibo ngokuthayipha i-rol yekhotiyo yezicelo ezichasene nangazo nazingesabo nangokwolwakhiwo olufunekayo ufake amagama oomajitha, thayipha i-rol ezongezelelweyo, yazi i-rol kubaqikqeli nakwiSikhululo seSikhululo soMongameli, qinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokulandelelana namafayile acococke ngokwemimandla, nika abaqethi bebango bamagonyamthetho imiyalelo yokubhalisa kuSebe loBulungiswa nophuhliso loMgaqo-siseko, yazi i-rol yekhotiyo kubantu abathintekayo nge-imeyile, yaphula ulwakhiwo lwazo igcine irekhodi yamagama amakhotiyo, bhala umsebenzi kwirekhodi yamava nyanga zonke ukuqinisekisa iyonke imiyalezo yamacala eqhutywa kwindlu yokuqala yeZeMimandla.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Engineering Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Engineering Services at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 7 engineering qualification and ECSA registration.
jobs.requirements: A Minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in engineering or relevant field of study. A minimum of 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level in the Engineering field. Compulsory professional registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA). Knowledge: Engineering best practice Project Management; Extensive knowledge of all engineering aspects of the building and construction environment; Public Finance Management Act; Occupational Health and Safety Act; Supply Chain Management; Contract Management. Skills: Decision making; Team leadership; Analytical skills; Creativity; Self- management; Financial management Communication; Computer literacy; Planning and organising; Negotiation skills; Problem solving and analysis. Personal Attributes: Programme and project management; Engineering design and analysis knowledge; Research and development; Computer aided engineering applications; Knowledge of legal compliance; Technical report writing; Creating high-performance culture; Networking; Engineering and professional judgment.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development of engineering plans, processes, and procedures. Oversee the development and maintenance of professional best practice parameters and quality standards and manuals and guideline on professional standards. Monitor and ensure the implementation and continuous adherence to professional guideline and standards. Manage approvals or audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory. Ensure engineering design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Oversee budget and timelines for engineering projects. Promote and enforce a safe and healthy work environment in accordance with applicable legislation and company policies and procedures. Drive continuous improvement of processes, quality and cost to maintain profitability and competitiveness. Oversee the maintenance of engineering operational effectiveness. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Ensure engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels in accordance with Departmental objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to departmental goals to direct or redirect engineering services. Ensure and monitor compliance with standard operating procedures. Provide expert advice on electrical safety and risk management. Ensure compliance to OHSA, legal and environmental requirements. Manage cost efficiency of engineering projects and life cycle costing. Manage and provide technical operational advice on water and wastewater treatment purification service to client departments. Oversee the implementation of Water Act within the department. Manage the implementation and maintenance of the Water and Waste Water Plants. Apply research findings to help minimise the environmental impacts of pollution, erosion, and other problems. Research ways to improve water conservation and preservation. Evaluate the feasibility of water-related projects, such as irrigation systems and waste treatment facilities. Manage the Chief Directorate. Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Develop and manage the operational plan of the Directorate and report on progress as required. Manage performance and development of employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575
jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Chief Director: Engineering Services must be submitted to: Recruitment26-83@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Ingenieursdienste
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Ingenieursdienste by die Hoofkantoor van die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-ingenieurskwalifikasie en ECSA-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in ingenieurswese of 'n relevante studierigting. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in die ingenieursveld. Verpligte professionele registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA). Kennis: Ingenieurswese se beste praktyke Projekbestuur; Uitgebreide kennis van alle ingenieursaspekte van die bou- en konstruksie-omgewing; Public Finance Management Act; Occupational Health and Safety Act; Toevoerkettingbestuur; Kontrakbestuur. Vaardighede: Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Analitiese vaardighede; Kreatiwiteit; Selfbestuur; Finansiële bestuur Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Beplanning en organisering; Onderhandelingsvaardighede; Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Persoonlike eienskappe: Program- en projekbestuur; Ingenieursontwerp en ontledingskennis; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings; Kennis van regsoplewing; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Skep van hoëprestasiekultuur; Netwerkwerking; Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling van ingenieursplanne, prosesse en prosedures. Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van professionele beste-praktyk-parameters en kwaliteitsstandaarde en handleidings en riglyne oor professionele standaarde. Monitor en verseker die implementering en deurlopende nakoming van professionele riglyne en standaarde. Bestuur goedkeurings of oudits op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe volgens ontwerpsbeginsels of teorie. Verseker ingenieursontwerpspogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Hou toezig oor begroting en tydlyne vir ingenieursprojekte. Bevorder en handhaaf 'n veilige en gesonde werkomgewing in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en maatskappybeleid en prosedures. Dryf deurlopende verbetering van prosesse, gehalte en koste aan om winsgewendheid en mededingendheid te handhaaf. Hou toezig oor die instandhouding van ingenieursoperasionele doeltreffendheid. Bestuur die uitvoering van instandhoudingstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Verseker ingenieursinstandhoudingstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke in ooreenstemming met departementele doelwitte om optimum operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor instandhoudingdoeltreffendheid volgens departementele doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te rig of herlei. Verseker en monitor nakoming van standaard bedryfsprosedures. Verskaf kundige advies oor elektriese veiligheid en risikobestuur. Verseker nakoming van OHSA, regs- en omgewingsvereistes. Bestuur kostedoeltreffendheid van ingenieursprojekte en lewenssikluskosteberekening. Bestuur en verskaf tegniese operasionele advies oor water- en afvalwaterbehandelingsuiweringsdiens aan kliëntdepartemente. Hou toezig oor die implementering van die Water Act binne die departement. Bestuur die implementering en instandhouding van die water- en afvalwateraanlegte. Pas navorsingsbevindings toe om die omgewingsimpakte van besoedeling, erosie en ander probleme te help minimaliseer. Ondersoek maniere om waterbewaring en -behoud te verbeter. Evalueer die haalbaarheid van waterverwante projekte, soos besproeiingstelsels en afvalbehandelingsfasiliteite. Bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat. Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtings te bereik. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Direktoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Stel al die vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Kwaliteitskontrole van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer is. Monitor die begroting en uitgawes vir die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Amasevisi Enjiniyela
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu: Amasevisi Enjiniyela ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Pretoria, elidinga iziqu zokujwayela i-NQF level 7 nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisongeziwe ezingeni le-NQF level 7 njengoba zivunyiwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kunjiniyela noma esikhundleni esihambisanayo sokufunda. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yokuhlalelela ezingeni lebaluleke kakhulu ekuphathweni enkundleni yonjiniyela. Ukubhaliswa njengomunwezulu emthethweni kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) okuyisinyathelo esibekiwe. Ulwazi: Izindlela ezinhle zokujwayela injiniyela; Ukuphatha iphulo; Ulwazi olubanzi ngazo zonzindaba zokujwayela injiniyela kumonga wokwakha nokuqamba; I-Public Finance Management Act; I-Occupational Health and Safety Act; Ukuphatha intambo yokuhlinzeka; Ukuphatha isivumelwano. Amakhono: Ukwenza izinqumo; Ukuba ngumholi weqembu; Amakhono okuhlaziya; Ukudala; Ukuziphatha; Ukuphatha izimali; Ukuxhumana; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuhlela nokuqamba; Amakhono wokuxoxisana; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Izici Zomuntu: Ukuphatha amaphulo; Ulwazi lokuyila nokuahlaziya injiniyela; Ucwaningo nentuthuko; Izinhlelo zokujwayela injiniyela ezingeyomkhondo; Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho; Ukubhala izinhlaka ezinobuchwepheshe; Ukudala isiko lokusebenza kanzima; Ukuxhumanisa; Ukwahlulela njengomunwezulu.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, izinqubo namagumbi okujwayela injiniyela. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwezibopho ezingcono kakhulu zomunwezulu, izinga lokulingana, amabhuku kanye nomhlahlandlela ngamazinga omunwezulu. Hlola ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa ngokuqhubekayo komhlahlandlela namazinga omunwezulu. Phatha izivumelwano noma ukuhlola kwezinto ezintsha zokuyila injiniyela ngokuyila imigomo noma inqubo. Qinisekisa imizamo yokuyila injiniyela nokuhlanganisa kwezikhundla ukuze kuhlanganiswe kahle neteknoloji yamanje. Qapha imephu yokusebenza kanye namasikhathi emisebenzi yonjiniyela. Khuthaza futhi wenze isimemo sendawo yokusebenza ephephile enempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho ohambisana kanye namapholisi namagumbi enkampani. Qedela ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwezinqubo, ikhwalithi nentengo ukuze kugcinwe inzuzo nokuncintisana. Qapha ukugcinwa kokusebenza kahle kokujwayela injiniyela. Phatha ukuphethwa kwendlela yokulondolozwa ngokunikeza izakhiwo, izinhlelo namathuluzi afanele. Qinisekisa amazinga okulondoloza injiniyela, izinkomba namazinga okukhonza ngokuvumelana nemigomo yomnyango ukuze kutholakale ukusebenza okuphumelelisayo. Hlola ukusebenza kahle kokulondoloza ngokuhambisana namagqanso omnyango ukuze kuholelwe noma kuphethwe ngaphandle amasevisi onjiniyela. Qinisekisa futhi uhlola ukuhambisana nezinqubo ezisetshenziswa zansuku zonke. Nikeza angaziyo ngokuphepha kagesi nolawulwa ingozi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-OHSA, imithetho nemithetho yemvelo. Phatha ukusebenza kahle kwentengo emisebenzini yonjiniyela kanye nenani leminyaka yokuphila. Phatha futhi nikeza ingazi yemisebenzo yobuchwepheshe kokutholwa nokuqothwa kwamanzi kanye namasokhwe amanzi kumanyango abathengi. Qapha ukuphethwa kwe-Water Act ngaphakathi komnyango. Phatha ukuphethwa nokulondoloza izitshalo zamanzi namasokhwe amanzi. Faka iziphumo zocwaningo ukuze kuncishiswe imiphumela yemvelo yokungcoliswa, ukuqhwaba, kanye nezinye izinkinga. Cinga izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukugcinwa nokulondolozwa kwamanzi. Hlola ukuzinza kwemisebenzi ehlobene namanzi, njengamasistimu okufukulwa namasokhwe okuhlanzwa. Phatha i-Chief Directorate. Sika futhi gcina izilawuli zangaphakathi ezifanele namasistimu wokubika ukuze kuhambisane nentengo yokusebenza. Thuthukisa futhi phathe ihlelo lokusebenza le-Directorate futhi bika ngokuqhubekayo njengoba kudingeka. Phatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Sika, faka futhi gcina izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle. Lenga futhi thumela zonke izinhlaka zokuphatha ezidingekayo. Lawula khwalithi yomsebenzi ohanjiswa ngabasebenzi. Hlola imali yokusebenza kanye nezimali ezichithiwe kwi-Directorate.

xh.title: Umkhulu weNgqalasela: Iinkonzo zoBunjiniyela
xh.summary: Umkhulu weNgqalasela: Iinkonzo zoBunjiniyela kwiNtloko ePretoria kwisebe lezaSebenzo kaLuntu nezeMiyalezo, kufuneka ifanelekelo lobunjiniyela leNQF level 7 neregileshano leECSA.
xh.requirements: Iselifikelelo esincinanyiyo kumQF level 7 njengokuqatshelwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwibhanqa yobunjiniyela okanye indawo efanayo yokufunda. Isipho sohamba ixesha esingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-5 kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwindawo yobuNjiniyela. Ukubhalwa njengomchweli ngokumthetho kwiEngineering Council of South Africa (ECSA). Ulwazi: Amalungelo amahle obunjiniyela noLawulo loMSebenzi; Ulwazi olubanzi ngazo zonke iindawo zobunjiniyela zokwakhiwa nendawo yakhiwayo; UMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaLuntu; UMthetho woKhuseleko loBuqu neMpilo ekuSebenzeni; uLawulo loKwabiwa kweSabelo; uLawulo lweNkonzo. Amandla: Ukuthatha izigqibo; Ukulawula iqela; Amandla okuhlola; Ukuziphuma; uLawulo lwakho; uLawulo lweMali nokuThethana; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuqamba nokuCoca; Amandla okuxoxa; Amandla okusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda. Iimpawu zoBuqu: uLawulo lweNkqubo nemiSebenzi; Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuqonda ubunjiniyela; uphando nentluthuko; Iinkqubo zobunjiniyela ezisebenza ngekhompyutha; Ulwazi ngokuzithobela umthetho; Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe; Ukudala inkqubo yemveliso ephakamileyo; Ukwakhiwa kweenxibelelwano; Ukuphawula ngobunjiniyela nolwazi lwabachweli.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso lweendawo zomsebenzi zobunjiniyela, iinkqubo, neendlela ezichanekileyo. Lawula uphuhliso nokugcina iindlela ezilungileyo zobuchwepheshe nemigangatho yemilinganiselo kwaye wenze iincwadana nezikhokelo ngeemigangatho zobuchwepheshe. Hlola ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza nokuzinikela ngokuqhubekayo kwizikhokelo nemiqathango yemilinganiselo yobuchwepheshe. Lawula izigqibo okanye ukuvavanywa kweendawo ezintsha zobunjiniyela ngokwemiqathayo nengcamango yokuqamba. Qinisekisa amandomatho aqamba iindawo zobunjiniyela nokuqulunqa kummandla wemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuleka kwezobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo. Lawula umthamo wemali nexesha lezamaxhongo obunjiniyela. Khuthaza ukuze uqinisekise isithuba esikhuselekileyo nesempilweni ngokwemithetho yelizwe namapolicy enkampani nendlela ezichanekileyo. Khokela uphuculo oluqhubekayo lweendlela, umgangatho nexabiso ukuze kugcinwe inzuzo nokukwazi ukunciphisa abanye. Lawula ukugcina ukusebenza kwezobunjiniyela. Lawula ukuze kubekwe iindlela ezifanelekileyo namanqanaba. Qinisekisa iindlela zobunjiniyela zokugcina umgangatho, iindingo namanqanaba enkonzo ngokwemigangatho yesebe. Hlola iindlela zobunjiniyela ngokwenjongo yesebe ukuze kuthiwe izinkonzo zokugcina zisebenze. Qaphela ukusebenza kweendlela ezichanekileyo zokuqhuba. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela kweendlela ezichanekileyo zokuqhuba. Nikela ingcebiso ngokhuseleko olutshwintshwa nobungozi bokulawula. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kwi-OHSA, kwaye ufunde iimfuno zomthetho. Lawula ukusebenza kwemali kwamaxhongo obunjiniyela nokuqamba iindlela ezithile. Lawula unike ingcebiso yobusebenzisi ngamachaphaza nokuhlanjwa kwamanzi kunye nolawulo lweenkonzo. Lawula ukubakho kumthetho wamanza. Lawula uphuhliso nokugcina amachaphaza amanzi. Sebenzisa iziphumo zophando ukunciphisa imiba echaphazela indalo. Phanda iindlela zokuphucula ukugcinwa kwamanza. Hlola ukuzinikela kwemisebenzi ngamanza. Lawula iNkonzo enkulu. Ziiqinisekiso zangaphakathi nezindaba ezibalulekileyo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi. Lungelelanisa ulawulo lwendlela nokuba nexesha eliqinisekileyo lokubika. Lawula iziphumo nokuba nexesha eliqinisekileyo lokubika ngokwakho. Yila ulawulo lwendlela neenkqubo ezisebenzayo nokuqinisekisa ukuqonda ngokubakho kolwazi. Bhala ulwandlalo lweendaba ezifanelekileyo ezibalulekileyo. Hlola ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ukubakho kolwazi ngokusebenza kwemisebenzi yobunjiniyela. Qinisekisa ukulunga kokubakho kolwazi olupheleleyo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi. Hlola umthamo wemali nokuhamba kolwazi.

jobs.title: Director: Real Estate Management Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Real Estate Management Services at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Cape Town, offering R1,317,384 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Real Estate Management/ Property Management/ Immovable Asset Management or Built Environment. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in real estate/property/immovable asset management and leading multidisciplinary teams across leasing, portfolio/asset acquisition/disposal, and/or facilities operations. An NQF 08 (Honours/Postgraduate) qualification in the above fields and more than 5 years direct middle/ senior management experience as specified above will serve as an added advantage). Leadership & Delivery: Demonstrated track record of managing teams to deliver measurable portfolio outcomes (e.g., timely lease renewals, cost optimisation, improved occupancy and condition, compliant disposals, accurate asset registers). Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel and work extended hours as needed. Security clearance will be required. Ability and willingness to adjust work hours to meet professional and organisational imperatives. Other added advantage: Relevant professional registration in built sector or property related and private sector property management or immovable asset management experience. Knowledge: Legislation & Compliance: GIAMA, PFMA, Treasury Regulations/Instructions, PPPFA, OHS Act, Public Service Act & Regulations, MISS, SPLUMA, Deeds Registries Act, Municipal Property Rates Act, and relevant State Land Disposal and property transaction frameworks. Property Practice: Leasing and tenant administration, acquisitions, disposals, servitudes, estates, portfolio/asset performance, facilities maintenance, contract/vendor management. Public Sector Governance: Budget management, SCM, audit & assurance, risk & internal control, HRM and labour relations, service delivery improvement and transformation. Skills: Strategic planning & execution. People leadership & performance management. Programme/portfolio & project management. Contract, lease and vendor management. Financial management & cost optimisation. Risk, compliance & quality assurance. Stakeholder management and negotiation. Advanced report writing & presentation. Data & systems proficiency (asset registers, property information systems, BI dashboards). Problem solving, decision-making and change management. Personal Attributes: Outcomes-driven, innovative and resourceful. High integrity and resilience under pressure. Strong interpersonal influence and relationship-building. Analytical, decisive and detail-attentive. Able to set high standards, coach teams and drive continuous improvement.
jobs.duties: Functional Leadership & Governance: Translate departmental strategy into a Directorate operating plan with clear targets, service standards and risks. Lead a multidisciplinary team and establish a high-performance culture, with robust internal controls, SOPs, and compliance to PFMA/Treasury and property legislation. Outcomes: Consistent delivery against APP/operational targets; clean governance, reduced audit findings, on-time reporting. Leasing & Tenancy Management: Oversee the end-to-end lease lifecycle (sourcing, contracting, renewals, terminations, rent reviews, escalations, recoveries). Ensure tenant satisfaction, accessibility, and regulatory compliance (incl. OHS). Outcomes: On-time renewals and cost-effective leases; accurate billing/recoveries; improved client feedback. Portfolio & State Property Management (incl. Vacant Land): Drive optimal utilisation and maintenance across state-owned properties; ensure security for vacant/unimproved assets. Direct property condition assessments, maintenance plans and operational/financial reporting (e.g., occupancy, condition, costs). Outcomes: Reduced downtime & backlog; improved asset condition and utilisation; cost and energy efficiency gains. Acquisition, Disposal & Servitudes: Manage transparent, compliant acquisitions and disposals aligned to GIAMA, national priorities and applicable reform programmes. Lead due diligence (ownership, zoning, valuations), transaction approvals and transfer processes. Outcomes: Timeous, compliant transactions; disposal pipeline progressed; value-for- money and strategic alignment demonstrated. Asset Register & Information Integrity: Ensure a complete, accurate and auditable Immovable Asset Register; integrate with portfolio systems and reporting. Maintain data quality, reconciliations and audit readiness; produce BI dashboards and insights for decision-making. Outcomes: Improved data integrity and audit outcomes; reliable portfolio intelligence to guide planning and budgeting. Client & Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with user departments, provincial/municipal partners and service providers. Resolve operational issues proactively; lead cross-functional collaboration and transversal initiatives. Outcomes: Faster turnaround times, fewer escalations, aligned accommodation solutions and better regional coordination. Financial Stewardship & SCM Compliance: Manage the Directorate’s budget, cash flows and cost drivers; ensure SCM processes are compliant and timely. Oversee creditors/debtors, rental collections/recoveries and contract performance. Outcomes: Spend within allocation; improved cost-to-serve; reduced irregular/fruitless/wasteful expenditure. People Management & Capability Building: Recruit, develop and performance-manage staff; drive learning, coaching, and sound labour relations. Embed discipline, ethics, wellbeing, and effective communication. Outcomes: Skilled, engaged team; improved productivity and retention; succession and bench strength in critical roles. Standards, Improvement & Innovation: Monitor changes in legislation and professional standards; update policies/SOPs and implement process improvements. Introduce digital tools and pragmatic innovations to improve quality, speed and compliance. Outcomes: Shorter cycle times, fewer defects, better client outcomes, continuous improvement culture.
