jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Director: Real Estate Management Services must be submitted to: Recruitment26-84@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Diense vir Grondbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Diense vir Grondbestuur by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Cape Town, teen R1,317,384 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken in Grondbestuur/Eiendomsbestuur/Onroerende-batebestuur of die Bou-omgewing. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel/senior bestuursvlak in grondbestuur/eiendomsbestuur/onroerende-batebestuur en die leiding van multidissiplinêre spanne oor huur, portefeulje/bateverkryging/afstoting, en/of fasiliteitebedrywighede. 'n NQF 08 (Honneurs/Nagraadse) kwalifikasie in bogenoemde velde en meer as 5 jaar se direkte middel-/seniorbestuurservaring soos hierbo gespesifiseer, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Leierskap en Lewering: Bewese rekord van spanbestuur om meetbare portefeulje-uitkomste te lewer (bv. tydige huurvernuwings, koste-optimalisering, verbeterde bewoning en toestand, volgehoue afstotings, akkurate bateregisters). Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis en lang ure te werk soos benodig. Veiligheidsklarering sal vereis word. Vermoe en bereidwilligheid om werksure aan te pas om aan professionele en organisatoriese imperatiewe te voldoen. Ander bykomende voordeel: Relevante professionele registrasie in die bousektor of eiendomverwant, asook privaatsektor-ervaring in eiendomsbestuur of onroerende-batebestuur. Kennis: Wetgewing en Nakoming: GIAMA, PFMA, Treasury Regulations/Instructions, PPPFA, OHS Act, Public Service Act & Regulations, MISS, SPLUMA, Deeds Registries Act, Municipal Property Rates Act, en relevante Staatsgrondafstoting- en eiendomtransaksieraamwerke. Eiendomspraktyk: Huur en huurderadministrasie, verkrygings, afstotings, servitute, boedels, portefeulje/bate-prestasie, fasiliteite-onderhoud, kontrak/verskafferbestuur. Openbaresektor-bestuur: Begrotingsbestuur, SCM, oudit en versekering, risiko en interne beheer, HRM en arbeidsbetrekkinge, diensleweringsverbetering en transformasie. Vaardighede: Strategiese beplanning en uitvoering. Menseleierskap en prestasiebestuur. Program/portefeulje- en projeksbestuur. Kontrak-, huur- en verskafferbestuur. Finansiële bestuur en koste-optimalisering. Risiko, nakoming en kwaliteitsversekering. Belanghebbendebestuur en onderhandeling. Gevorderde verslagskrywing en aanbieding. Data en stelselsvaardigheid (bateregisters, eiendominligtingstelsels, BI-dashboards). Probleemoplossing, besluitneming en veranderingsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Uitkomste-gedrewe, innoverend en vindingryk. Hoë integriteit en veerkragtigheid onder druk. Sterk interpersoonlike invloed en verhoudingsbou. Analities, beslis en aandag aan besonderhede. In staat om hoë standaarde te stel, spanne af te rig en deurlopende verbetering te dryf.
af.duties: Funksionele Leierskap en Bestuur: Vertaal departementele strategie in 'n Direktoraat-bedryfsplan met duidelike teikens, diensstandaarde en risiko's. Lei 'n multidissiplinêre span en vestig 'n hoë-prestasiekultuur, met robuuste interne beheer, SOP's, en nakoming van PFMA/Treasury en eiendomswetgewing. Uitkomste: Volgehoue lewering teenoor APP/bedryfsteikens; skoon bestuur, verminderde ouditbevindings, tydige verslagdoening. Huur en Huurderbestuur: Hou toesig oor die huur-lewensiklus van begin tot end (sourcing, kontraktering, vernuwings, beëindigings, huurherbesinning, eskalasies, terugvorderings). Verseker huurdertevredenheid, toeganklikheid en regulatoriese nakoming (insluitend OHS). Uitkomste: Tydige vernuwings en kostedoeltreffende huurkontrakte; akkurate fakturering/terugvorderings; verbeterde kliënterugvoer. Portefeulje en Statseiendomsbestuur (insluitend Ongenipte Land): Dryf optimale benutting en onderhoud oor staatsbesitte eiendomme; verseker sekuriteit vir leeg/ongegronde bates. Regstreekse eiendomtoestandassesserings, onderhoudsplanne en bedryfs-/finansiële verslagdoening (bv. bewoning, toestand, koste). Uitkomste: Verminderde stilstandtyd en agterstand; verbeterde batetoestand en benutting; koste- en energie-doeltreffendheidswinste. Verkryging, Afstoting en Servitute: Bestuur deursigtige, nakomende verkrygings en afstotings in ooreenstemming met GIAMA, nasionale prioriteite en toepaslike hervormingsprogramme. Lei due diligence (eiendomsreg, sonerings, waardasies), transaksiegoedkeurings en oordragsprosesse. Uitkomste: Tydige, nakomende transaksies; afstotingspyplyn gevorderd; waarde-teen-geld en strategiese belyning gedemonstreer. Bateregister en Inligtingsintegriteit: Verseker 'n volledige, akkurate en ouditeerbare Onroerende Bateregister; integreer met portefeuljestelsels en verslagdoening. Handhaaf datakwaliteit, rekonsiliasies en ouditgereedheid; skep BI-dashboards en insigte vir besluitneming. Uitkomste: Verbeterde data-integriteit en oudituitkomste; betroubare portefeulje-intelligensie om beplanning en begroting te lei. Kliënt en Belanghebbende Bestuur: Bou sterk verhoudings met gebruikersdepartemente, provinsiale/munisipale vennote en diensverskaffers. Los bedryfsake proaktief op; lei kruisfunksionele samewerking en transversale inisiatiewe. Uitkomste: Vinniger draaitye, minder eskalasies, belynde akkommodasie-oplossings en beter streekskoördinering. Finansiële Bestuur en SCM-Nakoming: Bestuur die Direktoraat se begroting, kontantvloei en koste-a drywers; verseker SCM-prosesse is nakomend en tydig. Hou toesig oor krediteure/debiteure, huurinkomste/terugvorderings en kontrakprestasie. Uitkomste: Besteding binne toekenning; verbeterde koste-om-te-dien; verminderde onreëlmatige/vrugtelose/verkwistende besteding. Mensebestuur en Vermoëbou: Werf, ontwikkel en prestasiebestuur personeel; dryf leer, afrigting en gesonde arbeidsbetrekkinge. Inbed dissipline, etiek, welstand en effektiewe kommunikasie. Uitkomste: Opgeleide, betrokke span; verbeterde produktiwiteit en retensie; opvolging en banksterkte in kritieke rolle. Standarde, Verbetering en Innovasie: Monitor veranderinge in wetgewing en professionele standaarde; dateer beleide/SOP's op en implementeer prosesverbeterings. Stel digitale gereedskap en pragmatiese innovasies bekend om kwaliteit, spoed en nakoming te verbeter. Uitkomste: Korter siklustye, minder gebreke, beter kliëntuitkomste, kultuur van deurlopende verbetering.

xh.title: Umphathi: Iinkonzo zoLawulo lweNdlela yokuphila ngayo iinkunzi
xh.summary: Umphathi weeNkonzo zoLawulo lweNdlela yokuphila ngayo iinkunzi kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi yoLuntu neziNkqubo zeZakhiwo eCape Town, linika R1,317,384 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kweNqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokuqatshiweyo nguMbane weeNgaMazwe nakwiiMfuno eziPhakamileyo eNingizimu Afrika (SAQA) kuLawulo leNdlela yokuphila ngayo iinkunzi/ uLawulo lwePropathi/ uLawulo lwefa ezingatshukiyo okanye iNdlela eYakhiweyo. Iyure ezingama-5 zamaqondo amaminathi obuchule kwiNqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu kwalo mphathi wolawulo lwendlela yokuphila ngayo iinkunzi/iproPathi/uLawulo lwefa ezingatshukiyo nokukhokela amaqela eminyanyeni engathathiyo kumathuba okuqesha, okuthenga/okuthengisa ipakathi/efa, kwaye naku/okunye ukusebenza kweziseko. Isifundo se-NQF 08 (iHonours/IsiNgangamva) kumabala angentla nangaphezulu kwi-5 yiminyaka yamaqondo amaminathi obuchule ephakathi/pezu kulawulo njengoko kuchaziwe ngentla kuya kuba ngumonde olongezelelweyo. uKukhokela & ukuZezelwa: Isibonakaliso esicacileyo sokukhokela amaqela ekuzizezeleni iziphumo ezingeni elithelekisekayo (umz., ukuvuselela amathuba okuqesha ngexesha, ukuyisa ubuncinci kwiindleko, ukuphucula ukubakwa nendlela eziko, iziphulo ezithobelelayo, ukuvakalisa ukubaluleka kwefa). Ilayisenisi yokushayela elisebenzayo nentembeko yokuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo njengoko kufuneka. Ukuqinisekiswa kokhuseleko kuya kufuneka. Ikhono nentembeko yokulungisa iiyure zokusebenza ukuze zihambelane neemfuno zobugcisa nezobuchule. Omnye umonde olongezelelweyo: Ubulungiseleli bokubhalisa njengomsebenzi obulungiselelweyo kwicandelo lezakhiwo okanye ezihlobene nepropathi nolwazi lwendlela yokuphila ngayo iinkunzi kwicandelo langesixwe okanye uLawulo lwefa ezingatshukiyo. ulwazi: uMthetho & ukuThobela: iGIAMA, iPFMA, iMirayili/Imiyalelo yeZindlu zeNgqikithi, iPPPFA, uMthetho we-OHS, uMthetho weeNkonzo zoLuntu & iiMirayili, iMISS, iSPLUMA, uMthetho weziBhalo zeMinyhadala, uMthetho weNkokhelo zePropathi zaseYilabhu, kunye neendlela ezihlobene nokuThengiswa kwaba kaBukhosi nokusingathwa kweenkqubo zamathuba epropathi. inkqubo yePropathi: ukuQesha nolawulo lwabaqeshwayo, ukuthenga, ukuthengisa, iindawo zokungena kwabanye kwizakhiwo, iindlu ezishiweyo, ukusebenza kwepakathi/efa, ukugcina iziseko, ulawulo lweenkonzo/abathengisi. uLawulo loBulungiseleli bakaWonke wonke: uLawulo lwebhajethi, i-SCM, ukuqinisekiswa nokuvavwa, ubungozi nolawulo lokungaphakathi, i-HRM nobuhlobo bemisebenzi, ukuphucula ukuthumela iinkonzo nokutsha. ukuzijinja: ucwangciso lwamacala onke nokuzezelwa. ukukhokela abantu nolawulo lokusebenza. ulawulo lwenkqubo/iPakathi & ulawulo lomsebenzi. ulawulo lweenkonzo, amathuba okuqesha nabanikezeli. ulawulo lweziNkqubo zokuSebenzisa imali nokuyisa ubuncinci kwiindleko. ubungozi, ukuThobela & ukuqinisekiswa kwakhona. ulawulo lwabathathi nxaxheba nokuxhuma. ukubhala iingxelo ezingagqithiswanga nokuzibonakalisa. ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yeData & nezixhumi (izibhalo zefa, iinkqubo zolwazi lwepropathi, i-BI dashboards). ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthabatha izigqibo nokuqonda ukutshintsha. iimpawu zobuntu: kuqala iziphumo, kuvakalisa indlela entsha kwaye kusuka kubuchule. ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo nokuqina xa kunzima. ukuchasana nabantu ngokukhuthaza nokwakha ubuhlobo. ukuyahlula-hlula, ukuthabatha isigqibo nokuqondisa iinkcukacha. ukwazi ukumisela iinqanaba eziphezulu, ukufundisa amaqela nokukhuthaza ukuphucula ngokozelelwayo.
xh.duties: uKukhokela ngokoMsebenzi & uLawulo: Guqula isicwangciso seSebe sibe nguNqamleza wokuQhutywa kokuSebenza ngeNqanaba eliqhutywa yiSebe, oneenjongo ezicacileyo, iinqanaba zeNkonzo nolungozi. Khokela iqela elingathathiyo yindidi yabantu abanomsebenzi ohluke-hlukeneyo, uze umise inkqubo yolwazi oluphezulu, nolawulo olukuniyo olungaphakathi, ama-SOP, nokuthobela iPFMA/iZindlu zeNgqikithi kunye nomthetho wepropathi. iZiphumo: ukuThumela iinkonzo ngokungaguqukiyo ngokwe-APP/okuhambelana nalo; uLawulo olucacileyo lokuhamba phambili, ukunciphisa okufunyanwayo kuvavanyo, iingxelo ezixesha. uLawulo loKuqesha nokuLawula abaQeshi: Qapha i-cycle yonke yamathuba okuqesha (ukuzinza, ukubhalisa, ukuvuselela, ukuyeka, ukuphonononga inkokhelo, ukunyuka, ukubuyisa). Qinisekisa ukwaneliseka komqeshwayo, ukufikeleleka, nokuthobela imithetho (kuquka i-OHS). iZiphumo: ukuVuselela amathuba ngexesha nokwenza amathuba okuqesha abe ngowesixhobo esigcinileyo; iingxelo ezicacileyo zokuLawula nokuThumela iinkonzo ezithile; ukuphucula iimvakalelo ziklayient. uLawulo lwePakathi & iPropathi yaseZweni (kuquka iNdawo eNgekho nto kuyo): Qhuba ukusebenziswa okuphezulu nokugcina iPropathi yonke kaBukhosi; qinisekisa ukhuseleko kwiinkxwaleko ezingenanto nasezindaweni ezingazange zenziwe nto kuzo. Qondisa ukuvavanywa kwejongo lePropathi, iindlela zokugcina nokuvela ngeNqanaba leNkonzo zoMsebenzi ezibaleka (umz., ukubakwa, ijongo, iindleko). iZiphumo: ukunciphisa ukungalungelelani & ukulibaziseka; ukuphucula ijongo lomnikelo nokusebenziswa; ukuphucula ukusetyenziswa kwamandla nolwazi. ukuThenga, ukuThengisa & iindawo zoKungena: Lawula ukuthenga nokuthengisa ngokucacileyo, ngokuthobela imithetho ngokweGIAMA, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zesizwe nazo zonke iinkqubo zolungelelwano ezifuneka. Khokela ukuqinisekiswa ngeNqanaba elincinci (ukuphathwa, ukumisela indawo, ukubala ixabiso), ukuvunywa kwenkqubo yokuthengisa nokuDlulisa. iZiphumo: iinkqubo ezithengiswa ngexesha, ngokuthobela imithetho; ukuphuhliswa kokuThengiswa; ukubonisa iNqanaba leXabiso elincinci nokuHambelana nokuQonda ngokobuchule. uBhalo loMnikelo & iNqanaba loLwazi: Qinisekisa uBhalo loMnikelo ongenakutshatshiswa ongazange adlule, ongathelekiswa nokuVavanywa; uzamanise neNkqubo yokusebenza iNkqubo yamathuba neNgxelo. Gcina izinga leNqanaba leData, ukubuyisela nokuqinisekiswa kokuvavanywa; zibe ne-BI dashboards nolwazi olutsha ngalo mmandla wokuThabatha iziGqibo. iZiphumo: ukuphucula iNqanaba leNqanaba leData nokuVavanywa; ukunika ulwazi oluthembekileyo ngeNqanaba leNkonzo ngokokuQonda ngokokuQonda neBhajethi. uLawulo bakaKlayient & abaThathi nxaxheba: Yakha ubuhlobo obuqinileyo namaSebe asebenzisana nawo, abalinganisela nabaseBamba iNkqubo yokuQhutywa kokuSebenza kweNgingqi. Solula iingxaki zokuSebenza ngokuziqondisa ngokungagqithiyo; khokela amaqela ahlukeneyo kunye nokusebenzisana ngokuchasana nokuzezelwa kwaye kudlulise iinkqubo eziningadi. iZiphumo: iSiphelo sesiXesha ngokuzesika, ukunciphisa iinkalo, ukuvumelana nokuQondiswa okufuneka kwaye kuhambelene neNgingqi eDluliswa kuyo. uLawulo lokuSebenzisa imali & ukuThobela i-SCM: Lawula iBhajethi, okubaleka nemali kunye neNqanaba leNqanaba leindleko zoMmandla wokuSebenzisa; qinisekisa iNkqubo ye-SCM ithobela ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha. Qaphala abaMnikeli nabaKolwa, ukuHlanganisa nokuBuyisela inkokhelo yokuQeshwa neNqanaba lokusebenza. iZiphumo: ukusebenzisa imali ngokweNqanaba eNikiweyo; ukuphucula iNqanaba leNqanaba leNkonzo; ukunciphisa ukusebenzisa imali ngendlela eNgalunganga/ eNgaluncindi/ eNgalulekanga. uLawulo bantu & uLwazi oluNyuka: Hlola, phucula uze uLawule ngokusebenza abasebenzi; khuthaza ukufunda, ukufundisa, nobuhlobo bemisebenzi obulungileyo. Misela isithintelo, ubugcisa, ukuzinikela kwabasebenzi, nokunxibelelaniswa ngokusebenza. iZiphumo: iqela elinesipho, elihambisana nomsebenzi; ukuphucula ukukhiqiza nokugcina abasebenzi; ukuthumela iNkela yokuBeka amadoda kunye nokukhulisa iNqanaba leziqu ngokulinganisela kumigibe eQonda ngobuchule. iNqanaba, ukuphucula & ukutsha: Qaphela ukutshintsha kumathetho nakuNqanaba lweNqanaba leNkonzo; vuselela iNqanaba leNqanaba/i-SOP nokuyisebenzisa ngokuphucula iNkqubo. Faka izixhumi zeNkqubo zokuSebenzisa iNkqubo ngokulungelelanisa ulwazi nokuyisebenzisa ngokutsha ukuphucula iNqanaba, isantya nokuthobela. iZiphumo: ukukhawuleza iNqanaba leNqanaba, ukunciphisa ukungalunganga, ukuphucula iZiphumo zikaKlayient, nokuQonda ngokuQonda ukutsha nokuphucula iNqanaba.

zu.title: Umphathi: Isevisi Yokuphathwa Kwezindlu Ezinkulu
zu.summary: Umphathi weSevisi Yokuphathwa Kwezindlu Ezinkulu kuDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure eCape Town, enikeza R1,317,384 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ithobela elingavunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba se-NQF level 7 njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kusoUkuphathwa Kwezindlu Ezinkulu/ Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla/ Ukuphathwa Kwempahla Ezingahambeki noma Isimo Esakhiwe. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yohluvu lobudala obuphakathi/nobandla obuphakeme ekuphathweni kwezindlu ezinkulu/izimpahla/impahla ezingahambeki nokukhokha amaqembu ahlukene kubungcweti ekubenisweni kwemivango, ekutholeni/ekuthengiseni amafoloto/impahla, kanye/noma emisebenzini yezisekelo. Isifundo se-NQF 08 (Honours/Postgraduate) kule minyaka evunyelwe kanye nokuba nokulingene okuningi ngaphezu kweminyaka eyi-5 yokuhluva ngqo kokuphathwa kwabaphathi abaphakathi/ abaphezulu njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla kuzoba ngusizo olwengeziwe). Ubulungu & Ukulethwa: Ubufakazi bokukhokha amaqembu ukuletha imiphumela egqamile yamafoloto (isb., uvuselelo lwemivango ngesikhathi, ukweqa ngokwezindleko, ukwanda kwesikhundla kanye nesimo, ukuthengiswa okuhambisana nemithetho, ukuqashelwa kwezempahla okunembile). Ithikithe ehamba ibizo nokuzikhetela ukuhamba nokusebenza amahora anomkhawulo njengoba kudingeka. Iviwo lokuphepha lizodingeka. Ikhalo nokuzikhetela ukulungisa amahora omsebenzi ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zomsebenzi kanye nezinhloso zenhlangano. Enye into enesibopho: Ukuqashelwa ngokugcwele ezindaweni ezihlobene nokwakhiwa noma izindlu, namava okuphatha izindlu esimihlabeni yangasese noma amava okuphathwa kwempahla ezingahambeki. Ulwazi: Izimisozemthetho & Ukuhambisana: GIAMA, PFMA, Treasury Regulations/Instructions, PPPFA, OHS Act, Public Service Act & Regulations, MISS, SPLUMA, Deeds Registries Act, Municipal Property Rates Act, namaphulasidi ahlobene nokuthengiswa kwezinkomazi kanye nezinhlela zentengo yezempahla. Amasu Okuphathwa Kwezindlu: Ukwenziwa kwemivango kanye nokuphathwa kwabahule, ukutholwa kwempahla, ukuthengiswa, izinkomba zokusebenzisa indawo yomunye, izigaba zempahla, ukusebenza kwamafoloto/impahla, ukunakekelwa kwezisekelo, ukuphathwa kwemivango/kabathengisi. Ukuphathwa Kwemikhankaso Yembuso: Ukuphathwa kwecebiso, i-SCM, ukuqashelwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa, ingozi kanye nokulawula ngaphakathi, i-HRM kanye neziqu zomsebenzi, ukuphuculwa kokuletha inkonzo kanye noshintsho. Amakhono: Ukuletha ukuhlela okuhlosiwe nokulandisa. Ukukhokha abantu kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Ukuphathwa kohlelo/foloto kanye neprojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwemivango, lease kanye kabathengisi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuqeda izindleko. Igozi, ukuhambisana kanye nokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi. Ukuphathwa kwabanikazi bomthelela kanye nokuqondana. Ukubhala okuphakeme kwemibiko kanye nokubonisa. Ulwazi ngeminingwane namaphulasidi (ukwaziswa kwempahla, izinkqubo zolwazi lwezindlu ezinkulu, ama-BI dashboards). Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuphathwa kushintsho. Izici Zomuntu: Uqondiswe yimiphumela, uphangisa futhi unesipiliyoni. Ukuzinza okuphezulu nokumelana nenkani ngaphansi kwezinsongo. Ukukhwazaneka okuphezulu kubantu kanye nokwakha izidingo. Ukuchaza ngemibuzo, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuqaphela imininingwane. Ukuba nokukghona ukuhlela izinga eliphezulu, ukukhuthuza amaqembu futhi ukhaliphe ekugxilweni ekwazisweni.
zu.duties: Ukukhokha Ukusebenza & Ukuphathwa: Ukuhumusha isu lomnyango sibe yindlela yokusebenza yedilikethe nenhloso ecacile, izinga lesevisi, kanye nengozi. Ukukhokha iqembu elihlukene kanye nokwakha isiko elisebenza ngamandla, elinamaphulasidi alo okulawula ngaphakathi, ama-SOP, kanye nokuhambisana ne-PFMA/Treasury kanye nemithetho yezindlu. Imininingwane: Ukulethwa okuzinile ngokwamaphulasidi e-APP/amaphulasidi okusebenza; ukuphathwa okuhlanzekile, ukuncitshiswa kwezindleko ze audit, ukubika ngesikhathi. Ukukhokha iLease kanye Nabantu Abaya Kurenta: Ukunaka isikhathi esiphelele samaphulasidi okukhishwa imivango (ukusesa, ukwenza imivango, ukuvuselela, ukukhishwa, ukuhlola ireyithi, ukweza, ukulandelana kwezimali). Ukuqinisekisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu abaya kurenta, ukufinyeleleka, kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho (kuhlanganise i-OHS). Imininingwane: Ukuvuselelwa ngesikhathi namaphulasidi akhokiswa kancane; ukubhala okunembele/ukubuyisela imali; ukuphuculwa kwemiphumela yamakhasimende. Ukuphathwa Kwamafoloto Kanye Nemiva Yomnyango (Kuhlanganise Nemiva Engenanto): Ukukhokha ukusetshenziswa okulungile nokunakekelwa kwemiva yombuso; ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemiva ezingenanto/ezingenalutho. Ukukhokha ukuqashelwa kwesimo sempahla, ukuhlela ukunakekelwa, kanye nokubika ngokusebenza/ezimali (isb., ukusebenza, isimo, izindleko). Imininingwane: Ukunciphisa isikhathi esingasebenzi & ukubambezeleka; ukuphuculwa kwesimo sempahla kanye nokusetshenziswa; izinzuzo zezindleko kanye namandla. Ukutholwa, Ukuthengiswa & Izinkomba Zomlinganisela: Ukuphathwa kokutholwa nokuthengiswa okuqondile okuhambisana ne-GIAMA, amaphulasidi wezwe kanye namaphulasidi okushintsha afanele. Ukukhokha ukuhlolwa okuzinile (okwamanani, ukulingana, ukuhlolwa kwentengo), imvume yentengo kanye nezinqubo zokudlulisela. Imininingwane: Izinkomba ezikhishwa ngesikhathi, ezihambisana nemithetho; intengo ethengiswa ihamba phambili; ukubukisisa kwekhwalithi kanye nokuhambisana okuqondile okubonisiwe. Isibuki Sezimpahla & Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezindingo: Ukuqinisekisa isibuki sezimpahla ezingangenwa esigcwele, esinembile futhi esikwazi ukuhlatshulwa; ukuhlanganisa namaphulasidi efalanto kanye nokubika. Ukugcina ikhwalithi yolwazi, ukuhambisana nokulungelelwa ukuhlatshulwa; ukukhiqiza ama-BI dashboards kanye nokuqonda ekwenzeni izinqumo. Imininingwane: Ukuphuculwa kokuzinile kolwazi kanye nemiphumela yokuhlatshulwa; ukwaziswa okuqinisekile kwamafoloto ekukhokheni ukuhlela kanye nesebuko. Abakhasimende & Ukuphathwa Kabanikazi Bomthelela: Ukwakha izindingo ezinhle namaphulasidi womnyango abayisebenzisayo, abalingani besifundazwe/nomasipala, kanye nabahlinzeka ngenkonzo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga zokusebenza ngokuzimisela; ukukhokza ukusebenza kwamathimba kanye nemibiko ehlangene. Imininingwane: Ukuphindwa kwesikhathi ngokushesha, ukuncitshiswa kwokuqhushuniswa, izixazululo zesikhundla ezilungele kanye nokuhlelwa ngokuhamba kwesifunda okungcono. Ukulondoloza Imali & Ukuhambisana Ne-SCM: Ukuphatha isebuko sedilikethe, amaphulasidi emali kanye nobangela wezindleko; ukuqinisekisa izinqubo zokuqasha (SCM) zihambisana futhi ziseduze. Ukunakeka abadayisi/abathengi, ukutholwa kwamaphulasidi okukhishiwe/okubuyiswa kanye nokusebenza kwemivango. Imininingwane: Ukuchithwa ngokusebuko; ukuphuculwa kokubiza ukuletha; ukuncitshiswa kwemali ehide ihambisani noma ehide ihamba ngeshwa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu & Ukukhulisa Amakhono: Ukuqasha, ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi; ukukhuthaza ukufunda, ukukhokha, kanye namakhono amakhulu okusebenza. Ukuzinzisa isimilo, amandla okuzimisela, kanye nokuthintana okusebenzayo. Imininingwane: Iqembu elinamakhono, elibambe iqhaza; ukusebenza kahle okuphuculwe kanye nokusalela; ukulandela kanye namandla esandulele kumaphulasidi abaluleke kakhulu. Izinga, Ukuthuthuka & Ukuphangisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho oluhlobene nemithetho namazinga okusebenza ngobungcweti; ukuvuselela imigomo/ama-SOP nokusetshenziswa kokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo. Ukufaka amaphulasidi digital kanye noshintsho olungenisa isibindi ukuphucula ikhwalithi, isivinini kanye nokuhambisana. Imininingwane: Ixesha elincitshiwe lokujikeleza, iziphene ezincitshiwe, imiphumela yamakhasimende engcono, isiko lokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo.

jobs.title: Director: Supply Chain Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Supply Chain Management sought for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Durban to lead SCM governance, policy and process innovation.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in SCM/ Procurement/ Accounting/ Logistics/ Law or SCM/ Procurement/ Logistics and Public Management in the related field. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in SCM/ Procurement. Experience at middle or senior management level leading multidisciplinary teams in supply chain management An NQF level 8 (Honours/Postgraduate) or above and more than 5 years direct middle/ senior management experience as specified above will serve as an added advantage. Leadership & Delivery: Demonstrated track record of managing teams to deliver business unit outcomes. Valid driver’s licence. Security clearance will be required. Ability and willingness to adjust work hours to meet professional and organisational imperatives. Knowledge: Legislative & Regulatory Mastery: Expert command of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury Regulations, ensuring all directorate activities withstand rigorous Auditor- General scrutiny. Strategic Budgetary Planning: Mastery of Government Budget systems, including the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) and Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), to align financial resources with strategic mandates. Supply Chain Management (SCM) Oversight: Deep understanding of the Government SCM Framework and Preferential Procurement Policy, ensuring fair, equitable, and transparent procurement that meets developmental goals. Financial Reporting Standards: Advanced knowledge of GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practice) and GAAP, ensuring that all financial statements and systems reflect the highest standards of accounting integrity. Financial System Integration: Strategic proficiency in Government Financial Systems (e.g., BAS, LOGIS) to monitor expenditure and prevent unauthorised or wasteful spending. Skills: Executive Management & Planning: Advanced ability to architect complex operational plans and organise resources to meet high-level departmental objectives. Programme & Project Management: Proven capacity to lead large-scale initiatives from inception to evaluation, ensuring delivery within specific timeframes and quality benchmarks. Decision-Making Authority: The ability to make high-stakes decisions under pressure, balancing risk with organisational requirements. Strategic Research & Information Gathering: Expert ability to conduct high- level research and synthesise complex data into actionable executive insights. Numerical & Financial Analysis: Sophisticated numeracy skills for interpreting financial reports, identifying trends, and ensuring budgetary compliance. Technical Report Writing: Mastery in drafting executive submissions, technical briefs, and formal reports that are concise, accurate, and persuasive. Executive Diplomacy & Interpersonal Dynamics: Exceptional ability to navigate sensitive political and administrative landscapes, building rapport with stakeholders at all levels. Strategic Communication: Highly developed verbal and written communication skills, ensuring clarity of purpose and alignment across the Directorate. Complex Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to identifying systemic challenges and designing sustainable, innovative solutions. Personal Attributes: Strategic Creativity: Possesses the ability to design original frameworks and innovative solutions to complex organisational challenges without requiring external direction. Analytical Rigour: A high-level conceptual thinker capable of dissecting complex data and systemic issues to inform evidence-based executive decisions. Unwavering Trustworthiness: Exemplifies the highest standards of professional ethics and confidentiality, serving as a reliable custodian of the Department’s reputation and resources. Dedicated Leadership: Demonstrates a disciplined commitment to the public service mandate, driving functional excellence through personal accountability and perseverance. Multi-Level Communication Mastery: Highly adept at articulating complex strategies to diverse audiences, ranging from frontline operational staff to political office bearers and executive boards. Strategic Diplomacy: Combines an approachable demeanour with executive gravitas, ensuring the ability to build rapport while maintaining the authority required for senior leadership. High-Stakes Tenacity: Replaces basic "hard work" with a sophisticated ability to maintain peak performance and quality of output under extreme pressure and within tight legislative timeframes. Solution-Orientated Mindset: Proactively identifies bottlenecks and focuses on delivering tangible outcomes, fostering a culture of high performance within the Directorate.
jobs.duties: Strategic SCM Governance & Process Innovation: Outcome: A compliant, agile, and technologically advanced SCM framework that anticipates legislative changes and drives departmental efficiency. Strategic Policy Leadership: Direct the research, design, and continuous improvement of SCM policies and strategies to ensure 100% alignment with National Treasury prescripts and the PFMA. Systems & Internal Controls: Architect and oversee a rigorous internal control environment to proactively identify and mitigate procurement risks, preventing irregular, fruitless, and wasteful expenditure. Business Process Modernisation: Lead the transition toward digital SCM support tools and automated workflows to enhance transparency and reduce lead times across the value chain. Strategic Demand & Procurement Planning: Outcome: A data- driven procurement strategy that aligns departmental needs with market realities and socio-economic objectives. Integrated Planning: Direct the consolidation of regional requirements into a robust, credible Annual Procurement Plan that supports the Department’s strategic goals and infrastructure mandates. Socio-Economic Impact: Oversee the implementation of the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework, ensuring that "preference point" systems are strategically applied to meet development and transformation targets. Technical Advisory: Provide executive oversight and high-level guidance on the development of complex Specifications, Terms of Reference (ToR), and Special Conditions of Contract. High-Integrity Acquisition & Committee Management: Outcome: A transparent and legally defensible bid adjudication process that ensures value for money and institutional integrity. Committee Governance: Ensure the statutory appointment and optimal functioning of Bid Specification, Evaluation, and Adjudication Committees, maintaining high ethical standards throughout. Adjudication Leadership: Chair the Sub-Bid Adjudication Committee with technical mastery, ensuring all recommendations are robust, unbiased, and fully compliant with the Central Supplier Database (CSD) requirements. Market Intelligence: Lead the strategic sourcing function to ensure the Department leverages the best available market rates and supplier capabilities. Contract Lifecycle & Supplier Performance Management: Outcome: Optimised service delivery through active monitoring and the rigorous enforcement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Contract Stewardship: Establish a comprehensive contract management framework that ensures suppliers meet all performance obligations, delivering corrective measures or penalties where necessary. Logistical & Auxiliary Excellence: Direct the procurement and management of the vehicle fleet, travel services, and archives, ensuring these auxiliary functions provide seamless support to the Department’s core operations. Movable Asset Management & Financial Integrity: Outcome: An accurate, audited, and fully optimised Asset Register that reflects the true financial position of the Department. Lifecycle Asset Management: Direct the strategic acquisition, maintenance, and disposal of movable assets, ensuring that warranties and maintenance plans are utilised to maximise asset lifespan. Verification & Reporting: Oversee the execution of bi-annual asset verifications and ensure the Asset Register remains 100% reconciled with financial systems for year-end reporting. Directorate Leadership & Financial Stewardship: Outcome: A high-performing, ethical Directorate that delivers against its operational plan within its allocated budget. Executive Leadership: Mentor and develop the SCM team, fostering a culture of professional discipline, ethical conduct, and accountability for outcomes. Fiscal Accountability: Exercise total oversight of the Directorate’s budget, ensuring expenditure is strictly monitored and aligned with the operational plan and Treasury guidelines. Operational Reporting: Direct the submission of accurate and timely administrative and performance reports to ensure the Executive has real-time visibility into the SCM function.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575
jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Director: Supply Chain Management must be submitted to: Recruitment26-85@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Voorsieningskettingbestuur gesoek vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Durban om VSB-bewind, beleid en prosesinnovasie te lei.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in VSB/Procurement/Rekeningkunde/Logistiek/Regte of VSB/Procurement/Logistiek en Publieke Bestuur in die verwante veld. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in VSB/Procurement. Ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in die leiding van multidissiplinêre spanne in voorsieningskettingbestuur. 'n NQF-vlak 8 (Honours/Postgraduate) of hoër en meer as 5 jaar direkte middel-/seniorbestuurservaring soos hierbo gespesifiseer, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Leierskap en Lewering: 'n Bewese rekord van die bestuur van spanne om besigheidsseenheidsuitkomste te lewer. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Veiligheidsklaring sal vereis word. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om werksure aan te pas om professionele en organisatoriese imperatiewe na te kom. Kennis: Wetgewende en Regulerende Meesterskap: Deskundige beheer van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie-regulasies, wat verseker dat alle direktoraat-aktiwiteite streng ondersoek deur die Auditor-General kan weerstaan. Strategiese Begrotingsbeplanning: Meesterskap van Regeringsbegrotingstelsels, insluitend die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) en Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), om finansiële hulpbronne met strategiese mandate te belyn. Voorsieningskettingbestuur (VSB) Toesig: Diepgaande begrip van die Regering se VSB-raamwerk en Voorkeurinkoopbeleid, wat billike, regverdige en deursigtige inkoop verseker wat ontwikkelingsdoelwitte bereik. Finansiële Verslagdoeningsstandaarde: Gevorderde kennis van GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practice) en GAAP, wat verseker dat alle finansiële state en stelsels die hoogste standaarde van rekeningkundige integriteit weerspieël. Finansiële Stelselintegrasie: Strategiese vaardigheid in Regeringsfinansiële stelsels (bv. BAS, LOGIS) om uitgawes te monitor en ongemagtigde of vermorsende besteding te voorkom. Vaardighede: Uitvoerende Bestuur en Beplanning: Gevorderde vermoë om komplekse operasionele planne te ontwerp en hulpbronne te organiseer om hoëvlak-departementele doelwitte te bereik. Program- en Projektbestuur: Bewese vermoë om grootskaalse inisiatiewe vanaf ontstaan tot evaluering te lei, wat lewer binne spesifieke tydraamwerke en gehaltemylpale verseker. Besluitnemingsgesag: Die vermoë om hoë-risko-besluite onder druk te neem, met die balansering van risiko teenoor organisatoriese vereistes. Strategiese Navorsing en Inligtingsversameling: Deskundige vermoë om hoëvlak-navorsing uit te voer en komplekse data in uitvoerbare uitvoerende insigte te sintetiseer. Numeriese en Finansiële Analise: Gesofistikeerde syfervaardighede vir die interpretasie van finansiële verslae, die identifisering van tendense en die versekering van begrotingsnakoming. Tegniese Verslagskrywing: Meesterskap in die opstel van uitvoerende voorleggings, tegniese opsommings en formele verslae wat beknopt, akkuraat en oortuigend is. Uitvoerende Diplomasie en Interpersoonlike Dinamika: Uitsonderlike vermoë om sensitiewe politieke en administratiewe landskappe te navigeer en verhoudings met belanghebbendes op alle vlakke te bou. Strategiese Kommunikasie: Hoogs ontwikkelde mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, wat duidelikheid van doel en belyning oor die Direktoraat verseker. Komplekse Probleemoplossing: 'n Proaktiewe benadering tot die identifisering van stelselmatige uitdagings en die ontwerp van volhoubare, innoverende oplossings. Persoonlike Kenmerke: Strategiese Kreatiwiteit: Besit die vermoë om oorspronklike raamwerke en innoverende oplossings vir komplekse organisatoriese uitdagings te ontwerp sonder om eksterne leiding te benodig. Analitiese Strenghheid: 'n Hoëvlak-konseptuele denker wat in staat is om komplekse data en stelselmatige kwessies te ontleed om bewysgebaseerde uitvoerende besluite te stuur. Onwankelbare Betroubaarheid: Beliggaam die hoogste standaarde van professionele etiek en vertroulikheid, en dien as 'n betroubare bewaarder van die Departement se reputasie en hulpbronne. Toegewyde Leierskap: Toon 'n gedissiplineerde toewyding aan die openbare diensmandaat, en dryf funksionele uitmuntendheid aan deur persoonlike verantwoordelikheid en deursettingsvermoë. Veelvlak-Kommunikasiemeesterskap: Hoogs vaardig in die verduideliking van komplekse strategieë aan uiteenlopende gehore, wat wissel van_frontlyn-operasionele personeel tot politieke ampsdraers en uitvoerende rade. Strategiese Diplomasie: Kombineer 'n toeganklike geaardheid met uitvoerende gesag, wat die vermoë verseker om verhoudings te bou terwyl die gesag wat vir senior leierskap vereis word, gehandhaaf word. Hoë-Risko-Volharding: Vervang basiese "harde werk" met 'n gesofistikeerde vermoë om piekprestasie en gehalte van lewerings onder uiterste druk en binne stywe wetgewende tydraamwerke te handhaaf. Oplossingsgerigte Denkwyse: Identifiseer proaktief knelpunte en fokus op die lewer van tasbare uitkomste, en bevorder 'n kultuur van hoë prestasie binne die Direktoraat.
af.duties: Strategiese VSB-bewind en Prosesinnovatie: Uitkoms: 'n Nakomende, rats en tegnologies gevorderde VSB-raamwerk wat wetgewingsveranderinge antisipeer en departementele doeltreffendheid dryf. Strategiese Beleidsleierskap: Direkteer die navorsing, ontwerp en deurlopende verbetering van VSB-beleide en -strategieë om 100%-belyning met National Treasury-voorskrifte en die PFMA te verseker. Stelsels en Interne Beheer: Ontwerp en hou toesig oor 'n streng interne beheeromgewing om proaktief inkopirisiko's te identifiseer en te verminder, en onreëlmatige, nuttelose en vermorsende uitgawes te voorkom. Besigheidsprosesmodernisering: Lei die oorgang na digitale VSB-ondersteuningsnutsgoed en outomatiese werksvloeie om deursigtigheid te verbeter en leitye oor die waardeketting te verminder. Strategiese Vraag en Inkoopbeplanning: Uitkoms: 'n Data-gedrewe inkoopstrategie wat departementele behoeftes met markrealiteite en sosio-ekonomiese doelwitte belyn. Geïntegreerde Beplanning: Direkteer die konsolidasie van streeksvereistes in 'n robuuste, geloofwaardige Annual Procurement Plan wat die Departement se strategiese doelwitte en infrastruktuurmandate ondersteun. Sosio-Ekonomiese Impak: Hou toesig oor die implementering van die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework, en verseker dat "voorkeurpunt"-stelsels strategiese toegepas word om ontwikkelings- en transformasiedoelwitte te bereik. Tegniese Advies: Verskaf uitvoerende toesig en hoëvlak-leiding oor die ontwikkeling van komplekse Spesifikasies, Terms of Reference (ToR), en Special Conditions of Contract. Hoë-Integriteit Verkryging en Komiteebestuur: Uitkoms: 'n Deursigtige en regtens verdedigbare bodtoekenningproses wat waarde vir geld en institusionele integriteit verseker. Komiteebewind: Verseker die statutêre aanstelling en optimale funksionering van Bid Specification-, Evaluation- en Adjudication Committees, en handhaaf hoë etiese standaarde deurgaans. Toekeningsleierskap: Voer sitting voor in die Sub-Bid Adjudication Committee met tegniese meesterskap, en verseker dat alle aanbevelings robuust, onbevooroordeeld en ten volle nakomend is aan die Central Supplier Database (CSD)-vereistes. Markintelligensie: Lei die strategiese bronningsfunksie om te verseker dat die Departement die beste beskikbare markkoerse en verskafferkapasiteite benut. Kontraklewensiklus en Verskafferprestasiebestuur: Uitkoms: Geoptimaliseerde dienslewering deur aktiewe monitering en die streng afdwing van Service Level Agreements (SLA's). Kontrustewardskap: Stig 'n omvattende kontrakbestuursraamwerk wat verseker dat verskaffers aan alle prestasie-verpligtinge voldoen, en lewer korrektiewe maatreëls of strawwe waar nodig. Logistieke en Hulpeesellende: Direkteer die verkryging en bestuur van die voertuigvloot, reisdienste en argiewe, en verseker dat hierdie hulpfunksies naatlose ondersteuning aan die Departement se kernoperasies bied. Roesbare Batebestuur en Finansiële Integriteit: Uitkoms: 'n Akkurate, oudit-gedane en ten volle geoptimaliseerde bate-register wat die ware finansiële posisie van die Departement weerspieël. Lewensiklus-Batebestuur: Direkteer die strategiese verkryging, onderhoud en wegdoening van roesbare bates, en verseker dat waarborge en onderhoudsplanne benut word om bate-lewensduur te maksimeer. Verifikasie en Verslagdoening: Hou toesig oor die uitvoering van halfjaarlikse bateverifikasies en verseker dat die bate-register 100% versoen bly met finansiële stelsels vir jaareinde-verslagdoening. Direktoraat-leierskap en Finansiële Stewardship: Uitkoms: 'n Hoëpresterende, etiese Direktoraat wat teen sy operasionele plan binne sy toegewysde begroting lewer. Uitvoerende Leierskap: Mentor en ontwikkel die VSB-span, en bevorder 'n kultuur van professionele dissipline, etiese gedrag en verantwoordelikheid vir uitkomste. Fiskale Verantwoordelikheid: Oefen algehele toesig oor die Direktoraat se begroting uit, en verseker dat uitgawes streng gemonitor en met die operasionele plan en Tesourie-riglyne belyn word. Operasionele Verslagdoening: Direkteer die indiening van akkurate en tydige administratiewe en prestasieverslae om te verseker dat die Uitvoerende regstreekse sigbaarheid oor die VSB-funksie het.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Kufunwa uMphathi Wokuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka osebenza kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure eDurban ukuba ahola ukuphathwa kwe-SCM, inqubomgomo kanye nenoveshini yokuqhuba.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezincane zeziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 njengoba kugunyazwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) ku-SCM/ Procurement/ Accounting/ Logistics/ Law noma i-SCM/ Procurement/ Logistics kanye noMphathi Womphakathi ohlobene nale ndawo. Ukuhlangabezana okuncane kweminyaka engu-5 yokuqashwa ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuphatha ku-SCM/ Procurement. Uqasho ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuphatha lokuheha amaqembu ahlukene okuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuhlinzeka Izinga le-NQF 8 (Honours/Postgraduate) noma ngaphezulu kanye nokuhlangabezana okungaphezu kweminyaka engu-5okuqashwa ngqo ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu njengoba kuchaziwe ngentla kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. ukuHola kanye Nokulethwa: Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuphatha amaqembu ukuze kulethwe imiphumela yohlelo lwebhizinisi. ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. kuzodingeka kwenziwe ukususwa kwezinkomba zokuphepha. ikhono nesifiso sokushintsha amahora okusebenza ukuze kuhlangabezwe izidingo zomsebenzi nenzimabepu. Ulwazi: ukuPhatha Komthetho kanye noMthetho: Ulwazi olujulile lomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye noMthetho we-Treasury, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yeqembu ihlabelelwa ngokucophelela nguMhloli-Jikelele. ukuCubungula Iholo Ngokubhekisele Phambili: Ulwazi lwezimiso zeholo Kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) kanye ne-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), ukuze kuhambiswe izinsiza zezimali nemigomo ebalulekile. ukuQaphela Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka (SCM): ukuQonda okujulile kwe-Government SCM Framework kanye ne-Preferential Procurement Policy, ukuqinisekisa ukuthenga okubuye okulinganayo, okusesithembeni okuthuthukisa izinhloso zokuthuthuka. iziKelo Zokubika iziNtlalo: Ulwazi oluthuthukile lwe-GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practice) kanye ne-GAAP, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke izitatimende zezimali kanye nezimiso zibonisa izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokuzinikela ekuqwashweni. ukuHlanganisa Isimiso Sezimali: Ukugqwesa ngokubhekisele phambili kwezimiso zezimali Kahulumeni (isb., BAS, LOGIS) ukuze kubhekwe ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nokuvimba ukuchithwa okungagunyaziwe noma okungalimazi. Amakhono: ukuPhatha okuPhezulu kanye noKucubungula: Ikhono elithuthukile lokwakhelela izinhlelo zokuqasha ezinzima kanye nokuhlela izinsiza ukuze kuhlangabezwe izinhloso eziphezulu zomnyango. ukuPhatha Amaphrojekthi kanye noKuhlela: Amandi okuqashwa okushiwo ngokwawo okokuheha iziqalo ezinkulu kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekubukeni, ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa phakathi kwesikhathi esithile nakuma-standards wekhwalithi. igunya Lokwenza iziQumo: Ikhono lokwenza izinqumo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngaphansi kongcindezi, ukuze kuthathelwe kanye ukubaluleka kwezingozi nezidingo zenzimabepu. ukuCubungula Ngokubhekisele Phambili kanye noQoqo Lolwazi: Ikhono elikhulu lokwenza ucwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu kanye nokuhlanganisa idatha eyinkimbinkimbi ibe ukuqonda okusebenzayo kokuphatha. ukuHlaulwa kweMininingwane kanye neZimali: Amakhono ohlelo lwemibalo okuyinkimbinkimbi okokutolikha izibiko zezimali, ukuqaphela izinhlobonhlobo, kanye noqinisekiso lokuhambisana namabhajethi. ukuBhala Izibiko Eziyinkece: Ulwazi lokubhala iziphephandaba eziphezulu, izifaniso ezinkimbinkimbi, kanye nezibiko ezivumile, ukuthi zicace, ziqiniseke futhi zikhombise ukuthembisa. ukuPhathwa kwezezimali kanye nokuxhumana nabantu: Ikhono elivelele lokuqhuba ezindaweni ezinungero ezihlukahlukene kwezombangazwe kanye nezokuphatha, wakha ubuhlobo namaphathi abantu. ukuxhumana Ngokubhekisele Phambili: Amakhono aphuculwe kakhulu okukhuluma nokubhala, aqinisekisa ukucaca kwenjongo kanye nokuhambisana eqenjini eliphethe imisebenzi. ukuSombulula iziNginkinga Ezinzima: Indlela eqonde phambili yokuqaphela izinkinga ezingumongo wemisimbo yokuqasha kanye nokwakhelela izisombululo ezihlala isikhathi eside futhi ezingezwa. izibaluli Zomuntu: ukuDlula Ngokubhekisele Phambili: ukuDlula Ngokubhekisele Phambili nokuba nokwakheka: unamandla okwakhelela izimiso ezithandwa kanye nezisombululo ezingezwa ezinkingeni ezinkimbinkimbi zenzimabepu ngaphandle kokudinga isiqondiso sangaphandle. ukuHlaulwa Ngokuqinisekile: umcabango ongashintshi osezingeni eliphezulu ongahlukanisa idatha eyinkimbinkimbi kanye nezinkinga zemisimbo yokuqasha ukuze athole izinqumo ezisekelwe ubufakazi. ukuThemba okungashintshi: ubonisa izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lobuzalwane bezomsebenzi kanye nokuqala, esiba ngomsindi wonxibelelwano we-Department yendawo nezinsiza. ukuHola Ngokuqinisekile: ubonisa isibopho esizwilwe emphakathini wesebenzimphakathi, ehonsa ukuphumelela ngokusebenza kanye nokuqina. ukuPhuma Phambili Kokuxhumana Ezingeni Eliphezulu: Ukuthotha kakhulu ukuchaza izinhlelo ezinkimbinkimbi ezimweni zabantu abehlukene, okusukela abasebenzayo abamhlophe kuye kwabashilo bamasiko zomphakathi nabaphathe izinkundla. iDiplomasi Ebheke Phambili: ihlanganisa isimo esithembisayo nokubaluleka kwesikhathi eside, iqinisekisa ukuthi akwazi ukwakha ubuhlobo ngesikhathi ekhona igunya elidingeka ekuphathweni ezingeni eliphezulu. ukuQina Ezingeni Eliphezulu: Kuyinto exhulumo ukusebenza kanzima nokukwazi ukugcina isimo esiphezulu sokusebenza, ikakhuluzi ngaphansi kongcindezi omkhulu kanye nasezinsukwini ezibekiwe. uBuchule Bokusombulula: ukubuka ngaphambili izikhundla ezisukela ekugqamiseni futhi aqonde ekuletheni imiphumela ekhona, akhe isiko sokusebenza esiphezulu eqenjini.
zu.duties: ukuPhathwa Kwe-SCM Ngokubhekisele Phambili kanye noNoveshini Yokuqasha: imiPhumela: ukuthungwa kwe-SCM okuhambisana, okushintshashintshayo, okuthuthukile ngekhompyutha okucabanga ukushintsha komthetho futhi khonsa ukusebenza komnyango. ukuHola Inqubomgomo Ngokubhekisele Phambili: ukuHola ucwaningo, ukwakheka, kanye nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwezinqubomgomo ze-SCM kanye nezinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana okuyi-100% nemithetho ye-National Treasury kanye ne-PFMA. izimiso kanye noMphathi Wangaphakathi: ukuHlela kanye nokuqapha isimo egqamile yokuphatha ngaphakathi ukuze kubonakale kanye nokubambezela ingozi zokuthenga, okuvimba ukuchithwa okungalungile, okungalimazi, nakho okungalimazi. ukuThuthukisa Inqubo Yebhizinisi: ukuHola ukushintshela kumathuluzi we-SCM abakha ngamakhompyutha kanye nezinqubo ezidluliswa amakhompyutha ukuthi kwandise ukusesithembeni kanye nokunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa emndeni wemisebenzi. ukuCubungula Imininingwane Ngokubhekisele Phambili kanye nokuHlela ukuThenga: imiPhumela: inqubomgomo yokuthenga ehleli ngaphakathi kolwazi evezwa imininingwane ehambisana nezidingo zomnyango kanye nesimo sangempela kanye nezinhloso zomnotho wangempela. ukuHlela Ngokwamanzi: ukuHola ukubumbwa kwezidingo zezindawo zondwa kuyilibe isahluko esigqamile, esithembisayo sokuThenga Somnyonyonyo (Annual Procurement Plan) esisekela izinhloso eziphakeme ze-Department kanye namajaha obunjiniyela. imPumela ekuPhathwa komNotho: ukuQaphela ukusetshenziswa komsimamo we-Preferential Procurement Policy, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphoyinti edlule angasetshenziswa ngokubhekisele phambili ukuze kuhlangabezane amaphuzu okuthuthuka kanye okushintsha. ukuNika iziLuleko: ukuNikeza ukuqashwa okuphezulu kanye nokuqondisa okusezingeni eliphezulu kokwakheka okunkimbinkimbi kweziKhalifikheshini, iZimo ZokuQashwa, kanye nesiMo esikhetheke Somthetho Wokuqasha. ukuThenga Okusesithembeni Okuphezulu kanye noKuphatha AmaKhomidi: imiPhumela: inqubo ethembisekayo, engahoxiswe, ethembise isabelo noma ukunika isibindi, esiqinisekisa ukuthi imali ihambisana nesabelo. ukuPhatha iKhomidi: ukuQinisekisa ukumiswa ngokomthetho nokusebenza okubalulekile kweziKhomidi zokuHlela, ukuHlola, kanye noKuhlola ngendlela ethembisayo ngokuphelele. ukuHola ukuDluleliswa kwesicelo: ukuHola iKhomidi ePhansi YokuDluleliswa kwesicelo ngekhono elikhulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkomba ziqinisekile, ezingahliwa uhlelo futhi zihambisana nezidingo ze-Central Supplier Database (CSD). ulwazi Ngaphandle Lwebhizinisi: ukuHola umkhankaso wokuqasha ukuthuthukisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Department isebenzisa amaphuzu amahle atholakalayo kanye namandla abathengisi. ukuphatha Ikhontrakthi ephilayo kanye noMsebenzi Womthengisi: imiPhumela: ukulethwa kwemiphumela okuhleliwe ngokubuka okusebenzayo kanye nokugqamisa ukusetshenziswa kwesiVumelwano Sezinga Lenkonzo (SLAs). ukuNakekela Ikhontrakthi: ukumisa isimiso esigqamile sokuphatha ikhontrakthi esikuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengisi bahlangabezana zonke izibopho zomsebenzi,beletha izinyathelo zokuqeda noma izigwebo lapho kudingeka khona. ukuQapha Amathuluzi nezinye izinto: ukuHola ukuthenga kanye nokuphatha imoto, izinkonzo zokuhamba, namaphoyinti, ukuze lezo zinsiza zokuphatha zinikeze ukusekela okuhlangene kumisebenzi okhona womnyango. ukuphatha isibuyekezo semali seSikhungo futhi sibe noBuhlakani bemali: imiPhumela: ukuba nesibuyekezo semali esiqinisekile esilungile, esibukisiswe, esihleliwe esikhiqiza imali namandla okwenza okukhanya ngokweqiniso. ukuphatha isibuyekezo sikamabhajethi nokulinganisela imali: ukwakheka isibuyekezo esibukeka kangangobudawuni, ukulungiswa, kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla, kuqinisekise ukuthi izinkomba zokuvikela kanye nezinkomba zokulungisa izisetshenziswa ukuze kwandise isikhathi esihleli impahla. ukuQinisekisa kanye nokubika: ukuQaphela ukwenza ukubuyekezwa kanye nokugqamisa ukuthi isibuyekezo semali sihlale sihambisana ngemali eningi lapho kubikwa ngosuku lokugcina. ukuHola iqembu kanye nokulawula imali: imiPhumela: iqembu elisebenza kahle, elinesithunywa, eletha imiphumela ehleleke kuhlelo lwaso olubekiwe ngaphakathi kwesabelo somsebenzi. ukuHola: ukuqeqesha kanye nokuthuthukisa iqembu le-SCM, aakhe isiko soqotho, ukuqotha, nokubeka amandla ngokuhambisana nezinhloso. ukubeka iNgqikithi: ukubeka amandla ngokuphela kwezimali zomnyango eqenjini, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuchithwa kuyabukwa ngokuqinile futhi kuhambisana nenhlelo yokusebenza kanye nokuqondisa i-Treasury. ukuBika Ngokusebenza: ukunika izingxoxo ezinembile kakhulu mayelana nokusebenza nokubika ngasese ukuze aqinisekise abaphethe ukuthi bayo bheka isikhathi sokubuka imisebenzi ye-SCM.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ulawulo Lwenani leziThengiso
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMlawuli woLawulo lweNani leziThengiso kwisebe lezoMsebenzi kaRhulumente nezeNzululwazi eDurban ukuba ayongamise ulawulo, iinkqubo zomthetho nolungiselelweko kwindawo yokusebenza.
xh.requirements: Igunya elincinane lokufunda kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwi-SCM/ ukuThenga/ ukuBalwa/ iLogistics/ uMthetho okanye i-SCM/ ukuThenga/ iLogistics noLawulo kaRhulumente kwicala elinxulumene nalo. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo kwi-SCM/ ukuThenga. Amandla okuba namava kwinqanaba eliphakathi okanye eliphezulu lolawulo ekuqholen amaqela amaninzi emisebenzi yolawulo lwenani leziThengiso. I-NQF level 8 (iHonours/ i-Postgraduate) ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphezulu kweminyaka emi-5 yamava ngqo kulawulo ophakathi/ophhezulu njengoko kuchazwe ngasentla kuya kubakho nzuzo eyongeziweyo. UkuQonda kunye noKulethwa: Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokulawula amaqela okukhokelela ukuphumeza iziphumo zeyuniti yoshishino. Ilayisenisi yokushuka esemthethweni. Kuya kufunwa kwenziwe ukucocwa koguquko lwezokhuseleko. Amandla nokulungelelana ukutshintsha iiyure zomsebenzi ukuze kuhlangabezwe iimfuno zobuchule nezoluntu. Ulwazi: Ukuqonda kakuhle uMthetho noLungelelwaniso: Ulawulo oluphezulu koMthetho woBalwo lweMali kaRhulamente (PFMA) noLungelelwaniso loNkamela, kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke izenzo zedirektore zikwazi ukumelana nokuqingqelwa okusesikweni koNkamela woQulunqo (Auditor-General). UkuLungiselela iNgqikithi yokuQeshwa: Ukuzipatha kakuhle kwiNkqubo zoBunjini benzeNgqikithi kaRhulamente, kuquka iNkqubo yokuQeshwa nakuqhutywa kwexesha eliphakathi (MTEF) nezigqibo zoNxwelo lweNkqubo yoLuntu (ENE), ukuze kuqamaniswe izibonelelo zemali neengqikithi. Ulawulo loLawulo lweNani leziThengiso (SCM): Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo kwiNkqubo ye-SCM kaRhulamente noMthetho oNqumama kuThengiso, ukuqinisekisa ukuthengisa okulingeneyo, okubulunge ngokulinganayo nokusemthethweni okuhlangabezana neengcamango zophuhliso. Izinga ezikulo iNkcazelo yeMali: Ulwazi oluphezulu nge-GRAP (Iindlela ezivunyelweyo zokuBalwa) nenge-GAAP, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke izitatimenti nezinkqubo zemali zibonisa izona ngingqi ziphakamileyo zokuzithoba kwentengiso. UkuDityaniswa kweNkqubo yeMali: Ukuzipha okulindelekileyo kwiNkqubo zeMali kaRhulamente (umz. i-BAS, i-LOGIS) ukuze kulawulwe ukuchithwa kwaye kuthintelwe ukuchithwa okungagunyazisiweyo okanye okungalunji. Amandla: Ulawulo noQwalaselo oluphezulu: Amandla aphezulu okwakha iinkqubo ezinzima zomsebenzi nokuqamba izibonelelo ukuze kuhlangabezane neengqikithi ezikwizigaba eziphezulu zesebe. Ulawulo lweNkqubo neMisebenzi: Amandla abonakalisiweyo okuyala iinkqubo ezinkulu evela ekuqaleni ukuya ekuqwalaselweni, ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa kwexesha elifunekayo nakuqhathaniswa ngokwemigangatho. Amandla okuThatha iziGqibo: Amandla okuthatha izigqibo ezibalulekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukulinganisa ingozi neemfuno zoluntu. Uphononongo olunika ngokubakho kunye nokuQokelelwa kolwazi olucukunzadiweyo: Amandla aphezulu okwenza uphononongo oluphezulu nokuqamba ulwazi oludityanisiweyo lwenziwe luze lube ngolwazi olusebenzayo ngokuphezulu. UkuBalwa kunye noQwalaselo lweMali: Amandla aphezulu okubala ukuze kuqondwe iingxelo zemali, kuqatshwe iindlela ezihamba ngayo, nokuqinisekisa ukuzinza kweenkqubo. UkuBhala iiNgxelo eziBuchuleyo: Amandla aphezulu okubhala iziprotho eziphezulu, iingxelo ezibuchuleyo, nangokwaneenelo eziyiwo ngokuchanekileyo ezifaka isandla ekujolisweni. UkuPhatheka phezulu kunye noBudlelwane nabantu: Amandla aphezulu okuqhuba iindawo ezinzima ngokwezopolitiko nolawulo, ukwakha ubudlelwane nabantu abanoxabano nabo. Unxibelelwano olubonakalisa iNgqikithi: Amandla aphezulu anamandla okuthetha nokubhala, ukuqinisekisa ukucaca kwejongo nokuqhathaniswa kwawo wonke amacandelo oLawulo. Ukusombulula iingxaki ezinzima: Indlela ephambili yokujonga iingxaki zeliso nokuqamba izisombululo ezingapheliyo, ezintsha. Iimpawu zobuuntu: Ukuzithoba ngokobuchule: Amandla okwakha iinkqubo ezintsha nokuzisombulula iingxaki ezinzima ngaphandle kokufuna isikhokelo kwangaphandle. Ukuziqonda ngokupheleleyo: Ukuqonda amagama aphezulu aneliso lokwahlula iingxaki ezinzima ezidityaniswe ngokweenkcukacha ukuze kuxhaswe izigqibo ezigqwethe kwezobuchule. Ukuzinza ngokuzigqatsa: Ukuqamba iindlela eziphezulu zobugcisa bokuziphatha nokuzigqatsa njengomthunywa othembekileyo wegama nezibonelelo zesebe. Ulawulo oluzinzeleyo: Ukuqinisekiswa ngokuzimisela kumthetho wenkonzo yoluntu nokuphumeza iziphumo ngeyakho ngeyakho nangokuzinza. Ukuqonda ulwazi kulo lonke ulwazi olunamanqanaba: Amandla aphakamileyo okubalisa iindlela ezinzima ezingabalandeli abanengqiwo, ukusuka kubasebenzi bangasemva ukuya kwaba baliweyo bamagunya ezopolitiko noMlambo. Ukuzinza ngokwengqikithi: Ukudibanisa ukuziphatha okuvulekileyo nokuzinza okuphezulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakha ubudlelwano ngelixa kugcinwa amandla afunekayo kwilawulo eliphezulu. Ukuzinza ngokweNqanaba eliphezulu: Ukutshintsha "umsebenzi oqinisekileyo" ngamandla okugcina ukusebenza ngokuphezulu nangomgangatho kuxinzelelo olukhulu nangexesha elilinganiselweyo ngokomthetho. Imbono yokuzisombulula iingxaki: Ukujonga phambili iingxaki nokuqwalasela ukuletha iziphumo ezingatshikeyekiyo, ukwakha inkqubo yokusebenza ngokuphezulu kwiDirektore.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lwe-SCM noQamba iNkqubo: Iziphumo: Inkqubo ye-SCM elungelelaniswe ngokomthetho, esebenzayo, nangobuchule echeba utshintsho lomthetho yaye incede ukusebenza kwesebe. Ulawulo lomThetho ngokubaluleka: Ukuqonda ucango, ukwakha, nokuphucula ngokokuqhubela phambili iinkqubo ze-SCM nolungelelwaniso ukuze kwenzike ukulingana okukhulu ngeengcamango zeNqila yeMali yesiZwe ne-PFMA. Iinkqubo noLawulo loNgaphakathi: Ukwakha ulawulo olukhulu olunesithili sokuziphatha ngaphakathi ukuze kubonwe ngokuphambili kwaye kuthintelwe iingozi zokuThenga, kuqinisekiswa ukuba akukho mali ichithwa ngokungalunanga, ngokungalunanga nangokungalunanga. Ukutsha kweenkqubo zeNgcwele: Ukuqondisa intshukela ekuhambeni ngenkqubo ye-SCM ekhoyo kwiikhompyutha nakulo nkqubo ezizenzekelayo ukuze kuqhubeke ukucaca nokusikhutsha isixa sexesha kwinkqubo yexabiso. uLungelelwaniso lokufuna nokuthengisa ngokobuBalulelayo: Iziphumo: Indlela yokuthengisa ngeempawu ezisebenzayo ekuqondiseni iimfuno zesebe ngokokunokwenzeka kwentengiso nangokwezinja ezoqoqosho. Ukuqhubelela phambili ngokudityaniswa: Ukuqondisa ukubumba kweenkcukacha ngasentsimini zibe ngumlondolo oqinileyo, ongamthembekiyo woNyaka wokuThengisa oxhasa iingqikithi zesebe neendawo ezifuna imisebenzi. Umphumo oqoqosho oluntu: Ukuqwalasela ukusetyenziswa komyalelo oNqamlezela kumthetho wokuThengisa, ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo "zamaphondo okukhetha" zisetyenziswa ngeNgqikithi yokuhlangabezana neengcamango zophuhliso notshintsho. Uluvo lokubonelela ngokwobuChule: Ukunika ulawulo oluphezulu noncedo lokulunga iNkcazelo ezoBuchule, iMigaqo yoNxibelelwano (ToR), nokuqinisekisa iindleko ezize ngokwenene. Ulawulo oluphezulu lokuThenga ngokuzinza: Iziphumo: Inkqubo ecacileyo nangokomthetho egqibelela kwi-bid esemthethweni ekuqinisekisela ixabiso lemali nangokuzinza kwentshi. Ulawulo lweKomiti: Ukuqinisekisa ukugqitywa ngokomthetho nokusebenza okubalulekileyo kweKomiti eCacisa iMfuno, eQwalasela yaye eGqiba ukugqiba ukuthengiswa, iqhutshwa ngamandla obugcisa obuzinzeleyo. Ulawulo lokugqiba: Ukukhokela iKomiti eNgaphantsini yoGqibo kuThengiswa ngobuchule, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke izindululo ziqinileyo, azikhethi bani, yaye zihambelana ngokupheleleyo neemfuno ze-Nqilana yeSicwangciso soMboneleli (CSD). Uqoqosho lokuThenga: Ukuqondisa inkqubo yokukhetha abathengi ukuba kuye kubekho isibonelelo sokufumana ukugcina isantya esihle nengenakubakho mafutha kwintengiso namandla. Ulawulo lweQabu lokusebenza nokuziphatha koMboneleli: Iziphumo: Ukusebenza okuphuculiweyo nokuqwalasela nokugxilisa iSivumelwano soQoqosho (SLAs). Ukugcina ulawulo: Ukuseka inqobo ethatha phezu konke ukulawula iinkqubo ezimiselwe ukwenza abahlinzeki bagcwalise izinto zonke ezimiselwe kumthetho yaza ukungazenzanga ngokwaneenelo ezinye okanye ezinye izohlwayo apho kuyimfuno. Ukuphumeza izibonelelo ezihlobene neLogistics: Ukuqondisa ukuthengisa nangokulawula iinqwelo mithuthwana, iinkonzo zokuhamba, nangokulondolozo zibe zikumhlaba othintele ubuncwane kwinkqubo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba le nkqubo ixhasa ngokukhululekileyo ukusetyenzwa kwezinye iinkalo zesebe. Ulawulo lweMpahla eNtswayo nokuzinza ngeMali: Iziphumo: ISazisi seMpahla esicacileyo, esiQwalaselwa ngokuchanekileyo nesipheleleyo, esibonisa isimo esiyinyaniso seMali sesebe. Ulawulo lweMpahla eNtswayo: Ukuqondisa ukuthengwa, ukugcinwa, nokuphahlwa kwempahla entswayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkampani ezinikezelwa ukulunga nazo zisetyenziswa ukuze kubekho impilo edluliselwa phantsi. Ukuqinisekisa nokuBhala iNgxelo: Ukuqwalasela ukuphumeza uQwalaselo lwempahla ngokuhamba kwexesha kabini nyaka ukuze kugcinwe ukubhalwa kwempahla eNtsimini ngokwemali ukuya phambili ngemfumba yenyanga. Ulawulo lweDirektore nokuGcina iNgqikitho yesebe: Iziphumo: Ulawulo olusebenzayo, oluzinzeleyo lweDirektore ekuqhuba nangokulungelelwaniso lwayo ngemali. Ulawulo oluphezulu: Ukuqeqesha baze baphuhliswe iqela le-SCM, ukwakha inkambo yolungelo lobugcisa, ukuziphatha ngokomthetho, nokuza kubizwa ngokweziphumo. UkuQwalasela iNgqikitho yemali: Ukuqwalasela yonke imali yedirektore, ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukuchithwa kusasaza ngokuchanekileyo, kubhalwe kakuhle kwaye kuhambelane nolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi ngokomthetho. UkuBhala iNgxelo ngokusebenza: Ukulawula ukungenisa iingxelo ezicacileyo ngexesha zokulawulo nakumsebenzi ukuba ukhululekile ngokwenene ukuba uLawulo lwakhe lweNkqubo lubone ngokunyanisekileyo ukuba kukho impilo ephilileyo kwi-SCM.

jobs.title: Director: Green Building
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director role at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, responsible for developing green building strategies, policies and research on sustainable design trends.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Built Environment/ Environmental Studies/ Law or relevant field. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the relevant field. Registration with a Build Environment Professional Council or registered as a Green Star Accredited Professional will serve as an added advantage. Certificate in funding and trade or related certification. Must be prepared to travel. Willing to adapt to working schedule in accordance with office requirements. Knowledge: Must be prepared to travel. Willing to adapt to working schedule in accordance with office requirements. Skills: Project Management; Planning and Organising; Support Fund Raising; Systems Thinking; Financial Management; Computer Literacy; Problem solving; Leadership; Analytical thinking; Numeric skills; Decision making; Advanced communication; Conflict management; Interpersonal skills; Time management; Motivational skills. Personal Attributes: Innovative; Resourceful; Solution orientated; Ability to work under stressful situations; Highly motivated; Trustworthy; Punctuality; Assertive; Hard-working; Ability to work independently.
jobs.duties: Manage the development of Public Works Green Building strategies, policies and procedures. Manage research on latest green building design (energy, waste and water efficiency) trends. Ensure development of effective and efficient strategies, policies and procedures aligned to relevant government prescripts. Ensure that all Green Building policies contribute to the Department’s strategic objectives i.e. Socio economic imperatives. Ensure identification of Green Technologies and Management Systems for Implementation in DPW property portfolio. Ensure compliance with applicable processes and procedures. Develop initiatives to quantify greenhouse gas emissions in Government buildings. Oversee the built environment’s contribution towards achieving objectives of Government sustainable building prescripts i.e. Climate Change Response White Paper, Energy Efficiency Strategy, Water Management Act, National Environmental Management Waste Act. Manage the implementation of Green Building rating and certification initiatives and contribute towards retrofitting and Green Building/Green Precincts projects. Establish, monitor and report on Green Building initiatives for new and established facilities aligned with the Green Building Star rating certification of the Green Building Council of South Africa. Coordinate the process of obtaining Energy Performance Certificate for DPWI facilities, contributing to energy efficiency goals, conducting energy data verification, Manage entire Green Building rating compliance and documentation process. Conduct performance benchmarks to identify levels of green building achievement for both capital improvement projects and facilities management efforts. Establish the requirements that facilities should meet to be certifiable and monitor on an on-going basis the performance of the portfolio. Effectively communicate the Green Building Requirements for state owned and leased buildings. Contribute towards local designation of Green Building materials and consumables – to balance with international technologies. Coordinate the execution and verification of performance goals. Manage the establishment and implementation of Water Efficiency initiatives. Oversee collaboration with internal and external stakeholders with a vision toward developing and implementing water efficient and sustainable initiatives. Oversee implementation of applicable strategies, policies and procedures. Oversee analysis on cost and resource savings in water. Oversee water audits and waste water management studies. Provide accurate water efficiency data. Ensure oversight and support to Regional teams and Service Providers undertaking water audits, metering, leak detection, and technology installations. Manage monitoring, verification, and reporting on achieved water savings. Manage initiatives aimed at identifying and managing alternative sources of water and water harvesting initiatives. Manage the establishment and implementation of energy efficiency and Renewable Energy initiatives. Oversee collaboration with internal and external stakeholders with a vision toward developing and implementing energy efficient and sustainable initiatives. Manage audits of the energy performance of existing buildings, use data to provide insight into the design energy efficiency improvements. Develop funding and delivery mechanism and roll-out PPP projects on renewable energy projects. Report on relevant key performance measures. measure and predict the effects of improved building covers on energy consumption. Create energy-efficiency models in conformance with program guidelines. Review construction documents and make recommendations for energy efficiency improvements. Manage the implementation of Energy efficiency initiatives. Manage various inter- governmental cooperation on energy efficiency and renewable energy. Ensure alignment of government building energy mix with Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) championed by Department of Energy. Manage the establishment and implementation of Waste Management initiatives. Oversee collaboration with internal and external stakeholders with a vision toward developing and implementing sustainable waste management initiatives. Oversee the implementation of the waste hierarchy strategy of reduce, re-use and recycle. Help minimise waste during construction and introduce best practises in waste management post occupancy. Oversee analysis on cost and resource savings in waste management. Manage awareness campaigns on waste management in built environment. Management of the Directorate. Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Establish implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the directorate and report on progress as required. Management of performance and development of staff. Plan and allocate work. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Maintenance of discipline. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Monitor the budget and expenditures within the directorate. Serve on transverse task teams as required.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG).
