All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. af.title: Direkteur: Groen Gebou
af.summary: Direkteurspos by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling van groen gebou-strategieë, beleide en navorsing oor volhoubare ontwerptendense.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Bou-omgewing/ Omgewingsstudies/ Regte of 'n relevante vakgebied. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in die relevante vakgebied. Registrasie by 'n Build Environment Professional Council of registrasie as 'n Green Star Accredited Professional sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Sertifikaat in befondsing en handel of verwante sertifisering. Moet bereid wees om te reis. Gewillig om aan te pas by werkskedule in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes. Kennis: Moet bereid wees om te reis. Gewillig om aan te pas by werkskedule in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes. Vaardighede: Projekbestuur; Beplanning en organisering; Ondersteuning van fondsinsameling; Stelseldenke; Finansiële bestuur; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Probleemoplossing; Leierskap; Analitiese denke; Numeriese vaardighede; Besluitneming; Gevorderde kommunikasie; Konflikbestuur; Interpersoonlike vaardighede; Tydbestuur; Motiveringsvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Innovatief; Hulpbronneryk; Oplossingsgerig; Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; Hoë gemotiveerd; Betroubaar; Stiptheid; Selfversekerd; Ywerig; Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van Public Works Green Building-strategieë, -beleide en -prosedures. Bestuur navorsing oor die nuutste groen gebou-ontwerp (energie-, afval- en waterdoeltreffendheid) tendense. Verseker die ontwikkeling van doeltreffende en effektiewe strategieë, beleide en prosedures wat met relevante regeringsvoorskrifte ooreenstem. Verseker dat alle Green Building-belede bydrae tot die departement se strategiese doelwitte, d.w.s. sosio-ekonomiese imperatiewe. Verseker die identifisering van Green Technologies en Management Systems vir implementering in die DPW-eiendomsportefeulje. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike prosesse en prosedures. Ontwikkel inisiatiewe om kweekhuisgasemissies in regeringsgeboue te kwantifiseer. Hou toesig oor die bou-omgewing se bydrae tot die bereiking van doelwitte van regeringsvoorskrifte vir volhoubare geboue, d.w.s. Climate Change Response White Paper, Energy Efficiency Strategy, Water Management Act, National Environmental Management Waste Act. Bestuur die implementering van Green Building-graderings- en sertifiseringsinisiatiewe en dra by tot retrogryp- en Green Building/Green Precincts-projekte. Vestig, monitor en rapporteer oor Green Building-inisiatiewe vir nuwe en gevestigde fasiliteite in ooreenstemming met die Green Building Star-graderingsertifisering van die Green Building Council of South Africa. Koördineer die proses om Energy Performance Certificate vir DPWI-fasiliteite te verkry, dra by tot energiedoeltreffendheidsdoelwitte, voer energiagegevensverifikasie uit, bestuur die hele Green Building-graderingsnakomings- en dokumentasieproses. Voer prestasie-benchmarking uit om vlakke van groen gebou-prestasie te identifiseer vir beide kapitale verbeteringsprojekte en fasiliteitsbestuurspogings. Vestig die vereistes wat fasiliteite moet nakom om sertifiseerbaar te wees en monitor op 'n deurlopende basis die prestasie van die portefeulje. Kommunikeer doeltreffend die Green Building-vereistes vir staatsgeboue en gehuurde geboue. Dra by tot plaaslike aanwysing van Green Building-materiale en verbruiksgoedere – om te balanseer met internasionale tegnologieë. Koördineer die uitvoering en verifikasie van prestasie-doelwitte. Bestuur die vestiging en implementering van Water Efficiency-inisiatiewe. Hou toesig oor samewerking met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met 'n visie om waterdoeltreffende en volhoubare inisiatiewe te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Hou toesig oor die implementering van toepaslike strategieë, beleide en prosedures. Hou toesig oor ontleding van koste- en hulpbronbesparings in water. Hou toesig oor wateroudits en afvalwaterbestuurstudies. Verskaf akkurate waterdoeltreffendheidsdata. Verseker toesig en ondersteuning aan streekspanne en diensverskaffers wat wateroudits, meterlesings, lekdetectie en tegnologie-installasies onderneem. Bestuur monitering, verifikasie en verslagdoening oor behaalde waterbesparings. Bestuur inisiatiewe gemik op die identifisering en bestuur van alternatiewe waterbronne en wateroesinisiatiewe. Bestuur die vestiging en implementering van energiedoeltreffendheids- en hernubare energie-inisiatiewe. Hou toesig oor samewerking met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met 'n visie om energiedoeltreffende en volhoubare inisiatiewe te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Bestuur oudits van die energieprestasie van bestaande geboue, gebruik data om insig te verskaf in die ontwerp van energiedoeltreffendheidsverbeterings. Ontwikkel befondsings- en afleweringsmeganismes en rol PPP-projekte oor hernubare energieprojekte uit. Rapporteer oor toepaslike sleutelprestasiemaatstawwe. Meet en voorspel die effekte van verbeterde gebouomhulsels op energieverbruik. Skep energiedoeltreffendheidsmodelle in ooreenstemming met programriglyne. Hersien konstruksiedokumente en maak aanbevelings vir energiedoeltreffendheidsverbeterings. Bestuur die implementering van Energy Efficiency-inisiatiewe. Bestuur verskeie interregeringsamewerking oor energiedoeltreffendheid en hernubare energie. Verseker belyning van die regeringsgebou-energiemeng met die Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) ondersteun deur die Department of Energy. Bestuur die vestiging en implementering van Waste Management-inisiatiewe. Hou toesig oor samewerking met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met 'n visie om volhoubare afvalbestuursinisiatiewe te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Hou toesig oor die implementering van die afvalhiërargie-strategie van verminder, hergebruik en herwin. Help om afval tydens konstruksie te minimeer en stel beste praktyke in afvalbestuur na bewoning in. Hou toesig oor ontleding van koste- en hulpbronbesparings in afvalbestuur. Bestuur bewusmakingsveldtogte oor afvalbestuur in die bou-omgewing. Bestuur van die Direktoraat. Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer- en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge na te kom. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel. Plan en wys werk toe. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Handhawing van dissipline. Stel en dien alle vereiste administratiewe verslae in. Monitor die begroting en bestedings binne die direktoraat. Dien op dwars/task spanne soos vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukwakha Izakhiwo Eziluhlaza
zu.summary: Indima yomphathi eDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, onobunkomishwe bokuthuthukisa izuvishelezo zokwakha izakhiwo eziluhlaza, izinqubomgomo nokucwaninga ngemigqa eya phambili ekwakhiweni okuzinza.
zu.requirements: Ithuba elimaphakathi elincane lamafa eNQF level 7 elicelwa ngumnyango we-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kumkhakha we-Built Environment/ Environmental Studies/ Law noma ohlobene nawo. Uhave weminyaka engu-5 ohlanganile ohlelweni lwabaphathi abaphakathi naba-phezulu kumkhakha ohlobene nalo. Ukubhalisa e-Build Environment Professional Council noma ukuba ngumuntu ophathwe ngokuba ngu-Green Star Accredited Professional kuzobe kungumthombo wamandla. Isitifiketi sokuxhaswa nentengiselwano noma esihlobene naso. Kuya kube yindlela yokuba ugqame ukuhamba. Yindlela yokuba uguquke nenhlelo yokusebenza ngokwesidingo sehovisi. Ukwaziswa: Kuya kube yindlela yokuba ugqame ukuhamba. Yindlela yokuba uguquke nenhlelo yokusebenza ngokwesidingo sehovisi. Amakhono: Uphatho lwamaphrojekthi; Ukucubungula nokuhlela; Ukuxhasa ukwemukela imali; Ukucabanga ngezinhlelo; Uphatho lwezimali; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ubunkokheli; Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; Amakhono okubala; Ukwenza izinqumo; Ukuxhumana okuseqophameni; Uphatho lwezinkinga; Amakhono obuntu bomuntu; Uphatho lesikhathi; Amakhono okukhuthaza. Izimpawu zobuntu: Buciko; Inqobo ebanzi; Okubhekise esixazululweni; Ikhono lokusebenza ezimeni eziphashile; Ukhatshiwe kakhulu; Ethembekile; Ukugcwala isikhathi; Nomsa; Osebenza kanzima; Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwamasuvishelezo, izinqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza umsebenzi ze-Public Works Green Building. Phatha ukucwaninga ngemigqa eya phambili ekwakhiweni okuluhlaza (amandla, iziphakamido kanye namanzi). Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamasuvishelezo asemthethweni, izinqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza umsebenzi ezihambisana nemiyalo kahulumeni ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubomgomo ze-Green Building zifaka isandla ezigqweni zenhlokweni yomnyango i.e. izidingo zenhlalo-ikonomi. Qinisekisa ukuqashelwa kwe-Green Technologies kanye ne-Management Systems ezizosetshenziswa kumthelelele wezimpahla ze-DPW. Qinisekisa ukulandela izinqubo nendlela ezifanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Thuthukisa imigudu yokulinganisa imithaonyawo emoyeni yamakhemikhali ezakhiweni zahulumeni. Qaphela ukufaka isandla kwendawo yokwakha ekufezeni izigqo zohulumeni mayelana nemiyalo yokwakha okuzinza i.e. Climate Change Response White Paper, Energy Efficiency Strategy, Water Management Act, National Environmental Management Waste Act. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemigudu yokulinganisa nokufakazela izakhiwo eziluhlaza futhi ufake isandla ekulungisweni kwemikhakha nezinkampani zamaphrojekthi ze-Green Building/Green Precincts. Saka, hlola futhi nika umbiko ngemigudu ye-Green Building ezindaweni ezintsha nasezakhiwe ekuhambisaneni nefakazeli lokulinganisa i-Green Building Star le-Green Building Council of South Africa. Hlela inqubo yokuthola i-Energy Performance Certificate kuma-DPWI facilities, ukufaka isandla ekufezeni izigqo zemali yamandla, ukwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwesilinganiso samandla, Phatha inqubo yonke yokulandela imithetho ye-Green Building nokuqoqa imibhalo. Yenza okulinganiselwa ukusebenza ukuze kubone izinga lokufeza izigqo kwakha okuluhlaza kokubili amaphrojekthi okuthuthukiswa amandla kanye nezinkambiso zokuphathwa kwezakhiwo. Hlela izidingo okufanele izakhiwo baziqede ukuze zifakazelwe bese uhlola ngokunyakathayo ukusebenza komthelelele. Xhumana ngokuphumelelayo izidingo ze-Green Building ezakhiweni ezinkunjulwa nasezibhukhiwe zombuso. Faka isandla ekubekweni kwezindawo eziseduze kwezinto zokwakha eziluhlaza nokuqoqwa kwazo – ukuzalisekisana namathuluzi azwelonke. Hlela ukuphephenyiswa nokuqinisekiswa kwesigqo sokusebenza. Phatha ukusakazwa nokuqhutshwa imigudu yemali yamandla amanzi. Qaphela ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi nangaphandle nabantu abahlukene ngokubona ngekhaya lokuthuthukisa nokuphephenyisa imigudu yokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela egcina amanzi futhi izinza. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwamasuvishelezo, izinqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza umsebenzi ezifanele. Qaphela ukuhlaziywa kwemali nensekelo ezigciniwe emanzini. Qaphela ukuhlolwa kwamanzi kanye nemigudu yokuhlolwa kwamanzi asetshenzisiwe. Yelela imininingwane eqondile mayelana namanzi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokwesekwa kwamakhasimende bezindawo ne-Service Providers abakwenza ukwenza ukuqashelwa kamanzi, ukulinganiselwa, ukukhanya kweziphakamido, nokubuyiswa kwezinto ezintsha. Phatha ukuqoqwa, ukuqinisekiswa, kanye nokunika imibiko ngemali egciniwe yamanzi. Phatha imigudu eholelwa ekuqasheleni nasekuphathweni kwemithombo yamanzi enye nokuqoqwa kwamanzi. Phatha ukusakazwa nokuqhutshwa imigudu yemali yamandla okuzinza kanye ne-Renewable Energy. Qaphela ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi nangaphandle nabantu abahlukene ngokubona ngekhaya lokuthuthukisa nokuphephenyisa imigudu yokusebenzisa amandla ngendlela egcina amandla futhi izinza. Phatha ukuhlolwa kwenani lamandla amakhasimende angakho, ukuthola imininingwane yokuzama ukubona izinto ezizakusiza ukulungiselela ukulungiswa kwamandla. Hlela imigudu yemali nokuqhutshwa kwe-PPP projects emaphrojekthini azuzisayo amandla. Nikeza imibiko ngokuqashelwa kwemigudu ebalulekile yokusebenza. Linganisa futhi ukucabanga ngemiphumela ezosha ezifakwe ezakhiweni ezithuthukisiwe kumandla okubaswa. Hlela amamodeli wamandla afanele ngendlela efanele kwiziNhlelo. Hlola imibhalo yokwakha bese unikeza izindikimba eziphathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwamandla. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemigudu yamandla okuzinza. Phatha ukuhlangana ngokuhlangene kahulumeni mayelana namandla okuzinza nokuqoqwa kwawo. Qinisekisa ukuvumelanisa inkathi yamandla ezakhiwa kahulumeni ne-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) eqokwe ngumnyango i-Department of Energy. Phatha ukusakazwa nokuqhutshwa imigudu yokuphathwa kweziphakamido. Qaphela ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi nangaphandle nabantu abahlukene ngokubona ngekhaya lokuthuthukisa nokuphephenyisa imigudu yokuphathwa kweziphakamido ekuqhubekayo. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwesuvishelelo lokuphathwa kweziphakamido lokuthuthukisa ukubuyisana nokusetshenziswa kwazinye izinto ezintsha. Siza ekwehliseni iziphakamido ngesikhathi sokwakha, bese uhlola izinto eziyisibonelo ekuphathweni kweziphakamido ngemva kokuqedwa kwakha. Qaphela ukuhlaziywa kwemali esegciniwe nensekelo ekuphathweni kweziphakamido. Phatha imigudu yokuvakashela abantu mayelana nokuphathwa kweziphakamido emkhakheni wokuqasha. Uphatho lweDirectorate. Saka futhi ugcine ukulawula ngaphakathi nendlela zokunika imibiko ukuze kuhambisane nezinyathelo zokusebenza ezithembisiwe. Saka, phumeza futhi ugcine imigudu yokuxhumana eguqukayo. Thuthukisa futhi phatha iplani yokusebenza iDirectorate bese unika imibiko ngokunyakaza njengoba kuyidingekile. Phatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Cabangela bese uhlela umsebenzi. Uphatho lwezinkomba yezinto ezinhle. Ukugcina isithulu. Qamba bese ungenisa yonke imibiko yezinto eziyindingo. Hlola imali kanye neziphakamido kwiDirectorate. Ukuba yilunga kumakhasimende ahumusha imisebenzi njengoba kuyidingekile.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukwakhiwa Koluhlaza
xh.summary: Inkundla yomsebenzi kaMphathi kwisebe lezoKusebenza kaLuntu neziQendu ePretoria, ebhekene nokuqamba iindlela zokwakhiwa koluhlaza, iinkqubo nomzobo oluncedo malunga nemijahiswano yokwakhiwa ngokungabikho kolimba.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esingentla kwi-NQF level 7 njengoko samkelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwisebe lezoQoqosho ezZakhwayo/ Izifundo zeNdalo/ uLuntu or mmandla ofanelekileyo. Uqeqesho olungenaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphakathi/ abaphezulu kwicala elichanekileyo. Uku-registration nge-Build Environment Professional Council okanye uku-registration njengo-Green Star Accredited Professional kuya kubakho nzuzo engeziweyo. Isatifikethi sokuxhaswa nentengiso okanye esinxulumaniswa neso. Makhwadi aphethe ukuzihamba. Makhululekile ukuziqhelanisa nexesha lomsebenzi ngokwemfuno yofiso. Ulwazi: Makhwadi aphethe ukuzihamba. Makhululekile ukuziqhelanisa nexesha lomsebenzi ngokwemfuno yofiso. Amakhono eProject Management; Planning and Organising; Support Fund Raising; Systems Thinking; Financial Management; Computer Literacy; Problem solving; Leadership; Analytical thinking; Numeric skills; Decision making; Advanced communication; Conflict management; Interpersonal skills; Time management; Motivational skills. Iimpawu zobuNtu: Innovative; Resourceful; Solution orientated; Ability to work under stressful situations; Highly motivated; Trustworthy; Punctuality; Assertive; Hard-working; Ability to work independently.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso lweendlela zePublic Works Green Building, iinkqubo neenkqubo zokusebenza. Lawula ucando lwemfundo malunga neendaba ezintsha zokwakhiwa koluhlaza (amandla, imfucuza namanzi) nokujihiswa. Qinisekisa uphuhliso lweendlela, iinkqubo neenkqubo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo ezihambelana nokubhalwayo kurhulumente. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo zoKwakhiwa Koluhlaza zidityaniswa neenjongo ezibalulekileyo zesebe njengoko kufunekwa ngokwezoqoqosho. Qinisekisa ukuchongwa kwezobuchwepheshe eziluhlaza nezinkqubo zoLawulo ukuze zisetyenziswe kwikhabhile yempahla ye-DPW. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Qamba iinkqubo zokulinganisa ukukhutshwa kwezinto ezibangela ukushisa kwemihlaba kwiZakhiwo zoLuntu. Lawula ugqatso lwasebuchwephesweni bokwakha ukufezekisa iinjongo zorhulumente ekubhalweni kokwakhiwa okungcoliseki njengoko kubekiweyo. Ngamagama athi Climate Change Response White Paper, Energy Efficiency Strategy, Water Management Act, National Environmental Management Waste Act. Lawula uku-setyenziswa kweenkqubo zokulinganisa nokugunyaziswa kokuKwakhiwa Koluhlaza kwaye uncede ekutyeni iiprojekthi zokwakhiwa Koluhlaza/ eendaweni eziluhlaza. Seka, qhathanisa nilinge ngakumbi ngenkqubo nokuCocwa Koluhlaza kumanqanaba amanotjhongo amatjha nokuqatjhwa kweekomiti ezisebenza ngamandla ahlangene eSouth Africa. Hlanganisa iinkqubo zokuRhweba isatifikethi soKwenza kwaManqli kwi-DPWI amanqanaba, unceda iinjongo zokubakho kwe-Star rating system of the Green Building Council of South Africa. Lawula ngokupheleleyo nokuqinisekiswa kwaye nokuCocwa Koluhlaza ngaphezu kwamagunya obukho bebafana belungiselelwa kwihhoso, njengoko iinkqubo zoKwakhiwa Koluhlaza nokuCocwa Koluhlaza eziyinkqubo elungelelanisiweyo. Lawula ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo zokwenza umsebenzi ophisilelyo, ngokukhanya kwamandla okhutshwayo kwamaza nokuqina kwamanzi eza kusetyenziswa ekulawuleni imisebenzi yoluntu olutsha nolungileyo. Hlanganisa ngqo nabanikazi bendlu kunye nabakwigunya leRhulumende okulawula ngokokulungelelanisa iinkqubo kunye neenkqubo zokucoca amandla eza kusetyenziswa ekulawuleni imisebenzi yoluntu. Lawula ngokupheleleyo nokuqinisekiswa kweekhathodi zokucoca amandla eMandla kaRhulumende, nokudlulisela amandla kwizakhiwo nasekubakho kokuqina kwamaza endlela yeelanga. Lawula ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo kunye neenkqubo zokubakho koluhlaza kweNkqubo yoLawulo Lwamanzi kwiHhovisi lokuQatjhwa kweMisebenzi yoluntu. Hlanganisa ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo neenkqubo zokugcinwa koluhlaza kunye nokuCocwa koluhlaza. Qhagamshela ngokukhawuleza iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezizakusetyenziswa ekulawuleni nasekuphuhliseni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Director: Finance
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Finance position at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Durban, requiring NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience in accrual-based accounting.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Financial Accounting/ Financial Management/Auditing or related field of study. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Accrual Based Accounting Principles. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, National Treasury regulations, guidelines and directives (MTEF, ENE), preferential procurement policy, Government supply chain management framework, Government Budget systems and procedures, Government Financial Systems and Financial prescripts (GAAP and GRAP). Skills: Planning and organizing, Problem solving, Interpersonal and diplomacy, Ability to conduct research and gathering of information, Ability to work on specific timeframes, Report writing, Management skills, Numeric skills, Ability to communicate at all levels and Analytical thinking.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation and monitoring of financial guidelines, processes, standards and strategies- Undertake research on the latest developments in professional guidelines, legislations and standards. Identify financial trends and opportunities for businesses processes improvement. Make recommendations for changes and improvements to existing financial guidelines, standards, policies and procedures. Manage the implementation of financial guidelines, standards, policies, procedures and strategies and related treasury prescripts. Ensure the development and implementation of support tools. Provide advice and guidance in various fora in relation to the financial guidelines. Monitor the implementation and ensure compliance with applicable policies and Directives. Ensure the implementation of sound effective and efficient internal control system. Manage the budget and planning function for the region-: Undertake detailed researches on matters pertaining to budget management. Manage the collation of budget inputs for budget planning and control. Analyse inputs related to Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Monitor fund transfers from National Treasury. Manage allocation of budgets according to components and financial years. Undertake quarterly reviews on the management of budget allocated to components. Ensure that Regional expenditure is in accordance with its budget allocations. Ensure that operational plans are aligned to the budget and strategic objectives. Regularly report on budget and cash-flow. Manage financial accounting and reporting services for the region: Manage account receivable and accounts payable. Manage and coordinate the compilation of financial statements (interim and annual). Manage bookkeeping and financial accounting services. Ensure the accuracy of allocation journals, receipts and payments. Manage the verification of payment interfaces. Ensure the timely reconciliation and clearing of control accounts. Ensure that invoice payments within the region are processed within 30 days in line with Treasury Regulations. Oversee timely production of reports. Implement a dashboard for tracking and resolution of queries from suppliers. Manage property payments and revenues-: Ensure effective implementation of the property expenditure management system. Manage property revenues; Ensure effectiveness of the Property Asset Register. Manage the authorisation of creditors’ payments and customer master file. Manage litigation and/or arbitration related to property payments and revenue. Maintain a sound financial governance and processes and ensure the implementation of measures for improving audit outcomes-: Prevent and detect the irregular expenditure, fruitless and wasteful expenditure and unauthorised expenditure. Ensure that the register is updated with all reported cases of irregular expenditure, Fruitless expenditure, unauthorized expenditure, lost, stolen and damaged assets. Monitor adherence to all internal policies and practices. Review management report and implement audit plan. Ensure regular progress report on the audit plan. Ensure effective document control and safeguard of source documents. Ensure that reconciliation, journals and payments are fully supported. Ensure timeous and accurate response to the Auditor General. Management of the Directorate-: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations; Maintenance of discipline; Management of performance and development; Establish implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements; Develop and manage the operational plan of the directorate and report on progress as required; Compile and submit all required administrative reports; Serve on transverse task teams as required; Quality control of work delivered by employees; Monitor the budget and expenditures on Financial accounting directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575
jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Director: Finance must be submitted to: Recruitment26-87@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Finansies
af.summary: Direkteur van Finansies-pos by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Durban, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in toekenninggebaseerde rekeningkunde vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken in Finansiële Rekeningkunde/Finansiële Bestuur/Oudit of 'n verwante studieveld. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in Toekenninggebaseerde Rekeningkundige Beginsels. Kennis: Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, National Treasury-regulasies, riglyne en direktiewe (MTEF, ENE), bevooroordeelde voorsieningsbeleid, Government se voorsieningskettingbestuursraamwerk, Government begrotingstelsels en prosedures, Government Finansiële Stelsels en Finansiële voorskifte (GAAP en GRAP). Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, probleemoplossing, interpersoonlik en diplomaie, vermoë om navorsing te doen en inligting in te win, vermoë om binne spesifieke tydraamwerke te werk, verslagskrywing, bestuursvaardighede, numeriese vaardighede, vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer en analitiese denke.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering en monitering van finansiële riglyne, prosesse, standaarde en strategieë- Ondersoek die jongste ontwikkelinge in professionele riglyne, wetgewing en standaarde. Identifiseer finansiële tendense en geleenthede vir die verbetering van besigheidsprosesse. Doen aanbevelings vir veranderinge en verbeterings aan bestaande finansiële riglyne, standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Bestuur die implementering van finansiële riglyne, standaarde, beleide, prosedures en strategieë en verwante tesourievoorskifte. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van ondersteuningsinstrumente. Verskaf advies en leiding in verskeie forums in verband met die finansiële riglyne. Moniteer die implementering en verseker nakoming van toepaslike beleide en Direktiewe. Verseker die implementering van 'n gesonde, doeltreffende en effektiewe interne beheerstelsel. Bestuur die begrotings- en beplanningsfunksie vir die streek-: Ondersoek gedetailleerd aangeleenthede rakende begrotingsbestuur. Bestuur die samestelling van begrotingsinsette vir begrotingsbeplanning en -beheer. Analiseer insette rakende die Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Moniteer fondsoordragte van die National Treasury. Bestuur die toekenning van begrotings volgens komponente en finansiële jare. Ondersoek kwartaalliks die bestuur van die begroting wat aan komponente toegeken is. Verseker dat Streeksbesteding ooreenstem met sy begrotingstoekenning. Verseker dat operasionele planne op die begroting en strategiese doelwitte uitlyn. Rapporteer gereeld oor begroting en kontantvloei. Bestuur finansiële rekeningkundige en verslagdoeningsdienste vir die streek: Bestuur debiteure en krediteure. Bestuur en koördineer die samestelling van finansiële state (tussentyds en jaarliks). Bestuur boekhou- en finansiële rekeningkundige dienste. Verseker die akkuraatheid van toekenningsjoernale, kwitansies en betalings. Bestuur die verifikasie van betalingkoppelvlakke. Verseker die tydige versoen en verreken van beheerrekenings. Verseker dat fakturenbetalings binne die streek binne 30 dae ooreenkomstig Tesourie-regulasies verwerk word. Hou toesig oor die tydige vervaardiging van verslae. Implementeer 'n dashboard vir die naspeur en oplossing van navrae van verskaffers. Bestuur eiendomsbetalings en inkomste-: Verseker effektiewe implementering van die eiendomsbestedingsbestuurstelsel. Bestuur eiendomsinkomste; Verseken die doeltreffendheid van die Property Asset Register. Bestuur die magtiging van krediteure se betalings en die klantmeesterlêer. Bestuur litigasie en/of arbitrasie wat verband hou met eiendomsbetalings en inkomste. Handhaaf 'n gesonde finansiële bestuur en prosesse en verseker die implementering van maatreëls om oudit-uitslae te verbeter-: Voorkom en bespeur onreëlmatige besteding, vrugtelose en vermorsende besteding en ongeoorloofde besteding. Verseker dat die register opgedateer word met alle aangemelde gevalle van onreëlmatige besteding, vrugtelose besteding, ongeoorloofde besteding, verlore, gestoor en beskadigde bates. Moniteer nakoming van alle interne beleide en praktyke. Hersien bestuursverslae en implementeer ouditplan. Verseker gereelde vorderingsverslae oor die ouditplan. Verseker effektiewe dokumentbeheer en beskerming van brondokumente. Verseker dat versoenings, joernale en betalings ten volle gesteun word. Verseker tydige en akkurate reaksie aan die Auditor General. Bestuur van die Direktoraat-: Stel en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer- en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik; Handhawing van dissipline; Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling; Stel, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie reëlings; Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis; Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in; Dien op dwars-taakspanne soos vereis; Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer is; Moniteer die begroting en besteding van die finansiële rekeningkunde-direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Izimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi wezimali eKuMnyangweni wezaMisebenzi kaZwelonke nokuKwakhiwa eDurban, esifuna izifundo ezinga le-NQF level 7 nokuhlangenwe ngamakhulu eminyaka yamava abaphathi abaphezulu kuyo inzululwazi yokubala ngendlela ye-accrual accounting.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso ezingeni le-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwe-Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Auditing noma indiza yokufunda enezelene naleyondiza. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yamava ezingeni labaphathi abaphakathi/abaphezulu kumiso ka-accrual Based Accounting Principles. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, Imitshayo yokuQondisa ye-National Treasury, iziqondiso nemiyalelo (MTEF, ENE), inqubomgomo yokuthenga ngokuthandayo, uhlaka lokuphathwa kwentambo yokuhlinzeka kahulumeni, izinhlelo nezindlela zebhajethi kahulumeni, kanye nezinhlelo zamanzi kanye nemiyalo yezimali (GAAP kanye ne-GRAP). Amakhono: Ukucubungula nokuqamba, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ubudlelwano bakithi nodiplomashe, ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo nokuqoqa ulwazi, ikhono lokusebenza ngezikhathi ezithize, ukubhali kwezibalo, amakhono okuphatha, amakhano okubala, ikhono lokuthinta abantu kuzo zonke izinga nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqaphela imiyalelo yezimali, izinqubo, izinga kanye namasu- Yenza ucwaningo ngezinto ezisha ezinomenyeziyelweni yemiyalelo yemikhakha, izimali nokuqondiswa. Hlola izinkomba zezimali namathuba okuthuthukisa izinqubo zoshungalomsebenzi. Nikela ngemininingwane yokushintsha ukuthuthukisa imiyalelo yezimali ezivezwe, izinga, inqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ezikhona. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalelo yezimali, izinga, inqubomgomo, izinqobo kanye namasu kanye nemiyalelo ehlobene ne-Treasury. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi okusekela. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa ezinhlanganweni ezahlukene ngokuhlobene nemiyalelo yezimali. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwenqubomgomo namayelelo asebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukumiswa kwezinqobo zolawulo zangaphakathi ezisebenzayo futhi ezikhulu. Phatha ibhajethi kanye nensebenzo yokucubungula isifunda-: Yenza ucwaningo olubanzi ngemayelana nokuphathwa kwebhajethi. Phatha ukuqoqa okufakwa kwebhajethi ngenhloso yokucubungula kanye nokuqondisa ibhajethi. Hlaziya okufakwe mayelana ne-Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Qaphela ukudluliswa kwemali evela ku-National Treasury. Phatha ukwabelwa kwebhajethi ngokwamakompothi kanye neminyaka yezimali. Yenza ukubuyekeza ngokwamasonto amane ekuphathweni kwebhajethi ebanjwe kwamakompothi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali esifundeni kuhambisana nokwabelwa kwebhajethi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlela zokusebenza zihambisana nebhajethi nangamgomo wokuqonda. Yenze imibiko njalo ngebhajethi kanye nesivikelo semali. Phatha ukubalwa kwemali nokwenza imibiko yezimali esifundeni: Phatha izimali ezifakwe esikweni kanye nezimali ezikhokhwayo. Phatha futhi uhlole ukwakhiwa kwemibiko yezimali (yaphakathi nonyaka). Phatha ukugcina izincwadi kanye namasevisi okubala imali. Qinisekisa ukumiswa kwamajenaluzo, iziphoqo nokukhokhelwa ngokuchanekileyo. Phatha ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlangana kwezikhokho zokukhokha. Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa ngokushesha kanye nokucaciswa kwezikhondi zolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikweletu zesifunda zikhokhelwa phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo ye-Treasury. Qapha ukukhiqizwa kwemibiko ngokushesha. Misidashibhodi yokuqaphela nokuxazulula imibuzo emvela kubanikazi bamaphakethe. Phatha izinkokhelo nenzuzo yezimpahla-: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwenqubo yokuphathwa kokuchitha izimpahla. Phatha inzuzo yezimpahla; Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-Property Asset Register. Phatha ukugunyaza kokukhokhwa kwezikweletu kanye nefayela yamakhasimende abakhulu. Phatha izinkantolo futhi/noma izinqumo ezihlobene nokukhokhelwa kwentengo yezimpahla nenzuzo. Gcina uhulumeni ohle kwezimali neziphatsimandla futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuphucula imiphumela yokuhlolwa-: Thibela futhi uhlole ukuchithwa okungalawuleki, ukuchithwa okungalulekile nentengo eningi kanye nokuchithwa okungalugunyaziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbhalo ubuyekezwa ngezono zonke izimo ezibikwa ngokuchithwa okungalawuleki, ukuchithwa okungalulekile, ukuchithwa okungagunyaziwe, izimpahla ezilahlekile, ezibekiwe nezilimele. Qaphela ukuze kuhle kwayo yonke imqondo yangaphakathi kanye nezenzo. Buyekeza imibiko yophatho futhi usebenzise iplani yokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa imibiko yentuthuko njengokuthi uhlelo lokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwamaphuzu emibhalu nokuphathwa kwemibhalo evela kuyo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqondanisa, amajenaluzo nokukhokhela axhaswe ngokugcwele. Qinisekisa ukuphendula ngokushesha ngokuchanekileyo ku-Auditor General. Ukuphathwa kweDirectorate-: Misa futhi ulawule izinqobo zangaphakathi nezinhlelo zokwenza imibiko ezifanele ukuze uhambisane nokulindelwe ngemiphumela; Ukugcina isiyalongo; Ukuphatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukisa; Misa, usebenzise futhi ulawule izinhlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo ezikhulu; Seka futhi uphathe iplani yokusebenza iDirectorate bese ubika inqondo njengoba kudingwa; Hlanganisa futhi unikeze yonke imibiko yesiphoqo esidingekayo; Zibambe iqhaza kumathimana okuhlanganyele njengoba kudingwa; Ukuqinisekisa izinga lomsebenzi okhiqizwa izisebenzi; Qaphela ibhajethi kanye nokuchithwa kwezimali eDirectorate.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ezezeemali
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli wezeemali kwi Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e Durban, sifuna izifundo ze NQF level 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava abaphathi abaphezulu kwi-akhawunti esekelwe kwi-akruyale.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwe NQF level 7 esivunyiwe ngabakwa South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwi Financial Accounting/ Financial Management/Auditing okanye kwindlela efanayo yokufunda. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi ophakathi/ophakamileyo kwi Accrual Based Accounting Principles. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, National Treasury regulations, izikhokelo nemiyalelo (MTEF, ENE), iindlela ezikhethwayo zokuthenga, iGovernmnet supply chain management framework, iinkqubo namacebo ebhajeti karhulumente, iinkqubo zezeemali karhulumente namagunya ezeemali (GAAP and GRAP). Amandla: Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, Ukuxazulula iingxaki, Ubudlelwane nobunyulu, Amandla okwenza uphando nokuqokelela ulwazi, Amandla okusebenza kwithuba elithile lokusetyenziswa, Ukubhala iingxelo, Amandla okulawula, Amandla kumanani, Amandla okuthetha nakuzo zonke iinqanaba kunye nokuqonda ngokuhlola.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenzisa nokujonga iindlela ezingumthetho wezeemali, iinkqubo, amagunya namacebo- Yenza uphando ngenkqubo yamagama amatsha kwizikhokelo zobungcali, emthethweni nakumagunya. Phawula iindlela ezihamba ngokwezeemali namathuba okuphucula iinkqubo zoshishino. Nikela iingcali ngezigqibo zemiba ezitsha nokuphuculwa kweendlela ezingumthetho zezeemali, amagunya, iinkqubo namacebo. Lawula ukusebenziswa kweendlela ezingumthetho wezeemali, amagunya, iinkqubo, namacebo kunye nemiyalelo ye-treasury. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kwezixhobo zoxhaso. Nikela ingcebiso nokuqondisa kumabandla ahlukahlukeneyo malunga neendlela ezingumthetho zezeemali. Qhathanisa ukusebenzisa ukuqinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweenkqubo namagunya. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa inkqubo elawulayo engcono nesebenzayo ngaphakathi. Lawula ibhajeti nomsebenzi wokucwangcisa kummandla-: Yenza uphando oluChaziweyo ngemiba ezithinta ulawulo lwebhajeti. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwezimvo zebhajeti ukucwangcisa nokulawula ibhajeti. Hlola iimvo ezahlukeneyo malunga ne Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Qhathanisa ukuhanjiswa kwemali kuvela kwi National Treasury. Lawula ukwabiwa kwamabhajeti ngokwakompon Nathi eminyaka yamawaka. Yenza oloPhando Ithathu ngokulawula ibhajeti abe usuku iNkomfa komgangatho nentla ngakumbi komsebenzi ka gqi fika isiseko sendalo yamakomponi. 05

jobs.title: Director: Risk Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Risk Management position at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Risk Management / Public Administration / Financial Management or related field. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the relevant field. Knowledge of Risk management framework; business planning processes; applicable legislation, norms and standards related to the built environment industry, including the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Instructions, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations and the Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; functioning of national, provincial and local government; fundamental economics; structure and functioning of the Department; Parliamentary protocol processes; linkages with government clusters; Departmental standards and regulations. Skills: Executive management skills; sound analytical and problem identification and solving skills; marketing and liaison; advanced communication; language proficiency; advanced report writing; research methodologies; financial administration; financial analyses; organising and planning; computer literacy; numeracy; advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills; programme and project management; time management; decision making skills; conflict management; negotiation skills; motivational skills; influencing skills. Ability to work effectively and efficiently under sustained pressure; ability to meet tight deadlines whilst delivering excellent results; ability to communicate at all levels, particularly at an executive level and ability to work independently.
jobs.duties: Manage the development of risk management strategies, systems (methodologies, models and tools etc.), policies and annual risk management plan-: Undertake research on the latest development of policies, professional guideline and standards. Ensure that all policies, guidelines and standards developed are aligned to the Departments strategic objective. Provide information on risk management policies, methods and practices. Manage and develop the Department’s business risk profile. Ensure that risk management philosophy and culture is embedded in the organisation. Monitor and ensure the implementation and continuous adherence to professional guideline and standards. Oversee the management and implementation of the risk management-: Undertake studies and analysis for identifying risks to establish the internal and external organisation context. Ensure development of risk management controls and contingency plans in the Department. Manage the risk management assessment process. Lead the implementation of risk strategies in conjunction. Ensure provision of risk management advisory services and participate in relevant internal and external structures. Manage the administration of risk analysis projects. Manage, monitor and review the identified risk response activities. Manage the development of risk profile (ensure that the risk register is maintained). Prepare reports on implementation and progress of risk strategies. Manage and undertake capacity development (inform, guide and advise employees on risk management matters). Provide effective management of business framework-: Manage the development of analysis work. Design business cases for business process management. Ensure prioritisation and evaluation of business analysis projects, Administer business analysis programmes. Provide inputs to change management projects. Compile reports on the management of business architecture for senior management. Ensure collection and assessment of information regarding implementation of risk strategies and provide information to Strategic Management-: Conduct risk analyses on risk information. Evaluate and prioritise risk analysis projects. Evaluate the effectiveness of integration of risk management within the organisation. Ensure that risks attached to business processes are addressed in conjunction with business analysis. Provide inputs with risk information. Explore and suggest solutions to identified risks. Provide inputs to change management components. Manage the Directorate: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations; Develop and manage the operational plan of the Directorate and report on progress as required; Manage performance and development of employees; Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements; Compile and submit all required administrative reports; Quality control of work delivered by employees; Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575
jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Director: Risk Management must be submitted to: Recruitment26-88@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Risikobestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Risikobestuur-pos by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Hoofkantoor in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF level 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Risikobestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante veld. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in die tersaaklike veld. Kennis van Risikobestuursraamwerk; besigheidsbeplanningsprosesse; toepaslike wetgewing, norme en standaarde wat verband hou met die bou-omgewingsbedryf, insluitend die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Instructions, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations en die Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; funksionering van nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering; fundamentele ekonomie; struktuur en funksionering van die Departement; Parlementêre protokolprosesse; skakels met regeringsklusters; departementele standaarde en regulasies. Vaardighede: Uitvoerende bestuursvaardighede; goeie analitiese en probleemidentifikasie- en oplossingsvaardighede; bemarking en skakeling; gevorderde kommunikasie; taalvaardigheid; gevorderde verslagskrywing; navorsingsmetodes; finansiële administrasie; finansiële ontledings; organisering en beplanning; rekenaarvaardigheid; syfervaardigheid; gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomasievaardighede; programme- en projeksbestuur; tydbestuur; besluitnemingvaardighede; konflikbestuur; onderhandelingsvaardighede; motiveringsvaardighede; beïvloedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend en doeltreffend onder volgehoue druk te werk; vermoë om styf tydsbeperkings te haal terwyl uitstekende resultate gelewer word; vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, veral op 'n uitvoerende vlak en vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van risikobestuursstrategieë, stelsels (metodes, modelle en gereedskap ens.), beleide en jaarlikse risikobestuursplan-: Ondersoek die jongste ontwikkeling van beleide, professionele riglyne en standaarde. Verseker dat alle beleide, riglyne en standaarde wat ontwikkel is, in ooreenstemming is met die departement se strategiese doelwitte. Verskaf inligting oor risikobestuursbeleide, metodes en praktyke. Bestuur en ontwikkel die departement se besigheidsrisikoprofiel. Verseker dat risikobestuursfilosofie en -kultuur in die organisasie ingebed is. Monitor en verseker die implementering en deurlopende nakoming van professionele riglyne en standaarde. Hou toesig oor die bestuur en implementering van risikobestuur-: Ondersoek studies en ontleding om risiko's te identifiseer om die interne en eksterne organisasiekonteks te vestig. Verseker die ontwikkeling van risikobestuurskontroles en noodplanne in die departement. Bestuur die risikobestuur-assesseringsproses. Lei die implementering van risikostrategieë in samewerking. Verseker die verskaffing van risikobestuursadviesdienste en neem deel aan tersaaklike interne en eksterne strukture. Bestuur die administrasie van risiko-ontledingsprojekte. Bestuur, monitor en hersien die geïdentifiseerde risiko-reaksie-aktiwiteite. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die risikoprofiel (verseker dat die risikoregister gehandhaaf word). Berei verslae voor oor die implementering en vordering van risikostrategieë. Bestuur en ondernem kapasiteitsontwikkeling (stel werknemers inlig, lei en adviseer oor risikobestuursake). Verskaffing van doeltreffende bestuur van besigheidsraamwerk-: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van ontledingswerk. Ontwerp besigheidsgevalle vir besigheidsprosesbestuur. Verseker prioritering en evaluering van besigheidsontledingsprojekte; administreer besigheidsontledingsprogramme. Verskaf insette tot veranderingbestuursprojekte. Stel verslae op oor die bestuur van besigheidsargitektuur vir senior bestuur. Verseker versameling en assessering van inligting aangaande die implementering van risikostrategieë en verskaf inligting aan Strategiese Bestuur-: Voer risiko-ontledings uit oor risikoinligting. Evalueer en prioriteer risiko-ontledingsprojekte. Evalueer die doeltreffendheid van die integrasie van risikobestuur binne die organisasie. Verseker dat risiko's wat aan besigheidsprosesse gekoppel is, in samewerking met besigheidsontleding aangespreek word. Verskaf insette met risikoinligting. Ontdek en stel oplossings voor vir geïdentifiseerde risiko's. Verskaf insette tot veranderingbestuurskomponente. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge na te kom; ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis; bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers; vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en doeltreffende kommunikasiereëlings; stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in; gehaltebeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word; monitor die begroting en uitgawes vir die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokuphathwa kwezingozi eDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office ePretoria, esidinga izifundo zenga NQF level 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yobuhle obuseduzane nobuphathi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingavuthwa ngaphansi kweNQF level 7 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kuleyo nkalo yokuphathwa kwezingozi / ukuphathwa kukaqondo / ukuphathwa kwezimali noma indlela ehlobene layo. Ukuze ube nobuhle obungangeniswa kule nkalo kudingeka ube neminyaka engu-5 eqoqwa ungena emkhakheni ophathwa ngamaphakathi abaphathi abaseduzane nobaphezulu kulowo mkhakha. Ukwazi ngeyakhokezelwa yezingozi; inqubo yokuhlela amabhizinisi; imithetho, izimiso namazinga ahlobene nomkhakha we-built environment, okuhlanganisa nebhalansi, imiyalo yeNdlu Yogqozi, umthetho wesevisi yesizwe, imithethonqubo yesevisi yesizwe kanye nokuqondiswa okungavuthwa i-Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; ukusebenza kwezikhungo ezingamahhovimenti, izifundazwe kanye nehovisi lezonyallweb; ukuzijwayeza izinto eziyisiseko; isakhiwo kanye nokusebenza kwaleyo ngingqi; inqubo yemitetho yePhalamende; ukuxhumana kwezikhungo zikahulumeni; izimiso namazinga abekwe yilesi sikhungo. Izinduduzo: Izinduduzo ezisesintweni; induduzo enomsoco yokuhlaziya leyo nokuqamba izixazululo, ukuthengisa nokuxhumana; ukuxhumana okuphezulu; ukuzitshwa okuhle phansi; ubuchule bokusebenzisa ulimi; ubuchule obuphezulu bokubhala imibiko; izindlela zocwaningo; ukuphathwa kwezimali; ukuhlaziywa kwezimali; ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ukwazi ukubala; amakhono okuxhumana nobuntu kanye nobungqondondothi; ukuphathwa kuhlelelo kanye nemikhiqizo; ukuphatha isikhathi; ukwenza izinqumo; ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; amakhono okuxoxisana; amakhono okukhuthaza; amakhono okushukumisa. Ikono lokusebenza kakuhle ngesikhathi esibekiwe; ikono lokuqedela emva kwesikhathi esibekiwe, kanti ukuphumelela ukudlula emimeni; ikono lokukhuluma ngazwo onke amazinga, ikakhuluzi ezingeni eliphezulu kanti nokusebenza ngokuzimela.
zu.duties: Phatha ukwakhiwa kwezindlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi, izindlela ezihlukene zokwenza umsebenzi (izindlela, izibhalo namathuluzi njll), izinqondiso kanye nenkqubo yonyaka yokuphatha izingozi-: Yenza ucwaningo ngokuthuthukiswa kwezinqondiso, izinhlobonhlobo zokuqondisa ngobuchule kanye namazinga. Qinisekisa ukuthi zoke izinqondiso, imiyalo yolwazi kanye namazinga akhiwa ahambisana nezinhloso ezibalulekileyo ezinqunyiwe kulesi sikhungo. Nikeza ulwazi ngezinqondiso zokuphathwa kwezingozi, izindlela namasiko. Phatha kanye nokwakha inqubo yokuhlaziya izingozi ezingena esikhungweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi inkambiso kanye nenhloso yokuphathwa kwezingozi ingena ngokujulile kule nqobo. Hlola kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa ngokuqhubekayo kwezinhlobonhlobo zokuqondisa ngobuchule kanye namazinga. Bukela kanye nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokuphathwa kwezingozi-: Thatha izifundo kanye nokuhlaziya ukuthola izingozi ukuze usungule inqondo yangaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kokuqondwa kwezingozi kanye nezindlela zokuvala izingozi eNkulisa kulesi sikhungo. Phatha inqubo yokuhlola izingozi. Hola ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi ngokuhlanganyela. Qinisekisa ukunikwa ngemiyalo yomphakathi yokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nokuhlanganyela kwezinhlobonhlobo ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ezihlobene nalo. Phatha ukuphathwa kophyetha lokuhlaziya izingozi. Phatha, hlola kanye ukubuyekeza imisebenzi yokuphendula izingozi ezitholakalile. Phatha ukwakhiwa kobuso bezingozi (qinisekisa ukuthi uhlu lwamazinga ezingozi lugcinwa lulungele). Lungelela imibiko ngokuqedwa kanye nokuqhubeka kwezindlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi. Phatha kanye nokuthatha uhambo lokwakhiwa kobuso bokusebenza (tshela, qondisa kanye nikeza umphakathi ngemiyalo eMayelana nokuphathwa kwezingozi). Nikeza ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwesakhiwo sebizinesi-: Phatha ukwakhiwa komsebenzi wokuuhlaziya. Diza amacala webizinesi ukuphathwa kwenqubo yebizinesi. Qinisekisa ukuqashwa ngokubaluleka kanye nokuhlaziya imikhiqizo yokuhalazisa ibizinesi, Phatha amahlelelokuziphilisa okuhlaziya ibizinesi. Nikeza imibhalo emikhakheni yephrofetho yokushintsha. Lungela imibiko ngokuphathwa kwesakhiwo sebizinesi abapathini abaphezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthola kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi ngomphumela wokuqeda inqobo yokuphatha izingozi, futhi nikeze ulwazi lokuphathwa okuhleliwe-: Yenza uhlolojwalo lokuhlaziya ulwazi ngezingozi. Hlaziya kanye nokubalula imikhiqizo yokuhlaziya izingozi. Hlaziya ukuphumelela kokuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezingozi kule nqobo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izingozi ezingena ngaphakathi kwenqbo yomsebenzi zixazululwa ngokuhlanganyela nokuhlaziya ibizinesi. Nikeza ngemibhalo ngolwazi lwamazinga ezingozi. Hlola kanye nokusikisa izixazululo kwezinhlebo zokuqonda izingozi. Nikeza ngemibhalo kumakhasimende ashintsha izinto ezingeni eliphezulu. Phatha iNqjana: Sika kanye nokugcina okulawulwayo kulesi sikhungu kanye nezinhlelokusebenza zokwenza imibiko ukuze uhambisane nezinhloso zokwenza umsebenzi; Hlela kanye nokuphatha inqbo yemisebenzi yalesi bhalansi futhi wenze imibiko ngokuqhubeka njengoba kudingekile; Phatha ukwakhiwa ngokuphumelela kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabo sebela isikhungo; Sika, phumelelisa futhi ugcine izindlela zokuxhumana ezilula kanti futhi eziphumelelayo; Hlela kanye nokuthumela yonke imibiko ezodingwa ukuphathwa kwayo; Ukulawula kwayo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi othunyiwe ovela kubasebenzi uphelele; Hlola imaliyesethi kanye nezindleko zokubeka abaphathi ababalulekile.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukulawula Iingozi
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli wokulawula iingozi kumagumbi eNtla koSebe lweZoMiso-mthetho woLuntu nezeMiba ePretoria, sifuna ikrifikheshini yengqondo elinqanaba lesi-7 le-NQF namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava enkulu ekulawulweni.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ebaluleke kakhulu elinganisiweyo kwinqanaba lesi-7 le-NQF njengoko ivunyiwe ngumbutho wokuQinisekisa iMimangaliswano yoMzantsi Afrika (SAQA) kummandla woKulawula iingozi / oBulungiseleli bikoLuntu / oBulungiseleli beeMali okanye kwelinye icandelo elifanayo. Iminyaka eyi-5 ubuncinane yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuqhuba kummandla ofaneleyo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokulawula iingozi; iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ushishino; umthetho ofanelekayo, iindlela ezisetyenziswayo neemfuno ezidibana noshishino lwezolimo nezentlalo, kuquka uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, iMiyalelo yeTreasury, uMthetho koMkhonzio woLuntu, iMiyalelo yoMkhonzio woLuntu noMthetho woMilinganiselo oNgcangcazela kakhulu (MISS); ukusebenza kolawulo lwezwe, lwephondo nasedolophini; izinto eziyintsika zoqoqosho; ulwahlulo olusemthethweni nendlela elisebenza ngayo iSebe; iinkqubo zendlela yokuziphatha kwisoNdingcatyo; uqhagamshelwano namaphando karhulumente; iimfuno neengqikithi zeSebe. Amandla: Amandla okulawula abaphathi abaphezulu; amandla angazanga agqithisileyo okutshintsha iingxaki nokuweza iingxaki; amanyathelo okuthengisa nokunxibelelanisa; unxibelelwano oluphuhlayo; ukusuka kolwimi; ukubhala iingxelo ezidityanisiweyo; iindlela zokupanda-kubandi; ulawulo lweemali; ukuhlalutywa kweemali; ukuhlela nokuqwalasela; ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esingenantlukwano; izibalo; amandla obudlelwane nobuchule bokulinganisa; ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi; ulawulo lwexesha; amandla okwenza izigqibo; ulawulo looyikholflikthi; amandla okuxoxisana; amandla okukhuthaza; amandla okuthabatha inxaxheba. Amandla okusebenza ngokusebenzayo nangempumelelo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo oluqhutshiweyo; amandla okugqiba ngexesha elimandiweyo ngelixa unika iziphumo ezilungileyo; amandla okunxibelelanisa kuzo lonke iinqanaba, ngakumbi kwinqanaba eliphakathi nendlela yokuzilawula ngokutsha.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zokulawula iingozi, iinkqubo (iindlela, iindlela zokusebenza nezixhobo njl.), iinkqubo nemigangatho yokuvalwa kwemisebenzi. Phanda iinkalo ezintsha ezikwinkqubo yemithetho, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo neemfuno. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imithetho, iinkqubo neemfuno ezintsha zihambelana nengozi ephuhliswayo yeSebe. Nikezela ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokulawula iingozi, iindlela nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Lawula uphuhlise iplani yeemfumba zeSebe. Qinisekisa ukuba inqbovane yokulawula iingozi nendlela yokuphila ibambe iqhaza kwishishini. Qwalasela qinisekise ukusetyenziswa nokulandelana kolwazi oluqhutshiweyo malunga neenkqubo neemfuno ezintsha. Qwalasela ulawulo nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokulawula iingozi. Phanda ukwenza isifundo nokuhlalutya ukuqonda iingozi ezingavela kwishishini langaphakathi nangaphandle. Qinisekisa uphuhliso lweenkqubo zokulawula iingozi neendlela ezilungele iSebe. Lawula inqubo yokuqwalasela iingozi. Ngenisa iinkqubo ezintsha ezikwinkqubo yokuqonda iingozi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kolwazi olutsha malunga nokulawula iingozi ngenxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezikulangaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula uphuhliso lweenkqubo ezintsha zokulawula iingozi. Lawula uqwalasele uvakalise iinkqubo ezintsha ezikulawulweni lweengozi. Lawula uphuhliso lwenkundla yengozi. Lungiselela iingxelo ezikulawulweni lweengozi ezintsha. Lawula uphuhliso lwezakhono ezintsha (ukwazisa, ukulungisa nokuqukumbesa abasebenzi ngeenkqubo ezintsha zokulawula iingozi). Yonke iinkqubo zokulawula iingozi kufuneki zithathwe ngokungathi ngumsebenzi weNkundla: Lungiselela uphuhliso lomsebenzi wokuphuhla iingozi ezingavela. Lungelelanisa iinkqubo ezikwindlela yokwenza ushishino. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ezintsha zokulawula iingozi. Lawula iinkqubo ezikwindlela yokwenza ushishino. Lawula, qwalasela uphinde ukulawule imisebenzi emininzi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olutsha kwiinkqubo ezikwindlela yokwenza ushishino. Lawula iNkundla: Seka nokuze ugcine iinkqubo ezikulawulweni zokulawula iingozi; uphuhlise ulawulo olutsha lweNkundla; lawula uphuhliso lobugcisa bobasebenzi; seka ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olutsha kwindlela yokwenza ushishino; lungiselela iingxelo ezikulawulweni; qwalasela ukulungiswa kwemisebenzi; qwalasela imirawudi yokubakho komsebenzi.

jobs.title: Director: Environment and Culture Sector
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director position to manage strategic and operational plans for the Environment and Culture Sector within the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Environmental Sciences or related field of study. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the relevant field. Knowledge: Strategic management processes; Business planning processes; Applicable legislation, norms and standards related to the management EPWP; Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and the Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; Functioning of national, provincial and local government; SAQA / NQF framework; Environmental Impact Management; Client relations; Knowledge of labour intensive environmental technology; Financial management; Structure and functioning of the Department; Departmental standards and regulations; Leadership and Advanced report writing. Skills: Management & decision-making skills; Diplomacy; Project and Programme management; Change management; Capacity building; Analytical thinking; Strategic management; Effective communication; Conflict management; Interpersonal relations; Policy formulation; Decision making skills; Motivational skills; Integration management and Computer Skills. Ability to work effectively and efficiently under pressure. Ability to communicate at all levels, participate at an executive level. Ability to work independently.
jobs.duties: Manage the development of strategic and operational plans and guidelines for the coordination of EPWP in the Environment and Culture Sector programmes- : Undertake research to develop frameworks 9moddels, guidelines, training strategies, etc). Consult with relevant stakeholders for inputs. Ensure that strategic and operational plans and guidelines are developed/ reviewed in line with applicable prescripts (APP, MTSF ect) and are aligned to the government’s priorities and outcomes. Promote the development of cross-sector norms and standards in alignment to the EPWP requirements. Monitor the implementation and compliance with the EPWP guidelines. Manage the coordination for the implementation of EPWP Environment and Culture sector programmes-: Support the identification and planning of Environment and Culture sector programmes and projects. Ensure the implementation of the Environment and Culture sector models in line with EPWP. Manage the allocation of financial resources (conditional grant) for sector projects. Promote the introduction of labour-intensive technologies in the sector. Monitor and evaluate the environmental impact of the Expanded Public Works Programme. Manage the coordination of the environmental and culture sector activities between the Department and relevant stakeholders-: Coordinate and support processes for establishment of sector governance structures for efficiency and effectiveness to maintain sound relationships with stakeholders. Oversee engagements with stakeholders on DPWI structures. Consult with relevant stakeholders with regards to the development of sector strategic frameworks e.g strategic plans, guidelines, training plans for the EPWP implementation; Coordinate the collating of inputs from participating departments and stakeholders to ensure reporting on work opportunities. Provide support to the sector regional coordinators and provincial implementing bodies. Coordinate the impact evaluation of the programmes. Prepare and submit regular progress reports to relevant stakeholders. Coordinate EPWP M&E procedures and processes of DPWI and implementing public body projects. Manage the Directorate-: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems to meet performance expectations. Develop and manage the operational plan of the Directorate and report on progress as required. Manage performance and development of employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports; Quality control of work delivered by employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885/Mr Chance Zaba at 083 633 8575
jobs.applications: Email Applications for the position of Director: Environment and Culture Sector must be submitted to: Recruitment26-89@dpw.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Omgewing- en Kultuursektor
af.summary: Direkteurspos om strategiese en operasionele planne vir die Omgewing- en Kultuursektor binne die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, gebaseer in Pretoria, te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) in Omggingswetenskappe of 'n verwante studierigting. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in die tersaaklike veld.
