Kennis: Strategiese bestuursprosesse; Besigheidsbeplanningsprosesse; Toepaslike wetgewing, norme en standaarde verwant aan die bestuur van EPWP; Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) en die Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; Werking van nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering; SAQA / NQF-raamwerk; Omggingsimpakbestuur; Kliëntverhoudinge; Kennis van arbeidsintensiewe omgginstegnologie; Finansiële bestuur; Struktuur en werking van die departement; Departementele standaarde en regulasies; Leierskap en gevorderde verslagskrywing. Vaardighede: Bestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede; Diplomatieke vaardighede; Projekte- en programbestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kapasiteitsbou; Analitiese denke; Strategiese bestuur; Effektiewe kommunikasie; Konflikbestuur; Interpersoonlike verhoudinge; Beleidformulering; Besluitnemingsvaardighede; Motiveringsvaardighede; Integrasiebestuur en rekenaarvaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend en effektief onder druk te werk. Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer en op uitvoerende vlak deel te neem. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van strategiese en operasionele planne en riglyne vir die koördinering van EPWP in die Omgewing- en Kultuursektorprogramme: Ondersoek doen om raamwerke (modelle, riglyne, opleidingsstrategieë, ens.) te ontwikkel. Raadpleeg tersaaklike belanghebbendes vir insette. Verseker dat strategiese en operasionele planne en riglyne ontwikkel/hersien word in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte (APP, MTSF ens.) en in lyn is met die regering se prioriteite en uitkomste. Bevorder die ontwikkeling van kruissektor-norme en -standaarde in ooreenstemming met die EPWP-vereistes. Monitor die implementering en nakoming van die EPWP-riglyne. Bestuur die koördinering vir die implementering van EPWP Omgewing- en Kultuursektorprogramme: Ondersteun die identifisering en beplanning van Omgewing- en Kultuursektorprogramme en -projekte. Verseker die implementering van die Omgewing- en Kultuursektormodelle in lyn met EPWP. Bestuur die toewysing van finansiële hulpbronne (voorwaardelike toelaag) vir sektorprojekte. Bevorder die bekendstelling van arbeidsintensiewe tegnologieë in die sektor. Monitor en evalueer die omggingseffek van die Expanded Public Works Programme. Bestuur die koördinering van die omgging- en kultuursektoraktiwiteite tussen die departement en tersaaklike belanghebbendes: Koördineer en ondersteun prosesse vir die vestiging van sektorgestuursstrukture vir doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit om goeie verhoudinge met belanghebbendes te handhaaf. Hou toesig oor betrokkenheid met belanghebbendes oor DPWI-strukture. Raadpleeg tersaaklike belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die ontwikkeling van sektor-strategiese raamwerke bv. strategiese planne, riglyne, opleidingsplanne vir die EPWP-implementering; Koördineer die samestelling van insette van deelnemende departemente en belanghebbendes om verslagdoening oor werksgeleenthede te verseker. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die sektor se streekskoördineerders en provinsiale implementeringsliggame. Koördineer die impakevaluering van die programme. Berei gereelde vorderingsverslae voor en Dien dit by tersaaklike belanghebbendes in. Koördineer EPWP M&E-prosedures en -prosesse van DPWI en implementerende openbare ligaamprojekte. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te nakom. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Direktoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie-reëlings. Stel al die vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in; Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Monitor die begroting en besteding vir die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umululeki: Sokuthi Isikhungo Sokuqonda Izinto Ezingcolile Nesiko
zu.summary: Isikhundla somululeki sokuphatha izinhlelo zokuqonda izinto eziyisilingqangemfundo nezokusebenza sokuqonda izinto ezingcolile kuleso sikhungo somnyango wezokwakha kanye nakwezokuthuthukiswa kokwakha, sise Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesibili ezinga le-NQF 7 njengoba kusobekwe i-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwezemfundo yezokuhlongozwa kwemvelo noma inkundla efana naleyo. Ukube kungenjalo ukuthi kumele kuhlolwe ukuthi bengachazanga ngokusobala njengoba kulindelekile kuleso simo. Ubudlule obungu-5 eminyakeni ngaphezulu kwesikhundla esiphezulu sabaphathi kuleyo ndawo. Ukwazi: Izinkomba ezihlobene nezinhlelo zokuphatha ubuchule; Izinhlelo zokubeka izindaba zomsebenzi; Umthetho ohambisanayo, izimiso nezidingo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwe-EPWP; I-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) kanye ne-Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; Ukusebenza kwahulumeni wazwelonke, wesifundaze kanye nedolobha; Umgudu we-SAQA / NQF; Ukuphathwa komthelela wezemvelo; Izinguquko phakathi kwabathwebuli; Ulwazi lobuchule bokuqonda imvelo olusebenza ngabantu abaningi; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuma nokusebenza komnyango; Izimiso nezinkinga zomnyango; Ukuba ngumholi nokubika ngobuchule obusembulu. Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha nokwenza izinqumo; Ukubekezela; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo ezinkulu; Ukuphathwa kokushintsha; Ukwakha amandla; Ukucabanga ngesahluko; Ukuphathwa okusembulu; Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo; Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; Izinhlobonhlobo zabantu; Ukumiswa kwebalazwe; Amakhono okwenza izinqumo; Amakhono okukhuthaza; Ukuphathwa kokuhlanganisa kanye namakhono wekhompyutha. Isikhathi esingakwazi ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo nangempumelelo ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Isikhathi esingakwazi ukuxhumana wonke amanqanaba, kuthathwe inxaxheba esibukweni esiphezulu. Isikhathi esingakwazi ukusebenza kodwa.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ubuchule kwezokusebenza nezixhumanisi eziseduzane ezisiza ekubumbeni we-EPWP kuleso sikhungu sokuqonda izinto ezingcolile kanye nemicu yezinkomba eziseduzane- : Yenza ucwaningo ukuthuthukisa izimiso zokusebenza (izikeli, izixhumanisi, izinhlelo zokuqonda ukuzikhuthaza, nokunye). Phathana nayebo abaseduzane ukuthola abantu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphatha ubuchule nezokusebenza eziseduzane zisungulwa/ zihlolwe ngokuhambisana nezimiso (APP, MTSF nokunye) futhi zihambisana nezinhloso zohulumene. Khuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yemikhakha eminingi eseduze kanye nezimiso ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-EPWP. Qapha ukuphathwa nokuhambisana nezixhumanisi ze-EPWP. Qondisa ukubumba ukuphatwa kokwenzwa kwe-EPWP kuleso sikhungu sokuthi kutholakale izinto ezingcolile kanye namabhuku ezinkomba- : Sekela ukubona nokubeka izinkomba zesikhungu sokuthi kutholakale izinto ezingolile kanye namabhuku ezinkomba kanye namaphulo. Qinisekisa ukuphatwa kwezimo zokuqonda izinto ezingcolile kanye namabhuku ngokuhambisana ne-EPWP. Qondisa ukwaba imali (imali enikezwe ngesiko) kumaphulo abalingiswa. Khuthaza ukwaziswa kobuchule bokusebenza ngabantu abaningi kuleso sikhungu. Qapha futhi uhlole umthelela wemvelo we-Expanded Public Works Programme. Qondisa ukubumba kwezinto ezihlobene nesikhungu sokuthi kutholakale izinto ezingcolile kanye nemikhakha yamasiko phakathi komnyango kanye nabo abaseduzane- : Bumba futhi usekele izinkomba zokumiswa kwezinkatha zokubusa kwesikhungu ukuze kwenzeke ngokuphumelelayo futhi kugcinwe ubuhlobo obuhle nabo abaseduzane. Qapha ukuxhumana nabo abaseduzane ngohlelo lwe-DPWI. Phathana nayebo abaseduzane ngokuthuthukiswa kwezimiso zobuchule zesikhungu njengoba kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuphatha, izixhumanisi, izinhlelo zokuqonda ukuzikhuthaza ze-EPWP; Qondisa ukuqoqa abantu kumikhakha ebanjwayo kanye nayebo abaseduzane ukuze kubikwe ngamathuba omsebenzi. Nikela inkondlo kubahlanganisi bakhulu besikhungu nagemu labo abaphatha ephumela kubuchwepheshe. Qondisa ukuqashwa komthelela wezinkomba. Lungiselela futhi uhambise ngokuvamile imibiko yentuthuko kuyebo abaseduzane. Qondisa izinqubo ze-EPWP M&E kanye nezinkomba ze-DPWI nokuphatwa kwemibiko yomphakathi. Qondisa ibhodi-: Misela futhi ugcine izinqubo zangaphakathi ezifanele kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ukugcwaliseza izithembiso. Thuthukisa futhi uphathe uhlelo lokusebenza lebhodi ulayeke ngokuthi kwenzeke ngokuthanda. Phatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Misela, usebenzise futhi ugcine izinhlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Hlanganisa futhi uhambise zonke izibalo ezingezimfihlo; Ukulawula khona ukulunga kwenza ngabasebenzi. Qapha imali elandelayo kanye nokushiswa kwebhodi.

xh.title: Umphathi: Candu lokuQonda Nobuntlalo
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi sokulawula iindlela ezicwangcisiweyo nezokuqhuba kwi Candu lokuQonda Nobuntlalo ngaphakathi kwi Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, esekelwe ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezincinane kwi NQF level 7 njengoko kwamkelwa yi South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwi Environmental Sciences okanye kwelinye igatya lokufunda. A minimum 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the relevant field. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo zolawulo ezicwangcisiweyo; Iinkqubo zokuqumba urhwebo; Umthetho ofanelekileyo, amanqanaba namazinga ahambelana nolawulo lwe EPWP; Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) kunye ne Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act; Ukusebenza kkarhulumente kazwelonke, kwiphondo nasekuhlaleni; Ulwakhiwo lwe SAQA / NQF; Ulawulo Lomphumo woQhinga; Iintshukumo zabo somnxhasi; Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bobunto bokusebenza ngamandla abantu abaninzi; Ulawulo lweemali; Ukwakheka nokusebenza kwe Department; Amanqanaba nomthetho we Department; Ukulawula nobuqedileyo bokubhala iingxelo. Amakhono: Amakhono okulawula nokwenza izigqibo; Ubuciko bokulinganisa; Ulawulo lweeprojekthi namaphulo; Ulawulo lotshintsho; Ukwakhiwa kwamandla; Okuqondakalayo; Ulawulo olucwangcisiweyo; Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo; Ulawulo loludano; Iintshukumo zoBuntu; Ulungiselelweni kolwakhiwo lwemigaqo; Amakhono okwenza izigqibo; Amakhono okukhuthaza; Ulawulo lokudibanisa kunye namakhono eKhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokusebenzayo nangexesha elongezeleleyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono lokunxibelelana kumanqanaba onke, nokuthatha inxaxheba kwinqanaba le-executive. Ikhono lokusebenza nokuzimela.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso lweendlela ezicwangcisiweyo nezokuqhuba nemigaqo yokulungelelanisa i EPWP kumaphulo e Candu lokuQonda Nobuntlalo- : Yenza uphando ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo (iimodeli, imigaqo, iindlela zokuqeqesha, njl). Phengamna nabathathi-nxaxheba abahambelanayo ngenjongo yokufumana izimvo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela ezicwangcisiweyo nezokuqhuba nemigaqo ziyaphuhuliswa/ ziyahlaziywa ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo (APP, MTSF njl) ezihambelana neenkqho zohambo karhulumente nempumelelo. Khuthaza uphuhliso lwamanqanaba namazinga phakathi kwamasebe ahambelana neemfuno ze EPWP. Qonda ukusebenza nokuhambelana kwemigaqo ye EPWP. Lawula ulungelelaniso lokuphuhliswa kwe EPWP Environment and Culture sector programmes-: Sekela ukumanywa nokucwangciswa kwamaphulo namaprojekthi e Candu lokuQonda Nobuntlalo. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kwamamodeli e Candu lokuQonda Nobuntlalo ngokwe EPWP. Lawula ukwabiwa kweemali zemali (conditional grant) zeprojekthi zamasebe. Khuthaza ukufakwa kobuchwepheshe obusebenzisa amandla abantu abaninzi kwisebe. Qonda kwaye ulinge umphumo woqhingela wenkqubo ye Expanded Public Works Programme. Lawula ulungelelaniso lweentshukumo zecandu lokuQonda nobuntlalo phakathi kwe Department nabathathi-nxaxheba abahambelanayo-: Lungelanisa kwaye uxamkele iinkqubo zokuqulunqa iindidi zolawulo zecandu ukwenza ukuba lusebenza kakuhle neentlywin, njengoko kwakhiwe ukuba kuqhubeke ubuhlobo obuhle nabathathi-nxaxheba. Qhathamisa unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba kumagumbi e DPWI. Phengamna nabathathi-nxaxheba abahambelanayo ngokuphathelene nokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo zecandu i.e ezicwangcisiweyo, imigaqo, iindwendwe zokuqeqesha ukuba kuqhutywe i EPWP; Lungelanisa ukuqokelela iimvo kwii departments ezithatha inxaxheba nakubathathi-nxaxheba ukwenza izingxelo ngamathuba abasebenzi. Nika inkxaso kubaluleli bamaphando asebe kumazwe emimandla namazwimbeko phakathi kweekarhulumente ekuphuhlisweni kwayo. Lungelanisa ulwazi lokulinganisa umphumo wamaphulo. Lungelelanisa kwaye ufake izinxibelelwano ezizezisithixo ngenkqubo ekunyukelaayo kubathathi-nxaxheba ngemigaqo eNgento. Lungelanisa iinkqubo namagumbi okuQonda nokuLinganisa kwe EPWP kwi DPWI kwaye uphuhle amaphulo eziko karhulumente. Lawula iNtaba-: Misela kwaye ulondoloze ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwangaphakathi neendidi zoxinzelelo nemiqathango yokuzalisekisa iimfuno zokusebenza. Phuhlisa kwaye ulawule uculo lokusebenza kwe Directorate kwaye wenze ingxelo ngemivuyo njengoko kufuneka. Lawula ukusebenza nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi. Misela, ukuyisebenzisa, kwaye ulondoloze okulungelelanisiweyo nokuhamba kakuhle kweenkqubo zolungelelwaniso. Yila kwaye ufake zonke iingxelo zolawulo ezifunekayo; Lawulo lomgangatho womsebenzi onikwe ngabasebenzi. Qonda ibhajeti neentslawulo ze Directorate.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Industry Research
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to research and analyse financial, economic and property trends, prepare reports and calculate property charges at the DPWI Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Built Environment, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent qualification. Appropriate work experience in a financial, data analytics, economic/property research environment. Knowledge: Competence in Microsoft Office applications, high competence in MS Excel (advanced), competence in research and report compilation, Knowledge and understanding of various data analytics software, understanding of analytical tool (or model) development, Knowledgeable in Financial or investment management principles, strong understanding of Financial Mathematics principles, good project and people management skills. Personal Attributes: Excellent interpersonal, communication and analytical skills, ability and willingness to work under pressure, able to work independently, dedicated, diligent and focused, passionate about knowledge and research, good presentation skills, innovative thinking, must be able to take initiative, commitment to excellence in every aspect of work.
jobs.duties: Research and analyse financial, economic, social and other trends and topics independently, perform data analysis and documentation of insights, prepare business reports, calculate property rent/user charges, work closely with stakeholders with different backgrounds to validate analyses and output, provide technical assistance to other units within the business, develop analytical tools (models and dashboards) and investment related policies.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Nywerheidsnavorsing
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om finansiële, ekonomiese en eiendomstendense te ondersoek en te ontleed, verslae voor te berei en eiendomsheffings by die DPWI-hoofkantoor in Pretoria te bereken.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driedejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Bou-omgewing, Finansies, Ekonomie, Wiskunde, Statistiek of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Toepaslike werkervaring in 'n finansiële, data-ontledings-, ekonomiese- of eiendomsnavorsingsomgewing. Kennis: Bevoegdheid in Microsoft Office-toepassings, hoë bevoegdheid in MS Excel (gevorderd), bevoegdheid in navorsing en verslagsamestelling, kennis en begrip van verskeie data-ontledingsagteware, begrip van die ontwikkeling van analitiese instrumente (of modelle), goed ingelig oor finansiële of beleggingsbestuursbeginsels, sterk begrip van finansiële wiskundebeginsels, goeie projek- en mensebestuursvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Uitstekende interpersoonlike, kommunikasie- en analitiese vaardighede, vermoë en bereidwilligheid om onder druk te werk, in staat om onafhanklik te werk, toegewyd, ywerig en gefokus, passievol oor kennis en navorsing, goeie aanbiedingsvaardighede, inniewe denke, moet in staat wees om inisiatief te neem, toewyding tot uitmuntendheid in elke aspek van die werk.
af.duties: Ondersoek en ontleed onafhanklik finansiële, ekonomiese, sosiale en ander tendense en onderwerpe, voer data-ontleding en dokumentasie van insigte uit, berei besigheidsverslae voor, bereken eiendomshuur/bruikersheffings, werk nou met belanghebbendes met verskillende agtergronde saam om ontledings en uitsette te valider, verskaf tegniese bystand aan ander eenhede binne die besigheid, ontwikkel analitiese instrumente (modelle en dashboards) en beleggingsverwante beleide.

zu.title: Umceli-Mandla: Ucwaningo Lohwebo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umceli-mandla ocwaninga futhi ahlaziye izinkomba zezimali, ezomnotho n nezempahla, alungise imibiko futhi abale izimali ezibhekene nempahla e-Head Office ye-DPWI e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwesikhathi esingafuni sokufunda iminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / i-National Diploma kumasimu okwakhiwo, izimali, ezomnotho, izibalo, izibalo ezingamaphesente noma iziqu ezinga lelo. Ukwaziswa ngomsebenzi ohambisana nezimali, ukuhlaziya idatha, nendawo yocwaningo lwezomnotho noma ezempahla. Ulwazi: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuqasha ze-Microsoft Office, ukukwazi okuphezulu ukusebenzisa i-MS Excel (izinga eliphezulu), ukukwazi ucwaningo nokuqoqa imibiko, ulwazi nokuqonda izinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokuhlaziya idatha, ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwamathuluzi ahlaziwayo (noma amamodeli), ukwazi izimiso zoku lawula izimali noma utshalo-mali, ukuqonda okujulile izimiso ze-Financial Mathematics, amakhono amahle okulawula imiklamo nabantu. Izimpawo zomuntu: Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana nokuxoxa nokuhlaziya, ikhono nokuthandi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngabanye, ukuzinikezela, ukuzifunda ngokucophelela nokugqamisa, ukuthanda ulwazi nophando, amakhono amahle okubukiswa, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha, makakwazi ukuthatha inhlakanipho, ukuzinikezela ekuhambeni kuhle kuyo yonke imisebenzi.
zu.duties: Cwaninga ukuze uhlaziye izinkomba nezihloko ngokuzimela mayelana nezimali, ezomnotho, emphakathini nakwezinye, enze ukuhlaziya idatha ubhale futhi ubuke izincazelo, ulungise imibiko yomhlalakuhle, ubale ukuqashwa komhlalakuhle noma izimali ezibhekene nempahla, usebenze kafushane nabahlanganyeli bemitombo eyahlukene ukuze uqinise izincazelo nemiphumela, unikeze lusizo lwezobuciko eminye imikhakha engaphakathi komkhakha, uthuthukise amathuluzi ahlaziwayo (amamodeli namadashibhodi) kanye namapholisi ahlobene notshalo-mali.

xh.title: Umcedisi weNkundla: Uphononongo lweNkonzo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMcedisi weNkundla ukwenza uphononongo nchananga kunye nokuhlalutywa kwamava emali, oqoqosho kunye nempahla, ukulungiselela iingxelo nokubala iindleko zempahla kwiNtloko yeSebe le-DPWI ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwamashumi amathathu esikolo samabanga aphezulu (iNqanaba le-NQF 06) / iDiploma yoMbazwe kwaseKwimpahla eYakhiweyo, eMali, oQoqosho, eMathematika, eZibalo okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Amava afanelekileyo omsebenzi kwindawo yophando lwemali, uhlalutyo lwedata, oqoqosho/impahla. Ulwazi: Ukuziphatha kakuhle kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office, ukuziphatha kakuhle kakhulu kwi-MS Excel (elingana nabanzi), ukuziphatha kakuhle kuphononongo nokuqokelela iingxelo, ulwazi nokuqonda ngezixhobo ezahlukeneyo zohlalutyo lwedata, ukuqonda izimbovo zohlalutyo (okanye iimodeli), ukwazi ngezenzo zoLawulo lweMali okanye tshajamntu, ukuqonda ngamandla ngeMathematika yeMali, amakhono amabaluleke kakhulu ekulawulen iiprojekthi nabantu. Iimpawu zobuntu: Amakhono aphambili onxibelelwano, kwindalo nakwohlalutyo, ikhono nentembeko yokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo, ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, ukuzinikela, ukuzinza njalo ukuzolisa nangaliphi na icala lomsebenzi, ithamsanqa nge-ncwadi nemizekelo eyahlukeneyo kwindawo yokusebenza.
xh.duties: Zidla ngokuzimeleyo ukuphonononga nokuhlalutywa kwamava emali, oqoqosho, nezentsapho nakwezinye iindaba; yenza uhlalutyo lwedata uze uphuhlise iingxelo; lungiselela iingxelo zeentshishwe; bala i-rhent/ iindleko zempahla; sebenza ngokusondeleyo nabantu abambini ngokubakho kwemvelaphi ezahlukileyo ukuqinisekisa uhlalutyo neziphumo; yedlulisele lusizo ngamakhono eminye imikhakha ngaphakathi kweshishini; phuhlise izixhobo zohlalutyo (iimodeli namadashibhodi) neenkqubo ezimalunga netshajamntu.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: Architectural Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage state accommodation solutions and architectural development plans at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Bachelor of Architectural Studies at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification architectural services experience in the built environment. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of the PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; Programme & Project Management; Client orientation & Customer focus; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project and MS Outlook), report-writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self-Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Manage state accommodation solutions within the existing development set- up to ensure integration. Ensure verification and Interpretation of Client departments’ needs, preferences, and space norms. Prepare balanced, proper, efficient and effective development plans and development frameworks compliant with legislative requirements, town planning schemes and governmental corporate image and customs. Preparation of drawings, reports and presentations. Prepare guidelines and objectives in documentation format for further detailed design of specific sites within precincts. Function as a team member and interact with appointed experts, local authorities, clients and management. Effectively manage the spatial programme and all interdependent and inter-reliant projects and stakeholders. Manage the programme resources and budget requirements. Effectively develop and manage the programme implementation framework as well as communication thereof. Participate in the administration and performance monitoring of Total Facilities Management (TFM) contracts, ensuring architectural service delivery, spatial standards and space norms are met by service providers. Conduct monthly site inspections to monitor project progress, verify work executed against payment claims, and report on quality and programme compliance. Promote sustainable practices aligned with Green Building standards and Occupational Health & Safety compliance. Conduct and contribute to Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) of state-owned buildings and precincts from an architectural and spatial planning perspective, and compile supporting condition assessment reports. Translate FCA findings into refurbishment, upgrade and precinct redevelopment proposals, prioritising interventions according to condition ratings, risk and available budget. Prepare Project Execution Plans (PEPs), outlining project scope, budget, procurement strategy, programme and resourcing for approved facilities management projects.

af.title: Beheer Werke Bestuurder: Argitektoniese Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur staatakkommodasie-oplossings en argitektoniese ontwikkelingsplanne by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Bachelor of Architectural Studies op NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken. Toepaslike drie jaar se na-kwalifikasie argitektoniese dienste-ervaring in die beboude omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act; kennis van die PFMA en National Building Regulations. Kennis van staatsaankoopstelsels in die beboude omgewing; Program- en Projekbestuur; Kliëntgerigtheid en Kliëntfokus; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies verbandhoudend met beste praktyke binne geïntegreerde Fasiliteitsbestuur. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management Raamwerk en staatsbegrotingsprosedure-vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project en MS Outlook), verslagdoeningsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, projekbestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, verstaanbaar, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, hardwerkend en analitiese dink. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd, en Kreatief.
af.duties: Bestuur staatakkommodasie-oplossings binne die bestaande ontwikkelingsopset om integrasie te verseker. Verseker verifikasie en interpretasie van kliëntdepartemente se behoeftes, voorkeure, en ruimtenorme. Berei gebalanseerde, behoorlike, doeltreffende en effektiewe ontwikkelingsplanne en ontwikkelingsraamwerke voor wat voldoen aan wetgewende vereistes, stadsbeplanningskemas en staatskorporatiewe beeld en gebruike. Voorbereiding van tekeninge, verslae en aanbiedings. Berei riglyne en doelwitte in dokumentformaat voor vir verdere gedetailleerde ontwerp van spesifieke terreine binne presinte. Funksioneer as 'n tintelid en kommunikeer met aangestelde kundiges, plaaslike owerhede, kliënte en bestuur. Bestuur effektief die ruimtelike program en alle interafhanklike en interafhanklike projekte en belanghebbendes. Bestuur die programhulpbronne en begrotingsvereistes. Ontwikkel en bestuur effektief die programimplementeringsraamwerk asook kommunikasie daarvan. Neem deel aan die administrasie en prestasie-monitering van Total Facilities Management (TFM) kontrakte, en verseker dat argitektoniese dienslewering, ruimtelike standaarde en ruimtenorme deur diensverskaffers nagekom word. Voer maandelikse terreininspeksies uit om projekvordering te moniteer, uitgevoerde werk teen betalingseise te verifieer, en oor gehalte en programnakoming te rapporteer. Bevorder volhoubare praktyke wat in lyn is met Green Building-standaarde en Occupational Health & Safety-nakoming. Voer fasiliteittoestandassesserings (FCA's) van staatgeboue en presinte uit vanuit 'n argitektoniese en ruimtelike beplanningsperspektief, en dra by tot die opstel daarvan, en stel ondersteunende toestandassesseringsverslae op. Vertaal FCA-bevindings in voorstelle vir opknapping, opgradering en presintherontwikkeling, en prioritiseer ingrype volgens toestandgraderings, risiko en beskikbare begroting. Berei Projekuitvoeringsplanne (PEP's) voor, wat projekomvang, begroting, aanbestedingstrategie, program en hulpbronvoorsiening vir goedgekeurde fasiliteitsbestuursprojekte uitlyn.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinsiza Zokwakha: Izinkonzo Zezokwakha
zu.summary: Phatha izixazululo zokuhlolwa kwesikhungo sikahulumani nezinhlelo zentuthuko yezokwakha eNdiweni YezokuSebenza Kahulumani Nezokwakha Ezingeni Eliphezulu ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Udingo elingancishanga ngqo i-Bachelor of Architectural Studies ezingeni le-NQF 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Uqeqesho olufanele okungenamva kweminyaka emithathu lokusebenza izinkonzo zezokwakha esigabeni sokwakhiwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi nge-PFMA Nemithetho YesiNzuzo Yokwakha Kazwelonke. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokuthengwa kwezinto kahulumani esigabeni sokwakhiwa; ilwelolo lezinhlelo namaphrojekthi; ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bamagathi abalulekile ahlobene nokwenza okuhle kakhulu ngaphakathi kokuPhathwa Kwesikhungo Esihlanganisiwe. Ulwazi lohlelo lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuhlinzeka kanye nezindlela zesabelo somphakathi kahulumani. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuhlela nokuqamba, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono obuholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okwenza kube lula, amakhono okuxhumana abasebenzayo. Ukube nomonde, ukuqonda, ukuthembeka, ukuzethemba, ukuba nobusobo, ukusebenza kanzima nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezulu, ukuzigqugquzela, nokuba nobusobo.
zu.duties: Phatha izixazululo zesikhungo sikahulumani ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezokuthuthukisa ekuvamile ukuqinisekisa ukuhlangana. Qinisekisa ukuhlola nokuhumusha izidingo, izintandokazi kanye nemigomo yesikhala sezinye izigaba zabathengi. Lungiselela izinhlelo zentuthuko ezilinganiswe kahle, ezifanele, ezisebenza ngempumelelo nangokukhanya ezingavumelanisi nomthetho, izinhlela zokuhlela idolobha nomfanekiso wocwece wezinhlangano kahulumani kanye namasiko. Ukulungiselela izidwebo, imibiko nezethula. Lungiselela imihlahla nemigomo esixhumanisini ukuya esibakwardeni esidingidwe ngasemuva kwezindawo ezithize ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezimaphakathi. Sebenza njengelungu lenhlanganisela uze uxhumane nabangane abaqashiweyo, izigaba zendawo, abathengi kanye nobuphathi. Phatha ngokusebenza uhlelo lokwesikhala kanye naphakathi kwamaphrojekthi ongajamelana noma ongalawula kanye nabanikelo bokwesekwa. Phatha izinsiza zohlelo nezidingo zesabelo. Hlaba ngokusebenza ukuqamba kanye nokuphatha imigomo yokuphoqa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuxhumana kwayo. Thatha inhlanga ekuphathweni nasekubukweni kokusebenza emibhalweni yokuphathwa kwamandla akho, ukuze uqiniseke ukulethwa kwezinkonzo zezokwakha, amazinga esikhala nemigomo yesikhala abahlinzeki bayafeza. Yenza okubukwayo okuzinyanga zonke izindawo zokusebenza ubuke ukubaqhqa kohlelo, qinisekisa ukwenziwa komsebenzi ngokumelene nezimangalo zokukhokha, uphinde ubike ngomthwalo nezokuzinza kohlelo. Khuthaza izindlela ezigcina isimo sendawo ezihambisana namazinga ezakhiwo aluhlaza kanye nokuzinza ngokomthetho we-Occupational Health & Safety. Yenza futhi useke ekuHlolweni kwezimo Zesikhungo (FCAs) sezakhiwo ezingowakahulumani nasezindawweni ezimaphakathi ngokubuka ukwakha ukuhlela isikhala, uphinde ulungiselele imibiko yesimo esisekayo. Humusha izimangalo ze-FCA kube iziphakamiso zokuqasha kabusha, ukuthuthukisa futhi wakhe kabusha isikhathi esithize, uhlele izinhlayiya ngokubuka ukulinganiswa kwezimo, ubungozi kanye nesabelo esitholakalayo. Lungiselela iNcwadi Yohlelo Lokuqamba Amaphrojekthi (PEPs), echasisa ibalazwe lomthamo wephrojekthi, isabelo, inqubo yokuthenga, uhlelo nezinsiza zamaphrojekthi okugunyazwe wezokuphathwa kwesikhungo.

xh.title: Umphathi Wolawulo: Iinkonzo Zezakhiwo
xh.summary: Lawula izisombululo zendlaliso yelizwe kunye nezicwangciso zophuhliso lwezakhiwo kwiNtloko yeSebe lezaSebe zoLwazi LwemiSebenzi yoLwazi nasePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isixa esingaphantsi kwe-Bachelor of Architectural Studies kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweenkonzo zezakhiwo emva kweminyaka emi-3 yokusebenza kwimeko yokuqatshelwa kwendalo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi nge-PFMA kunye ne-National Building Regulations. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokuqeshwa kolwazi koluntu kwimeko yokuqatshelwa kwendalo; Ulawulo loNgeniso lweProgyramu & lweProjekthi; ujoliswe kumthengi nokuqwalasela ixabiso lomthengi; ulwazi lobuchwephethile bemisebenzi ephambili edibana nenkqubo esimhle kwindlela eyaholweneyo yoLawulo lwezNdaliso ezidityaniswe kunye. Ulwazi lweSakhelo soLawulo loQhingelo lweSiseko kunye neendleba zebegethi kaRhulumente. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project kunye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono ebhala iingxelo, ukuqamba kunye nokuhlela, amakhono olawulo lweprojekthi, amakhono okuba ngumlawuli, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono okuncedisa, amakhono othetho olusebenzayo. Ukuba nomonde, ukuqonda, ukuthembeka, ukusembeka, ukuba yimveli, ukusebenza ngamandla nokuqonda ngokuhlalutya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuzimisela, nokuba nolwalamano olutsha.
xh.duties: Lawula izisombululo zendlaliso yelizwe ngaphakathi kokuqatshelwa kolandelelwano ekujoliswe kukuqinisekisa ukudityaniswa. Qinisekisa ukuqinisekiswa kunye nokuçatshula iimfuno, iimvakalelo, kunye neendlela zesithuba kwiimimandla zobathengi. Lungiselela izicwangciso zophuhliso ezilinganeyo, ezifanelekileyo, ezisebenzayo kwaye zisebenza ngokukhawuleza kunye neesakhelo zophuhliso ezihambelana neemfuno zemithetho, iindaba zocwangciso lwamaphondo kunye nembono yeshishini karhulumente namasiko. Ulungiselelo lwezobuciko bendalo, iingxelo kunye nezibheno. Lungiselela iindlela ezilawulayo nemiqobo kwifomathi yoxwebhu yoncedo kolawulo oluqhubekayo lokuzoba iindawo ezithile ngaphakathi kwamaphondo. Yiba lilungu leqela uze uxhume nabachwephesha abakhethiweyo, oorhulumente basekuhlaleni, abathengi nalawulo. Lawula ngokusebenzayo iiprogyramu zesithuba kunye nazo zonke iiprojekthi kunye nabathobi abathembekileyo. Lawula oovelo beprojekthi kunye neemfuno zebegethi yeprogyramu. Phuhlisa ulawule ngokusebenzayo isakhelo sokuqhuba iiprogyramu kunye nokuvelisa ulwazi ngayo. Ngena kwindleba yokulawula kwaye ulandelwe inkqubo yamakhono ama-Total Facilities Management (TFM), uqinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zezakhiwo, iindlela zesithuba nezilinganiso zesithuba ziyafezwa ngabo baphethe iinkonzo. Yenza iindwendwe zendawo nyanga zonke ukuze ulawule inkqubela yeprojekthi, uqinisekise umsebenzi ozenziweyo ochaseneyo neemfuno zentlawulo, uze uxele ngohlelo lokuthobela iimfuno neenkqubo. Khuthaza iindlela ezinokuhlala ixesha elide ezihambelana nezinga lwe-Green Building kunye nokuziphendula nge-Occupational Health & Safety. Yaza uncedise ekwenzeni iinkqubo zokuhlolwa kweemeko zezakhiwo (FCAs) kumanxweme olawulwa ngurhulumente kwimbono yezakhiwo nendlela yocwangciso lwezithuba, uze udibanise iingxelo ezixhasa iinkqubo zokuhlolwa. Guqula iziphumo ze-FCA kube zizipakamiso zokutsha, ukuphucula nokuqaliswa kwamaphondo kwakhona, kwaye udibanise iziphakamiso ngeendlela ngokugqitha amaxabiso weziko, amadingo nobungenge begethi ekhoyo. Lungiselela iinkqubo zoLawulo lokuQhutywa kwiProgyramu (PEPs), uchaze ummandla weprojekthi, ibegethi, indlela yentlawulo, iinkqubo nezibonelelo kwiiprojekthi zolawulo lwendaliso ezamkelwe.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: Civil/structural Engineering
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage technical facilities management activities and infrastructure maintenance for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure at Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of BSc/B.Eng./B.Tech in Civil/Structural Engineering at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification experience in civil or structural engineering in building services. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of the PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, and MS Outlook), report-writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem-solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self-Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Assess and report on the condition of the infrastructure. Technical evaluation of professional service providers’ and contractors’ bids. Solely account for planning, co-coordinating and managing all technical facilities management activities/projects. Oversee and ensure the maintenance of building assets from a structural engineering point of view. Oversee civil and structural infrastructure and ensure that they are efficiently, financially and optimally maintained. Supervise the service providers to deliver the preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance program for the departmental infrastructure. Efficiently attend to all maintenance requests and infrastructure facility management in line with operational standards and ensure the ongoing performance and reliability of the assets. Conduct quality control over the work of the consultant and the contractor during the execution phase of the project. Assist project managers in resolving technical disputes arising at different stages of the project. Review and audit final professional civil/structural engineering accounts and construction contract final accounts. Accept responsibility for the development, implementation, review and regular updating of standardised civil engineering practice manuals for the Department. Participate in the administration and performance monitoring of Total Facilities Management (TFM) contracts relating to civil and structural infrastructure, including service level agreement (SLA) compliance and contractor performance evaluation. Conduct monthly site inspections to monitor project progress, verify work executed against payment claims, and report on quality and programme compliance. Conduct detailed Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) of civil and structural infrastructure and compile condition assessment reports, including remedial cost estimates and prioritised intervention plans.
jobs.applications: Applications for the position of Control Works Manager: Civil/Structural Engineering Services must be emailed to: Recruitment26-92@dpw.gov.za

Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. af.title: Bestuurder Beheerwerke: Siviele/Struktuuringenieurswese
af.summary: Bestuur tegniese fasiliteitsbestuursaktiwiteite en infrastruktuuronderhoud vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure by Hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van BSc/B.Eng./B.Tech in Siviele/Struktuuringenieurswese op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA. Toepaslike drie jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in siviele of struktuuringenieurswese in geboudienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act; kennis van die PFMA en National Building Regulations. Kennis van regeringsverkrygingstelsels in die geboude-omgewing; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies verbonde aan beste praktyk binne geïntegreerde fasiliteitsbestuur. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management-raamwerk en regeringsbegrotingsprosedurevaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project en MS Outlook), verslagdoeningsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, projekbestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, verstaend, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, ywerig en analitiese denke. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd en skeppend.
af.duties: Evalueer en verslag oor die toestand van die infrastruktuur. Tegniese evaluering van die bieë van professionele diensverskaffers en kontraktors. Dra alleenlik verantwoordelikheid vir die beplanning, koördinering en bestuur van alle tegniese fasiliteitsbestuursaktiwiteite/projekte. Hou toesig oor en verseker die onderhoud van gebou-bates vanuit 'n struktuuringenieurswese-oogpunt. Hou toesig oor siviele en strukturele infrastruktuur en verseker dat dit doeltreffend, finansieel en optimaal onderhou word. Oesien die diensverskaffers om die voorkomende onderhouds- en korrigerende onderhoudsprogram vir die departementele infrastruktuur te lewer. Doeltreffend bywoon alle onderhoudsversoeke en infrastruktuurfasiliteitsbestuur in ooreenstemming met operasionele standaarde en verseker die deurlopende prestasie en betroubaarheid van die bates. Voer gehaltebeheer uit oor die werk van die konsultant en die kontraktor tydens die uitvoeringsfase van die projek. Bystand verleen aan projekbestuurders om tegniese geskille wat op verskillende stadiums van die projek ontstaan, op te los. Hersien en oudit finale professionele siviele/struktuuringenieurswese-rekenings en konstruksiekontrak-eindrekenings. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening en gereelde bywerking van gestandaardiseerde siviele ingenieurswese-praktykhandleidings vir die departement. Neem deel aan die administrasie en prestasiemonitering van Total Facilities Management (TFM)-kontrakte wat verband hou met siviele en strukturele infrastruktuur, insluitend diensvlakooreenkoms (SLA)-nakoming en kontraktorprestasie-evaluering. Voer maandelikse terreininspeksies uit om projekvoortgang te monitor, uitgevoerde werk teen betalings-eise te verifieer en oor gehalte- en programnakoming te rapporteer. Voer gedetailleerde Facility Condition Assessments (FCA's) van siviele en strukturele infrastruktuur uit en stel toestandevalueringsverslae op, insluitend herstelkoste-skattings en geprioriseerde ingrypingsplanne.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokulawula: Inzululwazi Yezenzakalo/Ezakhiwo
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yokuqashwa kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi eyakhayo ngaphansi koMnyango WezeMisebenzi Kazwelonke Nezokwakhiwa eNqolobane Elikhulu ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane eqingethe i-BSc/B.Eng./B.Tech kwiNzululwazi Yezenzakalo/Ezakhiwo ezingeni le-NQF level 7 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Isiphepho seminyaka emithathu sokusebenza ngemva kokuthola iziqu kwinzululwazi yezakhiwo noma izenzo zokwakhiwa ezinkundleni zokwakhiwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ngeMthetho Wokuqinisekisa Ugogo Nezempilo Nokuphila; ukwazi nge-PFMA Nezimiso Zokwakha Kazwelonke. Ukwazi ngezinhlelo zokuthenga kahulumeni kwindawo yokwakhiwa; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe mayelana nemisebenzi ebalulekile ehlobene nezindlela ezinhle zokwenza ngaphakathi kokuqashwa kwemisebenzi okuhlanganisiwe. Ukwazi nokuqonda Uhlelo Lokuqashwa Kwezinsiza kanye Namanyathelo Ahibe Isha alokahulumeni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono e-ukubhala imibiko, ukucubungula futhi uhlele, amakhono okuphatha amaphulo, amakhono okuba ngumholi, e-ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukumematheka, namakhono okuxhumana ngokusebenza. Ukuba nomothetha, ukuqonda, ethembekile, othembekayo, onesiqhenga, ozimiselayo, futhi ongumdla wokuhlaziya. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinsila, ukuzikhuthaza, futhi ongendlela yokuba khona okusha.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi ube imibiko ngokuwohloka kwemisebenzi eyakhayo. Ukulinganisa ngobuchwepheshe izinhlelo zezinsiza zamakhono ezenza imisebenzi nabakhi bezinsiza. Ukwethelela ngokwedlule ibeke ngaphandle kwakho ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha yonke imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ephathelene nokulawulwa kwemisebenzi/ amaphulo. Bheka phezulu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zamaphulo zigcinwa ngokuholela ekuqondweni kwenzululwazi yezakhiwo. Bheka izakhiwo ezingaphandle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zigcinwa ngokusebenza kahle, ngokwezimali futhi ngokuzimela. Qondisa izinsiza zamakhono ukuthi zethule uhlelo lokuvimbela nokulungisa ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zemisebenzi engaphandle komnyango. Sebenzisa ngokulingene wonke amasabelo okugcinwa futhi ukulawulwa kwemisebenzi yamaphulo ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokusebenza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kuhamba kahle futhi kuthembekile okuqashwayo. Yenza okuhle lokuhlola umsebenzi wezinkampani ezibusayo kanye nabakhi bezinsiza ngesikhathi kusetshenziswa iphulo. Siza abaphathi bezinhlelo ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibangelwa ubuchwepheshe ezibakho eminyakeni yonke yephulo. Hlaziya futhi uhlole imali yokugcina yamakhono obuchwepheshe bezinsiza namasabelo okugcina ohlelweni lwe-zenzululwazi yezakhiwe/ezakhiwo. Yamukela imithwalo yokuba ngaphandle kwakho ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, ukuhlaziya futhi ngokuvamile ukubuyisela imiqulu yeziqu mayelana nenhlalo yobuchwepheshe bezinsiza zezenhlalo yemisebenzi esemthethweni ngokusemthethweni. Thatha inhlazio ekuphathweni kanye nokulandelwa kwekhono leqasho eliphelele emsebenzini (TFM) eliphathelene nezinsiza ezingaphandle namaphilo azenzakalayo, okubandakanya ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ngezinkonzo (SLA) kanye nokugxila ekubukweni kwesikhono sabakhi bezinsiza. Hlola izindawo zokwakhiwa njalo ngenyanga ukuze ubuke ukuthi iphulo lihamba kanjani, uqinisekise imisebenzi ezenziwe ngokohlelo, futhi ulandele imali oyifunile, kanye nokubika ngokuhamba kahle kwekhono nokuhambisana kohlelo. Yenza ukuhlola izindawo ezitholakala ngokuzimela kokungasebi kahle kwemisebenzi yokwakhiwa engaphandle namaphilo azenzakalayo, uphathe imibiko yokuhlola ukusebenza, okubandakanya ukulinganisa imali elungisayo namaphulo ahleliwe ahlelwe ngokwebaluleko.

xh.title: Umphathi Wolawulo lweMisebenzi: Injinieri yokuLwa/ezakhiwayo
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yokulawula iziseko zokoluleko kwaye zigcinwe kwakunye nokuqinisekiswa kokulondolozwa koluntu kwesebe lezoBasebenzo boluntu nolwakhiwo eNtlanganisini ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isixa esingaphantsi seBSc/B.Eng./B.Tech kwiNjinieri yokuLwa/ezakhiwayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengoko kusetyenziswa yi-SAQA. Isiphumi esifanelekileyo seenyanga zesithathu zemiyalezo yokugqibela kwinjinieri yokuLwa okanye ezakhiwayo kwiinkonzo zokwakha. Ilayiseni yomqhubi egqityiweyo. Ukuqonda koMthetho woKhuseleko lwezeMisebenzi nakuNcedo lweMpilo; ukuqonda kwe-PFMA nakwiMigaqo yoLwakhiwo lweSizwe. Ukuqonda kweNkqubo zoLawulo zokuThenga kweeKhomishani zikaRhulumente kwindawo eze lolwakhiwo; ulwazi lwamandla emisebenzi ye nkqubo ephilayo kwiLawulo lweziseko eziqulunqiweyo. Ukuqonda kweNkqubo yoLawulo lweeNkonzo kwaye nakwiNkqubo yoLawulo loMbindi wezeMimo yekhomishana yaseburhulumenteni kunye namandla oKwaziswa ngeKhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, kunye ne-MS Outlook), amandla okubhala iingxelo, ukuqamba nokuhlela, amandla okulawula iiprojekthi, amandla okuba ngum的人文 koko kukho obu khokheli, ukusombulula iingxaki, amandla okuncedisa, amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuba nomonde, kuqondise, ethembekile, eqinisekileyo, ezingca, esebanga nzima kwaye enokucinga ngokutsha. Ukuba nengqondo yokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinxweba, nengqondo ezigqatsa ngokwemvelo nokuya phambili.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela kwaye axelele ngenxweme ngobume beluntu. Ukuqinisekisa ngamandla emisebenzi iingxelo zababenzi beenkonzo ezilungileyo nabakhi-misebenzi. Ukuzimela ngokuyila, ukuqamba umbutho yolawulo kwaye alawule yonke imisebenzi/iiprojekthi yolawulo olubanzi lweziseko. Ukugcina kwakunye nokuqinisekisa ukulondolozwa koluntu olulwakhiwo ngokubakalisa ngeNjinieri yokuLwa. Ukugcina ukulwa koluntu olulwakhiwo kwaye aqinisekise ukuba lugcinwa ngendlela echanekileyo, ngokweemali kwaye ngokuchanekileyo. Ukulawula ababenzi beenkonzo ukuba bazinikezele kwiinkqubo ezithintela ukulondolozwa ezilungileyo nangokulungisa iziseko zoluntu zekhomishana. Ukuqwalasela ngokuchanekileyo zonke iimfuno zokulondolozwa nangokulawula iindawo zoluntu ngokulandela imilinganiselo yemisebenzi yam, kwaye uqinisekise ukuphila nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo koluntu. Ukuqinisekisa ngamandla emisebenzi umsebenzi wengcali kwaye ngelixa lexesha leprojekthi. Ukunceda abalawuli beeprojekthi ekusombululeni iingxabano ezivela kwangaphakathi ngamanyathelo amalunga nayo. Ukuphonononga nokujonga ngokucosha iingxelo zokugqibela zenjinieri yomthetho wezilawulo zezakhiwo ezifana nezo nkqubo zokwakhiwa ezifana nezamanye amaNjinieri ezizeko zentsimbini kwaye ahlele iingxelo zobume beluntu, kuquka nezilinganiso zexabiso lokulungisa nokuyila iinkqubo ezingajoliswanga ndawonye ezibekwe kwindawo ebanzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni nokujonga ngokukhawuleza ukusebenza kweTotal Facilities Management (TFM) ukwenza iinkqubo ngokuchasene nokwakhiwa koluntu oluLwakhiwa, kuquka nokulandela imigaqo yeenkonzo (SLA) kunye nokuhlolwa kwabakhi-misebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusenziwa ukuhlolwa kwenyanga ngenyanga ngeendawo zokusebenza ukuze akhangele inkqubo yeprojekthi, aqinisekise umsebenzi owenziweyo ngokuchasene nezifundo zemali, axelele ngokwakhupha kweeminqweno. Ukuqwalasela ngesisesiko (FCA) kwiinkqubo zokwakhiwa koluntu oluLwakhiwa kwaye ahlele iingxelo zokuzimela koluntu, kubandakanya nezimali ezingayilungisa ngokubakalisa imilinganiselo nendlela yokuzimela ekuyilweyo.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: Electrical Engineering Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage electrical engineering services infrastructure at the Department of Public Works head office in Pretoria, overseeing facilities management projects and contractor evaluations.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification electrical engineering experience in building services. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of the PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, and MS Outlook), report-writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem-solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self-Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Assess and report on the condition of the electrical engineering infrastructure. Technical evaluation of professional service providers’ and contractors’ bids. Solely account for planning, co-coordinating and managing all technical facilities management activities/projects. Oversee and ensure the maintenance of building assets within the Electrical, Mechanical and Plumbing disciplines. Also accountable for services including standby generators, UPS, transformers, lighting system, MV and LV system, etc. Oversee electrical infrastructure and ensure that they are efficiently, financially and optimally maintained. Supervise the service providers to deliver the preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance program for the departmental infrastructure. Efficiently attend to all maintenance requests and infrastructure facility management in line with operational standards and ensure the ongoing performance and reliability of the assets. Conduct quality control over the work of the consultant and the contractor during the execution phase of the project. Assist project managers in resolving technical disputes arising at different stages of the project. Review and audit final professional electrical engineering accounts and construction contract final accounts. Accept responsibility for the development, implementation, review and regular updating of standardised electrical engineering practice manuals for the Department. Participate in the administration and performance monitoring of Total Facilities Management (TFM) contracts relating to electrical services, including service level agreement (SLA) compliance and contractor performance evaluation. Conduct monthly site inspections to monitor project progress, verify work executed against payment claims, and report on quality and programme compliance. Conduct detailed Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) of electrical infrastructure and compile condition assessment reports, including remedial cost estimates and prioritised intervention plans.
jobs.applications: Applications for the position of Control Works Manager: Electrical Engineering Services must be emailed to: Recruitment26-93@dpw.gov.za

Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. af.title: Bestuursmanager Beheer: Elektriese Ingenieurswese Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur infrastruktuur vir elektriese ingenieurswese dienste by die Department of Public Works se hoofkantoor in Pretoria, en hou toesig oor fasiliteitebestuurprojekte en kontrakteur se evaluerings.
af.requirements: Minimum van BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering op NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken. Toepaslike drie jaar se post-kwalifikasie elektriese ingenieurswese ervaring in geboudienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid; kennis van die PFMA en Nasionale Bouregulasies. Kennis van Staatsverkrygingstelsels in die geboude-omgewing; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies wat verband hou met beste praktyk binne geïntegreerde fasiliteitebestuur. Kennis van die Voorsieningskettingbestuursraamwerk en staatsbegrotingsprosedure vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, en MS Outlook), verslagdoeningsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, projekbestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, verstaandsaam, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, hardwerkend en analitiese dinkend. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveer, en skeppend.
af.duties: Evalueer en rapporteer oor die toestand van die elektriese ingenieurswese infrastruktuur. Tegniese evaluering van professionele diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs se bodde. Dra uitsluitlik verantwoordelikheid vir die beplanning, koördinering en bestuur van alle tegniese fasiliteitebestuursaktiwiteite/projekte. Hou toesig oor en verseker die onderhoud van gebou-bates binne die elektriese, meganiese en loodgietersdisiplines. Ook verantwoordelik vir dienste insluitend reserwegenerators, UPS, transformators, beligtingstelsel, MV- en LV-stelsel, ens. Hou toesig oor elektriese infrastruktuur en verseker dat dit doeltreffend, finansieel en optimaal onderhou word. Oordeel die diensverskaffers om die preventiewe onderhouds- en korrigerende onderhoudsprogram vir die departementele infrastruktuur te lewer. Doeltreffend al die onderhoudsversoeke en infrastruktuur-fasiliteitebestuur in lyn met operasionele standaarde bywoon en verseker die voortdurende prestasie en betroubaarheid van die bates. Voer kwaliteitbeheer uit oor die werk van die konsultant en die kontrakteur tydens die uitvoeringsfase van die projek. Help projekbestuurders met die oplossing van tegniese geskille wat op verskillende stadiums van die projek ontstaan. Hersien en oudit finale professionele elektriese ingenieurswese rekeninge en konstruksie-kontrak finale rekeninge. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening en gereelde opdatering van gestandaardiseerde elektriese ingenieurswese praktykhandleidings vir die departement. Neem deel aan die administrasie en prestasie-bewaking van Total Facilities Management (TFM)-kontrakte wat verband hou met elektriese dienste, insluitend diensvlakooreenkoms (SLA)-nakoming en kontrakteur-prestasie-evaluering. Voer maandelikse terreininspeksies uit om projekvoortgang te monitor, uitgevoerde werk teen betalingseise te verifieer, en oor gehalte- en programnakoming te rapporteer. Voer gedetailleerde Fasiliteittoestandevaluerings (FCAs) van elektriese infrastruktuur uit en stel toestandevaluasieverslae op, insluitend herstelkoste-skattings en geprioritiseerde ingrypende planne.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomsebenzi Wokulawula: Izenzo Zobunjiniyela Bagesi
zu.summary: Phatha insimbi yezokwakha yezenzo zobunjiniyela bagesi ehhovisi eliyinhloko le-Department of Public Works ePretoria, ukugcina iso kumaprojekthi okuphathwa kwemisebenzi nokuhlolwa kwezinkampani.
zu.requirements: I-diploma yebanga elincane le-BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech kubunjiniyela bageso kwelizinga le-NQF 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Isipiliyoni seminyaka emithathu esifaneleko somsebenzi wobunjiniyela bagesi emva kokuthola iziqu kumasevisi okwakha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ngoMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ukwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA kanye ne- National Building Regulations. Ukwazi ngamaphuzu wokuthenga kahulumathi endaweni esakhiwe; ulwazi lwemisebenzi ebalulekile enezindlela ezihlobene nokuqonda okuhle ngaphakathi kokuphathwa kwemisebenzi okuhlangene. Ukwazi ngesakhishiwo sokuphathwa kwenqwaba yokuhlinzeka kanye namakhono amahle ahlobene nendlela yokuqasha kahulumathi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukweluleka futhi uhlele, amakhono okuphatha imisebenzi, amakhono okuba nogogo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okukhuthaza, namakhono okuthumela umyalezo ngempumelelo. Ukuba nomonde, ukuqonda, ukwesaba ukwesaba ukuthembeka, ukuba namandla okuqina, ukuba nobuhlakani, ukusebenza kanzima nokucabanga ngokuhlakaniphwa. Isikhathi sokuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwegagasi lokuqina kwengqondo, nokuba nobuhlakani bokwakha izinto ezintsha.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi ubeke umbiko ngemo yezinto zokusebenza zobunjiniyela bagesi. Ukuhlola ngolwazi iziphakamiso zabakhiqizi besevisi ngezinkampani. Kubeka ibhasizana ngokucabanga, ukuhlanganisa kanye nokuphatha yonke imisebenzi/iprojekthi ephathwa ngamakhono okulawula. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla zendawo ezingamagesi, ezokushiswa kanye nezokuhlanzwa zingagcini kahle futhi zisebenza. Futhi ubeke isibopho emisebenzini efaka phakathi amajeneretha wokuqashelwa amagesi, ama-UPS, izitshintshi, izinhlela zokukhanyisa, uhlelo lwe-MV kanye ne-LV, njll. Hlola izinto zokusebenza zamagesi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zithathwa ngokuphathwa kahle nangokusebenza ngokwezimali nezobuchwepheshe. Qondisa izinkampani ezinikeza amasevisi ukuze zilethe uhlelo lokuvikela nokulungiswa kwezinto zomnyango. Phendula ngokushesha wonke amacephiso okulungisa izinto kanye nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yendawo ngokuhambisana namazinga okusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlala kunamandla ukusebenza nokuthembeka kwezinto. Yenza ukuhlola ikhwalithi emsebenzini weseluleki kanye nenkampani ngesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi. Siza abaphathi bemisebenzi ukuxazulula izingxabano ezivela kumazinga ahlukene eprojekthi. Cabangela futhi uhlole ama-akhawunti wezobunjiniyela bagesi okugqamile futhi wenze isiphetho samakhonthulakhi okwakhiwe. Zamukela ibhasizana lokuthuthukisa, ukuphatha, ukubuyekeza futhi uvuse ukushintshwa kwamavulumente wezobunjiniyela bagesi endaweni yomnyango. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni nasekugadweni ukusebenza kwamakhonthulakhi e-Total Facilities Management (TFM) ephathelene namasevisi amagesi, kufaka phakathi ukuzwana nesivumelwano samasevisi (SLA) kanye nokuqagela ukusebenza kwenkampani. Yezinsuku zonke zokuhlolwa kwendawo ukugada inqubekelaphambili yomsebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwe uhambisana nezimfuneko zokukhokha, futhi wenze umbiko ngobuhle bayo kanye nokuzwana kohlelo. Hlola isimo sezinto zokusebenza zamagesi ngokuphelele futhi uqoqe imibiko yesimo, okuhlanganisa izindleko ezibaliwe zokulungisa kanye nezinhlela ezibekwe phambili zokungenelela.

xh.title: UmLawuli weMenzi yoBuchwepheshe: Iinkonzo zoBuchwepheshe boMbane
xh.summary: Lawula izakhiwo zeenkonzo zobuchwepheshe kwisebe lezasebenza kahle kwikhaya le-Ntsebenziselwa iindawo ezahlukeneyo iRhulumente apho kungenwa iNgqungqushe ePretoria, ngokulawula iinkqubo zokugcina izifo nokulinganisa abathengisi besikhosi.
xh.requirements: Ukuze ufumane isithuba kufuneka ube ne-BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech kwInjineli yamandla kagesi kumanqanaba e-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka ubenamava eminyaka mithathu emva kokugqiba izifundo kwInjineli yamandla kagesi kwinkonzo yolwakhiwo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woKhuseleko lwabasebenzi naseMsebenzini; ulwazi nge-PFMA nezima Zolwakhiwo eZizwe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoKuthenga kolawulo Kurhulumente kwindawo yolwakhiwo; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe lweemisebenzi ephambili enxulumene nendlela engcono yokwenza izinto ngaphakathi kokuLawulwa kweZifo ezidibene. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yoLawulo loQoqosho kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zebhajethi yoRhulumente. Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala iingxelo, uqeqesho nokuqulunqa, amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi, amakhono okuba ngumlawuli, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono okulungelelanisa, amakhono oThetho olusebenzayo. Kufuneka ube nomonde, kuqondeka, uthembekile, uxhomekeke kuye, unobuchule obutsha, usebenze nzima kwaye ucinge ngokuhlola. Kufuneka ubenamandla okusebenza ngomswakama, uzichukumise ngokwakho, kwaye ube nobuchule bokudala izinto.
xh.duties: Hlola ngokucacileyo kwaye uthithe ngemeko yezakhiwo zolwakhiwo lwamandla kagesi. Ukulinganisa ngobuchwepheshe amacebo abanikazi beeNkonzo zobuchwepheshe nabathengisi. Ndini yedwa nawuphi na umntu ophatha uqeqesho, ulungelelaniso nokulawula yonke imisebenzi/amanqanaba aphathwayo emisebenzi yezifo. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukugcinwa kwempahla yezakhiwo ngaphakathi kwezifundo zoMbane, zoNyuso lweMishini nokuQhoboshela. Kwakhona unoxanduva lwezonkonzo eziquka izigqithi ezingenamandla, i-UPS, i-transformer, inkqubo yokuqhanyiswa, inkqubo ye-MV nako-LV, njl njl. Qwalasela izakhiwo zolwakhiwo lwamandla kagesi uze uqinisekise ukuba zigcinwa ngenkqubo, ngokutsho weemali nangokulinganiselwa kakuhle. Lilise abanikazi bekonzo ukuba bafeze inkqubo yokugcinwa ngokuqinisekileyo nokulungisa izinto ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zolwakhiwo zesabe. Phendula ngokulinganiselwa kakuhle kuko konke ukucela ukugcinwa nokulawulwa kwezakhiwo zolwakhiwo ngokwemigangatho yemisebenzi kwaye uqinisekise ukuphumeza ngokuqhubekayo nokuthembeka kwempahla. Yenza ulawulo lwekhwalithi kumsebenzi womcebisi nethengisi phakathi kwexesha lokuqaliswa kweprojekthi. Nceda abaphathi beprojekthi ekuxazululeni iingxabano zobuchwepheshe ezibakho kwiinqanaba ezahlukeneyo zeprojekthi. Phinda ubuye uhlolle i-akhawunti zokugqibela zobuchwepheshe bamandla kagesi namakhontrakti okwakhiwa i-akhawunti zokugqibela. Yamkela umxhamla wokuqulunqa, ukuphumeza, ukuhlola nokuhlaziya rhoqo iincwadi zomzekelo wolwakhiwo lwamandla kagesi ezimiselweyo kuSebe. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni nasekuboniseni ukusebenza kwekhontrakti zoLawulo lweZifo eZidibeneyo (TFM) ezidityaniswe namandla kagesi, kuquka ukuthobela isivumelwano sezinga lenkonzo (SLA) nokuqwalasela ukusebenza komthengisi. Yenza iQwalaselo lweNyanga zangaKwindla kwindawo yakho ukuze ulandele inkqubo yeprojekthi, uqinisekise umsebenzi ozenziweyo ogqithwe kwimigca yokuzelelwa, kwaye uthike ngokukhulu nangokuthobela inkqubo. Yenza iQwalaselo eNzulu lweMeko yeSifo (FCA) kwindawo yakho yamandla kagesi kwaye uqulunqe iingxelo zokuqwalasela imeko, kuquka iindleko zokuqikelela ukulungezisa iindlela zokuqlula ezibekelwe ixesha elithile.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: FM Compliance Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Control Works Manager needed at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria to monitor and enforce compliance with OHS, building regulations, and PFMA across departmental facilities.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of bachelor qualification in engineering at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification experience in building services. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of the PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and MS Outlook), report-writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem-solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self- Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Monitor and enforce compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act, National Building Regulations, PFMA, GIAMA and relevant SANS standards across departmental facilities and infrastructure. Develop, implement and maintain compliance monitoring frameworks, checklists and registers for Total Facilities Management (TFM) and other facilities management contracts. Conduct compliance audits and site inspections of TFM service providers and contractors to verify adherence to service level agreements (SLAs), statutory requirements and departmental policies. Review Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) reports and other technical reports to verify the regulatory and statutory compliance of building infrastructure and escalate non-conformances for corrective action. Evaluate professional service providers’ and contractors’ bids and appointments for compliance with the Supply Chain Management Framework and Government procurement prescripts. Liaise with regulatory bodies, statutory councils and internal stakeholders (Legal, Supply Chain Management, Risk Management) on compliance-related matters affecting facilities management. Compile and submit compliance monitoring reports, non-compliance registers and corrective action plans to management on a monthly and quarterly basis. Support the development, implementation, review and regular updating of standardised FM compliance policies, procedures and practice manuals for the Department. Provide input into risk management processes relating to facilities compliance, including the identification, assessment and mitigation of compliance risks. Assist project and contract managers in resolving compliance-related disputes arising at different stages of TFM and facilities management projects.

af.title: Beheer Werke-bestuurder: FM-nakomingsdienste
af.summary: Beheer Werke-bestuurder benodig by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria om nakoming van OHS, gebouregulasies en PFMA oor departementele fasiliteite te monitor en af te dwing.
af.requirements: A minimum of bachelor qualification in engineering at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Toepaslike drie jaar se post-kwalifikasi ervaring in geboudienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act; kennis van die PFMA en National Building Regulations. Kennis van regeringsverkrygingstelsels in die geboude omgewing; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies verbonde aan beste praktyke binne geïntegreerde fasiliteitebestuur. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management Framework en regeringsbegrotingsprosedures. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook), verslagskryfvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, projekbestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, begrypend, betroubaar, betroubaar, innoverend, ywerig en analities denkend. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd en kreatief.
af.duties: Monitor en dwing nakoming van die Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act, National Building Regulations, PFMA, GIAMA en toepaslike SANS-standaarde oor departementele fasiliteite en infrastruktuur af. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou nakomingsmoniteringsraamwerke, kontrolelyste en registers vir Total Facilities Management (TFM) en ander fasiliteitebestuurskontrakte. Voer nakomingsoudits en terreininspeksies van TFM-diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs uit om te verifieer dat hulle aan diensvlakooreenkomste (SLA's), statutêre vereistes en departementele beleid voldoen. Hersien Facility Condition Assessment (FCA)-verslae en ander tegniese verslae om die regulatoriese en statutêre nakoming van gebou-infrastruktuur te verifieer en nie-nakomings te eskaleer vir korrektiewe optrede. Evalueer professionele diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs se bieë en aanstellings vir nakoming van die Supply Chain Management Framework en regeringsverkrygingsvoorskrifte. Skakel met regulerende liggame, statutêre rade en interne belanghebbendes (Regte, Supply Chain Management, Risk Management) oor nakomingsverwante aangeleenthede wat fasiliteitebestuur raak. Stel nakomingsmoniteringsverslae, nie-nakomingsregisters en korrektiewe aksieplanne op en dien dit maandeliks en kwartaalliks by bestuur in. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening en gereelde bywerking van gestandaardiseerde FM-nakomingsbeleide, prosedures en praktykhandleidings vir die departement. Verskaf insette tot risikobestuursprosesse rakende fasiliteitenakoming, insluitend die identifisering, assessering en mitigering van nakomingsrisiko's. Bied hulp aan projek- en kontraktebestuurders om nakomingsverwante geskille wat tydens verskillende stadiums van TFM- en fasiliteitebestuursprojekte ontstaan, te besleg.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokuqaphela Izinto: Isevisi Yokuhambisana Nemithetho ye-FM
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Wokuqaphela Izinto e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Pretoria ukuze aqaphele futhi aphoqe ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho ye-OHS, imithetho yezakhiwo, kanye ne-PFMA kuzo zonke izikhungo zomnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor ezinqeni le-NQF level 7 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okulingene iminyaka emithathu yokuhlangene nemisebenzi yezinkonzo zezakhiwo emva kokuqeqeshwa. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi nge-PFMA kanye ne-National Building Regulations. Ulwazi lwamasistimu e-Government Procurement emhlabeni wokwakha; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bezimisebenzi ezibalulekile ohlobene ngqo namasu ahamba phambili kokuqashwa kokubusa okuhlangene kwezikhungo. Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Management Framework kanye namakhono okuhamba kwesinqumela sikahulumeni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukweluleka futhi uhlele, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono okuba yisikhokheli, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okukhuthaza, namakhono okuxhumana ngempumelelo. Ukuba nomonde, ukuqonda, ukuthembeka, ukuba wothando, ukuba nomqondo osha, ukusebenza kanzima kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela, ukuzimisela, nokuba nomqondo osha.
zu.duties: Qaphelela futhi uphoqe ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act, i-National Building Regulations, i-PFMA, i-GIAMA kanye nezindinganiso ezihambisanayo ze-SANS kuzo zonke izikhungo nokwakhiwa komnyango. Lakela, phumeza futhi gcina uhlaka lolwazi lwemithetho, uluhlu lwemibuzo kanye nalokho okubhalisiwe kwabaphathi bezinkonzo ezinguzonke (TFM) kanye namanye amakhasimende okuphathwa kwezinkonzo zezikhungo. Yenza izivivinyo zemithetho kanye nokuhlola izindawo zezinkonzo ze-TFM nabathweswe inkonzo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahambisana nemivumelwano yezinkonzo (SLAs), imithetho evunyelwe kanye nemigomo yomnyango. Phinda ubuke imibiko yokuhlola izimo zezikhungo (FCA) kanye namanye amabiko obuchwepheshe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo kuhambisana nemithetho nezinqumo ezivunyelwe, uphinde unyuse izinkinga ezingahambisani ukuze zixazululwe. Hlola iziphakamiso zabathweswe inkonzo ngobuchwepheshe nabathweswe inkonzo kokubekwa esikhundleni nangesikhathi sokuhambisana nohlaka lwe-Supply Chain Management futhi ngemithetho yemali kahulumenu yokuthenga. Xhumana nabaphathi bemithetho, amakhulu ezinqumo ezivunyelwe kanye nabashabanisi bangaphakathi (Ezomthetho, i-Supply Chain Management, i-Risk Management) ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuhambisana nemithetho ezithinta ukuphathwa kwezikhungo. Hlanganisa futhi uhambise imibiko yokulawula ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho, okubhalisiwe ngezenzo ezingahambisani nemithetho kanye namaphulani ezixazulula izenzo ezingahambisani kumabhodi okuphatha njalo ngenyanga kanye katheni. Sekela ukulungiselela, ukuphumeza, ukubuyekeza kanye nokuhlaziya okuvamile kwemigomo, izinqubo kanye nezincwadi zokusebenza ezingagcinwanga ngokuhambisana nemithetho ye-FM kumnyango. Nikeza imibiko ezinkundleni zokuqapha izingozi ezihlobene nokuthi izikhungo zihambisana nemithetho, kufaka phakathi ukuhlukanisa, ukuhlola futhi unciphise izingozi zokungahambisani nemithetho. Siza abaphathi bamaphrojekthi nasezinkontileka ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokungahambisani nemithetho ezibhema phakathi kwezinkathi ezahlukene zamaphrojekthi e-TFM kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkonzo zezikhungo.

xh.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wolawulo: Iinkonzo Zokuzithoba kwi-FM
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona uMphathi Womsebenzi Wolawulo kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria ukuze ajolise kwaye alawule ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo ye-OHS, yemigaqo yokwakhiwa, nakwi-PFMA kulo lonke ulawulo lwamasebe.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abe n Degrees yokugqiba kwesiqu se-bachelor kwi-engineering kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe namava emyaka emithathu axabisekileyo emva kokufumana isiqu kwinkonzo zokwakhiwa. Kufuneka abe ne-Layisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kuqonde imigaqo ye-Occupational Health and Safety Act; kuqonde i-PFMA kunye ne-National Building Regulations. Kuqonde iinkqubo ze-Government Procurement systems kwindawo ezakhiweyo; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe lokusebenza okubalulekileyo malunga namasu amabalulekileyo aphakathi kwe-integrated Facilities Management. Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Management Framework kunye nendlela yobungcali bokusebenzisa imeko ye-Government budget procedure; amakhono obuchwepheshe bekhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala iingxelo, ulungelelwaniso nokuhlela, amakhono okulawula amaphrojekthi, amakhono obuqhawe, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono okuncedisa, amakhono onxibelelwano olusebenzayo. Kufuneka abe nomonde, aqonde, ethembekile, othembekile, onesimilo, osebenza nzima kwaye nomonde wokucinga. Akho lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, uzimotivile, kwaye noncedo lokudala.
xh.duties: Jonga kwaye ulawule ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo ye-Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act, i-National Building Regulations, i-PFMA, i-GIAMA kunye nemigaqo ehambelanayo ye-SANS standards kulo lonke ulawulo lwamasebe nempahla. Phucula, yenze kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zokuqonda ukuzithoba, iikhonkco zokuqamba namarhwothi e-Total Facilities Management (TFM) nakwezinye iinkqubo zolawulo lwezikhongo. Qamba i-oditi zokuzithoba kwaye ujonge iindawo zomsebenzi zabahanjiswa be-TFM nabakhi-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba bayalandela iinkqubo zemivuzo (SLAs), iimfuno zemithetho kunye nemigaqo yesebe. Phinda ujonge iingxelo ze-Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) kunye nezinye iingxelo zobuchwepheshe ukuze uqinisekise ukuzithoba ngokwemithetho nangokomthetho kolawulo lolwakhiwo kwaye uphakamise izinto ezingazithobanga ukuze zilungiswe. Hlola iinkqubo zokuqatshwa kwababhaliswa beemveliso nabakhi-mthetho baxabisekileyo nokubekwa kwabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithoba ngokwe-Supply Chain Management Framework kunye nemigaqo yokuthenga kukaRhulumente. Ncedisanisa nabalinganisi bomthetho, amabhomu omthetho nabanomdla ngaphakathi (Legal, Supply Chain Management, Risk Management) kwimiba yokuzithoba echitha ulawulo lwamasebe. Qamba kwaye unikeze iingxelo zokuqonda ukuzithoba, amarhwothi okungazithoba kunye neendawo zokulungisa ngokwe-nyanga nakwi-ntshatsheli kubaphathi. Ncedisa ekuphuculweni, ekwenzeni, ekujongweni nakuhlaziyen iinkqubo zemigaqo yokuzithoba e-FM, iinkqubo zokusebenza namabhuku amazwi aphakathi kuthetha ukuzithoba. Nikeza igalelo kwinkqubo yolawulo lweengozi ezimalunga nokuzithoba kwamasebe, kuquka ukuziqondanisa, ukuqonda nokuthintela iingozi zokungazithobi. Ncedisa abaphathi bemiphuphu kunye nabalawuli bemiqathango ukuxazulula iingxabano zokungazithobi ezibakho kwizinga-ngqondoi ze-TFM kunye nemiphuphu yolawulo lwamasebe.
