Wees geduldig, verstaanbaar, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, hardwerkend en analitiese denke. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd en kreatief.
af.duties: Assesseer en verslag doen oor die toestand van die meganiese ingenieurswese-infrastruktuur. Tegniese evaluering van lisensie- en kontrakteursbiedings. Uitsluitlik verantwoordelik vir die beplanning, koördinering en bestuur van alle tegniese fasiliteitebestuursaktiwiteite/-projekte. Hou toesig oor en verseker die instandhouding van gebou-bates binne die Elektriese, Meganiese en Loodgieterswese-dissiplines. Ook verantwoordelik vir dienste insluitend Hysbakke, Roltrappe, HVAC, Brandopsporingstelsels, ens. Hou toesig oor meganiese en waterretikulasie-infrastruktuur en verseker dat dit doeltreffend, finansieel en optimaal onderhou word. Toesig hou oor diensverskaffers om die voorkomende en korrektiewe instandhoudingsprogram vir die departementele infrastruktuur te lewer. Doeltreffend aandag skenk aan alle instandhoudingsversoeke en infrastruktuurfasiliteitebestuur in ooreenstemming met operasionele standaarde en verseker die deurlopende prestasie en betroubaarheid van die bates. Voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit oor die werk van die konsultant en die kontrakteur tydens die uitvoeringsfase van die projek. Ondersteun Projekbestuurders in die oplossing van tegniese geskille wat tydens verskillende stadiums van die projek ontstaan. Hersien en ouditeer fin professionele meganiese ingenieurswese-rekeninge en konstruksiekontrak se fin rekeninge. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening en gereelde bywerking van gestandaardiseerde meganiese ingenieurswese-praktykhandboeke vir die Departement. Neem deel aan die administrasie en prestasie-monitering van Total Facilities Management (TFM)-kontrakte rakende meganiese dienste, insluitend diensvlakooreenkoms (SLA)-nakoming en kontrakteursprestasie-evaluering. Voer maandelikse terreininspeksies uit om projekvoortgang te moniteer, uitgevoerde werk teen betalings eise te verifieer, en oor gehaltee en programnakoming te verslag doen. Voer gedetailleerde Fasiliteitstoestandassesserings (FCAs) van meganiese infrastruktuur uit en stel toestandassesseringsverslae op, insluitend herstelkoste-skattings en geprioriteerde ingrypingsplanne.

zu.title: Abaphathi Bezomsebenzi Wokuqaphela: Amasevisi Enjiniyela Yezinsimbi
zu.summary: Phatha izakhiwo zamasevisi enjiniyela yezinsimbi e-HQ yomnyango we-Public Works e-Pretoria, ubukele imiklamo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza nokuhlola abakhiqizi bangaphandle.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 7 kwe-BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech ku-Mechanical Engineering njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwaziswa okufanelekile kweminyaka emithathu yokusebenza i-Mechanical Engineering ngemva kokuthola iziqu kwindawo yasemakadebona. I-License yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho ye-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi nge-PFMA nezinqubo zokwakha kwezwe. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zikahuluma zokuthenga kwindawo yasemakadebona; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bokusebenza kwezimiso eziyisihluthulelo ezihlobene nenqubo enhle ekuphathweni okuhlanganisiwe kwezinsiza. Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Management Framework nenzila yebhajethi kahulumu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono ekuqamba umbhalo wezibalo, ukweluleka nokuhlela, amakhono okuphatha imiklamo, amakhono okuba ngumholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubhekisisa, amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Ukube nomonde, kuqonde, ukwethembeka, ukuthembeka, ukuba nokwaziswa, ukusebenza kanzima kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ukuzimisela, kanye nobuciko.
zu.duties: Hlola ubume bengxenye yokwakhiwa kwenjiniyela yezinsimbi bese ubika. Ukubuyeza obuchwepheshe izinkulumo-mvula zabaqashi bezinsiza zobuchwepheshe nabakhiqizi bangaphandle. Ube necala elikhulu lokuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha yonke imisebenzi/imiklamo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngobuchwepheshe. Bheka futhi uqiniseke ukugcinwa kwempahla yezakhiwo kumagatsha e-Electrical, Mechanical kanye ne-Plumbing. Futhi uthathele icala amasevisi afaka phakathi ama-Lifts, ama-Escalators, i-HVAC, izinhlelo zokutholwa komlilo, njll. Bheka izinsimbi zendawo yokuhamba amanzi bese uqinisekisa ukuthi zigcinwa ngendlela efanele, nangemali, ngokuphumelelayo. Qaphela abaqashi bezinsiza ukuthi balethe uhlelo lokugcina izinto ngaphambi kwezinkinga nangemva kwezinkinga e-Departmental infrastructure. Phendula ngokuphumelelayo yonke imibuzo yokugcina izinto nokuphathwa kwezakhiwo ngokuhambisana namazinga okusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okuqhubekayo nokwethembeka kwempahla. Yenza i-quality control ngaphezu kwomsebenzi womqashi nongakhiqizi ngesikhathi sokwenza umklamo. Siza abaphathi bemiklamo ekuxazululeni izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezibakhona ezigabeni ezahlukene zomklamo. Buyeza futhi uhlole ama-account okugcina enjiniyela yezinsimbi yobuchwepheshe nama-account okugqamile oqiniso wesivumelwano sokuqasha. Yamukele ibhayolo ekuthuthukiseni, ukuphatha, ukubuyeza futhi uvuselela njalo imanuals ezilandelanayo zokusebenza enjiniyela yezinsimbi ku-Department. Thatha inhlangothi ekuphathweni nokubukela ukuphumelela kwe-Total Facilities Management (TFM) contracts eziphathelene namasevisi wezinsimbi, okubandakanya ukuzwelana ne-Service Level Agreement (SLA) kanye nokubuyeza ukuphumelela komqashi. Yenza ukubheka iziteshi zinyanga zonke ukulandelana komklamo, ukuqinisekisa umsebenzi ozenziwe ngokumelene nezinkulumo zokukhokha, bese ubika ngokuqala kanye nokuzwelana nezenkalo. Yenza ukubuyeza ubume bensiza bezinsimbi ngobuchwepheshe bese uhlanganisa izibalo zokuqinisekisa ubume, okubandakanya izibalo zokulungisa izinto eziyindleko kanye nezinhlela ezingaba yibhalansi ekuxazululeni izinkinga.

xh.title: Umphathi Wolawulo: Iinkonzo zeNzululwazi zesiQili
xh.summary: Lawula iziseko zokusebenza kweenkonzo zenkuliso yamashishini kuQelelo lweNtaba kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi yaRhamatli ePretoria, njengokulawula amaphulo ophatho lwezishebe kunye nokuhlola oqobo ngokomthetho.
xh.requirements: Ukuqeshwa kwe-BSc/B.Eng/B.Tech kwiNzululwazi yokuQili kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Okufanelekileyo amashumi amathathu eminyaka yokuzifunda ngemva kokufaneleka isikhundla senkuliso kwindawo eyakhiweyo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezaKhuseleko ekuSebenzeni nasekuNakekelweni kweZempilo; ulwazi nge-PFMA nakuMiso wokuQala eNqanaba leSizwe. Ulwazi ngezithinteli zikaRhulumente ekuThengeni izinto endaweni eyakhiweyo; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe kumagunya abalulekileyo ahambelana nokuQeshiswa ngokuSebenzela okuPhezulu kwiPhulo loPhatho lweeNkonzo. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoLawulo loGqingo lwaMatyathanga nendlela yokwenza umGqelelo kaRhulumente oKubakho iNqanaba lokuTshila. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yeKhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project kunye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono obhala iingxelo, ukuCwangcisa nokuHlela, amakhono oPhatho lwePhulo, amakhono oBukhosi, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono oNxulumaniso, amakhono oThetho abalulekileyo. Ukuba nomonde, ukuQonda, oThembekileyo, oQinisekileyo, oTsha imibono, oZimiseleko emsebenzini kwaye unako ukuQonda ngokweenjongo. Ukuba namandla wokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuZikhusela ngokwakho, nokuba noBuchule bokudala.
xh.duties: Hlola kwaye uchaze imeko yesiseko esisebenzayo senzululwazi yokuqili amashishini. Hlola ngokobuchwepheshe iindlela eziswa ngabo bafuni iinkonzo zochwepheshe kunye nabathengi abaxabisa. Hlala ngokukhululeka uxanduva lokucwangcisa, ukuqoqa kwaye ulawule onke amashishini amakhulu ophatho lwezishebe obuchwepheshe/amaphulo. Buka kwaye uqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwezinto ezakhiwayo ezisesixekweni ngaphakathi kwemimiselo yeKhompyutha, eyokuQila kunye nezoNtsimbi. Ukuba uxanduva kweenkonzo ezibandakanya iindawo zokuNyuka, oonqamlezoyi, i-HVAC, iiNkqubo zokuQaphela uMlilo, njl njl. Buka isiseko sokusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe nendlela yokuNtselwa kwaManzi kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ziyagcinwa ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokweemali nangokulinganiseleko. Lawula ababoneleli ngeenkonzo ukuba bazinike ezinkqubo zokunakekelwa okuthintelayo nakokulungisa iisebe ezisesikweni. Phendula kakuhle yonke imibuzo yokunakekelwa nophatho lwezishebe kwisiseko esisebenzayo ngokwemigangatho yokuqhuba kwaye uqinisekise ukuphila nokuQina kwezinto ezisebenzayo. Yenza uLawulo lweNqanaba leNgcango ngokomsebenzi wogqili kwaye ungumthengi ngesikhathi esiphethwe ngokuchaza isiphelo sephulo. Siza abaPhathi bePhulo ekuxazululeni iingxabano ezibuzwa ngokobuchwepheshe ezibakho kumagunya amahlanu ephulo. Pinda kwaye uqonde i-accents zokugqibela zenzululwazi yamashishini obuchwepheshe kunye ne-accents zokugqibela zesivumelwano sokwakha. Phatha uxanduva lokuphuhliswa, ukusebenziswa, ukuphinda kwaye ukulungisa rhoqo izikhokelo ezingagqibekanga zendlela yokwenzululwazi yokuqila yamashishini kwiSebe. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni nasekubukeni ukusebenza kwe-Facilities Management (TFM) ezidityaniswa ngeenkonzo zokuQila, kuquka ukuthobela iSivumelwano seNqanaba leenkonzo (SLA) nokuhlola ukusebenza komthengi. Yenza ukuqaphela kweendawo zokuSebenza ngenyanga ukubuka inkqubo yephulo, ukuqinisekisa umsebenzi oqediwe ngokuchasene ne-claims zemali, kwaye uchaze ngokwemigangatho nokuthobela inkqubo. Yenza iFacility Condition Assessments (FCAs) eNzulu yesiseko sokusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe kwaye uqokele iingxelo zokuqaphela imeko, kuquka uqikelelo lwamaxabiso okulungisa iindlela zoPhuculo ezibalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: Quantity Surveying Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Control Works Manager responsible for quantity surveying services, preparing tender documentation and evaluating tenders at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of B.Sc/B.Tech in Quantity Surveying at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification experience in building services quantity surveying. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of the PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, and MS Outlook), report-writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem-solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self-Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Prepare tender documentation, including scope of work, bills of quantities and evaluation criteria, for the procurement of professional service providers and contractors in line with Supply Chain Management (SCM) prescripts. Participate in the technical and financial evaluation of tender submissions and bids, ensuring compliance with SCM regulations and value-for-money principles. Value completed work, process payment certificates, and administer TFM contract accounts and variations in line with applicable fee frameworks. Cost Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) across departmental facilities, including elemental cost estimates for prioritised refurbishment and maintenance interventions. Benchmark TFM and FCA cost outputs against ASAQS methodology and industry norms to ensure value for money. Advise on materials, construction processes and technical solutions, applying quantity surveying principles to solve broadly defined technical challenges. Promote compliance with safety standards in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate and update technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology and current best practice. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly technical reports and provide input into the operational plan. Keep abreast of new technologies and industry developments through ongoing research and liaise with relevant professional boards and councils on quantity surveying matters. Attend and contribute to tender briefing sessions and site clarification meetings with prospective bidders. Conduct monthly site inspections to monitor project progress, verify work executed against payment claims, and report on quality and programme compliance. Compile and present project budget allocations and cost projections to Finance for inclusion in the departmental Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) and annual financial year planning. Prepare Project Execution Plans (PEPs), outlining project scope, budget, procurement strategy, programme and resourcing for approved facilities management projects.
jobs.applications: Applications for the position of Control Works Manager: Quantity Surveying Services must be emailed to: Recruitment26-96@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Beheer Werksbestuurder: Hoeveelheidopmettingsdienste
af.summary: Beheer Werksbestuurder verantwoordelik vir hoeveelheidopmettingsdienste, die voorbereiding van tenderdokumentasie en die evaluering van tenders by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van B.Sc/B.Tech in Quantity Surveying op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA. Toepaslike drie jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in hoeveelheidopmetting van boudienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act; kennis van die PFMA en National Building Regulations. Kennis van staatsinkoopstelsels in die bou-omgewing; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies verbonde aan beste praktyke binne geïntegreerde fasiliteitsbestuur. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management-raamwerk en staatsbegrotingsprosedures. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project en MS Outlook), verslagskryfvaardighede, beplanning en organisasie, projekbestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, begrypend, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, ywerig en 'n analitiese denker. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd en kreatief.
af.duties: Berei tenderdokumentasie voor, insluitend omvang van werk, hoeveelhede state en evalueringskriteria, vir die verkryging van professionele diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs in ooreenstemming met Supply Chain Management (SCM) voorskrifte. Neem deel aan die tegniese en finansiële evaluering van tenderindienings en bodde, en verseker nakoming van SCM-regulasies en waarde-vir-geld-beginsels. Waardeer voltooide werk, verwerk betalingssertifikate, en administreer TFM-kontrakrekeninge en variasies in ooreenstemming met toepaslike fooiraamwerke. Kostebepaal Facility Condition Assessments (FCA's) oor departementele fasiliteite, insluitend elementele kosteberamings vir geprioritiseerde opknappings- en instandhoudingsintervensies. Benchmark TFM- en FCA-koste-uitsette teen ASAQS-metodologie en bedryfsnorme om waarde vir geld te verseker. Gee advies oor materiale, konstruksieprosesse en tegniese oplossings, en pas hoeveelheidopmettingsbeginsels toe om breed gedefinieerde tegniese uitdagings op te los. Bevorder nakoming van veiligheidsstandaarde in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer en werk tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures by om nuwe tegnologie en huidige beste praktyk in te sluit. Stel maandelikse en kwartaallikse tegniese verslae op en dien dit in, en verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Bly op hoogte van nuwe tegnologieë en bedryfsontwikkelings deur voortgesette navorsing en skakel met relevante professionele rade en rade oor hoeveelheidopmettingsaangeleenthede. Woon tenderkortsessies en werfverduidelikingsvergaderings by en dra by met voornemende bieërs. Voer maandelikse werfinspeksies uit om projekvoortgang te monitor, uitgevoerde werk teen betalingseise te verifieer, en oor kwaliteit en programnakoming te rapporteer. Stel projekbegrotingstoewysings en kosteprojekties op en bied dit aan Finance vir insluiting in die departementele Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) en jaarlikse finansiëlejaarbeplanning. Berei Project Execution Plans (PEP's) voor wat projekomvang, begroting, verkrygingstrategie, program en bemanning vir goedgekeurde fasiliteitsbestuursprojekte uiteensit.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokuqapha: Izenzelo Zokuqapha Isibalo
zu.summary: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokuqapha ongamele izenzelo zokuqapha isibalo, ukulungosa amadokhumenti okuthengisa nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuthengisa eNdhaweni Elikhulu LeNdlu Yomnyango we Public Works and Infrastructure e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Udegree obuncane be-B.Sc/B.Tech ekubekeni ngemibhalo yamaminithi (Quantity Surveying) ezingeni le-NQF 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Isipiliyoni esifanelekile seminyaka emithathu ngemva kokuthola iziqu ekubeni ngumqaphi wesibalo wamasevisi okwakha. Ilayisense yokuqasha elivumelekile. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwendawo Yokusebenza; ulwazi nge-PFMA NeMithetho Yokwakha Kwezwe. Ulwazi lwamasu okuthenga kahulumeni endaweni yakhiwe; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bemisebenzi ebalulekile ehlobene nenhlalo emihle endaweni yokuphathwa kwezinsiza ehlanganiswe. Ulwazi lokuqondwa kohlangothi lokuLawula Kwezokunikezwa nenqubo yesabelomali kahulumeni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ohlelweni le-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono okuba ngumholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okwenza kubekhono lokukhuluma, ukuxhumana ngokusebenzayo. Ukuba nomoya onozekisa, ukuqonda, ukwethenjwa, ukwesekwa, ukuba nomqondo omtsha, ukusebenza kanzima nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegalelo, ukuzenzakalela, nokuba nomqondo omdala.
zu.duties: Lungisa amadokhumenti ezinhlelo zokuthengisa okuhlanganisa isibalo somsebenzi, izinkomba ezimalini kanye nemigomo yokuqoqwa, ekuthengeni abanikezeli bamasevisi abangochwepheshe nabakhwipi ngokuvumelana nemiyalo yokuphathwa kwezokunikezwa (SCM).

xh.title: Umphathi Wolawulo lwemisebenzi: Iinkonzo zoQikelelo lweMpahla
xh.summary: Umphathi Wolawulo lwemisebenzi onoxanduva loqikelelo lweempahla, ulungiselelo lwamaxwebhu entengiso-kuthengiso nokuhlola iintengiso kwiNtloko yeSebe lezaSebenzo zaLutsha noKwakhelwa iPhakamiso ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingenasiyo se-B.Sc/B.Tech kuQikelelo lweMpahla kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Okufanelekileyo amashumi amathathu eminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isidanga kuqikelelo lweempahla ezinkqubweni zokwakha. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woKhuseleko koMsebenzi noMthetho woKhuselo lweMpilo; ulwazi nge-PFMA noMthetho woKwakha weSizwe. Ulwazi lweendlela zokuThenga kolawulo loHulumeni kwindawo eyakhayo; ulwazi lwasemthethweni lwemisebenzi eyintloko enxulumene nendlela ethanda kakhulu ukwenza izinto ngaphakathi kolawulo oluhlangeneyo lweziVakalisi. Ulwazi lweSakhulo soLawulo lweNkqubo yoKuHlaba iNketho yokuHamba nexesha loQoqosho loHulumeni. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala iingxelo, ukuCwangcisa nokuhlela, amakhono oLawulo lweeprojekthi, amakhono oBukhosi, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono oKweluleko, namakhono oThothulwano olusebenzayo. Ukuba nomonde, kuqonde kakuhle, athembekile, othembekayo, onamabalo, osebenza nzima kwaye unamava okucinga. Amandla okusebenza ngoxinus, uzincede, kwaye unobuchule.
xh.duties: Lungiselela amaxwebhu entengiso-kuthengiso, kuquka nedlela yokwenza umsebenzi, iitshiti zezixa zempahla nemiqathango yokuqonda, ukuba ngabantu abathengisa abasebenziyo nabathengi ngokwemiqathango yoLawulo lweNkqubo yoKuhlatyulwa iNketho (SCM). Thatha inxaxheba ekuqondweni nasekuhloleni ngemali iingeniselo zentengiso-kuthengiso nezikwelo, kuqinisekiswa ulandelo lweemigaqo ze-SCM nemiqathayo yokuba imali ihamba ngokulingana. Qikelela umsebenzi oqediweyo, ulungelelanisa iitshiti zentlawulo, ulawule iiaKhowundi zentengiso ze-TFM noTshintsho lwemali ngokwemiqathango yamaxabiso ephilayo. Xabiso lokuQaphela iMimo zeSiseko seziVakalisi (FCA) kuzo zonke iindawo zokusebenza zesebe, kuquka nokulinganisa ixabiso ngeziqalelo zokutsha nokulungisa ezikhethwe kwindawo yonke. Qaphela ixabiso le-TFM ne-FCA ngokuchasene nendlela ye-ASAQS nemiqathango yemboni ukuqinisekisa ukuba imali ihamba ngokulingana. Nikela ingcebiso ngamachaphazelo, iinkqubo zokwakha nazisombululo ezisezantsi, usebenzisa iimigaqo zoQikelelo lweMpahla ukuze uxazulule iingxaki ezichaziweyo ngokubanzi. Khuthaza ukulandela imilinganiselo yokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yezomthetho nolawulo. Hlola uhlaziye iimanual ezisezantsi, iidrawing ezizezinye neendlela zokwenza ukubandakanya iindlela ezintsha zoloncedo kunye nendlela elicelwa kakhulu njengangoku. Qamba ungenise iingxelo zangenyanga nezihlobo ezisezantsi kwaye unikeze ingcebiso kwicebo lokusebenza. Hlala uyazi ngeendlela ezintsha zoloncedo nophuhliso lwemboni ngophando oluchanekileyo kwaye uqhagamshelane namabodlo amaqabanlie ngeendaba ezimalunga noQikelelo lweMpahla. Zithathele iinkqubo zokulula iingxaki zentengiso-kuthengiso kwaye unike neengxelo iintlanganiso zokuqondisa iindawo zokwenza umsebenzi kwabathengisi abanomdla. Qhuba iindwendwe zokuhlola iindawo zenyanga ukuze ulawule inkqubo yeprojekthi, uqinisekise umsebenzi owenziweyo ngokuchasene namangeniselo okuhlawula, kwaye unike ingxelo ngangcoliseko nolandelo. Qamba unike iingxelo zokwabiwa kwemali yeprojekthi kunye neenkcukacha zexabiso kuManyano ukuze ziboniswe kwiNdlela yoQoqosho ePhakathi (MTEF) kunye noCwangciso lweNyanga yokuQoqosho. Lungiselela iindlela zokuSebenzisa iProjekthi (PEP), uchaze indlela yomsebenzi weprojekthi, imali, indlela yokuthenga, inkqubo nobonelelo kwiiprojekthi zolawulo lwezivakalisi ezamkelekileyo.

jobs.title: Chief Works Managers: Technical Assistant/support
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assist with facility condition assessments and site inspections across departmental facilities, requiring a national diploma in engineering or related field with three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Civil Engineering/ Structural Engineering or Architectural Studies at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. Appropriate three years' post-qualification electrical engineering experience in building services. A valid driver’s Licence. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act; knowledge of PFMA and National Building Regulations. Knowledge of Government Procurement systems in the built environment; technical knowledge of key functions related to best practice within integrated Facilities Management. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Framework and Government budget procedure Skills. Computer Literacy in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and MS Outlook), report writing skills, planning and organising, project management skills, leadership skills, problem-solving, facilitation skills, effective communication skills. Be patient, understanding, trustworthy, dependable, innovative, hardworking and analytical thinking. Ability to work under pressure, Self-Motivated, and Creative.
jobs.duties: Assist with the planning, scheduling and conducting of Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) across departmental facilities, including site inspections, photographic surveys and data collection on the condition of building elements and services. Capture and consolidate FCA site information into condition assessment schedules, reports and supporting documentation for review by the ASD and Directors. Assist the ASD and Directors: Facilities Management with day-to-day technical and administrative tasks in the Technical Unit and carry out instructions and assignments as directed. Provide administrative support to the Technical Unit, including diary coordination, minute-taking, filing, and tracking of correspondence, submissions and approvals. Assist in the compilation, formatting and proofreading of technical reports, presentations, schedules and other documents prepared by the Technical Unit. Support the ASD and Directors in monitoring the progress of TFM and facilities management projects, and help track outstanding actions, deadlines and deliverables. Assist with the preparation and collation of documentation for meetings, site visits and technical evaluations, and follow up on action items as instructed by seniors. Maintain and update records, registers and databases relating to facility condition assessments, maintenance requests and technical unit activities. Assist with logistical and administrative arrangements for site visits and inspections undertaken by the Technical Unit. Perform any other reasonable duties as assigned by the ASD or Directors: Facilities Management in support of the Technical Unit's operations.

af.title: HoofWerksbestuurders: Tegniese Assistent/ondersteuning
af.summary: Bystand verleen met fasiliteits-toestandassesserings en terreininspeksies oor departementele fasiliteite, wat 'n nasionale diploma in ingenieurswese of 'n verwante veld met drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejaar-tertiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Civil Engineering/ Structural Engineering of Architectural Studies op NQF level 6 soos deur SAQA erken. Toepaslike drie jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in elektrotegniese ingenieurswese ten opsigte van geboudienste. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act; kennis van PFMA en National Building Regulations. Kennis van staatsverkrygingstelsels in die geboude omgewing; tegniese kennis van sleutelfunksies verbandhoudende met beste praktyke binne geïntegreerde fasiliteitsbestuur. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management Framework en staatsbegrotingsprosesse. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook), verslagdoeningsvaardighede, beplanning en organisasie, projektebestuursvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, fasiliteringsvaardighede, effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Wees geduldig, verstaanbaar, betroubaar, afhanklik, innoverend, ywerig en met analitiese dinkvermoë. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd en kreatief.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die beplanning, skedulering en uitvoering van Facility Condition Assessments (FCA's) oor departementele fasiliteite, insluitend terreininspeksies, fotosurveys en data-insameling oor die toestand van gebou-elemente en -dienste. Vang en konsolideer FCA-terreininligting in toestandassesseringskedules, verslae en ondersteunende dokumentasie vir hersiening deur die ASD en Directors. Bystand verleen aan die ASD en Directors: Facilities Management met daaglikse tegniese en administratiewe take in die Technical Unit en voer instruksies en opdragte soos aangewys uit. Administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Technical Unit bied, insluitend koördinering van dagboeke, notule neem, lêerwerk, en naspeur van korrespondensie, voorleggings en goedkeurings. Bystand verleen met die samestelling, formattering en proeflees van tegniese verslae, aanbiedings, skedules en ander dokumente wat deur die Technical Unit voorberei word. Die ASD en Directors ondersteun met die monitering van die vordering van TFM- en fasiliteitsbestuursprojekte, en help om uitstaande aksies, sperdatums en lewerbare items na te spoor. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding en samestelling van dokumentasie vir vergaderings, terreinbesoeke en tegniese evaluerings, en opvolg gee aan aksie-items soos deur senior persone aangewys. Rekords, registers en databasisse met betrekking tot fasiliteits-toestandassesserings, onderhoudsversoeke en Technical Unit-aktiwiteite onderhou en opdateer. Bystand verleen met logistieke en administratiewe reëlings vir terreinbesoeke en -inspeksies wat deur die Technical Unit onderneem word. Enige ander redelike pligte uitvoer soos deur die ASD of Directors: Facilities Management opgedra ter ondersteuning van die bedrywighede van die Technical Unit.

zu.title: Abaphathi Abakhulu Wezomsebenzi: On GKMD: Umsebenzi wezobuciko/ukwesekwa
zu.summary: Usiza ngokuhlola isimo sezindawo nokubukeka kwamakhempu kumanani wonke amafasilita womnyango, okudinga idiploma yezwe ezikhalweni zobuchwepheshe noma enye indawo ehlobene kanye neminyaka emithathu yohlelo oluhlobene.
zu.requirements: Isethensi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu yeziqu ezeqophelweni eliphezulu (NQF Level 06) / iDiploma yezwe kwe-Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Civil Engineering/ Structural Engineering noma izifundo ze-Architectural ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba izingunubevukelwa i-SAQA. Uhlelo olufanele lemnyaka emithathu ngemva kokuthola iziqu kwezobuchwepheshe kagesi empahleni wokwakha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ukwazi nge-PFMA kanye nezimiso zokwakha ezingeni lwezwe. Ukuluma izinhlelo zokuthenga kahulumeni ezindaweni ezisakhiwe; ulwazi lobuchwepheshe ngemisebenzi ephambili ehlobene nezinqubo ezinhle ekuqondweni okuhlangeneyo kokuphathwa kwezindawo. Ukwazi nge-Supply Chain Management Framework kanye nankqubo yesabelo kahulumeni. Ukulwazi ngemisebenzi yekhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, kanye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukulungisa nokuhlela, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono okubusa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okukhuthaza, amakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo. Ukuba nomotho, ukuqonda, ukwesekwa, ukuthembeka, ukubanga okusha, ukusebenza kanzima kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcanselo, ukuzimotisha, kanye nobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Usiza ngokuhlela, ukumisa isikhathi nokwenza izivivinyo zesimo sezindawo (FCA) kumanani wonke amafasilita womnyango, okuhlanganisa ukubukeka kwamakhempu, izinguqulo zezithombe kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane ngohlobo lwezinto ezizondiwa kanye namaphasela. Bamba futhi uhlanganise imininingwane yesikhundla se-FCA ezibukweni zesimo, kwimibiko kanye nemitshado yokusekela ukuze ibukwe yi-ASD kanye nabaphathi. Siza i-ASD kanye nabaphathi: Ukuphathwa kwezindawo ngemisebenzi yamapoyins na yemini yawo nobuchwepheshe ekkalapha lomsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe futhi ugcine imiyalo kanye nokwabelwa umsebenzi njengokuhoxiwe. Nikeza ingquenza yemisebenzi ekkalapha lezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukubukwa, ukubhala imaminithi, ukubeka amafayela, kanye nokulandula iziphepho, izimiso nezinkombiso. Siza ekubumbeni, ekwaziseni ukuthi okuhlanganiswe kahle nokuposa imibiko yezobuchwepheshe, imibukiso yamathoyizi, izibuko kanye namaphepha amunye okulungiswe ekkalapha lomsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe. Sekele i-ASD kanye nabaphathi ekulawuleni inqubo ye-TFM kanye namaphrojekthi okuphathwa kwezindawo, futhi usize ukulandula izenzo ezingagenwanga, izinguqubalo zesikhathi kanye nezinto ezisuke kwenzeke. Siza ekulungiseni nasekuqoqeni amaphepha okuqoqoqo emihlanganweni, ukubuka izinkambu kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane yezobuchwepheshe, futhi ulandule izinto ezithunyelwe njengoba kuveziwe ngabadala. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze amarekhodi, izibuko namathabulose ahlobene nezivivinyo zesimo sezindawo, izicelo zokulondoloza kanye nemisebenzi yekkalapha lezobuchwepheshe. Siza ngokuhlela nokulungisa izinto zokushova kanye nezokuphatha emabukweni ezinkambu kanye nezihloko ezenziwa ekkalapheni lezobuchwepheshe. Yipha nayiphi enye imisebenzi ethembekileyo njengoba kunikwa i-ASD noma abaphathi: Ukuphathwa kwezindawo ekusekelweni kwemisebenzi yekkalapha lezobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Abaphathi Abaphambili Beemisebenzi: Umncedi/Olxhaso Lwangokobuchwephethhe
xh.summary: Kuncedwa nokuhlola isimo sezimo zokusingathwa nokuhlola iindawo kuzo zonke izimo zesebe, kufuneka kubekho i-diploma yezizwe kwinqanaba le-NQF 06 okanye i-National Diploma kwizifundo zokwakha okanye indawo enxulumeneyo, enyakeni we-3 wamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwexesha leminyaka emithathu esikolweni samabanga aphakamileyo (i-NQF Level 06) / i-National Diploma kwi-Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Civil Engineering/ Structural Engineering okanye izifundo ze-Architectural Studies kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 njengokoqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amaxesha amathathu afanelekileyo amava enkqubo yamandla kwisebe lokwakha emva kokugqiba izifundo. I-License yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi nge-PFMA kunye nemiThethonqubo yoKwakha yoMzwe. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yoKuthenga karhulumente kwindawo yokwakha; ulwazi ngokuchwephethhe lweekhomitydhixi eziphambili ezinxulumene nendlela elungileyo yokwenza izinto kwisebe lokusingathwa iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo. Ulwazi nge-Supply Chain Management Framework nendlela yokuqamba amabhajeti karhulumente Amakhono. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kwi-MS Office (i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS PowerPoint, kunye ne-MS Outlook), amakhono okubhala iingxelo, ukuceba nokuhlela, amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi, amakhono obuqhawe, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okukhuthaza ixesha, amakhono okunxibelelwana okusebenzayo. Ukuba nomonde, kuqondakalise, ethembekile, othembekile, onesiphithiphithi, osebenzela nzima kwaye unokusinda ngokuhlalutya. Ukuba namandla okusebenza ngowomlinge, uzimotivwe, kwaye unolwahlulo.
xh.duties: Nceda ngokuciba, ukumisa umhla nokwenziwa kwe-Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs) kuzo zonke izimo zesebe, kuquka ukuhlola iindawo, iintyatyambo ezithathwa ngamafoto nokuqokelela iinkcukacha ngokubakho kwezinto ezahlulahlulwe eziyakhiweyo nesebe. Tsala kwaye uqhenge iinkcukacha zendawo ye-FCA zibe yimigangatho yoxinzelelo lweemeko, iingxelo namaxwebhu axhasayo ukuze ajongwe ngapha yi-ASD nabaGcini. Nceda i-ASD nabaGcini: Isebe lokulawula iziko ngemisebenzi yangokwentsuku ngokuchwephethhe nengowolawulo kwicandelo lokuchwephethhe kwaye uphumeze imiyalelo nemitjhinyo njengoko umyiwe. Nike ngolawulo iCandelo lokuchwephethhe, kuquka uqoqosho lweqhosha, ukubhala iinguqu, ukugcina amafayile, nokuqokelela iinguqu, izicelo namvume. Nceda kwibhalo, ukumisela kolungelelwaniso nokuqwalasela iingxelo ngokuchwephethhe, iinkcazelo, imigangatho namaxwebhu amaninzi acutshungwa yiCandela lokuchwephethhe. Xhasa i-ASD nabaGcini ekujolweni phambili kwe-TFM nakwiprojekthi zokulawula iziko, kwaye ucedise ekulandeleni iinkqubo ezingagqitywanga, amaxesha okugqiba neenkqubo eziphakamile. Nceda nokuqokelela kwaye ulungelelanise amaxwebhu angokwemibhalo yokubakhona kwamafirana iindawo ezithile nemipumelelo yokuchwephethhe, kwaye ulandele iinkqubo ezithile njengoko umiyelwe ngooMdala. Zigcine kwaye uhlaziye amaxwebhu, izitili namadatabheyisi anxulumene noxinzelelo lwemeko zokusingathwa iziko, izicelo zokwaziswa nemiSebenzi yeCandelo lokuchwephethhe. Nceda ngendlela yokubakhona kwamafirana namaxwebhu ngokuqokelelwa kwindawo yokubakho kweziko nokuqokelelwa kwindawo ezikwindlela ezithile. Yenza nayiphi na eminye imisebenzi enengqondo njengoko umiyiwe yi-ASD okanye abaGcini: Isebe lokulawula iziko ukuxhasa imisebenzi yeCandelo lokuchwephethhe.

jobs.title: Senior Security Officer
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Supervise security officers and service providers at the Mmabatho Regional Office, ensuring adherence to departmental security policies and procedures.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 12 qualification and No experience required. Grade B PSIRA. Knowledge of access control procedures, measures for the control and movement of equipment and stores, prescribed security procedures (e.g. MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, etc.) and the authority of security officers under these documents, relevant emergency procedure. Effective communication, analytical and numerical skills, organisation and planning, ability to meet deadlines, ability to work in a team, interpersonal skills, problem solving, motivational skills, computer literate, ability to operate equipment and machines. Analytical thinking, ability to work under stressful situations, ability to communicate at all levels, good interpersonal relationship and hard-working.
jobs.duties: Supervise the security functions performed by the security officers/service providers, ensuring adherence to department security policies: Allocate duties to security officers/service providers, monitor outcomes and institute the necessary corrective measures to address deviations from norms and standards. Monitor access control to prevent unauthorized entry in buildings and other premises. Authorisation of the equipment, documents and stores into or out of the building or premises, Inspect and report all none functioning of security measures (e.g. XRay machines, Walk-through metal detectors, security lights and etc.). Check incidents/occurrence books/registers. Monitor and provide support in case of emergencies. Render administrative and related functions, Determine rosters, shift schedules and overtime. Monitor performance of employees and determine training needs. Control leave and related personnel matters in line with HR procedures and prescripts. Provide security related services. Administer key control system. Identify risks and threats to the security of the department. Provide information regarding incidents to investigating officers. Monitor and respond to alarm system. Report faulty equipment/systems. Ensure systems are functioning optimally through scheduled services. Conduct preliminary incident investigations and submit reports. Administer all control room operations to safeguard the department’s assets, Supervise all control room activities. Report all incidents and any identified non-compliance relating to security prescripts. Review of footages upon request through proper procedure. Update all registers for the incidents observed.

Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only.
