Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a Single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Sekerheidsbeampte
af.summary: Hou toesig oor sekuriteitsbeamptes en diensverskaffers by die Mmabatho Streekkantoor, en verseker nakoming van departementele sekuriteitsbeleid en prosedures.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 12-kwalifikasie en geen ervaring word vereis. Grade B PSIRA. Kennis van toegangsbeheerprosedures, maatreëls vir die beheer en beweging van toerusting en winkels, voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsprosedures (bv. MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, ens.) en die gesag van sekuriteitsbeamptes kragtens hierdie dokumente, ter sake noodprocedure. Effektiewe kommunikasie, analitiese en numeriese vaardighede, organisasie en beplanning, vermoë om sperdatums te haal, vermoë om in 'n span te werk, interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing, motiveringsvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid, vermoë om toerusting en masjiene te bedryf. Analitiese denke, vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk, vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en ywerig.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die sekuriteitsfunksies wat deur sekuriteitsbeamptes/diensverskaffers uitgevoer word, en verseker nakoming van departementele sekuriteitsbeleid: Ken take toe aan sekuriteitsbeamptes/diensverskaffers, monitor uitkomste en stel die nodige korrektiewe maatreëls in om afwykings van norme en standaarde aan te spreek. Monitor toegangsbeheer om ongemagtigde toegang tot geboue en ander persele te voorkom. Magtiging van toerusting, dokumente en winkels in of uit die gebou of perseel, Inspekteer en rapporteer alle nie-funksionering van sekuriteitsmaatreëls (bv. XRay-masjiene, deurgang-metaalverklikkers, sekuriteitsligte ens.). Kontroleer voorvalle/voorvalboeke/registers. Monitor en bied ondersteuning in geval van noodlewens. Verskaf administratiewe en verwante funksies, Bepaal roosters, skofskedules en oortyd. Monitor prestasie van werknemers en bepaal opleidingsbehoeftes. Beheer verlof en verwante personeelsake in ooreenstemming met HR-prosedures en voorskrifte. Verskaf sekuriteitsverwante dienste. Administreer sleutelbeheerstelsel. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die sekuriteit van die departement. Verskaf inligting aangaande voorvalle aan ondersoekbeamptes. Monitor en reageer op alarmsisteme. Rapporteer defekte toerusting/stelsels. Verseker dat stelsels optimaal funksioneer deur geskeduleerde dienste. Voer voorlopige voorvalondersoeke uit en dien verslae in. Administreer alle beheerkamer-bedrywighede om die departement se bates te beskerm, Hou toesig oor alle beheerkamer-aktiwiteite. Rapporteer alle voorvalle en enige geïdentifiseerde nie-nakoming met betrekking tot sekuriteitsvoorskrifte. Hersien van beeldmateriaal op versoek deur behoorlike prosedure. Dateer alle registers vir waargenome voorvalle op.

zu.title: Inkulu EnoMthelela Wezokuvikela
zu.summary: Qapha abahlinzeki bezokuvikela kanye nezikhulu zezokuvikela eMmabatho Regional Office, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuhlonishwa izinqubomgomo nezindlela zomnyango mayelana nezokuvikela.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuphela kwamabanga asiye ngaphansi kwe-Grade 12 futhi asikho isidingo senkambiso. I-Grade B PSIRA. Ulwazi ngendlela zokulawula ukungena, izindlela zokulawula kanye nokunyakaza kwemishini nezimpahla, izindlela ezibekiwe zezokuvikela (isb. i-MISS, i-NISA, i-Protection of Information Act, njl.) kanye namandla ezikhulu zezokuvikela ngaphansi kwale mibhalo, kanye nendlela ehambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, amakhono okuhlaziya nakubala, ukuhlela nokuhlela isikhathi, ikhono lokufeza izikhathi ezibekiwe, ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini, amakhono okuxhumana nalabo abahlala nabo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okukhuthaza, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ikhono lokuphatha imishini namathuluzi. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ikhono lokusebenza emimeni ephanayo, ikhono lokuxhumana emazingeni wonke, ubudlelwano obuhle nalabo abahlala nabo kanye nokusebenza ngamandla.
zu.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yezokuvikela ebenywe izikhulu zezokuvikela/abahlinzeki, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuhlonishwa izinqubomgomo zomnyango mayelana nezokuvikela: Abela izikhulu zezokuvikela/abahlinzeki imisebenzi, qapha iziphetho ubuye ufake izinyathelo zokulungisa ezidingekayo ukubhekana nokwenyuka kwemithethonqubo namazinga. Qapha ukulawula ukungena ukuvimbela ukungena okungavunyiwe emakadeni nasezindaweni ezinye. Imvume yokusa imishini, amadokhumenti nezimpahla ezingaphandle nangaphakathi kwesakhiwo noma endaweni, hlole ubuye umbike noma yikuphi okungasebenzi kwezinyathelo zokuvikela (isb. izimoto ze-XRay, abahlohli besimbiya abangadluli kubo, amafifi ezokuvikela njl.). Hlola izingozi/izincwadi zezenzakalo/iziqhengqethi. Qapha unikeze inketho ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Yenza imisebenzi yabahlinzeki nezinye ezihlobene nayo, Quma izikhathi zokuqala nokuyeka, imishini yokushintshana namahora angaphezulu. Qapha inkambiso yabasebenzi uze uqume izidingo zokuqeqesha. Lawula ukukhishwa kweholide nezinye izindaba zomuntu ngokuqondana nezinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho ye-HR. Nikeza izinsiza ezihlobene nezokuvikela. Phatha indlela yokulawula amakhikheli. Hlola izingozi kanye nezinsongo ezibheke ezokuvikeleni komnyango. Nikeza ulwazi ngobungozi bazikali bezengozi. Qapha uphendule isistimu yamaholo (alamu). Bika imishini/izistimu ezingasebenzi kahle. Qinisekisa amasistimu asebenza kahle ngokuphepha ngezinsiza ezingezwa isikhathi. Yenza ukuphenya kwangaphambili ngezenzakalo uphinde uhambise imibiko. Lawula konke ukusebenza kwegumbi lokulawula ukuze uvikele impahla komnyango, Qapha konke okwenziwa egumbini lokulawula. Bika yonke imengozi noma yikuphi okungahambisana nemithetho okubonwe okuhlobene nezokuvikela. Buka izinkathi zokuqopha ngemibuzo ngendlela elungile. Buyekeza wonke amaqhengqethi ngezenzakalo eziboniwe.

xh.title: Isikhululi Esiphezulu SokuKhuseleka
xh.summary: Lawula abakhululi bokhuseleko nabahanisiweenkonzzo ebesiKikiliza saseMmabatho Regional Office, kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kweenkqubo ezichaza ikhuseleko zesabe namanyathelo azo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-12 ubuncinane kwaye akukho mfundo idingekayo. Isidanga B sePSIRA. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolawulo lokungena, iinyathelo zolawulo nokuhamba kwemisebenzi nezitishi, iinkqubo ezibekiweyo zokhuseleko (umz. iMISS, iNISA, iProtection of Information Act, njl.) nelayithorithi abakhululi bokhuseleko bayinayo phantsi kwalamaxwebhu, iinkqubo ezithile zomngxuma. Ukunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo, amakhono e-analitiki namanani, ukuqamba nokuhlela, ikhono lokugqiba ngomhla, ikhono lokusebenza eqelongweni, amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okukhuthaza, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ikhono lokusebenzisa izixhobo nomatshini. Ukucinga ngokudidiyela, ikhono lokusebenza kwiimeko ezinomsindo, ikhono lokunxibelelana kwazo zonke iinqanaba, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu nokusebenza nzima.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo zokhuseleko ezenziwa ngabakhululi bokhuseleko/abahanisiweenkonzzo, kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kweenkqubo zokhuseleko zesabe: Nagaba imisebenzi kubakhululi bokhuseleko/abahanisiweenkonzzo, lindela iziphumo uze usebenzise iinyathelo zokulungisa ezifunekayo ukujongana nokuphela kwemigaqo namazinga. Lindela ulawulo lokungela ukuthintelwa ukungena kwabantu abangenelayo kwiakhozhi nakuwezinye iindawo. Ukuvumela izixhobo, amaxwebhu nezitishi ukuba zingena okanye ziphume kwakhozhi okanye kwindawo, Hlola uze uxelo ngezo zixhobo zokhuseleko ezingasebenzi (umz. iimoto zeXRay, iWalk-through metal detectors, iibhaluni zokhuseleko njl.). Jonga iincwadi zezenzo/ezentsekiso/iirejista. Lindela uze unike inkxaso xa kunomngxuma. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo nendlela eqhotyoshelayo, Misela irosta, iinkqubo zoshift namahora abavayo. Lindela inkqubo yabasebenzi uze umisele iimfuno zokuzilolonga. Lawula iholo nemiba yabasebenzi exhoke kumaxwebhu nemiqathango ye-HR. Bonezela iinkonzo ezinxulumene nokhuseleko. Lawula inkqubo yolawulo loqagela. Bonakalisa iingozi nangoyiko esikhuselekweni sesabe. Nikezela ngolwazi ngezenko kumaphoyisa ophenyo. Lindela uze uphendule kwindlela yokhuseleko. Xela izixhobo/iinkqubo ezingasebenzi kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zisebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo ezijcwelwe ngaphambili. Zenza uphenyo lokuqala lwezenko uze ugcwalise iinxelo. Lawula zonke iinkqubo zegumbi lolawulo ukhusele izinto zesabe, Lawula yonke imisebenzi yegumbi lolawulo. Xela yonke iinkcenkcesho nasiphi na isigaba esingahambelaniyo nezibhalo zokhuseleko. Phinda ubuke iifuthu kumcelo ngokulandela inkqubo echanekileyo. Hlaziya yonke iirejista ngeenkcenkcesho ezebabonwa.

jobs.title: Officer: RED Tape Reduction
jobs.closing_date_text: 16 November 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Administrative officer supporting red tape reduction through policy research, stakeholder consultation and regulatory analysis at the Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF 6) in Economics / Public Administration / Developmental Studies / Social Science / Business Management or equivalent / related as recognised by SAQA. Minimum of 1 year of administrative experience in a stakeholder consultation environment with specific focus on communication techniques. Knowledge and understanding of legislation, policies and regulatory frameworks applicable to MSMEs, Co-operatives and Informal Businesses, including initiatives aimed at reducing red tape and improving the ease of doing business. Understanding of public policy development, policy analysis and regulatory review processes. Knowledge of research methodologies, data collection, analysis and impact assessment. Understanding of public administration and intergovernmental coordination processes. Knowledge of stakeholder consultation, public participation and engagement processes. Understanding of project and programme implementation, monitoring and reporting. Knowledge and understanding of the small enterprise development environment and the factors affecting the growth and development of MSMEs, Co-operatives and Informal Businesses. Job related skills: Research, data collection, data analysis and interpretation. Ability to identify, analyse and document regulatory and administrative bottlenecks affecting MSMEs, Co-operatives and Informal Businesses. Report writing, information synthesis and presentation. Stakeholder consultation, facilitation and information-sharing techniques. Project coordination, planning and administration. Monitoring, evaluation and progress reporting. Preparation of evidence-based recommendations and briefing documents. Ability to coordinate activities and compile information across national, provincial and local government spheres and other relevant stakeholders. Job competencies: Communication (Written and Verbal), Interpersonal skills. Attention to detail and Problem Solving. Project Management. Stakeholder Engagement. Service delivery and innovation. Networking. Programme Design and Delivery. Client orientation and customer focus. Planning, organising and prioritisation. Computer literacy (MS Office Packages), Policy Development, Project Management and a driver’s licence will be considered an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Conduct research on impacting factors in support of policy or programme development inclusive of but not limited to Desktop research, literature review and primary research (research design, survey design, data collection and analysis), and ongoing analysis of the key challenges, needs, and trends. Liaise with stakeholders across government to share best practices and collect status updates on red tape reduction initiatives. Provide support and contribute to the development of mechanisms, tools, programmes or improvement of concepts, theories and operational methods for Entrepreneurs and MSMEs inclusive of but not limited to developing SOPs, Templates and Database maintenance. Conduct performance monitoring inspections to determine compliance. Communicate with internal, external and colleagues; draft general correspondence such as response letters, emails, status report, presentations, memos, and submissions. Give advice on procedural and technical-related matters to ensure compliance. Provide general administrative and logistical support to the business unit, minute-taking during stakeholder meetings. Logistical support during events/workshops/meetings. etc. Procurement of goods and services (catering, venues, etc.).
jobs.enquiries: Enquiries for all advertised posts should be directed to the recruitment office Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by email to the relevant email and by quoting the relevant reference number provided on the subject line. Acceptable formats for submission of documents are limited to MS Word and PDF. Candidates must submit applications to recruitment8@dsbd.gov.za and quote the reference number for the above-mentioned position in the subject line (email) when applying, i.e. “REF NO: ORTR”
jobs.notes: The Department of Small Business Development is committed to the pursuit of diversity and redress, and appointment will be in line with the DSBD EE Plan. Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a recent comprehensive CV. Submission of copies of qualifications, Identity document, and any other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All non-SA citizens will be required to submit proof of permanent residence in South Africa when shortlisted. Personnel suitability checks will be done during the selection process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. In the pursuit of diversity and redress, appointments will be made in line with the DSBD EE Plan. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. The Department reserves the right not to fill or withdraw any advertised post. Note: a new application for employment (Z83) form is applicable from 01 January 2021. The new form can be downloaded online at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp. OTHER POST

af.title: Beampte: Red Tape Reduction
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat red tape-reduksie ondersteun deur beleidsondersoek, belanghebbende-konsultasie en regulatoriese ontleding by die Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Ekonomie / Publieke Administrasie / Ontwikkelingstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Besigheidsbestuur of gelykwaardig / verwant soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van 1 jaar se administratiewe ervaring in 'n belanghebbende-konsultasie-omgewing met spesifieke fokus op kommunikasietegnieke. Kennis en begrip van wetgewing, beleide en regulatoriese raamwerke van toepassing op MKME's, Koöperasies en Informele Besighede, insluitend inisiatiewe wat gemik is op die vermindering van red tape en die verbetering van die gemak van besigheid doen. Begrip van openbare beleidsontwikkeling, beleidsontleding en regulatoriese hersieningsprosesse. Kennis van navorsingsmetodes, data-insameling, ontleding en impakassessering. Begrip van openbare administrasie en intergovernmentele koördinasie-prosesse. Kennis van belanghebbende-konsultasie, openbare deelname en betrokkenheidsprosesse. Begrip van projek- en programimplementering, monitering en verslagdoening. Kennis en begrip van die klein-ondernemingsontwikkelingsomgewing en die faktore wat die groei en ontwikkeling van MKME's, Koöperasies en Informele Besighede beïnvloed. Werksverwante vaardighede: Navorsing, data-insameling, data-ontleding en -interpretasie. Vermoë om regulatoriese en administratiewe knelpunte wat MKME's, Koöperasies en Informele Besighede raak, te identifiseer, ontleed en dokumenteer. Verslagskrywing, inligtingsintese en aanbieding. Belanghebbende-konsultasie, fasilitering en inligtingsdelingstegnieke. Projekoördinasie, beplanning en administrasie. Monitering, evaluering en vorderingsverslagdoening. Voorbereiding van getuiggebaseerde aanbevelings en briefingsdokumente. Vermoë om aktiwiteite te koördineer en inligting oor nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regeringsfere en ander relevante belanghebbendes saam te stel. Werksbevoegdhede: Kommunikasie (Skriftelik en Mondelings), Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Aandag aan besonderhede en probleemoplossing. Projekbestuur. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Dienslewering en innovering. Netwerkwerk. Programontwerp en -levering. Kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus. Beplanning, organisering en prioritisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office-pakkette), Beleidsontwikkeling, Projekbestuur en 'n bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word.
af.duties: Voer navorsing uit oor impakfaktore ter ondersteuning van beleids- of programontwikkeling, insluitend maar nie beperk nie tot lessenaarnavorsing, literatuuroorsig en primêre navorsing (navorsingsontwerp, opname-ontwerp, data-insameling en -ontleding), en deurlopende ontleding van die kernuitdagings, behoeftes en tendense. Skakel met belanghebbendes oor die regering heen om beste praktyke te deel en statusopdaterings oor red tape-reduksie-inisiatiewe in te samel. Verskaf ondersteuning en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van meganismes, instrumente, programme of verbetering van konsepte, teorieë en operasionele metodes vir Entrepreneurs en MKME's, insluitend maar nie beperk nie tot die ontwikkeling van SOP's, sjablone en databasonderhoud. Voer prestasiemoniteringsinspeksies uit om nakoming te bepaal. Kommunikeer met interne, eksterne en kollegas; opstel van algemene korrespondensie soos antwoordbriewe, e-posse, statusverslae, aanbiedings, memo's en voorleggings. Gee advies oor prosedurele en tegnies-verwante aangeleenthede om nakoming te verseker. Verskaf algemene administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuning aan die besigheidseenheid, notule neem tydens belanghebbende-vergaderings. Logistieke ondersteuning tydens geleenthede/werkswinkels/vergaderings. ens. Verkryging van goedere en dienste (katering, plekke, ens.).

zu.title: Ihhovisi: Ukuncipha kwe-RED Tape
zu.summary: Ihhovisi lokuphatha elisekela ukuncipha kwamaphuzu abomvu ngephini lokucwaninga amapholisi, ukuxoxa nabahlanganyeli kanye nokuhlaziya imithetholwazi eDepartment of Small Business Development ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe (NQF 6) ku-Economics / Public Administration / Developmental Studies / Social Science / Business Management noma okulinganayo / okuhlobene nakho njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-1 yohlu lokusebenza lokuphatha endaweni yokuxoxa nabahlanganyeli nokuqamba ikhono lokuxhumana. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwemithetho, amapholisi namaphwebu omtsetfo afakelwa kuma-MSME, ama-Co-operatives kanye nezinkampani ezingalawulwa, kuhlanganise izinhlelo ezihlose ukunciphisa amaphuzu abomvu nokuthuthukisa lula ukwenza umabhizinisi. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwamapholisi omphakathi, ukuhlaziya amapholisi kanye nokuqagela imithetholwazi. Ulwazi lwegasu lokucwaninga, ukuqoqa idatha, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuqagela umthelela. Ukuqonda ukuphatha komphakathi nokuqondanisa phakathi kawomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuxoxa nabahlanganyeli, ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nokuqondisa. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuqalisa ukwenziwa, ukuqapha kanye nokubika. Ulwazi nokuqonda isimo sokuthuthukiswa kwezinkampani ezincane kanye namaphuzu athe ukuthinta ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kuma-MSME, ama-Co-operatives kanye nezinkampani ezingalawulwa. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucwaninga, ukuqoqa idatha, ukuhlaziya idatha nokuqondakalisa. Ukukwazi ukuhlola, ukuhlaziya futhi ubhale ukubekwa komthetho kanye nezinkinga ezithinta izinhlelo kuma-MSME, ama-Co-operatives kanye nezinkampani ezingalawulwa. Ukubhala imibiko, ukuhlanganisa ulwazi kanye nokwethula. Indlela yokuxoxa nabahlanganyeli, ukuqondisa nokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukuqondanisa, ukulungelela kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuqapha, ukuhlola kanye nokubika inqubo. Ukuhlunga izinkomba ezenzelwe ukusekela imibiko. Ukukwazi ukuqondanisa izinkalo kanye nokuqoqa ulwazi kulo lonke izinga likahulumeni kazwelonke, nyanga kanye nasedolobheni nasabahlanganyeli abakhona. Amaphuzu okusebenza: Ukuxhumana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo), amakhono okwabelana nabantu. Ukunakela imininingwane nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuhlangana nabahlanganyeli. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza nokuba buhle. Ukwakha ukuxhumana. Ukulungelela nokuqalisa izinhlelo. Ukuqondiswa ngomthengi ukuqondisa. Ukulungelela, ukuhlela nokubeka phambili. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office Packages), ukuthuthukiswa kwamapholisi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nelayisensi yokushayela kuzothathwa njengenye inketho.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo ngamaphuzu athe utshele ukuthuthukiswa kwephini noma inkalo kuhlanganise kodwa angakhawulelwa ekucwaningeni ngedesikithophu, ukuhlola imibhalo kanye nocwaningo lokuqala (ukulungiselela ucwaningo, ukulungiselela isifanekiselo, ukuqoqa kanye nokuhlaziya idatha), kanye nokuqhubekayo ukuhlaziya izinkinga ezibalulekile, izidingo, kanye namaphuzu abhalwe ngawo. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli kulo lonke uhulumene ukwabelana ngendlela ehamba phambili futhi uqoqe izibika zesimo ngezinhlelo zokunciphisa amaphuzu abomvu. Nikeza isisekelo futhi useke ekuthuthukiseni izindlela, izinsiza, izinhlelo noma ekuphuculeni imibono, imibhalo kanye nendlela zokusebenza kubashayela bhizinisi nakuma-MSME kuhlanganise kodwa ungakhawulelwa ekuthuthukiseni ama-SOP, ama-Template kanye nokugcina ukubhaliswa kolwazi. Yenza ukuqapha kokusebenza ukuze uhlole ukuziphendula. Xhumana nabangaphakathi, bangaphandle kanye nabasebenzi; bhalela ukuxhumana okuvamile njengemibhalo yokuphendula, ama-email, imibiko yesimo, izibanku, izinkomba, kanye neziphoqi. Nikeza advice ngokuba nengqondo kochwepheshe ngakho ukunqoba ukuziphendula. Nikeza isisekelo sokuphatha nokuhlela izinto kulesibhokhwe lebhizinisi, ukuthatha amaminithi kuhlangano yabahlanganyeli. Isisekelo sokuhlela izinto ngesikhathi sezinhlelo/amaseminari/kuhlangano. njll. Ukuze idingwe kugidwe izimpahla kanye nezinsiza (ukudla, izindawo, njll).

xh.title: Iofisa: Ukunciphisa i-RED Tape
xh.summary: Iofisa olulawulo exhasa ukunciphisa i-red tape ngophando lweenkqubo, kuqwalaselo kwabanomdla kwaye ngohlalutyo lolawulo kwi-Department of Small Business Development e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi-Economics / Public Administration / Developmental Studies / Social Science / Business Management okwayinzinyana / eqhagamshelanayo njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA. Ukwaziswa okungaphezulu kwe-1 yonyaka woluve lokusebenza kulawulo kwimeko yokuqwalasela abanomdla ngokujolisa ngokweziguqulo kwiindlela zoxhumo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kolawulo, iinkqubo neesakhiwo zolawulo ezisebenza kwi-MSMEs, i-Co-operatives nezoShishino ezingalawulanga, kuquka neemba ezijoliswe ekunciphiseni i-red tape nokuphucula ukulula kokwenza ushishino. Ukuqonda ukusungulwa kweenkqubo zikawonke-wonke, ukuhlalutywa kweenkqubo kwaye kuqwalaselwe iinkqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi lwendlela zophando, kuqokelelwa kwedata, uhlalutyo nokulinganisa Impelo. Ukuqonda kulawulo lukawonke-wonke kwaye kuhlangenwe nxeba iinkqubo zo-luntu. Ulwazi lokubaqwalasela abanomdla, ukuthathana-nxaxheba koluntu kwaye kwenziwe iinkqubo zothabatho-nxaxheba. Ukuqonda ukusebenza koluntu kolwazi kwaye nokuqonda ukuphunyezwa, ukuqwalaselwa nokubika. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwindawo yokusetyenziswa koluntu kolwazi iinkqubo neemba ezithintela nokuba zithe rhoqo nzima kokukhula kwexesha elifutshane phakathi kwamashishini amancinci aphuhlisa i-MSMEs, i-Co-operatives ne-Shishini ezingalawulanga. Ukusebenza ngamakhono: Uphando, ukuqokelelwa kwedata, ukuhlalutywa nokutolika idata. Ulwazi lokuchonga, uhlalutyo kwaye kutshatshaliswe iirekhodi zolawulo nezithintelo ezithintela i-MSMEs, i-Co-operatives kwaye ne-Shishini ezingalawulanga. Ukubhala iiripoti, iindlela zokudibanisa ulwazi kwaye kubhalwe izibizo. Ukuqwalasela abanomdla, ukulungelelanisa kwaye kuthintwe iindlela zokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukuqhagamshelana koluntu, ulawulo lweeprojekthi, nokuqwalaselwa koluntu. Ukubika ngokuqhuba, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela. Ukulungelelanisa ii-activities kwaye kuqokelelwe ulwazi kuzo zonke iindawo zabaholi behlabathi nakubanomdla. Iimpawu zokusebenza: Unxibelelwano (olubhaliweyo noluthethwayo), amakhono obuntu. Ukunaka iinkcukacha nokuzisombulula. Ulawulo lweenkqubo. Ukuthintana nxaxheba. Ukuphuculwa kwesevisi nempumelelo. Ukudibanisa. Ukulungiselela iinkqubo. Ukuqwalasela uluntu. Ulungelelwaniso, ukulungelelanisa nokugqwesa iimpawu zokuqala. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha (i-MS Office Packages), ukuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo, ulawulo lweenkqubo kunye nelayisenisi yokuqhuba kuya kuthathwa njengesongezo.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando kwiimpawu ezinamandla ekuxhaseni ukusungulwa kwenkqubo okanye enkqubo kuquka kodwa ungathintelwa kuphando lweDesktop, ukuphonononga iliterature kwaye uphando lweqondo elingundoqo (ukulungiselela uphando, ukulungiselela isurve, ukuqokelelwa kwedata nokuqokelelwa kwedata), kwaye kuqhubeka ukuhlalutywa kweekhalengi ezibalulekileyo, iimfuno, kwaye kuqhutywa iintshukumo. Thintana nabano mdla kuzo zonke iindawo zoluntu ukwabelana ngamakhono amakhulu kwaye uqokele iindaba ezintsha ngokunciphisa i-red tape. Nikeza inkxaso kwaye uncedise ukusungulwa kweendidi, amathuba, iinkqubo okanye ukuphucula iinkqubo, iinkqubo ngeendidi ngeendidi, iindlela zokusebenza kubazimexeshi kwi-MSMEs ngokusungulwa kolwazi lweSOPs, iiTemplates nokulungiselela iDatabase. Yenza ukuqwalaselwa ngokusebenza kwesevisi kwaye uqonde ukulandela iinkqubo. Thintana nangaphakathi, ngaphandle nakwabasebenzi; bhala iincwadi ezinjengokwazisa iincwadi, i-imeyile, iiripoti zolawulo, izibizo, kwaye ezenziwe ngapantsi. Nikeza ingcebiso malunga ngeenkqubo ngeendaba eziqukethwe teknikhali ukuqinisekisa ukuzilandela iinkqubo. Nikeza inkxaso ekuqwalaselwa kwaseburhulumenteni kwaye kubhalwe imizuzu kwiminye yabalawuli. Inkxaso ekuyiyo xa kwenzakala iimixholo ezinkulu / iingqungquthela / ukubakwa kwaye. Ukuhlela kweziqu izinto ezisetyenziswa ngosuku ngesixhobo esingu-catering okanye izithuba.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk Supervisor
jobs.centre: Division: Technology Management Services – Head Office Section: Data Centre Management and Hosting Services
jobs.city: Data Centre Management and Hosting Services
jobs.summary: Supervise administration within the SAPS Data Centre Management section, coordinating SLA documentation and information consolidation at Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post; Be fluent in at least two of the official languages, of which one must be English; Applicants will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening and fingerprint verification; Must have no criminal record or pending criminal/ departmental cases; Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF Level 4 as recognized by SAQA). The following will serve as added advantage: At least four (4) years’ relevant experience in an administrative environment; Experience within an ICT, Data Centre Management, Hosting Services or similar technical environment will also serve as an added advantage; An applicable three (3) year Diploma / Degree (NQF level 6 or higher as recognized by SAQA) as well as relevant training courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage. A valid driver’s license Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of relevant prescripts applicable to the Public Service. Good verbal and written communication skills. General Computer literacy (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Report writing. Presentation Skills, Problem Solving, Sound Planning, Organising and Administration skills, Strong Analytical Skills and Facilitation Skills. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: Assist with the general administration and coordination of the following duties within the section: collecting, consolidating and maintaining information and documentation required for the development of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) for Data Centre Management; collecting and consolidating information for the development of standards and policies for Data Centre Management and Hosting Services ;Provide administrative coordination and support relating to backup, data centre and associated Hosting Services activities. Manage and utilize all resources allocated to the immediate post environment in accordance with the relevant prescripts.
jobs.enquiries: can be directed to: Lt Col G Xoko //Captain WD Maimela / PO J Nkadimeng Tel No: (012) 432 7709/ 8884/ 7964
jobs.applications: Application forms must be hand delivered or emailed to the following Email Address: tms.vacancies@saps.gov.za OR hand deliver to Office No. PPS 138/143; 1234 Tulbagh Park Building; Cnr. Stanza Bopape (Church) and Jan Shoba (Duncan) Streets; Hatfield, Pretoria
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS, will be expected to undergo a personal interview and shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct). Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short- listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POST

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk Toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor administrasie binne die SAPS Data Centre Management-afdeling, koördineer SLA-dokumentasie en inligtingskonsolidasie by Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos; Wees vloeiend in ten minste twee van die amptelike tale, waarvan een Engels moet wees; Aansoekers sal onderwerp word aan 'n ondersoekproses wat veiligheidskeuring en vingerafdrukverifikasie sal insluit; Mag geen strafblad of hangende strafregtelike/ departementele sake hê nie; Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud gelewer moet word. Besit 'n Graad 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF Level 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Die volgende sal as bykomende voordeel dien: Ten minste vier (4) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing; Ervaring binne 'n ICT-, Data Centre Management-, Hosting Services- of soortgelyke tegniese omgewing sal ook as 'n bykomende voordeel dien; 'n Toepaslike drie (3)-jaar Diploma / Degree (NQF level 6 of hoër soos deur SAQA erken) asook relevante opleidingskursusse in die veld van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van relevante voorskrifte van toepassing op die Openbare Diens. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede. Algemene rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossing, Bevlykte Beplanning, Organisasie en Administrasie vaardighede, Sterk Analitiese Vaardighede en Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Wees gewillig om onder druk en verlengde ure te werk.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die algemene administrasie en koördinasie van die volgende pligte binne die afdeling: die insamel, konsolideer en onderhou van inligting en dokumentasie wat vereis word vir die ontwikkeling van die Service Level Agreement (SLA) vir Data Centre Management; die insamel en konsolideer van inligting vir die ontwikkeling van standaarde en beleide vir Data Centre Management en Hosting Services ;Verskaf administratiewe koördinasie en ondersteuning rakende rugsteun, data sentrum en geassosieerde Hosting Services-aktiwiteite. Bestuur en benut alle hulpbronne wat aan die onmiddellike posomgewing toegeken is in ooreenstemming met die relevante voorskrifte.

zu.title: Umphathi Womhloli Wobaqhashi Bezokulawula
zu.summary: Qapha izokulawula ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokulawula Isikhungo Sedatha se-SAPS, ukuqambathisa ukulungiselwa kumayunifomu phakathi ne-HQ.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kufanele babonise ikhono kumisebenzi eyisiseko yesikhundla; Bakwazi ukukhuluma kahulu izilimi ezisemthethweni okungenani ezimbili, okuyilodwa kuzo kufanele sibe isiNgisi; Abafakwayo bazobekwe esibukweni okuzofaka ukuhlolwa kokuvikeleka kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezigxivizo zeminwe; Kungabi nomlando webubhi noma izindaba zebubhi ezingekaqedwa noma ezomnyango; Abe ngumakade waseRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika okufanele abekhombise iziqiniseko ezibhalwe njengosuku olungena esikhungweni sokukhulumisana. Abe nokuthola ibhajulaphedi lesiFundazwe lesi-12/ Isatifikedi Ephakeme / i-NCV Level 4 noma iziqu ezilinganayo (NQF Level 4 njengabukwa yi-SAQA). Okulandelayo kuzosiza njengento enenzuzo: Uhlolojinge oluhlobene nokuba khona ukugcwele, ukusebenza kohlelo, izinkonzo zokusingathwa idatha noma izinkalo ezinhle eziyisibonelo eziphakathi nendawo eyinkimbinkimbi eze-ICT, okuzoba nzuzo: idiploma/ ibhajulaphedi okulingene neminyaka emi-3 noma efoleneyo eqinisekisiweyo njengasemthethweni-6 womtheo wamakhono we-South African Qualifications Authority. Ulwazi kumayunifomu kanye nokuba nokwazi ukulawula kanye nekhono elinhle lokukhuluma nokubhala emsebenzini wezomphakathi. Khono elidlulelo lokusebenzisa inqwaba yezinsizakuxhumana. Khono lokuhlola amapulani, ukwelula nokuba nesandla esigqilini emibikweni yolwazi. Thobela izigaba ezithile, ukuze kubuyekezwe uhlelo nokusungula amagugu emisebenzi, izigaxa namaphoyisa ekuqondakaliseni uhlelo lokusebenza. Isatifikidi se-conducter's license
zu.duties: Kusiza ngohlelo lwezokulawula oluvamile nokuqambisa imisebenzi elandelayo ngaphakathi kwesigaba: ukuqoqa, ukwenza ibhalo elilodwa kanye nokugcina ulwazi namaphasiya okudingekayo ekwakhiweni kozibophiso Lokuvikela Ukusingathwa kwabathintelayo, Ukutholakala Kwedatha, Ukusingathwa Kwamasevisi, noma okufanayo; ukutholakala kolwazi emhlabeni wesibhedlela ngokusemthethweni nangokukhulumisana ngendlela eqotho nokusebenzela ngokusheshe ngokusemthethweni wokusebenza.

xh.title: Mphathi Womcebisi Wolawulo
xh.summary: Ukuqondisa ulawulo ngaphakathi kwisebe loLawulo lweSikhulu SeZibalo seSAPS, ngokulungelelanisa uxwebhu lweSLA nokuqokelelwa kolwazi kwindawo yokuHlala iNtloko.
xh.requirements: Abafakelwayo kufunze babonise ukuzipatha kumsebenzi osemoyeni wesithuba; Bakwazi ukuthetha ngokuvakalayo ngalo nangaphezu kwelinye kweelwimi ezisemthethweni, apho enye kuzo kufuneka ibeNgesi; Abafakelwayo baya kujongwa ngqo ngokukhuselwa naloluviwe kuyandathwa nasemva kwalo lungisa inqanaba; Makangabi noludwaxa nangaba nalawo atsha akanyangekanga osemthethweni/nasebesebenzi; Makabe ngumZi welizwe leMzantsi Afrika, apho kaloku ufakelo lolwazi olubhalisiweyo luya kubekwa ngemini yomjongano. Makabe nesiMigaqwe 12/ iNqanaba leSenior/ iNCV Level 4 okanye isimangaliso esilinganayo (NQF Level 4 njengokuqatshiwe yiSAQA). Oku kulandelayo kuya kubakho ngenzuzo ekongezelelweyo: Ukuba ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezine (4) zemfundo/ukwazi kwinkonzo yolawulo; Ulwazi ngaphakathi kwe-ICT, uLawulo lweData Centre, iNkonzo yokuHlala okanye indalo efanayo yenkqubo ekwakho inkalo nayo eza kubakho ngenzuzo ekongezelelweyo; iDiploma/ iNqanaba leNyanga ezintathu (3) okanye eliphezulu ngokwazi (NQF level 6 okanye ngaphezulu njengokuqatshiwe yiSAQA) efanayo, nakuphi na ukulungiselela kwamakhosi anechweba lesithuba kuya kuba nenzuzo ekongezelelweyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni Ulwazi, Amakhono, aNcedo: Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi afanele aNkonzo kaRhulumente. Amakhono amnandi okuthetha nokuBhala. Ulwazi ngokuSebenzisa iKompyutha kwelizwe (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Ukubonisa ukuzipatha okuzimeleyo, okoBungcali, okoNxiba nxaxheba nokuThemba. Amakhono amnandi okuthetha nokuBhala. Amakhono anobudlelwane obuqinileyo. UkuBhala iNgxelo. AmakhonookuBonisa oNgeniso, oKusombulula iingxaki, oKuqamba iNgcaphephe, oLungelelanisa nawoLawulo, amakhono okuHlola anamandla aqinileyo nawokuNcedisa. Mkushiye ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nangemithetho egqwesayo.
xh.duties: Uncedisa ngolawulo jikelele nangokulungelelanisa oku kulandelayo ngaphakathi kwesebe: ukuqokelela, ukuHlanganisa nokugcina ulwazi naxwebhu oludingekayo lokuthatha inkbawu ye-Service Level Agreement (SLA) yoluLawulo lweData Centre; ukuqokelela nokuHlanganisa ulwazi ngokubeka amagqabantshintshi aqamba iNgcaphephe ngoluLawulo lweData Centre ngeeNkonzo zokuHlala ;unikela ngeLungelelaniso lolawulo ngenkxaso ekukhupheni iData centre nakwimisebenzi yeNkonzo yokuHlala ephathene nayo. lawula futhi usebenzise onke amakhosi anikwa ngqo inkonzo yendalo ngokwamagqabantshintshi afanele.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Arts, Culture, Promotion and
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, an all-inclusive remuneration package, consisting of a basic salary (70% of the total remuneration package), State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules and guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-General for Arts, Culture, Promotion and Development in Pretoria, leading creative industry programmes at a senior management level.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Post graduate qualification (NQF level 8) as recognised by SAQA in Social Sciences/ Art Studies/ Arts & Culture/ Heritage Management/ Humanities/ Social Sciences or any relevant arts and culture qualification; Successful completion of the Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) as endorsed by the National School of Government; 8 years relevant experience at Senior Management level in policy development, strategic leadership, and stakeholder management in the arts, culture, creative industries or any relevant culture sector environment. Valid driver’s licence; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of the arts and culture sector; Knowledge of government policies, legislations, prescripts and National Programme of action; Knowledge of relevant legislation (PFMA, Public Service Act, National Heritage Resources Act, White Paper on Arts, Culture and Heritage, etc.); Knowledge and understanding of the transformation of the arts and culture sector; Knowledge and understanding of domestic and international arts and creative industry market trends; Knowledge of the South African cultural landscape; Strategic Capability and Leadership; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation (SDI); Problem solving and Analysis; People Management and Empowerment; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Accountability and Ethical Conduct; Presentation skills; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer literacy; Visionary Leadership; Cultural Sensitivity; Collaboration and Networking; Analytical and Critical Thinking; Ethical Leadership; Willingness to travel
jobs.duties: Oversee, lead and promote the development of the arts, culture and creative industries-Oversee alignment of Arts, Culture and Heritage programmes with national government priorities; Oversee programmes that develop and promote sustainability of cultural and creative industries; Oversee and facilitate transformation of the arts and culture sector in line with equity and redress imperatives; Oversee and promote innovation, digitisation, and competitiveness within the creative sector; Lead and coordinate the implementation of the Cultural and Creative Industry (CCI) Masterplan, in line with national priorities and departmental objectives; Establish and strengthen partnerships with stakeholders in the arts, culture, and heritage sectors; Oversee governance, risk management, compliance and accountability within the branch; Provide support and strategic advice to relevant stakeholders; Promote integrated planning, monitoring and reporting within the branch; Oversee and ensure the development, review and implementation of policies, strategies, and frameworks for the promotion and development of arts, and culture; Oversee the development and promotion of creative nation programmes in the cultural and creative industry-Oversee and monitor programmes that support and promote visual arts, performing arts, literary arts, music, crafts, and other cultural expressions; Manage and facilitate initiatives aimed at developing artists and cultural practitioners; Promote equitable access to arts and cultural opportunities across communities; Support the development of transformation, inclusivity, and diversity within the arts sector; Conduct research in support of the development of arts, culture and creative industries; Oversee and promote reading within the books and publishing industry; Oversee the promotion and strategic support to community art centers, schools and other structures that create growth in industry; Oversee funding and capacity-building initiatives for artists, cultural practitioners, institutions, and organisations; Manage and oversee cultural excellence and nation building programmes-Provide strategic leadership for the development and implementation of programmes that promote social cohesion, nation building, active citizenship, and a shared national identity; Champion policies and initiatives that advance cultural diversity, social inclusion, indigenous knowledge systems, and the preservation and promotion of the nation's cultural heritage; Oversee and provide strategic direction for national commemorative programmes, cultural celebrations, and flagship nation-building initiatives; Drive transformation, equity, and inclusivity within the arts, culture, and creative sectors to ensure broad-based participation and access; Foster strategic partnerships with government, civil society, traditional leadership structures, and international stakeholders to advance national development objectives through culture; Monitor and evaluate the impact of cultural programmes and interventions on social cohesion, nation building, and cultural development outcomes; Promote South Africa's cultural identity and values nationally, regionally, and internationally; Manage and facilitate the establishment of partnerships with stakeholders and Intergovernmental engagements-Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with government departments, public entities, academic institutions, research bodies, industry stakeholders, and international organisations; Coordinate intergovernmental and sector engagements to support collaboration and alignment on arts, culture, and innovation initiatives; Represent the Department in stakeholder forums, working groups, and collaborative platforms as required; Facilitate research, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to support evidence-based decision-making and sector development; Promote the adoption of innovative technologies, digital transformation, and best practices within the cultural and creative sectors; Coordinate collaboration with innovation agencies and strategic partners to advance cultural innovation and development; Establish and maintain knowledge management systems, processes, and repositories to preserve and share institutional knowledge; Monitor and evaluate innovation and partnership initiatives to assess impact and identify opportunities for continuous improvement; Manage projects that promote Arts and Culture sector-Manage programmes and projects undertaken within the Branch; Ensure planning, implementation evaluation, monitoring and alignment of all Programs/ Projects within the Branch; Ensure officials in the Branch are equipped with project management skills; Lead programmes and projects that promote cultural diversity through arts and culture initiatives; Promote intercultural dialogue, unity in diversity, and cultural diplomacy projects; Oversee partnerships with communities, civil society, private sector, and international stakeholders to advance cultural exchange and cooperation; Manage the resources of the Branch-Ensure appropriate management of assets, resources and facilities allocated to the Branch; Create stakeholder management platforms to ensure integration and alignment; Ensure delivery of all targets against the APP; Manage performance of employees in the Branch; Manage Budget of the Branch and ensure compliance to relevant policies and prescripts; Manage risks and monitor adherence to the Branch’s risk register; Manage audit related matters and ensure there are no repeat findings; Oversee sound governance, compliance, monitoring, and reporting systems; Promote a high-performance culture, ethical leadership, and professional development within the Branch.

jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be     sourced      from     the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal: Kuns, Kultuur, Bevordering en
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal vir Kuns, Kultuur, Bevordering en Ontwikkeling in Pretoria, wat skeppende nywerheidsprogramme op 'n seniorbestuursvlak lei.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 8) soos erken deur SAQA in Sosiale Wetenskappe/Kunsstudies/Kuns & Kultuur/Erfenisbestuur/Geesteswetenskappe/Sosiale Wetenskappe of enige relevante kuns- en kultuurkwalifikasie; Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government; 8 jaar relevante ervaring op Seniorbestuursvlak in beleidsontwikkeling, strategiese leierskap en belanghebbende-bestuur in die kuns-, kultuur-, skeppende nywerhede of enige relevante kultuursektor-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie; Kennis van Public Service Regulations; Kennis en begrip van die kuns- en kultuursektor; Kennis van regeringsbeleide, wetgewing, voorskrifte en Nasionale Program van aksie; Kennis van relevante wetgewing (PFMA, Public Service Act, National Heritage Resources Act, White Paper on Arts, Culture and Heritage, ens.); Kennis en begrip van die transformasie van die kuns- en kultuursektor; Kennis en begrip van binnelandse en internasionale kuns- en skeppende nywerheidsmarkneigings; Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse kultuurlandskap; Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Program- en projekbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Diensleweringinnovasie (SDI); Probleemoplossing en analise; Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus; Verantwoording en etiese gedrag; Aanbiedingsvaardighede; Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Visioenêre leierskap; Kulturele sensitiwiteit; Samewerking en netwerking; Analitiese en kritiese denke; Etiese leierskap; Bereidwilligheid om te reis
af.duties: Oorsien, lei en bevorder die ontwikkeling van die kuns-, kultuur- en skeppende nywerhede-Oorsien die belyning van Kuns-, Kultuur- en Erfenisprogramme met nasionale regeringsprioriteite; Oorsien programme wat die volhoubaarheid van kulturele en skeppende nywerhede ontwikkel en bevorder; Oorsien en fasiliteer die transformasie van die kuns- en kultuursektor in ooreenstemming met gelykheid en regstellingsimperatiewe; Oorsien en bevorder innovasie, digitalisering en mededingendheid binne die skeppende sektor; Lei en koördineer die implementering van die Cultural and Creative Industry (CCI) Masterplan, in lyn met nasionale prioriteite en departementele doelwitte; Vestig en versterk vennootskappe met belanghebbendes in die kuns-, kultuur- en erfenissektore; Oorsien bestuur, risikobestuur, nakoming en verantwoording binne die tak; Verskaf ondersteuning en strategiese advies aan relevante belanghebbendes; Bevorder geïntegreerde beplanning, monitering en verslagdoening binne die tak; Oorsien en verseker die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide, strategieë en raamwerke vir die bevordering en ontwikkeling van kuns en kultuur; Oorsien die ontwikkeling en bevordering van skeppende nasie-programme in die kulturele en skeppende nywerheid-Oorsien en monitor programme wat visuele kuns, uitvoerende kuns, letterkundige kuns, musiek, ambagte en ander kulturele uitdrukkings ondersteun en bevorder; Bestuur en fasiliteer inisiatiewe wat gemik is op die ontwikkeling van kunstenaars en kulturele praktisyns; Bevord gelyke toegang tot kuns- en kulturele geleenthede oor gemeenskappe heen; Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van transformasie, inklusiwiteit en diversiteit binne die kunssektor; Voer navorsing uit ter ondersteuning van die ontwikkeling van kuns, kultuur en skeppende nywerhede; Oorsien en bevorder lees binne die boeke- en uitgewerybedryf; Oorsien die bevordering en strategiese ondersteuning van gemeenskapskunssentrums, skole en ander strukture wat groei in die nywerheid skep; Oorsien befondsings- en kapasiteitsbouinisiatiewe vir kunstenaars, kulturele praktisyns, instellings en organisasies; Bestuur en oorsien kulturele uitmuntendheid en nasiebou-programme-Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir die ontwikkeling en implementering van programme wat sosiale samehorigheid, nasiebou, aktiewe burgerskap en 'n gedeelde nasionale identiteit bevorder; Kampioen beleide en inisiatiewe wat kulturele diversiteit, sosiale inklusie, inheemse kennistelsels, en die bewaring en bevordering van die nasie se kulturele erfenis bevorder; Oorsien en verskaf strategiese rigting vir nasionale herdenkingsprogramme, kulturele vierings en vlagskip-nasiebouinisiatiewe; Dryf transformasie, gelykheid en inklusiwiteit binne die kuns-, kultuur- en skeppende sektore om breë-gebaseerde deelname en toegang te verseker; Vestig strategiese vennootskappe met regering, die burgerlike samelewing, tradisionele leierskapstrukture en internasionale belanghebbendes om nasionale ontwikkelingsdoelwitte deur kultuur te bevorder; Monitor en evalueer die impak van kulturele programme en ingrypings op sosiale samehorigheid, nasiebou en kulturele ontwikkelingsuitkomste; Bevorder Suid-Afrika se kulturele identiteit en waardes nasionaal, regionaal en internasionaal; Bestuur en fasiliteer die vestiging van vennootskappe met belanghebbendes en interregeringsbetrokkenheid-Ontwikkel en onderhou strategiese vennootskappe met regeringsdepartemente, openbare entiteite, akademiese instellings, navorsingsliggame, nywerheidsbelanghebbendes en internasionale organisasies; Koördineer interregerings- en sektorbetrokkenheid om samewerking en belyning oor kuns-, kultuur- en innovasie-inisiatiewe te ondersteun; Verteenwoordig die departement in belanghebbende-forums, werkgroepe en samewerkingsplatforms soos vereis; Fasiliteer navorsing, innovasie en kennisdelingsinisiatiewe om bewysgebaseerde besluitneming en sektorontwikkeling te ondersteun; Bevorder die aanvaarding van innoverende tegnologieë, digitale transformasie en beste praktyke binne die kulturele en skeppende sektore; Koördineer samewerking met innovasie-agentskappe en strategiese vennote om kulturele innovasie en ontwikkeling te bevorder; Vestig en onderhou kennisbestuurstelsels, prosesse en bewaarplekke om instellingkennis te bewaar en te deel; Monitor en evalueer innovasie- en vennootskapsinisiatiewe om impak te assesseer en geleenthede vir voortdurende verbetering te identifiseer; Bestuur projekte wat die Kuns- en Kultuursektor bevorder-Bestuur programme en projekte wat binne die Tak ondernem word; Verseker beplanning, implementering, evaluering, monitering en belyning van alle Programme/Projekte binne die Tak; Verseker dat amptenare in die Tak toegerus is met projekbestuursvaardighede; Lei programme en projekte wat kulturele diversiteit deur kuns- en kultuurinisiatiewe bevorder; Bevorder interkulturele dialoog, eenheid in diversiteit en kulturele diplomasie-projekte; Oorsien vennootskappe met gemeenskappe, die burgerlike samelewing, die privaatsektor en internasionale belanghebbendes om kulturele uitruil en samewerking te bevorder; Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Tak-Verseker toepaslike bestuur van bates, hulpbronne en fasiliteite wat aan die Tak toegewys is; Skep belanghebbende-bestuursplatforms om integrasie en belyning te verseker; Verseker lewering van alle teikens teenoor die APP; Bestuur prestasie van werknemers in die Tak; Bestuur begroting van die Tak en verseker nakoming van relevante beleide en voorskrifte; Bestuur risiko's en monitor nakoming van die Tak se risikoregister; Bestuur ouditverwante aangeleenthede en verseker dat daar geen herhaalde bevindings is nie; Oorsien gesonde bestuur, nakoming, monitering en verslagdoeningstelsels; Bevorder 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, etiese leierskap en professionele ontwikkeling binne die Tak.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 noma ezifanayo; Iziqu eziphezulu kweziqu zebhakhalari (NQF level 8) njengoba kwemukelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwezifundo zomphakathi / Izifundo ezingokwezobuciko / Ezobuciko kanye namoso wansuku zonke / Izifundo ezingokwesimo senhlalo yomuntu / Izifundo ezingokwesayensi yomphakathi noma inoma yiziphi iziqu ezingokwamandla ezokubonakaliswa imiklulo yezobuciko; Ukwedlula okuphelele kwesitifikedi samuntu oqamba ebaqashiyo ngaphambi kokungena esikhundleni sokuba ngumqashi we-Senior Management Service (SMS) njengoba kubonwe yi-National School of Government; Imfundo yeminyaka engu-8 kuleso sikhundla ebandakanya ukuqamba amaphulo, ukubeke iqhaza ekubeni yisihlalo esihle futhi ekusimweni kwemibango yonke noma emikhakheni yamamasiko; Amalungiselelo okuqasha kanye nelungelo lokusebenzisa izimoto ezimukelwe kalula; Ulwazi ngezinqumo zomsebenzi kahulumeni wesifundazwe; Ulwazi nokuqonda isikhungo sezobuciko kanye namasiko; Ulwazi ngemigomo kahulumeni, umthetho, izinkomba zemigomoya nokuhambisana nezinkomba zalelo zombuso; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuguqulwa komkhakha wokutholakala kwezokwethula izinto eziyisikhashana nezombusomphakathi; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuthakathana nokwakheka kwamasiko emphakathini nakwamanye amazwe omhlaba; Ulwazi ngokusuka kwamandla emikhakha ehlinzeka ngezinsizakulo ema-Art ngokubanzi; Amakhono okubamba ilunga nokuba ihlu okuhle ekulawulweni komphakathi; Amakhono okulawula imindeni kanye nokulawula imiyalo; Amakhono okulawula imali nokuhlangabezana nezimali; Amakhonyo okulawula ukushintsha kwezimiso; Amakhono okubamba ilunga elaziyo ukulawula imikhakha kahulumeni wesifundazwe; Amakhono okwenza izinto eziqinile futhi athuthuke; Amakhonyo okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokukwazi ukuhlola; Amakhono okupatha abantu kanye nokuqinisa abantu ekubeni banamandla; Amakhono okubheka ukuthuthukiswa kwesibini ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha ekwazisweni kwamasiko; Ukuziphendulela ngokuzenzakalela nokuthembeka emiphakathini yamabutho emikhakha kahulumeni; Amakhono okubonakalisa ngokuvezwa okuhle kanye nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu; Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zangomakhelwane; Amakhono okubamba iqhaza emphakathini nabantu; Amakhono okukhwabanisa ngokubona ngokuhle; Ukukhethwa kokuba nomdlandla wokuqonda kwezombusomphakathi; Ukuzwa okuhle ngokusabela futhi ungathathi hlangothi; Amakhono okuhamba nabaningi kwezinhlelo zokusiza abantu; Ulwazi lwemithetho yamanye amazwe; Ukuthanda ukuvakatshela amanye amazwe
zu.duties: Qapha, ehola futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuciko, amasiko kanye nezimboni eziyimiphumela yobuciko; Qapha ukuqondaniswa kwemiklulo yezobuciko, amasiko kanye nemikwa ngezinto eziphambili kahulumeni wesifundazwe; Qapha imiklulo ehuthaza futhi ivikela ukusimama kwezinsizakalo zamamasiko nakwezimboni eziyimiphumela yobuciko; Qapha futhi kwesungula ukuguqulwa komkhakha wezobuciko namasiko ngokusebenzisa izinkondlo zokulinganisela kanye nokuvisisisa; Qapha futhi kuthuthukise amasu, izinkomba, ukwakheka nokuba mandla kumkhakha wemvelonke wezobuciko; Hola futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kweCultural and Creative Industry (CCI) Masterplan, ngokuhambisana nezinto eziphambili zikahulumeni kanye ngemigomo kahulumeni; Hola ukubusa, ukulawula kwengozi, ukuziphendulela nokuqondisa kumkhakha wemisebenzi yezobuciko; Akela iminikelo nokuqondisa kwabuqotho kwabaphathi bokwesekela; Sekela ukubambisana nokwaziswa nokuvela kwemigomo yamanyuvesi; Qapha futhi uqinise ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlola nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo, amasu kanye nezisekelo ezenziwa ukwenzela ukuthuthukiswa kokubili kwezobuciko nemoso wansuku zonke.

jobs.title: Procurement Admin Officer
jobs.summary: Procurement Admin Officer in Pretoria handling contract administration, lease agreements and supplier performance monitoring for the Department of Transport.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management with 1 year experience in Supply Chain Management. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of SCM policies, prescripts and practices, knowledge of Public Service Regulation and Public Service Act, Computer Literate (SCM System, MS Word, Excel), Understanding and application of SCM and PFMA Prescripts. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Planning and Organising Skills, Good verbal and written communication skills. Financial management skills and Project Management skills.
jobs.duties: Maintain contract and commitment register. Render Contract administration. Assist to manage the lease agreements in the Department in terms of RT3 and providing support to line function in this regard. Monitor supplier performance.
jobs.applications: Department of Transport, Private Bag X193, Pretoria, 0001 or hand deliver at the 159 Forum Building, Cnr Struben and Bosman Street, Pretoria for attention Recruitment Unit. Room 4034 or email to: Recruitment@dot.gov.za. Note: email applications must be sent as one attachment to avoid non-delivery of the email and only quotes the name of the post you are applying for on the Subject Line as directed on the post note.
jobs.notes: Applications must be accompanied by a completed new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, (or obtainable at). Applicants must fill in full new Z83 form part A, B, C, and D. A recent updated comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and dates). Applicants will submit certified copies of all qualifications and ID document on the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process; the logistics will be communicated to candidates prior to the interviews. Note that National School of Governance (NGS) has introduce compulsory SMS pre-entry certificate with effect from 01 April 2020 as Minimum Entry Requirements for Senior Management Services (submitted prior to appointment) and can be accessed through the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.          The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. The successful candidate must disclose to the Director-General particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the Director-General within three months from the date of assumption of duty. The successful candidate must be willing to sign an oath of secrecy with the Department. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and assessments at a time, date and place as determined by the Department. An offer letter will only be issued to the successful candidate once the following has been verified educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. Please note: Correspondence will only be entered into with short-listed candidates OTHER POST

af.title: Aankoopadministrasiebeampte
af.summary: Aankoopadministrasiebeampte in Pretoria wat kontrakadministrasie, huurooreenkomste en leveransierprestasiemonitoring vir die Department of Transport hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management met 1 jaar ervaring in Supply Chain Management. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van SCM-beleide, voorskrifte en gebruike, kennis van Public Service Regulation en Public Service Act, rekenaargeletterd (SCM-stelsel, MS Word, Excel), begrip en toepassing van SCM- en PFMA-voorskrifte. Kennis van Treasury Regulations. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede, goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede en projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou kontrak- en verbintenisregister. Verskaf kontrakadministrasie. Bied bystand om die huurooreenkomste in die departement te bestuur in terme van RT3 en ondersteuning aan lynfunksie in hierdie verband te bied. Monitor leveransierprestasie.

zu.title: Inkantshu Yesikhungo Sokuthenga
zu.summary: Inkantshu Yesikhungo Sokuthenga ePretoria egcina imisebenzi yamakontrathi, izivumelwano zokuhamba ngesikhathi kanye nokubheka imisebenzi yabahlinzeki kuso i-Department of Transport.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management eminyakeni eyi-1 yokuhlolwa ku-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwemigomo, yemithetho nokuqondiswa kwe-SCM, ulwazi lwe-Public Service Regulation ne-Public Service Act, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (SCM System, MS Word, Excel), ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho ye-SCM ne-PFMA Prescripts. Ulwazi lwe-Treasury Regulations. Amandla okuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo, amandla okukhuluma nokubhalwa kahle. Amandla okuphatha imali kanye namandla okuphatha amaphrojekhi.
zu.duties: Gcina irejista yamakontrathi nokuzelelwa. Nikeza imisebenzi yokulawula amakontrathi. Siza ekuphatweni kwezivumelwano zokuhamba ngesikhathi kuleso sikhungo ngokuka-RT3 futhi unikeze inkokhelo emisebenzini ngale ndlela. Bheka imisebenzi yabahlinzeki.

xh.title: Iofisa yolawulo lokuthenga
xh.summary: Iofisa yolawulo lokuthenga ePretoria elibamba iqhaza kolawulo lwezivumelwano, izivumelwano zokuhola nokuqaphela ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki kwisebe lezoThutho.
xh.requirements: Isifikelelo esingangoqondo le-NQF level 6 njengokunakwe SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management kunye neminyaka emi-1 yamava kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigqatho, imithetho nendlela zika-SCM, ulwazi lwe-Public Service Regulation naku-Public Service Act, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (SCM System, MS Word, Excel), ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho ka-SCM ne-PFMA. Ulwazi nge-Treasury Regulations. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela, amakhono amabalokuxela nokubhala anzima. Amakhono olawulo lwezemali namakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi.
xh.duties: Zigcine irejista yezivumelwano nokuqinisekisa. Zenze ulawulo lezivumelwano. Siza ekulawuleni izivumelwano zokuhola kwisebe ngokwale-RT3 kunye nokunika inkxaso kumsebenzi wolawulo kule ndlela. Qaphela ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki.

jobs.reference_number: 131126/01 Branch: Water and Sanitation Services Management: GP CD: Provincial Operations: Gauteng
jobs.title: Director: Water Services Infrastructure Development and
jobs.summary: Director role leading water services infrastructure development policy and grant-funded project prioritisation with municipalities, requiring a civil engineering degree and extensive senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Project Management at NQF level 7 qualification. Ten (10) years programme and project management in civil engineering within the water sector-built environment. Five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior management level. Experience should preferably be in the water sector. Successful completion of the Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) as endorsed by the National School of Government. Working knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Possess a general understanding of contract administration, business principles, and business law. A valid and unexpired driver’s license. A broad understanding of each engineering discipline. Working knowledge of drafting of agreements Effective computer skills (Microsoft Office Software, lotus notes, and other company and discipline-specific software applications). Effective and excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing with management, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the Department. Effective analytical and problem-solving skills. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resources Management Legislations, policies, practices, and procedures. Knowledge of Public Financial Management Act (PFMA). Framework for managing performance information. Knowledge of implementing policies of PMDS. Client orientation and customer focus. Service Delivery Innovation (SDI). Problem management and empowerment. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic direction in the implementation of policies on water services infrastructure programmes, in conjunction with provincial COGTA and municipalities, to ensure that grant-funded projects are optimally prioritised on an ongoing basis. Ensure that policies on water services infrastructure grant programme are aligned to the departmental strategic plan. ensure that plans are available for water services infrastructure grant programmes. Facilitates and support implementation of water services infrastructure grant programmes for provincial operations. Ensure that Regional Bulk Infrastructure programme is implemented in the province. Various water sector consulted on water issues. Needs of business sectors catered for on water bulk infrastructure grant programmes. Implement water policies for regional bulk infrastructure supply of water. Promote partnership between government public entities, private sector, and civil society regarding water services infrastructure grant programmes. Ensure that water supply is available for all business sectors. Avail raw water supply for all municipalities. Ensure that all other water key stakeholders are communicated regarding water issues. budgeted for in medium term expenditure framework. Compile budget for building water services infrastructure grant programme. Monthly reporting. Early warning system management. Ensure that budgeted funds are used properly. Ensure that monitoring and evaluation for water services infrastructure grant programmes are properly conducted in provinces. Compile reports on monitoring and evaluation. Ensure projects are carried out as planned. Implement water policies for regional bulk supply of water. Compile monthly and quarterly reports.
jobs.enquiries: Mr WJ Maluleke Tel No: (012) 392 1303 OTHER POSTS

Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful.
