af.title: Direkteur: Ontwikkeling van Waterdienste-infrastruktuur en
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat beleid vir die ontwikkeling van waterdienste-infrastruktuur en die prioritering van toekeninggefinansierde projekte met munisipaliteite lei, wat 'n graad in siviele ingenieurswese en uitgebreide seniorsbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad in siviele ingenieurswese of konstruksieprojekbestuur op NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie. Tien (10) jaar program- en projekbestuur in siviele ingenieurswese binne die beboude omgewing van die watersektor. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Ervaring moet by voorkeur in die watersektor wees. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Pre-entry Sertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (SMS) soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur. Werkende kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Besit 'n algemene begrip van kontrakadministrasie, besigheidsbeginsels en besigheidsreg. 'n Geldige en onvervalde bestuurslisensie. 'n Breë begrip van elke ingenieursdissipline. Werkende kennis van die opstel van ooreenkomste. Effektiewe rekenaarvaardighede (Microsoft Office-sagteware, lotus notes en ander maatskappy- en dissipline-spesifieke sagteweretoepassings). Effektiewe en uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede beide mondeling en skriftelik met bestuur, kollegas en individue binne en buite die Department. Effektiewe analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis en begrip van Human Resources Management-wetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures. Kennis van Public Financial Management Act (PFMA). Raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van die implementering van beleide van PMDS. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Service Delivery Innovation (SDI). Probleembestuur en bemagtiging. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese rigting by die implementering van beleide vir waterdienste-infrastruktuurprogramme, in samewerking met provinsiale COGTA en munisipaliteite, om te verseker dat toekeninggefinansierde projekte deurlopend optimaal geprioritiseer word. Verseker dat beleide vir die waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogram op die departementele strategiese plan afgestem is. verseker dat planne beskikbaar is vir waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogramme. Fasiliteer en ondersteun implementering van waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogramme vir provinsiale operasies. Verseker dat die Regional Bulk Infrastructure-program in die provinsie geïmplementeer word. Verskeie watersektorrolspelers word geraadpleeg oor waterkwessies. Behoeftes van besigheidssektore word voorsien op waterbulk-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogramme. Implementeer waterbeleid vir streek-bulkinfrastruktuurvoorsiening van water. Bevorder vennootskap tussen staatsopenbare entiteite, privaatsektor en burgerlike samelewing rakende waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogramme. Verseker dat watervoorsiening beskikbaar is vir alle besigheidssektore. Beskikbaarestel rouwatervoorsiening vir alle munisipaliteite. Verseker dat met alle ander sleutelwaterbelanghebbendes oor waterkwessies gekommunikeer word. begrotings word opgeneem in die medium term expenditure framework. Stel begroting op vir die bou van die waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogram. Maandelikse verslagdoening. Bestuur van vroeë waarskuwingstelsel. Verseker dat begrote fondse behoorlik gebruik word. Verseker dat monitering en evaluering van waterdienste-infrastruktuurtoekenningsprogramme behoorlik in provinsies uitgevoer word. Stel verslae oor monitering en evaluering op. Verseker dat projekte soos beplan uitgevoer word. Implementeer waterbeleid vir streek-bulkvoorsiening van water. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op.

zu.title: Umphathi: Inhlubeko Yezinsiza Zamanzi Nokuthuthukiswa Kwayo
zu.summary: Indima yomphathi ehola inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwenhlubeko yezinsiza zamanzi kanye nokuqashelwa kwezinhlelo ezixhaswa ngezibonezelo kahulumeni kumasipala, okudinga iziqu zobunjiniyela bezokwakha kanye nocwaningo oluseduze lokuhola ezingeni eliphakeme.
zu.requirements: I Degree in Civil Engineering noma i Construction Project Management e NQF level 7 qualification. Iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuphatha izinhlela nemiqondo yokuphatha kubunjiniyela bezokwakha ngaphakathi kwesimo sezakhiwo zesecta yamanzi. Iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yocwaningo ezingeni eliphakathi/laphezulu lokuhola. Kumele ucwaningo lube ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusecta yamanzi. Ukuphumelela ukugcwaliseka kwe Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) njengoba kunikezwe i National School of Government. Ulwazi lokusebenza lomthetho we Public Finance Management Act. Ukuba nokuqonda jikelele ngokuphathwa kwezinketho, imigomo yebhizinisi, nomthetho webhizinisi. Ilayisense yabadayisi evunyiwe nengaphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukuqonda okubanzi ngamagatsha wonke obunjiniyela. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusungula izivumelwano; Amakhono obuchwepheshe ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office Software, lotus notes, kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezithile zebhizinisi nediscipline). Amakhono okhumulana ahle nakhulu ngokomlomo nakubhalwayo nabaphathi, abasebenzi nabo, kanye nabantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle kwe Department. Amakhono okuhlaziya nokuxazula izinkinga. Ulwazi nokuqonda komthetho, izinkambiso, amasiko, kanye nemigomo yokuphatha abasebenzi (Human Resources Management). Ulwazi lomthetho we Public Financial Management Act (PFMA). Ohlaka lokuphatha ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ulwazi lokuqashwa kwamaphoyisa a PMDS. Ukuqondana nokubuka ngokuya kumthengi. Inoveshi yokulethwa kwezinsiza (Service Delivery Innovation). Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokuqinisekiswa. Ukubeke phansi nokuziphatha ngokomphathelele.
zu.duties: Nikela ngalezo ezinkundla ekuqashweni kwemigomo kumaphrogramu enhlubeko yezinsiza zamanzi, ngokuhlangana ne-provincial COGTA kanye namasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zibekwa esikhundleni esihamba kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imigomo kumaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso yamasesevisu wamanzi ihambisana neplani emgqeni wezinhloko kanye nezinhloko zesigaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlela zamaphrogramu amasesevisu wamanzi anemibhaso. Siza futhi uxhase ukuqashwa kwamaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zokwakhiwa kwamasesevisu wamanzi emisebenzi yesifunda. Qinisekisa ukuthi iphrogramu ye Regional Bulk Infrastructure isetshenziswa esifundeni. Ukuthi ezinye izakhamuzi zendawo yamanzi zicubungule ngemibuzo yamanzi. Izidingo zesigaba sebhizinisi ziholwa ngokuhamba kwamaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zamasesevisu wamanzi. Qasha imigomo yamanzi kokulethwa kwamanzi nge Regional Bulk. Khuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kwamabhizinisi kahulumene abakhwele, ibhizinisi labantu, kanye nomphakathi ngamaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zamasesevisu wamanzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amanzi atholakala kuzo zonke izigaba zebhizinisi. Yenza amanzi okuyiwo ezingeni elingcolile atholakale kuzo zonke amasipala. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abanye abaholiyo kwindawo yamanzi baxazulwa ngemibuzo yamanzi. Iholo ku-budgeti phakathi kwesikhathi esiphakathi sokuchithwa kwemali. Hlela ibhajethi yamaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zokwakhiwa kwamasesevisu wamanzi. Ukubika ngenyanga. Ukuphatha ukuxwayisa ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali eholwayo isetshenziswa kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola nokubuyekeza ngemigomo yamaphrogramu ezixhaswa ngemibhaso zokwakhiwa kwamasesevisu wamanzi kwenziwa ngokusho kwemigomo emaphakathi. Hlela imibiko ngekuhlola nokubuyekeza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyenziwa njengoba bekulotshiwe. Qasha imigomo yamanzi nge Regional Bulk Supply. Hlela imibiko yenyanga nenyanga kanye neyikhathi nethemu.

xh.title: Umntamhlophe: Uphuhliso LwemiNgozi yokuQaqambisa iNkonzo zeManzi
xh.summary: Indima yoMntamhlophe ehola inqobo yeplaniyokuphuhlisa imingezi yonkonzo yamanzi nokuqwalasela kubongakanani amaprojekthi axhaswa ngemali zozimali kunye nemimango, kufuneka kubekho degree yolwakhiwo lwempucuko kunye namava amaninzi ohlalo aphakamileyo.
xh.requirements: IDegree kwiNzululwazi yeMpucuko okanye uLawulo lwaManqanaba kwiplani eNQF level 7. Iminyaka elishumi (10) yohlelo nolawulo lwaprojekthi kwinzululwazi yempucuko ngaphakathi kwendawo yakhiwa kwesimbo sommandu wamanzi. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kumanqanaba olawulo oluphakathi/ophakamileyo. Amava mafanele ukuba abe ngaphakathi kwesimbo sommandu wamanzi. Ukugqibelela ngemveliso kwiSetifikethi sokungena ngaphambili kwiSixokelelwanisi soLawulo sikhulu (SMS) njengoko kunikwa igunya yiSikolo sikaRhulumente weQonga. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngeMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Ukuqonda ngokubanzi ukulawula iinkontrathi, iimigaqo zoshishino, nomthetho woshishino. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo engazange iphela. Ukuqonda ngobubanzi ngamagatya onke enzululwazi yempucuko. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokubhala iinkontrathi Amandla amsebenzisayo ekhompyutha (iSoftware yeMicrosoft Office, lotus notes, nakunye iinkqubo zesoftware ezithile zekampani nagatya). Amandla aphezulu nokuchanekileyo ekunxibelelaneni ngokuthetha nokubhala nalawulo, nabasebenzi, nabanxibekelelo ngaphakathi nangaphandle koSebe. Amandla aphumeleleyo ekwahluleleni iingxaki nokuwciphisa iingxaki. Ulwazi nokuqonda koLawulo lweMithetho eNtlalontle, iinkqubo, iziko, nendlela yokwenza izinto yoluntu. Ulwazi lweMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Uluntu lokuqulunqa ulwazi lweNkonzo. Ulwazi ngokuphumeza iinkqubo ze-PMDS. Ukuqwalasela kumthengi nokuqwalasela kumthengi. Ingqi yoholelo lweNkonzo (SDI). Ukuqonda ukulawula iingxaki nanika amandla. Ixabiso nendlela yokuziphatha ngokugqibelela.
xh.duties: Nika iNdlela eQondileyo ekuphumezeni iNkqubo iindlela zokwenza imisebenzi kumazwe aphezulu ngeNkqubo yokusebenza, ekudibana namaziko aphakathi kwiProvincial COGTA kunye namaziko abakhiwa, qinisekisa amaziko asezantsi urhulumente ukuba axhaswe ngemali ayahambelana nokuqwalasela kokuqhubekayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezixhaswa ngemali kumazwe aphezulu ezoNkonzo ziya ngemfundo eyiNkqubo yeplani yesebe. Qinisekisa ukuba zikho iindlela zokuqonda kwizinto zokwakha imingezilezo yonke imisebenzi. Axhasa ekuphumezeni imisebenzi yokwakha iinkqubo zemisebenzi yamaza aphezulu ngokusebenza kwamaziko angaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yezaNgqangemiti ezikwizinga eliphezulu isentsimbi iphumezelwa kwingingqi. Kudibana namaziko aphezulu ngesimbo sommandu ngemiba yamanzi. Kudingelwa iimfuno ezikumazwana abashishino kwindlela yonke imali yonke amaziko. Phumeza iplani yamanzi kwimiba yokubonelela amanzi asezantsi. Khuthaza ukudibana ngokusebenza phakathi kwamajelo oxinzelelo lwentlalo, izikrobho, nentshilo ngokubanzi. Qinisekisa ukuba amanzi anomdlandla wonke amaziko abakhiwa. Qinisekisa ukuba amanzi asezantsi anomdlandla ngemiba ekuthunyelwa. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abadibana ngesimba ngamnye banikwa amanzi okusingathwa kwinkonzo yamanzi. Amaziko abakhiwa akawaxhaswa kwiplani yemali. Qinisekisa ukuba imali exhaswayo ihlawulwa kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqwalaselwa kubakho imisebenzi yokwakha imingezilezo yamaza aphezulu kwinkonzo yamanzi ngokusebenza kwindlela. Hlanganisa amaziko amaninzi ibali lemali yokwakha imisebenzi esuka kwakhona kwindlela zolonwabo ekuzuzisweni kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yonke igqitywa. Qinisekisa ukuba ukubonelela kwamaza ngaphandle nomdlandla ngesiQinisekiso ngaphezulu kwesimiso esihle. Hlanganisa amaziko abakhiwa ngokusetyenziswa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yonke iphumezelwe ngokwendlela echanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iplani yokubonelela amanzi.

jobs.title: Scientist Manager Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Lead climate change analysis and strategic scientific direction at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Master of Science (MSc) degree (NQF Level 9) in Climate Science / Environmental Science / Hydrology / Water Resources Management / Atmospheric Science / Environmental Management / Engineering or relevant Scientific discipline. A PhD (NQF Level 10) in Climate Science/Environmental Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Water Resources Management, Atmospheric Science, Engineering or another relevant scientific discipline will be an added advantage Ten (10) years' appropriate experience in the relevant scientific field, climate science and/or the application of climate information to water resources management. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a professional scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Knowledge on and a clear understanding of integrated water resource management and/or water related sciences will be an added advantage. Knowledge of international and national climate change policies, water resources, and the water sector as a whole. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written). Good liaison and organizational skills. Skills in financial management, decision making, strategic capability and leadership, analytical, creativity, office administration, programme and project management, scientific methodologies and models, technical report writing. Knowledge and experience of using electronic communication platforms and internet. Applicants must be able to travel nationally and internationally as required to represent the Department and the sector.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following: Provide scientific leadership and strategic direction in climate change analysis within the Department. Coordinate and guide the analysis of historical and projected climate trends and their implications for South Africa's water resources. Identify emerging climate risks and scientific developments relevant to the Department's mandate. Coordinate climate vulnerability assessments at national, provincial, catchment, and Water Management Area (WMA) levels. Assess the implications of climate change for water availability, water quality, droughts, floods, groundwater, water infrastructure, and water services. Provide scientific evidence to support climate-resilient water resources planning and infrastructure development. Lead the generation, analysis and interpretation of climate information and climate intelligence relevant to the water and sanitation sector. Ensure alignment of the Department's climate change response with relevant national and international policy and legislative requirements. Provide scientific and technical inputs into the development, review and implementation of climate change policies, strategies, frameworks and programmes within the water and sanitation sector. Coordinate the identification of climate-resilient interventions for different Water Management Areas. Promote innovative approaches to building climate-resilient water and sanitation systems. Develop and manage strategic scientific research programmes addressing climate change and water. Identify opportunities for collaborative research, innovation, knowledge generation and technology development. Provide scientific advice to the Department's senior management and relevant stakeholders on climate change and water-related matters. Establish and maintain networks of climate change and water experts.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: This is an affirmative action position. Preference will be given to candidates from previously disadvantaged groups, in accordance with the Department’s Employment Equity Plan and applicable legislation. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the posts of Assistant Director: Auxiliary Services Ref No: 301026/19 and Personal Assistant Ref No: 301026/38, advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 37 dated 16 October 2026, have been withdrawn. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Wetenskaplike Bestuurder Graad a
af.summary: Verskaf leiding rakende klimaatsverandering-analise en strategiese wetenskaplike rigting by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Magistergraad in Wetenskap (MSc) (NQF Level 9) in Klimaatwetenskap / Omgewingswetenskap / Hidrologie / Waterhulpbronbestuur / Atmosferiese Wetenskap / Omgewingsbestuur / Ingenieurswese of 'n relevante wetenskaplike dissipline. 'n PhD (NQF Level 10) in Klimaatwetenskap / Omgewingswetenskap, Atmosferiese Wetenskap, Hidrologie, Waterhulpbronbestuur, Atmosferiese Wetenskap, Ingenieurswese of 'n ander relevante wetenskaplike dissipline sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Tien (10) jaar se toepaslike ervaring in die relevante wetenskaplike veld, klimaatwetenskap en/of die toepassing van klimaatinligting op waterhulpbronbestuur. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as professionele wetenskaplike. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van en 'n duidelike begrip van geïntegreerde waterhulpbronbestuur en/of waterverwante wetenskappe sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van internasionale en nasionale klimaatsveranderingsbeleid, waterhulpbronne, en die watersktor as geheel. Uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goie skakel- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vaardighede in finansiële bestuur, besluitneming, strategiese vermoë en leierskap, analitiese, kreatiwiteit, kantooradministrasie, program- en projekbestuur, wetenskaplike metodes en modelle, tegniese verslagskryfwerk. Kennis en ervaring in die gebruik van elektroniese kommunikasieplatforms en die internet. Aansoekers moet nasionaal en internasionaal kan reis soos vereis om die departement en die sektor te verteenwoordig.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir, maar nie beperk tot, die volgende: Verskaf wetenskaplike leierskap en strategiese rigting in klimaatsverandering-analise binne die departement. Koördineer en lei die analise van historiese en geprojekteerde klimaatsneigings en die implikasies daarvan vir South Africa se waterhulpbronne. Identifiseer ontluikende klimaatsrisiko's en wetenskaplike ontwikkelings wat relevant is tot die departement se mandaat. Koördineer kwesbaarheidsassesserings vir klimaatsverandering op nasionale, provinsiale, opvanggebied- en Waterbestuursgebied (WMA) vlakke. Assesseer die implikasies van klimaatsverandering vir waterbeskikbaarheid, waterkwaliteit, droogtes, vloede, grondwater, waterinfrastruktuur en watersdienste. Verskaf wetenskaplike getuienis om klimaatbestande waterhulpbronbeplanning en infrastruktuurontwikkeling te ondersteun. Neem die leiding by die generering, analise en interpretasie van klimaatinligting en klimaatintelligensie wat relevant is tot die water- en sanitasieskektor. Verseker belyning van die departement se klimaatsveranderingsreaksie met relevante nasionale en internasionale beleids- en wetgewingsvereistes. Verskaf wetenskaplike en tegniese insette by die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van klimaatsveranderingsbeleid, strategieë, raamwerke en programme binne die water- en sanitasieskektor. Koördineer die identifisering van klimaatbestande ingrypings vir verskillende Waterbestuursgebiede. Bevorder innoverende benaderings tot die bou van klimaatbestande water- en sanitasiestelsels. Ontwikkel en bestuur strategiese wetenskaplike navorsingsprogramme wat klimaatsverandering en water aandui. Identifiseer geleenthede vir samewerkende navorsing, innovasie, kennisherwinning en tegnologie-ontwikkeling. Verskaf wetenskaplike advies aan die departement se senior bestuur en relevante belanghebbendes oor klimaatsverandering en waterverwante aangeleenthede. Vestig en onderhou netwerke van klimaatsverandering- en waterkenners.

zu.title: Umphathi Wosayensi Izinga a
zu.summary: Holusa ukuhlaziywa koshintsho lwesimo sezulu nokubhekisela kolwazi mayelana neziqu ezigxilile eziveni emnyangweni we Water and Sanitation e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se Master of Science (MSc) (NQF Level 9) kwi Climate Science / Environmental Science / Hydrology / Water Resources Management / Atmospheric Science / Environmental Management / Engineering noma esinye isikhathi esihambisana nesayensi. I-PhD (NQF Level 10) kwi Climate Science / Environmental Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Water Resources Management, Atmospheric Science, Engineering noma enye indima esebenzayo esihambisana nesayensi izoba ngaphezulu. Iminyaka yisikhombisa (10) yamava ohambisana nendima yesayensi, isayensi yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye/noma ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwesimo sezulu ekuphathweni kolwazi lwamanzi. Ukwengamela okuphoqelele ku SACNASP njengosayensi ochwepheshe. Ukubuyisa ilayisenisi yokuqasha esebenzayo angaphelelwa isikhathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda okucacile ngokuphathwa kwamanzi okuhlanganisiwe kanye/noma izayensi eziphathene namanzi kuzoba ngaphezulu. Ulwazi ngemigomo yamazwe ngamazwe nasentlango ngoshintsho lwesimo sezulu, amanzi, kanye nendawo yonke yamandla. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokwethula (okuthukuthayo nokubhaliwe). Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokuhlela. Amakhono okuphatha izimali, ukwenza izinqumo, amandla nokubhekisela phambili nobuholo, ukuhlaziya, ukudala, ukulawula ofisi, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namaphrogra, izindlela nesayensi nemodeli, ukubhala imibhalo yesobuciko. Ulwazi namava okusebenzisa izindawo zokuxhumana ngekhompyutha kanye ne-intanethi. Abantu abafaka isicelo kumele bakwazi ukuhamba emhlabeni jikelele nangaphandle kwendawo njengoba kudingwa ukumela umnyango kanye nendawo yonke.
zu.duties: Umuntu ozoqoba ube nomsebenzi wale miminingwane, kodwa awukhawulelwa okulandelayo: Hola ngokobuchwepheshe futhi unike isiqondiso mayelana nokuqapha ushintsho lwesimo sezulu emnyangweni. Hlanganisa futhi uhole ekwelapheni iminingwane yamandulo kanye nezinkomba ezibonakalayo kanye nemithelela yazo kolwazi lwamanzi e South Africa. Thola izinsongo ezibonakalayo zezimo sezulu kanye nezinthe zosayensi ezihambisana nomthetho womnyango. Hlanganisa ukuqoqwa kolwazi ngenhlangothi yezimo sezulu ngemizinga yezwe, yasifundazwe, somkhondo wamanzi, kanye namadolobha e Water Management Area (WMA). Hlolisisa imithelela yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu ekutholakaleni kwamanzi, emandla omanzi, izomiso, izikhukhula, amanzi aphansi komhlabathi, izinsiza zokuthutha amanzi, kanye namasevisi omanzi. Unike ulwazi lwesayensi ngokusekela ukulandelwa kolwazi lwamanzi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Hola ekudalweni, ekuhlaziyeni nasekuhumusheni ukudluliselwa kolwazi lwesimo sezulu kanye nezezimiso ezihambisana nendawo yamanzi nokuhlanza. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwemphendulo yomnyango ngoshintsho lwesimo sezulu nemigomo ngamazinga nasemhlabeni jikelele kanye nezidingo zomthetho. Nike izinkomba zobuchwepheshe kumthelela wokuthuthukiswa, ukuphinda uhlolishe nokusebenzisa imigomo, izinqubo, izakhiwo namaphrogra ngoshintsho lwesimo sezulu endaweni yamanzi nokuhlanza. Hlanganisa ekutholweni kwezindlela ezingangenwa izinsongo ezihambelana nendawo yamanzi ezahlukene. Khuthaza izindlela ezintsha zokwakha izinsiza zokumelana noshintsho lwesimo sezulu wamanzi nokuhlanza. Duduza futhi uphathe amaphrogra ezesayensi abambelela ekubhekeni noshintsho lwesimo sezulu namanzi. Hlola amathuba okucwaninga ngokuhlanganyela, ukwakhiwa kokusha, ukwakhiwa kolwazi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe. Nike izindulela zesayensi ekuphathweni kwabaphezulu bomnyango nasezinduleni ngoshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye nezindaba eziphathene namanzi. Misela futhi ulondoloze izinkundla zabachwepheshe boshintsho lwesimo sezulu namanzi.

xh.title: Umphathi weSayensi inqanaba le-a
xh.summary: Qonda ucandelo lokutshintsha kwemozulu nolawulo lokusesigqini kwisebe leManzi nokuQothula ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Master of Science (MSc) (NQF Level 9) kwiSayensi yeMojozulu / iSayensi yeNdalo / i-Hydrology / uLawulo lweeRisizi zeManzi / iSayensi yeMoyomkhulu / uLawulo lweNdalo / i-Engineering okanye esikhokelo sayensi esifanelekileyo. I-PhD (NQF Level 10) kwiSayensi yeMojozulu / iSayensi yeNdalo, iSayensi yeMoyomkhulu, i-Hydrology, uLawulo lweeRisizi zeManzi, i-Engineering okanye elinye isikhokelo sayensi esifanelekileyo kuya kuba ngumonde olongeziweyo Iminyaka elishumi (10) yamava afanelekileyo kwikhobabu lesayensi elichanekileyo, isayensi yemozulu kwaye nokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwezemozulu kulawulo lwerisizi zamanzi. Ubulungiselelo obanyelelayo kwi-SACNASP njengosayensi opezulu. Ukuzivulela ngeelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo engeyo qotho. Ulwazi nokuqonda okucacileyo ngolawulo oludityanisiweyo lwamathatha amanzi kwaye nangamanye amagatya ayenzelwe amanzi kuya kuba ngumonde olongeziweyo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zomhlaba nezasekurhulumente zotshintsho lwemozulu, amathatha amanzi, kunye noluntu lwezonyulu ngokubanzi. Amakhono amabalise ngokubanzi nakwithuba nabantu (ngokuthetha nasokubhala). Amakhono amabalise ngokuzenzela nabantu kunye nokuqhubekeka kwezinto ngokulungiselelana. Amakhono kulawulo lweemali, ukwenza iigqibo, amakhono okulawula abantu ngokusesigqini, ukwahlula-hlula, ukwenza izinto ngeenjongo ezintsha, ulawulo lweofisi, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, iindlela zesayensi neemodeli, ukubhala iingxelo eziqukethe inxaxheba yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi namava okusebenzisa iindlela zokunxibelelanana ngezikqubo zesikhokelo kunye nethowa elidlulisa ulwazi ngekhompyutha. Abafakeli kufuneka bakwazi ukuhamba nakuzwe nakumazwe ngaphandle njengoko kufunekayo ukumela iSebe nesoqothulo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi ophumeleleyo uya kuba nawo umsebenzi olandelayo, kodwa ongasakubekelwa ibala: Ukubonelela ngolawulo kwizayensi nolungelelwaniso lokusesigqini kwicandelo lokutshintsha kwemozulu ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ukuqamba kunye nokulawula ukwahlula-hlula kokutshintsha kwemozulu yakudala nolungelelwaniso lwayo nangona iphila kanjani amathatha amazi eMzantsi Afrika. Ukuzisa izoyiko ezivelayo kwelundo lwemozulu nophuhliso oluchanekileyo oluthe ngqo kwimisebenzi yesebe. Ukuqamba ukupimwa kokungakhuseleki kwemozulu kwabanjambele, kwelinye ibango, kwizinto eziyimida yokuhamba kwamanzi, nakummandla wokuLawula iNanzi (WMA). Ukuqonda ngakumbi iimpembelelo zotshintsho lwemozulu ekufumaneni amanzi, ngokulunga kwamanzi, ngamakroba, ngokuzala kwamanzi, ngamathatha amanzi angephansi, ngesiseko sezakhiwo zamanzi, nangenkonzo yamanzi. Ukubonelela ngeziqinisekileyo zesayensi ezixhasa ulungelelwaniso namaphulo oqondisa amathatha amanzi abhekisele kwemozulu ehlanahlaniweyo. Ukulawula ukwenziwa, ukuwahlula-hlula nokutolika ulwazi ngekhompyutha ngemozulu nolwazi olummandla wamanzi nokuQothula. Qinisekisa ukulungelelwanisa kwezimemo zesebe mayiza notshintsho lwemozulu ngeenkqubo zolawulo namazwe naphandle ezichanekileyo nemigaqo esemthethweni. Ukubonelela ngemiqulu yobugcisa bokulawula ezisesigqini ekwenzeni, ukuphonononga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezibhekise kuyo imojula, iindwela, amagatya noluntu ngokubanzi. Ukuqamba ukuzisa iindlela ezintsha ezinokusetyenziselwa ukwakha iinkqubo zamanzi nokuQothula ezihlala zimi ngokuchanekileyo kwimo ekungayilungi yomzulu. Yila ulawule iinkqubo zophando kwisayensi ezisesigqini eziphathelene notshintsho lwemozulu namanzi. Zisa amathuba okwenza uphando, ukuphuhula izinto ezintsha, ukuvelisa ulwazi nokuphuhlisa ubugcisa bokusebenza. Bonelela ngamacebo ebugcisa basayensi kubaphathi abaphezulu basebe noluntu abalinganiselelwao ngezinto ezikhuselekileyo ezibhekisa kwezemozulu nezamanzi. Misela ulugcinade lwabantu abayiingcali kwezemozulu nezamanzi kwaye uzigcine ubomi babo belungelelwanisiweyo.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108 – R1 504 797 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer in the Department of Water and Sanitation responsible for dam classification, safety evaluation, and licensing in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An Engineering degree (B Eng/BSc (Eng) or relevant qualification in Civil Engineering. Six (6) years post qualification experience in the Water Engineering field. Compulsory registration with Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a professional Engineer. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Extensive dam engineering experience related to design, flood hydrology, construction, management, and safety of dams. Knowledge of programme and project management, legal and operational compliance. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Engineering and professional judgement. Strategic capability and leadership. Problem Solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation skills. Change management.
jobs.duties: Investigate, analyse, and recommend classification of dams. Evaluate and investigate engineering aspects of license applications for the construction of new dams, alteration of existing dams, first filling and operational aspects of dams. Monitor the safety evaluation and investigation reports and carry out risk assessments. Follow up on dam safety betterment work with owners of dams. Develop/maintain guidelines and policies on dams with safety risk. Liaise with regional officials, dam owners, professional engineers, and the public. Give presentations and advice on dam safety matters and legislation. People management. af.title: Hoofingenieur Graad a
af.summary: Hoofingenieur in die Department of Water and Sanitation verantwoordelik vir damklassifikasie, veiligheidsevaluering en lisensiëring in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/BSc (Eng)) of relevante kwalifikasie in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Ses (6) jaar ervare na kwalifikasie in die Wateringenieursweseveld. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as professionele ingenieur. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Uitgebreide damingenieurservaring wat verband hou met die ontwerp, vloedhidrologie, konstruksie, bestuur en veiligheid van damme. Kennis van program- en projektebestuur, regsondersteuning en operasionele nakoming. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Personeelbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Ondersoek, ontleed en beveel klassifikasie van damme aan. Evalueer en ondersoek ingenieursaspekte van lisensieaansoeke vir die konstruksie van nuwe damme, wysiging van bestaande damme, eerste vulsel en operasionele aspekte van damme. Monitor die veiligheidsevaluerings- en ondersoekverslae en voer risiko-assessering uit. Volg op vir damveiligheidsverbeteringswerk met eienaars van damme. Ontwikkel/onderhou riglyne en beleide vir damme met veiligheidsrisiko. Skakel met streeksamptenare, dameienaars, professionele ingenieurs en die publiek. Hou voorleggings en gee advies oor damveiligheidsaangeleenthede en wetgewing. Personeelbestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bekwame kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van ingenieursdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker, bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde in te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik. Superveiseer en train kandidaatingenieurs en tegnici soos vereis. Genereer verslae en statistieke om vordering met die Dam Safety Programme te meet.

zu.title: Uchwephesbe Wezinga A
zu.summary: Uchwigaba wezinga A eMnyangweni Wezamanzi kanye nesiNdlalo, njengabachwepheshe abayisihluthulelo ekuhloleni izinhlobo zamathambo amakhulu, ukuphepha, kanye nokunikwa amalayisense ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Idegree yobuchwepheshe (B Eng/BSc (Eng) noma iziqu ezihambisanayo eBuchwepheshe Bemipo. Abangu-Six (6) iminyaka yokuhlelekwa emsebenzini eMandleni eMponi. Ukuqiniswa okuyimfuneko eNzabeni yokuQiniseka KobuChwephehe saseNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengomunye wezomchazamhlabo. Ukumiswa kwekhodi yebhayisi engiphelele futhi engekuphelelwa yisikhathi. Okubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuphenya kwezobuchwepheshe eMandleni eMponi mayelana nokwakha amathambo amakhulu, izindinganiso zemifula, ukwakha, ukuphatha, kanye nokuphepha kwamathambo amakhulu. Ulwazi ngohlelo futhi ngokwakwa izinkambiso, umthetho kanye nokuqiniseka kokusebenza. Ukuphenya futhi ukwakha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhuselekile ngekhompyutha. Ukudala isiko elihle lokusebenza. Ukuphakamisa izeluleko ngobuchwepheshe. Ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe kanye nobuhlakahle. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuholwa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlolwa. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuholwa kwabaqembu. Ukubona. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuqikelela kakhulu futhi kusabekele imiphakathi. Ukuxhumana. Iziqu zekhompyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela futhi uqgibe. Ukuphatha izingxabano. Iziqu zokuxoxisana. Ukuphatha ukushintsha.
zu.duties: Hlola, hlaziya, futhi unzipula ngokuhlelwa kwamathambo amakhulu. Hlola futhi uphenye izindaba ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe bezimiso zezinkambiso zokwakha amathambo amakhulu amatsha, ukushintsha amathambo amakhulu asekhona, ukugcwalisa kwesikhathi esokuqala kanye nezindaba zokusebenza kwamathambo amakhulu. Qapha imibiko yokuhlola ukuphepha kanye nokuphenya futhi wenze ukulinganisela kwezengozi. Landelela imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kwamathambo amakhulu nabanikazi bamathambo amakhulu. Hlatha futhi ugqamise izinkambiso kanye nezinqubomgomo ngamathambo amakhulu anengozi yokuphepha. Thintana namaphoyisa esiFunda, banikazi bamathambo amakhulu, abachwepheshe, kanye nomphakathi. Yela izinkomba futhi unike izeluleko ngendaba zokuphepha kwamathambo amakhulu kanye nomthetho. Ukuphatha abantu. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthaza nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu ngobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqiniseke umthombo ogwinyile wolwazi ozoqhubeka nempumelelo yezinsiza zobuchwepheshe njengoko kudingwa futhi kuhlinzekwa inhlangano, phatha izindaba eziyisihluthulelo zempumelelo zabaphansi ngokuhlela futhi uqapha amazinga okusebenza futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ukwehluka ukuze kuzuqatshwe izinhloso zomnyango. Qapha futhi uqeqe abachwepheshe abaqeqwayo kanye nabuchwepheshe njengoko kudingwa. Akela imibiko kanye nezibalo ukuze kulinganiswe inqubo nohlelo lokuphepha kwamathambo amakhulu.

Ukuphuhliswa/ukugcinwa kwezikhokelo namapolisi ngamadama anobungozi bokhuseleko. Unxibelelwano nabasebenzi banjingalwa, banini bamadama, abanjiniya abachwepheshe, noluntu. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa, ukunika amandla nokusetyenziswa kweemfuno zabantu abasemthethweni woqhakamshelwano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngokusesigxeni lokuphumelela ngokungapheli kweenkonzo zenjiniya ngokwemfuno neemfuno zoluntu, ukulawula iindawo ezibalulekeyo zokusebenza kumagosa angaphansi ngokumisa nokumilinganisa amanqanaba okusebenza kwaye uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa iimpazamo ukuze kufezekiswe iinjongo zesebe. Ukuqonda kwaye qeqeshe abajinja abafuna nabanjiniya abatsha njengoko kufunekile. Ukuyila iingxelo nestatistics ukulinganisa inkqubela ngeNkqubo yoKhuseleko lweDama.

af.summary: Produksie-Ingenieur Graad A tot C by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir strategiese beplanning van waterbronne en die versoen van waterbeskikbaarheid met groeiende vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Graad (B Eng/BSc (Eng). of NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Siviele Ingenieurswese of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Minimum drie (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie relevante ervaring in Wateringenieurswese word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n professionele Ingenieur. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-vervalde bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die National Water Act (no 36 of 1998) asook ander relevante wette en wetgewing soos die Water Services Act en die National Environmental Management Act (no 107 of 1998) en damveiligheidswetgewing.

zu.requirements: I-Degree (B Eng/BSc (Eng). noma iziqu ze-NQF level 7 ku-Civil Engineering noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezi. Ukuqashelwa kuyisinyathelo esiphoqiwe kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniya osebenzayo. Ukuchaza ukuthi unelayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo engakapheli. zu.duties: Lesi sikhundla siphawula ku-Chief Engineer sifaka phakathi okulandelayo: Ukuhlela okuhlosiwe kwemithombo yamanzi okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa kanye nokubuyiselwa emuva kwezindlela ezifanele zokubuyisa emuva ukutholakala kwamanzi kanye nezidingo ezikhula ezindaweni zokuhlela ezihambisanayo. Ukuthuthukisa, ukugcina, kanye nokubuyisa emuva izindlela zokubuyisa emuva amanzi izinhlela zokuletha amanzi kanye namachibi ezwe lonke. Ukuqamba izifundo zokuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwamanzi okuhlanganisa ukumodela amanzi emachabeni ahlukene ezweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwezindlela zokubuyisa emuva amanzi kwizakhiwo namaphakishi endaweni yokuhlela ehambisanayo. Ukuletha imibono ezinhlelweni ezihlosiwe kanye kwi-Annual Performance Plans. Ukuletha imibono ekuqanjweni kanye nokubuyisweni kwamaphuzu, izixwayiso, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezwa amanzi. Ukuletha imibono ekulethweni kwemibhalo yamalayisensi yokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukuxhumana ngemibuzo yokuhlelwa kwemithombo yamanzi kokubili emazweni nasemazwe ngaphandle ngokuphathelene nemigwemgemgwa yamanza ehlukanisa izwe. Ukulawula ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle izifundo/ziphrojekthi zemithombo yamanzi. Ukubambezela inxulumana nabathintekayo ekuphatheni okuhlangene kwemithombo yamanzi. Ukuqulatha iindlela ezinje ngokwabantu, lemali, nanakuzisiseko ekucwangciseni amafutha amanzi elizwe. Inika inkxaso ngokwobuchwephesha nangolawulo.

Knowledge of the National Water Act (no 36 of 1998) as well as other relevant acts and legislations such as the Water Services Act and the national Environmental Management Act (no 107 of 1998) and dam safety legislations.
jobs.duties: The Engineers will report to the Chief Engineer in one of the Northern, Central, Eastern or Southern Planning Regions and will form part of a project team that would be involved in the optimisation and planning of water resources utilisation and development in South Africa through the evaluation of various options. The incumbent will be responsible for the identification of available water resources and development needs through multidisciplinary basic studies, Conceptualisation of possible solutions to meet water demands and evaluation of associated social, economic and environmental impacts. Involvement in the development of water management strategies, comparative analysis, optimisation and reporting of feasibility investigation of possible water resource development. Preparation of inputs for decision-making regarding the selection, appointment, and control of professional service providers.

Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad a - C
af.summary: Produksie-ingenieur benodig by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria om waterbronne te beplan en te optimaliseer, met 'n graad in siviele ingenieurswese en ECSA-registrasie as vereiste.
af.requirements: A Civil Engineering degree (B Eng/BSC (Eng) qualification. Drie (3) jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie in siviele ingenieurswese word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Relevante kennis en ervaring binne die veld van waterhulpbronbestuur is noodsaaklik. Kennis van die National Water Act (no 36 of 1998) asook ander relevante wette en wetgewing soos die Water Services Act en die national Environmental Management Act (no 107 of 1998) en damveiligheidswetgewing.
af.duties: Die ingenieurs sal aan die Hoofingenieur rapporteer in een van die Northern, Central, Eastern of Southern Planning Regions en sal deel uitmaak van 'n projekspan wat betrokke sal wees by die optimalisering en beplanning van waterbronnebenutting en -ontwikkeling in Suid-Afrika deur die evaluering van verskeie opsies. Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die identifisering van beskikbare waterbronne en ontwikkelingsbehoeftes deur multidissiplinêre basiese studies, konseptualisering van moontlike oplossings om in waterbehoeftes te voorsien en evaluering van gepaardgaande sosiale, ekonomiese en omgewingsimpakte. Betrokkenheid by die ontwikkeling van waterbestuursstrategieë, vergelykende analise, optimalisering en verslagdoening van haalbaarheidsondersoeke van moontlike waterbronne-ontwikkeling. Voorbereiding van insetsel vir besluitneming rakende die keuse, aanstelling en beheer van professionele diensverskaffers.

zu.title: Injiniya YokuKhiqiza izinga a - C
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniya yokuKhiqiza eDepartment of Water and Sanitation ePretoria ukuze kukhunjulwe futhi kulungiswe izinsiza zamanzi, kudingwa idigri yokuba injiniya yemigoqo kanye nokubhaliswa ku-ECSA.
zu.requirements: Idigri yoBunjiniya bemigoqo (B Eng/BSC (Eng). Kudingwe amava eminyaka emithathu (3) ngemuva kokuthola isifundaZwe kuCivil Engineering. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphumelelayo ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Injiniya oGunyaziwe kuyadingeka. Ukuzulisa ilayiseni yokuShayela evumelekileyo engakapheli. Ulwazi olubalulekile nalamava enkundleni yokuPhatha izinsiza zamanzi kuyadingeka. Ulwazi ngakuNational Water Act (no 36 of 1998) kanye namanye amagazethi nomthetho ohlobene njengoWater Services Act kanye no national Environmental Management Act (no 107 of 1998) kanye nomthetho oPhathwa ngokuvikeleka kwamadhemu.
zu.duties: Izinja zokuKhiqiza ngezikalele ku-Injiniya oMkhulu kwenye yezifunda zokuKhunjulwa iNyakatho, iMaphakathi, iMpumalanga noma iNingizimu futhi ziba yingxenye yeqembu eliza libandakanyeka ekulungiseni nasekukhunjulweni kokusetshenziswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamanzi eSouth Africa ngokuHlolwa kwezinketho ezahlukene. Lo muntu oze kulesi sikhundla uzobe nephoqo yokuhlonza izinsiza zamanzi ezitholakalayo kanye nezidingo zokuthuthukisa ngokwenziwa kwezifundo ezibanzi ezingahlukene, ekucongeniseni izixazululo ezinzuzo ukuze kuhlangabezwe nezidingo zamanzi kanye nokuhlolwa kwezimpembeleko ezingaba khona ngokomphakathi, ezomnotho nasemvelweni. Ukubandakanyeka ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuPhatha amanzi, ukuHlolwa ngokuqhathanisa, ukulungisa nokubika ngokuphenya ngokuzipha kwangempela okungenzeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamanzi. UkuLungisa okungenayo ekwenzeni izinqumo ngokuhlobene nokuKhethwa, ukuQokwa kanye nokuLawulwa kwezinkonzo eziphathwa ngabangunjiniya abagunyaziwe.

xh.title: Injiniyela Yokukhiqiza inqanaba a - C
xh.summary: Kufuneka injiniyela yokukhiqiza kwiSebe lezeManzi nokuQhatha ePretoria ukuyila nokuphucula amathafa amanzi, kwaye kufuneka kubekho isidanga sezobunjiniyela zolwakhiwo nokuqatshelwa kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezobunjiniyela zolwakhiwo (B Eng/BSC (Eng). Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava emva kokufumana isidanga kwiCivil Engineering. Kuqatshelwe ngokuyimfuneko kwiEngineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengoMghanakazi weNjiniyela. Ukuzisa ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo namava endlwini yolawulo lwamathafa amanzi luyimfuneko. Ulwazi lweNational Water Act (no 36 of 1998) nakuwo namanye oomthetho obalulekileyo nokuchanekileyo njengeWater Services Act ne-national Environmental Management Act (no 107 of 1998) nomthetho othintela ukhuseleko lwamadama.
xh.duties: IiNjiniyela ziya kuxela kuChief Engineer kwelinye lamaNdawo oYilo eMantla, eMbindini, eMpuma okanye eMzantsi kwaye ziya kuba yinxalenye yeqela leprojekthi eliya kubandakanyeka ekuphuculeni nokuyleni ukusetyenziswa nokuphuhliswa kwamathafa amanzi eMzantsi Afrika ngokujonga iinketho ezahlukeneyo. Lo mntu uya kuba nawo umsebenzi wokuchonga amathafa amanzi afumanekayo nediyaya zophuhliso ngokwenziwa kweephononongo ezahlukeneyo zeendalo, ukuqamba iindlela ezingaba zizonke zimfuneko zokwanelisa iimfuno zamanzi nokujonga iimpembelelo ezinxulumene nentlalo, oqoqosho nendalo. Ukubandakanyeka ekuphuhlisweni kwezicwangciso zolawulo lwamanzi, ukuqhotsa izixhobo zolwazi, ukuphucula nokubika ngophando lokuba sebenzayo malunga nokuphuhliswa kwamathafa amanzi. Ukulungisa izalathiso ezingeniswa ezifuna isigqibo ngokukhethwa, ukwenzelwa nokulawula ababoneleli benkonzo yobunjiniyela.

jobs.summary: Production Engineer needed at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria to evaluate dam safety, classify dams, and assess licence applications.
jobs.requirements: An Engineering degree (B Eng/ BSc Eng) in Civil Engineering. Three (3) years post qualification Civil Engineering experience required. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Experience in dam engineering specifically in aspect of dam safety evaluation, design and construction supervision of dams is highly recommended. Knowledge of program and project management. Knowledge of technical design and analyses of dams. Significant dam engineering experience related to design, flood hydrology, construction, management, and safety of dams with a safety risk. Willingness to travel throughout South Africa when required for operational purposes. Knowledge of the water sector and relevant legislation (including but not limited to the Chapter 4 and Chapter 12 of National Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) and the Dam Safety Regulations published in Government Notice R. 139 of 24 February 2012). Understanding of research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications including relevant computer software knowledge. Technical report writing, networking, and professional judgement. Problem solving and analyses, decision making, team leadership, creativity, self-management, customer focus, and responsiveness Sound interpersonal and leadership skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Planning, organising, and people management.
jobs.duties: Investigate, analyse, and recommend classification of dams. Evaluate applications of Approved Professional Persons (APPs). Evaluate and investigate engineering aspects of licence applications for the construction of new dams, alteration of existing dams, first filling and operational aspects of dams. Monitor the safety evaluation and investigation reports and carry out risk assessments of dams. Follow up on dam safety betterment work with dam owners. Liaise with regional offices, dam owners, professional persons, APPs, and the public regarding dam safety matters. Conduct dam safety inspections at dams with a safety risk. Respond to emergency situations, such as dam failures, at dams and action Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs). Conduct site visits to illegal or unlawful constructed dams and compile technical reports for the issuance of illegal dam letters and directives. Develop and/or maintain guidelines and policies and advise on dam safety matters and legislation. Generate reports and statistics to measure progress with the Dam Safety Program. Support the Chief- and/or Specialist Engineer with all reasonable requests pertaining to dams with a safety risk. Assist with the development of Candidate Engineers, Candidate Engineering Technicians and Candidate Engineering Technologists for registration as professionals.

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad a - C
af.summary: Produksie-ingenieur benodig by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria om damveiligheid te evalueer, damme te klassifiseer en lisensie-aansoeke te assesseer.
af.requirements: 'n Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/ BSc Eng) in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Siviele Ingenieurswese na kwalifikasie word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Verklaring van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Ervaring in damingenieurswese, spesifiek ten opsigte van damveiligheids-evaluering, ontwerp en konstruksietoets van damme, word sterk aanbeveel. Kennis van program- en projektbestuur. Kennis van tegniese ontwerp en ontleding van damme. Beduidende damingenieurswese-ervaring rakende ontwerp, vloedhidrologie, konstruksie, bestuur en veiligheid van damme met 'n veiligheidsrisiko. Bereidwilligheid om vir operasionele doeleindes dwarsdeur Suid-Afrika te reis wanneer vereis. Kennis van die watersektor en relevante wetgewing (insluitend maar nie beperk tot Hoofstuk 4 en Hoofstuk 12 van die National Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) en die Dam Safety Regulations gepubliseer in Government Notice R. 139 van 24 February 2012). Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings insluitend relevante rekenaarsagtergrondkennis. Tegniese verslagskrywing, netwerkwerking en professionele oordeel. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming, spanleierskap, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, klienfokus en reaksievermoë. Sterk interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede. Sterk mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Beplanning, organisering en mensebestuur.
af.duties: Ondersoek, ontleed en beveel klassifikasie van damme aan. Evalueer aansoeke van Approved Professional Persons (APPs). Evalueer en ondersoek ingenieursaspekte van lisensie-aansoeke vir die konstruksie van nuwe damme, wysiging van bestaande damme, eerste vul en operasionele aspekte van damme. Monitor die veiligheids-evaluerings- en ondersoekverslae en voer risiko-assessmente van damme uit. Volg damveiligheidsverbeteringswerk by dameienaars na. Skakel met streekkantore, dameienaars, professionele persone, APPs en die publiek rakende damveiligheidsake. Voer damveiligheidsinspeksies by damme met 'n veiligheidsrisiko uit. Reageer op noodsituasies, soos damfalings, by damme en aktiveer Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs). Voer werksbesoeke aan onwettig geboude damme en stel tegniese verslae op vir die uitreik van onwettige dam-briewe en direktiewe. Ontwikkel en/of handhaaf riglyne en beleide en gee advies oor damveiligheidsake en wetgewing. Genereer verslae en statistieke om vordering met die Dam Safety Program te meet. Ondersteun die Hoof- en/of Spesialisingenieur met alle redelike versoeke rakende damme met 'n veiligheidsrisiko. Help met die ontwikkeling van Kandidaat-ingenieurs, Kandidaat-ingenieurstegnici en Kandidaat-ingenieurstegnoloë vir registrasie as professioneles.

zu.title: Umkhiqizi webhalansi yesikhundla izinga a - C
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wokukhiqiza e-Department of Water and Sanitation ePretoria ukuze ahlolo ukuphepha kwamadhemu, awelukanise amadhemu, futhi ahlolo izicelo zamalayisensi.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-Engineering (B Eng/ BSc Eng) ku-Civil Engineering. Kuyadingeka kube khona eminyakeni emithathu (3) yeminyaka yokuhlolwa okuhamba phambili kokuthola i-degree, koku-Civil Engineering. Ukubhalisa ngokuyikho ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengomphathi wezobuchwepheshe (Professional Engineer). Ukwethula ilayisensi yokushayela evuze futhi engakapheli. Kunconywa kakhulu ukuba nolwazi lokuhlolwa kwamadhemu ikakhulukazi okubhekene nokuhlola ukuphepha kwamadhemu, ukuklama nokuphatha ukwakhiwa kwamadhemu. Ulwazi mayelana nokuphatha izinhlelo nezinhlelo. Ulwazi lokuqamba izinhlelo zesikhathi eside kanye nesikhathi esifushane. Ulwazi lokulunga nokuqamba izinto eziyisikhathi eside. Ulwazi lokuqamba izinto eziyisikhathi eside nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqamba izinto eziyisikhathi eside mayelana nokulungiswa kwazo, izinga lamanzi, ukwakhiwa, ukuphathwa, kanye nokuphepha kwalezo izinto ngokuphepha. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika kanti kuyadingeka uma kunesidingo sokwenza imisebenzi. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yamanzi nomthetho ohlobene nalo (okuqukethe kodwa lingagcini lapho) Isahluko 4 kanye neSahluko 12 seNational Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) kanye Nemiyalo Yokuphepha Kwama-damu eshicilelwe Kumasiko Kazwelonke R. 139 ka-24 February 2012). Ukuzwa ngqo ngomthelela wamazwi abantu abaningi futhi ohlukanisa izinhlobo zamagama nokusetshenziswa kwawo. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi yocwaningo. Izinhlelo zokweluleka ezinganikeza amathuba okuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi esebenzisa amakhompyutha kanye nokwaziswa kwabo. Imibiko ethuthukiswa ngocwaningo nokudlondlobalwa ngomkhakha webhalansi. Ukulungisa izinkinga kanye nokuqonda okuhlobene nemibuzo yemisebenzi, ukuzethemba ekwenzeni izinqumo, ukukhuthaza nokuphatha abantu ngokuba ngabaholi, ukuzimisela, ukubhekana nabantu ngendlela eba khona, futhi nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphendula, ukuba nobungani kanye nokubekelana ngendlela yokuziphathe kalula, ukusebenza futhi uthole ulwazi. Isandulela sohlobo lwemibhalo yokungenwa okungenwa ubuchwepheshe emkhakheni wamakhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo mayelana namaphoyisa nokuqamba amaphoyisa.
zu.duties: Phenya, hlaziya, futhi uncome ukwelukaniswa kwamadhemu. Hlola izicelo zabantu Abahlolwayo Abakhulu (APPs). Hlola futhi uphenye izindlela zobuchwepheshe zezicelo zelayisensi zokwakha amadhemu amasha, ukushintsha amadhemu akhona, ukuqaliswa kokuqala kwegesi kanye nezindlela zokusebenza kwamadhemu. Qaphula imibiko yokuhlola kanye nokuphenya ukuphepha, futhi wenze ukuhlola izingozi kwamadhemu. Landela imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kwamadhemu nababanini amadhemu. Xhumana namahhovisi wesifunda, abanini amadhemu, abantu abakhulu, ama-APP, kanye nomphakathi ngemayelana nemikhuba yokuphepha kwamadhemu. Yenza okuhlolwa kokuphepha kwamadhemu kwamadhemu anengozi yokuphepha. Phendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, njengokuhluleka kwamadhemu, emadhemu futhi usebenzise Izinhlelo Zolungeleliswe Izenzakalo (EPPs). Yenza ukuvakashela izindawo kwamadhemu akhiwe ngokungemthetho noma ngokungalungile futhi uhlanganise imibiko yobuchwepheshe mayelana nokukhiphwa kwamagundwana amadhemu angemthetho kanye nemiyalo. Sungula futhi/noma gcina imihlahlandlela kanye nezinqubomgomo futhi uphakamise ngemikhuba yokuphepha kwamadhemu kanye nomthetho. Akha imibiko kanye nezibalo ukuze ulinganise inqubomgomo yokuphepha kwamadhemu. Sekela umphathi omkhulu- kanye/noma umphathi wezobuchwepheshe ngazo zonke izicelo eziyisidingo ezingamukeleka mayelana namadhemu anengozi yokuphepha. Siza ekuthuthukiseni ama-Engineer abafundi, Abafundi be-theknoloji yobu-Engineer kanye Naba Fundi Be-theknoloji be-Engineer ukuze babhalise njengabanemfundo.

xh.title: Injiniyezokuqulunqa Umveliso Inqanaba a - C
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNjiniyezokuqulunqa Umveliso kwisebe leZamanzi nokuQhushumba ePretoria ukuba hlola ukhuseleko lwamadama, wahlule iindidi zamadama, aze ahlole izicelo zamalayisense.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezobuNjiniyela (B Eng/ BSc Eng) kubuNjiniyela boMzila ongaziphelelanga. Kufuneka kube khona amakhulu amathathu (3) amnye eminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isidanga kwimizila yonke yeNjiniyela boMzila ongaziphelelanga. Kuyinyanzelo ukubhalisa kwiBhunga lezoBunjiniyela laseMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengoNjiniyela oSebenzayo. Ukubhalisa ilayisenisi yokushayela elisebenzayo, elingekabonngaqonya. Kumacebiso apha phambili ukuba nalo naziphi na amava kumzila wamadama ngokukodwa kwindawo yokuhlola ukhuseleko lwamadama, ukuyilela nokulawula ukwakhiwa kwamadama. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuyilela kweemfihlo kunye nokuqondwa kwamadama. Amava amakhulu kwimodeli yamadama ngokuhlobene nokuyilela, i-hydrology yemilingo, ukwakha, ukulawula, nokhuseleko lwamadama anengozi. Isabelo sokuhamba kulo lonke uMzantsi Afrika xa kuyimfuneko ngenjongo zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngoluntu lwamanzi nomthetho ofanelekileyo (kuquka kodwa angagqityelwa kuko Isiqendu 4 nesiQendu 12 somthetho kaZwelonke wokuManzi (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) kunye noMthetho woKhuseleko lwamadama ushicilelwe kuGovernment Notice R. 139 ngo-24 February 2012). Ukuqonda kuphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zokubuyela kwiNjiniyela ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka nolwazi lwenkqubo yekhompyutha. Ukwabhala iingxelo ngezobuchwepheshe, ukukopanela, negqibo ekubuzweni. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda, ukwenza iigqibo, ukuloba iqela, ukuzoba, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi, kwaye uphendule ngokukhawuleza; Amabono amaninzi ubugcisa bokuzonwabisa nokuloba iqela. Amabono amaninzi ethetha nokuqhathanisa. Amabono amaninzi obelethisa kokubili (ethetha nokuqhathanisa). Ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, nokulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Iphando, aze waqonda, aze acebeke ukwahlulwa kweendidi zamadama. Ukuhlolela izicelo zeBantu abaPhefumleliyo abaGunyaziweyo (APP). Ukuhlolela nokuphanda iimbonakaliso zeNjiniyela zezicelo zamalayisense zokwakhiwa kwamadama amatsha, ukutshintsha amadama akhoyo, ukuqala kuzaliswa amanzi kuwo, nesezinto ezisebenza kumadama. Ukujonga iingxelo zohlolo lwezokhuseleko zokuphandwa kwaye wenze ukulinganisa ingozi kwamadama. Ukulandela ukwenziwa kolwazi olungcono ngokhuseleko kwamadama namachibi abanamadama. Ukuqhagamshelana kumagumbi abo bagqithiswe kummandla, abanamadama, abantu abaPhefumleliyo abaGunyaziweyo (APP), nakuluntu mayela nendaba yokhuseleko lwamadama. Ukuqhutywa kwezihloko zokuqhathanisa ukhuseleko lwamadama kwamadama anengozi. Ukuphendula kwiimeko zomngcipheko, njengokuphuka kwamadama, nakumadama nokuphatha iCwangciso eLungele uKulinganisa umNgcipheko (EPP). Ukuqhutywa okuhamba ndawonye kumadama akhiwe ngendlela engasebenzisayo nakho na ukuyicela baze bagqibe iingxelo zezobuchwepheshe zokunika oonobumba bengxelo yamadama angamnye nokunika iziqondiso. Ukuqamba nokugcina izalathiso namacebo ngokubaluleka kwexabiso lokhuseleko lwamadama naye achebeke ngendaba yokhuseleko lwamadama nomthetho. Ukubakha iingxelo neesithathuthele sazo ukulinganisa inyathelo loNqwenqwesho loKhuseleko lwaManzi. Ukuxhasa iNjiniyela eNkosana nokuNjiniyela oPhezulu kwizicelo ezizezona azifunayo malunga namadama anengozi yakhuseleko. Ukunceda abakufunde ubuNjiniyela abafuna ukuba bengamnye wabaBhalisiweyo abafuna ukuMjiniyela abafuna ukuba besiGqithisi sabo sokuba bayiNjiniyela abajwayelekileyo abalathisiweyo abakwaziyo ukubhalisa njengabantu abakwaziyo ukuba ngabasebenzi abakwaziyo ukuba ngabasebenzi abakwaziyo abajwayelekileyo abakwaziyo ukuba sesikhundleni sabo.

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad a - C

zu.title: Injiniye Yokukhiqiza Izinga a - C
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniye yokukhiqiza eDepartment of Water and Sanitation ePretoria ukuyakha izimiso, ukuhlela amaphrojekhi kanye nokuthuthukisa izixazululo zobunjiniye ezizinqabele.
zu.requirements: I-B Eng noma i-BSc Eng Degree yobuNjiniye kwi-Mechanical Engineering. Emva kokuthola iziqu kuyadingeka kube namaphamu amathathu (3). Kudingeka sibe namava obunjiniye. Ukuqanjelwa kuyingxenye okuphoqele kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniye oyingcalene. Ukuzivulela ilayisensi yokushayela esevakadile nengakapheli. Ukwazi kahle ukuphathwa kwamanzi njalo nokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi.ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekhi. Ukucabangisiswa kwakho nge-study, knowledge, kanye nokulawula abantu. Ukuzibophezela ekufundiseni futhi ekudluliselen ulwazi; Isigaba esithi Ukwazi ukubala imefutho yemibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukudweba okuvamile kanye namaphrosedha ukuze kufakwe ithkinoloji entsha; Kubhalwa izinkomba ze-tender; Kubheka ngokucophelela ukuze kutholwe ukuthi ukuhlela nokudweba abakwabanye kwenziwe ngokuvumelana nemigomo yobunjiniye ehle njengoba kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezenzakalelayo. Ukuqasha ukuthi abakwa-ofisi abaqashiwe bathole iziqu bengakabi ngayinye kanti bathole iziqu ze-tender nakancane bengagqamanga kukho imininingwane elandelayo; Kubuyekezwa futhi kubhalwe imigomo yemisebenzi yobunjiniye; Kwenziwa inhlalo yokuphatha abasebenzi bokuqeqesha ekuthuthukiseni iziqu kanye namakhandidethi, ukuqinisekiswa kwengcindezi yokusebenza ngendlela efanele, ukwazi ukulawula isabelo sendawo, kanye nokusebenzisa ulimi kahle emibhalweni evela, ukwazi ukubika kubantu ngokusemthethweni nezinga elikhulu lemfundo, ukulawula imali etholwayo, ukulawula imibango engaphezulu; ukuphathwa komuntu wesilisa wesifazane; ukuphathwa kwesithombe, ukulawula imisebenzi, ukwazi ukuthola izixazululo, ukwazi ukutshala imali, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokulwa nobudlozayo.
zu.duties: Dweba izimiso entsha ukuze kuxazululeke izinkinga zensimbi zefakha lemifula kuye kwaphuculwe ukusebenza kahle komshini kanye nokuvikelwa abasebenzi. Hlela, dweba, sebela, ukugcina nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo zemisebenzi; Thuthukisa izixazululo ezingabizi kakhulu ngokuvumelana nemithetho esemthethweni;ilinganisa imibhalo ekhona yezinsimbi, izithombe ezivamile kanye namaphrosedha ukuze kufakwe ithkinoloji entsha; Thuthukisa izinkomba ze-tender; Qinisekisa ngokuqonda ukuthi ukuhlela nokudweba kwenziwe ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zemisebenzi yobunjiniye ehle njengoba kuhambisana namathuluzi nemithetho yokusebenza ngokuvumelana nemithetho esemthethweni ukuze kutholwe isigqibo; Qeda imisebenzi yobunjiniye ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso ezichaziwe nemithetho yokuphatha; Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhandidethi nezinsimbi, amakhandidethi, ukuqeqeshwa kolwazi kokuqonda, ukwazi, ukubuyela emuva futhi ulalele imithetho yobunjiniye okuhle, kwakanye namathuluzi okulalela; Ukuphatha i-ofisi, ukubala ukugcinwa kwemali ekhokhelwa imisebenzi; Ukucwaninga imibhalo yokusebenza, izifundo zamalebula eNzalo, ulwazi lokugcina izinsimbi, ukukhiqiza nokutholakala kolwazi.

xh.title: Injiniyela Wokukhiqiza Inqanaba a - C
xh.summary: Kufunwa Injiniyela Wokukhiqiza kwiSebe leManzi nokuCima amathuba ePretoria ukuyila iinkqubo, ukuqamba iiprojekthi kwaye aphuhamise izisombululu ezityhila ixabiso lezobunjiniyela.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seB Eng okanye iBSc Eng sobuNjiniyela kwiMechanical Engineering. Iiminyaka elithathu (3) emva kokufumana isifundo. Kufuneki nolwazi lobunjiniyela. Ukubhalisa ngokunyanzelisayo kuEngineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengomprofeshonale weNjiniyela. Ukuvumba ilayisenisi yokushayela evalidi nengazange iphiele. Ulwazi olululo lolawulo lwamanzi oludityanisiweyo nokukhuselwa kwemithombo yamanzi. Ukuqonda kolawulo lweenkqubo neeprojekthi. Ulwazi loluyilo nokuhlalutya lubunjiniyela kuquka kodwa lingagqithiswa kwiipampu neenkqubo zamapampu, imisebenzi yokuphuma kwamadam ukuyila ngokwezobuchwephesha ezimeko kobuso nobuqambo kwaye naseMisebenzi woLawulo loMthombo woManzi. Ulwazi lophando nentuthuko. Iinkqubo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwizobunjiniyela. Ulwazi logunyaziso lomthetho, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla kwaye nokuqonda okusemthethweni. Ukwenza izigqibo, ukuba ngumphathi weqela namakhono ahlalutyo. Ukwenza izinto ngokwemveliso, ukuzilawula, izimali, ukulawula iingxabano nokuLawula abantu. Ukuqonda izinto kubathengi kwaye uphendule ngokukhawuleza. Isithembu sokuhamba kulo lonke ilizwe. Amakhono oluthetho oluhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukulawula utshintsho nokuvelisa izinto ezintsha.
xh.duties: Kuyila iinkqubo ezintsha ukusombulula iingxaki zobunjiniyela ezisebenzayo kwaye ukuphucula ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nakho kuthuthuzele ukhuseleko. Ukuqamba, ukuyila, ukusebenzisa kwaye ugcine iiprojekthi zobunjiniyela; Uphuhlise izisombululu ezingabizi kakhulu ngokwemigangatho evunyiweyo; Ukuhlalutya imanuals zobuchwephesha ezikhoyo, iidayimpha ezingqamileyo neenkqubo ukuze ufake nobuchwephesha obutsha; Uphuhlise iispekishini zokuqengqelela; Qinisekisa ngokuhlalutya ukuba ukuqamba nokuyila abakwenzayo kwenziwa ngokwemigaqo esisiseko yobunjiniyela kwaye ngokwemigaqo nemilinganisyo yokuqamba; Vuma imisebenzi yobunjiniyela ngokwemigaqo nemilinganisyo ebonisiweyo; Qinisekisa uqeqesho nentuthuko yabantu basebenza ngobuchwepheshe, nabakhiqizi njengamakhandaphathi abanjiniyela ukunxibelelanisa ulwazi namakhono kwaye kuqatshelwe imigaqo esisiseko yobunjiniyela nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi; Urhulumente kwindlu yomsebenzi nocwangciso webhajethi; Uphenisisa kwiinkqubo zophando ngobuchwephesha zobunjiniyela ukuphucisa amakhono.

Ukuvezwa kolayisense lokushayela okusebenzayo. Ukuqonda kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nezinto. Ulwazi kanye noqondezulu lwezidingo zikahulumeni ekuthengeni izinto ezitholakala kumaphrojekthi ezingxenyekazi. Ulwazi noqondezulu lwezincwadi zomthetho kahulumeni ezihlobene nendima. Ulwazi ekuyilweni kwezinkalo zezinsiza kanye nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi ekuphenyini izinto ezintsha kwaye zithuthukiswe. Ukubhala okusobala ngezinto ezenziwayo. Isiqondi sokuphatha iqhaza, ukweluleka nokuhlela. Ukuqonda kwezimali, ukuphatha ukungaboni njalo komqondo nokuphatha abantu. Ukusebenzisa isikhompiyutha.

Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlela nokuyila ngamanye akwenziwa ngaphandle kwemithetho yezobunjiniya. Hlinzeka ngomsizi oguqukayo otholakala ngaphandle komthetho. Hlola imibhalo ekhona yemiyalo, kanye nokuqonda okuqukethwe kuyo. Hlaziya izinto ezenziwayo. Yila izindlela ezintsha ukunika isibonakaliso esihle samaphrojekthi. Pheqa izingxenye ngendlela ehamba kahle ekunyuseni isimo. Yila ukuthi kwenziwe njani. Hlinzeka ngomsizi ohleliwe oguqukayo oguqulwe ngokuka somophathi. Pheqa futhi uhlole izinto ezitholakala ezindaweni zikahulumeni ezihlukene eziphathwa ngamaphrojekthi ezingxenyekazi. Yila amasu okubeka imithetho yokuthengiswa kwamaphrojekthi. Hlinzeka ngohlelo lokubeka isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu. Beka imithetho ephathwa ngayo imisebenzi ehleliwe eqinisekiswa. Qinisekisa izinga elihle kokuba kuhle kakhulu. Pheqa futhi uhlole imithetho yezinsiza zendawo. Beka izinsiza ezahlukene ezitholakala emaphrojekthini. Hlinzeka ngesiqondi esihle sokusebenza. Pheqa futhi uhlole imisebenzi ehleliwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhle kakhulu.

xh.title: Injiniya (PRODUCTION) Inqanaba a – C
xh.summary: Injiniya yoKukhiqiza Inqanaba A ukuya ku-C ebhalisiwe kwi-ECSA, iphela imele iiprojekthi zenjinari kwaye zigcinwe ze-Isebe leManzi nokuQhushumba kwi-Mbombela.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Civil Engineering (B Eng / BSC (Eng) okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7. Iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava enjinari emva kokuthweswa isidanga. Ubhaliso obuyiyo kwi-Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Professional Engineer (Pr Eng). Ukuzivula ngeelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ezingapheliyo. Ukuqonda ukulawula amanqanaba namaprojekthi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuthenga kwurhulumente kwiiiprojekthi zolwakhiwo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho karhulumente ehlobene neli candelo. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yenzululwazi kuhlalutyo. Ulwazi ngophando nophuhliso. Ukwabhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukukhokela iqela, ukuceba kwaye ukuhlela, namakhono ekuhlalutyeni. Ukuqonda amakhono okulawula iimali, abantu noku管理a imigodzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Kuyilwa iinkqubo ezintsha ukusombulula iingcinga zomsebenzi wezomzobo, ukuphucula isiphezulu kwaye kuqhubeke kukhuselekile. Kuceba, kuyile, kuqhuba kwaye kugcina amaprojekthi obuchwepheshe. Kuqinisekiswa ngokuhlalutya okuba ukuceba nokuyila abakwenzayo kwenziwe ngokwemiqathango engundoqo yenjinari nangokomgangatho kwaye ngokwemiqathano yemisebenzi. Kuphuhliswa izisombululu ezikwaxabiso ngenjongo ethile ngokomgangatho. Kuqwalaselwa amanwadi obuchwepheshe amagama adibanisiweyo, iinkcazelo ezingagqibekanga, namanyuzelo ukuze kungeniswe inqanaba elitsha lobuchwepheshe. Kuhlalutya kwaye kwenziwa isalathiso malunga nokuceba, ukuyila, ukwakha noku gcina iinkqubo zemveliso igazi elingcolileyo kwaye noku mxhaka amanzi oqhagamshelwano, kuquka ukuthwala, ukuphathwa, oku gciniweyo, ukusasazwa, kwaye nasipho. Kuphuhliso koku ceba okanye / iinkqubo zokusebenza izicwangciso okanye iinkqubo zoxhaso lokuqamba malunga nophuhliso lwamanzi okanye / / la lwamanzi okulawula izixhobo ezingundoqo. Kuyilwa iinkcazelo ezithile malunga ne nkqubo yokulinga ngokusabela. Iinkqubo ze-Business Plan. Kuvunywa imisebenzi yamathu arhothothi ngokwezimiso ezibekiweyo namagunya. Kuqinisekiswa ukuziqeqesha nokuphuhlisa kwabasebenzi abakwanayo, iinkampani ezikumgangatho, kwaye ukwakha iinkqubo zobuchwepheshe kubakho ukuthumela iinkqubo zabantu, nasekuthobelweni kwemithetho yamathu arhothothi, kwaye kwikhowudi yokusebenza emi qathano. Kuyalathwa umsebenzi okhoyo noyilo lwezinxulumana namathu arhothothi. Kwenziwa ukulawula ukuphumelela nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi. Kuqinisekiswa ukuthobela imithetho nolandelo lokuthenga abantu abasebenza ngokurhulumente. Kulawulwa abantu abasebenzayo. Kususa kwaye kuthathwa ingqalelo lokuchitha. Kwenziwa ingxelo malunga nokuchitha noku dibanisa abasebenzi emkhakheni ngokufanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 – R1 189 767 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on years of experience)
jobs.summary: A production scientist is needed to manage hydrological data acquisition, processing, auditing and archiving for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Gauteng.
jobs.requirements: A Science (BSc) (Hons) Degree or relevant qualification. Three (3) years post qualification natural scientific experience in the field of Hydrology. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Computer literate. Good understanding on the processes and mechanisms for data acquisition, processing, auditing, archiving, and dissemination including information flow processes. Knowledge and understanding on Chapter 15 of the National Water Act (Act 36 of 1998). Scientific methodologies and models. Research and development. Technical report writing. Data analysis. Presentation skills. Mentoring. Decision making. Analytical skills. Creativity. Problem solving and analysis. Innovation. Good technical, scientific report writing and interpretation skills. Ability to work productively in an environment consisting of interdisciplinary internal and external stakeholders. Sound interpersonal skills as well as willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively in remote areas.
jobs.duties: Provide technical role regarding hydrological data acquisition and data processing. Application of scientific skills in data auditing and information improvement using appropriate data and information systems (Hydstra). Ensure the application of standards and procedures in data auditing and quality improvement of historical hydrological data. Ensure good quality data with minimal gaps is archived and available for use in Hydstra. Provide inputs and technical support within the Directorate: Water Resource Management Support regarding correcting errors and spikes found in data. Ability to analyse hydrological data, identify and fill gaps to improve data quality. Disseminate data and information to intending users in appropriate forms (usable computer files of raw data). Engage to provide understanding and clarity on the hydrological data disseminated to all users. Compilation of annual statical summaries in yearbook form. Ability to Interpret and compile reports summaries of hydrological data (stream flows and levels). Give inputs in the projects relevant to the optimisation of Provincial water resource monitoring network initiated by the department. Assist with the facilitation of training and career development of staff. Supervision of staff. Assist in the development and setting of standards, policies, and systems for data collection in the water sector. Conduct field visits to evaluate and assess gauging stations across Gauteng Province.
