af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad a
af.summary: Daar word 'n produksiewetenskaplike benodig om die verkryging, verwerking, ouditering en argivering van hidrologiese data vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Gauteng te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Wetenskaplike (BSc) (Hons) graad of relevante kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie natuurlwetenskaplike ervaring in die veld van Hidrologie. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaargeletterd. Goeie begrip van die prosesse en meganismes vir dataverkryging, -verwerking, -ouditering, -argivering en -verspreiding, insluitend inligtingsvloeiprosesse. Kennis en begrip van Hoofstuk 15 van die National Water Act (Act 36 of 1998). Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Data-ontleding. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Mentorskap. Besluitneming. Analitiese vaardighede. Kreatiwiteit. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Innovasie. Goeie tegniese, wetenskaplike verslagskrywing en interpretasievaardighede. Vermoë om produktief te werk in 'n omgewing wat bestaan uit interdissiplinêre interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede asook bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en wyd in afgeleë gebiede te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n tegniese rol met betrekking tot hidrologiese dataverkryging en dataverwerking. Toepassing van wetenskaplike vaardighede in data-ouditering en inligtingsverbetering deur gebruik van toepaslike data- en inligtingstelsels (Hydstra). Verseker die toepassing van standaarde en prosedures in data-ouditering en gehalteverbetering van historiese hidrologiese data. Verseker dat goeie gehalte data met minimale gapings geargiveer en beskikbaar is vir gebruik in Hydstra. Verskaf insette en tegniese ondersteuning binne die Directorate: Water Resource Management Support met betrekking tot die korrigering van foute en spitsies wat in data gevind word. Vermoë om hidrologiese data te ontleed, gapings te identifiseer en in te vul om datakwaliteit te verbeter. Versprei data en inligting aan voornemende gebruikers in toepaslike vorme (bruikbare rekenaarlêers van rou data. Tree in aanlyn om begrip en duidelikheid te gee oor die hidrologiese data wat aan alle gebruikers versprei word. Samestelling van jaarlikse statiese opsommings in jaarboekvorm. Vermoë om hidrologiese data (stroomvloei en vlakke) te interpreteer en verslagopsommings saam te stel. Verskaf insette in projekte wat verband hou met die optimalisering van die provinsiale waterhulpbron-moniteringsnetwerk wat deur die departement inisieer is. Bied bystand met die facilitering van opleiding en loopbaanontwikkeling van personeel. Toesig oor personeel. Bied bystand by die ontwikkeling en opstel van standaarde, beleide en stelsels vir dataversameling in die watersektor. Doen veldbesoeke om meetstasies reg Gauteng Provinsie te evalueer en te assesseer.

zu.title: Usosayensi Wokukhiqiza Izinga a
zu.summary: Kudingeka usosayensi wokukhiqiza ukuphatha ukuthola, ukucubungula, ukuhlola nokugcina imininingwane yamanzi e-Department of Water and Sanitation eGauteng.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Science (BSc) (Hons) noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Isikhathi esingaba yiminyaka emithathu (3) sokusebenza emkhakheni wesayensi yemvelo ngemva kokuthola izifundo emkhakheni we-Hydrology. Ukubhalisa ku-SACNASP njengososayensi wezemvelo okuyinto ephoqelekile. Ukwazisa ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ezingapheli. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngakomkhomba-mlilo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuqhubekayo kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola, ukucubungula, ukuhlola, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa imininingwane kuhlanganise izinqubo zokugeleza kwemininingwane. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngasuKwesithi 15 se-National Water Act (Act 36 of 1998). Izindlela zesayensi namamodeli. Ucwaningo nokuqhubeka kolwazi. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlaziya imininingwane. Amakhono okubamba inkulumo. Ukwelisa. Ukwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ubuciko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Intuthuko entsha. Amakhono ahle obuchwepheshe, okubhala imibiko yesayensi nokutolika. Ikono lokusebenza ngenqikithi endaweni enezinhlaka ezingaphandle kanye nezangaphakathi ezihlukene. Amakhono ahle abantu kanye nokuqonda nokusebenza amahora angajwayelekile futhi uhambe kakhulu ezindaweni ezikude.
zu.duties: Dlala indima yobuchwepheshe ngokuphathelene nokuthola imininingwane yamanzi kanye nokucubungula imininingwane. Ukusebenzisa amakhono esayensi ekuhloleni imininingwane nokuqhubeka kolwazi usebenzisa izinhlelo ezifanele zemininingwane nolwazi (Hydstra). Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilinganiso nezinqubo ekuhloleni imininingwane nokuqhubeka kolwazi lweziqu ezitholakala emininingwaneni yamanzi esikhathini esedlule. Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane ehle ngaphandle kwezikhala eziningi igcinwe futhi itholakale ukusetshenziswa kwi-Hydstra. Nikeza izindlela nokweseka ubuchwepheshe ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate: Water Resource Management Support ngokuphathelene nokulungisa amaphutha kanye nokweqela okutholakala emininingwaneni. Ikono lokuhlaziya imininingwane yamanzi, ukuyithola futhi ukugcwalisa izikhala ukuphucula izinga lemininingwane. Sabalalisa imininingwane nolwazi kubasebenzisi abayifunayo ngendlela efanele (amafayela wakhompyutha okusebenzisa imininingwane engahlaziywanga). Hlanganyela ukunikeza ukuqonda nokucacisa imininingwane yamanzi ephiswe kubo bonke abasebenzisi. Ukulungiselela izifinyezo ezinyakeni zonyaka ngendlela yebhuku lenyanga. Ikono lokutoluka nokubhala imibiko evela emininingwaneni yamanzi (ukugeleza kanye namazinga amanzi). Nikeza izimiso emaphrojekthi ahlobene nokuthuthukisa inethiwekhi yokulondoloba amanzi esifundazwe eqaliswe umnyango. Siza ekweliseni nakuqhubukeni kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukugada abasebenzi. Siza ekwakheni nokumisa izilinganiso, izinqubomgomo, nezinhlelo zokuqoqa imininingwane emkhakheni wamanzi. Yenza izivakashi zasendaweni ukuze uhlola futhi uqashe iziteshi zokulinganisa kulo lonke i-Gauteng Province.

xh.title: Isayensi yeMveliso inqanaba a
xh.summary: Kufuneki isayensi yemveliso ekusingathweni kolwazi ngamanzi, ukuqhelanisa, ukuhlola nokugcina iirekodi zeNdawo yokuBamba amanzi eGauteng.
xh.requirements: Iseyensi (BSc) (Hons) idangatya okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo. Iyahlo (3) iminyaka emva kokuba negunya isipili sesayensi yemveliso kwilizwe le-Hydrology. Kuyaphothwe ukubhalisa kwi-SACNASP njengengcali yesayensi yemveliso. Kufuneka kubonise ilayisenisi yokushayela engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kakuhle. Ukuqonda kakuhle iinkqubo neendlela zokuthatha ulwazi, ukulungisa, ukuhlola, ukugcina, nokusasaza ulwazi kuquka neenkqubo zokuha ulwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngeSahluko 15 seMthetho weZwelonke wamanzi (UMthetho 36 ka-1998). Iindlela zokuqhelanisa kwisayensi neemodeli. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Ukubhala iingxelo ezithe ngemigaqo. Ukuhlolwa kolwazi. Amabizo okubonisa. Ukukhokela. Ukwenza izigqibo. Amabizo okuhlola. Ubuchule. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlola. Ubuchule bokuzisa into entsha. Amabizo okubhala iingxelo ezithe ngemigaqo zesayensi nokuqhuba imibuzo yemigaqo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngemveliso kwendawo esequka abantu abavela kwizahluko ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ubuchule bokuhamba nabantu abaxhosa kunye nethemba lokusebenza amavesi angalunganga kwaye uhamba kakhulu kumap amakhulu amancinci.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemigaqo malunga nokuthatha ulwazi ngamanzi nokuqhelanisa kolwazi. Faka amabizo esayensi ekuhloleni ulwazi nokuphucula inkcazelo ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi namaxabiso alungele (Hydstra). Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemigaqo neendlela ekuhloleni ulwazi nangokuphucula iwthwasi lwamanzi lwexesha elidlulileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olusemgangathweni olungekho masimba lugcinwe lwaye lufumaneka kwi-Hydstra. Nika amagama axhaso emigaqo ngaphakathi kwiDirectorate: Water Resource Management Support malunga nokulungisa amaphutha namaphuphu afumaneka kulwazi. Isakhono sokuwahlola ulwazi ngamanzi, sokuqamba nokuzalisa iindawo ezize ukuphucula iwthwasi lolwazi. Sasaza ulwazi nolwazi kubasebenzisi abanethemba ngendlela ezifanelekileyo (amafayili ekhompyutha alungele iimveliso zolwazi). Thetha ukunika ukuqonda nokucacisa malunga nolwazi ngamanzi olusasazwa kubo bonke abasebenzisi. Ukuqamba iisathistikhazihlo zonyaka ngendlela yencwadi yonyaka. Isakhono sokuqhuba nokudibanisa iingxelo ezimfutshane zolwazi ngamanzi (iimvobo namanxweme). Nika amagama eziplinjini ezihlobene nokwenza ulwazi lolwazi lolwazi lolwazi lolwazi lwendawo yamaphondo asungulwe yisebe. Nceda ngokulungelelanisa ukuqeqesha nophuhliso lomsebenzi babasebenzi. Ukuqonda kwabasebenzi. Nceda kuphuuhliso nasemfunyekeni kwemigaqo, iindaba, neendlela zokuthatha ulwazi kwibizo lemanzi. Yenza iindwendwe zasezibukweni nokuqonda nokuhlola iindawo zokulinganisa kulo lonke iphondo lase-Gauteng.

jobs.summary: Control Environmental Officer Grade A implementing the National Water Act and river health monitoring in Durban for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A 4-year Degree or relevant qualification in Natural or Environmental Sciences Six (6) years post-qualification experience. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of the National Water Act and all water related and relevant Environmental Management legislation and policies. Sound knowledge of all aspects and processes related to Resource Directed Measures and Integrated Water Resource Management. Knowledge and experience on River Health Monitoring and indices. Knowledge and understanding of the tools developed for Reserve determination. Proven ability and experience to write and interpret technical and scientific reports and documents and assist with the management of projects. Proven management and negotiation skills. Ability to work productively in an environment consisting of multidisciplinary internal and external PUCMA staff and stakeholders. Computer literacy. Good written and verbal communication, presentation, and report writing skills. Able to provide technical and scientific support to other PUCMA functions as well as the ability to capacitate and act as a mentor and supervisor to junior staff. Good interpersonal skills. Implementation and co-ordination of the Adopt-a-River Initiative (ARI). Organize field trips and assist with the preparation of the required supportive technical information as well as the writing of technical and other reports. Liaise with the Department Water and Sanitation on Adopt-a-River initiatives, reserve determination and implementation, River Health Programme, and other programmes. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders regarding RDM initiatives, especially ARI. Integrate reserve determinations with other PUCMA functions such as water use license applications and provide general technical and scientific support and comments. Develop ToR’s and manage PSPs. Participate in capacity building programmes and mentorship programmes for junior staff. Prepare monthly reports and quarterly reports. Ensure adherence to deadlines on submissions as per the Standard Operating Procedures. Manage and ensure effective financial planning for water resource management. Supervise staff in accordance with PUCMA policies and procedures.

af.title: Beheer Omgewingsbeampte Graad A
af.summary: Beheer Omgewingsbeampte Graad A wat die Nasionale Waterwet en rivierge sondmonitering in Durban vir die Department of Water and Sanitation implementeer.
af.requirements: A 4-jarige graad of relevante kwalifikasie in Natuur- of Omggingswetenskappe. Ses (6) jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet en alle waterverwante en relevante Omgewingsbestuurswetgewing en beleide. Deeglike kennis van alle aspekte en prosesse wat verband hou met Resource Directed Measures en Integrated Water Resource Management. Kennis en ervaring van River Health Monitoring en indekse. Kennis en begrip van die instrumente wat vir Reserve determination ontwikkel is. Bewese vermoë en ervaring om tegniese en wetenskaplike verslae en dokumente te skryf en te interpreteer en om met die bestuur van projekte te help. Bewese bestuurs- en onderhandelingvaardighede. Vermoë om produktief te werk in 'n omgewing wat uit multidissiplinère interne en eksterne PUCMA-personaal en belanghebbendes bestaan. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie-, aanbiedings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. In staat om tegniese en wetenskaplike ondersteuning aan ander PUCMA-funksies te verleen asook die vermoë om junior personeel op te lei en as mentor en toesighouer op te tree. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om met gemeenskappe en belanghebbende groepe te skakel.
af.duties: Implementering van die National Water Act 36 van 1998 met die fokus op Resource Directed Measures (RDM). Die implementering van die Reserve in die WMA. Implementering en koördinering van die Adopt-a-River Initiative (ARI). River Health Monitoring in the Pongola-Mtamvuna Water Management Area. Voer lae-vlak reserve determinations uit, insluitend die loop van hidrologie en ander relevante modelle waar nodig. Reël velddienste en help met die voorbereiding van die vereiste ondersteunende tegniese inligting asook die skryf van tegniese en ander verslae. Skakel met die Department Water and Sanitation oor Adopt-a-River inisiatiewe, reserve determination en implementering, River Health Programme, en ander programme. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes rakende RDM inisiatiewe, veral ARI. Integreer reserve determinations met ander PUCMA-funksies soos water gebruik lisensie aansoeke en verskaf algemene tegniese en wetenskaplike ondersteuning en kommentaar. Ontwikkel ToR's en bestuur PSP's. Neem deel aan kapasiteitsbouprogramme en mentorskapsprogramme vir junior personeel. Berei maandelikse verslae en kwartaalverslae voor. Verseker nakoming van sperdatums vir voorleggings volgens die Standard Operating Procedures. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe finansiële beplanning vir waterhulpbronbestuur. Oefen toesig oor personeel uit in ooreenstemming met PUCMA-beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Isikhundla SoMphathi Wezemvelo izinga A
zu.summary: Isikhundla SoMphathi Wezemvelo izinga A sokuphumeza i-National Water Act nokulondolozwa impilo yemifula e-Durban kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 noma iziqu ezihambisanayo kwez Sayensi Yemvelo noma Zezemvelo. Unyaka oyisithupha (6) weminyaka yokuhlolwa ngemva kweziqu. Ukwazisa isilayisense sokushayela esivumelekileyo esingekupheli. Ulwazi ngomthetho i-National Water Act nayo yonke imithetho nezenqubo ezihlobene namanzi nezokuLawula Imvelo. Ulwazi olujulile ngazo zonke izingxenye namacandu ahlobene ne-Resource Directed Measures kanye ne-Integrated Water Resource Management. Ulwazi loluhlelo lokulondolozwa impilo yemifula futhi namagama ahlobene nalokhu. Ulwazi nokuqonda amathuluzi asuselwa ekuqondweni kwe-Reserve. Ikhono elivezwe ukubhala nokuhumusha imibiko nemitshwalense yezobuchwepheshe futhi usize ekuphathweni kwamaprojekthi. Amakhono obukhosi kanye nobuhlakaniph ekuxoxiswaneni. Ikhono lokusebenza ngemvelo ehlanganisa abasebenzi bangaphakathi nangaphandle be-PUCMA abavela kumacandu ahlukene. Ulwazi lokusebenla ngocwelingcompyutha. Amakhono mahle okubhala nokuqoqisana, aphatha inkinga, nokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokunika inkxaso yezobuchwepheshe nezisayensi eminye imisebenzi ye-PUCMA, kanye nokuqasha ukuba ngumchithi nosihlalo kubasebenzi abasafunda. Amakhono amahle okusebenelana nabantu. Ikhono lokuqhakamshelana namakhomphuyunithi namaqembu alinganiselwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphumeza i-National Water Act 36 of 1998 ngokugqamisa kuma-Resource Directed Measures (RDM). Ukuphumeza i-Reserve kuma-WMA. Ukuphumeza nokoqoqisa i-Adopt-a-River Initiative (ARI). Ukulondolozwa kweMpilo Yemifula kuma-Pongola-Mtamvuna Water Management Area, ukwenza ama-reserve ahlakaniphile, okuhlanganisa ukuqhuba ihayidoloji namanye amamojula ahoike lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuhlela izinkalo zokuya ezinkundleni futhi usize ekulungiseni ulwazi lothehnikhali oludingeka kanye nokubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe nanhinye. Ukuxhumana ne-Department Water and Sanitation mayelana nezinhlelo ze-Adopt-a-River, ukuqondwa nokusetshenziswa kwe-Reserve, uhlelo lweMpilo Yemifula, nanhinye izinhlelo. Ukuxhumana nabalawuli bangaphakathi futhi bangaphandle ngamagqabaza e-RDM, ikakhulu i-ARI. Ukuhlanganisa ukuqondwa kwe-Reserve nanhinye imisebenzi ye-PUCMA njengemibiko yokuthenga ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kanye nokukhokha ngokujwayelekile inkxaso nokuqonda ngezobuchwepheshe nezisayensi futhi nike imibono. Ukulunga i-ToR's futhi uphele i-PSPs. Ukuba yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono namaprogramu okuba ngumchithi kubasebenzi abasafunda. Ukulungisa imibiko yanyanga zonke imibiko yesikhathi esithathu. Ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi kugcinwa izinsuku zokuphela ngokuhambisana ne-Standard Operating Procedures. Ukuphatha futhi uqiniseke isikhwama esihle semali ekulawulweni kwemithombo yamanzi. Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezenqubo namapholisi we-PUCMA.

xh.title: ISikhululi sikaMphathi wezeMizekelo esiKwindla esilungileyo Grade a
xh.summary: ISikhululi sikaMphathi wezeMizekelo esiKwindla Grade A esithintela ngokusebenzisa uMthetho wezeMvula yoMzantsi Afrika nokulawula impilo yemilambo eDurban kwisebe lezeMvula nokuQinisekisa ukuCoceka.
xh.requirements: IDigri yeminyaka emi-4 okanye izifundo ezifaneleyo kwiZiNzululwazi zeNdalo okanye zeMizekelo. Amashumi amathandathu (6) eminyaka yamava emva kokuqeshwa. Ukuzivula ngeelayisensi yokushayela ekelumeelayo nesebenzayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezeMvula yoMzantsi Afrika nayo yonke imithetho kwaye iinkqubo ezithintelwa ukulawula iMizekelo ezidityaniswe namanzi. Ulwazi olucacileyo ngeendlela zonke iinkqubo ezithintelwa ukwenziwa kweZiga eziQondwa ziSabelo nokuLawulwa kokuHlanganiswa koBulela bamanzi. Ulwazi namava ngokuQwalaselwa kweMpilo yemiLambo namanqaku ezoNto kummandla oLawulwa amanzi iNqanaba leBumba yokuLawula amanzi iKomani-Qonce, Condolisa ngokubeka amagcisa azo kwaye yaye athembise ukuba akhoyo ngokusebenza iintlobo zeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo nezinye ezingagqitywa yiNqanaba leNgqondo zoBuchule njengoko kuyimfuneko. 1 : Ukuqwalasela inkqubo engangenisa ulwazi, unako na ukuyenza kweyakho inkqubo yokuvavanya imidlalo yelizwe nangezinye iingcali zolwazi lwesayensi, kwaye ufuna isikhundla kumazwe angaphandle; ngoko ke, uthembisa ukuba uzakwenza imisebenzi yakho ngokufanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngokusebenza iindidi ezahlukeneyo zokulinganisa amanzi, nokukwazi ukusebenzisa iiprogramu ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenza oku. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezixhobo ezilungele ukucwangciswa kwesabelo ngokusemthethweni. Ukuzimisela okubonakalayo kwamava ukubhala nokutolika iingxelo zemiba yobugcisa nobungcali kwaye uncedise ekulawulweni kweeprojekthi. Amakhono abonakalileyo okulawula nokuqhotsa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kwimeko equka abasebenzi bePUCMA abavela kumacandla ahlukeneyo angaphakathi nangaphandle kunye nabaqeshi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalula ebhalwe nakuthethwayo, okubonakalisayo, nokubhala iingxelo. Ukwazi ukunika inkxaso yobugcisa nobungcali kwezinye iinkqubo zePUCMA, kunye nakhono lokukhulisa amakhono nokuba ngumfundisi-ntsapho nogqirha kubasebenzi abasha. Amakhono amabalula okusebenzisana nabantu. Ikhono lokuchasisa ngeentsapho kunye neeqela labaqeshi.
xh.duties: Ukuqhutywa komthetho weMvula yoMzantsi Afrika 36 ka-1998 kubalulekile kwiziga eziQondwe ziSabelo (RDM). Ukuphumeza isabelo kwi-WMA. Ukuqhutywa nokuqamba iNkqubo yeNkxaso yeMlambo (ARI). UkuQwalaselwa kweMpilo yemiLambo kummandla oLawulwa amanzi iNqanaba leBumba yokuLawula amanzi iKomani-Qonce, Condolisa ngokubeka amagcisa azo kwaye yaye athembise ukuba akhoyo ngokusebenza iintlobo zeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo nezinye ezingagqitywa yiNqanaba leNgqondo zoBuchule njengoko kuyimfuneko. 1 : Ukuqwalasela inkqubo engangenisa ulwazi, unako na ukuyenza kweyakho inkqubo yokuvavanya imidlalo yelizwe nangezinye iingcali zolwazi lwesayensi, kwaye ufuna isikhundla kumazwe angaphandle; ngoko ke, uthembisa ukuba uzakwenza imisebenzi yakho ngokufanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngokusebenza iindidi ezahlukeneyo zokulinganisa amanzi, nokukwazi ukusebenzisa iiprogramu ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenza oku. Cwangcisa iindwendwe zaselwandle uncedise ekulungiseleleni ulwazi oluyimfuneko lobugcisa, njengoko kukwalungele ukubhala iingxelo ezibhalwe ngobugcisa nezinye. Qhagamshelana nesebe lamanzi nokuQinisekisa ukuCoceka ngenkxaso yemilambo, ukugqiba kwesabelo nokuphumeza, inkqubo yeMpilo yemiLambo, ngenkqubo ezinye. Qhagamshelana neentsapho angaphakathi nangaphandle malunga neenkqubo ze-RDM, ngokukodwa i-ARI. Dibanisa iindlela zokuqamba isabelo ngezinye iinkqubo zePUCMA ezinjengoko kusetyenziswa iimvume zokusebenzisa amanzi, unike inkxaso yobugcisa nobungcali ekubhaleni. Cwangcisa ii-ToR ulawule oo-PSP. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokwakhisa amakhono nentshukumo yokuba ngumfundisi-ntsapho kubasebenzi abangakanjani. Lungiselela iingxelo nyanga zonke nethoba kwexesha. Qinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwexesha lokunikezela njengoko kubekiweyo kwiinkqubo eziSebenzayo eziQhagamshelana nokuQinisekisa ukuCoceka kwezigqibo. Lawula uqinisekise ukuqwalaselwa ngokufanelekileyo kwezimali ngokulawula imithombo yamanzi. Qhagamshela ngokulawula kubasebenzi ngokwemigaqo nokuQhagamshela iNtengiso yamakhadi aPUCMA.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Capacity Building
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Capacity Building role at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville, requiring a National Diploma in Social Science and five years' water services experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Social Science at NQF level 6 or relevant qualification. Five (5) years’ experience in water services environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of strategic and operational plan management. Ability to implement policies. Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation principles.
jobs.duties: Provide support in the implementation of water services policy and strategy by the water services sectors. Provide support in the implementation of Basic household water service policy. Facilitate workshops to create awareness on policies and guidelines. Implement water services strategy through WSDPs and ensure compliance with the Basic household water service policy and guidelines. Facilitation of best practice learning in the country as well as in the SADC region. Assist in the development of appropriate maintenance procedures through best practices. Provide support to water services sector in business planning, appraisal and monitoring. The provision of support to the water services authority through the development of capacity in operations and maintenance of water services infrastructure. The empowerment and building capacity of newly elected councillors on water services business. The provision of skills development to unemployed youth in order to create job opportunities. Provide support with water services capacity building, skills training and job creation through EPWP. Promote water advocacy programmes. Assist with the promotion of health and hygiene awareness through the implementation of WASH programmes to minimise water-borne diseases. Manage mainstreaming of Health and Hygiene in water and sanitation programmes. The management of Human Resources within the section. To participate in the recruitment and selection of staff. To manage the development of individuals in the section. Ensure that HRD policies are applied to all staff members within the section.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the posts of Assistant Director: Auxiliary Services Ref No: 301026/19 and Personal Assistant Ref No: 301026/38, advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 37 dated 16 October 2026, have been withdrawn. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Kapasiteitsbou
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Kapasiteitsbou-pos by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe en vyf jaar se waterdienste-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe op NQF-vlak 6 of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n waterdienste-omgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van strategiese en operasionele bestuursbeplanning. Vermoë om beleide te implementeer. Kennis van monitering en evaluering-beginsels.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning in die implementering van waterdienste-beleid en -strategie deur die waterdienste-sektore. Verskaf ondersteuning in die implementering van basiese huishoudelike waterdienste-beleid. Fasiliteer werkswinkels om bewustheid oor beleide en riglyne te skep. Implementeer waterdienste-strategie deur WSDP's en verseker voldoening aan die basiese huishoudelike waterdienste-beleid en riglyne. Fasilitering van bestepraktykleer in die land sowel as in die SADC-streek. Bystand in die ontwikkeling van toepaslike instandhoudingsprosedures deur beste praktyke. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die waterdienste-sektor in besigheidsbeplanning, assessering en monitering. Die verskaffing van ondersteuning aan die waterdienste-owerheid deur die ontwikkeling van kapasiteit in bedrywighede en instandhouding van waterdienste-infrastruktuur. Die bemagtiging en kapasiteitsbou van nuutverkose raadslede oor waterdienste-besigheid. Die verskaffing van vaardigheidsontwikkeling aan werklose jeug om werksgeleenthede te skep. Verskaf ondersteuning met waterdienste-kapasiteitsbou, vaardigheidsopleiding en werkskepping deur EPWP. Bevorder water-voorligtingsprogramme. Bystand met die bevordering van gesondheids- en higiëne-bewustheid deur die implementering van WASH-programme om watergedraagde siektes te minimaliseer. Bestuur die instroming van Gesondheid en Higiëne in water- en saniteerprogramme. Die bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne binne die afdeling. Om deel te neem aan die werwing en seleksie van personeel. Om die ontwikkeling van individue in die afdeling te bestuur. Verseker dat HRD-beleide toegepas word op alle personeellede binne die afdeling.

zu.title: Umncedisihlalo: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisihlalo: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla emnyangweni i-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Bellville, sidinga i-National Diploma kwi-Social Science nokuthi ube nobudlwangudlwangu eminyakeni emihlanu ngemisebenzi yamanzi.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Social Science ezingeni le-NQF level 6 noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. Ubudlwangudlwangu eminyakeni emihlanu (5) ohlotsheni lwemisebenzi yamanzi. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engekasho isikhathi. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kohlangothi oluhlelayo nolusebenzayo. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lwezimiso zokuqapha nokuhlola.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesekelo ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo noma isu lemisebenzi yamanzi ohlotsheni lwemisebenzi yamanzi. Nikela ngesekelo ekusebenziseni inqubomgomo yesevisi yamanzi yasekhaya esisisekelo. Hlela izikhungazela ukwakha ukuzwa ngemithetho noma izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Sebenzisa isu lemisebenzi yamanzi nge-WSDPs futhi qinisekise ukuziphendulela kwinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokusebenza zesevisi yamanzi yasekhaya esisisekelo. Ukuhlela ukufunda okuhle kangcono ezweni nakulesifundazwe se-SADC. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubo zokugcina ezifanele ngezinqobo ezinhle. Nikela ngesekelo ohlotsheni lwemisebenzi yamanzi ekwelaphweni kwebhizinisi, ekuhloleni nasekuqapheni. Ukunikezwa kwesekelo kubandakanya amandla emisebenzi yamanzi ngokuthuthukisa amandla ekusebenzeni nasekugcineni kwesisekelo semisebenzi yamanzi. Ukugqugquzela futhi kwakha amandla kubaphathi abakhethwe sha nthla ngohlelo lwemisebenzi yamanzi. Ukunikezwa kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kubasebenzile abangasebenzi ukuze kudalwe ithuba lokusebenza. Nikela ngesekelo ngokwakhiwa kwamandla emisebenzi yamanzi, ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono nokudalwa kwamasebenzo nge-EPWP. Khuthaza izinhlelo zokuxoxa ngemisebenzi yamanzi. Sida ekukhuthazeni ukuzwa ngempilo nokuhlanzeka ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-WASH ukunciphisa izifo ezithwalwa amanzi. Phatha ukufakwa kokuzwa ngempilo nokuhlanzeka ohlelweni lwemisebenzi yamanzi nokushiswa kwemfucuza. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zabanini bantshinga ngaphakathi kohlangothi. Ukubamba iqhaza ekubeni abantu abasha naseyukweni kwabasebenzi. Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bahlangothini. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ze-HRD zisetshenziswa kubasebenzi bonke bahlangothini.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNhlangano: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi weNhlangano: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla kwisebe leZoNamanzi nokuCima iQhalabhala eBellville, sifuna iDiploma yezwe kulawulo lwezenzululwazi ezenModelweni yoLuntu inqanaba le-NQF 6 kunye namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava kumasebe amanzi.
xh.requirements: IDiploma yezwe kulawulo lwezenzululwazi ezenModelweni yoLuntu inqanaba le-NQF 6 okanye izidanga ezifaneleyo. Imihla yamashumi amahlanu eminyaka esithubeni semisebenzi emanzini. Ukwazisa ngelayisensi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo engazange iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ulwazi loku Lawula iplani zoluntu nolwembethe kunyuso-Izinto ngenkqubo. Amandla okuyisebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo ezizisasidanga. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulawula nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kweenkqubo.
xh.duties: Nikeza inkxaso ekusebenzeni iinkqubo zolawulo kunye nezicwangciso zamasebe amanzi ngokwamacandelo amanzi. Nikela inkxaso ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezikumgangatho wamansimbi ngamansimbi ngamansimbi ngakunye iqhingqa lasekhaya. Yenza imibuthano yomnyhadala ukwazi -Uvavanyo nokusombulula. Lawula inkqubo ezifana neelanga namaziko onwaba kwizitovela zokuqonda -Izinto zokubakho ngakunye nomonakalo ezingazange kwenzeki esixekweni neenkqubo nakuwo onke amacandelo. Yenza isikhokelo ekusebenzeni kunye nomsebenzi ngokuchanekileyo ngoku Qeqsha iindwendwe ezinyukwa zonke iindwendwe zikaNgogo ekusebenzeni iinkqubo ngakumbi nakakhulu, iingxowa zemithi nentsimbi eMzantsi Afrika. Yenza iinkqubo zokuthengiswa kwabakhethiweyo ngokukhankanya kwamajelo ka-Amanzi lawulo nhlahle nokuLawula. lawula amajelo eNdalo ngokuhamba kwexesha. Lawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngokusinika ulwazi kubakhethwa kunye nonyuso lwemisebenzi kululwazi. Qinisekisa ukuba bakhethwa ngendlela ekhoyo nendlela ezingekho nanyana aphilileyo ngelixa kubakho kutyhila iinkqubo okuhambwa ngokuchanekileyo. Yala iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kuyo yonke imisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba amajelo akhoyo malunga nokubakhona kwaye anomsa ngamnqamlezo ngokusuka kwisixeko esikhulu ngelixa asenokungabikho. Yila iingoma neenkqubo zokulawula iziqu nendlela ekulawulwa ngayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqenyni abantu basekhaya ngelixa lisalathisa ngobugcisa bokubakhona kwentsimbi. Lawula nokuba liqhinga ekusingeni iinkqubo ekulawulweni kwabantu ngokusela ukulawula kwemisebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekukhethweni nasekusoleni kwabasebenzi. Lawula ukuphuhliswa kwabantu kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ze-HRD ziyasebenziswa kwabo bonke abasebenzi kwisebe.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technician sought by the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria to investigate and classify dams, evaluate engineering licence applications, and assess professional persons.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Engineering or relevant qualification. Six (6) years post qualification technical Engineering experience. Compulsory registration with Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of program- and project management. Knowledge of technical design and analyses of dams. Significant dam engineering experience related to design, flood hydrology, construction, management, and safety of dams. Knowledge of the water sector and relevant legislation (including but not limited to the Chapter 4 and Chapter 12 of National Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) and the Dam Safety Regulations published in Government Notice R. 139 of 24 February 2012). Understanding of research and development. Computer aided engineering applications including relevant computer software knowledge. Technical report writing, networking, and professional judgement. Problem solving and analyses, decision making, team leadership, creativity, self- management, customer focus, and responsiveness. Sound interpersonal and leadership skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Planning, organising, and people management. Willingness to travel throughout South Africa when required for operational purposes.
jobs.duties: Investigate, analyses and recommend classification of dams. Evaluate applications of Approved Professional Persons (APPs). Evaluate and investigate engineering aspects of license applications for the construction of new dams, alteration of existing dams, first filling and operational aspects of dams. Monitor the safety evaluation and investigation reports and carry out risk assessments of dams. Follow up on dam safety betterment work with dam owners. Liaise with regional offices, dam owners, professional persons, APPs and the public regarding dam safety matters. Conduct dam safety inspections at dams with a safety risk. Respond to emergency situations, such as dam failures, at dams and action Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs). Conduct site visits to illegal or unlawful constructed dams and compile technical reports for the issuance of illegal dam letters and directives. Develop, maintain guidelines and policies. Advise on dam safety matters and legislation. Generate reports and statistics to measure progress with the Dam Safety Program. Support the Chief Engineer with all reasonable requests pertaining to dams with a safety risk. Manage Candidate and Production Engineering Technicians, Candidate and Production Engineering Technologists and Candidate Engineers reporting to him/her. Assist with the development of Candidate Engineering Technicians for registration as professionals. Assist and manage the Dam Safety Regulation database (Microsoft Access Database). Assist with compiling the Annual Report and Annual Performance Plan. Assist the Director with technical inputs, data, statistics, and other reasonable requests.

af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstegnikus Graad a
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstegnikus gesoek deur die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria om damme on te onderzoek en te klassifiseer, ingenieurslisensie-aansoeke te evalueer, en professionele persone te beoordeel.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Ses (6) jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese Ingenieurservaring. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstegnikus. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van tegniese ontwerp en ontleding van damme. Beduidende damingenieurservaring wat verband hou met die ontwerp, vloedhidrologie, konstruksie, bestuur en veiligheid van damme. Kennis van die watersektor en relevante wetgewing (insluitend maar nie beperk nie tot Hoofstuk 4 en Hoofstuk 12 van die National Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) en die Dam Safety Regulations gepubliseer in Government Notice R. 139 van 24 February 2012). Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaarondersteunde ingenieurstoepassings insluitend relevante rekenaarsagtewarekennis. Tegniese verslagskrywing, netwerk bou en professionele oordeel. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming, spanleierskap, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, klem op klante en reaksievermoë. Gesonde interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede. Sterk mondelinge en geskrewe kommunikasievaardighede. Beplanning, organisering en mensebestuur. Bereidwilligheid om dwarsdeur Suid-Afrika te reis wanneer dit vir operasionele doeleindes vereis word.
af.duties: Onderzoek, ontleed en beveel die klassifisering van damme aan. Evalueer aansoeke van Approved Professional Persons (APPs). Evalueer en onderzoek ingenieursaspekte van lisensie-aansoeke vir die konstruksie van nuwe damme, wysiging van bestaande damme, eerste vul en operasionele aspekte van damme. Monitor die veiligheidsevaluering en ondersoekverslae en voer risikobevalgings van damme uit. Volg op oor damveiligheidsverbeteringswerk met dameienaars. Skakel met streekskantore, dameienaars, professionele persone, APPs en die publiek rakende damveiligheidsake. Voer damveiligheidsinspeksies uit by damme met 'n veiligheidsrisiko. Reageer op noodsituasies, soosdammislukings, by damme en aktiveer Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs). Voer terreinbesoeke aan onwettig geboude damme uit en stel tegniese verslae op vir die uitreik van onwettige dambriewe en richtlyne. Ontwikkel en onderhou riglyne en beleide. Adviseer oor damveiligheidsake en wetgewing. Genereer verslae en statistieke om vordering met die Dam Safety Program te meet. Ondersteun die Hoofingenieur met alle redelike versoeke rakende damme met 'n veiligheidsrisiko. Bestuur Kandidaat- en Produksie-Ingenieurstegnici, Kandidaat- en Produksie-Ingenieurstegnoloë en Kandidaat-Ingenieurs wat aan hom/haar rapporteer. Bied hulp met die ontwikkeling van Kandidaat-Ingenieurstegnici vir registrasie as professioneles. Bied hulp en bestuur die Dam Safety Regulation-databasis (Microsoft Access Database). Bied hulp met die opstel van die Jaarverslag en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan. Ondersteun die Direkteur met tegniese insette, data, statistieke en ander redelike versoeke.

zu.title: Ithimba Lobuchwepheshe Lokulawula (Grade A)
zu.summary: Ithimba lobuchwepheshe be-Engineering lidingwa emnyangweni weWater and Sanitation ePretoria ukuba libheke amaphuzu amakhulu nezinketho ezintsha ezitholakalayo, lihlole izicelo zamalayisensi we-Engineering, futhi libheke abantu abaqeqeshiwe.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (National Diploma) eNcwadini Yezobuchwepheshe noma iziqu ezifanele. Amandla (Compulsory registration) eNdyondyo Yezobuchwepheshe eNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengomuntu ofanelekile. Ukuvezwa kwamakhadi (ehluke kwezinsizakusebenza) ehlukene, kuhlanganise (kepha kungadingidingi) izinsizakusebenza ezibonakalayo (ezitholakalayo) ezintsha kanye nokusetshenziswa okulungile okuhambisana nesikhathi. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlolwa nokutholakala kwezindlu zamakhono ezinhle, ezifanele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ekusebenzeni kwesigaba. Imfundo efanayo neziqu eziphansi. Ulwazi ngohlelo oluphelele olubandakanya imithi yokuhlolwa nokuvikelwa kwawo wonke amaphoyisa. (Amaphoyisa nawo ayadingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwazile ukuhlola ngokusemthethweni nokusebenza kahle kwemithi.) Ulwazi ngohlelo lwemithi yokusebenza nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukuqonda kwamathuluzi amasha afana nokusebenza kwezinsizakusebenza (e.g. GIS, MS Office, MS Project). Ulwazi olubalulekile ngamanye amaphuzu akhangayo ekusebenzeni kahle kwemithi.
zu.duties: Hlola, hlaziya futhi ngokusemthethweni uphakamise ukugcinwa kokuhlolwa kwemithi (inspections) namabhuku okuhlolwa kwimithi (inspection reports) egunyazwe ngokusemthethweni. Hlola isicelo sabantu abanezikhungo zobuchwepheshe abagunyaziwe (APP). Hlola futhi uhlolye izici zohlulo lwamakhono ezinsizakusebenza (engineering) zemvula yokwakha imithi emisha, ukulungisa imithi ekhona, ukugcwalisa kwasekuqaleni (ukugcwaliswa kwamanzi) kanye nezinye izici ezenziwayo. Imisebenzi ephathelene neqembu elibheke izidingo, futhi uhlole izinsizakusebenza ezibalulekile ezihlotshaniswa nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Qinisekisa futhi ugcine amagunya wobuchwepheshe ahlobene nenhlangano yonke (corporate) kanye namanye amagunya, ubuncwane (archives), izinkomba (indicators) namanye amagunya ahlobene nokubika ngemithi. Lolu hlobo lokuhlolwa kufanele lwenziwe ngale kwamaphuzu okukhethwa abucayi abakhethiwe abacatshangelwayo. Imisebenzi ebhekwe kulolu gaba kumele yenziwe ngokuzinikela ngokuphelele.

xh.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
xh.summary: I-Control Engineering Technician ifunwa yi-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Pretoria ukuphanda nokwabalula iindilu, ukuvavanya izicelo zelayisenisi zojongano, nokuvavanya iziguli zobugcisa.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Engineering okanye ngesimfuno esinjalo. Amashumi amathandathu (6) eminyaka yamava obuchwepheshe be-Engineering emva kokufumana isimfuno. Uku bayiswa ngamnye kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njenge-Professional Engineering Technician kuyinyani. Ukuvula ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekileyo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ulwazi lwalolu phononongo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lolugcino lobuchwepheshe noluhlalutyo lweendilu. Amava obujunjunu besigqebhezana neendilu afanelekileyo malunga nolugcino, i-hydrology yemimvula, ukwakhiwa, ulawulo, nokhuseleko lweendilu. Ulwazi lwemida yamanzi nomthetho ochwayekileyo (kuquka kodwa kungadingiweyo ukuba kugqitywe kwi-Chapter 4 ne-Chapter 12 ze-National Water Act (NWA, Act No. 36 of 1998) nama-Dam Safety Regulations ashicilelwe kwi-Government Notice R. 139 ka-24 February 2012). Ukuqonda ukuphanda nophuhliso. Izicelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwe-software yekhompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, ukwakha umnatha, nokuzigqatsa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula ziingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulowula iqela, ubuchwephesha bokwenza izinto, ukuzilawula, ukugqithisa kumthengi, nokuwavula. Amakhono amabini aqinileyo okuziqhelanisa nabantu nolowulo. Amakhono amabini aqinileyo okuthetha nokuwela. Ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, nolawulo lwabantu. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kuyo yonke i-South Africa xa kufuneka ngenjongo zokusebenza.
xh.duties: Ukuphanda, ukuhlalutya kunye nokuncoma ukubalula kweendilu. Ukuvavanya izicelo zaba-Approved Professional Persons (APPs). Ukuvavanya nokuphanda ngeendaba zobuchwepheshe zezicelo zelayisenisi zokwakhiwa kweekhulu ezintsha, utshintsho lweekhulu ezikhoyo, ukuqala kokuwuzalisa ngeendaba zokusebenza kweekhulu. Ukulandelela iingxelo zovavanyo lokhuseleko nolphando kwaye uzenze isilinganiselo seengozi kweekhulu. Ukulandelela umsebenzi wokuphucula ukhuseleko lweekhulu nabaniniweekhulu. Ukunxibelela neeofisi zamaphondo, abaniniweekhulu, iziguli zobugcisa, aba-APPs noluntu malunga neendaba zokhuseleko lweekhulu. Ukwenza iindwendwe zovavanyo lokhuseleko kweendilu ezinengozi yokhuseleko. Ukusabela kwiimeko ezibuthathaka, njengokusilela kweekhulu, kweekhulu bese usebenzisa iza-Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs). Ukwenza iindwendwe kweekhulu ezakhiwe ngengalo nangendlela engasekho mthethweni bese uqamba iingxelo zobuchwepheshe zokuvelisa iileta zeedilu ezingasekho mthethweni neemyalelo. Ukuphuhlisa, ukugcina iinkqubo zobulungiselelo namagunya. Ukuyala ngeendaba zokhuseleko lweekhulu nomthetho. Ukudala iingxelo ngeestatistics ukulinganisa inkqubo yokhuseleko lweekhulu. Ukuxhasa i-Chief Engineer nayo yonke imiyalelo eqinisekileyo ehlobene neendilu ezinengozi yokhuseleko. Ukulawula aba-Candidate ne-Production Engineering Technicians, aba-Candidate ne-Production Engineering Technologists naba-Candidate Engineers abamelayo kuye. Ukuncedisa ukuphuhlisa aba-Candidate Engineering Technicians ukuba babhaliswe njengabagcisa. Ukuncedisa noku lawula idatabase yomthetho we-Dam Safety Regulation (Microsoft Access Database). Ukuncedisa ukuqumba iingxelo yonyaka ne-Annual Performance Plan. Ukuncedisa u-Head nomnikelo zobuchwepheshe, idatha, iestatistics, namanye omnye umyalezo oqinisekileyo.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
jobs.summary: Control engineering technician needed in Bloemfontein to manage technical services and support in hydrological services, requiring a National Diploma in Civil Engineering and ECSA registration.

Compulsory registration with Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Program and project management. Technical design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge and understanding of hydrological processes are essential. Demonstration of good understanding and competence in all aspects of hydrometry. Computer literacy. Problem solving and analysis. Innovative and creative thinking. Planning and organizing. Decision making. Teamwork and leadership. Good written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Technical consulting. Data analysis. Customer focus and responsiveness. People management skills and financial management. Willing to travel and work away from home whenever required. Ensure quality assurance of technical designs with specifications and authorise/make recommendations for approval by the relevant authority. Manage hydrometry tasks in a sub-region of the Free State operational area. Calibration of gauging weirs and calibration report writing. Surveying of gauging weirs and gauge plates. Data collection from various electronic data loggers. Data analysis, processing and archiving on HYDSTRA database. Data management and dissemination. Maintenance and calibration on near real-time dataloggers. Flow measurements using Acoustic Current Doppler Profilers, in particular during the high flow season. Develop and customize operational procedures. Mentor, train and develop candidate technicians and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer. Manage the performance management and development of staff.

af.title: Beheeringenieurstegnikus Graad a
af.summary: Beheeringenieurstegnikus benodig in Bloemfontein om tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in hidrologiese dienste te bestuur, met 'n vereiste van 'n National Diploma in Civil Engineering en ECSA-registrasie.
af.requirements: 'n National Diploma in Civil Engineering. Ses (6) jaar post-kwalifikasie tegniese ervaring in hidrologiese dienste. Verpligte registrasie met Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstegnikus. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Program- en projekbestuur. Tegniese ontwerp- en ontledingskennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis en begrip van hidrologiese prosesse is noodsaaklik. Toon goeie begrip en bevoegdheid in alle aspekte van hidrometrie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Innoverende en kreatiewe denke. Beplanning en organisering. Besluitneming. Spanwerk en leierskap. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van regsverenigbaarheid. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Tegniese konsultasie. Data-ontleding. Klantfokus en reaksievermoë. Mensebestuursvaardighede en finansiële bestuur. Bereid om te reis en weg van die huis te werk wanneer ook al vereis. Moet bereid wees om uitgebreide interne opleiding by verskeie plekke te ondergaan.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Ingenieurs, Tegnoloë, en geassosieerde professionele persone in die veld en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die nakoming en bevordering van veiligheidsstandaarde in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge, en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verseker kwaliteitsversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die betrokke gesag. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses en die bestuursplan vir vraag. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese/ingenieursbedryfsplan. Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering, en instandhouding van databasisse. Bestuur, superviseer en beheer tegniese en verwante personeel en bates. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Om met relevante liggame/raad oor hidrologiese-verwante aangeleenthede te skakel. Hersiening van hidrologiese toerusting en verkryging van nuwe toerusting. Ondersoek nuwe tegnologie relevant tot hidrologiese dienste. Bestuur hidrometrie-take in 'n sub-streek van die Free State bedryfsgebied. Kalibrering van meetdamme en kalibreringsverslagskrywing. Opmeting van meetdamme en meetplate. Data-insameling vanaf verskeie elektroniese dataloggers. Data-ontleding, verwerking en argivering op HYDSTRA databasis. Databestuur en -verspreiding. Instandhouding en kalibrering op naby-intydse dataloggers. Vloeimetings met behulp van Acoustic Current Doppler Profilers, veral tydens die hoogvloeiseisoen. Ontwikkel en pas bedryfsprosedures aan. Mentoor, train en ontwikkel kandidaattegnici en andere om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag te bevorder. Bestuur die prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Itheknikhikhini Yobunjini Bezilawuli Izinga a
zu.summary: Kudingeka itheknikhikhini yobunjini bezilawuli eBloemfontein ukuphatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokusekela kumasevisi wezamanzi, kudingwa iDiploma Yezwe kuBunjini Bokuqasha kanye nokubhalisa ku-ECSA.
zu.requirements: IDiploma Yezwe kuBunjini Bokuqasha. EMinyakeni eyisithupha (6) yohlu olutholwe kamuva kwemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe kumasevisi wezamanzi. Ukubhalisa ngokumiselwe kwiNdlu Yobunjini BaseNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengeTheknikhikhini Yobunjini Yobuchwepheshe. Ukulisa ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaqedi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nemikhiqizo. Ulwazi lwezakhiwo zezobuchwepheshe kanye nenhlathululo. Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kobunjini. Ulwazi kanye noqonde lomchilo wamanzi kuyadingeka. Ukubonisa ukuqonda kahle nethemba ezimeni zonke zamabhalo obuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqoqa. Ukucabanga ngendlela entsha nokuqamba. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu nokuqondisa. Amakhono abalawwe kahle okubhala nokukhuluma. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ukweluleka ngemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe. Ukuqoqa imininingwane. Ukuqonda izidingo zekhasimende kanye nokuphendula. Amakhono okuphatha abantu kanye nokuphatha izimali. Ukuthanda ukuhamba kanye nokusebenza kude nendlu noma nini lapho kudingeka khona. Kudingeka ukulungele ukuthatha ukwelulekwa okukhulu ngaphakathi emagunyazini ahlukene.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokusekela kanye nabaGqogi, iTheknolojisti, kanye nabachwepheshe abahambisanayo emhlabeni nasezikhungweni ezobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kanye nokukhuthazwa kwemigomo yokuphepha ngokuvumelana nezidingo ezisemthethweni nasezomthetho. Hlola imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe esikhona, izithombe ezingavamile, kanye nemikhuba ukuze kufakwe inqubomgomo entsha. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi yezakhiwo zezobuchwepheshe ngemiyalo futhi wemukule/nikela izincomo ukuze zivunyelwe ngumgunyazi ohambisanayo. Nikeza izimomvo kumchilo wokwabiwa kwezimali kanye neplani yokuphatha izidingo. Hlela futhi unikeze imibalo njengoba kudingwa. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izimomvo eplani yokusebenza yezobuchwepheshe/ubunjini. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinsiza zamnininingwane. Phatha, qondisa kanye ukulawula abantu abahlobene nezobuchwepheshe kanye nezimpahla. Ukuthuthuka ngobuchwepheshe ngokuqhubeka ukuze ugwamise netheknoloji entsha kanye nemikhuba. Ucwaningo/izifundo zemibhalo kwinethemoloji yezobuchwepheshe ukuthuthukisa ulwazi. Ukuhambisana nabaqashi/amakhonsada ahambisanayo ngamaphuzu ahlobene namamanzi. Ukuhlola izinsiza zamamanzi nokuthenga izinsiza ezintsha. Cwaninga ngobuchwepheshe obusha obuhlobene namasevisi wezamanzi. Phatha imisebenzi yokubala amanzi endaweni ehlanganyelweyo ehwebweni le-Free State. Ukuqaphela izinto zokulinganisa amanzi kanye nokubhala imibalo yokuqaphela. Ukuhlola izinto zokulinganisa amanzi kanye namaphuleti okulinganisa. Ukuqoqa imininingwane kusukela kumalogo ahlukene okuqoqa imininingwane yabakhompyutha. Ukuqoqa, ukucubungula kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane kwisevisi ya-HYDSTRA. Ukuphathwa kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwemininingwane. Ukulondoloza kanye nokuqaphela amalogo ahhora-ngempela. Ukulinganisa ukugeleza kusetshenziswa ama-Acoustic Current Doppler Profilers, ikakhulu ngesikhathi sehlandla eliphezulu. Tuthukisa futhi ulungise imikhuba yokusebenza. Qondisa, funde futhi tuthukisa otheknikhikhini abahola kanye nabanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi. Phatha ukuphatha imisebenzi nentuthuko yabasebenzi.

xh.title: Ithekhinishian yoLawulo lweNzululwazi inqanaba le-A
xh.summary: Kufuneka ithelwe ithedhinishian yolawulo lwenzululwazi eBloemfontein ukuyaphatha iinkonzo ezisebenzela itekhnoloji kunye nenkxaso kwiinkonzo zezesazi namanzi, kufuneka ibe nesiQinisekiso seLizwe kwiNjineli yoLweMiziwe kwaye ibhalise kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: IsiQinisekiso seLizwe kwiNjineli yoLweMiziwe. Amashumi amathandathu (6) eminyaka yamava obuchwepheshe emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso kwiinkonzo zezesazi namanzi. Ukubhalisa ngokungenakuzikhandela kwiBhunga leNjineli eMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengeThekhnishian yeNjineli yoBuchwepheshe. Ukuvula ibhunga lelayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo nezingekapheli. Ulawulo lwenkqubo neziprojekthi. Ulwazi lwendlela yokwakela itekhnoloji kunye nokuhlalutywa. Upelo-lwazi nokuphuhliswa kwalo. Izicelo zekhompyutha ezenza ulawulo lwenzululwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zesesazi namanzi zimfuneko. Ukuqatshelwa okucocekileyo nokuqonda konke okumayelana ne-hayidrometri. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutywa. Ukucinga ngeendlela ezintsha kunye nezenzo ezingaqondwayo. Ukuqhathanisa indlela nokuhlela. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengeqela kunye nokuba ngumholi. Amakhono amabaliseyo abhalwayo nethethwayo. Ulwazi ngokuziiyela ngemigaqo yomthetho. Ukubala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Iingxoxo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlalutywa kwedata. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuva iimfuno zakhe. Amakhono okulawula abantu nokuqweba iimali. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza kude nasekhaya nanini na xa kufuneka. Kufuneka alungiselelwe ukuyenzela inkqubo yokuzilolonga phakathi kwenkampani iindawo ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe nenkxaso ngokubambisana nabaNjineli, abaTsoluli-bugcisa, nabochwepheshe abahlobo kumhlaba nakwiinkqubo zofiso lobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukulandela nokuphakamisa iindlela zokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo-nethetho kunye nemimiselo yokulawula. Hlola izifanekiso-kodwa zobuchwepheshe, iifom ezisesikweni, nemigaqo ezikhoyo ukuzifaka itekhnoloji entsha. Qinisekisa izinga lemigeqa yendlela yobuchwepheshe ngeemeko ezichaziweyo uvume/azenze iingcebiso zokuvunywa ngurhwebi olukhuphisayo. Phawula ekuqoqweni kwexabiso nakuqwebeni le ngcebiso yolawulo. Hlenga ithathe unike iingxelo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Unikeze uze uqoqe iingcinga kwinkqubo yokusebenza kobuchwepheshe/enzululwazi. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusetenziswa, nokugcina iindawo zokugcina iinkcukacha. Lawula, ulawule uze ulawule abantu, izixhobo ezahlukeneyo zobuchwepheshe ezikufutshane nendawo. Inkqubo ezenza ngokuchanekileyo yokuzilolonga ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngeekhompyutha nolwazi lwamva nje. Uphando/izifundo nge-tekhnoloji yokulawulo inzululwazi ukuphucula ulwazi. Ukuqhathanisa iziqu ezahlukeneyo ngeziqu ezikumgangatho olinganayo malunga neziganeko ezimalunga nesesazi namanzi. Ukuhlolo-hlobo kwesixhobo sesesazi namanzi kwaye athenge ezezona ntsha. Uphando lobugcisa obutsha obunodaka oluthile kwinzizo zokwazi namanzi. Phatha imisebenzi yohayidrometri kwiziko esithile sokusebenza kwi-Free State. Ukulungelelanisa i-weirs ezingajingiyo nokubhala iingxelo ezimalunga nesesixhobo esijingiyo. Ukulinganisa ngokucokisa i-weirs ezingajingiyo namapleyiti ezingajingiyo. Iqoqo lemininzi kusuka kumagoshi be-elekthroniki ahlukeneyo. Ukuhlalutywa, ukucwangcisa nokugcina imininingwane ye-HYDSTRA. Ukulawula iinkcukacha kunye nokuzihambisa. Ukulungisa nokulinganisa idatha-loggers ezikufutshane nokuze ngokwenyani. Ukulinganisa ukusuka ngenani ngokusebenzisa i-Acoustic Current Doppler Profilers, ngakumbi ngexesha lokuphakama kwamanzi ootyelelwano. Bala ize wenze ngokwendalo imigaqo yesesiphithiphithi. Fundisa, qeqesha ize uphucule abakwabo abathe nkqubo nakwezinye ukuphucula ulwazi/nolwazi lokudlulisa izakhono. Lawula inkqubo yohlolo-lwazi yokulawula abantu ukuba baphuhliswe kwaye bakhule.

Knowledge and understanding of financial management and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Disciplinary knowledge in policy. Knowledge of techniques and procedures for the planning and excursion of operations. Understanding of programme and project management. Knowledge of relationship management. Problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct. Shoot high-quality photographs and videos for marketing campaigns, internal newsletters, and social media. Implement multimedia production and visual content services. Implement branding, marketing, and promotional activities through design concepts. Provide live streaming services. Manage human resources.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Korporatiewe Kommunikasie
af.summary: Bestuur die korporatiewe kommunikasie-ontwerpatelier wat fotografie, videografie en infografieke vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria produseer.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF level 6-kwalifikasie in fotografie/videografie soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf jaar se ervaring in die beoefening van fotografie/videografie. Vakkundige kennis van fotografie/videografie, bemarkings- en advertensieriglyne en protokol. Vakkundige kennis van openbare administrasie. Kennis van ontwerpbeginsels, tegnieke en gereedskap. Kennis van die skryfproses, hersiening en proeflees. Begrip van watersektor-wetgewing, beginsels en prosedures. Kennis en begrip van finansiële bestuur en die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Vakkundige kennis van beleid. Kennis van tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van operasies. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van verwantskapsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Menslike en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Bewese ervaring in die bestuur van 'n fotografiese atelier.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwerpatelier en alle toerusting. Ontwikkel infografieke. Implementeer interne kommunikasieprogramme en inligtingverspreiding deur visuele media. Neem hoëgehalte-foto's en video's vir bemarkingsveldtogte, interne nuusbriefs en sosiale media. Implementeer multimediaproduksie en visuele inhoudsdienste. Implementeer branding-, bemarkings- en bevorderingsaktiwiteite deur ontwerpbeginsels. Verskaf lewendige stroomdiens. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqhaza: Izinkulumo Ezingamphimbo Zenkampani
zu.summary: Phatha istudiyo yokwakha izinkulumo ezingamphimbo zenkampani, okutholakala ngayo ukuthwebula izithombe, ukuthwebula amavidiyo, kanye nezithombe ezinolwazi eziyisifanekiso se-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhethi elihambisana ne-NQF level 6 ekuthwebuleni izithombe/ ukuthwebula amavidiyo njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Unyaka lwayo lokuqashwa ekwenza ukuthwebula izithombe/ ukuthwebula amavidiyo. Ulwazi lwasemkhakheni ekuthwebuleni izithombe/ukuthwebula amavidiyo, imihlahambiliqondo yokumaketha nokukhangisa kanye nemithetho yokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi lwasemkhakheni ekuphathweni kwabaphathi bomphakathi. Ulwazi ngemigudu yokwakha izinto, izindlela, kanye nezinsiza. Ulwazi ngakhoqoqo lokubhala lokubuyekeza kanye nokuhlolisisa imibhalo. Ukuqonda ngemithetho, imigiginyo, kanye nemikhuba yemikhakha yamanzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuphathwa kwezimali kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi lwasemkhakheni ngomgogo. Ulwazi ngendlela nemikhuba yokuhlela kanye nokwenza izindlela zokusuka. Ukuqonda ngokuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezibopho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu nokuqhuba izinhlobonhlobo. Ukumisela isithombe somthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono ohlelo lokuthumelana ulwazi emlonyeni nakubhalwe. Ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngendlela ehloniphekile. Okuqinisekisiwe kokuphatha istudiyo yokuthwebula izithombe.
zu.duties: Phatha istudiyo yokwakha kanye zonke izinsiza. Biza izithombe ezinolwazi eziyisifanekiso. Sebenzisa izinhlela zezinkulumo zangaphakathi kanye nokusabalalisa ulwazi ngezinsiza eziyisithombe ezibonwayo. Thwebula izithombe namavidiyo anezinkomba ezinhle zemikhankaso yokumaketha, amaphephandaba angaphakathi, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana komphakathi. Sebenzisa ukukhiqiza okumidasini kanye nesevisi yokuqukethwe okuyizithombe ezibonwayo. Sebenzisa izinkalo zokudlalwa komphakathi, ukumaketha, kanye nokukhuthaza ngamahlelo okwakha. Nikeza ngesevisi yokusakaza ngokubukeka ngqo. Phatha abasebenzi.

xh.summary: Lawula istudio yoyilo lwezixhobo zonxibelelwano zenkampani, ezivelisa izithombe, amavidiyo, nolwazi olumagazini olusezithombeni kwiSebe lamanzi nokuCoceka ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo seNQF level 6 kumzobi wezithombe/ umzobi wamavidiyo njengokuqatshiwe yiSAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu yamava ekuzimeni ukubhala izithombe/ ukubhala amavidiyo. Ulwazi ngokuzibophelela ekubhalweni kwezithombe/ukubhalwa kwamavidiyo, iindlela zemigimbo kunye namacebo okuthengisa. Ulwazi ngokuzibophelela kointloko yolawulo loluntu. Ulwazi ngeendlela, iindlela namacebo oyilo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokubhala, ukuphononza nokuhlengahlengisa amagama. Ukuqonda ngemithetho, iimigaqo nendenkqubo yohandlo lwamanzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngoku lawula izimali kunye nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi ngokuzibophelela kumthetho wolawulo. Ulwazi ngeendlela nendenkqubo zokucazulula nokwenziwa kweziseko. Ukuqonda ngoku lawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi ngokulawula ubudlelwane. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukulawula abantu nokwahlukahlukana kobuntu. Ukuqondelela kumxhasi nokuqwalasela umxhasi. Amabanga amahle onxibelelwano womlomo nabalowo (owenziwayo nangomzobe). Ixabiso lokuphendula nokuziphatha ngokwenene. Amava abonwayo ekusebenziseni istudio yezithombe.
xh.duties: Lawula istudio yokuyila nayo lonke icebo lokusebenza. Yenza iinfographics. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zonxibelelwano langaphakathi nokusasaza ulwazi ngezixhobo eziyinto ebonakalayo. Thatha izithombe zomgangatho ophezulu namavidiyo amacebo okuthengisa, iindaba ezingaphakathi, nethangaphakathi. Zisebenzise ukwenziwa kwemultimedia neenkonzo zesiqulathi sendaba esibonakalayo. Zisebenzise ukuzinza nokuqashwa kwentengiso, nokukhuthaza imisebenzi ngeengcinga zoyilo. Zenze iinkonzo ezibukayo ngesixhobo esiphilayo. Lawula imisebenzi yabantu.

Ulwazi ngokuqhubekisela phambili komsebenzi wokubhala, ukubhala okukopishiwe, kanye nokufunda ukuqinisekisa amaphutha. Ulwazi lokupatha abantu. Ukuqonda umthetho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo zesigaba samanzi. Ukuqonda kanye nokuzezelwa emigomini, izinqubomgomo, kanye namaohlelo kahulumeni. Ukuqonda ukulawula imali kanye nolwazi ngomthetho woLawulo LweMali yoMphakathi (PFMA). Ulwazi ngezindlela kanye nezinqubo zokuhlela kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi. Ukuqonda ukuphatha amahlelo kanye namaprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuphatha izinhlobonhlobo zobudlelwano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqondisa. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuqoqwa kwemibono ehlukene. Ukuqondiswa ekusebenzeleni namakhasimende kanye nokuqashekwa kwakho. Amakhono ahle wokuxhumana kokubili (okwenkomayo nokuqoshiwe). Ukwabelana kanye nokuziphatha ngokuqotho. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi kanye nokuhlangabezana namasuomu.
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa kwamahlela wezindabo ngokuhambisana namagaba wezindabo, amagaba wokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yezindabo ukugqamisa umsebenzi womnyango. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela ngokulandelana izinkulumo zabezindabo, okumfushane, okuhamba kwayo, kanye nemicimbo yezindabo ukuze kushicilelwe ngomnyango. Ukuhlanganisa ukuvakashela kwamakhasi wezindabo ukudala kanye nokuqhuba ubuhlobo obuhle nabezindaba. Ukupatha amakhompyutha ezenza ngokuxhumana komnyango kanye nasezikhundleni zokukhangisa. Ukulawula abasebenzi bomnyango.

xh.title: Umntu onguMlawuli ongumncedisi: Uqhagamshelwano nezixhobo zendaba
xh.summary: UMlawuli ongumncedisi: Uqhagamshelwano nezixhobo zendaba kwisebe leZemanzi nokuCoceza kwindawo yokuhlala eyi-Pretoria, kufuneka kubekho nqanaba le-NQF 6 kwaye abe nakho namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava ahambelana nalo msebenzi.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kubekho nqanaba le-NQF 6 kwisidanga esihambelana nalo msebenzi kwindawo yokuQhagamshela / iyoBhala nendaba / uManyano lwakuBani ngokwendalo njengoko sivunywa yi-SAQA. Amashumi amahlanu (5) eminyaka yamava ahambelana nalo msebenzi kurhulumente okanye ekwenziwenzi okulawulwayo okanye kwindawo yendaba yedijithali/igumbi leendaba. Ukuvula nesazisi esisezayo nesingaphelelwa lixesha lesazisi lokushayela. Ulwazi ngokusesikweni kwinkqubo yokuQhagamshela nokwazi izifundo zendaba. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindlela nezixhobo zendaba. Ulwazi ngendlela yokubhala, ukubhala okulungisiweyo nokuphinda kuqwalaselwe. Ulwazi ngokuphatha abantu. Ukuqonda umthetho, iingqungquthela neendlela zentshiso yamanzi. Ukuqonda aze azinikeze ngokusukelelwa ngakumbi ngamagqabantshintshi, iingqungquthela namacebo urhulumente. Ukuqonda ukulawula imali nokwazi uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Ulwazi ngeendlela neenkqubo zokuCwangcisa nokwenza iziphumo. Ukuqonda ukulawula amacebo namaphulo. Ulwazi ngokulawula uqhagamshelwano. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzahlulela. Ukulawula abantu nentsidi. Ukuqwalasela abathengi kwaye kuqwalaselwe kakhulu yimiqobo yabathengi. Amakhono amabalise ekuQhagamshela (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugqiba izicwangciso ngexesha.
xh.duties: Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zendaba ngokuhambelana neendlela zendaba, iindlela zoQhagamshelwano neengqungquthela zesebe. Ukudala iziphumo zendaba ukuze kubonakale umsebenzi wesebe. Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba imibhidango yendaba, iindlela zokuChazwa kwendaba, iindwendwe neziganeko zendaba ukubhaqa umsebenzi wesebe. Ukuqwalasela iindwendwe ezindalweni zendaba ukudala aze agcine ubudlelwane obuhle nezixhobo zendaba. Ukulawula inkqubo yentaba yoluntu kwisebe nakwiinkqubo zayo. Ukulawula izixhobo zabasebenzi bokwabantu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Auxiliary Services
jobs.summary: Manage administrative functions including travel, facilities, security compliance, records and human resources for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF Level 6 Qualification in Administration / Public Management / Public Administration. Five (5) years’ experience in administrative environment with three (3) years serving as a supervisor. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Computer literacy (MS Office Software package). Sound knowledge, interpretation and application of public service legislations/Acts, Regulations, directives, processes, and procedures relevant to the post. Good communication, interpersonal skills and ability to interact with people at all levels. Ability to work independently, without close supervision and ability to lead a team. Good planning, organising, and execution skills. Be able to prioritize and produce quality work. Accountability, ability to multitask, work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Excellent report writing skills. Problem-solving, creativity, and initiative skills. Analytical thinking with ability to pay attention to details and handle confidential information.
jobs.duties: Management of key administrative areas within the Directorate including its Area Offices. Manage corporate travel arrangements. Manage, facilities and support services. Ensure safety and security compliance. Manage records and documents. Manage human resource and performance. Monitor and ensure compliance to national and departmental legislations/acts, regulations, directives regarding corporate travel, transport management, Facilities management, records management, telecommunications, safety, and security. Ensure proper management of service provider contracts, payment of services, accounts, debt recovery, queries, reconciliation of accounts and expenditure reporting. Ensure quarterly reporting on contract performance. Ensure efficient maintenance of information and accurate databases. Provide inputs to the monthly and annual spending plans aligned to business plan. Provide inputs on the development/review of budget and business plans with clear roles and responsibilities assigned with the resource’s requirements identified. Develop, maintain, and implement standard operating procedures for efficient utilisation and compliance to corporate travel, transport management, facilities management, records management, telecommunications, safety, and security. Advise management and officials on administrative key activities` policies, directives, processes, and procedures. Compile submissions for implementation of administration activities and provision of management reports. Compile submissions, memoranda and submitting of monthly operational reports. Manage administration support personnel including co- ordination of key administrative and operational activities within the Directorate.

zu.title: Onozane: Amasevisi Okwesekela
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yolawula okuhlanganisa ukuhamba, izakhiwo, ukuvumelana nezindinganiso zokuvikela, amarekhodi nemisebenzi yabasebenzi koMnyango Wezamanzi Nokucoceko ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 Ezolawulen / Eziphathweni Likahulumeni / Ekolawulweni Kahulumeni. Isiphi senyanga esihlanu (5) sokusebenza endaweni yolawulo lomnyango kanti isiphi sezinyanga ezintathu (3) esijwayene ukuba ngumphathi. Ukukhishwa kobhalwe lokushayela okusebenzayo futhi okungaluki isikhathi. Ukubhala nokuqonda ikhompyutha (Iphakheji yesoftware ye-MS Office). Ulwazi olunjani, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa izimiso/emiKhozo yezinkonzo zikahulumeni, Izimiso, iziqondiso, izinqubo, nezindlela ezihambisana nale sikundla. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu, amakhono obudlelwano abantu kanye namandla okuxhuma nabantu kuzo zonke izinga. Amandla okusebenza kwabanye, ngaphandle kokuphathwa okuseduze kanye namandla okuhola iqembu. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, kanye nokwenza. Ukukwazi ukubeka izinto ngokwedlulelo futhi ukukhiqiza umsebenzi womgangatho ophezulu. Ukubekezelela, amandla okwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo nokugcina izedeli ezinamanzi. Amakhono aphambili okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukudala, kanye nokuthatha isinyathelo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokukwazi ukunaketa imininingwane kanye nokuphatha ulwazi olumfihlo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izindawo eziyinhloko zolawulo ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate okuhlanganisa nazo izikhungo zayo Eziyisithelo. Phatha izinhlelo zokuhamba zinkampani. Phatha, izakhiwo namasevisi okusekela. Qiniseza ukuphepha nokuvumelana nezindinganiso zokuvikela. Phatha amarekhodi namadokhumenti. Phatha abasebenzi kanye namandla. Qapha futhi uqiniseze ukuvumelana nezimiso/emiKhozo yezwe nentanyana kanye nemimiselo, iziqondiso ngokuhamba kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha, ukuphathwa kwezakhiwo, ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi, izokuxhumana, ukuphepha, nokuvikela. Qiniseza ukuphathwa okufanele kwezinkontilana zabanikeli bamasevisi, ukukhokhelwa kwamasevisi, izikhwameni, ukubuyiselwa kwemali enikwe inzuzo, imibuzo, ukuqoqaniswa kwezikhwameni nokubika ukuchithwa. Qiniseza ukubikwa kwakho ngesikhathi sobunyanga obuyisithupha ngokusebenza kwezinkontilana. Qiniseza ukugcinwa okusebenzayo kolwazi kanye namadatabheyisi anembile. Nikeza izinkuleko zenyanga nezinyanga zonke zochitho ohambisana nenhlelo yebhizinisi. Nikeza izinkuleko ekuthuthukisweni / ukubuyekezweni kwebhajethi kanye nahlelo yebhizinisi kunemitthelela ehlukaniswe ngokocacileyo inezidingo ezibonakalisiwe. Buka, gcina, futhi ukwenze izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokusebenzayo kwaye kuhambisana nokuhamba kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha, ukuphathwa kwezakhiwo, ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi, izokuxhumana, ukuphepha, nokuvikela. Luleka ukuphathwa kwaye nabasebenzi ngemisebenzi ephathelene nezinhlelo zolawulo, iziqondiso, izinqubo, neziqondiso. Hlela izinkuleko zokwenza imisebenzi yolawulo kunaye nokubikwa kwezibiko zokuqondisa. Hlela izinkuleko, amamokhumente kwaye unikeze izibiko zokuqhutywa zenyanga. Phatha abasebenzi basekela ukulawula okuhlanganisa ukuqhutywa kwemisebenzi ephathelene nolawulo kwaye nekuqhutywa kwemisebenzi engaphakathi kwe-Directorate.

xh.title: Umcedisi weQela elibhekisa kwiinkonzo ezingundoqo: Isebe lezeManzi nokuQhotsa
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo ehlangabezisa indlela yokuhanjiswa, iziseko, ukuthobela imigaqo yokhuseleko, amarekhodi namaphakathi abasebenzi kwisebe lezeManzi nokuQhotsa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 6 esifanelekileyo kwilawulo / Ulawulo lwakuwoLwimi / ULawulo lwakuLuntu. Iminyaka yamava emi (5) kwimeko yolawulo ngenani yeminyaka emithathu (3) ethatha inxaxheba njengomphathi. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yokushayela egqithisiweyo enye nesebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha (Isiphakam ngamakompyutha e-MS Office). Ulwazi olubambekileyo lokutolika nokusetyenziswa kwemithetho/iso-mthetho yolwimi lolawulo, izicwangciso, imiyalelo, iinkqubo, namaqgibo afanele nalesi sithuba. Amap fades: isazimo esilula kwabanto, abanto abanobungakanani bokulinganisa namava omhle wokuthetha nokuhamba. Isiphikelelo sokuphila esingenamphathi phantsi, nokusebenza eluntwini kunye namandla okukhokela iqela elisebenzayo. Amaphum: amandla obulungiselelo, ngokucwangcisa, nangokwenza izinto ngokuphumelelayo. Ukube ngamandla okubeka iimfuno phakathi kokucwangcisa nangokuphefeni umsebenzi ofanelekileyo. Ukuziphendula, amandla okusebenza ngezinto eziningi, ukusebenza ngengcipha nokuphumelela ngokubekwa kwexesha. Amandla amangalisayo wokubhala iingxelo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki, ukuqamba amagqabantshintshi kwaye nenkxaso evela kumntu. Ukucinga ngokuthe ngcangca nokunamandla okubala izinto ezincinci kakhulu kwaye uphathe iinkcukacha ezifihliweyo.
xh.duties: Uku lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zolawulo ngaphakathi kweQela lezeMisebenzi kuwo onke amaqhekeza oMnyezo. Lawula iindawo zokuhamba komsebenzi kwi-Khampani. Lawula iziseko nekhuselo ezininzi. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko nokuthobela imigaqo yolawulo. Lawula amarekhodi namaxwebhu. Lawula amaphakathi abasebenzi nokusebenza kwabo. Qapha kwaye uqiniseke ukuthobela imithetho/iso-mthetho yolwimi yephakathi nesebe, izicwangciso, imiyalelo malunga nokuhamba komsebenzi kwi-Khampani, ulawulo lokuhamba, ulawulo lweziseko, ulawulo lwamarekhodi, iinkonzo zokunxibelelana, ukhuseleko, nokuqinisekisa amaxwebhu okukhuseleko. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lweenkonzo ezinziwa kumthengisi, ntlawulo leenkornzo, i-akhawunti, ukuphinda ufumane imali enikwe ntlawulo, imibuzo, ulungelelwaniso i-akhawunti nokubhala iingxelo zemali echithiweyo. Qinisekisa iingxelo ezithunyelwa kwisikhashana ngeminyaka yamava emi-3. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okusebenzayo kolwazi nakulwazi oluchanekileyo lwe-data. Nikela ngegalelo kwisicwangciso sokuchitha kwamabakhusi ngamnye ngokuhambelana nesicwangciso somsebenzi. Nikela ngegalelo kumaphefumlelo wobuni bokulinganisa/kubuyisa kabusha umthamo wemali ngesicwangciso esinamagabelo ngokubekiweyo nangemiqathango egqithisiweyo ebalulekileyo nekwaziwa. Cwangcisa, gcina, kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo ezingatshongo ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokusetyenziswa nokuthobela imithetho yokuhamba komsebenzi kwi-Khampani, ukulawula kwamalahle, ulawulo lweziseko, ulawulo lwamarekhodi, iinkonzo zokunxibelelwa, ukhuseleko, namaxwebhu obukhuseleko. Nike iinkcukacha kulawulo nakubasebenzi ngokwemisebenzi ephethe khona; kwezicwangciso, imiyalelo, iinkqubo, namaqgibo. Qamba amaphefumlelo ukuqalisa imisebenzi yolawulo kwaye unike iingxelo zolawulo. Qamba amaphefumlelo, amamkholari, ukuthumela iingxelo ezibekiweyo zamaxesha amnye zomsebenzi. Lawula abantu abanike inkxaso ngokulawula iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo zolawulo kwaye ulawule imisebenzi ekubeni ngamandla kwiQela leMisebenzi.
