Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures. Kennis van regeringsfinansiële stelsels. Kennis van tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van operasies. Program- en Projekbestuur. Kennis van verhoudingsbestuur. Begrip van Kontrakbestuur. Toegewyd aan hoëvlak-kwaliteitsbeheer. Kennis van die implementering van PMDS-beleide. Organisatoriese vaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise-vaardighede. Mens- en Diversiteitsbestuursvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. Kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en Etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Lewer administrasie oor logistiese aangeleenthede van die komponent. Bystand met die ontwikkeling en implementering van strategiese plan. Analiseer huidige beleide. Analiseer departementele strategiese doelwitte. Implementeer administrasiebeleide en verskeie dissiplines. Beveel beleidswysigings aan. Hou padvertonings wat die departement oor kernbeleid-aangeleenthede voorlig. Voorlig bestuurders oor beleidsvereistes. Verskaf kundige advies oor kontrakbestuur. Verseker dat strategiese doelwitte dienooreenkomstig geïmplementeer word. Voer sekuriteitsassesserings en verslagdoening uit, koördineer sekuriteit vir Provinsiale en Ministersgeleenthede. Ondersoek van sekuriteitskendings. Monitor beleidimplementering. Bestuur rekords en registratuurdienste, reis- en vlootdienste, fasiliteitsbestuur en kontrakte. Monitor die skoonmaakdienste van die departementele Provinsiale Kantore Western Cape. Bestuur en monitor parkeerterreine en parkeertoewysings. Inspekteer geboue vir regulatoriese nakoming. Bestuur departementele bates en toerusting onder die eenheid. Bestuur en monitor koerierdienste. wysig bestaande programme waar van toepassing. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne in die eenheid. Bestuur finansiële hulpbronne en nakomingsvoorskrifte in die eenheid. Bestuur en monitor ontvangs en boodskapperdienste. Implementering van beleide. Analiseer, bestuur prestasie en neigings in menslike hulpbronontwikkeling in die eenheid. Verskaf insette oor beleidswysigings. Monitor die besteding van die komponent. Doen vroeë waarskuwingstelsels. Verskaf insette oor die begroting vir die komponent. Doen maandelikse verslae. Reageer op ouditvrae.

zu.title: Onozimele: Izenzo Ezesekelayo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnozimele: Izenzo Ezesekelayo eDepartment of Water and Sanitation eBellville, esidinga izifundo zengoqweni lwe-NQF level 6 nokuhlolwa iminyaka emihlanu ngaphansi kobuchwepheshe bolawulo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekile zengoqweni lwe-NQF level 6 kumEzenzo eZomphakathi, uLawulo/iQondiso komphakathi noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuhlolwa kulawulo. Ukuzivulela ngelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engakapheli. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), i-Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA). Ulwazi ngokuMiso Okungukizinga Okuphezulu Kwolwazi Ngokuphephile (MISS) kanye noMiso Okungukizinga Okuphezulu Kokuphepha Komzimba (MPSS). Ulwazi ngemikhuba kanye namasistimu ezenzo zolawulo nezomhlebelelo. Ulwazi ngokubhaliswa kanye nemikhuba yomnyango. Ulwazi ngamasistemu ezimali kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngezindlela nezindlela zokuqamba kanye nokwenza imisebenzi. uLawulo lwezinhlelo kanye namagepha. Ulwazi ngokuLawula ubuhlobo. ukuQonda uLawulo Lwesivumelwano. Ukuqinisela ukulawula izinga eliphezulu lekhwalithi. Ulwazi ngokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo ze-PMDS. Amandla okuhlela inhlekelele. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Amandla okuphatha abantu kanye nokubekezela ngokwehlukana kwabantu. ukuzinika ngomxhasi kanye noKugxila kumxhasi. Amandla okukhuluma. ukuBeka amaphuzu kanye nokuziphatha ngokomoya. .
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinto zolawulo ngemikhuba yokuhamba eya ohlelweni. Siza ekwakheni nasekuhleleni uhlelo lwamasu. Hlaziya izinqubomgomo ezikhona. Hlaziya izinhloso ezibalulekile zomnyango. Hlela izinqubomgomo zolawulo namagatsha ahlukene. Phakamisa izinguquko kwezinqubomgomo. Yiba nabezindaba ihamba nabo exwayisa umnyango ngemibuzo ebalulekile yezinqubomgomo. Yenza izikhulumi zibize abaphathi ngemikhuba edingekayo yezinqubomgomo. Nikela ngeluleko eliseduze ekulawuleni izivumelwano. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhloso ezibalulekile zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Yenza okuhlola ukuphepha kanye nokubika, ohlelweni lokuphepha okuya emicimbini yesifundazwe kanye nalabo bakaMphathi. Phenya ngokuphulwa kokuphepha. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Lawula amarekhodi kanye namasistimu esibhalisa, kuhamba kanye namasistimu emikhumbi, ukuphathwa kwesikhungo, nezivumelwano. Qapha amasistimu okuhlanzwa koMnyango wezikhungo zesiFundazwe iWestern Cape. Lawula kanti futhi qapha izikhungo zokupaka kanye nokuhlukanisa indawo yokupaka. Hlola izakhiwo ngezenzo ezivumelana nomthetho. Lawula impahla namasistemu womnyango ongaphansi kohlelo. Lawula futhi uqaphe amasistimu okuthumela. Shintsha izinhlelo ezikhona lapho kufanele khona. Lawula abasebenzi ngaphansi kohlelo. Lawula amasistemu ezimali kanye nokubhaliswa kwemiyalo ngaphansi kohlelo. Lawula futhi uqaphe amasistimu okwamukela kanye nezinsiza zokwamukela. Hlela izinqubomgomo. Hlaziya, lawula imikhuba kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zomuntu ohlelweni. Nikela ngemibono yokuqeda izinqubomgomo. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kohlelo. Yenza amasistimu okuxwaya ngaphambili. Nikela ngemibono yebhajethi yohlelo. Yeza imibiko yanyanga zonke. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlolwa

xh.title: Umsekeli weNqanaba: Iinkonzo eziNguncedo
xh.summary: Isithuba somSekeli weNqanaba: Iinkonzo eziNguncedo kwisebe lezeManzileyo nezeNdlela ezingcolileyo eBellville, lifuna izatifikethi ezikumqangatho NQF 6 kwaye leminyaka emihlanu yamava olawulo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo esimqangathweni NQF 6 kwiZenzululwazi zeZentlalo, uLawululo oluKaRhulumente/uLawulo okunye ngezatifikethi ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kulawulo. Ukuvula urhwebo lokutyhila ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA) nolawulo lweNqola, uMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi nokuZinceda (OHSA), noMthetho woLawulo lweeAsethi ezingatshatanga nguRhulumente (GIAMA). Ulwazi ngeziNgangatho eziPhantsi zoKhuseleko loLwazi (MISS) nakuNgangatho eziPhantsi koKhuseleko loNyuso (MPSS). Ulwazi lweenkqubo neendlela zolawulo ngezomphanga. Ulwazi lweenkqabamthetho neendlela zesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqabo zemali zikaRhulumente. Ulwazi lweendlela nolulungelelwaniso lokuqamba nokuwenza izicwangciso. uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi. Ulwazi lolawulo lobufundi. Ukuqonda uLawulo lweeKontraki. Uxanduva lokulawula umgangatho phezulu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqabamthetho ze-PMDS. Amandla okuhlela. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Amandabuva okulawula abantu noNdalo. Ukujolisa kwabathengi nogqaliselo kumXhasi. Amandabuva okunxibelelana. Uxanduva nokuziphatha ngokuzithobileyo.
xh.duties: Zenza izicwangciso zolawulo kumaphupha okuhambisa izinto zelunga. Qinceda ekuphepheni nokuqhuba inkqubo eqamba isicwangciso. Hlalutya iinkqabamthetho ezikhoyo. Hlalutya iinjongo ezicwangcisisiweyo zesebe. Sebenzisa iinkqabamthetho zolawulo nolwahlulo olahlukeneyo. Phakamisa izilungiso zeenkqabamthetho. Yenza iindibano zokuvakalisa izinto eziphambili ngeenkqabamthetho kwisebe. Yenza iingxoxo nabaphathi ngeemfuno zeenkqabamthetho. Nikeza isluleko ngekontraki ekulingeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinjongo ezicwangcisisiweyo zisenziwa ngokufanelekileyo. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwakhuseleko nokuvelisa iingxelo, ulungelelwaniso lokhuseleko kwemicimbo yoMmandla nokoBaphathi. Uphando lwoonikezelo bobukhuseleko. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweenkqabamthetho. Lawula iirekhodi neenkonzo zefayili, iindululo noqhagamshelwano nokuqhuba iimoto, ulawulo lwezindlu kunye neekontraki. Qwalasela iinkonzo zokucotha kweeofisi zesiB esiPhathelwa phakathi kwamaphondo iNtshona Koloni. Lawula ukuqwalasela iindawo zokupaka nabelo lokupaka. Hlola izakhiwo ukuze zihambelane noMiraro. Lawula iiasethi zesebe nempahla engaphantsi komthimba. Lawula ukuqwalasela iinkonzo zokuhamba ngeqonga. Lungisa iinkqabo ezikhoyo xa kufanelekile. Lawula amathambo amthusa omntu ngamthusa kumthimba. Lawula iinkcukacha zemali nokuhambelana neemiraro kumthimba. Lawula ukuqwalasela iinkonzo zokwamkela nabathunywa. Ukusebenzisa iinkqabamthetho. Hlalutya, lawula ukusebenza kwaye uhlaze amathuba ophuhliso wamathusa omntu ngamthusa kumthimba. Nikeza isibonelelo ngolungiselelo lweenkqabamthetho. Qwalasela ukuchithwa kwemali yelunga. Yiza inkqubo yokhuseleko edlulisa inkumbulo eqondo ngaphambi kwexesha. Nikeza isibonelelo sejikelele-mali yelunga. Yenza iingxelo nyanga zonke. Phendula iimbuzo yokhangelo

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Auditor
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Internal Auditor position in the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, requiring a degree in Internal Auditing and three to five years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 (Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma) in Internal Auditing or a relevant tertiary qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in General Internal Auditing, Compliance Auditing, Performance Auditing, Forensic Investigations, Quality Assurance Auditing or General Control Review and Applications Control, or completion of the Internal Audit Technician (IAT) learnership (three (3) years) from the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) plus two (2) years’ internal audit experience. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Knowledge and understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) and of governance, risk management, and control processes. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and guidelines. Knowledge of the Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy and anti-corruption and fraud prevention measures. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management legislation, policies, practices, and procedures. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems, institutional policies and procedures, and governmental financial systems. Knowledge of the principles and practice of financial accounting. Knowledge of the framework for managing performance information. Business strategy translation and alignment, problem solving and analysis, people and diversity management, and client orientation and customer focus skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for supervising and executing internal audit, compliance audit, performance audit, forensic investigation, quality assurance audit, general control review, and applications control engagements, as well as consultancy engagements, to support the implementation of the approved Internal Audit Operational Plan. Supervise and participate in the development of the three-year strategic and annual risk-based internal audit plans, including identifying key risk areas emanating from current operations as set out in the strategic plan and risk management strategy. Participate in the coordination with other internal and external assurance providers to ensure proper coverage and minimise duplication of effort. Develop proposals to determine the scope of allocated internal audits, develop engagement work programmes, and supervise and execute allocated audits in accordance with the IIA Standards and the legislative framework. Collect, analyse, and interpret data, develop findings and recommendations for the enhancement of controls and processes, and compile and review audit reports for each engagement. Monitor progress on the implementation of agreed-upon action plans. Review, collect information and compile progress, quarterly and annual reports to the Accounting Officer and the Audit Committee. Keep up to date with new developments in the internal audit environment by studying professional journals and publications, monitoring relevant industry, legislative, standards, and policy framework changes, and engaging in continuous professional development. Supervise employees, allocate duties, and perform quality control on work delivered by supervisees, and ensure that supervisees are trained and developed to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Manage the performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees (PMDS). Provide inputs for the enhancement of audit methodologies and technologies.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudi-teur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudi-teur pos in die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, wat 'n graad in Interne Ouditering en drie tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF level 7 (Bachelorsgraad of Gevorderde Diploma) in Interne Ouditering of 'n relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Algemene Interne Ouditering, Nalewingsouditering, Prestasie-ouditering, Forensiese ondersoeke, Kwaliteitsversekeringsouditering of Algemene Beheerhersiening en Toepassingsbeheer, of voltooiing van die Internal Audit Technician (IAT) leerderskap (drie (3) jaar) by die Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) plus twee (2) jaar se interne oudit-ervaring. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en begrip van die International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) en van bestuurs-, risikobestuurs- en beheerprosesse. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en riglyne. Kennis van die Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy en korrupsie- en bedrogvoorkomingsmaatreëls. Kennis en begrip van Wetgewing, beleide,praktyke en prosedures vir Menslikehulpbronbestuur. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende aksie-riglyne en wette. Kennis van administratiewe en skriftelike prosedures en stelsels, instellingsbeleid en -prosedures, en staatsfinansiële stelsels. Kennis van die beginsels en praktyk van finansiële rekeningkunde. Kennis van die raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Besigheidsstrategie-vertaling en -belyning, probleemoplossing en analise, mense- en diversiteitsbestuur, en kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokusvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die toesig en uitvoering van interne oudit-, nalewingsoudit-, prestasie-oudit-, forensiese ondersoek-, kwaliteitversekeringsoudit-, algemene beheerhersienings- en toepassingsbeheer-opdragte, asook konsultasie-opdragte, om die implementering van die goedgekeurde Interne Oudit-bedryfsplan te ondersteun. Toesig hou en deelneem aan die ontwikkeling van die driejaar-strategiese en jaarlikse risiko-gebaseerde interne ouditplanne, insluitend die identifisering van sleutarrisiko-areas wat voortspruit uit huidige bedrywighede soos uiteengesit in die strategiese plan en risikobestuurstrategie. Deelneem aan die koördinering met ander interne en eksterne versekeraars om behoorlike dekking te verseker en duplisering van pogings te minimaliseer. Voorstelle ontwikkel om die omvang van toegekende interne oudite te bepaal, opdragwerkprogramme ontwikkel, en toesig hou oor en toegekende oudite uitvoer ooreenkomstig die IIA Standards en die wetgewende raamwerk. Data versamel, ontleed en interpreteer, bevindings en aanbevelings ontwikkel vir die verbetering van beheer en prosesse, en ouditverslae vir elke opdrag opstel en hersien. Vordering op die implementering van ooreengekome aksieplanne monitor. Hersien, versamel inligting en stel vordering-, kwartaal- en jaarverslae vir die Rekenpligtige Beampte en die Ouditkomitee op. Tred hou met nuwe ontwikkelings in die interne oudit-omgewing deur professionele joernale en publikasies te bestudeer, relevante bedryfs-, wetgewende-, standaard- en beleidsraamwerkveranderinge te monitor, en deel te neem aan voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling. Werknemers toesighou, pligte toeken, en kwaliteitsbeheer uitvoer op werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word, en verseker dat toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Die prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesighouers bestuur (PMDS).Insette verskaf vir die verbetering van ouditmetodologieë en -tegnologie.

zu.title: Umncedisi weSikhulumi: umhloli wangaphakathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi weSikhulumi: umhloli wangaphakathi kumnyango we-Water and Sanitation e-Polokwane, sidinga iziqu e-Internal Auditing kanye nomuzwa wesikhathi esingu-three to five years ohambisana nalokhu.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 7 (I-Bachelor's Degree noma i-Advanced Diploma) ku-Internal Auditing noma iziqu ezingaba zinhle ezingaphakeme. Isikhathi esinga-three (3) kuya kwa-five (5) years somuzwa ku-General Internal Auditing, Compliance Auditing, Performance Auditing, Forensic Investigations, Quality Assurance Auditing noma General Control Review and Applications Control, noma ukugcwaliseka kwe-Internal Audit Technician (IAT) learnership (three (3) years) esuka kwi-Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) kanye ne-two (2) years yomuzwa wokuhlola ngaphakathi. Ukwazisa isipayi elifanele elingekashoni lesiLungiselelo sokushayela. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngwe-International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) kanye nezinqubo zokuphatha, yolawula ingozi, nezokulawula. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, kanye neziluleko. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy kanye ngezinyathelo zokuthwala ukungalungi nokuvikela ukukhohliswa. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho we-Human Resource Management, izinqubo, izimiso, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokusethwa ngokulingana kwezithuba kanye neziluleko nemithetho yensimbi ethuthukisiwe. Ulwazi ngezinqubo nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezokubhalisa nezomlomo, izinqobo nemithetho yenhlangano, kanye nezinhlela zikahulumeni zezimali. Ulwazi ngemigomo nokuqonda kokubhaliswa kwezimali. Ulwazi ngohlaka lokuqondisa ukulawula ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ukuguqula futhi ulinganisele inkqubo yebhizinisi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu nokuhlukahluka, kanye namakhono okuqondiswa kuklayenti nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala ngomlomo nakubhalwayo. Ukwethembeka kanye nokuziphatha okuhle kwemorali.
zu.duties: Lowo othweswe isikhundla uzobe egunya ukulawula futhi enze izinhlelo zokuhlola ngaphakathi, ukuhlola ukuvunyelwa, ukuhlola ukusebenza, ukuphenya ngokobulelesi, ukuqinisekisa izinga lokuhlolwa, ukuhlola ukulawula okujwayelekile, kanye nokuqashelwa kolawulwa lokusebenza, kanye nokubonisana ngokweluleka, ukuze kusekelwe ukusetshenziswa kohlaka olugunyaziwe lokusebenza kwangaphakathi kokuhlola. Ukulawula futhi athathe inhlangothi ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo zokuhlola ngaphakathi ezisezinsukwini ezingu-three-year strategic kanye nezinye zonyaka ezingase ngingozi, okuhlanganisa nokubona izindawo ezibaluleke zengozi eziphuma emisebenzini yamanje njengoba kushiwo ohlakeni lwezindlela nezindlela zokulawula ingozi. Ukuthatha inhlangothi ekuxhumaneni nabanye abanikezi besiqiniseko abangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa okufanele futhi kuncishiswe ukuphindwa kwemizamo. Ukuthuthukisa iziphakamiso ukuze kutholwe ibanga lokuhlola okwabeliwe ngaphakathi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, nokulawula futhi kuqashelwe ukusetshenziswa kohlolo olwabeliwe ngokuya nge-IIA Standards kanye nohlaka womthetho. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya, futhi kuqondwe imininingwane, ukuthuthukisa iziphumelo neziluleko ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulawula kanye nezinqubo, futhi kuqoqwe futhi kuqashwe umbiko wokuhlola ngasinye isikhathi. Ukubuka inqubomgomo yomzila wokuqashelwa kwesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezinyathelo ezingamukelekile ezivumelene. Ukuphinda ubuke, uqoqe ulwazi futhi uhluze imibiko yokunqamula kanye nemibiko yonyaka evela kwi-Accounting Officer ne-Audit Committee. Ukuhlala ukatsha ngemvelo entsha ekuhlolweni okwangaphakathi ngokufunda imagazini nokushicilelwa kwabangobungcweti, ngokuqapha izinguquko ezithintayo embonini, eshwamatheni, ezinhlobonhlobo, nasohlakeni lwenqubomgomo, kanye nokuzibandakanya ekuthuthukiseni ubungcweti ngokuqhubekayo. Ukulawula abasebenzi, ukwaba imisebenzi, futhi ukwenza ukulawula izinga emsebenzini onikelwe abalawuli, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abalawuli bahlezi bafundiswa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi wezinga elidingwa kahle ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nobungcweti kwabalawuli (i-PMDS). Ukunikeza okungenayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela kanye nethekhnoloji yokuhlola.

xh.title: Umlawuli ongundosule: Internal Auditor
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli ongundosule kwiSebe lezeManzo nokuCogula ePolokwane, sifuna isidanga kwi-Auditing yangaphakathi kwaye sifuna iminyaka yamava eyi-ukusuka kwithree ukuya kwi-five.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF level 7 (i-Bachelor's Degree okanye i-Advanced Diploma) kwi-Internal Auditing okanye ngowona mugaqo wezesi-fundi. Iimvula ezithathu (3) ukuya kwezihlanu (5) zedanga yamava kwi-General Internal Auditing, Compliance Auditing, Performance Auditing, Forensic Investigations, Quality Assurance Auditing, ukugqiboza okubanzi kwe-General Control Review kwaye Applications Control, okanye ukugqitywa kwe-Internal Audit Technician (IAT) (iminyaka elishumi (3)) ukusuka kwi-Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) kwaye kwezimvula ezibini (2) zamava kwi-internal audit. Ukuvula okusemthethweni ko lwesmati yasekhaya elingezanga kuphelelwa sisikhathi. Ulwazi nokulondekwa kwamagama obulumko abavela kumapapashuwo we-International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) kwaye kumagama obulumko abavela kumapapashuwo aqhutshwa yi-Ithuba lokuLawula iingozi, iindlela zokuLawula, kwaye nokulawula. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, kwaye nezo ndlela zokuqwalasela. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy kwaye nezindlela zokuqhawula umonakalo wokukhwela imali kwaye nokuthintela ukwenza okungalunganga nokwenza inkohlakalo. Ulwazi nokulondekwa kolwazi lweze-mfundo lwe-Human Resource Management legislation, iindlela zokuqhuba imisebenzi, kwaye nemigaqo yokusebenza. Ulwazi olubonelela ngamathuba alinganayo kwaye namagama ashukumisayo aqhutshwa yi-affirmative action. Ulwazi lwezondlela zokuqhuba izinto ezingoyiko nobulumko bokuqhuba izicwangciso ze-ofisi, namagama obulumko abathunyelweyo, kwaye izimiso zeendlela zeemali karhulumente. Ulwazi ngamagama obulumko aqhutshwa kwi-financial accounting. Ulwazi lwezondlela zokuqhuba ulwazi lwezenzo zokusebenza ezingagqibekanga. Ukuguqula kwaye ulungelelanise iindlela ze-business strategy, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, ukuphatha abantu nokwahlukahluka kwezonto, kwaye kukwazi ukuqwalasela iimfuno zabathengi. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngokwexesha. Isidima nokuziphatha ngokwemigaqo yemfundo.
xh.duties: Kuya kubakho wena ke ongemnyama wokulawula kwaye ulenze i-internal audit, i-compliance audit, i-performance audit, i-forensic investigation, i-quality assurance audit, i-general control review, kwaye abantu bakho bahlakulele izicwangciso zokwenza umsebenzi, kwaye abantu bakho bahlakulele kubakho wena ke ongemnyama wokulawula nokulawula abantu abenza iimfuno ezincinci kwaye abantu abenza iimfuno ezincinci, ukuxhasa ukuqaliswa kwezicwangciso ezamkelweyo ze-Internal Audit Operational Plan. Lawula kwaye ulinge ukuyila izicwangciso zonyaka mawathathu zokulingana nomnquba wokuqwalasela oqhutywa lixesha, okuquka ukuchaza iindawo ezibalulekileyo ezingozi ezivela kumanqamano alolo nyaka azikwizicwangciso ezikumgaqo-nkqubo wobulumko bokulawula. Thatha inxaxheba kulungelelaniso kwezinye iindlela ze-internal and external assurance providers kwaye uqiniseke ukubonelelwa okufanelekileyo kwaye unciphise ukuphindaphinda kwemisebenzi. Yila izicwangciso ukuze uqwalasele isithuba sokuhlawulwa kwemirhi yangaphakathi, yila imirhi yokusebenza, kwaye ulawule ulenze imisebenzi yokuhlawulwa efakelwe kwindlela ekuqwalaselwa kuyo ngokwemigaqo ye-IIA Standards. Iqokele, iqwalasele, kwaye yichaze idatha, yila iziphumo kwaye izindulula eziphakamisayo ukuphucula iindlela zokulawula nemisebenzi, kwaye uqokele kwaye ulawule iindulula zokuqwalasela ngale nyanga. Qwalasela ukuphuhliswa kwezicwangciso ezivunyiweyo. Qwalasela, qokelela ulwazi kwaye uqokele izindulula ngale nyaka yonke nezicwangciso ezikwindlela yokwenza umsebenzi kwaye kwindlela yonyaka, uzinike kwi-Accounting Officer naye i-Audit Committee. Ziphathe ngononophelo ngezithjini ezintsha kwindlela yokwenza umsebenzi ngokufunda iimpapasho ezikumathunga obuchwepheshe kwaye ngokupapashwa, ngokulawula ngokutsha kweendaba, kwabanywe umthetho, kwamagama obuchwepheshe, kwaye kwamagama obulumko abo, kwaye uzonike umdla ngononophelo ukuphuhlisa ulwazi lwakho. Lawula abantu, abeke izicwangciso zomsebenzi, kwaye uqwalasele kakuhle umsebenzi ozenziwa ngabantu abalawulwayo, kwaye uqiniseke ukuba abantu abalawulwayo bafundelwe kwaye baphuhliswe ukwenza umsebenzi oqwalaselweyo ngokukhawuleza kwaye ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ukwenza umsebenzi, indlela yokuziphatha, nendlela yokuqhawula iingxaki zabantu abalawulwayo (PMDS). Nikela ngezimvo ukuphucula iindlela namachiza okuqwalasela.

jobs.title: Engineering Technologist Production Grade a - C
jobs.summary: Engineering Technologist needed to conduct structural integrity assessments of water and wastewater treatment works, requiring a BTech in Civil Engineering and ECSA registration.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering (BTech) qualification. Three (3) years post qualification engineering technologist experience is required. Compulsory registration with Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA) as a professional engineering technologist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver's license. Understanding of programme and project management. Technical design and analysis knowledge. Understanding research development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing and consulting. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making, creativity and teamwork. Understanding of people financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Computer Skills. Planning and organizing. Management.
jobs.duties: Conduct structural integrity assessments of Water Treatment Works (WTWs) and Wastewater Treatment Works (WWTWs) to evaluate infrastructure conditions, identify defects and risks, and recommend appropriate remedial measures as part of regulatory process. Evaluate and assess WCWDM strategies and monitor implementations. Participate in the Blue Drop, No drop and Green Drop certification programmes by providing engineering and technical support to the relevant teams, including the Very Rough Order of Measurement (VROOM) initiative. Serve as Water Services Regulation representative at the committees mandated to provide engineering expertise and technical inputs to the evaluation of water services projects including Water Demand and Water conservation management (WCWDM) projects. Conduct research and recommend as part of regulatory process, innovative and emerging technologies aimed at improving the planning, design, operation, maintenance, rehabilitation, and sustainability of water and wastewater infrastructure. Develop and manage knowledge of current and emerging technologies and optimise technical interventions through the application of sound engineering principles and best practices. Provide input into the budgeting process. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide Engineering inputs in the enhancement of databases such as (IRIS). Manage, supervise, and control technical related personnel and assets.

zu.title: Injiniya Technologieshi Yokukhiqiza Izinga a - C
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniya technologieshi ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlola ukuqina kwezakhiwo zemisebenzi yokuhlanzwa amanzi nokuhlanzwa amanzi adingekayo, okudinga i-BTech kubu-injiniya_basesi_lwakho bensimbi nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA.
zu.requirements: Ithobela lesiqui se-Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering (BTech). Kudingeka amava eminyaka eyisithupha (6) emva kokuthola lesiqui njengenjiniya technologieshi. Ukubhaliswa okuyimfuneko kwi-Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniya technologieshi yobuchwepheshe. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile esingekapheli isikhathi. Ukuqonda ohlelweni nokuqhuba imiklamo. Ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ekuklanyeni nokuhlaziya. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kophando. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa kwekhompyutha zokuhlinzeka ngabezobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe nokubuzisisa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukudala nokusebenza njengeqembu. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwabantu nezimali. Ukugxila kubathembu nokuvala. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle ngomlomo nangokubhala. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukuphatha.
zu.duties: Kwenze ukutolikwa kolwazi ngokuhlela nokwenza imibiko ngohlelo lokuqashwa kwemisebenzi yokuhlenza amanzi. Kubheke futhi kuqashe izindlela zokuqonda kwamanye amanzi nokulawulwa kwezinto ezingekho emthethweni ngokusebenza kwesikhashana. Kwenze ukubhaliswa kwamafayela akwaNhlangano yeZwe yokuBhekana nezeMisebenzi yeNhlekeleke namathani namathathu amasha. Kuzobe kubhalwa izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza ukusetshenziswa kwamaza enkathi ekubhaleni imibhalo. Kube igosa eliphethe ngemisebenzi yokungenelela ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu noma ezincane ezibangelwa ukungaphathwa kwamaza amanzi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kwenze izinhlelo zokuqashwa nokuqamba nokuqedela imisebenzi ehlelekile nengaqedwa noma kudingwa ukusetshenziswa kwezinye izindlela ezisha ekutholeni amaza emisebenzi. Kube ngumela Wesifunda Ongemthetho ekugcineni ngokusebenzisa izinto zomthetho kanye nesigaba sokuqamba imisebenzi nokuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwamaza emisebenzi. Kwenze ukugqama imisebenzi engakavumi ukuphothula uhlelo lokuqashwa nokuqedela imisebenzi ngokuvumelana nenhlangano yamaza emisebenzi. Kube ngumelaphi wokuqondisa nokuqedela imisebenzi yesikhathi samanje nasekwenzeni izinhlelo ezintsha ngokuvumelana nenhlekeleke yamaza emisebenzi. Kube yiso esinamandla ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokuqashwa kanye nokuqedela imisebenzi ekusebenziseni kwamaza emisebenzi. Kube ngumela wakho konke ukugcina imisebenzi nokuqedela imisebenzi yonke. Kwenze futhi aqashe amanye amaza noma abe yiso ekuqedeleni imisebenzi ngokuvumelana nesigaba sokuqashwa nokuqedela imisebenzi. Kwenze ukugcina imisebenzi nokuqedela imisebenzi yamaza emisebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinga lamaza emisebenzi.

xh.title: Injiniya yobuchwepheshe yokwenziwa inqanaba a - C
xh.summary: Kufuneka injiniya yobuchwepheshe yokwenza ukuqonda iinkqubo zokuhlolwa kokuzinza kwezakhiwo zemizi yokuhlonza nokugqithisa amanzi, kwaye kufuneka abe nayo i-BTech kwi-Civil Engineering anokusayinwa kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-Bachelor of Technology kwi-Civil Engineering (BTech). Kufuneka zibe nguMithathu (3) iminyaka yamava njengenjiniya yobuchwepheshe emva kokuqwalasela isigqibo. Kufuneka ubhaliswe njengenjiniya yobuchwepheshe ngokugqithisileyo kwi-Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA). Kufuneka afake izaziso ezichanekileyo azikapheliyo lesenti yokushayela. Kuqonde ukulawula amacebo amaninzi namaphrojeki. Ulwazi lokuyila ngokobuchwepheshe nokuhlalutya. Kuqonde uphuhliso wolwucwengqangqamathu. Izicelo zenyuzi encedwa yikhompyutha njengenjiniya. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe kunye nokuceba. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda okubalulekileyo. Ukwenza izigqibo, ukudala ngokwakho nokusebenza njengesiqhathi. Ukuqonda ukulawula imali yabantu. Ukuqonda iimfuno zabathengi nokuphendula ngokukhawuleza. Amakhono amabalawuni athetha ngesandi nakubhalwayo. Amakhongco ekhompyutha. Ukuquka iindaba nokuhlela. Ukulawula.
xh.duties: Qonda iinkqubo zokuhlolwa kokuzinza kwezakhiwo zokuhlonza nokugqithisa amanzi (WTWs) kwaye nezakhiwo zokugqithisa amanzi (WWTWs) ukuze uhlolwe imo yezakhiwo, aqonde iingxaki neengozi, aze anike izindulela echanekileyo zokulungisa njengenxalenye yenkqubo yomthetho. Qonda ukuhlalutya iingqwalasela iindlela zokuqonda i-WCWDM ulandele ukusetyenziswa kwazo. Thatha inxaxheba kumathuba e-Blue Drop, i-No drop ne-Green Drop ngokunika inkxaso yenyuzi ngokobuchwepheshe nakwezamathuba kumaphaphu othileyo, kuquka isiphelo esibi kakhulu sokulinganisa (i-VROOM). Yiba ngummeli wolawulo lwamathuba amaza kumabango afunyanwe ngokunika ingcebiso yenyuzi nakwelinye ithuba elithile ukuqwalaselwa kweeprojethi zamathuba amanzi kuquka namaphrojethi woLondolozo lwamathuba amanzi nokuhambisa i-WCWDM. Yenza uphando unike izindulela njengenxalenye yenkqubo yomthetho, ngeenyuzi ezitsha neziphuhlayo eziphuhliswa ukuphucula ukuquka iindaba, ukuyila, ukusebenza, ukulungisa, ukubuyisa nokuzinza kwezakhiwo zokuhlonza nokugqithisa amanzi. Phuhlisa ulawule ulwazi ngeenyuzi ezikhoyo nezitsha uze ulungise ukungena kobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzisa iingcalu zenyuzi ezilungileyo nezona zinto ezingcono. Nikezela ingcebiso kumathuba amanzi. Hlanganisa ungenise iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikezela ingcebiso yenyuzi ekuphuculweni kweziseko zolwazi ezinjengoko kuyi-(IRIS). Lawula, ulawule ulawule abantu abavela ngobuchwepheshe kunye nezinto ezingenamsebenzi ngqo kweli candelo lobuchwepheshe.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant
jobs.summary: Senior State Accountant needed at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria to manage vendor reconciliations, VAT submissions, and general ledger accounts.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Financial Management or related field. Three (3) to four (4) years’ experience in Accruals and Accounts Payable. At least two (2) years’ experience as a State Accountant or similar. Knowledge and understanding on financial legislation, policies, practise, and procedures. Knowledge and understanding of financial prescripts such as PFMA, Treasury Regulations and other post relevant Government regulations and policies including GRAP. Knowledge, experience as well as interpretation of accruals accounting including the application of government and other financial systems, i.e. SAP, BAS. Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems. Department policies and procedures. Knowledge of learning and teaching procedures and techniques. Computer literacy (MS Excel, MS Word and MS PowerPoint and outlook). Framework for managing performance information. Knowledge and understanding of the Value-added Tax Act No.89 of 1991, as amended. Proactive and creative problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Perform the vendor reconciliations for the key accounts and the top 150 vendors. Follow up long outstanding invoices on the vendor statement. Perform the VAT reconciliation and the submission of monthly VAT returns to SARS. Reconciliations and clearing of advances and other suspense general ledger accounts applicable to Accounts Payable. Monitoring and reporting of the 30 days payments of the suppliers. Maintain the Trade and Sundry vendor invoice register. Authorise the trade vendor purchase order and sundry payment transactions. Authorize the trade vendor purchase order and sundry payment transactions. Authorise sundry vendors created on the sundry vendor master account group relating to expenditure management. Monthly reporting of the trade payables and provide inputs for the Interim Financial Statement and Annual Financial Statement. Ensure that all audit requests are dealt with and respond to timeously. Ensure the safekeeping of all financial records and face- value documents by maintaining an effective and efficient filling system. Supervising and managing the performance of employees in accordance with the Department policies

af.title: Seniorstaatsrekenmeester
af.summary: Seniorstaatsrekenmeeter benodig by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria om verskafferversoeninge, BTW-indienings en grootboekrekenings te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur of verwante veld. Drie (3) tot vier (4) jaar se ervaring in Aanwas en Rekenings betaalbaar. Ten minste twee (2) jaar se ervaring as 'n Staatsrekenmeester of soortgelyk. Kennis en begrip van finansiële wetgewing, beleid, praktyk en prosedures. Kennis en begrip van finansiële voorskifte soos PFMA, Tesourie Regulasies en ander posverwante Regeringsregulasies en -beleid insluitend GRAP. Kennis, ervaring asook interpretasie van aanwasrekeningkunde insluitend die toepassing van regerings- en ander finansiële stelsels, bv. SAP, BAS. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Departementele beleid en prosedures. Kennis van leer- en onderrigprosedures en -tegnieke. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Excel, MS Word en MS PowerPoint en outlook). Raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis en begrip van die Value-added Tax Act No.89 van 1991, soos gewysig. Proaktiewe en kreatiewe probleemoplossingsvaardighede en vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Voer die verskafferversoening vir die sleutelrekeninge en die top 150 verskaffers uit. Volg uitstaande fakture op die verskafferstaat na. Voer die BTW-versoening en die indiening van maandelikse BTW-opgawes aan SARS uit. Versoening en skering van voorraad en ander hangende grootboekrekenings van toepassing op Rekenings betaalbaar. Monitering en rapportering van die 30 dae betalings van die verskaffers. Onderhou die handels- en diverse verskafferfaktuurregister. Magtig die handelsverskaffer-inkooporder en diverse betalingsfondstransaksies. Magtig die handelsverskaffer-inkooporder en diverse betalingsfondstransaksies. Magtig diverse verskaffers geskep op die diverse verskaffer-meesterrekeningsgroep wat verband hou met bestuursbesteding. Maandelikse verslagdoening van die handelskrediteure en voorsien insetsels vir die Interim Finansiële Staatsverslag en Jaarlikse Finansiële Staatsverslag. Verseker dat alle ouditversoeke hanteer en betyds beantwoord word. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle finansiële rekords en nominale waarde-dokumente deur 'n doeltreffende en doeltreffende stelsel van invul te handhaaf. Toesig hou oor en bestuur van die prestasie van werknemers in ooreenstemming met die departementele beleid

zu.title: I-Senior State Accountant
zu.summary: I-Senior State Accountant idingeka e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Pretoria ukuphatha ukuqondanisa kwabathengisi, ukubeka izibiko ze-VAT, kanye nama-akhawunti abalulekile abhalwa kahle.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yesizwe kwi-financial Management noma enye indawo efanayo. Ukwaba okunike amasizini (3) kuya kwezinhlangothi (4) iminyaka yokuqeqesha kubakhashimane abathengisa ngohlobo lwezimali ezenzelwe imali yokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-(2) yokuqeqesha njengombhalisi wezimali zombuso noma ngokulingana nalokho. Ukwaba nokuqonda imithetho ephatha imali, imithetho nemiXholo yokusebenza, imithetho yokusakaza imali. Ukwaba nokuqonda imithetho yokusakaza imali efana ne-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations neminye imithetho nokuhambisana imigomo kahulumeni efana ne-GRAP. Ukwaba ukubona, ukuhlola nokusiza kumini yokusingatha imali ekhokhiwe kungakakhokhiwa, okuhlanganisa nokuqonda imithetho esebenzisa amathuluzi kahulumeni kanye namanye ohwahle wokusetshenziswa njengale-SAP, BAS. Ukwaba kokuthile okungenhla okuyimithetho yohwebo nemiyalo yezokungquluva nemithetho yokuqondanisa imali. Imithetho kahulumene nemithetho yemikhandlu kahulumene nezinhlangano ezehlukene. Ukwaba kokuqonda imiyalelo yokufunda nokufundisa emikhandlwini. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Excel, i-MS Word, kanye ne-MS PowerPoint kanye ne-outlook). Ukwazi ukuhlola ibaluleke kwemithetho yokubuka imali eqondene nokutholakala kwemali eqoqe isikhundla esingu 89 sonyaka ka-1991, okushushulwa ngenxa yokuba ngomumo wokuthola isidingo sokuba ngaphansi kwemithetho. Ukuba wumuntu ohlala ethanda ukuboneka futhi ongumuntu okhakha imicabango eyisixazululu eqonde ekuxazululeni izinkinga futhi othanda ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuqondanisa kwabathengisi bakwamanye amakhasimane abalulekile kanye nabathengisi abangu 150 abaphezulu. Landela izikweletu eziqhubekayo ezithinte izinkampani ezinde zamakhasimane abathengisi. Yenza ukuqondanisa kwe-VAT kanye nokubeka izibiko ze-VAT ezingamashumi ayisikhathi kuSARS. Ukuqondanisa kanye nokusula amasheji abakhokheli kanye namanye ama-akhawunti ashukumisayo anikezela kwe-Accounts Payable. Ukulandela kanye nokubika kokukhokha abathengisi esikhathini esingamalanga angu 30. Gcina irejista yamakhasimane abathengisi kwezohwebo kanye nezohlu. Dunda amakhasimane ohwebo kanye nokuqedela izinkweletu ezihlukahlukene. Duda amakhasimane ohwebo kanye nokuqedela izinkweletu ezihlukene. Duda amakhasimane aqhubekayo abakhiwe esikhundleni se-sundry vendor master account group okuhlobene nenkokhelo. Ukubika ngenyanga kwabathengisi behwebo futhi usebenze ngezimali ezitholakalayo eziphakathi nenhllalo, zeze imali ehlezi kahle ekugcineni konyaka. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikwama-odidiyethi ziyaphathwa futhi ziphenduleka ngesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kahle kokubhhalwe okusemthethweni emafayela agcinwa kalula kabi, afundwa kalula futhi abuye azifake ngokulandela imithetho nemigomo yomnyango okuhlongqwe inkinga yomsebenzi osetshenziswa ngemvunyelweni yokuphatha abantu basebenzi bezinkondolo, kusetshenziswa imithetho kahulumeni nezeqembu.

xh.title: Mphathi wezoNgemiso zeLizwe
xh.summary: Kufuneka Mphathi wezoNgemiso zeLizwe kwiSebe lezaManzi nokuCocekisa ePretoria ukuze alawule uqonde-lweentsapho zabanikezeli, iingeniselo ze-VAT, nee-akhawunti zeqela eliphambili.
xh.requirements: INazali Diploma kwiLawulo leMali okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Iimvelo zothando lwe-(3) ukuya kwankqonkqo (4) emisebenzini ye-Accruals ngee-Akhawunti ezihlawulelwayo. Kwisigqibo (2) iimvelo zothando njengMphathi wezoNgemiso zeLizwe okanye okufanayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yemali, iinkqubo, iziko nakwezinkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemiyalelo yemali efana ne-PFMA, Iimigozo yeQoqo leMali neminye imithetho nemiqathango kahulumeni enxulumene nesithuba nokubandakanya i-GRAP. Ulwazi, amava njengokutolikwa i-akhawunti ze-Accruals kubandakanya ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhulu kahulumeni nezemali, umz. i-SAP, i-BAS. Ulwazi lweenkqubo nemiqathango yolawulo noko kubhalwa. Iinkqubo nemiqathango yesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo nendlela zokufundisa nokufundiswa. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Excel, i-MS Word ne-MS PowerPoint kunye ne-outlook). Umqathango wolawula ulwazi ngemveliso. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho we-VAT waka-89 ka-1991, njengoko ulungisiwe. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki ngendlela ephambili nokuqamba nokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Yenza uqonde-lweentsapho zabanikezeli kwi-akhawunti eziphambili nakubanikeli abaphezulu abali-150. Landela iinvoices ezingaxhunyiwekw ixesha elide kwisitatimende sabanikezeli. Yenza uqonde-lwe-VAT nangingeniselo yenyanga zee-VAT returns kwi-SARS. Ukuqonda-lula nokucoca iindleko zehamba phambili nakwezinye ii-akhawunti ze-suspense eqela eliphambili ezinxulumene nee-Akhawunti ezihlawulelwayo. Ukulandela nokubika ngemahlawulo abanikezeli emini yangama-30. Phatha iresista ye-invoice yabanikezeli be-Trade nabaSundry. Vuma uku odole i-trade vendor purchase order nokuqhelanisa iintengiselwano zokuhlawula aba-sundry. Vuma uku odole i-trade vendor purchase order nokuqhelanisa iintengiselwano zokuhlawula aba-sundry. Vuma aba-sundry vendors abadalelwe kwisebe laba-sundry vendor master eqela elinxulumene nolawulo lokuchithwa. Ibika ngemahlawulo ye-trade payables yenyanga kaninzi ukuze unike iingcaphepheko ze-Iinterim Financial Statement kunye ne-Annual Financial Statement. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo yokujonga iyaphathwa kwaye iphendulwa ngexesha. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwazi ngemali kunye namaxwebhu obuko obuyixabi ngokugcina inkqubo egqweswayo necebileyo yokugciniwa. Ukulawula nokulawula imveliso yabasebenzi ngokwezinkqubo nemiqathango yesebe

zu.title: UmPhathi OPhakeme Wezokuphila Nabasebenzi Nenkulu Yezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMphathi OPhakeme Wezokuphila Nabasebenzi Nenkulu Yezempilo eKimberley ukuthi asungule izinhlela zezokuphila aphinde ahlanganisele imisebenzi yokwazisa ngempilo eMnyangweni Wezamanzi NokuCocekwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuqashelwa i-SAQA kwi-Social Work/Industrial Psychology/Psychology. Uhalaza iminyaka eyi-three (3) ohlotsheni lwe-Employee Health and Wellness. Ukwaziswa ngekhadi lokushayela elisebenzayo nelingakapheli. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukulandelwa, kanye namagugu okuhlola. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okukhulunywa nokubhaliwe). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukudala nokuba nodumo ngamasiko. Ulwazi lokuhlanganisa nokwedlulela phambili kwezinhlela. Amakhono amahle okuqala. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ukwakhiwa kwenhlela yezokuphila kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi lwemigogo namasu okwakha nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zezokuphila endaweni yomsebenzi. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zezempilo nezokuphila, okuhlanganisa ukuhambisana nemithetho ezansi OHSA, iziqondiso ze-EHWP. Ulwazi lwemigogo yezempilo yomphakathi nabezempilo basemsebenzini. Ukuqonda izinkinga ezibalulekile zezempilo (isb. ezomlando, izifo ezingapheli, ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa) endaweni yokusebenza. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Ukuqonda nokuphendla izidingo zabasebenzi, ukunika izinsiza eziyafinyeleleka futhi ezisebenzayo zezokuphila.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa izinhlela, izinqubomgomo, namasu abasebenzi ezezokuphila. Ukusekela ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zezifo ezingapheli. Ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokwazisa mayelana nezempilo nezokuphila. Ukuhlanganisa izinhlela zemidlalo nezokuzijabulisa. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa ehlobene nenhlela yezokuphila.

Volgehoudige professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologie en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieursonderhoud om kundigheid te verbeter; en om met tersaaklike liggame/rade oor ingenieurswesaangeleenthede te skakel. Effektiewe koordinering en bestuur van Infrastruktuur-ontwikkelingsprojekte. Die verskaffing van projekimplementeringsondersteuningsdienste aan die Waterdienste-owerhede (WSAs) en die verskaffing van tegniese ingenieursondersteuningsdienste.

zu.title: Ithini Yobunjiniyela Yokukhiqiza Isigaba a – C
zu.summary: Ithini Yobunjiniyela eBellville exhasa imiklamo yamanzi nesokudletha, idinga iDiploma Yezwe, ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA, kanye neminyaka emithathu yobuchwepheshe.
zu.requirements: IDiploma Yezwe Yobunjiniyela noma izifundo ezihambisana nayo. iminyaka emithathu (3) yokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe bemisebenzi yobunjiniyela emva kokuthola isifundo. Ukubhaliswa okuyisibopho kuMkhandlu Wezobunjiniyela WaseNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengoba Ithini Yobunjiniyela Yobuchwepheshe. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo engakapheli. Ukuqonda ukulawula izinhlelo nemiklamo. Ulwazi lolwakhiwo lobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya, Intuthuko yocwaningo, izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha zobunjiniyela, Ulwazi lokuziphatha ngokomthetho, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe kanye nokubonisana ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukwenza izinqumo, ukudala kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu, Ukuqala kakhulu kumthengi kanye nokusabela, Ukwehluleka kobunjiniyela nokuziphatha ngobungcweti. Uphinde wenze imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa, ukulungisa, ukuphathwa kokwaziswa nokuqinisekiswa; ukubhala, ukulawula, ukugcina nokukhombisa imininingwane yokugcina imininingwane. Ukuqasha imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa, ukulawula nokugcina ukwaziswa okuneminingwana; kanti nokuthuthukisa ulwazi ngokusebenzisa amaphilosi okuqonda imininingwane yakho; kube nokuxhumanisa, ukudweba nokulawula izinkinga. Ukubhala, ukulawula, ukulungisa nokuba nokuxhasa okusemthethweni okungenalwazi nokuholela ekwazisweni okuphelele ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe nokubonisana ngobuchwepheshe, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukudala nokusebenza njengeqembu, ukuqala komthengi nokuphendula, ukwahlulela kobunjiniyela nokuziphatha ngamakhono aphathwa ngabanye. Ukugcina izinto ezenza kanti nokwazisa, ukuxhumanisa, ukudweba nokugcina abantu, ukulawula, ukuphatha imisebenzi, ukugcina amaphilosi okuqonda imininingwane yakho; nokuxhumanisa, ukugcina, ukulawula ukuphathwa kweqembu. Ukulawula, ukugcina, ukuphatha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ngomthetho, ukuxazulula izinto ezenzakalo. Ukubhala, ukugcina, ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa, ukuhola nokulawula i kompyutha. Ukuxhumanisa, ukudweba, ukulawula nokugcina abantu, ukuphathwa kokushintsha, ukuhlela nokuhlela izikhathi.

Inkonzo enikezwa ngokuxhasa ukuphumeza inkqubo yeprojekthi kumagunya abasebenzi bokwenzela amanzi okunika inkxaso ngokwemizekelo yokubonelela ngokobuchwepheshe.

Ulwazi ngohlalutyo lwezenzo, iinkqubo ezisebenza ngekhompyutha, ukuhambelana nomthetho, ukubhala nokwenza iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, kunye nolwazi namakhono obugcisa bokwenza. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo ezihlaziya iingxaki, ukusebenza njengeqela namakhono ahlalutyayo. Ukuyila, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi, nokuphendula. Amakhono othetho (olwandlalo nalwesi) nobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha. Amakhono acwangcisa nahlela. Ukulawula iingxabano. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nokwazi ukumelana nexinxwana. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezempilo yokusebenza nokhuseleko, i-PMDS nepFMA. Amakhono okuzoba nokuqonda iidrawing.
xh.duties: Ukugcina iziseko ezingakanani zamanzi agaziyo (iidam, iireservoir, iindlu zesebe, iipump station, kunye neendyweli zamanzi) nokuqhashiswa. Ukugcina nokuqwalasela igesi yekhuseleko lokuthumba (i-TRU). Ukuqwalasela uqhashiso lwamaxhoba wezona ngexesha lamaqhosha obuchwepheshe kulungiselelwe ngokwemigangatho. Ukukhonza uqhashiso ngokwejadulwelo. Ukuqokelela iimpazamahlo kwiinkqubo ze-SCADA/PLC kunye ne-telemetry. Kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lwekhwalithi ngokwemimiselo. Kuqinisekiswe ukulandelana kwemigangatho yokuqhashisa, iimfuno, namagunya. Ukusebenzisa ucwangciso lokugcina nokuqwalasela iibhuku ezibhalwa kuzo ukugcina. Ukulungelelanisa nokuhambisa iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Ukulawula kunye nokukhokela abasebenzi. Ukuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo umntu ngamnye ukuze agxile kwiindaba ezintsha zekhompyutha neenqubo. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nakwinqanaba lokusebenza njengesigqoki, nokuqonda ukusebenza iure ezinde nokuphumelela kwangaxeshexesha ngexinxwana.

jobs.title: Artisan Foreman Grade a
jobs.summary: Artisan Foreman Grade A needed at Breede/Gouritz in Worcester to supervise and construct civil technical services and structures for the Department of Water and Sanitation.

Five (5) years’ post-trade-test experience as a qualified Artisan. The A valid unexpired driver’s licence (minimum Code B; a Code C1 or higher is required for the travel requirements of the post). Knowledge of legal compliance. Knowledge of technical analysis. Knowledge of the PFMA and the OHSA. Strong leadership and management ability. Ability to communicate effectively at operational level. Must be computer literate. Knowledge of technical report writing. Decision making and problem-solving ability. Ability to work independently and in a team. Analytical and creativity skills. Communication and interpersonal skills. Planning, organising, and execution. Willingness to travel throughout South Africa when required for operational purposes.
jobs.duties: Supervise and construct civil technical services and structures according to specifications and within limits of production capability. Produce objects with material and equipment according to job specification and recognized standards. Supervise the maintenance of civil technical services. Repair civil structures and facilities according to standards and specifications. Service civil structures and facilities according to schedule. Perform administrative and related functions. Update register on maintained and repaired faults. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide inputs to the civil maintenance plan. Ensure adherence to safety standards, requirements, and regulations. Plan resources available and schedule maintenance work. Repairs of faults. Identify training needs for your team, Leave management and personnel performance management. Supervise and mentor staff. Ensure compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 and Building Regulations. Responsible for construction works and general maintenance on the canals, weirs, dams, and all departmental infrastructures. The incumbent must be willing to work away from the office and home and will be required to perform duties at all schemes throughout the Western Cape.

af.title: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A
af.summary: Ambagsman Voorman Graad A word by Breede/Gouritz in Worcester benodig om siviele tegniese dienste en strukture vir die Department of Water and Sanitation toesig te hou en te bou.
af.requirements: ’n Geskikte siviele ambagsman-sertifikaat in een van die volgende sivielverwante ambagte: skrynwerk, messelwerk, loodgieterswerk, of algemene konstruksie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring na ambagsman-sertifikaat as ’n gekwalifiseerde Ambagsman. ’n Geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie (minimum Kode B; Kode C1 of hoër word vereis vir die reisvereistes van die pos). Kennis van wetlike nakoming. Kennis van tegniese analise. Kennis van die PFMA en die OHSA. Sterk leierskap- en bestuursvermoë. Vermoë om doeltreffend op operasionele vlak te kommunikeer. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Kennis van tegniese verslagskrywing. Besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in ’n span te werk. Analitiese en kreatiwiteitsvaardighede. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Beplanning, organisering en uitvoering. Bereidwilligheid om dwarsdeur South Africa te reis wanneer vir operasionele doeleindes vereis.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en bou siviele tegniese dienste en strukture volgens spesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Vervaardig voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasie en erkende standaarde. Hou toesig oor die instandhouding van siviele tegniese dienste. Herstel siviele strukture en fasiliteite volgens standaarde en spesifikasies. Onderhou siviele strukture en fasiliteite volgens skedule. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Werk register bygewerk vir instandhouding en herstel van foute. Stel verslae op en dien dit soos vereis in. Verskaf insette tot die siviele instandhoudingsplan. Verseker nakoming van veiligheidsstandaarde, vereistes en regulasies. Beplan beskikbare hulpbronne en skeduleer instandhoudingswerk. Herstel van foute. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes vir jou span. Verlofbestuur en personeelprestasiebestuur. Hou toesig oor en mentor personeel. Verseker nakoming van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 en Building Regulations. Verantwoordelik vir konstruksiewerk en algemene instandhouding aan kanale, dwerwe, damme en alle departementele infrastrukture. Die ampsdraer moet bereid wees om weg van die kantoor en huis af te werk en sal vereis word om pligte by alle skemas dwarsdeur die Western Cape uit te voer.

zu.title: Induna Yabasebenzi Ngobuciko Izinga A
zu.summary: Kudingeka Induna Yabasebenzi Ngobuciko Izinga A eBreede/Gouritz eWorcester ukuba ahlole futhi akhe izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zomyalezo kanye nezakhiwo zeDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele Sokuhlolwa Kobuchwepheshe Bommyalezo esisodwa kwezobuciko eziyinkimbinkimbi ezihlobene nomyalezo okulandelayo: ukubumba ngamakhono, ukwakha ngezitini, ukulungisa amathumbu, noma ukuakhiwa okuvamile. Ukucondza kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) ngemva kokesitifiketi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe njengenkwenci eqotho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, engagange iphelelwe yisikhathi (okuncane iCode B; i-Code C1 noma ephezulu kudingwa ngenxa yezidingo zokuhamba zaleso sikhundla). Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqoqwa kobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi nge-PFMA nange-OHSA. Ikhono elikhulu lokubusa nokuphatha. Ikhono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo ezingeni lokusebenza. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ikhono lokuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa kanye nakilabo. Amakhono okuhlola nokudala. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukulungisa, ukuhlela, nokuphumeza. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kulo lonke iSouth Africa lapho kudingeka ngenxa yezidingo zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Qaphela futhi akhe izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zommyalezo kanye nezakhiwo ngokwesinqumo futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Akha izinto ngamasotshi namathuluzi ngokwesinqumo somsebenzi ngokuhambisana nemithetho evunyiwe. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe zommyalezo. Lungisa izakhiwo nezinsiza zommyalezo ngokuhambisana nemithetho futhi ngokwesinqumo. Hlalela izakhiwo nezinsiza zommyalezo ngokuhambisana nesikeshidi. Yenza imisebenzi yophatha kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo. Buyekeza irekhodi ngeziphazamisi ezibuyekeziwe kanye nalungisiwe. Hlanganisa futhi uhambise imibalo njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza iminikelo ohlelweni lokugcina izinsiza zommyalezo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izindingan zobuciko, izidingo, kanye nemithetho. Cacisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo futhi uhlele umsebenzi wokulungisa. Ukolwa kwamafayela ephutha. Hlola izidingo zokugcina iqembu lakho, uphathwe ikhefu kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Qaphela futhi uholele abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 kanye Nemithetho Yokwakha. Uqaphele ukwakhiwa nokulungiswa kwamakhwela amanzi, izikweletu, izibhelu, kanye nazo zonke izinsiza zomnyango. Lo othe ithatha leso sikhundla kumele azithobe ukusebenza kude nehhovisi nasekhaya futhi uzodingwa ukwenza imisebenzi kuzo zonke izikimu kulo lonke iWestern Cape.

xh.title: Umphathi Wababazi Bedlavela Inqanaba A
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumphathi wababazi bedlavela inqanaba A kwisebe leBreede/Gouritz eWorcester ukuyiqondisa nokwakhiwa kweenkonzo zobugcisa bezakhiwo kunye neenkokhelo zesebe lezaManzi nokuCoceza luganga.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokuvavwa kobugcisa bezakhiwo kwenye yale ngcinga zilandelayo ezinxulumene nezakhiwo: ukwenza iindonga ngeengcingo, ukwakha ngeesanti, ukuseka amanzi, okanye ukwakhiwa ngokubanzi. Iminyaka yamakhulu amahlanu (5) yokulinganiswa emva kokuvavwa njengomabazi wedlavela ogqithisiweyo. Ifayile lesiFundo lesiQinisekiso sokusebenza esingangeni kwixesha elifanelekileyo (elingaphantsi kweKhowudi B; iKhowudi C1 okanye inkulu iyafuneka ngokwemfuneko yokuhamba kwesithuba). Ulwazi ngokuthobela imigaqo. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokuhlengahlengisa ngokwenza inqaku elidumileyo. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA nange-OHSA. Ikhono elomeleleyo lokulawula nemphatho. Ikhono lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo kolona lonke inqanaba lokusebenza. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokubhala iingxelo zobugcisa bezakhiwo. Ikhono lokuzimisela nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nakuluntu. Iimpawu zokuhlengahlengisa nokuzila. Amaphuphu okunxibelelana nabanye. Ulungo, ulawulo, nokuzinika. Amava okubhalisa kumgaqo wezixhobo ezingekoyo ngokulinganiswa nangemfuneko.
xh.duties: Qondisa ukwakhiwa kweenkonzo zobugcisa nezakhiwo ngokomiselo lwemigaqo nangaphakathi kweendawo ezinamandla okwenza ngobukhali bokuvelisa. Yenza izinto ngokwemiba kunye nezixhobo ngokomiselo wokusebenza nayindlela eziqhelwe ngazo iinkqubo. Qondisa ukugcinwa kweenkonzo zobugcisa bezakhiwo. Lungisa izakhiwo nobunyulu ngokwemigaqo nomiselo. Nikela izakhiwo nobunyulu ngokwendlela ecwangcisiweyo. Panga imisebenzi yeemfuyo ekuvunyweni ngemfuneko. Gqiba izibhalo ezithile ekukhonzwa emsebenzini wemiba engazange ihlengwe. Ndwendwesa iindaba ezixhwayo ezibhalwe ngokulungele, ukuhlala uvuselela, nokulawula ngokokubakho. Yenza iingxelo ezidingwa ngesikhathi esithile. Yenza isicwangciso sesixhobo sokulungiselela izakhiwo. Hlonipza imigaqo yokhuswa nangabemi. Lungelelanisa amacebo akho okusebenzisa iinkonzo ezifikelela kuluntu nasezindaweni. Lunga izikhalazo zemiba equkethwe ngokulawulo. Qondisa ukubhaliswa nokukhuthaza abantu ngokokulungelelanisa iingcali kwilixa elingacwangcisiweyo. Yenza isixhobo esinceda ekulawulweni kwezinto ezingalunganga. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yoMthetho wokuKhuseleka koNyilo nakuGqibelela iMandla ka-1993. Hlala ume ngokugqibeleleyo ukuqinisekisa amaxhoba apha phambili nangaphakathi. Phethe imisebenzi yokwakha nokulungisa ngokubanzi kuWorcester nakulawulo olubandakanywa kuluntu nakumanyano. Kufuneka azimisele ngokusebenza aze ahamba aqondise ekusebenzeni ezindaweni ezihlukahlukeneyo kulo lonke elaseNtshona Koloni.

jobs.summary: Environmental Officer needed in Bellville to implement and enforce water legislation, requiring a National Diploma in Environmental Management or Natural Sciences.

One (1) year experience in the relevant field of Water Resources Management including internship or experiential learning will serve as an added advantage. The disclosure of valid unexpired driver’s license. Research and development. Knowledge and experience in project and programme management. Understanding social and economic development issues. Technical report writing. Professional judgement. Data analysis. Policy development and analysis. Presentation skills, creativity, mentoring, team leadership and analytical skills. Decision making. Understanding of conflict, people and financial management. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Problem solving and analysis. Computer literacy. Planning and organizing.

Perform inspections of wastewater collection and treatment systems, including public and private wastewater treatment facilities. Compilation of detailed wastewater treatment works inspection reports, feedback letters, and non-compliance letters. Implementation of the Water Services Regulation Operational Plan in relation to wastewater services. Monitor and verify wastewater monitoring data submitted by Water Services Institutions on the Departmental Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Provide guidance and support to Water Services Institutions, including reviewing Wastewater Risk Abatement Plans (W2RAPs) and monitoring the implementation thereof. Respond to wastewater-related complaints, pollution incidents, and reported failures of wastewater treatment systems. Conduct investigative and audit wastewater sampling for laboratory analysis, interpretation of analytical reports and compilation of wastewater quality status reports. Participate in the implementation of the National Green Drop Programme within Water Services Institutions. Monitor compliance and progress of corrective action plans for the National Green Drop Programme. Monitor the operational and process performance of wastewater treatment works, including effluent quality, flow monitoring, process control, sludge management, and maintenance. Represent the Department in various standing intergovernmental committees and stakeholder forums.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie Graad a – C
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte benodig in Bellville om waterwetgewing te implementeer en af te dwing, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsbestuur of Natuurwetenskappe vereis.
af.requirements: A National Diploma in Environmental Management or Natural Sciences. Een (1) jaar ervaring in die tersaaklike veld van Waterhulpbronbestuur, insluitend internskap of ervaringsleer, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis en ervaring in projekte- en programbestuur. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Professionele oordeel. Data-ontleding. Beleidontwikkeling en -ontleding. Voorleggingsvaardighede, kreatiwiteit, mentorskap, spanleierskap en analitiese vaardighede. Besluitneming. Begrip van konflik-, mense- en finansiële bestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Implementering en handhawing van die National Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998), Water Services Act, 1997 (Act No. 108 of 1997), tersaaklike beleide, verpligte nasionale water- en sanitasienorme en -standaarde, protokolle, standaardbedryfsprosedures, strategieë, en Regulation 3630 in verband met afvalwaterbestuur en -behandeling. Ondersoeke uitvoer van afvalwaterinsameling- en behandelingsisteme, insluitend openbare en private afvalwaterbehandelingsfasiliteite. Samestelling van gedetailleerde inspeksieverslae vir afvalwaterbehandelingswerke, terugvoerbriewe, en nie-nakomingsbriewe. Implementering van die Water Services Regulation Operational Plan in verband met afvalwaterdienste. Monitor en verifieer afvalwatermonitoringsdata wat deur Water Services Institutions op die Departmental Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS) ingedien word. Voorsien leiding en ondersteuning aan Water Services Institutions, insluitend die hersiening van Wastewater Risk Abatement Plans (W2RAPs) en die monitering van die implementering daarvan. Reageer op afvalwaterverwante klagtes, besoedelingsvoorvalle, en gemelde faling van afvalwaterbehandelingsisteme. Voer ondersoekende en oudit-afvalwatermonsterneming vir laboratoriumontleding uit, interpretasie van analitiese verslae en samestelling van afvalwaterkwaliteitstatusverslae. Neem deel aan die implementering van die National Green Drop Programme by Water Services Institutions. Monitor nakoming en vordering van regstellende aksieplanne vir die National Green Drop Programme. Monitor die operasionele en prosesprestasie van afvalwaterbehandelingswerke, insluitend effluentkwaliteit, vloeimonitering, prosesbeheer, slykbestuur, en onderhoud. Verteenwoordig die departement in verskeie staande intergouvernementele komitees en belanghebbende-forums.

zu.title: IOfisa yomphakathi wezemvelo ukukhiqiza izinga A – C
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNjolose yemvelo eBellville ukuze kuphathwe futhi kugcinwe umthetho wamanzi, okudinga iDiploma yezwe ekuphathweni kwemvelo noma eMvelonjulalwazi.
zu.requirements: IDiploma yezwe ekuphathweni kwemvelo noma eMvelonjulalwazi. Unyaka (1) owodwa wamava enkundleni ehlobene nokuphathwa koMthombo wamanzi, okuhlanganisa isikhathi sokufundela emsebenzini noma ukufunda ngokuba khona, kuzodingeka kube lusizo. Ukwenza okwaziyo ngelayisensi yokushayela ehlezi futhi ongeke uphele isikhathi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ulwazi namava ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ukuqonda izindaba zentuthuko yomphakathi nenzululwazi. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukubumba okuhlakaniphile komphakathi. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlaziywa kwezinqumbo. Amakhono okubukisa, ukusungula, ukwengamela, ukukhokela iqembu, kanye namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa koxabano, kwabantu nangemali. Amakhono okuxhumla ahle kithi kokubili (okwenkomoyo nakokubhalwayo). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuzihlaziya. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubamba uhlelo nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha nokugcina umthetho weNational Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998), iWater Services Act, 1997 (Act No. 108 of 1997), izinqumbo ezihlobene, izimiso namazinga abantu bonke wamanzi nokucocekisa, izinqubo, izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile, izuva, kanye noMthetho wokuLawula 3630 ngokuphathwa nokwelashwa kwendle. Ukwenza izikhitsha zohlelo lokuthola nokuqoqwa kwendle kanye nezinto zokuhlanza amanzi, okuhlanganisa iziteshi zomphakathi nongasese zokuhlanza amanzi. Ukuqoqa imibiko eqopheme kakhulu yesikhitsha sezinto zokuhlanza amanzi, izinhlamvu zempendulo, namagama wezincwadi ezingahambisanga nomthetho. Ukuphatha uhlelo lokusebenza lolawulo lweNkonzo yamanzi ngokuhlobene namasevisi endle. Ukugcina amehlo kuqinisekisa idatha yokulawula indle ethunyelwe izikhulu zamasevisi amanzi kwesistimu yolawulo yomnyango (IRIS). Ukuqondisa futhi usekela izikhulu zamasevisi amanzi, okuhlanganisa ukubuyeza izinhlela zokunciphisa ingozi endeni (W2RAPs) nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Ukuphendula izikhalazo ezihlobene nendle, izehlo zokungcoliswa, kanye nezenzo zokuphahlwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi. Ukwenza ucwaningo nokuqoqwa kwezampula zendle ukuze zihlolwe elabhorethri, ukuhlaziya imibiko yokuqoqwa kwendle, kanye nokubhala imibiko yesimo sokuhlanza amanzi endeni. Ukubambe iqhaza ekuphathweni kohlelo lweNational Green Drop Programme emaqembu amasevisi amanzi. Ukugcina amehlo ukulandela ukuziphatha kanye nenqubela yohlelo lokulungisa ukuhambisana nenani elitholakalayo leGreen Drop. Ukugcina amehlo ukusebenza kanye nokuqoqwa kokusebenza kwamathuluzi okuhlanza amanzi, okuhlanganisa izinga lamanzi akhishwayo, ukulawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, ukulawula inqubo, ukuphatha idobe nokugcina. Ukumelela umnyango emakomithini ahlukene kahulumeni ome bude nokumatshana wezinkundla zomphakathi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka iSikhululi Sezinto zendalo eBellville ukuphumeza nokuzeke umthetho wamanzi, kwaye kufuneka kube ne-National Diploma e-Environmental Management okanye i-Natural Sciences.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Environmental Management okanye i-Natural Sciences. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava kwinkimbinkimbi efaneleyo ye-Water Resources Management kuquka nesiqendu sokuzilolonga okanye ukufunda ngamava kuya kuba yinxaxheba engaphezulu. Izityhila ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni engakagqibeki. Uphononongo nentluko. Ulwazi namava ekulawulweni kwephulo noshicilelo lweenkqubo. Ukuqonda iingcamango zentluko nentlalo yoluntu. Ukubhala iingxelo ngezobuchwepheshe. Isigqibo sezemiganu. Uhlalutyo lwedata. Uphuhliso nohlalutyo lweenqobo. Amakhono abalisa, ubuchule, ukuyala, ukulawula iqela namakhono ohlalutyo. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukuqonda ingxabano, abantu nolawulo lweemali. Amakhono alphathwa kahle ekunxibelelwani kokubili (ngomlomo nangokubhalwe). Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza komthi. Uplani nokuhlela.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza nokuzeke i-National Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998), i-Water Services Act, 1997 (Act No. 108 of 1997), iinqobo ezifaneleyo, iimpawu nemiqathango yamazwe nezityhogara ephanynzisiweyo, iiprotocol, iinkqubo zokuqhuba ngokweemfuno, iindlela, kunye ne-Regulation 3630 malunga nolawulo lwamanzi aselwayo nokunyanga. Ukwenza ukhangelo lweekqubo zokuqokelela nokucotha amanzi aselwayo, kuquka nezikhululo zoluntu nezabucala zokucotha amanzi aselwayo. Ukwakhiwa kweengxelo ezichazwe ngobunzima ngokukhangelwa kwemisebenzi yokunyanga amanzi aselwayo, iileta zempendulo, kunye neeleta zokungahambelani nomthetho. Ukuphumeza iNkqubo yoLawulo ye-Water Services Operational Plan malunga neenkonzo zamanzi aselwayo. Ukujonga kuqinisekisa idata yokuhoywa kwamanzi aselwayo ethunyelwa ziziKhululo ze-Water Services kwinkqubo ye-Departmental Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Ukunika inkqubo nentshkelo kuziKhululo ze-Water Services, kuquka nokuphonononga i-Wastewater Risk Abatement Plans (W2RAPs) nokujonga ukuphumeza kwayo. Ukuphendula kwiingxaki ezinxulumene namazi aselwayo, iiganeko zokungcoliswa, nokuwa okuxelweyo kweekqubo zokunyanga amanzi aselwayo. Ukuqokelela iisampulu zokuphonononga nokuqinisekisa amanzi aselwayo ngenjongo yokuhlalutya kwilaborathi, ukucazulula iingxelo zohlalutyo nokwakha iingxelo ngemo yekhwalithi yamanzi aselwayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphumezeni iNkqubo ye-National Green Drop Programme kuziKhululo ze-Water Services. Ukujonga ukuthobela kunye nokuqhubela phambili iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ze-National Green Drop Programme. Ukujonga ukusebenza komsebenzi n inkqubo yemisebenzi yokunyanga amanzi aselwayo, kuquka nekhwalithi yamanzi achithiweyo, ukuhoywa kwamaza, ulawulo lwenkqubo, ulawulo lweglontshi, kunye nokugcina. Ukumela i-Department kumakomiti ahlala ukhoyo karhulumente phakathi kwamasebe nakuwo onke amanxaxheba.

jobs.title: Human Resource Practitioner: Human Resource
jobs.summary: Human Resource Practitioner role in the Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley, focusing on PMDS implementation and performance management, requiring a National Diploma in HR Management.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Human Resource Management or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. One (1) years' functional experience in HRD and Performance Management environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge of the Skills Development Act and related prescripts. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations and relevant HR prescripts. Knowledge of Record management and administrative skills. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Knowledge and experience of PERSAL systems. Knowledge of registry duties and practices. Planning and organising skills. People and Diversity Management skills. Be client Orientation and Customer Focus. Good verbal and written communication skills. Accountability and Ethical Conduct. Flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and analysis. Attention to details and willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Interpret and implement PMDS policies, procedures, guidelines, and directives. Coordinate and facilitate the implementation of PMDS within the region. Administer mid-year and annual performance assessments for non- SMS employees. Conduct quality assurance on Performance Agreements, Mid-Term Reviews and Annual Assessments. Capture and maintain PMDS records on the PERSAL system. Maintain accurate records and ensure the safekeeping of confidential employee information. Distribute PMDS templates, guidelines and circulars to managers and employees within prescribed timeframes. Compile and provide PMDS statistics and reports as required. Provide advice and support on PMDS-related enquiries. Facilitating departmental training needs assessments and identify skills development gaps. Coordinate and implement the Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) in accordance with delegated authority. Conduct Workplace Skills Plan workshops and provide guidance to managers and employees. Assist in the development, coordination and implementation of training and development programmes. Facilitate the allocation and administration of bursaries within the region. Coordinate and implement induction programmes for newly appointed employees. Compile monthly training and development reports. Assist with the implementation and administration of the Internship Programme. Support the implementation and monitoring of the Mentor-Mentee Programme within the region. Provide administrative and developmental support to employee capacity-building initiatives. Maintain effective filing systems for correspondence, training records, certificates, and related documentation. Retrieve records and information for reporting, auditing, and compliance purposes. Assist with the maintenance of service records on PERSAL upon request from the supervisor. Ensure compliance with records management and confidentiality requirements. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly PMDS and Human Resource Development activities. Provide administrative support on human resource development and performance management matters. Assist with the implementation and monitoring of approved resolutions and action plans. Supervise, guide, and monitor the performance of staff within the sub-directorate. Ensure the effective utilisation and management of allocated resources. Promote compliance with departmental policies, procedures, and service delivery standards.
