af.title: Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn: Menslike Hulpbronne
af.summary: Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn-rol in die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley, met die fokus op die implementering van PMDS en prestasiebestuur, waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma in HR-bestuur vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Een (1) jaar se funksionele ervaring in 'n HRD- en Prestasiebestuursomgewing. Die openbaring van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van die Skills Development Act en verwante voorskrifte. Kennis van Public Service Regulations en relevante HR-voorskrifte. Kennis van rekordbestuur en administratiewe vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Kennis en ervaring van PERSAL-stelsels. Kennis van registratuurtake en -praktyke. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuursvaardighede. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Buigsaamheid en spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en -ontleding. Aandag aan besonderhede en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Vertolk en implementeer PMDS-beleide, prosedures, riglyne en riglyne. Koördineer en fasiliteer die implementering van PMDS binne die streek. Administreer middeljaar- en jaarlikse prestasieassesserings vir nie-SMS-werknemers. Voer gehaltversekering uit op Prestasieooreenkomste, middeltermyn hersienings en jaarlikse assesserings. Voer PMDS-rekords op die PERSAL-stelsel in en handhaaf dit. Handhaaf akkurate rekords en verseker die veilige bewaring van vertroulike werknemerinligting. Versprei PMDS-sjablone, riglyne en sirkulaires aan bestuurders en werknemers binne die voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Stel PMDS-statistieke en verslae op en verskaf dit soos vereis. Verskaf advies en ondersteuning oor PMDS-verwante navrae. Fasiliteer departementele opleidingsbehoeftesassesserings en identifiseer vaardigheidsontwikkelingsgapte. Koördineer en implementeer die Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) ooreenkomstig gedelegeerde gesag. Hou Workplace Skills Plan-werkswinkels en verskaf leiding aan bestuurders en werknemers. Bied bystand by die ontwikkeling, koördinering en implementering van opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprogramme. Fasiliteer die toewysing en administrasie van beurse binne die streek. Koördineer en implementeer inlywingsprogramme vir nuut aangestelde werknemers. Stel maandelikse opleidings- en ontwikkelingsverslae op. Bied bystand by die implementering en administrasie van die Internship Programme. Ondersteun die implementering en monitering van die Mentor-Mentee Programme binne die streek. Verskaf administratiewe en ontwikkelingsondersteuning aan werknemerskapbou-inisiatiewe. Handhaaf doeltreffende lêerstelsels vir korrespondensie, opleidingsrekords, sertifikate en verwante dokumentasie. Haal rekords en inligting op vir verslagdoenings-, oudit- en nakomingsdoeleindes. Bied bystand met die handhawing van diensrekords op PERSAL op versoek van die toesighouer. Verseker nakoming van rekordbestuurs- en vertroulikheidsvereistes. Stel maandelikse en kwartlikse PMDS- en Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsaktiwiteite op en dien dit in. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning oor menslike hulpbronontwikkeling en prestasiebestuursaangeleenthede. Bied bystand by die implementering en monitering van goedgekeurde besluite en aksieplanne. Onderrig, lei en monitor die prestasie van personeel binne die subdirektoraat. Verseker die doeltreffende benutting en bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne. Bevorder nakoming van departementele beleide, prosedures en diensleweringstandaarde.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabezemplilo: Izinsiza Zomuntu
zu.summary: Indima yomphathi wezinsiza zomuntu Kwisikhungo sokusebenza emnyangweni we Department of Water and Sanitation e Kimberley, egxile ekusebenziseni i-PMDS nasekuphathweni kwezenzo, kudinga i-National Diploma ekuqinisekiseni izinsiza zabantu.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF level 6) ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zabantu noma izifundo ezifanele njengoba zibonwa yi-SAQA. Ubudlwana obungu-1 emsebenzini osebenzayo kumongo we-HRD nokuphathwa kwezenzo. Ukuboniswa ikholishi yokushayela evumelekile nezingeki sikhathi kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Act we-Development we-Skills nemithetho ehlobene nawo. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Regulations nemithetho ehlobene ne-HR. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwerekhodi namakhono obumphathi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi lolunyazi lwamehlo lwe-PERSAL systems. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi nezinqubo zeregistry. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Amakhono okuphatha abantu nobunye. Ukuqonda iklayenti nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuzekelelana nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ukuqhubeka komthelela nokusebenza njengeqembu. Ulwazi olusukela esigabeni lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda imininingwane. Ukunakela imininingwane nokuzimisela ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Hhumusha futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, izinqubo, iziqondiso nemiyalelo ye-PMDS. Hlele futhi uthuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwe-PMDS ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Phatha ukuvivinywa kwezenzo ekwindlovana ngonyaka nakonke unyaka kubasebenzi abangaphandle kwe-SMS. Yenza ukucwaninga ikhwalithi kokuqamba izivumelwano zokusebenza, ukubuyekeza phakathi kwesikhathi nokuvivinywa konke unyaka. Faka futhi ulondoloze izinkomba ze-PMDS kulesimiso se-PERSAL. Londoloza izinkumba ezifanele futhi qinisekisa ukugcina ngokuphepha imininingwane yabasebenzi ephathekayo. Yabelana ngamasethi e-PMDS, iziqondiso namagobolqondo kubaphathi nabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Qamba futhi nikeze izibalo nemicimbi ye-PMDS njengokuvela. Nikezezelwa ngokuhambisana nemibuzo ehlobene ne-PMDS. Yenza ukuvivinywa kwezidingo zokulolonga emnyangweni futhi uhlonze izikhala ekuthuthukiseni amakhono. Hlele futhi usebenzise i-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) ngokuhambisana nolawulwa olunikelwe. Yenza amawokishophu we-WSP futhi uholele abaphathi nabasebenzi. Siza ekwakheni, ekuhleleni nasekusebenziseni amaphrohramu okulolonga nasekuthuthukiseni. Yenza ukwabelwa nokuphathwa kwezibali ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Hlele futhi usebenzise amaphrohramu okungenisa abasebenzi abasha. Qamba amabhili okulolonga nokuthuthukisa nyanga zonke. Siza ekusebenziseni nasekuphathweni kwamaphrohramu abantu abasebenza ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Sekela ukusebenza nokuhlola ukwenziwa kwamaphrohramu oMentor-Mentee ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Nikeza inkuselelo ngokuphathwa kanye nokusiza ekuthuthukisweni abasebenzi. Londoloza izimiso zokugcina amafayela ezinsiza zomuntu, amarekhodi okulolonga, izitifiketi namadokhumenti ahlobene. Khuphula izinkumba nolwazi ngokubika, ukuhlola nokuhambisana nomthetho. Siza ukulondoloza izinkumba zokusebenza kwi-PERSAL laphocelwa umqashi. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho yokuphathwa kweekhodi nokugcinwa koshobo. Qamba futhi uhambise imibiko yamaphrohramu e-PMDS nasekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zabantu nyanga nganye nethemu nganye. Nikeza inkuselelo ngokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu nokuphathwa kwezenzo. Siza ekwenzeni nasekuhloleni izinqumo nokuqamba izinqubo ezamukelekile. Hola, holela futhi uhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kolunyazi olunikelwe ngempumelelo. Khuthaza ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo, izinqubo futhi ukusebenza ngamazinga okwamukelwa emnyangweni.

xh.title: UMpraktishija woLwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu: Ulwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguMpraktishija woLwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation eKimberley, ijolise ekusetyenzisweni kwe-PMDS nakulawulo lokusebenza, kufuneka i-Diploma yaseLizwe kokuLawula i-HR.
xh.requirements: Kufunke i-Diploma yaseLizwe (i-NQF level 6) kokuLawula uLwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko zivunywe yi-SAQA. Kusafuneka ubenamava eminye unyaka (1) wokusebenza kwindawo ekhululekileyo yokulwa lolwazi loqeqesho nasekuLawuleni ukuSebenza. Ukuzivela kolayisensi yokushayela egqithisiweyo kunye nesesikhundla kuya kubakho nzuzo enkulu. Ulwazi ngomthetho woPhuhliso lweakhono kunye neenkcazelo ezidibaniswe nawo. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa koluntu kwiinkonzo zoLuntu kunye neenkcazelo ezifanelekileyo ze-HR. Ulwazi lokuLawula irekhodi kunye neakhoni zokulawula inkqubo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakwikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi kunye namava ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ze-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngesimo sokuLawulwa koluntu nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ikhono lokuLawula abantu kunye nobunyulu bobuntu. Makabe nokumisela kuMthengi kwaye ajongeke kwiimfuno zoMthengi. Ikhono elilodwa lokuthetha nokuwuchaza ngelivi kolwazi olubhaliweyo. Ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngokwenene. Ukuzinza kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza nabanye. Ulwazi olusentsimini lokusombulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa iinkcukacha. Ukunakwa iinkcukacha nokuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Tolika icacise kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo, iinkqubo zomsebenzi, iinkqubo ezalathisa izindlela, kunye neemiyalelo ze-PMDS. Lawula kwaye ukhoke ukusetyenziswa kwe-PMDS kwingingqi. Lawula ukuqikelelwa kokusebenza ngexesha lonyaka nakweminyaka yonke kubasebenzi abangengabo ababenikwe isikhundla sokulawula (non-SMS). Yenza isigqibo sokucingisiswa kwemigqa yeendibano zoMsebenzi, ukuHlolwa phakathi kwexesha kunye neNqanabaokuqikelelwa kwakhona ngonyaka. Faka kwaye ugcine irekhodi ze-PMDS kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL. Gcina amarekhodi achanekileyo kwaye qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemfihleko yenkcazelo yabasebenzi. Yahlula iitempleyiti ze-PMDS, iinkqubo ezalathisa izindlela kunye namawebhu abakhokhi nabasebenzi ngexesha elichaziweyo. Hlanganisa kwaye unikeze izibalo kunye neemeko ze-PMDS njengoko kufuneka. Nikela ngengcebiso kunye n inkxaso kumabuzo afana ne-PMDS. Ukukhokela ukuqokelelwa kokulinganisa iimfuno zolwa lwazi loqeqesho kwisebe kunye nokuchonga iindawo ezikwisikhewu ezikululwa ulwazi. Lawula kwaye usebenzise iNkqubo yeKhadi leKhono eKwindla (WSP) ngokwemigaqo enikiweyo. Qhuba iindibano zeNkqubo yeKhadi leKhono eKwindla kwaye unikeze isikhokelo kubakhokhi nabasebenzi. Nceda ekuyilenzeni, ekulawuleni nasekusetyenzisweni kweenkqubo zolwa lwazi loqeqesho nophuhliso. Khokela ukwabiwa nokulawula izibonelelo zezifundo kwingingqi. Lawula kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kubasebenzi abatsha. Hlanganisa iingxelo zolwa lwazi loqeqesho nezophuhliso nyanga nganye. Nceda ngokusetyenziswa kunye nokulawula iNkqubo yokuQeqesha abafundi. Xhasa ukusetyenziswa kunye nokuqwalaselwa kweNkqubo yoQeqesho ngaloomntu ongumqeqeshi kwingingqi. Nikela ngenkxaso yolawulo nophuhliso kwiqhinga lokwakha amandla abasebenzi. Gcina iinkqubo zokulungiselela iifayile ezisebenzayo zolu lwazi, iirekhodi zolwa lwazi loqeqesho, izatifikethi, namaxwebhu axhunyiweyo. Khupha iirekhodi nolwazi ukuze kubekho iingxelo, ukuqwalaselwa, kunye noyilo lokuzithoba. Nceda ngokugcina iirekhodi zenkonzo kwi-PERSAL xa kucelwa ngumlawuli. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kweekhava ezimalunga nokulawula iifayile kunye neemfuno zokugcina imfihleko. Hlanganisa kwaye ungenise iingxelo ze-PMDS nezicelo zoPhuhliso loLwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu ngenyanga nakwekhota. Nikela ngenkxaso yolawulo kumaphuphu oPhuhliso loLwazi loQeqesho lwezeBantu alawula ukusebenza. Nceda ngokusetyenziswa kunye nokuqwalaselwa kwezigqibo ezamkelekileyo kunye neenkqubo zokwenza izicwangciso. Lawula, khokela, kwaye uqwalasele ukusebenza koluntu kweso sebe ngaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kunye nokulawula izixhobo ezinikiweyo. Khuthaza ukuzithoba kweekhava zomthetho, iinkqubo zomsebenzi, kunye neendlela zokuba ngumsebenzisi ohambelana namagunya.

Verskaf administratiewe pligte tydens tender/bied-kortingsessies. Help met die samestelling van tenderbieddokumente en bevestig of dit in ooreenstemming is met toepaslike VKB-voorskryfte en prosesse. Verskaf hulp met die hersiening van die omvang van die Terme van Verwysing (TOR). Help met die monitering van die geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Help met die koördinering en uitvoering van die biedproses-: Reël en woon biedevalueringskomiteevergaderings by. Berei register vir boders voor. Kontroleer die nakoming van VKB-voorskryfte en prosesse. Reageer op spesifieke navrae tydens die tender/bied-kortingsessies. Maak bieddokumente oop en kontroleer die responsiwiteit en nie-responsiwiteit van dokumente. Berei puntelikkemodel/tenderaanbeveling en evalueringsverslae voor. Voorbereiding/ deursiening van aanbeveling vir Toewysing. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan VKB (Verkrywingsbestuur).

zu.title: Umenzi Wezohwebo
zu.summary: Umenzi Wezohwebo udingeka e Department of Water and Sanitation e Pretoria ukuba usize ekuthengweni, axhase amakomidi eziqhingqi, aphathe futhi inqubo yezinketho.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing Management/ Public Administration / Public Management/ Procurement/ Financial Management and Logistics Management ezingeni le-NQF 6 njengoba sekuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Isiphephelo esisodwa (1) seminyaka sokuhola kwi-Supply Chain Acquisition Management. Ukubiza ikhalazhi yokushayela evaliweyo engakaphelelwa isikhathi. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokuphatha izinketho nokuthenga. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, i-PPPFA kanye nenqubo ye-BBEE. Ulwazi ngenqubo nokumithethwa kokuthenga. Ulwazi lwesifundo mayelana nomthetho wabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesikhwama. Ulwazi ngenqubo zokusombulula iziphazamiso. Ukuqonda izindlela zentuthuko yomphakathi nenzululwazi. Ukuphatha izimali ngokwesisekelo. Ukuphatha ulwazi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nobuhlukahlukeni. Ukuqondisa iklayenti kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma kanye nokubhala). Ukuphathwa kanye nokuziphatha ngokwenza okuhloniphekile.
zu.duties: Busa ukuthenga kwempahla kanye nezinsiza ngokusebenzisa inqubo esemthethweni yezinketho. Nikeza inkonzo yokusekela lokomidi eziqhingqisi ukuze xhase amakomidi eziqhingqi.enza imisebenzi yokuphatha ngesikhathi sezinhlanganisela zezinketho/ziqhingqi. Siza ekubhaleni amadokhumenti wezinketho futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ahambisana nemiyalo kanye nemiqondo yesisekelo ye-SCM. Siza ekubukeni kabusha isikhathi sayo kumathegi we-Terms of Reference (TOR). Siza ekuqaphelelweni isikhathi esivela kuzinketho eziyiwe. Siza ekuhlanganiseni nasekuqhubeni inqubo yokwenza izinketho-: Hlela bese uyowona izinkulumo zekomidi lokuhlola izinketho. Lungiselela irekhodi yabafakweziinketho. Hlola ukuthi kuhambisana yini nemiyalo kanye nemiqondo yesisekelo ye-SCM. Phendula imibuzo ethile ngesikhathi sezinhlanganisela zezinketho/ziqhingqi. Vula amadokhumenti wezinketho uhlole ukuzwelayisisekelo nokungazwelayisisekelo kwamadokhumenti. Lungiselela imodeli yokubala/incomiso yezinketho kanye nemibiko yokuhlola. Ukuqinisekiswa/kokuqondisa okuhlolwayo kwe-Acjukication. Nikeza inkonzo yokuqasha i-SCM (Supply Chain Acquisition Management).

xh.title: UmLawuli weNkqubo yokuzelelwa
xh.summary: Kufuneka umLawuli weNkqubo yokuzelelwa kwiSebe lezaManzi kunye nokuCogula ePretoria ukuyalela inkqubo yokuThenga, ukuxhasa iKomiti yoManyano lokuHluza iinclusion, nokulawula iinkqubo zokuzelelwa.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka elithathu (3) kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lokuzelelwa kweempahla/ iNkqubo yoLawulo lokuThenga/ iNkqubo yoLawulo loLuntu/ iNkqubo yoLawulo loMphathi/ iNkqubo yokuThenga/ iNkqubo yoLawulo lwezeMali kunye neNkqubo yoLawulo lweLogistics kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 njengoko kugunyaziswe yi-SAQA. Isipiliwo seminyaka elinye (1) kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lokuThenga iimpahla. Ukubhengeza ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egunya nelingabonakaliyo. Ulwazi ngokulawula iinkqubo zokuThenga nokusebenza ngeenkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezeMali. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, i-PPPFA kunye namagqabanthwe e-BBEE. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuThenga nomthetho. Ulwazi olubanzi ngomthetho wabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lwezeMali. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuxazulula iingxaki. Ukuqonda iingxaki zophuhliso lwentlalo nobuhlali. Ulwazi olusesiqwini malunga noLawulo lwezeMali. Ulwazi ngokulawula ulwazi. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuzahlula. Ukulawula abantu nolwahluko. Ukwakha isakhono sabakhiwo. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwa). Ukuzelelwa nokuziphatha ngokwesidima.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambili inkqubo yokuzelelwa kweempahla nesevisi ngqo ngeenkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo yokuzelelwa. Zinikele inkxaso yomsebenzi weSikhokelo kwiKomiti yoManyano lokuHluza iinclusion. Zinike inkxaso yomsebenzi wokulawula iinkcukacha ngelixa kubakho iinkqubo zokwazisa ngeenkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo yokuzelelwa. Nceda nokwenza iinkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo yokuzelelwa kwaye uqinisekise ukuba zidalwe ngokwemigaqo yokuLawula inkqubo yezeMali kunye neenkqubo. Zinike inkxaso ekubhaleni iinkcukacha zoMda woSebenzo. Nceda nokulawula umhla wokuvala iinkqubo zokuzelelwa ezivaliweyo. Nceda ekubumbeni kunye nokwenza inkqubo yoManyano lokuHluza iinclusion: Lungiselela ukuya kwaye uphuhlise iKomiti yoManyano lokuHluza iinclusion. Lungiselela urhulumente wabahlinzeki. Qinisekisa ukulandela imigaqo yokuLawula inkqubo yezeMali kunye neenkqubo. Phendaba imibuzo ethile ngelixa kubakho iinkqubo zokwazisa ngeenkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo yokuzelelwa. Vula iinkcukacha zesithsaba senkqubo yokuzelelwa kwaye uqinisekise ukuziphendulela nokungaziphenduleli kwezi nkqubo. Lungiselela inkqubo yokwahlula ngesiXhesha kunye neenkcukacha zamaxabiso kunye neenkcukacha zokuHluza iinclusion. Lungiselela/Hluza iinkcukacha zamaxabiso malunga noManyano lokuHluza iinclusion. Zinike inkxaso yolawulo kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lokuzelelwa kweempahla.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to a manager at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville, requiring a Secretarial Diploma and three to five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Secretarial Diploma or equivalent qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in rendering support to Senior Management. Knowledge of administrative procedures. Knowledge of secretarial duties. Excellent Computer literacy skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suit. Sound organisational skills. Good people skills. High level of reliability. Written communication skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Good grooming and presentation. Self-management and motivation. Knowledge of dispute resolution process. Understanding of Social and Economic development issues. Basic Financial Management and knowledge of PFMA. Knowledge Management. People and Diversity management. Problem solving People and Diversity Management. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Remain up to date regarding the prescripts, policies and procedures applicable to his / her work terrain to ensure efficient support to the manager. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written). Accountability and Ethical Conduct.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial/ receptionist support service to the manager. Implement administrative procedures for the component. Receive telephone calls and visitors on behalf of the manage. Implement policies and procedures. Engage the Supply Chain Management regarding purchased materials. Ensure that financial procedures are observed in the section. Liaise with travelling agencies to make travelling arrangements for the office. Arrange meetings and events for the manager and staff in the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the manager including the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Taking of basic minutes of the meetings of manager where required. Administer matters like leave registers and telephone accounts and proper filling of document. Prepare all relevant documents to enable the manager to prepare for meeting. Provide feedback on identified administrative gaps provide records on goods and services procured and handle all the procurement items for the office.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan 'n bestuurder by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville, wat 'n Sekretariële Diploma en drie tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die lewer van ondersteuning aan Senior Bestuur. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Kennis van sekretariële pligte. Uitstekende rekenaarvaardighede. Gevorderde vaardigheid in Microsoft Office Suite. Deeglike organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie mensevaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en voorkoms. Selfbestuur en motivering. Kennis van geskilbeslegtingsproses. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Basiese Finansiële Bestuur en kennis van PFMA. Kennisbestuur. Mense- en Diversiteitsbestuur. Probleemoplossing Mense- en Diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en Kliëntefokus. Op hoogte bly van die voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures wat op sy/haar werksterrein van toepassing is om doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die bestuurder te verseker. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en Etiese Gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële/ ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder. Implementeer administratiewe prosedures vir die komponent. Neem telefoonoproepe en besoekers namens die bestuurder aan. Implementeer beleide en prosedures. Skakel met die Supply Chain Management rakende aangeskafte materiaal. Verseker dat finansiële prosedures in die afdeling nagekom word. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reivreëlings vir die kantoor te tref. Reël vergaderings en geleenthede vir die bestuurder en personeel in die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die bedrywighede van die bestuurder se werk, insluitend die reis- en bestedingsvorderings vir die eenheid. Neem basiese notule van die bestuurder se vergaderings waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings en behoorlike invulling van dokumente. Berei alle relevante dokumente voor om die bestuurder in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Verskaf terugvoer oor geïdentifiseerde administratiewe leemtes, verskaf rekords oor aangeskafte goedere en dienste en hanteer alle verkrygingsitems vir die kantoor.

zu.title: Umncedi Omuntu
zu.summary: Nikela ngokwesekela kwabasebenzi bobungqangi bokulalela abaphumayo nokumamela kumnikazi we Department of Water and Sanitation e Bellville, okudinga idiploma yokusekela abasebenzi bobungqangi futhi kube nokutholakala kweminyaka emithathu kuya kwayisihlanu yokutholakala okuhambisana naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: Idiploma yasebuleni noma isimo sokuhambisana nesiqu. Iminyaka eyithathu (3) kuya kunhlanu (5) yokuqeqeshwa ekunikelweni ngesekela uBaphathi Baphezulu. Ulwazi mayelana nemikhakha yokuqhuba izinto ezihlukahlukene. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yasebulela. Amakhono amahle kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi oluzijwayezile ekusebenziseni ihlelo le Microsoft Office. Amakhono aqinile okuhlela izinto. Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu. Izinga eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa ukuba nokwethembeka. Amakhono okubhala nokuthumela imiyalezo. Isikhathi esihle sokuphatha ngobuhlakani obusobala nokuthi ungakhulumi ngodwa. Ukuzilungisa nokubukeka kahle. Ukuziphatha nokuzikhiyiza. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yokulungisa izinkinga ezingabhekwa. Ukuqonda ngemibuzo yezomnotho kanye nenhuthuko yabantu. Ulwazi lokuqonda imali nokuhlela imali kanye nokuqonda i-PFMA. Ukuqonda izinto ezihlukene nokuziphatha kwabantu. Ukukwazi ukulungisa izinkinga. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokubhekezelelwa kwamathemba abantu nokuphathwa kokuqonda izidingo zabathengi. Ukuba nolwazi olusha ngemithetho, izinqubo nemikhakha ehambisana nomsebenzi yakhe ukuze akwazi ukunika isekela esihle kumnikazi wesikhundla. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukubekezelela nokuziphatha kwayo umuntu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesekela okuphathelene nokulalela abaphumayo nokumamela kumnikazi wesikhundla. Hlela izindlela zokuqhuba imisebenzi yale mininingwane. Thola imibhalo yababizi kanye nalabo abangangeni ngaphakathi ngokomthetho kaBaphathi. Hlela imithetho nezinqubo ezibeka ukulandelana kwezinto. Thinta abasebenzi bokuqinisekisa izinto ezithengiwe ukwenza isivumelwano. Qinisekisa ukuthi imithetho mayelana nemali ilandelwa emkhakheni. Thinta othise abahamba nendlela yokwenza izinhlelo zokuhamba komkhakha. Hlela izinkomishishini nezinhlelo zomnikazi nabasebenzi emkhakheni. Qhuba yonke imali okufanele ihlawulelwe imisebenzi kaMnikazi okuhlanganisa imali yokuhamba kanye nezimali zokuzelelwa ukubhukuda. Qamba imininingwane yezinkulumo-mvula ezenziwe nguDirekhthela namaphoyisa lapho kudingeka khona. Linganisa izinkomba ezifana nesibuko sokugibela imoto kanye namanani okukhuluma nabanikazi balezo zinkomba kanye nokugcwalisa imibhalo kahle. Hlela zonke izinkomba ezidingekayo ukuze umnikazi wesikhundla akwazi ukuhlanganisela inkulumo-mvula. Nikeza impendulo ngemikhakha yokulawula okungalungile, nikeza izinkomba ezihlobene nemali ethengiwe, bese uphatha konke okudingekile ekuthengweni kwezinto zikahleko ezisebenza emkhakheni.

xh.title: Umncedi Komntu
xh.summary: Kunikezela inkxaso yomsebenzi wamagosa e-ofisi nokuamkela iindwendwe kumlawuli kwiSebe leManzi nokuCogula kwiBellville, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yomsebenzi wamagosa e-ofisi nokuba namava ahambelana neminyaka yamathathu ukuya kwaye anahlala.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yomsebenzi wamagosa e-ofisi okanye izidanga ezilinganayo. Iiminyaka elithathu (3) ukuya kwelihlanu (5) yamava ekukenzeleni inkxaso kwiNkulumbuso ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo lwezomphilo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomncedi. Amandla aphakamileyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ukuziphatha okuphakamileyo kwesoftware ye-Microsoft Office. Amandla aphakamileyo ekuhleleni. Amandla agqithisayo okuxhelana nabantu. Iqondo eliphezulu lokwethembeleka. Amandla abhalwayo ekunxibelelaneni. Amandla okuziphatha ngobunye nobuthonto. Ukuzihlamba nokubukeka okuhle. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhusela. Ulwazi langaxhala lokuzama. Ukunxibelelana nezehlo lweentlalo nokuphuhliswa kwezoqoqosho. Ulawulo oluqhelekileyo lweMali nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo lwabantu nobunikelo bexego. Ukusombulula iingxaki zoLawulo lwabantu nobunikelo bexego. Umdweliswa weKhasimende kunye nokuqwalaselwa kwiKhasimende. Ukuhlala ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kummandla wakhe/wakhe womsebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke inkxako ephilileyo kumlawuli. Amandla aphezulu ekuqhuba uthetho (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukuza kuzipendula kwaye wenze ngendlela ethe nkqo.
xh.duties: Kunika inkxako yomsebenzi wamagosa e-ofisi/okuamkela iindwendwe kumlawuli. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zolawulo lwezomphilo kwicala. Ukumkela amagama e-athiliki nabantu ezingelo lomlawuli. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo nendlela. Ukuba nxibelelwano noLawulo lwe-Supply Chain ngemithi ethengiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindlela zemali zilandelwe kule candelo. Ukuba nxibelelwano nee-agents zokuhamba ukuze uqhelanise ukuhamba koluntu kwe-ofisi. Ukuqhelanisa iindibano neziganeko zamawela umlawuli nabasebenzi kwindlu. Ukusebenza onke amaxwebhu okurhoxa amavela kumsebenzi womlawuli kuquka izifundo zokuhamba nokuzihlambulula kwesigaba. Ukuwela imizuzulo e-ngowethu yendibano zamawela umlawuli apha kufuneka. Ukulawula izinto ezinjengabhalo bethutyana ne-athiliki kwaye uzalise ngokufanelekileyo amaxwebhu. Ukuqokelela onke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo ukwenza umlawuli akhelane nondibano. Kunikela ingxelo ngamathuba olawulo ezalathwayo kwaye unike iirekhodi ngeempahla ngenkonzo ezithengiweyo kwaye uphathe zonke izinto ezithengwayo ze-ofisi.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant (OFFICE of the Chief Executive)
jobs.summary: Personal assistant required to provide secretarial and administrative support to the Office of the Chief Executive in Durban.
jobs.requirements: A Secretarial Diploma or equivalent qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in rendering support services to senior management. Excellent computer literacy skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Good Office management skills (document tracking, storage, and retrieval system). Sound organizational skills. High level of reliability. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Ability to research and analyse documents and situations. Good grooming and presentation skills. Self-management and motivation. Knowledge of dispute resolution process. Knowledge of basic financial management and knowledge of relevant legislations skills. The successful candidate must be highly reliable, self-motivated, flexible, creative, client focused and quality orientated. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written). Good accountability and ethical conduct. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide personal assistance, including a secretarial support service, to the Office of the Chief Executive. Rendering administrative support services. Providing support to the Chief Executive Officer regarding meetings. Supporting the Chief Executive Officer with the administration of the budget of the office. Operates and ensures that office equipment, e.g. computer systems and photocopiers are in good working order. Perform advanced typing work. Utilise discretion to decide whether to accept / decline or refer to other employees’ requests for meetings, based on the assessed importance and urgency of the matter. Coordinates with and sensitizes / advises the manager regarding engagements. Compiles realistic schedules of appointments. Ensure the effective flow of information and documents to and from the office of the manager. Ensure the safekeeping of all documentation in the office of the manager in line with relevant legislation and policies. Obtain inputs, collates reports, e.g. progress reports, monthly reports, and management reports. Scrutinize routine submissions / reports and make notes and / or recommendations for the manager. Draft documents as required. Do filing of documents for the manager and the unit where required. Collects, analyses, and collates information requested by the manager. Clarifies instructions and notes on behalf of the manager. Priorities issues in the office of the manager. Manages the leave register and the telephone accounts for the unit. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationery, refreshments etc. Scrutinize documents to determine actions / information / other documents required for meetings. Collects and compiles all necessary documents for the manager to inform the manager on the contents. Record minutes / decisions and communicates to relevant role players, follow up on the progress made. Prepare briefing notes for the manager as required. Coordinate logistical arrangements for meetings required. Collect and coordinate all documents that relate to the manager’s budget. Keep record of expenditure commitments, monitor expenditure and alert managers of possible over and under spending. Acquaintance with the relevant Public Services and departmental prescripts or policies and other documents. Remain up to date with regard to the prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to the manager to ensure efficient and effective support.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent (KANTOOR van die Hoof-Uitvoerende Beampte)
af.summary: Persoonlike assistent benodig om sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Kantoor van die Hoof-Uitvoerende Beampte in Durban te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die lewer van ondersteuningsdienste aan senior bestuur. Uitstekende rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede. Gevorderde vaardigheid in Microsoft Office-pakket. Goeie kantoorbestuursvaardighede (dokumentopsporing, berging en herwinningstelsel). Deeglike organisatoriese vaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Vermoë om dokumente en situasies te ondersoek en te ontleed. Goeie versorging en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Selfbestuur en motivering. Kennis van geskilbeslegtingsproses. Kennis van basiese finansiële bestuur en kennis van relevante wetgewing. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet hoogs betroubaar, selfgemotiveerd, buigsaam, kreatief, kliëntgerig en kwaliteitgeoriënteerd wees. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf persoonlike bystand, insluitend 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsdiens, aan die Kantoor van die Hoof-Uitvoerende Beampte. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Hoof-Uitvoerende Beampte met betrekking tot vergaderings. Ondersteun die Hoof-Uitvoerende Beampte met die administrasie van die begroting van die kantoor. Bedryf en verseker dat kantoortoerusting, bv. rekenaarestelsels en fotostaatmasjiene, in goeie werkende toestand is. Voer gevorderde tikwerk uit. Gebruik diskresie om te besluit of om versoeke vir vergaderings van ander werknemers te aanvaar / af te wys of te verwys, gebaseer op die beoordeelde belangrikheid en dringendheid van die saak. Koördineer met en sensibiliseer / adviseer die bestuurder met betrekking tot betrokkenhede. Stel realistiese skedules van afsprake op. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en vanaf die kantoor van die bestuurder. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor van die bestuurder in ooreenstemming met relevante wetgewing en beleide. Verkry insette en stel verslae saam, bv. vorderingsverslae, maandelikse verslae en bestuursverslae. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings / verslae en maak notas en / of aanbevelings vir die bestuurder. Opstel van dokumente soos vereis. Doen lêerwerk van dokumente vir die bestuurder en die eenheid waar vereis. Versamel, ontleed en stel inligting wat deur die bestuurder versoek word, saam. Verduidelik instruksies en notas namens die bestuurder. Prioritiseer kwessies in die kantoor van die bestuurder. Bestuur die verlofregister en die telefoonrekeninge vir die eenheid. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos stasiegnere, verkwikkings, ens. Ondersoek dokumente om handelinge / inligting / ander dokumente wat vir vergaderings benodig word, te bepaal. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente vir die bestuurder saam om die bestuurder oor die inhoud in te lig. Neem notule / besluite op en kommunikeer dit aan relevante rolspelers en volg die vordering op. Berei voorleggingsnotas vir die bestuurder soos vereis voor. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir vereiste vergaderings. Versamel en koördineer alle dokumente wat verband hou met die bestuurder se begroting. Hou rekord van bestedingsverpligtinge, monitor besteding en waarsku bestuurders van moontlike oor- en onderbesteding. Rakend met die relevante Openbare Dienste en departementele voorskrifte of beleide en ander dokumente. Bly op hoogte met betrekking tot die voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat op die bestuurder van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning te verseker.

zu.title: Umkekeli Buciko (IHhovisi likaMongameli Ophethe)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umkekeli buciko onikeze inkonzoye yobuhlakani bezokubhalisa nezolawuleko kuHhovisi likaMongameli Ophethe eDurban.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezokubhalisa noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Isiphepho saminyaka eyithathu (3) kuye kwamihlanu (5) sokunikeza izinkonzo zokwesekela abaphathi abaphezulu. Amakhono aphakeme okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubakuguquli okuphezulu kuhlelo i-Microsoft Office. Amakhono amahle okulawula ihhovisi (ukulandela amadokhumenti, ukugcina, kanye nesistimu yokubuyisa amadokhumenti). Amakhono aqinisekile ahleliwe. Izinga eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Ikhono lokuziphattha ngobuhlakani nangokubhophephile. Ikhono lokucwaninga futhi uhlaziye amadokhumenti kanye nezimo. Amakhono amahle okuzilungisa nokuzibonakalisa. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhalimela. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lolawulo lwezimali oluyisisekelo kanye nolwazi lwemithetho ehlobene. Ophumelelayo kumele athembeke kakhulu, azikhalimele, aguquguquke, adala, agxile kumthengi futhi ahlose ngomgogwela. Amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana (akhotho futhi abhaliwe). Ukuziphendulela okuhle kanye nokuziphatha ngokukuziphatha. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni.
zu.duties: Nika umsekeli wobuciko, okuhlanganisa inkonzo yokwesekela ngobuhlakani bezokubhalisa, kuHhovisi likaMongameli Ophethe. Nikela izinkonzo zokwesekela ezolawulweni. Nikeza ukwesekela kuMongameli Ophethe ngokuqondene nezinkomisho. Sekela uMongameli Ophethe ngolawulo lebhajethi lehhovisi. Usebenzise futhi aqiniseke ukuthi izinto zehhovisi, isb. amasistimu ekhompyutha nezimoto zokushaja zisebenza kahle. Yenza umsebenzi wethayiphing owuthuthumuke. Sebenzisa ukuzikhuza ngokuhlakanipha ukunquma ukuthi wamukele / wenqabe noma wakhombise kwezinye izicelo zabasebenzi sezinkomisho, okusekelwe enkombweni yobukhulu nokuqubula kwenkinga. Hlela futhi uxwayise / weluleke umphathi ngokuqondene nezinhlangano. Hlanganisa izikhathi eziqinisekile zemiqedhule. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlephuleka kwolwazi namadokhumenti kuyahamba kahle kuhhovisi komphathi nakuhsitha. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwawo onke amadokhumenti ohhovisi komphathi ngokuqondene nemithetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene. Thola okungenayo, hlanganisa imibiko, isb. imibiko yokuqhubekayo, yenyanga, kanye nemibiko yezompilo. Hlola okulethwayo okuvamile / imibiko futhi ube amaphuzu futhi / noma izincomo komphathi. Lumba amadokhumenti njengoko kudingeka. Yenza ukufaka kwamadokhumenti komphathi kweyuniti lapho kudingeka khona. Qoqa, hlaziye, futhi uhlanganise ulwazi olucelwa ngumphathi. Cacisa imiyalo kanye namaphuzu emele umphathi. Babeka izinto abalulekile ohhovisi komphathi. Phatha irejista yokubuyela emsebenzini kanye nemali yocingo yeyuniti. Phatha ukuthengwa kwamadokhumenti ajwayelekile njengamadokhumenti okubhala, ukuphakelwa kwezimpilo njll. Hlola amadokhumenti ukunquma izinyathelo / ulwazi / eminye imibiko edingeka enkomeni. Qoqa futhi uhlanganise onke amadokhumenti adingeka komphathi ukuze ummemeze ngokuqukethwe kwawo. Qaphula imizuzu/ izinqumo futhi uxhumanise nabaphathi abahlobene, ulandele inqubo eyenziwe. Lumba amaphuzu okuhlakanipha aqondene nomphathi njengoko kudingeka. Hlela izinhlelo zokuthutha izinto ngezinkomisho ezingeka. Qoqa futhi uhlanganise onke amadokhumenti ahlobene nebhajethi yomphathi. Gcina ukhumbulo lwezibopho zokuchitha, hlola ukuchithwa futhi uxwayise abaphathi ngekwengo nokuqubuda. Qonda imiyalo / amapholisi ahlobene nezokomphakathi kanye nalezomnyango. Hlala ukhulekele ngokuqondene nemiyalo / amapholisi kanye nokuqondene nezinqubo ezihlobene nomphathi ukuze uqiniseke ukwesekelwa okusebenza kalula futhi ngokusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Umncedi wakuqondisisa (IOFISI likaMlawuli oPhezulu)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedi wakuqondisisa onikeze inkxaso yokubhala nokulawula nasezoshishino kwiFisi likaMlawuli oPhezulu eDurban.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe nediploma yokubhala okanye nesiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Kufuneka ibe nobulumko bokusebenza eminye iminyaka elithathu (3) kuya kwemihlanu (5) kwindawo yokuvinjwa kwenkxaso kubaphathi abaphezulu. Kufuneka kubekho izikrweqe ezilungileyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Kufuneka kubekho ubuchwepheshe obugqithisileyo kwiMicrosoft Office suite. Kufuneka kubekho izikrweqe ezilungileyo zokulawula ofisi (ukulandelela amaxwebhu, ukugcina, nendlela yokuzihlaziya). Kufuneka kubekho izikrweqe ezilungileyo zokuququzelela. Kufuneka kubekho inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Kufuneka kubekho ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuqu neembeko. Kufuneka kubekho ikhono lokuphangakis nokuhlalutya amaxwebhu nangemiba. Kufuneko kukho igoso elilungileyo nobuchwepheshe bobumi bokubonakalisa. Kufuneka kubekho ukuzilawula nokuzikhusela. Kufuneka kukwazi inkqubo yokuqondisa iingxaki. Kufuneka kukwazi iziseko zolawulo lweemali nokwazi ngemithetho ethile. Umntu oza kugqibela kulindeleke ukuba athembekile kakhulu, azikhusenze, abe lula, anamabali, ajolise kumthengi ajolise kakhulu kwisiphelo. Kufuneka kubekho izikrweqe ezilungileyo zokuqhathanisa (ngamagama nangokubhaliweyo). Kufuneko kukho ayikountabhiliti nendlela yokuziphatha ngokweemfanelo. Ilayiseni yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Kufuneka anikeze inkxaso yomncedi wakuqondisisa, kuquka inkxaso yokubhala, kwiFisi likaMlawuli oPhezulu. Anikeze iinkxaso zokulawula nasezoshishino. Anikeze inkxaso kuMlawuli oPhezulu ngokwemiqungu. Axhase uMlawuli oPhezulu ngokulawula ibhajeti yefisi. Asebenze aze abuquzele ukuba izixhobo zefisi, njengenkqubo yekhompyutha nezoqobo ixwebhu zisebenza kakuhle. Ayenze ubugqithiselekayo ubudlelwane bokuthayipha. Aphathe ngokuzithoba ukugqiba ukuba wamkela na / uyala okanye ukujolisa iimfuno zabasebenzi bezokusoloko umqungu, ngokusekelwe kubaluleko nokusetyenziswa komsifa. Axhumane nam aze amqondise / umcebise umphathi ngokubandakanyeka kwakhe. Ahlanganise iinkqubo zexesha ezinika isiqiniseko zemiqungu. Aze abuquzele ukuhamba kweerefomasi namaxwebhu ukuya nakunaphandle kwefisi komphathi. Aze abuquzele ukugcinwa kwamaxwebhu onke kwifisi komphathi ngokwemithetho neengqinisekiso ezifanelekileyo. Athathe iingxelo, ahlanganise iingxelo, njengokuba zii-progress reports, ii-monthly reports, nadi-management reports. Aqwalasele izicelo ezenzelwayo / iingxelo aze abhale iinngcamango / okanye izindululo zomphathi. Abhale amaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Agenze ugcinio lwamaxwebhu komphathi nendlela apho kufuneka kusetyenziswa khona. Aqokele, ahlalutye, ahlanganise iinkcazelo eceliwa ngumphathi. Acacise iinkcazelo neengcinga ngokumela komphathi. Axhase kubaluleke kwindawo yefisi komphathi. Alawule irejista yokushiya iindawo zomsebenzi kunye nama-akhawunti efowuni yendlela. Aphathe ukuthengwa kwemibhalo eqhelekileyo njengokuba zii-stationery, ii-refreshments nokunye. Aqwalasele amaxwebhu ukuze agqibe ukuba yintoni izenzo / iinkcazelo / amanye amaxwebhu afunekayo emiqungu. Aqokele ahlanganise onke amaxwebhu afunekayo komphathi ukumzalisela ngokoqukuqo. Abhale iinkcazelo / izigqibo aze axhumanye nabalandeli abafanelekileyo, alandele inkqubo yenteniso. Alungise iinngcamango zokumembesa komphathi njengoko kufuneka. Axhumene nokulungiselela iinkqubo zokulawula ezifuneka emiqungu. Aqokele ahlanganise onke amaxwebhu ahlobene nebhajeti yomphathi. Agcine irekhodi yamayalezelo yokuchitha, alawule ukuchithwa kwemali amze abhengeze abaphathi ngokugqithiswa nokungalifinyeleli linguqelo lomthwalo. Aqonde ngemithetho yolawulo loLuntu nesebe neemigqibo nokunye. Agcine kube ngokuqinisekileyo ngemithetho / iingqinisekiso iindlela ezisebenzayo kumlawuli ukuze abone inkxaso elungileyo nasebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle.

jobs.title: Chief Assistant Technical Officer (SCIENTIFIC Support)
jobs.summary: Provide data extraction and coordination services from the Water Management System in support of water quality monitoring at Roodeplaat Dam.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/ Grade 12 certificate with Mathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Six (6) to ten (10) years’ experience in water-related data collection, processing, and/or laboratory environment. Knowledge of data administration and water quality processes and systems. Knowledge of laboratory and monitoring equipment. Computer literacy. Valid driver's licence. Problem solving skills.
jobs.duties: To provide accurate and efficient data extraction and coordination services from the Water Management System (WMS) in support of internal and external stakeholders. Extract and compile data from the Water Management System (WMS) by applying sound business knowledge and system expertise. Interpret data requests and ensure accurate retrieval aligned with monitoring requirements. Coordinate and conduct data searches related to monitoring points, variables, datasets, and associated information in consultation with relevant colleagues. Liaise with internal and external clients to troubleshoot, clarify unclear, incomplete, or ambiguous data requests. Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of all data supplied. Maintain proper records of data requests and outputs to ensure traceability and accountability.

af.title: Hoofassistent Tegniese Beampte (WETENSKAPLIKE Ondersteuning)
af.summary: Verskaf data-ekstraksie- en koördineringsdienste vanuit die Waterbestuurstelsel ter ondersteuning van watergehalte-monitering by Roodeplaat Dam.
af.requirements: 'n Senior-/Graad 12-sertifikaat met Wiskunde/Wiskundige Geletterdheid/Fisiese Wetenskap. Ses (6) tot tien (10) jaar ervaring in waterverwante data-insameling, verwerking en/of laboratoriumomgewing. Kennis van datatoedeling en watergehalteprosesse en -stelsels. Kennis van laboratorium- en moniteringstoerusting. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf akkurate en doeltreffende data-ekstraksie- en koördineringsdienste vanuit die Waterbestuurstelsel (WMS) ter ondersteuning van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ekstraheer en stel data saam vanuit die Waterbestuurstelsel (WMS) deur deeglike besigheidskennis en stelselkundigheid toe te pas. Interpreteer dataversoeke en verseker akkurate onttrekking in ooreenstemming met moniteringsvereistes. Koördineer en voer datasoektogte uit wat verband hou met moniteringspunte, veranderlikes, datastelle en gepaardgaande inligting in oorleg met relevante kollegas. Skakel met interne en eksterne kliënte om onduidelike, onvolledige of dubbelsinnige dataversoeke op te klaar. Verseker die akkuraatheid, volledigheid en integriteit van alle verskafde data. Hou behoorlike rekords van dataversoeke en uitsette om naspeurbaarheid en aanspreeklikheid te verseker.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esidlule Esibusayo Sobuchwepheshe (ISEKELO LEZENZULULWAZI)
zu.summary: Nikela ngemisebenzi yokukhipha idatha nokuhlanganisa kusuka kuhlelo loLawulo Lwamanzi ukuze sekela ukulolonga khwalithi yamanzi e-Roodeplaat Dam.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi somatasa/ Grade 12 nesibalo/Isibalo esivela kwezokwengqondo/Isayensi yezomzimba. Ukuthola ukuthinta okuyisihlanu (5) kuye kwayishumi (10) iminyaka kokuqoqwa kwezolwazi ngamamanzi, ukucubungula, kanye/noma endaweni yelaborothari. Ukwazi ngokuqashwa kwedatha kanye namazinga okulawula khwalithi yamanzi. Ukwazi ngezemishini yezolwazi eziphathwa ngalamalaborothari. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kahle. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ubuchwepheshe obuseduzane nokuqamba izixazululi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokukhipha imininingwane nezimiso ezishe ukuqoqwa ngendlela ephumelelayo kusuka kwinkqubo yoLawulo Lwamanzi (WMS) ngokuqinisekiswa ukuba sekela abantu abangaphakathi kanye nalabo abangaphandle. Ukukhipha futhi uqoqe imininingwane esuka kuhlelo loLawulo Lwamanzi (WMS) ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluzalisekileyo ngemisebenzi nolwazi ngokuqhutywa kwemisebenzi yohlelo. Ukutolikwa ngendlela ofuna ngayo imininingwane nokuqinisekiswa ngokuqinisekileyo ngokukhululeka kwezidingo ngokulandelwa kokuqaphela imisebenzi ekuhlotshanisiweyo. Ukuqhutywa kobudlelwane obusemthethweni bokuseshwa kwemisebenzi ekuhlotshanisiweyo nabantu abangaphakathi, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, izinto ezingachazwa ngokucacileyo ezidibana nayo. Ukulolonga ubomi bezinto ukuze kugqitywe ukuba ngolwazi nokuqinisekiswa ngokupheleleyo nokungapheleleyo kolwazi. Ukuphathwa ngokuchanileyo kolwazi ngokuphathwa kolwazi ngokuthintana nemibuzo yamalungu amnyama ngokuqinisekiswa kwenguquko yemisebenzi yokuqamba iindaba.

xh.title: NoMkhulu wesixhobo esincedisayo (INKXASO YESAYENSI)
xh.summary: Nika iinkonzo zokukhupha idatha nokuhlungelanisa kwinkqubo yoLawulo lwaManzi ngenkxaso yokubeka ngqondweni ukhathalelo lomgangatho wamanzi eRoodeplaat Dam.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/ Grade 12 ngeMathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Ukusukela kwiiyure ezingamaSix (6) kuya kweli-ten (10) zeminyaka yamava kwindawo ekuthathwa idatha enxulumene namanzi, ukuqhubekisa, kunye/nokwakhiwo lobugcisa bokulinganisa. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwedatha kunye nenkqubo namaxhobo omgangatho wamanzi. Ulwazi ngeempahla zokulinganisa nokubeka ngqondweni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngeenkonzo ezichanekileyo nezisebenzayo zokukhupha idatha nokuhlungelanisa kwindalo yamnikeli kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lwaManzi (WMS) ngenkxaso kumnikeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha uze uhlobe idatha kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lwaManzi (WMS) ngokusebenzisa ulwazi olululo lwebhizinisi nolwesixhobo. Chaza iicelo zedatha uze uqinisekise ukukhutshwa okuchanekileyo okuhambisana neemfuno zokubeka ngqondweni. Hlungelanisa uze wenze ukukhangela idatha enxulumene namaphawu okubeka ngqondweni, iinguqu, iiseti zedatha, nolwazi oluhambelanayo ngokuvakalelana nabaphathi abafaneleyo. Thetha noxhwebu labakhandi ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuqinisekisa, ukuqamba ngokusondeleyo, okungazigqibeliyo, okungagqibekanga, okungaqondakaliyo iicelo zedatha. Qinisekisa ukuchanekile, ukugqibela, nokuzinza kolwazi lonke olunikezelwayo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zeecelo zedatha nokuvela ukwenza isigqibo esiya kujolisa ukubuyela umva kwaye kubekwe intlukwano.

jobs.title: Water Plant Superintendent (TEAM Leader)
jobs.summary: Water Plant Superintendent team leader sought at Berg River Dam to coordinate shift operations and maintenance of pump stations, dams, pipelines and reservoirs.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 at NQF level 4 qualification. Five (5) years’ experience in operations and infrastructure operations. The disclosure of a valid, unexpired driver’s licence (minimum Code B; a Code C1 or higher). Knowledge in controlling and managing the water distribution for all government waterworks within the Area Offices jurisdiction. Understanding of policy implementation. Monitoring and evaluation principles. Knowledge in managing human resources management. Disciplinary knowledge in Occupational Health and Safety. Disciplinary knowledge in public administration. Knowledge in supporting water utilisation and water resource strategy. Knowledge of flood controlling. Understanding of government legislations. Good communication skills both (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Coordinate shift operations of pump stations, dam and dam walls, pipelines and weirs, reservoirs, and residential and office infrastructure. Coordination of maintenance at pump stations, dam and dam walls pipelines and weirs, reservoirs, and residential and office infrastructure. Implementation of OHS and legal compliance. Management of human resources.

jobs.notes: Preference will be given to candidates from the Geographical Area. af.title: Water Plant Superintendent (TEAM Leier)
af.summary: Water Plant Superintendent spanleier gesoek by Berg River Dam om skofbedrywighede en instandhouding van pompstasies, damme, pyplyne en reservoirs te koördineer.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12 op NQF vlak 4-kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in bedrywighede en infrastruktuurbewerkings. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie (minimum Kode B; 'n Kode C1 of hoër). Kennis van die beheer en bestuur van waterverspreiding vir alle regeringswaterwerke binne die Area Offices se jurisdiksie. Begrip van beleidsimplementering. Monitering en evalueringsbeginsels. Kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuur. Dissiplinêre kennis in Arbeidsveiligheid en Gesondheid. Dissiplinêre kennis in openbare administrasie. Kennis van die ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterhulpbronstrategie. Kennis van vloedbeheer. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Koördineer skofbedrywighede van pompstasies, dam en dammure, pyplyne en dyke, reservoirs, en residensiële en kantoorinfrastruktuur. Koördinasie van instandhouding by pompstasies, dam en dammure pyplyne en dyke, reservoirs, en residensiële en kantoorinfrastruktuur. Implementering van OHS en regsverenigbaarheid. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sethemu Esibhekene Namanzi (Umlweli Weqembu)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umluleli weqembu loSiphathi Sethemu Esibhekene Namanzi e-Berg River Dam ukuze uhlole imisebenzi yeshifthi nokugcinwa kweziteshi zamapompa, amadamu, imigudu namakhophokhopho.
zu.requirements: I-Senior/Grade 12 ezingeni le-NQF level 4. Uhlumo lwe-Five (5) years emsebenzini wemisebenzi nokuqhutywa kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engaphelelwe isikhathi (okungenani i-Code B; i-Code C1 noma okuphezulu). Ulwazi ekulawulweni nokuphathweni kokusatshazelwa kwamanzi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zamanzi zahulumenti ngaphakathi kolawulo lwe-Area Offices. Ukuqonda ukuqashwa kwenqubomgomo. Iminqulo yokubuka nokuhlola. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kokulawulwa kwabantu. Ulwazi olukhulu lokuziphendulela kwi-Occupational Health and Safety. Ulwazi olukhulu ekuphathweni kahulumenti. Ulwazi ekusekeleni isu lokusetshenziswa kwamanzi namathuba amanzi. Ulwazi lokulawula izikhukhula. Ukuqonda umthetho kahulumenti. Amakhono okuthintana ahle kahle kokubili (akukhulumweni nakubhalweni).
zu.duties: Hambisa imisebenzi yeshifthi yeziteshi zamapompa, idamu namadivaysi edamu, imigudu nama-weirs, amakhophokhopho, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zokuhlala namakomishi. Ukuhambisaniswa kokugcinwa kweziteshi zamapompa, idamu namadivaysi edamu imigudu nama-weirs, amakhophokhopho, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zokuhlala namakomishi. Ukuqashwa kwe-OHS nokuvumelana nomthetho. Ukuphathwa kwabantu.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade a – C (ELECTRICAL)

jobs.requirements: An appropriate Electrical Trade Test Certificate. Experience in electrical maintenance will serve as an added advantage. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Ability to work in a team. Knowledge of project management. Understanding technical design and analysis. Knowledge of computer-aided technical applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Knowledge of technical reports report writing. Decision making, teamwork, creativity, analytical skills, self-management, customer service and responsiveness, planning and organizing. Good communication skills both (verbal and written. Knowledge of computer skills. Problem-solving skills.
jobs.duties: Maintenance of electrical installations in various dams, reservoirs, departmental houses, pump stations, machinery, repeater stations, dam walls, and pipelines. Electrical maintenance and inspections of cathodic protection/ transformer rectifying units. Inspect equipment for technical faults and repair according to standards. Service equipment according to schedule. Ensure quality assurance in line with specifications. Ensure adherence to safety standards, requirements, and regulations. Implement planned maintenance and update maintenance logbooks. Compile and submit reports as required. Individual / personal development to keep up with new technologies. Compile and submits technical reports. Keep and maintain job records/ register and supervise and mentor staff.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad a – C (ELEKTRIES)
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A tot C (Elektries) by Jericho Dam, verantwoordelik vir die onderhoud van elektriese installasies by damme, pompstasies, reservoirs en pypleidings.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Elektriese Vaktoetsertifikaat. Ervaring in elektriese onderhoud sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, ongeërfde bestuurslisensie. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Kennis van projekbestuur. Begrip van tegniese ontwerp en analise. Kennis van rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsverenigbaarheid. Kennis van tegniese verslagskrywing. Besluitneming, spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, analitiese vaardighede, selfbestuur, kliëntediens en reaksievermoë, beplanning en organisering. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Kennis van rekenaarvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhoud van elektriese installasies by verskeie damme, reservoirs, departementele huise, pompstasies, masjinerie, herhalerstasies, dammure en pypleidings. Elektriese onderhoud en inspeksies van kattodiese beskerming/ transformator-gelykrigmakereenhede. Inspekteer toerusting vir tegniese foute en herstel volgens standaarde. Diens toerusting volgens skedule. Verseker kwaliteitversekering in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Verseker nakoming van veiligheidsstandaarde, vereistes en regulasies. Implementeer beplande onderhoud en werk onderhoudslogboeke by. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Individuele / persoonlike ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë. Stel tegniese verslae op en dien dit in. Hou en onderhou werksrekords/ register en hou toesig oor en mentor personeel.

zu.title: Umuntu ozenza ngomsoko wekhiyenjali Isigaba A – C (ELECTRICAL)
zu.summary: Umuntu ozenza ngomsoko wekhiyenjali Isigaba A kuye ku-C e-Jericho Dam, onegunya lokugcina izinhlelo zikagesi kulo lonke ulwandle, iziteshi zokupompa, izigcwevo kanye namabhodwe.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele se-Trade Test se-Electrical. Isipiliyoni ekugcineni izinto zikagesi sizonikeza inzuzo engeziwe. Ukwembula ilayisenisi yokuqasha esevunjwile. Ikono lokusebenza ngesiqembu. Ukwazi ngokuqondisa iphrojekthi. Ukuqonda ukwakhiwa nokuhlaziya okusezingeni lenjulalwazi yobuchwepheshe. Ukwazi ngezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisekelwe kukhompyutha. Ukwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukwazi ngokubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza ngesiqembu, ukuba nobuciko, izikhokelo zokuhlaziya, ukuziphatha, ukukhonza abathengi nokuphendula, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Izakhono zokuxhumana ezilungele (ezinkulumweni nasekubhalweni. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokhompyutha. Izakhono zokusombulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukugcina izinhlelo zikageshi kulo lonke ulwandle, izigcwevo, izindlu zomnyango, iziteshi zokupompa, izinsimbi, iziteshi zokuphinda umsindo, izindonga zolwandle, namabhodwe. Ukugcina nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuvikela ekuqhweni kanye nezinto ezilungisa i-transfoma. Ukubheka izinsimbi ngezono zezobuchwephesha futhi uzilungise ngokwezinga. Ukukhonza izinsimbi ngokwesikathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukhwalithi ngokuhambisana nezinkingqayizana. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela izigaba zokuphepha, izidingo, kanye nomthetho. Ukusebenzisa okukhulelwe ukugcinwa nokubhalisa izinsuku zokugcina umsebenzi. Ukuqamba futhi uhambise imibiko njengoba kudingwa. Intuthuko yomuntu ngamunye yokugcina isivinini namaphoyinti amasha obuchwepheshe. Ukuthola nokuhambisa imibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Ukugcina futhi uphephisa amarekhodi omsebenzi futhi ahlole futhi alule abantu.

xh.title: Isenzi Sokukhiqiza Inqanaba A – C (ELEKTRIKHOL)
xh.summary: Isenzi Sokukhiqiza Inqanaba A ukuya ku-C (Elektrikhol) e Jericho Dam, Nigelxelo ekugcineni izimiso zelektrikhol kumazela, kwiisiteshi zepampu, nakwindawo yokugcinela amanzi nasekuthungeni kolwelo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikhejhi esifanelekilesyo sivivinyo sabakhiqizi be-elektrikhol. Amava ekugcineni izimiso zelektrikhol kuya kuba lusizo. Ukuvaza ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo engakapheli. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokulawulwana. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwamaprojekthi. Ukuqonda ukuyila nokuhlalutya ubuchwepheshile. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha kumacandwo obuchwepheshile. Ulwazi ngokuthobela imigaqo. Ulwazi ngokubhalwa kweenkcukacha zobuchwepheshile. Ukwenza iigqibo, ukusebenza ngokulawulwana, ubuzwe, amakhono ekuhlalutya, ukuzilawula, inkonzo yabathengi nokuphendula, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Amakhono oluxhumo oluhle ngamalanceko (olunovakalayo nokubhalwayo. Ulwazi ngamakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Ukugcina izimiso zelektrikhol kumazela ahlukeneyo, kwindawo yokugcinela amanzi, kwezindlu zesebe, kwiisiteshi zepampu, kumashini, kwiisiteshi eziphindisa isignal, kumazela odonga, nasekuthungeni kolwelo. Ukugcina nokuqwalasela izimiso zelektrikhol zokhuselo okucathodic/ yamayunithi ezilungisa i-transfoma. Ukukhangela iimpahla ngempazamo zobuchwepheshile kuzilungise ngokomgangatho. Ukukhonza iimpahla ngokwelidishe. Kuqinisekiswe ukhathazo lomgangatho ngokomiselo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela imigaqo yokhuseleko, iimfuno, nemigaqo. Ukusebenzisa ulawulo olucwangcisiweyo nokuhlaziya iincwadi ezibhalwa ngokugcina. Ukubhala kwaye uzithumele iingxelo njengoko kufunekayo. Ukuphuhliswa komntu / ngamalungelo ukuze agcinele kunqanaba nobuchwepheshile obutsha. Ukubhala nokuthumela iingxelo zobuchwepheshile. Ukugcina nokuqhuba iirekhodi zemisebenzi/ irejista kwaye ulawule kwaye ululeke abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk Production (SUPPLY Chain
jobs.summary: Administration clerk for supply chain and fleet coordination at Boskop Hydrological Services Office, requiring Grade 12 and computer literacy.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or relevant qualification. Relevant experience in Supply chain Management will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge in general clerical support services. Knowledge of office administration and data capturing. Computer literacy. Sound knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet applications. Good verbal and written communication skills. Practical experience in client orientation and customer focus, letter, and report writing. Accountability and ethical conduct. Planning and organising. Experience in the national water use registration process. Knowledge of the National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) and other relevant legislations. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Facilitation of fleet co-ordination and rendering services to regional and area offices (pool). Ensure that all available fleet vehicles are recorded, optimally utilised, and thoroughly maintained. Ensure that the correct procedures are followed on the issuing of vehicles. Conduct pre- and post-inspection of vehicles on a daily basis for every trip. Arrange regular vehicle servicing and vehicle maintenance with the respective service providers. Manage accounts between the Directorate: Water Resource Management Support and the service provider. Reconcile the fleet account with agreed tariffs with the service provider. Reconcile the BAS and SAP reports against the statement of account. Process the application for requisition of short-term rental. Liaise with the service provider in case of accident for provision of relief vehicle. Control and manage the transport unit. Procurement of vehicles for the provincial office. Provide a monthly status report on all fleet account. Ensure effective provisioning of transport reservation. Ensure effective and efficient control of fleet. Render administrative on maintenance, fuel remuneration and financial payments to service provider. Coordinate travel arrangement. Liaise with travel agency with the arranged bookings. Monitor travel needs of the directorate for compliance and alignment of budget. Verify payments and reconciliation of account with travel agency. Provide cost containment in terms with car hire, accommodation, and flight. Align the travel policy and monitor the adherence pertaining to the application on specified types of car hire. Compile report to management on cost savings, deviations, and exceptions.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk Produksie (Toesienketting)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk vir toesienketting en vlootkoördinering by Boskop Hidrologiese Dienste Kantoor, wat Graad 12 vereis en rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Graad 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Relevante ervaring in Toesienkettingbestuur sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis in algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Kennis van kantooradministrasie en dataregistrasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Deglike kennis van woordverwerking en sigbladtoepassings. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Praktiese ervaring in kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntefokus, brief- en verslagskrywing. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Beplanning en organisering. Ervaring in die nasionale watergebruikregistrasieproses. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet, (Wet 36 van 1998) en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Fasilitering van vlootkoördinering en lewer van dienste aan streeks- en gebiedskantore (poel). Verseker dat alle beskikbare vlootvoertuie aangeteken, optimaal benut en deeglik onderhou word. Verseker dat die korrekte prosedures gevolg word by die uitreiking van voertuie. Voer daagliks voor- en na-inspeksies van voertuie uit vir elke rit. Reël gereelde voertuigdiens en voertuigonderhoud met die onderskeie diensverskaffers. Bestuur rekeninge tussen die Direktoraat: Waterhulpbronbestuurondersteuning en die diensverskaffer. Vereenselwig die vlootrekening met ooreengekome tariewe met die diensverskaffer. Vereenselwig die BAS- en SAP-verslae teen die rekeningstaat. Proseseer die aansoek om requisisie van korttermynverhuur. Skakel met die diensverskaffer in geval van 'n ongeluk vir voorsiening van 'n bystandsvoertuig. Kontroleer en bestuur die vervoereenheid. Verkryging van voertuie vir die provinsiale kantoor. Verskaf 'n maandelikse statusverslag oor alle vlootrekeninge. Verseker effektiewe voorsiening van vervoerreservering. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende beheer van vloot. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning aangaande onderhoud, brandstofvergoeding en finansiële betalings aan diensverskaffer. Koördineer reisreëlings. Skakel met reisagentskap met die gereëlde besprekings. Monitor reisbehoeftes van die direktoraat vir nakoming en belyning van begroting. Verifieer betalings en vereenselwiging van rekening met reisagentskap. Verskaf kostebeheer ten opsigte van motorhuur, akkommodasie en vlugte. Belyn die reisbeleid en monitor die nakoming met betrekking tot die toepassing op gespesifiseerde tipes motorhuur. Stel verslag aan bestuur oor kostebesparings, afwykings en uitsonderings.

zu.title: Iclerki yolawula Ukukhiqizwa (I-SUPPLY Chain
zu.summary: Iclerki yolawula eyenza umsebenzi we-supply chain nokuqhathaniswa kwe-fleet eBoskop Hydrological Services Office, edinga i-Grade 12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. Isiphambo esihambisana e-Supply chain Management sizoba yinzululwazi. Ulwazi mayelana nesevisi yonke yonke yokusekela emsebenzini weclerki. Ulwazi lolawulo lwezinhlobo kahulumeni wofane nezokuthwebula idatha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nokushintsha amagama kanye nezinhlelo zokubala. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Isiphambo esipheziwe ekumisweni kwebonke kanye nokugxila kumthengisi, ekubhaleni izincwadi nokuqamba imibiko. Ukuziphendulela nokucondza kwemvelo. Ukwakheka ukuhlela. Isiphambo mayelana nenqubo yokubhaliswa kwezindlela zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ezweni. Ulwazi lomthetho we-National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) neminye imithetho ephathelene nayo. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezeliwa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuxhumana kwe-fleet kanye nokuboneza isevisi kumabhuloho wesifunda nendawo (pool). Qiniseka ukuthi wonke amathafula e-fleet abhalwe, asetshenziswe kahle, agcinwe kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi kulandelwa izinqamule ezifanele ekukhishweni kwamathafula. Yenza ukubuyekeza kwangaphambili nangemva kwamathafula nsuku zonke yonke inqubo. Hlela ukukhonza kwamathafula njalo nokugcina amathafula nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Phatha ama-akhawunti phakathi kwe-Directorate: Water Resource Management Support nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Qhathanisa i-akhawunti ye-fleet ngezilinganiso ezivunyelwe nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Qhathanisa imibiko ye-BAS ne-SAP nembiko we-akhawunti. Cubungula isicelo sokucela ukuthengiswa kwesikhathi esifushane. Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza uma kwenzeke isheke imoto ukuze kutholwe enye. Lawula uphathe iyunithi yokuhamba. Ukuthengiswa kwamathafula ehhovisi lesifunda. Nikeza umbiko wenyanga zonke ngawo wonke ama-akhawunti e-fleet. Qinisekisa ukubonezwa okusebenzayo kokugcina isikhathi sokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukulawula kwe-fleet okusebenzayo kahle. Yenza umsebenzi wokuphathwa kwemoto, inkokhelo yegesi namanamathelisa emali kubahlinzeki bezinsiza. Hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba. Xhumana ne-ageksi yokuhamba ngemibuzo yokuhamba ehleliwe. Buka izidingo zokuhamba zedirekhate ukuze zihambisane nemali ebekelwe. Qinisekisa izinkokhelo nokuqhathanisa i-akhawunti ne-ageksi yokuhamba. Boneza ukugcina izindleko ngokuhamba kwamakhasimende, amagumbi, namaphulethi. Hlanganisa inqubo yokuhamba ubuke ukulandelwa ngokuhambisa uhlobo oluthize lokuthengiswa kwemoto. Lenga umbiko kubaphathi ngokulondolozwa kwezindleko, ukungahambi kahle, nezikhuthazo.

xh.title: Isekela loLawulo ekwenziweni kwemisebenzi (SUPPLY Chain
xh.summary: Umlawuli wokubhaliswa kokugqithisa nokulungelelanisa iifleet kwiziko leBoskop Hydrological Services, efunwa iGrade 12 nolwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade 12 okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo kuLawulo lwesupply chain luya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi kwimisebenzi ejwayelekileyo yolawulo. Ulwazi lolawulo lwe-ofisi nokungena kwedatha. Ukuba lilungu lokusebenza ngemowutara. Ulwazi olusetyenzayo lokusebenza ngamanani amaninzi ekhompyutha. Amakhono amabaliso okuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi lokuzinika inkathazo kumthengi nokubeka umthengi phambili, ukubhala kwamagama, nokuqamba iingxelo. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokungakhuselekanga. Ukuqamba kunye nokuqwalasela. Ulwazi kwinkqubo yobhaliso lwesetyenziso senkqubo samanzi kazwelonke. Ulwazi loMthetho weMithombo yaManzi, (Act 36 of 1998) namanye omathetho ahlobene. Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngokulungelelanisa iifleet nokubonelela ngeenkonzo kwi-ofisi zommandla nezengingqi (pool). Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iifleet ezikhoyo zibhalwe, zisetyenziswe ngokugqithisileyo, zigcinwe ngokupheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezichanekileyo ekunikweni kwezithuthi. Yenza iscreening phambi nangemva kokuhamba kwesithuthi ngosuku olunye ngalunye ngaloo hambo. Lungiselela ngokwesiqhelo ukwenziwa kwenkonzo yezithuthi nokulungiswa kwezithuthi kunye nababanikezeli benkonzo abafanelekileyo. Phatha i-akhawunti phakathi kweSebe: Ixhaso loLawulo lweMithombo yeManzi kunye nomnikeli wenkonzo. Lumkana i-akhawunti yefleet ngeembuyekezo ezivunyelwene kunye nomnikeli wenkonzo. Lumkana iingxelo zeBAS nezeSAP kwicala lesiteyitment se-akhawunti. Yenza isicelo sokufuna i-renta yexeshana. Thetha nomnikeli wenkonzo kwimeko yontsholobo ukubonelela ngesithuthi sesikhondo. Lawula uphathe iqela lothutho. Fumana izithuthi kwi-ofisi yephondo. Bonelela ngingxelo yango-nyanga ngeenkcukacha ze-akhawunti yefleet yonke. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngokusebenzayo ngesithuba sothutho. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lwefleet. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo malunga nolungiso, inkqubo yefuel nahlelo lokuhlawula komnikeli wenkonzo. Lungiselela izicwangciso zohambo. Thetha ne-ofisi yohambo ngezicwangciso ezilungisiweyo. Qapha iimfuno zohambo zesebe ukuze zihambelane nemigangatho yebhajeti. Qinisekisa iintlawulo nolungelelaniso lwe-akhawunti ne-ofisi yohambo. Yenza isithuba sokugcina iindleko ngokuphathwa kokurentwa kwezithuthi, indawo yokuhlala, neendlela zokuhamba. Lungiselela umgaqo-nkqubo wokuhamba uze ulawule ukutyotyelwa kwawo malunga nokusetyenziswa kweendidi ezithile zokurentwa kwezithutho. Hlenga ingxelo kabaphathi malunga nolondolozo lweendleko, iintshuko, neze exceptions.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk Production (TRANSPORT)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk responsible for fleet coordination and transport services at Boskop Hydrological Services Office.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or relevant qualification. Relevant experience in Transport services will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge in general clerical support services. Knowledge of office administration and data capturing. Computer literacy. Sound knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet applications. Good verbal and written communication skills. Practical experience in client orientation and customer focus, letter, and report writing. Accountability and ethical conduct. Planning and organising. Experience in the national water use registration process. Knowledge of the National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) and other relevant legislations. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Facilitation of fleet co-ordination and rendering services to regional and area offices (pool). Ensure that all available fleet vehicles are recorded, optimally utilised, and thoroughly maintained. Ensure that the correct procedures are followed on the issuing of vehicles. Conduct pre- and post-inspection of vehicles on a daily basis for every trip. Arrange regular vehicle servicing and vehicle maintenance with the respective service providers. Manage accounts between the Directorate: Water Resource Management Support and the service provider. Reconcile the fleet account with agreed tariffs with the service provider. Reconcile the BAS and SAP reports against the statement of account. Process the application for requisition of short-term rental. Liaise with the service provider in case of accident for provision of relief vehicle. Control and manage the transport unit. Procurement of vehicles for the provincial office. Provide a monthly status report on all fleet account. Ensure effective provisioning of transport reservation. Ensure effective and efficient control of fleet. Render administrative on maintenance, fuel remuneration and financial payments to service provider. Coordinate travel arrangement. Liaise with travel agency with the arranged bookings. Monitor travel needs of the directorate for compliance and alignment of budget. Verify payments and reconciliation of account with travel agency. Provide cost containment in terms with car hire, accommodation, and flight. Align the travel policy and monitor the adherence pertaining to the application on specified types of car hire. Compile report to management on cost savings, deviations, and exceptions.
