af.title: Administratiewe Klerk Produksie (VERVOER)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk verantwoordelik vir vlootkoördinering en vervoerdienste by Boskop Hidrologiese Dienste-kantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of relevante kwalifikasie. Relevante ervaring in vervoerdienste sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Kennis van kantooradministrasie en datavaslegging. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Deeglike kennis van woordverwerking en sigbladtoepassings. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Praktiese ervaring in kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus, brief- en verslagskrywing. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Beplanning en organisering. Ervaring in die nasionale watergebruikregistrasieproses. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet, (Wet 36 van 1998) en ander relevante wetgewing. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Fasilitering van vlootkoördinering en die lewer van dienste aan streeks- en area-kantore (poel). Verseker dat alle beskikbare vlootvoertuie aangeteken, optimaal benut en deeglik onderhou word. Verseker dat die korrekte prosedures gevolg word by die uitreiking van voertuie. Voer daagliks voor- en na-inspeksie van voertuie uit vir elke rit. Reël gereelde voertuigonderhoud en voertuigonderhoud met die onderskeie diensverskaffers. Bestuur rekeninge tussen die Direktoraat: Waterhulpbronbestuurondersteuning en die diensverskaffer. Vereenselwig die vlootrekening met ooreengekome tariewe met die diensverskaffer. Vereenselwig die BAS- en SAP-verslae teen die rekeningstaat. Verwerk die aansoek om повторно short-term huur. Skakel met die diensverskaffer in geval van 'n ongeluk vir die verskaffing van 'n noodvoertuig. Beheer en bestuur die vervoereenheid. Verkryging van voertuie vir die provinsiale kantoor. Verskaf 'n maandelikse statusverslag oor alle vlootrekeninge. Verseker effektiewe verskaffing van vervoerbesprekings. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende beheer van vloot. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning rakende onderhoud, brandstofvergoeding en finansiële betalings aan diensverskaffer. Koördineer reëlings vir reise. Skakel met reisagentskap met die gereëlde besprekings. Monitor reisbehoeftes van die direktoraat vir nakoming en belyning van begroting. Verifieer betalings en vereenselwiging van rekening met reisagentskap. Verskaf kostebeheer ten opsigte van motorhuur, akkommodasie en vlugte. Belyn die reisbeleid en monitor die nakoming met betrekking tot die toepassing op gespesifiseerde tipes motorhuur. Stel verslag aan bestuur op oor kostebesparings, afwykings en uitsonderings.

zu.title: Inkantshana Yophethe Izinto Zentengiso (TRANSPORT)
zu.summary: Inkantshana yophethe izinto ehlose ukwenza kube lula ukusetshenziswa kolunye uhlelo lwezimoto kanye namasevisi ezokuthutha eBoskop Hydrological Services Office.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seSenior/Grade 12 noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. Okuhlotshaniswayo ukubekephila kwentengiso ezokuthutha kuzoba yindlela ekungeza inzuzo. Ukuqonda mayelana namasevisi okwesekela angaphandle komnyango. Ukwazi ukuphatha ihhovisi kanye nokuqoqa ulwazi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ngokweqiniso izinhlelo zokucubungula amagama kanye nezinhlelo zespredshit. Amandla okukhuluma ngomlomo nokubhala kahle. Okuhlotshaniswayo okuphathwayo ekugxileni kulukhuni kanye nokugxila kumthengi, ukubhala amagama ayimpumputhe kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukuqashela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuyijwayele. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela kabusha. Okuhlotshaniswayo ekulandiseni inqubo yokubhalisa kwezokuthutha kwamanzi kazwelonke. Ukuqonda iNational Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) kanye nezinye izinto ezihambisana nayo. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwegunya.
zu.duties: Ukwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kolunye uhlelo lwezimoto kanye nokunikeza amasevisi ohhovisi abukhululekile bese nisebenzisa izimoto noma oyedwa kulonakele. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimoto ezitholakalayo zibhalisiwe, zisetshenziswa ngokugcwele, futhi zigcinwa kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambiswe nendlela ephathekayo ekunikeni izimoto. Hlola izimoto ngaphambi kanye ngemuva kokuzivakashela nsuku zonke ngamugqibeleleyo. Hlela ukwenziwa kwezimoto noma ukunakekelwa kwazo kuphathwe abantu abangenelela. Phatha ama-akhawunti phakathi kweDirectorate: Water Resource Management Support kanye nabantu abangenelela. Hlanganisa i-akhawunti yezimoto nezimali ezivunyelwene ngazo nabantu abangenelela. Hlanganisa imibiko yeBAS neSAP ngokumelene nesitatimende se-akhawunti. Hlela isicelo sokugidinga ukuthathwa kwamasbheshu ekhasho elifushane. Xhumana nabanikeli besevisi uma kunesikhathi sokungahambi ngakho ukunikwa izimoto okuyiputha. Lawula futhi uphathe isixuku sezokuthutha. Thenga izimoto zohhovisi lwesifundazwe. Nikeza imibiko yenyanga zonke ngemali yazo zonke izimoto. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezokuthutha ezihlolwe kahle. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokugcwele kwezimoto. Nikeza izinto eziphathwayo ekuhleleni ukunakekelwa, ukukhokha ukudla ngezimali ezenziwa ukukhokha kubahlinzeki. Hlanganisa izindlela ezihlolwe kahle zokuhamba. Xhumana nabantu abangenelela ukuthutha ngezikhathi ezihleliwe. Hlola izidingo zabo ekugidini ukuba kuhambisane nemali ekhishiwe. Qinisekisa ukukhokha kanye nokuhlanganisa i-akhawunti nohulumende abangenelela ekuthutheni. Yenza kwehlise imali ekuthatheni izimoto, ekulaleni nasekubheni. Hlanganisa inqubo yokuhamba kanye nokuhlolwa kwayo ekulandiseni uhlobo oluthile lokuthathwa kwezimoto. Hlela imibiko kubaholi mayelana neziqhwaphazini zimali, ekwehlulekeni, kanye nezinto ezingezanga zibhekwe.

xh.title: Clerk Wezolawulo Umveliso (IITHUTHO)
xh.summary: Inkonyana yesixhobo solawulo enoxanduva lokulungelelanisa ibhayisekhi kunye neenkonzo zothutho kwiOfisi yeDyunivesithi yeBoskop yeMininzi-gazi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade 12 okanye nesiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo. Amava ahambelana neenkonzo zothutho aya kubakho nzuzo enkulu. Ulwazi ngokuxhaswa kwemisebenzi ejolise ekuqokelelweni kolwazi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lofisi nokuthatha i-data. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olululo lokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokucwangcisa amagama nakule zokwenza iispeadsheet. Amakhono amabalwe e-afikelweyo nokubhala. Ulwazi ngokumkhusela iimfuno zabathengi, ukubhala iilettera, kunye neengxelo. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokungakhethiyo. Ucwangciso nokuhlelelwa ngokuthe ngqo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokubhalisa amanzi. Ulwazi lothetho olumiselwe ngokomthetho olukwaziyo, ikakhulukazi umthetho ojoliswe ekusebenziseni amanzi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngocinezelo.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ibhayisekhi nokunika inkonzo kwezofisi zommandla nezomcamango (kwindlu yobunikazi). Qiniseka ukuba yonke imithutho ekhoyo igcinwe, isetyenziswa kakuhle, kwaye igcinwe njalo. Qiniseka ukuba iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zilandelwa ekunikeni imithutho. Yenza ipekolo yaphambi nangemva kokuqhuba imoto yonke imihla ngomhla wokuqhuba. Lungiselela ukonakalisa imithutho njalo nokuyigcina inento ngenkonzo evela kumthengisi ogqithisayo. Phatha i-akhawhukthi phakathi komkhakha wolawulo lolwazi lwamanzi noinkonzo ezenziwa ngumthengisi ogqithisayo. Xhumanisa i-akhawthi yemithutho nenkokhelo ekwelwe ngayo nomthengisi ogqithisayo. Xhumanisa iingxelo zeBAS neSAP nge-akhawthi. Qhubelela phambili isicelo sokuyalela i-renta esheshiyo. Thetha nomthengisi ogqithisayo xa kunethuba lokungcoliswa kwemoto ukuze kufunyaniswe enye. Lawula kwakunye nokuphatha inkxaso yothutho. Thengisa imithutho kwezofisi zobumbano. Nikeza ingxelo yemihla ngemihla yonke imithutho ngesixhenxe. Qiniseka ukuba kwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo ibhukhwa yothutho. Qiniseka ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle imithutho. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo yokugcina, ukwenza inkonzo ngephetrolo nakwezimali ezikhokelwa kumthengisi ogqithisayo. Lungiselela iindawo ezithengiswa ngokubhalisa. Thetha neenkonzo ezithengisa izithuba ezithengisa iindawo ezikwaziyo. Qwalasela iimfuno zohambo lwengqungquthela ukulawula ulungelelwaniso lweMali. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kweenkonzo ezihamba nagama-akhawthi eziya kumthengisi ogqithisayo. Xelela iinkonzo ngeendleko ezincinisekileyo ezibangelwa ukuthengiswa kwakunye nokugcinwa kweendawo ezilungele ukuthengiswa. Hlanganisela iingqungquthela ngokulawula iingxelo ezimiselwayo kwaye ulawule ukulandelwa kweenkqubo ezimiselwayo ezifana nezabakhenkethi abanikezela iindawo. Hlanganisa iingxelo kwabaphathi ngokugcinwa kweendleko, iindlela ezisusweyo nakwezinye iinkqubo ezilungelelwe ukulawulwa.

Keep records of repaired equipment. Supervises subordinates and ensures that daily duties are completed effectively. Assist with housekeeping at DWS offices and infrastructure (i.e. grass cutting/cutting down trees/fire breaks).

af.title: Algemene Voorman
af.summary: Algemene Voorman benodig by Voelvlei-skema in Gouda vir die instandhouding van brongewaterinfrastruktuur, wat Graad 8 en 'n kode 10-bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 8 of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Hoër kwalifikasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Een (1) tot Twee (2) jaar se werkservaring. Bykomende jare se ervaring in die uitvoer van handearbeid sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke kode 10-bestuurderslisensie. Die volgende kennis en bevoegdhede word vereis: Basiese kennis van die beheer en bestuur van brongewaterinstandhouding op toerusting. Kennis van die werk aan verskeie algemene take en die hantering van toerusting en apparaat. Kennis van daaglikse instandhoudingsprosedures vir doeltreffende masjien/toerustingprestasie. Kennis van tuinmaak en kraggereedskap. Basiese kennis van beleidsimplementering. Basiese kennis van roetine-inspeksie van toerusting. Kennis van Arbeidsbeskermings- en Veiligheidsprosedures. Basiese dissiplinêre kennis in Openbare Administrasie. Basiese kennis van die ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterhulpbronstrategie. Basiese begrip van Regeringswetgewing. Goed toesig, kommunikasievaardighede en vermoë om in 'n spanomgewing te werk. Moet in staat wees om naby riviere, damme, kanale en in beperkte ruimtes te werk. Moet in staat en bereid wees om ander skemas en instandhoudingsteams te assisteer wanneer nodig rondom Western Cape. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.duties: Onderneem roetine-instandhouding aan kanale, sluite, meetstrukture. Hou strukture en hul omgewing skoon. Hou maatplaatjies skoon. Hou die oewerwal in goeie toestand. Skoon en onderhou gronde, herstel gereedskap en strukture soos geboue, heinings met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap. Bestuur vragmotor by die gestasioneerde skema asook na ander terreine binne die Western Cape-streek. Sny bome en gras op toonvlak op die oewerwal. Verwyder puin by inlate-uitlate strukture. Gate in die oewerwal moet aangemeld word. Stagnante water op die oewerwal en kanale moet aangemeld word. Skoonmaak van roosters op die kanaal. Soek na krake in meetstrukture en meld gebreke aan. Inspekteer en herstel heinings. Meld beskadigde toerusting aan ander diensverskaffers vir herstel. Hou rekords van herstelde toerusting. Oorsig ondergeskiktes en verseker dat daaglikse pligte doeltreffend voltooi word. Bystand met huishouding by DWS-kantore en infrastruktuur (d.w.s. grassny/boom sny/brandgordels).

zu.title: Induna Jikelele
zu.summary: Kudingeka Induna Jikelele e-Voelvlei Scheme e-Gouda ukugcina izinto zokwakha zokulethwa kwamanzi amakhulu, kudingwa ibanga le-8 nalayisensi yokuqasha yekhodi 10.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-8 noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho. Izifundo eziphakeme zizoba yinzuzo. Umuzwa wokusebenza owunyakeni (1) kuya kweminyaka emibili (2). Okunye okweminyaka yokuzwelana nomsebenzi wezandla kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokuqasha yekhodi 10 egunyaziwe nengaphelelwa yisikhathi. Kudingwa ulwazi olulandelayo nokukwazi: Ulwazi olusobala lokulawula nokuphathwa kokugcina kwezinto zokulethwa kwamanzi amakhulu kumshini. Ulwazi lokusebenza emisebenzini yonke kanye nokuphathwa kwemishini nezinto zokusebenza. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nsuku zonke yemishini/izinto zokusebenza ukuze kusebenze kahle. Ulwazi lokulima izinkambiso kanye namathuluzi amandla. Ulwazi olusobala ekuqalisweni kwamasu. Ulwazi olusobala ekuhloleni imishini njalo. Ulwazi lwenqubo yeMpilo Nokuphepha Emsebenzini. Ulwazi olusobala ekuqondeni iNqubo e-Mphathwa. Ulwazi olusobala ekusekeleni ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi noma inqubo yamathombo amanzi. Ukuqonda okusobala ngomthetho kahulumeni. Ukukwazi ukulawula abanye, ikakhono lokuxhumana kanye nokuba ngcono ekubumbaniseni iqembu. Kudingeka ukukwazi ukusebenza eduze kwemifula, amasibi, amafuwe kanye nasemizileni ethile. Kudingeka ukuba ukwazi futhi uzitsha ukusiza amanye emasimi kanye namaqembu okulungisa lapho kudingeka khona e-Western Cape. Ilayisensi yokuqasha egunyaziwe iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukulungisa okujwayelekile emafuwe, ezivulvalweni, nasemisakazweni yokulinganisa. Ukugcina izakhiwo kanye nendawo ezingqongile zicoce. Ukugcina amapuleti okulinganisa acoce. Ukugcina onke izintaba zomhlabathi zisemqoka. Ukucumba nokulondoloza izindawo, ukulungisa amathuluzi nezakhiwo njengezindlu, okubakwe izandla namathuluzi amandla. Ukuqasha ithraki esibayeni nasezinye izindawo eziku-Western Cape. Ukusika izihlahla kanye noboya emgodini wezintaba. Ukukhipha izinto ezingezinhle kumakho woNgenisa naphuma. Amathambo ezintaba kumele abikwe. Amanzi aqothwe ezintabeni nasemafuweni kumele abikwe. Ukucamba kwesiqu emafuwe. Ukubuka imiqondo emiyalo yokulinganisa ibikwe. Ukubuka nokulungisa okubakwe. Ukubikela imishini engakhiwa kwezinye izinkonzo ukulungise. Ukugcina ukulungiswa kwemishini egcinwe. Ukulawula abasebenzi kanti bafe ukwenza umsebenzi wansuku zonke ngempumelelo. Ukusiza ekugcineni indlu ema-DWS kanye nokuqashaniswa (okungukuthi, ukusika uboya/ukusika izihlahla/ukwenza izibambo).

xh.title: General Foreman
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-General Foreman kwi-Voelvlei Scheme e-Gouda ukugcina iziseko zokubonelela ngamanzi amakhulu, kwaye kufuneka abe negreyidi 8 nelayisensi yokushayela ikhowudi 10.
xh.requirements: Ireyidi 8 okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ireyidi ephezulu iya kuba ngomdla olongezelelekileyo. Eyoku (1) kuni (2) iminyaka yamava lokusebenza. Iminyaka engaphezulu yamava kumsebenzi wokusetyenzwa kweenyawo iya kuba ngomdla olongezelelekileyo. Ukuzisa ilayisensi yokushayela ikhowudi 10 esebenzayo engaphelelwa lixesha. Kulandela ulwazi namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ekulawuleni nasekolulweni kokugcinwa kolwabiwo lwamanzi amakhulu kwisixhobo. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kumsebenzi jikelele nokuphatha iisixhobo nezixhobo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokugcinwa yemihla ngemihla yenza imo esebenzayo kumashini/isixhobo. Ulwazi ngezixhobo zokwenza udonga lwetyhula namandla. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo kumalawulo asebenzayo ekupheneznini. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ekuhloleni isixhobo njalo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yezaNtloko nezoKhuseleko ekuSebenzini. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo kuBalo lukaRhulumente. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ekuxhaseni ukusetyenziswa kwamanza nomgaqo-nkqubo wamathafa amanzi. Ukuqonda okusetyenzwayo kwimithetho kaRhulumente. Ukulawula kakuhle, amakhono ekuhamba kwemiyalezo nokuze ukwazi ukusebenza kwimeko yeqela. Makakwazi ukusebenza kufutshane nemilambo, iindam, iindlela zamaza amanzi nakuwo wonke amabango. Makakwazi akube sengathi unomdla wokuncedela kolunye ulwabiwo nokuze amaqela okugcina ukuba kuyimfunko apho nakweyiphi na kwiNtshona Koloni. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo iyafuneka.
xh.duties: Kwenza ukugcinwa njalo kwindlela zamaza amanzi, iitsalisi, izakhiwo ezilinganisa. Ukugcina izakhiwo nendawo ejikele izo zicoce. Ukugcina iplaati ezingamagagadu zicoce. Ukugcina onke amapha ukuze abe kwimo elungileyo. Ukucoca nokugcina amabala, ukulungisa izixhobo nezakhiwo ezinjengakakho nziyo ezenza ngokusetyenziswa ngezandla nangamandla. Ukushayela ilori kulwabiwo ekuhlala kulo ukwade kwezinye iindawo kwicala leNtshona Koloni. Ukusika iinkuni namatyi kwesithuba sephaphu. Ukususa amatyholo kwizakhiwo ezingenisa naseziphumo. Amathafa kwibala kufuneka axelwe. Amanzi angenamandla ephaphu nakule minelleda kufuneka axelwe. Ukucothaza kwamaza amanzi. Ukukhangela umonakalo kwiindonga. Ukutshintsha iindonga ezingahlanjulwanga. Ukuhlola nolungisa imigangatho. Ukuba nahlele isixhobo. Ukugcina iiresiti zokulungiswa kwesixhobo. Uncedo kwimeko yokukhohlisa; kwaye ngelixa lomnye wokubonelela imali kukumbathwa yomsebenzi woluntu. Nokunye ncedo ngendlela ezingangenwa.

jobs.title: Water Control AID
jobs.summary: Water Control AID at Voelvlei Scheme in Gouda, managing water distribution, collecting hydrological data and performing minor maintenance on government water works.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 2 or relevant qualification. One (1) year work experience in water related functions will serve as an added advantage. The disclosure a valid unexpired Code B driver’s licence. Good verbal, writing, reading, and communication skills. Basic Knowledge in controlling and managing the Water distribution for all government water works. Ability to read measuring gauges and record water level. Ability to read water meters, record measurements, and complete logbook sheets accurately. Basic understanding in Occupational Health and Safety. Basic knowledge of flood control. Basic understanding of record keeping.
jobs.duties: Opening and closing of sluices according to scheme regulations, collection of hydrological data. Handling the Water distribution sheet according to scheme regulation. Preform minor maintenance of structures, fencing, and sluices. Assist with opening blocked pipes and canals. Remove of algae and water grass in canals regularly. Conduct daily routine inspection on section. Holes in embankment must be reported to Water Control Officer. Look for cracks in measuring structures and report detects. Stagnant water on embankment must be reported. Clean the area around the post boxes. Keep canal grids, sand traps, and outlet structures clean. Keep gauge plates clean. Keep structure clean and their surroundings. Keep embankment in good condition. Clean intake towers, weirs, and meter houses. Safe keeping equipment and property. Must be able to assist other schemes and maintenance team around Western Cape. Assist with housekeeping at DWS offices and infrastructure (i.e. grass cutting/cutting down trees/fire breaks).

af.title: Waterbeheer AID
af.summary: Waterbeheer AID by Voelvlei-skema in Gouda, bestuur waterverspreiding, versamel hidrologiese data en voer geringe instandhouding aan regeringswaterwerke uit.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF vlak 2 of relevante kwalifikasie. Een (1) jaar werkervaring in waterverwante funksies sal as 'n voordeel dien. Bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke Code B-bestuurslisensie. Goeie mondelinge, skriftelike, lees- en kommunikasievaardighede. Basiese kennis in die beheer en bestuur van waterverspreiding vir alle regeringswaterwerke. Vermoë om meetmeters af te lees en waterpeil aan te teken. Vermoë om watermeters af te lees, metings aan te teken en logboekvelle akkuraat in te vul. Basiese begrip van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Basiese kennis van vloedbeheer. Basiese begrip van rekordhouding.
af.duties: Oopmaak en toemaak van sluite volgens skemaregulasies, insameling van hidrologiese data. Hanteer die waterverspreidingsblad volgens skemaregulasie. Voer geringe instandhouding van strukture, omheinings en sluite uit. B help met die oopmaak van geblokkeerde pype en kanale. Verwyder gereeld alge en watergras in kanale. Voer daaglikse roetine-inspeksie op seksie uit. Gate in walwerke moet aan die Waterbeheerbeampte aangemeld word. Soek na krake in meetstrukture en meld gebreke aan. Stagnante water op walwerke moet aangemeld word. Maak die area rondom die posbusse skoon. Hou kanalarosters, sandvange en uitlaatstrukture skoon. Hou peilmeterplate skoon. Hou strukture skoon en hul omgewing. Hou walwerke in goeie toestand. Maak inlaat torings, oorloope en meterhuise skoon. Veilige bewaring van toerusting en eiendom. Moet in staat wees om ander skemas en instandhoudingspanne rondom Western Cape by te staan. Bied hulp met huishouding by DWS-kantore en infrastruktuur (d.w.s. grassny/boomkap/brandbane).

zu.title: I-Water Control AID
zu.summary: I-Water Control AID e-Voelvlei Scheme e-Gouda, ephathe ukusatshaliswa kwamanzi, ukuqoqa idatha yezamanzi nokwenza ukulungisa okuncane kumsebenzi wezamanzi kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 2 ehambisanayo noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Unyaka (1) owodwa womsebenzi ohlobene namanzi uzoba yinzuzo. Ukuvezwa ikhadi lesiqukathi lesiB elisebenzayo nengakapheli. Amakhono ahle okukhuluma, ukubhala, okufunda, nakokusazisa. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ekulawulenweni nasekuphateni ukusatshaliswa kwamanzi kuso sonke isakhiwo sezamanzi kahulumeni. Ikhono lokufunda amajaji okulinganisa nokubhalisa izinga lamanzi. Ikhono lokufunda amamitha amanzi, ukubhalisa izilinganiso, nokugcwalisa amakhasi ekhodi ngokunembile. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngoZempiro yeMpilo Nokuphepha. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngolawulo lwamanzi abandayo. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngokugcina amarekhodi.
zu.duties: Ukuvula nokuvala amasokhwezi ngokusho kwezimiso zesiklamo, ukuqoqa idatha yamanzi. Ukuphatha ikhasi lokwabiwa kwamanzi ngokusho kwezimiso zesiklamo. Ukwenza ukulungisa okuncane kwezakhiwo, izibali, namasokhwezi. Ukusiza ekuvuleni uthiobjwe amaphayiphu namakhanali. Ukukhipha amafuzi namanani emanzini emakhanalini njalo. Ukwenza ukuhlola okujwayelekile nsuku zonke esigabeni. Izimbobo ezikumgqeni wempahla kumele zibikwe kunoMlawuli Wokulawula Amanzi. Buka umonakalo ophukileyo kwezakhiwo ezilinganwayo ubike. Amanzi azele kumgqeni wempahla kumele abikwe. Cwasha indawo ejikeleze amabhokisi aposi. Gcina amagridi ekhanali, izivali zesihlabathi, nezakhiwo zokuphuma zicocekile. Gcina amapuleti okulinganisa acocekile. Gcina izakhiwo zicocekile kanye nendawo ezingqonge. Gcina umgqeni wempahla usebenza kakuhle. Cwasha izinthonya zokufaka, amaphondo, namakhaya okulinganisa. Ukugcina impahla nepropathi ngokuphephile. Kumele ukwazi ukusiza amanye amaklamo neqembu lokulungisa ejikeleze iWestern Cape. Usiza ukulungisa izindlu emakantoroni eDWS nasolwakhiwo (okungukuthi ukushoba ubutshani/ukusika izihlahla/okuhambisana nomlilo).

xh.title: Ulawulo lweNdlela yoNcedo lwaManzi
xh.summary: Ulawulo lweNdlela yoNcedo lwaManzi kwiSikimu saseVoelvlei eGouda, ukulawula ukusabalalisa kwamanzi, ukuqokelela iindatha ezimayela namanzi nokwenza izigqibo ezincinci kumsebenzi osemthethweni wakarhulumente wamanzi.
xh.requirements: Iqondo elithile elalingana ne-NQF level 2 okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava omsebenzi kumisebenzi ehambelana namanzi uya kuba lusizi olongezelelekileyo. Ukuvula ilayisenisi yokushayela evisiweyo, eze nayo igqithiswa ixesha elidelweyo ethi Code B. Amakhono amhle okuthetha, okubhala, okufunda, nokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi olusiseko ekulawuleni nokulawula ukusabalalisa kwamanzi kumasebenzi onke akarhulumente wamanzi. Ukwazi ukufunda okulinganisa kwaye urekhode inqanaba lamanzi. Ukwazi ukufunda iimeter zamazi, urekhode izilinganiso, aze agqibeze ngokuchanekileyo amaphepha e-logbook. Ukuqonda okusiseko ngeMigaqo yoKhuseleko lweMisebenzi. Ulwazi olusiseko ngolawulo lamanzi amakhulu. Ukuqonda okusiseko ngokugcina iirekhodi.
xh.duties: Ukuvula nokuvala i-sluisis ngokweemigaqo yesikimu, ukuqokelela iindatha ezimayela namanzi. Ukuphatha iphepha lokusabalalisa kwamanzi ngokweemigaqo yesikimu. Ukwenza izigqibo ezincinci kuzakhiwo, ootsho, nase sluisini. Ukuncedisa ekuvuleni iipayipi ezivaliweyo nakumanzi amaninzi. Ukususwa kwe-algae nengca yamanzi kumanzi amaninzi njalo. Ukwenza ukhangelo lweemini zonke kwicandelo. Amabungu kumonakalisiwe mabenikwe isaziza kuLawuli woManyano lwaManzi. Kufunke kubekho ukukhangela iindonga eziphukileyo kwizakhiwo ezilinganisa kwaye kubikwe ngazo. Amanzi alo ndawo anganamanzi kumagqabi mabenikwe isaziza. Ukucotha indawo ejonge koomarhombe beposi. Ukugcina amagridi amanzi, izibiyela esigxininisisa ulwathi, nezakhiwo zokuphuma zicothiwe. Ukugcotha amapuleti okulinganisa. Ukugcina izakhiwo zicothiwe nendawo ezijikeleze zona. Ukugcina amonakalisiwe esimo esilungileyo. Ukugcotha iindonga zokuthatha amanzi, i-weir, nasezindlwini zeemitha. Ukugcina ngokukhuselekileyo isixhobo nepropati. Kufuneka akwazi ukuncedisa amanye amasikimu kunye neqela labakhuseli kwindawo yaseWestern Cape. Ukuncedisa ekugcineni indlu kwezoDwAphu eziyiofisi zikaDWS nakwiloxwe (okt. ukusika ingca / ukusika iihlahla / izithuba zomlilo).

af.title: Algemene Storesassistent
af.summary: Algemene Storesassistent by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Standerton, wat NQF Level 1 en een jaar se winkel- of pakhuiservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF Level 1. Een jaar ervaring in 'n winkel- / pakhuisomgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van gesondheids- en veiligheidsprosedures. Kennis van winkelonderhoud, ontvangs en uitreikingspraktyke. Basiese begrip van Regeringswetgewing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om onder toesig te werk. Onafhanklik, in 'n span en onder druk.
af.duties: Ontvang en versprei voorraad en materiaal. Bestuur voorraaduitreiking en -beheer. Onderhou akkurate dokumentasie en verslagdoening. Verseker veilige en georganiseerde berging. Koördineer voorraadlogistiek en steunbedrywighede.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezimpahla Jikelele
zu.summary: Umsebenzi ongum ncane kwimfashini ekwindlu kazwelonke yamaza nokuhlanzwa kwindawo yokuphuza eStanderton, idinga i-NQF Level 1 kanye nesisikhathi esisodwa sezenzo zokulawula izitolo noma izinkomba zamaphakethe.
zu.requirements: I-NQF Level 1 ehambelana nale ndima. Unyaka owodwa wokuhlola emondeni wesitolo noma esikhungweni sezimpahla. Ukulandisa ilayisensi yokuqasha ehamba phambili futhi engakapheli kuzoba yinzuzo eyedwa. Ulwazi ngenqubo yezempilo nokuphepha. Ulwazi ngokugcinwa kwesitolo, ukwamukela nokukhishwa kwezimpahla. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho kahulumeni. Amandla okuxhumana kahle (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo). Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo. Ngokwezedwa, eqenjini futhi ngaphansi kwegxabo.
zu.duties: Yamukela futhi wabelane ngempahla nezinto zokwakha. Lawula ukukhishwa kwenempahla nokulawula inempahla. Gcina ukushaywa kwemibhalo ngokunembile nokubika. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okuphephile nokuhleliwe. Lungisa amalogistic enempahla futhi usekele imisebenzi yokuphatha.

xh.title: Umntwana oNcedisayo kwiNtlobo Esebenzayo kwiSitore
xh.summary: Umntwana oNcedisayo kwiNtlobo Esebenzayo kwiSitore kwiSebe leZamanzi nokuQhutywa kwiSitore kwiNtlobo Esebenzayo eStanderton, efunaNQF Level 1 kunye neminyaka elinye yamava onke womsebenzi oqhutywa kwiKhusi eliyintoni ekuphakanyiswayo.
xh.requirements: EzifanelekileyoNQF Level 1. Unyaka omnye wamava kwimeko yendawo yokugcina izinto. Ukuvuza ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo engaphelelwa lixesha kuya kuba lusisongezo. Ulwazi ngendlela ezempilo nakhuselwa. Ulwazi ngokuqhuba indawo yokugcina izinto, ukungenisa kwaye nokupha ezokwenza ngokwenziwe. Ukuqonda okusesiqu ngeNgalo kaRhulumente. Amandla okunxibelelana ngokubhalisa nakunokuwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo. Ngokuzimeleyo, kwindyebano nakuxinzelelo.

Qinisekisa imisebenzi egcinwa kakuhle kwaye yenziwe ngendlela. Lawula isikqubo semisebenzi yamalungiselelo kwaye ncedise ngokusebenzisa imisebenzi.

jobs.title: Tradesman AID (ELECTRICAL)
jobs.summary: Assist electrical artisans with maintenance, repairs and servicing of facilities, vehicles and equipment at Jericho Dam, requiring an NQF Level 3 qualification and six months' trade-related experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of an NQF level 3 qualification (Grade 10 or relevant qualification). Six (6) months trade-related experience in electrical maintenance. Knowledge of machinery repairs, service, and maintenance. Knowledge of hand tools and power tools. Basic knowledge in maintenance of infrastructure and managing the water distribution for government water scheme. Basic knowledge in policy implementation. Good technical problem- solving abilities. Basic knowledge of Government policies. Basic knowledge in Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS Act). Basic knowledge in understanding of Government procurement systems. Good interpersonal relations.

Carry tools and equipment and keep them in a good condition. Ability to carry out manual duties and receive instructions from supervisor. Willingness to perform other related duties. Loading and off-loading. Adhere to Occupational Health and Safety Act.

af.title: Ambagsman HULP (ELEKTRIES)
af.summary: Bied hulp aan elektriese ambagsmanne met die onderhoud, herstel en diens van fasiliteite, voertuie en toerusting by Jericho Dam, wat 'n NQF Level 3-kwalifikasie en ses maande se handelverwante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n NQF level 3-kwalifikasie (Graad 10 of relevante kwalifikasie). Ses (6) maande handelverwante ervaring in elektriese onderhoud. Kennis van masjienherstel, diens en onderhoud. Kennis van handgereedskap en kraggereedskap. Basiese kennis van onderhoud van infrastruktuur en bestuur van waterverspreiding vir regeringswaterskema. Basiese kennis van beleidstoepassing. Goeie tegniese probleemoplossingsvermoëns. Basiese kennis van regeringsbeleid. Basiese kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS Act). Basiese kennis en begrip van regeringsverkrygingstelsels. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Verskaf hulp met die onderhoud van fasiliteite, voertuie en toerusting Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om elektriese ambagsmanne by te staan in die uitvoering van onderhoudspligte, herstelwerk, skoonmaak, diens en veilige bewaring van toerusting en gereedskap volgens standaarde van die masjinerie en elektriese installasies in verskeie damme, reservoirs, pomptasies en pyplyne. Bystand en ondersteuning bied aan die Artisan en ander tegniese personeel in die uitvoering van meganiese/elektriese dienste wat die volgende insluit: onderhoud en herstelwerk aan toerusting en inspeksies uitvoer op gereedskap en toerusting nadat dit van take terugkeer. Dra gereedskap en toerusting en hou dit in 'n goeie toestand. Vermoë om handwerk take uit te voer en instruksies van toesighouer te ontvang. Bereidwilligheid om ander verwante pligte uit te voer. Laai en aflaai. Hou by die Occupational Health and Safety Act.

zu.title: I-Tradesman AID (ELECTRICAL)
zu.summary: Siza abahlinzi abangasesandleni kagesi ekugcineni, ukulungiseni nasekuhogelelweni kwemisebenzi, izimoto nezisetshenziswa e-Jericho Dam, kudingeka ifaneleka ngesikhundla se-NQF Level 3 futhi abe nezinyanga eziyisithuphu ezihlobene nomsebenzi wokuhlinza.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kumele babe nesifundo se-NQF level 3 (Grade 10 noma ifaneleka ngendlela ehambisana nalokhu). Zinyanga eziyisithupha (6) zokuhlinza okuhlobene nasekulungiseni izinto zagesi. ULwazi mayelana nokulungisa, ukuhogela kanye nokugcina imishini. ULwazi ngamathuluzi angesandla namathuluzi amandla. ULwazi oluyisisekelo ekugcineni izakhiwo nasekuphathweni kokusatshalaliswa kwamanzi kahulumeni ohlelweni lwamanzi. ULwazi oluyisisekelo ekuqalisweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ikhono elihle lokuxazulula izinkinga ngobuchwepheshe. ULwazi oluyisisekelo ngezinhlelo kahulumeni. ULwazi oluyisisekelo ku-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS Act). ULwazi oluyisisekelo ekuqondeni izinhlelo zokuthenga kahulumeni. Izinga elihle lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu.
zu.duties: Nikela usizo ekugcineni izakhiwo, izimoto nezisetshenziswa Umuntu okhethiwe uzodingeka ukuba asize abahlinzi abangasesandleni kagesi ekwenziweni kwemisebenzi yokugcina, ekulungiseni, ekweni ukuhlolelwa kohlelo kanye nokugcina izisetshenziswa namathuluzi ngokumiswa kwemishini nezinto zokufakela kagesi emadamini ahlukene, amantankale, iziteshi zamapompo nasemigwaqweni yamanzi. xh.title: Umncedisi wobugcisa (ELECTRICAL)
xh.summary: Nceda abagcisi bambahle ngolondolozo, izilungiso nesevicayo yezikhululo, iimoto nemibono e Jericho Dam, kufuneka ube nesidanga se-NQF Level 3 nendalo yamaveyi amathandathu ehambelana nobugcisa.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesidanga se-NQF level 3 (Grade 10 okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo). Amathandathu (6) amaveyi ohlu lobugcisa kulondolozo lwamaza. Ulwazi ngezilungiso, isevicayo nolondolozo lwezixhobo. Ulwazi ngezixhobo zezandla nolwazi ngamandla ezixhobo. Ulwazi olusesiqu ngolondolozo lweziseko zoluntu nolawulo lokusasaza amanzi koluhlelo lwamanzi lukarhulumente. Ulwazi olusesiqu ngokuqalwa kweenkqubo. Iakhondo ezilungileyo zokuxazulula iingxaki ngokobuchwephetha. Ulwazi olusesiqu ngeenkqubo karhulumente. Ulwazi olusesiqu nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS Act). Ulwazi olusesiqu ngokuqonda iinkqubo zoluthengiso karhulumente. Ubudlelwane obulungileyo phakathi kwabantu.

Nceda axhasa umgcisi nabanye abantu basebuchwephetha ekwenzeni iinkonzo ezinobugcisa/yamaza ezibandakanya oku kulandelayo: ulondolozo nezilungiso kwezixhobo ukwenza iingqwalasela kumathulusi nezixhobo emva kokubuyela kumsebenzi. Thwala izixhobo namathulusi uzigcine zikwikondisi elilungileyo. Iakhondo yokwenza imisebenzi ngesandla nokuamkela imiyalelo kumlawuli. Ilungelelaniswa lokwenza eminye imisebenzi ehambelana nale. Ukulayisha nokukhupha. Lithobele i-Occupational Health and Safety Act.

Okulandelayo ulwazi namakhono adingekile: Ulwazi lokusebenza emisebenzini yonkana kanye nokuphatha izisetshenziswa nezinto zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngesisetshenziswa sezolimo okuhlanganisa inqubo yokunakekelwa kwensimbi namakhono adingekile (inqubo namasu okusika kanye nokuhlela). Ulwazi lokusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali (ukubilisa/ukuxuba) kanye nolwazi ngemikhiqizo yamakhemikhali. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokunakekelwa kwansuku zonze ukuze kusebenze kahle izisetshenziswa. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ekukeni inkambiso yokusebenzisa amanzi nenhlahlqondo yemithombo yamanzi. Ulwazi lwenqubo yezempilo nokuphepha. Ulwazi lonakekelwa lwesimo sendawo kanye nokutshalwa kwemifuno. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho kahulumeni. Amakhono okukhuluma kahle kanye nokukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza eduze noma esibhakabhakeni semifula, amadamu, namakhandlela, kanye nasemiyalweni ekhawule. Kufanele ukwazi futhi ukuzimisela ukusiza eminye imiklamo namaqembu okunakekelwa uma kudingeka. Kufanele ukhonze isikhathi, ukhiqize, futhi ube nokuzinikela. Ukukhuluma kahle kanye nokuxhumana nabanye.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi ulondoloze imijuda ulungise izinsimbi kanye nezakhiwo ezinjengamakhaya, okhuninini okhiwe ngezinsimbi. Sika izitshalo bese usebenzisa izitshajantshani. Sika imithi nobuhlanti ngokulinganisa phansi. Susa amablanti namatshana emibanjeni, kwezimisebenzi, nama-drains. Susa izinto ezibambe isikhathi namashoji amade. Susa izinto ezingatholakali ngaphandle noma ngaphakathi. Bukela futhi ulungise okhuninini. Susa okuqediwe kwezimisebenzi eziqamula imithi. Gcwala futhi uxinze amakhefu endlela ebya ibanga. Gcwala futhi uxinze amakhefu ongqam. Susa izinto ezingaphakathi kwesithebe esingeziwe. Hlanza izisetshenziswa. Bika ngemishini nokusetshenziswa ephukile.

xh.title: Umgcini wemimandla
xh.summary: Isithuba somgcini wemimandla kwi-Scheme ka-Voelvlei kwingingqi yaseNtshona Kapa esifuna isatifikethi se-ABET, sinika umvuzo we-R144 024 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-Level 02.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-ABET okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuba nenqanaba lokuqhelana lokusebenza elinguziro (0) ukuya kolunye (1) unyaka. I Disclosure yelayisenisi elisebenzayo elingatshintshanga yekhowudi B. Iminyaka eyongezelelweyo yamava kwinkqubo yokwenza umsebenzi ngezandla iya kuba luncedo. Oku kulandelayo ngolwazi nakhono okufunekayo: Ulwazi lokusebenza kumaxesha amaninzi emisebenzi jikelele nokuphatha izixhobo nezinto ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi ngezixhobo zokulima indlu kwakunye nenkqubo yenkathalo kwezitshathi nakhono abafunekayo (inkqubo namacebo okusika nokuthunga). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhemikhali (ukunciphisa/ukudibanisa) nolwazi ngeemveliso zekhemikhali. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuhlala kwaye zilungisele iinsuku zokwenza ukuba izixhobo/umsebenzi usebenze kakuhle. Ulwazi olusesikweni lokuxhasa indlela yokusebenzisa amanzi namacebo okugcina amanzi. Ulwazi ngeenkqabo zempilo nakhuselo lokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngenkxaso yendlu yokulima nokubhala iinkqubo zokulima. Ukuqonda okusesikweni ngemithetho yoLuntu. Amakhono amatsha okuthetha nonxibelelwano nokuqaqelelana ukusebenza eqeleni. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza kufuphi okanye kumanzi, kumaxhoba, nakumanzi amatsha, nakwindawo ezivaliweyo. Kufuneka ukwazi kwaye ufune ukuncedisa ezinye iindlela namaqela okulungisa xa kuyimfuneko. Kufuneka ube ngumntu ozigcoba ngexesha, ovela ngemveliso, onesithembu. Unxibelelwano oluhle nokubakho kweentsingisano phakathi kwabantu.
xh.duties: Ukucotha kwaye ugcine imimandla ulungise izixhobo nezakhiwo ezinjengezindlu, izikrawu, nokusebenzisa izixhobo zesandla. Ukusika utyani nokufaka i-herbicide. Ukusiza iinkuni nettshathi kwinqanaba lesandla kumathafa. Ukucima iindityalho netyeba kwiibhrige, kumanzi, naku-suppers. Ukusula iindityalho zeenti nokuqhuba amanzi amade. Ukususa iindityalho ezikumnyango wamanzi- kwindlu yokuphuma. Ukuphonononga nokulungisa izikrawu. Ukusula iindityalho zendlu yamanzi. Ukugcwalisa nokuxinza iindawo ezinamathuba ngumgama wokufikelela. Uku gcwalisa nokuxinza iindawo ezinamathuba kumathafa. Ukususa iindityalho ezikwindlu yamanzi. Ukucoca izixhobo. Ukuxela ngezixhobo ezingasebenziyo nezinye izixhobo.

jobs.title: General Worker
jobs.summary: General worker position at De Mist Kraal Dam performing grounds maintenance, cleaning, loading and offloading tasks.

Knowledge of working on various general work including lawn care process. Knowledge of pruning, trimming process and techniques. Basic knowledge of chemical use (dilution / mix) chemical product. Basic knowledge of daily maintenance procedures for efficient machine / equipment performance. Basic knowledge in supporting water utilisation and water resource strategy. Basic knowledge of health and safety procedures. Basic understanding of Government legislation.
jobs.duties: Perform general assistant work. Load and off load furniture, equipment, and any other goods to relevant destination. Clean government vehicles. Clean relevant workstations. Cutting of grass and cleaning pavements. Cutting and stockpiling of trees.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to candidates from the geographical area. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the posts of Assistant Director: Auxiliary Services Ref No: 301026/19 and Personal Assistant Ref No: 301026/38, advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 37 dated 16 October 2026, have been withdrawn. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Algemene Werker
af.summary: Algemene werkerposisie by De Mist Kraal Dam wat grasonderhoud, skoonmaak, laai-en-aflaaitake uitvoer.
af.requirements: 'n ABET-sertifikaat. Hoër kwalifikasies sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van algemene werk in die hantering van toerusting en apparaat. Kennis van werk aan verskeie algemene take insluitend die grasversorgingsproses. Kennis van die snoei- en knipproses en tegnieke. Basiese kennis van chemikaliegebruik (verdunning / mengsel) chemiese produkte. Basiese kennis van daaglikse onderhoudsprosedures vir doeltreffende masjien / toerustingprestasie. Basiese kennis van die ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterbronstrategie. Basiese kennis van gesondheids- en veiligheidsprosedures. Basiese begrip van Regeringswetgewing.
af.duties: Voer algemene assistentiewerk uit. Laai en laai meubels, toerusting en enige ander goedere na die onderskeie bestemming af. Skoon regeringsvoertuie. Skoon onderskeie werkstasies. Sny van gras en skoonmaak van sypaadjies. Sny en opstaap van bome.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi jikelele e De Mist Kraal Dam sokwenza ukugcinwa kwesigaxa, ukucisha, ukufaka kanye nokukhipha ukuphakelwa.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-ABET. Izinga eliphezulu lemfundo lizoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi jikelele ekuphatheni izisetshenziswa nezinsiza. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi jikelele ohlukahlukene kufaka phakathi inqubo yokunakekelwa kwensimu. Ulwazi lwenqubo namakhono okusika kanye nokuhlelwa kwezihlahla. Ulwazi olusisisekelo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto zezikhali ukubulala izitshwala / ukuxuba imikhihzo. Ulwazi olusisisekelo lwezindlela zokunakekelwa nsuku zonke ukuze kusebenze kahle izinsiza. Ulwazi olusisisekelo ngokusekela ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi namacebo okugcina amanzi. Ulwazi olusisisekelo ngemiyalo yokugcina umphilo. Ukuqonda okusisisekelo ngomthetho kahulumeni.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi jikelele yokusiza. Ukufaka futhi ukukhipha ifenitshala, izinsiza nanoma yiphi impahla endaweni ehambisana nayo. Ukugeza izimoto kahulumeni. Ukugeza iziteshi zokusebenza ezifanele. Ukusika uhlobo kanye nokuhlanzwa kwezindlela zokuhamela. Ukusika nokugcina izihlahla.

xh.title: Omsebenzi Jikelele
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi jikelele kwi-De Mist Kraal Dam somsebenzi wokuhlala indalo, ukucoca, ukulayisha nokukhuphela iimphahla.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-ABET. Izinga eliphezulu lemfundo liza kuba ngumoncedo. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi jikelele ekusebenziseni izixhobo nezinto ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kumisebenzi jikelele ehlukahlukeneyo kuquka nenkqubo yokunakekelwa kwegazi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuqhwesha, nokusika iintyatyambo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi olusesingeni malunga nokusebenzisa iimveliso zezichemo (ukuthabatha / ukuxuba) iimveliso zezichemo. Ulwazi olusesingeni malunga neenkqubo zokunakekelwa yonke imihla ukunika isigqibo esichanekileyo kwimifanekiso / isixhobo. Ulwazi olusesingeni malunga nokuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi nomgama wokugcina amanzi. Ulwazi olusesingeni malunga neenkqubo zempilo yomzimba nokhuseleko. Ukuqonda okusesingeni malunga nemithetho kahulumeni.
xh.duties: Kwenziwe umsebenzi wongenelelo jikelele. Kulayishwe kwaye kukhutshelwe ifanitsha, izixhobo, nakunye na amagugu kwindawo echanekileyo. Kucotywe izithuthi zikahulumeni. Kucotywe iindawo zokusebenza ezifanelekileyo. Kusitywe utyhidi kwaye kucotywe iindawo zokuhamba. Kusitywe kwaye kugcinwe iindulu zemi hlambo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Corporate Support Services
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (level 11), all-inclusive remuneration package
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026 (16:30 walk ins and 00:00 on email)
jobs.summary: The Presidency seeks a Deputy Director to manage corporate support operations, facilities, accommodation and auxiliary services at level 11 in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus an appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/ or National Diploma OR an equivalent qualification on NQF level 6. A minimum of 3-4 years’ applicable middle managerial experience. Knowledge of facilities management, accommodation and household services, auxiliary services, transport, procurement and asset control. Good managerial, leadership, decision-making, planning, organising and problem-solving skills. Financial management, resource management and operational planning skills. Excellent written and oral communication. Planning and organising. Service delivery. Client service. Ability to function independently without supervision. Loyalty/honest. Computer literate. Research. Presentable. Reporting. Accommodation & household management. Personnel management. Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary services and manage matrix reporting arrangements.
jobs.duties: Corporate Support Services: Manage and coordinate corporate support operations, planning, service standards and reporting in Cape Town. Accommodation and Facilities: Oversee accommodation, maintenance, housekeeping, catering and hospitality services, liaising with DPWI and service providers. Auxiliary and Transport Services: Oversee reception, messenger, frontline, switchboard, transport and driver services. Supply Chain and Asset Management: Coordinate procurement and ensure effective asset control and compliance in Cape Town Office. ICT and HRM Support: Coordinate regional ICT and HRM support with the relevant Union Buildings directorates/units. Coordinate logistical, catering, ICT, transport and facilities support for high- level meetings and events in Cape Town. Governance and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with legislation, policies, OHS, Internal Security requirements and audit actions, while managing operational risks. Stakeholder Management: Liaise with internal directorates, DPWI and service providers, monitoring service delivery and performance. People and Resource Management: Supervise designated Assistant Directors and manage staff performance and available resources. Matrix Coordination and Reporting: Coordinate services with Union Buildings directorates, resolve operational challenges and escalate matters requiring management intervention.
jobs.applications: The Presidency, Private Bag X1000, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at Government Avenue, Union Buildings, Pretoria or by email: applications@presidency.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms K Maubane
jobs.notes: NB: Email applications must on the subject line state only the Reference number: DDCSS/PRES/2026 (with no spaces) Applications must include only Two (2) documents (a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) website link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a detailed Curriculum Vitae). ONLY shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of Identity Document, Grade 12 Certificate and the highest required qualifications as well as a Driver’ s licence where necessary, to Human Resources on or before the day of the interview. Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’ s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report when requested. Please ensure that your application reaches the Department before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Due to the large number of applications expected, correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only, applications will however be acknowledged by auto response. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department be affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: The Department reserves the right not to fill a position. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, which may include social media profiles of the shortlisted candidates and pre-employment screening to determine the suitability of a person for employment. Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered during / after the interview took place, the application will not be considered and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The successful candidate will be subjected to reference checks and a security clearance up to the level of “Top Secret” as well as enter into a performance agreement. In addition, the successful candidates may be required to disclose their financial interests depending on their job. OTHER POST

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: The Presidency soek 'n Onderdirekteur om korporatiewe ondersteuningsbedrywighede, fasiliteite, akkommodasie en hulpdienste op vlak 11 in Cape Town te bestuur.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus 'n gepaste Bachelor's Degree/ of National Diploma OF 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6. 'n Minimum van 3-4 jaar se toepaslike middelbestuurservaring. Kennis van fasiliteitebestuur, akkommodasie en huishoudelike dienste, hulpdienste, vervoer, verkryging en batesbeheer. Goeie bestuurs-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings-, beplannings-, organiserings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede, hulpbronbestuur en operasionele beplanningsvaardighede. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Beplanning en organiserings. Dienslewering. Kliëntediens. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder toesig te funksioneer. Lojaal/eeu. Rekenaarvaardig. Navorsing. Aanvaarbaar. Verslagdoening. Akkommodasie- en huishoudelike bestuur. Personeelbestuur. Vermoë om multidissiplinêre dienste te koördineer en matriksverslagdoeningsreëlings te bestuur.
af.duties: Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste: Bestuur en koördineer korporatiewe ondersteuningsbedrywighede, beplanning, diensstandaarde en verslagdoening in Cape Town. Akkommodasie en Fasiliteite: Hou toesig oor akkommodasie, onderhoud, skoonmaakdienste, etes- en gasvryheidsdienste, in oorleg met DPWI en diensverskaffers. Hulp- en Vervoerdienste: Hou toesig oor onthaal, boodskapper-, voorlyn-, skakelbord-, vervoer- en bestuurdersdienste. Voorsieningsketting en Batesbestuur: Koördineer verkryging en verseker effektiewe batesbeheer en nakoming in Cape Town Kantoor. ICT en HRM Ondersteuning: Koördineer streeks- ICT- en HRM-ondersteuning met die tersaaklike Union Buildings direktorate/eenhede. Koördineer logistieke, etes-, ICT-, vervoer- en fasiliteitsondersteuning vir hoëvlakvergaderings en -geleenthede in Cape Town. Bestuurs- en Risikobestuur: Verseker nakoming van wetgewing, beleide, OHS, interne sekuriteitsvereistes en ouditaksies, terwyl operasionele risiko's bestuur word. Belanghebbendebestuur: Skakel in met interne direktorate, DPWI en diensverskaffers, monitor dienslewering en prestasie. Menslike en Hulpbronbestuur: Hou toesig oor aangewese Adjunkdirekteurs en bestuur personeelprestasie en beskikbare hulpbronne. Matrikskoördinering en Verslagdoening: Koördineer dienste met Union Buildings direktorate, los operasionele uitdagings op en eskaleer aangeleenthede wat bestuursingryping vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi OnguMongameli: Isevisi Zokusekela Ezenkampani
zu.summary: URhulumente ufuna Umphathi OnguMongameli okuphatha izimisebeli zokusekela zenkampani, izinto, indawo yokuhlala nezinsizakalo ezibuswayo ezingeni 11 eCape Town.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samatrikulensi esiphezulu kahle kanye ne-Degree ye-Bachelor efanelekile/ noma i-Diploma Yezwe Noma iziqu ezulinganayo ezingeni 6 le-NQF. Okungenani ungomzuzu oyi-3-4 wemisebenzi ephakathi komphathi. Ulwazi ngokuphatwa kwezinto, indawo yokuhlala nezinsizakalo zasekhaya, izinsizakalo ezibuswayo, ukuthutha, ukuthenga nokulawula impahla. Amakhono amahle okuphatha, ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo, ukucubungula, ukuhlela nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuphatha imali, okuphatha izinsiza nokuhlela izindlela zokusebenza. Ukuxhumana okuhle ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulunywa. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Isevisi yabathengi. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kokulawulwa. Ukuzinikela/ukwethembeka. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucwaninga. Ukubukeka kahle. Ukubika. Ukuphathwa kwendawo yokuhlala nezasekhaya. Ukuphatha izisebenzi. Ikono lokuhlanganisa izinsizakalo eziningi futhi kuphathwe izimbalamadi zokubika.
zu.duties: Isevisi Zokusekela Ezenkampani: Phatha futhi uhlanganise izimisebeli zokusekela zenkampani, ukucubungula, izindinganiso zenkonzo nokubika eCape Town. Indawo Yokuhlala Nezinto: Qaphela indawo yokuhlala, ukugcina, ukusiza endlini, ukupheka kanye nezinsizakalo zokwamukela izivakashi, uxhumane ne-DPWI nezinikezeli zezinsizakalo. Izinsizakalo Ezibuswayo Nokuthutha: Qaphela ukwamukela, ukuletha imiyalezo, isevisi ebusweni, i-switchboard, ukuthutha nezinsizakalo zabashayeli. Ukuthenga NokuLawula Iketshi Lemali: Hlanganisa ukuthenga futhi uqinisekise ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kwempahla nokuhambisana nemithetho eOfisini yaseCape Town. I-ICT Nokusekela I-HRM: Hlanganisa ukusekela kwe-ICT ne-HRM yendawo namadilijenti/amingo avela kwa-Union Buildings. Hlanganisa ukusekela ukuletha izinto, ukupheka, i-ICT, ukuthutha nezinto kumihlangano nezikhathi eziphakeme eCape Town. Ukulawula Nokuphatha Izingozi: Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, i-OHS, izidingo zokuvikela ngaphakathi nezinyathelo zokuqasha, ngenkathi uphepha izingozi zokusebenza. Ukuphatha Abasebenzisi: Xhumana namadilijenti angaphakathi, i-DPWI nezinikezeli zezinsizakalo, ulawule ukulethwa kwenkonzo nokusebenza. Abantu NokuLawula Izinsiza: Lawula oMphathi oBaKho futhi uphephe ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nezinsiza ezikhona. UkuHlanganisa Amabalambu Nokubika: Hlanganisa izinsizakalo namadilijenti avela kwa-Union Buildings, uxazulule izinkinga zokusebenza uphinde ukhuphule izinto ezifuna ukungenelelwa kukaphathi.

xh.title: Isekabaphathi: Iinkonzo zoXhaso lezeNhlangano
xh.summary: I-Presidency ifuna uSekabaphathi ukulawula iziphithiphithi zonxibelelwano lwezinhlangano, iziseko, indawo yokuhlala nezinkonzo ezongezelelweyo kwinqanaba 11 eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu kahle ngesidanga seBachelors/ okanye i-Diploma yaseMzantsi Afrika OK iziqu ezalinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF 6. Okungenani unyaka wama-3-4 wamava abalulekileyo abalawuli abaphakathi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweziseko, indawo yokuhlala nezinkonzo zasekhaya, ezinkonzo ezongezelelweyo, ezothutho, lokuthenga nolawulo lwempahla. Amabalance abalulekileyo, abaphathi, abathatha izigqibo, abacekileyo, abahleli kwaye banobulo kumathuba. Ulawulo lwemali, ulawulo lwamathuba nokucekiswa kweziganeko. Ukubhala nethetha kakuhle. Ukucinga nokuhlela. Ukuletha inkonzo. Inkonzo yabathengi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo ngaphandle kolawulo. Intembeko/qqinisekileyo. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Uphando. Kubonakala kakuhle. Iinkcazelo. Ulawulo lwendawo yokuhlala nasekhaya. Ulawulo labasebenzi. Ikhono lokulungelelanisa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo nolawula iinkcazelo zematriksi.
xh.duties: Iinkonzo zoXhaso lweNtlalo: Lawula nolungelelanisa iziphithiphithi zonxibelelwano lwezinhlangano, ukuhlehla, amagqabo enkonzo neenkcazelo eCape Town. Indawo yokuhlala neeNkalo: Qonda indawo yokuhlala, ukulungisa, ukugcina indlu, ukutya nokwamkela iindwendwe, unxibelelwano ne-DPWI nabanikezeli benkonzo. Iinkonzo ezingezizo eziyimfuneko nokuThutha: Qonda ukwamkela, abathunywa, iinkonzo zaphambili, i-switchboard, ukuthutha nikonzo zabashayeli. Umthombo oHamba phambili nokuLawula iMpahla: Lungelanisa ukuthenga ukuqinisekisa ukulawula kweempahla ngokusebenza kakuhle kwaye ngokwemigaqo eCape Town Office. I-ICT nokuNxibelelanisa kwe-HRM: Lungelanisa inkxaso ye-ICT yemimandla nese-HRM namadirectorates/units e-Union Buildings aphilileyo. Lungelanisa inkxaso yokuthutha, ukutya, i-ICT, ezothutho neziseko kwindibano yamabanga aphezulu nemiqobo yembali eCape Town. I-ICT nokuLawulwa kweZendlu neNgcinezelo: Qonda ukuphumelela kwemigaqo, i-ICT, ne-NQF level 6. Okungenani amava emisebenzi yabalawuli abaphakathi angama-3-4 eminyaka. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweziseko, ukwendlala nasekhaya, iinkonzo ezongezelelweyo, ukuthutha, ukuthenga nokulawula impahla. Amakhono obulawu, bokukhokela, bokuthatha izigqibo, bokucinga, bokuhlela nokuqonda iingxaki. Amakhono obulawu bemali, obulawu bethemba nokuhlela iziganeko. Ukubhala nokuquula ngokusuka nje. Ukucinga nokuhlela. Ukuletha iinkonzo. Iinkonzo zabathengi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngazak ubani ngaphandle kokulawulwa. Intshisho/qqinisekile. Ukubhala ngekhompyutha. Uphononongo. Kubonakala ngokwemveliso. Iingxelo. Ulawulo lokwendlala nasekhaya. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ikhono lokulungelelanisa iinkonzo ezongqamaniyo nokulawula iingxelo zematrixi kwilayini elithile yomsebenzi nethamsanqa eliqinisekileyo lokuyisebenzisa ubuchule obuhle eCape Town. Iingxelo zobuLawu beGqwetha: Qinisekisa ukutyikitywa ngokwemigaqo yaseKho, izicwangciso, izicwangciso zokuQinisekisa iNgqondo, izicwangciso zokuQinisekisa iNgqondo eNgaphakathi nezicwangciso zokuhlola, ukulawula ingozi yemisebenzi yonke. Iingxelo zobuLawu bemiQondiso: Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwemigaqo yomthetho, iinkqubo, i-OHS, iimfuno zoKhuzeleko langaphakathi nezinyathelo zokuhlolwa, ngelixa ulawula iingozi ezisebenzayo. Ulawulo bemiQondiso: Qinisekisa ukubambisana nabalawuli baseCape Town kunye nabahlobo bomthetho weCape Town Office kwi-ICT kunye ne-HRM Support. Lungelanisa inkxaso yokuhamba, ukutya, i-ICT, ukuhamba neziseko kwindibano yamabanga aphezulu nemiqobo eCape Town. Ulawulo kwaye ulawule iingozi: Qinisekisa ukulandwa komthetho, iinkqubo, i-OHS, iimfuno zoKhuseleko langaphakathi nokuqaliswa kwezinyathelo zokucinga, ngelixa ulawula iingozi zokusebenza. Ulawulo lweSazinda: Thintathanta namadala ekhaya lezo ziseko kunye ne-DPWI, ilawula ulawulo lwemali nokusebenza kahle kwezi seko eCape Town. Ulawulo lwamathambo abantu nabo bahlaziyo: Lawula ukulawulwa kokusebenza komntu wonke kunye nezinto eziphila zikaCape Town Office kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwe-ICT kunye namadala e-Union Buildings kwi-Cape Town Office nazo zonke izinto ezifunwa kumzi kaCape Town Office. Ulawulo ngokulandela iMithetho: Qonda ukwendlala nokuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kwemali eCape Town Office. Ulawulo lweStakeholder: Thintathanta namaphandle kunye nangaphakathi ezo ziseko, i-DPWI kunye nabahlinzeki bekhaya abakwaziyo, ulawula ulawulo lwemali nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kokuthutha eCape Town. Ulawulo lweNtlangano nobuLawu: Lungelanisa ulawulo lweziseko zakhaya kunye namadala e-Union Buildings abo, kwaye qonda nokusombulula iingxaki zangaphakathi nangaphandle ezisebenzayo ezisebenza ngokulawula, ulawule ukugqithiswa kolawulo emthethweni womntu wonke, iingozi zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo nezinye iingozi ezinokubakho, ngelixa ulawula iimfuno ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza eCape Town. Ulawulo lokusingathwa kweNtlangano nokuLawula ukusebenza: Qhuba nokusingatha ulawulo lwabasebenzi baseCape Town Office kunye nendlela yokusebenza i-ICT nokuLawula nokuhambisana kwamathamsanqa e-Cape Town Office abakwaziyo nokusebenza kakuhle kwelinye iqonga le-ICT kunye nendlela yokuhamba ngokulawulwa kwamathamsanqa kwindibano yamabanga aphezulu eCape Town nasekuqwalaselweni kwezinyathelo zokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nezithintela ezinokubakho ekuqwalaselweni kwendlela yokusebenza kwe-ICT yamathamsanqa eCape Town Office.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: District Coordination &
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum. (Level 15), (all-inclusive remuneration package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion of 30% that may be structured in terms of applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement within three months after assumption of duty.
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-General for District Coordination in the Eastern Cape Department of Education, overseeing quality teaching and learning implementation across public schools and ECD centres.
jobs.requirements: An appropriately recognised bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 8) in Public Administration, Public Management, Financial Management, Supply Chain Management, Resource Management, Education Management, Infrastructure Management, Governance, Business Administration or a related field. A postgraduate qualification at NQF Level 8 or higher in any of the aforementioned fields will serve as a strong recommendation. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Service (SMS) Pre-Entry Programme and possession of a valid driver's license (except for persons with disabilities). A minimum of eight (8) years of experience at a Senior Managerial Level within the public sector, of which substantial experience must have been gained in school resourcing, institutional support services, physical resource management, infrastructure planning, financial management, risk management, educational operations, budget management and service delivery oversight. Competencies: The successful candidate must demonstrate extensive knowledge of public sector governance, education policy, institutional operations and resource management. The incumbent must possess strong strategic leadership capabilities with a proven ability to provide executive oversight of large-scale resource allocation, school resourcing and institutional support systems. A sound understanding of the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Division of Revenue Act, risk management frameworks and corporate governance principles is essential. The candidate must demonstrate advanced capabilities in financial management, strategic planning, policy development, programme oversight, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder management and organisational performance management. Strong analytical, decision-making, communication, negotiation and change leadership skills are required, together with the ability to drive accountability, compliance and service delivery improvement within a complex public sector environment.
jobs.duties: Oversee implementation of policy framework for provisioning of quality teaching and learning in public, Special schools and ECD Centres of Eastern Cape Province. Ensure the coordination of consistent implementation of standard /uniform mode of operation for teaching & learning in public schools of Eastern Cape. Ensure implementation intervention and tools supporting quality curriculum delivery in schools. Ensure implementation of school management and governance legislation, policies and procedures in public and special schools in Eastern Cape. Ensure coordination intergovernmental relation processes to ensure all education district offices are positioned for optimal service delivery. Coordinate the provision of technical support for education district functionality. Oversee provisioning and guidance on implementation of policy framework for Physical Resource Management in Eastern Cape Schooling system in line with the Division of Revenue Act. Ensure coordination of physical resource planning services. Ensure the provisioning of infrastructure delivery services. Provide strategic guidance in development and monitoring of Disaster Recovery Plans impacting Eastern Cape Public and Special Schools. Ensure accountability, monitoring and reporting on Infrastructure Grant Framework in Eastern Cape public, Special schools and ECD Centres. Oversee implementation of policy framework for school resourcing and administration. Ensure planning and budgeting for school resourcing needs including Learner Teacher Supporting Materials, school furniture etc. Ensure the coordination on the implementation of policy and regulations for the administration of home schooling, public ordinary, independent, special schools and Early Childhood Development Institutions. Ensure coordination and management of policy and regulation for School Management and School Governing Bodies (SGB’s). Ensure functionality and viability of public ordinary, special schools and ECD Institutions. Oversee provisioning of leadership and guidance in supporting systems for delivery of quality education system in Eastern Province. Ensure provision of school mapping services, revitalisation of schools and rural education. Ensure management of facilitation of planning for school extension and new school implementation. Ensure provisioning Quality Promotion Standard education research and data analytics. Ensure implementation of Education Management Information system in all public & Special Schools. Ensure management & evaluation interventions, learner attainment improvement strategy (LAIS) and vacation schools. Manage the allocated resources of the Branch in line with legislative and departmental policy directives and comply with corporate governance and planning imperatives. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeously development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. SA Maasdorp Tel No: (040) 608 4200 For e-Recruitment Enquiries, Email: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za (under Careers) and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00- 16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews.
