af.title: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal: Distrikskoördinering &
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal vir Distrikskoördinering in die Eastern Cape Department of Education, wat toesig hou oor die implementering van gehalte-onderwys en -leer in openbare skole en ECD-sentra.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike erkende bachelorsgraad (NQF Vlak 8) in Public Administration, Public Management, Financial Management, Supply Chain Management, Resource Management, Education Management, Infrastructure Management, Governance, Business Administration of 'n verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 8 of hoër in enige van bogenoemde velde sal as 'n sterk aanbeveling dien. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Service (SMS) Pre-Entry Programme en besit van 'n geldige bestuurslisensie (behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede). 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring op 'n Senior Bestuursvlak binne die openbare sektor, waarvan aansienlike ervaring opgedoen moes gewees het in skoolbrontoerusting, instellingsondersteuningsdienste, fisiese hulpbronbestuur, infrastruktuurbeplanning, finansiële bestuur, risikobestuur, opvoedkundige bedrywighede, begrotingsbestuur en diensleweringsopsig. Bevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet uitgebreide kennis van openbare-sektorbestuur, onderwysbeleid, instellingsbedrywighede en hulpbronbestuur toon. Die ampshouer moet oor sterk strategiese leierskapsvermoëns beskik met 'n bewese vermoë om uitvoerende toesig oor grootskaalse hulpbrontoewysing, skoolbrontoerusting en instellingsondersteuningstelsels te verskaf. 'n Deeglike begrip van die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Division of Revenue Act, risikobestuursraamwerke en korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels is noodsaaklik. Die kandidaat moet gevorderde vermoëns in finansiële bestuur, strategiese beplanning, beleidsontwikkeling, programtoesig, monitering en evaluering, belanghebbende-bestuur en organisatoriese prestasiebestuur toon. Sterke analitiese, besluitneming-, kommunikasie-, onderhandelings- en veranderingleierskapsvaardighede word vereis, tesame met die vermoë om verantwoordelikheid, nakoming en diensleweringsverbetering binne 'n komplekse openbare-sektuurbestuur te drywe.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die implementering van 'n beleidsraamwerk vir die verskaffing van gehalte-onderwys en -leer in openbare, Spesiale skole en ECD-sentra van Eastern Cape Province. Verseker die koördinering van konsekwente implementering van standaard/uniforme werksmetodes vir onderwys en leer in openbare skole van Eastern Cape. Verseker die implementering van intervensies en instrumente wat gehalte-kurrikulumaflewering in skole ondersteun. Verseker die implementering van skoolbestuurs- en bestuurswetgewing, beleide en prosedures in openbare en spesiale skole in Eastern Cape. Verseker die koördinering van intergovernmental relation-prosesse om te verseker dat alle onderwysdistrikkantore vir optimale dienslewering geposisioneer word. Koördineer die verskaffing van tegniese ondersteuning vir onderwysdistriksfunksionaliteit. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing en leiding van die implementering van 'n beleidsraamwerk vir Fisiese Hulpbronbestuur in die Eastern Cape-skoolstelsel in ooreenstemming met die Division of Revenue Act. Verseker die koördinering van fisiese hulpbronbeplanningsdienste. Verseker die verskaffing van infrastruktuurafleweringsdienste. Verskaf strategiese leiding in die ontwikkeling en monitering van Disaster Recovery Plans wat Eastern Cape Public en Special Schools raak. Verseker verantwoordelikheid, monitering en verslagdoening oor die Infrastructure Grant Framework in Eastern Cape openbare, Spesiale skole en ECD-sentra. Hou toesig oor die implementering van 'n beleidsraamwerk vir skoolbrontoerusting en -administrasie. Verseker beplanning en begroting vir skoolbrontoerustingsbehoeftes insluitend Learner Teacher Supporting Materials, skoolmeubels ens. Verseker die koördinering van die implementering van beleid en regulasies vir die administrasie van huisonderwys, openbare gewone, onafhanklike, spesiale skole en Early Childhood Development-instellings. Verseker die koördinering en bestuur van beleid en regulasies vir Skoolbestuur en Skoolbeheerliggame (SGB's). Verseker die funksionaliteit en lewensvatbaarheid van openbare gewone, spesiale skole en ECD-instellings. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van leierskap en leiding in ondersteuningstelsels vir die aflewering van 'n gehalte-onwyssisteem in Eastern Province. Verseker die verskaffing van skoolkarteringsdienste, die herstigting van skole en landelike onderwys. Verseker die bestuur van die fasilitering van beplanning vir skooluitbreiding en die implementering van nuwe skole. Verseker die verskaffing van Quality Promotion Standard-onderwysnavorsing en data-analitiek. Verseker die implementering van die Education Management Information-stelsel in alle openbare en Spesiale Skole. Verseker die bestuur en evaluering van intervensies, learner attainment improvement strategy (LAIS) en vakansieskole. Bestuur die toegewysde hulpbronne van die Tak in ooreenstemming met wetgewende en departementele beleidsriglyne en voldoen aan korporatiewe bestuurs- en beplanningsimperatiewe. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstaande werk lewer in terme van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimale leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywings en implementering van Werkplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker die bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates.

zu.title: INduna-KaMbhali: Ukulungiselelana Kwesifunda &
zu.summary: INduna-KaMbhali kuKulungiselelana Kwesifunda eMnyangweni wezemfundo wase-Eastern Cape, obhekene nokuphathwa kokufundisa nokufunda okunomsoco kuyo yonke izikole zomphakathi nabezikhungo ze-ECD.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor's degree (NQF Level 8) ezifanelekile ezibhalwe ngazi ku-Public Administration, Public Management, Financial Management, Supply Chain Management, Resource Management, Education Management, Infrastructure Management, Governance, Business Administration noma noma yisiphi isigaba esihlobene. Izeqembu lokuphuma esikoleni esingaphezulu eNQF Level 8 noma ngaphezulu kunoma yisiphi esabalule esinikezelwe ngaphambili sizoba yincomo eqinile. Ukuqeda ngemvelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Service (SMS) Pre-Entry Programme nokuba nelayisense lokushayela okusemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ukuphothulwa okuncane kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) yohlelo lwesigaba se-Senior Managerial Level ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sabantu, lapho kumesipho okukhulu kumele kutholwe ekunikeni izinsiza ezikoleni, kulezeinsiza zokwesekwa kwezikhungo, ekuphathweni kwabezinsiza ezingokwesabekayo, ekuhlelweni kolwakhiwo, ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuphathweni kwezingozi, kusezinhlelweni zemfundo, ekuphathweni kwebhajethi nasekuqwalaseleni ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ikhono: Oqeqeshiwe kumele abonise ulwazi olwandisiwe mayelana nokubusa kwesikhungo sabantu, inqubomgomo yemfundo, imisebenzi yezikhungo nokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Lowo ohlezi kulesi sikhundla kumele abe nokuhlakanipha okuqinile ekukhokheleni ngesobala ngamandla ikhono lokunika ukulawula okuphezulu kokwabiwo kwezinsiza ezinkulu, ukunikwa kwezinsiza ezikoleni kanye nezinhlelo zokwesekwa kwezikhungo. Kuwubude obuhle ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Division of Revenue Act, izingxoxo zokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nemigomo yokubusa komphakathi. Oqeqeshiwe kumele abonise amandla aphezulu ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuhlelweni ngesobala, ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo, ekuqwalaseleni ohlelweni, ekubukweni nokuhlaziya, ekuphathweni kwabanikazi bengxoxo nakokuphathwa kwenkompi. Amakhono okuhlaziya, okuthatha izinqumo, okuxhumana, okuxoxisana nokushintsha izikhokheli ayadingeka, kanye n ikhono lokukhuthaza ukubophezela, ukuvumelana nokuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwezinsiza ngaphakathi kwezimo ezibucayi zesikhungo sabantu.
zu.duties: Bhekana nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokunika izingxenye zokufundisa nokufunda okunomsoco ezikoleni zomphakathi, ezikoleni zabantu abakhubazekile nabezikhungo ze-ECD esifundazweni sase-Eastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelana kokusetshenziswa okuhambisanayo kwezindlela ezijwayelekile/zokulinganayo zokusebenza ukufundisa nokufunda ezikoleni zomphakathi zase-Eastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokungenelela nezinsiza eziyisixhosi ezikwesekwa ukulethwa kwezifundo ezinomsoco ezikoleni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwegazethi yokuphathwa kwezikole nokubusa, izinqubomgomo kanye neziNdikwana ezikoleni zomphakathi nabezikhubazekile e-Eastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelana kwezinqubo zokuhlobana phakathi kahulumeni ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi wonke amagosi esifunda semfundo abekwe kahle ukuze alethe izinsiza ngokugcwele. Lungiselelanisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ukuthi isifunda semfundo sisebenze kahle. Bhekana nokunikwa kwezinsiza nokuqondiswa kokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza ezingokwesabekayo esimweni sezikole sase-Eastern Cape ngokuvumelana ne-Division of Revenue Act. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelana kwezinsiza zokuhlela izinsiza ezingokwesabekayo. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza zokwakhiwa. Nikeza ukuqondiswa ngesobala ekuthuthukiseni nakubukweni kweZinhlelo ZokuBuyisela Ezenziwe ezithinta Izikole Zomphakathi Nabezikhubazekile zase-Eastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukubophezela, ukubuka nokubika ngakho Konke uMthetho wokuNikela ngeMali weNqolobana ezikoleni zomphakathi, ezikoleni zabantu abakhubazekile kanye nabezikhungo ze-ECD e-Eastern Cape. Bhekana nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokunikela izikole ngezinsiza nokuphathwa. Qinisekisa ukuhlela nokubajetha izidingo zezinsiza zezikole kubandakanya Izinsiza ZokuNikela Othisha NabeFundi, ifenitshala yezikole njll. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelana kokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo kanye neMithetho yokuphathwa kokufundisa ekhaya, izikole zomphakathi ezijwayelekile, ezingazimele, ezikoleni zabantu abakhubazekile kanye nabezikhungo be-ECD. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelana nokuphathwa kwenqubomgomo kanye noMthetho wokuPhathwa kweZikole kanye Nezikhulu eZiPhatha Izikole (SGB's). Qinisekisa ukusebenza nokuphumelela kwezikole zomphakathi ezijwayelekile, ezikoleni zabantu abakhubazekile kanye nabezikhungo be-ECD. Bhekana nokunika abakhokheli nokuqondisa ekuhlesenizeni izinhlelo zokuletha izinhlelo zemfundo ezinomsoco esifundazweni sase-Eastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza zokumakha izikole, ukuvuselelwa kwezikole kanye nemfundo yasemaphandleni. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kokuqondisa ukuhlela okwandisa izikole nokuqalisa izikole ezintsha. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kweNqubo eNtanta yokuKhuthaza iNqubo yokufunda nokucwaninga idatha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kweNqubo yoKwaziswa nokuPhathwa kweMfundo kuyo yonke izikole zomphakathi nabezikhubazekile. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokuhlolwa kwezinhlelo zokungenelela, isu lokuthuthukisa ukuphumelela kwabafundi (LAIS) kanye nezikole zeholide. Phatha izinsiza ezinikezwe igatsha ngokuvumelana nemithetho kanye neziNdikwana zenqubomgomo kanti futhi uhambisane nokubusa nokuhlela okudingekayo. Giba izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu/isigaba sikhiqiza umsebenzi omuhle ngokobungako/balinganiso nangesikhathi. Xazulula izinkinga zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngokuqondiswa okuncane okuvela kumkhokheli. Nikeza abasebenzi imisebenzi ngokwesipho sabo bese unikeza ukuqondiswa nokwesekwa okudingekayo, ubanikeze abasebenzi ithuba lokuzifundela nokuthuthukiswa okwanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi izincazelo zomsebenzi zithuthukiswa ngesikhathi kanti futhi kuqaliswe amaplani okusebenza kanye namaplani okuzithuthukisa (PDP's) kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Phatha ukuphumelela kwabasebenzi nsuku zonke ukuze uqinisekise ukubukwa ngokushesha ukuphumelela kwabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokusindwa kwempahhala.

xh.title: Isekela lephini leJenerale: Uqoqosho lweZithili &
xh.summary: Isekela lephini leJenerale koQoqosho lweZithili kwiSebe lezemfundo leEastern Cape, elibukelela ukusebenza kwemfundo nokufundisa ekhwalithi ephakamileyo kumanzele abafundi abakhawulezileyo nakuqoqosho lwemfundo yakwanenkq年轻.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokungabambelela esivunywe ngokufanelekileyo (NQF Level 8) kwiNtengiso kaBantu, uLawulo lokuQonda, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweNqela lokuQokelela, uLawulo lweMithobo, uLawulo lweMfundo, uLawulo lweZakhiwo, ulawulo oluzimeleyo, iNtengiso yeShishini okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Isidanga esingaphezulu kwesidanga sokungabambelela (NQF Level 8) okanye ngaphezulu kuyo nayiphi na kwezi ndawo ngasentla kuya kuba ngumcebisi onamandla. Ukugqiba ngokuphumeleleyo iNkqubo yeNyukela Public Service Senior Management Service (SMS) Pre-Entry Programme nokuba negunya lokushuka (ngaphandle kweemeko zabantu abakhubazekileyo). Okungenani iminyaka yamashumi asibhozo (8) yamava kwinqanaba loMphathi oPhakamileyo kwisebe loluntu, apho kufuneka kube khona amava amakhulu kumaziko emfundo, iinkonzo zokuxhasa, ulawulo lwemithobo, uqoqosho lwezinto ezifuneka, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lweengozi, imisebenzi yemfundo, uqoqosho lweemali nokuqwalasela inkonzo ezisetyenziswayo. Ukuzithembisa: Umfundi ofanelekileyo kufuneka abonise ulwazi olubanzi ngolawulo lweqondo loluntu, iNqumbela yemfundo, imisebenzi yoqoqosho ulawulo lwemithobo. Isikhundla kufuneka sibe namandla okubeka iNkqubo iNkokheli eqinisekileyo ekunikeni ulawulo olubanzi lokumisela imithobo, amaziko emfundo noqoqosho oluxhasa iNkqubo yoluntu. Kuqhelekile ukuba nomfundo oqondileyo we-Public Finance Management Act, iTreasury Regulations, i-Division of Revenue Act, iNkqubo yokuLawula iingozi nemiGaqo yoLawulo iNkampani. Umfundi kufuneka abonise ukuzinikela ngokumangalisayo kulawulo lweMali, uqoqosho lokuQamba iNkqubo, ukuQamba iNqumbela, ukuQwalasela iNkqubo, ukuQwalasela nokulinganisa, uLawulo lweQela labantu, ulawulo loQoqosho lwemisebenzi. Kufuneka ube namandla okuQonda ngokubanzi, ukwenza iZigqibo, ukuXhumanisa, ukuXhelana, ukuTshintsha uLawulo lweNkosi kuphela, kunye namandla okuQhuba iNkqubo yokubambelela kwaye, ulawulo nokukhulisa iNkonzo kwindawo ethile ekubeni iqondo loluntu.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kwemigaqo yeNkqubo yonikezelo lweMfundo nokufundisa iNkqubo ethileyo, iNkqubo yeZikolo eZinzima nokuQeqesha iNkqubo yamantyantya kwiNgingqi yaseEastern Cape Province. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungelelana kokuSebenza ngokungathandabuziyo kwendlela eqhelekileyo yokusebenza kwemfundo nokufundisa kwizinhlangothi zaseEastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kokungenelela nezixhobo ezixhasa iNkqubo yokuNikezela iMfundo ngekhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukusebenza komthetho wolawulo wesikolo, iNqumbela nokuQwalasela ezikolweni zoluntu nezikolo ezizimeleyo kwindawo yaseEastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukulungelelana kwenkqubo yamaqumfhu kaRhulumente ngokuqinisekisa ukuba wonke amaziko emfundo emi kwimeko ezigqibeleleyo. UkuNika isixhaso seNkqubo ezingatshintsha nasekusebenzeni kweziko lemifundo. Qwalasela ukunika inkqubo yolwazi noQoqosho ngokuSebenza iNkqubo yeMigaqo yolawulo lweMithobo eqhelekileyo kwizikolo zaseEastern Cape ngokulawula uMthetho we-Division of Revenue Act. Qinisekisa ukuLungelelana kweNkonzo yokuQamba iMithobo eqhelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweNkonzo yokwakhiwa kwezinto. Nikeza iNkqubo eQinileyo ngokuQamba nokulawula iNkqubo yokubuyela umva kwiingozi ezikumngcipheko weSikolo saseEastern Cape. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela nokulawula nokuchaza ngokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo yeNkqubo yokunikwa iMali eqhelekileyo kwindawo ezigqibeleleyo zeNqanaba loluntu. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweNkqubo yemigaqo yolawulo olupheleleyo kwiMveliso nokuQondisa iNkqubo yoluntu. Qinisekisa ukuQamba uqoqosho nokulawula iNkqubo yemfundo eqhelekileyo, nokuLungelelana iNkqubo yeMali efunwa kwiMfundo nokuNcedisa iNkqubo yonikezelo lweMithobo, izinto ezibakhiwayo, iNkqubo yokuQamba iNkqubo nokuQwalasela iNkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungelelana kweNkqubo kusebenza ngokufanelekileyo, ngokusetyenziswa kwemigaqo kunye nokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo yeMfundo yasekhaya, izikolo zoluntu, ezizimeleyo, ezikhethekileyo, neziko lemifundo yabantwana abasebancinci. Qinisekisa ukuLungelelana nokuLawula iNqumbela nokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo yeNkqubo kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lweSikolo nabantu abaNika ulwazi. Qinisekisa ukusebenza nokuzinza kweNkqubo ezifanelekileyo kwizikolo, ezikhethekileyo nakuMfundo yabantwana. Qwalasela ukunikezwa kweNkqubo eQinileyo nokuQondisa nokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo ezixhasa iNkqubo yoNiko lweMfundo ekhwalithi ephakamileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iNkonzo yokulawula iNkqubo yoQoqosho lwesikolo, ukubuyela umva kweSikolo nokuLawula iNkqubo yemfundo. Qinisekisa ukulawula iNkqubo yeNkqubo yokuSetyenziswa nokuNgena iNkqubo iNtsha. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweNkqubo eQinileyo yokukhuthaza iNkqubo eqhelekileyo nokuQamba iNkqubo ngokusetyenziswa kweMfundo kunye nokuQwalasela iNkqubo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yeMfundo kuLawulo iNkqubo eQoqo kuzo zonke izikolo zoluntu nakuNkqubo ezikhethekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokuQwalasela iNkqubo yokuzinza okuThileyo, iNkqubo eQinileyo yokuba ngowona umfundi oQinisekileyo (LAIS) kwaye abone iNkqubo yeSikolo. Lawula iNkqubo eNikwe iNkqubo ngokulawula iNkqubo iNkqubo iNqumbela yamagatya nokuLawula iNkqubo yeMfundo iNkqubo nokuQwalasela iNkqubo. Zisa iNkqubo eqhelekileyo ngokuQinisekisa ukuba iqela / indawo ikhiqiza umsebenzi oQinileyo ngokwakhwalithi / Ubungakanani nokuQinisekisa iNkqubo. Qwalasela iNkqubo yokuba zinkcitha iNkqubo ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo kwaye ibe ngumcedo ongaphandle kukaMphathi. Nikeza abantu abasebenzayo umsebenzi ngokusebenzisa amandla abo okusebenza, wabanike iNkqubo eQinileyo nokuQinisekisa ukufunda nokukhula. Qinisekisa ukuba kubhaliwe iNkqubo yeMfundo ngokuchanekileyo kwaye kuSetyenziswe iNkqubo yoQoqosho nokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo (PDP's) kubo bonke abantu abakulungelelana ngokusebenza. Lawula ngemini yonke ukusebenza kumsebenzi kwaye uQinisekise iNkqubo yokwenza iNkqubo yeNkqubo ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukulondoloza nokugcina izinto ezikhoyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Events Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 – R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive salary package), structured as follows: Basic salary – 70% of package; State contribution to the Government Employee Pension Fund – 13% of basic salary. The remaining flexible portion may be structured in terms of the applicable remuneration rules.
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Events Management in the Eastern Cape Department of Education, overseeing event frameworks, logistics, and stakeholder coordination at Zwelitsha.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognized (3-year) undergraduate NQF level 6/7 in Events Management, Business Administration/ Management, Communications, Project Management, Public Relations or any related field as recognised by SAQA. 3 - 5 years at Assistant Director level in Event Coordination environment. Experience in Protocol, Communications and Stakeholder Coordination will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s license. Skills: Project Management. Applied Strategic Thinking. Applied technology. Budgeting and Financial Management. Communication and Information Management. Citizen Focus and Responsiveness Strategic Management. Develop Others. Financial Management. Diversity Management. Impact and Influence Networking and Building Bonds. Managing Interpersonal Conflicts & Resolving problems. Planning and Organising Team Leadership. Communications Problem Solving and Decision Making. Knowledge: Coordination of events. Legislative frameworks that govern the Public Service SASREA, Security Standards, PFMA and financial compliance expertise, Public Service Regulation, Constitution of South Africa and other relevant acts, policies and regulations. Understanding of service level agreements and contracts. Familiarity with corporate Identity (CI) and branding standards. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: Manage the development and maintenance of the event management framework and instruments. Manage the provision of logistical arrangements for departmental events. Manage formal interaction and liaison with other event role players, inclusive of security and protocol personnel. Manage the provisioning of advice on the design of the marketing tools. Coordinate research of venues, suppliers and contractors for events. Manage the coordination of suppliers and all event logistics. Manage all pre-event planning and drills. Oversee the dismantling and removal of event and clearance of the venue. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeous development and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. ZZ Mnqanqeni Tel No: (040) 608 4200 For e-Recruitment Enquiries, e-mail: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za (under Careers) and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00- 16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Gebeurtenisbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Gebeurtenisbestuur in die Eastern Cape Department of Education, wat toezig hou oor gebeurtenisraamwerke, logistiek en belanghebbende-koördinasie by Zwelitsha.
af.requirements: ’n Toepaslike erkende (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF vlak 6/7 in Gebeurtenisbestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie/Bestuur, Kommunikasie, Projektbestuur, Openbare Betrekkinge of enige verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 3 - 5 jaar op Adjunkdirekteur-vlak in ’n gebeurteniskoördinasie-omgewing. Ervaring in Protokol, Kommunikasie en Belanghebbende-koördinasie sal ’n bykomende voordeel wees. ’n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede: Projektbestuur. Toegepaste strategiese denke. Toegepaste tegnologie. Begroting en finansiële bestuur. Kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur. Burgerlike fokus en reaksievermoë strategiese bestuur. Ontwikkel ander. Finansiële bestuur. Diversiteitsbestuur. Impak en beïnvloeding netwerkwerk en die bou van bande. Bestuur van interpersoonlike konflikte en probleemoplossing. Beplanning en organiseer van spanleierskap. Kommunikasie probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Kennis: Koördinasie van gebeurtenisse. Wetgewende raamwerke wat die Openbare Diens regeer SASREA, Sekuriteitsstandaarde, PFMA en finansiële nakomingskundigheid, Openbare Diensregulasies, Grondwet van Suid-Afrika en ander relevante wette, beleide en regulasies. Begrip van diensvlakooreenkomste en kontrakte. Vertroudheid met korporatiewe identiteit (CI) en bakenstandaarde. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal ’n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van die gebeurtenisbestuursraamwerk en instrumente. Bestuur die voorsiening van logistieke reëlings vir departementele gebeurtenisse. Bestuur formele interaksie en skakeling met ander gebeurtenisrolspelers, insluitend sekuriteits- en protokelpersoneel. Bestuur die voorsiening van advies oor die ontwerp van die bemarkingsinstrumente. Koördineer navorsing van plekke, verskaffers en kontrakteurs vir gebeurtenisse. Bestuur die koördinasie van verskaffers en alle gebeurtenislogistiek. Bestuur alle voor-gebeurtenisbeplanning en oefeninge. Hou toezig oor die ontmonteling en verwydering van gebeurtenis-toerusting en ontruiming van die plek. Handhauf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstaande werk lewer in terme van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimum leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP’s) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Bestuur daaglikse werknemersprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-evaluerings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates.

zu.title: Onozinandisi: Izinhlela Zezinkundla
zu.summary: Onozinandisi wezinhlela zezinkundla ku Eastern Cape Department of Education, obheke izakhiwo ezisekelwe ezenkundla, izimpahla zokusebenza, nokuhlanganisa abanye abahlosele inkinga e Zwelitsha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivunywe ngokusemthethweni (minyaka we-3) ezingeni le-NQF 6/7 ezinhlelweni zezinkundla, Ezabhizinisi/Izinhlelo zokuphatha, Ezokuxhumana, Izinhlela zokuqasha, Ubudlelwano nomphakathi noma noma yiphi inkalo ephathelene nalokhu njengokuvunywe yi-SAQA. 3 - 5 iminyaka ezingeni likaMqashi ongumongameli kwindawo yokucofa izinkundla. Isipiliyingo kokuziphatha ngokomthetho, Ezw kummininingwane kanye nokuhlanganisa abantu kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile. Amafundi: Izinhlela zokuqasha. Ukucabanga okusetshenziswa ngokobuchwepheshe. Ukusetshenziswa kwemfundo. Izindleko kanye nokuqashwa kwezimali. Ukuxhumana kanye nokuqashwa kweminingwane. Ukugxila kubuzindiswa kanye nokuphendula ngokobuholo. Ukubaqeqesha abanye. Imafundo wezezimali. Ukulawula izinto ezingafani. Ithonye negalelo ukuxhumana nokwakha ubuhlobo. Ukulawula izinkinga phakathi kwabantu nokuzixazulula. Ukucubungula nokuhlela ubuholo benqoto. Ukuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi: Ukuhlanganisa izinkundla. Izinhlelo zomthetho ezibuswa umnyango wezasezakhukhini ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi SASREA, izinga lokulondolozwa, PFMA nobuchwepheshe bokuhambisana nemali, umthetho wezikhulu zikahulumeni, umthethosisekelo wase Ningizimu Afrika kanye eminye imithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho elandelayo. Ukuzuva izinkundla ezinkundla ezinkundla. Ukuzuva ngokobuchwepheshe bokuhlonza ngemfundo (CI) nokuqinisekiswa kwezimpawu.
zu.duties: Qasha isikhathi esithile ngokucutshungula nokugcina izinhlela zezinkundla. Qasha ukuhlinzwa ngezinsizakusebenza kumnyango kwezinkundla. Lawula ukuxhumana okusemthethweni nokubonisana nabanye abadlali bezinkundla, okuhlanganisa abolunya nokuvikelwa komthetho. Lawula ukubonelela ngamacebo wokwakha izinto zokuthengisa. Hlela uphenyo lwamazwe, abathengisi nabaqashi bezinkundla. Lawula ukuhlela kwabalimisi bonke balezo zezinkundla. Lawula konke ukucubungula okungenziwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi nezivivinyo. Bukela ukukhipha nokususa izinto zesikhathi kanye nokuhlanza indawo. Gcina izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba siveza umsebenzi ohle njengobuningwane / ngobunkombe nangokushesha. Xazulula izinkinga zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngosizo oluncane othole kumqashi. Nikeza abantu imisebenzi ngokusekelwe kwamandlabo abo nikeza isiqondiso nesixhaso esidingekayo futhi nikeza abantu ithuba elifanele lokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa. Qasha isikhathi esithile sokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokusebenza kanye nezenzo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu (PDP’s) kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nsuku zonke futhi uqinisekise isikhathi sokulinganiswa ngokusebenza kwabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokulondolozwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: UkuLawula Iinkqubo Zeziganeko
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wokuLawula Iinkqubo Zeziganeko kwiSebe lezeMfundo eNtshona Koloni, elibukelela iinkqubo zeziganeko, izinto ezidingekayo kunye nokuqhagamshelana namashishini kwiZiko leZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile esivunyelweyo (seminyaka eli-3) se-undergraduate esesiNqanaben i-NQF level 6/7 kokuLawula Iinkqubo Zeziganeko, isoXazululo lweShishino/nokuLawula iShishino, ukuXhumana, ukuLawula iProjekthi, ukuQhubelana phakathi koLuntu nanayo na ndlela ehambelana nayo njengoko kwinikwa isiminya ngu-SAQA. I-3 - 5 iminyaka kwindqanaba kaMncebi Mlawuli kwindawo yokulungelelanisa iziganeko. Uluhlu lweNkqubo, ukuXhumana nokuQhubelana phakathi koLuntu kuya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amakhono: ukuLawula iProjekthi. Ukucinga ngokobuchule. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zolonakalo. ukwakha iiBhajeti kwaye ulawule iMali. ukuXhumana kwaye ulawule ulwazi. ukuNxanelwa ngabemi kwaye uphendule kuLawulo lweMigaqo. ukuzala abanye. ukulawula iMali. ukulawula iNtslobogu. ukuba nethemba nokuNamathela kwiNhlangano nokwakha uQhagamshelano. ukulawula iingxabano phakathi kwabantu kwaye uzixolulise iingxaki. ukuCwangcisa kwaye uHlele ukulawula iQela. ukuXhumana, ukuxolulisa iingxaki kwaye wamke isigqibo. ULwazi: ukulungelelanisa iziganeko. iinkqubo zemigaqo ezilawula inkonzo yaBantu i-SASREA, iMilinganiselo yoKhuseleko, i-PFMA nolwazi ngokuthe ngqo kwemali, imigaqo yeNkonzo yaBantu, uMgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika namanye emagqo, iinkqobo neenkqubo ezingalawanga ngalutho. ukuQonda iivumelwano zesebe ngokubonelela ngeenkonzo namaqili kwaye noXwebhu lweQili. ulwazi ngemveliso yekampani (CI) neemilinganiselo yokwakuhombisa. ulwazi kwiQela leMfundo luya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso nolondolzwo lwenkqubo yolawulo lweziganeko nezixhobo. Lawula ukubonelela ngezinto ezidingekayo kumanqanaba weziganeko kwisebe. Lawula ukudibana okusemthethweni nokunxibelelane nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba kumanqanaba eziganeko, kuquka abantu abalawula ukhuseleko nemigaqo. Lawula ukunika inkqubo ngeyona ndlela yokwakhiwa kwamathuba okuqhuba urhwebo. Hlelanisa uphononongo lwendawo, kuboneleli nabaqeshiweyo abazenzakalayo eziganekweni. Lawula ukuhlelanisa ababoneleli nazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo kwiziganeko. Lawula yonke icwangciso yangaphambili kunye nemilinganiselo yangaphambi kweziganeko. Qwalasela ukutshatyalaliswa nokushenxiswa kweziganeko kwaye kuhlanzwe indawo. Zigcine iinkqubo eziphakamileyo ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela/nqanaba lisebenza ngokuphumelelayo ngokobungakanani nangokwesithoba. Xolulisa iingxaki zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngenkqubo encinci encanyathelweyo ngumlawuli. Wanike iinkonzo kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe kumathuba avakalayo wabanike inkqubo efunekayo nokuNxanelwa uze abasebenzi ube nayo mathuba okuqeqesha nokuphuhlisa. Qinisekisa isiphelo sendlela yokucwangcisa neyokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoMsebenzi kunye neNkqubo yoPhuhliso lomntu (i-PDP's) yabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Lawula imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yabasebenzi kwaye uqinisekise isiphelo sendlela yokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa, ukugcinwa nokugcina okukhuselekileyo kwezinto ezinexabiso.

jobs.title: Admin Officer: PMDS & Iqms
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Administer human resource and performance management services, including IQMS, at the Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office in Zwelitsha.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate (3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 in Human Resource Management/ Training/ Public Management / Administration as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience in Human Resource Management environment. Computer Literacy. Practical working knowledge of PERSAL or any HRM related system. A Valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel is essential. Relevant PERSAL Certificates will be an added advantage. Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collect statistics. Computer Literacy Skills. Planning and organisation. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills. Honesty and integrity. Professionalism. Self – driven. Teamwork. A good knowledge and understanding of legal framework governing Human Resources. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: Provide human resource and performance management administration. Provide human resource development administration services. Provide performance management administration services. Provide administration of IQMS performance management services. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data (line function). Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filing system for the component. Type basic letters and/or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing register of the component. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Obtain quotations, complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register of the component (district offices). Maintain a leave register for the component. Keep and maintain personnel records in the component. Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Capture and update expenditure in component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.

jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za (under Careers) and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00- 16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address.

af.title: Administrateur: PMDS & Iqms
af.summary: Administreer menslike hulpbron- en prestasiebestuursdienste, insluitend IQMS, by die Eastern Cape Department of Education se hoofkantoor in Zwelitsha.
af.requirements: Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Opleiding/Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Praktiese werkkennis van PERSAL of enige ander HRM-verwante stelsel. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis, is noodsaaklik. Relevante PERSAL-sertifikate sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van klerklike pligte en praktyke, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en statistiek te versamel. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Professionaliteit. Selfgedrewe. Spanwerk. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die regskader wat Menslike Hulpbronne regeer. Kennis van die Onderwysektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf menslike hulpbron- en prestasiebestuursadministrasie. Verskaf administrasiedienste vir menslike hulpbronontwikkeling. Verskaf prestasiebestuursadministrasiedienste. Verskaf administrasie van IQMS-prestasiebestuursdienste. Los probleme van motivering en beheer met minimum leiding van bestuurder op. Liasseer, organiseer, berg, lê vas en onttrek korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie). Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostaatkopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkette aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel van die komponent. Tik basiese briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande register van die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaardkantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikskantore). Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Lê uitgawes in komponent vas en werk dit by. Kontroleer korrektheid van bestaans- en reisiesklikte van amptenare en dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en klein kontant vir die komponent. Ken werk toe en versewerk gehalte van werk. Personele ontwikkeling. Evalueer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Iflikhela LoKulawula: PMDS & Iqms
zu.summary: Lawula izinsizakalo zasemthethweni zabantu kanye nezokuphathwa kokusebenza, okuhlanganisa i-IQMS, ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Education e-Eastern Cape e-Zwelitsha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele (zeminyaka eyi-3) zeziqu ezingaphezulu ezingu-NQF 6 kwi-Human Resource Management/ Training/ Public Management / Administration njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3-5 yohlaka oluhambisana nendawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza lokubambisene ne-PERSAL noma nakuphi uhlelo oluhlobene ne-HRM. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nesithakwelo sokuhamba kuyadingeka. Ithifikhethi le-PERSA elihambisana naleso sikhundla lizoba ngaphezulu kwezinye izindleko. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yocansi, namasu kanye namandla okubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuthola izibalo. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukucubungula kanye nokuqamba. Ulimi. Amandla ahle kahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuqotho kanye nokuqinisekisa. Ukwazi kwabakhulu bomsebenzi. Ukuqina ngokwakho. Ukusebenza njengesiqu. Ulwazi oluqinile kanye nokuqonda ngemithethonqondo ephatha izinsizakalo zabantu. Ulwazi ngo-Sector ye-Education kuzoba ngaphezulu kwezinye izindleko.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngolawulo oluhlobene nezinsizakalo zabantu nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Hlinzeka ngolawulo lwezinsizakalo zabantu ezibhunga ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Hlinzeka ngolawulo lwezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kokusebenza. Hlinzeka ngolawulo lwe-IQMS ezinsizakalweni zokuphathwa kokusebenza. Xazula izinkinga zommyalo kanye nokulawula ngaphandle kwesixwayo esincane esiya kumphathi. Bhala, hlela, gcina, bamba futhi uthole imibhalo kanye nedatha (kumsebenzi oqoqwayo). Mukha amabhukhu okubhalisa kanye nezibalo. Phathela imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele ngefax. Yahlukanisa amadokhumenti/amasethebe kubantu abahlukene njengoko kudingwa. Gcina futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lwemibhalo yalowo phakathi. Bhala emagama namagama kwamanye amadokhumenti uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ibhukhhu lokungena nokuphuma lwalowo phakathi. Xhumana nababantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Thola izikawuti, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izimpahla zokuvamile zohhovisi. Lawula izimpahla ezihlolakaliwe zohhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ibhukhhu lezimpahla lwalowo phakathi (amahhovisi essifundazwe). Gcina futhi ulondoloze ibhukhhu lokuphumula lwalowo phakathi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze imibhalo yabantu kulelo phakathi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ibhukhhu lokungena lwalowo phakathi. Hlela ukuhamba kanye nezindlu ezingahambi. Bamba futhi mukeze imali echithiwe kulowo phakathi. Hlola ukuthi izimangalo zokuhamba nezindleko zabahleli zilungile bese uzingumunyameli wobhuti baze bamukeze. Lawula amakhawunti efoni kanye nemali encane yalowo phakathi. Yabelana futhi qiniseka izinga lemisebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabahleli. Linganisa ukusebenza kwabahleli. Faka isigqoko.

xh.title: Ifoma wobulawulo: PMDS & Iqms
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu kunye nokulawula inkqubo yokusebenza, kuquka i-IQMS, kwindawo enkulu yesebe leMfundo eMpuma Koloni eZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (kwiminyaka esi-3) se-undergraduate NQF 6 kwiQhela loLawulo loBasebenzi/ uQeqesho/ uLawulo lukaWuso/ uphando njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angapheli kweminyaka engama-3-5 kwikalathi yokulawula imisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusebenzayo nge-PERSAL okanye nakwelinye inkqubo ehambelana noLawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela elisebenzayo kunye nokuqonda ukuhamba kubalulekile. Iifom ze-PERSAL ezifanelekileyo ziza kuba yoncedo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yoffice, iindlela zayo nako kunye namandla okuthatha ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthenga izibalo. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqamba ngokulungelelanisa izinto. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalawuli okuthetha nokubhala. Ukunyaniseka nokuzinikela. Ubungcali. Ukuqonda ukuziqhuba ngokwakho. Ukusebenza njengothi. Ulwazi olululo nokuqonda inguquko yomthetho elawula imisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi ngeMgaqo weMfunda luya kuba yoncedo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu nokulawula inkqubo yokusebenza. Nika inkonzo yolawulo lophuhliso lwemisebenzi yabantu. Nika inkonzo yolawulo yenkqubo yokusebenza. Nika inkonzo yolawulo lenkqubo yokusebenza ye-IQMS. Sikiba iingxaki zokuzibandakanya nolawulo ngoncedo luncinane eliveliswe ngumphathi. Bhala, hlela, gcina, thatha ulwazi nokuze idatha (umsebenzi wolawulo). Hlaziya izibhengezo kunye nezibalo. Phendula imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza amakhophi bese wamkela okanye uthumela iifax. Sula amaxwebhu/iiqabane kumahlombe ahlukahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka. Gcina ulwazi lwefayile yesebe. Bhala iilet eziyisiseko nakwezinye iindaba xa kufuneka. Gcina bese ulungisa izibhengezo ezizingenayo neziphumayo zesebe. Thetha namahlombe angaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthenga izinto nezinkonzo. Thenga izibizo, gcwalisa iifom zokuthenga izinto eziqhelekileyo zofise. Lawula izinto zofisi. Gcina bese ulungisa izibhengezo zempahla yesebe (iiofisi zezithili). Gcina izibhengezo zolweswetshi yesebe. Gcina ulwazi lobungakanani basebenzi kwisebe. Gcina bese ulungisa izibhengezo zobukho basebenzi basebe. Hlela ukuhamba nokuuhlalwa. Hlaziya bese ubhalaindlela yokuchithwa kwemali kwisebe. Vakalisa ukuchanekile kokuhamba nokusetyenziswa kwemali ngabasebenzi bese unikela umphathi ukuvuma. Lawala iinkonzo zefowuni kunye nemali encinci yesebe. Dibanisa bese uqinisekisa ukuchanekile komsebenzi. Uphuhliso lwabasebenzi. Linganisa inkqubo yokusebenza yabasebenzi. Sebenzisa inyameko.

af.duties: Bystand verleen met die koördinering, monitering en verslagdoening oor die implementering van die skoolvoedingsprogram in die distrik. zu.title: Isikhulu Sezengqondo: Ukudla, Izithuthi NAmahhotela
zu.summary: Isikhulu sezengqondo esisekela ukudla kwesikole, izithuthi zezincwadi kanye nokuhlinzwa kwamahhotela emakhaya e Buffalo City naku Chris Hani emaKhaleni e Eastern Cape Department of Education.
zu.requirements: I-degree yesibili (yeminyaka engu-3) eyahluke ngengoqoqosho ye-NQF 6 kwi-Public Management/ Administration, i-Logistics njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani ungamaphakathi eminyaka engu-3-5 yokuhlolwa okuhlobene le-ndawo. I-Driver's License ekelwe ngokusemthethweni kanye nentshisekelo yokuhamba ngiyisidingo. Ukuqonda kwezomsebenzi wokubhala, kanye namakhono okungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqoqa izibalo. Amakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukucwangciswa kuhle kanye neqembu. Ulwimi. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubhala. Ukwazeka nokuzithoba. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti. Ukuziqhuba ngokwakho. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukuqonda okuhle kanye nokuva izinhlaka ezithintela umthetho eziphethe i-Human Resources. Ukuqonda i-Sector ye-Education kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Siza ekulungeniseni, ukuqapha kanye nokuqikelela ngokusebenziswa kwephrograme yamahhotela esikole emmandla. Siza ekulungeniseni ukuhlinza izinsiza zezithuthi zezincwadi, ukukhethwa kwabafundi abakhunjulwayo kanye nezindlela. Siza ekuqapheni, ukuhlolwa kanye nokuqikelela ngokuhlinzwa kwezinsiza zezithuthi zabafundi ngabasebenzisi abazifakelelayo. Lunganisa ukuhlinzwa kwamahhotela ezikole ezikhethiwe kanye nokuqamba izinsiza ezintsha. Phatha izinsiza ezabelwe isikhundla esincane, phatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke yabasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwe-Performance Assessments ngemuva kwesikhathi sabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthuthukiswe futhi kusebenziswe ngokushesha i-Job Descriptions, i-Work Plans kanye ne-Personal Development Plans (PDP's) bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokusikwa kwempahla. Zigcine ezinkulweni eziphakeme ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / ingxenye ikhiqiza umsebenzi omuhle ngokobungakumbi / ngokobuningi kanye nokuqedwa ngokushesha. Xazulula izinkinga zokwazisa kanye nokulawula ngosizo oluncane ovela kumphathi. Nikeza imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe kumandla abhoqo, nikeza usizo oludingekayo kanye nasekusekeleni futhi unike abasebenzi ithuba elanele lokulolongwa kanye nentuthuko.

xh.title: Iofisa loLawulo: Ukutya, ukuHamba kwabafundi nabaZinzele
xh.summary: Iofisa lolawulo elixhasa ukutya kwesikolo, ukuhamba kwabafundi nokubonelela kumaziko abazinzelayo kumamaba we-Buffalo City ne-Chris Hani kuSebe lezeMfundo lasiPhondo le-Eastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate ze-(3-year) ze-NQF 6 kwi-Public Management/ Administration, i-Logistics njengokwamkelwe yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angu-3-5 ubudala kwindawo ethile. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni nokulungelelaniswa nokuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabakhaliphuli, iinkqubo kunye namandla okugcina i-data, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Amandla okusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Ucinga nokuqamba. Ulwimi. Amava amaninzi okuthetha nokubhala. Inyaniso nokuqinisekisa. Ubugcisa obufanelekileyo. Ukuziqhelisa. Ukusebenza njengeqela. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda ingxangxasi yomthetho elawula iZikhali zabantu. Ulwazi loMmandla wezeMfundo luya kuba lusengocongco.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuvumelaniseni, ekuphenyeni nakuxela ngokuphunyezwa kwenkqubo yokutya kwesikolo kwidistrikithi. Nceda ukuvumelanisa ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zokuhamba kwabafundi, ukumisela abafundi abafanelekileyo neendleid phantse. Nceda ekuphenyeni, ekulinganisweni nakuxela ngokubonelela ngeenkonzo zokuhanjwa kwabafundi ngamagosa aputhwayo. Vumelanisa ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zamaziko abazinzelayo kumaziko amisiweyo nokuqamba iinkonzo ezintsha. Lawula izabelo zemithombo yommandla ongaphantsi kolawulo, lawula inkqubo yemisebenzi yemini yonke kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ukuphonononga ngokusebenza kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho kwenziwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkcazelo yeMisebenzi, Iplani yoMsebenzi neNkqazo yePhuhliso labuntu (PDP’s) zabaphansi kwakho zithuthakaliswe kwaye ziphunyezwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukugcina nokuqhina izinto. Zigcine iingabo eziphakamileyo ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / candelo lvela umsebenzi omhle ngokwemigqa nangokwexesha. Solisa iingxaki zamandla nokulawula ngolawulo oluncinci ovela kumlawuli. Nikezela imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe kwangamandla bomntu ngamnye, nikeza isixhaso esidingekayo kwaye unike abasebenzi ithuba elifanelekileyo lemfundo nophuhliso.

af.title: Administratiewe beampte: Skoolgesondheid
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat die implementering en monitering van skoolgesondheidsdienste ondersteun, met 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie in openbare bestuur en 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jarige) voorgraadse NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie en enige relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n relevante omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis is noodsaaklik. Kennis van klerklike pligte en praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en statistieke te versamel. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Professionaliteit. Selfgemotiveerd. Spanwerk. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die regsraamwerk wat Menslike Hulpbronne regeer. Kennis van die opvoedingssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf leiding oor die implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van geïntegreerde strategieë, beleide en prosedures vir besigheidsprosesbestuursdienste. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van verwante planne en programme. Koördineer die voorsiening van skoolgesondheidsdienste by gewone, volldiens-, spesiale en onafhanklike skole. Skakel met die distrikkantoor van die Health Department, relevante plaaslike munisipaliteite, NGO's en ander gesondheidsdiensverskaffers en vennote om toepaslike dekking van alle skole in die distrik te verseker. Koördineer die voorsiening van primêre gesondheidsdienste aan leerders met MIV/VIGS en ander chroniese siektes in skole. Koördineer sifting- en ondersteuningsprogramme vir leerders met gesigskerpheid, gehoor, tandheelkundige en verwante gesondheidstoestande. Koördineer periodieke sifting van leerders vir groeivertraging, voedingstekortkominge en verwante voedingsgebaseerde gesondheidsuitdagings. Monitor skole vir uitbreek van aansteeklike siektes, doen daaroor verslag en koördineer met die Health Department die implementering van inperkingsmaatreëls. Koördineer, monitor en doen verslag oor die implementering van beroepsgeondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls wat leerders in skole raak. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseer tydige prestasie-assessering van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseer tydige ontwikkeling en implementering van werkbeskrywings, werkplanne en persoonlike ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Verseer bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van kwaliteit/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimale leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede.

zu.title: Inkantili Eqondiswe Izindaba Ezikhungweni: Izenhlelo Ezempilo Ezikoleni
zu.summary: Inkantili eqondiswe izindaba ezikhungweni enikela ngokwesekwa ukuphumeleliswa kwezenhlelo ezempilo ezikoleni kanye nokuqaphela, kadinga izifundo ze-NQF 6 ezenza iziqu kuloMphathi Wezisebenzi Kahulumeni kanye namava afanele eminyaka engu-3-5.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezingemakhaya ezingu-(3-year) ze-undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Public Management/ Administration nanoma yisiphi isifundo esifanele njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Uhamo oluncane lwamava afanele olungu-3-5 eminyakeni endaweni efanele. Ilayisensi yokushayela enesesikhathi nesithanda ukuhamba kuyadingeka. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebhulogi, izindlela kanye nethemba lokubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Amakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukubeka ihlelo. Ulimi. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Ukwethembeka nokuba ngumuntu oqotho. Ukuba ngumuntu othatha izinto ngokusesibhakabhakeni. Ukuziqhuba. Ukubamba ndawonye. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda kwemithetho ephatha Abasebenzi Bezesikhathi. Ulwazi ngeQoqo lezeMfundo kuzoba yinzuvo.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso ekuphumelelisweni, ekuqapheleni nokubika ngezindlela ezihlangene, izinqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza izinsizakalo zokuqondisa inqubo yebhizinisi. Buthaze ulandele ukuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi ezihlobene. Hlanganisa ukunikwa kwezenhlelo ezempilo ezikoleni eziqhelekile, ezenza izinsizakalo ezigcwele, eziqondiswe kubantu abakhubazekile kanye nezikole eziqaswe ngabanye. Xhumana nekhaya lesifunda leSikhungo Sezempilo, abasipho basha abahlobene, i-NGO's kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezempilo nabahlanganyeli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubamba kwazo zonke izikole esifundeni. Hlanganisa ukunikwa kwezenhlalo ezempilo eziyisisekelo kwabafundi abanesifo se-HIV/AIDS nanye izifo ezingapheli ezikoleni. Hlanganisa ukuqapha kanye nezinhlelo zokusekela abafundi abanesono, abangezwa, abanezinyo kanye nezinye izinkinga ezempilo. Hlanganisa ukuqapha ngesikhathi abafundi ngezinkinga zokukhula kabi, ukungondleki kwemisipha nezinye izinkinga ezimpilo ezingokudla. Qaphela izikole ngokuqhwaya kwezifo ezibhebhethekiswayo, bize ngakho futhi uhlanganyele neSikhungo Sezempilo ekuphumelelisweni kwezindlela zokuqinisekisa. Hlanganisa, qaphela futhi ufake imibiko ngokuqondiswa kwezinyathelo ezisuka emsebenzini ezithinta abafundi esikoleni. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nsuku zonke futhi qinisekisa ukuqatshwa kwamakhono abantu bonke abangabakhosi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izincazelo zemisebenzi, Izinhlelo Zokusebenza kanye nezenhlalo Zokuzikhulula zabantu bonke abangabakhosi ziphumeleliswe ngesikhathi esifanele. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokubeka izimpahla ngokuphepha. Gcina izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sibe nomsebenzi omuhle ngaphakathi kobuhle / ngobuningi futhi ngesikhathi esifanele. Nxephezela izinkinga zamandla futhi ulawule ngosizo oluncane ositholayo kumqashi. xh.title: IOfisa yeolawulo: Impilo yezikolo
xh.summary: Iofisa yolawulo elixa inkqubo yesebe lempilo kwaye lilawula ukusebenza kwayo, kufuneka libe nengqondo ezingangeni ngaphantsi kwesixhenxe (NQF 6) kwaye libe nomava weminyaka engama-3 ukuya kuma-5.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Public Management/ Administration nakho nasiphi na isidanga esifanelekileyo njengoko besikwaziwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinci beminyaka engama-3-5 yomava ofanelekileyo kwendawo eahambelana nalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela ekeloyo nokuzimisela ukuhamba kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuqamba, iinkqabo kunye namandla okuqamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ucoco nolungelelwaniso. Ulwimi. Amandla amaninzi nokuvelisa inkqubo ethembekileyo ekuthetheni nakubhalweni. Inyaniso nolwazio. Ubugcisa bomsebenzi. Ukuzinqula. Ukusebenza njengesigqiza. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ephethe i-Human Resources. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Nikeza isikhokelo ngokuphumeza, ukulawula nokubika ngokudibanisa iinkqakamba, iimigaqo nemiqathango yesebe lempilo. Qamba ulawule ukuphunyezwa kweenkqakamba ezahambelanayo neenkqubo. Lawula ukunikwa kweinkonzo zeempilo zezikolo kumaziko aqhelekileyo, amaziko apheleleyo, amaziko abalulekileyo namaziko azimeleyo. Thethathu nomntu wonke we-district office we-Health Department, iintopo zasekhaya, i-Ngo's namanye abaniki beinkonzo zeempilo abanjiselana ukuze axokelele ukuba bonke abantu bafumana inkonzo. Lawula ukunikwa kwezempilo ezingangeni ezikolweni kubafundi abanegciwane lesandulela ngculaza nas kwizifo ezinde. Lawula ukukhangela inkxaso kubafundi abamehlo, indlela, amazinyo nezinye iindawo ezikhubekileyo kwimpilo. Lawula ukukhangela kabuhle ngexesha ngezinto ezifana nokufiphala, ukungangenisa i-impilo ezikolweni namanye amaxhala eempilo. Lawula iinkonzo ngokubika ngezifo ezingangenayo kwizikolo nokudibanisa ne-Health Department ukuphumeza iinkqubo zokubamba. Lawula ulawule kuze kubhalewe ngokuphumeza iinkqubo zokhuseleko olukhulu nakwiindawo ezibangelwa ukungena kwesigqibo kwizikolo. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi bentsuku zonke ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusenziwa ukuphuhliswa ngexesha lokubakho. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa okusheshayo nokuphumeza iindaba zokusebenza, iinkqubo zokusebenza nokuqamba iinkqubo zokuphuhliswa. Lawula ukugcina ukusebenza kweempahla nokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwazo kakuhle. Zikhusele ekubeni iqela lenkqubo elenza umsebenzi omhle kangangobuninzi nobukhali obukhulu. Susa iingxaki zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngaphandle kwesikhokelo kakhulu kumphathi. Khupha imisebenzi kwabasebenzi ngokusekelwe kumandla okuqonda, nikeza isikhokelo esifanelekileyo nekhuselo kwaye unike abasebenzi ithuba lokuzilolonga nokuphuhliswa.

jobs.summary: Admin Officer supporting EMIS, governance and special programmes at the Department of Education in Nelson Mandela Bay, requiring a public management qualification and 3-5 years' experience.

A minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience in relevant environment. A Valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel is essential. Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collect statistics. Computer Literacy Skills. Planning and organisation. Language. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.

Assist in developing and monitoring the implementation of the related plans and programmes. Assist to coordinate EMIS in the district. Assist in coordinating the implementation of youth and special programmes in the district. Assist in coordinating governance, resourcing and rationalisation of schools. Assist to coordinate of stakeholders, learner teacher support material and SGB programs in the district. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure timeously development and implementation of Job Descriptions, Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities.

af.title: Administratiewe beampte: Emis, Bestuur en Spesiale Programme
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat EMIS, bestuur en spesiale programme by die Department of Education in Nelson Mandela Bay ondersteun, wat 'n kwalifikasie in openbare bestuur en 3-5 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Public Management/ Administration en enige tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in 'n tersaaklike omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis is noodsaaklik. Kennis van klerklike pligte en praktyke sowel as die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek in te samel. Rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Professionaliteit. Selfgedrewe. Spanwerk. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die regsraamwerk wat Menslike Hulpbronne regeer. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van leiding oor die implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van geïntegreerde strategieë, beleide en prosedures vir besigheidsprosesbestuursdienste. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en monitering van die implementering van verwante planne en programme. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van EMIS in die distrik. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van die implementering van jeug- en spesiale programme in die distrik. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van die bestuur, bronneverskaffing en rasionalisering van skole. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van belanghebbendes, leerder-onderwyser ondersteuningsmateriaal en SGB-programme in die distrik. Daaglikse werknemerprestasie bestuur en tydige prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes verseker. Tydige ontwikkeling en implementering van werkbeskrywings, werkplanne en persoonlike ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes verseker. Bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates verseker. Hoë standaarde handhaaf deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Probleme van motivering en beheer met minimum leiding van die bestuurder oplos. Funksies aan persone delegeer op grond van individuele potensiaal, die nodige leiding en ondersteuning bied en persone voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede bied.

zu.title: Iofisa Euphatho: EMIS, Ukulawula Ngokomthetho & Izinhlelo Ezikhethekile
zu.summary: I-ofisa Euphatho esekela i-EMIS, ukulawula ngokomthetho nezinhlelo ezikhethekile eDepartment of Education eNelson Mandela Bay, edinga izifundo ezithile eziphathisweni komphakathi nakho konke okuhlobene nalokho, kanye namakhulu eminyaka eyi-3-5 yokuhlangabezana nezimo ezifanele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisisekelo ze-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 ku-Public Management/ Administration nakho konke okuhlobene nalokho njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka oyisi-3-5 ohambisana nezidingo olimini nasezindaweni ezifanele. I-Valid Driver's license kanye nesifiso sokuhamba kuyadingeka. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokwenza izinto ngokomthetho kanye namakhono okubhala izibalo, ukusebenzisa ikhompuytha nokuthola izibalo. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuytha. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuqotho nokuba nesibindi. Ukuziphatha kahle. Ukuzethemba. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ulwazi oluhle nokuzuva umthetho ohlolwe ngokuphathwa kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwe-Education Sector luyobe lusizo olukhulu.
zu.duties: Siza ukunikela ngokuqondiswa ekusebenziseni, ekulawuleni nasekubikeni izinhlelo ezibekiwe, izimiso nemigangatho yokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo kumphakathi. Siza ekwakheni nasekulawuleni ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlobene nalokhu. Siza ukuhlanganisa i-EMIS esifundazweni. Siza ekuhumusheni ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zentsha nezinhlelo ezikhethekile esifundazweni. Siza ekuhumusheni ukulawula ngokomthetho, izinsiza nokuhleliswa kabusha kwezikole. Siza ukubeka kahle izinhlobo zezinsizakalo ezihlukene, izibalo zokuqeqesha abafundi nezinhlelo ze-SGB kuleyo ndawo. Lawula ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwabasebenzi futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlola ngokugcizelela ukusebenza ngokwesikhathi esifanele kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ngokushesha kwakhiwa futhi kusetshenziswe izincazelo zemisebenzi, Izinhlela Zokusebenza kanye Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Komuntu Ngamunye (PDP's) kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Lawula, zigcine futhi zibe khona ngokuphepha onke izimpahla. Phakamisa izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhiqiza umsebenzi omuhle ngokobuningi / ubuhle nokuthi uzenza ngokwesikhathi. Luphuulula izinkinga zokuzethemba nokulawula ngokuncika kakhulu komunhu wokulawula. Yimisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe endaweni yomuntu ngamunye, nikezela isiqondiso nesekelo esidingekayo futhi abasebenzi banikezwe ithuba elifanele lokuzilolonga nethuba lokuthuthuka.

xh.title: IOfisa yolawulo: Emis, Ulawulo & Iinkqabo Ezizodwa
xh.summary: IOfisa yolawulo elisekayo EMIS, ulawulo nemiqathango ezizodwa kwisebe leZemfundo eNelson Mandela Bay, lifuna isifundo solawulo kawonke-wonke namava eminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwe-5.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo (seminyaka emi-3) sabaphatha abangesiNqanaba se-6 seNQF kwiLawulo Kawonke-wonke/ uLawulo nalipina na isifundo esifanelekileyo njengoko sivunywe yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angu-3-5 eminyaka kwimeko efanelekileyo. Ilayisenesi yokuQhuba eSebenzayo nokuzimisela ukuhamba kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yobhala, iinkqabo nokwazi ukuthatha iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthatha izibaluli. Amakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Uqwalaselo lolwele. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalathisa abalulekileyo okuthetha nokupeyinta. Inyaniso nokuzithembisa. Uburhwebo. Ukuqhuba ikakhulu. Ukusebenza njengaqela. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda ingqikithi yomthetho elawula iZisebenzi. Ulwazi ngeNgcali yoNgcangca luya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekunika isikhokelo ngokusebenzisa, ukuqwalasela nokuchaza iindlela ezibhalwe ngantsakuzo, iinkqubo neenkqubo zenkqubo yokulawula iinkonzo. Nceda ekuyila nokuqwalasela ukusebenzisa iicwangciso neenkqabo ezinxulumene nayo. Nceda ukulungelelanisa i-EMIS kwisithili. Nceda ekulungelelaniseni ukusebenzisa iinkqabo zabantwana abasebancini neezizodwa kwisithili. Nceda ekulungelelaniseni ulawulo, ukunikwa iinkonzo nokulinganisa iikholeji. Nceda ukulungelelanisa abathintatho, izixhobo zokuncedisa titisha ngabafundi neenkqabo ze-SGB kwisithili. Lawula imisebenzi yabasebenzi yemihla ngemihla ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuqwalaselwa ngexesha ukusebenza kwabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuba kubhalwa ngexesha kwaye kusebenziswe iinkcazelo zeMisebenzi, iNkqubo zoMsebenzi neeNkqubo zoPhuhliso zeBucophela (i-PDP) zabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukulondoloza nokugcina izinto. Gibelela pam ngokuzinika iindlela ezikwindidi ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / candelo linya inkqubo emnandi ngokobungakanani / ngokobungakanani nangexesha. Zisombulula iingxaki zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngosikhokelo suncinci esivela kumlawuli. Nikeza imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokwamandla abo mntu abanawo unike isikhokelo nencekede efunekayo usize abasebenzi ngamathuba okuqeqeshwa nokuqhubela phambili.

Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede.

zu.title: Ofisa Ohlela: ICT/ E-learning - Ukuthuthukiswa KweMfundo
zu.summary: Ofisa ohlela osekela i-ICT nokuqeqeshwa kwemfundo nge-e-learning eNelson Mandela Bay, ofuna iziqu ze-IT namava eminyaka engu-3-5.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zangaphansi kwesikhashana (kweminyaka eyi-3) ezingeni le-NQF 6 kwi-Information Technology/ Information Systems/ Computer Science njengoba kuvunyelwe yi-SAQA. Uhlulo oluncane lwamava afanelekile eminyakeni engu-3-5 kumhlanganosize othinteka. Ukubhala ngefompeyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokugqamela ukuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yenhlibamvo nemasiko, kanye namandla okubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Amandla okubhala ngefompeyutha. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ulimi. Amasoho ohlezi namagama abalulekile kobuso bomlomo nokubhala. Ukuqiniseka nokuzethembeka, ukuziqhuba nokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Ulwazi ngabahlinzeki bemfundo kuzoba lunzuzo.
zu.duties: Siza ekunikeleni ukuqeqeshwa kweminyakho yezikole neziqu zeminyango. Siza ekunikeleni inkxaso ngokuqhubekiswa kokukhula kwabashaithisha kumyango. Siza ekuphatheni ukulethwa kwemicimbe yamaphuzu okukhula kwemfundo emzingeni wesithili. Siza ekunikeleni inkxaso yafundi kushishini nentumantliziyo. Yenza ngemiqondo umgqabuko wempumelelo yensuku zonke futhi uqinise ukucutshungulwa ngesikhathi esifanele kwabangaphansi. Yenza ngemiqondo ukukhiqizwa kwesiqondongama senkinga, Umhlelo ohleliwe kanye namaphuzu obumuntu kuwo wonke umuntu. Yenza ukubeka izinkomamkhondo ekuphatheni, ukwakhiwa nokulondolozwa kwezinto. Zise izindinga eziphansi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / lesigaba sidlula ngokuhle ngokobuningi / inani kubaluleke. Hlola izinkinga zenzika nokulawula ngenkombandlela ephansi ethiwe ukuphathi. Yenza abasebenzi abasezansi ngamandla abo babe naso isikhala esihle kakhulu ngokuthuthukisa amandla abo.

xh.title: Ifofisa yolawulo: ICT/ E-learning - Ukuziphuhlisa kwemfundo
xh.summary: Ifofisa yolawulo exhasa ICT nakuqeqesho lokufunda kwentliziyo eNelson Mandela Bay, efuna isatifikethi se-IT kunye noluhlu lweminyaka engama-3-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: I-undergraduate (yeminyaka engama-3) NQF 6 elifanelekileyo kwiTeknoloji yolwazi/ Iinkqubo Zolwazi/ ISayensi yekhompyutha njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka engama-3-5 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kwendalo efanayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisa esevisi nentwelo yokuhamba yeyfuneko. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yababhali-patha, iinkqubo njengakunokho namandla okugcina iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthoba izibalo. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uqeqesho lolweso nokuhlela. Ulwimi. Amandla amaninzi okuthetha nokuwakha ngelungisa nangokubhalwa. Inyaniso nokuzinza, ukuqhuba nokusebenza ngesixhobo. Ulwazi ngesector yemfundo kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekunikeleni uqeqesho lwamaqela olawulo ezikolo namadistrict. Nceda ekunikelweni inkxaso kwinkqubo yokuziphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo koogqirha bethutyana kwinqanaba ledistrict. Nceda ekulawuleni ukunikwa koludwe lweenkqubo zokuziphuhlisa zendawo yemfundo kwinqanaba ledistrict. Nceda ekunikezweni inkxaso kwabafundi noogqirha bethutyana nendawo zobutyalo-nemali. Lawula inkqubo yemisebenzi yamaphethu ngemini yonke ukuqinisekisa isilinganiso sokuqatshanisa isikhathi kwabashenxi abaphantsi. Qinisekisa isekuthi ukuziphuhlisa nokuwusebenzisa iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, amacebo okusebenza namacebo okuziphuhlisa umntu wonke (PDP) abashenxi abaphantsi. Qinisekisa ulawulo, ukugcina nokugcina izinto ezixabisekileyo. Nqamlela iilinga eziphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / candelo lizisa umsebenzi omhle ngokwemilinganiselo / inani nangexesha elihambelana nalo. Solulise iingxaki zentwelo lolawulo ngokuncediso kancinane onikwa ngumlawuli. Nikela imisebenzi kumashleli njengamandla omntu wonke nikezela ncedo noluncedo oluqinisekileyo nimise abashleliithuba esifanelekileyo sokuziqeqesha nokuziphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Labour Relations Officer: Employee Relations, Compliance
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Labour Relations Officer at the Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office in Zwelitsha, handling misconduct cases, grievances and dispute resolution at salary level 7.

The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. zu.summary: Inkulu Yezomthetho Wabasebenzi e Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office e Zwelitsha, ebhekene necala lokuziphatha kabi, izikhalazo nokuqediswa kwezingxabano ezingeni leholo 7.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kulezi Community Relations/ Labour Law/ Human Resources Management noma Industrial Relations. Ukuhlangabezana okungenani okunyakeni we-2 kuya kowayi-3 ezindabeni ze-Labour Relations/Labour Law. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlangabezana nokwazi le mithetho elandelayo: Labour Relations Act: Employment of Educators' Act; Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations kanye namanye amaphuzu abalulekile e-Employment Legislation kanye nemithetho. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Amakhono okuhlela ukuthuthukisa nokuqonda ukuba ngumholi. Amakhono okwenza izethulo nokuqeqesha. Amakhono okubhala okubika. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Ukugcina amehlo nokuhlola. Ukuxoxisana nokuqeda izinkinga. Ukugxila kumthengi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwazi nge-Education Sector kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Bhekana necala lokuziphatha kabi. Qamba izindlu zokuphenya ubhale okubikayo. Qeqesha izinqumo zezikhalazo. Phenya izikhalazo ezitholiwe uzibeke iziphetho nokuthi kulindele ukwenziwa nganisiphi isinqumo esigqibili. Nikeza izeluleko uthuthukise ngendaba zomthetho wabasebenzi. Phatha izinkomba zokuqeda izinkinga ngempumelelo. Qeqesha ukugqamisa izinkinga ezixazululwa ngokomthetho. Bhalo izinkomba zezincomo ume ngakwesilungiseleli kumacala okulalelwa ngomthetho.

xh.title: Isebe lamaQabane akwaBasebenzi: EzamaQabane aBasebenzi, ukuHambelana neMithetho
xh.summary: Isebe lamaQabane akwaBasebenzi kwiNtlangano yeNdzala yoMbindi wePhondo laseMpuma Koloni eZwelitsha, elibhekene neecalengaba zobundlobongela, iingxaki nokusombulula iingxabano kwinqanaba lesi-7 lomvuzo.
xh.requirements: Ifundo kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 kumazinzo abantu/ Umthetho wamasebenza/ Ulawulo lweZisebenzi okanye uMaqabane amashishini. Ikhondo elingeni elingaphantsi kwe-2-3 emandulo wamaphondo kwimeko yomthetho wamasebenza/Umthetho wamashishini. Ilayisense yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesebe: Ikhondo nolwazi ngalemithetho ilandelayo: Umthetho wamaQabane akwaBasebenzi: Umthetho wokuQeshwa kwaThisha; Umthetho weNkonzo yoLuntu. Iimithetho yeNkonzo yoLuntu nakunye namagazini aphambili eMithetho yokuQeshwa namapolisi. Amakhono ahambelana nesebe: Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Uqumbi-lwazi lokucwangcisa ngokubumbeko noku babeka. Amakhono okubonisa nokuquumba iinkomfa. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Uqhelaniso lolwazi nochanzelo. Uthethathethwano nosombululo lweengxabano. Ukwagqibelela ukwenzela abathengi. Ukubamba kakuhle ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lweNdzala yamaphondo kuya kuba lusizo ngamehlo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba amacala obundlobongela. Ukwenza uphando nokuqokelela iingxelo. Ukukhuthaza iinkqubo zeesikrabhula. Ukuqhuba uphando kwiingxaka ezifunyenwe kunye neengcamango malunga nesigqibo ngokwamafumaniso kunye neengcebiso. Ukubonelela ngengcedo nentlulo kwezamacala abasebenzi. Ukuyala amacala eengxabano ngokusebenzayo. Ukukhuthaza ukusombululwa kweengxabano. Ukubhala izicelo ukuyalela nokumela iqabane kwiinkqubo zokuva amacala.
