zu.summary: I-Eastern Cape Department of Education ifuna abantu abayinkantshi bezokusebenza ukubhekana nobukhophobho, izikhalazo kanye namaphikiswe ema-ofisini amaningi ezifunda.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhethesheni ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kwezokusebenza/ umthetho wokusebenza/ Ukuphathwa Kwemithombo Yabasebenzi noma Izindaba Zokusebenza. Okungezi kuqashelwe ukuthi ube neminyaka engu-2 -3 yokuthola ulwazi kwindawo yezokusebenza/ umthetho wokusebenza. Isibhamu sokushayela esivumelekile. Ubufakazi bomsebenzi: Uluhlu namabomu wokwazi okuphathisene nomthetho kulawa mthetho alandelayo: Labour Relations Act, Employment of Educators' Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations kanye nomthetho omunye ongumgqa ongokomsebenzi nemikhuba. Ikhono elihlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ikhono lokuhlela isu nokuholuza abantu. Ikhono lokuhola izingqungqulu kanye nokuvedela. Ikhono lokubhala umbiko. Ikhono lokuphatha abantu. Ukugcina isikhathi ekubukweni nokuhlolwa. Ikhono lokuxoxisana nokubulala impikiswano. Ukugxila ebathengeni. Ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ukwazi ukusebenza kwentunja yeze-Mfundo kuzodingeka.

jobs.title: Wellness Practitioner: Employee Wellness
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Coordinate and implement employee wellness programmes, policies and strategies including wellness days and health screenings for the Department of Education in the Eastern Cape.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at an NQF level 6 in Occupational Health and Safety/ Social Work/ Human Recourses Management or Industrial Relations. Minimum of 3 years’ experience Employee Health and Wellness environment. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation principles. Knowledge of Employee Wellness Programme design, including principles and practices for designing and implementing workplace wellness initiatives. Understanding of health and wellness policies, including regulatory compliance (e.g. OHSA and EHWP guidelines). Knowledge of public health and occupational health principles. Understanding of key health issues (e.g. mental health, chronic illness and substance abuse) in the workplace. Programme coordination and facilitation. Planning and organising. Problem solving skills. Creativity and awareness. Knowledge of the following legislations: Labour Relations Act, Employment of Educators' Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations and other key pieces of Employment Legislation and Policies. Communication (verbal and written). Strategic planning and leadership skills. Presentation and facilitation skills. Report writing skills. People management skills. Monitoring and evaluation. Negotiation and conflict resolution. Customer focus. Computer literacy. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for coordinating the employee wellness programme. Implement employee wellness programmes, policies and strategies by initiating the day-to-day running of the wellness programme, rolling out health and wellness activities such as wellness days and health screenings, coordinating logistics for wellness events in collaboration with service providers, promoting participation through communication campaigns, and monitoring programme participation and effectiveness. Support the implementation of chronic disease programmes by conducting health education sessions on chronic illness management, distributing educational materials and referring employees to counselling and testing services, and tracking participation in awareness campaigns and outreach initiatives. Coordinate health and wellness awareness activities by organising awareness sessions, distributing educational materials during awareness events, coordinating schedules and venues for campaigns and workshops, and gathering participant feedback to improve future activities. Coordinate the sports and recreational programme by coordinating internal sports events and recreational activities, maintaining schedules, equipment and participation records, communicating upcoming events to employees, and gathering feedback to improve future sporting initiatives. Execute administrative duties related to the wellness programme, including administering the scheduling and execution of mobile clinic services and other wellness activities, creating and maintaining records and databases of wellness programme activities, participants and outcomes, maintaining attendance registers and documentation, maintaining organised filing and record-keeping systems, and compiling monthly wellness statistics for internal reports.

af.title: Welsynspraktisyn: Werknemerwelsyn
af.summary: Koördineer en implementeer werknemerwelsynprogramme, beleide en strategieë, insluitend welsynsdays en gesondheidskramings vir die Department of Education in die Eastern Cape.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid/ Maatskaplike Werk/ Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of Arbeidsverhoudinge. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in Werknemer Gesondheid en Welsyn-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van monitering en evalueringsbeginsels. Kennis van die ontwerp van Werknemerwelsynprogramme, insluitend beginsels en gebruike vir die ontwerp en implementering van werkplekwelsyninisiatiewe. Begrip van gesondheids- en welsynsbeleide, insluitend regulatoriese nakoming (bv. OHSA- en EHWP-riglyne). Kennis van openbare gesondheid en beroepsgesondheidsbeginsels. Begrip van sleutel gesondheidsake (bv. geestelike gesondheid, chroniese siekte en middelmisbruik) in die werkplek. Programkoördinasie en fasilitering. Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kreatiwiteit en bewustheid. Kennis van die volgende wetgewing: Labour Relations Act, Employment of Educators' Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations en ander sleuteltukke van Arbeidswetgewing en Beleide. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Strategiese beplanning en leierskapsvaardighede. Aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Mensebestuursvaardighede. Monitering en evaluering. Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing. Kliëntefokus. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die koördinering van die werknemerwelsynprogram. Implementeer werknemerwelsynprogramme, beleide en strategieë deur die daaglikse loop van die welsynprogram te inisieer, gesondheids- en welsynsaktiwiteite soos welsynsdays en gesondheidskramings uit te rol, logistiek vir welsynsgeleenthede in samewerking met diensverskaffers te koördineer, deelname deur kommunikasieveldtogte te bevorder, en programdeelname en doeltreffendheid te monitor. Ondersteun die implementering van chroniese siekteprogramme deur gesondheidsopvoedingsessies oor chroniese siektebestuur te hou, opvoedkundige materiaal te versprei en werknemers na berading en toetsdienste te verwys, en deelname aan bewustheidsveldtogte en uitreikinisiatiewe op te spoor. Koördineer gesondheids- en welsynsbewustheidsaktiwiteite deur bewustheidssessies te reël, opvoedkundige materiaal tydens bewustheidsgeleenthede te versprei, skedules en plekke vir veldtogte en werkswinkels te koördineer, en deelnemersterugvoer in te samel om toekomstige aktiwiteite te verbeter. Koördineer die sport- en ontspanningsprogram deur interne sportgeleenthede en ontspanningsaktiwiteite te koördineer, skedules, toerusting en deelnamerekords te handhaaf, opkomende geleenthede aan werknemers te kommunikeer, en terugvoer in te samel om toekomstige sportinisiatiewe te verbeter. Voer administratiewe pligte uit wat verband hou met die welsynprogram, insluitend die administrering van die skedulering en uitvoering van mobiele kliniekdienste en ander welsynsaktiwiteite, die skep en handhaaf van rekords en databasisse van welsynprogramaktiwiteite, deelnemers en uitkomste, die handhaaf van bywoningsregister en dokumentasie, die handhaaf van georganiseerde lêer- en rekordhoudingstelsels, en die opstel van maandelikse welsynstatistieke vir interne verslae.

zu.title: Umuntu Osebenza Ekuqinisekiseni Impilo: Impilo Yabasebenzi
zu.summary: Qondanisela futhi usebenzise izinhlelo, izinqubomgomo nezindlela ezimala neyimpilo yabasebenzi, okuhlanganisa namaph impilo nokuhlolwa kwezempilo kuMnyango Wezemfundo e Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Isiqu esisezingeni le-NQF 6 kwi-COccupational Health and Safety/ Social Work/ Human Recourses Management noma Industrial Relations. Okungenani unyaka abangu-3 osesikhathini Eze mpilo kanye noyilo yabantu bendsebenzi. Idrayivali esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngezindingo ezeqondiswa futhi zihlolwa. Ulwazi ngohlelo E kwimpililyabantu basebenzi, oluhlangan nisimiso nezindlela ekwakheni ngoluhlelo. Ukwaciseka kwemithetho nemigomo Yempilo, okuhlanganis noku hambisana nemithetho (isb. OHSA kanye nezindlela ze-EHWP). Ukwati ngesempilo yomphakathi kanye nesiqu esimala neyimpilo yomuntu emsebenzini. Ukuqonda izihloko ezibalulekile zempilo (isib. impilo yengqondo, isiffo esihlehlwayo nentengiswa kwezidakamizwa) emsebenzini. Ukuqondan izindle kanye nokulawula inhlelo. Ukulungiselela nokuhlelwa. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzidalula nokuba seduze ngolwazi. Ulwazi ngemithetho elandelayo: Labour Relations Act, Employment of Educators' Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations kanye neminye imithetho ephathelene nabasebenzi. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala). Ukulungiselela izind lende kanye nokuba ngumbhali. Ikhono lokuphath kanye nokuphathis izinkulumo. Ikhono lokubhala okubalulekile. Ikhono lalokuphath abantu. Ukuphenya ukuthi kusebenza yini. Ukuxoxa ngokuxazulula izingxabano. Ukwazisa abakufisa. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngabezemfundo kuzoba yilunga elidlule emqoka.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi: Lowo omutsha kule miqondo uzobe ngumuntu ophathe ngokuqondan isa hlelo sempilo yabasebenzi. Usebenzise imithetho nemithe yempilo yabasebenzi ngokuqalisa ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwelulo, ukusatshalis izakhamuzi zokwakha isigcawu nesiqhumulo esikunesemphilo, aze aphathe nemitholwano yamaph impilo ent sebnzi, axhase ekuthumeni imilenze yabantu basebenzi ngenhlobomxhumaniso, aphinde aloloke ukuthi bantu abaniningi bangena kuhlelo. Usekela ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zesifo esihlala isikhathi eside ngokwenza izinkulumo-mfundvo ngendlela okuphilwa ngayo esikhathini eside, ukwabelana ngolwazi ngesifo, nokuqondisa abasebenzi ukuba bafunde kabanzi baze bafake imali ekuhlolweni kwesifo, okuhlanganisa nokulandelwa kwabantu abathanda ukwazi kabanzi ngaleso sifo. Qondanisela imikhakha eminingi ngokuhlela izinhlango, ukwaba abantu abaningi ngolwazi, ukuhlela isikhashana namaphi la impilo baze bathole imibuzo kubantu ukuthi bazokwazi ukwenzisa kusasa. Qondanisela imikhakha yamaph imidlalo nezinto ezinjabulo ngokuqondan is a imidlalo yangaphakathi nemitsho yezinjabulo, aze agononde imigwaqo yemidlalo, izinto zokuzid okuhlangene nabayayinikinga imibuzo ngendlela eza kuthengiswa kusasa. Yenza imisebenzi egema ngokusungula noku hlelwa kwezinto eziningi imisebenzi yempilo.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi Wezempilo: Impilo Yabasebenzi
xh.summary: Ukucothisa nokusebenzisa iinkqaba zemizimba ngabasebenzi, iinkqubo kunye neenthungo kuquka iintsuku ezimpilo kwaye nokuqwalasela impilo kwisebe leMfundo e-Eastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esinqanaben i-NQF level 6 kwi-Occupational Health and Safety/ Social Work/ Human Recourses Management okanye i-Industrial Relations. Okungonelanga unyaka wama-3 wamava kolwazi kwendalo ye-Employee Health and Wellness. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokugqola nokuhlolwa. Ulwazi ngoyilo lwenkqaba ye-Employee Wellness Programme, kuquka imigaqo namaziko okuyila nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezithuthuzela impilo kwizithuba zokusebenza. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zempilo nokuziphilisa, kuquka nokuthobela imigaqo (umz. i-OHSA namalungiselelo e-EHWP). Ulwazi ngempilo yomntu wonke namaxahttps olwazi lwamafa aphilayo. Ukuqonda iingxaki eziphambili zempilo (umz. ingqondo, isifo esihlala khedini nokusetyenziswa kwezizidlani) kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lokuba naye nabakho kulungiselelo, ukwakha nokuhamba-hambisa izinto. Isakhono somculo sokuqonda izinto ezingalunganga nokuziphendula. Isakhono sokubakuba ngumntu onolwazi olutsha kunye noqonde lwemivo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yamthetho elandelayo: i-Labour Relations Act, i-Employment of Educators' Act, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations naye nyani ome ngamagqabantshintshi amakhulu eMthetho kwaye neenkqubo zoLawulo lokuNikela ngeMfundo. Isakhono sokunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Isakhono sokuqamba amaceba okuhamba phambili nokusikhokela. Isakhono sokubonisa nokuqeqesha. Isakhono sokubhala iingxelo. Isakhono sokulawula abantu. Ukugqola nokuhlolwa. Isakhono sokuxoxisana nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukunikela ngokwengqondo kubathengi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lwe-Sector leMfundo luya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Lowo waba kule sithuba uza kuba necelo lokuba nxibelelane nokusebenzisa inkqaba ye-Employee Health and Wellness. Ukusebenzisa iinkqaba, iinkqubo kunye neenthungo ngokuvula iinkqaba zenyanga zonke, ukuhambisa izinto ezinkqubo zempilo ezinjengentsuku ezimpilo nokuqwalasela impilo, ukulungelelanisa amacebo okuhamba phambili ekuhambeni kwemisebenzi yempilo ngenye nenye nabaphathi bemisebenzi, ukukhuthaza ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokubakho kolwazi olusasazwa, nokuqwalasela ukuthabatha inxaxheba kobukhosi kwaye nakusebenza kwaye kusetyenziswa inkqaba. Ukuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqaba ezingabantu abanesifo esihlala khedini ngokwenza izigqibo zokufundisa abantu malunga nokulawula isifo esihlala khedini, ukusasaza izinto ezingafundiswa ngokusebenza kwazo zonke iindawo, ukubakhokelela abasebenzi kumacebo onke kakhulu okuqwalasela impilo nokubakho kolwazi, nokuqwalasela kubakho kolwazi okusemthethweni wokuba ngumntu onjalo kwiinkqaba ezithi zihambe ziya ekuqwalaseleni kubakho kolwazi. Ukuyala ukwazi nokuqwalasela ukusasaza kolwazi ngokulunga izithuba ezingafundiswa kuzo izinto, ukusasaza izinto ezingafundiswa ngokusebenza kwaye nasekunyenyemeni kolwazi, ukulungelelanisa amaxahttpsokuqala nemigaqo yamathuba okuya kwiinkqaba namawaka, nokuqokelela izimvo zabathathi nxaxheba ukuze kusikelelwe ngokubakho kolwazi olutsha nolungangeniswa kwiinkqaba zangomso. Ukuyila iinkqaba zemidlalo nangokuzonwabisa ngokuyila imidlalo yangaphakathi nokuqhuba imisebenzi yezokuzonwabisa, ukugcina imigaqo yonke imihla, izixhobo kunye namarekhodo okuthatha inxaxheba, ukusasaza ulwazi malunga neentsuku ezintsha nasekuhambeni kwemisebenzi kubasebenzi, nokuqokelela izimvo ukuze kufundwe kuzo iinkqaba ezizakwakhiwa ngomso. Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yolawulo engqamana kakhulu nenkqaba, kuquka nokulawula ukusika iintsuku nokusebenzisa iinkonzo zeedzibaso ezihamba nayo nakuwo nawo onke amanye amacebo okwakha impilo, okudala nokugcina amarekhodo namaxa ezi-eth databases zokuhamba-hambisa iinkqaba, abathathi-nxaxheba namaphumo abo, ukugcina amaphepha okubakho nxaxheba nabaphila bethu, ukugcina amaphepha ngokulungelelanise kunye nendlela egcinwa ngayo amagunya, kwaye nokugcinwa kokuhamba kokubakho kolwazi iivenelo zeentsuku zinyanga zonke ngamakhasi angaphakathi.

jobs.title: Principal Personnel Officer: Employee Provisioning
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Principal Personnel Officer managing employee provisioning and recruitment processes at the Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office in Zwelitsha.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate (3-year) undergraduate NQF 6/7 in Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience in Human Resource Management environment. Computer Literacy. Practical working knowledge of PERSAL or any HRM related system. A good knowledge and understanding of legal framework governing Human Resources. A Valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel is essential. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for handling relating to the receiving of applications. Capturing / scheduling of applications. Maintain registry pertaining to applications. Provide secretarial support to recruitment and selection processes. Updating of recruitment database. Explain service contracts and relevant conditions of service to new appointees. Provide support to Assistant Director and the Deputy Director. Compile submissions for contracts extension, appointments, and terminations. Provide recruitment and selection training to managers and staff. Perform all human resource functions as directed by the supervisor, compile and submit monthly Recruitment and Selection reports. Provide employee recruitment planning and administration services. Assist to provide selection support services. Assist in providing employee appointment administration services. Assist in providing employee and post establishment reconciliation services.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M Zazela Tel No: (040) 608 4228 For e-Recruitment Enquiries, Email: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za (under Careers) and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00- 16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.requirements: 'n Geskikte (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6/7 in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Openbare Bestuur/ Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die regsraamwerk wat Menslike Hulpbronne beheer. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis is noodsaaklik. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die hantering van aangeleenthede rakende die ontvangs van aansoeke. Vaslegging / skedulering van aansoeke. Handhaaf register wat op aansoeke betrekking het. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan werwing- en seleksieprosesse. Opdatering van werwingdatabasis. Verduidelik dienskontrakte en relevante diensvoorwaardes aan nuwe aangesteldes. Verskaf ondersteuning aan Assistentdirekteur en die Adjunkdirekteur. Stel voorleggings op vir kontrakverlengings, aanstellings en beëindigings. Verskaf werwing- en seleksie-opleiding aan bestuurders en personeel. Voer alle menslike hulpbronfunksies soos deur die toesighouer aangewys uit, stel en dien maandelikse Werwing- en Seleksieverslae in. Verskaf werknemer-werwingbeplanning en administratiewe dienste. Bied bystand om seleksie-ondersteuningsdienste te verskaf. Bied bystand by die verskaffing van werknemer-aanstelling-administratiewe dienste. Bied bystand by die verskaffing van werknemer- en postbesettingsversoeningsdienste.

zu.title: Unduna Abantu Abakhulu: Ukuhlela Abasebenzi
zu.summary: Unduna Abantu Abakhulu obuphatha ukuhlela abasebenzi kanye namaphrosesi okubumba abasebenzi e-Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office e-Zwelitsha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikolo samabanga aphakeme (eminyaka engu-3) ze-NQF 6/7 kwi-Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Ukuhlangenwe nakho okufanele okuncane iminyaka engu-3-5 kwindawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokuqinisekileyo lokusebenza nge-PERSAL noma nayiphi na inkqubo ehlobene ne-HRM. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda ngenkqubo yomthetho ephatha i-Human Resources. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo kwaye kukho ukulungelelani ukuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector kuya kuba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Umntu okhethiwe uya kuba nawo umsebenzi wokuphatha okumayelana nokwamkela izicelo. Ukufaka izicelo ohlelweni/ukucwangcisa izicelo. Ukugcina irejistri emayelana nezicelo. Ukunikela inkxaso yobunyulu kumaphrosesi okubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha. Ukuvuselela idatabase yokubumba abasebenzi. Ukucacisa iinkonzo zesivumelwano nemigaqo ebalulekileyo yesevisi kubasebenzi abatsha. Ukunikela inkxaso kwi-Assistant Director nase-Deputy Director. Ukwabhala izicelo zokwandiswa kwezivumelwano, ukuqeshwa, nokupheliswa kwesevisi. Ukunikela iinjingijingi zokubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha kubaphathi k nabasebenzi. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yamabungu abantu njengoko umyalelwe ngumphathi, ukubhala nokuhambela iireportsnye zenyanga zokuBumba abasebenzi nokuKhetha. Ukunikela iinkonzo zocwangciso loluntu nokulawula ukuqeshwa. Ukuncedisa ukunikela iinkonzo zokukhetha. Ukuncedisa ukunikela iinkonzo zolawulo lokuqeshwa kubasebenzi. Ukuncedisa ukunikela iinkonzo zokulinganisa abasebenzi nokuqwalasela izikhundla.

xh.title: IPS Esephakamileyo Lemisebenzi Yabantu: Ukubonelela Basebenzi
xh.summary: IPS Esephakamileyo Lemisebenzi Yabantu elawula ukubonelela basebenzi kwaye nezinze iinkqubo zokuthumela nabasebenzi eEastern Cape Department of Education Head Office eZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (samaxesha ama-3) esingaphantsi kwesidanga se-NQF 6/7 kwi-Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration njengoko kusetyenziswa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalulekileyo aphela kweminyaka engama-3-5 kwindawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza nge-PERSAL noma naluphi na inqubo enxulumene ne-HRM. Ulwazi olululo nokuqonda iziseko zomthetho ezilawula i-Human Resources. Ilayisensi yokuqamba epheleleyo kunyaka nemfanelo yokuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Omnye umntu okhethiweyo uya kubizwa ngokuba ngowokuqwalasela izinto ezithintelele ukwamkelwa kwezicelo. Ukufaka izicelo kwaye uzibe ngesicwangciso. Ukugcina irejista ngezicelo. Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yolwedini kwiinkqubo zokuthuma noku Khetha. Ukuhlaziya idatha yokuqokelela abantu abathunyiweyo. Ukuchaza iinkontraxi zenkonzo nayimimiselo ngenkonzo kubantu abatsha abakhethiweyo. Ukunika inkxaso kwi-Assistant Director nakwi-Deputy Director. Ukuqamba iingxelo zamaxesha, ukuthumela ngabasebenzi abatsha, nasekupheliseni iinkontraxi. Ukunika i-Human Resource, i-recruitment and selection training kubaphathi. Ukuqokelela ngokweenkontraxi ezibekwa ngokomyalelo, iinkontraxi ezingathathi nhlangothi, ukunikwa iinkontraxi, nokugqitywa kwamacandelo onke emisebenzi yabantu ngokomyalelo wesikhokelo ngokulawula ukugqibela nokusetyenziswa, nokwenza iinkqubo ezinzima, umbhalo ongamkelwayo, nokuthunyelwa kolwazi ekuyi-recent Recruitment kumacandelo entsini entsha olula.

zu.title: Isikhundla Esikhulu Somphathi Wabasebenzi: Ukuqashwa Kwabasebenzi Kwezenhlalo
zu.summary: Isikhundla Esikhulu Somphathi Wabasebenzi esiphephisa ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi kwezenhlalo, ukumiswa kwebutho elisha labagqizi kanye nesinxibelelano sokwakhiwa kwamakhono ohlelo lonke maqondana nomnyango WeMfundo e-Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate (eminyakeni eyi-3) ze-NQF 6/7 ezingqondiswe ekwenzeni isikhathi esingezansi seminyaka eyisithupha kumkhakha WeZezimali Nabasebenzi/ Kwenze Imithetho Kahulumeni noma ezemfundo eqotho esemthethweni noma eqotho ekubuyiseni noma ukulungisa izinto. ucwaningo lokusebenza olwaziyo kahle uhlelo lwe-PERSAL noma lwaziyo nawo nawo onke amanye amasimu ahlobene kakhulu nokuqashwa kwezenhlalo kwezentengiso. ulwazi oluhle kakhulu nokuqonda okuqotho kwezimo zomthetho. ukuba nelayisensi yokuqasha ize nethuluzi lokuhlolisisa isimo sezimali kanye nesikhathi esithile. ukwazi ukuhlola imisebenzi yabantu kanye nokuqasha abantu ekufanele ukuba uqashe ngokuphelele.
zu.duties: Yetha izinsiza zokuphathwa komsebenzi wokumiswa kwabagqizi abavikela. Yetha izinsiza zesinxibelelano sezakhamuzi kanye nokwakhiwa kwamakhono. Yetha izinkomba zokuphathwa kokwaziswa kwezocansi namakolishi. Phatha ngokubanzi imithombo yokugcina imali yezimali ekuqashiwe ekhaya noma ezweni. Gcina izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu/ isigaba sikhuluma kahle nangensimu yeSizwe. Zikhulise izinkinga zokunika amandla okunika isifundo esincane ekuqashweni kwemisebenzi yamakhaladi nezezentengiso. Yahlula futhi uqinisekise izinga lomsebenzi. Vuselela kanye nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Hlola ukwenza komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Faka isiyalu.

xh.title: Principal Personnel Officer: Human Resource Provisioning
xh.summary: Principal Personnel Officer uphatha ukumiselwa kwe-HR, ukugqitywa kokuqeshwa kabafundisi abathatha indawo kwaye azenzele ukuvumelanisa kwezithuba kwi Eastern Cape Department of Education.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (3-year) se-NQF 6/7 kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Administration njengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuqeqeshwa okubangalo 3-5 kwiminyaka kwimvelaphi ethile kwindawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwenene lwe-PERSAL nanayo inkqubo ehlobene ne-HRM. Ulwazi olululo nokuqonda kwendawo yomthetho ephatha i-Human Resources. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo kwaye ukulungele ukuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zolawulo zokuqeshwa kabafundisi abathatha indawo. Nika iinkonzo zovumelaniso lwabasebenzi nezithuba. Nika iinkonzo zolwazi lolawulo lwe-HR. Phatha izixhobo ezabelwe iYunithi ngokwemigaqo yomthetho namapolisi asebe ukuze uhambelane nemiba ephathwa kukarhulumente nakwakuqulunqa. Gcina amango aphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / candelo lwenza umsebenzi ongummangaliso ngokwesimbo / ngobukhulu nangexesha. Sezangxaki zokuxhathisa nokulawula ngaphandle kokulawuliswa kakhulu kumaneja.abela kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho womsebenzi. Uphuhliso basebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Sezisa isohlwayo.

jobs.title: Principal Personnel Officer: Conditions of Service
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Supervise conditions of service benefits, PILIR, transfers and remuneration processes within the Eastern Cape Department of Education at Head Office.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate (3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 in Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience in Human Resource Management environment. Computer Literacy. Practical working knowledge of PERSAL or any HRM related system. A good knowledge and understanding of legal framework governing Human Resources. A Valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel is essential. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: Supervise the implementation of Conditions of Service benefits e.g. Capped Leave Audit, Long Service Awards. Supervise the implementation of PILIR. Supervise the implementation of transfers and resettlements at exit. Supervise the processes for the initiation of remuneration and allowances on PERSAL. Manage the allocated resources of the Unit in line with legislative and departmental policy directives and comply with corporate governance and planning imperatives. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M Zazela Tel No: (040) 608 4228 For e-Recruitment Enquiries, Email: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za (under Careers) and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00- 16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Hoofpersoneelbeampte: Diensvoorwaardes
af.summary: Bestuur diensvoorwaarde-voordele, PILIR, oorgawes en vergoedingsprosesse binne die Eastern Cape Department of Education by die Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Publieke Bestuur/ Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Praktiese werkkennis van PERSAL of enige HRM-verwante stelsel. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die regsraamwerk wat Menslike Hulpbronne beheer. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis is noodsaaklik. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van Diensvoorwaarde-voordele bv. Opeisbare Verlof-oudit, Langdienspryse. Bestuur die implementering van PILIR. Bestuur die implementering van oorgawes en hervestiging by uitrede. Bestuur die prosesse vir die inisiering van vergoeding en toelaes op PERSAL. Bestuur die toegewysde hulpbronne van die Eenheid in ooreenstemming met wetgewende en departementele beleidsriglyne en voldoen aan korporatiewe bestuurs- en beplanningsimperatiewe. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/ afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte/ hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer met minimum leiding van die bestuurder op. Wijs werk toe en verseker die gehalte daarvan. Personeelontwikkeling. Assesseer werknemersprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Isikhundla Esikhulu Somphathi Wabantu: Izimo Zokusebenza
zu.summary: Qondisa izinzuzo ezitholwa ngaphansi kwezimo zokusebenza, i-PILIR, ukudluliselwa kwezikhundla kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu ngaphakathi kwabasebenzi emnyangweni we-Mfundo waso-Eastern Cape eNdayo Elikhulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile ze-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration njengoba kunikwa isiqiniseko yi-SAQA. Isiphequluli seminyaka eyi-3-5 yemvelo ekusebenzeni kwi-Human Resource Management. Ukwaziswa kwegumbi lokusebenza. Ulwazi oluphathwayonke lwalezi zikhungo ze-PERSAL noma nakweyiphi na indlela ehlobene noMphathi Wabantu. Ulwazi oluhle kanye nokuqonda kwesisekelo sezomthetho esibusabantu abasebenzayo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela kanye nokuviwa ukuthi uzohamba iyimfunzo. Ulwazi ngaphakathi kweziwezimali zemfundo kuzoba yinzuzo etholakalayo ekutheni abantu bakhuleke.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinzuzo ezifanelekile ezisuka ezimeni zokusebenza njengesibonelo: Ukubilisa ukubuyisa i-Capped Leave Audit, I-Sipho Sikahle Sokusebenza eside. Qondisa ukuphumeza i-PILIR. Qondisa ukuphumeza ukudluliswa kwabantu kanye nokubuyisana emva kokuphuma. Qondisa imigudu yokuqalisa ukuqashwa kwabantu kanye nezimali ezingenayo e-PERSAL. Phatha izinsiza ezenzelwe iqembu ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yomthetho kanye nemiyalo yeminyango futhi uhambisane nezinyathelo zomthetho zenhlangano kanye nokuhlelwa. Hlalela izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / ingxenye ikhiqiza umsebenzi omuhle uma kuqhathaniswa izinga / inani kanye nesikhathi. Susa izinkinga zokukhalazelela kanye nokuqondisa ngosizo oluncane osoluvela kumoninzi. Hlukanisa futhi uqinisekise izinga lomsebenzi. Inkuliso yamandla emisebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Faka umthetho.

xh.title: ISebe Sokuqala Sezabasebenzi: Iimeko Zokwenza Umsebenzi
xh.summary: Lawula iinzuzo ezithinteyo iimeko zokwenza umsebenzi, i-PILIR, iindawo zokusuka kwaye niyekwe nezinkqubo zorhutyo kwisebe lemfundo lase Eastern Cape kwindlu enkulu yesebe.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (seminyaka e-3) se-NQF 6 kwiMphatho yoBuntu/ uBulungisi boLuntu/ uLawulo njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Isipilingo seminyaka e-3-5 sokugqitha kwelona balo lisebenzayo lokwazi nokusebenza ngeNkqubo yoBuntu oluNgcangcashele nokuqonda amacebo alawula uluntu. Ikelasi yobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusebenzayo i-PERSAL okhany inkqubo enye edityaniswe kum. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenzisa iimeko kwankqubo ezikwimigqaliselo elawula iMphatho yoBuntu. Irayisensi yokushayela elungileyo nokuzinceda kokuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi ngesektor yeMfundo kuya kuba lusizo ekongezweni kwamava.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezibonelela ngemeko yokwenza umsebenzi njengoko kwiimfuno ezingqinelana nokutshaywa koshishino. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwe-PILIR. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kokushunqulelwa koluntu ngokuzimasa kwamava. Lawula inkqubo yokutjhoja korhutyo namaxesha. Lawula izibonelelo namandla abo basebenzi abayabelweyo njengoko kubekwa ngumthetho namagunya oLuntu iMfuno. Fumana ukungabi naluphi na ukubakho kwexabiso elibi ngokumisela amava awayo ngokobunjani nangokubukhulu kwesixeko esilawulwayo. Lawula izinkinga ezinzima nokuziphatha kwabasebenzi ngokuzinciphisa ngokulawulwa nguBukhulu besebe. Lawula izinto ezifanelekileyo nomsebenzi. Khulisa abasebenzi. Vakatya iziphumelelo zabasebenzi. Sebenzisa isilumkiso.

af.title: Hoofpersoneelbeampte: Vestigingsdienste
af.summary: Bestuur HR-voorsiening en PERSAL-vestigingsdienste vir die Eastern Cape Department of Education by Zwelitsha.
af.requirements: 'n Gesikte (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Menslikehulpbronbestuur/ Openbare Bestuur/ Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring in 'n Vestigingsomgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Praktiese werkkennis van PERSAL of enige HRM-verwante stelsel. zu.title: Induna Yabasebenzi: Izinsiza Zokwakhiwa Kwesikhungo
zu.summary: Phatha ukwetholwa kwabasebenzi kwe-HR kanye nezinsiza zokwakhiwa kwesikhungo ze-PERSAL e-Eastern Cape Department of Education eZwelitsha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zedinga (3-year) zesibili ezinga le-NQF 6 kuHuman Resource Management/ Public Management/ Administration njengoba kuvunywe yi-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka we-3-5 wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambelanayo endaweni yokwakhiwa kwesikhungo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza okuphilayo lwe-PERSAL noma noma yimuphi uhlelo ohlobene ne-HRM. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda okusemthethweni okuphatha i-Human Resources. Ilayisensi yokushayela esevumelekileyo nokuzithoba ukuhamba kuyisidingo. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector lungeza inzuzo.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso ezinsizeni zokuHlela kwa-HR kanye nokwetholwa kwabasebenzi. Gcina amafayili nerekhodi ehhovisi ngokwetholwa kwamaphosti kuwo onke amasithi. Hlola izibhalo ezihlobene ne-HRP. Dala izinhlanga, amaphosti bese uyawasusa. Ukudalwa kwe-Acting Allowances. Ukufakelwa kwe-matrix. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ye-PERSAL ehlobene nezindaba zokwakhiwa kwesikhungo. Phatha ukwakhiwa kwabasebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Ukufakelwa kwe-Organizational structure kanye ne-Post Provisioning Norms kwi-PERSAL.

xh.title: IPS Ehlo eliphezulu laba basebenzi basebenzela kuLwazi lweNtsebenziswano: Iinkonzo zokuQhelanisa nabantu
xh.summary: Lawula ukubonelela kwe-HR nakwiinkonzo zokuqhelanisa zabantu basebenzela iSebe lemfundo yoMzantsi Kapu kwiZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-nqamlezethu (3-year) esingaphantsi kwesiNqanaba 6 se-NQF kokuLawula uLuntubasebenzi/ uLawulo loLuntu/ uLawulo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kothotho lonyaka we-3-5 kwindawo yokugcina uluntu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lwezemisebenzi lokuqhelana ne-PERSAL noma naluphi na inkqubo ehlobene noLawulo lwaBantubasebenzi. Ukuqonda kakuhle nolwazi lwegunya elilawula abantubasebenzi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela ethembekileyo nokulungele ukuhamba ngokufunekayo. Ulwazi ngangcamango lwemfundo kuya kuba yingasemva eyongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekuLungenisweni kwe-HR nasekuBoneleleni iinkonzo. Gcina iifayile kunye neerekhodi ofisini kubonelelo lwesithuba kuzo zonke iindlebe. Phepha ngokuthumela izicelo ezinxulumene noLungelelwaniso lwaBantubasebenzi. Yila amacandelo, iisithuba kunye nokucinywa kwezithuba. Yila iMali yokwenza ngokubamba. Faka isakhelo. Yenza zonke iinkqubo ezinxulumene namacandlo kuPERSAL. Lawula izicelo zabantubasebenzi ngokusebenzisa i-PERSAL. Faka uLungelelwaniso ngokwasembonini kunye neendalo ezisemthethweni zabantubasebenzi ngokusebenzisa i-PERSAL.

jobs.title: Admin Officer: Records and Document Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Admin Officer managing records and document systems for the Department of Education in Nelson Mandela Bay, requiring an NQF 6 qualification and 3-5 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate (3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 in Public Management/ Administration as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience in administration environment. Computer Literacy, Excellent Communication Skills, Administration Skills, People Skills, Organisational Skills, Typing and Writing Skills, Strong Leadership Skills, Basic financial recording, minute taking and report writing skills. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: Provide district resource centre management services. Monitor and evaluate document management processes. Implement the departmental records management policy, systems and procedures for the district. Provide a central registry service and maintain the electronic records management system including document disposal and archiving services. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure timeously development and implementation of Job Descriptions, Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. af.title: Administratiewe beampte: Rekord- en Dokumentbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat rekord- en dokumentstelsels vir die Department of Education in Nelson Mandela Bay bestuur, met 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jarige) voorgraadse NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Publieke Bestuur/Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, administrasievaardighede, mensevaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede, tik- en skryfvaardighede, sterk leierskapsvaardighede, basiese finansiële rekordhouding, notuleneem en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf bestuursdienste vir die distrikshulpbronsentrum. Monitor en evalueer dokumentbestuursprosesse. Implementeer die departementele rekordbestuursbeleid, stelsels en prosedures vir die distrik. Verskaf 'n sentrale registratuurdiens en onderhou die elektroniese rekordbestuurstelsel, insluitend dokumentverwydering en argiveringsdienste. Bestuur daaglikse werknemersprestasie en verseker tydige prestasie-evaluerings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseiser betyds die ontwikkeling en implementering van Werksbeskrywings, Werkplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer met minimum leiding van die bestuurder op. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning, en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede.

zu.title: Phini Loluphathi: Ukuphathwa kweziqukathi nemibhalo
zu.summary: Phini Loluphathi oluphatha iziqukathi namasistimu emibhalo eDepartment of Education eNelson Mandela Bay, elidinga izifundo ze-NQF 6 nokuhlolwa kweminyaka eyi-3-5.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 ePublic Management/ Administration njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3-5 yokuhlolwa okuhambisana nendawo yokuphatha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Amakhono Okuxhumana Ahle, Amakhono Okuphatha, Amakhono Abantu, Amakhono Okuhlelela, Amakhono Okuthayipha nokubhala, Amakhono Obuholi Abalulekile, Ukugcina okuyisisekelo izimali, ukubhala imizuzu kanye namakhono okubhala umbhalo. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Education Sector kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngamasiko okuphatha izikhungo zezinsiza zendawo. Bheka futhi uhlolo inqubo yokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Sebenzisa inqubo, amasistimu namaphrosedha womnyango weziqukathi zendawo. Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokugcina iziqukathi ebalulekile futhi igcine isistimu yeziqukathi ezikhompuyutha okuhlanganisa ukulahiswa kwemibhalo nesevisi yokugcina emabhokisi. Phatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke yabasebenzi futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlolwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukusebenza kwabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthuthukiswa futhi kusetshenziswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi izincazelo zemisebenzi, Amaphulani Okusebenza nama-Personal Development Plans (PDP's) kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokuphephiswa kwempahala. Zigcine emazingeni aphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhiqiza umsebenzi ohle njengoba kuhlobene nentengo / inani kanye nenhloso yesikhathi. Axazulule izinkinga zokuzikhwazisa nokulawula ngenosizo encane otholwe kumphathi. Abase abasebenzi imisebenzi ngokusekelwe kumandla womuntu ngamunze uthole eyidingayo eyisiqondiso kanye nancusa futhi unikeze abasebenzi ithuba elifanele lokuzilolonga nokuthuthuka.

xh.title: IOfisa Yoqeqesho: Ulawulo Lweerekhodi nemiQulunqo
xh.summary: IOfisa Yoqeqesho elawula iirekhodi nezixhobo zemiqulunqo kwiSebe leMfundo kwiNelson Mandela Bay,elifuna izifundo zeNQF 6 kunye namava eminyaka yama-3-5.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 6 (semiminyaka emi-3) seNgqondo yoLawulo loluLuntu/oloLawulo njengakubonwa yiSAQA. Umba wamava abahluleleyo amnyaka ama-3-5 ohlobo oluhambelana nendawo yolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono amaninzi oNxibelelwano, amakhono oLawulo, amakhono oLuntu, amakhono eZicwangciso, amakhono okuChwetheza nokubhala, amakhono amakhulu oBukhosi, ukugcina irekhodi yemali enqinci, ukuthatha amaminithi namakhono okubhala iinkcazelo. Ulwazi ngeNgingqi yeMfundo kuya kuba lusizo elongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yolawulo leziko lemidada yamaceba. Qwalasa kwaye ulinganise iinkqubo zolawulo lwemiqulunqo. Zisa kwamaceba inkqubo, iinkqubo nemigaqo yolawulo lweerekhodi yesebe.nika inkonzo yerejista evela kumbindi kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yereekhodi yamakhompyutha kuquka nokulahla imiqulunqo nolonke lwezicwangciso zamandulo. Lawula imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yabasebenzi kwaye qinisekisa ukuba kuqatshwa ngexesha elichanekileyo kwabasebenzi abangaphantsi. Qinisekisa ukubakho kwexesha elide kwaye kusetenziswe iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, amascwangciso omsebenzi namascwangciso okuziphucela (amaPDP) kuwo onke abasebenzi abangaphantsi. Qinisekisa ulawulo, ulondolozo nokugcina izinto zexabiso. Zigcine iinqanaba ziphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela/icala lida imisebenzi emhle mayela nobungakanani/izinga kwaye ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Sob isinxaxhi sokhuthazo nolawulo ngoncedo oluncinci ovela kumlawuli. Yabelana imisebenzi kwabasebenzi ngokusekwe kwinkalo yomntu ngamnye unike oncedo olufunekayo kwaye unike abasebenzi ithuba elifanelekileyo lokuzilolonga nophuculo lwamakhono.

af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat koördinering van eksamens en assessering oor Eastern Cape onderwysdistrikte bestuur, wat 'n tersaaklike NQF 6-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar se administratiewe ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Tersaaklike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, administratiewe vaardighede, mensevaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede, tik- en skryfvaardighede, sterk leierskapsvaardighede, basiese finansiële boekhouding, notuleer- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die koördinering van alle assesseringsverwante aktiwiteite in die Distrik vir GET, FET en ABET. Skakel en koördineer met die provinsie en skole oor alle aangeleenthede rakende assessering en eksamens. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van alle assesserings- en eksamenaktiwiteite binne die distrik. Verseker die implementering van alle beleide en prosedures ten opsigte van Assessering en Eksamens in die distrik. Verseker die implementering van nasionale en provinsiale assesserings- en eksamenbeleidsvereistes soos uiteengesit in Nasionale en Provinsiale Assesseringsomsendbriewe en UMALUSI. Dit sluit in die versekering van die implementering van die sekuriteitsnorme en -standaarde vir eksamens binne die distrik in ooreenstemming met provinsiale en nasionale riglyne en beleidsvoorskrifte. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van die proses van die verspreiding van alle Assesseringsinstruksies aan distrikbeamptes en skole. Stuur alle distriksaansoeke vir die benoeming van eksamenverwante personeel na distrikbestuur en provinsiale hoofkantoor. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van finansiële, menslike en fisiese hulpbronne, insluitend effektiewe batebeheer binne die distrik. Bystand verleen met die opstel en bestuur van operasionele begrotings. Bystand verleen met die toesig oor die veiligheid en sekuriteit (insluitend berging en register) van alle assesseringsinstrumente/-nutsessies in die distrik. Verseker die implementering van die PFMA en Voorsieningskettingbestuursvoorskrifte.

zu.title: Ofisa Wophathele: Ukuhlolwa kanye Nokuqashwa
zu.summary: Ofisa Wophathele ohlola ukubambisana kokuqashwa kanye nokuhlolwa emaphethelweni emfundo e Eastern Cape, ofuna izifundo ezifanele ze NQF 6 kanye neminyaka emi-3 kuya ku-5 yohlelo lwaphathele.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele esingenzelwe iminyaka emithathu sokufunda esigabeni le NQF 6 kwi Public Management/ Administration njengokuqashwa yi SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 yohlelo oluhle ekuphatheni. Ukusebenziswana nekhompyutha, Amakhono Okuxhumana Ahle kahle, Amakhono Okuphathwa, Amakhono Okuxhumana Nabantu, Amakhono Akuhlelwa, Amakhono Okuthayipha kanye Nokuwuna, Amakhono Obuholi Abalulekile, Ukulondolozwa kwezimali ngokwesisekelo, ukuthatha amaminithi nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi nge Education Sector kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Siza ekuhlanganisweni yonke imisebenzi ehlobene Nokuqashwa ESifundazweni sa GET, FET kanye ne ABET. Xhumana ube nomsebenzi wokubambisana nesifundazwe kanye nezikolo kuzo zonke izindaba zokuqashwa kanye nokuhlolwa. Siza ekuhlanganisweni yonke imisebenzi yokuqashwa kanye Nokuhlolwa esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwawo wonke amapholisi kanye namanyathelo ngokuqashwa kanye Nokuhlolwa esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezidingo zenqubo yesifunda sawo naso sonke isifundazwe mayelana Nokuqashwa kanye Nokuhlolwa njengokuqashiwe Kumaminithi Kakuqashwa Kwezwe nesiFunda kanye ne UMALUSI. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezokuphepha kanye nezilinganiso zokuhlolwa esifundeni ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yesifundazwe kanye nasezweni kanye nemiyalo yephulisi. Siza ekuhlanganisweni inqubo yokusabalalisa yonke imiyalo yokuqashwa kubaphathi besifunda nakwizikolo. Thumela yonke izicelo zesifunda zokubekwa komuntu oqashwa nokuhlolwa kubaphathi besifunda nasehhovisi elikhulu lesifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo nokuqinisekile kwezimali, abantu kanye nezinsiza ezingokwemvelo, okuhlanganisa nokulawula impahla ngokuphumelelayo esifundeni. Siza ekwakheni nasekuphatheni amabhajethi okusebenza. Siza ekuqapheleni ukuphepha nokuvikelwa, okuhlanganisa nokugcinwa kanye nesilabhu yayo yonke impahla yokuqashwa esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe PFMA, nemiyalo ye Supply Chain Management.

zu.title: Isihlungi Sokuqala Sabasebenzi: Izimo Zokusebenza
zu.summary: Isihlungi Sokuqala Sabasebenzi esiphatha izimo zokusebenza kumnyango we-Education e-Amathole East, Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingezansi ze-(3-year) NQF 6/7 ezifanelekileyo kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management/ Administration njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Isipho esingentla kweminyaka ye-3-5 yokuhlala kwendawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuzenzisa ngokuqondisa nge-PERSAL noma nakuphi na inkqubo ebandakanya i-HRM. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuhle kolwandle wokumthetho ohlola i-Human Resources. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiweyo nokuzithanda ukuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector luya kuba lusizo lokwengeza.
zu.duties: Ukuqonda nokulawula imigangatho yemali yokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ngezeliso ezinikiwe kundawo. Ukuqonda nokugcina irekhodi labasebenzi ngeholo yonyaka, iholo yokufunda, iholo yokugula nokuqeshwa okukhethekileyo kwaye uthintele imibuzo kubaphathi nasekubasebenzini ngokwakha okutsha. Ukusebenzisa izimo zokusebenza, inkqubo yokuhola nezinto ezinzuzo zabasebenzi. Kuqinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yayo yonke inkqubo (yamaphesha nokuqashwa) nezibonelelo zenziwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izimo zokusebenza nezinto ezinzuzo zenkonzo (Iholo, izindlu, i-Medical, iNkonzo eQinisekiswayo, ukuQatshwa kuQinisekile, ukumoshwa kwamandla, Iholo yokwenza iNkonzo eQinisekileyo, ukushiywa kwendawo, iPension, izibonelelo, i-PILIR). Ukunikwa nokubeka iso ekugqityweni kwenkonzo. Ukunikwa iinkonzo zokuqonda iholo. Ukwaba nokugcina izinga lomsebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ukulinganisa inkqubo yomsebenzi wabasebenzi. Ukusebenzisa isigqibo.

xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (kwiminyaka esi-3) se-graduate ye-NQF 6/7 kwiZicwangciso zoBuntu beMisebenzi/uBulawuli kaRhulumente njengoko kuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalule kakhulu eminyakeni engama-3-5 equkuqweyo kwindlu yokusingathwa koBuntu beMisebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusebenzayo nge-PERSAL naliphi na inqanaba elinxulumene noBuntu beMisebenzi. Ulwazi oluhle nokuqonda kolwimi-mthetho olulawula uBuntu beMisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni nokulungelelaniswa nokuhamba kubalulekile. Ulwazi ngeQondo lemfundo kuya kuba lusizo oluthe kratya.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokulawula iibhajeti zoRhwesho lwabaSebenzi nemiQatho enikezelwe kummandla. Ukuqonda nokugcina irekhodi labasebenzi ngemvume yokuphumla yonyaka, imvume yokufunda, imvume yokugula kunye nemvume etshoyo, kwaye unikeze isikhokelo kwabaphathi nasekubeni basebenzi malunga nezinto ezintsha ezenzekayo. Ukulawula iimeko zoSebenzo, imivuzo nezinzuzo zabasebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba intlawulo yazo naziphi na iinzuzo (kumda wokugqibela nasemva kwemisebenzi) kunye nemali yokongezelelwa yenziwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa iimeko zoSebenzo kunye nezinzuzo zoSebenzo (Imvume yokuphumla, ukuhlala, yeMedyeshala, iNgonakalo esebenzini, ukuQatshwa koBuntu beMisebenzi besixesha eside, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesixa, ukuHamba, iRhenti, imali efunwa ngokomthetho, iNzuzo, i-PILIR). Ukuqinisekisa nokubeka amaxesha okuphuma emsebenzini. Ukunika inkonzo yolawulo lwemivume yokuphumla. Ukwaba nokugcina ukuchaneka komsebenzi. Uphuhliso labo bantu abasebenzayo. Ukuqokelela iimfuno zabasebenzi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi olufunwayo kunye nemigudu yomthetho ezikwinkqubo yokubuyela ngembuyaeko ekuxineni, ixabiso elinguzunzi nokuthoba ukuziphatha kwimisebenzi ekuyo.

Three (3) years’ functional experience in Supply Chain Management at a public entity or government institution. A valid driving license. Computer Literacy. Excellent Communication Skills. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.

Check alignment of requisitions with Logis regulations. Receive submissions from end-users. Check validity of the accompanying documents. View, capture and authorize requisitions on the system. Assist in reviewing supply chain management processes, policies and performance and make recommendations to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the supply chain unit. Supervise junior or production clerks and ensure compliance measures are adhered to.

af.requirements: Driejaar-Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of voorgraadse bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Finansiële Bestuur/ Toesienkettingbestuur/ Inkoop / Logistiek/ Openbare Administrasie / Finansies / Rekeningkunde / Ekonomie / Interne Oudit. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Toesienkettingbestuur by 'n openbare entiteit of regeringsinstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede. Basiese finansiële rekordhouding, notuleer- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Ontvenginkoopdokumentasie van die Interne Kontrole-eenheid en verifieer akkuraatheid. Vang en magtig kwotasies en versoekte in, insluitend verifikasie van Goods Received Vouchers (GRV). Werk inligting op die stelsel by en korrigeer weergawe daarvan. Druk verslae en kontroleer status van verskaffers. Fassiliteer registrasie van verskaffers op die databasis (Sentrale en Logis). Kontroleer vereiste inligting op die kwotasies. Wanneer vereis, registreer verskaffers met aktiewe nommers op beide stelsels. Verseker nakoming van tersaaklike SCM-wetgewing. Superviseer junior- of produksieklerke en verseer dat nakomingsmaatreëls gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: Isikhulu se-SCM: Ukuphathwa kwe-Logistics nezitolo
zu.summary: Ukuphathwa kwe-logistics nezitolo ngaphakathi kwenyunyana ye-Supply Chain Management e-Head Office yomnyango we-Education e-Eastern Cape, okudinga i-diploma ehlobene nezimali kanye neminyaka emithathu yokuhluleka e-SCM.
zu.requirements: Three-year National Diploma (NQF 6) noma i-undergraduate bachelor's degree (NQF 7) ku-Financial Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing / Logistics/ Public Administration / Finance / Accounting / Economics / Internal Audit. Three (3) years’ functional experience in Supply Chain Management at a public entity or government institution. A valid driving license. Computer Literacy. Excellent Communication Skills. Administration Skills. Interpersonal Skills. Organisational Skills. Typing and Writing Skills. Strong Leadership Skills. Basic financial recording, minute taking and report writing skills. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
zu.duties: Thola ukwaziswa kokuthenga ekuvela ku-Internal Control Unit bese uqinisekisa ukulingana. Faka bese unikela igunya emagazini nasezinqubungweni kuhlanganisekuqinisekisweni kwe-Goods Received Vouchers (GRV). Nikela igunya kuma-purchase orders kulesosistimu. Hlola bese ukhiqiza i-LOGIS reports noma ngabe zidingeka nini. Siza ekusuleni kwe-commitment futhi uhlinzeke nge-commitment analysis reports noma ngabe zidingeka nini. Hlola okuthunyelwe okutholakele okwaziswa ngokwesimiso. Qondisa ukuqedwa kwamafomu log. Yenza imisimulo yemithetho nezimiso. Khiqiza okuthunyelwe nama-memos wokuthenga. Hlola ukulingana kwezinqubo nemisimulo ye-Logis. Thola okuthunyelwe kubasebenzisi bokugcina. Hlola ukusemthethweni kwamadokhumenti ahambisana nawo. Buka, faka bese unikela igunya ezinqubungweni kulesosistimu. Hlola amakhodi ahambisana namanani okuthenga. Qondisa ukuthenga kulesosistimu. Thola futhi ufake idatha yezibambo zokuthenga ezamukelekile. Buyekeza futhi ulungise ukuboniswa kwaziswa kulesosistimu. Shicilela imibiko bese uhlola isimo sabathengisi. Qondisa ukubhalisa abathengisi kwidatabase (Central and Logis). Hlola ukwaziswa okudingeka emagazini. Uma kudingeka, bhalisa abathengisi ngamanani abasebenzayo kuzo zombili izinhlelo. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa komthetho ohlobene ne-SCM. Siza ukubuyekeza izinqubo, imisimulo kanye nokusebenza kwe-supply chain management bese unikeza izindulumiso ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle nokuguqulwa kwenyunyana ye-supply chain. Lawula abakhiqizayo abasebancane noma abakhiqizi bamasheya futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokulandelwa zimaziwe.

xh.title: ISikhulu se-SCM: Ulawulo loQhagamshelwano namaQumrhu
xh.summary: Ukulawula uqhagamshelwano namaqumrhu ngaphakathi kweyunithi yoLawulo loQhagamshelwano loQhagamshelo kwiNtloko yeSebe lezeMfundo eNtshona Koloni, kufuna isidanga esinxulumene nezimali neminyaka emithathu yamava e-SCM.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sikaMnazwe seeminyaka emithathu (NQF 6) okanye isidanga se-Undergraduate se-bachelor's (NQF 7) kuLawulo lweMali / uLawulo loQhagamshelwano loQhagamshelo /okuThenga / uQhagamshelwano / uLawulo lukaRhulumente / eMali / isiBali / iQonomics / uKwangaphakathi. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava omsebenzini kuLawulo loQhagamshelwano loQhagamshelo kwisikhundla sabantu okanye isikhululo karhulumente. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha. Amaxabiso amaninzi eNtetho. Amaxabiso oluLawulo. Amaxabiso oBudlelwano nabantu. Amaxabiso lokuQamba. Amaxabiso okuBhala nokuthayipha. Amaxabiso amaninzi eQondo. Amaxabiso abalulekileyo oqikelelo lweMali, okubala amaminithi nokubhala iingxelo. Ulwazi ngeQela loQhagamshelwano lweMfundo kuya kuba luswele olukhuselekileyo.
xh.duties: Amkele uxwebhu lokuthenga oluvela kwiYunithi yoLawulo lwaNgaphakathi uze uqinisekise ukuchaneka. Uqhathe futhi uvume amaxabiso nezicelo kuquka ukuqinisekiswa kweemvoucha zeempahla ezamkelekileyo (GRV). Uvume iiodolo zokuthenga kwisixokelewayo. Uhlaluthe uze uvelise iingxelo ze-LOGIS njengoko kufuneka. Usize ekususeni i-commitment uze unike iingxelo zohlalutyo lwe-commitment njengoko kufuneka. Uqinisekise uxwebhu olutholwe kumagqabhala ngokwemigaqo. Ukhuthaze ukugqitywa kweefomu zelogi. Ufakela iinkqubo zemigaqo nemiyalelo. Uvelise amagqabhala namemo okuthenga. Uqinisekise ukulondolozwa kwezicelo nemigaqo yeLogis. Amkele amagqabhala avela kubasebenzisi bokugqibelela. Uqinisekise ukusebenza kokuxwebhu okulandelayo. Ubonise, uqhathe uze uvume izicelo kwisixokelewayo. Uqinisekise amakhodi afanelekileyo namanani okuthenga. Ukhuthaze ukuthenga kwisixokelewayo. Amkele uze uqhathe idatha yamagqabhala okuthenga avunyiweyo. Uhlaziye uze ulungise ukubonakala kolwazi kwisixokelewayo. Uphrinte iingxelo uze uqinisekise imeko kabathengisi. Ukhuthaze ukubhaliswa kabathengisi kwidatabase (eQongo naseLogis). Uqinisekise ulwazi olufunekayo kwamaxabiso. Xa kufuneka, bhalisa abathengisi namanani asebenzayo kuzo zombini iinkqubo. Siza ekuhlalutweni kweenkqubo,zemigaqo nentlalo yolawulo loqhagamshelwano lokuqhagamshela uze unike izindulo zokuphucula ukusebenza kokusebenza kolawulo loqhagamshelwano. Qwalasela abakhaliphi abancinci okanye abavelisi uze uqinisekise ukuthobela iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.summary: SCM Officer managing asset and disposal records at the Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office in Zwelitsha, requiring a diploma or degree and three years' SCM experience.

af.summary: VKB-amptenaar wat bate- en wegdoeningsrekords bestuur by die Eastern Cape Department of Education Hoofkantoor in Zwelitsha, wat 'n diploma of graad vereis en drie jaar se VKB-ervaring.
af.requirements: Drie-jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of voorgraadse bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Finansiële Bestuur / Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Aankope / Logistiek / Openbare Administrasie / Finansies / Rekenkunde / Ekonomie / Interne Oudit. Drie (3) se jaar funksionele ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur by 'n openbare entiteit of regeringsinstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede. Administratiewe vaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Organisatoriese vaardighede. Tik- en skryfvaardighede. Sterke leierskapvaardighede. Basiese finansiële rekordhouding, notule neem en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die Onderwyssentrum sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Oorsien die samestelling en onderhoud van rekords. Verifieer die uitreiking van toerusting en bybehoeftes aan komponente en individue in nood. Identifiseer oortollige, nie-diensbare en verouderde toerusting vir wegdoening. Oorsien die verifikasie van die bate-register. Dateer op en onderhou die verskaffer (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis. Verseker dat verskaffers op die stelsel vasgelê en geregistreer word. Versoeq en ontvang kwotasies. Vang spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel vas. Verseker dat alle bestellings betyds geplaas word. Reik bieddokumente uit en ontvang dit. Verskaf sekretariaat of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die oorweging van bod en die afsluiting van kontrakte. Kontroleer, plaas en verifieer bestellings vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Vang goedere vas en verseker dat dit in registers en databasisse vasgelê word. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Kontroleer en onderhou goederegisters. Dateer op en verseer die onderhoud van die register van verskaffers. Ken werk toe en verseer gehalte daarvan. Personeelontwikkeling. Assesseer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

Nike izinto kubasebenzisi bokugqibela. Pheqa ugcine iirekhodi zezinto. Hlaziya uqinisekisa ulondolazo lwerekhodi yababoneleli. Wabela uqinisekise ukuguquguqulelwa komsebenzi. Uphuhliso labasebenzi. Hlola inkqubo yabasebenzi. Sebenzisa isohlwayo.

zu.summary: Hlela izinqubo zokuthenga kuhlanganise izinkomba, izinqubo zokubeka izitshixo kanye nokudala amadeshi ohlelo lwe-Department of Education eZwelitsha.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yomzulu Wezimbabwe (NQF 6) weMinyaka Emithathu noma i-degree yabaphushi be-undergraduate (NQF 7) kwiFinancial Management / Supply Chain Management / Purchasing / Logistics / Public Administration / Management / Finance / Accounting / Economics / Internal Audit. zu.duties: Siza ukuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba, amagama okubuka kanye nokuphatha izinqubo zokucaphuna/ukubeka izitshixo. Siza ukudala amadeshi okuthenga impahla kanye nezinsiza ngokulandela isicaphuno esamukiwe noma izinkomba zokubeka izitshixo. Faka amasistimu wokuqapha ukuthobela izimiso nokulawula, hlela ukwenziwa kolwazi oluthuthukisiwe. xh.summary: Thwebula iinkqubo zomthwalo ongena ngaphakathi kuquka iimveliso, iinkqubo zokuthengisa nokwenza iiodolo zeSebe leMfundo eZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) yeminyaka emithathu okanye izidanga zobugcisa obuzenzekelayo (NQF 7) kwilawulo lezeMali / ulawulo loMthwalo wemisebenzi / ukuThenga / iLogistics / uLawulo oluBhalwe ngakuLuntu / uLawulo / izeMali / i-Accounting / i-Economics / ukuQinisekisa ngaphakathi. Iimveliso zeminyaka emithathu (3) yokusingatha kwilawulo loMthwalo wemisebenzi kumthetho woluntu okanye kwisikhululo karhulumente. Ileyisensi yokushayela (i-Code B nangaphezulu) esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngeQela leMfunda kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Nceda ukuthwebula ukusetyenziswa kweemveliso, iinkqubo zokwenza izalathiso nokumiswa kweenkqubo zokuqamba ixabiso/zokuthengisa. Nceda ukunika amaxwebhu okuthengisa, ukuze ugcine isiseko seenkonzo ezinikezelwayo, uhlalutye izicelo zokuthenga ezingeniswa. Nceda ekwenzeni iiodolo ukuthenga izimpahla neenkonzo ngokuhambelana neqondo nesityibiliki esamkelekileyo. Gcina amaphuzu ngokuzalathisa nomthetho, ugcobe iinkqubo zokwaziswa ukwenza iinkonzo ezingcono. Thwebula, hlanganisa ubhlehlele amabali okusebenzela nezamabali ngemithetho yonke yamathengiso kwiiSebe. Bala uqinise imimiselo yokugcina amagama, ukuhlala ixesha elide nokubuyisela kwamagama ngokwemigaqo yesabe. Lawula abasebenzi abangangenwa ziimfundo kwiYunithi yoLawulo lweMithetho. Yahlula uqinise ukhuseleko komsebenzi. Ukuziphuhlisa kubasebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Sebenzisa isohlwayo.

af.summary: Twee SCM-beamptes word benodig vir bate- en voorraadbestuur in die Eastern Cape Department of Education, met 'n diploma of graad en drie jaar se SCM-ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Driejaar-Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of voorgraadse bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Finansiële Bestuur/Voorraadkettingbestuur/Aankope/Logistiek/Openbare Administrasie/Finansies/Rekenkunde/Ekonomie/Interne Oudit. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Voorraadkettingbestuur by 'n openbare entiteit of regeringsinstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede. Administrasievaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Organisasievaardighede. Tik- en Skryfvaardighede. Sterk Leierskapsvaardighede. Basiese finansiële boekhouding, notuleer en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Hou toesig op die samestelling en instandhouding van rekords. Verifieer die uitreiking van toerusting en bybehoeftes aan komponente en individue in nood. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir beskikking. Hou toesig op die verifikasie van die bateregister. Werk die verskaffer(insluitend kontrakteurs)-databasis by en onderhou dit. Verseker dat verskaffers op die stelsel vasgelê en geregistreer word. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Lys spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel. Verseker dat alle bestellings betyds geplaas word. Uitreik en ontvang boddokumente. Verskaf sekretariaats- of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die oorweging van die bod en die afsluiting van kontrakte. Kontroleer, plaas en verifieer bestellings vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lys goedere in registers en databasisse en verseker dat dit gedoen word. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reis goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Kontroleer en onderhou goederegisters. Werk die register van verskaffers by en verseer die instandhouding daarvan. Wiis werk toe en verseker gehalte. Personeelontwikkeling. Assesseer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe eminyaka emithathu (NQF 6) noma iziqu ze-undergraduate ze-bachelor (NQF 7) ku-Financial Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing/ Logistics/ Public Administration/ Finance/ Accounting/ Economics/ Internal Audit. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuxhumana. Amakhono okolawulo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuqamba izinhlelo. Amakhono okuthayiphwa nokubhala. Amakhono amakhulu ohulumeni. Amakhono asemthethweni okurekhoda izimali, okuthatha amaminithi kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi nge-Education Sector kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuqoqa kanye nokugcina amarekhodi. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwemishini namaseshensi kumakomponi kanye nabantu abadingayo. Hlola imishini engasetshenziswa, engasebenzi kanye neyadlula umuso yokulahleka. Qaphela ukuqinisekiswa kwerejista yamafa. Buya updatea futhi ugcine idathabheysi yabanikezeli (okuhlanganisa nabaqashayi). Qinisekisa ukuthi abanikezeli babotshwe futhi babhaliswe kulesistimu. Cela futhi wamukeze amaquotation. Bhalisa izindinganiso kulesistimu yekhompyutha yokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaholo abekwe ngesikhathi. Nikeza futhi wamukeze amadokhumenti ohlolo. Nikeza isekretariyethi noma ukusekelwa ngokuhlelekwa ngesikhathi sehlolo kanye nesiphetho sezinkontileka. Hlola, beka futhi qinisekisa amaholo emithengiso. Yamukeza futhi qinisekisa imithengiso kubanikezeli. Bhalisa futhi qinisekisa ukuthi imithengiso ibhaliswe kwamarekhodi nakwidathabheysi. Yamukeza izicelo zemithengiso kubasebenzisi bokugcina. Nikeza imithengiso kubasebenzisi bokugcina. Hlola futhi ugcine amarekhodi emithengiso. Buya updatea futhi qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwerejista yabanikezeli.abela futhi qinisekisa ikhwalithi yomsebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Hlola inkambiso yabasebenzi. Faka isisu.

af.requirements: Driejaar-Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of Voorgraadse Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Vervoer / Logistiek / Publieke Administrasie / Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Vlootbestuur by 'n openbare entiteit of regeringsinstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Kliëntediens (Batho Pele-beginsels). Fondswaardes. zu.duties: Ukuphumeza inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezimoto yomnyango, izinqubo kanye nokubekwa kwabanye. Ukuphatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphathwa kwezimoto.
