af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Uitgawebestuur
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester in Uitgawebestuur by die Department of Education, Eastern Cape, wat skuldeiserbetalings, afstemmings en BAS-verwante finansiële administrasie hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Gesikte (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Finansiële Rekeningkunde/Finansiële Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar in finansiële of rekenkundige dienste. Kennis van die Government Financial System (BAS), Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die onderwyssektor en finansiële bestuur op departementele vlak sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van finansiële beplanning, begroting en verslagdoeningstelsels van die staat. Vaardighede: Deurlopende Verbetering, Probleemoplossing en Besluitneming, Beplanning en Organisering, Netwerkwerk en Verhoudingsbou, Impak en Invloed, Kommunikasie en Inligtingsbestuur, Begroting en Finansiële Bestuur. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Fasiliteer verwerking van skuldeiserbetalings binne 30 dae. Kontroleer vir akkuraatheid van fakture en egtheid van ondersteunende dokumente wat aan die kwitansie geheg is. Berei betaalde bondels voor en dien dit in vir lêer. Reageer op navrae van diensverskaffers. Berei maandelikse afstemming van skuldeiserrekenings voor. Volg skuldeisernavrae na wat voortspruit uit skuldeiserafstemming. Verwerk betaling van salarisverwante aangeleenthede. Berei maandelikse uitgawverslae voor en dien dit in. Onderhou betalingsregister om alle vorme van betalings na te hou. Implementering van uitgawepatrone van die departement. Berei uitgaweverslagdokumentasie voor volgens verantwoordelikheidskodes van die programme. Identifiseer wan toekenning van fondse. Verskaf uitgawe-administrasiedienste vir die distrikkantoor en section 20 openbare skole. Analiseer uitgawetendense en verskaf tegniese adviesdienste. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Ken werk toe en verseker gehalte van werk. Personeelsontwikkeling. Evalueer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Isiphathimndeni sikahulumende: Ekuqapheleni Izimali Eziyisisekelo
zu.summary: Isiphathimndeni sikahulumende kukuqaphela izimali eziyisisekelo eDepartment of Education, Eastern Cape, ekuphatheni izimali ezikhokhelwa abanikazi zikadanga, ekulinganiseni nasekuphatheni izimali ezihlobene ne-BAS.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zediploma yezinga le-NQF 6 eminyakeni emithathu kwezimali noma ekuqashweni kwezimali njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani amabhaka eminyaka eyi-3-5 kulemikhankaso yezimali noma amasenti ezezimali. Ulwazi ngeGovernment Financial System (BAS), i-Public Finance Management Act nezimiso zeNdlu yokugcina imali. Ulwazi ngesikhathi samfundo nasekuphathweni kwezimali kumnyango kuzothola usizo. Ulwazi ngokuqumela izimali, ukwakhiwa kwebhajethi, ngezinhlelo zokubika kahulumende. Amakhono: Ukuphucula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuxhuman nokwakha izibopho, Ukuthonya nokuwusa, Ukuxhumanisa ulwazi nokuqashwa kokuqhubekayo, Ibhajethi nokuphathwa kwezimali. Amakhono okuxhumana aphephileyo (okubhaliwe nokuvelayo) kanye nokuqonda okuhle kolimi lwesiNgisi. Ulwazi ngeEducation Sector kuzothola usizo.
zu.duties: Qedela ukuthunyelwa kwemali kwabanikeli kungakapheli amasonto angu-30. Hlola ukuzwakalwa kwamabhilidi kanye nokunganaki okuhle okufakwe kulethi. Lungelele futhi uthumele amabhatsi abhukhwele ukugcina. Phendula imibuzo kubanikela. Lungelele nokwenza isilinganiso sekhulu lezimali zabamikeli. Landele imibuzo yabamikeli evela kusilinganiso sabo. Qedela ukukhokha izimali ehlobene neholo. Lungelele futhi uthumele amabhikhi wezimali ezikhokhwayo njalo ngenyanga. Gcina irikhothi yokukhokha ukuze ulandele yonke imikokhwa. Sebenzisa izinto ezikubukeka ukuthi umnyango usebenzisa izimali kanjani. Lungelele ukhokhothe amaphephu okubika ngemali ngapha kwezinkomba zobunyononile bemibhalo. Bonakalise imono eyihole esikhashana. Nikezela isikhala sabanikela imali nge-ofisi yesithili nangesikole sabakhathi be-20. Hlola ukuhamba kwemali futhi nikezela izeluleko zezinsuku. Qondise abantu abasebenzayo. Kabisa futhi othole ukuthi umsebenzi ulungele. Phuhlisa izisebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Sebenzisa inhlakahla.

xh.title: Isikwere kaGcino: Ulawulo lokuxhabalazwa
xh.summary: Isikwere kaGcino kuLawulo lokuxhabalazwa kwiSebe leMfundo, eNtshona Koloni, elibhekisa kuhlawulo lwabanikazi bemali, ukuqwalaselwa kwemali kunye nolawulo lwezimali oluhambelana noBAS.

Ulwazi ngebhunga lemfundo kunye nolawulo lwezimali kwinqanaba lesebe kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi ngokuhlela izicwangciso zezezimali, ukwakha amabhajeti, kunye neenkqubo zokuchaza ezarhulumente. Amapakeni: Ukuphucula ngokuhamba nayixo, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo,okuqwalasela noKuhlelwa, ukuzidibanisa nokwakhiwa kwezibophelelo, ukunika amandla nokuchukumisa, Ulwaziso lolonwabo noLawulo lwamaxhathu, amabhajeti noLawulo lweMali. Amakhono othetho olusebenzayo (olubhalwe noluthethwayo) nolwimi olulungelelhantlaka kwisiNgesi. Ulwazi ngeNgingqi yeMfundo kuya kuba yingezi ezodwa.
xh.duties: Qhubele phambili ukuqhuba kwezihlawulo zabakholwa kwiintsuku ezingama-30. Phonononga ubunyani ngenxa yemali efakiweyo kunye nokuzinza kwamaxwebhu axhasa efakeliweyo kwi-voucher. Lungisa ungenise amakhomityi ahlawuliweyo afakelwa kufayili. Phendula imibuzo evela kubakhi Besebenzi. Lungisa ungenise iinyanga ukuphinda uqwalasele i-akhawunti zabakholwa. Landela izigqibo zemibuzo yabakholwa evela kuQwalaselwa ngokutsha kwabakholwa. Qhuba izihlawulo ezihlobene nomvuzo. Lungisa ungenise iingxelo zemali ezixhutshwa zinyanga zonke. Gcina irekhodi lesihlawulo ukuze ulandele zonke iindlela zokuhlawula. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuhlawula kwesebe. Lungisa ukuqulunqa amaxwebhu engxelo yezezimali ngokweekhowudi ezithathwa kumaziko. Zibuza ngokuhliswa kwemali kwindawo engafaneleyo. Zisa iinkonzo zolawulo lwemali kwiofisi yesithili nakumaziko a-20 emfundweni sikarhulumente. Phengulula iindlela ezixhutshwa yimali unike iinkonzo ngomcebisi wamava. Lawula abasebenzi besebenzisa abantu. Hlengahlengisa kwaye uqinisekise isidima somsebenzi. Ukuzithutha-Ntutha koluntu. Qwalasela umthetho wokusebenza kubasebenzi. Sebenzisa inzondo.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Distrikbegrotingskoördinering
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeenter benodig vir distrikbegrotingskoördinering in die Eastern Cape Department of Education, wat 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie in finansies en 3-5 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Financial Accounting/Financial Management. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar in finansiële of rekenkundige dienste. Kennis van die Government Financial System (BAS), Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die onderwyssektor en finansiële bestuur op departementele vlak sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van finansiële beplanning, begroting en verslagdoeningstelsels van die staat. Vaardighede: Deurlopende verbetering, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, beplanning en organisering, netwerking en verhoudingsbou, impak en invloed, kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur, begroting en finansiële bestuur. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelinge vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: : Die behandeling van S & T-eise. Die behandeling van fakture vir die betaling van ander eise. Deelneem aan die begrotingsproses en help met die samestelling, konsolidasie en ontleding van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse uitgawerslae binne die kantoor teen die goedgekeurde begroting. Die behandeling van voorsienings- en verkrygingsake in die kantore wat finansiële implikasies het. Inisiëer en plaas rekenkundige transaksies op rekord. Finansiële verslae opstel, help met die maandelikse bywerking van die databasis van die kantoor oor finansiële inligting en voldoen aan die voorskrifte van die Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations asook departementele finansiële beleide en prosedures. Personeel adviseer oor die korrekte benutting van finansiële of begrotingsprosedures. Die behandeling van fakture vir die betaling van ander eise. Monitor die strepieskode-bates en werk die batesregister by.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikahulumeni Esibhekene Nezimali: Ukuhlelelelana Kwesabelomali Sifunda
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhundla sikahulumeni esibhekene nezimali sokuhlelelelana kwesabelomali esifundeni ku Eastern Cape Department of Education, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF 6 kumkhakha wezimali nephilo eminyaka engu-3-5 yemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezinganga eminyaka emithathu ze-NQF 6 kwi-Financial Accounting/ Financial Management. Uphawu lweminyaka engu-3-5 kumkhakha wezimali noma ezimali zokubhalisa. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Government Financial System (BAS), i-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi mayelana nomkhakha wezemfundo kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali kwizinga lomnyango kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi mayelana nokuhlela kwalezimali, ukwenza isabelomali, kanye namasistimu wokubika wesive. Amakhono: Ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo, Ukuhlela kanye Nokuqamba, Ukuxhumana kanye Nokusungela Izinhlonzi, Ukuthonya kanye Nokuminyanisa, Ukuxhumana kanye Nolwazi Lokuphatha, Ukwenza Isabelomali kanye Nokuphathwa Kwamali. Amakhono okuxhumana abalulekile (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo) kanye nobuhlakani obuhle kolimi lesiNgisi. Ulwazi mayelana nomkhakha wezemfundo kuzongeza inzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukuziphathela ngemikhankaso ye-S & T. Ukuziphathela ngamafomu okukhokha eminye imikhankaso. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwenqubo yokuqamba isabelomali kanye nokusiza ekwakhiweni, ekuhlanganisweni kanye nokuhlaziya imibiko yokuchithwa kwemali yenyanga, kwekota nakonyaka ofisini ngokumelana nesabelomali esivunyiwe. Ukuziphathela ngemikhankaso yokuhlinzeka nokuqasha ema-ofisini anemithelela ezimali. Ukuqala bese kubhalwa izimali zokubhalisa esigabeni. Ukukhiqiza imibiko yezimali, ukusiza ekubhaleni nyanga zonke ulwazi lwesizindalwazi ofisini ngolwazi lwezimali kanye nokulandela imiyalo ye-Public Finance Management Act ne-Treasury Regulations kanye nemithetho nezinqumo zomnyango ngokwezimali. Ukuletha abasebenzi ngendlela efanele yokusebenzisa izinqumo zezimali noma ukwenza isabelomali. Ukuziphathela ngamafomu okukokha eminye imikhankaso. Ukuphatha amafa emikhondisogebha bese ubhalisa izinkomba ezihlobene nawo.

xh.title: IsiAccountant sikaRhulumente: Ulungelelwaniso lweBajeti yoMmandla
xh.summary: Kufuneka isiAccountant sikaRhulumente oluvela kolungelelwaniso lebajeti yommandla kwiSebe leZeMfundo eEastern Cape, kwaye kufuneka sibenemfuno yeNQF 6 kwezezimali nephuhlviso lonyaka we-3-5.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zesidanga se-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Financial Accounting/ Financial Management. Ixesha elingentla le-3-5 emisebenzini yezemali okanye abasebenzi abanenjongo. Ulwazi ngeGoverment Financial System (BAS), i-Public Finance Management Act neTreasury Regulations. Ulwazi ngabancedisi bemfundo nokulawula iinkqubo zemali kumgangatho wesebe kuya kuba ngumdla. Ulwazi lweendleba zemali, ulungelelwaniso lwebajeti, neenkqubo zokuvelisa iinkcukacha zolawulo. Ikhono: Ukuphucula ngokunganiki, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo, Ulungelelwaniso nokuqamba, Ukuseka unxibelelwano nokwakha ubudlelwane, Nakuphi na ukuthintela kwaye kwangaphandle, iimpawu zolwazi nolawulo, Ulungelelwaniso lwebajeti nokulawula iimali. Ukusebenza okubandakanya ukubhala nokuthetha nolwimi oluhle lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi ngebala lemfundo luya kuba ngumphawu ongongezi.
xh.duties: Phendula izikhalazo ze-S & T. Phendula iinavosi ngeemfuneko zokuhlawula ezinye izikhalazo. Thatpaathi ekulungelelwaniseni ibajeti yoncedise ekubhaleni, ekudibaniseni nasekuqwalaseleni iinkcukacha zokuqhaqhofo kwexesha lokukhululeka kwexesha elinye, kwikota nasekuhlohlweni ngokuchasene nebajeti egunyaziweyo kwiofisi. Phendula iindaba zokuqokelela nokuveliswa kwempahla kumagumbi aneempembelelo kwiimali. Qinisekisa kwaye ubhale izicelo ezimalini emgcenweni. Velisa iingxelo zemali, nceda ekugciniweni kwexesha leinye kwegcagcagcemalunga nolwazi olumiselweyo kwi-ofisi nithobele iimiso ze-Public Finance Management Act neTreasury Regulations njengoko kukho neenkqubo zeemali zesebe. Nceda abasebenzi ngokusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kweenkqubo zemali okanye zebajeti. Phendula iinavosi ngeemfuneko zokuhlawula ezinye izikhalazo. Qwalasela ukhondo abambe nemali zepahla kwaye uvise isitshintsho sempahla kumagumbi ombhalo.

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jarige) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Rekenkunde/Finansiële Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar in finansiële of rekenkundige dienste. Kennis van die Government Financial System (BAS), Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die onderwyssektor en finansiële bestuur op departementele vlak sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van finansiële beplanning, begroting en verslagdoeningstelsels van die staat. Vaardighede: Deurlopende Verbetering, Probleemoplossing en Besluitneming, Beplanning en Organisering, Netwerkwerk en Verhoudingsbou, Impak en Invloed, Kommunikasie en Inligtingsbestuur, Begroting en Finansiële Bestuur. af.duties: Fasiliteer die verwerking van krediteurbetalings binne 30 dae. Kontroleer die akkuraatheid van fakture en die egtheid van ondersteunende dokumente wat by die kwitansie aangeheg is. zu.summary: Isikhwama Sezimali Sezwe esiphethe izinkokhelo zokudluliswa eEastern Cape Department of Education Head Office eZwelitsha, esidinga isigungvu sezimali nokuba namava eminyaka eyi-3-5.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanelekile se-(3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Accounting/Financial Management njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-3-5 kuleze nkonzomali noma ezimali. Ulwazi nge-Government Financial System (BAS), i-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi ngemmango yemfundo kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ezingeni lomnyango kuzoba yinzuza. Amakhono: Ukuthuthuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo, Ukuhlela nokuhlela kabusha, Ukuxhumanisa nokwakha izibopho, Ukuthonya kanye nokubakhuthaza, Ukuxhumana kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi, Ukwenza izikweletu nokuphathwa kwezimali. zu.duties: Qondisa ukuqashelwa kwezinkokhelo zabakhekhe kungakapheli emasikhathini angu-30. Hlola ukuqonda kwe-invoice kanye nokuzithoba kwamadokhumenti okusekelayo athunyelwe kwi-voucher. Landa imibuzo yabahlinzeki evela kusukweni kabahlinzeki. Lungisa futhi uhambise izibiko zokusebenzisa izimali ngenyanga. Gcina irekhodi yokukhokha ukuze ulande zonke izinhlobo zezinkokhelo. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuqoqa izimali zomnyango. Lungisa amadokhumenti ezibiko zokuqhoshwa kwemali ngokwezakhiwo ekuphathweni. Qaphela ukungalungiswa kokwabiwa kwemali. Hlinzeka ngokwaziswa ngokuphathwa kokushiswa kwemali. Hlola ukuthi imali isetshenziswa kanjani bese unikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe. Qaphela nokuphatha izinsizakalo. Yaba imisebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yenziwe kahle. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Fakela isigqobo.

Ulwazi ngabalambele bemfundo nolawulo lwezimali kwinqanaba lesibe kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi ngokucinga ngezimali, ukwenza ibhajeti, kunye namaphakamiso wesizwe. xh.duties: Lungisa ukuqhuba imaxabiso yabahanisiweyo kungemphakathi yemini engama-30. Pheqa ukuchaneka kwesixa nokuqinisekisa amaxwebhu axhasayo anamathele kwi-voucher. Lungisa ngokubhala bese ulawula iibhacthi ezihlawuliweyo zokuzigcina. Phendula imibuzo evela kubabanisi beeNkonzo. Lungisa kwangenyanga ukulinganiswa kwe-akhawunti zabahanisiweyo. Uphuhliso lwabantu. Pheqa isimilo sabantu basebenza. Faka isohlwayo.

jobs.summary: Manage departmental debts, interdepartmental claims and revenue services at the Eastern Cape Department of Education Head Office in Zwelitsha.

af.title: Staatrekenmeester: Skuld- en Inkomste Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur departementele skulde, interdepartementele eise en inkomste dienste by die Eastern Cape Department of Education Hoofkantoor in Zwelitsha.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Rekeningkunde/ Finansiële Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar in finansiële of rekeningkundige dienste. Diepgaande begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Begrip en toepassing van die volgende voorskrifte: Public Finance Management Act, DORA, Treasury regulasies, Treasury / Practice Notes, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Algemene Rekeningkundige Beginsels, SCM Riglyne en Raamwerke, Begrip van Finansiële Bestuur se beste praktyke. Finansiële Bestuur Stelsels (PERSAL, BAS). Kennisbestuur. Diensleweringsinnovasie. Probleemoplossing en analise. Rekenaarbedrywig. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelinge vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestuur van departementele skulde en interdepartementele eise. Vang in, analiseer en hersien skulde, doen opvolg op nie-betalings van skulde. Stel op, vang in/ magtig skuldopnames en joernale. Monitering en mentorskap van distrik skuld- en inkomste amptenare. Ontvang en bank van kontant. Vang in/ dag- einde ontvangs, Skakel uit van Uitsondering en skuld suspend. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op. Voldoening aan departementele voorskrifte. Mentorskap/ toesig van rekeningklerke, leerders en internes. Personeelbestuur. Verseker bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span / afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte / hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimum leiding aan ondergeskiktes. Handhaaf 'n gunstige werksomgewing en bestuur van afwesigheidsverlof.

Okungenani amava eminyaka engu-3-5 kumasevisi wezimali noma ezokubala. Ukuqonda ngokujulile ummandla wemithetho ohlolisa Isevisi Yomphakathi. xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (kwiminyaka elithathu) se-undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Accounting / Financial Management njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-3-5 kwiinkonzo zezimali okanye zokuqhutywa kwezimali. Ukuqonda ngokujulile kwesakhiwo somthetho esibusa iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izichazi-mthetho ezilandelayo: i-Public Finance Management Act, i-DORA, i-Treasury regulations, ama-Treasury / Practice Notes, ama-Treasury & DPSA Circulars, i-General Accounting Principles, i-SCM Guidelines and Frameworks, ukuQonda kwe-Financial Management best practices. Ii-Financial Management Systems (PERSAL, BAS). Ukuqonda ngokwakha ulwazi. I-Service Delivery Innovation. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuwahlula-hlula. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalawulo obuhezeko (awabhalwayo nawathethwayo) nokulawula ngokucokisekileyo ulwimi lwesiNgesi. Ukuqonda nge-Sector yokuQondisa kubakho ngenxa yokuphucula.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha iisuspense accounts zesebe nokuulandela iintengiselwano ezingazicntyuliweyo. Ukuqamba ukuqamba/ukuqinisekisa ukuthathwa kwezikolwe nge-journals. Okokubalwa nokukhuthaza iisuspense accounts zeedolophu. Ukuqamba iingxelo ngenyanga nangonyaka kwikota. Ukuzithoba ngokwezichazi-mthetho zesebe. Ukusebenza kuko konke ukugxabha nokwaliwa kwe-Salary. Ukuqamba iingxelo ngenyanga nangonyaka kwikota. Ukuzithoba ngokwezichazi-mthetho zesebe. Ukuqondisa/kulawula ababali-imali, abafundi nabaqeqeshi. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphatha, ukugcina nokusinda kweempahla. Ukugcina amanqanaba aphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / icandelo liza nemisebenzi emangalisayo ngokwemilinganiselo / ngobuningi nangexesha. Ukuxazulula iingxaki zokunikela inthemba nokulawula ngocoluleko oluncinci kubalawuli. Ukugcina indawo yonqamlezio efanelekileyo nokulawula ukushiya nge-vacation.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Financial Monitoring and Reporting
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: State Accountant position in the Department of Education providing financial monitoring and reporting support services at Head Office in Zwelitsha.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate (3-year) undergraduate NQF 6 in Accounting/ Economics/ Financial Management as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years in financial or accounting services. In-depth understanding of legislative framework that governs the Public Service. Understanding and application of the following prescripts: Public Finance Management Act, DORA, Treasury regulations, Treasury / Practice Notes, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, General Accounting Principles, SCM Guidelines and Frameworks, Understanding of Financial Management best practices. Financial Management Systems (PERSAL, BAS). Knowledge Management. Service Delivery Innovation. Problem Solving and analysis. Computer literate. Good communication skills (written and verbal skills) and a good command of English language. Knowledge of Education Sector will be added advantage.
jobs.duties: Provide in-year monitoring services. Assist in provide interim and annual reporting support services. Provide interim and annual reporting support service. Administration of Departmental debts and liabilities. Assist in the compilation of Interim and Annual Financial Statements. Assist in safeguarding and storage of financial records. Assist in the monitoring, controlling, and reporting of the departmental cash flow. Monitor and report on the wasteful expenditure, irregular and unauthorized expenditure when detected. Assist with the compilation of IYM reports for the department. Provide advice and guidance on budget to programmes. Compile monthly and quarterly reports. Compliance with departmental prescripts. Process all Bond and Salary rejections. Compile monthly and quarterly reports. Compliance with departmental prescripts. Mentoring/ supervising of accounting clerks, learners and interns. Personnel management. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance to subordinates. Maintain conducive working environment and management of leave of absence.

af.title: Administrabeamptelike: Projekoördinering
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte vir Projekoördinering by die Eastern Cape Department of Education Hoofkantoor in Zwelitsha, wat 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar se administrasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike (3-jaar) voorgraadse NQF 6 in Public Management/ Administration of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administrasie-omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, administrasievaardighede, mensevaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede, tik- en skryfvaardighede, sterk leierskapsvaardighede, basiese finansiële rekordhouding, notuleneem en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n organisatoriese dashboard vir alle projekte. Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van tegniese adviesdienste oor projeksbestuursbeginsels en prosedures. Bystand verleen met ondersteuning vir die ontwikkeling van 'n standaardraamwerk vir DEO se projeksbestuursraamwerk. Bystand verleen met ondersteuning vir die implementering van strategiese inisiatiefprogramme en projekte soos EPWP, School Rationalisation, ICT Roll-out en E-learning, bevordering van Afrikatale in skole ens. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van finansiële, menslike en fisiese hulpbronne, insluitend effektiewe batesbeheer. Bystand verleen met die opstel en bestuur van operasionele begrotings. Verseker die implementering van die PFMA en Supply Chain Management-voorskrifte.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuphathwa kwezinto: Ukuhlukanisa Phakathi Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuphathwa kwezinto sokuhlukanisa phakathi kwemisebenzi esikhundweni esiyingqayizivele se Eastern Cape Department of Education e Zwelitsha, sidinga iziqu ze-NQF 6 neminyaka eyi-3-5 yokuhlanganisa ulwazi kokuphathwa kwezinto.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele eziyisikhathi esingeminyaka eyi-3 ze-NQF 6 ezenziwe ngaphansi kwebanga leziqu eziyisisekelo kwi Public Management/ Administration noma naliphi elinye iziqu elihambisana nalelo njengoba kuqashelwe yi SAQA. Okungenani amava eminyaka engu-3-5 ahambisana nendawo yokuphathwa kwezinto. Ukusebenzisana nekhomphyutha, amakhono aphezulu okuxoxa, amakhono okuphathwa kwezinto, amakhono okusebenza nabantu, amakhono ekuqokelelweni kwemisebenzi, amakhono okubhala nokuthayipha, amakhono aphakeme okukhokha, ukuqopha okuyisisekelo kwezimali, ukuthatha iminutingi nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngeqoqo lemfundo kuzoba ngusizo olukhulu.
zu.duties: Siza ekwakheni nasekugcineni isibonakaliso senhlangano kuzo zonke imisebenzi. Siza ngamacebo obuchwepheshe ekuphathweni kokuqoka kwemisebenzi nendlela ekwenziwa ngayo. Siza ekwesekeni ekwakheni umphatho ovamile wohlelo lokuqoka kwemisebenzi kuhlelo lwe DEO. Siza ekwesekeni ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqoka nezinkalo ezinhle njenge EPWP, ukuqoqwa kwezikole, ukusatshaliswa kwe ICT nokufundela ngokusebenzisa ikhomphyutha, ukukhuthaza izilimi zase-Afrika ezikoleni njll. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokusebenza kahle kwezimali, abantu nokuletha izinto, okuhlanganisa nokuqapha okusebenzayo kokuphathwa kwempahla. Siza ekuqokeleleni nasekuphathweni kwezimali ezisetshenziswa nsuku zonke. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe PFMA nemithetho ye Supply Chain Management.

xh.title: Iofisa woMlawulo: uLawulo lweProjekthi
xh.summary: Iofisa woMlawulo wokuLawula iProjekthi kwiOfisi enkulu ye-Eastern Cape Department of Education eZwelitsha, ifuna isigqibo se-NQF 6 namava eminyaka eyi-3-5 kulawulo.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esifanelekileyo (seminyaka esi-3) se-undergraduate NQF 6 kwi-Public Management/ Administration okanye naliphi na elinye isigqibo elihambelana nalo njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalulekileyo eminyaka eyi-3-5 kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha, amakhono eNtwazulwimi amBalaseleyo, amakhono oLawulo, amakhono eBantu, amakhono eNqanaba loluntu, amakhono eThayiphi nokuBhala, amakhono eBalulekileyo eQonda, ukugcina irekhodi yemali esisiseko, ukuthatha imizuzu nokubhala iiriphotha. Ulwazi ngeQondo leMfundo luya kuba yinzuzo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuphuhliseni nasekugcineni idashibhodi yeqanaba loluntu kuzo zonke iiprojekthi. Nceda ekunika iinkonzo zenkxaso malunga neemvisiswano nemiqathango yoLawulo lweProjekthi. Nceda ekunikeni inkxaso ekuphuhliseni isiseko esizeleyo somthetho wokwenza umsebenzi wolawulo lweeprojekthi ze-DEO. Nceda ekunikeni inkxaso ekusebenziseni iinkqubo neeprojekthi ezibalulekileyo ezinjenge-EPWP, ukuHlaziwa kweziKolo, ukuKhutshwa kwe-ICT nokuFunda nge-akhompyutha, ukuthuthuzwa kolwimi zesiNtu kumaziko emfundo n研究报告 naxa ngaphezulu. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nokusebenza kakuhle kweempahla zemali, zabantu nenzulu, kuquka ukulawula ngokusebenzayo izinto. Nceda ekuyilweni nasekulawuleni imigangatho yemali yemisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa i-PFMA, imigaqo yoLawulo lweNkcitho.

af.title: Sekretaresse: Leerderontwikkeling en Maatskaplike Ondersteuning
af.summary: Sekretaresse wat ontvangs- en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Direkteur by die Eastern Cape Department of Education Hoofkantoor in Zwelitsha verskaf, waarvoor 'n Graad 12-sertifisaat vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifisaat met geen ervaring vereis nie. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondelinge vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis van die Wetlike Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens. Bewese bevoegde kennis van basiese kantooradministrasiepraktyk. Kennis van verkrygingstelsels. Bevoegdhede: Rekenaarvaardigheid, Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede, Administrasievaardighede, Mensevaardighede, Organisasievaardighede, Tik- en Skryfvaardighede, Sterk Leierskapsvaardighede, Basiese finansiële boekhouding, notuleneem- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf sekretariële/ontvangstoondersteuning aan die Direkteur soos volg: Neem telefoonoproepe aan en verwys die oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke bestuurder bedoel is nie. Neem afsprake en gebeure in die bestuurder se dagboek op. Tik dokumente vir die bestuurder en die ander personeel binne die eenheid op 'n woordverwerker. Bedryf kantoorstoerusting soos faksmasjiene en fotostateerders. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuningsdienste aan die bestuurder. Dit behels die volgende: Skakel met agentskappe om reisdokumentreëlings te tref, kontroleer die reëlings wanneer die betrokke dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en gebeure vir die bestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers, organiseer verfrissings en stel skedules vir vergaderings en gebeure op. Verwerk die reis- en bestaanseise vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die bestuurder se werk. Neem basiese notule van die bestuurder se vergaderings waar nodig. Opstelle roetine-korrespondensie en verslae. Doen invul van dokumente vir die bestuurder. Administreer sake soos die verlofregister en telefoonrekenings. Hanteer die verkryging van standaardartikels. Neem aan, registreer en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Versamel alle betrokke dokumente om die bestuurder in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures wat op haar/sy werkterrein van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die Direkteur te verseker.

zu.title: Unobhala: Intuthuko Yabafundi Nokuxhasa Komphakathi
zu.summary: Unobhala ohlinzeka ngokwesekwa kwezokwamukela izivakashi kanye nokuphathwa kwezinto olawula iNkantolo Elikhulu leMnyango weMfundo eEastern Cape eZwelitsha, ofuna isitifiketi seGrajiyedi 12.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrajiyedi 12 asidingi noma yiphi ngolwazi. Amakhono okuxhumana asebenzayo (okubhaliwe nangomlomo) nokuqonda kahle ulimi lwesiNgisi. Ulwazi mayelana Nenhleleleko Yomthetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi oluziwayo olukhombisa ukuziphatha kokuqonda izisekelo zokuphathwa kwezinto zohhovu. Ulwazi ngamaphulatifomu okuthenga. Izikhali: Ukuba nokwazi ngamakhompyutha, Amakhono Okuxhumana Aphezulu, Amakhono Okuphathwa Kwezinto, Amakhono Ohlwini Lwabantu, Amakhono Ezenhlaka, Amakhono Okubhala Nokuthayipha, Amakhono Ebuholi Obunamandla, Ukugcina izinkokhelo zezimali ezisisiseko, ukubhala imininingwane yezinkulumo nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngesecta yemfundo kuzoba yindlela yokunceda okwengeziwe.
zu.duties: Uhlinzeka ngesevisi yokwesekwa komunobhala/okwamukela izivakashi kwiNkulu njengokulandelayo. Wamukela amakholi efoni futhi adlulise amakholi kubantu abafanele uma engewabonwa komphathi. Ubhala izinketho zemibhalo nezinkathi kumabhuku womphathi. Uthayipha amafayela umphathi kanye nabanye abasebenzi ohlwini kusetshenziswa igama elenziwe. Usetsha izinto zohhovu njengamafeksi nokushicilelwa kakhulu. Uhlinzeka ngesevisi yesisekelo esibhalwe umphathi. Lokhu kuzofaka okulandelayo. Xhumana nezinhlanganiso ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhamba kwamadokhumenti, Hlola izinhlelo uma amadokhumenti afanele etholwa. Hlela izinkulumo nezinkathi zomphathi nabasebenzi ohlwini. Misa izindawo, mema abadlali abafanele, hlela ukuphathwa kwokusondela okukhulu kanye nesibuyekezo sezinkulumo nezinkathi zomphathi. Xhuma izimali zokuhamba kanye nokuhlukanisa izinkokhelo zohlelo. Xhuma zonke izinkokhelo ezingela emsebenzini womphathi. Bhala imininingwane ebalulekile kwezinkulumo zomphathi lapho kudingeka khona. Cabangela amagama okuxhumana nezinhloso zemibhalo. Yongeza amafayela omphathi. Phatha izinto njengoba ukugcina izinkokhelo nokuyeka kanye namabhuku wamafoni. Xhuma ukuthenga okuvamile. Thola, bhala futhi wabelane zonke izinto ezingena nokuqhumisa. Qoqa wonke amafayela afanele ukuze umphathi akwazi ukuhlanganisa izinkulumo. Gcina ulwazi ngemithetho nemiqulu mayelana nomsebenzi wakhe ukuze wenze ngokusebenza kahle kweNkulu.

xh.title: Unobhala: Ukuphuhlisa abaFundi nokuNxulumanisa ngokweZentlalo
xh.summary: Unobhala onikeza inkxaso yokwamkela iindwendwe nolawulo kuMlawuli kwiNtliko eNkulu koSebe lezeMfundo koMntla Mpuma Koloni eZwelitsha, ofuna istifikedi seQeli le-12.
xh.requirements: Istifikedi seqeli le-12 akukho nalunye ulwazi olufunekayo. Amapuzu amaninzi awasebenzayo okunxibelelwana (awokubhalayo nokuThetha) nokuqonda kakuhle ulwimi lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi ngeSiseko seMithetho yoMsebenzi woLuntu. Ulwazi oluzinze lusemgangathweni ngamapolasi omlinze wolawulo lofisi. Ulwazi ngezithuba zokuthenga. Ikhono: Ukuba lisesikrinibhali/kompyutha, Amapuzu oMangalisweyo okuNxibelelwana, Amapuzu oLawulo, Amapuzu oBantu, Amapuzu oLungelelwaniso, Amapuzu okuBhala noKuthayipha, Amapuzu aManinzi oBukhosi, uBhalo lwamaMallet eMali aMsulwa, ukuthabatha amanqaku kwaye ubhale iingxelo. Ulwazi loLwango loQeqesho luya kuba lusizo ngaphezulu.
xh.duties: Unikeza inkxaso yokuba ngumamkeli wamakhol/kunobhala kuMlawuli ngale ndlela: Ukwamkela ucingo olutsalayo kwaye aluludluleleko kubadlali abalungileyo bendlu xa bungengowomlawuli. Ubhale iintsapho negqabi zomhla kwisiqwengana somlawuli. Uthayiphe amaxwebhu amlawuli kwaye nalabo basetyhini kwindlu yakhe ngomoya, icandelo ngelinye. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zofisi ezinjengefeksi kwaye ithathe izihobe ezingacwangciswanga. Unikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yofisi kumlawuli. Oku kuya kuqulathe oku: Uqhagamshelane noMmandla ukuze alungiselele ipepa zokuhamba, Akuqinisekise ukulungelelanisa xa amaxwebhu afunyaniswa. Ahlele iintlanganiso nemiganosho kumlawuli nasebantini bandlu yakhe. Afumane iindawo, abize abadlali bendlu, alungiselele ukutya kwaye ahlele ishedi yemiganosho. Akuqhube imiyalelo yokuhamba nokutyhala kulwazi kwaye alawule zonke iingxato ezingavela kumsebenzi womlawuli. Abhale amanqaku eziseko zeentlanganiso zomlawuli apho kufunekayo. Abhale iingxelo nemiyalelo eqhelekileyo. Agenise amaxwebhu kwaye alungiselele umlawuli. Alawule izinto ezinjengesazizi sokuShiywa kwesikhathi ngesixa-mali sefoni. Aphathe ukuthengwa kwezinto eziqhelekileyo. Awamkele, abhale kwaye abeke zonke ipepa eziza kwaye eziphuma. Athwale onke amaxwebhu afunekileyo ukuze umlawuli akwazi ukulungiselela iintlanganiso. Agcine ulwazi malunga nemithetho/iingcebiso neendlela ezikwimeko yakhe ukuze anikeze inkxako kumlawuli ngenkathalo ekhoyo ixesha elide.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Onderwysdienste-bedrywighede
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig in Mthatha om korrespondensie, lêerstelsels en data-invoer vir die Eastern Cape Department of Education te bestuur.
af.requirements: A grade 12-sertifikaat met geen ervaring wat vereis word nie. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelingse vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal; Kennis en begrip van PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act en Employment of Educator Act. Effektiewe mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goed-ontwikkelde redenering wiskundig, innoverende denke asook probleemoplossingsvermoë, vermoë om 'n verskeidenheid take uit te voer en in staat te wees om onder druk te werk. Kennis van die onderwysektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Registreer, organiseer, stoor, voer in en onttrek korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie). Dateer registers en statistieke op. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotokopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimilies. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik basiese briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande register van die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikkantore). Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaan- en reis-eise van amptenare en dien in by bestuurder vir goedkeuring. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Inqubo Yezinsiza zemfundo
zu.summary: Kudingeka clerk wezolawulo eMthatha ukuphatha ukuxhumana, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amafayela nokungena kwemininingwane ngokwe Eastern Cape Department of Education.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se grade 12 kanti asikho isidingo senkathazo. Amakhono okuxhumana ngempumelelo (amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma) nolimi oluhle lwesiNgisi; Ulwazi nokugonda ngakwa-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act ne-Employment of Educators Act. Amakhono aphumelelayo okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukucabanga okuphumelelayo okumathematheka, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha kanye nokuba nokwandlondlobalo lokuxazulula izinkinga, ikhono lokwenza inhlobo yemisebenzi ehlukene nokuba nokwandlondlobalo ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkula. Ulwazi ngesiqondi Semfundo kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Qopha, hlela, gcina, faka futhi ulande ukuxhumana nemininingwane (inkqubo yomugqa). Mukela ukuvuselelwa kwezarejista nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele ama-fax. Sabelisa amadokhumenti/amasentimishi ohulumeni abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze inkqubo yokulondoloza amafayela yeqoqo. Thayipha amagama okuyisisekelo kanye/noma okunye ukuxhumana uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ukulalelana kwarejista kuleqoqo. Xhumana nohlulumeni bangaphakathi nabangaphandle kokuthenga ukuthi kutholakale impahla kanye namasevisi. Thola izikotshana, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga ngesikhathi kuthengiswa izinto eziyisisekelo zofishi. Lawula isitoko sezinto zofishi eqoqweni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lempahla yeqoqo (izikhungo zesifunda). Gcina irejista yezikhathi zokulala eqoqweni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi eqoqweni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yokubakho eqoqweni. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala endaweni. Hlola ukuthi ama-claims okuhamba nokudla abasebenzi ayingiyongo yini bese uwathumela kummanaja ukuba awomemezele. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nensiwa encane eqoqweni.

xh.title: Inkgebiso Koluluze: Imisebenzi YeZiko Lemfundo
xh.summary: Kufuneka inkgebiso koluluze e Mthatha ukulawula uqhagamshelwano, iinkqubo zokugcina iifayile nokuqokelela iingcombolo kwi Eastern Cape Department of Education.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe senqanaba lesi-12 akukho nalunye uqeqesho olufunekayo. Amakhono apheleleyo oluxhomo (amakhono okubhala nokuqaqambisa) nokuqonda kakuhle ulwimi lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwe-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act kunye ne-Employment of Educators Act. Amakhono apheleleyo oluxhomo olwenziwa nolubhalwayo. Ukucinga okukhululekileyo kwemathematika, ukucinga okutsha kunye namandla okusombulula iingxaki, amandla okwenza iindidi ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nokuze ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi ngamacandla emfundo kuya kuba yincedo.
xh.duties: Qopha, hlela, gcina, qokelela naphinda ulande uqhagamshelwano nengcombolo (umsebenzi woluhlu). Hlaziya iirejista kunye neesithathistathistatu. Jala imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi ezongaziwa nathabatha okanye uthumele iifeksi. Sazisa amaxwebhu/amasentiza kubahlali abahlukeneyo njengoko kufunekayo. Gcina ulungelelanise inkqubo yokugcina iifayile yecandelo. Bhala iilet ezisisiseko nakuba apho nyana olunye uqhagamshelwano xa kufuneka. Gcina ulungelelanise iirejista ezikengo naphuma kwecandelo. Thetha nabahlali abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthengwa kwempahla neenkonzzo. Fumana izibizo, gqiba iifomu zokuthengwa kwempahla eqhelekileyo zofiso. Lawula isitokhwe sempahla zofiso. Gcina ulungelelanise i-rejista yempahla yecandelo (i-ofisi zommandla). Lungelelanisa i-rejista yobuso becandelo. Gcina ulungelelanise iirekhodi zabasebenzi kwicandelo. Gcina ulungelelanise i-rejista yokubakho becandelo. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwesimali malingo zokuhamba neendleko zabasebenzi uzithumele kumphathi ukuvunywa. Jala ii-akhawunti zefowuni nenyolo encinci kwicandelo.

zu.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, thwebula futhi ulande izincwadi eziyisixhumanisi nezinkomba (umsebenzi woluhlu). Buyekeza amarekhodi noma imibhalo ezobalwa. Phatha imibuzo yamalanga. Thayipha izincwadi eziyisisekelo kanye/noma ezinye izincwadi lapho kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi leminyuzi epehla yaphuma nalengena ngaphakathi komnyango. Xhumana nabaningi abangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngokuqoqwa kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Phemba izikweletu, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga ukuthenga izinto eziyisisisekelo zohluzo. Lawula izinto zohluzo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze uhlu lwempahla yomnyango (kanti izikhungo zingaphakathi noma ngaphandle). Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lemvume yokuhamba yomnyango. Hlela ukuhamba nokulala ugesi.

xh.title: Clerk woMlawulo: Emis, uluLawulo & iNggaxa
xh.summary: Isebe leZemfundo le Eastern Cape lifuna clerk wolawulo ukulawula amarekhodi, ukuzigcina kwefayili noluxhumo e Nelson Mandela Bay.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12 akukho mfundo edunyiswayo. Amakhono axhumana aphumeleyo (amakhono okubhala nokuthetha) nokulawula kolwimi yesiNgesi. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwe PFMA, i Treasury Regulations, i Public Service Act nokuSebenzisa i Employment of Educator Act. Amakhono okuthetha nokubhala aphumeleyo. Iindlela zokucinga ezithuthileyo ezibalo, ukucinga ngendlela entsha nakakhono ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwazi ukwenza iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi nge Education Sector kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Qamba, hlela, gcina, bamba kwaye uze uphezele uluxhumo nedatha (umsebenzi woluhlu). Hlaziya amarejista namanani. Phatha imibuzo yamaxesha athe ngqo. Yenza iikopi kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele iifaksimile. Yahlula amaxwebhu/amasenti kubahlali abahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulawule inkqubo yokugcina iifayili yale nlungu. Bhala iileta ezisiseko kunye/noma elinye uluxhumo xa kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista lokungena nokuphuma kwale nlungu. Xhumana nabahlali bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuhlobene nokuthengwa kwempahla nesebe. Fumana iintengiso, gcwalisa iifomu zokuthenga izinto zofisi eziqhelekileyo. Lawula isitokhwe zempahla zofisi. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista lempahla yale nlungu (ii-ofisi zesithili). Lawula irejista yokuhamba yale nlungu. Gcina kwaye ulawule amarekhodi abasebenzi kule nlungu. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista lokubakho yale nlungu. Hlela uhambo nendlalo. Qinisekisa ubuchanaphezulu bokuza kubakho izicelo zohambo zabasebenzi kwaye uzithumele kumanejala ukuze zamukele. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni nemali encinci yale nlungu.

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Stroombestuursadministratiewe Ondersteuningsseenheid
af.summary: Die Departement van Onderwys soek ses administrasieklerke vir strookantore in Mbizana, met Graad 12 as vereiste en geen ervaring wat nodig is nie.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met geen ervaring vereis nie. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelingse vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis en begrip van PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, Openbare Dienswet en die Wet op die Indiensneming van Onderwysers. Effektiewe mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goed ontwikkelde redeneringswiskunde, innoverende denke asook probleemoplossingsvermoë, vermoë om 'n verskeidenheid take uit te voer en in staat wees om onder druk te werk. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Registreer, organiseer, berg, vang en haal korrespondensie en data op (lynfunksie). Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostaatkopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkette aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik basiese briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande register van die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes ten opsigte van die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaardkantoorartikels. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikskantore). Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Rëel reis en akkommodasie. Kontroleer korrektheid van bestaans- en reis-eise van amptenare en dien by bestuurder in vir goedkeuring. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Umlobi Wemibhalo: I-Circuit Admin Support Unit
zu.summary: Umnyango we-Education ufuna abasebenzi abayisithupha ababhala imibhalo ohhovisini le-circuit e-Mbizana, kudingeka i-Grade 12 futhi akudingeki ulwazi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 singadinga ulwazi. Amandla okuxhumana asebenzayo (amandla okubhala nokukhuluma) nalokhu ukuqonda kahle ulimi lwesiNgisi Ulwazi nokuzuva i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act kanye ne-Employment of Educator Act. Amandla asebenzayo okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukucabanga okuhle ngemibala kukhombisa izibalo, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha kanye namandla okuxazulula izinkinga, amandla okwenza inhlobo-hlobo yemisebenzi nokuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Ulwazi lwe-Education Sector luzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka kusistimu bese kuphinda kutholakale ukuxhumana namathambo nedayetha (umsebenzi ohleliwe). Buyekeza imibhalo nesibalo. Phathela imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza amakhophi bese wamukela noma uthumela amafax. Sula amadokhumenti/amasethji kubahlaleli bezinhlobo-hlobo njengoba kudingeka. Gcina bese ulondoloza isistimu yefayela lesigaba. Bhala amagama ayisisekelo namathambo abhalwayo noma enye into lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina bese ulondoloza umbhalo wokungena nokuphuma wesigaba. Xhumana nabahlaleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthengwa kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo. Thola amaqashiso, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezingajwayelekile zohhovisi. Lawula isitoki sesithomathomanendo sohhovisi. Gcina bese ulondoloza umbhalo wempahla wesigaba (ihhovisi lendawo). Gcina bese ulondoloza umbhalo wokulahlwa kwesikhundla wesigaba. Gcina bese ulondoloza imibhalo yabantu kulesigaba. Gcina bese ulondoloza umbhalo wokubakhona wesigaba. Hlela ukuhamba nokuchitha ubusuku. Hlola ukungakahlwa kwamaphuzu okuhamba nokuphila kwabasebenzi bese uwathumela kumenejeri ukuze uvume. Phatha izikweletu zocingo nemali encane yesigaba.

xh.title: Umlamathi Kolawulo: INdulamthetho yoNcedo loLawulo lweSebe
xh.summary: Isebe leMfundo lifuna abalamathi bolawulo abasixhenxe kwi-ofisi zesixeko e Mbizana, kufuneka abe neGrade 12 akukho mfundo yamava edingekayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seGrade 12 akukho mava ezidingekayo. Amakhono abalulekileyo enkxaso (amakhono ebhalwe namakhalo) nolunxulumano olulungileyo lolwimi lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi nokugqonda kwiPFMA, Iimigaqo zeNqolowa, uMthetho woKukhonza kaWonke wonke noMthetho woMsebenzi wabaThisha. Amakhono abalulekileyo enkxaso ebalwe namakhalo. Ikhono lezibalo, ukucinga okutsha kunye nakhono lokuxazulula iingxaki, ikhono lokwenza iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nokuqonda ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Ulwazi lweNdawo yoMfundo luya kuba ngumahlulo.
xh.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, thata kwaye ugcobe unxibelelwano nedayitha (umsebenzi woluhlu). Hlaziya iirejista nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikhophi kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele iifeksi. Yahlula amaxwebhu/iiqhiqamatheli kumacandelo ahlukeneyo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulawule inqanaba lokugcina laye candelo. Bhala iileta ezisisiseko okanye enye into yonxibelelwano xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yokungena nophuma kweso candelo. Thethathetha namacandelo angaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nokuthenga izinto nkonzo. Fumana iisaziso, gcwalisa iifomu zokuthenga izinto zofice eziqhelekileyo. Lawula isitokhwe seshishini sofisi. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yezinto zomnikazi we candelo (iiofisi zesithili). Hlaziya irejista yokuhamba kuyo candelo. Gcina kwaye ulawule irekhodi zabasebenzi kuyo candelo. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yokubakho kuyo candelo. Lungiselela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwamasikelo okuhamba nabasebenzi kwaye uzinikele kumanejala ukuvunywa. Phatha ii-akhawunti zefowuni nezimali ezincinci zayo candelo.

xh.summary: Clerk yolawulo ophatha unxibelelwano ngeemeko zokusebenza, efayila athi agcine ulwazi kwaye abuyise idatha kwisebe lezemfundo lase Eastern Cape.

Isiphiwo sokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo (iziphiwo zokubhala nezothethayo) nay olunolwazi oluhle lolwimi lwesiNgesi Ulwazi nokuqonda kwi PFMA, i Treasury Regulations, i Public Service Act ne Employment of Educator Act. af.title: Registerklerk: Diensvoorwaardes
af.summary: Die Department of Education soek 'n Registerklerk om pos, lêerbestuur en kliëntnavrae by twee Eastern Cape-sentrums te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat sonder dat enige ervaring vereis word. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelingse vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Kennis van registerpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van bergings- en terugwinning prosedures binne die werksomgewing. Kennis en begrip van die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act en Employment of Educator Act. Effektiewe mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goed ontwikkelde redeneringswiskundige, innoverende denke asook probleemoplossingsvermoë, vermoë om 'n verskeidenheid take uit te voer en om onder druk te kan werk. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos/lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en versprei pos. Versprei kennisgewews oor registerkwessies. Open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/berging, naspeur (elektronies/ handmatig) en terugwinning van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Open en hou frankingsmasjienregister by. Frank pos, registreer geld en werk die register daagliks by. Doen steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Sluit pos in pos sak vir bodes om na die Poskantoor te af te lewer. Open en hou remittance-register by. Registreer alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in remittance-register. Hand af en teken remittances oor aan finansies. Stuur verkeerde remittances via geregistreerde pos terug na die sender en registreer die verwysingsnommer in die register. Hou daagliks rekord van die hoeveelheid briewe gefrank. Superviseer die verwerking en verwerk dokumente vir argivering en/of vernietiging. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om geargiveer te word en dien dit by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords van geargiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Clerk Rejista: Izimo Zenkonzo
zu.summary: I-Department of Education ifuna u-Clerk Rejista ukuphatha iposi, ukulawula amafayela, kanye nemibuzo yabathathi isikhundla ezikhungweni ezimbili zase-Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 njengoba akudingwa ngabe unamava. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (okubhala nokukhuluma) kanye nokuqonda okuhle kolimi lwesiNgisi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi rejista, izinqubo kanye nenhlelo yokungenisa idatha, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kanye noqonda ohlelo lomthetho lolawula i-Public Service. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nokuthola kabusha imibhalo ngokomtholampilo wendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi noqonda we-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act kanye ne-Employment of Educator Act. Amakhono aphezulu okuxhumana ngokukhuluma nokubhala. Isipho sokcabanga, isibalo, okucabanga okusha kanye nenhlelo yokusombulula izinkinga, ikhono lokwenza uhlobo oluhlukene lomsebenzi nokuqoba ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Ulwazi lwe-Education Sector lizoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Phatha abathathi isikhundla. Phatha imibuzo yefoni kanye neminye ezwakalayo. Yamukela bese ubhalisa iposi/amafayela alethwe ngesandla. Phatha ukushintshana ngemibhalo engena naphuma. Yamukela yonke iposi. Hlukanisa, bhala bese uthumela iposi. Saza izaziso mayelana nezindaba rejista. Vula bese uvala amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlukanisa irekhodi. Ugcinwe/ukubhaliswa, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokuthola kabusha imibhalo namafayela. Qedelisa amakhadi ashintsho kwawo wonke amafayela. Vula bese ulondoloza irekhodi lefreyiki. Faka uphawu iposi, bhala imali bese uvuselela irekhodi nsuku zonke. Hlola iposi noma kunjalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese. Khiya iposi esikhwameni seposi abathunywa ukuba bayithumele e-Post Office. Vula bese ulondoloza irekhodi lemali ethunyelwe. Bhala yonke imikhiqizo ethinta inani njengoba kushiwo kurekhodi lemali ethunyelwe. Ithunyele ngesandla bese usayina ukudlulisela imali efinance. Thumela imali ethunyelwe kabi emumumthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe bese ubhala inombolo yenkomba kurekhodi. Gcina irekhodi nsuku zonke yegeni lezizatshana ezibhalwe. Qaphela inqubo bese ulungisa imibhalo yokugcina/kulahlekelwa. Ukuhlola amafayela ngekhompyutha. Hlukanisa bese upakha amafayela ukugcinwa nakusatshalaliswa. Hlela uhlu lwemibhalo okufanele igcinwe bese uyinikeza ongqonqoshe. Gcina imibhalo yamafayela agcinwe.

xh.title: Umshicileli weFayile: Iimeko zokuSebenza
xh.summary: Isebe leMfundo lifuna uMshicileli weFayile ophatha iimeyile, ulawulo lweefayile, namabizo abathengi kumaziko amabini eEastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 ngaphandle kokufuneka nugqoqo lomsebenzi. Amakhono okunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo (amakhono okubhala nokuqhathanisa) noluniko oluhle lolwimi lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yefayile, iindlela zokuqhelanisa nokugcina amaxwebhu, kunye nokuqonda ukwenza amaxwebhu, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi nokuqonda imithetho yolawulo ephatha uMmandla kaRhulumente. Ulwazi lweendlela zokugcina nokubuyisela amaxwebhu ngokwelimeko lendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act, ne-Employment of Educator Act. Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nokubhala. Ukuzwela okukhululeyo kwesoqondo, amabalo, ukucinga ngendlela entsha kunye nokuqonda ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukwazi ukwenza iindidi ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nokuqonda ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwesithintelo. Ulwazi ngeMmandla woMfundo luya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Kumathathwe abathengi. Kuphathe imibuzo yefowuni neminye ibizo elifunyenweyo. Amkele kwaye abhalise iimeyile/iifayile ezibekiweyo ngesandla. kuphathe ukubhalelana koluntu olungena nokuphuma. Amkele onke amaxwebhu okubhala. Axabe, abhalise athumele iimeyile. Abhahalize izaziso ngemisebenzi yokugcina iindawo eziguqukayo. Avule azivale iifayile ngokomthetho wokuhlelwa kweeklayim. Azigcine/Azigcine, axhokwele (ngekhompyutha/gesandla) abuyise amaxwebhu neefayile. Agqibe amakhadi wokubhalisa iifayile. Avule agcine irekhodi yethuluzi lesikrwele. Asikrwele iiposi, abhale imali aze ashaye irekhodi yamaxesha. Axilibe ngakumbi izikrwele qobo eziguquguquvayo. Aze abhale ngokupheleleyo ibhalo lemali elahlekileyo ekumkela ngalo kuPost Office. Avule & agcine iBhalo labathunywa bhedi. Abhale uninzi lwemali ibhalo elitsha elithengiswa kubantu bemali, athi nhleka-abhokise ekuphela komhla.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 ngaphandle kokutholwa kokuhlanganiselelana. Amakhono okuxhumana aphephileyo (okubhaliwe kanye namakhono okukhuluma) kanye nokuphatha kahle ulimi lwesiNgisi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yesibhalo sabadayimbe, izindlela kanye nokuqashelwa kokutholakala kwemiyalo nokuqondakala kokuwasebenzisa, kanye nokutholakala komhlaba wangempela wesikhundla, okuhlanganiselelana kwemisebenzi kanye nokutholakala kokuqonda ulimi olulodwa kanti kuyadingeka nokutholakala kwesimo esilula. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yomthetho yokukhunga nokuqonda kokuwusebenzisa, ukuphathwa kokuqonda kweyona afulele ukulondoloza ibhange ekhaya lokutholakala kwezinkomba zokulandulwa kwabalingiswa, ukuqondakala kokuqonda nokuqonda amalungiselelo okukwenza ukuba ulwazi lwabo. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali ezenzwa ngaphandle kwezimali. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act kanye Employment of Educator Act. Amakhono okuxhumana aphephileyo okubhala nokukhuluma. Ukubakho kwamakhono okuhlanganiselelana kwemibuzo, ukubakho kwamakhono okuqonda nokucabanga ngokuhlakahlisombono kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amandla okwenza umsebenzi ongafanele ukuba usebenze emigqeni ehlukene kanti kuyadingeka nokuba ngamunye umuntu okufanele ukuba angabi nokuhlupheka kanti futhi ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bokuthi bafake emkhankathini. Ulwazi ngase-Education Sector luzobe lukhethe ikhanda likhulu.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 akukho nqanaba laphuqelweyo. Amakhono wokuthetha ngokuchanekileyo (akhono okubhala nokuthetha) nolwimi olululo lwesiNgesi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomatsho wezifayili, iindlela zokwenza, kunye nolwazi lokungena kwemininingwane, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda inguquko yomthetho ebalulekileyo elawula Inkonzo kaWonke-wonke. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokuphinda kufunwe kwendalo yokusebenza. Ulwazi nokuqonda iPFMA, iZimo zowiso-mali weNdlu yethwalu, uMthetho wenkonzo kaWonke-wonke noMthetho woBakhoyo Baphathwa abasebenza emzimbeni. Amakhono athetha ngokuchanekileyo nokubhala. Ukuphila okuzinze kokuqonda izibalo, ukucinga ngendlela entsha kunye namakhono okusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okwenza iintlobo ngeentlobo zemisebenzi nokuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwexesha elinzima. Balisa uluhlu lwemibhalo ethunyelwa windawo yokugcina umlando uze unike umphathi. Gcina iirekhidi zemibhalo egcinwe kwindawo yokugcina umlando.

zu.title: Ikhaluka Kazibhalweni: Ekuqashweni nasekulawuleni Izidingo
zu.summary: Izikhundla ziklawuka kazibhalweni ekuqasheni nokulawula izidingo ezidinga i-Grade 12, lapho imisebenzi ifaka phakathi ukulawula amarekhodi, ukugcina amafayela kanye nokuphathwa kwemibuzo evamile.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 ngeke sadinga ngisho nolunye uhalaza. Amandla okuxhumana (amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma) kanye nokuthi uqonde kahle ulimi lwesiNgisi. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, Izimiso Zesikhwama Senhlalakahle, Umthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wokubashwa Kubasebenzi Bayo. Amakhono aphumelelayo okukhuluma nokubhala. Ikono elivelele lokucabanga ngezibalo, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha kanye nethonyama lokuxazulula izinkinga, ikono lokwenza uhlobo olulodwa lwemisebenzi nokuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Ukulwazi ngqo mayelana noMnyango Wezemfundo kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uthole incwadi eyayisemthethweni nedatha (umsebenzi welayini). Buyekeza amarejista nezibalo. Phathela imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele amafeksi. Sabelisa amadokhumenti/amasethizi kubahlaleli abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze isistimu yokugcina amafayela enkampanini. Bhala amaleta asemqoka kanye/noma enye incwadi ephathelene nobudlelwano lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lokungena nokuphuma lenkampanini. Xhumana nabahlaleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nentengo kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo. Thola izikhandlela, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezijwayelekile zofisi. Lawula isitoko samathuluzi ofisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lezimpahla lenkampanini (ihhovisi lesifunda). Londoloza irejista lokuhlala lenkampanini. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi enkampanini. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lokubikhona lenkampanini. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Hlola ukuzwakala kwamafomu ezimali zokuhamba nabasebenzi bese uwahumushela umphathi ukuba awamukele. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nemali encane enkampanini.

xh.requirements: IsatifikethesGrade12akukhafunzoluningaqwayo.Aphumezelekokunyanyezela(somabhalana namatshanyanisi)kananjalo lunanolwazigqibeleleloluselwisiCingesiUlwaziLunombwiniwoqondaPFMA,miGaqosoriPhando,YomthethoWonkonzoZentlanganoYomthethoWonkonzoAbafundisi.Aphumezelelunyanyezelobumnyanabathethana.Uqonakugqithiswekokuqondisauphawuzibalo,intsingiseloekhanyayoekudalaingakukoimvizokunombwiniNokufumaniswa kokusombulula iingxaki, Ulawulo lokwenza iindidi zemisebenzi nokuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kokuxinzelela. Ulwazi kwiNgingqi yoMfundo kuya kuba lusizo elongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Qulatha, yenza uhlelo, gcina, bhala kwaye uze ubuyisele uxwebhu ulwazi (umsebenzi woluhlu). Hlaziya oovimba benani nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi zawe ukwamkela okuthumela amafeksi. Sabelanamaxwebhu/amasundukhulu kumahlomlenze ahlukahlukeni njengoko kufuneka. Gcina ulondoloze uhlelo lokulayisha amafa lolunxweme. Bhala iileta ezisisiseko nokuba yinyani naxwebhuakukhonjisiwe. Gcina ulondoloze oovimba bemibhaleyo nelayishi ephumayo eyangaphakathi. Thetha naboahlomlenze bangaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nokufumaniselwa kombhale wempahla namasebevisi. Fumana izicelo, gcwalisa iifomu ezosetyenziselwa ukuthenga izinto ezisisiseko zohlanga. Lawula isitokhhe sombhale woluhlu lwehofisi. Gcina ulondoloze oovimba bembaleka lolunxweme (zamahlelo ezithile). Gcina ulondoloze uhlelo lokulayisha iindleko zolunxweme. Gcina ulondoloze iirekhodhi zabasebenzi kwinxweme. Gcina ulondoloze oovimba bekukho yenzelwa lolunxweme. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo kweziindleko zehamba nabasebenzi nize nizithumle kumlawuli ukuba amke. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni netyala elincinci elosetyenziselwa lolunxweme.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 ngaphandle kolwazi oludingekayo. Amakhono okuxhumana asebenzayo (amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma) nolimi oluhle lwesiNgisi Ulwazi nokugonda i-PFMA, Imithetho Yezigqibo Yobe-Ndlu Yokugcina Imali, Umthetho Womphakathi Nokwenza Izinsiza Nomthetho Wokubeka Abafundisi. Amakhono asebenzayo okukhuluma nokubhala. Ikhono elithuthukisiwe lokuhlakanipha ngokwezibalo, ukucabanga okusha kanye nenhlanhla yokuxazulula izinkinga, ikhono lokwenza inhlobonhlobo yemisebenzi kanye nokuhlale ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingxabano. Ulwazi lwe-Sekthi Yemfundo kuzoba yincluster.
zu.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uphinde ulande unyathiselwano nezinkomba (umsebenzi welayini). Buyekeza izibhalo nengalo yezibalo. Phatha imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele uthume izwi ngefeksi. Yaba imibhalo/amasheke kubahlaleli behlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi ugcine uhlelo lokuqoqa amafayela esigaba. Bhala amabhali abanzi noma onyathiselwano lunye lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi ugcine isibalo sokungena nokuphuma kuleso sigaba. Xhumana nabahlaleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuqhathaniswa kwezimpahla nezinsiza. Thola izikweletu, gcwalisa amafomu okuthengisa izimpahla zofisi ezivamile. Lawula isitoko sesiceshi sofisi. Gcina futhi ugcine isibalo sezimpahla lesesigaba (izikhungo zendawo). Gcina isibalo sokubuyisela lesesigaba. Gcina futhi ugcine amabhali abasebenzi kulesesigaba. Gcina futhi ugcine isibalo sokuya kub asebenzi balesesigaba. Hlela ukuvakatsha nokuhlala. Hlola ukuthi izindleko ezinkulu zokuya kubasebenzi zivumelekile futhi uzinike umphathi ukuthi azivume. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nemali encane yaleso sigaba.

xh.summary: Mntu wonxibelelwano wezimali ekulawulweni kokuchithwa kwemali kwiNdlu yoMfundo yase Eastern Cape, efunesa ibhashe le Grade 12 ngaphandle kokuhlu-bukho, kwinqanaba 5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12 ngaphandle kokuhlu-bukho olufunekayo. Amandla anomdla wokunxibelelwana (okubhalwayo nokuthethwayo) nolwimi olululo lwesiNgesi Ulwazi nokuqonda kwi PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, iPublic Service Act naku Employment of Educator Act. Amandla anomdla wokunxibelelwana okuthethwayo nokubhalwayo. Ukukwazi ukucinga ngezonxibelelwano, ukucinga ngendlela entsha, nendlela yokuzoba iingxaki, ukukwazi ukweniza imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kokuxinzelelo. Ulwazi ngeQoqo loMfundo luya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Qamba, hlela, gcina, bhalisa naphinde ulande iindleko namanani (umsebenzi wemigca). Hlaziya amarejista namanani. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi zamaphepha uze wamkile okanye wathumele iifeksi. Yahlulela amaxwebhu/iipakethe kumalungu abahlukene njengoko kufunekayo. Gcina ulondolazele ukubhalwa kwamaxwebhu kule nto. Bhala iileta ezisisiseko naso nayiphi na enye iindleko xa kufunekayo. Gcina ulondolazele nahlaziya irejista yabakuyo nabaphumayo kwesi sebe. Thetha namalungu angaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthenga izinto neenkonzo. Fumana iiquotheshini, zgqiba iifomu zokuthenga izinto zofice eziqhelekileyo. Lawula isitokhwe sezinto zokubhala zofice. Gcina ulondolazele nahlaziya irejista yezinto zesi sebe (oo-ofisi bezithili). Hlaziya irejista yokushiya kwesi sebe. Gcina ulondolazele amarekhodhu abasebenzi kule nto. Gcina ulondolazele irejista yokubakho kwesi sebe. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Pokuza ukuqaqamba kwezimali mazimpumelelo zabasebenzi zenkqubo yokuhamba uze uzinikele kumphathi ukuze avume. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni nemali encinci yale nto.

Gcina futhi ulondoloze izibhalisi zababhalayo nabaphumayo nale nkomponi. Xhumana nabashaywe bengaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezenzo. Thola iziketshuni, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezingajwayelekile zehhovisi. Lawula isitoko sehhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izibhalisi zempahla yale nkomponi (izikhungo zesifunda). Lawula izibhalisi zokubuyela emsebenzini yale nkomponi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izibhalisi zabasebenzi yale nkomponi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izibhalisi zokubakhona yale nkomponi. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Hlola ukulunga kwamafomu wokubuyela emsebenzini nokuhamba abasemkhakheni uphathise kumenenja ukugunyaza. Phatha amakhonthi ethilophu kanye nemali encane yale nkomponi.

xh.title: Clerk yeBolo lweNtengiso: Ukuphuhliswa kweZemvelo eZincedisayo (X7
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuba ngamaclerks eBolo lweNtengiso kummandla weemfundo osasazekileyo woMntla-Koloni ongaphandle. Iindidi ezi zifuna ukuba zihlakaniphe izinto ezahlukeneyo ezifana nokubhala, nokugcina iifayile, nasekuncedeni ngokusetyenziswa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezisemthethweni ngokwemigaqo
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela lesi-12 akukho mfundo edlulileyo. Isakhono sokuziphatha ngokubhala nangokuthetha nokuziphathe ngokubhala ngonengamso kaBantu (iselwa nangokubhala) iNgesi Ulwazi nokuqonda kukaBantu mthetho wezeMali, iMigaqo yoBulungisa, uMthetho weeNkonzo kaBantu noMthetho wokuBeka oThisha. Isakhono esinzima sokuziphatha ngokuthetha nakubhala. Ukuziphatha okukhulu ngokucanda, ukubala izinto, ukucinga izinto ezintsha kwaye noKonzakaliswa ngokulinganisa iNgeniso, ukuziphatha okuziphatheleyo izinto ezahlukeneyo kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngengxolo eNzima. Ulwazi ngeNgingqi yeZemfundo iya kubakho yona ingenelelo.
xh.duties: Qamba, hlela, gcina, bambisa kwaye uphinde uwaphike izimemo neentsingiselo zomsebenzi ohlukeneyo. Hlaziya izibhalo ezahlukeneyo nezingqubaniso. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi ezindala kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele iifeksi. Sasaza amaphepha okanye izikwerelezo kubantu abahlukene njengoko kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yokugcina iifayile yeqela. Bhala iileta ezisisiseko okanye ezinye izimemo xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze isibhalo sokubuyisa nokuthumela seqela. Thath’inxaxheba ngokubonisana nabantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokufumaniswa kwemali yamagumbi nezinkonzo. Fumana izicelo ezahlukeneyo, gcwalisa iifomu zefumaniso kwaye uthenge izinto zofisi ezahlukeneyo. Lawula izinto ezizakuwe zofisi. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze isibhalo sezinto ezahlukeneyo seqela (kumagumbi omandla). Hlaziya isibhalo sobunini eqeleni. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze izixhobo zabasebenzi eqeleni. Gcina kwaye ulondiloze isibhalo sokuzigcina eqeleni. Hlela ulando neendawo zokuhlala. Pheka ukuzinikela ngeentsikelelo nangemizuzu yokuhamba yabasebenzi kwaye uze udibanise nomphathi ukusuka enkwininweni. Phatha iintsapho zefowuni lezityalo zamafuthe eqela.

af.duties: Vang data vir die verwerking van werwing en betaling vir Skoolgesondheid- en Lewensvaardigheidsbegunstigdes wat in skole en S-bestuursentrums gekontrakteer is met behulp van sigblaaie. Hlola ukunemba kwemininigwe eqoqiwe uphendwe imibuzo, Qiniseka ukugcinwa kahle kwezibhalo eziyadingeka ukubhala izimali eziyisibonezelo njengemibizo namalithi aqinisekisiwe ngokuvumelana nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinto eziyisikhwama, Qoqa imininigwe ye-School Health and Safety ekwabhasi yemininigwe bese ukhiqiza imibizo nxa kucelwa ukuba ukwenze, Gcina ibhasi yemininigwe ye-Peer Education Clubs ne-Soul Buddyz Clubs ezikoleni, Abahlanganyeli namanye abasunguli abalethwa izinsizakalo zesikole eziphathwa ngobuqhawe nokuphephwa kwezempilo, Xhumana no-School Admin Clerks ukuhlola imininigwe yesikole ngezobuqhawe nokuphepha etshashiweko e-SASAMS, Hlola i-School Health and Safety LTSM, izinqubo zemibhalo namalithi abhisiwa ezikoleni uphendwe amalithi ahlelekiweyo, Qhutshela okuhlolwa kwexesha ngamathathu kweziqhathi ezenzwa ngamaphulo o-LSA, o-LSA Supervisors nabaqeqeshiweko be-Social Work Graduates uhlanganise imibiko yemigomo nxa kucelwa ukuba ukwenze, Bhala uphendwe imibizo yenyanga, yesikhashana, nenyaka ko-Nyunyana bePhondo.

xh.title: Umgcini weMininikhulu: Mali yenkxaso yeHIV & Aids yeNzululwazi ngokuTiya iMfuno
xh.summary: Ukugcina idatha yolwabiwo lwenkxaso kunye nentlawulo yeHIV nakugula kwe-AIDS kwinkxaso yeNzululwazi ngokuTiya iMfuno kwiNtloko yeSebe leMfundo yoMbindi Kolonela eZwelitsha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sobhedu ngowama-12 asikho isipho esifunekayo kulo msebenzi. Abantu abangenamava bokwenza umsebenzi kwi-MS Office Package, umzekelo naku-Excel, Word, njl. kuya kubakho nzuzo yongezo. Ukusebenzisa ulwimi kwakho nakuphawula ngendlela efanelekileyo nokuba nesiphatho sesiNgesi. Ukuyazi iNkqubo yoMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumayethu. Ukuba nolwazi lokwazi iziseko zolawulo zisebe. Ulwazi lokwazi iinkqubo ezithengwayo. Iimfuno: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amaphuphu okuThetha namacandi, Izakhono ezigcinwa ngendlela, Isiphatho sentlalo, Izakhono zokuLawula, Ulwazi lokuPinda-ukubhala kunye neKhadi, Ukuba ngumlawuli ngokusebenzisa iNqanaba, Izakhono ezinqeneyo. Ulwazi lokutshula iindleko zokubhala iinkcazelo ezifunekayo kwimisebenzi yaseburhulumeni, ukubhala iinkcazelo ngentsomi. Ulwazi kwelalo leMfundo luya kubakho nzuzo yongezo.
xh.duties: Gcina idatha yokwenza umsebenzi wolwabiwo lwenkxaso nakutshalwa kweentlawulo zabaphumeleli beNkonzo yeMpilo kunye neNzululwazi ngokuTiya iMfuno abathathiweyo kumaziko emfundo naseKwindla yoLawulo iindawo, qhagamshelana namaPhondo xa kufunwa iinkcazelo zeenyanga zonke kwi-LSA, ooyili be-LSA, kunye nabazuziweyo bemisebenzi yabaxhasi babantu, qinisekisa ukuba idatha igqitywe ngokuchanekileyo, iqinisekisiwe, ivakatyaliswe. Qinisekisa ukuba idatha igqitywe ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ulungise imibuzo. Gcina uxwebhu olubalulekileyo ngokukhuselekileyo ukwenzela ukuba kutshalwe imbuyezelo kubasebenzi, umzekelo iinkcazelo, izinto ezigqithiswe ngomsebenzi kunye nezinto ezagqitywe kwisiseko somthetho esemgangathweni ukuya kwesiphelo senkqubo yokugcina imida yabathathi-nxaxheba, Qamba idatha yonke eya kuthi yafakwe kwidathabheyisi eya kuthi yadluliswa, ukuya kwinkqubo yamaza amaninzi enkcukacha ezibalulekileyo kunye nokufumana iingqinisiso, Qinisekisa ukugcina iindaba zamaza ngokumafa ngobukhulu becala kwindawo nendlela ethile. Qhagamshelana noBaluli beNkonzo kwiiNkqubo zemfundo ukuya kwinkqubo eqinisekisa idatha yokuphumelela. Vavanya inkqubo yemfundo kwelona Khaladi leMfundo apho zixelwe khona, Ulwazi lwamagama athengwayo, iinkqubo zemithetho kunye nemithetho yokusebenza. Qonda ukuba zithini na iinkqubo ezothileyo ukuya kwigumbi lobuKhaladi kwindawo ithile, Skena imisebenzi eqhuba kwindlela ethize kwakhona ukwenzela ukuba kulawulwe. Bhala kwaye ulandele ngokubeka iinkcazelo, ukuya kwinkqubo eqinisekisa iinkcazelo ezithile, nokugcina amaxwebhu aqinisekiswayo anokubakho oyena mntu wonke.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo futhi akudingeki siphephandle. Ulwazi: Departments, Iziyalezo zesifundazwe, DPSA Polices, Amasikwele neZiyalezo, Amasikwele neZiyalezo ze-DBE, Amasikwele neZiyalezo ezingeni lesizwe nesesifundazwe. Amakhono: Ukuphatha ukusebenza, Ukuphatha imali, Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, Amakhono okuxhumana, Iziphemogo, Ukuphatha abantu, Ucwaningo, Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Okubhaliwayo, Ukuxazulula izingxabano, Amakhono olimi, Amakhono ahlelekile okuhlela abantu, amakhono ahlelekile wokuxhumana abantu, Amakhono absisisekelo okubhaliwayo. Ukuqotho nokuzethemba. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti. Ukuqhubeka ngokuzethemba. Ukusebenza ndawonye.
zu.duties: Siba imininingwane ezinkoxweni ezitholakalayo zibe ohlelweni oludingwayo njengamininingwane ezinkundleni, etafuleni, nakomakhashekhadi. Qinisekisa umbuzo imininingwane engavlekile namaphutha abonakalayo ngesikhathi kungeniswa imininingwane. Buka futhi qinisekisa yonke imininingwane ezinkoxweni. Hambisa imininingwane. Yenza ukulondoloza imininingwane njalo. Buyekeza izibalo nezibalo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinkoxo namafayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkoxo namafayela ahlelwe kahle zibhekezele. xh.title: Umqambi weMininingwane: Inyunyano yoMsebenzi yoMfundo yoMgangatho
xh.summary: Qamba uze uqinise imininingwane kumagqabi ezolwazi nakuwo amacwecwe e-selfuti kwindlu enkulu yesebe lezeMfundo lase Eastern Cape e Zwelitsha, lifuna isatifikethi seQela lesi-12.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela lesi-12 okanye esilinganayo kwaye akukho mfundo yamava efunekayo. Ulwazi: Iisebe, iMiyalelo yoMmandla, iNqumamiso zeDPSA, amaNqaku nokuba ngamomiyalelo, amaNqaku nokuba ngamomiyalelo e-DBE, amaNqaku namomiyalelo eQongo nakuwo oMmandla. Amandla oKusebenza: uLawulo lokuSebenza, uLawulo lweMali, amandla oLawulo lwe Projekthi, amandla oNxibelelwano, Iingxoxo, uLawulo lwe Ntu, uPhando, ukucinga ngokwahlulela, ulwazi lwe Khompyutha, ukuxomba iingxaki, iNgcaciso, ukuSombulula iingxabano, amandla oLwimi, amandla alomso ohlelekileyo, amandla amabhloko abantu, amandla asisiseko okubhala. Inyaniselo nokuzithembisa. Ubumunduli. Ukuzigqithela. Ukusebenza njengesiqu.
xh.duties: Qamba imininingwane kwimibhalo ekhoyo zibe kulwangu olufunekayo umzekelo amagqabi ezolwazi, itheyibhile, ispredi shithi. Qinisekisa imininingwane yokutsha imininingwane ngeengxaki ezibonwa ngelixa kungenwa imininingwane. Phawula uze uqinise imininingwane yonke kwimibhalo. Nika imininingwane. Yenza iikhophi ezizezinye rhoqo zeminingwane. Hlaziya izibhalo namba lanani. Gcina uze ulondoloze imibhalo namafayili. Qinisekisa ukuba imibhalo namafayilihleliwe ngokwaneleyo zize zikhuseleke. Nikisa ulwazi kumacandelo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Planning
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 – R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive remuneration package.
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Financial Planning at the Eastern Cape Provincial Office in Bisho, coordinating MTEF and expenditure framework inputs. Requires a relevant financial degree and 3-5 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus a relevant Financial Information Systems (FIS) qualification, Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Financial Management/Accounting at NQF Level 7, as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3–5 years’ experience in a finance environment at Assistant Director level. Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially advanced Excel, graphs and pivot table interpretation. Knowledge of budgeting, preparation and analysis. Knowledge of BAS and PERSAL. A driver’s licence is a prerequisite. Competencies: Communication skills, both oral and written. Client orientation and customer focus. Honesty and integrity. Service delivery innovation. Knowledge management. Financial management. Problem-solving and analysis. Strategic capability and leadership. Programme and project management. People management and empowerment. Change management. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework and policy formulation processes within government. Understanding business and management principles relating to strategic planning, resource allocation, human resource modelling and leadership techniques. Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation methods, tools and techniques. Statistical and data analysis. Policy analysis and research. Analytical thinking, report writing and presentation skills. An understanding of financial statements will be an advantage.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and consolidate inputs for the compilation of the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Coordinate and consolidate inputs for the compilation of the Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Compile Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), including reprioritisation, requests for additional funds and movement of funds, for the branches. Allocate funds to the various responsibilities within the branches. Coordinate inputs for in-year monitoring reports for the branches. Compile expenditure forecasts for the branches. Compile monthly management reports. Advise budget managers on budget-related matters. Cost the establishment. Assist with the preparation and review of the financial statements.
