af.title: Onderdirekteur: Finansiële Beplanning
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Finansiële Beplanning by die Eastern Cape Provincial Office in Bisho, wat MTEF- en bestuursraaminsette koördineer. Vereis 'n tersaaklike finansiële graad en 3-5 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n tersaaklike Financial Information Systems (FIS)-kwalifikasie, 'n Bachelors-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie in Financial Management/Accounting op NQF Level 7, soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3–5 jaar se ervaring in 'n finansiële omgewing op Assistant Director-vlak. Kennis van Microsoft Office, veral gevorderde Excel, grafieke en ondersoeking van draaitabelle. Kennis van begroting, voorbereiding en ontleding. Kennis van BAS en PERSAL. 'n Bestuurderslisensie is 'n voorvereiste. Bevoegdhede: Kommunikasievaardighede, beide mondelings en skriftelik. Kliëntoriëntasie en klieÿntfokus. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Diensleweringsinnovering. Kennisbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projekbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Veranderingsbestuur. Kennis van die Public Service Regulatory Framework en beleidsformuleringsprosesse binne die regering. Begrip van besigheids- en bestuursbeginsels met betrekking tot strategiese beplanning, hulpbrontoewysing, menslike hulpbronmodellering en leierskaptegnieke. Kennis van moniterings- en evalueringsmetodes, -instrumente en -tegnieke. Statistiese en data-ontleding. Beleidsontleding en navorsing. Analitiese denke, verslagskrywing en aanbiedingsvaardighede. 'n Begrip van finansiële state sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Koördineer en konsolideer insette vir die samestelling van die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Koördineer en konsolideer insette vir die samestelling van die Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Stel Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) op, insluitend herprioritisering, versoeke om bykomende fondse en beweging van fondse, vir die takke. Allokeer fondse aan die verskillende verantwoordelikhede binne die takke. Koördineer insette vir in-jaar moniteringsverslae vir die takke. Stel bestuursvoorspellings vir die takke op. Stel maandelikse bestuursverslae op. Adviseer begrotingsbestuurders oor begrotingsverwante aangeleenthede. Bereken die vestiging koste. Bied hulp met die voorbereiding en hersiening van die finansiële state.

zu.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuhlela Kwezimali
zu.summary: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuhlela Kwezimali e Eastern Cape Provincial Office e Bisho, ehlanganisa okufakwe kwi-MTEF nakwejwayidwe lokuchitha imali. Kudinga iziqu eziyelethene kwezimali kanye nesisindo sabo-3-5 eminyakeni.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhathi le-Senior Certificate kanye nesiqu esihambisana ne-Financial Information Systems (FIS), ibhayelori noma isiqu esilinganayo kwi-Financial Management/Accounting ezingeni le-NQF Level 7, njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani isidindo sabo-3–5 eminyakeni sokusebenza emhlabeni wezimali ezingeni le-Assistant Director. Ulwazi lwe-Microsoft Office, ikakhulukazi i-Excel yezinga eliphezulu, ukushicilela izifanekiso kanye nokuhumusha amathhebula aphendukayo. Ulwazi ngokuqamba amabhajethi, ulungiselelo kanye nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi nge-BAS kanye ne-PERSAL. Ilayisensi yokushayela iyisidingo. Ikhono: Ikhono lokuxhumana, kokubili okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuqinisekisa nokuba nekhasimhlabathi. Intuthuko kokuqashwa kwenkonzo. Ulwazi lolawulo. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ikhono elihuqukileyo kanye nokuqhatha. Ulawulo lwezinhlelo kanye nezinshiselwa. Ulawulo labantu nokuwkakhenisa. Ulawulo lokushintsha. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Framework kanye namaprosesi okuqamba amapholisi ngaphakathi kukahulumeni. Ukuqonda imigomo yokuhweba kanye nalawulo ehlobene nokuqamba izinhlelo ezinjengomgomo, ukwabiwa kwemithombo, ukumodela imithombo yabantu kanye ngezindlela zokuqhatha. Ulwazi ngendlela, amathuluzi kanye namasu okuhlola kanye nokuhlolisisa. Ukuhlaziya izibalo kanye nedatha. Ukuhlaziya amapholisi kanye nokuphenya. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko kanye nekhono lokwethula. Ukuqonda izitatimende ezingezimali kuzuba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa kanye nokuhlanganisa okufakwe ukuze kuhlelwe i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Hlanganisa kanye nokuhlanganisa okufakwe ukuze kuhlelwe i-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Hlela i-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), okuhlanganisa ukubuyela emuva ukubalule, izicelo zemali engeziwe kanye nokunyakaziswa kwemali, kumagatsha. Wabela imali kumasebe ahlukene ngaphakathi kwamagatsha. Hlanganisa okufakwe kumibiko yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwenyanga kumagatsha. Hlela ukubikezela ukuchithwa kwemali kumagatsha. Hlela imibiko yokuphetha nyanga zonke. Letela abaphathi bephajethi ngemikhuba ehlobene nephajethi. Lenga iindleko zokusungula. Siza ngolungiselelo kanye nokuqamba izitatimende ezingezimali.

xh.title: Under-Director: Ulwundo LweziNdalo
xh.summary: Under-Director: Ulwundo LweziNdalo kwiSebe lePhondo le Eastern Cape e Bisho, ukuqhotyiswa kwezongeniso ze-MTEF nentsapho yokuchitha imali. Ifuna idigra yemali esemthethweni namava emyaka angama-3-5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliPhezulu negunya elichanekileyo le-Financial Information Systems (FIS), idigra ye-Bachelor okanye igunya elilinganayo kwi-Financial Management/Accounting kwiNqanaba le-7 le-NQF, njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane bamava eminyaka engama-3–5 kwimeko yemali kwinqanaba loMlawuli oNcedisayo. Ulwazi nge-Microsoft Office, ngokukodwa i-Excel ethuthukeleyo, iigrafu nokutolika iitafile ezetha imiba. Ulwazi ngokulungiselela imali yokusebenza, ukulungiselela nokuhlola. Ulwazi nge-BAS nange-PERSAL. Ilayisensi yokushuka imigaqo yamacebo ayimfuneko. Izakhono: Izakhono zokunxibelelanisa, ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zabathengi. Inyaniseklo nenkululeko. Intsingiselo yokulekelela inkonzo. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo lweziNdalo zeMali. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nohlolo. Ikhono lokuzama ukuyala nokukhokela. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ulawulo labantu nokuqinisa. Ulawulo lenguquko. Ulwazi ngeMsululo woQhubekeko kaQhagamshelo lwaZizwe kunye namaxanduva okwakha iimali karhulumente. Ukuqonda iimvisiswano zalawulo netsapho yoqoqosho ezidityaniswe nokuqamba iiplani eziballwa phambili, umabo welalu lwemali, ukubumba abantu nemfuyo yezikhondo zokukhokela. Ulwazi ngeendlela, izixhobo namakhono okuqhuba nokuqwalasela inkqubo. Uhlolo lwesibalo nolwamaxa. Uhlolo lobuntu bomthetho kunye nophando. Ukucinga ngokwahlulwa, ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okubonakalisa. Ukuqonda iingxelo zemali kuya kuba luncedo.
xh.duties: Qhotyiswa kokudityaniswa kwezongeniso ukuze kwakhiwe i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Qhotyiswa kokudityaniswa kwezongeniso ukuze kwakhiwe i-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Ukudityaniswa kwe-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), kuquka ukubuyiswa kwexabiso phambili, izicelo zemali eyongezelelweyo nokuhamba kwemali, kumagatsha. Ukwabelana imali kumagatsha ngokwemisebenzi yayo. Qhotyiswa izongeniso zeemvisiswano ezenza iphondo ezingaphakathi kwamnyaka kwamagatsha. Ukudityaniswa kwemibalo yokuchitha imali emagatsheni. Ukudityaniswa kweengxelo zenyanga eziphatha. Ukuyala ooyili bomali malunga nemiba ehamba nomali. Amaxabiso obuntu obusebenzayo. Uncedo ngokulungiselela nohlolo lweengxelo zemali.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Employee Relations
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 – R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive remuneration package.
jobs.closing_date_text: 13 November 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Employee Relations at the Eastern Cape Department of Social Development, managing labour relations, collective bargaining, and disciplinary processes at Level 11.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate Plus a National Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Law, Labour Relations, Human Resource Management or any relevant/equivalent qualification. 3-5 to five years’ relevant experience at Assistant Director level in Labour Relations. A driver’s licence is a prerequisite. Competencies: Sound knowledge of Labour relations legislation and prescripts, including the Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, disciplinary procedures, grievance management and collective bargaining processes. Knowledge of PSCBC and sectoral council resolutions and policies. Strong leadership, conflict management, negotiation, dispute resolution, analytical, report-writing and problem-solving skills. Good communication, stakeholder management, planning and organisational skills. Ability to interpret and apply labour legislation and policies. Computer literacy in MS Office packages. Strong supervisory and people-management skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate labour relations and collective bargaining functions within the Department. Provide advice and support to management on labour relations matters, disciplinary processes, grievances, misconduct, incapacity and dispute resolution. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of labour relations policies, procedures and collective agreements. Represent the Department in disciplinary hearings, conciliations, arbitrations and negotiations at relevant bargaining council structures, including the Public Service Coordinating Bargaining Council. Facilitate sound employer–employee relations and promote labour peace within the Department. Monitor compliance with labour legislation, collective agreements and departmental policies. Analyse labour relations trends and case law, and develop intervention strategies to address workplace conflict and misconduct. Compile reports, submissions and statistics on labour relations matters. Liaise with organised labour, management and relevant stakeholders on labour relations and collective bargaining matters. Supervise staff and ensure effective management of resources within the component.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Werknemersverhoudinge
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Werknemersverhoudinge by die Eastern Cape Department of Social Development, wat arbeidsverhoudinge, kollektiewe bedinging en dissiplinêre prosesse op Vlak 11 bestuur.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n National Diploma of Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Regsgeleerdheid, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of enige relevante ewekwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring op Assistant Director-vlak in Arbeidsverhoudinge. 'n Bestuurderslisensie is 'n voorvereiste. Bevoegdhede: Deeglike kennis van arbeidsverhoudingewetgewing en voorskrifte, insluitend die Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, dissiplinêre prosedures, klagtesbestuur en kollektiewe bedingsprosesse. Kennis van PSCBC- en sektorale raadsresolusies en -beleide. Sterk leierskap-, konflikbestuurs-, onderhandelings-, geskillebeslegtings-, analitiese, verslagskryf- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie, belanghebbende-bestuur, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om arbeidswetgewing en -beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office-pakkette. Sterk toesighoudende en mensebestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer arbeidsverhoudinge- en kollektiewe bedingsfunksies binne die Departement. Verskaf advies en ondersteuning aan bestuur oor arbeidsverhoudingsake, dissiplinêre prosesse, klagtes, wangedrag, onvermoë en geskillebeslegting. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid, -prosedures en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Verteenwoordig die Departement in dissiplinêre verhore, konsiliasies, arbitrasies en onderhandelinge by relevante bedingsraadstrukture, insluitend die Public Service Coordinating Bargaining Council. Fasiliteer goeie werkgewer-werknemer-verhoudinge en bevorder arbeidsvrede binne die Departement. Monitor nakoming van arbeidswetgewing, kollektiewe ooreenkomste en departementele beleid. Analiseer arbeidsverhoudingstendense en gevalreg, en ontwikkel ingrypingstrategieë om werkplekkonflik en wangedrag aan te spreek. Stel verslae, voorleggings en statistieke oor arbeidsverhoudingsake op. Skakel met georganiseerde arbeid, bestuur en relevante belanghebbendes oor arbeidsverhoudings- en kollektiewe bedingsake. Hou toesig oor personeel en verseker doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne binne die komponent.

zu.title: Usomlungiseleli: Izindinganiso Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Usomlungiseleli Wezindinganiso Zabasebenzi e Eastern Cape Department of Social Development, uphatha izindinganiso zomsebenzi, ukuxoxisana ngokuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nezenzo zolunyulo ezingeni Level 11.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma noma i-Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Law, Labour Relations, Human Resource Management noma noma yisiphi isimemo esifana/nokulingana nesokulelo. Ukuze ube namava okuyiminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengu-5 ohlelweni oluhlobene nalolu lwe-Assistant Director kwe-Labour Relations. I-driver's licence iyadingeka. Ikhono: Ukuqonda okuphelele ngomthetho wezindinganiso zabasebenzi nezinkomba, okuhlanganisa i-Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, izinqubo zolunyulo, ukuphathwa kwezinalo, kanye nezenzo zokuxoxisana ngokuhlangenwe nakho. Ukuqonda ngokugqamisa kwe-PSCBC kanye nezinqumo nezinhlelo zomkhandlu wesigaba. Amakhono obuholi obusimeme, okuphathwa kwezingxabano, ukuxoxisana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuqonda inkinga nokuxazulula. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli, ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo. Isikhathi sokutolikwa futhi usebenzise umthetho wezindinganiso zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumaphakheji we-MS Office. Amakhono aphakeme okuqondisa nabantu kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi uhlele imisebenzi yezindinganiso zabasebenzi kanye nokuxoxisana ngokuhlangenwe nakho ngaphakathi kwe-Department. Nikeza izeluleko kanye nokusekela abaphathi ngemibandela yezindinganiso zabasebenzi, izinqubo zolunyulo, izinalo, ukuziphatha kabi, ukungabi namandla nokuxazulula izinkinga. Hlela futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zezindinganiso zabasebenzi, izinqubo kanye nezivumelwano ngokuhlangenwe nakho. Mele i-Department ezinkulungwaneni zolunyulo, ekuqoqweni, ekuqumeni kanye nasexoxweni ezakhiwo zomkhandlu ezihambisanayo, okuhlanganisa i-Public Service Coordinating Bargaining Council. Sikhondise izindinganiso ezinhle phakathi kweqembu nabaqashwayo futhi usize ukuthula ezindinganisweni zabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Department. Qapha ukuzigcina kwemithetho yezindinganiso zabasebenzi, izivumelwano ngokuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nezinhlelo ze-Department. Hlaziya amathrendi wezindinganiso zabasebenzi nomthetho wezimo, futhi wenze izinhlelo zokungenelela ukubhekana nezingxabano kanye nokuziphatha kabi esikhundleni sokusebenza. Hlanganisa imibiko, izithunywa kanye nezibalo ngemibandela yezindinganiso zabasebenzi. Xhumana neqembu labasebenzi elihleliwe, abaphathi, kanye nabahlanganyeli abahlobene ngemibandela yezindinganiso zabasebenzi nokuxoxisana ngokuhlangenwe nakho. Qondisa abasebenzi futhi qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokusebenza ngaphakathi kwengxenye.

xh.title: Isexeba: Iindaba zabasebenzi
xh.summary: Isexeba kwindaba zabasebenzi kwi Eastern Cape Department of Social Development, elilawula iindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi, iinkqubo zokuxoxisana ngeentengiso, namanyathelo obugcisa enqanaba lesi-11.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi ezinqamlezileyo samabanga aphezulu kwaye nam Nqanaba lesi-6/7 kwi-NQF kwiZomthetho, kwiindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi, ekulawulweni kwabantu okanye naliphi na igunya elichanekileyo/elingabi nanto. 3-5 kwiminyaka emihlanu yamava afanelekileyo kwinqanaba lomqeqeshi kwindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba iyimfuno. Ikhono: Ulwazi olumandla ngemithetho ngeendaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi namawebhu, kuquka noMthetho weendaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi, uMthetho weemiqathango esisiseko yomsebenzi, uMthetho wesebe likawonke-wonke, Iimigaqo yesebe likawonke-wonke, iinkqubo zobugcisa, ukulawulwa kweziningithi nemiqathangonongqisho. Ulwazi ngezigqibo namapolisi ze-PSCBC kunye nobume kumacandelo. Amandla okukhokela, ukulawula iingxabano, ukuxoxa ngeentengiso, ukuzisombulula iingxabano, ukwahlula-hlula, ukubhala iingxelo nokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla asheshiseyo ekunxibelelaneni, ekulawulweni kwabathathi-nxaxheba, ekucwangcisweni nasekulawulweni kwesebe. Amandla okutolika nokusebenzisa umthetho namapolisi wendawo yomsebenzi. Ukubeka kakhulu ngakwiiKompyutha kwiinkqubo zika-MS Office. Amandla amandla okulawula abantu nokuqonda indlela yokubaphatha.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise iindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi nemiqathango yokuqalisana ngengxoxo yentengiso kwisebe. Nikela ngengcebiso ngenkxaso kwabaphathi ngeendaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi, iinkqubo zobugcisa, iingxabano, ukwenza okungalunganga, ukungakwazi ukusebenza nokuqondanisa iingxabano. Lungelelanisa kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwamapolisi wendawo yomsebenzi, iinkqubo namagqesha obudlelwane bobusebenzi. Mela isebe kumaziko obugcisa, ekuqondanisweni, kwesityholo nasemaxhoxhweni emabandla afanelekileyo obuxoxo yentengiso, kuquka naseBandleni loXabiso lomZamo lweSebe xa likawonke-wonke. Khuthaza ubudlelwane obulungileyo phakathi kweqabakho labasebenzi, igosa elinesikhokelo abe kwindawo yokubakho yesebe ngenkuthazo yokubakho kobudlelwane ngenkxaso yamandla obudlelwane bobusebenzi ngokumalunga nomsebenzi weqabakho iindaba ezingathathi hlangothi zabasebenzi ezingatshatanga kwingxaki yemithetho yabasebenzi namaxwebhu obudlelwane bobusebenzi aqinisekiswa kwindawo yonke iindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi nangoncedo lobugcisa okanye esele ekwindawo obungathi iyaqhubeka emaxhoxhweni phantsi kwesigqibo kwigqesha iindaba zobudlelwane bobusebenzi, imilumbo yobugcisa nomsebenzi ongalunganga. Lungelelanisa amava aphakathi kwendalo ezinkqubo zobugcisa ngokumalunga nobukhali iindaba ezinkqubo zokuncedisa kumacingwana ngamakhasi nangokusombulula ngenkqubo ngasekhaya yendawo yomsebenzi kwisebe ukuya ngokulawula kwaye umntu kummandla alawule imisebenzi elungiselelwe kwindawo ezingagqibeki kuyo ndlela ibambe iqondo ngendlela iindaba ezisebenzayo kwindawo yokubakho yendawo yokunxibelelana kwendawo kwindawo yomsebenzi ngokumalunga nokubakho ngokwenyani ngabaphathi.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Plaaslike Dienskantoor
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur om 'n plaaslike dienskantoor in Joe Gqabi te bestuur, met toesig oor ontwikkelende maatskaplike welsyn, gemeenskapsontwikkeling, asook finansiële en menslike hulpbronfunksies.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Baccalaureusgraad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6/7) in Openbare Administrasie, Maatskaplike Werk, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingsstudies of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak. 'n Bestuurslisensie is 'n voorvereiste. Bevoegdhede: Uitgebreide kennis van die Maatskaplike Ontwikkelingssektor. Begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk relevant tot die Maatskaplike Ontwikkelingssektor. Deeglike kennis van finansiële, menslike hulpbron- en voorsieningskettingbestuur. Goeie beplannings-, organisatoriese en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Uitstekende bestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Diensleweringsinnoviasie. Kliënt- en kursoriëntasie. Begrip van die Batho Pele-beginsels. Uitstekende probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer. 'n Ontwikkelingsbenadering en 'n duidelike begrip van Suid-Afrikaanse beleide oor maatskaplike transformasie en gemeenskapsontwikkeling.
af.duties: Wees verantwoordelik vir die algehele bestuur en beheer van die gebied. Bestuur ontwikkelende maatskaplike welsyn- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdienste. Bestuur finansiële, menslike hulpbron- en voorsieningskettingfunksies. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die gemeenskap om selfvolhoubareheid en geïntegreerde ontwikkeling te bevorder. Ontwikkel, monitor en evalueer die gebied. Konsolideer programverslae. Analiseer en rapporteer oor ontluikende tendense. Ontwikkel, monitor en evalueer gebiedsjaar- en operasionele planne.

zu.summary: USekela weNduna ophethe ihhovisi lezinsizakalo zasendaweni e Joe Gqabi, obuka phansi inhlalakahle emphakathini, ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi, kanye nemisebenzi yezimali neyabantu.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate kanye ne-Bachelor's degree/i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Public Administration, i-Social Work, i-Social Sciences, i-Development Studies noma izifundo ezingana nalezi. Uzoba namava afanele eminyakeni engu-3-5 ezingeni lika-Assistant Director. Ilayisensi yokushayela iyisidingo. Ikhono: Ulwazi olujulile mayelana nesekthi ye-Social Development. Ukuqonda isikhungo somthetho esihambisana nesekthi ye-Social Development. Ulwazi oluhle lokuphathwa kwezimali, kwabantu kanye nokuphathwa kwesonto sezinsizakalo. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela, lokubumba nokuqumba. Ikhono lokuba nokubona ngaphambili kanye nokuqamba amasu nokuba nogogo. Ikhono elikhulu lokuphatha kanye nokuabusisa. Intuthuko yezindlela zokuletha izinsizakalo. Ukuzinaka kumthengi. Ukuqonda imigomo ye-Batho Pele. Ikhono elihle lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuxhumana kuzo zazo zonke izinga. Indlela yokuthuthukisa kanye nokuqonda ngokusobala izinqubomgomo zaseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuguqula komphakathi nokuqhubela phambili komphakathi.
zu.duties: Uzibophezele ekuphathweni nasekulawulweni kwendawo okukeke ngokuphelele. Uphathe inhlalakahle nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Uphathe imisebenzi yezimali, yabantu kanye nesonto sezinsizakalo. Nikela usizo komphakathi ukuze ukhuthaze ukuziphilisa okuzimele kanye nentuthuko ehlanganiswe ndawonye. Yakha, uqaphe futhi uhlolisise indawo. Hlanganisa izibalo zemisebenzi. Hlaziya futh unikeze umbiko mayelana nemikhuba evelayo. Yakha, uqaphe futhi uhlolisise izinhlelo zonyaka zomsebenzi zendawo.

xh.title: ISekela weNkundla: Isebe leNkonzo yasekuLalini
xh.summary: ISekela weNkundla oza kulawula isikhululo seenkonzo sasekuLalini kwiJoe Gqabi, elibukeela phantsi ukutshintshela kwentlalo yoluntu, ukuzithuthisa koluntu, nemisebenzi yemali nembali yamalungiselelo abantu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSekolo samabanga aPhakamile kunye neDyigra yesiBakala/Ndyigra yoMzantsi Afrika (iNqanaba le-NQF 6/7) kwiZenzo zeNkululeko, iNkonzo eNzima yeNtlalo, iziCience zeNtlalo, iziFundo zoPhuhliso okanye isiphengululi esilinganayo. Iiminyaka ezili-3-5 yamava ahambelana nale msebenzi kwinqanaba likaMncedisi weNkundla. Ilayisenesi yokuQhuba iyimfuneko. Iikhompethensi: Ukuqonda okubanzi kwesebe leNtlalo nokuPhuhliso koluntu. Ukuqonda kwakho ngamagunya elandelwa kwisebe leNtlalo nokuPhuhliso koluntu. Ukuqonda okuchanekileyo ngokulawula imali, abantu nokuBonelela nokuLawula iXesha eliNqamlezayo. Amaplanu amanje, ukuhlela kunye nokuzimisela ekwenzeni izigqibo. Ikhapabhiliti yamabala neziqu bokulawula. Amaplanu amanje okulawula nokuNika mandla abantu abanye. Iindlela ezitsha zokuNikezela iinkonzo. Ukuzinika ngokugcwaliselela iimfuno zabathengi. Ukuqonda iimvisiswano zeBatho Pele. Amaplanu amanje okusombulula iingxaki. Ukuzinika ngokuchazwa nabanini nangakunye na. Indlela eza kutshintshelela nokuqonda kakhulu ngamagunya eMzantsi Afrika malunga notshintsho lwentlalo nokuPhuhliso koluntu.
xh.duties: Kuxhomekeka kuwe ukulawula nokuLawula iNdawo yonke. Lawula iinkonzo zentlalo ezingatshanga kakhulu nokuziphumelezela koluntu ekuqhamakeni koluntu. Lawula imisebenzi yemali, ngabasebenzi nokuBonelela kwiXesha elifutshane. Nikeza inkxaso kuluntu ukuyixhasa ukuba izibonele ngokwayo nokuKhusela uPhuhliso oluNgezelelweyo. Phuhlisa, jonga nokuHlola iNdawo. Dudisa amanqaku eLungiselelo amacebo. Hlala uqonda iimpawu evela ngamaxesha. Phuhlisa, jonga nokuHlola amacebo wonyaka wendawo nokuSebenza ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.

Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social systems, and the skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments to promote social well-being. Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress, and use resources effectively. Understanding and ability to provide social work services to protect people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves. Ability to mentor and coach Social Auxiliary Workers.
jobs.duties: Render social work services relating to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes. Support Social Auxiliary Workers and volunteers. Keep up to date with new developments in the Social Work and Social Welfare fields. Perform all required administrative functions.

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Vlak 1
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker Vlak 1-posisies by verskeie Eastern Cape-sentrums, vereis 'n Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk en SACSSP-registrasie, bied R338208 tot R397668 per jaar.
af.requirements: Standaard 10/Vlak 12 plus 'n Baccalaureus-graad in Maatskaplike Werk. Jongste bewys van registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. Suksesvolle kandidate wat nie in besit van 'n bestuurslisensie is nie, sal binne ses (6) maande vanaf die datum van aanvaarding van pligte bewys moet voorlê. Toepaslike/erkenbare Maatskaplike Werk-ervaring na registrasie by die SACSSP as Maatskaplike Werker sal vir aanstelling oorweeg word. Bevoegdhede: Vaardighede om strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit te daag. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels, en die vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interaksie het om sosiale welsyn te bevorder. Vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle te pleit en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter. Vermoë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor te pleit en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig, en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik. Begrip en vermoë om maatskaplike werkdienste te verskaf om mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar en onbevoeg is om hulleself te beskerm, te beskerm. Vermoë om Maatskaplike Hulpwerkers te mentorens en op te lei.
af.duties: Lewer maatskaplike werkdienste met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die relevante programme. Ondersteun Maatskaplike Hulpwerkers en vrywilligers. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die Maatskaplike Werk- en Maatskaplike Welsynsvelde. Voer alle vereiste administratiewe funksies uit.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokweluleka Izenhlalo Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zikaMsebenzi Wokweluleka Izenhlalo Isigaba 1 kumakhulu amasikhungo aseEastern Cape, efuna iBachelor of Social Work nobhaliso kwiSACSSP, linikeza iholo le-R338208 kuya ku-R397668 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: I-Standard 10/Grade 12 kanye nediploma ye-Bachelor of Social Work. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa samanje ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokweluleka izenhlalo. Okezelelayo abangakabi nelayisensi yokushayela kuzofuneka bethole isitifiketi kungapheli kwezinyanga eziyisithupha (6) kusukela osukwini bakuqala umsebenzi. Okuhlobene/okungashongothiwe ukuba nomhlabuko wokusebenza kokweluleka izenhlalo emva kokuqinisekiswa ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP njengomsebenzi wokweluleka izenhlalo kuzocashunwa ekubekweni esikhundleni. Iziqu: Ubuchule bokuphikisana nobungozi bezenhlalo, ukungalingani, ukucindezelwa, ukuhlukaniswa nokukhishwa emphakathini. Ulwazi nenqondo yokuziphatha komuntu kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi, nobuchule bokuqhathulela ezindaweni lapho abantu bwhasisa nemvelo yabo khona ukukhuthaza impilo yezwehlalo. Ikhono nobuchule bokusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela nokuphakamisa abantu, osaphala, amaqembu, izinhlangano kanye nemiphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabo ngokwesiya sabo sokuhlakale nobuchule bokuqhaqhambisa izinkinga. Ikhono lokukhuthaza, ukubuyisa, ukugcina, ukumela nokuphakamisa ukusebenza kwabuntu, osaphala, amaqembu kanye nemiphakathi ngokubasiza ukufeza imisebenzi yabo, ukuvimbela nokusiza ukusinda ekuqhathatheni, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ngempumelelo. Ukuqonda nokwenza imisebenzi yezinsiza yokweluleka izenhlalo yokuvikela abantu abasengozini, abangenamshelelo futhi abangeke bakwazi ukuzivikela. Ikhono lokuqondisa nokufundisa abasebenzi abosizi benhlalo (Social Auxiliary Workers).
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yezinsiza zokweluleka izenhlalo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa, ukwesekwa, ukuvikelwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu, amaqembu, osaphala kanye nemiphakathi abangenamshelelo kumasekelo ezenhlalo ahlobene. Sekela abasebenzi abosizi benhlalo (Social Auxiliary Workers) kanye nabathandi. Gcina ukuthuthukiswa okusha emkhakheni wokweluleka izenhlalo kanye namasekelo aphila izidingo zomphakathi. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yopopayi efunekayo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wezobunzenelo Bezentlalo Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zoMsebenzi Wezobunzelelo Bezentlalo Inqanaba 1 kumaziko amaninzi eEastern Cape, efuna izidanga zeBachelor of Social Work nokubhalisa kwiSACSSP, elinika umvuzo ovela kwiR338208 ukuya kwiR397668 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seStandard 10/Grade 12 ngokongezelelwe nezidanga zeBachelor of Social Work. Isiqinisekiso sokubhalisa esingatsha kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengoMsebenzi Wezobunzelelo Bezentlalo. Oonqobilayo abangazibambi nalayisensi yokushayela baya kufuneka bahambise isiqinisekiso kwathi ngexesha leenyanga eziyaka (6) ukususela kumhla wokuqalisa umsebenzi. Oluvo olufanelekileyo/nolungaqondwa ngemisebenzi yeSocial Work emva kokubhalisa kwiSACSSP njengoMsebenzi Wezobunzelelo Bezentlalo luya kuqwalaselwa xa kugqitywa ukumiswa. Ikhompetensi: Ikhono lokusabela kumthombo woqhetshaba loqhaqho, olungezingqwalasela, lokucinezela, lokwahlula nokuxhathwa ngaphandle. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha komntu kunye nezimiso ezentlalo, kunye namakhono okungena phakathi kweloo ndawo abantu abadibana nemidlalo yabo yendalo ukuphucula impilo entlalweni. Ikhono nakhompetensi yokunceda, ukuphucula, ukuchasa ngokwesiko lovimba wolwazi abanalo nokuqinisekisa amandla abantu ngabanye, usapho, amaqela, iintlangano kunye nabemi ukuphucula ukusebenza kwabo kwentlalo nakhono ukusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokuphakamisa, lokubuyisa, lokugcina, lokuchasa ngokwesiko lovimba wolwazi nokuphucula ukusebenza komntu ngamunye, osapho, amaqela nakuwo onke amacala, ngokubanika amandla okuphumeza imisebenzi yonke abayifunayo, bathintele kwaye banyamezele nzondo yokuhlupheka, bakwaze nokusebenzisa amathuba onke ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuqonda nakhono loku boneka ngokupela iinkonzo zokubonelela ngemisebenzi ebalulekileyo yokuzinza kwabantu ekuqinisekiseni ukhuseleko lwabo, ukuzigcina kumngcipheko wokungenwa kaluhle kunye noluntu nolwazi olubalulekileyo ngokukhathalela ukukhuseleka kwabo ngokupheleleyo. Ikhono lokuba ngumgwadi oqeqesha ukukhokela ngomsebenzi oqeqesha abo bakhoyo beSocial Auxiliary Workers.
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zomsebenzi wezobunzelelo ezikumngcipheko wokukhathalela, ukuxhasa, ukukhusela nokuphucula abantu abasindileyo kumacala onke amakhaya, kwiintsapho, kumacala onke amaqela kunye nabemi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Xhasa abaqeqeshi beSocial Auxiliary Workers nabathanda ukwenza iinkonzo ngenxaxhe. Gcina ulwazi olutsha malunga nophuhliso lwamashishini okwaziwa ngokuba yiSocial Work and Social Welfare. Phumeza onke amaxwebhu okulawula afunekayo.

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Graad 1
af.summary: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyns word in agt Eastern Cape sentrums benodig om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe te fasiliteer en plaaslike strukture te mobiliseer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Baccalaureusgraad/Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingsekonomie, Ontwikkelingstudies of Gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Suksesvolle kandidate wat nie oor 'n bestuurderslisensie beskik nie, sal binne ses (6) maande vanaf die datum van aanvaarding van plig bewys moet voorlê. Rekenvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Toepaslike/erkenningsonder-ervaring na nakoming van die vereiste opvoedkundige kwalifikasie vir aanstelling oorweeg word. Bevoegdhede: Teoretiese begrip en praktiese ervaring/blootstelling aan gemeenskapsontwikkelingsake. Vermoë om 'n fasiliterende benadering te gebruik om konstruktiewe deelname aan programontwikkeling en -implementering te motiveer. Vermoë om programme en projekte in die vereiste formaat te dokumenteer en daaroor verslag te doen. Kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede, Organiserings- en beplanningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Fasiliteer bewusmakingsveldtogte oor gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme. Mobiliseer plaaslike gemeenskappe in geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsstrukture. Fasiliteer gemeenskapsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe in elke plaaslike munisipaliteit. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van gemeenskapsprofiele met behulp van gekontekstualiseerde deelnemende ontwikkelingsmetodes. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling, belyning en benutting van hulpbronne van verskeie departemente ten einde die implementering van Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplanne in elke plaaslike munisipaliteit te bewerkstellig. Beoordeel aansoeke om departementele befondsing deur gemeenskapsorganisasies. Monitor, evalueer en verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan befondsde programme/projekte.

zu.title: Umuntu Osebenza Nentuthuko Yomphakathi Ohlangothini 1
zu.summary: Badingwa abantu abasebenza nentuthuko yomphakathi kuzinkungu eziyisishiyagalombol e Eastern Cape ukuthuthukisa izinhlela zentuthuko yomphakathi nokubumba izakhiwo zomphakathi zendawo.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree/National Diploma kwi-Social Sciences, Developmental Economics, Development Studies noma Community Development. Obuye bathole umsebenzi abangawabi nelayisensi yokushayela bazodinga ukuthi bethule umbhalo obufakazi lokho kungakapheli kulesi sikhathi esingamashiya amathupha (6) esuka osukwini bazuza umsebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwekhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo. Okuhlobene/okuqhathaniswayo okungenziwa ngemva kokuhambisa izidingo zemfundo ezidingwayo kuzocatshangelwa ohlwini lwabantu ababizwayo. Ikhono: Ukuqonda ngokwendlela yokubona kanye nokuhlangana ngokuphatha izinkathi zentuthuko yomphakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa indlela yokuthuthukisana ukukhuthaza ukuthatha inxaxheba okuhle ekuthuthukiseni nokuphoqelela izinhlela. Ukukwazi ukubhala nokubika ngohlela kanye namaphrojekthi ngendlela ebalulekile. Ikhono lokuxhumana nomuntu, nokuhlela nokuhlela izinhlela.
zu.duties: Qondisa imikhankaso yokwazisa ngezinhlela zentuthuko yomphakathi. Babaza imiphakathi yendawo ibe yizakhiwo zentuthuko ehlangene. Qondisa izinhlela zentuthuko yomphakathi kumunyama ngamunyama wesigodi. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba zomphakathi ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihloniphekile zentuthuko ehlanganisiwe. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukuqondanisa nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezivela kumamnyango ahlukene ukuba kusetshenziswe ama-Integrated Development Plans kumasipala ngamunyama wesigodi. Hlola izicelo zokuxhaswa ngemali komnyango izinkampani zomphakathi. Buka, hlola futhi nikeza izinsiza zokusekela izinhlela/amaphrojekthi axhaswa ngemali.

xh.title: Community Development Practitioner Grade 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka iingcali zophuhliso loluntu kumaziko asi-8 eEastern Cape ukuyinkqubo yophuhliso loluntu nokuqokelela iinkqubo zaselokishini.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu saseNatali negunya leBachelor's Degree/National Diploma kwiSocial Sciences, Developmental Economics, Development Studies okanye Community Development. Abagqatswa abaphumeleleyo abanelayisensi yokushayela baya kufuneka bafake isibonakaliso kungadlanga iinyanga ezithandathu (6) ukusuka kumhla wokuqala ukusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyuther luya kuba ngesonelo. Amava afanelekileyo/abonakalayo emva kokuhambisa ngokupheleleyo isimfuno zemfundo efunekayo aya kuqwalaselwa kwinkqubo yokumiswa. Iikhompetensi: Ukuqonda ngokwethiyori namava okusebenzisa/ukutyhila kumaphu alophuhliso loluntu. Ikhono lokusebenzisa indlela yedlanzana ukhuthaze ukuzinikela ngokwakhiwo ekuphuhliseni nokusebenziseni iinkqubo. Ikhono lokubhala iinkqubo neeprojekthi kwaye wenze iingxelo ngokwemfuno echaziweyo. Ikhono lokuthetha nolutshwalwano, kwaye nokuzoba iindaba zokuhlela.
xh.duties: Memezela iinkqubo zokuvusa ingqondo malunga neenkcubeko zophuhliso loluntu. Bidisa iimiphakathi yasekuhlaleni zibe ziinkqubo ezibumbeneyo zophuhliso. Qhuba iinjongo zophuhliso loluntu kwisixeko ngasinye somasipala. Qhuba ukuphuhliswa kweeprofayili zomphakathi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezibumbeneyo ezinomntu wonke ezikwimo yayo. Qhuba ukuphuhliswa, ukuqwalaselwa nokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ezivela kumasebe ahlukahlukeneko ngokujolise ekusebenzeni kweenkqubo ezibumbeneyo zophuhliso kwisixeko ngasinye somasipala. Vavanya izicelo zemali yesebe ezivela kubuchule boluntu. Qwalasela, hlola uze unikeze iinkonzo zoxhaso kwiinkqubo/iiprojekthi ezixhaswayo.

af.title: Kinder- en Jeugsorgwerker Graad 1
af.summary: Kinder- en Jeugsorgwerker Graad 1-posisies by Veilige Huise in die Eastern Cape, wat sorg en ontwikkelingsondersteuning aan kinders en jeug bied.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate. Toepaslike/erkende kinder- en jeugsorgervaring wat na die verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie opgedoen is, sal vir aanstelling oorweeg word. Suksesvolle kandidate wat nie 'n bestuurslisensie het nie, sal binne ses (6) maande vanaf die datum van aanvaarding van pligte bewys moet voorlê. Bevoegdhede: Kommunikasie: Vermoë om duidelike, eenvoudige en maklik verstaanbare boodskappe/inligting aan kinders en jeug oor te dra. Empatie: Vermoë om kinders en jeug te respekteer en positiewe verhoudings met hulle op te bou. Betroubaarheid: Vermoë om verhoudings van vertroue met kinders en jeug op te bou. Eerlikheid: Om beginselvas en eerlik teenoor jouself en andere te wees. Samewerking en spanwerk: Vermoë om saam met ander en as deel van 'n span saam te werk. Begrip van beginsels: Vermoë om kinder- en jeugsorgbeginsels te verstaan en toe te pas. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Sorg en ontwikkeling: Verstaan en voorsien in die sorg en ontwikkeling van kinders en jeug. Begrip van basiese behoeftes: Verstaan die fisiese, emosionele, geestelike, kognitiewe en sosiale behoeftes van kinders en jeug. Administrasie: Verrig administratiewe aktiwiteite met betrekking tot logboeke, voorvalverslae en ander rekords. Rolmodel: Identifiseer, wys toe en neem deel aan praktiese aktiwiteite om vaardighede aan kinders en jeug oor te dra. Programimplementering: Help met die implementering van beplande programme en aktiwiteite gebaseer op die geïdentifiseerde ontwikkelingsbehoeftes van kinders en jeug. Kinders se regte: Bevorder en handhaaf die regte van kinders en jeug. Reëls en prosedures: Ken en pas die reëls en prosedures van die sorgsentrum toe.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokunakekelwa Kwabantwana Nabantu Abasha Bazinga 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomsebenzi wokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha bazinga 1 ezindaweni zokuphepha e-Eastern Cape, okunikeza ukunakekelwa nokuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwabantwana nabantu abasha.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate. Ngemfundo efanelekile/eqashwayo yokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha etholwe ngemva kokuzuza isidingo semfundo ebalulekile sizobhekwa ekumisweni. Owayo abaphumelelayo abanayo ilayisenisi yokushayela bazodingwa ukuba bathole uphawu lokuthi bayinayo emasikhathini amathupha (6) kusukela osukwini bokuqala ukusebenza. Iziqu eziyisidingo: Ukuxhumana: Ikhono lokudlulisa imiyalezo/ulwazi eliqondakalayo, elilula futhi elide kakhulu kuqondwe ngabantwana nabantu abasha. Uzwela: Ikhono lokuhlonipha nokwakha izimbangi ezinhle zabantu nabantu abasha. Ukuthembeka: Ikhono lokwakha izimbangi zokwethemba ngabantwana nabantu abasha. Uqotho: Ukuba nomgomo futhi uthande inqobo ngokwakho nakubantu abanye. Ukusebenza njengesiqandu nokuhlanganyela: Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana nabanye futhi njengengxenye yesiqandu. Ukuqonda imigomo: Ikhono lokuqonda nokusebenzisa imigomo yokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa nokuthuthukiswa: Ukuqonda nokunakekela ukuthuthukiswa kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuqonda izidingo eziyisiseko: Ukuqonda izidingo ezomzimba, ezenhliziyo, ekomoya, ekuqondeni nasekuhlanganeni kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuphatha: Ukwenza izenzo zokuphatha ezihlobene namabhuku okulandi, imibiko yezehlakalo naneminye imininingwane. Ukuba yisibonelo: Ukuqapha, ukwaba futhi ukuthatha inxaxhebe kuzenzakalo ezisebenzayo ukudlulisa izikhala kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuphatha uhlelo: Ukusiza ekuphatheni izinhlelo nezenzakalo ezcplaniwwe ezisekelwe izidingo ezitholwe zokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Amalungelo abantwana: Ukukhuthaza nokugcina amalungelo abantwana nabantu abasha. Imithetho nendlela: Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho nendlela yesikhungo sokunakekelwa.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokunakekelwa Kwabantwana Nabantu Abasha Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Izithuba somsebenzi wokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha inqanaba 1 kwindawo ezikhuselekileyo kwingingqi yakwaEastern Cape, kunikezelo lonakekelo nentuthuzelo kwabantwana nabantu abasha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatikethi eSizulu. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo/olusayinwayo lokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha olufunyenwe emva kokufumana isigaba esifunekayo siya kuqwalaselwa kumiselo. Obaqeshiweyo abangenawo ilayiseni yokuqhuba baya kufuneka banikeze isibonakaliso kwiinyanga ezithandathu (6) ukusuka kumhla wokuqala komsebenzi. Ikhono: Unxibelelwano: Ikhono lokudlulisa imiyalezo/ulwazi ecacileyo, elula nokuqondeka kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuziphatha ngokuzanza: Ikhono lokuhlonela kwakwayo nokwakha iindibaniselwano ezintle nabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuthembeka: Ikhono lokwakha iindibaniselwano zothembeko nabantwana nabantu abasha. Inyaniso: Ukuba nemiqondophandle nokwetheinyani kuwe nakubanye. Ukusebenza ngokwamaqela nokubambisana: Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana nabanye njengesiqwenga seqela. Ukuqonda imigaqo: Ikhono lokuqonda nokusebenzisa imigaqo yokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Unakekelo nentuthuko: Ukuqonda kwakunye nokunikela ngokunakekelo nentuthuko yabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuqonda iimfuno ezisisiseko: Ukuqonda iimfuno ezomzimba, ezentlononto, ezeemoya, ezengqondo nentlalontle zabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuqashela imisebenzi: Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuphatha ehlotshaniswa namabuku okuqhelanayo, iingxelo zezenzakalo nolunye ulwazi. Ukuyalelwa ngokuziphatha: Ukuqaphela, ukwabela nokuthatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi yamanyuzi ukudlulisa amakhono kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ukuphatha iinkqubo: Ukuncedisa ekuphatweni iinkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo nemisebenzi esekelwe kwiimfuno zentuthuko ezibonakalisiweyo zabantwana nabantu abasha. Amalungelo abantwana: Ukukhuthaza kwakunye nokuzigcina amalungelo abantwana nabantu abasha. Imigaqo nolwabiwo lomsebenzi: Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imigaqo nolwabiwo lomsebenzi lwesikhululo sonakekelo.

af.title: Assistent Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Graad 1
af.summary: Bystand verleen met gemeenskapsprofilering en toegang tot regeringsdienste by die Dimbaza Sosiale Ontwikkelingsentrum in die Eastern Cape.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring wat na die verkryging van die vereiste opvoedkundige kwalifikasie opgedoen is, sal vir aanstelling oorweeg word. Suksesvolle kandidate wat nie oor 'n bestuurslisensie beskik nie, sal binne ses (6) maande vanaf die datum van aanvaarding van plig bewys moet voorlê. Bevoegdhede: Interpersoonlike vaardighede en die vermoë om met mense en gemeenskapsstrukture te skakel. Deernis vir mense in nood en kwesbare groepe. Begrip van sosiale dinamika en basiese kennis van gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Passie vir gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Bereidwilligheid om te leer. Kommunikasievaardighede. af.duties: Gemeenskaps- en huishoudelike profilering uitvoer. Bystand verleen aan gemeenskappe om toegang te verkry tot dienste wat deur regeringsdepartemente aangebied word. zu.summary: Nika usizo ekwenzeni iprofayela yomphakathi nasekufinyeleleni ezinsizeni zahulumeni eDimbaza Social Development Centre eEastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatikhethi Aphakeme noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Ukuhlakanipha okufanele/okubonakalayo okutholwe emva kokuzuza izifundo ezingezényu kuzoqwalaselwa ekumiseni. Owokekayo abangenawo ilayisensi yokushayela bazodinga ukuletha isibonakaliso kungakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha (6) kusukela osukwini bokuqala umsebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza: Amandla okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuhlakanipha okukuvumela ukuthi uxhumane nabantu namasuwo omphakathi. Ukuzwela izidingo zabantu abaseningizindaweni. Ukuqonda okunyukele ngokomphakathi kanye nokuqonda okuyisisekelo ngenhuthuko yomphakathi. Ukuthanda inhuthuko yomphakathi. Ukuzethemba ukufunda. Amandla okukhuluma. Ukuqonda ulimi lwaseduze kanye namasiko. Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokulawula izinkimbinkimbi kungase kubone usizo.
zu.duties: Yenza iprofayela yomphakathi kanye nemakhaya. Siza imiphakathi ekufinyeleleni izinsiza ezinikezwa ngamapanele kahulumeni. Hlala kumabhonqo omphakathi nasekumbizweni ukuthola ulwazi ngamadingo omphakathi futhi usize ekwelulekeni ukuhlelwa kokuhlangenwe ndaba. Siza ekugcineni kanye nokwesekweni amaphrojekthi omphakathi axhaswa ngemali.

xh.title: Umncedi weNqozo yoPhuhliso loLuntu Onqanaba loku-1
xh.summary: Nceda nokwenza iprofayile yoluntu kunye nolufikelelo kwiinkonzo karhulumente kwiZiko loPhuhliso loLuntu leDimbaza eEastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior okanye izifundo ezilinganayo. Amava afanelekileyo/evunyiweyo afunyenwe emva kokuqokelela izifundo ezifunekayo uya kuqwalaselwa kwinxaxheba. Baphumeleleyo abangabini belayisensi yokushayela baya kufuneka bahonge ubungqina phakathi kweenyanga ezintandathu (6)kusukela kumhla wokuqalisa umsebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza: Amandla okusebenza nabantu nokusebenzisana nabantu namaqembu oluntu. Inxaxheba ngeenjongo nabantu abaswiniyo namaqembu athathelwe phantsi. Ukuqonda iindidi zeluculo ulwazi olusisiseko ngophuhliso loluntu. Inzondo ngophuhliso loluntu. Ukuzimisela ukufunda. Amandla okunxibelelana. Ulwazi lolwimi namasiko endawo. Ulwazi ngakompyutha nokuqonda iindlela zokulawula izinto kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza iprofayile yoluntu nasekhaya. Nceda amaqembu ukuba afikelele kwiinkonzo ezinikwa ziisebe zorhulumente. Ziga iintlanganiso zoluntu neembizo ukuthatha iinkcukacha malunga neemfuno zoluntu kunye nokunika inkxaso ekuvulweni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Nceda ekulondolozweni nasekunikeni inkxaso kumaphulo oluntu axhaswa ngezimali.

jobs.title: Director: Early Childhood Care & Education Directorate
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 – R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), an all-inclusive salary package. The total package includes 70% basic salary, a state contribution to the Government Employee Pension Fund and flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable guidelines. This appointment is subject to the signing of an Annual Performance Agreement and obtaining a security clearance.
jobs.summary: Director position to manage and coordinate Early Childhood Care and Education services in the Free State Department of Education, based in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: An applicable qualification at NQF level 7 as recognized by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). 5 Years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Valid Code B/EB Driver’s license. Preference will be given to candidates with strong conceptual and formulation skills; strong leadership skills with specific reference to the ability to display thought leadership and co- ordination of complex applications; strong interpersonal skills; excellent verbal and written communication skills; outstanding planning, organizational and people management skills; computer literacy; a highly developed interpretative and conceptualization/ formulation ability; the ability to render advice and guidance in an objective and dedicated manner; The ability to multi-task, deal with ambiguity and manage under rapidly changing and pressurized circumstances; the ability to persuade and influence; the ability to lead and direct teams of professionals and service providers and ability to deal with complex situations.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective and efficient coordination and overall management of the Early Childhood Care & Education (ECCE) service in the province. To manage the implementation of strategic plan, Annual Performance Plan and the Operational Plan. To manage the performance of the unit in term of the Children’s Act 38 of 2005 pertaining to partial care and Child Protection as well as the implementation of the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) and all other applicable legislations in the ECCE sector. Ensure proper financial management and coordination in the ECCE sector in line with the PFMA and related policies. Monitor and ensure timely transfer payments to ECDs. Ensure proper planning and coordination of professional development of Social Workers and ECCE practitioners in the ECD sector. To ensure that Partial care database/registers are in place and monitored. Ensure that all ECCE service is uploaded on the agreed upon Learner Management System. Ensure that capacity building support programs and training are conducted and monitored for ECCE management and governance and output assessed. Ensure that the district quarterly review sessions are arranged and guidance is provided on the expected outcomes. Ensure the expansion of the ECCE service within the province by providing the necessary support across the districts. Facilitate Inter-Sectoral Coordination to improve and better the ECCE service. Manage the provision of partial care facilities and programmes in the Free State. Manage the provision of Early Childhood Care and Education programmes. Develop and manage the implementation of norms and standards for Early Childhood Care & Education Centre’s. Manage a comprehensive electronic information Management system. Manage funding of partial care and Early Childhood Care & Education facilities and programmes.
jobs.applications: Please go to the website as indicated below to apply for this post. https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
jobs.notes: It is the intention to promote representativity in the Department through the filling of these posts. The candidature of applicants from designated groups especially in respect of people with disabilities, women and youth will receive preference. A recent comprehensive, detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) containing, inter alia, a complete chronological record of training, experience, competencies, and previous employment record as well as the names and telephone numbers of three persons willing to act as referees. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents). All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks on criminal records, citizenship verification, financial records, qualification verification and applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Separate applications must be submitted for every vacancy. Failure to comply with the procedure outlined above, will lead to an application being rejected. Applicants who terminated their services with voluntary severance packages may not apply; salary progression on the salary scales is subject to performance assessment; The FSDoE reserves the right not to fill advertised positions. It is expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place determined by the Free State Department of Education. It is the applicants’ responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Non-RSA residents/permanent residents will submit proof only when shortlisted. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their application has been unsuccessful. Introduction and general measures: NB: as of 1st July 2006, all new appointments in the public service have to be part of the Government Employee Medical Scheme (GEMS) in order to qualify for a Government Medical Subsidy. Correspondence will only be entered into with shortlisted applicants. Entry level requirement for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1, a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Nyukela (Compulsory Pre- Entry Certificate for entry into the SMS) Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The Course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https:www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/.According to the Explanatory Guide on SMS Competency- Based Assessment, paragraph 5.1, All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioral preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. According to the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1, paragraph 1.32.1, all shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Direktoraat vir Vroeë Kinderopvoeding en -onderwys
af.summary: Direkteurspos om vroeë kinderopvoedings- en -onderwyssdienste in die Department of Education, Free State te bestuur en te koördineer, gebaseer in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurderslisensie. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kandidate met sterk konseptuele en formuleringvaardighede; sterk leierskapsvaardighede met spesifieke verwysing na die vermoë om denkleierskap te toon en die koördinasie van komplekse toepassings; sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede; uitstekende mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; uitstekende beplannings-, organisatoriese en mensebestuursvaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; 'n hoë ontwikkelde interpretatiewe en konseptualiserings-/formuleringvermoë; die vermoë om advies en leiding op 'n objektiewe en toegewyde wyse te verskaf; Die vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer, met dubbelsinnigheid om te gaan en onder vinnig veranderende en drukvolle omstandighede te bestuur; die vermoë om te oortuig en te beïnvloed; die vermoë om spanne professionele persone en diensverskaffers te lei en te bestuur asook die vermoë om met komplekse situasies om te gaan.
af.duties: Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende koördinasie en algehele bestuur van die vroeë kinderopvoedings- en -onderwysdiens in die provinsie. Bestuur die implementering van die strategiese plan, die jaarlikse prestasieplan en die operasionele plan. Bestuur die prestasie van die eenheid in terme van die Children's Act 38 of 2005 met betrekking tot gedeeltelike sorg en kinderbeskerming asook die implementering van die National Curriculum Framework (NCF) en alle ander toepaslike wetgewing in die ECCE-sektor. Verseker behoorlike finansiële bestuur en koördinasie in die ECCE-sektor in ooreenstemming met die PFMA en verwante beleide. Monitor en verseer tydige oordragbetalings aan ECD's. Verseker behoorlike beplanning en koördinasie van professionele ontwikkeling van maatskaplike werkers en ECCE-praktisyne in die ECD-sektor. Verseker dat databasisse/registers vir gedeeltelike sorg in plek is en gemonitor word. Verseer dat alle ECCE-diens op die ooreengekome Learner Management System gelaai word. Verseker dat kapasiteitsbou-ondersteuningsprogramme en -opleiding vir ECCE-bestuur en -bestuur uitgevoer en gemonitor word en die uitsette geassesseer word. Verseker dat die distrikte se kwartaallikse hersieningsessies gereël word en leiding verskaf word oor die verwagte uitkomste. Verseker die uitbreiding van die ECCE-diens binne die provinsie deur die nodige ondersteuning oor die distrikte te verskaf. Fasiliteer intersektoriële koördinasie om die ECCE-diens te verbeter. Bestuur die verskaffing van gedeeltelike sorgfasiliteite en -programme in die Free State. Bestuur die verskaffing van vroeë kinderopvoedings- en -onderwysprogramme. Ontwikkel en bestuur die implementering van norme en standaarde vir vroeë kinderopvoedings- en -onderwyssentrums. Bestuur 'n omvattende elektroniese inligtingsbestuurstelsel. Bestuur befondsing van gedeeltelike sorg- en vroeë kinderopvoedings- en -onderwysfasiliteite en -programme.

zu.title: Umhla ki: Umnyango Wezokuhlukanisa Namaphoyisa Esiqoshwa Esihle
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikamongameli ukuphatha futhi uhlele izinsizakalo zokuqashwa komntwana esemusha kanye nemfundo kumnyango wezemfundo esifundazweni sakwa Free State, sitholakala e Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziye zathathwa emazingeni e NQF level 7 njengoba zivunywe yi South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Uzobe unamava eminyaka engu 5 ohlelweni lwabaphathi abaphakathi noma abaphezulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela ye Code B/EB. Kuzothunyelwa inhlonhlo kwabangenelelo abanamakhono amakhulu wokuqamba imibono nokuhlakanipha, amakhono okuba ngumholi ohlakaniphile ngokukhethekile ngokuqamba imibono yokuhlakanipha nokuhlela izinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi; amakhono mahle wokuhlobana nabantu; amakhono aphakeme okukhuluma nokubhala; amakhono amakhulu wokuhlela, ukulungisa nokuphatha abantu; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amandla aphakeme wokuqonda nokuhlakanipha, kanye namandla okunikela incezu futhi uholele ngendlela ephathekayo; Amandla okwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukubekezela ekubumbathekeni futhi ukuphatha ngaphansi kwezimo ezishintsha ngokushesha futhi ezibanga umfutho; amandla okukhuluma futhi ukutshala umbono; amandla okuhola futhi uqondise amaqembu abantu abahlakaniphile futhi abahlinzeka izinsizakalo, kanye namandla okubhekana nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa okusebenzayo futhi okupumelelayo kanye nokuphatha ngokuphelele insizakalo yokuhlala kwabasha (ECCE) esifundazweni. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwehle lokuhlela ngendlela ephusha isikhathi, uHlelo Lweminyaka Yonke Lokuqhuma kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza. Lawula ukusebenza kweyikhaya ngokomthetho we Children's Act 38 of 2005 ngokuphathelene nokunakekelwa okuncane kanye nokuvinjelwa komntwana kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe National Curriculum Framework (NCF) kanye nakwezinye izimiso zomthetho ezisebenza ohlelweni lwe ECCE. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle futhi ukuhlelwa ohlelweni lwe ECCE ngokuya kwesiqu somthetho we PFMA kanye nemigomo ehubile. Bheka futhi uqinisekise ukukhishwa kwezimali ngesikhathi ohlelweni lwe ECD. Qinisekisa ukuhlela okuhle nokuhlelwa kokuthuthuka ngokwabantu kwe Social Workers kanye nabasebenzi be ECCE ohlelweni lwe ECD. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlu zokunakekelwa okuncane zitholakala futhi zibhekwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke insizakalo ye ECCE ifakwe kuso uLearner Management System. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokukhulisa amandla nokuhlatshwa kwenhlalakahle ziqhutshwa futhi zibhekiwe ekuhlenqeni kokuphatha nokubusa i ECCE, futhi imiphumela ibhekiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkulumo zesigaba ngesigaba ezifunda zihlelwa futhi kunikwa incezu ngemiphumela ehlelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo ye ECCE inwetshwe esifundazweni ngokunikeza inketho edingekayo kuyo yonke imihlobo yezifunda. Hlela ukuhlelwa phakathi kwabahluki ukwenza insizakalo ye ECCE ibe ngcono. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemiyalo yokunakekelwa okuncane kanye nezinhlelo esifundazweni sakwa Free State. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuncane komtwana. Hlela futhi phatha ukusebenzisa imigomo kanye namazinga okunakekelwa okuncane komntwana kumikhakha yokuqashwa kanye nemfundo. Lawula ohlelweni oluqukethe imininingwane kahle lokuphatha ngokushelele. Lawula ukunikwa kwemali yokunakekelwa okuncane okuyinsiza yokukhulisa nokuhlala kwabasha ohlelweni.

xh.title: Umphathi: Isebe lezeMfundo ekuQwalaselweni kwaBantwana eba seminyeni yokuKhathalelwa & ekuFundweni
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi sokulawula nokulungelelanisa iinkonzo zokuKhathalelwa kwaBantwana eba seminyeni yokuQwalaselwa nokokuFundwa kwabo kwiSebe lezeMfundo lase-Free State, esekwe eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 njengoko zivunywe nguMbane woMgaqo-nkqubo weSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Iminyaka emi-5 yamava ngengangathu phakathi kwabaphathi abaphezulu. Ifayitsha yokushayela ekusebenzayo yeKhowudi B/EB. Kuya kubakho amandla amakhulu kubasebenzi abanobuchule bokucinga nokudidiyela; amandla aphakamileyo okukhokela anendlela ethile yokubonisa ubuchule bokukhokela ingqondo nokuLungelelanisa izicelo ezinzima; amandla amakhulu okwenza ubudlelwane nabantu; amandla amakhulu ekuthetheni nokuBhaliweyo; amandla aphezulu kwiNkqubo, ekuQwalaselweni kwaye nakulawulweniabantu; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ikhono eliphezulu elikhulileyolelokuchaza nokucinga/nokudidiyela; ikhono lonika izifundo nokuKhokela ngendlela echanekileyo neZinikeleyo; Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi emininji ngexesha elinye, ukuba nesibindi kwiimeko ezibucayile nokulawula kumava aguqukayo kodwa anomonakho woxinzelelo; ikhono lokukhohlisa nokuphucunda; ikhono lokukhokela nokukhokela amaqela eengcali kunye nabahanini besebenzi kwaye nokuba nesibindi kumava amabinzima.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulungelelanisa okusebenzayo nokufanelekileyo nokulawula iinkonzo zonke ekuKhathalelweni kwaBantwana eba seminyeni yokuQwalaselwa nokokuFundwa kwabo (ECCE) kwiphondo. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa kwenkqubo yokucwangciswa, iNkqubo yoNyaka yokwenza kunye neNkqubo yokuSebenza. Ukulawula ukwenza komsebenzi weyuniti ngokomthetho weActs yabaNTWANA yo-2005 ngokufanelekileyo ekukhathaleleni kuncedo oluyimota yamapha eCandwe kunye neNkqubo yokuKhathalelwa abantwana ngokufanelekileyo nokusebenzisa iNational Curriculum Framework (NCF) nakunye nemithefutho yonke eguqulayo kwicandwe le-ECCE. Qinisekisa ukulawula ukusebenza kweemali kunye nokuLungelelanisa kwicandwe le-ECCE ngokwePFMA nangokweenkqubo ezinxulumene nayo. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukudluliswa kolawulo-lwemali ngexesha elizeleko kuma-ECD. Qinisekisa ukucwangciswa okufanelekileyo nokulungelelanisa iNkqubo yokuphucula abaSebenzisi bezeZomtsalane kunye nabasebenzi be-ECCE kwicandwe le-ECD. Ukulungelelanisa iNkqubo yokubhaliswa kolwazi ngokwecandwe lokuLungisa nokwazi ukuba ngaphantsi kokuQwalaselwa kwabantwana. Qinisekisa ukuba inkonzo yonke ye-ECCE itshintshiwe kumanobumba aqokiweyo eLearner Management System. Qinisekisa iinkqubo zokukhuxa nokwazisa inkampani nokuqwalaselwa zenziwa kwaye iqwalaselwe ukulawulo lolwazi kwi-ECCE kwaye iziphumo ziqwalaselwe. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuQwalaselwa ngokweNtsimbi kwimithetho yakuqwalaselwa yokucwangciswa zemida isikhulule kwaye izifundo zinikwa ngokwemithetho yemithetho yokuRatwa. Qinisekisa ukuAndiswa kweenkonzo ze-ECCE kwiphondo ngokunika inkxaso efunekayo kummandla wonke. Qwalasela nokuQwalaselwa ngokuLungelelanisa phakathi kweeNdawo nokuPhucula iinkonzo ezingcono ze-ECCE. Lawula ukunikezwa kweendawo zokuQwalaselwa neenKqubo kwiFree State. Lawula ukunikezwa kweenkqubo zokuKhathalelwa nokuFundwa kwaBantwana eba seminyeni. Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule ukusebenziswa kweenkqubo namazinga okuKhathalelwa nokuFundwa kwaBantwana eba seminyeni kumaziko e-ECCE. Lawula inkqubo elungelelanisiweyo yokuQwalaselwa kolwazi ngekhompyutha. Lawula imali yamandla eQwalaselwa nokuKhathalelwa kwaBantwana eba seminyeni nokuFundwa kwabo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1-3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 – R1 121 241 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 – R1 297 089 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 – R1 713 534 per annum all -inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Medical Aid (Optional) Employee must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Medical Officer sought at Katleho District Hospital in the Free State to manage medical conditions, perform compulsory commuted overtime and supervise junior staff.
jobs.requirements: Matric. Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Current annual registration with HPCSA. Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 1 year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Knowledge and Skills: Extensive knowledge on Public Service legislation, policies and procedures. Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, report writing, medico-legal reports). Good interpersonal skills as well as display of honesty, integrity and excellent work ethics.
jobs.duties: Management of all medical conditions to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Candidates will have to perform commuted overtime duties (compulsory & non-negotiable). Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions. Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long term follow up. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to become skilled in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill-patients.

af.title: Mediese Offisier Vlak 1-3
af.summary: Mediese Offisier gesoek by Katleho Distrikshospitaal in die Free State om mediese toestande te bestuur, verpligte kommuterende oortyd te verrig en toesig oor junior personeel te hou.
af.requirements: Matric. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk) moontlik maak. Huidige jaarlikse registrasie by HPCSA. Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Uitgebreide kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling, skriftelik, verslagskrywing, medies-regtelike verslae). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede asook vertoon van eerlikheid, integriteit en uitstekende werksetiek.
af.duties: Bestuur van alle mediese toestande om te verseker dat bekwame diens aan alle pasiënte gelewer word. Kandidate sal kommuterende oortydspligte moet verrig (verpligtend en nie-onderhandelbaar). Hou toesig oor junior personeel om voldoende mediese sorg te verskaf en om hulle op te lei om sleutelmediese ingrypinge te kan uitvoer. Raadpleeg pasiënte op 'n buitepasiëntbasis om optimale chroniese siektebestuur en goeie langtermyn-opvolg te verseker. Voorligting, inligting en berading van pasiënte en, waar toepaslik, familielede rakende voorkoming, behandeling, operasies, komplikasies en rehabilitasie. Streef daarna om vaardig te raak in hersuspitasie-maatreëls en intensiewe sorgbehandeling om die oorlewing van kritiek sieke pasiënte te verseker.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezokwelapha Izinga 1-3
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umsizi Wezokwelapha eKatleho District Hospital eFree State ukuphatha izimo zokwelapha, ukwenza okushiwo ngokusebenza ngemahora adlulisiwe njengesibopho kanye nokuphatha izisebenzi ezincane.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric. Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa neHPCSA njengesebenzi Wezokwelapha (Isenzo Esizimele). Ukubhalisa kwamajeje okumanjana neHPCSA. Izinga 1: Akukho lutho ngemva kokubhalisa neHPCSA njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha maqondana nabeqeqeshwe eSouth Africa. Unyaka ogu-1 wokuhlola okuhambisana ngemva kokubhalisa njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha neNdhuna Yamalungu Wezempilo ebezwa ngaphandle mayelana nabeqeqeshwe ngaphandle, abangeke badingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eSouth Africa. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yokuhlola okuhambisana ngemva kokubhalisa neHPCSA njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha maqondana nabeqeqeshwe eSouth Africa. Eminyakeni engu-6 wokuhlola okuhambisana ngemva kokubhalisa njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha neNdhuna Yamalungu Wezempilo ebezwa ngaphandle mayelana nabeqeqeshwe ngaphandle, abangeke badingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eSouth Africa. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yokuhlola okuhambisana ngemva kokubhalisa neHPCSA njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha maqondana nabeqeqeshwe eSouth Africa. Eminyakeni engu-11 wokuhlola okuhambisana ngemva kokubhalisa njengosebenzi Wezokwelapha neNdhuna Yamalungu Wezempilo ebezwa ngaphandle mayelana nabeqeqeshwe ngaphandle, abangeke badingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eSouth Africa. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olubanzi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nendlela yomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (athintathingo, abhalwe, ukubhala imibiko, imibiko yezomthetho wezokwelapha). Amakhono ohlotshaniswa nabantu ahle kanye nokubonisa ukwethembeka, ukuqotho kanye namazinga ahle emsebenzini.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha yonke imigogofa yezokwelapha ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kunikwa inkonzo ekwaziyo kubo bonke abagulayo. Abaqeqeshwa bazodinga ukwenza imisebenzi yamahora adlulisiwe (okuyisibopho futhi angeke kuxoxwe ngayo). Ukuphatha izisebenzi ezincane ukuze kunikwe ukunakekelwa okwanele kwezokwelapha kanye nokubaqeqesha ukuba bakwazi ukwenza izenzo eziyinhloko zezokwelapha. Ukubuka abagulayo ngendlela yokungangeni esibhedlela ukuze kuba nokuphathwa okuhle kwesifo esihlalo kanye nokulandelwa kahle isikhathi eside. Ukwazisa, ukutshela kanye nokweluleka abagulayo kanye nasendaweni efanele abasenayo ngokuthintwa, ukwelashwa, izindlela zokwelashwa, izinkinga kanye nokululama. Ukuhleleka ukuba nolwazi ekwenzeni izenzo zokusindisa kanye nokunakekelwa okujulile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusindwa kwabagulayo ababucayini.

xh.title: I Ofisi Yezempilo Inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Kufunekiwa i Ofisi Yezempilo e Katleho District Hospital e Free State ukulawula izigulo zezempilo, ukuze yenze imisebenzi yothotho lwexesha elongeziweyo ekuyinyaniso kwaye alawule abasebenzi abangabanncinci.
xh.requirements: Imatrikile. I skilled out that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Current registration with HPCSA. Grade 1: Akukho after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 1 year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Knowledge and Skills: Extensive knowledge on Public Service legislation, policies and procedures. Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, report writing, medico-legal reports). Good interpersonal skills as well as display of honesty, integrity and excellent work ethics.
xh.duties: Management of all medical conditions to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Candidates will have to perform commuted overtime duties (compulsory & non-negotiable). Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions. Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long term follow up. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to become skilled in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill-patients.

Klank mondelinge en skriftelike vaardighede. Klank mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint).
