Verseker gehaltegesondheidsdienste soos vereis deur Ideal Clinic Standards, Infection Prevention Control, Occupational Health and Safety-nakomingsstandaarde.

zu.title: Dentist Grade 1-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Dentist esibhedlela i-Itemoheng District Hospital e-Free State, esinamazinga 1 kuya ku-3 ngeholo eliqala ku-R1,011,516 kuya ku-R1,713,534 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesidanga esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengama-Dentist. Ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoma-Dentist. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoma-Dentist ku-HPCSA mayelana nemisebenzi yomphakathi oqeqeshwe e-SA. Grade 2: Ukwazi okungenani eminyakeni eyi-7 isipiliyoni esifanele njengoma-Dentist ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-PHCSA njengoma-Dentist. Grade 3: Ukwazi okungenani eminyakeni eyi-12 isipiliyoni esifanele njengoma-Dentist ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoma-Dentist. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje 2026/2027). Ilayisensi yokuqasha esebenzayo (Code B/EB). Ulwazi nobuhlule: Zinikela kuzo zonke izidingo nezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko, amadokhumenti ezokwelapha, ukugcina irekhodi nokuqamba izincomo. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ekukhulumeni nasekubhalweni. Amakhono amahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Zinikela kumazinga we-National Core Standards noma izidingo zesikhungo/ikliniki ehlukaniswe njengoko kusebenza kanye nokuphatha isikhathi kahle. Ukuhlela ukwelashwa nokulandela njengoko kudingeka. Ikono lokuba noguquko futhi ube nokwakhiwa emsakweni kwezidingo ezahlukene zabathengi.
zu.duties: Nika inkuleko, buholi nobulungiswa kwisebe lezinyo. Inika amasevisi ezenyongqongqoshe nesesibili kubantu abadala namasevisi ezenyongqongqoshe yesibili kubantu abadala kanye nezingane emakliniki we-PHC ethumela amaphakheji abhalisiwe wokunakekelwa kwemilomo ekubukweni kwangaphandle kwentela yokuqasha nolawulo olusebenzayo. Intela yolawulo nokulawula izitokhwa esebenzayo. Qinisekisa amasevisi ezezempilo okulingene njengokufunwa amazinga e-Ideal Clinic Standards, ukulawulwa kokuvikelwa kwentela, ukuhambisana namazinga ayingqayizihlaka e-Occupational Health and Safety.

xh.title: UDokothawezinyo inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguDokotha wezinyo eItemoheng District Hospital eFree State, sinika amaqabi aqela ukuya kwelithathu anemivuzo egqithiswa ukusuka kwi-R1,011,516 ukuya kwi-R1,713,534 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Umatric ngokunjalo nelayisensi efanelekileyo evumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njenguDokotha wezinyo. Ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njenguDokotha wezinyo. Ulwazi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ludlwana kubhaliswa njengeDokotha wezinyo kwiHPCSA mayela nomsebenzi onelungelo eSA. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-7 yamava afanelekileyo njengoDokotha wezinyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotha wezinyo. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-12 yamava afanelekileyo njengoDokotha wezinyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotha wezinyo. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku 2026/2027). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (iCode B/EB). Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuthobela yonke imfuno nendlela yesebe. Ukubhala iingxelo ezibalaseleyo, amaxwebhu ezempilo, ukugcina iirekhodi nokuvela iiletters zokuqhuthumba. Amakhono abalwe kwaye abhalwe ngokusembokweni. Amakhono okuthetha nokubhala ngokusembokweni. Amakhono amabalweakhompyutha amabalaseleyo (iMS Word, Excel nePowerPoint). Ukuzithobela iimfuno zeNational Core Standards neyefasiliti/iklinikhi ealuseleyo njengoko kufuneka nokulawula ixesha ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuqamba isicwangciso sezempilo nokulandela njengoko kuyimfuno. Amandla okuzinqandla nokuba nobuntu obutsha kusabela kwiimfuno ezahlukeneyo zexhaswa.
xh.duties: Ukunika intlanganiso, ulawulo nokulawula kwindawo yamazinyo. Ukunika iinkonzo zabantu abakhulu nezincinci zezinyo ezingunyculo nesibini kwiikliniki zePHC ezinika iphakheji esiseko lonakeko lwamazinyo kwindwendwelo olusebenzayo olulawulo nolusebenzayo. Ukuqokelelwa kolawulo nolusebenzayo kwenkxaso. Ukuqinisekisa iinkonzo zempilo ezikumgangatho ophezulu njengoko kufunwa ziMigangatho yeIdeal Clinic, uLawulo lokuthintela ukutshaikalwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza kolawulo koNyango loBomi baseMsebenzini nokuze kwenzeke ukuzinza kolawulo lokhuseleko lomnyango.

Deeglike mondelinge en skriftelike vaardighede. Deeglike mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Voldoen aan Nasionale Kernstandaarde en/of ideale fasiliteit/kliniekvereistes soos van toepassing en goeie tydbestuur. Kliniese beplanning en opvolg soos nodig. Vermoe om buigsaam en innoverend te wees in reaksie op uiteenlopende kliëntbehoeftes.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap, bestuur en beheer in die tandheelkundige eenheid. zu.title: Umeshi Wamazinyo Izinga 1-3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomeshi wamazinyo ezingeni 1 kuye kwe-3 esifundeni i-Lejweleputswa, zidinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomeshi wamazinyo wonke ubuncweti obuhambisana naleso sikhundla.

Ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomeshi wamazinyo. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje 2026/2027. Ubuncweti: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomeshi wamazinyo ku-HPCSA mayelana nemsebenzisi oqeqeshwe e-SA. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-7 yobuncweti obuhambisana nalokhu njengomeshi wamazinyo ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-PHCSA njengomeshi wamazinyo. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-12 yobuncweti obuhambisana nalokhu njengomeshi wamazinyo ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomeshi wamazinyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela enamandla (i-Code B/EB). Ulwazi nezakhono: Ukuhambisana nazo zonke izidingo nemiqathango yomnyango. Ubuhlakuhlakwesi bokubhala imibiko, amadokhumenti ezokwelapha, ukugcina amarekhodi kanye nokubhala amakhasimende abhekise kwezinye izikhungo. Izakhono ezinhle zokukhuluma nokubhala. Izakhono ezinhle zokuxhumana ngokukhuluma nokubhala. Izakhono ezinhle zekhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ukuhambisana ne-National Core Standards kanye/noma izidingo zesikhungo/ikliniki eyingqayizevelo njengoba kufanelekile kanye nokuphatha isikhathi kakuhle. Ukuhlela izinto zokwelapha kanye nokulandela inkambiso njengoba kudingeka. Ikono lokuba nobunye ubuhle futhi ukuba nezindlela ezintsha ekuphendulweni kwezidingo ezehlukene zabakhasimende.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholo, ulawulo loluzondo kanye nokuphatwa kwesikhungo sezinyo. Nikeza izinsiza ezimaphakathi nezesibili lezokunakekelwa kwamazinyo kubantu abadala kanye nezinsiza ezisesibili ezokunakekelwa kwamazinyo kubantu abadala nabantwana emakliniki we-PHC ethula amaphakheji abalulekile okunakekelwa kwesidlwalwa kumathekithi okukhishwa emhlabeni wonke ngesikhathi kuhlinzekwa ukulawula nokuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokulawula nokuphatha isitokhwa ngempumelelo. Qinisekisa izinsiza ezingangcono zezempilo njengoba kudingwa umgaqo we-Ideal Clinic Standards, ukulawula ukuvikelwa kokutheleleka, kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Occupational Health and Safety.

xh.requirements: I-Matric plus Isidanga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodotshila. Amaxa: Iqela 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa njengodotshila kwi-HPCSA mayela nomsebenzi ovela kwi-SA. Iqela 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka elingu-7 yamava afanelekileyo njengodotshila emva kokubhalisa kwi-PHCSA njengodotshila. Iqela 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka elingu-12 yamava afanelekileyo njengodotshila emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodotshila. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (i-Code B/EB). Ulwazi nemakhono: Ukuzithoba kuzo zonke iimfuno ze-isebe kunye neenkqubo. Amakhono amabalwe obhalo lweengxelo, uxwebhu lwezempilo, ukugcina iirekhodi nokubhala iireferali. Amakhono amabalwe alulwimi nokubhala. Amakhono amabalwe oonxibelelwano lusapho nokubhala. Amakhono amhle ekhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint). Ukuzithoba kwi-National Core Standards nakwikliniki/isebe esifanelekileyo njengoko kusebenza kunye nokulawula ixesha kakuhle. Ukuqumba iinkqubo zempilo nokulandela njengoko kufuneka. Ikhono lokuba nobuchule nokuba nombhono ekuphenduleni iimfuno ezahlukeneyo zabathengi.
xh.duties: Nika inkululeko, ulawulo nokulawula kwicandelo lezinyo. Nikela iinkonzo ezinyo eziphambili nezibhozo kubantu abadala kunye nezonke ezibhozo ebantwini abadala nabanincinane nakwikliniki ze-PHC ezinika iipakethe ezisisiseko ezinkonzo zonye ngexesha lokunyanga ezinika ulawulo nokulawula ngokusebenzayo. Nikela ngolawulo nokulawula kwifestile. Qinisekisa iinkonzo zempilo zamagunya njengoko kufunwa ngemiGaqo ye-Ideal Clinic Standards, i-Infection Prevention Control, ne-Occupational Health and Safety compliance standards.

af.requirements: Matric plus 'n Diploma in Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op bestuursvlak (ASD). Kennis en Vaardighede: Breë kennis en begrip van die funksionele areas wat deur die portefeulje van die uitvoerende gesagsbevoegdheid gedek word. Werkende kennis van die politieke en parlementêre prosesse in Suid-Afrika. Openbare diens regulasies (PSR) 2016 soos gewysig, Openbare diens wet (PSA), Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet. af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf stelsels, registers en databasisse om die vloei van dokumente na, van en binne die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesagsbevoegdheid te monitor en te bestuur. Stel korrespondensie, voorleggings en kabinetsmemorandums soos vereis op. Bestudeer, redigeer en kommentarieer op voorleggings wat aan die uitvoerende gesagsbevoegdheid vir oorweging voorgelê gaan word. Bestuur die verkryging en onderhoud van toerusting en administreer die begroting in die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesagsbevoegdheid. Bestuur die verspreiding van memorandums aan Kabinet/uitvoerende raadslede. Bestuur die verspreiding van dokumente en voorleggings aan die relevante wetgewer en staande/portefeuljekomitees. zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mongameli: Isekelo Lolawulo Nokuqondanisa
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mongameli sezekelelo lolawulo nokuqondanisa e Department of Health e Bloemfontein, sifuna idiploma yokulawula kanye neminyaka emithathu yomlando wokusebenza kulawulo.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye ne-Diploma kwi-Management/Public Administration noma okulingana nakwazinga le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka omu-3 womlando wokusebenza ezingeni lokulawula (ASD). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olubanzi nokuzuva kwemikhakha ehlanganiswe uwiso loluhlelo lobulungu begunya. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamaphrocessi ezombusazonke nesesishayamthetho eNingizimu Afrika. I-Public service regulations (PSR) 2016 njengoba lisushunyisiwe, i-Public service act (PSA), i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Labour Relations Act. Ukubeka ngaphambili, ukulungelelisa nokuqamba, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, Unxibelelwano, Ukwazi khomphyutha, Ukugcina imali, Amakhono okuqaga izinkinga.
zu.duties: Athuthukise, aphonye futhi agcine izimiso, izinkomba namadatabhase okuqapha nokuphatha ukuhamba kwamadokhumenti aya, eza kanye naphakathi kwofishi lobulungu begunya. Ahlanganise unxibelelwano, izinikelo kanye nememorandakhabinethi njengoba kudingiwa. Afunde, ahlele futhi anikeze izinkombo ezinikelweni ezizothunyelwa ebunyeni obaliwayo ukuze zihlolelwe. Aphathe ukuthenga nokugcina izibhakabhaka aze abhalise imali efisini leSekela Mongameli egunya elibeke. Aphathe ukwesekwa ngokuyisisekelo efisini ebunyeni obaliwayo. Athuthukise, aphonye futhi agcine uhlelo lokuhlela amafayela afisini ebunyeni obaliwayo. Aphathe inziso yamafayela efisini ebunyeni obaliwayo. Aqinisekise ukuthi amadokhumenti aqoqwe ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ye-MIS futhi atshatswe ngendlela ehambisana nokuqoqwa kwawo. Amzimisele iNkosana Yebose ngemikhakha ehlobene nesikhwama sobulungu obaliwayo ohlelweni lweCabinet/isigungu. Axhumane nabaphathi abaphezulu kulezi zikhungo ezingaphakathi kwesikhwama sobulungu obaliwayo. Ahlele imisebenzi efisini ebunyeni obaliwayo. Aphathe ukusabalaliswa kwememorandakhabinethi kwamalungu eCabinet/isigungu. Aphathe ukusabalaliswa kwamadokhumenti nezinkwibo ekomidi elidingekayo lomthetho ikomidi elihlale/lisebenza. Agcina irekhodi lezinqumo zeCabinet/isigungu aze exwayise iNkosana Yebose kanye nobulungu obaliwayo ngezinyathelo okumele zithathwe namasuku okubaluleka. Ukugcina amehlo kuye wonke amasebenzi abasebenzi befisini ebunyeni obaliwayo. Ukulawula ikhwalithi yomsebenzi ohlinzekwa ngaphansi kokulawula. Sikhomise owayisisekelo abaphansi kwakhe ngezindaba ezithinta wonke amaphuzu omsebenzi. Ukubeka isibopho ngokomthetho wokuqotho wobungozi obuqothoywe. Aqinisekise ukuthi wonke owayisisekelo baholwa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuba bakhone ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi ohleliwe kahle futhi ngokusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Inkxaso yolawulo nokuQhoboshwa
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli weNkxaso yolawulo nokuQhoboshwa kwiSebe lezeMpilo eBloemfontein, lifuna isatifikethi sokulawula kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava olawulo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma kuLawulo/uLawulo lwesiZwe okwa thothotho eNQF level 6 njengokwamkelwa yiSAQA. Iqondo elingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-3 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo (ASD). Ulwazi nayo nako: Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda iindawo ezisebenzayo ezikhangelwa lusetyenziso lulawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwemigaqo yezopolitiko kunye neyamaphalamente eSouth Africa. Iimigaqo zolonikezelo lwenkonzo yomntu wonke (PSR) 2016 njengoko zilungisiwe, uMthetho wolonikezelo lwenkonzo yomntu wonke (PSA), uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uMthetho weQhina lokuSebenza. Iprezente, iplani nokuqulunqa, uLawulo lwexesha, uThethathethwano, ukuqonda ikhompyutha, uLawulo lweMali, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, yenze igqibe ulondolozo lweendlela, iirejista kunye namabanki edata ukuze ulawule nophononongo lwamagama aya kwaye avela nakule ndlu yolawulo egunyazisiweyo. Qamba amagama, izicelo kunye nememoranda yeKhabhinate njengoko kufuneka. Phonononga, hlengahlengisa uphawule izicelo eziza kuthumelwa kulawulo olugunyazisiweyo ukuze zicwangciswe. Lawula ukuthengwa nolondolozo lweempahla uzobe ulawula ngemali kwiofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Lawula inkxaso yemisebenzi kwiofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Phuhlisa, yenze igqibe ulondolozo loluhlelo lwemifanekiso yamagama kwiofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Lawula irejista yamagama kwiofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amagama aqulunqwa ngokwemigaqo yeMIS kwaye ajatshulwa ngokwendlela equlunqwe ngayo. Xelela uMlawuli weN Tsiku ngezindaba ezithintela lusetyenziso lolawulo olugunyazisiweyo kwiproposi yamagqabantshintshi eKhabhinate/ikomiti yolawulo. Thetha nabaphathi abaphezulu kwiindlu zonke ezikulawulo olugunyazisiweyo lungunjululo. Qhobosha imisebenzi yofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. Lawula ulahleko lwememoranda kwamalungu eKhabhinate/ikomiti yolawulo. Lawula ulahleko lamagama nezicelo kumagunyaziso afanelekileyo amaphalamente nakwiiKomiti ezimeleyo/zeproposi. Gcina irekhodi yezigqibo eKhabhinate/ikomiti yolawulo ulumke uMlawuli weNtsiku nolawulo olugunyazisiweyo ngesenzo okufuneka senziwe nangemini yokugqibela. Ukulawulwa ngokubanzi kwamagosa kwiofisi yolawulo olugunyazisiweyo. ULawulo lwesiphumo somsebenzi ovela kubalawuli. Lala icebiso kubalawuli malunga nawo onke amacala omsebenzi. Zibe ngumgunyazisi wesigaba esimthethweni malunga nabalawuli. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abalawuli bafundiswa baphuhliswa ukuba bakwazi ukunika isiphumo somsebenzi esimfuneko ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo.

jobs.title: Depurt Director: Managerial Accounting

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursrekeningkunde
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur van Bestuursrekeningkunde in die Department of Health, Free State, wat toon oor finansiële beleide, kontantvloei-bewaking en nakoming van voorskrifte.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate plus, Bachelor's Degree/ Advanced Diploma in Financial Management /Accounting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar verwante ervaring in bestuursrekeningkunde op toesig/bestuurvlak (ASD). Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Treasury Regulations issued in terms of the PFMA, Free State Provincial Revenue Act and Performance Management System. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Public Service Regulations (PSR). Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling. Menslike hulpbronbestuur, finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering en tydbestuur. Spanspeler, strategiese beplanning, goeie kommunikasie, rekenaargeletterdheid, verslagskryfvaardighede. Fasilitering, koördinering, leierskap, veranderings- en kennisvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk om te verseker dat daar kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelings. Ontwikkel en handhaaf beleide en prosesse. Monitor kontantvloei en dien kontantvloeiverslae en -planne in soos vereis. Monitor nakoming van finansiële voorskrifte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor die gebruik van vooruitskatting. Beplanning – Verseker dat inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes behoorlik versamel en ontleed word. Begroting – Bestuur, hersien, ontleed en verseker die gehalte van die begrotingsvoorbereidingsproses. Verslagdoening – Koördineer, hersien, ontleed en verseker die gehalte van die bestuursrekeningkunde-verslagdoeningsprosesse. Verseker dat inligting oor die vereiste vir oorrolversoeke aan verantwoordelikhede- en programbestuurders versprei word. Verseker dat alle oorrolversoeke oorweeg word, voorstelle ontwikkel en aan die CFO vir oorweging voorgelê word. Verseker dat die goedgekeurde oorrols in die aanpassingsbegrotings ingesluit word. Assesseer die behoefte aan addisionele fondse wat vereis word vanuit die aanpassingsramingsproses deur die monitering van bestedingsneigings. Verseker die assessering van bestedingsneigings en die ontwikkeling van voorstelle oor die oorplasing of verskuiwing van fondse. Handhawing van dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem menslike hulpbron- en ander verwante administratiewe funksies. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die subdirektoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarslopende taakspanne. Aankope en batebestuur. Beplanning en toekenning van werk. Gehaltebeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Funksionele tegniese advies en leiding.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikabelediri: Eziphathwa Ngokwezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMphathi ongumama ophethe kweziphathwa ngokwezimali Kumnuyango wezempiro Free State, ophethe izinqubomgomo zezezimali, ukulondolozwa kokugeleza kwemali nokuhambisana nemiyalo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samabanga aphezulu kanye ne-Degree ye-Bachelor / i-Advanced Diploma ekuPhathweni Kwezimali / Ukuhola noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yomlando wokusebenza ohlotshaniswe naye kukuholwa kwezimali ezingeni lokuqondisa / ezingeni lokuphatha (ASD). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Labour Relations Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Treasury Regulations ekhishwe nge-PFMA, i-Free State Provincial Revenue Act kanye ne-Performance Management System. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Public Service Regulations (PSR). Ukuhlaziya nokuqamba izinqubomgomo. Ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha izimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukucubungula nokuhlela kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Ukusebenza njengomunye wethimba, ukulelelela okuhle, ukuxhumana okuhle, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okukhuthaza, okuhlanganisa, okukhoza, okushintsha kanye nokuqonda ulwazi.
zu.duties: Qapha isisekelo sezinqubomgomo nezomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhlolwa izinto ezintsha ezitholakalayo. Qamba futhi ulondoloze izinqubomgomo nokuqhubeka phambili. Qapha ukugeleza kwemali kanye nokuthumela imibiko yokuqaphela ukugeleza nemaphuzu njengoku diyiwe. Qapha ukuhambisana nemiyalo ezimalini. Nikeza izeluleki nokuqondisa abadlali bemidlalo ngokusebenzisa ukuqagela okuhle. Ukuhlela - Qinisekisa ukuthi ukwaziswa okudingeka ngenhlosso yokuhlela kuqoqwa futhi kuhlaziywe ngendlela efanayo. Ukuhlela kwesabelo malimaza - Phatha, hlaziya, hlaziya futhi hlonza inqubo yokulungiselela ukwenza isabelo somsebenzi. Imibiko - Hlanganisa, hlaziya, hlaziya futhi hlonza inqubo yemibiko yezimali eziyinhloko ezibalwe ukusetshenziswa. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukwaziswa ngesidingo sabadlali bemidlalo ngosuku lokucisha imali sithunyelwa kumaphathi abomphathele. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abadayisa ngokususa ngosuku bayacatshangelwa, iziphakamiso zenziwe zithunyelwe ku-CFO ukuze kucatshangelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukususwa ngosuku okugunyaziwe kufakwe emahlelweni okulungiswa amaphuzu. Hlola isidingo semali engeziwe eceleni esuswa esibukweni sokuhlaziya ngokuqaphela ukuthi imali ihamba kuphi. Qinisekisa ukuqoqwa kwemali engasetshenziswa kanye nezenzo ezithi ukugqamisa okanye ukushintshwa kanye nokudluliswa kwemali. Ukugcina inzima yokuphatha. Ukuphatha amandla nokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Thatha izisebenzi zamathambo okungenasithi zibe ngokwesabekile. Qamba, phume nzuzo futhi ukulondoloze izinhlelo zokusabalalisa amandla ngokusebenzisa okuhle. Beka emsebenzini isihlelo sokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi bese uthumela imibiko yokuthi kuyaqhubeka kanjani njengoba kuyisidingo. Qamba phume nzuzo futhi ugqoke izindlela ukuze uhlole ngokugqamisa kwemisebenzi. Qamba futhi uthumele yonke imibiko efuneka. Fundisa emisebenzini yamatholire njengoba kuyisidingo. Ukuhola izinkomba kanye nokuphatha okuyizimpahla. Hlela futhi ulomise umsebenzi. Ukulawula inqondo yomsebenzi ohlinzwa ngabasebenzi. Izeluleko nezindlela ezifanele zokuqhaza imisebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: I-Managerial Accounting
xh.summary: I-Sekela Mongameli we-Managerial Accounting kwi-Free State Department of Health, ejonge izicwangciso zeemali, ukumonisa ukugeleza kweemali kunye nokuzinikela ngokoqobo lweemithetho.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate plus, i-Bachelor's Degree/ Advanced Diploma kwi-Financial Management /Accounting okanye isiqu esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze kubekho ubuncinane beminyaka eli-3 yamava ahlobene nomanagement accounting kwinqanaba labaguqukeli/balawulo (ASD). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Labour Relations Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, ama-Treasury Regulations apapashwe ngokweenjongo zika-PFMA, i-Free State Provincial Revenue Act kunye ne-Performance Management System. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Public Service Regulations (PSR). Ukuhlalutya kwaye kuphuhliswe iindlela. Ukulawula abantu, ukulawula iimali, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukuqamba iplani nokuqokelela kunye nokulawula ixesha. Ukusebenza njengelungu leqela, ukuqamba iplani ngokwezicwangciso, ukuthethathethana kakuhle, ukwazi ukusebenzela ikhompyutha, amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okukhuthaza, ukulungelelanisa, ukukhokela, ukutshintsha ulwazi.
xh.duties: Qwalasela inkqubo yezicwangciso kunye nemithetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuqatshelwa izinto ezintsha ezikhulayo. Phuhlisiza zigcine izicwangciso iinkqubo. Qwalasela ukugeleza kweemali uze uze ngemiqulu yokuvela ukungeleza iimali iiplani njengoko kufuneka. Qwalasela ukuzinikela ngokoqobo ngokwemithetho yeemali. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abadlali beembumba ngokusetyenziswa kwokuqikelela. Ukuqamba iplani – Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olusetyenziswa ngenjongo zokuqamba iplani luthathwa luluhlalutyalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ulawulo lweemali – Lawula, qwalasela, hlalutya uze uqinisekise ukuchanekileyo inkqubo yokulungiselela ulawulo lweemali. Imirholo – Lungelanisa, qwalasela, hlalutya uze uqinisekise ukuchanekileyo iinkqubo zemiqulo ye-management accounting. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi malunga nemfuno yokuthwala ibali phambili lisasazwa kumakhowudi abanoxanduva kunye nabaphathi beenkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuzama zonke iifom zo kuthwala ibali phambili, iproposal iphuhliswe ithunyelwe kwi-CFO ukuba iqwalaselwe. Qinisekisa ukuba konke okuqinisekisiweyo kuthwala ibali phambili kufakwe kulawulo lolungiselelo lweemali. Hlola imfuno yemali yongezo efuneka kwinkqubo yokulinganisa ngokuhlola iindlela zokusetyenziswa kweemali. Qinisekisa ukuhlola iindlela zokusetyenziswa kweemali nophuhliso lweziposal ngokutshintshalo okanye ukushifta iimali. Ukugcina isithintelo. Ukulawula ukusebenza nophuhliso. Thabatha i-Human Resource nezinye iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo. Seka ukusebenza ukuqamba ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo nangempumelelo izicwangciso zoxhumano lweemibono. Phuhlisa ulawule iplani yokusebenza yesebe kwaye ube ngemiqulu yimiqhubeko njengoko kufuneka. Seka uqambe ugcinise iinkqubo ukuqinisekisa ukulawula okulungileyo komsebenzi. Hlaziya uze uthumele yonke imiqulo efunekayo yolawulo. Ziba kwiqela leemvisiswano njengoko kufuneka. Ukuthenga nolawulo lweempahla. Ukuqamba iplani nokuabelana ngomsebenzi. Ukulawula ukuchanekileyo komsebenzi onikiweyo ngumsebenzi. Ululeko nokuqondisa ngeempawu nangamakhono.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Pnb3: Advanced Midwifery and
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R821 454 per annum, plus, 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Operational Manager for advanced midwifery in Lejweleputswa District, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Registered Nurse in General Nursing. OR - A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse (2026/2027). A minimum of 9 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to the above must be appropriate / recognisable experience in the Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science after obtaining 1-year post-basic qualification in the Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science specialty. Skills and Knowledge: Computer literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Legislation, policies and procedures. Thorough knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, etc. Knowledge of HR policies such as: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure.
jobs.duties: Coordination of optimal, holistic specialized nursing care provided within set standards and a professional/legal framework. Manage effectively the utilization and supervision of resources. Coordination of the provision of effective training and research. Provision of Effective Support to Nursing Services. Effective utilization of resources (Human and Material) participation with training and research. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development. Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how to impact on service delivery. Ensure clinical nursing practices by the nursing team (unit) in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determine by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate and basic understanding HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisor, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work as part of multi-disciplinary team at unit level to ensure good nursing care by the nursing team. Work effectively and amicable, at supervisory level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to manage own work, time and that of junior colleagues to ensure proper nursing services in the unit. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the unit adheres to the principle of Batho Pele. Able to develop contact, build and maintain a network of professional relations in order to enhance service delivery. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Pnb3: Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskunde en
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder vir gevorderde vroedvrouenskunde in Lejweleputswa Distrik, waarvoor 'n verpleegkundediploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n equivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde toelaat. OF - 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026/2027). 'n Minimum van 9 jaar se toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science wees na verkryging van die 1-jarige post-basiese kwalifikasie in die Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science spesialiteit. Vaardighede en Kennis: Rekenvaardigheid. Kennis van openbare dienswetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Deeglike kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegwetgewing en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels, ens. Kennis van HR-beleide soos: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure.
af.duties: Koordineering van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsors wat binne vasgestelde standaarde en 'n professionele/regsraamwerk verskaf word. Bestuur die benutting en toesig van hulpbronne doeltreffend. Koördinering van die voorsiening van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing. Voorsiening van effektiewe ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne (menslik en materieel) en deelname aan opleiding en navorsing. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering inwerk. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyke deur die verpleegspan (eenheid) in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsors soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiele beleide en praktyke. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessionele en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span op eenheidsvlak om goeie verpleegsorg deur die verpleegspan te verseker. Werk doeltreffend en bevreeslik op toesigvlak met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdiensverskille. In staat om eie werk, tyd en dié van junior kollegas te bestuur om behoorlike verpleegdienste in die eenheid te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder, beyder en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat die eenheid die beginsel van Batho Pele navolg. In staat om kontak te ontwikkel, 'n netwerk van professionele verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf ten einde dienslewering te verbeter. Toon basiese rekenvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wemisebenzi Pnb3: Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuthuthukile Kwezokubeletha Nezasesibhedlela Sabantwana
zu.summary: Umlawuli wemisebenzi wezokuhlinzeka ngokuthuthukile kwezokubeletha e-Lejweleputswa District, ofuna idiploma noma idigri yokuhlengwa egcinwe kwa-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Sezikhathi Ezedlule, isiqu esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri yokuhlinzwa) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongugi Ohlinzayo Ojwayelekile. NGEKE - I-degree ye-Bachelor yeminyaka eyi-4 Yokuhlengwa (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongugi Ohlinzayo Ochwepheshe. Isiqu sokuhlinza sasesikhundleni esiphezulu nendlela yonyaka ophindwe kanye naye, esagunyazwe yi-SANC kuso isayensi yokuhlinzeka ngokuthuthukile nezantshontshwaneni. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-South African Nursing Council njengongugi Ohlinzayo Ochwepheshe (2026/2027). Ukuze ube nokuhlanzwa okuncane kweminyaka eyi-9 kokuhlanzwa okuhambelana/okubonakalayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengongugi Ohlinzayo Ochwepheshe ne-SANC kuhlengwa olujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yaleso sikhathi esikhulunywe ngasenhla kumele ibe ngokuhlanzwa okuhambelana/okubonakalayo kwesayensi yokuhlinzeka ngokuthuthukile nezantshontshwaneni ngemuva kokuthola isiqu sokuhlinza sasesikhundleni esiphezulu sonyaka ophindwe kanye nawe kokuhlinzeka ngokuthuthukile nezasesibhedlela sabantshontshwane. Amakhono Nelwazi: Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngeMithetho Yomphakambili, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Ulwazi olujulile ngezinqubo nokunakekelwa kokuhlinza, iziqu zomthetho zokuhlinza, kanye namanye amakhalendi ezomthetho afana: I-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, uMqulu Wamalungelo Abaguli, imigomo ye-Batho-Pele, njll. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo ze-HR efana: i-Skills Development Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, ikhodi kanye nenqubo yokuqhwaba, inqubo yezikhalazo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kokuhlinza okuyisiseko, okubambisene kakhulu okuhlinzekwayo ngaphakathi kwezilinganiso ezimisiwe nesakhiwo somthetho somsebenzi. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuhlola wena okusetshenziswayo. Ukuhlanganisa ukuhlinzwa ngokusebenza kahle kokuhlinzisa nokufunda. Ukuhlinza ngokusekela kahle Izinsiza Zokuhlinza. Ukusetshenziswa ngempumelela kwesabelo (abantu kanye nezinto) ukuthatha inxaxheba ekulolongweni nokufundeni. Ukugcina ukukhula ngomsebenzi/izinga zokuziphatha nokuziphilelela. Ukukhombisa ukuqonda okujulile ngephunga lomthetho kwezokuhlinza kanye nokuhlinzwa ngokomthetho nangokuziphatha okuhlobene kanye nendlela okushintsha ngayo ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzwa kwamakhono yiqembu lokuhlinza (iyunithi) ngokuvumelana nendawo yokwenza umsebenzi kanye nezilinganiso zokuhlinza njengokuqondiswa isikhungo sezempilo esihambisana nawo. Ukukhuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kokuhlinza njengokuqondiswa isikhathi somsebenzi ochwepheshe kanye nezilinganiso njengokuqondiswa isikhungo sezempilo esihambisana naso. Ukukhombisa ukuqonda okuyisiseko kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR kanye nezomnotho kanye nokwenza umsebenzi. Ukukhombisa ukuxhumana ngempumelelo nomguli, umlawuli, abanye ochwepheshe bempiilo kanye nabahlobo abancane, okuhlanganisa ukubhala izibali eziyinkimbinkimbi lapho kudingeka khona. Ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinemikhakha eminingi ezingeni leyunithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kokuhlinza yiqembu. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngendlela ethobekile, ezingeni lokuhlola, nabantu abaningi ngokwezinkalo, amasiko, izinhlanga noma inkolo. Ukuba nakho ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho, isikhathi sakho nasabalalele abancane ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinsiza zokuhlinza ezilungile kuleyonthi. Ukukhombisa ukukhathazeka ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza, ukwesekela nokwenza lula ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okulungile futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyunithi ilandela imigumo ye-Batho Pele. Ukuba nakho ukuthuthukisa ukuhlanganyela, wakhe futhi ugcinhe inethiwekhi yobuhlobo bomsebenzi ngenhloba yokukhulisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukukhombisa ukubhalisele okuyisiseko ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha njengesixazululi sokukhulisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuSebenza Pnb3: uBuchule bokubeleka nokuthengiswa kwabantu abanobugcisa
xh.summary: Umphathi wokuSebenza wobufundi bokubeleka abakhulu kwisiXeko saseLejweleputswa, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga sezempilo eziphathwayo kunye nerejista yeSANC.
xh.requirements: I-Matric/isenzo, isikhalazo esiyimfuno seR425 esisekelo (oko kukuthi idiploma/isidanga kwinzululwazi yokunyanga) okanye isikhalazo esilinganayo esivumela urejista kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oBhalisiweyo kwiZempi loNxaxheko. OKanye - Isidanga seNyanga se-4 seseBachelors kwinzululwazi yokunyanga (R174) esivumela urejista kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oPhambili. Isikhalazo sokunyanga sokwenziwa emva kwesiseko esithi ubude bawo buyimizuzwana engu-1 ubudala, esamkelwe yiSANC kwinzululwazi yokubeleka nokunyanga abantwana abasashiywa kusapho. Ugqibo lwerejista kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomongikazi oPhambili (2026/2027). Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-9 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo kwinzululwazi yokunyanga emva kogqibo lomongikazi oPhambili kwiSANC kwiZempi loNxaxheko. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 kwangethamsathqa legqitywe ngasentla kufuneka ibe yimava efanelekileyo / evakalayo kwinzululwazi yokubeleka nokunyanga abantwana abasashiywa kusapho emva kokufumana isikhalazo esiyimfuno sobude beminyaka engu-1 kwizifundo ezikhethekileyo zokubeleka nokunyanga abantwana abasashiywa kusapho. Amandla nolwazi: Ulwazi lokusebenzela iikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, iinkqubo nezicwangciso. Ulwazi olusuka kwiinkqubo zokunyanga nemicimbi yolwazi, izikhalazo zokunyanga, nolunye ulwazi oluxhomekekeko olunjengokuba: uMthetho weMongikazi, uMthetho weZeMpilo, uMthetho weMpilo nakhoKusinga kwabasebenzi, isiKhalazo samalungelo abagulayo, iimvisiswano zeBatho-Pele, njl. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zamaphathi eHr ezinjengokuba: uMthetho weNtshukumo yeNthuthuko, iimVisiswano zeNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho weNxulumano ngoBasebenzi, iKhowudi nemiSebenzi yoNxibelelwano, nokuQala ixatsho.
xh.duties: Ukuqhubekeka kolunye usuku oluqulunqwe lulwazi olukhulu nendlela yokunyanga ekubekiweyo kwizithethe nakuwo onke amagunya omtsetho. Lawula ngokufaneleyo ukusebenzisa nokulawula amacebo. Ukuqhubekeka kolunye usuku olunika isiphelo esifanelekileyo kolunye usuku nolunye ucandelo lwesayensi. Inkonzo eNika ulawulo oluZinzileyo lokuQinisekisa uluntu oluqhubekayo kwinzuzo yonke imisebenzi yokunyanga. Ukusebenzisa ngokufaneleyo amacebo (amathambo nolunye usuku) ukuzibandakanya nokuzonwabisa nolunye ucandelo. Ukulondoloza ukhula/izithethe ezizinzileyo nendlela yokuziphilisa. Ukubonisa ulwazi olukhulu ngomthetho wezempilo nolunye usuku oluhambelana nolunye ucandelo wezempilo kwaye ngalo ulwazi luthengisa ngokuthi uluntu luye lwaphumezelelwa njani. Qinisekisa uluntu lwezempilo nolunye ucandelo (njengoba kuchaziwe) ukulawula uluntu olubhalwe ngaphantsi. Khuthaza uluntu olusekwe kwiNkqubo yokunyanga kwiNkqubo esemthethweni yamagunya anikezela ngalo owayo awukhupha ekuhlaleni. Yazi kakhulu uluntu oluvela kwiinkalo ezahlukeneyo. Bonisa kwaye ubuncinane bobulumko bokusebenzela abagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokwakha isixuku kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nolunye ucandelo wolwazi. Sebenza njengesahlulelo kuluntu oluqhuba iinkalo ezahlukeneyo kwiziko lenkonzo. Lawula uluntu olusekwe kwiNkqubo yokunyanga kwiSaziso sezeMethsetho yoluntu nokuba lolunye usuku lunamathisele ngokuthi, nalapha kusenokubakho amaxwebhu apha. Lawula kakhulu isimemo soBulungisa iNkqubo yeMihla ngemihla kunye namagunya abo bakhululekileyo ukugqitha kolunye usuku kwaye ngokuthi luluntu luye lwakha njani.

Monitor and ensure proper utilization of financial and physical resources.

Diploma/Grade in Verpleegkunde) of 4 jaar Baccalaureus in Verpleegkunde (R174) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026/2027) Professionele Verpleegkunde. zu.title: Umphathi Ohlanganyele Wezokunyonga
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohlanganyele wezokunyonga esibhedlela i-Katleho District Hospital e-Free State, sifuna ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nokuba namava eminyaka yoku-8 yokunyonga.
zu.requirements: I-Matric, i-basic R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree kwezokunyonga) noma i-Bachelor of Nursing yeminyaka eyi-4 (R174) noma izifundo ezingabalulekile ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council njengoguli lolwazi olubanzi wezokunyonga jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026/2027) kokunyonga kwabongoti. Ukuba nobuncwane bemva eminyakeni eyi-8 ebalulekile/abonakalayo ekunyongeni ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoguli lolwazi olubanzi wezokunyonga ku-SANC ekunyongeni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yimva ebalulekile/ebonakalayo ezingeni lolawulo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngamathuba nezinqubo zokunakekelwa kokunyonga, izimizi yezokunyonga kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezibalulekile.
zu.duties: Yabelana, qaphela futhi uhlanganise ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa kwabaguli okusebenzayo nokunembile ngokunakekelwa kokunyonga okwanele. Qala futhi uthathe inhlangothi ekukhungenisweni kwempilo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuxhumana okuhambisana kolwazi olubalulekile, olunembile nolugcwele mayelana nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Yakha/sonke futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obuhle emsebenzini nabongoti bayo nakwezinye izandla ezibandakanyekayo (okungukuthi, ukusebenza komthamphlika phakathi kwabongoti, phakathi kwezinsiza futhi ohlelweni oluningi). Thatha inhlangothi ekuhlaziyweni, ukwakheni nokuphotheni iziqondiso zokunyonga, amasu, izinga nezinqubo. Lawula abantu. Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okulungele kwezimali nezinsiza eziyingqayizivele.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMphathiswa weMongikelo
xh.summary: Isithuba soMncedisi woMphathiswa weMongikelo esibhedlele i-Katleho District Hospital e-Free State, esifuna ukubhalisa kwi-SANC kunye neminyaka yamava emi-8 elongikelo.
xh.requirements: I-Matric, i-basic R425 (oko kukuthi i-Diploma/Degree kuNursing) okanye i-Bachelor of Nursing yeminyaka e-4 (R174) okanye nesi satifikedi esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoGqitha weMongikelo ngokubanzi. Ukubhalisa okusemhlanganisweni kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026/2027) njengoMongikeli ochunyiweyo. Iminyaka engu-8 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo elongikelo emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikeli ochunyiweyo kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka engu-3 kule minyaka elandelayo kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo kwinqanaba loLawulo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalazocwadi. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namagatya enkonzo yelongikelo, namagatya elongikelo nakwezinye iinkqubo ezinxulumene nayo.
xh.duties: Ukwabelana, ukulawula nokuhlanganisa ukunikwa kwenkonzo yamafa afanelekileyo nasebenzayo yegula ngokwanelisa inkonzo yelongikelo. Ukwenza futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekwandiseni impilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudluliselwa kolwazi oluhambelana nalolu oluchanekileyo nolubanzi malunga nenkonzo yempilo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni uhlalutyo, ekuyileni nasekuphothweni iinkqubo, amagatya neenkqubo zelongikelo. Ukulawula amabasebenzi abantu. Okokubeka ukuba kusetyenziswe ngendlela efanelekileyo amabhodi emali nezixhobo eziphathekayo.

Kennis en vaardighede: Vereiste kennis, vaardigheidsopleiding en bevoegdhede: deeglike kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegwette, en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke, soos: - Nursing Act, Health Act, Patient Right Charter, Batho Pele-beginsels, Public Service Regulations, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedures in die Openbare Diens. Vermoë om met diverse belanghebbendes en gesondheidsorggebruikers en -verskaffers te kommunikeer. Goed kommunikasie-, verslagskrywing-, fasilitering-, koördinerings-, skakel-, inligting-, beplannings- en rekenaarvaardighede.
af.duties: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering inwerk. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan (eenheid) in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder kwaliteit van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessioneles en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span op eenheidsvlak om goeie verpleegsorg deur die verpleegspan te verseker. Werk effektief en vriendelik, op toesigvlak, met persone van diverse intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en tyd en dié van junior kollegas te bestuur om behoorlike verpleegdiens in die eenheid te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder, beywer en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat daar voldoen word aan die beginsels van Batho Pele. In staat om kontakte te ontwikkel, 'n netwerk van professionele verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf ten einde dienslewering te verbeter. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Pna5
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobunesi somphathi wemisebenzi esibhedlela i-Bongani Regional Hospital ese-Free State, esifuna iziqu zobunesi kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okungaphezulu kweminyaka eyisikhombisa.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, iziqu ze-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu zobunesi) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonesi obhalisiwe ezokwelapha ngokuvamile. NGENKANI - I-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 ekuNeseni (R174) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNesi Esisebenzi Ngobuchwepheshe. Okuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka eyi-7 okufanelekile/okuqashelwa ekuniseni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengesiNesi Esisebenzi Ngobuchwepheshe kwi-SANC ezokwelapha ngokuvamile. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwi-SANC (2026/2027). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi, ukuqeqeshwa amakhono namandla adingekayo: ukuqonda kabanzi ngemikhuba namagugu okunakekelwa kwabanesi, izimizi zobunesi, namanye okunemithetho ehlobene, njengoku: - i-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Patient Right Charter, izimiso ze-Batho Pele, i-Public Service Regulations, iKhowudi Yezenso Ezilungiswayo Namaphethini kuPhiko Lomsebenzi Wohulumeni. Ikono lokuxhumana nabahlalo bezindawo ezahlukene nabasebenzisi nabaniki bobunesi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, ukubhala imibiko, ukweluleka, ukuhlanganisa, ukuxhumana, Ulwazi, ukuhlela ukuqamba kanye namakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Khombisa ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho wobunesi kanye namaphethini ezomthetho nezobunene bokunakekela kanye nendlela lokhu okuthinta ngayo ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kobunesi ngokwesibhedlela iqembu labanesi (iyunithi) ngokuvumelana nobumo bokusebenza namazinga okunaka njengokuqunywe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kobunesi njengokuqondiswa yisibalo sabuchwepheshe sokusebenza namazinga njengokuqunywe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR nezomali bese ukhombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabagulayo, abaphathi, nabanye ochwepheshe bezempilo nabalingisi, kuhlanganze nokubhala imibiko eyinkimbinkimbi uma kudingeka. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu labezinhlanga ezahlukene ezinga lenyunithi ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuhle okukhuphuka iqembu labanesi. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo ngokuzwana, ezingeni lokulawula, nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, ngesiko, ngesibala noma ngenkolo. Ukube nokupatha umsebenzi wakho, isikhathi nesabalingisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe isevisi elihle lobunesi eziyunithi. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza, ukwesekela nokwenza kube lula ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa kwezimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ukube nokwazi ukwakha izintambo, ukwakha kanye nokugcina inethiwekhi yobudlelwano obusemthethweni ukuze kuquthwe ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Khombisa ukwazi okuyisisekelo ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha njengesekeli ukuze kuquthwe ukulethwa kwenkonzo.

xh.title: Umphathi Wesebe Lophetha IimFundo Pna5
xh.summary: Isithuba sokusingathwa kogqitho njengomphathi wesebe ngasese esibhedlele iBongani Regional Hospital eFree State, sifuna isiqu sokugqitha ngakunye noluhlu lweminyaka eyisixhenxe ngaphezulu yokukho isiphiwo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, isiqu se-Basic R425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/iziqu kogqitho) okanye isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqithiweyo Othweswe Isiqu kogqitho jikelele. OKanye - Izigqibo ze-4 zenyanga kugqitho (R174) ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqithiweyo Othweswe Isiqu. Iqondo elinganayo leminyaka eyi-7 yamava ahambelanayo/avakalwayo kugqitho emva kokubhalisa njengoGqithiweyo Othweswe Isigu ku-SANC kugqitho jikelele. Ukbhaliswa okwangoku ku-SANC (2026/2027). Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi, ikhono lokuqeqesha nokuzelelwa okulingelayo: ulwazi olujulile ngeenkqubo zokusingathwa kokunyanga nemigaqo, izigaba zogqitho, nolunye ulwilo oluhambelanayo lolugqo, njengoku: - iNursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Patient Right Charter, iinkqubo zeBatho Pele, i-Public Service Regulations, iKhowudi yokuLawula kunye neenKqubo kuLawulo zoLuntu. Ikakhono lokusebenzisana nabahlalu-lwazi abahlukeneyo, kwaye nokubasebenzisi nabakhonzi bezempilo. Iikakhono ezilungileyo lokunxibelelana, kokubhala iingxelo, lokukhuthaza, lokuhlanganisa, lokunxibelelana, loLwazi, lokuCwangcisa nokuhlela kwaye nokusebenzisa iikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukubonisa ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho wogqitho, omnye nemithetho ehambelanayo nethe nkqo yamagqitho kwaye ukubonisa indlela okuchithwa ngayo iinkonzo. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iqela logqitho liba nghenelo lwenkqubo yogqitho evela kwicala elithile ngokwexesha elifanelekileyo namagqitho aqheliswayo kwicandelo ngokwezigqibo ezinjengoko zqalwe ngummandla weempilo ezikwisibhedlele. Ukukhuthaza ukwizingca kweemfundo zokusingathwa kokunyanga ngokwamagqitho egqithiweyo ukuba athathwe ngoko nangoko ngokwexesha elifanelekileyo nezigqibo ezinje ngoko ziqulunywe kwisibhedlele. Ukubonisa ukuqonda okuyimvelaphi kwezicwangciso ngabasebenzi ngakunye nezemali, ukuzinza okusuka kwiziko elidibana nathi, ootitshala, abanye bagqithiweyo ngokwamagqitho, ooyise nokubhala iingxelo ezibi nzima xa kufuneka. Ukusebenza njengesinye isigqeba seqela elihlanganene ukuba kunjalo nokuba yindawo ehanjiswa ngokomgaqo wezibhedlele kubakho ukuvakalwa kokunyangwa ngokutsha. Ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuhambisana ngokomthetho nokwakha nokugcina amakhosi obudlelwane nabantu abanamava ahlukeneyo ezingqongqozo, ezamasiko, kwizizukulwana okanye ezikoluko. Ukuba nakho ukulawula umsebenzi wakhe, isikhathi kunye nesabelo sabo bagqithiweyo ukuyisebenzisa ukuba lisebe lincedisise ukunyanga abantu. Ukubonisa inkathalo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza, ukukhusela nokukhokelela ekunyathedeni ukuba kulungile nokutsha nokuhamba koluntu kolawulo lwentlalo ngakunye nokwamagqitho. Ukuba nakho ukwakha amakhosi obudlelwane kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo, ukuyakha nokuzigcina kubudlelwane nobugqithi benkonzo ukwandisa ukusebenza kweenkonzo. Ukubonisa ulwazi olusetyenziswa kumanqanaba eempilo ukwandisa inkonzo engakapheli nje iindlela ezifunekayo zokukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Coordinator Pna5 Clinical Education
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R571 161 – R654 285 per annum Grade 2: R661 572 – R752 9130 per annum plus, 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Clinical programme coordinator at Bongani Regional Hospital in the Free State, coordinating clinical education and training of student nurses and staff.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Registered Nurse in General Nursing. OR - A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A maximum of 7 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse in general nursing. An accredited post basic qualification (at least 1 year) in Nursing Education. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026/2027). Knowledge and Skills: Computer literacy and statistics. Knowledge of the relevant Health Legislation and policies, ability to collect and analyse data, leadership in planning, organising, coordination, and communication skills, ability to take charge and make appropriate independent decisions. Research skills to advise hospital management, responsiveness, pro-activeness and professionalism, accuracy, flexibility, initiative, co- operation, team-player, supportive and assertive.
jobs.duties: Coordinates the clinical orientation, teaching, learning, assessment, mentoring, and support of student nurses and staff development. Clinical teaching and learning: coordinate work-integrated learning (WIL), day-to-day bedside accompaniment, clinical supervision, and simulation preparation for student nurses. Student and staff orientation: manage onboarding, orientation, and induction programs for newly placed student nurses, graduate nurses, and clinical staff. Skills audits and gap analysis: identify learning and competency gaps among nursing staff and students, and design relevant in-service training plans. Preceptorship and mentorship: support and coordinate clinical preceptors and mentors across hospital wards to ensure proper student-to-staff guidance ratios. Assessments and competency evaluation: conduct continuous clinical competence assessments, review professional practice files, and track student learning contracts. Compliance and quality assurance: ensure adherence to SANC (South African Nursing Council) standards, accreditation requirements, and Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC) protocols. Reporting and administration: compile monthly, quarterly, and annual operational reports on CETU activities, training records, and student progress for hospital and nursing college management.

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder Pna5 Kliniese Onderwys
af.summary: Kliniese programkoördineerder by Bongani Streeks hospitaal in die Free State, wat kliniese onderwys en opleiding van studenteverpleegkundiges en personeel koördineer.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate, basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde toelaat. OF - 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Maksimum van 7 jaar toepaslike of herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in algemene verpleegkunde. 'n Geakkrediteerde postbasiese kwalifikasie (ten minste 1 jaar) in Verpleegkundeonderwys. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (2026/2027). Kennis en Vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid en statistiek. Kennis van die tersaaklike Gesondheidswetgewing en beleide, vermoë om data te versamel en te ontleed, leierskap in beplanning, organisering, koördinering en kommunikasievaardighede, vermoë om beheer te neem en toepaslike onafhanklike besluite te neem. Navorsingsvaardighede om hospitaalbestuur te adviseer, reaksievermoë, proaktiwiteit en professionaliteit, akkuraatheid, buigsaamheid, inisiatief, samewerking, spanspeler, ondersteunend en assertief.
af.duties: Koördineer die kliniese oriëntasie, onderrig, leer, assessering, mentorskap en ondersteuning van studenteverpleegkundiges en personeelsonwikkeling. Kliniese onderrig en leer: koördineer werk-geïntegreerde leer (WIL), dag-tot-dag bedsye begeleiding, kliniese toesig en simulasievoorbereiding vir studenteverpleegkundiges. Studente- en personeeloriëntasie: bestuur onboarding-, oriëntasie- en inlywingsprogramme vir nuutgeplaasde studenteverpleegkundiges, gegradueerde verpleegkundiges en kliniese personeel. Vaardigheidsoudits en gaping-ontleding: identifiseer leer- en bevoegdheidgapings onder verpleegkundige personeel en studente, en ontwerp tersaaklike in-diens opleidingsplanne. Preceptorskap en mentorskap: ondersteun en koördineer kliniese preseptors en mentors oor hospitaalsale om behoorlike student-tot-personeel begeleidingsverhoudings te verseker. Assessering en bevoegdheidevaluering: voer deurlopende kliniese bevoegdheidassesserings uit, hersien professionele praktyklêers en hou studenteleerkontrakte dop. Nakoming en gehalteversekering: verseker nakoming van SANC (South African Nursing Council) standaarde, akkreditasievereistes en Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC) protokolle. Verslagdoening en administrasie: stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse operasionele verslae oor CETU-aktiwiteite, opleidingsrekords en studentevordering vir hospitaal- en verpleegkollegebestuur op.

zu.title: Umlinganisi Wohlelo Lwezokwelapha Pna5 Imfundo Yezokwelapha
zu.summary: Umlinganisi wohlelo lwezokwelapha eBongani Regional Hospital e-Free State, ohlanganisa imfundo nokugadluliswa kwabafundi bobhudoki nabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate, iziqu ezisesikhathini esingokwamanje ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekuqashweni kobhudoki) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongqoshi obhalisiwe ekuqashweni kobhudoki ngokujwayelekile. Noma - Idigri yeminyaka eyi-4 ekuqashweni kobhudoki (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongqoshi osethesheni eliphezulu. Isiphiwo seminyaka engu-7 esifanele noma esihlonishwe ekuqashweni kobhudoki ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongqoshi osethesheni eliphezulu ekuqashweni kobhudoki ngokujwayelekile. Isiqu esivunyiwe esingemuva kwesisekelo (okungenani unyaka oyedwa) emfundweni yobhudoki. Ukubhalisa okwamanje kwi-South African Nursing Council (2026/2027). Ulwazi nokuzidedela: Ukusebenzisa ikhompuytha nokubala izibalo. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nemigomo yezempilo ehlobene, ikhono lokuthola nokuhlaziya idatha, ubuholi ekubekweni ihlelo, ekuqoqweni, ekuhlanganiseni, nakunokuxhumana, ikhono lokuthatha ilungelo nokwenza izinqumo ezifanele ezingayilaleli muntu. Amakhono ocwaningo wokuphakamisa kalaborhu ophatha isibhedlela, ukuzwelana, ukusebenza ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwezinto, nokuzethoba, ukunembeza, ukuguquguquka, inkanuko, ukusebenzisana, ukudlala njengelungu leqembu, ukusekela, nokuzimisela.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukugadiniswa ngokwelapha, ukufundisa, ukufunda, ukuhlola, ukweseka, kanye nokuqasela abafundi bobhudoki kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Ukufundisa nokufunda ngokwelapha: hlanganisa ukufunda okuhlotshaniswe nomsebenzi (WIL), ukuqashelwa nsuku zonke ecaleni komumunjelwa, ukuphenya ngokwelapha, kanye nokulungiselela imodeli yokulingisa abafundi bobhudoki. Ukuqalisa kwabafundi nabasebenzi: phatha ukungeniswa, ukuqondiswa, kanye nezinhlelo zokweseka abafundi bobhudoki ababekwe kusha, obhudoki abaqede iziqu, kanye nabasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuhlola amakhono kanye nenhlolanyelo yezikhala: thola izikhala zokufunda nakokuzihlola phakathi kwabasebenzi nabafundi bobhudoki, bese udweba izinhlelo zokugadluliswa ezingaphakathi. Ukuba ngumeluleki nongweseki: sekela futhi uhlanganise abameluleki nabagadini bezokwelapha emagumbi esibhedlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi nabasebenzi bahola ngokulingana. Ukuhlola kanye nenhlolanyelo yokuzihlola:enza ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kokuzihlola ngokwelapha, cabangela amafayela okusebenza ngobungcweti, bese ulandela izivumelano zokufunda zabafundi. Ukuziphendisa kanye nokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi: qinisekisa ukuthobela amasu e-SANC (South African Nursing Council), izidingo zokuvunyelwa, kanye nemithethoisiko ye-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Iyiphothaphilishi yolwazi nokubika: hlanganisa imibiko yeminye yonke ihlelo ngenyanga, nangexesha, nangonyaka yokusebenza kwamasevisi we-CETU, okokugadluliswa, kanye nokuqhubela phambili kwabafundi okubalwa kalaborhu kanye nalabaphathi ekuqashweni kobhudoki.

xh.title: Umqambi Wenkqubo Yezempilo Esebenzayo Pna5 Uluntu Lwezempilo
xh.summary: Umqambi wenkqubo yezempilo esebenzayo kwiBongani Regional Hospital eFree State, elungisa uluntu lwezempilo nololuleko lwabafundi abafundi abangamaNesi nabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate, isigqizo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt. idiploma/idegre kwizempilo) okanye isigqizo esilinganayo esikuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi obhalisiweyo kwiNurses eZijoliswe kwezoMpilo. OKT - i-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka engama-4 kwizempilo (R174) ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi oYilo. Isiphiwo esingaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-7 somava ofanelekileyo okanye oqatshelwayo kwizempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi oYilo kwizempilo eQhelekileyo. Isigqizo esibhalisiweyo semfundo engaphezulu (ubuncinane unyaka we-1) kwimfundo yeBesi. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-South African Nursing Council (2026/2027). Ulwazi nekhono: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngeestatistiki. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yezempilo echanekileyo namagqeba, ikhonoiokuqokelela nokuhlalutya iinkcukacha, inkoka ekuqweneni, ekuqwalaseleni, ukulungisa, nakhono lokunxibelelana, ikhono lokuthatha ilungelo lenkxaxheba laba yokwenza izigqibo ezizimeleyo nangezidiko. Iikhono zophando ekucebisini abaphathi besibhedlele, ukusabela, ukuzimisela ngaphambili nobugcisa, ukuchaneka, ukuguquguquka, ukuzimisela, ukusebenzisana, ukusebenza njengelungu leqela, ukuxhasa nokuzimisela.
xh.duties: Ulungelelwa koluntu lwezempilo, ukufundisa, ukufunda, ukuqwalasela, ukuyala nokuxhasa abafundi ababangamaNesi nolululeko lwabasebenzi. Ukufundisa nokufunda ngempilo: ukulungelelanisa ukufunda okuhoyene nomsebenzi (WIL), ukusikhathalelela ecaleni kwesigul kwangemini, ukulawula ulwazi lwezempilo, nolungelelwaniso lwezopolisto zabafundi ababangamaNesi. Uluntu nokuqheliswa kwabafundi nabasebenzi: ukulawula ukungena, ukuqheliswa, nokuqaliswa kweenkqubo zabafundi ababangamaNesi ababekwe kwindawo entsha, abaNesi abagqithisileyo, nabasebenzi bezempilo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwamakhono nophando lwezikhewu: ukuqamba iindawo zokufunda nakhona kubasebenzi ababangamaNesi ngeendlela ezifanelekileyo zolululeko lwangaphakathi. Ukuyala nokuyala: ukuxhasa nokuqwalasela abaYali nabayali bezempilo kuzo zonke iindawo zokulaliswa kwesibhedlele ukuqinisekisa iiganeko ezifanelekileyo zokuyalisa abafundi kwabasebenzi. Ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela ukuchaneka: ukuqhubeza ukuqwalaselwa ngokuqhubeka kwezempilo, ukuqwalasela iifayile zoqeqesho lomsebenzi, nokuqhubeza iinkonzo zokufunda zabafundi. Ukuzelelana nomthetho nokuqinisekisa umgangatho: ukuqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwemigangatho ye-SANC (South African Nursing Council), iimfuno zokubhalisa, namagqeba e-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Ukuvela nolawulo: ukuqamba iingxelo zokuqhuba ngeenyanga, nxaxheba kunyaka ngeenkqubo ze-CETU, iirekhodi zolululeko, nangokuqhubela kwabafundi kubaphathi besibhedlele nekolishi labaNesi.

Ubuholi ekwelulekeni, ekuhleleni, ekuqondisweni, kanye namakhono okuxhumana. Ikono lokuthatha isibopho kanye nokwenza izinqumbo ezizimele ezifanele. Amakhono ekuphenyi ukuze usicele imibandela yesibhedlela. Ikono elikhulu lokwakha kanye nokusebenza njengelungu lenhlangano. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana kanye nokusebenzisana phakathi kwemikhakha. Amakhono aphansi wobuholi kanye nobunkethi bokuphatha. Ikono lokuhlaziya idatha kanye nokuhlolwa kokuqinisekisa.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso esisebenzayo senqubo ye-HIV, AIDS, STI's ne-TB (HAST) esibhedlela. Nikeza inkxaso yamathuluzi kanye namathuluzi welasho emisebenzini yezempilo nakubantu abahlobene. Ukuqashelwa kwayo yonke iminqubo ye-HAST esibhedlela kanye nokuqapha kwayo. Khuthaza izinga lokunakekelwa kokunakekela njengokuqondiswa isikhathi sokusebenza ngobungcweti namazinga njengokuqondiswa isikhungo sezempilo esihambisana. Khombe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabaguli, abaphathi nabanye ochwepheshe bokwelapha, okuhlanganisa nokubhala umbhalo lapho kudingwa khona. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene emikhakheni ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kahle. Sebenza ngokusebenza kahle, ngokuhambisana nabantu abahlukene ngobukhosi, ngamasiko, ngohlanga noma ngenkolo. Ukukwazi ukucabanga futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho nalowo wabantu abakusekelayo ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okufanele. Khombisa inkathi ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokukhuluma ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokuthanda ukuphendula izidingo zabaguli, izidingo nokulindeleka (Batho Pele). xh.summary: Umthunywa weProfeshonali oqheliswa kwiNkcubela ePhuhliqekileyo eBongani Regional Hospital eFree State, efuno ngokubhalisa kwi-SANC nediploma okanye idigri yokhathalelo lwezifo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, isigaba se-Basic R425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/idigri yokhathalelo lwezifo) okanye isigaba esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqithazwe kuKhathalelo lwezifo jikelele. OKYE - iDigri yeBachelor yeminyaka emi-4 (R174) ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwiiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMthunywa weProfeshonali. Uqikelelo lweminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kokhathalelo lwezifo emva kokubhalisa njengoMthunywa weProfeshonali kwiSANC kuKhathalelo lwezifo jikelele. Ukubhalisa okwamanje kwiiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026/2027). Isigaba sokhathalelo lwezifo esingemuva kwesiseko, sithatha inyanga unyakeni ubuncinane esamkelwe kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) kwenye yale ndawo zilandelayo ezijoliswe kuzo: iNkcubela ePhuhliqekileyo kunye neNkonzo yokhathalelo lwezifo zeSana, iNkonzo yokhathalelo lwezifo zeSana ezingoNtshatshana, iNkonzo yokhathalelo lwezifo eziBangelwa yiNkamva eQinileyo, uKhathalelo lwezifo kwiThumbatho lokwenza iQhagamshelwano, iNkonzo yokhathalelo lwezifo eziBangelwa iNzondo kunye neNgxwangu ePhezulu, iSayensi yokhathalelo lwezifo eziNtsundu. af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge-posisie in die Free State Department of Health, wat 'n graad in Arbeidsreg en drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate plus, erkende Degree (NQF 7) in Labour Law/ Labour Relations of ekwivalente kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die uitvoer van wangedrag-ondersoeke; hantering van griewe en Konsolidasie en Arbitrasie op toesigvlak. zu.title: Umuntu Ofanayo: Izinhlobonhlobo Zomsebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somuntu ofanayo: Izinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi kuMnyango WezempiLo ku Free State, ofuna iziqu ezimali nobulili kanye neminyaka emi(3) yeFA ehambisana naye.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Esiphezulu kanye nendodakazi esemthethweni (NQF 7) kumthetho wamabhalanse/ Izinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi noma iziqu ezingulingana njengoba zinhlonzekwa yiSAQA. Ukuze kuseduze, kufuneki abe neminyaka emi(3) yokwenza imibuzo ephathene nokuqeda okungalungile, yokubamba izikhalazo kanye nokubumba imibuzo emkhakheni ophethe. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: ukuqonda umthetho wezinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi, imikhuba yemisebenzi ephathene nezinhlobonhlobo, izimo ezijwayelekile zomsebenzi kuMnyango Wezomphakathi. Ukuthi ukwazi uMnyango Wezomphakathi, imikhuba yeCCMA, PSCBC, GPSSBC kanye nekuqonda izinqumo kanye Nesivumelwano Esihlangenwayo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukukhuluma kahle, ukukwazi ukuyisa iqhaza, ukukwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukukwazi ukukhiqiza izinombolo, ukukwazi ukuqonda izinto ezibalulekile, ukukwazi ukufundisa, ukukwazi ukubonisa okuthile, ukukwazi ukuxoxa, ukukwazi ukuhlela, kanye nokukwazi ukuxhumaneka
zu.duties: Siza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezimali nobulili. Hlela/ yenza imibuzo ephathene nokuqediswa kwemisebenzi engalungile nezesikhalazo ukuze ukwazi ukweluleka ngendlela efanele. Yeluleka abaphathi ngazo zonke izinto eziphathene nezinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi ukuze kuncishwe izenzo ezingalungile zomsebenzi. Mela uMnyango emixoxweni esebenisana neqhaza labasebenzi abahleliwe. Yenza uphathe imisebenzi ephathene nokulawula kwemisebenzi efanayo. Lawula izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza izinhloso zalezo zingxenye.

xh.summary: Isithuba somSomlimi ongenamfanelo: Iindaba zobudlelwane bentlabour kwisebe lezeMPilo laseningizimu yomzantsi, elifuna idyagrwe kweli ndlela yokuqala elithi (NQF 7) kwaye alinesithuba esingamashumi amathandathu (3) entsimbi kwaye afuna isikhundla sobunkokheli obunesithuba esiqinisekileyo kwaye asebenze ngokunesikhundla esithile.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSayansi phantse neDyagrwe (NQF 7) kwintsimi yezomthetho wezabasebenzi/ Iindaba zobudlelwane ngokusemthethweni okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo njengoko singaziwa ngumgaqo-siseko we-SACE. Ixesha elingengaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-3 (eyomthathu) yamava kwimibuzo yamafa ethile; imiba yezigqibo nokubulunga nokugqiba izinto ngokusemthethweni kwelinye inqanaba. Ulwazi namakhono: uMthetho wezabasebenzi basebenza ngokomthetho, iinkqubo zomthetho wezabasebenzi, iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokubanzi kummandla kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokusebenza, iinkqubo ze-CCMA, i-PSCBC, i-GPSSBC nokutolika iNgqikitho yoMthetho noQeqesho loluntu. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ngokwemeko yezixhobo zentsapho, ulwazi lokuziphatha okuhle, ulwazi lokuqeqesha, ukusombulula izwi elibi phakathi kwabantu, amakhono okuhlaziya ulwazi, amakhono okutolika, amakhono oqeqesho, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono ezingxoxo, amakhono okulungiselela kwaye enokusondelelana kakuhle nabanye.
xh.duties: Nceda ngokuhlaziya iNgqikitho yoMthetho wezabasebenzi basebenza. Qhoboshela/ yenz imibuzo engamanzi ngokwenza okungalunganga nangemiba yamabala afuna ukuba uyicebise kakuhle. Yicebise intsapho yabo ngemiba yamabala abakho aphantsi komthetho ukuba angabi nentsimbi engalunganga. Mela isebe ngexoxo luqobo neenyani ngamalungu oluntu. Yenza kwaye ulawule izinto ezininzi ngokwemeko yexesha nangokwemeko yentsapho. Lawula izixhobo ukuvumele ukuba imigqibo yexesha ngalinye iphumelele ngokupela.

af.title: Fisioterapeut Graad 1-3
af.summary: Fisioterapeut-posisies by Graad 1 tot 3 is beskikbaar by Bongani Regional Hospital in die Free State, wat assesering en behandeling van pasiënte behels.
af.requirements: Graad 12 en BCS in Fisioterapie of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Fisioterapeut moontlik maak. Grade 1: Vereis geen ervaring na registrasie met HPCSA nie. Grade 2: Vereis tien (10) jaar minimum ervaring met HPCSA in 'n relevante professie. Grade 3: Vereis twintig (20) jaar minimum ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA (2026/2027). Kennis en Vaardighede: Soliede interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Assesering en behandeling van in-pasiënte, buite-pasiënte en eksterne belanghebbendes in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk. Kliniese toesig oor fisioterapiestudente verrig. Deelneem aan programme van professionele departemente. zu.requirements: Isikhundla 12 neBCS kwezokwelapha ngokuzivocavoca komzimba noma izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengowesokwelapha ngokuzivocavoca komzimba. Isikhundla 1: Akudingi kunakwa olunye luzamu olwenziwe ngemuva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA. Isikhundla 2: Kudinga iminyaka eyishumi (10) ephansi yamava ngemuva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA esifundazweni esihlobene. Isikhundla 3: Kudinga iminyaka engamashumu amabili (20) ephansi yamava ngemuva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA (2026/2027). Ulwazi nakhono: Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuxhumana. Ikono lokusebenza endaweni yabasebenzi abaningi abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana nokwakha ubudlelwano nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola nokuphatha abaguli abalalwe esibhedlela nalabo abangenalwa esibhedlela kanye nalabo abahlobene nabo ngaphandle kokulandela isibalo samandla okwenza umsebenzi. Usiza emisebenzini yolawulo yomnyango, ekuqinisekisweni kwkhwalithi nakuhlelokusebenza okusekelwe ezintweni eziyisibonelo. Unikeza ngokusiza ekukhuliseni nasekuthuthukiseni umnyango wezokwelapha ngokuzivocavoca komzimba. Wenza ulawulo lwezokwelapha kwabafundi bezokwelapha ngokuzivocavoca komzimba. Umuntu okhethiwe kufanele aziame ukushintshashintsha futhi abe nexaxheba ezindaweni ezahlukene ezihlobene nezokwelapha ngokuzivocavoca komzimba futhi azenze imisebenzi yehora elengeziwe ekupheleni kwamasonto.

xh.title: Umagcini wezilungelelwaniso zomzimba Inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Amasithuba abagcini bezilungelelwaniso zomzimba kwiNqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-3 afumaneka eBongani Regional Hospital eFree State, aquka ukuhlolwa kwaye kusetyenziswa kwiiguli.
xh.requirements: Isigidimi soku-12 kunye ne-BCS kwiPhysiotherapy okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomagcini wezilungelelwaniso zomzimba. Inqanaba 1: Akufuneki kube namava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA. Inqababa 2: Kufuneka kube namava angaphezulu kweminyaka elishumi (10) njengexesha elincinci elifunekayo nge-HPCSA kwiziko elichanekileyo. Inqanaba 3: Kufuneka kube namava angaphezulu kweminyaka amashumi amabini (20) njengexesha elincinci elifunekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (2026/2027). Ulwazi nekhono: Ikhono elichanekileyo leliselelonwabo nokucommunicada. Ikhono lokusebenza kwendalo ebandakanya izahlulelo ezahlukeneyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngocinezelo. Ikhono elichanekileyo lokucommunicada nokuqhagamshelana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngocinezelo. Ukuba nabom bakwi-computer kuya kuba yinceda.
xh.duties: Ukuhlolwa kwaye kusetyenziswe kwiiguli ezingangenayo ezibhedlele, ezingaphandle, nakubantu abahlobene nesebe ngaphandle ngokulandela ummandla wokuqhelanayo wolwazi. Uncedo kwimsebenzi wolawulo wesebe, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho, kunye namacebo asekelwe kubungqina. Inegalelo elizele kumphumo wokuphuhlisa nokukhulisa isehbe lezilungelelwaniso zomzimba. Ukwenza ulawulo lwezilwimi zokwelwa kumafundi bezilungelelwaniso zomzimba. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumacebo kumasebe aphantsi. Umphandli kufuneka abe nokulungele ukujikeleza athathe inxaxheba kumacala amaninzi ahlobene nokuqhelanisa kolunye nosetyenziso lwexesha elidlulile ngaphezu kweekhadinali.

jobs.title: Labour Relations Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Labour Relations Officer position in the Free State Department of Health handling misconduct cases, grievances and disputes, requiring a Diploma in Labour Law or Labour Relations.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate plus, recognized Diploma (NQF 6) in Labour Law/ Labour Relations or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. No experience is required. Knowledge and Skills: Labour Relations Legislation. Processes of labour relation matters. Computer literacy, good communication skills, facilitation skills, conflict resolution skills, analytical skills, presentation skills, negotiation skills, organising skills and interpersonal relationship skills. Knowledge of the Public Service Processes of the CCMA, PSCBC and GPSSBC.
jobs.duties: Preliminary investigate misconduct cases, grievances and disputes. Report on outcome of preliminary investigations of labour relation matters. Implement misconduct procedures. Implement grievance procedures. Implement dispute procedures. Advise on disciplinary procedures. Advise on grievance procedures. Advise on dispute procedures. Update labour relation information on the system. Report progress on a monthly basis. Maintain the disciplinary filing system. Report on strike actions. Compile and distribute the agenda to the relevant members. Distribute the minutes of the previous meeting. Draft minutes of the meeting in line with discussions and decisions.
jobs.applications: Free State Provincial Department of Health utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
