af.title: Arbeidsverhoudingsbeampte
af.summary: Arbeidsverhoudingsbeampte-pos in die Free State Department of Health wat wan gedragsake, klagtes en geskille hanteer, en 'n Diploma in Labour Law of Labour Relations vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate plus, recognized Diploma (NQF 6) in Labour Law/ Labour Relations of ekwivalente kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing. Prosesse van arbeidsverhoudingsake. Rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie kommunikasievaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, konflikoplossingsvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Kennis van die Openbare Diens Prosesse van die CCMA, PSCBC en GPSSBC.
af.duties: Doen voorlopige ondersoeke na wandragsake, klagtes en geskille. Rapporteer oor die uitkoms van voorlopige ondersoeke van arbeidsverhoudingsake. Implementeer wandragsprosedures. Implementeer klagteprosedures. Implementeer geskilprosedures. Adviseer oor dissplinêre prosedures. Adviseer oor klagteprosedures. Adviseer oor geskilprosedures. Dateer arbeidsverhoudingsinligting op die stelsel op. Rapporteer maandeliks oor vordering. Onderhou die disiplinêre lêerstelsel. Rapporteer oor stakingsaksies. Stel die agenda op en versprei dit aan die relevante lede. Versprei die notule van die vorige vergadering. Op stel notule van die vergadering in ooreenstem met besprekings en besluite.

zu.title: Umnikazi Wezindaba Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somnikazi wezindaba zabasebenzi kumnyango wezemvelo e Free State siphatha izehlakalo zokuziphatha kabi, izikhalazo nezinkanglingo, sidinga iDiploma kumthetho wabasebenzi noma ezindabeni zabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate kanye ne, Diploma evunyelwe (NQF 6) kumthetho wabasebenzi/ ezindabeni zabasebenzi noma iziqu ezingabalwa njengezinfaniso ngokusho kwa SAQA. Akukho njalo efunwayo. Ulwazi nobukhono: Umthetho wezindaba zabasebenzi; Izinqubo zezindaba zabasebenzi; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyitha, amakhono okuxhumana kahle, amakhono okuqeqesha, amakhono okuxazulula izingxabano, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuhlela kanye namakhono okwakha ubuhlobo nabantu. Ulwazi lwezinqubo ZabeSebenzi Bezikhundla zikahulumeni kwa CCMA, PSCBC kanye ne GPSSBC.
zu.duties: Phenya ngokuqala izehlakalo zokuziphatha kabi, izikhalazo nezinkanglingo; Cabangela ngemiphumela yophenyo lokuqala ngezindaba zabasebenzi; Phatha izinqubo zokuziphatha kabi; Phatha izinqubo zezikhalazo; Phatha izinqubo zezinkanglingo; Nikeza izeluleko ngezinqubo zesigwebo; Nikeza izeluleko ngezinqubo zezikhalazo; Nikeza izeluleko ngezinqubo zezinkanglingo; Buya ushintshe ulwazi ngabasebenzi kwisistimu; Cabangela ngokuqhubeka njalo nyanga zonke; Gcina isistimu yemibhalo yezigwebo; Cabangela ngezinyathelo zokubetha; Hlela futhi usabalise ajenda kumalungu ahlobene; Sabalisa imizuzu yomhlango wangaphambilini; Bhala imizuzu yomhlango ngokusho kwezinkingiswayo nezinqumo ezithathiwe.

xh.title: Iofisa Wezomsebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMphathiswa Wezomsebenzi kwisebe lezeMpiIo eFree State ngenjongo yokusingatha iimeko zokuziphatha kabi, iingxaki neentanje, kufuneka idiploma kwiMithetho yoMsebenzi okanywa ekuQhathaniswa koMsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior Certificate ngesondelo, idiploma esemthethweni (NQF 6) kwiMithetho yoMsebenzi/ ukuQhathaniswa koMsebenzi okanye isifundo esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa ngusika SAQA. Akukho nqene ediniwayo ifunekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: IMithetho yoMsebenzi nokuQhathaniswa koomsebenzi. Iinkqubo zeemeko zomsebenzi nokuqhathaniswa. Ukuqonda ikhompyutha, amakhono olunxsulumaniso olulungileyo, amakhono okukhokela iingxoxo, amakhono oksombulula iingxabano, amakhono oyanucwa, amakhono abonakalisa iinkcazelo, amakhono axoxisana ngokuzinikela, amakhono olungelelanisa nezinye iinkqubo ngokubambisana namakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoMsebenzi woLuntu zeentsapho zeCCMA, PSCBC neGPSSBC.
xh.duties: Tshatha ngokwandulela iimeko zokuziphatha kabi, iingxaki neentanje. Ingxela ngeziphumo zophando olwandulela ngemeko zomsebenzi nokuziphatha. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zokuziphatha kabi. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zeengxaki. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zeentanje. Zekelela ngeenkqubo zolwahlulo. Zekelela ngeenkqubo zeengxaki. Zekelela ngeenkqubo zeentanje. Zihlaziye ulwazi ngemeko zomsebenzi kwinkqubo. Ingxela inkqubela rhoqo nyanga zonke. Zigcine inkqubo yokulondoloza iifayili ezikrwada. Ingxela ngemeko zokuhanjiswa kolwazi oluthintelweyo ziilungu ezifanelekileyo. Sasaza ishedi yemibhinqo yeqela lomzimba kwiilungu ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resource Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Senior Human Resource Officer at Thabo Mofutsanyana District Office overseeing complex HR administration practices including recruitment, appointments and transfers.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, plus Diploma in Human Resource Management or related areas qualification at NQF 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum 3 years’ experience in HR environment. Relevant PERSAL Certificates. Knowledge and Skills: Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Public Service Regulation 2016, as amended and Public Finance Management Act. Computer literacy, planning and organisation. Good communication (verbal and written). Team work, flexibility and responsibility.
jobs.duties: Supervise and undertake the more complex implementation and maintenance of human resource administration practices: HR Provisioning (Recruitment and Selection, appointments, transfer, verification of qualifications, secretariat functions at interviews, absorptions, probationary periods etc.). Implement conditions of service and service benefits (Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on Duty, Long Service Recognition, overtime, relocation, Pension, allowances etc.). Termination of service. Recommend (approve) transactions on PERSAL according to delegations. Performance Management. Prepare reports on human resource administration issues and statistics. Handle human resource administration enquiries. Allocate and ensure quality of work Personnel development.

af.title: Senior Menslike Hulpbronbeampte
af.summary: Senior Menslike Hulpbronbeampte by Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrikkantoor wat toesig hou oor komplekse HR-administrasiepraktyke, insluitend werwing, aanstellings en oorplasing.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat, plus 'n Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie op NQF 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ondervinding in 'n HR-omgewing. Relevante PERSAL-sertifikate. Kennis en vaardighede: Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Openbare Diensregulasie 2016, soos gewysig, en die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet. Rekenaargeletterdheid, beplanning en organisasie. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Samewerking, buigsaamheid en verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Bystaan en onderneem die meer komplekse implementering en instandhouding van menslike hulpbronadministrasiepraktyke: HR-voorsiening (Werwing en keuring, aanstellings, oorplasing, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, sekretariaatsfunksies by onderhoude, absorpsies, proefperiodes, ens.). Implementeer diensvoorwaardes en diensvoordele (verlof, behuising, medies, besering op diens, erkenning vir lang diens, oortyd, herlokasie, pensioen, toelaes, ens.). Beëindiging van diens. Beveel (keur) transaksies op PERSAL aan volgens delegerings. Prestasiebestuur. Berei verslae oor menslike hulpbronadministrasiekwessies en statistiek voor. Hanteer navrae oor menslike hulpbronadministrasie. Ken werk toe en verseker gehalte van werk Personeelontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhandi Wamabungu Abantu
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhandi Wamabungu Abantu eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office obuhlola izinto ezingeye yocingo ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kwamabungu abantu okuhlanganisa ukubumba iqembu, ukumiswa kwabasebenzi kanye nokushintshwa kwabo.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate, kanye ne-Diploma ku-Human Resource Management noma izifundo ezihlobene ezingeni le-NQF 6 njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yamava kwindawo yamabungu abantu. Izipesheli ezingezene ze-PERSAL. Ulwazi nanamakhono: Ukuba nolwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda umthethosisekelo ohlela izinto koMnyango Womphakathi. I-Public Service Regulation 2016, njengoba iguquliwe kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act. Ukubuka konke ukuqonda ukusebenza kwekhompyutha, ukwenza izinhlelo kanye nokuhlela. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuguquguquka kanye nenxaxheba.
zu.duties: Qapha kwenze izinto ezingeye yocingo ezihlobene nokuqashelwa nokugcinwa kwezindlela zokuphatha amabungu abantu: Ukubumba abantu (Ukubumba iqembu kanye nokukhetha, ukumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukushintshwa, ukuqinisekisa izifundo, imisebenzi yesikhwama ekuhlolweni kwabangeneleli, ukumiswa ngokuphelele, ithuba lokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi basha njll.). Susele izinto ezihlobene nemisebenzi nezinzuzo zemisebenzi (Ukuyeka umsebenzi okwesikhashana, Izindlu, Izokwelashwa, Ukulimala emsebenzini, Ukugujwa kweminyaka yosebenzo exhaswe kakhulu, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi, ukushintsha indawo yokuhlala, iPension, izimali ezedululo njll.). Ukuphela kwesikhathi somsebenzi. Phakamisa (vuma) izinto ezenziwayo kwi-PERSAL ngokuya ngamandla anikiwe. Ukuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Lungiselela imibiko ngemikhondo yokuphatha amabungu abantu kanye nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo ehlobene nokuphathwa kwamabungu abantu. Abela futhi uqinisekise izinga lomsebenzi ekuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Somagcina Wezabasebenzi Ophakamileyo
xh.summary: ISomagcina Wezabasebenzi Ophakamileyo kwiOfisi yoMmandla weThabo Mofutsanyana ephethe iindlela ezinzima zolawulo lwezabasebenzi eziquka uqeqesho, iimvume zomsebenzi kunye nokuqhubekisa phambili.
xh.requirements: Iseytifikethi ephezimu, kananjalo iDiploma kwiLawulo LoLwazi Lwabasebenzi okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nayo kumanqanaba NQF 6 njengakuqatshwa yiSAQA. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka 3 ukusebenza kwindawo yolawulo lwabasebenzi. Iseytifikethi zePERSAL ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda ngolwimi lolawu olulawula inkonzo kahulumathi. IsiCedulu senkonzo kahulumathi ka-2016, njengoko silungisiweyo noMthetho woLawulo lweMali kahulumathi. Ukuziphatha kwekhompyutha, ucwangciso nolungelelwaniso. Unxibelelwano oluhle (oluthethwayo nolubhaliweyo). Ukusebenza njengesiqhanga, ukuguquguquka naxanduva.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda waze waphatheza ukusebenza nokuqhuba iindlela ezinzima zolawulo lwamaphulo ezabasebenzi: Ukubonelela ngabasebenzi (UqeqeshookuKhetha, iimvume zomsebenzi, ukuqhubekisa phambili, ukuqinisekisa izifundo, imisebenzi yobuhlalu kwiinkcshelelo, ukamiselwa, iixesha zokuqeqesha njl.). Ukusebenzisa iimeko zenkonzo nenzuzo zenkonzo (Ikuqeshwa, Izindlu, IYezokwelapha, Iinkcakara ezenzeka ngelixa lomsebenzi, Ukuqatshelwa Isevisi Ende, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha, ukuhamba, iPension, izibonelelo njl.). Ukuqhwesha isebenso. Ukunikela izindululo (ukuvuma) iintengiso kwiPERSAL ngokwemithetho yabelo. Ulawulo lokuSebenza. Ukuqulunqarisa iingxelo ngeendaba zolawulo lwabasebenzi namanani. Ukupatha imibuzo yolawulo lwabasebenzi. Ukumisa waze waziqinisekisa umgangatho womsebenzi kwingcalabo yabantu.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (PNA2)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R324 384 - R382 107 per annum Grade 2: R396 132 - R466 623 per annum Grade 3: R476 367 - R610 662 per annum plus, Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse position at Katleho District Hospital in the Free State, requiring a nursing diploma or degree and SANC registration, with salaries ranging across three grades.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Registered Nurse in General Nursing. OR - A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse Grade 1: Experience: None after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Knowledge and Skills: Ability to work under pressure; Good communication (Written and Verbal); Good interpersonal relations; Professionalism; Confidentiality and basic computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate an understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Implement a comprehensive nursing care plan/program for the promotion of health, self-care, treatment and rehabilitation of patients. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Maintain a plan to improve the quality of nursing and health care. Actively engage in the educational and training of students in the health care system. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing health care. Protect and advocate rights of patients regarding health care. Implement patient care standards, policies and procedures. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Disseminate information on epidemics, nutritional disease, maternal and infant morbidity and mortality and other common diseases. Communicate with the multi-disciplinary health teams, organisations and special interest groups when dealing with community health issues and needs. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (PNA2)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige-pos by Katleho District Hospital in die Free State, wat 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad vereis, asook SANC-registrasie, met salarisse wat oor drie grade strek.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging toelaat. OF - 'n 4-jarige Bachelorsgraad in Verpleging (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Kennis en Vaardighede: Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Goede kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings; Professionaliteit; Vertroulikheid en basiese rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Implementeer 'n omvattende verpleegsorgplan/program vir die bevordering van gesondheid, selfsorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie van pasiënte. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Handhaaf 'n plan om die gehalte van verpleeg- en gesondheidsorg te verbeter. Neem aktief deel aan die opvoeding en opleiding van studente in die gesondheidsorgstelsel. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleeggesondheidsorg van toepassing is. Beskerm en beywer vir die regte van pasiënte ten opsigte van gesondheidsorg. Implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde, beleide en prosedures. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Versprei inligting oor epidemies, voedselsiektes, moeder- en babasterfte en -morbidity en ander algemene siektes. Kommunikeer met multidissiplinêre gesondheidspanne, organisasies en spesiale belangegroepe wanneer gemeenskapsgesondheidskwessies en -behoeftes hanteer word. Benut menslike, materiaal- en fisiese bronne doeltreffend en effektief

zu.title: Unesi Osebenzayo (PNA2)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sonesi osebenzayo esibhedlela iKatleho District Hospital eFree State, esidinga idiploma noma idigri yokunesa nokubhalisa kuSANC, ngeholo elihlukahlukene kuzinga ezintathu.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, isiqu se-Basic R425 (okukuthi idiploma/idigri yokunesa) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonesi obhalisiwe ekunakekelweni kwesifo ngokujwayelekile. NGA - Idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka eyi-4 eNursing (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonesi osebenzayo Izinga 1: Isiphephelo: Alikho ngemuva kokubhalisa kuSANC njengonesi osebenzayo. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 ngemuva kokubhalisa kuSANC njengonesi osebenzayo. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-20 ngemuva kokubhalisa kuSANC njengonesi osebenzayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo; Ukuxhumana okuhle (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo); Izibopho ezinhle phakathi kwabantu; Ukwesebenza ngobungcweti; Ukugcina imfihlo kanye nokwazi okuyisisekelo ngemikhiqizo yangaphakathi yeziCikizi.
zu.duties: Khombisa ukuqonda ngezomthetho zokunesa kanye nemisebenzi yamasesethi ehlobene nemithetho nezimiso zokuziphatha ekunakekelweni kokugula. Faka ohlelo/uhlelo olubanzi lokunakekelwa kokunesa olujwayelekile ekukhuthazeni impilo, ukuzinakekela, ukwelashwa kanye nokubuyiselwa esimeni esihle kwabaguliswayo. Faka izindinganiso, izindlela, izilinganiso kanye nezinkomba zokunesa olungcono (izinga lokusebenza).ugcine uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinga lokunesa nalenakekelwa impilo. Yiba nandima enkulu emfundweni nokuqeqeshweni kwabafundi ohlelweni lenakekelwa impilo. Sebenzisa inakekelwa yokunesa kanye nalenakekelwa impilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho kanye nemiqulu ehlobene nanakekelwa impilo yokunesa. Vikela futhi useke amalungelo abaguliswayo mayelana nanakekelwa impilo. Faka izindinganiso, izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zokunakekelwa abaguliswayo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza noonesi kanye nalabo abanye abahlangene nalesi sikhundla. Sazisa ulwazi ngamagciwane ephakameyo, izifo ezibangelwa ukungondleki kahle, ukubhebhetheka nokufa kwabomama kwanabantwana abancane nakwezinye izifo ezivamile. Xhumana namaqembu ahlukene ezokwelapha, izinhlangano kanye namaqembu anentshisekelo enkulu ekuphatheni izindaba nezidingo zenakekelwa emphakathini. Sebenzisa okwabantu, izinto kanye nezinsiza zomzimba ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle

xh.title: Unesi yeNgcweti (PNA2)
xh.summary: Isithuba senesi yengcweti eKatleho District Hospital eFree State, esifuna idiploma okanye isidanga sokunyanga kwaye kubekho bubhaliso kwi-SANC, nomvuzo oqhekahlaka kumagatya amathathu.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, isigaba se-R425 esisisiseko (okt. idiploma/isidanga ekunyuseni) okanye isigaba esilinganayo esivumela ubhaliso kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenesi ebhaliweyo ekunyangeni ngokubanzi. OKanye - Isidanga seBachelor seminyaka emine ekunyuseni (R174) esivumela ubhaliso kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenesi yengcweti Inqanaba 1: Isipili: Akukho nasinye emva kobhaliso kwi-SANC njengenesi yengcweti. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-10 emva kobhaliso kwi-SANC njengenesi yengcweti. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-20 emva kobhaliso kwi-SANC njengenesi yengcweti. Ulwazi namakhono: Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo; Unxibelelwano olululo (Elibhaliweyo neli thethwayo); Uqhagamshelwano oluhle phakathi kwabantu; Ubugcisa bokusebenza; Iimfihlo nolwazi olusisiseko lokusebenza ngekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwe-mithetho yokunyanga nayo yonke imithetho edibanayo nenkqubo yomthetho nemigaqo ethe nkqo yokunyanga. Zonke izicwangciso zokunyatela izigqibo/inkqubo ezizezona ngokupheleleyo zokuqhubela phambili impilo, ukuzikhathalela, unyango nokubuyisela kwasekhaya abagulayo. Phuma phambili ekusebenziseni imigqatho, iinkqubo, iindlela namagqagqam ezinga eliphezulu lonyango (izinga lenkqubo). Gcina isicwangciso sokuphucula izinga lonyango nempilo yonyango. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kwimfundo nokuqeqeshwa abafundi kwindlela yempilo yonyango. Yenza umsebenzi wokunyanga nempilo yonyango ngokulandela imithetho nemigaqo ehambelana noyonke imithetho yempilo yonyango. Vikela uze uphendule amalungelo abaguli ngokupathwa kwempilo. Zonke iinkqubo zokunyathela kwabaguli, iinkqubo nemigaqo. Gcina ubudlelwane obwakho obusebenzayo kubasebenzi bonyango nabo bonke abanamanxeba. Sasaza inkcazelo ngokubakala kwamayeza, izifo ezithintelwe ukutya, ukugula nokufa kwabazala kwabantwana nakwezinye izifo eziqhelekileyo. Thetha nabaqheliswa bemixholo banjengoko sibhanqo bemitha yempilo, amaqumbe ahlukeneyo nakwezinye iindibaniselwa zomdla ekuphathweni kwezidingo zendalo ngokupathwa kwempilo. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto namacebo asemzimbeni ngokusebenza kakuhle nangendlela echanekileyo

af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met geen ervaring. Toepaslike Vaktoetssertifikaat (Passer). 'n Voltooide leerling en bewys van die slaag van 'n vaktoets volgens Artikel 13(2)(h) van 1981, van die Mannekragwet, 1981 soos gewysig of 'n sertifikaat uitgereik onder die bepalings van Artikel 28 of 30 van die Mannekragwet, 1981, soos gewysig of uitgereik onder die bepalings van die herroepde Artikel 27 van die betrokke Wet. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet, 1993 (Wet No. 85 van 1993) (BGV Wet). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Uitstekende tydbestuur, Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede met kollegas en ander departemente en verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Produceer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasie en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produceer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasie en erkende standaarde. Kwaliteitsversekering van geproduceerde voorwerpe en inspekteer toerusting en of fasiliteit vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteitsdefekte volgens standaarde. Toets en herstel toerusting en masjinerie in die fasiliteit volgens die spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en masjinerie in die fasiliteit volgens die instandhoudingsplanskedule. Kwaliteitsverseker onderhoude en in stand gehoude toerusting in die fasiliteit. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. Verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Hou en onderhou werksrekords/ register, bestuur en mentoor personeel. Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuKukhiqiza ikhono lokusebenza ngokushibiliswa nokagesi eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office, sifuna ibanga le-12 nesitifikedi esihambisana soVivinyo Lobuso obunesipesheli.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ngaphandle kokwenziwa isipiliyoni. Isitifikedi esifanele soVivinyo Lobuso (Fitter). Umfundi ogqitshisiwe ngokuphelele nobufakazi bokudlula isivivinyo sobuso ngokwesigaba 13(2)(h) sika-1981, soMthetho Wamandla Abantu, ka-1981 njengoba ulungisiwe noma isitifikedi esinikezwe ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zesigaba 28 noma 30 soMthetho Wamandla Abantu, ka-1981, njengoba ulungisiwe noma esinikezwe ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zesigaba 27 esiyekwe soMthetho othiwa. Ilayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile. Ulwazi Nobukhono: Ulwazi loMthetho Wokuqinisekisa Iziphuzo Nokuvikela Emsebenzini, ka-1993 (Umthetho No. 85 ka-1993) (Umthetho we-OHS). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi okuhle, Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo), amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu abangabalingani nasezinye izigaba nokubhala amabhali okuphathwayo.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izindlela ngokwesici somthengi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakhiwa ngesisetshenziswa ngokwesici somsebenzi nangokuhambisana nemigomo evunyiwe. Qinisekisa izinga lezinto ezenziwe futhi uhlole isisetshenziswa noma isikhungla ngaphakathi ukuthi singayiphi impazamo yobuchwepheshe. Lunga iziphazamiso zesisetshenziswa kanye nesikhungla ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Vivinya futhi ulunge isisetshenziswa nemishini ekusebenzini isikhungla ngokohlelo oluchaziwe. Phatha ngokulondolozwa isisetshenziswa nemishini ekusebenzini isikhungla ngokuhlelo lokulondoloza. Qinisekisa izinga lesisetshenziswa esiphathiwe nesilondolozwe esikhungleni. Hlala futhi unikeze amabhali. Nikeza izinto ezingangenisa ohlelweni lokusebenza. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi ohlelo lomsebenzi/noma isibuko, qaphesisize futhi uholele abasebenzi. Ukuthuthuka ngokuphepha komuntu ngamunye okuqhubekayo ukuze ugcine ngezobuchwepheshe namasu amasha.

xh.requirements: Ibhanga le-12 okanye isifundo esilinganayo ngaphandle kokundiphiwa. Isatifikethi esifanelekileso sovavanyo lwebhakaka (Umjikeli). Umfundi ogqitye isikhathi somsebenzi wokuzilolonga ubuchwepheshe nobungqina bokuphumelela uvavanyo lwebhakaka ngokwesigaba 13(2)(h) sika-1981, seMthetho woBasebenzi, ka-1981 njengoko ulungiswe, okanye isatifikethi esinikiwe ngaphantsi kwezinqungetheko zesigaba 28 okanye 30 seMthetho woBasebenzi, ka-1981, njengoko ulungiswe, okanye esinikiwe ngaphantsi kwezinqungetheko zesigaba 27 esesiwisiwe somthetho ochazwe apha. Ilayiseni yomqeshi egqityiweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi naye Mpilo, ka-1993 (uMthetho wama-85 ka-1993) (uMthetho we-OHS). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukulawula ixesha ngokugqibeleleyo, Ukunxibelelanisa (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo), amakhono amabalé ahleleyo nabasebenzi nokuhamba kakuhle namanye amasebe nokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Kukhiqize iimodeli ngokwemigaqo yomthengi ngaphakathi kolulinganiso lokukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto ezisettyenziswayo nolwelo ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi nemigangatho ekuqinisekisiweyo. Kuqinisekiswe umgangatho kwezinto ezenziweyo kwaye kuqwalaselwe ulwelo okanye isikhululo ngeeempazamo zobuchwepheshe. Kulungwe iimpazamo zolwelo nesesikhululo ngokomgangatho. Kuvavanywe kulungiswe ulwelo namashini esikhululweni ngokwemigaqo. Kwenziwe ulwelo namashini esikhululweni ngokwecwangciso lonkonzo. Kuqinisekiswe umgangatho kolwelo nelonke azenziwe isikhululweni. Kuqokelelwe kungeniswe iingxelo. Kungeniswe ingxelo kwicwangciso lokuqhuba. Kugcinwe kulondoloze iirekhodi zomsebenzi / urejista, kugqitywe kwaye kuhola abasebenzi. Kuphuhliswe ngokuqhubekayo ngamntu ngamnye ukuze kusale nabuchwepheshe nangolunye uhlelo olutsha.

af.title: Registerklerk
af.summary: Registerklerk benodig by die Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrikkantoor in die Free State om pos, lêerwerk en kliëntnavrae te hanteer, met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Rekenaar, Beplanning en organisering, Taal, Rekenaargeletterd, Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Kommunikasie, Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid, Spanwerk. Openbarediensregulasies (PSR).
af.duties: Kliënte bedien. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos/lêers. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit · Verspreid kennisgewings oor registerkwessies. Oopmaak en sluit van lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêering/berging, opsporing (elektronies/ met die hand) en terugwinning van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Oopmaak en onderhou Franking-masjienregister. Frank pos, teken geld aan en werk register daagliks by. Doen steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Sluit pos in pos sak vir bodes om by die Poskantoor te lewer. Oopmaak en onderhou remittansieregister. Teken alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in die remittansieregister aan. Lewer remittansies met die hand af en teken dit aan finansies oor. Stuur verkeerde remittansies via geregistreerde pos terug na sender en teken verwysingsnommer in register aan. Hou daaglikse rekord van die hoeveelheid briewe gefrank is. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel lys van dokumente op om gearchiveer te word en dien by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords vir gearchiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Umlobi werekhodi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi werekhodi eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office eFree State ukuphathela imeyili, ukuqoshwa kwamafayela nemibuzo yabathathi zinhlangothi, kudingeka isitifikedi se-Grade 12.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mqondo odingekayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, Ulimi, Ukuqonda ikhompyutha, Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nokuwabhala. Ukuxhumana, Izinkomba zabantu. Ukuguquguquka, Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi (PSR)
zu.duties: Ukukhathalela abathathi zinhlangothi. Ukuphatha imibuzo etholwe ngocingo namunye. Ukuthola bese uqamba imeyili/amafayela alethwe ngesandla. Ukuthola yonke imeyili. Ukuhlunga, ukuqamba bese uthumela imeyili · Ukusabalakisa izaziso ngemikhondo yerekhodi. Ukuvula bese kuvalwa amafayela ngokwesistimu yeqoqo lemibhalo. Ukuqoqa/ukugcina, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokukhipha imibhalo namafayela. Ukugcwalisa amakhadi okuqamba wonke amafayela. Ukuvula bese ulondoloza irekhodi lemithi yokuthumela imeyili. Ukupenda iposi, ukuqoshi imali bese ubuyekeza irekhodi nsuku zonke. Ukwenza izihloko zokuhlola iposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese. Ukuvala iposi esikhwameni seposi ukuthi iithumbe ziyokulethela ePost Office. Ukuvula & ukulondoloza irekhodi lezimali ezithunywa. Ukuqoqa bonke obucatshangwa obunesibopho njengokuqokiwe kurekhodi lezimali ezithunywa. Ukuthumela ngesandla bese usayina izimali ezithunywa kumnyango wezimali. Ukubuyisela izimali ezithunyiwe ezingalungile kumthumeli ngeposi eqoshiwe bese uqoshainkomba kurekhodi. Ukugcina irekhodi nsuku zonke lenani lemapheshana apendiwe. Ukuskena amafayela ngekhompyutha. Ukuhlunga bese ubeka amafayela ngemifanekiso ukuwothunyelwa kumagumbi okulondoloza bese usabalakisa. Ukuqoqa uhlu lwemibhalo okumele iyonakalwe bese uyihambisa kumphathi. Ukugcina imibhalo yemibhalo enakaliwe

xh.summary: Kufuneki ngumntu wonyule iirekhodi eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office eFree State ukugcina iposti, ukulungisa iifayili nemibuzo yabathengi, kwaye kufunekile isatifikethi seGrade 12.

Ukuguquguquka, Ukusebenza njengesebe. Imigaqo-nkqubo yenkonzo yomntu wonke (PSR)
xh.duties: Ukwenza inkonzo kubathengi. Ukuphatha imibuzo ngomnxeba neminye efunyenweyo. Ukuyamkela bize uqale ibhalise iposi/iifayili ezilethwe ngesandla. Ukuyamkela yonke iposi. Ukuhlela, ukubhalisa nokuthumela iposti · Ukusasaza izaziso ngeenkcukacha zerekhisithri. Ukuvula nokuvala iifayili ngokwendlela yokuhlela iirekhodi. Ukugcina iifayili/ukuzigcina, ukuzifumana (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokuvelisa amaxwebhu ngee fayili. Ukugqiba amakhadi okwalathisa iifayili zonke. Ukuvula kugcinwe irekhodi lemshini wokuposa. Ukuposa, ukubhalisa imali kwaye uvuselele irekhodi yonke imihla. Ukwenza ukhangelo olungqamana neposti ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho poso yangasese ifakelweyo. Ukugcina iirekhodi zamaxwebhu esikhululo samaxwebu

zu.title: Umhlengikazi wesikhundla 1-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhlengikazi 1-3 esibhedlela i-Bongani Regional Hospital e-Free State, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi ohlolwe ukungena.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphakeme/ Grade 12 noma izifundo ezingangemumo. Isifundo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi ohlolwe ukungena. Grade 1: Akukho mengcelelwa yomkhankulo. Grade 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yomkhankulo ohambelana noma oqashelwayo ekunakekelweni kwesiguli ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi. Grade 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-20 yomkhankulo ohambelana noma oqashelwayo ekunakekelweni kwesiguli ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi. Ulwazi namakhono: Umfunwa kumele abe namakhono okuxhumana nokubhala okuyisisekelo. Kubheke ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokwakha ubudlelwano nabantu. Ulwazi ngemizinga yokunakekela isiguli, uMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezempilo nomThetho WabeNkomfa kaZwelonke ka-2016, njengokulungisiwe. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha lizokuba yinzuzo engeziwe.
zu.duties: Linganisa, humusha futhi ubhale uphawu lwegazi. Siza ogqirha bokunakekelwa ngemisebenzi yezokwelapha (okunjengokuphatha amashothi emisipha engaphakathi). Uyavuma ukujikeleza emnyangweni futhi usebenze ebusuku. Gcina ukukhula ngomkhankulo/ izinga zokuziphatha futhi uzithuthukise. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihaba amakhaya amaningi futhi usekela abaphathi ukuze uqiniseke ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okuhle. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngesiguli, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kokuhlanzwa kwesiguli. Gcina isimo sokudla kwesiguli. Yenza kubhekiseke ekunyakazisweni kwamagulu. Yenza kubhekiseke kumasevisi wokuqeda. Ukulungiselela iziguli emisebenzini yokuhlola nokwelapha ngokuhlinzwa. Celani impahla nezixhobo ngendlela ecolisa ngemali. Sebenzisa zonke izixhobo ezihambelanayo nezibonakaliso.

xh.title: Umongikazi woBuntu inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Isikhundla somongikazi wobuntu inqanaba 1-3 esibhedlele iBongani Regional Hospital kwiphondo leFree State, sifuna ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi yesenior/ iGrade 12 okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. Isifanekiso esivumela ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi wobuntu. Ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nqubomgama ofunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 yonqubomgama ofanelekileyo/ovakalayo kulunyango emva kobhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi wobuntu. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-20 yonqubomgama ofanelekileyo/ovakalayo kulunyango emva kobhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi wobuntu. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Umfunghi kufuneka abe namakhono omthethonqophiso nokubhala. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza njengesixanduva seqela elisebenza ngamanyanga. Amakhono omthethonqophiso athile nokuqhathanisa nabantu. Ulwazi ngeemigangatho yolunyango lwezempilo, iNursing Act namaziko asebenza ezeNkonzo zoLuntu ka-2016, njengoko atyhilliweyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela iikhompyutha kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Linganisa, ukuqhoma ubhalwe iimpawu eziphathulukayo. Nceda abongikazi abangabalulekileyo ngeenkcukacha zezokwelapha (okt ukunikela iinjection zaselugongcilweni). Ukulungele ukujikeleza kwisebe nokusebenza ebusuku. GCina ukukhula kwemveliso/ imigangatho yomthetho nokuziphucela. usebenza njengesixanduva seqela elisebenza ngamanyanga nixhasa abaphathi ukuqinisekisa ulunyango olulungileyo lwezempilo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabaguli, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kobuhle bomguli. Hlala uqinisekisa isimo sokutya komguli. Yenza kube lula ukunyakaza kwabaguli. Yenza kube lula iinkqubo zokuqhumisa. Ulungiselelo kwabaguli beenkcukacha zokunqanja nokuhlinzwa. Funa isitokhwe nempahla ngendlela engatshali mali kakhulu. Sebenzisa zonke iiaparathasi nempahla efunekayo.

zu.title: Umongikazi Ohlezi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongikazi ohlezi esibhedlela i-Katleho District Hospital e-Free State, sifuna ukubhalwa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi obhalisiwe, ngezizinga ezintathu ezisekelwe esiphephelweni.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikhethe/ Isigaba se-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Izifundo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ohlezi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi obhalisiwe. Isigaba 1: Akukho siphephelo esidingekayo. Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yomsebenzi ohambelana/owaziwayo wokunyanga emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ohlezi. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yomsebenzi ohambelana/owaziwayo wokunyanga emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ohlezi. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Umuntu ophakelayo kufanele abe nokwazi ukuxhumana nokubhala okuyisisekelo. Akwazi ukusebenza njengengxenye yethimba elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi. Ukuxhumana okuhle namakhono obudlelwano bomuntu. Ulwazi ngemazinga enakekelo yokunyanga, umthetho wokunyanga kanye Nomthetho Wabelethi Wezewe Lomphakathi ka-2016, njengoba ulungisiwe. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Linganisa, humusha futhi ubhale uphawu lokuphila. Siza omongikazi abangabantu abanekhono ngemisebenzi yokwelapha (okukhulu ukuphatha imithi egonywe emsipheteni). Zimisele ukushintshashintsha phakathi kweminyango nasekusebenzeni ebusuku. Nakekeliswa kukhuleleko komsebenzi/ amazinga okuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. Sebenza njengengxenye yethimba elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi futhi useke abaphathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inakekelo ekuhle kuni yokunyanga. Khombisa ukukhathalela ngabagulayo, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kokuhlanzeka kwabagulayo. Gcina isimo sokudla komuntu ofakwe esibhedlela. Yenza kube lula ukunyakaza kwabagulayo. Yenza kube lula izinqubo zokuqeda. Lukhulule abagulayo ngemisebenzi yokuhlola naseyokwelapha ngesibhakela. Oda isitoko namathuluzi ngendlela engagibeli imali okumayo. Phatha wonke amathuluzi nemiqondo ehambelana nomsebenzi.

xh.title: Umongikazi Wabasebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi wabasebenzi kwiKatleho District Hospital eFree State, sifuna ukubhalwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ohlotshiweyo, kwaye sineenqanaba ezintathu ezisentlalweni ngokusekelwe kwiminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi esphezulu/Grade 12 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo. Isifundo esivumela ukubhalwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi wabasebenzi. Ukubhalwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ohlotshiweyo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho namva alingelayo. Inqanaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka elingu-10 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo ekunyangesi emva kokubhalwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi wabasebenzi. Inqanaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka elingu-20 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo ekunyangesi emva kokubhalwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi wabasebenzi. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Umfundi kufuneka abe nokwazi ukuxoxa nokuwumbuva ngokwesiseko. Akwazi ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqela elinamakhondo amaninzi. Ukuxoxa kakuhle namakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Ulwazi ngamazinga enyango lokunyanga, uMthetho weNyango noMthetho Wesebe LikaRhulumente ka-2016, njengoko ulungisiwe, Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwegcinekiso. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Linganisa, uchaze igqithisile kwaye ulugcine ulwazi lwemiqondiso yokuphila. Uncede oongikazi abanamava ngemisebenzi yokunyanga (okt ukunika iinjekshi ze-intramuscular). Ukulungele ukujikeleza kwisebe kwaye usebenze esikhundlweni sobusuku. Zigcinele ukukhula ngokwemisebenzi/izingqubomgqobo ezifanelekileyo nakuqeqeswa kwakho. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqela elinamakhondo amaninzi kwaye uncedise abaphathi kukuqinisekisa inyango elikhoyo. Bonise inkathalo ngabagulayo, Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kokuhlanza komguli. Qinisekisa isimo sokutya somguli. Yenza kubelula ukuhamba kwabagulayo. Yenza kubelula iinkqubo zokuqhuba. Ulungiselela abagulayo iinkqubo zokuqokelela ulwazi nokuqhawula. Faka odolo lwezinto nezixhobo ngendlela egcina imali. Phephenisa yonke i-apparatus nezixhobo ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 - R207 225 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 – R239 922 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 – R310 890 per annum plus, 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Nursing Assistant sought at Katleho District Hospital in the Free State to provide basic patient care, with salaries ranging across three experience grades.
jobs.requirements: Basic qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Experience: Grade 1: Non after registration with SANC. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Current registration with SANC (2026/2027). Knowledge and Skills: Demonstrate elementary communication with patients. Knowledge of nursing care standards, Nursing Act and Public Service Regulation 2016, as amended.
jobs.duties: Assist patients with activities of daily living (physical care). Maintain hygiene of patients. Provide nutrition. Assist with mobility. Assist with elimination processes. Provide elementary clinical nursing care. Measure, interpret and record vital signs. Operate all relevant apparatus and equipment. Assist professional nurses with clinical procedures (i.e. administering of oral medication). Preparation of patients for diagnostic and surgical procedures. Maintain professional growth/ ethical standards and self development. To maintain the code of conduct as required in the Public Service and by the Professional Body.

af.title: Verpleegassistent
af.summary: Verpleegassistent gesoek by Katleho Distrikshospitaal in die Free State om basiese pasiëntsorg te verskaf, met salarisse wat oor drie ervaringgrade strek.
af.requirements: Basiese kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegassistent toelaat. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by SANC. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegassistent. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegassistent. Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026/2027). Kennis en Vaardighede: Toon elementêre kommunikasie met pasiënte. Kennis van verpleegsorgstandaarde, Nursing Act en Public Service Regulation 2016, soos gewysig.
af.duties: Help pasiënte met aktiwiteite van daaglikse lewe (fisiese sorg). Handhaaf higiëne van pasiënte. Verskaf voeding. Help met mobiliteit. Help met eliminasieprosesse. Verskaf elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg. Meet, interpreteer en teken lewensfunksies aan. Bedryf alle toepaslike toerusting en apparatuur. Help professionele verpleegkundiges met kliniese prosedures (d.w.s. toediening van orale medikasie). Voorbereiding van pasiënte vir diagnostiese en chirurgiese prosedures. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Om die gedragskode soos vereis in die Public Service en deur die Professionele Liggaam na te kom.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo
zu.summary: Kufunwa uMmsizi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo e-Katleho District Hospital esifundazweni sakwa-Free State ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kubaphilisi, ngeholo elihluca ngamagangu amathathu abhothozothando.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esiyisisekelo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoMmsizi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo. Abhothozothando: I-Garde 1: Akukho bhothozothando emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC. I-Grade 2: Ubuncane besikhathi seminyaka eyi-10 sobhothozothando obufanele/obuhlonishwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoMmsizi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo. I-Grade 3: Ubuncane besikhathi seminyaka eyi-20 sobhothozothando obufanele/obuhlonishwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoMmsizi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwi-SANC (2026/2027). Ulwazi namakhono: Bonisa ukuxhumana okuyisisekelo nabaphilisi. Ulwazi ngemigomo yezokunakekelwa kwezempilo, uMthetho Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo kanye noMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-2016, njengoba ulungisiwe.
zu.duties: Siza abaphilisi ngemisebenzi yansuku zonke yokuphila (ukunakekelwa komzimba). Gcina ukuhlanzwa kwabaphilisi. Nikeza ukudla. Siza ngokunyakaza. Siza kwinqubo yokukhipha okungatholakali emzimbeni. Nikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo. Linganisa, humusha futhi urekhode izibonakaliso eziphila. Setha wonke amabhodi namadivaysi ahlobene. Siza oonakekeli abangamabhakhense ngezenzo zokwelapha (okunjengokupha imithi yomlomo). Lungiselela abaphilisi bakuqoqo lokuxilonga kanye nezenzo zokuqhaqhwa. Gcina ukukhula ngomsebenzi/izincazelo zobu-ethical kanye nentuthuko yomuntu. Ukugcina ikhodi yokuziphatha njengoba kudingeka kwisevisi yomphakathi futhi ngumnyango we-Bhodi Yabaphathi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weZisesi
xh.summary: Kufunekwe umncedisi wezisesi eKatleho District Hospital eFree State ukunika unyango olusisiseko lwabagula, nomvuzo ohluahlukene ngakwemiqathango emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezisisiseko ezivumela ukubhalisa kuSANC njengomncedisi wezisesi. Aamava: Grade 1: Akukho mnqamlezo emva kokubhalisa kuSANC. Grade 2: Okungenani iminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokubhalisa kuSANC njengomncedisi wezisesi. Grade 3: Okungenani iminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokubhalisa kuSANC njengomncedisi wezisesi. Ukubhalisa okwangoku kuSANC (2026/2027). Ulwazi nobuchule: Bonisa unxibelelwano olusisiseko nabagula. Ulwazi ngamazinga onyango lwezisesi, iNursing Act nePublic Service Regulation 2016, njengoko iguquliwe.
xh.duties: Unceda abagula nokuqhuba iimpilo zabo zansuku zonke (unyango lomzimba). Ukugcina ucoceko kwabagula. Nikezisa ngokutya. Unceda ngokuhambeka. Unceda ngokuqhuba iinkqubo zokuqhuba iindlela zomzimba. Nikezisa unyango lwezisesi olusisiseko. Funda, hlaluhamba ubhale iziphawuli eziphambili. Sebenzisa zonke iiplanethi nezixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Unceda oongqondisa bezisesi ngenkqubo zonyango (umz. ukunika amachiza omntu). Ulungiselela abagula ukwenza iinkqubo zokuqaphela nokudlula iinkqubo zokwelashwa ngokuhlabula. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga zokuziphatha nokuziphucula. Ukugcina ikhowudi yokuziphatha njengoko kufuneka kukawonke-wonke nakwiProfeshini.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.salary_text: R170 226 - R200 523 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Driver position at Thabo Mofutsanyana District Office in the Free State, requiring Grade 10, a valid licence and public driving permit, with at least 7 months driving experience.
jobs.requirements: A grade 10 or equivalent qualification as recognised SAQA. Valid motor vehicle license as well as valid public driving permit. A minimum of 7 months driving experience. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of public service ethics and departmental transport. Ability to comply with driver's responsibility according to Treasury and PFMA. Good interpersonal relations, loyal, commitment, time management and accountability.
jobs.duties: Drive light and medium motor vehicles to transport passengers and deliver other items (mail and documents). Do routine maintenance on the allocated vehicle and reports defects timely. Complete all the required and prescribed records and log books with regard to the vehicle and the goods handled. Render a clerical support/messenger service in the relevant office.

af.title: Bestuurder
af.summary: Bestuurderpos by Thabo Mofutsanyane Distrikkantoor in die Free State, waarvoor Graad 10, 'n geldige lisensie en openbare bestuurpermit vereis word, met ten minste 7 maande se bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige motorvoertuiglisensie asook geldige openbare bestuurpermit. 'n Minimum van 7 maande se bestuurservaring. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van openbare diens-etiek en departementele vervoer. Vermoë om te voldoen aan die bestuurder se verantwoordelikheid volgens Treasury en PFMA. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, lojaal, toewyding, tydbestuur en verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Bestuur ligte en medium motorvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items (pos en dokumente) te lewer. Doen roetine-onderhoud aan die toegewysde voertuig en rapporteer tydig foute. Voltooi al die vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke met betrekking tot die voertuig en die goedere wat hanteer is. Lewer 'n skrywerige ondersteuning/koerierdiens in die betrokke kantoor.

zu.title: Umshayeli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somshayeli eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office eFree State, esidinga ibanga le-10, ilayisensi esebenzayo nephermiti yokushayela koluntu, okuhlanganisa nokuhlakanipha okungenani izinyanga eziyi-7 zokushayela.
zu.requirements: Ibanga lesi-10 noma iziqu ezilinganayo njengoba kubonwa uSAQA. Ilayisensi esebenzayo yemoto kanye nephermiti esebenzayo yokushayela koluntu. Okungenani izinyanga eziyi-7 zokushayela. Ulwazi nobukhono: Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwemithetho yasezikhungweni zikahulumende nangokuhamba kwezimoto zomnyango. Ikono lokuziphendulela ngemithwalo yomshayeli ngokwegunya leTreasury kanye ne-PFMA. Ubufundiswa obuhle abantu, ukuzithoba, ukuzibophezela, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi kanye nokuzelelwa isibopho.
zu.duties: Shayela izimoto ezibusayo neziningi ukuze uhambise abagibeli kanye nokuletha izinto ezinye (iposi namadokhumenti). Yenza ukunakekelwa okujwayelekile kwesimoto enikeziwe bese ubika iziphaziso ngokushesha. Gcwalisa yonke imibhalo edingekayo naleyo ethintelwe kanye namabhuku okuloga mayelana nendawo kanye nezinto ezibekwayo. Nikeza inkonzo yokweseka ezindaweni zokubhala/ngezenkosi ebhilidi elihlobene.

xh.title: Umshayeli
xh.summary: Isithuba somshayeli kwiOfisi kaThabo Mofutsanyana District kwi-Free State, esifuna iGrade 10, ilayisenesi esemthethweni nephayimithi yokushayela koluntu, enokunya okungazange kudlule kwezi ngenxa zoku-7 zeshishu.
xh.requirements: I-grade 10 okanye isifundo esalinganayo njengoko siyaziwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisenesi yemoto esemthethweni nakwipayimithi yokushayela koluntu esemthethweni. Okunguzimo encinci kwe-7 ngenyanga yokushayela. Ulwazi noBugcisa: Ulwazi ngobugcisa koluntu kwakunye nethrekhi yesebe. Ikhono lokuzalathisa ngemithwalo yomshayeli ngokweTreasury ne-PFMA. Izibophelelo ezilunge njalo, zithembekileyo, zinokuzinikela, ziphathe ngokuchaneka ixesha kwaye zibambe inqwaba.
xh.duties: Shayela izimoto ezilula nakwezangamnyama ukuthwala abagibi kwaye uze uhambise izinto ezinye (imeyile namaxwebhu). Yiza imizekelo ejwayelekileyo kwimoto enikelwe kwayo kwaye ucacise iimfutshane ngexesha. Gqibezela zonke iirekhodi neeloguthi ezifunekayo kwaye ezichaziwe ngokwemoto nangokwezinto eziphathwayo. Zisa inkonzo yeenkundla/yoncedo lomthwali wemiqxhobho kule ofisi ethile.

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.salary_text: R170 226 - R200 523 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Security officer needed at Thabo Mofutsanyana District Office in the Free State to perform access control and visitor management duties, requiring PSIRA Grade D registration.
jobs.requirements: Basic Education and Training (NQF level 3). Basic security officer's course. Grade D registration with PSIRA. No experience required. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of access control procedure. Knowledge of measure of control and movement of equipment & stores. Prescribes security procedures. e.g. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, Emergency Procedures. Communication skills, Read and write. Batho Pele Principles.
jobs.duties: Perform access control functions. Determine appointments/ or services that the visitors require. Contract relevant employee to confirm appointment or refer visitor to the relevant service delivery point. Complete or ensure that the admission control register is completed. Issue admission control documents/cards as required. Escort visitors to relevant employees/ venues where lock and unlock entrances. Ensure that unauthorised persons and dangerous objects do not enter the building/ premises. Follow-up on incidence. Undertake building/premises patrols. Identify and check doors are locked or unlocked as required. Check water leaks and that taps are closed. Identify and check fire hazards, exposed electrical contacts and other fire hazards. Check lights, switch on and off as required. Check suspicious objects and packages and report. Apply emergency procedures. Ensure safe keeping of equipment, documents and stores of the department complete registers to control the movement of equipment, stores and documents. Confirm that no equipment, stores and assets of the department leave the building/premises unauthorised. Inspect vehicles entering and leaving the premises. Gather information and report on missing and stolen equipment and stores. Handle documents at points of entry according to classification and the prescript.

af.title: Sekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Sekuriteitsbeampte benodig by Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrikkantoor in die Free State om toegangsbeheer- en besoekerbestuurspligte te verrig, waarvoor PSIRA Graad D-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Basiese Onderwys en Opleiding (NQF vlak 3). Basiese sekuriteitsbeampte-kursus. Graad D-registrasie met PSIRA. Geen ondervinding vereis nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van toegangsbeheerprosedure. Kennis van maatreëls van beheer en beweging van toerusting & stores. Voorskryf sekuriteitsprosedures. bv. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, Noodprosedures. Kommunikasievaardighede, Lees en skryf. Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Verrig toegangsbeheerfunksies. Bepaal afsprake/ of dienste wat die besoekers benodig. Kontak relevante werknemer om afspraak te bevestig of verwys besoeker na die relevante diensleweringspunt. Voltooi of verseker dat die toelatingsbeheerregister voltooi is. Reik toelatingsbeheerdokumente/kaarte uit soos vereis. Begelei besoekers na relevante werknemers/ plekke waar toegange gesluit en ontsluit word. Verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe nie die gebou/ perseel binnegaan nie. Volg voorvalle na. Onderneem gebou/perseelpatrollies. Identifiseer en kontroleer of deure gesluit of ontsluit is soos vereis. Kontroleer waterlekke en dat krane toe is. Identifiseer en kontroleer brandgevare, blootgestelde elektriese kontakte en ander brandgevare. Kontroleer ligte, skakel aan en af soos vereis. Kontroleer verdagte voorwerpe en pakkette en rapporteer. Pas noodprosedures toe. Verseker veilige bewaring van toerusting, dokumente en stores van die departement voltooi registers om die beweging van toerusting, stores en dokumente te beheer. Bevestig dat geen toerusting, stores en bates van die departement ongemagtig die gebou/perseel verlaat nie. Inspekteer voertuie wat die perseel bingaan en verlaat. Versamel inligting en rapporteer oor vermiste en gesteelde toerusting en stores. Hanteer dokumente by toegangspunte volgens klassifikasie en die voorskrif.

zu.summary: Kudingeka inkosi yokuvikela eThabo Mofutsanyana District Office eFree State ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena nokuphathwa kwezivakashi, kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwe-PSIRA Grade D.
zu.requirements: Basic Education and Training (NQF level 3). Ikilasi elisisisekelo senkosi yokuvikela. Ukubhaliswa kwe-Grade D ne-PSIRA. Akukho mlando wokuqasha odingekayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi mayelana nendlela yokulawula ukungena. Ulwazi mayelana nendlela yokulawula kanye nokuhamba kwezokuthutha & izitolo. Izinqubo ezibalulekile zokuvikela. Ngok. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, Izinqubo Zezesimo Esiphuthumayo. Amakhono okuxhumana, ukufunda nokubhala. Izimiso zikaBatho Pele.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena. Qinisekisa izinhlelo zokugqashula noma izinsiza abazingivakashi abidingayo. Thintana nomsebenzi ofanele ukuqinisekisa ukugqashula noma uholele umuntu ephazini elifanele lokuletha insiza. Qedela noma qinisekisa ukuthi irekhodi yokulawula ukungena igqityiwe. Nikela amadokhumenti/amakhadi okulawula ukungena njengoba kudingekile. Hambisa izivakashi kubasebenzi abafanele/ lapho kufaka kanye nezikhezo ezingena. Qinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangavunyelwe kanye nezinto ezingozwakalayo zingangeni esakhiweni/ endaweni. Landela izehloko. Yiza nokuhlola izakhiwo/ izindawo. Hlola futhi qinisekisa ukuthi amacashi abivaliwe noma avuliwe njengoba kudingekile. Hlola ukuphuka kwamanzi kanye nokuthi imitapo iyavaliwe. Hlola kanti ubuke izingozi zomlilo, okuthintana ngokagesi okuveziwe kanye nezinye izingozi zomlilo. Hlola ukukhanya, vula futhi uvale njengoba kudingekile. Hlola izinto ezisolayo namaphakethe ubike. Faka izinqubo zezesimo esiphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezokuthutha, amadokhumenti nezitolo zomnyango qeda ukugcwalisa izinhlu ukulawula ukuhamba kwezokuthutha, izitolo kanye namadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho zokuthutha, izitolo kanye nezimpahla zomnyango ziphuma esakhiweni/ endaweni zingavunyelwe. Hlola izimoto zingena kanye neziphuma endaweni. Qoqa ulwazi futhi usho izokuthutha, izitolo ezilahlekile kanye nezibiwile. Phatha amadokhumenti lapho kungena ngokwemigqa kanye nendlela ebalulekile.

xh.title: Isebe Lokhuseleko
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhokeli sokhuseleko kwiOfisi yesiSithili sase Thabo Mofutsanyana kwi Free State ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi yolawulo lwengenelo nolawulo lababakeli, kufuneka kubekho ubhaliso lwesigaba D kwi PSIRA.
xh.requirements: Imfundo eyimveliso nephiliso (NQF level 3). Ikholeji yemisebenzi yesebe lokhuseleko. Ubhaliso lwesigaba D kwi PSIRA. Akukho mpumelelo efunekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwenkqubo yolawulo lwengenelo. Ulwazi lwezinyithi zolawulo noluhhamo lwezixhobo & iindawo zokugcina. Umthetho wemigaqo yokhuseleko. Umz. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, Iinkqubo zeMvingo. Amakhono okunxibelelana, Ukufunda nokubhala. Iimigaqo zeBatho Pele.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwengenelo. Qinisekisa iintembisano/ okanye iinkonzo ezingafunwa ngumvakeli. Thintana nomsebenzi othintekayo ukuze uqinisekise intembisano okanye uqulunge umvakeli kwindawo ephathhekileyo yokuzezekisa inkonzo. Qedlula okanye qinisekisa ukuba irekhodi yolawulo lwangengenelo igqityiwe. Nikela amaxwebhu/khadi olawulo lwengengenelo njengoko kufuneka. Qhuba ababakeli kumsebenzi othintekayo/ kwindawo apho kuthyangwa nokuvalwa amnyango. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu abangenamtshintsho nezinto ezingozi zingangeni kwakhiwo/ endaweni. Landelela iimeko ezenzekileyo. Yenza ukuhamba-hamba kwakhiwo/ endaweni. Bonisa ukuze uqinisekise ukuba amnyango avaliwe okanye avuliwe njengoko kufuneka. Khangela ukutyhola amanzi aphantsi kwaye uqinisekise ukuba imiqobo ivaliwe. Bonisa kwaye uqinisekise iingozi zomlilo, uqhagamshelo olungalunganga lwamandla kwaye nazanye iingozi zomlilo. Khangela iibhulbhu, uvule kuvale njengoko kufuneka. Khangela izinto ezikrakaxiweyo namaphakethe uze uxelo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zeMvingo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezixhobo, amaxwebhu nendawo zokugcina zesebe uze uqedlule amarekhodi ukuze ulawule ukuhamba-hamba kwezixhobo, iindawo zokugcina namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba akukho zixhobo, iindawo zokugcina nanempahla zesebe ezingaphuma kwakhiwo/ endaweni zingazange zivunyelwe. Hlola iimoto ezingenayo nsezihamba endaweni. Qokelela ulwazi uze uxele ngezixhobo ngeendawo zokugcina ezilahlekileyo nasezibyiweyo. Phatha amaxwebhu kumaphandle ongenelo ngokwezinga lomthetho wokwahluka nokumisela.

Thetha neenqanaba ezifanelekileyo zomvuzo ukuqinisekisa ukuba onke amaqweqwe ePERSAL afakwe kakuhle ngokwelisigqibo esityayiniweyo sokuyeka.

jobs.reference_number: REFS/057142 Branch: Chief Directorate: Economic Empowerment and Transformation
jobs.title: Chief Director: Economic Empowerment and
jobs.summary: Chief Director leading economic empowerment and transformation policy development within the Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Economics/Development Studies / Public Policy / Public Administration/ Business Administration. A postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage Nyukela Certificate for entry into SMS (Senior Management Service) from the National School of Government submitted prior to appointment. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at senior management level in Economic Empowerment and Transformation environment. Code 8/10.
jobs.duties: Lead the development and implementation of strategic plans for economic empowerment and transformation. Oversee the formulation of policies that support inclusive economic growth and monitor their effectiveness. Evaluate and identify barriers to economic empowerment faced by historically disadvantaged groups. Support the implementation of policies and initiatives to promote entrepreneurship and economic inclusion among groups. Guide the development of partnerships with private enterprises and NGOs to create opportunities for skills development and capacity-building. Assess the impact of empowerment programmes on improving socio-economic conditions. Advocate for policies and regulations that support the economic upliftment of marginalised communities. Collaborate with educational institutions to create pathways for education and training for underrepresented groups. Engage with government officials, community leaders and stakeholders to ensure programmes are culturally sensitive and inclusive. Develop a strategic roadmap for targeted programmes aimed at industry development and economic transformation. Allocate resources and funding to support the implementation of the programs across key sectors. Collaborate with industry leaders to identify growth opportunities and address bottlenecks hindering transformation. Monitor program implementation to ensure alignment with transformation objectives and desired outcomes. Evaluate the effectiveness of industry-focused initiatives in driving economic transformation. Facilitate access to markets and investment opportunities for emerging businesses from historically marginalised backgrounds. Conduct regular assessments to measure the impact of the programs on industry growth and transformation. Guide the implementation of programmes to promote industrial development, transformation of industries and to enhance competitiveness. Manage the development and implementation of mechanisms to monitor equity ownership by previously disadvantaged groups as well as compliance and enforcement of BBBEE codes. Assess the implementation of BBBEE and local production and content compliance. Provide advisory services regarding various transformation charters. Lead the development of strategies to bridge the gap between job seekers and employment opportunities, especially for marginalised groups. Establish partnerships with public and private entities to create job placement programs. Manage and guide the designing of initiatives to support entrepreneurship as a means of job creation and economic participation. Monitor labour market trends and analyse data to identify areas with high potential for job creation. Collaborate with educational institutions to align curricula with market demands and promote skills development for employability. Oversee mentorship and coaching programs to prepare individuals for employment or entrepreneurship. Advocate for inclusive hiring practices within businesses and organisations. Build and maintain partnerships with public and private sector entities. Facilitate dialogue and cooperation among stakeholders to advance inclusive economic growth, transformation and empowerment. Provide expert advice to government and relevant stakeholders on inclusive economic growth, transformation and empowerment. Represent the department in forums and committees related to inclusive economic growth, transformation and empowerment. Perform strategic and operational planning. Oversee the administrative support functions. Perform people management functions. Perform financial management functions. Perform asset management functions.

Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department.
