af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Ekonomiese Bemagtiging en
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur wat ekonomiese bemagtiging en transformasiebeleidontwikkeling binne die Gauteng Department of Economic Development lei.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Economie/Development Studies/Public Policy/Public Administration/Business Administration. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toetrede tot SMS (Senior Management Service) van die National School of Government voor aanstelling ingedien. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in 'n ekonomiese bemagtigings- en transformasie-omgewing. Code 8/10.
af.duties: Lê die ontwikkeling en implementering van strategiese planne vir ekonomiese bemagtiging en transformasie. Hou toesig oor die formulering van beleide wat inklusiewe ekonomiese groei ondersteun en monitor hul doeltreffendheid. Evalueer en identifiseer struikelblokke tot ekonomiese bemagtiging wat deur histories benadeelde groepe in die gesig gestaar word. Ondersteun die implementering van beleide en inisiatiewe om entrepreneurskap en ekonomiese insluiting onder groepe te bevorder. Lei die ontwikkeling van vennootskappe met private ondernemings en NGO's om geleenthede vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en kapasiteitsbou te skep. Assesseer die impak van bemagtigingsprogramme op die verbetering van sosio-ekonomiese toestande. Pleit vir beleide en regulasies wat die ekonomiese verheffing van gemarginaliseerde gemeenskappe ondersteun. Werk saam met opvoedkundige instellings om paaie vir opvoeding en opleiding vir onderverteenwoordigde groepe te skep. Skakel met regeringsamptenare, gemeenskapsleiers en belanghebbendes om te verseker dat programme kultureel sensitief en inklusief is. Ontwikkel 'n strategiese padkaart vir geteikende programme wat op bedryfsontwikkeling en ekonomiese transformasie gemik is. Ken bronne en befondsing toe om die implementering van die programme oor kernsektore te ondersteun. Werk saam met bedryfsleiers om groeigeleenthede te identifiseer en knelpunte wat transformasie in die wiele staar, aan te spreek. Monitor programimplementering om belyning met transformasiedoelwitte en verlangde uitkomste te verseker. Evalueer die doeltreffendheid van bedryfsgefokusde inisiatiewe in die aandrywing van ekonomiese transformasie. Fasiliteer toegang tot markte en beleggingsgeleenthede vir ontluikende besighede uit histories gemarginaliseerde agtergronde. Voer gereelde assesserings uit om die impak van die programme op bedryfsgroei en transformasie te meet. Lei die implementering van programme om nywerheidsontwikkeling, transformasie van bedrywe en om mededingendheid te bevorder. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van meganismes om aandelebesit deur voorheen benadeelde groepe te monitor, asook nakom en handhawing van BBBEE-kodes. Assesseer die implementering van BBBEE en plaaslike produksie- en inhoudsnakoming. Verskaf adviesdienste rakende diverse transformasiehandves. Lei die ontwikkeling van strategieë om die gaping tussen werksoekers en indiensnemingsgeleenthede te oorbrug, veral vir gemarginaliseerde groepe. Vestig vennootskappe met openbare en private entiteite om werkplasingsprogramme te skep. Bestuur en lei die ontwerp van inisiatiewe om entrepreneurskap as 'n middel tot werkskepping en ekonomiese deelname te ondersteun. Monitor arbeidsmarkneigings en analiseer data om gebiede met hoë potensiaal vir werkskepping te identifiseer. Werk saam met opvoedkundige instellings om kurrikula met markvereistes te bely en vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir indiensneembaarheid te bevorder. Hou toesig oor mentorskap- en afrigtingsprogramme om individue vir indiensneming of entrepreneurskap voor te berei. Pleit vir inklusiewe werwingspraktyke binne besighede en organisasies. Bou en handhaaf vennootskappe met openbare en privatesektorentiteite. Fasiliteer dialoog en samewerking tussen belanghebbendes om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, transformasie en bemagtiging te bevorder. Verskaf kundige advies aan die regering en relevante belanghebbendes oor inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, transformasie en bemagtiging. Verteenwoordig die departement in forums en komitees wat verband hou met inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, transformasie en bemagtiging. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Hou toesig oor die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer menslike bestuursfunksies uit. Voer finansiële bestuursfunksies uit. Voer batebestuursfunksies uit.

zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Amandla Okuthuthukisa Iqhazimaguguneli
zu.summary: Umqondisi Omkhulu ohola intuthuko yamasu okwamandla okuthuthukisa iqhazimaguguneli kanye nentuthuko phakathi kukaGauteng Department of Economic Development.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeNQF level 7 ku-Economics/Development Studies / Public Policy / Public Administration/ Business Administration. Iziqu zesiqu esiphakeme kuzoba ngumvuzo wokungeza; Isitifikedi seNyukela sokungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) esitholakale esikoleni seNational School of Government sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yohlelo emazingeni aphakeme eabaphathi kwindawo yeEconomic Empowerment and Transformation. Code 8/10.
zu.duties: HOLA intuthukisiso kanye nokuphumelelisa amasu aphelele ekuqhubeni amandla okuthuthukisa iqhazimaguguneli kanye nentuthuko. Qaphisela ukwakhiwa kwamasu axhasa ukukhula kweqhazimaguguneli okuhlanganayo futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwawo. Hlola futhi uhlonze izithiyo ekuqhubeni amandla eqhazimaguguneli abhekene nakho amaqembu alaswela imali esikhathini esidlule. Xhasa ukuphumelelisa amasu kanye nemitapo yokukhuthaza ubumnini weqhazimaguguneli nokuhlanganisa kwamaqembu ezoqoqosho. Qondisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlangano zobuhlobo namabhizinisi anamasha kanye ne-NGO ukudala ithuba lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokwakhiwa kwamandla. Hlola ukuthi imitapo yokunika amandla iqhazimaguguneli inthusha kanjani izimo eziyinzuzo eziyisikhathi eside. Sibeka amasu kanye nemithetho exhasa ukuphakanyiswa kweqhazimaguguneli kwezindawo ezingabi mnandi. Sebenzisana nezikhungo zemfundo ukudala izindlela zemfundo kanye nokuqeqesha ngamabhinqa abekekile. Zama ukuxhumana nezikhulu kahulumeni, abaholi bemiphakathi kanye nalabo abahilelekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba imitapo iyabeke ngokwesiko futhi ihlanganise bonke. Thuthukisa isu elibhekiswe emitapweni ehlose ukuthuthukisa imikhakha kanye nentuthuko yezoqoqosho. Aba imithombo kanye nemali yokuxhasa ukuphumelelisa imitapo kumikhakha ebalulekile. Sebenzisana nabaholi bemikhakha ukuze kuhlonze ithuba lokukhula futhi kuxazulule izithiyo ezibeka intuthuko. Qapha ukuphumeleliswa kwemitapo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nenhloso yentuthuko kanye nemiphumela ehlosiwe. Hlola ukusebenza kwemitapo ehlose imikhakha ekukhuthazeneni ukuqhuba iqhazimaguguneli. Yisa ithuba lokufinyelela emakethe kanye nematuba eziyizimali kubumnini bomshini osanda kuqala abasuka kumaphulo abekekile. Yenza izinhlelo ezivamayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imitapo inthusha kanjani ukukhula kwemikhakha kanye nentuthuko. Qondisa ukuphumelelwa kwemitapo yokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha, ukuqhuba iqhazimaguguneli kwemikhakha kanye nokuqinisa amandla. Lawula ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphumelelisa izindlela zokuqaphela ubumnini obulinganayo ngamaqembu abekekile kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kanye nokuphoqelelwa kwamakhodi e-BBBEE. Hlola ukuphumelelwa kwe-BBBEE kanye nokulandelwa kokukhiqizwa kwesikhathi sonke. Nikeza izinkundla zokubonisana mayelana namatshali entuthuko ahlukene. Hola ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokubeka abafuna imisebenzi eduze kwamathuba omsebenzi, ikakhulukazi kumaqembu abekekile. Sula izinhlangano zobuhlobo nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kanye nezangezantsi zomphakathi ukudala imitapo yokuqashwa komsebenzi. Lawula futhi uqondise ukwakhiwa kwemitapo yokuxhasa ubumnini bomshini njengendlela yokudala imisebenzi kanye nokuqhathaniswa ezoqoqosho. Qapha izimpande zesimo somsebenzi futhi uhlaziye idatha ukuze uhlonze izindawo ezithwe isidlana esiphezulu sokudala imisebenzi. Sebenzisana nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze ulinganise izifundo nezidingo zomphakathi futhi ukhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ukuze kutholwe umsebenzi. Qaphisela imitapo yokubaluleka kanye neyokuqeqesha ukuze alunge abantu besebenzini noma kubumnini bomshini. Khuthaza izindlela zokuqasha abantu ezihlanganayo ezinhlanganweni nakumaphakathi. Sakaza futhi ugcine izinhlangano zobuhlobo nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kanye nezangesenza sezantshi. Bhekisa inkulumo kanye nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabahilelekile ukuze kuqhutywe iqhazimaguguneli okuhlanganayo, ukuthuthuka nokwamukelwa. Nikeza inceku ecebile kahulumeni nalabo abahilelekile ngesinqumo sokukhula okuhlanganayo, intuthuko nokwamukelwa. Yenza isikhundla kumnyango emihlanganweni nakumakomidi ahlobene nokukhula kweqhazimaguguneli okuhlanganayo, intuthuko nokwamukelwa. Yenza ukulandelwa kwezindlela kanye nokuhlelwa. Qaphisela izinkundla zokusekela ngokomphatho. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha abantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula imali. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha impahla.

xh.title: IChief Director: Economic Empowerment and
xh.summary: IChief Director ekhokela inkqubo yokuzinovatha kwezoqoqoshe nokuguqulwa kweenkqubo ngaphakathi kwisebe le-Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
xh.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Economics/Development Studies / Public Policy / Public Administration/ Business Administration. A postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage Nyukela Certificate for entry into SMS (Senior Management Service) from the National School of Government submitted prior to appointment. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at senior management level in Economic Empowerment and Transformation environment. Code 8/10.
xh.duties: Qhatha ekulungiseni nasekuhlalweni kwamakhongo apho auqonda ukuzinovatha nokuguqulwa kwezoqoqoshe. Qhatha ekulungiseni iinkqubo ezixhasa ukukhula okuqukelelayo kwezoqoqoshe ulawule nokusebenza kwazo. Qinisekisa nokuchaza iintende ekuzinovatheni kwezoqoqoshe ezibhekiswa kwiziqokelelo nabantu abafumana nzalo engundoqo yokutsalwa emva yemigangatho. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo neenkqubo ezintsha ezonyusa ubuchwepheshe nokuzinovatha phakathi kwesiqokelelo sabantu. Qhatha ekuphuhlisweni kwezidingo zomanyano nemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo kwaye unike amathuba okuqeqeswa nokwakhiwa abantu. Linganisela umphumo wenkqubo ezixhasa ukuzinovatha ekuphuculeni iimeko zoluntu nasekuqhubeni kwemisebenzi yomntu qwaphi. Qinisekisa amanqaku amakhulu, kunye nezindlu ezixhasa ukuphuculwa kwekoloni nabafuni nto kuzo zonke iindawo zokuphila kwesi songa esisodwa. Qingcwala ngamanye amanqaku abakhusela ukuba nabakho abantu abafuna iliso ekubeni bafumana nzalo engundoqo yokutsalwa emva yemigangatho. Sebenzela koluntu nabasebenzi bakarhulumente, iindlu zoluntu nabantu abafuna nto kuzo zonke iindawo, ukuyiqonda nokulawula imisebenzi. Nika amanqaku okubakuqondisa koluntu nakoluntu. Lungiselela amathuba emisebenzi ekuqhubeni koluntu nabantu abafuna nto abantu ababakho. Nika amanqaku okuba bagcine amathuba okuqeqeswa kwamakhono emisebenzi koluntu nasekubeni ngamathambo amanqaku apho kulindeleke ukuba kwenziwe umbono wobulungisa kwelinye iqela. Qhatha ekuphuhlisweni kwezindlela ezikhoyo ezilungele idilesi yomsebenzi nokuphuculwa koluntu nakuluntu nakuluntu. Yenza amanqaku abakhusela uluntu ekuphuculeni iindlela ezisuka kumthetho weqanda nokwenza inkqubo eqondwayo.

jobs.title: Director: Smme & Cooperative Support
jobs.summary: Director position leading SMME and cooperative development strategy for the Gauteng Department of Economic Development, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' management experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Economics/Development Studies / Business Management / Public Administration / Public Management qualifications Nyukela Certificate for entry into SMS (Senior Management Service) from the National School of Government submitted prior to appointment. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle/ senior management level in SMMEs and Co-operatives environment. Code 8/10.
jobs.duties: Develop the SMME development strategy for the GCR economy. Lead and report on the implementation of the SMME development strategy across the province. Align SMME and Co-operative policies with broader economic development strategies. Champion the implementation of the Township Economic Development Act. Identify priority sectors for targeted support and investment. Develop incentive schemes to stimulate entrepreneurship and co- operative formation. Integrate policies with local economic development (LED) initiatives. Foster linkages between SMMEs, Co-operatives, and value chains. Measure economic impact through job creation, income generation, and productivity. Use data analytics to refine strategies and scale successful interventions. Conduct needs assessment to identify the specific non-financial support services required by SMMEs and Co-operatives. Develop strategic partnerships with government agencies, private sector entities, and non-profit services for SMMEs and Co-operatives organizations to deliver a diverse range of support services. Create a centralised platform that provides easy access to information and resources related to non-financial support services. Implement targeted training programs and workshops focusing on business management, marketing, legal compliance, and other relevant areas. Establish a robust monitoring and evaluation system to assess the impact of support services and refine them based on feedback and performance data. Launch outreach and awareness campaigns using multiple communication channels to ensure SMMEs and Co-operatives are informed about available support services. Leverage government grants, private sector investment, and donor funding to ensure sustainable financial support for incubators. Engage industry professionals and successful entrepreneurs to mentor and advise incubated SMMEs and Co-operatives. Offer targeted training, workshops, and seminars on business planning, marketing, compliance, and financial literacy. Track performance and growth of incubated enterprises to tailor support and improve incubator effectiveness. Facilitate networks among incubators to exchange best practices, share resources, and replicate successful models. Lead outreach programmes to identify and support emerging community enterprises. Provide localised training tailored to rural and underserved areas. Establish community enterprise hubs for shared resources and collaboration. Promote youth and women participation in enterprise development. Facilitate partnerships with local municipalities and development agencies. Support community-led sustainability initiatives. Track social impact metrics to guide future interventions. Strengthen evidence-based decision-making and innovation. Partner with universities and think tanks to conduct sector studies, impact assessments, and policy research. Create platforms for SMMEs and Co-operatives to connect with investors, suppliers, and customers. Use surveys, interviews, or focus groups to understand stakeholder needs and improve engagement strategies. Partner with government departments, NGOs, and private sector entities to pool resources and align efforts. Perform strategic and operational planning. Oversee the administrative support functions. Perform people management functions. Perform financial management functions. Perform asset management functions.
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: SMME- en Koöperatiewe Ondersteuning
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat SMME- en koöperatiewe ontwikkelingstrategie vir die Gauteng Department of Economic Development lei, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Ekonomie/Ontwikkelingstudies / Besigheidsbestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur kwalifikasies. Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toetrede tot SMS (Senior Management Service) van die National School of Government wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/ seniorbestuursvlak in 'n SMME- en Koöperatiewe omgewing. Kode 8/10.
af.duties: Ontwikkel die SMME-ontwikkelingstrategie vir die GCR-ekonomie. Lei en rapporteer oor die implementering van die SMME-ontwikkelingstrategie oor die provinsie heen. Belyn SMME- en Koöperatiewe beleide met breër ekonomiese ontwikkelingstrategieë. Ondersteun die implementering van die Township Economic Development Act. Identifiseer prioriteitssektore vir geteikende ondersteuning en belegging. Ontwikkel aansporigingskemas om entrepreneurskap en koöperatiewe vorming te stimuleer. Integreer beleide met plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling (LED)-inisiatiewe. Bevorder skakels tussen SMME's, Koöperatiewe en waardekettings. Meet ekonomiese impak deur werk skepping, inkomste generering en produktiwiteit. Gebruik data-analise om strategieë te verfyn en suksesvolle ingrypings te skaal. Voer behoeftebepalings uit om die spesifieke nie-finansiële ondersteuningsdienste wat deur SMME's en Koöperatiewe benodig word, te identifiseer. Ontwikkel strategiese vennootskappe met regeringsagentskappe, privaatsektor-entiteite en nie-winsgewende dienste vir SMME- en Koöperatiewe organisasies om 'n diverse reeks ondersteuningsdienste te lewer. Skep 'n gesentraliseerde platform wat maklike toegang tot inligting en hulpbronne met betrekking tot nie-finansiële ondersteuningsdienste bied. Implementeer geteikende opleidingsprogramme en werkswinkels wat op besigheidsbestuur, bemarking, regsonderhoud en ander relevante areas fokus. Stig 'n robuuste moniterings- en evalueringstelsel om die impak van ondersteuningsdienste te assesseer en dit op grond van terugvoer en prestasiedata te verfyn. Loos uitreik- en bewustheidsveldtogte deur middel van veelvuldige kommunikasiekanale om te verseker dat SMME's en Koöperatiewe ingelig word oor beskikbare ondersteuningsdienste. Benut regeringsubsidies, privaatsektorbelegging en skenkerbelywings om volhoubare finansiële ondersteuning vir inkubeerders te verseker. Betrek bedryfsprofessionele persone en suksesvolle entrepreneurs om geïnkubeerde SMME's en Koöperatiewe te mentor en te adviseer. Bied geteikende opleiding, werkswinkels en seminare oor besigheidsbeplanning, bemarking, nakoming en finansiële geletterdheid aan. Hou prestasie en groei van geïnkubeerde ondernemings dop om ondersteuning te pas en inkubeerderdoeltreffendheid te verbeter. Fasiliteer netwerke onder inkubeerders om beste praktyke uit te ruil, hulpbronne te deel en suksesvolle modelle na te boots. Lei uitreikprogramme om opkomende gemeenskapsondernemings te identifiseer en te ondersteun. Bied gelokaliseerde opleiding wat op landelike en onderbediende gebiede toegespits is. Stig gemeenskapsondernemingspunte vir gedeelde hulpbronne en samewerking. Bevordery jeug- en vrouepartisipasie in ondernemingsontwikkeling. Fasiliteer vennootskappe met plaaslike munisipaliteite en ontwikkelingsagentskappe. Ondersteun gemeenskapsgeleide volhoubaarheidsinisiatiewe. Hou sosiale impakmetings dop om toekomstige ingrypings te rig. Versterk op bewyse gebaseerde besluitneming en innovasie. Werk saam met universiteite en dinktenks om sektorstudies, impakassesserings en beleidsnavorsing uit te voer. Skep platforms vir SMME's en Koöperatiewe om met beleggers, verskaffers en kliënte te verbind. Gebruik opnames, onderhoude of fokusgroepe om belanghebbendes se behoeftes te verstaan en betrokkenheidsstrategieë te verbeter. Werk saam met regeringsdepartemente, NGO's en privaatsektor-entiteite om hulpbronne byeen te bring en pogings te belyn. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Hou toesig oor die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer mensebestuursfunksies uit. Voer finansiële bestuursfunksies uit. Voer batesbestuursfunksies uit.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukwesekwa kwe-SMME & Amakho-opherethivu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi sokukhokhela inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwe-SMME nakamakho-opherethivu kuGauteng Department of Economic Development, esidinga iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 namafive years' okuhlakanipha ekuphatweni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kwi-Economics/Development Studies / Business Management / Public Administration / Public Management. Isitifiketi se-Nyukela sokungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) esivela ku-National School of Government kufanele sincithwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukuhlakanipha okungu-5 years' okuncane ezingeni lokuphathwa phakathi/ phezulu kwindawo ye-SMMEs nakamakho-opherethivu. Code 8/10.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwe-SMME ekonomi ye-GCR. Hola futhi ubike ngokusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwe-SMME kulo lonke iphovinsi. Hambisanisa amapholisi we-SMME nakamakho-opherethivu neminqubo ebanzi yokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Ukuba ngumphekisi ekusetshenzisweni kwe-Township Economic Development Act. Hlola izigaba ezibalulekile zokwesekwa okuhlosiwe nakotshalwe imali. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokweseka ukukhuthaza ukubangwa komsebenzi nokwakhiwa kwamakho-opherethivu. Hlanganisa amapholisi nemigqundo yokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho yendawo (LED). Khuthaza izinhlonzi phakathi kwe-SMMEs, amakho-opherethivu, namasentingi enani. Kala umthelela wezomnotho ngokudalwa kwemisebenzi, ukukhiqizwa kwemali, nokusebenza kahle. Sebenzisa ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze ulungise amaqhingi futhi ukhulise ukungenelela okupumelelile. Yenza ukuhlola izidingo ukuze uqeqeshe izidingo ezithile zokwesekwa okungeyona ezezimali ezidingwa yi-SMMEs namakho-opherethivu. Thuthukisa ubudlelwano obuyisinqa nemisebenzi kahulumeni, izinhlangano zangasese, nezinsiza ezingenzi inzuzo ezinhlanganweni ze-SMME namakho-opherethivu ukuletha uhlu oluhlukene lwezinsiza zokwesekwa. Dala isikhungo esisendaweni esinike ukufinyelela okulula kwolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene nezinsiza zokwesekwa ezingezona ezezimali. Phetha amaqhoshiswe okuzuliswa kohlelo kanye namawokishophu ahlongeka ekuphathweni kwamabhizinisi, ekuthengisweni, ekuhambisaneni ngomthetho, nakwezinye izindawo ezihlobene. Misela uhlelo oluqinile lokuqapha nokuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe umthelela wezinsiza zokwesekwa futhi zilungiswe ngokusekelwe emvimweni nasedathini yokuqhuba. Qalisa imigqundo yokukhuluma nabantu nokuqaphisa ngokusebenzisa iziteshini ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi ama-SMME namakho-opherethivu atsheliwe ngamanye amahlelo okwesekwa akhona. Sebenzisa izibonelelo zikahulumeni, tshalo imali yomphakathi, kanye nemali yokweseka abanikazi bemibhalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukwesekwa okuzinzile ngokwezimali kubasabalalisi. Xhumanisa ochwepheshe bezentimboni nabantu abaphumelele emsebenzini ukuze bakho futhi banikezelwe ngokwesaba ku-SMME namakho-opherethivu abasabalalisiwe. Nikeza ukuzuliswa okuhlosiwe, amawokishobha, kanye namasemina ngokuqamba amabhizinisi, ukuthengisa, ukuhambisana nomthetho, nokuqonda ngeziyalo zezimali. Landela ukusebenza kahle nokukhula kwamabhizinisi abasabalalisiwe ukuze ukwesekwa kulinganiswe kanye nokuphuculwe ukusebenza kwesabalalisi. Lenza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabasabalalisi ukushintshanisa amasu aphezulu, ukwabelana ngezinsiza, futhi kubuyisele izifanekiso eziphumelele. Hola imigqundo yokukhuluma nabantu ukuze batholwe futhi beseke izinhlangano zomphakathi ezibuthakathaka. Nikeza ukuzuliswa kwasendaweni okulinganiswe kumakhaya angaselwa kanye nendawo ephuthelwe. Misela izikhungo zokuba izinhlangano zendawo ngokwabelana ngezinsiza nokusebenzisana. Khuthaza ukuthathana okuyintsha nakabesimame ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlangano. Yenza ubuhlobo kahulumeni nemakhaya endawo kanye nabathuthukisi. Sekela imigqundo yokulondolozwa ekhokhwa umphakathi. Landela izinkomba zomthelela wokwakha ukuze kuhole kokuzele ngaphambili. Pucukisa ukuzuma izinqumo ngokusekelwe kubufakeli kanye nokutakula okusha. Hlanganisa namanye amanyuvesi namasiko essocense ukuze kwenziwe izifundo zezigaba, ukuqashwa komthelela, kanye nentolaluyochibo. Dala iziteshini ze-SMME namakho-opherethivu ukuzoxhumanisa nabatshalimali, abathengisi, nabanikibuzo. Sebenzisa izingxoxo, izingcingo, noma amaqembu okugxila ekutheni uqonde izidingo zokubambisana bese ukuthuthukisa imigqundo yokuzibandakanya. Yenza ubuhlobo neminyango kahulumeni, ama-NGO, kanye nezinhlangano zangasese ukuze kuqoqe izinsiza futhi kuhlanganiswe umzamo. Yenza ukuhlela okuyisinqa futhi okusebenzayo. Qapha imisebenzi yezinsiza zokuphatha. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha abantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha imali. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha impahla.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Inkxaso ye-SMME & Kwabasebenzisana
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli sikhokela iindlela zentluko ye-SMME nakwabasebenzisana kwisebe leGauteng Department of Economic Development, lifuna izifundo ze-NQF Level 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ze-NQF Level 7 kwi-Economics/Development Studies / Business Management / Public Administration / Public Management. Ifestile yeNyukela Certificate yokungena kwi-SMS (Senior Management Service) esuka kwi-National School of Government ezalathiswe ngaphambi kokuziswa esikhundleni. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-5 kwinqanaba lolawulo laphakathi/ aphezulu kwimeko ye-SMMEs and Co-operatives. Code 8/10.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa iindlela zentluko ye-SMME ze-erekhonomi ye-GCR. Qhoboshela emva kwaye uchaze ngenkululeko malunga nokusetyenziswa kweindlela zentluko ye-SMME kunye neembonakaliso ezingasentla nasemzini wonke. Linganisa iindlela-politiki ze-SMME ne-Co-operative ngee-strategies ezibanzi zentluko. Zama ukuphumeza isiTyhute se-Township Economic Development Act. Chonga iindawo ezibalulekileyo zenkxaso ejiwayelekileyo netyalomali. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokukhuthaza ezokusuka kumatyala kwintswebho nakumanyano lwabasebenzi. Xenya iindlela-politiki nokuqaliswa kwentluko yemida yeedolophu (LED). Khuthaza uqhagamshelwano phakathi kwe-SMME, i-Co-operatives, neqhina lexabiso. Linganisa ithonya le-erekhonomi ngokwenza amathambo, ukwenza imali, nokuphakamisa ukusebenza. Sebenzisa ukwahlulwa-hlulwa kweenani ukuze ulungise iindlela nokwandisa iindlela eziphumelelayo. Yenza ukuvavanya iimfuno ukuze kuchongwe iinkxaso ezingezo zemali ezizodwa efunwa yi-SMME ne-Co-operatives. Phuhlisa ubudlelwane bokuzela namakhasimkhasi, iidolophu, iinkampani, namaqembu abancedisi abangekho nzuzweni kumazwe ngamazwe ngokubanzi ekunikelweni iinkxaso eziyindidi-ngaphakathi. Yiza indawo eqhelekileyo ethi ihlala ixhobela inkxaso kubomi bethu kwiinkqubo zokukhulisa namazwe apha ngqo kwindalo ngokungagqibekanga okukhoyo. Phumeza ukunyanzeleka okukhethiweyo kweenkqubo ezithobela iindlela-politiki ezixhomeke kumthetho nokusebenza koluntu, iinkqubo ezijoliswe ekuxhaseni iinkampani, iinkqubo ezichwetheza kwezamashishini, iinkqubo zokukhuthaza kwezommandla, iinkqubo zokubonisa nokuxhasa. Khuthaza ngokumalunga ne-festile yabantu abatsha amashishini neenhlangano ezinamava amakhulu. Khangela iinkqubo ezikhethekileyo zokuphucula inkxaso ekukhuliseni amashishini kubantu abatsha nabafazi. Khuthaza ukuzimisela nokubakho kokusebenzisana nemimandla yabantu ngokubanzi ekuphuculeni iinkqubo ezikhethekileyo namashishini kubantu abatsha nabafazi. Misa iindawo ezikumhlaba wonke kwiinkampani namashishini ngokubanzi. Khuthaza iinkqubo zokuphucula imimandla yonke ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Lawula inkxaso ngokubanzi ekulungiselelweni kwenkxaso ngokubanzi. Khuthaza inkqubo yokubonisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-SMME kwaye ulungise iindlela-politiki ngokusekelwe kwiinkqubo eziphumelelayo. Khangela ukuba kukho inkxaso ngokubanzi kubantu abatsha nabafazi kwii-quaters ezingafaneleyo namashishini kummandla ongazinjongo. Hlola nokukhuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-SMME, i-Co-operatives, neekhratshi namakhasimkhasi. Linganisa imveliso ye-erekhonomi ngokuqhagamshelana, ukwenza imali, nokuphucula. Khuthaza amashishini kubantu abatsha nabafazi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwimimandla yonke. Qhoboshela amashishini ngokubanzi ngokusebenzisa iindlela-politiki namakhasimkhasi. jobs.title: Director: Executive Support
jobs.summary: Director of Executive Support at the Department of Economic Development in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Public Administration / Public Management / Political Science / Business Administration qualifications. Nyukela Certificate for entry into SMS (Senior Management Service) from the National School of Government submitted prior to appointment. A minimum of 5 years of experience at a middle / senior managerial level in executive support / governance / administration. Demonstrable experience in PFMA/Treasury Regulations compliance, secretariat services, and intergovernmental coordination. Code 8/10.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and quality-assure HOD briefings, submissions, memos and related correspondences. Manage end-to-end meeting logistics, that is, scheduling, agenda setting, document packs, minute-taking, and resolutions tracking. Operate a decision-tracking system, log directives, allocate actions, monitor progress and produce weekly exception reports. Standardise templates and procedures for executive documents (Cabinet/MEC submissions, minutes, reports). Provide research and synthesis on policy, legislation and programme issues to support HOD decisions. Maintain secure, organised records and a central repository for executive correspondence and decisions. Embed PFMA, Treasury Regulations, DPSA directives, POPIA, MISS/MPSS, and applicable provincial frameworks in office processes. Run quarterly compliance reviews on submissions, delegations, records and decision logs, remediate gaps and report assurances. Coordinate responses to audit findings (GAS/AGSA), track management action plans, and verify closure evidence. Maintain the HOD Delegations of Authority register, ensure alignment to financial and administrative delegations. Identify executive office risks, keep a risk register and implement control measures including confidentiality and information security. Facilitate policy/procedure updates and compliance training for executive office staff and document custodians. Maintain an integrated HOD calendar linking strategic priorities, statutory deadlines and stakeholder engagements. Operate an executive workflow dashboard-incoming/outgoing items, due dates, dependencies and bottleneck alerts. Coordinate quarterly performance reviews with Strategy/M&E, compile executive performance packs and insights. Synchronise HOD directives with programme plans and operational cycles, escalate slippage and propose recovery actions. Implement service standards for turnaround times on submissions, queries and approvals and monitor compliance. Produce monthly performance and workload analytics for the Office of the HOD (volumes, turnaround, quality scores). Manage protocols and channels between the HOD and MEC/EXCO, Office of the Premier, Treasury, DPSA, and sector departments. Coordinate executive meeting packs (MEC briefings, clusters, FORUMs), ensuring completeness and strategic alignment. Track undertakings from intergovernmental forums, drive inter-departmental cooperation to close actions on time. Prepare stakeholder engagement plans, briefs, and follow-up matrices and ensure issues are resolved and feedback loops closed. Maintain a stakeholder risk and issues log, advise the HOD on emerging sensitivities and mitigation options. Produce concise, outcome- focused communiqués and post-engagement reports for executive audiences. Implement and monitor a secure records management system for executive documents, aligned to POPIA and MISS/MPSS. Establish classification, retention, and disposal schedules, audit compliance and correct deviations. Oversee the drafting, formatting, and clearance of executive correspondence to ensure consistency with corporate identity. Operate version control and approvals workflow for briefs, speeches, media responses and communiqués. Maintain an executive knowledge base: policies, cabinet decisions, provincial priorities, sector insights, and precedents. Introduce digital tools/workflows (e.g., document trackers) and train staff to improve accuracy and turnaround. Perform strategic and operational planning. Manage stakeholder relationships. Oversee the administrative support functions Perform people management functions. Perform financial management functions. Perform asset management functions.
