All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Uitvoerende Ondersteuning
af.summary: Direkteur van Uitvoerende Ondersteuning by die Department of Economic Development in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Politieke Wetenskap / Besigheidsadministrasie-kwalifikasies. Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toelating tot SMS (Senior Management Service) van die National School of Government voor aanstelling ingedien. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel / senior bestuursvlak in uitvoerende ondersteuning / bestuur / administrasie. Aantoonbare ervaring in PFMA/Treasury Regulations-nakoming, sekretariaatsdienste en intergovernomentele koördinasie. Code 8/10.
af.duties: Koördineer en verseker die gehalte van HoD-aantekeninge, voorleggings, memoranda en verwante korrespondensie. Bestuur end-tot-end vergaderingslogistiek, dit wil sê skedulering, agendavastelling, dokumentpakke, notule neem, en nasporing van besluite. Bedryf 'n besluitneming-nasporingstelsel, registreer direktiewe, wysig take toe, monitor vordering en produseer weeklikse uitsonderingsverslae. Standaardiseer sjablone en prosedures vir uitvoerende dokumente (Kabinet/MEC-voorleggings, notule, verslae). Verskaf navorsing en sintese oor beleid, wetgewing en programkwessies om HoD-besluite te ondersteun. Onderhou veilige, geordende rekords en 'n sentrale bewaarplek vir uitvoerende korrespondensie en besluite. Bed PFMA, Tesourie Regulasies, DPSA-direktiewe, POPIA, MISS/MPSS, en toepaslike provinsiale raamwerke in kantoorprosesse in. Voer kwartaallikse nakomingsoorsigte uit op voorleggings, delegasies, rekords en besluitlogboeke, remedeer gapings en rapporteer versekerings. Koördineer reaksies op ouditbevindinge (GAS/AGSA), spoor bestuursaksieplanne, en verifieer sluitingbewyse. Onderhou die HoD Delegerings van Bevoegdheid-register, verseker belyning met finansiële en administratiewe delegasies. Identifiseer uitvoerende kantoorrisiko's, hou 'n risikoregister en implementeer beheermaatrels insluitend vertroulikheid en inligtingsekuriteit. Fasiliteer beleid/prosedure-opdaterings en nakomingsopleiding vir uitvoerende kantoorpersoneel en dokumentbewaarders. Onderhou 'n geïntegreerde HoD-kalender wat strategiese prioriteite, statutêre sperdatums en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid koppel. Bedryf 'n uitvoerende werkvloei-dashbord-inkomende/uitgaande items, sperdatums, afhanklikhede en knelpuntwaarskuwings. Koördineer kwartaallikse prestasie-oorsigte met Strategie/M&E, stel uitvoerende prestasiepakke en insigte saam. Sinkroniseer HoD-direktiewe met programplanne en operasionele siklusse, eskaleer agterstande en stel herstelaksies voor. Implementeer diensstandaarde vir omkeertye op voorleggings, navrae en goedkeurings en monitor nakoming. Produseer maandelikse prestasie- en werklading-analitiek vir die Kantoor van die HoD (volumes, omkeer, gehaltescore). Bestuur protokolle en kanale tussen die HoD en MEC/EXCO, Kantoor van die Premier, Tesourie, DPSA, en sektordepartemente. Koördineer uitvoerende vergaderingspakke (MEC-aantekeninge, trosse, FORUMs), en verseker volledigheid en strategiese belyning. Spoor ondernemings van intergovernomentele forums na, dryf interdepartementele samewerking om tydigheid van aksies te sluit. Berei belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsplanne, kortings en opvolgmatrices voor en verseker dat kwessies opgelos en terugvoerluse gesluit word. Onderhou 'n belanghebbende-risiko en kwessielogboek, adviseer die HoD oor opkomende sensitiwiteite en mitigasie-opsies. Produseer bondige, uitkoms-gefokde kommunikés en na-betrokkenheidsverslae vir uitvoerende gehore. Implementeer en monitor 'n veilige rekordbestuurstelsel vir uitvoerende dokumente, belynd met POPIA en MISS/MPSS. Stel klassifikasie, retensie en uitwasskemas op, oudit nakoming en korrigeer afwykings. Oorsien die opstel, formatering en vrijskering van uitvoerende korrespondensie om konsekwentheid met korporatiewe identiteit te verseker. Bedryf weergawebeheer en goedkeuringswerkvloei vir kortings, toesprake, mediareaksies en kommunikés. Onderhou 'n uitvoerende kennisbasis: beleide, kabinetbesluite, provinsiale prioriteite, sektorinsigte en presedente. Stel digitale gereedskap/werkvloei (bv. dokumentnavorings) voor en oplei personeel om akkuraatheid en omkeer te verbeter. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Bestuur belanghebbende-verhoudinge. Oorsien die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer personeelbestuursfunksies uit. Voer finansiële bestuursfunksies uit. Voer batebestuursfunksies uit.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukusekela Abaphathi Abaphezulu
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokusekela Abaphathi Abaphezulu eDepartment of Economic Development eJohannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 nomyaka omuhlanu wamava obumpetha obuphezulu ophathweni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kwi-Public Administration / Public Management / Political Science / Business Administration. Isitifiketi se-Nyukela sokungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) esivela e-National School of Government esinikezwa ngaphambi kokugqashwa. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yamava ohlwini lomphathi ophakathi / ophezulu kokusekela abaphathi abaphezulu / ubulungiswa / ukuphatha. Amava abonakalayo ngokuzilandela i-PFMA/Treasury Regulations, izinsizakusekela iqembu, nokuqondanisa phakathi kahulumeni. Code 8/10.
zu.duties: Nqamula futhi uhlole ukuthembeka kwemibiko, izinikelo, imemorandamu nemiyalezo ephathelene nayo ye-HOD. Phatha emisebenzi yohlelo lokuqoka izintela ukugqama, ukumisa isikhathi, ukwakheka kohlelo, ukuhluhlela amadokhumenti, ukuthatha iminithi, nokuholwa kwezinqumo. Sebenzisa uhlelo lokulandela izinqumo, qophisa imiyalo yokuqondisa, abela imisebenzi, qapha inqubo bese ukhiqiza imibiko yamaphutha yamasonto onke. Linganisa izifanekiso nezinqubo zemadokhumenti zabaphathi abaphezulu (izinikelo ze-Cabinet/MEC, iminithi, imibiko). Nikeza uphando nokuhlanganisa ngemigomo, umthetho nemibuzohlelo ukuze usekele izinqumo ze-HOD. Gcina amarekhodi aphephile ahiqwe kahle nendawo egcwele yonke emiyalezweni nezinqumo zabaphathi abaphezulu. Faka i-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, imiyalo ye-DPSA, POPIA, MISS/MPSS, nezinhlelo zesifunda ezifanelekile emaqenjini emisebenzi. Qamba ukubuyekezwa kokuzilandela kwamakota ngeminikelo, owayo, amarekhodi namalogi ezinqumo, lionisa izikhala ubike isiqiniseko. Nqamula izimpendulo kumaphuzu okuhlola (GAS/AGSA), landela izinhlelo zomphathi zokwenza, futhi qinisekisa ubufakela bokuvala. Gcina irejista ye-HOD Delegations of Authority, qinisekisa ukuqondana nokubeka amandla okwezimali nokuqasha. Hlakanipha izingozi zehhovisi labaphathi abaphezulu, gcina irejista yezingozi bese usebenzisa izindlela zokulawula okuhlanganisa ukubingelelwa kokwaziswa nokuphepha kwaziso. Qasha ukubuyekezwa kwemigono/nqubo kanye nokweluleka ukuzilandela kubasebenzi behhovisi labaphathi abaphezulu nabalondolozibhodi bodokhumenti. Gcina ikhalenda yonke yonke ye-HOD exhuma izindlela ezibalulekile, izikhathi zokuvala ezimthethweni nokujoyina abahweba. Sebenzisa idashibhodi yohlelo lomsebenzi yabaphathi abaphezulu izinto ezingena/eziphumayo, izikhathi zokuhlawulela, ukuncintisana nokusazwa kwezinto. Nqamula ukubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwamakota ne-Strategy/M&E, hlanganisa amaphakethe okusebenza kwezela nemibono yamaphathi abaphezulu. Yezisana imiyalo ye-HOD nezinhlelo uhlelo kanye nemijikelezo yokusebenza, phakamisa izingozi busekele ukwenza kabusha. Phatha izinkomba zokusebenza kanye nezinqubo zokwenza ngokuphendula, izibuto nokuvuma kanye nokulandela ukuzilandela. Khipa incazelo yenqubo yokusebenza bese kwenziwa isilinganiso somthwalo wehhovisi ye-HOD (izinani, ukubuyela, amaphuzu obukhulu). Phatha izinqubo nemitshingo phakathi kwe-HOD ne-MEC/EXCO, i-Office of the Premier, iTreasury, i-DPSA, kanye namaphuzu awo. Hlanganisa imiphakathi yemihlangano yabaphathi abaphezulu (izikeliwa ze-MEC, amaqembu, izinkundla), kuqinisekiswe ukuqedwa kwayo nokulinganisela kwezindlela. Landa izithembiso emihlanganweni phakathi kahulumeni, qondisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaphuzu ukuze kwenzeke ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lungiselela izinhlela zokujoyina abahweba, izikeliwa, namafomu okulandela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibuzo ixazululwa ibuye kubuyela iminikelo. Gcina irejista yezingozi nemibuzo yabahweba, elule i-HOD ngokuzwela okuphumayo nezindlela zokuqeda. Khipa imiyalezo emfishane egxile kumaphuzu ubize imibiko ngemuva kokujoyina kubapathi abaphezulu. Sebenzisa futhi ulandele isistimu yokugcina amadokhumenti ephathekile yamadokhumenti abaphathi, ehambisana ne-POPIA ne-MISS/MPSS. Misela isigaba, ukugcina, bese kwenziwa ishejuli yokulahla, hola ukuzilandela ubuyise kumaphutha. Qapha ukubhala, ukumisa, nokususa noma ukuvumela imiyalez yabaphathi abaphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukungabi nakwehlule kwezinkomba. Sebenzisa ukulawula ukudlula okuwona nokuqinisekisa amaphakethe abaphathi kwezinkomba, izinkulumo, imibiko yabezindaba. Gcina ulwazi lwabaphathi: imigono, izinqumo zekhabhethi, izindlela eziphambili zesifunda, imibono yomkhakha, kanye neziqu ezitholakalayo. Faka amathuluzi/ amaphathi: izinombolo, imibhalo kanye ne-POPIA. Hlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza ngokuzenzakalela, ukubhala imibhalo yabantu ebiwayo, nokwenza izinkomba. Yenza ukwenza isu lobuchule kwaye nokuqhakambisa ukuqhakambisa imibono ngohlelo. Sebenzela kumandla wemisebenzi, uphathe i-Office of the Premier, i-Treasury, i-DPSA, kanye namaphuzu womkhakha. Nqamula imiphakathi yabaphathi abaphezulu, ohlwini lomsebenzi abaphathi abaphezulu bathola isikhundla kuhlelo ngokuphelele nokuzinza. Landela izinhlalo ezinhle zehhovisi, khuthaza ngokuhamba kwamaphuzu ezinyangeni ezinhle ukwenza kube khona isiphakeme. Yenza izinhlela zobuchwepheshe bomsebenzi ngohlelo lokusebenzela, lungiselela imibhalo, futhi gcina ukubeka kahle imisebenzi yokuhlela bese kuqinisekiswa ukuhamba kahle. Gcina i-HOD futhi usebenze ngokuzinza ohlelweni lwezimali, izinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Sebenzela abantu ababhekeneyo, abasebenzela kwezinye izindlela ezinhle ezinconyiwe, futhi wenze kube lula ukusebenzela ukuhamba kohlelo ngokuphelele. Hlolisisa ngokususa nokuqinisekisa izinkomba, imibono kanye nokuchofoza, ukwenza kabusha izinto ezingeyiwe, futhi uqinisekisile ukuthi kuhamba kahle. Nika abantu abaphethe imibhalo ngohlelo lokuqinisekisa, ukubhala imibhalo, ukusebenza, ukweluleka, bese uqinisekisa ukuzinza.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Inkxaso eNkulu yeziPhathwa
xh.summary: Umlawuli wenkxaso enkulu yeziphathwa kwiSebe lePhuhliso leziQozi kwindawo iJohannesburg, lifuna isifikezelo seNQF Level 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ephakathi kwabaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isifikezelo seNQF Level 7 kwiPublic Administration / Public Management / Political Science / Business Administration. Isatifikethi seNyukela sokungena kwiSMS (Senior Management Service) esivela kwisikolo sebala likarhulumente iNational School of Government esinikezelwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo kunkxaso enkulu yeziphathwa / ulawulo / inkqubo yolawulo. Amava abonakalayo kokuzalathiswa kweziga zePFMA/Treasury Regulations, iinkonzo zebala lekomiti, nokuqwalaselwa kweenkundla phakathi karhulumente. Ikhodi 8/10.
xh.duties: Qwalasela kwaye uqinisele ubuhlakanuni bxesha kumabali eHOD, iinkonzo ezidityaniswayo, iimemo neminye imibhalo edityanisiweyo. Lawula iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ezize ngokupela, oko kukuthi, ukuqwalasela ixesha, ukumisela ihlelo, ukuqokelela amaxwebhu, ukubhalwa kwezinqobo zexesha, noku landelela izigqibo. Sebenzisa inkqubo yokulandelela izigqibo, qamba imiyalelo, kwaba izenzo, lilole inkqubo kwaye uveze iingxelo zangaphandle ngeveki nganye. Zenza iitempleyiti neenkqubo ezingagqitywa ngoluvo lwezixhobo zomlawuli (iinkonzo zeCabinet/MEC, iinqobo zexesha, iingxelo). Zenze uphando nedibaniselo malunga neyona ndlela, umthetho neemiba zenkqubo ukuze uxhase izigqibo zeHOD. Gcina ixwebhu elizimelelo, elihleliweyo nendawo ephakathi yokugcina imibhalo yeziphathwa n.esigqibo. Faka iziga zePFMA, zeTreasury Regulations, zeDPSA, zePOPIA, zeMISS/MPSS, nezolawulo zendawo ezifanelekileyo kwiinkqubo zofisi. Qhutyela iingxelo zokuqwalaselwa kweziga nyaka ngamnye, ngokwemisebenzi edityanisiweyo, iinkqubo zokwabelana amandla, amaxwebhu nemiyaqo yesigqibo, uhlole amathoba kwaye uveze uqiniseko. Qwalasela iimpendulo kwiziphene zokuhlolwa (iGAS/AGSA), ulandelele iinkqubo zenkqubo yolawulo, kwaye uqiniseke iziqinisekiso zokuvalwa. Gcina irejista yeHOD Delegations of Authority, qinisekisa ukumisela kwemali nendlela yolawulo yokwabelana amandla. Chaza iingozi zofisi yomlawuli, zigcine irejista yengozi kwaye usebenzise iziqendu zolawulo eziquka ukugcina iyimfihlo nolwazi olukhuselekileyo. Sikhokela izihloko zeendlela/zenkqubo ezintsha nokugqithisa kwabasebenzi bafisi yomlawuli kunye nabagcini baxwebhu. Gcina ikhalenda ebandakanyayo yeHOD enendlela yokudibanisa iipriorities eziphambili, iingqineliso ezizeyomthetho, nokuqhubela phambili unxibelelwano nabathathi nxaxheba. Sebenzisa idashboard yokuhamba kwenkqubo yomlawuli (izinto ezizayo/ezihambayo, iintsuku zokuvalwa, iindlela ezithembekileyo, nokuqwalasela iingxaki). Qwalasela iingxelo zokuvela kwamava nyaka ngamnye nabakwiStrategy/M&E, qamba amaxwebhu abaphathi abaphezulu kwaye uveze imibono. Lunganisa imiyalelo yeHOD neenkqubo zeenkqubo zomsebenzi, phakamisa iingxaki kwaye uveze iinkqubo zokuziphilisa. Zisebenzise iziqendu zenkonzo malunga nexesha elithathwe ekugqityeni kwenkonzo, iimibuzo nokuqinisekisa kwaye ulole ukuzalathiswa kwezona. Yila iingxelo zenyanga ngamnye zobungakanisi bomsebenzi kunye nomthwalo wemisebenzi woFisi weHOD (iintlobo, ixesha elithathweyo, amanqanaba omgangatho). Lawula iinkqubo nendlela zokunxibelelana phakathi kweHOD neMEC/EXCO, iOfisi yePremier, iTreasury, iDPSA, nemiSebe yediraktha. Qwalasela ukulungiselelwa kwamaxwebhu abaphathi abaphezulu (iindaba zeMEC, iiklasi, iFORUMs), uqinisekise ukuphumelela komsebenzi nokuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo. Landelela izithembiso ezivela kumabala phakathi karhulumente, khuthaze ukusebenzisana kwemiSebe ukuze kuvalwe izenzo ngexesha. Lungelelanisa iinkqubo zokunxibelelana namathathi nxaxheba, amabali, nokuqwalaselwa kwezinto ezikwiziko kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iimba zixazululwa kwaye iinkqubo zokubuyela emva zivaliwe. Gcina irejista yengozi nokuqwalaselwa iimba, yala iHOD ngokuziphemba okutsha nendlela zokunciphisa. Yenza iindlela zokunxibelelwana ezifutshane, ezigqithiselwe kumphumo nemiyaqo yokuxoxwa emva kweenkqubo ukwazisa abaphathi abaphezulu. Sebenzisa kwaye ulole inkqubo yokugcina amaxwebhu abakhuselekileyo abamlauli, eqwalaselwa kwiPOPIA nakuMISS/MPSS. Misela iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa, ukugcina, nokuqotywa kwamaxwebhu, hola ukuhambelana neenkqubo kwaye ulungize iimpazamo zokubakho kwezinto ezingalunganga. Qwalasela ukuqamba, ukuqamba ngokuhlukileyo, kwaye kusetyenziswa indlela efanelekileyo yokucoca imibhalo yolawulo, ukuze kubekho isiqiniseko sokuzinza kwindlela yentsapho. Sebenzisa ukulawula inguquko nokuqinisekisa ukuhamba komsebenzi wokwenza ii briefs, iinkulumo, iimpendulo zamajoni, nezinye izinto eziphathwa ngaphandle. Gcina ulwazi olubaliweyo ngabaphathi: iindlela, izigqibo zekhabhinethi, iipriorities zesifundazwe, imibono yendawo, izinto ezibekiweyo. Faka amacebo/izixhobo ezizinzileyo (umz. abalandeli baxwebhu) kwaye uqeqeshe abantu ukuba bangcono ngokuchaneka kwezinto nokuhamba kwexesha. Yenza iplani yokusebenza ngokwesikhuthalo nokusebenza ngokobuchule. Lawula ubudlelwane namathathi nxaxheba. Qwalasela iinkonzo zolawulo zenkxaso. Yenza iinkonzo zokuphatha abantu. Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali. Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo lweempahla.

jobs.title: Director: Consumer Protection
jobs.summary: Director of Consumer Protection role in Johannesburg requiring a Law degree, attorney or advocate admission, and five years of senior managerial legal experience.
jobs.requirements: University Degree in Law (NQF 7) Admission as an Attorney or Advocate in terms of the laws governing the legal profession in the Republic. Nyukela Certificate for entry into SMS (Senior Management Service) from the National School of Government submitted prior to appointment. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in legal environment, preferably in areas or matters relevant to civil litigation, consumer protection/regulatory enforcement, complaints & investigations, compliance inspections, and stakeholder relations at middle management level. Code 08.
jobs.duties: Develop or review the departmental consumer protection strategies, policies, procedures and implementation frameworks aligned with provincial and national legislative requirements. Monitor compliance with applicable National and Provincial Consumer Protection legislation. Give advice on legislative related matters, including the development or review of consumer protection legislation and regulatory frameworks. Monitor compliance of businesses and trade with applicable National and Provincial Consumer Protection legislation. Oversee the implementation of new or amended consumer protection legislation and related transitional and operational arrangements within the Directorate. Manage complaints lodged and advise on appropriate action to be taken should a complaint fall outside the mandate of the office Report on the status of consumer complaints per business sector and/or industry including perceived consumer impacts and risks that may be harmful to the consumer and how these can be mitigated within the Province. Monitor and oversee the assessment, allocation, investigation, compliance monitoring and resolution of complaints against applicable turnaround times and performance standards. Analyse complaint and compliance monitoring outcomes to identify trends, including emerging trends and systemic consumer protection risks to inform corrective interventions. Oversee the referral of complaints to relevant regulatory bodies, tribunals, or enforcement authorities, where appropriate. Oversee the appropriate resolution, conciliation, settlement, referral and escalation of consumer matters. Manage the referral of unresolved consumer complaints to the Consumer Affairs Court. Assume statutory, delegated and other functions as may be assigned to the Consumer Protector. Oversee the issuing of prescribed pleadings, notices or other applications or document s .to persons responsible for unfair business practices / prohibited conduct or business conduct prejudicial to consumers. Ensure representation of the Consumer in unresolved consumer complaints before the Consumer Court. Facilitate, where appropriate, the enforcement of Consumer Court orders. Review and facilitate the handling of reviews, appeals or other statutory remedies on administrative decisions taken. Engage with cluster Departments in the Province to leverage on Consumer Protection initiatives being implemented by various Departments with the intention to create an investor- friendly province through cohesive and structured consumer participation efforts. Represent consumers who may have been aggrieved by unfair business practices in the Consumer Affairs Court .Collaborate with the Communication Unit on Consumer Protection initiatives Engage with Provincial Consumer Protection and other Regulatory Authorities on Consumer Protection related issues. Facilitate appropriate referrals, coordination and joint interventions where consumer protection matters fall within or overlap with the mandates of other competent authorities. Perform strategic and operational planning. Manage stakeholder relationships. Oversee the administrative support functions. Perform people management functions. Perform financial management functions. Perform asset management functions.
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Verbruikersbeskerming
af.summary: Direkteur van Verbruikersbeskerming-pos in Johannesburg wat 'n Regte-graad, toelating as prokureur of advokaat, en vyf jaar se senior bestuursreg-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Universiteitsgraad in Regte (NQF 7) Toelating as 'n Prokureur of Advokaat ooreenkomstig die wette wat die regsprofessie in die Republiek regeer. Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toetrede tot SMS (Senior Management Service) van die National School of Government voor afkondiging voorgelê. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n regsomgewing, by voorkeur in areas of aangeleenthede relevant tot siviele litigasie, verbruikersbeskerming/reguleringshandhawing, klagtes en ondersoeke, nakomingsinspeksies, en belanghebbendes-verhoudinge op middelbestuursvlak. Kode 08.
af.duties: Ontwikkel of hersien die departementele verbruikersbeskermingstrategieë, beleide, prosedures en implementeringraamwerke in ooreenstemming met provinsiale en nasionale wetgewende vereistes. Monitor nakoming van toepaslike Nasionale en Provinsiale Verbruikersbeskermingswetgewing. Gee advies oor wetgewende verwante aangeleenthede, insluitend die ontwikkeling of hersiening van verbruikersbeskermingswetgewing en reguleringsraamwerke. Monitor nakoming van besighede en handel met toepaslike Nasionale en Provinsiale Verbruikersbeskermingswetgewing. Hou toesig oor die implementering van nuwe of gewysigde verbruikersbeskermingswetgewing en verwante oorgangs- en operasionele reëlings binne die Direktoraat. Bestuur klagtes wat ingediend is en adviseer oor gepaste optrede wat geneem moet word indien 'n klagte buite die mandaat van die kantoor val Rapporteer oor die status van verbruikersklagtes per besigheidssektor en/of industrie insluitend waargenome verbruikersimpakte en risiko's wat skadelik vir die verbruiker kan wees en hoe hierdie binne die Provinsie versag kan word. Monitor en hou toesig oor die assessering, toewysing, ondersoek, nakomingsmonitering en resolusie van klagtes teen toepaslike omkeertye en prestasiestandaarde. Analiseer klagte- en nakomingsmonitoringsuitkomste om tendense te identifiseer, insluitend opkomende tendense en stelselmatige verbruikersbeskermingsrisiko's om korrektiewe ingrypings in te lig. Hou toesig oor die verwysing van klagtes na relevante reguleringsliggame, tribunale, of handhawingsowerhede, waar toepaslik. Hou toesig oor die toepaslike resolusie, konsiliasie, skikking, verwysing en eskalasie van verbruikersaangeleenthede. Bestuur die verwysing van onopgeloste verbruikersklagtes na die Consumer Affairs Court. Neem statutêre, gedelegeerde en ander funksies waar wat aan die Verbruikersbeskermoer toegewys mag word. Hou toesig oor die uitreiking van voorgeskrewe pleitstukke, kennismettings of ander aansoeke of dokumente .aan persone verantwoordelik vir onbillike besigheidspraktyke / verbode gedrag of besigheidsgedrag nadelig tot verbruikers. Verseker verteenwoordiging van die Verbruiker in onopgeloste verbruikersklagtes voor die Consumer Court. Fasiliteer, waar toepaslik, die handhawing van Consumer Court-bevele. Hersien en fasiliteer die hantering van hersienings, appèlle of ander statutêre regmiddels oor administratiewe besluite geneem. Raakpleeg tros-departemente in die Provinsie om voordeel te trek uit Verbruikersbeskermingsinisiatiewe wat deur verskeie departemente geïmplementeer word met die voorneme om 'n beleggingsvriendelike provinsie te skep deur samehangende en gestruktureerde verbruikersdeelname-pogings. Verteenwoordig verbruikers wat moontlik benadeel is deur onbillike besigheidspraktyke in die Consumer Affairs Court . Werk saam met die Kommunikasie-eenheid oor Verbruikersbeskermingsinisiatiewe Raakpleeg Provinsiale Verbruikersbeskerming en ander Reguleringsowerhede oor Verbruikersbeskerming-verwante kwessies. Fasiliteer toepaslike verwysings, koördinasie en gesamentlike ingrypings waar verbruikersbeskermingsaangeleenthede binne die mandate van ander bevoegde owerhede val of daarmee oorvleuel. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Bestuur belanghebbendes-verhoudinge. Hou toesig oor die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer personeelbestuursfunksies uit. Voer finansiële bestuursfunksies uit. Voer batebestuursfunksies uit.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuvikelwa Abathengi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezokuvikela abathengi e-Johannesburg esidinga iziqu zobumthetho, ukwamukelwa njengommeli noma sikhulumi, kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlengo lwaphezulu lolawulo emthethweni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Nqf 7 eMthethweni. Ukwamukelwa njengommeli noma sikhulumi ngokomthetho ohlola umsebenzi womthetho eRiphabhuliki. Isitifikedi seNyukela sokungena ku-SMS (Isevisi Yolawulo Oluphezulu) esitholakala e-National School of Government kufanele sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in legal environment, preferably in areas or matters relevant to civil litigation, consumer protection/regulatory enforcement, complaints & investigations, compliance inspections, and stakeholder relations at middle management level. Code 08.
zu.duties: Bumba noma ubuyekeze izindlela zokuvikelwa kwabathengi zikamnyango, izinqobo, inqubo nezakhiwo zokuqalisela ezihambisana nezidingo zomthetho wesifundazwe nezikazwelonke. Qaphela ukuthobela umthetho osetshenzisekayo we-National and Provincial Consumer Protection legislation. Nikeza izeluleko ezimalunga nomthetho, okuhlanganisa ukwakheka noma ukuhlola kabusha komthetho wezokuvikelwa kwabathengi nezakhiwo zolawulo. Qaphela ukuthobela komthetho wabhizinisi nezohwebo ngomthetho osetshenzisekayo we-National and Provincial Consumer Protection legislation. Buka ukusetshenziswa komthetho omusha noma uguquliwe wezokuvikelwa kwabathengi kanye nezinhlelo zethuthuko nezokusebenza endlini yezokuphatha. Phatha izikhalazo ezifakiwe futhi weluleke ngomnyakazo ofanele ongathathwa uma isikhalazo siphula ihlabathi lika- and how these can be mitigated within the Province. Qaphela futhi ubuke ukuhlola, ukwabiwa, uphenyo, ukulandela ukuthobela nokuxazulula izikhalazo ngokwesikhathi esibekiwe kanye namazinga okusebenza. Hlaziya imiphumela yesikhalazo nokulandela ukuthobela ukuze ubone iziqondo, okuhlanganisa iziqondo ezibonakalayo kanye nobungozi bezokuvikelwa kwabathengi ukuze kuthuthuke izinyathelo zokulungisa. Buka ukudluliswa kwesikhalazo kubahlinzeki bolawulo abahlobene, amakhothi, noma iziphathmandla zokuqinisa umthetho, lapho kufanele khona. Buka ukuxazulula okufanele, ukuhlanganisa, ukuvumelana, ukudluliswa nokuqiniswa kwezindaba zabathengi. Phatha ukudluliswa kwezikhalazo zabathengi ezingaxazululanga e-Court Yezindaba Zabathengi. Thatha imisebenzi yomthetho, edluliswe noma eminye enganikezwa umvikeli wabathengi. Buka ukukhishwa kwamaphepha abekiwe, izaziso noma ezinye izicelo noma amadokhumenti kubantu ababhekene nemikhuba yabhizinisi engalungile / imikhuba engavunyelwe noma imikhuba yabhizinisi ehlazo abathengi. Qinisekisa ukumelwa kabathengi kulezo zikhalazo ezingaxazululanga phambi kwekhothi yezindaba zabathengi. Kabhisela, lapho kufanele khona, ukuqinisa imiyalo yekhothi yezindaba zabathengi. Buyekeza futhi ubheke izimo zoku buyekeza, ukuphikisa noma ezinye izindlela zomthetho ezingathathwa ngezinqumo zolawulo. Zibandakanye namaphinsi amnyango esifundazweni ukuze usebenzise izinhlelo zokuvikela abathengi eziqaliswa amaphansi ahlukene ngenjongo yokudala isifundazwe esimukelekayo abatshali bezimali ngokuqanyelwa ngokuhlangeneyo kanye nokuhlelelwa kwezinhlelo zabathengi. Mela abathengi abehlukunyazwe yimikhuba yabhizinisi engalungile e-Court Yezindaba Zabathengi . Sebenzisana ne-Unit Yokuxhumana kuzinhlelo zokuvikela abathengi. Xhumana ne-Regulatory Authorities Zesifundazwe Zokuvikela Abathengi kanye nezinye iziphathmandla ngezinkinga zokuvikela abathengi. Kabhisela ukudluliswa okufanele, ukuhlelwa kanye nokungenelela okuhlangene lapho izindaba zokuvikela abathengi zitholakala ngaphakathi noma zihlangana namandla eminye imithetho ehlelekile. Yenza ukuhlelela okubalulekile nezokusebenza. Phatha ubuhlobo babathintekayo. Buka imisebenzi yesekelayo yolawulo. Yenza imisebenzi yabasebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi yezimali. Yenza imisebenzi yezimpahla.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Ukukhusela Abathengi
xh.summary: Indima ka lawuli wokukhusela abathengi e Johannesburg efuna isidanga somthetho, ukwamkelwa njengommeli okanye sisikhokelo, kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava aphakamileyo abalawuleyo kwimeko yomthetho.
xh.requirements: Isidanga saseYunivesithi kwiMthetho (NQF 7). Ukwamkelwa njengoMmeli okanye isiKhokelo ngokomthetho ulawulo lwesigwegamba somthetho kwiRiphabhlikhi. Isatifikethi seNyukela sokingo kwiSMS (Inkonzo yoLawulo ePhakamileyo) esuka kwiSikolo sikaHulumeni yethunyelwe ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe ukuqeshwa. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphakamileyo lolawulo kwimeko yomthetho, ngokukhetha kummandla okanye kumacala ahambelana nematyala yesigqibo, ukukhuselwa kwabathengi/uqobo lomthetho, iingxaki ne phononongo, ikuqwalaselo kolandelo, kunye nothungelano nabaphathi abahlobene nayo kwinqanaba lolawulo eliphakathi. Ikhodi 08.
xh.duties: Pezisa okanye qwalasela iindlela zamasebe zokukhusela abathengi, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuqhuba neezakhiwo zokuphumeza izim ezingqamaniswe neemfuno zomthetho wephondo nakwizizwe. Qwalasela ukuthobela komthetho osebenzayo wokukhuselwa kwabathengi weSizwe nakwiPhondo. Nikela icebiso kumacala ahambelana nomthetho, kuquka ukuphepha okanye ukuqwalasela komthetho wokukhuselwa kwabathengi nokuqwalaselo kolawulo. Qwalasela ukuthobela komthetho kumashishini nakorhwebo ngokomthetho wokukhuselwa kwabathengi weSizwe nakwiPhondo. Lawula ukuqhubwa komthetho omtsha okanye otshintshiweyo wokukhuselwa kwabathengi nokuqwalaselwa okuhambelana nokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe elikhusela abathengi. Lawula iingxaki ezishiwayo unike icebiso ngesenzo esifanelekileyo esithi sithathwe xa ingxaki ikhawule ngaphandle kwesabelo sofiso. Chenga ngemo yamngxaki abathengi ngaphakathi kweshishini okanye urhwebo kuquka nemiphumo yokubakho kubathengi iingozi ezingayenzakalisa umthengi nendlela ezingagqithwa ngayo ngaphakathi kwiPhondo. Qwalasela ulawula ukuqwalasela, ukwaba, ukuphonononga, ukuqwalasela ukuthobela ukunyanga iingxaki ngokuchasene nexesha elifanelekileyo nemigangatho yokusebenza. Hlala iingxaki nemiqwalaselo yokuthobela ukuchonga iimvelo, kuquka neemvelo ezibakha iingozi zokukhuselwa kwabathengi ezinokukhokeza kuthintelo lokulunga. Lawula ukuthumela iingxaki kubalphathi bomthetho abahlobene nayo, iinkundla zeentshabo, okanye iindiso zomthetho, apho kufanelekileyo. Lawula ukunyanga ngokufanelekileyo, ukulungisa, ukuvumelana, ukuthumela nokwandisa amacala abathengi. Lawula ukuthumela amacala abathengi angananyiselwa kwiNkundla yezezo Zabathengi. Zama ukwenza imisebenzi emisiweyo, ethunyelweyo nobunye njengoko kungenjalo kubekwe kumKhuseli wabaThengi. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezicwangciso ezithi zithi ngokomthetho, izaziso okanye ezinye izicelo okanye amaxwebhu abantu abasetyenziselwa izorhwebo ezingalunganga nendlela engamkelekileyo kubathengi. Qinisekisa ukumela abaThengi kwimikosi enganyiselwa phambi kweNkundla yabaThengi. Phathelela ngokufanelekileyo, ukuphumeza iimvisiswano zenkundla yabaThengi. Qwalasela uphathise uphatho lwezimvo, izibhengezo okanye ezinye izikhokelelo ngokomthetho zeentshabo ezithathiweyo. Zibandakanye namasebe ePhondo ukusebenzisa izikhokelelo zokukhusela abathengi ezithi ziqhutywe yimimandla yamasebe ngelenjongo yokudala iphondo elifanelekileyo kubatyali-mali ngokusebenzisa imizamo ekhokeleyo ngokukhusela abathengi. Mela abathengi abasetyenziswe kakhulu ngenkqubo yorhwebo ezingalunganga kwiNkundla yabaThengi. Sebenzisana neNyongo yokuThetha ngokuKhuselwa abaThengi. Sebenzisana namaphondo okuKhusela abaThengi nabanye oBaphathi bomthetho kumacala okukhuselwa abathengi. Phathelela ngokufanelekileyo iindlela zokuthumela, ulungelelwaniso nemizamo edibene ngaphakathi kwamandla okukhusela abathengi xa kudibana namakhosi amanye abaphathi. Yenza iplani yokusebenza neyokulungelelisa. Lawula ubudlelwane namaphathi. Lawula imisebenzi yonke yentshabo. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula abantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula imali. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula izinto.

jobs.title: Director: Organisation Efficiency
jobs.summary: Director of Organisation Efficiency at the Gauteng Department of Economic Development, overseeing policy development and organisational efficiency initiatives.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Industrial Psychology, Management Services, Operations / Production Management, Human Resources, Public Administration or equivalent as recognized by SAQA. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in an Organisational Development Successful completion of the certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS) endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on www.thensg.gov.za. Submitted prior to appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development, implementation and continuous review of policies, plans and methodologies relating to Organisation Efficiency. Oversee the development of guidelines for non-discriminatory employment practices and monitor their implementation and impact. Oversee the implementation of the DPSA Operation Management Framework in the GDED. Provide leadership and guidance in the development and implementation of all strategies and procedures, focusing on Organisation Efficiency programmes. Determine research to be conducted in Organisation Efficiency and analyse against best practice. Oversee the research on drafting of speeches and briefing notes for the MEC and Executive management of the department on Employment Equity, Disability management and Gender mainstreaming in the GDED. Benchmark against international and national best practices. Oversee projects that are aligned with the operational plan for Organisation Efficiency to address the needs of the GDED. Monitor project deadlines and devise appropriate measures to address challenges with projects. Oversee the development and submission of compliance reports with DPSA. Facilitate the development of monthly reports and consolidate inputs from the Sub directorates. Oversee the submission and consolidation of inputs into the departmental annual, quarterly, and or related reports. Manage collaborative relationships with other components within GDED. Oversee the facilitation of Organisation Efficiency workshops and information sessions. Provide guidance to internal components through liaising, consulting, and providing relevant Organisation Efficiency interventions. Participate in all forums of the province and focus on addressing Organisation Efficiency challenges. Build and maintain relations with internal and external stakeholders, including other Government departments, organisations for people with disabilities, Women organisations within the three tiers of government, organized business and Higher Learning Institutions. Present to management and GDED components on Organisation Efficiency issues and other related matters. Manage responses to Audit findings. Manage the flow of work. Manage the development, performance of, and discipline staff. Manage the financial resources of the Unit
jobs.enquiries: Siphiwe Nhlapho/Lebohang Molefe at 066 196 6890/079 803 5373 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Organisasiedoeltreffendheid
af.summary: Direkteur van Organisasiedoeltreffendheid by die Gauteng Department of Economic Development, wat toezig hou oor beleidsontwikkeling en inisiatiewe vir organisasiedoeltreffendheid.
af.requirements: An NQF level 7 kwalifikasie in Bedryfsielkunde, Bestuursdienste, Bedryfs-/Produksiebestuur, Menslike Hulpbronne, Openbare Bestuur of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n Organisasieontwikkeling. Voltooide suksesvolle afronding van die sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Service (SMS) wat deur die National School of Government bekragtig is en beskikbaar is as 'n aanlynkursus op www.thensg.gov.za. Voor aanstelling ingedien. Alle gekorte lys kandidate vir SMS poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS kandidate psigometriese assesserings ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer.
af.duties: Hou toezig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en deurlopende hersiening van beleide, planne en metodes met betrekking tot Organisasiedoeltreffendheid. Hou toezig oor die ontwikkeling van riglyne vir nie-diskriminerende indiensnemingpraktyke en monitor die implementering en impak daarvan. Hou toezig oor die implementering van die DPSA Operation Management Framework in die GDED. Verskaf leierskap en leiding by die ontwikkeling en implementering van alle strategieë en prosedures, met die fokus op Organisasiedoeltreffendheid programme. Bepaal navorsing wat in Organisasiedoeltreffendheid uitgevoer moet word en analiseer dit teen beste praktyk. Hou toezig oor die navorsing vir die opstel van toesprake en kortingsnotas vir die MEC en Uitvoerende bestuur van die departement oor Indiensnemegelykheid, Bestuur van gestremdhede en Gender hoofstroom in die GDED. Vergelyk met internasionale en nasionale beste praktyke. Hou toezig oor projekte wat in lyn is met die operasionele plan vir Organisasiedoeltreffendheid om in die behoeftes van die GDED te voorsien. Monitor projek sperdatums en bedink geskikte maatreëls om uitdagings met projekte aan te spreek. Hou toezig oor die ontwikkeling en indiening van voldoeningsverslae by DPSA. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van maandelikse verslae en konsolideer bydraes van die Subdirektorate. Hou toezig oor die indiening en konsolidasie van bydraes tot die departementele jaarlikse, kwartaal-, en of verwante verslae. Bestuur samewerkende verhoudings met ander komponente binne GDED. Hou toezig oor die fasilitering van Organisasiedoeltreffendheid werkswinkels en inligtingsessies. Verskaf leiding aan interne komponente deur te skakel, te raadpleeg en tersaaklike Organisasiedoeltreffendheid ingrypings te verskaf. Neem deel aan alle forums van die provinsie en fokus op die aanpak van Organisasiedoeltreffendheid uitdagings. Bou en handhaaf verhoudings met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend ander Regering departemente, organisasies vir persone met gestremdhede, Vroue organisasies binne die drie vlakke van regering, georganiseerde besigheid en Hoër Leerinstellings. Dien voorleggings aan bestuur en GDED komponente oor Organisasiedoeltreffendheid kwessies en ander verwante aangeleenthede. Bestuur response op Ouditbevindings. Bestuur die vloei van werk. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, prestasie van, en dissipline van personeel. Bestuur die finansiële hulpbronne van die Eenheid

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukusebenza Kahle Kwezinhlelwe
zu.summary: Umphathi wezinhlelwe ukusebenza kahle eGauteng Department of Economic Development, obuke imiqondo yesimiso futhi abuke imizamo yokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kwi-Industrial Psychology, Management Services, Operations / Production Management, Human Resources, Public Administration noma okulinganayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Uzobe uneminyaka engu-5 yohlu lokusebenza ezingeni lokuphathi eliphakathi/phezulu kwi-Organisational Development. Ukuqeda ngempumelelo isitifiketi sokungena ku-Senior Management Service (SMS) esivunyiwe yi-National School of Government esitholakala njengenkosi yamakhasu e-inthanethi ku-www.thensg.gov.za. Kufanele sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokumiselwa. Bonke abagcotshiwe abangesikhashana kumaposhi we-SMS bazothola isivivinyo sobuchwepheshe kanye nesingxoxo. Emva kwesivivinyo sobuchwepheshe nesingxoxo, abagcotshiwe abangu-(3) abaphakathi kwe-SMS bazocwaningwa ngokwengqondo ukuze kuhlolwe amandla okucabanga, izinketho zokuziphatha, ukuqonda izinkamvo, kanye nokuzithoba. Imibuzo mayibekwe ku-Fhatuwani Mulaudzi, 082 043 3523.
zu.duties: Buka ukuthuthukiswa, ukuqashwa kanye nokubuyekeza ngokuqhubekayo komthetho, amasu kanye nezindlela ezihlobene nokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe. Buka ukuthuthukiswa kwemiqikhitha yamamanye amasiko ahhubela ngokungenabandla kanye nokuhlola ukuqashwa kwawo kanye nemiphumela yawo. Buka ukuqashwa komyalo we-DPSA Operation Management Framework i-GDED. Nikeza ubuholo kanye noxholo ekuthuthukisweni nakuqashweni kwazo zonke izinkombandlela kanye namayathelo agxile kumakhasu okusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe. Quma ucwaningo oluzodweni ekusebenzeni kahle kwezinhlelwe futhi uluhlule ngokumelana nokuqeqeshwa kahle. Buka ucwaningo ngokuqamba amabalasi nezaziso ezixhunyiwe i-MEC kanye nolawulo lalabo abaphathi bomnyango ngo-Employment Equity, Disability management kanye ne-Gender mainstreaming i-GDED. Qeqesha ngokuqeqeshwa kahle ngamazwe omhlaba nangaphakathi kwelinye. Buka imigqomo ehambisana nesimiso sokusebenza i-GDED ukubhekana nezigciro ze-GDED. Hlola izingemuva zemigqomo futhi ube yiyathelo elifanele ukubhekana nobunzima bemigqomo. Buka ukuthuthukiswa nokuthunyelwa kwezibika zobuqotho ne-DPSA. Phakamisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezibika zanyanga zonke futhi uhlanganise okungenayo kuma-Sub directorates. Buka ukuthunyelwa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwokungenayo ezibikeni zomnyango zomnyaka, kwethemu, noma eziyeqhingwe. Phatha izimiso ezihambisanayo namanye amakhompothi angaphakathi i-GDED. Buka ukuxhaswa kwezinkomfa zokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelze kanye nezinkomfa zokwazisa. Nikeza uxholo kolawulo olungaphakathi ngokuxhumanisa, ukubuza, kanye nokunika okuhlobene nokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe. Thatha inhlombe kuzo zonke izinkomfa zesifunda futhi ugxile ekubhekaneni nobunzima bokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano nalabo abayi-dolobha kanye nalabo bangezandleni, okuhlanganisa namanye emnyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano zabantu abasile ngenxa yezimpawu, izinhlangano zensiza ngaphakathi kwezidingo ezintathu zohulumeni, inhlangano yamabhizinisi kanye namanyuvesi aphakeme. Yethula kulawulo kanye namakhompothi i-GDED ngokuqondwa kokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelwe kanye neminye imikhakha ehlobene. Phatha imibiko yohlobo lwe-Audit. Phatha ukuhamba kwemisebenzi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusebenza, kanye namakhaya omuntu. Phatha imali etholwayo ye-Unit.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukusebenza Ngempumelelo Kwesehlobo
xh.summary: Umongameli weSiseko sokusebenza ngempumelelo kwisebe leGauteng Department of Economic Development, elibukelela inqubo yokuphuhlisa iindlela nezinto ezibhekisa ekusebenzeni ngempumelelo kwisehlobo.
xh.requirements: Ithuba leNQF level 7 kwizifundo ezinjengeIndustrial Psychology, Management Services, Operations / Production Management, Human Resources, Public Administration okanye ezincedisana nazo njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka yamava emi kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lobuqu oxwebhu kwindlela yokuziphatha yomntu ohola kwindalo yelakrihlali kudliwano-ndlebe Nokugqibezela kufuneka kwenziwe kumzila othile apho kubekho iNdlela yokuHlola ezinye izigqibo ezithile kwaye ukugqibelela kusebenzo ngokusuka kubungakanani. Ithatshatha kwindlela eza kwangoku ezinokuba ngaphantsi ngesigqibo sobuqu ekuvavanyeni iindlela ezithile kwinqanaba leziko lemphakathi nokuqinisekisa ukuba abo bafuna ukungenela kwindima zabo ezinkulu bafaka isicelo sokwenza isicelo sabo ngokupela kwakhona kwiziko elibonelela ngokuziqhelanisa ngamava emisebenzi eqhutywa njengengeniso kwiziko elifana nokuzinika amanqaku aphakamileyo.
xh.duties: Bukelela ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokucoca iindlela ezisemthethweni, iiplan nezindlela ezibhekisa kwindlela yokuqhubeka phambili ngenkqubo kaGauteng Department of Economic Development. Bukelela ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokusebenza kubantu ngokungazibandelanga kwaye ulandele ukusetyenziswa nobungakanani bazo kwindlela yokusebenza kwabo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kobunkqonkqo kubuqu oxwebhu ngokomthetho okhankanyiweyo kumaGauteng Department of Economic Development ukwenza okukhankanyiweyo kwinkqubo ka-DPSA ngolu hlobo eGDED. Nikeza iingcebiso malunga nokuqonda iindinganiso namava kwimpumelelo yokusebenza kwentengiso ngokulandela imimiselo yesixeko njengesihloko esibalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba nakho ukubona iziphumo zemisebenzi yonke enokusuka kwinkqubo ka-DPSA kwisebe leGDED. Buka iziphumo ekunikelwa ngokusuka kumacandelo angaphakathi aze afake ngesicelo ekubeni kukho imisebenzi ephilayo eqhutywa njengesiqithina kwisebe leGDED ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Yenza iinkqubo zokubonelela ngolwazi kwindlela emangalisayo kwezezimali kwii-ofisi ezingaphakathi nokunikezela ngamava kumsebenzisi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kumaziko amaninzi angaphandle eqhagamshela nabasebenzi abenza imisebenzi ekufutshane namaziko abantu abangamajwarha, iindawo abantu abangazenzisiyo, kubafazi ngaphantsi kwenkqubo yamagumbi amathathu abo bokungenisa iqela elizimeleyo ngomtsalane kwaye usize ngokumisela inkqubo yokulawula amaxhosa oqobo ngokusebenzisa iindlela zokuvavanya ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo ngeziko elinemali yokubonelela.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Manufacturing
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Manufacturing in Johannesburg to develop and review policy frameworks and growth strategies for the manufacturing sector at the Department of Economic Development.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. NQF Level 7 in Economics/Development Studies/Development Economics qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years' experience at Assistant Director level or equivalent supervisory management experience in economic development, policy development, strategy development, project management, industrial development or manufacturing sector development. Code 8/10 driver’s license is essential.
jobs.duties: Develop, review, and promote policy frameworks and strategies to ensure the development and maintenance of a comprehensive and tailor-made ecosystem for the manufacturing sector. Develop and review growth enhancing strategies for the manufacturing sector. Develop and review sector strategies/plans that align the development of the manufacturing sector to changes in the industry. Develop and review policies and strategies/plans that advance coordination and cooperation amongst the different spheres of government. Develop implementation guidelines for reviewed policies and sector-specific strategies/plans. Determine if current policies and strategies/plans are still relevant or if they should be reviewed. Benchmark against best practice manufacturing sector strategies, policies, and common practices. Benchmark against new initiatives within the manufacturing sector. Display a clear understanding of industrial policy and its implementation. Display a clear understanding of manufacturing and its role in industrial development. Possess the ability to identify key interventions to ensure industrialisation, inclusive growth and township development. Review existing programmes to accelerate growth and job creation within the manufacturing sector. Design new programmes and mechanisms to accelerate growth, sustainability, and job creation within the 10 high-growth sectors and other key manufacturing sectors. Identify potential partners to implement provincial objectives on industrialisation. Develop a business case and terms of reference to appoint key industry players for the development of the sector for industrialisation purposes. Collaborate with key business units to develop business cases and terms of reference to meet provincial objectives of job creation, SMME development and industrialisation. Develop a business case and terms of reference with the intention of identifying and appointing a potential partner. Develop an implementation plan with the service provider to achieve economic development aspirations. Develop an MOU/MOA to guide the relationship with the service provider. Develop an SLA for the particular financial year to implement the identified programme. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of the programme. Manage outsourced projects. Possess the ability to design and plan mitigation strategies to ensure successful implementation of identified programmes. Consult with stakeholders in the national, provincial and local governments, private sector, international organisations and entrepreneurs. Communicate new projects and improved sector policies and strategies. Collaborate with staff within the department, other departments, and the private sector in the development of sector plans and the implementation of projects for the manufacturing sector. Prepare speeches and briefing notes for the political office bearers on the development of policies and strategies for the manufacturing sector. Correspond with research and educational institutions on the policies and strategies on manufacturing. Engage with implementing partners and assess progress of the project, identify challenges and intervene. Report monthly, quarterly, and annually on project implementation. Collect and verify proof of evidence based on targets stated in the implementation plan and Service Level Agreements. Manage responses to audit queries.
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Vervaardiging
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Vervaardiging in Johannesburg om beleidsraamwerke en groeistrategieë vir die vervaardigingssektor by die Departement of Economic Development te ontwikkel en te hersien.
af.requirements: Graad 12. NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Ontwikkelingstudies/Ontwikkelingsekonomie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op Assistant Director-vlak of gelykwaardige toesighoudende bestuurservaring in ekonomiese ontwikkeling, beleidsontwikkeling, strategieontwikkeling, projekbestuur, nywerheidsontwikkeling of vervaardigingssektorontwikkeling. Kode 8/10-bestuurslisensie is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en bevorder beleidsraamwerke en strategieë om die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n omvattende en op maat gemaakte ekosisteem vir die vervaardigingssektor te verseker. Ontwikkel en hersien groei-verbeterende strategieë vir die vervaardigingssektor. Ontwikkel en hersien sektorstrategieë/-planne wat die ontwikkeling van die vervaardigingssektor belyn met veranderinge in die bedryf. Ontwikkel en hersien beleide en strategieë/-planne wat koördinering en samewerking tussen die verskillende sfere van regering bevorder. Ontwikkel implementeringsriglyne vir hersiene beleide en sektor-spesifieke strategieë/-planne. Bepaal of huidige beleide en strategieë/-planne nog relevant is of dat dit hersien moet word. Toets teenoor best-practice vervaardigingssektorstrategieë, beleide en algemene praktyke. Toets teenoor nuwe inisiatiewe binne die vervaardigingssektor. Toon 'n duidelike begrip van nywerheidsbeleid en die implementering daarvan. Toon 'n duidelike begrip van vervaardiging en die rol daarvan in nywerheidsontwikkeling. Besit die vermoë om sleutelintervensies te identifiseer om nywerheidsontwikkeling, inklusiewe groei en dorpontwikkeling te verseker. Hersien bestaande programme om groei en werk skepping binne die vervaardigingssektor te versnel. Ontwerp nuwe programme en meganismes om groei, volhoubaarheid en werk skepping binne die 10 hoë-groei sektore en ander sleutel vervaardigingssektore te versnel. Identifiseer potensiële vennote om provinsiale doelwitte ten opsigte van nywerheidsontwikkeling te implementeer. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidsaangeleentheid en terme van verwysing om sleutelbedryfspelers vir die ontwikkeling van die sektor vir nywerheidsontwikkelingsdoeleindes aan te stel. Werk saam met sleutelbesigheidseenhede om besigheidsaangeleenthede en terme van verwysing te ontwikkel om provinsiale doelwitte van werk skepping, SMME-ontwikkeling en nywerheidsontwikkeling te bereik. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidsaangeleentheid en terme van verwysing met die doel om 'n potensiële vennoot te identifiseer en aan te stel. Ontwikkel 'n implementeringsplan met die diensverskaffer om ekonomiese ontwikkelingsaspirasies te bereik. Ontwikkel 'n MOU/MOA om die verhouding met die diensverskaffer te begelei. Ontwikkel 'n SLA vir die betrokke finansiële jaar om die geïdentifiseerde program te implementeer. Monitor en evalueer die implementering van die program. Bestuur uitbestuurde projekte. Besit die vermoë om mitigasiestrategieë te ontwerp en te beplan om suksesvolle implementering van geïdentifiseerde programme te verseker. Raadpleeg belanghebbendes in die nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering, privaatsektor, internasionale organisasies en entrepreneurs. Kommunikasie van nuwe projekte en verbeterde sektorbeleide en -strategieë. Werk saam met personeel binne die departement, ander departemente en die privaatsektor in die ontwikkeling van sektorplanne en die implementering van projekte vir die vervaardigingssektor. Berei toesprake en vir briefingsnota's vir die politieke amp draers voor oor die ontwikkeling van beleide en strategieë vir die vervaardigingssektor. Korrespondeer met navorsings- en opvoedkundige instansies oor die beleide en strategieë oor vervaardiging. Skakel met implementeringsvennote en beoordeel vordering van die projek, identifiseer uitdagings en tree in. Rapporteer maandeliks, kwartaalliks en jaarliks oor projekimplementering. Versamel en verifieer bewysmateriaal gebaseer op teikens vermeld in die implementeringsplan en Service Level Agreements. Bestuur reaksies op ouditnavrae.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokumisa Ohlangothini: Ukukhiqiza
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sokumisa Ohlangothini: Ukukhiqiza e-Johannesburg ukuthuthukisa futhi kubuyekeze izakhiwo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokukhula ezimutholwe ngqo zesigaba sokukhiqiza e-Department of Economic Development.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. I-NQF Level 7 kwez-Economics/Development Studies/Development Economics njengokuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani amaphesenti ayisikhombisa (3) eminyakeni okuhlanganise isipiliyoni ohlwini lokaSiza-Abaphathi noma isipiliyeni esincane sokuphatha ekuthuthukisweni kwezomnotho, ekuthuthukisweni kwenqubomgomo, ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo, ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi, ekuthuthukisweni kwamabhizinisi noma ekuthuthukisweni kwesigaba sokukhiqiza. Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code 8/10 iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa, buyekeza, futhi ungcobe izakhiwo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwe-ecosystem ephelele neyothekileyo eyesigaba sokukhiqiza. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinhlelo zokukhulisa ukukhula zesigaba sokukhiqiza. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinhlelo/zinhlela zesigaba ezihambisanisa ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba sokukhiqiza noshintsho olwembonini. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo/izinhlela eziphusha inhlangano nokusebenza ndawonye phakathi kwamagumbi ahlukene kahulumeni. Thuthukisa iziqondiso zokuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo ezibuyekwe kanye nezinhlelo/izinhlela ezithile zesigaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo/izinhlela zamanje zisatholakala ngokusafaneleka noma kufanele zibuyekeze. Bhekisisa ngokwamasu ahamba phambili, izinqubomgomo, kanye nemikhakha evamile yesigaba sokukhiqiza. Linganisa ngezinhlela ezintsha ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokukhiqiza. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacile ngenqubomgomo yamabhizinisi nokuphathwa kwayo. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacile ngokukhiqiza nendima yalo ekuthuthukisweni kwamabhizinisi.iba namandla okuqonda izinyathelo eziyinhloko ukuqinisekisa indandathulo yamabhizinisi, ukukhula okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamalokishini. Buyekeza izinhlelo ezikhona ukuze kusheshiswe ukukhula kanye nokudalwa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokukhiqiza. Kuma izinhlelo ezintsha kanye nezinhlela zokusheshisa ukukhula, ukugcinwa, kanye nokudalwa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwamagatsha angu-10 okukhula ngokushesha kanye namanye amagatsha abalulekile okukhiqiza. Hlola abahlanganyeli abangaba khona ukuphumeza izinjongo zesifunda ngenkathi kuthuthukiswa amabhizinisi. Thuthukisa isikhalazo sebizinisi kanye nezinkomba zokuqondisa ukugqoka abadlali abayinhloko kumabhizinisi ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba ngenjongo yokwenza amabhizinisi. Sebenzisana namayunithi abalulekile e-bhizinisi ukuthuthukisa izikhalazo ze-bhizinisi kanye nezinkomba zokuqondisa ukuze kufinyelelwe izinjongo zesifunda ekudalweni kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-SMME kanye nokwenza amabhizinisi. Thuthukisa isikhalazo se-bhizinisi kanye nezinkomba zokuqondisa ngenhloso yokuhlonza kanye nokugqoka umhlanganyeli ongaba khona. Thuthukisa ihlela lokuphatha nomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo ukuze kufinyelelwe izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Thuthukisa i-MOU/MOA ukuba ohola ubudlelwano nomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo. Thuthukisa i-SLA yonyaka wezimali othile ukuze kusetshenziswe uhlelo oluhlonzwe. Qapha futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwehlela. Phatha amaphrojekthi abekiwe ngaphandle. Iba namandla okwakheka kanye nokuqamba izinhlela zokunciphisa ingozi ukuqinisekisa ukuphumeza ngemphumelelo izinhlelo ezihlonzwe. Phathisana ngemibuzo nabahlanganyeli ebukhoseni likazwelonke, lesifunda nasedolobheni, kwabalingisi bezenkimba, kumahlelo amazwe ngamazwe nakwitrepreneni. Yazisa ngamaphrojekthi amasha kanye nokuqhutshwa izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zesigaba. Sebenzisana nabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo, kwezinye izikhungo, nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlela zesigaba kanye nokuphumeza amaphrojekthi ohlelweni lokukhiqiza. Lungiselela izinkulumo kanye nezibhalo-ezihlobene nezombusazwe abazwayo baphathwa izikhundla ngenkathi kuthuthukiswa izinqubomgomo nezinhlela zesigaba sokukhiqiza. Thumela imibhalo emikhakheni yocwaningo namayunivesithi ngezinqubomgomo nezinhlela ngokukhiqiza. Thintana nabahlanganyeli kanye nokubuyekeza inqubo yephrojekthi, ukuhlonza izinselelo futhi ungene phakathi. Bika ngenyanga zonyaka ngenyanga ngokuphathwa kwezinhlela. Qoqa futhi uqinisekise ubufakela obusekelwe ezinhlosweni ezibalulwe kulesohlela lokuphathwa kanye kwi-Service Level Agreements. Phatha izimpendulo ezithunyelwa kwisikali.

xh.title: iSekela Mongeni: ukuVusa iindaba eziziilwandle
xh.summary: iSekela Mongeni: ukuVusa iindaba eziziilwandle eJohannesburg ukuphepha nokugqiba iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo okukhula kwicala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle kwiSebe lePhuhliso lezoQoqosho.
xh.requirements: I-GRADE 12. Isidanga se-NQF Level 7 kwiQoqosho/Izifundo zePhuhliso/Ingcogo yeQoqosho njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezintathu (3) zemfundo ezingcali kwindqanaba leSekela Mongeni okanye ulwazi olulinganayo ekulawulweni kwiPhuhliso leQoqosho, iPhuhliso lomgaqo-nkqubo, iPhuhliso lomceli-mnga, ulawulo lweprojekthi, iPhuhliso lentengiso okanye iPhuhliso lecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Ilayisenesi yokushayela i-Code 8/10 iyimfuno ebalulekileyo.
xh.duties: Phepha, gqiba, kunye nokuthuthisa iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo ukuze kuqinisekiswe uphuhliso nokugcinwa kwendalo equlunqwe ngokweenkqubo ngecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Phepha ugqibe amacebo okukhula awayphisela kwiqoqosho lecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Phepha, gqiba amacebo ecala/iinkqubo ahambisanisa uphuhliso weqoqosho lwecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle nobutshintsho kwintengiso. Phepha, gqiba iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo/iinkqubo axhasa ulawulezimo lokusebenzisana phakathi kweenqulamthetho ezahlukeneyo zalawulo. Phepha iinkqubo zokuphumeza iinkqubo ezigqibiweyo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo/iinkqubo ezithileyo. Qamba ukuba ngaba iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo/iinkqubo zangoku zisakulungele okuba zikufuneka zigqitshwe. Linganisa ngaphezu kwezona nqubo zibalaseleyo zamacebo, iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo, nolawulo oluqhelekileyo lwecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Linganisa ngaphezu kwezi nkqubo ezintsha kwiqoqosho lecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacileyo ngomgaqo-nkqubo wentengiso nokuphumeza kwawo. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacileyo ngokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle nendima yayo kuphuhliso wentengiso. Balisa ulwazi lokumisela iindlela eziyimfuno eziphakamisayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe intengiso, ukukhululeka kwentlalo kunye nophuhliso kumaphandle. Gqiba iinkqubo ezikhoyo ukuze kwandiswe ukukhula nokudala amathuba emisebenzi ngaphakathi kwecala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Cwangcisa iinkqubo ezintsha neendlela zokuphumeza ukuze kwandiswe ukukhula, iziqu, nakudala amathuba emisebenzi kwii-10 ezikumacala amakhulu kokukhula kwezinye iindaba ezikumacala amakhula okuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Misela abahlobo abanako ukuphumeza iinjongo zomphathiswa kentengiso. Lungelelanisa isicwangciso senkampani nemiqaqo yokumiselwa ukubiza abo babalaseleyo bencwadi yenkqubo yecala ukuba lisebenzisane nabo ukuphuhlisa isicwangciso ukwenzela iindlela ezentengiso. Sebenzisana nemicu embalaselayo yeshishini ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezikumacala eziyimfuno ukwenzela ukuba kugqitywe iinjongo zomphathiswa zokudala amathuba emisebenzi, ukuphuhlisa i-SMME nentengiso. Phepha inkqubo yeshishini nemiqaqo yokumiselwa ngenjongo yokumisela nokubiza umhlobo onokuthi enze ngaphandle. Phepha isicwangciso sokwenza umsebenzi nomphathi wolwazi ukuze kufezekiseke iinjongo zokuphuhlisa iqoqosho. Phepha i-MOU/MOA ekuqwalaselwa ngayo umdibaniso wolwazi kunye nomphathi. Phepha i-SLA yalo nyaka wemali idunyiswe ukuze kuphunywe ngayo iinkqubo eziyimfuno ezichongiweyo. Qwalasela nokulinganisa ukwenziwa kwenkqubo. Lawula iiprojekthi ezingaphandle. Balisa ulwazi lokucwangcisa amacebo okuqhathanisa iziphithiphithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe uphumeze lwenkqubo ezichongiweyo. Tyhila ngabathintekayo kumazwe aphakathi, kumaphondo, nakomasipala, kwishishini lokutyhila ngenyani, kumagatya amazwe nasemagxeni entengiso. Sakaza iiprojekthi ezintsha nopolwe lomgaqo-nkqubo kwiindaba ezintsha ezibakanga nemicu yeshishini ephuculiweyo. Sebenzisana nabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe, kumanye amanye amasebe, nashishini lokutyhila ngenyani ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zecala nakuphumezeni iinkqubo kwicala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Lungelelanisa iinkulumo nolwazi lokuqwalasela kubathethi beqoso ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo kwicala lokuvusa iindaba eziziilwandle. Qhagamshelana nemitsho yokuphando-kunye nokufundisa ngamanye amaxwebhu ngeenkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo ekuvusweni kwezinto eziyilwandle. Thyathisa ngabaphumezi inkqubo kwaye ulinganise ukugqibeka kweprojekthi, ukuqaphela iingxaki ukuba zikho nokuzilungisa. Ngexesha, kweenyanga ezithathu, kwakunye ngeminyaka yonke ukugqibeka kokwenziwa kweprojekthi. Qokelela ukugqiba ngokuchaneka kolawulo lwemfuno ekuqwalaselwa kwiinkqubo ezichongiweyo. Lawula iimpendulo kumaxwebhu olinganiso.

Develop a business case and terms of reference to appoint key industry players for the development of the sector for industrialisation purposes. Collaborate with key business units to develop business cases and terms of reference to meet provincial objectives of job creation, SMME development and industrialisation. Develop a business case and terms of reference with the intention of identifying and appointing a potential partner. Develop an implementation plan with the service provider to achieve economic development aspirations. Develop an MOU/MOA to guide the relationship with the service provider. Develop an SLA for the particular financial year to implement the identified programme. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of the programme. Manage outsourced projects. Possess the ability to design and plan mitigation strategies to ensure successful implementation of identified programmes. Consult with stakeholders in the national, provincial and local governments, private sector, international organisations and entrepreneurs. Communicate new projects and improved sector policies and strategies. Collaborate with staff within the department, other departments, and the private sector in the development of sector plans and the implementation of projects for the manufacturing sector. Prepare speeches and briefing notes for the political office bearers on the development of policies and strategies for the manufacturing sector. Correspond with research and educational institutions on the policies and strategies on manufacturing. Engage with implementing partners and assess progress of the project, identify challenges and intervene. Report monthly, quarterly, and annually on project implementation. Collect and verify proof of evidence based on targets stated in the implementation plan and Service Level Agreements. Manage responses to audit queries.
