af.title: Onderdirekteur: Bedrog en Korrupbiebestryding
af.summary: Onderdirekteur-pos in bedrog en korrupsiebestryding by die Gauteng Department of Economic Development, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12. NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Ontwikkelingstudies/Ontwikkelingsekonomie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardige toesighoudende bestuurservaring in ekonomiese ontwikkeling, beleidsontwikkeling, strategie-ontwikkeling, projekbestuur, nywerheidsontwikkeling of vervaardigingssektor-ontwikkeling. 'n Code 8/10-bestuurslisensie is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en bevorder beleidsraamwerke en strategieë om die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n omvattende en pasgemaakte ekosisteem vir die vervaardigingssektor te verseker. Ontwikkel en hersien groei-bevorderende strategieë vir die vervaardigingssektor. Ontwikkel en hersien sektorstrategieë/-planne wat die ontwikkeling van die vervaardigingssektor belyn met veranderinge in die bedryf. Ontwikkel en hersien beleide en strategieë/-planne wat koördinasing en samewerking tussen die verskillende sfere van regering bevorder. Ontwikkel implementeringsriglyne vir hersiene beleide en sektor-spesifieke strategieë/-planne. Bepaal of huidige beleide en strategieë/-planne nog relevant is of herrraai moet word. Vergelyk met beste-praktyk vervaardigingssektorstrategieë, beleide en algemene praktyke. Vergelyk met nuwe inisiatiewe binne die vervaardigingssektor. Toon 'n duidelike begrip van nywerheidsbeleid en die implementering daarvan. Toon 'n duidelike begrip van vervaardiging en die rol daarvan in nywerheidsontwikkeling. Besit die vermoë om sleutelintervensies te identifiseer om industrialisering, inklusiewe groei en dorpontwikkeling te verseker. Hersien bestaande programme om groei en werk skepping binne die vervaardigingssektor te versnel. Ontwerp nuwe programme en meganismes om groei, volhoubaarheid en werk skepping binne die 10 hoë-groei sektore en ander sleutervervaardigingssektore te versnel. Identifiseer potensiële vennote om provinsiale doelwitte rakende industrialisering te implementeer. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidsaak en terme van verwysing om sleuternywerheidspelers te benoem vir die ontwikkeling van die sektor vir industrialiseringsdoeleindes. Werk saam met sleutelbesigheids-eenhede om besigheidsake en terme van verwysing te ontwikkel om provinsiale doelwitte van werk skepping, SMME-ontwikkeling en industrialisering te bereik. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidsaak en terme van verwysing met die doel om 'n potensiële vennoot te identifiseer en te benoem. Ontwikkel 'n implementeringsplan met die diensverskaffer om ekonomiese ontwikkelingsaspirasies te bereik. Ontwikkel 'n MOU/MOA om die verhouding met die diensverskaffer te rig. Ontwikkel 'n SLA vir die betrokke finansiële jaar om die geïdentifiseerde program te implementeer. Monitor en evalueer die implementering van die program. Bestuur uitbesteedde projekte. Besit die vermoë om matigeringsstrategieë te ontwerp en te beplan om suksesvolle implementering van geïdentifiseerde programme te verseker. Raadpleeg belanghebbendes in die nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regerings, private sektor, internasionale organisasies en entrepreneurs. Kommunikeer nuwe projekte en verbeterde sektorbeleid en -strategieë. Werk saam met personeel binne die departement, ander departemente en die private sektor in die ontwikkeling van sektorplanne en die implementering van projekte vir die vervaardigingssektor. Berei toesprake en voorleggingsnotas vir die politieke ampsdraers voor oor die ontwikkeling van beleide en strategieë vir die vervaardigingssektor. Skryf aan navorsings- en opvoedkundige instellings oor die beleide en strategieë rakende vervaardiging. Raakpleg met implementeringsvennote en assesseer vordering van die projek, identifiseer uitdagings en tree in. Rapporteer maandeliks, kwartaalliks en jaarliks oor projekimplementering. Versamel en verifieer bewysmateriaal gebaseer op teikens wat in die implementeringsplan en Service Level Agreements vermeld is. Bestuur antwoorde op ouditvragen.

zu.title: Isikhundla SikaSomphetha: Ukukhwabanisa Nokuqeda Ukuphatha Kabi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSomphetha ekukhwabaniseni nokuqeda ukuphatha kabi kuGauteng Department of Economic Development, esidinga iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava okuphuma ekuphathweni.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kwi-Economics/Development Studies/Development Economics njengoba ezinakekelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwaba okungaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava esigabeni sikaAssistant Director noma amava alingana nawo okuphatha abantu ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo, ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela, ekuphathweni kwemikhiqizo, ekuthuthukisweni kwamakampani noma ekuthuthukisweni kwesikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code 8/10 iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Bumba, phinda ubuke, futhi uthuthukise izakhiwo zezinqubomgomo nezindlela ukuze uqiniseke ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwesimiso esiqondile nesisuselwa kulezo ezidingekayo ngokusikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Bumba futhi uphinde ubuke izindlela zokwandisa ukukhula ezisuselwa esikhungweni sokukhiqiza. Bumba futhi uphinde ubuke izindlela/izinhlelo zesikhungwa ezihambisanisa ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungwa sokukhiqiza noshintsho omlandwoni. Bumba futhi uphinde ubuke izinqubomgomo nezindlela/izinhlelo ezibusisa ukubambisana nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinkomba ezahlukene zahulumeni. Bumba izindlela zokuphoqa izinqubomgomo ezibukhiye ezibukwe kabusha kanye nezindlela/izinhlelo ezithile ngaleso sikhungwa. Hlola ukuthi izinqubomgomo nezindlela/izinhlelo zamanje zisazidingeka yini noma zidinga ukubukwa kabusha. Qhathanisa nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu zesikhungwa sokukhiqiza, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela eziyisijwayele. Qhathanisa nokuqalisa okusha ngaphakathi kwesikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacile ngenqubomgomo yamakampani kanye nokuqashelwa kwayo. Khombisa ukuqonda okucacile ngosuku lokukhiqiza kanye negalela laso ekuthuthukisweni kwamakampani. Banakho ikono lokubona izindlela ezibambiweyo ukuze kuqiniseke indalo yamakampani, ukukhula okuhlanganisayo nendalo yezakhiwo ezingakaze zathuthuka. Phinda ubuke imiklalo ekhona ukuze ukhuthaze ukukhula kanye nokudala imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Hlola imiklalo entsha kanye nezindlela ukuze ukhuthaze ukukhula, ukuzinza nokudala imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwezikhungwa eziyisishiyagalombili ezikhula ngokushesha kanye nezinye izikhungwa eziyisibambe sokukhiqiza. Bona abahlanganyeli abangaba khona ukuze kuqaliswe izinhloso zasifundazande ekuthuthukisweni kwamakampani. Bumba isigaba senhlangano nemibandela yomsebenzi ukuze kuthunywe abadlali ababambiwe emhlabeni wemikhiqizo ukuze kuthuthukiswe lesikhungwa ngenhloso yokuthuthukiswa kwamakampani. Sebenzisana namayunithi abalulekile emhlabeni wezoshishino ukubumba amacala kanye nemibandela yokuhlangabezana nezinhluso zasifundazande zokudala imisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-SMME nokuqalwa kwezamakampani. Bumba isinikezelo senhlangano nemibandela yayo ngenhloso yokubona nokubaqhiza umhlaleli ongaba khona. Bumba isu sokuqalisa konke nokuthi kusuke kwenziwa ngumhlinzeki wezinsiza ukufeza amaphupho ekuthuthukisweni komnotho. Bumba isivumelwano se-MOU/MOA ukuze kuqhutshwe ubudlelwano nomhlinzeki wezinsiza. Bumba isivumelwano se-SLA ngalesosikhathi somnyaka wezimali ukuze kuqaliswe i-program eqhutshiwe. Qaphela futhi uhlole ukuphunywa kwe-program. Phatha amaphulo asetshenziswa abanye abantu. Bawa ikhono lokuyakha futhi ulungiselele izindlela zokuqabela ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuphumelela kokuqalisa kwezinhlelo ezitholakele. Phathisana nabanomdakashini kuwo womabili amahulumeni abangaphakathi futhi esifundeni nasendaweni yonke, kulezangamva, kumahlelokuso, nezinhlangano zomhlaba njengabayimisela abaphile emhlabeni. Yazisa ngephulo elisha kanye nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisiweyo ezesikhungwa nasendlela. Sebenzisana nabanqangi ngaphakathi komnyango, eminye iminyango, kanye nolwandle abasino bokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zesikhungwa kanye nokuphumeza izinhlelo kulesikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Lungiselela izinkulumo kanye nezinto ezibekiweyo zokuphathwa kubaphathi bezinkulumo zombuso mayelana nokubunjwa kwezinqubomgomo nezindlela kulesikhungwa sokukhiqiza. Thumela izincwadi kwezinhlangano zesibalo nemfundo mayelana nezinqubomgomo nezindlela ngokusuka kumakampani. Nibisane nabahlanganyeli ekwenzeni ibhizinisi uhlole inqubo yephulo, ubhe izinkinga futhi ulungise. Yike imibiko yenyanga, yexesha elifushane, kanye yenkathi ngamunye ngamunye ngokwenziwa kophulo. Qoqa futhi uqinise izibonakaliso ezifanele ngokuzindlela ezikinikeziwe ngokuhleleni kwesu nangokuvumelwana ne-Service Level Agreements. Phatha impendulo kumibuzo yokuhlolwa kwezimali.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamzi: Ukurhoxisa ngokuzonakalisa nokuChasana nokuziphatha kabi
xh.summary: Indima yesekela mongamzi ekurhoxiseni ngokuzonakalisa nasekuChasaneni nokuziphatha kabi kwiSebe leNtshiseko yezoQoqosho kwiGauteng, elifuna izidanga ze-NQF Level 7 namava eminyaka emithathu yolawulo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12. Isidanga se-NQF Level 7 kwi-Economics/Development Studies/Development Economics njengokoqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava amncinci eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinqanaba lomsindi ovela kwindima yesekela mongamzi okanye amava olawulo ofanayo ekuthuthuzweni kwezomqobo, ekuthuthuzweni kweenkqubo, ekuthuthuzweni kwezicwangciso, ekulawulweni kweeprojekthi, ekuthuthuzweni kwezimboni okanye ekuthuthuzweni kwindawo yezandiso zomzi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela ye-Code 8/10 iyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, phinda uyihlole, kwaye unyuse iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nezicwangciso kuqinisekise ukuthuthuzwa nokugcinwa kwendalo egqithisileyo nezilungele ukulingana kwindawo yezandiso zomzi. Phuhlisa uphinde uhlole iinkqubo ezandisa ukukhula kwindawo yezandiso zomzi. Phuhlisa uphinde uhlole iinkqubo/iicwangciso zommandla ezidityanisa ukuthuthuzwa kwendawo yezandiso zomzi namaguquko kwishishini. Phuhlisa uphinde uhlole iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nezicwangciso/iinkqubo eziphambili unxibelelwano noluntu phakathi kweendawo zahulumente ezahlukahlukeneyo. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokusebenzisa iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo ezihlokiweyo nezicwangciso/iinkqubo ezithile zommandla. Qamba ukuba ngaba iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nezicwangciso/iinkqubo zangoku zisaluncedo okuba kufuneka ziphinde zihlolewe. Qhathanisa neenkqubo ezilungele khona kwishishini lezandiso zomzi, iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo, nendlela eziqhelekileyo zokwenza izinto. Qhathanisa nokuqaliswa okutsha ngaphakathi kwishishini lezandiso zomzi. Bonisa ukuqonda okucacileyo ngenkqubo yomgaqo-nkqubo wemboni nendlela isetyenziswa ngayo. Bonisa ukuqonda okucacileyo ngezandiso zomzi nendima yazo ekuthuthuzweni kwezimboni. Yiba nolawulo lokubona iindlela eziphambili zokungenelela ukuqinisekisa iindalo zokwenza izimboni, ukukhula kuquka bonke nentshukumo yamaphakade. Phinda uhlole iinkqubo ezikhoyo ukunyusa izinga lokukhula nasekudalweni amathuba emisebenzi ngaphakathi kwishishini lezandiso zomzi. Yila iinkqubo ezitsha neendlela zokunyusa ukukhula, ukungapheli, nasekudalweni amathuba emisebenzi kwi-10 sectors ezikhula ngokukhawuleza nakwezinye iindawo eziphambili zokwenza izimboni. Qaphela abahlanganyeli abanokwenzela ukuphumeza iinjongo zephondo ekwenzeni izimboni. Phuhlisa isicwangciso shishini nemigaqo yokubeka abadlali abaphambili kwindawo yethu ukuqinisekisa ukuba baye bagqibe ukuthuthuzwa kwalo ngenjongo yokwenza izimboni. Sebenzisana namayunithi aphambili eshishini ukuze uphuhlise iicwangciso zeshishini nemigaqo yokuzalisa iinjongo zephondo zokudala amathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthuzwa kwe-SMME nokuwenza izimboni. Phuhlisa isicwangciso shishini nemigaqo ngenjongo yokubeka kwaye uqaphele umhlanganyeli onokubakho. Phuhlisa isicwangciso sokusebenzisa nomthengisi womsebenzi ukuze kufezekiseke iinjongo zokuthuthuzwa kwezomqobo. Phuhlisa i-MOU/MOA ukukhokela ubudlelwane nomthengisi womsebenzi. Phuhlisa i-SLA yonyaka wohlohlo othile ukuyisebenzisa kwinkqubo eqapheliweyo. Lilinde kwaye uhlôle ukusebenziswa kwenkqubo. Lawula iiprojekthi ezigqityiweyo abazange benze ngaphandle. Yiba nolawulo lokuyila neyocwangcisa iindlela zokunciphisa iingenelo ukuze kuzaliseke isiphumelelo ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezibaluliweyo. Qhathanisa nabalindlele kwihulumente yezizwe, yamaphondo nedolophu, kwicala lokutshishino, kumazwe ngamazwe nakumashishini. Yaza ngeeprojekthi ezintsha nangeenkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nemicwangciso ethuthukisiweyo yommandla. Sebenzisana nabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe, namanye amasebe, nasekwichala lokutshishino ekuphuhliseni iicwangciso zommandla nasekusebenziseni iiprojekthi ezikwilitya yezandiso zomzi. Lungiselela iinkulumo zamagatya namanqaku okubika abathweswe uburhulumente ngethuba elithile ekuthuthuzweni kweenkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nezicwangciso ezikwindawo yezandiso zomzi. Qhathanisa nabantu kwiinkqubo zophando nasezikolweni ngeenkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nemicwangciso ekwenzeni izandiso. Zibandakanye nabahlanganyeli ekusebenziseni uphinde ulinganise inkqulo yomzobo weprojekthi, qaphela iingxaki uphinde ungenele. Iingxelo nyanga nganyanga, kwikota, ngonyaka ngenkqubo yokusebenza. Qokeleza uphinde uqinisekise ubungqina obusekwe kumagetya achaziweyo kwicwangciso lokusebenza nas kwiService Level Agreements. Lawula iimpendulo kumbuzo wesikhangiso.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Consumer Protection
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Johannesburg requiring a Law degree and 4-5 years of litigation experience to manage consumer protection policies at the Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
jobs.requirements: Degree (NQF Level 7) in Law qualification as recognised by SAQA. 4-5 years’ experience in litigation, investigation, and court work. Driver’s license is essential.
jobs.duties: Manage the development and implementation plans, policies, legislative frameworks, procedures, and systems to institutionalise Consumer Protection matters at GDED. Give advice on legislative related matters. Conduct research and analysis on Consumer Protection issues. Provide trend analysis on unfair business practices commonly applied in identified industries for investigations initiated by the office. Determine the causes of delays on investigated complaints. Evaluate investigation reports and implement appropriate action to be taken. Manage the handling of consumer complaints by investigators and confirm or re-assess the decisions taken. Manage Investigate and dispose of cases of alleged unfair business practices. Attend to escalated cases referred to the office. Draft and facilitate the issuing of summons and subpoenas to persons responsible for unfair business practices / prohibited conduct or business conduct prejudicial to consumers. Present cases in the Consumer Court. Write monthly reports (Statistical and narratives on cases and evaluation thereof, status and monetary value. Engage with cluster Departments in the Province to leverage on Consumer Protection initiatives being implemented by various Departments with the intention to create an investor friendly province through cohesive and structured consumer participation efforts. Represent consumers who may have been aggrieved by unfair business practices in the Consumer Affairs Court. Collaborate with the Communication Unit on Consumer Protection initiatives. Engage with. Provincial Consumer Protection and other Regulatory Authorities on Consumer. Protection related issues. Allocate work. Manage staff performance. Develop and motivate staff. Provide budgetary inputs for the Sub directorate. Advise management on risk factors and mitigating strategies.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Verbruikersbeskerming
af.summary: Onderdirekteur-pos in Johannesburg wat 'n Regte-graad en 4-5 jaar se litigasie-ervaring vereis om verbruikersbeskermingsbeleid by die Gauteng Department of Economic Development te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad (NQF Level 7) in Regte soos deur SAQA erken. 4-5 jaar se ervaring in litigasie, ondersoek en hofwerk. Bestuurderslisensie is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementeringsplanne, beleid, wetgewende raamwerke, prosedures en stelsels om Verbruikersbeskermingsake by GDED te institusionaliseer. Verskaf advies oor wetgewingsverwante aangeleenthede. Voer navorsing en ontleding oor Verbruikersbeskermingskwessies uit. Verskaf tendensontleding oor onregverdige besigheidspraktyke wat algemeen in geïdentifiseerde bedrywe toegepas word vir ondersoeke deur die kantoor geïnisieer. Bepaal die oorsake van vertragings op ondersoekte klagtes. Evalueer ondersoekverslae en implementeer toepaslike optrede wat geneem moet word. Bestuur die hantering van verbruiksklagtes deur ondersoekers en bevestig of herassesseer die besluite geneem. Bestuur ondersoek en beskik van sake van beweerde onregverdige besigheidspraktyke. Reken op geeskalmeerde sake wat na die kantoor verwys is. Opstel en fasiliteer die uitreiking van dagvaardings en subpoena's aan persone wat verantwoordelik is vir onregverdige besigheidspraktyke / verbode gedrag of besigheidsgedrag nadelig vir verbruikers. Hou sake in die Verbruikershof voor. Skryf maandelikse verslae (Statistiese en vertellings oor sake en evaluering daarvan, status en monterêre waarde. Raakpleeg tuislanddepartemente in die Provinsie om te put uit Verbruikersbeskermingsinisiatiewe wat deur verskeie Departemente geïmplementeer word met die voorneme om 'n beleggingsvriendelike provinsie te skep deur samehangende en gestruktureerde verbruikersdeelname-pogings. Verteenwoordig verbruikers wat moontlik benadeel is deur onregverdige besigheidspraktyke in die Verbruikersakehof. Werk saam met die Kommunikasie-eenheid oor Verbruikersbeskermingsinisiatiewe. Raakpleeg met. Provinsiale Verbruikersbeskerming en ander Regulerende Owerhede oor Verbruikersbeskerming. Beskermingsverwante kwessies. Wijs werk toe. Bestuur personeelprestasie. Ontwikkel en motiveer personeel. Verskaf begrotingsinvoere vir die Subdirektoraat. Adviseer bestuur oor risikofaktore en matigingsstrategieë.

zu.title: Isekela Mongqondile: Ukuvikelwa Kwebathengi
zu.summary: Isikhundla seSekela Mongqondile e-Johannesburg esidinga iziqu zobululezela kanye namava eminyaka yoku-4-5 kule minyaka ekuphenweni kwezamacala ukuze kuphathe izinqubomgomo zokuvikelwa kwebathengi eGauteng Department of Economic Development.
zu.requirements: Iziqu (NQF Level 7) ezingxenyeni zobululezela njengoba zaziwa yi-SAQA. Uluvo lweminyaka eyi-4-5 ekuphenweni kwezamacala, ukuphenya, kanye nomsebenzi othile enkantolo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo, izinqubomgomo, izakhiwo zomthetho, izindlela, kanye nezimiso zokuba yisisekelo izindaba zokuvikelwa kwebathengi e-GDED. Nikela izeluleko ezindabeni ezihlobene nomthetho. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokuhlaziya izindaba zokuvikelwa kwebathengi. Hlinzeka ngohlolo lwamathrendi ezindlela ezingalungile zebhizinisi ezisetshenziswa emikhakheni etholakele ekuphenyeni izikhalazo eziqalwe ihhovisi. Hlola izimbangela zokubambezela ekuphenyweni izikhalazo. Hlaziya imibhalo yophando futhi usebenzise izinyathelo ezifanele ezithathwayo. Phatha ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo zabathengi ngabaphenyi futhi qinisekisa noma uhlolo kabusha izinqumo ezithathiwe. Phatha uphenye futhi uqedele amacala ezindlela ezingalungile zebhizinisi eziphikisanwayo. Y ukunakwa kwamacala asukuliswe aveywe ehhovisi. Bhala futhi usize ekukhishweni kwesitesko nezimemeko kubantu ababhekene nezindlela ezingalungile zebhizinizi / ukuziphatha okwenqatyiwe noma ukuziphatha kwabhizinisi okuyizinxa kubathengi. Mela amacala enkantolo yabaThengi. Bhala imibhalo yanyanga zonke (ezibalengayo kanye nezinkcazelo zamacala nokuviwayo kwawo, isimo kanye nenani lemali. Xhumana namaphi the iminyango eMkhandathini eSifundazweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlela zokuvikelwa kwebathengi ezisetshenziswa ziwonke iminyango ngenjongo yokudala isifundazwo esihambisana nabatshalizi ngamabalomgumele obubhalo bokuvikelwa kwebathengi. Mela abathengi abangase babenziwa inkinga ngamzila webhizinisi ongalungi enkantolo yezindaba zebaThengi. Sebenzisana ne-Communication Unit kuzinhlela zokuvikelwa kwebathengi. Xhumana no. Provincial Consumer Protection kanye nezinye izikhulu eziLawula ku. Ukuvikelwa kwebathengi ezindabeni. Zihlonge. Phatha ukusebenza komphakathi. Thuthukisa futhi kuthuthukise abaphakathi. Nikeza iziphakamiso zemali ebungazini. La tula abaphathi ngamazinga ubungozi kanye nezindlela zokunciphisa.

xh.title: Isekela Mongqondo: Ukukhusela Abathengi
xh.summary: Indima yesekela mongqondo e Johannesburg efunayo isidanga kwiMthetho kunye namava eminyaka engama-4-5 kwinkundla ukulawula iinkqubo zokukhusela abathengi kwiGauteng Department of Economic Development.
xh.requirements: Isidanga (NQF Level 7) kwisiqu seMthetho njengokuvunywa yiSAQA. Iimvela zeminyaka engama-4-5 kwinkundla, ukuphonononga, nomsebenzi wenkundla. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba iyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Lawula izicwangciso zophuhliso nokuqhelaniswa, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zomthetho, iinkqubo, kunye neendlela zokuzeza imiba yokukhusela abathengi kwiGDED. Nikela ingcebiso ngemiba ehambelana nomthetho. Yenza ucophozo nolungelelwaniso kwimiba yokukhusela abathengi. Nikela nolungelelwaniso lwemigca ngemizekelo yoshishino ebizwa ngokuba yimigaqo engalunganga yoshishino eqhele ukusetyenziswa kushishino oluchaziweyo kuphononongo oluqaliswe lilungu. Misela iimbangela zokubambelela kwiingxaki eziphononongiweyo. Hlola iingxelo zophononongo uze usebenzise izigqibo ezifanelekileyo eziza kuthathwa. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezingxaki zabathengi ngabaphononongi uze uqinisekise okanye uhlolo kabusha izigqibo ezithathiweyo. Lawula ukuphonononga kwaye usixophe iicala zemigaqo engalunganga yoshishino ebhilwe ngayo. Phatha iicala ethunyelwe kwindlu esigqibela ezwelo kwindlu enkulu. Bhala uze ulawule ukunika isaziso sesicelo senkundla kunye nezaziso kubantu abanexanduva leemigaqo engalunganga yoshishino / imigaqo echanekileyo nangokuziphatha kushishino ekubangela ingozi kubathengi. Mela iicala kwindlu enkulu yamathengi. Bhala iingxelo nyanga zonke (Ezibalulo nengamabali ngecala nolungelelwaniso lwazo, imo kunye nexabiso lemali. Nxibelelane namaSebe amaninzi kwiPhondo ukusebenzisa iinjongo zokukhusela abathengi ezisetyenziswa ngamasebe amaninzi ngenjongo yokudala iphondo elibungele abatyali-mali ngokusebenzisa amanqamlelo olu lulo kwaye alungelelaniswe kumanyano ekusebenziseni ngenjongo yokukhusela abathengi. Mela abathengi abangabudalarho yimigaqo engalunganga yoshishino kwindlu enkulu yamathengi. Sebenzisana neNqanaba lokunxibelelwana ekwingqondo zokukhusela abathengi. Nxibelelane no. Mthetho wokukhusela abathengi wePhondo kunye namaNyango amatsha okuLawula kwamathengi. Imiba yokukhusela abathengi ehambelana nayo. Yabelana umsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Phuhlisa uze wakhule abasebenzi. Nikela izigqibo zemali esebenziselwa iNqanaba elingezantsi. Yala abaphathi ngeempazamo zengozi kunye neendlela zokuzithintela.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Administrative Support and Portfolio

Valid driver’s license (code B). Competencies: Working knowledge of the political and parliamentary processes in South Africa. Computer literacy. Communication, Workflow coordination, Strategic capability and leadership, Programme and project management, Financial Management, Problem solving and analysis, People management and Empowerment, Governance, Broad knowledge and understanding of the functional areas covered by the executive authority’s portfolio.

Liaise with internal and external role players with regard to matters relating to the portfolio of the executive authority and the accounting officer. jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. af.title: Onderdirekteur: Administratiewe Ondersteuning en Portefeulje
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat administratiewe ondersteuning en portefeuljekoördinering binne die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag in Johannesburg bied.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike graad NQF (Level 07) in Kantooradministrasie / Openbare Bestuur en Bestuursregering / Openbare Administrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Administrasie soos deur SAQA erken. 3 jaar ervaring onder middelbestuur op Assistentdirekteur-/middelbestuurvlak. Lewer 'n Kabinet/uitvoerende raad-ondersteuningsdiens aan die uitvoerende gesag en rekenpligtige beampte. Hou toesig oor werknemers.

jobs.summary: Assistant Director responsible for fraud risk assessment, anti-corruption policy development and investigating unethical conduct within the Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Forensic Auditing/ Auditing /Compliance as recognized by SAQA. Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) would be an added advantage A minimum of 3 years’ experience in Investigation/Forensic audit environment. Code 8/10 driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Coordinate periodic/regular identification and assessment of fraud risks. Gather information and provide inputs on the development of fraud Prevention Policy and Plan. Assist with the Facilitation of the development of an Anti- corruption Policy and Plan. Report all incidents of unethical/fraud and corruption the DD and CRO. Assist with the implementation of ethics management strategies. Liaise with relevant stakeholders (e.g., other investigative units, Departments etc). Evaluate mitigating measures and monitor their implementation. Manage the fraud/ethics risk register on an on- going basis. Facilitate training to management and employees of the Department on risk management and its components, including internal controls. Provide ongoing awareness of Legislative Framework regulating anti- corruption and fraud prevention to management and staff through workshops and other medium of communication. Keep abreast of national and international developments in fraud prevention and anticorruption. Conduct investigations into allegations of fraud and corruption reported to the department. Identify & request supporting documents. Compile Planning document. Identify personnel to interview. Conduct interviews with relevant stakeholders to establish facts. Draft investigation reports with detailed findings and clear recommendations for review and approval. Communicate recommendations to management for implementation. Follow-up on the implementation of recommended actions by management. Submit monthly reports to management on investigations conducted. Ensure implementation of ethics, fraud and corruption investigation procedures. Investigate all allegations of unethical, fraud and corruption in accordance with policy. Collaborate with law enforcement agencies in the investigation of corruption cases. Record all unethical and corruption cases in the information systems Provide information to all stakeholders (HoD, Executing Authority, GAS, Office of the Premier, law enforcement agencies) on corruption incidents and cases. Assist managers and staff in reporting risk information. Assist in ensuring 100% financial disclosure by SMS, MMS, and Other Designated categories Provide support to employees with the completion of e-Disclosure/ Conduct verification of financial disclosures and investigate anomalies. Assist employees with the process of Remunerative Work Outside Employee’s Employment (RWOEEs) application from beginning to end AND declaration of gifts Update and monitor the Remunerative Work Outside Employee’s Employment (RWOEEs) register, Gift Register. Engagements with auditors during the audit of ethics management programme i.e biannual/ Quarterly data analysis audit Co- ordinate the implementation of life-style audit.
