af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bedrog, Antikorrupsie en Integriteit
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur verantwoordelik vir bedrogrisiko-assesserings, die ontwikkeling van antikorrupsiebeleid en die ondersoek van onetiese gedrag binne die Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
af.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Forensic Auditing/ Auditing /Compliance soos erken deur SAQA. Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n ondersoek-/forensiese oudit-omgewing. Kode 8/10 bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer tydige/gereelde identifisering en assessering van bedrogrisiko's. Versamel inligting en verskaf insette oor die ontwikkeling van 'n bedrogvoorkomingsbeleid en -plan. Help met die fasilitering van die ontwikkeling van 'n antikorrupsiebeleid en -plan. Rapporteer alle voorvalle van onetiese/bedrog- en korrupsiegedrag aan die DD en CRO. Help met die implementering van etiekbestuursstrategieë. Skakel met tersaaklike belanghebbendes (bv. ander ondersoekeenhede, departemente ens). Evalueer matigende maatreëls en monitor die implementering daarvan. Bestuur die bedrog-/etiekrisiko-register op 'n deurlopende basis. Fasiliteer opleiding aan bestuur en werknemers van die departement oor risikobestuur en sy komponente, insluitend interne beheermaatreëls. Verskaf deurlopende bewustheid van die wetgewende raamwerk wat antikorrupsie en bedrogvoorkoming reguleer aan bestuur en personeel deur middel van werkswinkels en ander kommunikasiemediums. Bly op hoogte van nasionale en internasionale ontwikkelinge in bedrogvoorkoming en antikorrupsie. Voer ondersoeke uit na bewerings van bedrog en korrupsie wat aan die departement gerapporteer is. Identifiseer en versoek ondersteunende dokumente. Stel 'n beplanningsdokument op. Identifiseer personeel om te onderhou. Voer onderhoude met tersaaklike belanghebbendes om feite te vasstel. Stel ondersoekverslae op met gedetailleerde bevindings en duidelike aanbevelings vir hersiening en goedkeuring. Kommunikeer aanbevelings aan bestuur vir implementering. Volg die implementering van aanbevole aksies deur bestuur op. Dien maandelikse verslae by bestuur in oor ondersoeke wat uitgevoer is. Verseker implementering van etiek-, bedrog- en korrupsieondersoekprosedures. Ondersoek alle bewerings van onetiese gedrag, bedrog en korrupsie in ooreenstemming met beleid. Werk saam met wetstoepuringsagentskappe by die ondersoek van korrupsiegevalle. Rekord alle onetiese en korrupsiegevalle in die inligtingstelsels. Verskaf inligting aan alle belanghebbendes (HoD, Executing Authority, GAS, Office of the Premier, wetstoepuringsagentskappe) oor korrupsievoorvalle en -gevalle. Help bestuurders en personeel met die rapportering van risikoinligting. Help om 100% finansiële openbaarmaking deur SMS, MMS en ander aangewese kategorieë te verseker. Verskaf ondersteuning aan werknemers met die voltooiing van e-Disclosure. Doen verifikasie van finansiële openbaarmakings en ondersoek anomalieë. Help werknemers met die proses van Remunerative Work Outside Employee's Employment (RWOEEs)-aansoek van begin tot einde EN die verklaring van geskenke. Werk die Remunerative Work Outside Employee's Employment (RWOEEs)-register en geskenkregister by en monitor dit. Raakpleging met ouditeurs tydens die oudit van die etiekbestuursprogram, d.w.s. tweemaandelikse/kwartaallikse data-ontledingsoudit. Koördineer die implementering van lewensstyloudits. Voer die oudits uit waar nodig. Bestuur die prestasie van personeel onder toesig. Ontwikkel personeel. Motiveer personeel en kweek 'n kultuur van dienslewering.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ukukhwabanisa, Ukulwa Nokungalaleli, kanye Nokuziphatha Kokuqotho
zu.summary: Onozimele onenjongo yokuhlolwa kwezingozi zokukhwabanisa, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo zokulwa nokungalaleli kanye nokuphenya ukuziphatha okungalungile ngaphakathi kwe Gauteng Department of Economic Development.
zu.requirements: Izinga le-NQF Level 7 ekuloleni I-Akauthi Yezokuhlola Izinsimbi/ Ukuhlola/ Ukuziphathisa njengoba kuthathwa ngumhlabathi i-SAQA. Ukuba nguMhloli Ohlotshiwe Wokukhwabanisa (CFE) kungayiba yinzele empilweni. Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka emi-3 kumazinga okuphenya/ ekuhloleni izinsimbi ze-Forensic. Ilayisensi yokushayela Code 8/10.
zu.duties: Hlelela ukubonwa nokuhlolwa ngesikhathi nangamunye hleze kwezingozi zokukhwabanisa. Qoqa ulwazi futhi unikeze iminikelo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo Nohlelo Lokuvikela Ukukhwabanisa. Siza ekubumbeni kwenqubomgomo Yokulwa Nokungalaleli kanye noHlelo wayo. Bika wonke amacala okungalungile/okukhwabanisa nokungalaleli ku-DD kanye ne-CRO. Siza ekusebenziseni izindlela zokulawula izimiso zokuziphatha. Xhumana namabalengi abalulekile (izikelo, eminye iminyango yophenyo, eminye iminyango, njll). Hlolisisa izinyathelo zokunciphisa izingozi futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Lawula ukubhaliswa kwezingozi zokukhwabanisa/izimiso zokuziphatha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Hlelela ukuqeqeshwa komphathi nabasebenzi beMnyango kokuLawulwa Kohlelo nokwakhe kwalo, okuhlanganisa izilawulo zangaphakathi. Nikeza ulwazi oluqhubekayo ngohlaka Lomthetho olulawula ukulwa nokungalaleli nokuvikela ukukhwabanisa kubaphathi nabasebenzi ngezinhlangano zokufundisa kanye nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana. Zinzele ngokuqhubekayo kolwazi mayelana nentuthuko yezwe nemhlaba ekuvikeleni ukukhwabanisa nokulwa nokungalaleli. Yenza iziphondo ngezikhalazo zokukhwabanisa nokungalaleli ezibikwe kumnyango. Bonakalise futhi ucele amaxwebhu axhasayo. Hlola umtapo wolwazi wamadokhumenti kanye nokuhlelelwa kwawo. Khetha abantu abazobuzwa. Buza ababalengi abalulekile ukuze ushiye isithombe sendawo. Bhala imibiko yophenyo ngeziphumo ezenziwe ngokuningiliziwe kanye neminikelo evecile ezele ukubuyekezwa nokuqinisekiswa. Yenze iminikelo ibe seduzane kubaphathi ukuba bayisebenzise. Landela ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo eziminikiwe ngabaphathi. Thumela imibiko yenyanga ngayinye kubaphathi ngemiphakathi ezenziwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokuphenya izimiso zokuziphatha, ukukhwabanisa nokungalaleli. Phenya wonke amacala angalungile, ukukhwabanisa nokungalaleli ngokwemithetho yesiNqubomgomo. Sebenzisana namaphoyisa ekuphenyeni amacala ezenzo ezingcolile. Bhala wonke amacala angalungile nokungalaleli ohlelweni lwemiyalo. Nikeza ulwazi kubabalengi bonke (iHoD, Umbuso Ohlephayo, i-GAS, iNkundla YesiNkulu, amaphoyisa) ngamacela okungalaleli kanye nezensele. Siza abaphathi nabasebenzi ekubukeni ukungalaleli kwezwe. Siza ekubukeni ukuthi izikhalazo zobuphathi ziyabhalwa ngo-100% ngesi-SMS, i-MMS, namaqoqo abhalisiwe. Siza abasebenzi nokuqedwa kwe-e-Disclosure/ ukuhlola ukungalaleli kohlelo lwezimali nokuphenya okungalungile. Siza abasebenzi ngomumo wokuqashwa Kwemisebenzi Ekwelashwa Ngaphandle Komsebenzi (RWOEE) ukusuka ekuqaleni kuye ekugcineni kanye nokubhala izipho. Buyekeza futhi ulawule ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi engaphandle kwegodi (RWOEE), kanye nokubhalwa kwezinsimbi zokufaka izipho. Xhumana nabahleli ngesikhathi sohlelo lokuhlolwa ngemithetho yokuziphatha njengamancazelo okuhlolwa kwesikhashana njengenyanga yonke. Hlelela ukubhaliswa nokuhlolwa kwe-Criminal Record. Yenza uhlelo lokuhlolwa lapho kudingeka khona. Lawula ukusebenza kwabantu abalawulwayo. Phuhlisa abasebenzi. Khuthaza abasebenzi futhi ukhiqize isiko lokuletha amandla.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba: Ukoluka, Ukuchaswa nokonakaliswa kweziQinisekiso, nokuZinikela ngokuzithoba
xh.summary: Umncedisi onoxanduva lokuhlola ingozi yobukrelekrwe, kwakho iindlela zokuchasa ukonakaliswa kweziqinisekiso nokuphandela imveliso engalunganga ngaphakathi kwiGauteng Department of Economic Development.
xh.requirements: I-NQF Level 7 kwi-Forensic Auditing/Auditing/Compliance njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba yi-Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) kuba kuya kuba ngumlene ongongeza inzuzo. Iminyaka engu-3 yamava kwendawo yokuphanda/ukuhlola ubukrelekrwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code 8/10.
xh.duties: Qhoboshela ukuchonga nokuhlola rhoqo iingozi zobukrelekrwe. Qokelela ulwazi kunye nezinto ongenazo kumashishini kwiindlela zokuThintela uKoluka neNkqubo. Ncedisa ekukhuliseni iindlela ze-Nticipal would kwiNkqubo nendebe yokuchasana nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso. Xela yonke imizekelo yemveliso engalunganga/yobukrelekrwe kunye nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso kwi-DD kunye ne-CRO. Ncedisa ekusebenzeni iindlela zokulawula imigaqo yokuziphatha. Thethana nabathintekayo (umz., amanye amaqela okuphandisa, Iisebe njl). Hlola izithintelo ezithintelwayo zulwalela nanjani ziyasebenza. Lawula irekhodi lezyliselwa zobukrelekrwe yemigaqo ngokuntshatsho kwaye ukhokelele. Yenza uqeqesho kubaphathi kunye nabasebenzi beSebe malunga nokuLawula iingozi nemitshanayo, kuquka nolawulo lwasaphakathi. Yaza ngokuqhubekayo ngenkqubo ze-Mthetho elawula ukuchaswa nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso ukuyixelesiwa kubaphathi nakubasebenzi ngamasebe okusebenzisa izihlwalu nendlela zokuthetha. Zigcine kakhulwazi iinkqubela zamazwe ngamazwe nasemaphandleni ekuthinteleni ubukrelekrwe ukuchaswa nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso. Yenza imiphanda kumangalo wobukrelekrwe nokonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso exelwe kusebe. Chonga futhi ucele amaxwebhu axhasa. Hlaziya ixwebhu lokulungiselela. Chonga abantu abaza kubuziswa. Yenza imibuzo kunye nabathintekayo ngenjongo yokuxela inyani. Bhala iinkcazelo zokuphanda ezinetiphakamiso neenkcukacha ezicacileyo zokuhlola ukugunyaziswa. Xela iziphakamiso kubaphathi ukuba bazisebenzise. Landelela ukusebenza kweziphakamiso eziziweyo ngabaphathi. Thumela iinkcazelo nyanga zonke kubaphathi malunga nemiphanda eyenziweyo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwemigaqo yokuphanda imigaqo nokonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso. Phanda yonke imangalo yemigaqo engalunganga, ubukrelekrwe nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso ngokulandela umgaqo. Sebenzisana namaphetha womthetho ekuphandeni imeko zonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso. Zifake ngokubhalisa zonke iimeko zemigaqo engalunganga nolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso kwinkqubo yolwazi. Nikeza ulwazi kuwo onke abathintekayo (uHoD, igunya lokwenza, i-GAS, iNkundla kaNdunankulu, amaphetha womthetho) malunga neengozi nemeko zolonakaliswa lweziqinisekiso. Ncedisa abaphathi nabasebenzi ekuxela ulwazi ngeengozi. Ncedisa ekuvakaliseni ukuba kuye kubekho ngokupheleleyo ukutyhila ngemali ngakwabantu abakumagqabi, abakwindima yemigaqo nabenye iLungelo oluqatshiweyo. Nikela inkxaso kubasebenzi ekugqibeleni kwe-e-Disclosure okanye ukuqinisekisa ukutyhila kwemali nokuphanda izinto ezingahambiswanga. Ncedisa abasebenzi ngenkqubo yokuSebenza iNkxaso ekuPhangeleni ngaphandle koPhango lomSebenzi (RWOEEs) ukusuka ekuqaleni kuye kugqibele kwaye uvakalise izipho. Hlaziya ulwalele inkqubo yokuSebenza iNkxaso ekuPhangeleni ngaphandle koPhango lomSebenzi (RWOEEs), ukuBhalisa izipho. Thetha nabaphengi ngelixa kokuphanda inkqubo yokulawula imigaqo, oko kukuthi ukuhlolwa ngokuqhubekayo kwesikdata kwigqrithi nangesinye isikathi. Qhoboshela ukusebenza kokuhlola indlela yokuphila. Yenza okuhlwayo xa kufuneka. Lawula imisebenzi yabantu abalawulwayo. Phuhlisa abasebenzi. Khuthaza abasebenzi uze wakhe inkcubeko yokubonelela ngemisebenzi yaseburhulumeni.

jobs.title: Liquor Trade Inspector
jobs.summary: Liquor Trade Inspector at the Department of Economic Development in Johannesburg, requiring a law degree and 3-5 years' investigation experience.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s degree in law, Forensic Investigation qualification as recognised by SAQA. LLB qualifications will be an added advantage. 3-5 years’ experience in Liquor Affairs / Investigation Officer or relevant work experience. Code 08/10.
jobs.duties: Visit and conduct inspection at the new applicants ‘premises Compare the actual site/ structure of the premises with the application to ensure compliance to the Liquor Act. Confirm the file is up to date. Compile site visit reports and make recommendations to the Licensing Board. Receive complaints from members of the public/interested parties. Conduct investigations and gather evidence to verify allegations. Compile a report on the findings. Escalate and provide evidence (of non-compliance) to the Licensing Board as and when required. Establish whether the outlet/premises are trading in compliance with the granted license conditions/ Gauteng liquor Act. Gather evidence of non- compliance (if premises are not trading in compliance to license conditions/Gauteng liquor Act). Issue a non-compliance notice (section 116 of the Gauteng liquor act. Conduct follow up site inspection to establish whether the terms of the non-compliance notice has been complied with. Compile reports on findings and escalate to the board (if the non-compliance notice has not been complied with). Compile and update inventories and lists of records earmarked for archiving or disposal. Arrange the transfer of records approved for archiving to the designated archival storage facility. Facilitate the disposal of records upon approval by the authorised officials.
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Drunkhandel-inspekteur
af.summary: Drunkhandel-inspekteur by die Department of Economic Development in Johannesburg, wat 'n regterlike graad en 3-5 jaar se ondersoekervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad in regte, kwalifikasie in forensiese ondersoek soos deur SAQA erken. LLB-kwalifikasies sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Drank sake / Ondersoekbeampte of tersaaklike werkervaring. Kode 08/10.
af.duties: Besoek en doen inspeksie by die nuwe aansoekers se persele. Vergelyk die werklike terrein/struktuur van die perseel met die aansoek om te verseker dat daar aan die Drankwet voldoen word. Bevestig dat die lêer op datum is. Stel perseelbesoekverslae op en doen aanbevelings aan die Lisensiëringsraad. Ontvang klagtes van lede van die publiek/betrokke partye. Doen ondersoeke en versamel bewyse om beweringe te verifieer. Stel 'n verslag oor die bevindings op. Eskaleer en verskaf bewyse (van nie-nakoming) aan die Lisensiëringsraad soos en wanneer dit vereis word. Vaststel of die afset/perseel in ooreenstemming met die toegelate lisensievoorwaardes/Gauteng Drankwet handel dryf. Versamel bewyse van nie-nakoming (indien persele nie in ooreenstemming met lisensievoorwaardes/Gauteng Drankwet handel dryf nie). Reik 'n nie-nakomingskennisgewing uit (artikel 116 van die Gauteng Drankwet). Doen opvolg-perseelinspeksie om vas te stel of daar aan die bepalings van die nie-nakomingskennisgewing voldoen is. Stel verslae oor bevindings op en eskaleer dit na die raad (indien daar nie aan die nie-nakomingskennisgewing voldoen is nie). Stel en werk voorraadlyste en lyste van rekords wat vir argivering of vernietiging gemerk is, by. Reël die oordrag van rekords wat vir argivering goedgekeur is na die aangewese argiefbergingsfasiliteit. Fassiliteer die vernietiging van rekords na goedkeuring deur die gemagtigde beamptes.

zu.title: Inhloli Yentengiso Yotshwala
zu.summary: Inhloli Yentengiso Yotshwala eKhomishini Yezomnotho eJohannesburg, edinga iziqu zomthetho neminyaka yamava eminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengu-5 yokuphenya.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor ezomthethweni, iziqu zokuphenya ngezindlela zesayensi ezingabonakaliswa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ze-LLB zizokuba yinuzu elengeziwe. Amava eminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengu-5 kwezomabo wotshwala / Njengomphenyi noma amava okusebenza ahambisana nalokho. Ikhodi 08/10.
zu.duties: Vakashela futhi wenze ukucwaninga ezindaweni zabanikelayo abasha. Qhathanis indawo yakho / ukwakheka kwendawo ngesicelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana noMthetho Wotshwala. Qinisekisa ukuthi ifayela libhaliswe ngosuku lwamanje. Hlela imibiko yokuvasisha indawo futhi unike izincomo kuBhodi Lokukhishwa Kwamalayisense. Yamukela izikhalazo kubantu / kubahlakuli. Yenza iziphenyo futhi uqoqe izibulo ukuqinisekisa izinsolo. Hlela umbiko ngokuqhabo. Phakamisa futhi unike izibulo (lokungahambisani) kuBhodi Lokukhishwa Kwamalayisense njengoba kudingeka. Hlola ukuthi uwindo / indawo iyashintsha ngokuhambisana nezimo ezinikiwe yilayisense / noMthetho Wotshwala we-Gauteng. Qoqa izibulo lokungahambisani (uma indawo ingashintshi ngokuhambisana nezimo zalayisense / noMthetho Wotshwala we-Gauteng). Khishana isaziso sokungahambisani (isigaba 116 soMthetho Wotshwala we-Gauteng). Yenza ukucwaninga okulandelayo endaweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkalo zesaziso sokungahambisani sezihambiswe. Hlela imibiko ngokuqhabo futhi uyiphakamise ebhodini (uma isaziso sokungahambisani singakuhambiswa). Hlela futhi ubuyekeze izinto ezibhalwe ngokwemininingwane namakhulu obunikelo abhalwe ukuze agcinwe noma lazingwa. Hlela ukudluliswa kobunikelo obuvunyiwe ukuze kugcinwe endaweni ebaluliwe yokugcina ubunikelo. Qedelela ukulahla ubunikelo uma kuvunyiwe ngabaphathi abagunyaziwe.

xh.title: Mvakeli Wentengiso yaseLali
xh.summary: Mvakeli Wentengiso yaseLali kwiSebe leZenzo loPhuhliso lezoQoqosho eJohannesburg, elifuna isidanga kolwesiwoqqobo kunye namava eminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwengama-5 ekuphenjeni.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor kolwesiwoqqobo, isatifikethi seForensic Investigation esivunywe ngumgaqo weSAQA. Iqualifications zeLLB ziya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Amava eminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwangama-5 kwiZindaba zeLali / Njengomvakeli okanye amava ohlelo lokusebenza ahambelana nalo. Ikhodi 08/10.
xh.duties: Tshaya iindawo ezintsha zabafakeli kwaye uqalise uvakelo kwindawo abayicaphule. Thathanisa indawo/ukwakhiwa kwendawo ngesicelo ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba kolwesiwoqqobo ngokuMthetho waseLali. Qinisekisa ukuba ifayile ihlaziyiwe. Hlaziya iingxelo zokutshaya iindawo kwaye wenze izindululo kwiLicensing Board. Wamke iingxaki ezisuka kubahlali/baphathi abanomdla. Qalisa imiphenyo kwaye uqoke iimbangi ukuqinisekisa izityholo. Hlaziya ingxelo ngemiphumo. Yiphakamise kwaye unike iimbangi (zokungazithobi) kwiLicensing Board njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuba iveni/indawo ithengisa ngokuzithoba kumagqabantshintshiwalayisensi anikezelweyo/uMthetho weGauteng liquor Act. Qoke iimbangi zokungazithobi (ukuba indawo ithengisa ngokungalawuleki kwamagqabantshintshiwalayisensi/uMthetho weGauteng liquor Act). Nikezela isaziso sokungazithobi (icandelo 116 loMthetho weGauteng liquor act. Qalisa uvakelo lolandelayo kwindawo ukuqinisekisa ukuba amagqabantshintsho wesaziso sokungazithobi ahleliwe. Hlaziya iingxelo ngemiphumo kwaye uziphakamise kwibhodi (ukuba isaziso sokungazithobi asihleliwe). Hlaziya kwaye uvuse izinto ezibhalwe noluhlu lwegama elinqunyiweyo lokugcinwa okanye ukutshatyalaliswa. Lungisa ukudluliswa koluhlu lwemibhalo evunyiweyo yokugcinwa kwindawo egunyazisiweyo yokugcina iindawo. Yenza ukutshatyalaliswa koluhlu lwemibhalo emva kokuvunywa ngamaphakanyiswa agunyazisiweyo.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk: Executive Support
jobs.summary: Registry clerk providing counter services and managing incoming mail and documents in the executive support office at Umnotho House, Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. 1-2 years’ experience in the Office of an Executive.
jobs.duties: Provide registry counter services. Attend to registry clients and respond to telephonic and other registry-related enquiries. Receive and register hand- delivered mail, files and documents in the appropriate registry registers or electronic systems. Date-stamp, sort and categorise incoming documents in accordance with established registry procedures. Verify and acknowledge receipt of documents submitted at the registry counter, ensuring completeness and providing confirmation of receipt where required. Distribute and route documents and files to the relevant officials or offices for further processing. Process Incoming and Outgoing Correspondence. Prepare outgoing correspondence for dispatch in accordance with departmental procedures. Verify recipients’ details, addresses and supporting documents before dispatch. Dispatch official correspondence through approved channels, including courier, postal services, email or hand delivery. Monitor the delivery of outgoing correspondence and follow up on delayed or undelivered items. Maintain proof of dispatch and delivery for accountability and audit purposes. Track outstanding correspondence and report delays or discrepancies to the relevant supervisor. Maintain an Effective Filing and Records Management Service. Operate office equipment, including photocopiers, scanners, printers and binding machines, to support registry operations. Reproduce and scan official documents as required for departmental recordkeeping and administrative purposes. Monitor the availability of paper, toner and other consumables required for the effective operation of office equipment. Perform basic routine maintenance and troubleshooting of office equipment in accordance with operating instructions. Operate and Maintain Office Equipment for Registry Functions. Report equipment faults and arrange for repairs or servicing through the appropriate departmental channels. Coordinate the Processing of Documents for Archiving and Disposal. Identify records due for archiving or disposal in accordance with approved records retention schedules. Assess and prepare records for archiving or disposal in line with departmental records management procedures. Compile and update inventories and lists of records earmarked for archiving or disposal. Arrange the transfer of records approved for archiving to the designated archival storage facility. Facilitate the disposal of records upon approval by the authorised officials and in accordance with applicable legislation and departmental policies.
jobs.applications: Apply online to the http:jobs.gauteng.gpg.gov.za website only.
jobs.notes: Application form (Z83) should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring their originally certifies copies of their qualifications, ID and drivers licence. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Kindly note that: successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance in terms of a criminal record check, verifications of qualifications. All short-listed candidates may be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, for which the logistics will be communicated by the department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Registerklerk: Uitvoerende Ondersteuning
af.summary: Registerklerk wat toonbankdienste lewer en inkomende pos en dokumente in die kantoor vir uitvoerende ondersteuning by Umnotho House, Johannesburg bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12. 1-2 jaar se ondervinding in die Kantoor van 'n Uitvoerende Beampte.
af.duties: Lever register-toonbankdienste. Bedien register-kliënte en reageer op telefoon- en ander registerverwante navrae. Ontvang en registreer per afgelewerde pos, lêers en dokumente in die toepaslike registerregisters of elektroniese stelsels. Dateer-stempel, sorteer en kategoriseer inkomende dokumente in ooreenstemming met gevestigde registerprosedures. Verifieer en bevestig ontvangs van dokumente by die registertoonbank ingedien, verseker volledigheid en verskaf bevestiging van ontvangs waar nodig. Versprei en roeteer dokumente en lêers na die relevante beamptes of kantore vir verdere verwerking. Verwerk Inkomende en Uitgaande Korrespondensie. Berei uitgaande korrespondensie vir versending voor in ooreenstemming met departementele prosedures. Verifieer ontvangers se besonderhede, adresse en ondersteunende dokumente voor versending. Stuur amptelike korrespondensie deur goedgekeurde kanale, insluitend koerier, posdienste, e-pos of aflewering per hand. Monitor die aflewering van uitgaande korrespondensie en volg vertraagde of nie-afgelewerde items na. Handhaaf bewys van versending en aflewering vir verantwoording en ouditdoeleindes. Spoor uitstaande korrespondensie na en rapporteer vertragings of afwykings aan die relevante toesighouer. Handhaaf 'n Effektiewe Lêer- en Rekordbestuursdiens. Bedryf kantoortoerusting, insluitend fotokopieerders, skandeerders, drukkers en inbindmasjiene, om registerbedrywighede te ondersteun. Reproduseer en skandeer amptelike dokumente soos benodig vir departementele rekordhouding en administratiewe doeleindes. Monitor die beskikbaarheid van papier, toner en ander verbruiksmiddele wat vir die effektiewe werking van kantoortoerusting benodig word. Voer basiese roetine-onderhoud en probleemoplossing van kantoortoerusting uit in ooreenstemming met bedryfsinstruksies. Bedryf en Onderhou Kantoortoerusting vir Registerfunksies. Rapporteer toerustingfoute en reël herstelwerk of onderhoud deur die toepaslike departementele kanale. Koördineer die Verwerking van Dokumente vir Argivering en Vernietiging. Identifiseer rekords wat vir argivering of vernietiging in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde rekordretensieskedules gedoen moet word. Evalueer en berei rekords vir argivering of vernietiging voor in ooreenstemming met departementele rekordbestuursprosedures. Stel opsaai en dateer voorraadlyste en lyste van rekords wat vir argivering of vernietiging voorgenom is. Reël die oordrag van rekords wat vir argivering goedgekeur is na die aangewese argiefbergingsfasiliteit. Fasiliteer die vernietiging van rekords na goedkeuring deur die gemagtigde beamptes en in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en departementele beleide.

zu.title: Clerk woMgcini Wezefayili: Inkxaso Yomphathi
zu.summary: Clerk woMgcini wezefayili ohlinzeka ngesevisi yasesikhundleni nangezinsiza futhi uphatha imaphosta ezingena namadokhumenti enkxasweni yomphathi e-Umnotho House, eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Unyaka we-1-2 wokuhlangabezana enkundleni yomphathi.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yomgcini wezefayili esikhundleni. Phathisana nabalifelayo besevisi yomgcini wezefayili uphendule imibuzo ephathelene nomgcini wezefayili efoni naye yonke eminye. Yamukela ubhalise imaphosta, amafayili namadokhumenti anikelwa ngesandla kumagazini okugcina okufanele noma kwezinhlelo zikagesi. Faka izithombe-zinsuku zomgcini wezefayili, hlela bese uhlotshanisa amadokhumenti angena ngokwemigcibo yomgcini wezefayili esunguliwe. Qinisekisa bese uvuma ukuthi uyamukele amadokhumenti anikelwa esikhundleni somgcini wezefayili, uqinisekisa ukuthi aphelele futhi unikeza isiqiniseko sokumukela lapho kudingeka khona. Sabelisa bese uqondisa amadokhumenti namafayili kubasebenzi noma kwezikhungo ezifanele ukuze kwenziwe ukucubungula okuqhubekayo. Chibiyela ukuthunyelwa nokuthunywa kuleyo nhlobo yemibhalo. Lulungisele imibhalo ethunyelwa iyaphuma ukuze ithunyelwe ngokwemigcibo yomnyango. Qinisekisa imininingwane yabathunyelwele, izikhombi namadokhumenti axhasayo ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Thumela imibhalo esemthethweni ngesikhombimsebenzi esamukelekile, okuhlanganisa nomThunywa, izinsiza zeposidi, i-email noma ukunikeza ngesandla. Qaphula ukufika kwemibhalo ephumayo bese ulandela ngomva imikhiqizo ebeliviwe noma ezingafinyelelwanga. Gcina isiqiniseko sokuthunyelwa nokufika ngenhloso yokwenzela ukubaluleka kanye nokuholwa. Landela imibhalo ehlala ihamba bese ukhombisa ukubambezeleka noma okungalungi kumphathi ofanele. Gcina isevisi Esebenzayo Yokugcina Namafayili nokuphathwa Kwemibhalo. Sebenzisa izinto zikagesi zangasese, okuhlanganisa nomshini wokushumayela ngokushicilelwa, abagcini bamaphoyinti, abashicileli namashini okuboph, ukuze uxhase imisebenzi yomgcini wezefayili. Shicilela bese ushenza amadokhumenti esemthethweni njengoba kudingeka ngenhloso yokugcina imibhalo yomnyango nongqeqsho lolunye. Qaphula ukutholakala kwephepha, isihluku nolunye olushisiwe oludingeka ukuze kusebenze kahle izinto zikagesi zangasese. Yenza ukulungiswa nokuxazulula izinkinga ezibekiwe kwezinto zikagesi zangasese ngokwemiyalo yokusebenza. Sebenzisa Ulondoloze Izinto Zikagesi Zangasese Ngenhloso Yemisebenzi Yomgcini Wezefayili. Khomba izinkinga zezinto zikagesi bese uhlela ukulungiswa noma ukwenziwa izinsiza ngesikhombimsebenzi sikaNyango esifanele. Hlela ukucubungula amadokhumenti ukuze agcinwe noma aphekuliswe. Khomba imibhalo edinga ukugcinwa noma ukuphekulwa ngokohlela oluvunyiwe lokugcina imibhalo. Hlola bese ulungiselela imibhalo ukuze igcinwe noma iphekulwe ngokwemigcibo yokuphathwa kwemibhalo kaNyango. Buta buse uvuselela izinhlu zemibhalo eqondiswe ukugcinwa noma ukuphekulwa. Hlela ukudluliswa kwemibhalo evunyiwe ukugcinwa endaweni etholakala khona ukugcina imibhalo. Yenza kube lula ukuphekulwa kwemibhalo uma kuvunyelwe ababeki bakaNyango futhi ngokwelimo elisebenzayo namapholisi kaNyango.

xh.title: Umntu Wonkqebela Wokubhalisa: Inkxaso Yabaphathi Abakhulu
xh.summary: Umntu wonkqebela wokubhalisa onika iinkonzo zesikhidini kwindawo yokusingathwa nokulawula iposi ezingenayo namaxwebhu kwindawo yenkxaso yabaphathi abakhulu kwindlu i-Umnotho House, eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: I-Grede 12. Iiminyaka ezingama-1-2 yamava kwindlu yomphathi oqhuba.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zesikhidini kwindawo yokubhalisa. Yonwaba kumaxhwebhu endawo yokubhalisa uphendule imibuzo ngomnxeba nangeminye imibuzo enxulumene nendawo yokubhalisa. Yamkela uze ubhale iposti ezingenisiwe ngesandla, iifayile namaxwebhu kwii-register ezifanelekile zokubhalisa okanye kweenkqubo zamakhompyutha. Faka usuku, uhlele uzahlule amaxwebhu agenisiwe ngokuhlomela iindlela eziseziselweni zokubhalisa. Qinisekisa uvume ukwamkelwa kwamaxwebhu axeliweyo kwindawo yesikhidini yokubhalisa, uqinisekise ukuba aplwe ngokupheleleyo unike isiqinisekiso sokwamkelwa apho kufuneka khona. Yahlula uze uhambise amaxwebhu neefayile kubasebenzi okanye kwiiofisi ezifanelekileyo ezakuziswa phambili. Cwangcisa ukuhamba nokuphuma kweenkxwembo ezingenayo nasezithumwayo. Lungisa iinkxwembo ezithunwayo zokuze zithunyelwe ngokomgaqo-nkqubo wesebe. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha zabamamkelayo, iidilesi namaxwebhu axhasayo ngaphambi kokuba zithunyelwe. Thumela iinkxwembo ezisemthethweni ngeendlela ezivunyiweyo, kuquka ukuthunyelwa ngomthwamkazi, ngeposi nange-imeyile okanye ngesandla. Lilinda ukufikelela kweenkxwembo ezithunjiweyo uze ulandelele izinto ezilibazisekileyo okanye ezingazange zifikele. Zigcine iimbekisizo zoku-thunyelwa nokufikelela ngenjongo yokubala nokuhlola. Landela iinkxwembo ezingazange ziphume uze uxele ngokulibaziseka okanye ngokungahambelaniyo kumlawuli ofanelekileyo. Gcina inkonzo esebenzayo yokulungisa iifayile nokulawula iirekhodi. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofisi, kuquka izikopi zamaxesha amaninzi, iiscanara, iiprinda nezixhobo zokubopha, ukuze uxhase imisebenzi yokubhalisa. Phinda uhlakaze amaxwebhu esemthethweni njengoko kufuneka ngenjongo yokugcina iirekhodi zesebe nangabenjongo bolawulo. Lilinda ukubakho kwephepha, i-toner nezinye izinto ezidityaniswayo ezifunekayo ukuze zisebenze kakuhle izixhobo zofisi. Yenza ulungiselelo olusetyenziswayo nolulula ngokwenza isiphithiphathi kwiinkxwembo ngokwemiyalelo yokusebenza. Sebenzisa uze ulondoloze izixhobo zofisi ngenjongo yemisebenzi yokubhalisa. Xela iimpazamo kumathuba awombane othuthukileyo uzicwangcise nokulungiswa okanye ukonakalisa ngokwemigangatho yesebe. Hlela ukucwangciswa kwamaxwebhu ukuba zithunyelwe kolwalamko okanye zohlakalwe. Chaza iirekhodi ezifanele ukuba zithunyelwe kolwalamko okanye zohlakalwe ngokohlelo oluvunyelweyo loku-gcina iirekhodi. Hlola uze ulungise iirekhodi ukuba zithunyelwe kolwalamko okanye zohlakalwe ngokumgaqo-nkqubo wesebe wolawulo. Qamba uhlome uluhlu lweerekhodi ezichongiweyo ukuba zithunyelwe kolwalamko okanye zohlakalwe. Cwangcisa ukudluliswa kweerekhodi ezivunyelwe ukuba zithunyelwe kolwalamko endaweni egciniweyo yolwalamko. Yenza lula ukuhlakahlakwa kweerekhodi emva kokuvunywa ngabasebenzi abagunyazisiweyo nangokomthetho osebenzayo nangokomgaqo-nkqubo wesebe.

jobs.title: Director: Supply Chain Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to an individual’s needs)
jobs.summary: Director of Supply Chain Management sought by the Department of Environment in Johannesburg to oversee procurement, inventory and asset management, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 5 years' management experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Supply Chain Management/ Finance or other related qualifications as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience at middle or senior management level in Supply Chain Management. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership skills, People Management, Empowerment and Intergrity, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and project Management. Technical Competencies: Departmental policies and procedures, Government Priorities, Reporting procedures and Information system. Strong managerial and communication skills (written and verbal). Thorough knowledge of the Financial Prescripts of Public Service and Supply Chain Management. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Ability to work in a team and independently. Strong Management skills. Problem Solving and Analysis, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication.
jobs.duties: Manage procurement for goods and services. Lead the identification of Supply Chain Management needs. Identify procurement priorities and finalisation. Ensure the finalization of procurement plans. To develop and maintain an inventory management system. Development and implement movable assets management strategy. Lead the rendering of services with regard to requisition, ordering, receipt and distribution of goods. Make input into the Strategic and Annual Performance Plans to support the achievement of the construction procurement policy in the Institution. Finalize procurement plans. Finalize Bid Specification Documentation, Advertisement processes and Tender Clarification Meetings. Manage the process related to the receipt and opening of Tender Proposals and/or Expressions of Interest. Manage implementation of responsiveness testing. Manage implementation of Tender Evaluation. Provide inputs to the development of a Supply Chain Management policy framework that deals with the whole spectrum of procurement. Provide inputs to the determination of delegations for procurement. Design and establish procurement processes and procedures [Standard Operating Procedures] that are fair, competitive, equitable, transparent and cost effective. Design and implement a system to monitor the performance of suppliers and the performance of the Contracting Institution. Develop risk mitigation strategies to evaluate the performance of suppliers. Development of Standard Procurement Templates. Provide inputs to the appointment of Tender Committee Members. Manage the design and implementation of controls to comply with contract requirements. Manage and review all cancellations, amendments, expansions, variations, extensions or transfer of contracts awarded through the Bid Committee. Manage implementation of penalties where required. Manage expansions of contracts above the amounts provided in terms of contingencies. Manage motivations to authorise increases in the total prices excluding price adjustment for inflation in excess of the amount stated in the contract and make recommendations. Manage motivation for events which in terms of the contract increase and make recommendations. Manage the preparation of performance reports for the service provider based on input received from the relevant units. Monitor communication between SCM and other units in order for various branches to meet all contractual timelines and related obligations. Sign performance agreements for the Directorate based on approved Job Descriptions, Strategic and Annual Performance Plans of the Department. Manage human resources in the Directorate and maintain discipline. Manage training and development of personnel according to agreed training interventions. Manage the provision of equipment required by personnel for achievement of outputs in their respective Job Descriptions. Provide regular verbal and written feedback [aligned to quarterly performance assessments] to personnel on performance. Mentor and coach personnel. Determine the human resources needs of the Directorate in consultation with Corporate Services. Develop and update the delivery service and work plan for the Directorate. Provide sufficient guidance to personnel in terms of the service delivery plan, work plans, core business roles and priorities of the Department through quarterly personnel meetings. Manage skills transfer between personnel in the Directorate and outside technical assistants and/or consultants. Plan and allocate work responsibilities and processes to control work performance including quality assurance. Manage funds in the Directorate in compliance with the Public Finance. Management Act and the Treasury Regulations. Limit under spending or overspending by the Directorate in terms of the departmental budget allocations. Manage the effective spending of infrastructure grant funding. Align the strategic priorities and the work plans of the Directorate with the Chief Directorate. Develop operational plans for the Directorate and work plans for each staff member in the Directorate. Provide written contributions to departmental quarterly progress reports, Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget speeches, Annual Performance Plan etc.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za send an email at: GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za. quoting the relevant reference number.
jobs.notes: Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Toeskakelkettingbestuur
af.summary: Die Department of Environment in Johannesburg soek 'n Direkteur van Toeskakelkettingbestuur om verkryging, voorraad- en batebestuur te oorsien, met 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar se bestuurservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Toeskakelkettingbestuur/ Finansies of ander verwante kwalifikasies soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in Toeskakelkettingbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskapsvaardighede, mensebestuur, bemagtiging en integriteit, finansiele bestuur, veranderingsbestuur, program- en projekbestuur. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Regeringsprioriteite, verslagdoeningsprosedures en inligtingstelsel. Sterk bestuurs- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Deeglike kennis van die Finansiele Voorskryfte van die Publieke Diens en Toeskakelkettingbestuur. Eienskappe: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoe om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Vermoe om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Sterk bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise, kliensorientering en kliensteun, kommunikasie.
af.duties: Bestuur verkryging van goedere en dienste. Lei die identifisering van Toeskakelkettingbestuurbehoeftes. Identifiseer verkrygingsprioriteite en finalisering. Verseker die finalisering van verkrygingsplanne. Om 'n voorraadbestuurstelsel te ontwikkel en te onderhou. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n bestuursstrategie vir roerende bates. Lei die lewer van dienste met betrekking tot versoek, bestelling, ontvangs en verspreiding van goedere. Lewe bydraes tot die Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne om die bereiking van die konstruksieverkrygingsbeleid in die Instelling te ondersteun. Finaliseer verkrygingsplanne. Finaliseer Biedspesifikasiedokumentasie, Advertensieprosesse en Tenderverhelderingsvergaderings. Bestuur die proses wat verband hou met die ontvangs en opening van Tender voorstelle en/of Belangstellingsuitings. Bestuur implementering van reaksie toetsing. Bestuur implementering van Tender evaluering. Verskaf bydraes tot die ontwikkeling van 'n Toeskakelkettingbestuurbeleidsraamwerk wat die hele spektrum van verkryging hanteer. Verskaf bydraes tot die bepaling van delegasies vir verkryging. Ontwerp en vestig verkrygingsprosesse en prosedures [Standbedryfsprosedures] wat regverdig, mededingend, billik, deursigtig en kostedoeltreffend is. Ontwerp en implementeer 'n stelsel om die prestasie van verskaffers en die prestasie van die Kontrakterende Instelling te monitor. Ontwikkel risikobeperkingsstrategiee om die prestasie van verskaffers te evalueer. Ontwikkeling van Standaard Verkrygingsjablone. Verskaf bydraes tot die aanstelling van Tenderkomiteelede. Bestuur die ontwerp en implementering van kontroles om aan kontrakvereistes te voldoen. Bestuur en hersien alle kansellasies, wysigings, uitbreidings, variasies, verlengings of oordrag van kontrakte wat deur die Biedkomitee toegestaan is. Bestuur implementering van boetes waar nodig. Bestuur uitbreidings van kontrakte bo die bedrae wat ingevolge kontingensies voorsien is. Bestuur motiverings om verhogings in die totale pryse, eksklusiveer prysaanpassings vir inflasie, bo die bedrag in die kontrak vermeld, goedgekeur en doen aanbevelings. Bestuur motivering vir gebeurtenisse wat ingevolge die kontrak toeneem en doen aanbevelings. Bestuur die voorbereiding van prestasieverslae vir die diensverskaffer gebaseer op insette ontvang van die relevante eenhede. Monitor kommunikasie tussen Toeskakelkettingbestuur en ander eenhede sodat verskeie takke alle kontraktuele tydlyne en verwante verpligtinge kan nakom. Teken prestasieooreenkomste vir die Direktoraat gebaseer op goedgekeurde Werksbeskrywinge, Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne van die Departement. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne in die Direktoraat en handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel ooreenkomstig ooreengekome opleidingsintervensies. Bestuur die verskaffing van toerusting wat deur personeel benodig word vir die bereiking van uitsette in hul onderskeie Werksbeskrywing. Verskaf gereelde mondelinge en skriftelike terugvoer [belyn met kwartaalprestasie-assessering] aan personeel oor prestasie. Mentor en afrig personeel. Bepaal die menslike hulpbronbehoeftes van die Direktoraat in oorleg met Korporatiewe Dienste. Ontwikkel en dateer die leweringsdiens- en werksplan vir die Direktoraat op. Verskaf voldoende leiding aan personeel in terme van die dienslewering, werksplanne, kernbesigheidsrolle en prioriteite van die Departement deur kwartaal-personeelsvergaderings. Bestuur vaardigheidsoordrag tussen personeel in die Direktoraat en eksterne tegniese assistente en/of konsultante. Beplan en wys werkverantwoordelikhede en prosesse toe om werkprestasie, insluitend kwaliteitversekering, te beheer. Bestuur fondse in die Direktoraat in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance. Management Act en die Treasury Regulations. Beperk onderbesteding of oorbesteding deur die Direktoraat in terme van die departementele begrotings toekenning. Bestuur die doeltreffende besteding van infrastruktuurtoelaefondse. Belyn die strategiese prioriteite en die werksplanne van die Direktoraat met die Hoofdirektoraat. Ontwikkel operationele planne vir die Direktoraat en werksplanne vir elke personeellid in die Direktoraat. Verskaf skriftelike bydraes tot departementele kwartaalvorderingsverslae, Jaarverslag, SCOPA, Begrotings toesprake, Jaarlikse Prestasieplan ens.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokuphathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka ofunwa ngumnyango WezemoLimo eJohannesburg ukuze aphephe ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwentsime kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla, kufuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 neminyaka engu-5 yamava okuphatha.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye neziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu ze-bachelors (izinga le-NQF 7) kusoUkuphathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka/ Imali noma ezinye iziqu ezihlobene njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Ubufakazi beminyaka engu-5 bokuhlanganyela okuphathwayo kwenga eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokubusa ekuPhathweni Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ikhono: Ikhono lokubuka phambili nokuholwa abantu, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukunikwa amandla nokuzinza, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ikhono lobuchwepheshe: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, Okuphambene kahle kukahulumeni, izinqubo zokubika kanye nesistimu yolwazi. Ikhono elinamandla lokubusa noku(thintana) abantu (okushiwo nangomlomo). Ukuqonda okujulile kwemiHlaka Yemali Yesevisi Yomphakathi nokuPhathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka. Izimpawu: Ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ngaphansi kwengcindezi nokuhlaba izikhathi. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nokwedwa. Ikhono elinamandla lokubusa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuqonda ngomthengi nokugxila kumthengi, ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthenga kwezimpahla kanye nosebenzo. Hola ekuqoqweni kwezidingo zokuPhathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka. Hlaziya izinhloso zokuthenga kanye nokugqiba. Qinisekisa ukugqibwa kwezinhlelo zokuthenga. Ukuthuthukisa futhi sigcine isistimu yokuphathwa kwentsime. Ukuthuthukisa futhi siyisebenzise inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kempahla ehamulekayo. Hola ekuhleni izinkonzo ngokuqondene nokucela, uku-oda, ukwamukela kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezimpahla. Nikela ngemibono kuhlelo lokusebenza olubuka phambili nalo Nyakeni ukuze usekele ukufeza kwenqubomgomo yezokuqasha ezakhiweni esikhungweni. Gqiba izinhlelo zokuthenga. Gqiba uKwaziswa Kokuqamba Iminikelo, izinqubo zokuKhomomba kanye Nezinkomplathi Zokuqashisa. Phatha inqubo ehlobene nokwamukelwa kanye nokuvulwa kweziNkinga zokuQashisa kanye/noma Izinkombandlezo Zenth Interest. Phatha ukusebenziswa kokuhlolwa kokuzwela. Phatha ukusebenziswa kokuHlolwa kokuQashisa. Nikela ngemibono ekuthuthukiseni isikhungo senqubomgomo sokuPhathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuhlinzeka esiphatha wonke isibalo sokuthenga. Nikela ngemibono ekumiseni okukhomoshwayo kokuthenga. Lumba futhi umise izinqubo zokuthenga [Izinqubo Ezisebenzayo Eziyisisekelo] ezilungele, ezikhwebelana ngokulinganayo, ezibusayo futhi ezibiza kancane. Lumba futhi sebenzisa isistimu yokubuka ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo kanye nokusebenza kweSikhungo Esiqashisayo. Thuthukisa izindlela zokunciphisa ingozi ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamafomu Okuthenga Ayisisekelo. Nikela ngemibono ekumisweni kwezinLungu Zebhodi Eziqashisayo. Phatha ukulumba kanye nokusebenzisa izilawulo ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zesivumelwano. Phatha kanye nokubuka zonke izinhlekelelo, izinguquko, ukwandiswa, okuguquguqukayo, ukunwebwa noma ukudluliselwa kwezivumelwano ezinikezwe ngeKhomidi YokuQashisa. Phatha ukusebenzisa izezo ezenzelwe kuleso sikhathi. Phatha ukwandiswa kwezivumelwano ngaphezu kwemali enikezwe ngokusho kwezidingo. Phatha izinsizakalo ukugunyaza ukukhushulwa kwamaxabiso aphelele okungahlanganisi ukulungiswa kwamaxabiso okwethonya ngaphezu kwemali ethiwe esivumelanweni bese unikela ngokumelana nokulungiswa. Phatha izinsizakalo yemikhakha yamaphathi kwesivumelwano. Phatha ukulungiselela imibiko yamaphathi yezinkonzo ngokusekelwe ngemibano etholwe kumakhono okuhlobene. Hlola ukuthintana phakathi kokuPhathwa Kwezinsimbi Zokuthenga namanye amakhono ukuze wonke amagatsha ahlangabezane nawo wonke amasikhathi kwezivumelwano kanye nezibopho ezihlobene. Sayina izivumelwano zokusebenza zeDirektheji ngokusekelwe kwiNqubo Yokusebenza evunyiwe, uhlelo lokusebenza oluhlobene lokubuka phambili kanye naloNyakeni komnyango. Phatha izinsizakalo zezabantu eDirektheji bese ulondoloza isisulu. Phatha ukuqeqesha futhi ukuthuthukiswa ngaphakathi endaweni yokusebenza kwezisebenzi ngokuhambisana nokusebenzisa kokuqeqesha. Phatha ukunikwa izinsiza ezidingwa ngabezempahla ukuze kufeze imikhiqizo kumakhono okuhlangene nemigomo Yomsebenzi. Nikeza ngokusikhathi okungenantjhongo ngomlomo kanye nokubhaliwe ngokusebenza, kwezisebenzi. Coache bese uyisiza izisebenzi. Qinisekisa izidingo zabantu eDirektheji ngokubonisana nabeNkonzo Zezinkampani. Thuthukisa bese ubuyekeza uhlelo lokuletha inkonzo kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lweDirektheji. Nikeza ngokuqondisa okwanele izisebenzi ngokusho kohlelo lwenkonzo, amahlela okusebenza, izindima eziyisiseko zeshungo kanye nezinhloso zomnyango ngezinkomplathi zemihlangano yezisebenzi. Phatha ukudluliswa kwezakhono phakathi kwabezempahla eDirektheji kanye nabasizi abangaphandle noma ongamelwa bakaqeqesha. Hlela bese uqabela izikundla ngokusebenza nezinqubo ezolawula isimo sokusebenza okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa. Phatha imali eDirektheji ngokuhambisana noMthetho Weqhaza eNgqalasweni Yemali. Linganisa nokuchithwa kabi komthengisi okukhulu noma okuncane yileDirektheji ngokuhambisana nesilinganiso sezimali senhlangano. Phatha ukuchithwa kwezimali okusebenzayo kwemali enikezwe yokwakhiwa. Linganisa okuphambene ngokuqonda kakhulu kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lweDirektheji. Thuthukisa amahlela okusebenza eDirektheji kanye namahlela okusebenza yabezempahla bonke abaseDirektheji. Nikeza ngemibiko ngesandla esibhalelwe emibikweni yenhlangano yesikathi ngokuhamba kwesikathi, emibikweni yoNyaka, eSCOPA, Izinkulumo Zamafoni, EPLE etc.

xh.title: Umlawuli: uLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo
xh.summary: Isebe lezeNdalo lithanda uMlawuli woLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo eJohannesburg ukuze alawule ukuthengwa kwempahla, ulawulo lwesisitoko nepahla, kubekho nesiqinisekiso seNQF 7 neminyaka emi-5 yamava obukhulu.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 kunye nesiqinisekiso se-undergraduate (inqanaba leNQF 7) kuLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo/ iMali okanye ezinye iimfuno ezinxulumenayo njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Amava abekwe phantsi eminyakeni engama-5 ehambelana nalo msebenzi kwinqanaba lobufunda nololulawulo kuLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompethensi: Amandla okuQamba iindcwana noBuncwane beNkokeli, uLawulo lweSebenzi, uMandla wokuNika amandla noBuzo, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lweNkqubo noMsebenzi. Iikhompethensi zeNgcayo: iNqununu namacebo osebe, iMigangatho kaRhulumente, iinkqubo zokuBika iingxelo nendlela yolwazi. Amakhono abalaseleyo obulawulo nokuThethathetha (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo). Ukuqonda ngokucokile kwemiThetho yeMali yeseKuncwence lweLizwe nakuLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo. Iimpawu: Izidibaniselwe ezilunge kwindalo. Amandla okusebenza ngoxuba nxaxha ezinkqubela nokuqedalisa ngexesha. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwqela namanye ngabodwa. Amakhono abalaseleyo obulawulo. Ukuzisombulula iingxaki noNgcwathi lwemiba, uQwalaselo lwoMthengi nogqaliselo loMthengi, uNcwadi lwesoKwazisa.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukuthengwa kwempahla nezenkonzo. Ukukhokela okubonakalisa iimfuno zoLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo. Ukuqamba okubalulekileyo kuthengiweyo nesiqedelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphela kweenkqubo zokuthengwa. Ukuphuhlisa kwaye sigcine ndlela yolawulo lwesisitoko sempahla. Ukuphuhlisa kunye nokusebenzisa inkqubela yolawulo lweempahla ezihambahambayo. Ukukhokela ukubonelela iinkonzo malunga nokucelwa, ukuthengiswa, ukwamkelwa nokusaswa kwempahla. Ukwenisa iinkcukacha kwiNkqubela yoBucwane noMSebenzi woNyaka woMgangatho ukuze axhasa ukufezwa kwengcombolo yokuthenga kuseLungiselelweni. Ukuqedalisa iinkqubo zokuthenga. Ukuqedalisa uBhalo lweNkqubo eBiziweyo, iinkqubo zoKwaziswa kunye neMiQopho yokuQinisekisa iMigqaliselo. Ukulawula inkqubo enxulumene nokwamkelwa kuvulekile kweMigqaliselo yeNkqubo nokuba zithandwa kakhulu. Ukulawula ukuqatshwa lweenkqubo zovavanyo. Ukulawula ukuqatshwa lweNkqubo yokubuyela ngemigaqo. Ukunikela iinkcukacha ekuphuhliseni ngendlela yolawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo ethatha iingongoma ngenxa yokuthengwa. Ukunikela iinkcukacha kwigqiza lolawulo lokuthenga. Ukuyila kwaye usike iinkqubo namagqabo okuthenga [iNqununu eQhagamshela iqhutywa sisikhokelo] ezilungele, eziqwasekileyo, ezilungileyo, eziqhamayo kwaye zisebenza ngexabiso elilingana. Ukuyila kwaye usebenzise inkqubo yokujonga ukusebenza kwabathengisi nokusebenza kweLungiselelo. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezithintela ingozi yokujonga ukusebenza kwabathengisi. Ukuphuhlisa iNqunulu yoKuthenga ezixhobelwa kuyo. Ukunikela iinkcukacha kwigqize labaLiswa beKomiti. Ukulawula ukuyila nokusebenzisa izilawulo ezihambelana nemigqatho yekhonthrekthi. Ukulawula ukuhlola zonke iinkqubo ezirhoxisiweyo, ezilungisiweyo, ezikhululekileyo, eziguqukileyo, ezandisiweyo okanye ezidluliselwe kwabanye abo bethunyelwe ngokusesikweni iKomiti. Ukulawula ukusebenzisa iigazi apho kufuneka khona. Ukulawula ukwandiswa kwamakhonthrekthi ngaphezu kwemali ebonelelwe ngokomthetho weemfuno. Ukulawula iingcombolo zemveliso ezinika ilungelo lokuvusa ixabiso elipheleleyo ngaphandle kokulungiselelwa kwamaxabiso kokwenyuka kwamaxabiso ngaphezu kwemali ebhalwe kwithamsi kwaye zenze izindululo. Ukulawula izindululo zeziganeko ezihamba ngokwekhonthrekthi kwaye zenze izindululo. Ukulawula ulungiselelo lwangemihla lweengxelo zokusebenza zabathengisi nxaxhamba kokubalelelwa kumacandlo ahlobeneyo. Ukuqwalasela iNkqubela yolwazisaniselano phakathi koLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziNkonzo namanye amacandlo ukuze iqondo ngamanye amasebe akwazi ukuqeda zonke iinkqubo zexesha lekhonthrekthi nezigqizo ezinxulumene nazo. Ukusayina iNkqubela yokuSebenza yoMnyango weQela ngokusekelwe kwiNkqubo eYilelweyo yoMsebenzi, iNkqubela yoBucwane noMSebenzi woNyaka woMgangatho weSebe. Ukulawula abantu kulawulo oluthunyelwe kwaye ulondoloze isithozama. Ukulawula uqeqesho nokuphuhlisa basebenzi ngokohambo loqeqesho elizamileyo. Ukulawula ukubonelelwa ngesixhobo abasebenzi esifunekayo ukuze bakwazi ukufeza iinjongo kwinkqubo yoMsebenzi wabo abayilawulayo. Ukunika iingxelo ezithethwayo ezibhaliweyo [ezihambelana nokujongwa kwamakwindla] abasebenzi ngokusebenza kwabo. Ukukhokela kwaye uncede abasebenzi. Ukucacisa iimfuno zabantu abalawulwa kulawulo kwisiko loQeqesho lweNkqubo yeNtlangano. Ukuphuhlisa kwaye uhlaziye iNkqubela yokubonelela kweenkonzo noMsebenzi wolawulo. Ukunika isikhokelo esanele abasebenzi ngokweNkqubela yobonelelo lweenkonzo, oMsebenzi, iindima zeNkqubo eBalulekileyo namagqibo eSebe ngokweminyhadla yamakwindla abasebenzi. Ukulawula ukudluliswa kwakhono phakathi kwabasebenzi kulawulo kwaye abe ngamanye ooncedisi basesigqini besebenza ngenkxaso yonkqubo. Ukucwangaliswa kwaye kugqitywe umsebenzi wokuthweswa kwaye kucutshungulwe ukuqwalasela ukusebenza okubandakanya uQinisekiso lomgangatho. Ukulawula imali kulawulo ngokuzithintela ngokoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Ukulawula nokuhambelana kweMithetho yeNxuwa yamawaka. Ukulinganisa okungalahlwa okanye okugqithisa ngokwahlulwa kwemali yoMnyango. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa kwemali efanelekileyo yesibonelelo soyilo lwezokwakha. Ukulungelelanisa amagqibo eNkqubela yamagqibo kunye noMsebenzi woQela ngakunye noBukhulu beNqunulu. Ukuphuhlisa iNkqubela yokusebenza kolawulo noMsebenzi ngamnye umsebenzi kulawulo. Ukubhala iingxelo zemveliso kwimibhalo yamakwindla ukuya phambili, iNgxelo yoNyaka, iKomiti yeNqunulu yeMali, iNkcazelo zeSabelo, iNkqubela yoNyaka woMgangatho nokunye.

jobs.title: Biodiversity Officer Specialised Production: Enforcement
jobs.summary: Biodiversity enforcement officer in Johannesburg to investigate nature conservation complaints, conduct covert and overt investigations, and compile detailed reports.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) in Nature Conservation as recognised by SAQA. Minimum of 6 years relevant experience in Nature conservation. Experience in implementation of investigations (covert and overt) and detective work. Valid drivers’ license. Competencies: Computer Literacy; Good communication, writing and networking skills with stakeholders both in government and outside of government spheres; Ability and competency in interpreting and implementing policy, legislation and guidelines. Must have a strong personality and conflict management skills. Successfully completed Environmental Management Inspector training is an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Investigate complaints received and complete investigations thereof. In-depth knowledge of Nature Conservation Ordinance, National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act 10 of 2004 and TOPS regulations, CITES and Criminal Procedure Act 51 of 1977. Write detailed investigation reports, file and maintain all records while maintaining strict confidentiality. Coordinate search and seizure warrants for biodiversity related investigations. Attend court cases during trail days to ensure that the NPA can prove the guiltiness of the transgressor beyond reasonable doubt and to ensure that the sentence reflects the seriousness of the crime. Collect, analyse and preserve evidence for court. Work with other law enforcement agencies to solve biodiversity crimes. Good organizational and time-management skills. Excellent interviewing and interrogation skills. Undertake site inspections to ascertain compliance and submit reports thereof to Biodiversity Control. Assist other Biodiversity Officers and SAPS on various endangered and rare species of wild fauna and flora species identification. Assist Biodiversity Control in ensuring that the unit project are undertaken timeously and appropriately. Ensure that reports are written according to the Departmental standards.
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za send an email at: GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za. quoting the relevant reference number.
jobs.notes: Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Biodiversiteitsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie: Handhawing
af.summary: Biodiversiteitshandhawingsbeampte in Johannesburg om natuurbeweringsklagtes on te ondersoek, geheime en oop ondersoeke uit te voer, en gedetailleerde verslae op te stel.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Honneursgraad (NQF Vlak 8) in Natuurbewaring soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring in natuurbewaring. Ervaring in die implementering van ondersoeke (geheim en oop) en speurwerk. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Rekenaarvaardigheid; Goeie kommunikasie, skryf en netwerkvaardighede met belanghebbendes beide in regering en buite regeringsfere; Vermoë en bevoegdheid in die interpretasie en implementering van beleid, wetgewing en riglyne. Moet 'n sterk persoonlikheid en konflikbestuursvaardighede hê. Suksesvol voltooide Omgewingsbestuursinspekteur-opleiding is 'n bykomende voordeel.
af.duties: Ondersoek ontvangde klagtes en voltooi ondersoeke daarvan. Diepgaande kennis van Natuurbewaringsverordening, National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act 10 of 2004 en TOPS-regulasies, CITES en Criminal Procedure Act 51 of 1977. Skryf gedetailleerde ondersoekverslae, lê alle rekords in en handhaaie dit terwyl streng vertroulikheid gehandhaaf word. Koördineer deursoek- en beslaglatingbevele vir biodiversiteitsverwante ondersoeke. Woon hofgedinge by gedurende verhoordae om te verseker dat die NPA die skuld van die oortreder bo redelike twyfel kan bewys en om te verseker dat die vonis die erns van die misdaad weerspieël. Versamel, analiseer en bewaar bewysmateriaal vir die hof. Werk met ander wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam om biodiversiteitsmisdaad op te los. Goeie organisatoriese en tydbestuurvaardighede. Uitstekende ondervragings- en verhoorvaardighede. Onderneem terreininspeksies om nakoming vas te stel en dien verslae daaroor by Biodiversiteitsbeheer in. Bystand aan ander Biodiversiteitsbeamptes en SAPS met die identifisering van verskeie bedreigde en seldsame spesies van wilde fauna en flora. Bystand aan Biodiversiteitsbeheer om te verseker dat die eenheidsprojekte tydig en toepaslik onderneem word. Verseker dat verslae volgens die departementele standaarde geskryf word.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinto Eziyisipiliyono Ezinganeni: Ukuphatha Imisebenzi
zu.summary: Phenya ngemvume nokungalunganga izikhalazo eziphathelene nokulondoloza izinto zasendle e-Johannesburg kanye nokubuyekeza izinhlelo ezivela kwezobuhlakani bokuphila nokuphatha imisebenzi ethile, futhi uhlanganise imibiko eqophelwe ngamandla.
zu.requirements: Isiqu sama-Garde 12 kanye ne-Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) ku-Nature Conservation njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ukube nguqobo eminyakeni engu-6 yesipiliyoni kwe-Nature conservation. Isipiliyono ekuqashweni kokuqashwa kwezinsizakusebenza (covert and overt) kanye nomsebenzi wokuphenya. Ithikithi lokuqasha elivunyiwe. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi: Ukuba nepiliyethi ekusebenzeni ngamakhalendlalekhompyutha; Ukubiza nokuxhumana kwabaholi bokusebenza kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ngokugqamayo nezingxoxo eziphathelene nobudlelwane bokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu; Ukuba nokuzonda ukuthi uhlobo luni lomuntu ofanele ukuba nguye nokubuyekezwa kwemithetho; Amaphupho okuhambisana nendlela yokuphila okufakazelwa ngamaphupho; Ithuba elihle lokuthi kube khona izinketho ezingakhethwa ukubona izincazelo zemithetho kanye namaphupho okubuyekza imithetho yokuphila. Isipiliyono ngokuphumelelayo esiseduze nesipiliyono samaphupho okubuyekeza imithetho; Isipiliyono ekubuyekzeni kwezinhlelo nemithetho engumthethosisekelo; Isipiliyono sokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela nezinhlangano abasebenza ngaphakathi kwesikhungo ukuxazulula izinkinga ezingaxazululeki.
zu.duties: Phenya izikhalazo ezitholiwe bese qedela ukuphenya kwalezo zikhalazo. Ukwaziswa okujulile nge-Nature Conservation Ordinance, i-National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act 10 of 2004 nemithetho ye-TOPS, i-CITES kanye ne-Criminal Procedure Act 51 of 1977. Bhala imibiko eqophelwe ngokujulile yokuphenya, ulondoloze lonke umbhalo ogciniwe ngenkutho ulondoloze ukungabhikici okungenamaphutha. Linganisa futhi uphathe amawolosho okusesha nokuthatha impahla ezinkambisini zokuphenya eziphathelene nobuhlakani obuhlukahlukene bokuphila. Buka amacala enkantolo phakathi nezinsuku zolalele ubufakazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-NPA ikwazi ukufakaza ubungalunganga bentenzuzo ngaphezu kwentengo ethile ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esiboniswa nge-Biodiversity Control. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi ulondoloze ubufakazi enkantolo. Sebenza kwelinye amaphoyisa asezimeni ukuxazulula amacala obuhlakani obuhlukahlukene bokuphila. Ubuchule obuhle bokuhlelela futhi nokuqashwa isikhathi. Abasebenzi bokuphenya abangakwazi ukubonisa ubuchule obuhle bokubuzelela nokubuzisisa imibuzo. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kwendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho bese kuthunyelwa imibiko yaleyo nkambiso. Siza abanye oBiodiversity Officers kanye ne-SAPS ekuboneni izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane zesifazane nezinhlama eziyingozi ezingajwayelekile ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni ezihlukene zokuhlala kwezilwane zasendle. Siza ukubuyekeza izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ezindaweni zokuhlala kwesifazane nokulondoloza izinongo ezingavunyelwe. Siza kubuyekeza ezinkambisini ezahlukene ezindaweni zokuhlala kwesifazane ezibangelwa ukungalungiswa kuhle ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezinengozi.

xh.title: Isikhululi seBiodiversity ekuKhiweni ngokweZemvelo: Ukuqikelela ukuThintela umthetho
xh.summary: Isikhululi seBiodiversity sokuqikelela ukuThintela umthetho eJohannesburg ukuphanda ngemibuzo yokusingatha kwindalo, ukwenza uphando olufihliweyo nolungaqamveli, nokuyila iirepo ezenzelwe ngokweenkcukacha.
xh.requirements: I-Graji ye-12 nge-Digri ye-Honours (i-NQF Level 8) kuConservation yeNdalo njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA. Isiphelo seminyaka yamava ayi-6 ahambelana nendalo kwiConservation yendalo. Amanqanaba amava ekusebenziseni iindlela zokuphanda (ezifihliweyo nangaqamveli) nomsebenzi wokuzingela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono amabalwe okuthetha naxhama nabaxhasi bobukhosi bahle bobukhosi bangaphandle nabakwilizwe; Ikhono lokuphonononga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo, umthetho namagqabantshintshi. Kufuneka unobuntu obuqinileyo namakhono okulawula ingxabano. Ukuzifundela ukuzimela kolunye uqeqesho kwi-Environmental Management Inspector kubakho ngenxa yokuba luncedo.
xh.duties: Phanda imibuzo efakiweyo yaye ugqibe ukuphanda ngayo. Ulwazi oluziinkcukacha lweConservation yendalo, i-National Environmental Management: i-Biodiversity Act 10 ka-2004 nemiqathango ye-TOPS, i-CITES nomyalelo we-Criminal Procedure Act 51 ka-1977. Bhala iirepo zokuphanda ezizinze, zibe zigcinwe uze zigcine zonke iirekhodi ngelixa ulondolozo ingqinisiso yokungabi nayo inkimbinkimbi. Qhela imithetho yokukhangela nokuthatha ukhupho ekuphandweni ngeBiodiversity. Zithethe kumatyala eNkantolo ngemihla yokuqatshelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuba i-NPA inokubonisa ubuqhwesha bomphangi ngaphaya kwamakhaqiniba alawulayo kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukuba isigwebo sibonisa ubukhulu besono. Qokelela, hlaziya yaye ulondoloze iziqinisekiso zetyala. Sebenza neminye imimisela yolawulo ukusombulula iindlela ze-Biodiversity. Amakhono amabalwe alungelelanisa ixesha nokulawula ixesha. Amakhono amabalwe okuphuhlisa umbuzo nokubuzwa imibuzo enzima. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwendawo ukumisela ukuthobela umthetho yaye uze ungenise iirepo ngayo ku-Biodiversity Control. Ncedisa abanye aba-Officers be-Biodiversity nabaSAPS ngeentshaba zezilwanyana zehlabathi nezityalo ezingaphefumliyo ezihlala kwingozi yaye eziqhelekileyo zodidi. Ncedisa i-Biodiversity Control ekuqinisekiseni ukuba iiprojekthi zequmrhu zenziwa ngesixa sokuqinisekisa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iirepo zibhalwa ngokomgangatho we-Department.

jobs.title: Admin Clerk
jobs.centre: Placement across Gauteng Provincial Nature Reserves and regional offices
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk needed to provide clerical support, capture data and manage correspondence across Gauteng Provincial Nature Reserves, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with no prior experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. No experience required. Competencies: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collect statistics. Skills: Computer literacy, Good verbal and written communication skill.
jobs.duties: Render administrative support to departmental functions, the processing and capturing of applications for services and activities from the department including permitting and clients bookings/reservations systems; receiving and managing correspondence; maintaining accurate records and electronic databases; tracking processes and related documentation and contributing to improved efficiency through the use of digital systems and electronic administrative processes. Take and distribute meeting minutes. Deal with correspondence, filing and administrative records. Provide clerical support in the unit, handle communications and enquiries from clients and monitor the use of telecommunication facilities. Maintain high standard of customer service and provide professional service to the public. Render financial management support. Collect revenue/payments from clients for services rendered.
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za send an email at: GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za. quoting the relevant reference number.
jobs.notes: Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
