af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig om klerklike ondersteuning te bied, data vas te lê en korrespondensie oor Gauteng Provinsiale Natuurreservate te bestuur, waarvoor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat sonder vorige ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardigheid.
af.duties: Verleen administratiewe ondersteuning aan departementele funksies, die verwerking en vaslegging van aansoeke vir dienste en aktiwiteite van die departement insluitend permitting en kliëntboekings/reserveringstelsels; ontvang en bestuur korrespondensie; handhaaf akkurate rekords en elektroniese databasisse; hou prosesse en verwante dokumentasie dop en dra by tot verbeterde doeltreffendheid deur die gebruik van digitale stelsels en elektroniese administratiewe prosesse. Neem en versprei vergaderingsnotule. Hanter korrespondensie, lêerwerk en administratiewe rekords. Verleen klerklike ondersteuning in die eenheid, hanteer kommunikasie en navrae van kliënte en monitor die gebruik van telekommunikasiefasiliteite. Handhaaf 'n hoë standaard van kliëntediens en verleen professionele diens aan die publiek. Verleen finansiële bestuursondersteuning. Versamel inkomste/betalings van kliënte vir dienste gelewer.

zu.title: Um Sekere Wokuphathwa Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsekere wokuphathwa kwemisebenzi onikeze inkxaso yomsebenzi wezinkantolo, abhale idatha aphinde alawule inxibelelwano kulo lonke iGauteng Provincial Nature Reserves, kudingwa isitifikedi seGrade 12 ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nolwazi lwangaphambilini.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12 noma iziqu ezinhlobonhlobo ezivunywe yiSAQA. Akukho lokuhlangabezana kolwazi okudingekayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezinkantolo, izendlela kanye nenhla yokubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Amafundi: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuthetha nobhalwe kahle.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kumisebenzi yomnyango, ukucubungula nokubhala izicelo zemisebenzi nemisebenzi evela kumnyango kuhlanganise namapede kanye nesimiso sabaklayenti bokubhala nabanikazi besikhundla; ukwamukela nokulawula inxibelelwano; ukugcina amarekhodi anembile namadethabheyisi abhalwe ngokusakazeka kolwazi; ukulandelisa izinqumo namadokhumenti ahlobene nokuthi ahlangabezane nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kakhulu ngokusebenzisa amasistimu e-dijithali kanye neziphatho zemisebenzi ezentulikhompyutha. Bese uthatha uwudlule amaminithi emihlangano. Phathela inxibelelwano, ukufaka amafayela namarekhodi okuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Nikeza inkxaso yezinkantolo ekuhloleni, phatha inxibelelwano nemibuzo evela kubaklayenti uphinde uqaphele ukusetshenziswa kwamafasitela okuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganise nokuqinisekisa ukuthi inkxaso yomphakathi ihambisana nemigomo yomnyango nokunikeza inkxaso eyisibonelo kumphakathi. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwemali. Qoqa imali/izinkokhelo kubaklayeni ngenxa yemisebenzi enikiwe.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi wezokulawula
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona umsebenzisi wezokulawula onikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yokubhala, abhalise idatha ajonge nokusingatha unxibelelwano kunye neSihlalo seLali lwaseGauteng ezinamagcisa eendalo, kufuneka aneeslumni zegreyidi 12 angazange aphesule kakade.
xh.requirements: Ieslumni zegreyidi 12 okanye izifundo ezihambelana nazo njengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mdla wamava afunekayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhala nendlela zayo kanjalo nakhona nokuba nakho ukubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthoba iistatistiki. Ikhono: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukusebenzisa ulwimi kakuhle ngomlomo nakubhalwayo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kumisebenzi yesebe, ukuqhuba nokubhalisa iimfuno zemisebenzi nentsebenziswano evela kwisebe kuquka namaphepha-mvume nendlela yokugcina iindawo zohlobo lwabathengi; ukwamkela nokusingatha unxibelelwano; ukugcina izikumbuzo ezichanekileyo nezicwangciso zobunjineli; ukuqhuba amanyathelo ngezicwangciso ezinxulumene nazo zenzeke ngokulinganiseleyo, kwakhona ukugalelwa ekuphuculeni ukusebenza ngokusebenzisa iindlela zamandla nobunjineli ezingelantlalo ngobuchwephesha ngemisebenzi yokulawula; Sithathe sabelule iimotho zomzila njengoko kuhambelana nequmfo lomthetho kwindalo emiselwe ngumthetho kuzo zonke iindawo ezisebenza ihlelokqaleko ngokugqitha, kwangaxeshanye kwiziko neliphethwe yivisi yelizwe ngokupheleleyo. Thatha usasaze iinqobo zomzila. Phatha unxibelelwano, ukubeka iifayile namarekhodi ezokulawula. Nikezela ngentlxaso yokubhala kwicandelo, phatha unxibelelwano nemibuzo evela kubathengi kwaye uqaphele ukusetyenziswa kwezinto zokunxibelelwana njengoko kulindelekile. Yiba ngowasekela ngokulinganiseleyo iindlela zokukhulisa isimo sabantu ngokubakho nokwenza okukhulu ukwenza okuhle kwabantu bonke abasebenzisa iinkonzo zalawulo zentando kaRhulumade; ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngowasekela iindleko ngenkxaso-mali ehleli. Hlanganisa imali/inkxaso evela kubathengi njengemvuzo wemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Nature Conservation Assistant
jobs.centre: Placement of Employees Across Gauteng Provincial Nature Reserves
jobs.summary: Assist with nature reserve operations across Gauteng including infrastructure maintenance, firefighting, fencing and invasive plant management.

af.title: Natuurbewaringassistent
af.summary: Bystand verleen met natuurreservaatbedrywighede regoor Gauteng, insluitend infrastruktuuronderhoud, brandbestryding, omheining en bestuur van indringerplante.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 1 of 2 (Abet-vlak 2/3-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig). Vaardighede: Brandbestryding, Meganies, Lasmont, Dakrywerk, Elektrifisering en Kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en ter sake kennis van natuurreservaatbedrywighede sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien.
af.duties: Ondersteuning van die hulpbronbestuurspersoneel. Bestuur van amptelike voertuie. Onderhoud van infrastruktuur, voertuie en toerusting. Verbranding van brandgordels. Bystand met natuurlike hulpbronbestuur wat die bestuur van indringerplante insluit. Oprigting en herstel van heinings. Gronderosiebeheer. Wildtel en patrollies. Hulpbronbestuur naweekpligte volgens skedule, basiese begrip van die natuurreservaatterrein.

zu.title: Msizi Wokulondololwa Kwendalo
zu.summary: Siza nokuqhuba izikhungo zokulondololwa kwendalo e Gauteng okuhlanganisa ukugcinwa kwezinsimbi, ukulwa nomlilo, ukubeka izibambo kanye nokuphathwa kwezihlahla ezingasekho endaweni yazo.
zu.requirements: NQF level 1 noma 2 (isitifiketi se-Abet level 2/3 noma okulinganayo). Amakhono: Ukulwa nomlilo, Okwezobuchwepheshe, Ukuhlanganisa izinsimbi, Ukwakha ngotshi, Ukufakwa kagesi, kanye Namakhono okuxhumana. Lesibili elivunyelwe lokushayela kanye nolwazi oluhlobene nokuqhubwa kwezikhungo zokulondololwa kwendalo kuzoba yinexusa elengeziwe.
zu.duties: Siza abasebenzi bokuqondwa kwezinsizakusebenza, Ukushayela izimoto ezisemthethweni, Ukugcinwa kwezinsimbi, izimoto nempahla, Ukushiswa kwezibambo zomlilo, Usizo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zendalo okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezihlahla ezingasekho endaweni yazo, Ukubeka izibambo kanye nokuzilungisa, Ukulawula ukubola kwenhlabathi, Ukubala izilwane kanye Nokuphatha. Imisebenzi yangoMgqibelo yokulawula izinsizakusebenza njengohlelo, ukuqonda okuyisisekelo indawo yesikhungo sokulondololwa kwendalo.

xh.title: Umncedi Wolwaziko Lwendalo
xh.summary: Nceda ngeenkqubo zesigidimi sendalo kulo wonke axabekelayo Gauteng kuquka nokugcina iziseko, ukulwa nomlilo, ukubeka iindonga kunye nokulawula izityalo ezingafunyaniswanga kwindawo.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba le-NQF 1 okanye 2 (Isatifikethi se-Abet level 2/3 okanye esingunaphakade). Amaphethu: Amandla okulwa nomlilo, eZobuchwepheshe, eZokudibanisa ibhotile, eZokudibanisa amatyholo, eZombane, kunye namaphethu othetho-lwazi. Ilayiseni elisebenzayo lokushayela izithuthi kunye nolwazi oluhambelanayo ngeenkqubo zesigidimi sendalo luya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Nceda abasebenzi bolawulo lwezibonelelo. Ukushayela izithuthi zikarhulumente. Ukugcina iziseko, izithuthi nezixhobo. Ukutsha imigca yomlilo. Incedo ekulawulweni kwemithombo yendalo equka ukulawula izityalo ezingafunyaniswanga kwindawo. Ukwakha iindonga nokuzilungisa. Ulawulo lwenkululeko yomhlaba. Ukubala iilwane zesigidimi kunye noKuzingela. Imisebenzi yoweekende yolawulo lwezibonelelo njengoko kumiswe, ukuqonda okusesiseko kwendawo yesigidimi sendalo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum, (all-inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer position at Leratong Hospital in Gauteng requiring an appropriate medical degree and HPCSA registration, with three grade levels based on years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate medical degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as a medical practitioner. Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Officer. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as medical officer after registration with the HPCSA as a medical officer. Practitioners completing community service on 31 December 2026 are eligible to apply. Possession of up to date ACLS, PALS, ATLS/EMATT/ITLS will be an advantage. Cost-containment measures in service delivery is important. Proper clinical record keeping and ethical practice in line with HPCSA Booklet 1 and Booklet 9. Teaching of medical interns and other junior staff. Commitment to highest level of care, ethics, professionalism and punctuality. Expected ability to work within a multi-disciplinary team and to report all conflict of interest and mismanagement. Perform commuted overtime. Good knowledge of prevention and management of Patient Safety Incidents (PSI). Comply with Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) assessments.
jobs.duties: Clinical assessment of patients, formulation, development and execution of evidence based and compassionate patient care plans. Daily ward wounds and attendance at OPD, preparation of patients for theatre and performance of surgical procedures as indicated concordant with a medical officer position. Assessment and management emergencies. After- hours calls and execution of urgent procedures. Counselling and education of patients and families. Proper clinical record keeping and participation in ward/ departmental administrative duties. Commitment to the highest level of care, ethics, professionalism and punctuality. Work responsibility within a multi- disciplinary team. Work at, and participate in outreach, at any of the Gauteng Health cluster facilities. Academically: will participate in the teaching programme with the aim of passing the CMSA related exams. The incumbent will and supervise medical interns and medical students.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Serobatse (011) 411-3563 / Ms M Moeketsi Tel No: (011) 411-3766
jobs.applications: should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Kindly note that no payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part B, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Application without proof of a new Z83 application form and detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview). Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted prior appointment. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Preference will be given to South African citizens. The performance of normal and commuted overtime is not mandatory, however it will be based on the operational needs of the hospitals. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Gauteng Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

af.title: Mediesebeampte
af.summary: Mediesebeampte-pos by Leratong-hospitaal in Gauteng wat 'n toepaslike mediese graad en HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met drie graadvlakke gebaseer op jare se ervaring.
af.requirements: Toepaslike mediese graad wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n mediese praktisyn toelaat. Graad 1: Geen ondervinding word vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ondervinding as Mediesebeampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediesebeampte. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ondervinding as mediesebeampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n mediesebeampte. Praktisyns wat gemeenskapsdiens op 31 Desember 2026 voltooi, kom in aanmerking om aansoek te doen. Besit van op-datum ACLS, PALS, ATLS/EMATT/ITLS sal 'n voordeel wees. Kostebeheermaatreëls in dienslewering is belangrik. Behoorlike kliniese rekordhouding en etiese praktyk in ooreenstemming met HPCSA Boekie 1 en Boekie 9. Onderrig van mediese internes en ander junior personeel. Toewyding aan die hoogste vlak van sorg, etiek, professionaliteit en stiptheid. Verwagte vermoë om binne 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk en alle belangenbotsing en wanbestuur te rapporteer. Voer gereelde oortydwerk uit. Goeie kennis van die voorkoming en bestuur van Pasientveiligheidsvoorvalle (PSI). Voldoen aan Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel (PMDS)-assesserings.
af.duties: Kliniese assessering van pasiënte, formulering, ontwikkeling en uitvoering van bewysgebaseerde en deernisvolle pasiëntsorgplanne. Daaglikse saalwondes en bywoning van OPD, voorbereiding van pasiënte vir teater en uitvoering van chirurgiese prosedures soos aangedui in ooreenstemming met 'n mediesebeampte-pos. Assessering en bestuur van noodgevalle. Buite-kantoor oproepe en uitvoering van dringende prosedures. Voorligting en opvoeding van pasiënte en gesinne. Behoorlike kliniese rekordhouding en deelname aan saal-/departementele administratiewe pligte. Toewyding aan die hoogste vlak van sorg, etiek, professionaliteit en stiptheid. Werkverantwoordelikheid binne 'n multidissiplinêre span. Werk by, en deelname aan uitreik, by enige van die Gauteng Health-klusterfasiliteite. Akademies: sal deelneem aan die onderrigprogram met die doel om die CMSA-verwante eksamens te slaag. Die ampsdraer sal mediese internes en mediese studente toesig hou.

zu.title: Ikwebhetha lezoKwelapha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sekwebhetha lezoKwelapha eLeratong Hospital eGauteng esidinga iziqu ezifanele zokwelapha nokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA, nanamazinga amathathu okulinganiselwa eminyakeni yohlu lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zokwelapha ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomsebenzi wezokwelapha. Izinga 1: Akukho huvo lolu oludingekayo. Izinga 2: Ukuze ube nobuncwane beminyaka engu-5 yohlu lolu olulingana njengekwebhetha lezoKwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengekwebhetha lezoKwelapha. Izinga 3: Ukuze ube nobuncwane beminyaka engu-10 yohlu lolu olulingana njengekwebhetha lezoKwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengekwebhetha lezoKwelapha. Abasebenzi bezokwelapha abaphetha inkonzo yomphakathi ngomhlaka 31 December 2026 bavunyelwe ukusingatha isicelo. Ukuwukuba namaphasi we-ACLS, PALS, ATLS/EMATT/ITLS ajwayelekile kuzoba yinzuzo. Izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko ekulethweni kwenkonzo zibalulekile. Ukugcina irekhodi lezokwelapha ngendlela efanele nokwenza ngokomthethonqubo ngesikhungo se-HPCSA Booklet 1 kanye ne-Booklet 9. Ukufundisa abafundi bezokwelapha kanye namalunga amancane. Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okulinganiselwa kwanezinga eliphezulu, ukuziphatha komthethonqubo, ubungcweti kanye nokuvela ngesikhathi. Kulindeleke ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwanqowo wabantu abaningiwe kanye nokubika yonke ingxabano yenzinto kanye nokuphathwa kabi. Ukwenza amahora amaningi ohlelweni. Ukwazi kahle ukuthibela kanye nokuphatha izehlakalo zokuphepha kwegulagula (PSI). Ukuhambisana nokuhlola kokwenza kweNdlela yokuphathwa kanye Nokususwa kokuqashwa (PMDS).
zu.duties: Ukuhlola iziguli, ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokunakekelwa kweziguli ezinobufakazi kanye nenhlonipho. Ukuvakashela izilonda ezibhedeni nsuku zonke nokubandakanya eklinikhini lomphakathi (OPD), ukulungisa iziguli zokuhamba ethiyetha kanye nokwenza izinkqubo zokuhlinzwa njengoko kudingwa ngokuhambisana nesikhundla sekwebhetha lezoKwelapha. Ukuhlola kanye nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Amabhiloho ahleli ekusebenzeni kwesikhathi kanye nokwenza izinkqubo ezijwayelekile. Ukweluleka kanye nokufundisa iziguli kanye nomndeni wazo. Ukugcina irekhodi lezokwelapha kanye nokubandakanya emsebenzini wezobuqhathi webhedeni/ kwezomnyango. Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okulinganiselwa kwanezinga eliphezulu, ukuziphatha komthethonqubo, ubungcweti kanye nokuvela ngesikhathi. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwanqowo wabantu abaningiwe. Ukusebenza, nokubandakanya ekusizeni kwamanye amagatsha, kunoma isiphi isikhungo sezempilo sikaGauteng. Kwezemfundo: uzoba yingxenye yohlelo lokufundisa nenhloso yokudlula ukuhlolwa okuhlobene ne-CMSA. Umntu ovekile uzofunda kanye nokubuka abafundi bezokwelapha namafundiswa wezokwelapha.

xh.title: I-ofisa yezokwelapha
xh.summary: Isithuba se-ofisa yezokwelapha eLeratong Hospital eGauteng esifuna izidanga ezifanelekilekoo zezokwelapha nokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA, namanqanaba amathathu okuqwalasela axhomekeke kminyaka yolwazi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokwelapha esifanelekileyo esivumela ukuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha. Inqanaba 1: Akukho lwazi lufunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Uluhlu olungenaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-5 yolonwazi olufanelekileyo njenge-ofisa yezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-ofisa yezokwelapha. Inqanaba 3: Uluhlu olungenaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-10 yolonwazi olufanelekileyo njenge-ofisa yezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-ofisa yezokwelapha. Oqeqeshi bagqibe izibonelelo zoluntu ngomhla wama-31 December 2026 baneligible lokusebenzela. Ukuba nokuqinisekiswa okusesikhathini kwama-ACLS, PALS, ATLS/EMATT/ITLS kuya kuba yinxaxheba. Iindlela zokugcina iindleko ekubonelelweni ngenkonzo zibalulekile. Ukugcina irekhodi elilandelayo yezokwelapha nokuziphatha ngokwasemthethweni ngokwe-HPCSA Booklet 1 no-Booklet 9. Ukufundisa abaqeqeshi bezokwelapha nabasebenzi ababambi phantsi. Uzinikelo kumngangatho ophezulu wokunakekelwa, masiko obugqila, ukuziphatha ngokuchanileyo nokuza ngexesha. Ikhono elilindelekileyo lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela elinabaphathi abahlanga kwaye ukuxela ngayo yonke ingxabano yenzala nokulawula kakubi. Ukwenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo zokusebenza. Ulwazi oluhle lokuthintela nokulawula iingozi zokhuseleko lomtuwonke (PSI). Ukuzalathiswa nokuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo yoMlawulo noPhuhliso loMsebenzi (PMDS).
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela umtuwonke ngokwezokwelapha, uqulunqo-lwazi, uphuhliso nokuqhuba iindlela zokunakekela umtuwonke ezingekho nzima kwaye zikho nencesa. Ukukhangela amachiza amabebe emihla ngemihla nokuzimasa kwi-OPD, ulungiselelo lomtuwonke wakwaqonga neziphene zokwelapha ngokuhamba kwexesha ngokwesithuba se-ofisa yezokwelapha. Ukuqwalasela ukulawula iimeko eziphuthumayo. Iikholidi ngeeyure zemihla ngemihla nokuqhuba iindlela ezifuna ukuba zisetyenziswe ngokukhawuleza. Iinkcitha zemfundo kumatu wonke nomntwini wakhe osaphila nentsapho yakhe. Ukugcina irekhodi elilandelayo yezokwelapha nokuqhubeleka phambili kweekhondo zolawulo zebala/isebe. Uzinikelo kumngangatho ophezulu wokunakekelwa, masiko obugqila, ukuziphatha ngokuchanileyo nokuza ngexesha. Ukusebenza ngomthwalo wakho oqwalaselwa ngaphakathi kweqela elinabaphathi abahlanga. Ukusebenza, nokuqhubelela phambili kwindima yokusasakwa, kuyo nayiphi na iziko lezempilo zaseGauteng. Kwizifundo: iya kuqhubelela phambi kwinkqubo yemfundo nengozi yokudlula uviwo lwezibonelelo ezinxulumene ne-CMSA. Umntu oqeqeshwe iya kuba nolwazi kwaye alawule abaqeqeshi bezokwelapha nabafundi bezokwelapha.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 1 341 85 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 2: R1 531 032 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 3: R1 773 222 per annum, (all-inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist sought at Leratong Hospital in Gauteng to provide clinical management of general medical patients and lead operational and academic ward rounds.
jobs.requirements: A Medical Degree (MBChB/MBBCh) or equivalent thereof, FCP(SA) or equivalent, MMed in Internal Medicine, Registration with HPCSA as a Specialist Physician. Current registration with HPCSA (2025/2026) as a Specialist Physician. Essential skills: patient first mentality: general management skills; excellent communication skills; good professional judgement; integrity and professional dependability; leadership experience; conflict management; cost containment; management training and experience; technology and computer skills; problem solving experience; coaching and mentoring experience.
jobs.duties: As a consultant, the candidate will be responsible for clinical management of general medical patients. The incumbent will be required to lead operational and academic ward rounds including post-intake, follow up and ward rounds. As the most senior doctor in the unit, the incumbent will be required to supervise medical officers, intern doctors and students in patient care and the performance of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Other clinical duties will include managing patients at OPD, managing patients attending Subspecialty OPD or Specialty ward consultations within a relevant Sub-specialty. The desired candidate will be required to set an appropriate example of an exemplary medical practitioner and serve as a role and clinical mentor to junior doctors and associated clinical staff. Co-ordination of services at Leratong hospitals for both inpatient and outpatient services. Supervision of clinical technology services as required. Overseeing the development of appropriate referral pathways and development of services at referral hospitals. Invited candidates will be subjected to employment vetting process and medical surveillance. Academic: performance of research within the department. Supervision of research within the department.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Serobatse Tel No: (011) 411-3563 / Ms M Moeketsi Tel No: (011) 411-
jobs.applications: should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za.
jobs.notes: Kindly note that no payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part B, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Application without proof of a new Z83 application form and detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview). Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted prior appointment. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Registrars will be required to rotate between the different institutions. Preference will be given to South African citizens. The performance of normal and commuted overtime is not mandatory, however it will be based on the operational needs of the hospitals. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Gauteng Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis gesoek by Leratong Hospital in Gauteng om kliniese bestuur van algemene mediese pasiënte te verskaf en operasionele en akademiese saaltogte te lei.
af.requirements: 'n Mediese graad (MBChB/MBBCh) of gelykwaardig daarvan, FCP(SA) of gelykwaardig, MMed in Interne Geneeskunde, Registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Spesialis Geneesheer. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA (2025/2026) as 'n Spesialis Geneesheer. Essensiële vaardighede: pasiënt-eerste mentaliteit: algemene bestuursvaardighede; uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede; goeie professionele oordeel; integriteit en professionele betroubaarheid; leierskapservaring; konflikbestuur; kostebeheer; bestuursopleiding en -ervaring; tegnologie- en rekenaarvaardighede; probleemoplossingservaring; afrigtings- en mentorskapservaring.
af.duties: As konsultant sal die kandidaat verantwoordelik wees vir kliniese bestuur van algemene mediese pasiënte. Die ampsdraer sal vereis word om operasionele en akademiese saaltogte te lei insluitend na-opname, opvolg en saaltogte. As die mees senior geneesheer in die eenheid sal die ampsdraer vereis word om mediese beamptes, interniste en studente te superviseer in pasiëntsorg en die uitvoering van diagnostiese en terapeutiese prosedures. Ander kliniese pligte sal die bestuur van pasiënte by OPD insluit, asook die bestuur van pasiënte wat Subspesialiteit OPD of Spesialiteit saalkonsultasies binne 'n relevante subspesialiteit bywoon. Die gesogte kandidaat sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike voorbeeld van 'n voorbeeldige mediese praktisyn te stel en as rol- en kliniese mentor vir junior geneeshere en geassosieerde kliniese personeel te dien. Koördinering van dienste by Leratong hospitale vir beide in-pasiënt en buite-pasiënt dienste. Supervisie van kliniese tegnologie-dienste soos vereis. Toesig oor die ontwikkeling van toepaslike verwysingsroetes en die ontwikkeling van dienste by verwysingshospitale. Genooide kandidate sal onderworpe wees aan 'n indiensnemingkontrolproses en mediese monitering. Akademies: uitvoering van navorsing binne die departement. Supervisie van navorsing binne die departement.

zu.title: Ithizinjini Yezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa Ithizinjini Yezokwelapha eLeratong Hospital eGauteng ukunikeza ukuphatwa kwezokwelapha kwabagula bezemfizi jikelele nokuhola ukujikeleza kwangaphakathi kanye nezomfundo kumawodi.
zu.requirements: IDigri Yezokwelapha (MBChB/MBBCh) noma okulingana nayo, FCP(SA) noma okulingana nakho, MMed kwi-Internal Medicine, uKubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA (2025/2026) njengesikhulu sezokwelapha. Amakhono abalulekile: imvaqo yomguli: amakhono okuphatha jikelele; amakhono okuxhumana ahle kahle; isinqumo sezomsebenzi esihle; ukuzinemeshe nokuthembeka sezomsebenzi; inhlonipho yokuhola; ukuphatha konke phakathi; ukugcina izindleko; ukuqeqeshwa nokuhlakanipha ekuphatweni; amakhono obuchwepheshe namakhompyutha; inhlonipho yokuxazulula izinkinga; inhlonipho yokulebusa nokwelisa.
zu.duties: Njengesikhulu, umgqiki uzobe uyimeni ngokuphatwa kwezokwelapha kwabagula bezemfizi jikelele. Lowo owayebekelwe isikhundla uzodingwa ukuba ahole ukujikeleza kwangaphakathi kanye nezomfundo kuhlanganisa okwasemva kokwamukelwa, ukulandela kanye nokujikeleza emawodini. Njengodokotela ophakeme kunabo bonke kwelungisise, lowo owayebekelwe isikhundla uzodingwa ukuba alawule abaphathi bezokwelapha, odokotela abaqeqeshi kanye nabafundi ekunakekelweni kwabagula nasekwenzeni izenzo zokuqapha nezokwelapha. Eminye imisebenzi yezokwelapha izohlanganisa ukuphatha abagula e-OPD, ukuphatha abagula abaye e-Subspecialty OPD noma izithakazelo zewodi ze-Specialty ngaphakathi kwesidwambu ohlukene. Umphakamisi ozotshiywa uzodingwa ukuba akeze isibonelo esifanele somwelaphi ohle kahle futhi aze abe njengesikhwaba kanye nomwelaphi kubadokotela abancane nakwelabo abahlobene nabasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuhlanganiselela amasevisi eLeratong hospitals kokubili amasevisi abagula abangenisiwe kanye nabangaphandle. Ukuqapha amasevisi obuchwepheshe bezokwelapha njengoba kudingwa. Ukuqapha ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela ezifanele zokuqhuba kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamasevisi kwezibhedlela eziqhubisayo. Abagqiki abamenyiwe bazohlangabezwa nesenzo sokuqinisekiswa ukusebenza nokugqamisa kwamasokoni. Izomfundo: ukwenza ucwaningo ngaphakathi komnyango. Ukuqapha ucwaningo ngaphakathi komnyango.

xh.title: Iqhakamba leMesebenzi yokuThuthuzela
xh.summary: Kufunwa iqhakamba leMesebenzi yokuThuthuzela eLeratong Hospital eGauteng ukunika ulawulo lweklinikhi lwabaguli bezonyango ngokubanzi nokukhokela iindlela zokusebenza kwezokusebenza nangemigaqo yophando kwindawo yokwamkela abaguli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga soGqirha (MBChB/MBBCh) okanye okulingana naso, iFCP(SA) okanye okulingana nayo, iMMad kwesebe leNkcubeko yangaphakathi, uBhaliso kwiHPCSA njengoGqirha oPhezulu. UBhaliso lwangoku kwiHPCSA (2025/2026) njengoGqirha oPhezulu. Amakhono obumgama: ingqondo yokubeka umguli kuqala; amakhono olawulo ngokubanzi; amakhono okunxibelelana alungileyo; isigqibo esilungileyo sezobuchwepheshe; inyaniselo nokuthembeka ngokobugqirha; amava obuqhawe; ulawulo lwezingxabano; ukuqhela kokugcina iindleko; uqeqesho namava olawulo; amakhonyobuchwepheshe nekhompyutha; amava okusombulu iingxaki; amava okuqeqesha nokukhokela.
xh.duties: Njengomceli-mango, umkhweli uza kuba nawo uxanduva lolawulo lweklinikhi lwabaguli bezonyango ngokubanzi. Umntu oza kugcinwa kule sithuba uza kufunwa akhokele iindlela zokusebenza kwezokusebenza nangemigaqo yophando kwindawo yokwamkela abaguli eziquka ukwamkelwa kwabaguli, ukulandela inkqubela phantsi kom ngonngqondwan na kwindawo yokwamkela abaguli. Njengogqirha omdala kunabo bonke kwicandelo, umntu oza kugcinwa kule sithuba uza kufunwa alawise ababalisi bezonyango, abaqeqeshwa njengabaqeqeshi kubugqirha n aba fundi ekunakekelweni kwabaguli nakuphumezeni iinkqubo zokuqonda nokwelapha. Eminye imisebenzi yeklinikhi iza kuquka ukulawula abaguli kwiOPD, ukulawula abaguli abaya kwiOPD yesebe ngesithili okanye iingxoxo zangaphakathi kwesebe ngesithili esifanelekileyo. Umguli ofunwayo uza kufunwa abeke umzekelo ofanelekileyo wogqirha ohamba phambili abe ngumohlala nomqeqeshi weklinikhi kubagqirha abancinane nasebenzi laba phakathi kwabasebenzi bezenza. Ukuqhela kweenkonzo eLeratong Hospital zooncedo lwabaguli ababambele kwindawo yokwamkela abaguli abangabambele. Ukulawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe beklinikhi njengoko kufuneka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweendlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqamba abaguli nokuphuhliswa kweenkonzo kuzibhedlele zokuqamba abaguli. Abakhweli abamemeziweyo baza kufakwa kwinkqubo yokuhlolwa komsebenzi nokujongwa lwezempilo. Isebe lemigaqo yophando: ukuphumeza uphando kwesebe. Ukulawula uphando kwisebe.

jobs.title: Manager Medical Services
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 479 723 per annum, inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules Plus Commuted Overtime CENTRE                 Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital: Howick
jobs.summary: Manager Medical Services sought to oversee safe, ethical medical care in a psychiatric hospital, requiring an MBCHB, HPCSA registration and supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 or equivalent; Plus, MBCHB or equivalent qualification. A minimum of three years’ experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with HPCSA Plus Current registration with HPCSA. A minimum of two years’ supervisory experience. Computer literacy in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint and Unendorsed valid driver’s licence (code 8) or C drivers’ license (code 10). Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of general medicine and psychiatry, laws and regulations that govern medical services. Ability to diagnose and manage common medical problems and emergencies. Knowledge of relevant Acts, Policies and Regulations governing the Public Service. Knowledge of the District Health System. Sound clinical knowledge and experience. Ability to function as part of a multidisciplinary team. Ability to work and maintain meaningful relationships with stakeholders. Management skills. Supervisory skills. Communication and Interpersonal skills. Implementation and evaluation skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound negotiation. Organizing and conflict management skills. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Ensure the provision of safe, ethical, legal and high-quality medical care in a psychiatric hospital. Facilitate the formulation of policies and procedures and ensure that these are in line with statutory regulations and code of ethics. Ensure the provision of protocols and guidelines to doctors at the correct level. Participate in the quality improvement programme of the component to ensure that policies and procedures are followed. Conduct clinical audit with the support of the clinical staff. Liaise with the District Office and Head Office on matters related to medical services. Ensure that effective delivery service is maintained within the hospital. Maintain discipline and deal with labour relations issues in terms of the laid down procedures. Supervise and support medical officers, sessional doctors and community service doctors. Serve in all clinical related committees, including management committees like Management Committees, Cashflow committee, IMLC etc. Ensure availability of clinical protocols for the management of high-risk conditions at the hospital. Provide duties that can be allocated in terms of the hospital, district and departmental needs. Organize both academic and clinical service functions of the Department, including ward rounds, outpatient clinics and clinical training ward rounds. Participate in clinical research and academic programmes in the respective clinical departments. Provide academic and clinical administrative leadership. Attending to staff at the Occupational Health clinic if the Medical Officer allocated is not available.
jobs.enquiries: Mr VM Mvelase Tel No: (033) 3306146, Ext. 120
jobs.applications: Applications quoting the relevant reference UMG 07/2026. All Applications should be forwarded to: Mr VM Mvelase, The Chief Executive Officer, Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital, Private Bag X23, Howick, 3290 for attention: Human Resource Department or courier OR hand delivered at the Human Resources Office Umgeni Hospital, Old Main Road, Howick, 3290. Applications can also be emailed to UmgeniHospital.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. UMG 05/2019. FOR ATTENTION : Mr VM Mvelase
jobs.notes: The following documents must be submitted: Amended application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on the application. Such documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. No faxed applications will be considered. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post/s. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA for the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. 'n Minimum van drie jaar se ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by HPCSA Plus Huidige registrasie by HPCSA. 'n Minimum van twee jaar se toesigervaring. Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook en PowerPoint en ongelisensieerde geldige bestuurslisensie (kode 8) of C-bestuurslisensie (kode 10). Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van algemene geneeskunde en psigiatrie, wette en regulasies wat mediese dienste regeer. Vermoë om algemene mediese probleme en noodgevalle te diagnoseer en te bestuur. Kennis van toepaslike Wette, Beleide en Regulasies wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van die Distrik Gesondheidstelsel. Deeglike kliniese kennis en ervaring. Vermoë om as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Vermoë om te werk en betekenisvolle verhoudings met belanghebbendes te handhaaf. Bestuursvaardighede. Toesigvaardighede. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Implementering en evaluering van vaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike onderhandeling. Organiserings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verseker die voorsiening van veilige, etiese, wettige en hoë gehalte mediese sorg in 'n psigiatriese hospitaal. Fasiliteer die formulering van beleide en prosedures en verseker dat dit in ooreenstemming met statutêre regulasies en kode van etiek is. Verseker die voorsiening van protokolle en riglyne aan dokters op die korrekte vlak. Neem deel aan die gehalteverbeteringsprogram van die komponent om te verseker dat beleide en prosedures gevolg word. Voer kliniese oudit uit met die ondersteuning van die kliniese personeel. Skakel met die Distrikkantoor en Hoofkantoor oor aangeleenthede rakende mediese dienste. Verseker dat effektiewe dienslewering binne die hospitaal gehandhaaf word. Handhaaf dissipline en hanteer arbeidsverhoudinge-aangeleenthede ooreenkomstig die vasgestelde prosedures. Hou toesig oor en ondersteun mediese beamptes, sessiedokters en gemeenskapsdiensdokters. Dien in alle klinieverwante komitees, insluitend bestuurskomitees soos Bestuurskomitees, Kontantvloei-komitee, IMLC ens. Verseker beskikbaarheid van kliniese protokolle vir die bestuur van hoërisikotoestande by die hospitaal. Verskaf pligte wat toegewys kan word in terme van die hospitaal, distrik en departementele behoeftes. Organiseer beide akademiese en kliniese diensfunksies van die Departement, insluitend saalrondes, buitepasiëntklinieke en kliniese opleidingsaalrondes. Neem deel aan kliniese navorsing en akademiese programme in die onderskeie kliniese departemente. Verskaf akademiese en kliniese administratiewe leierskap. Bied aandag aan personeel by die Beroepsgesondheidskliniek as die toegewysde Mediese Beampte nie beskikbaar is nie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinsizakalo Zokwelapha
zu.summary: Kuyafunwa umphathi wezinsizakalo zokwelapha ongasoze abheke impilo yokunakekelwa okuphephile, okungokomculo kwezomthetho esibhedlela sezimo yeqondo, ofuna i-MBCHB, ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA noma ulwazi lokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatric/Isigaba 12 noma okulingana naso; okwengeziwe, i-MBCHB noma iziqu ezilingana nalezi. Okungenani amashumi amathathu weminyaka yemisebenzi njengodokotela ozokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA okuhambisana nokubhaliswa kwamanje ku-HPCSA. Okungenani iminyaka emibili yemisebenzi yokuhlola. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook kanye ne-PowerPoint kanye nekhadi elivumelekile lokushayela elinganamaphuzu (code 8) noma ikhadi lokushayela lesi-C (code 10). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngokwelapha jikelele nangengqondo, ngemithetho nemithetho ephatha izinsizakalo zokwelapha. Ikhono lokuxiluma nokuphatha izinkinga ezijwayelekile zokwelapha kanye nezeziphetho ezibucayi. Ulwazi ngomthetho othize, izinqubomgomo nemithetho ephatha Inkonzo kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngesistimu yezempilo yesifunda. Ulwazi nolwazi oluhle lokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinabalingisi abaningi. Ikhono lokusebenza nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle nalabo abahlose ukusebenza nabo. Amakhono okuphatha. Amakhono okuhlola. Amakhono okuthintana nabantu nokuxhumana nabo. Ikhono lokusebenzisa nokuhlola. Amakhono ahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuxoxisana okuhle. Amakhono okuhlela nokulawula izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukunikezelwa kokunakekelwa okuphephile, okuhambisana nomthetho futhi okungokomculo kwezomthetho esibhedlela sezimo yeqondo. Siza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo nemigomo bese qinisekisa ukuthi le zihambisana nemithetho yezwe kanye nemithetho yomculo. Qinisekisa ukuba khona kwemithetho yokuqondisa kudokotela ezingeni elifanele. Thatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuthuthukisa izinga lenkompone ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo nemigimo ilandelwa. Yenza ukuhlola okuphathwe ngabantu abanengqondo ngosizo lwabasebenzi bomtholampilo. Xhumana noMnyango WesiFunda noMnyango Wezinhloko ezindabeni ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo efanele ihlala inikwa ngendlela efanele esibhedlela. GCina inzima yomthetho uphathe izinkinga zohlelo olusemgangathweni ngokulandelwa kwemithetho. Hlola uphathise udokotela, udokotela wesikhathi nokudokotela besebenza baphila. Hlala emakomithi ahlobene nendawo yokukhuluma kwezokwelapha, ahlanganisa namakomithi okuphatha njengasezinhlanganweni zokuphatha, ikhaya lezimali, i-IMLC njl. Qinisekisa ukuba khona kwemithetho yokwelapha yokuphatha izimo ezibucayi ngokuphila esibhedlela. Yiza nemisebenzi engabelwa ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela, yesifunda nomnyango ongahle ufake ngezidingo. Hlela imisebenzi yezemfundo nensebenzo yesibhedlela, kuhlanganisa ukuzulula iziguli ezikhonza ithimba, amakliniki abantu abaphuma bengaphakathi nokuzulula isiguli esifunda izinto ezihambisana nayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekupheni izinto ezintsha nokwenza ucwaningo lwezokwelapha nemikhakha yezemfundo kumnyango oyedwa. Nikeza umkhakha wezemfundo nolawulo lwezokwelapha. Siza abasebenzi esikhungweni sokunakekelwa kwempilo yokusebenza uma udokotela otholakele ezingekho.

xh.title: Umphathi wesebe lezeMpilo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kusetyenziswe iSebe lezeMpilo ngokusiba mmeli wokulawula inkqubo yonikezelo lwezempilo, ekhuselekileyo nangobugcisa kumzimdlalo weengcinga zobudenge, ngokulandela umthetho weHPCSA nokubhaliswa ngokusemthethweni kwi-HPCSA, nokuba nolwazi lokuba ngumlawuli ongqonge abo badlula kumthetho weHPCSA, nokuba nolwazi lokuba ngumlawuli ongqonge abo badlula kumthetho weHPCSA, nokuba nolwazi lokuba ngumlawuli ongqonge abo badlula kumthetho weHPCSA.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12 okanye ezifanayo; Kanjalo, i-MBCHB okanye izifundo ezifanayo. Iminyaka engu-3 okube ngaphezulu yokuba nguGqirha eDorophu emva kokuqesheka ku-HPCSA kunye nokubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA. Iminyaka emibi okube ngaphezulu yolwazi lokuba ngumlawuli. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha nge-Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook nakwi-PowerPoint nokuba nelayisensi yokushayela (code 8) engazaliswanga okanye i-C drivers' license (code 10). Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi ngogqirha jikelele nengqondo yokuhlala ivale kwindlela ezilawula inkonzo yamagqirha. Ukwazi ukuxiluma nokulawula iingxaki zomzimba ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo nemigaqo ebalawula inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngendlela ezilawula iNkqubo yezeMpilo kummandla. Ulwazi nolwazi lokugqirha oluswekileyo. Ukwazi ukusebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elisebenza ngokuhlanganiswayo. Ukwazi ukusebenza nokwakha ubudlelwane obunentsingiselo namalungu abaqhubi. Amakhono okulawula. Amakhono okuba ngumlawuli. Amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu. Amakhono okusebenzisa nokuhlolwa kolwazi. Amakhono amabalwa nokubhala. Ukuxoxa ngokuswekileyo. Ukucwangcisa nokulawula ingxabano. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba kukho lonikezelo lwezempilo olukhuselekileyo, olusemthethweni, olungathathi hlangothi nolwemgangatho ophezulu kwisibhedlele sobugcisa obunengqondo. Phakamisa ukwenziwa kweenkqubo namagunya aqinisekisa ukuba zilandela imithetho yepilo kunye nemithetho yonikezelo lwezempilo. Qinisekisa ukubakho kweziqulatho nezikhokelo ezisiya kugqirha kwinqanaba elifanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwenkqubo yokuphucula umgangatho welunga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kusenziwa ngokweenkqubo namagunya agqithiweyo. Yenza iindhlu zokuhlolwa kolwazi ngokugqirha ngosetyenziso lwamagqirha akwindawo yokusebenza. Nxibelelana ne-Ofisi yommandla ne-Ofisi esentla ngezindaba ezimalunga nonikezelo lwezempilo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqhubeka kakuhle ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Phatha ulawulo kwaye usombulule iingxaki zobudlelwane-basebenzi ngokwemithetho eshiweyo. Lawula nokuxhasa oogqirha abangamagosa, oogqirha abangenayo kwizikhundla kunye nogqirha basesibi sawo wonke amakomiti afanelekileyo kulwazi lokugqirha, kuquka namakomita olawulo njengamakomita olawulo, i-Cashflow committee, i-IMLC njl. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iziqulatho zegqirha zokusingatha iimeko ezibangelwa bubungozi obukhulu kwisibhedlele. Yiza ngemisebenzi engabelwa ngokweemfuno zesibhedlele, nommandla kunye nesebe. Cwangcisa imisebenzi yolwazi nolonikezelo lwezempilo kwesebe, kuquka nokujonga abagula, iikliniki zomnye wabagula nokujonga abagula ngokwamayethu olwazi. Thatha inxaxheba kuphando kolwazi nakwiinkqubo zolwazi kumasebe olwazi ahambelanayo. Nikeza ngolawulo oluluncedo kolwazi nololawulo lwezempilo. Kuya kugqirha odielelwe ukusetyenziswa kule ndawo xa engekho.

Izindatshana zocwaningo, ulwazi ngocwaningo, amakhono kanye namandla (kuzaba ngusizo).
zu.duties: [Inqubo Yokuphathwa Kwethuluzi Nokuthuthukiswa Kokusebenza Kweqaphi (EPMDS) ehleliwe izophatha ukunakekelwa ngokwelapha, isifundo, ubuchwepheshe, ukuphathwa, izindlu zomphakathi kanye nokuphathwa kwentengo kanye nokuqathaniswa kwendlela ezihambisana namandla oNkosi Yezokwelapha kwe-HPCSA.]Qaphisa, thuthukisa futhi uphathe ukunikezwa kwenkonzo yamahora angu-24 ezenzeka esikhathini esiphuthumayo yokunakekelwa kwezokuGwinya Okunzima kanye ne-Pulmonology kwizigaba eziyiIntensive Care zabantwana eGrey’s Hospital nakuleso sigaba sabantu sasePietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni amahora angu-24 ezenzaka ebulaweni nakwabangelayo kokunakekelwa kwezokuGwinya ePietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex. Thatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuyovuka lomnyango esigabeni. Siza ekugcineni izinga lokunakekelwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuthuthukiswa ikhwalithi kulelo mnyango. Siza kocwaningo, okokugada kanye nokusekela abayili, othisha bezokwelapha, abaQashi bezenzo kanye nabafundi kulesi sikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokufunda nokugadisa lweminyango; Siza ekuphathweni kwenxenye yomnyango wezokuGwinya eGrey’s Hospital. Thatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yomnyango yokuqasha nokugadisa abafundi abangaphansi kwebanga eliphakeme, kwezangaphezu kwesibanga kanye nabafundi bokusebenza; okuhlanganisa nokungena eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natali (UKZN) njengelungu lefakhalithi yezeMpiLo, Isikole Sokuqasha ezokuGwinya kanye Nezempilo Yabantwana. Siza futhi uthathe inxaxheba emisebenzini yocwaningo njengokuqanjwe kulelo mnyango.

xh.title: Isebe lezonyango Ikhampasi ye Grade 1,2,3
xh.summary: Kufunekwa isebe lezonyango kwiPaediatrics kwiGreys Hospital complex ePietermaritzburg, enobhaliso kwiHPCSA nempumelelo ezifanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. MBChB okanye eqholayo. FC Paeds (SA) okanye Eqholayo nobhedi wobhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango kwiPaediatrics. Ubhaliso wangoku kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango kwiPaediatrics. Grade 1: Akusebenziswanga; Ubhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango. Abagqibi-mfundo basemazwe angaphanela bafuna 1 Year apexperience elifanelekileyo emva kobhaliso kwiHPSA njengesebe lezonyango, abangabangelo abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkqubo yeZiko lokuQokelelwa Komthi. Grade 2: 5 Years amava afanelekileyo njengesebe lezonyango emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango kwizigaba ezifanelekileyo. Abagqibi-mfundo basemazwe angaphanela baya kufuna 6 Years amava afanelekileyo emva kobhaliso kwiHPSA njengesebe lezonyango abanga kufunelwa ukwenza Inkqubo yeZiko lokuQokelelwa Komthi. Grade 3: 10 Years amava afanelekileyo njengesebe lezonyango emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango kwizigaba ezifanelekileyo. Abagqibi-mfundo basemazwe angaphanela baya kufuna 11 Years amava afanelekileyo emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyango abanga kufunelwa ukwenza Inkqubo yeZiko lokuQokelelwa. Impumelelo nokuqonda ngakumbi: Cert Paediatric Critical Care (SA) okanye okufanayo, Cert Paediatric Pulmonology (SA) okuye ukatraina ngokuqinisekileyo nakwezi mpumelelo. Amava ngaphambili ePaediatric Critical Care / Pulmonology emva kokuphumelela njengesebe lezonyango aya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi, Amakhono namava: Ulwazi, amakhono namandla ohlelo njengesikhokeli sesifo sokwengula nemithetho yamaza. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla ohlelo njengesikhokeli sobugcisa bezemizimba kwiPaediatric critical care / paediatric pulmonology. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekiswa kwezempilo nakumthetho womsebenzi kaRhulumente, iimigqaliselo nemigaqo, Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwabasebenzi beza amayeza, ulwazi ngokusasaza isifo, uphando namanani. Ukuyilwa ngokonyango, amava nakwamakhono (luncedo). Amava emisebenzi yophando, ulwazi ngophando, amakhono nokuziphatha (luncedo)
xh.duties: [Inkqubo yoLawulo lomSebenzi noPhuhliso lomSebenzisi (EPMDS) esekelwe kwindlela yokusebenza iya kqamba ukhathalelo lwezempilo, izifundo, ukuziphatha ngobungcali, ulawulo, intengiso nolawulo nezinto zokuqwalasela ezijamelene namakhono oBasesebe bonyango beHPCSA]Onjula, phuhlisa ngakumbi ulawule inkonzo yeeyure ezingama-24 yodaka nokhathalelo olubalulekileyo nolonwabo lwesoftware kwizixholo zePaediatric Intensive Care Unit/s eGrey's Hospital kunye nabemi ababambelelayo kwiPietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex. Thatha inxaxheba kunkonzo yee-24 hour yokhathalelo lwezempilo lwengane abangenayo nabalawuli kwisixholo sePietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokubhalisa koluntu kwisebe ukuya kummandla obambeleyo. Nceda ekugcineni imilinganiselo yokhathalelo nakuphothweziweenkqubo zokuphucula ubungakanani kwisebe. Nceda ngokuphando, kwinkqubo yolawulo nokukhokela ababhalisi, abasebenzi boonyango, amaCSOs nabalimi kwisebe. Thatha inxaxheba kunkqubo ye-academic nokuyilwa koluntu kwisebe, Nceda ekulawulweni kweziko lesebe lePaediatric eGrey's Hospital. Thatha inxaxheba kumasebe amkhankaso wophuhliso nokuyilwa koluntu kwabafundi abangaqothulwanga basalwa kwikhosi yabafundi, kubandakanya ukudibanisa iNyuvesi yaKwazulu- Natal (UKZN) njengelungu leFakhalithi yezeMpi lo, isikolo sonyango lokuQwalasela, isebe lePaediatrics & Child Health. Nceda uthathe inxaxheba kumasebe amkhankaso wophando njengoko kuchazwe kwisebe.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1,2,3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Plus Commuted Overtime which is subject to the needs of the department. Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics wanted at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, offering a Grade 1 to 3 all-inclusive package from R1,395,528 to R1,844,151 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. MBChB or equivalent. FCS (SA) or MMED (Anaesthetics) Plus Registration certificate with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiologist. Current registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics. Grade 1: Not applicable; Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist. Foreign candidates require 1 Year relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 2: 5 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 6 Years relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 3: 10 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 11 Years relevant experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Sound clinical knowledge within the department of Anaesthesiology. Good communication and human relations. Sound knowledge of clinical procedures and protocols within the discipline. Assessment and management of patients. Behavioural Attributes Required: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationships.
jobs.duties: To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the institution that are consistent with standards of patient care and to perform duties / functions that fall within the reasonable prescripts of acceptable legislation. Accept responsibility for administration of anaesthesia. Willingness to participate in the after-hours call system, with an undertaking to sign a contract to participate in 16 hours commuted overtime per week, is essential. Overtime work will encompass both Critical Care and Anaesthesia call cover at any of the three hospitals in the PMB metropole. Liaise with other Metropolitan hospitals and Medical School as and when necessary, in consultation with the Head of Department. Supervision of postgraduate and undergraduate training. Participate in postgraduate and other relevant academic / and training programmes. Provide support to the Head of Department, in ensuring an efficient standard of patient care and services are maintained. Assess patients, plan, initiate and supervise medical care management of critically ill patients. Ensure the proper and economical use of equipment and other resources. This is a metropolitan post and the incumbent will be expected to be available for work at any of the metropolitan hospitals (Grey’s, Harry Gwala Regional and Northdale). Willingness to rotate through ICU for up to 6 months is essential. Candidates must remain within 30 minutes of the relevant PMB Hospital during all periods of on call at that hospital.
jobs.enquiries: Dr Chantal Rajah- Head Clinical Unit at 084 520 0361/033 8973413, Email: rajahchantal@gmail.com
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: This post would be suitable for candidates who have recently passed their specialist examinations and completed registrar time. If a candidate who is eligible for specialist registration but has not received such registration from the council is successful, the appointment will be at their current salary level, with an upgrade to Specialist Grade 1 once registration is received. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources and may be subjected to competency test. The employment equity target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Vlak 1,2,3
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Narkose gesoek by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, met 'n Vlak 1 tot 3 alles-insluitende pakket van R1,395,528 tot R1,844,151 per jaar.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat. MBChB of gelykwaardig. FCS (SA) of MMED (Narkose) plus Registrasiesertifikaat met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anestesiologie. Huidige registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. Vlak 1: Nie van toepassing nie; Registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Buitelandse kandidate benodig 1 Jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met HPSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Vlak 2: 5 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in die tersaaklike dissipline. Buitelandse kandidate sal 6 Jaar relevante ervaring benodig na registrasie met HPSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis waarvan dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Vlak 3: 10 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in die tersaaklike dissipline. Buitelandse kandidate sal 11 Jaar relevante ervaring benodig na registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis waarvan dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Deeglike kliniese kennis binne die departement Anestesiologie. Goeie kommunikasie en menslike verhoudinge. Deeglike kennis van kliniese prosedures en protokolle binne die dissipline. Assessering en bestuur van pasiënte. Gedragskenmerke benodig: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die instelling te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntsorg en om pligte / funksies uit te voer wat binne die redelike voorskrifte van aanvaarbare wetgewing val. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir die toediening van narkose. Bereidwilligheid om aan die buite-ure oproepstelsel deel te neem, met 'n onderneming om 'n kontrak te teken om aan 16 ure pendeloortyd per week deel te neem, is noodsaaklik. Oortydwerk sal beide Kritiese Sorg- en Narkose-oproepdekking by enigeen van die drie hospitale in die PMB-metroop omvat. Skakel met ander Metroop-hospitale en die Mediese Skool soos en wanneer nodig, in oorleg met die Hoof van Departement. Toesig oor nagraadse en voorgraadse opleiding. Neem deel aan nagraadse en ander tersaaklike akademiese / en opleidingsprogramme. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Hoof van Departement om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en dienste gehandhaaf word. Assesseer pasiënte, beplan, inisieer en hou toesig oor mediese sorgbestuur van kritiek siek pasiënte. Verseker die behoorlike en ekonomiese gebruik van toerusting en ander hulpbronne. Dit is 'n metrooppos en die ampsdraer sal verwag word om beskikbaar te wees vir werk by enigeen van die metroophospitale (Grey's, Harry Gwala Regional en Northdale). Bereidwilligheid om vir tot 6 maande deur ICU te roteer is noodsaaklik. Kandidate moet binne 30 minute van die tersaaklike PMB-hospitaal bly tydens alle periodes van oproeplig by daardie hospitaal.

zu.title: Isekelwe Sokwelapha Ezinga 1,2,3
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isekelwe Sokwelapha koBunjiswa bezokwelapha e Grey's Hospital e Pietermaritzburg, sinikeza iphakheji ebonakaliswe konke esuka ku Grade 1 kuya ku Grade 3 okusukela ku R1,395,528 kuya ku R1,844,151 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. MBChB noma okulinganayo. FCS (SA) noma MMED (Anaesthetics) Kanye nesitifiketi sokubhalisa ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha koBunjiswa beAbethesia. Ukubhalisa okwamanje ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha koBunjiswa beAbethesia. Grade 1: Akukho okushiwo; Ukubhalisa ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha. Omgeni badinga unyaka o-1 womcumo ofanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku HPSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha, lapho kungadingeki ukuba kwenze isevisi yomphakathi. Grade 2: Unyaka o-5 womcumo ofanele njengesekelwe sokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha kuleso sikhathi. Omgeni badinga unyaka o-6 womcumo ofanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku HPSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha lapho kungadingeki ukuba kwenze isevisi yomphakathi. Grade 3: Unyaka o-10 womcumo ofanele njengesekelwe sokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha kuleso sikhathi. Omgeni badinga unyaka o-11 womcumo ofanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku HPCSA njengesekelwe sokwelapha lapho kungadingeki ukuba kwenze isevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi, Amakhono nomCumu: Ulwazi olusimilo oluhle ngaphakathi kumnyango weAnaesthesiology. Ukuxhumana okuhle nezakhamuzi. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezinqubo neziqondiso zokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukuhlola nokuphatha abaguli. Izici zokuziphakamisa ezingemva: Ukubekezela enkathazweni, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba, ukuzethemba kanye nesisindo sokwakha nokuqinisa ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngesikhumba, ukusekela imigomo nezinjongo zesikhungo eziyahambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kweguli nokwenza imisebenzi / imisebenzi ephakathi kwemigomo evela emthethweni evunyelwe. Ukumukela ibango lokuphatha ukubethwa kakhulu ukulala. Ukulungela ukubamba iqhaza kusistimu yokubiza emahoreni emva kwesikhathi, nokuba uzosayina isivumelwano sokubamba iqhaza kumahora angu-16 okusebenza ngale kwaye ngevhiki, kuyimfuneko. Ukusebenza kwahora okungeyona nje kuzohlanganisa kokubili ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kanye nokubethwa kakhulu ukulala kunoma yisiphi isibhedlela kunanoma yisiphi isiphi phakathi kwamathathu esibhedlela e PMB metropole. Xhumana namanye amasibhedlela Metropolitan kanye nesikole sezokwelapha noma nini uma kunesidingo, ngokubonisana noNhloko woMnyango. Ukugcina amaphuzu kokuqeqesha kwesikole esingaphezulu nangaphansi. Ukuthatha iqhaza kokuqeqesha okungaphezulu kwekholishi kanye namanye amahlelo okuqeqesha / kwezemfundo. Ukunikela inkxaso kuNhloko woMnyango, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amazinga okunakekelwa kweguli kanye namasevisi aphezulu agcinwe. Hlola abaguli, cezela, qala kanye nokugcina ukunakekelwa kokwelapha kwabaguli abagula kabi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile nokugcina emalo kweqembu kanye nezinye izinsiza. Lesi isikhundla se-metropolitan kanti lowo othathiwe kuzodingeka abe khona ukusebenza kunoma yisiphi isibhedlela se-metropolitan (Grey's, Harry Gwala Regional kanye ne Northdale). Ukulungele ukuhlola ngaphakathi ko-ICU unyaka ongafika konyaka o-6 kuyimfuneko. Omgeni kumelwe bahlale phakathi kwamaminithi angu-30 esibhedlela esithile se PMB ngaso sonke isikhathi besebenza ngaleso sibhedlela.

xh.title: Iganxa Lemizi Gqo Kwamayezo inqanaba 1, 2, 3
xh.summary: Kufuneka iGqumileyo lokuqaliswa kwamayeza kwabhananiswe kwindlu yeGqumileyo kaGrey's ePietermaritzburg, ngokwabiswa ngesixa esingenisa zonke iindleko kwisiqalo esisuka kwisiqendu R1,395,528 ukuya kuR1,844,151 ngamnye unyaka.
xh.requirements: Iqela le 12 / Isatifikethathi Sendalo. MBChB okanye eselifana nalo. FCS (SA) okanye MMED (Anaesthetics) Kwaye satifikethathi yokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo kwabaphilisi bokuqaliswa kwamayeza. Ukubhalisa ngokuqhubeka kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo kwabaphilisi bokuqaliswa kwamayeza. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto ichazwayo; Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo. Abarhwebi abavela ngaphandle kwezilumko badinga unyaka woluvo olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo, abanga kubadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka emi-5 yoluvo olufanelekileyo njengogqirha ohlankathwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo kwelona candelo elifanelekileyo. Abarhwebi abavela ngaphandle kwezilumko baya kudinga iminyaka engu-6 yoluvo olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo apho kungadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka eli-10 yoluvo olufanelekileyo njengogqirha ohlankathwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo kwelona candelo elifanelekileyo. Abarhwebi abavela ngaphandle kwezilumko baya kudinga iminyaka engama-11 yoluvo olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha ohlankathwayo apho kungadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi, Amakhono noLuvo: Ulwazi olupheleleyo lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesebe lezokuqaliswa kwamayeza. Unxibelelwano oluhle nendlela ezizo ngenene yokuphathwa kwabantu. Ulwazi olupheleleyo ngeendlela nemithetho yokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesiqu sabo. Ukulinganisa nokuphatha abagulayo. Iimpawu ezingokuziphatha ezingenziwayo: Ukumelana nenxaxheba, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba, ukuzethemba nako nokwakha kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze wenze imisebenzi nemitshato ngobuchule, ukuze uxhase iinjongo nemitshato yendalo ngokuhambelana nemiqathango yokunakekelwa kwezigulwi nokuwenza imisebenzi / imisebenzi ekule phakathi kwemigiqatho yemithetho efanayo. Ukubambe isibopho sokulawula i-anesthesia. Ukulungele ukuzihlanganisa kwinkqubo yokubizangeoxesha efikayo, nokuba nayiphi na imiathambetho yokusayina inkqubo yokuzihlanganisa kumawetha okuqhubela unyaka ngamnye kwiveki eminye, kubalulekile. Umsebenzi we-overtime uza kubandakanya i-Critical Care kwaye nokuqhubeleka kokubiza ngaphandle kwamayeza kunye naphakathi kwezibhedlele ezintathu kwasePMB metropole. Unxibelelwano namanye amazibhedlelo aseMetropolitan naseSikolo samayeza naxa imfuno isekho, ngokubonisana noQhawe lomnyango. Ukulawula uqeqesho lwesikolo sabafundi abaphakamileyo nabalowo basemva kwesikolo esiphakamileyo. Ukuzihlanganisa kwizikolo ezikhululekileyo kwaye neminye imizekelo efanelekileyo yophando / nokuqeqeshwa kwezithuba. Unika inkxaso kuQhawe lomnyango, ngokuqinisekisa ukuba imiqathango yokunakekelwa kwezigulwi nolonikezelo lusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukulinganisa izigulwi, ukuyicwangalisa, ukuyiqalisa nokulawula ukuphathwa kwezilwanyana ezizigulayo ezibuhlungu. Ukunyanzelelwa kokusetenziswa okuchanekileyo nangokugcina izixhobo nentsimbi eziqhubekayo. Ngumsebenzi odidiyelwe kwi-metro, kwakhe kuya kufuneka abeikhoyo ekubeni kwakhe nayiphi na esibhedlelo sametro ezifanayo (iGrey's, iHarry Gwala Regional kwaye eNorthdale). Ukuzithanda ukujikeleza kwi-ICU ukuya kuthi kona kwinyanga ezisi-6 kubalulekile. Ababhaliswa kufuneka bahlale kunxweme lwemizuzu engama-30 esibhedlele i-PMB ngexesha lonke lothumelo olubizwa kulo sibhedlele.

Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in General Surgery sought for Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, requiring HPCSA registration and FCS(SA) qualification, with remuneration from R1,395,528 to R1,844,151 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. MBChB or equivalent. Appropriate qualifications that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery, which must include an FCS (SA) and MMED completion and adequate time in a general surgery registrar program. Registration certificate with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Current registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Applicants awaiting registration with the HPCSA as a specialist general surgeon can apply and will require registration as a specialist before commencing employment in the post. Grade 1: Not applicable; Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist. Foreign candidates require 1 Year relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 2: 5 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 6 Years relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 3: 10 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 11 Years relevant experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Knowledge of appropriate specialist level procedures and protocols within the field of general surgery. Specialist will be required to run the Breast, Endocrine and Renal Surgery Unit. Sound knowledge of Human Resource management. Financial Management – monitoring of expenditure, Essential Drug List, Management functions – policy analysis and implementation, strategic management, project management, information management, total quality management and improvement, legal aspects, patient care and service delivery, applicable mandatory requirements and Acts, Regulations, Protocols and Guidelines used in Health Services.
jobs.duties: Participate in the delivery of in-patient and out-patient general surgery service esp. breast and endocrine service within the Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex based at Grey’s hospital. Management of patients requiring general surgery. Assisting in the management of the surgical database. Function as the intern curator when required. Inter-disciplinary coordination of the management of general surgery patients. Supervision of the surgical trainees and interns rotating through the unit. Ensuring the highest standards of clinical, professional, and ethical behaviour. Undertake teaching of interns, undergraduate medical students, postgraduate general surgery trainees, and allied health care personnel. Conduct, assist, and stimulate research within the ethical guidelines of the Health Care Act. Promote education in cancer prevention. Develop management protocols for the general surgery service in accordance with the Hospital and Department policies; Provide appropriate surgical care to general surgery patients; Responsible for the Breast, Endocrine and Renal Surgical Unit. Maintain the effective and efficient utilisation of human resources in respect of: overseeing and supervising general surgery staff in the execution of their duties; training staff and promoting ongoing staff development in accordance with their individual and departmental development needs; recruiting and selecting staff in accordance with government prescripts; assessing performance of general surgery staff; allocating general surgery personnel to respective wards and call roster. Provide measures and guidance on quality assurance to comply with set quality standards; Incumbent to provide general surgery outreach services in the Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex and Area 2. Foster collaboration with other hospitals within and outside the district; Exercise cost control over the activities of the department in line with the allocated budget; Participate in all academic and clinical meetings of the general surgery Department; Participate in departmental research activities. Accept responsibility for continuous professional development to keep up to date with new developments in the field of expertise and related fields. Any other duties as assigned by the Head of Department.
jobs.enquiries: Dr R Sathiram- Acting Head Clinical Department Tel No: (033) 897 3379
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments.
