af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1,2,3
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgiese sowek vir Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n FCS(SA)-kwalifikasie vereis, met 'n besoldiging van R1,395,528 tot R1,844,151 per annum.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat. MBChB of ekwivalent. Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie toelaat, wat 'n FCS (SA) en MMED-voltooiing asook voldoende tyd in 'n algemene chirurgie-registrateurprogram moet insluit. Registrasiesertifikaat met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Huidige registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Aansoekers wat op registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n spesialis algemene chirurg wag, kan aansoek doen en sal registrasie as 'n spesialis voor aanvang van diens in die pos benodig. Graad 1: Nie van toepassing nie; Registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Buitelandse kandidate benodig 1 Jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Graad 2: 5 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in die relevante dissipline. Buitelandse kandidate sal 6 Jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis benodig, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Graad 3: 10 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in die relevante dissipline. Buitelandse kandidate sal 11 Jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis benodig, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Kennis van toepaslike spesialisvlakprosedures en -protokolle binne die veld van algemene chirurgie. Spesialis sal vereis word om die Bors-, Endokriene en Nierchirurgie-eenheid te bestuur. Deeglike kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuur. Finansiële Bestuur – monitering van uitgawes, Essential Drug List, bestuursfunksies – beleidsontleding en -implementering, strategiese bestuur, projekbestuur, inligtingsbestuur, totale gehaltebestuur en -verbetering, regsaspekte, pasiëntesorg en dienslewering, toepaslike verpligte vereistes en Wette, Regulasies, Protokolle en Riglyne wat in Gesondheidsdienste gebruik word.
af.duties: Neem deel aan die levering van in-pasient en buite-pasient algemene chirurgiedienste, veral bors- en endokriene dienste binne die Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex gebaseer by Grey's hospital. Bestuur van pasiënte wat algemene chirurgie benodig. Bystand in die bestuur van die chirurgiese databasis. Funksioneer as die intern kurator wanneer vereis. Interdissiplinêre koördinering van die bestuur van algemene chirurgie-pasiënte. Toesig oor die chirurgiese opleidingsgevalle en internes wat deur die eenheid roteer. Verseker die hoogste standaarde van kliniese, professionele en etiese gedrag. Onderrig van internes, voorgraadse mediese studente, nagraadse algemene chirurgie-opleidingsgevalle en allied health care-personeel. Voer navorsing uit, help en stimuleer navorsing binne die etiese riglyne van die Health Care Act. Bevorder opvoeding in kankervoorkoming. Ontwikkel bestuursprotokolle vir die algemene chirurgiediens in ooreenstemming met die Hospitaal en Departement se beleide; Verskaf toepaslike chirurgiese sorg aan algemene chirurgie-pasiënte; Verantwoordelik vir die Bors-, Endokriene en Nierchirurgie-eenheid. Onderhou die effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van menslike hulpbronne ten opsigte van: toesig oor en begeleiding van algemene chirurgie-personeel in die uitvoering van hul pligte; opleiding van personeel en bevordering van deurlopende personeelsontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met hul individuele en departementele ontwikkelingsbehoeftes; werf en selekteer personeel in ooreenstemming met regeringsvoorskripte; assesseer prestasie van algemene chirurgie-personeel; allokeer algemene chirurgie-personeel tot onderskeie sale en oproeprooster. Verskaf maatreëls en leiding oor gehalteversekering om aan gestelde gehaltetstandaarde te voldoen; Ampsdrager verskaf algemene chirurgie-uitreikdienste in die Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex en Area 2. Bevorder samewerking met ander hospitale binne en buite die distrik; Oefen kostebeheer uit oor die aktiwiteite van die departement in ooreenstemming met die toegekende begroting; Neem deel aan alle akademiese en kliniese vergaderings van die algemene chirurgie-departement; Neem deel aan departementele navorsingsaktiwiteite. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om op hoogte te bly van nuwe ontwikkelings in die kundigheidsveld en verwante velde. Enige ander pligte soos deur die Hoof van Departement toegewys.

zu.title: Usochwepheshile Wezokuhlinza Izinga 1, 2, 3
zu.summary: Usochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ohlinzayo ohambisanayo ebusweni we-General Surgery, ocelwa eGrey's Hospital ePietermaritzburg, odinga ubhalo ne-HPCSA nokuqeqeshwa iFCS(SA), ngoholo oluqala ku-R1,395,528 kuya ku-R1,844,151 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ithewui lika-12 / Isitifikedi esingokoqobo. Isiqu se-MBChB noma esingafani naso. Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalwa ku-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ezesigulukweni, okufanele kuquke ukuphela kwe-FCS (SA) ne-MMED kanye nesikhathi esanele ocwaningweni lwesibalo ezingaxhunyiwe. Isitifikedi sobhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ezesigulukweni. Ubhalo lwangempela ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ezesigulukweni. Abafaka izicelo abalinde ubhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe bangafaka isicelo futhi bazodinga ukubhalwa njengosochwepheshile ngaphambi kokuba baqale ukusebenza esikhundleni. Ithewui 1: Akuvumelekile; Ubhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza. Obonake abangeminyango yezinye izwe badinga unyaka oyi-1 wobunzima obuhambisanayo ngemuva kobhalo ne-HPSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza, ongadingeki ukubaenze iNkonzo yoluntu. Ithewui 2: Iminyaka eyi-5 yokusebenza okufanele njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ngemuva kobhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza esigabeni esihambisanayo. Obonake abangeminyango yezinye izwe bazodinga iminyaka eyi-6 yobunzima obuhambisanayo ngemuva kobhalo ne-HPSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ongadingeki ukubaenze iNkonzo yoluntu. Ithewui 3: Iminyaka eyi-10 yokusebenza okufanele njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ngemuva kobhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza esigabeni esihambisanayo. Obonake abangeminyango yezinye izwe bazodinga iminyaka eyi-11 yobunzima obuhambisanayo ngemuva kobhalo ne-HPCSA njengosochwepheshile wezokuhlinza ongadingeki ukubaenze iNkonzo yoluntu. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Nokuqobo: Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nezithintela ezingokoqobo ezinga lesi kuhlalo ezingaxhunyiwe. Usochwepheshile uzodingwa ukuba aphathe iBhetha, i-Endocrine, nese-Renal Surgery Unit. Ulwazi olwanelelokugcina imisebenzi yabantu. Ukuphatha ngemali – ukuqapha imali echithwayo, uhlu lwemitho ebalulekile, imisebenzi yokuphatha – ukuhlazwa nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo, ukuphatha ngobuchwepheshile, ukuphatha amaphulo, ukuphatha ngolwazi, ukugcina izinga lokuphatha ngokuphelele kokuthuthukiswa, izinkomba zomthetho, ukunakekelwa kwesiguli nokulethwa kwensiza, imigomidingo ephoqiwe neMithetho, imigomo, neMihlahlandlela esebenziswa kwiNzima EzaNempilo.
zu.duties: Thinta ekuletheni insiza yezesamuntu nangaphandle ngasese yokuqhuba izibalo ebusweni phakathi kwe-Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex esekwe esibhedlela i-Grey’s hospital. Engcupheni kwabesiguli abadinga izibalo ezingaxhunyiwe. Ukusiza ekwenzeni ngcono isikhathi sesibalo sokuhlinzwa. Ukusebenza njengomfuyi wesigaba esimaphakathi lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuba negunya lokuhlanganisa imisebenzi phakathi kweminyango yokulawula abesiguli besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe. Ukugcina isikhundla esiphezulu kwezokuhlinza, ngobuciko, nobulungu bomthetho. Ukufundisa iziqu, abafundi besayensi yezamayelegada, abaqeqeshi beziqu ezingaxhunyiwe, nabasebenzi bezokunakekelwa kwempilo. Ukuphatha, ukusiza, futhi ukukhuthaza ucwaningo ngaphakathi kwemithetho yesokudla nokuhlinzwa komphakathi. Ukukhuthaza imfundo ekuthotenweni kwesifo sowomumo. Ukuthuthukisa amaphuzu okuphatha insiza yezibalo ezingaxhunyiwe ngokuvumelana nemigomo yesibhedlela nomnyango; Ukukhuluma ngensiza yokuhlinza ngokuhlinzwa kubesiguli besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe; Ukuba nogunya ebuhlaleni bezibalo ezingaxhunyiwe, kwezinhlayiya, nasekunakekelweni kwesibalo esigulukweni. Ukugcina ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwabasebenzi ngokuhlinza kwabantu ngokuhlinzwa: ukunakekela futhi ulawule abasebenzi besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo; ukuqeqesha abasebenzi futhi ukhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi ngokuhlinza ngemigomo yabo ngayinye nangokuhlinza nomnyango; ukuthola futhi ukhethe abasebenzi ngokuhlinza ngemithetho kahulumeni; ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe; ukuqamba abasebenzi besibalo ezingaxhunyiwe kwamawadi ahambisanayo nasekubhaleni. Ukunikeza izinyathelo futhi umlayezo wokuvikelwa kwesikhathi sendlela yokuhlinza ukuze kuhambisane nezindinganiso eziqinile; Ukuba nogunya ekunikela insiza yokuhlinza kwesibalo ezingaxhunyiwe e-Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex nasendaweni i-Area 2. Ukuba nogunya ekubumbeni kwezinye izibhedlela ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesifunda; Ukusetshenziswa kwesibalo nangemali emsebenzini yomnyango ngokuvumelana nesabelo semali esinikiwe; Ukuthinta kuyo yonke imihlangano yesayensi yezokufunda neyezokuhlinza yomnyango wezibalo ezingaxhunyiwe; Ukuthinta emisebenzini yocwaningo yomnyango. Ukubeka ngokuzenzela ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhuba emiqatha yokugcina usezakwazi okusha ebuhlaleni bakho obuchwepheshile nakwezinye izindawo. Eminye imisebenzi njengoba umyango wezakhamuzi uyinikeza.

xh.title: Isikhulu seMela seMedisi Seqingqa 1,2,3
xh.summary: Kufunwa Isikhulu seMela seMedisi kwi-General Surgery esibhedlele i-Grey's Hospital e-Pietermaritzburg, sifuna ukubhalwa kwi-HPCSA nokuqwalaselwa kwesatifikethi se-FCS(SA), inikezelwa ngemivuzo eqala ku-R1,395,528 kuya ku-R1,844,151 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: i-Grade 12 / Isatifikethi ePhakamileyo. i-MBChB okanye esilinganayo. Iziqinisekiso ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalwa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) njengesikhulu semedisi kwi-General Surgery, kufuneka zibandakanye i-FCS (SA) nokugqitywa kwe-MMED nexesha elifanelekileyo kwinkqubo yabafundi abayi-registrar kwi-general surgery. Isatifikethi sobhaliso nge-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi kwi-General Surgery. Ugqibo lobhaliso nge-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi kwi-General Surgery. Abaqulunqi abalindele ukubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengaba-chwebha be-general surgery banako ukusebenzisa, kwaye baya kudinga ukubhalwa njengaba-chwebha phambi kokuba baqale ukusebenza kulesi sithuba. Iqingqa 1: Akukusebenziseki; Ukubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi. Abaqulunqi bemivo afuna unyaka o-1 wamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi, abangekho kudingekiwa ukuba benze iNkonzo yomPhakathi. Iqingqa 2: Iminyaka e-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengesikhulu semedisi emva kokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi kwinto ephathwayo. Abaqulunqi bemivo baya kudinga iminyaka e-6 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi abangekho kudingekiwa ukuba benze iNkonzo yomPhakathi. Iqingqa 3: Iminyaka e-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengesikhulu semedisi emva kokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi kwinto ephathwayo. Abaqulunqi bemivo baya kudinga iminyaka e-11 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu semedisi abangekho kudingekiwa ukuba benze iNkonzo yomPhakathi. Ulwazi, Amandla namaVa: Ulwazi ngeendlela nemithetho yamazinga afanelekileyo esikhulu phakathi kwendawo ye-general surgery. Isikhulu siza kudingwa ukuba siphathe iNkomfa ye-Breast, Endocrine ne-Renal Surgery. Ulwazi oluqinileyo lolawulo lwamathumba abantu. Ulawulo lweMali – ukwengca intlawulo, uLuhlu lweziYeza eziyimfuno, imisebenzi yoLawulo – uqwalaselo nokusebenzisa iinkqubomphulo, ulawulo oluqhuba phambili, ulawulo lweendalo, ulawulo lolwazi, ulawulo nokuphucula ubungakanani jikelele, iindaba zomthetho, ukhathalo lwesigulane nokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo, iindingo eziyimfuno namagunya, iMithetho, iNkqubo, iNdlela neziQinisekiso ezisetyenziswa kwiIinkonzo zeZeMPilo.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ekunikezelweni kwenkonzo ye-general surgery kwabaguli abangenayo naye egula ngaphandle ngakumbi inkonzo ye-breast nendocrine ngaphakathi kwiPietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex ese Grey's hospital. Ulawulo lwabaguli abadinga i-general surgery. Ukuncedisa ekulawulweni kwegcine elingagqibekanga le-surgical. Ukusebenza njengomntu ogcina i-intern xa kufuneka. Uqhathaniso phakathi kweendawo wolawulo lwabaguli be-general surgery. Ukuqwalasela kwabafundi be-surgical nabantu abayi-intern abajikelezayo kwindawo. Qinisekisa amazinga aphezulu kakhulu ekuziphatheni ngezemondle, ngokuchwephesha, ngokunyaniseka. Yenza imfundo kwabangengadyani, abafundi bezonyango ezinqamlezileyo, abafundi be-general surgery abangenanga eziqu, kwaye nabantu bokhathalo loluntu oluhambelana nokhathalo lwezempilo. Qhutywa, nceda, kwaye khuthaza uphononongo phakathi kweenkqubo zezeqondo zobomi zezeMPiLO Act. Khuthaza imfundo ekuthinteleni i-cancer. Phatha iinkqubo yolawulo zenkonzo ye-general surgery ngokwemigaqo yeSiBhedlele namasebe; Nikeza unyango olufanelekileyo lwe-surgical kwabaguli be-general surgery; Yiba nawo umrhumo wokuLawula iNkomfa yeBreast, Endocrine neRenal Surgical. Gcina ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nangen iso ezisebenzayo kwamathumba abantu ngokwoku: ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela abasebenzi be-general surgery ekuphumezeni imisebenzi yabo; ukulungiselela abasebenzi nokukhuthaza ukuphuculwa kwabasebenzi ngokuhamba kwexesha ngokwemfuno yawo ngamnye namasebe yokuphucula; ukuqokelela nokukhetha abasebenzi ngokomyalelo kahulumende; ukuqwalasela ukusebenza koluntu olusebenzayo kwi-general surgery; ukwabela abantu abasebenzayo kwi-general surgery kumagumbi ahlukeneyo kwaye naluhlu lokubiza. Qinisekisa iziqondiso namacebiso ngokuqinisekisa ubungakanani ukuze bahambelane nemilinganiselo ekuqikelelwe kuyo; Ume womsebenzi kufuneka anikeze iinkonzo zokuphuma i-general surgery e-Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex nakuNdawo 2. Khuthaza uquhaniselwano namanye amabhedlele ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesithili; Lawulaindlela zokulawula iindleko kumanyano omsebenzi wesebe ngokomthetho we-mali oqokelelweyo; Thatha inxaxheba kwaye nasiphi na isiqendu esimalunga nemfundo neminyhadala yesebe le-general surgery; Thatha inxaxheba koluntu oluphando kwisebe. Yamkela umrhumo wokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo ngamandla ukuze ugcine ukuya phambili nokuqhubeka nokuqaliswa kwamva kwindawo oqeqwe kuyo nakwezinye iindawo ezingamanxulumene nayo. Nako nakwenyke imisebenzi enye njengoko umiselwe yiNtloko yoMsebenzi.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1,2,3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Plus Commuted Overtime which is subject to the needs of the department. Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine sought for Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, requiring MBChB, MMED and HPCSA registration, with clinical and training duties.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. MBChB or equivalent. MMED Qualification. Registration certificate with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Current registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Grade 1: Not applicable; Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist. Foreign candidates require 1 Year relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 2: 5 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 6 Years relevant experience after registration with HPSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Grade 3: 10 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in the relevant discipline. Foreign candidates will require 11 Years relevant experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist of which it is not required to perform Community Service. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Competent general medicine skills, appropriate for the level of a specialist in Internal Medicine; Ability and willingness to work as part of a multi-disciplinary health care team, including liaison and communication with senior and junior staff; Understanding and ability to apply, appropriate to the post, public sector and health sector legislation, medical ethics and financial management; Ability and willingness to participate in information management, quality assurance programmes and human resource management as appropriate to the post; Ability to supervise junior staff; Ability and willingness to participate in and provide undergraduate and postgraduate training.
jobs.duties: Incumbent’s duties will be performed in the Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Department of Internal Medicine as per the HOD discretion. Participation in clinical and training programmes: After-hours participation in the clinical services in the Departments of Internal Medicine as per operational requirements. Valid code EB Driver’s Licence (code 8) Plus. Additional Information: A Masters’ degree in Public Health or similar in research will be an added advantage. Master’s in Public Health (MPH) will also be an added advantage. Computer literacy. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: Job Purpose: To develop, facilitate, monitor and evaluate evidence-based strategies to i) reduce maternal morbidity and mortality, including HIV-related and ii) vertical transmission prevention (VTP) of HIV, syphilis and Hepatits B; and improve the quality of maternal and perinatal health through improving service delivery, ensuring transfer of appropriate knowledge, skills and developing community intervention strategies. Manage resource allocation and monitor implementation of maternal health care and VTP policies within the province; comprehensive data collection, analysis and strategic planning in the field of maternal health and VTP. The ideal candidate must possess the following: Technical knowledge on maternal health policies and VTP. Knowledge of the current health and public health services legislation. Financial management skills. Project management skills. Understanding of epidemiology and statistics. Leadership skills, including good communication, decision making and clinical skills. Possess sound knowledge of human resources. Management skills, including budgeting, planning, implementation, and quality assurance.
jobs.duties: Develop, review and ensure implementation of relevant policies and guidelines: Performance standard. Update existing provincial maternal health and VTP related guidelines and policies. Develop new guidelines and policies for the Province in response to identified issues in maternal health and VTP field. Provide guidance to districts regarding best practices for maternal health and VTP coordinators. Identify maternal health and VTP advocacy needs according to priorities. Program Management & Implementation: Performance standard. Develop and implement strategies to reduce maternal and perinatal health-related morbidity and mortality, including HIV-related in each key programme area (preconception/ antenatal care; labour and childbirth, post- natal care) as per Saving Mothers recommendations and consolidated HIV guidelines. Report on key activities conducted aligned to these strategies. Facilitate engagement on programme performance at women’s health management and provincial quarterly meetings. Offer assistance and technical support to all districts to improve Maternal Health and VTP Services: Performance standard. Support the district in devising district plans to address district-specific health issues. Provide technical assistance to district and facility management team. Conduct outreach support visits (on site or virtual to all districts) with priority given to districts with poorest performance. Facilitate training in all key areas of women’s health programme. Offer assistance and technical support to all districts to improve Maternal Health Services. Stakeholder Collaboration - Liaise with national and provincial Departments of Health, funders (like UNICEF), partners, and local stakeholders to ensure coordinated effort and program integration. Improve service delivery through capacity building: performance standard: Facilitate training of midwives and doctors where applicable on the new developments and protocols, as well as to maintain and improve skills and knowledge (e.g. ESMOE, EMOTIVE); engage districts to conduct skills audits for relevant trainings; Organize and provide orientation and training for healthcare providers and facility staff on VTP guidelines, screening, and preventative therapies. Monitor and evaluate maternal health services: performance standard. Review and update maternal health and VTP data elements. Quarterly reports prepared with remedial actions. Correct data errors. Analysis of relevant indicator performance with the team. Monitor quarterly the implementation of saving mothers recommendations. Undertake other managerial and administration duties; performance standard. Coordinate provincial maternal mortality confidential enquiry. Coordinate Provincial perinatal morbidity and mortality committee. EPMDS completed. Compile DORA. Participate in provincial and district interviews as panel member.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Moedersgesondheid/vtp
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Moedersgesondheid by KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health wat 'n verpleeg- of mediese kwalifikasie met MCWH-koördinasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat (Graad 12). 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 7) of Diploma (NQF 6) in Verpleegkunde. Of Mediese graad (MBCHB) Plus. Huidige registrasie SANC of HPCSA. Ervaring as 'n Kliniese Koördineerder vir MCWH (Moeder-, Kind- en Vrouegesondheid) sal 'n vereiste wees. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring as 'n Assistent-direkteur Plus. Vyf jaar se ervaring na registrasie by professionele liggaam in Moedersgesondheidsprogram Plus. Gevorderde Vroedvrou-kwalifikasie of enige moedersgesondheidsverwante kliniese ervaring word vereis. Geldige kode EB-bestuurslisensie (kode 8) Plus. Bykomende inligting: 'n Meestersgraad in Openbare Gesondheid of soortgelyk in navorsing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Meesters in Openbare Gesondheid (MPH) sal ook 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Werkdoel: Om bewysgebaseerde strategieë te ontwikkel, faciliteer, monitor en evalueer ten einde i) moederlike morbiditeit en mortaliteit te verminder, insluitend MIV-verwante en ii) vertikale transmissievoorkoming (VTP) van MIV, sifilis en Hepatitis B; en die gehalte van moederlike en perinatale gesondheid te verbeter deur dienslewering te verbeter, toepaslike kennisoordrag te verseker, vaardighede te ontwikkel en gemeenskapsintervensiestrategieë te ontwikkel. Bestuur hulpbrontoewysing en monitor implementering van moedersgesondheids- en VTP-beleide binne die provinsie; omvattende data-insameling, ontleding en strategiese beplanning op die gebied van moedersgesondheid en VTP. Die ideale kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: Tegniese kennis van moedersgesondheidsbeleide en VTP. Kennis van die huidige gesondheids- en openbare gesondheidsdienste-wetgewing. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Begrip van epidemiologie en statistiek. Leierskapsvaardighede, insluitend goeie kommunikasie, besluitneming en kliniese vaardighede. Oor beskik oor deeglike kennis van menslike hulpbronne. Bestuursvaardighede, insluitend begroting, beplanning, implementering en gehalteversekering.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en verseker implementering van relevante beleide en riglyne: Werkverrigtingsstandaard. Werk bestaande provinsiale moedersgesondheids- en VTP-verwante riglyne en beleide by. Ontwikkel nuwe riglyne en beleide vir die Provinsie in reaksie op geïdentifiseerde kwessies in die moedersgesondheids- en VTP-veld. Verskaf leiding aan distrikte aangaande beste praktyke vir moedersgesondheids- en VTP-koördineerders. Identifiseer moedersgesondheids- en VTP-voorligtingsbehoeftes volgens prioriteite. Programbestuur en Implementering: Werkverrigtingsstandaard. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om moederlike en perinatale gesondheidsverwante morbiditeit en mortaliteit te verminder, insluitend MIV-verwante in elke sleutelprogramgebied (voorbevrugting/voorgeboortelike sorg; kraam en geboorte, na-geboorte-sorg) soos per Saving Mothers-aanbevelings en gekonsolideerde MIV-riglyne. Rapporteer oor sleutelaktiwiteite wat uitgevoer is in ooreenstemming met hierdie strategieë. Fasiliteer betrokkenheid oor programprestasie by vrouegesondheidsbestuur en provinsiale kwartaalvergaderings. Bied bystand en tegniese ondersteuning aan alle distrikte om Moedersgesondheids- en VTP-dienste te verbeter: Werkverrigtingsstandaard. Ondersteun die distrik om distrikplanne op te stel om distrikspesifieke gesondheidskwessies aan te spreek. Verskaf tegniese bystand aan distrik- en fasiliteitsbestuurspan. Voer bystandsondersteuningsbesoeke uit (ter plek of virtueel aan alle distrikte) met voorrang gegee aan distrikte met die swakste prestasie. Fasiliteer opleiding in alle sleutelgebiede van die vrouegesondheidsprogram. Bied bystand en tegniese ondersteuning aan alle distrikte om Moedersgesondheidsdienste te verbeter. Belanghebbendesamewerking - Skakel met nasionale en provinsiale Departments of Health, befondsers (soos UNICEF), vennote en plaaslike belanghebbendes om gekoördineerde poging en programintegrasie te verseker. Verbeter dienslewering deur kapasiteitsbou: werkverrigtingsstandaard: Fasiliteer opleiding van vroedvroue en dokters waar toepaslik oor die nuwe ontwikkelings en protokolle, asook om vaardighede en kennis te handhaaf en te verbeter (bv. ESMOE, EMOTIVE); betrek distrikte om vaardigheidsoudits vir tersaaklike opleidings uit te voer; Reël en verskaf oriëntering en opleiding vir gesondheidsorgverskaffers en fasiliteitspersoneel oor VTP-riglyne, sifting en voorkomende terapieë. Monitor en evalueer moedersgesondheidsdienste: werkverrigtingsstandaard. Hersien en werk moedersgesondheids- en VTP-data-elemente by. Kwartaalverslae voorberei met remediërende maatreëls. Korrekte data-foute. Ontleding van tersaaklike aanwyserprestasie met die span. Monitor kwartaalliks die implementering van Saving Mothers-aanbevelings. Onderneem ander bestuurs- en administratiewe pligte; werkverrigtingsstandaard. Koördineer provinsiale vertroulike ondersoek na moederlike sterftes. Koördineer Provinsiale perinatale morbiditeits- en mortaliteitskomitee. EPMDS voltooi. Stel DORA op. Neem deel aan provinsiale en distriksonderhoude as paneellid.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mcondontshi: Impilo Yabesifazane/vtp
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mcondontshi wezempilo yabesifazane eKwaZulu-Natal Department of Health esidinga iziqu zokuhlonza noma zokwelapha nokuba nohlelo lokusebenza ngemizamo yokubambisana kwe-MCWH.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric (Grade 12). Isiqu esingaphansi kwezinga (NQF 7) noma i-Diploma (NQF 6) ekuhlonzeni. Noma iziqu zokwelapha (MBCHB) Okwengeziwe. Ukuqashiwa kwamanje ku-SANC noma i-HPCSA. Lolu hlu lusebenza njengesidingo. Ulwazi lweminyaka emithathu (3) njengoMbhalaji weNkomishi Plus. Iminyaka emihlanu yokuhamba phambili ngemuva kokuqashwa kwesikhwama emkhakheni we-Hololoid. Ukuqashwa okungavumelekile noma noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusiza abesifazane noma inhlolokhulu. I-Certificate Code EB Driver's Licence (code 8) Plus. Izindleko ezingeziwe: Isiqu seziqu ezingeni lama-Master kwiNyuvesi noma nganoma yisiphi isiqu esibuye sibe ngezinga. Isiqu se-Master's in Public Health (MPH) nezinye iziqu. Ulwazi lokusebenza nekhompyutha. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha kanye namakhono ezinga: Injongo yomsebenzi: Ukuthuthukisa, ukwenzela ukuthuthukisa, ukubheka nokuhlaziya izindlela ezisekelwe ukubhala ukuba i) ukunciphisa ukuhamba kwezifo nezifo ezibulala abesifazane, kuhlanganise ne-HIV kanye no-HIV, i-syphilis ne-Hepatitis B; kuthuthukise izinga lempilo yabesifazane nabantu abasha ngokuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo, kuqiniseke ukudluliselwa kolwazi olufanele, amakhono nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokungenelela emphakathini. Ukuphatha ukwabiwa kwemithombo yokulawula nokubheka ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo kwe-HIV kanye nemithetho kuleyo ndawo; ukwemukela idatha yonke, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuhlela ezinkundleni zemfundo yomsebenzi we-HIV kanye ne-VTP. Umuntu othandwa kufanele abe nalo lawa: Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe nge-HIV kanye nemithetho ye-VTP. Ulwazi ngemithetho equkethwe yisoqobo noma ingangenwa emthethweni. Amakhono okuphatha imali. Amakhono okuphatha uhlelo. Ukuqonda ukugcinwa kolwazi kanye nezibalo. Amakhono okubusa, kuhlanganise nokuxhumana, ukuthatha izinqumo namakhono ekwelapha. Ukuba nolwazi oluhliziozindayo ngezinsizakalo zangempela. Amakhono okuphatha, kuhlanganise nokuhlela kabusha amandla, ukuhlela, ukusebenzisa, kanye nohlolojwazi.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyisela kabusha nokuthi kwenziwe imithetho nezinkomba eziyinhloko: Izinga lokuqala ukubonakala. Ukubuyisela kabusha imithetho nezinkomba zomphakathi namuhla mayelana ne-HIV kanye ne-VTP. Ukuthuthukisa imithetho nezinkomba ezintsha zoMphakathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi noma uma kubonakala noma yisiphi isidingo. Ukunikela ngemithetho kumakhaya nemithetho yamakhasimende abe ngu-Maternal Health kanye nabahleli be-VTP. Ukuhlola imikhuba ye-HIV kanye nohlelo lwe-VTP mayelana nezidingo ezingaba khona. Ukuqondisa izinkomba ze-HIV kanye ne-VTP. Imisebenzi ye-HIV: Izinga lokuqala ukubonakala. Ukuthuthukisa kokuqonda ukuqonda imikhuba emisha yokunciphisa ukubulawa kwabantu abasha kanye nezifo ezibulala abesifazane, kuhlanganise ne-HIV, ezinkundleni eziyinhloko (ukukhulelwa / ukukhulelwa; ukubeletha nokuqeda ukubeletha, ukukhuliswa kwabantu abasha) njengoba kuncoma i-Saving Mothers ne-consolidated HIV guidelines. Ukubika ngemikhuba eyinhloko eyenziwe kule ndlela. Ukuxhumana nokubonisana ngemikhuba yomphakathi ngezinkathi ezinhle zobukhosi bamakhosi, imihlangano yesifunda kanye namahora. Ukunikela ngosizo olufanele kubantu bonke ukunciphisa ukuba khona komthwalo we-HIV kanye nezinsizakalo ze-VTP: Izinga lokuqala ukubonakala. Ukusiza isifunda ekuqondiseni amaphuzu abeke kuhlele amaphuzu abantu basesikhundleni. Ukunika usizo ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe abantu basesikhundleni kanye nabahleli. Ukwenza ukuvakashela (endaweni noma kwi-intanethi) wonke amasebe obuso noma okungenwa endaweni. Ukuxhumana nabo ukuba nabo bonke abantu abakwazi ukusiza kakhulu kwe-VTP. Ukubuyisela kabusha izindinganiso zomsebenzi nokukhombisa kubantu bonke kulesi sikhathi esisha sokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho, ukuze kulondolozwe futhi kuthuthukiswe amakhono nolwazi (isb. ESMOE, EMOTIVE); ukuxhumana namasebe obuso ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kwamakhono; Ukuhlela nokunika ukulungiselela kubantu basezinsizakalo zokwelapha nabantu basesikhundleni ukuthola imithetho ye-VTP, ukuqashwa kwemithetho, kanye neziguli ezisiza. Ukubheka futhi ukuhlaziya izinsizakalo zokuqondisa: Izinga lokuqala ukubonakala. Ukubuyisela kabusha ukugcinwa kwesifundo se-HIV. Ukulungiselela amaphuzu amasha kwe-VTP. Ukuqondanisa idatha enephutha. Ukuhlaziya imikhuba engasize kubantu abakwazi ukuhlola. Ukubheka njalo isigaba sokuqondisa ukuthi kusetshelezwe kangakanani ukugcinwa kolwazi mayelana nabesifazane abasindile. Ukwenza eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha nokuqondisa; Izinga lokuqala ukubonakala. Ukubheka imithetho yesifunda ngokusondela. Ukubheka ukubheka imithetho ngokusondela kwesoqotho sokubulawa kwabantu basesikhundleni. I-EPMDS iqedile. Ukuqamba i-DORA. Ukubamba iqhaza emikhakheni yesifunda nakwezinsizakalo ezibekelwe abantu abasesikhundleni sokuqondisa.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Impilo Yomzimba Wabomama/vtp
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli weMpi lo Yamazimba Wabomama kwiSebe leMpe e KwaZulu-Natal elifuna izidanga zamabugcisa bokunyanga okanye ezonyango kunye nolwazi lokulawulwa kwe-MCWH.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric (Grede 12). Isidanga se-undergraduate (NQF 7) okanye iDiploma (NQF 6) kwiNursing. Okanye izidanga zonyango (MBCHB) Ngaphezu koko. Ukbhaliso lwangoku kwi-SANC okanye i-HPCSA. Ulwazi njengesiQaqambeli seZoclinic kwi-MCWH (Impilo kaMama, yoMntwana neyoBafazi kuya kuba yimfuno. Ubuncinci beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava njengoSekela Mongameli Ngaphezu koko. Iminyaka emihlanu yamava emva kokubhalisa komzimba osebenzayo kwinkqubo yeMaternal Health Programme Ngaphezu koko. Isidanga sokuba nguMagesi ophuhlile okanye naluphi na ulwazi loclinical oluhambelana nempilo yomzimba wabomama luyafuneka. Ilayisensi yokushayela evakalayo ikhowudi EB (ikhowudi 8) Ngaphezu koko. Ulwazi Olwongeziwe: Isidanga seMasters kwiNtshona yoLuntu okanye elifanayo kuphononongo luya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. I-Master's kwiNtshona yoLuntu (MPH) nayo iya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono: Injongo yoMsebenzi: Ukuphuhisa, ukulawula, ukujonga nokuhlola iindlela ezisekelwe kubungqangqsha ukuba i) kuncitshiswe isifo esibangelwa kubomi bami bomzimba nokuFa, kuquka esidolophu-i-HIV kunye noku ii) thintela ukusasazwa ngokuthe nkqo (VTP) i-HIV, isifo sofuba be-Hepatits B; kwaye kuphuculwe khululo lwempilo yomzimba wabomama nasekusela ngokuphucula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo, kuqinisekiswe ukudluliselwa kolwazi olufanelekileyo, amakhono kwaye kuphuhiswe iindlela zokungenelela kommango. Lawula ukwabiwa kwesixhobo ulwazi kwaye ulolule ukusebenza kweenkqachamthetho zempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP ngaphakathi kwiphondo; ukuqokelelwa okubanzi kwedata, ukuhlalutya kunye noqwalaselo olucwangcisiweyo kwinkalo yempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP. Umphathi oqwenelayo kufuneka abe nako ulandelayo: Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe malunga neenkqachamthetho zempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekisiwe kwangoku kwemithetho yempilo nontshona yoluntu. Amakhono oLawulo lweMali. Amakhono oLawulo loMgangatho. Ukuqonda i-epidemiology nabiostatistics. Amakhono oBukhosi, kuquka ukunxibelelana kakuhle, ukuthatha iigqibo kunye namakhono oclinical. Ukuba nolwazi olusoundo ngabantu. Amakhono oLawulo, kuquka ukwenza amaphulu, ukucwangcisa, ukusebenzisa, nokuqinisekisa khululo.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, hlola uqinisekise ukusebenza kweenkqachamthetho neengcombolo ezifanelekileyo: Izinga lomsebenzi. Hlaziya iingcombolo ezikhoyo zephondo zempilo yomzimba wabomama ezihambelana ne-VTP kunye neenkqachamthetho. Phuhlisa iingcombolo ezintsha neenkqachamthetho zePhondo ukuyiphendula imiba ebonelelweyo kwindalo yempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP. Nikela isalathiso kumaphondo ngamacebo amahle ezo kubalawuli bempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP. Chonga iimfuno zokuxelwa izandla kwempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP ngokweenkqonyela. oLawulo noQeqesho lomgangatho: Izinga lomsebenzi. Phuhlisa kwaye usebenzise iindlela ukunciphisa isifo esibangelwa kubomi bami bomzimba nokuFa okuhambelana nokusela, kuquka i-HIV kwinkalo nganye yomgangatho ophambili (oncedo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa/ oncedo ngexesha lokukhulelwa; ukubamba nokubeletha, oncedo ngemva kokuzalwa) njengoko kuchazwa kwi-Saving Mothers recommendations kunye neengcombolo ezihlangeneyo ze-HIV. Ithini ngeendalo ezibalulekileyo ezenziwayo ezihambelana nale ndlela. Lawulisa inxaxheba kwindalo yomsebenzi kwindalo yohoyelo wabantu bomama kunye namaphondo ephondo. Nikezela ncedo kunye nolwazi loclinical kulo onke amaphondo ukuphucula iinkonzo zempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP: Izinga lomsebenzi. Xhasa iphondo ekuyilenza amaphulu ephondo ukuphendula imiba yempilo yephondo. Nikela ulwazi olubonelela kwindalo yophondo nabaphathi bomgangatho. Qeqesha izixhobo zokugcina iindwendwe kwindalo eqongqothi (esiteshi okanye ngekhompyutha kulo onke amaphondo) ngeenkqonyela zokuqala kumaphondo ane nkqonyela ebi kakhulu. Lawulisa uqeqesho kulo onke amaphulu amaphambili ohoyelo wabantu bomama. Nikezela ncedo kunye nolwazi loclinical kulo onke amaphondo ukuphucula iinkonzo zempilo yomzimba wabomama. Ulwabi lwoqhagamshelo - Thintana namaphondo kazwelonke nakamaziko kaZwelonke, nabasiboneleli (njenge-UNICEF), abalinganiselwa nabantu bommango ukuyiqinisekisa inkxaso eqhagamshelweyo kwaye uhoyelo ludityaniswe. Phucula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ngokuyakha amakhono: izinga lomsebenzi: Lawulisa uqeqesho kwabagesi nabagqirha kwindawo eqhagamshelweyo ngenkqutsho yolonwabo kunye neenkqachamthetho, njengokugcina nokuphucula amakhono nolwazi (umz. i-ESMOE, i-EMOTIVE); qhagamshela amaphondo ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwamakhono kuzo zonke iindalo ezingasentla zokuqeqeshwa; Hlela kwaye nikeze inkqutsho kunye noqeqesho kubaphathi bempi lo buluntu nabo basebenza kwindalo ngeengcombolo ze-VTP, ukuhlolwa, kunye nendlela ezithintelayo zonyango. Jonga kwaye uhlale iinkonzo zempilo yomzimba wabomama: izinga lomsebenzi. Hlola kwaye uhlaziye iimpawu zedata zempilo yomzimba wabomama kwaye i-VTP. Iingxelo zenyanga ziliqhuqhwa ngeendlela zokulungisa. Lungisa iimpazamso zedata. Ukuhlalutya kokusebenza kwexabiso leminxulu kunye neqela. Jonga ngenyanga yeqakamba ukusebenza kwe-Saving Mothers recommendations. Thatha omnye umsebenzi wolawulo nengcobo; izinga lomsebenzi. Lawulisa isibuzo esiyimfihlo nge-Fa yabomama esiphondo. Lawulisa ikomiti yephondo yegciwbe nesifo esibangela ukufa kwekusela. I-EPMDS iqediwe. Hlela i-DORA. Thatha inxaxheba kwiingxoxo zephondo nasezimali njengelungu leqela.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY)- Nephrology
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 per annum, plus, 13th cheque, medical aid (optional), Homeowners allowance (employees must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing specialising in Nephrology at Grey's Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a Professional Nursing qualification with SANC registration and nine years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Degree/Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. 1 Year Post–basic / Post graduate qualification in Nephrology Nursing Science. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). A minimum of 9 years appropriate experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing of which 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Nephrology Nursing Science. OR A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing of which ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Nephrology Nursing Science. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients’ rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the Haemodialysis Unit. Manage and provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public accessing health care services at Grey’s Hospital. Demonstrate effective communication to patients, families, multidisciplinary team members and other stakeholders within the hospital. Ensure that high-quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing Renal health services at Grey’s Hospital, taking into consideration safety risk assessments and patient safety incident prevention and reporting. Manage the utilisation and supervision of all resources, taking into consideration cost containment measures. Manage, coordinate and plan the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at the improvement of Nephrology nursing care. Manage and instil discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Develop strategies which will ensure compliance with quality care, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain a constructive working environment with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F.S. Matibela- Nursing Manager Tel No: (033) 897 3331
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources). The employment equity target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (SPESIALITEIT)- Nefrologie
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde met spesialisasie in Nefrologie by Grey's Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie en nege jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroedvroukunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 1 Jaar Post-grondse / Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Nefrologie-verpleegkunde-wetenskap. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegkunderaad (2026 SANC-kwitansie). 'n Minimum van 9 jaar gepaste ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode gepaste/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na behaling van die een jaar post-grondse kwalifikasie in Nefrologie-verpleegkunde-wetenskap. OF 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegkunderaad in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan tien (10) jaar van die bogenoemde periode gepaste/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na behaling van die een jaar post-grondse kwalifikasie in Nefrologie-verpleegkunde-wetenskap. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegkundestatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Verpleegwet, Beroepsgesondheid- en veiligheidswet, Handves vir pasiënte se regte, Batho Pele-beginsels, Openbare diensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Dissiplinêre kodes en prosedures, Grieweprosedure, Finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Leierskaps-, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institutionele beleidsraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandelings-, konflikhanterings- en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die beplanning/organisering en monitering van doelwitte van die Hemodialise-eenheid. Bestuur en verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek wat gesondheidsorgdienste by Grey's Hospital bekom. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie aan pasiënte, gesinne, multidissiplinêre spanlede en ander belanghebbendes binne die hospitaal. Verseker dat hoë gehalte verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat Niergesondheidsdienste by Grey's Hospital bekom, gelewer word, met inagneming van veiligheidsrisiko-assesserings en pasiëntveiligheidsvoorval-voorkoming en -rapportering. Bestuur die benutting en toesig oor alle hulpbronne, met inagneming van koste-inperkingsmaatreëls. Bestuur, koördineer en beplan die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met fokus op programme gemik op die verbetering van Nefrologie-verpleegsorg. Bestuur en instill dissipline, professionaliteit en werksetiek onder werknemers. Ontwikkel strategieë wat nakoming van gehalte-sorg, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IPC)-programme sal verseker, bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S). Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksomgewing met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste, bv. bystand met onlastverpligtingspligte aan verpleegbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wezokwelapha (ISIKHUMBA ESIKHULU)- I-Nephrology
zu.summary: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wezokwelapha ohholela kwi-Nephrology esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, ofuna iziqu zobuhlengikazi abahlinzeki nezokwelapha ngenani elibhalisiwe nesikhungo se-SANC futhi enamava eneminyaka engu-nine.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Degree/Diploma kwe-General Nursing kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengesidlali. I-1 Year Post–basic / Post graduate qualification kwi-Nephrology Nursing Science. Ukubhalisa okwamanje ne-South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). Ubungozi bomzimba ongaphansi kwe-9 years emhlabeni obhekele emphakathini ezingeni lokugcina ukubhaliswa njengesidlali ngokusemthethweni we-SANC General Nursing, lapho kufanele khona iminyaka engu-5 yaso sonke isikhathi ukuba ukholwa ekugqamini kwe-1 year post basic qualification kwi-Nephrology Nursing Science. noma Hlola ngokusemthethweni kwe-14 (14) years ekubhaliseni okusemthethweni njengesidlali ngokusemthethweni we-South African Nursing Council General Nursing, lapho iminyaka engu-10 (10) yaso sonke isikhathi kumele ibe ukholwa ngokusemthethweni ekugqamini kwe-1 year post basic qualification kwi-Nephrology Nursing Science.
zu.duties: Siza ekupulani/hlezeni nasekuqaphehleni izinhloso ze-Haemodialysis Unit. Phatha futhi unikeze isindikelo esihle kubasebenzi, abagulayo nalomphakathi okufinyelela ezinsizakalo zokwelapha e-Grey's Hospital.

xh.title: Umphathi Weemisebenzi Wokhathalelo lwamagaza (INDALO EQELE) - i-Nephrology
xh.summary: Umphathi Weemisebenzi Wokhathalelo lwamagaza ogqithise kwi-Nephrology e Grey's Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal, efuna isikhundi sokukhathalela amagaza njengogqatyoiIwezamanga kunye nobhaliso kwi-SANC kunye neminyaka elithoba yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12. I-Degree/Diploma ekukhathaleleni amagaza ngokubanzi nasekuvelisweni abuvumela ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengogqathileyo bamagaza. Isikhundi senyanga elinye se-Post–basic / Post graduate kwisiXhanga seNephrology Nursing Science. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwi-South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). Oona machini amnye nje emava kwi-Nursing emva kobhaliso njengogqathileyo bamagaza kwi-SANC kwikhathalelo lwamagaza ngokubanzi, apho eminyaka emi-5 kule minyaka idwelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isikhundi senyanga elinye se-post basic kwisiXhanga seNephrology Nursing Science. OKUNYE Oona machini amnye nje (14) emava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kobhaliso njengogqathileyo bamagaza kwi-South African Nursing Council kwikhathalelo lwamagaza ngokubanzi, apho eminyaka elumi (10) kule minyaka idwelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isikhundi senyanga elinye se-post basic kwisiXhanga seNephrology Nursing Science. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namava afunekayo: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo neenkqubo zokhathalelo lwamagaza, izithethe zamagaza, nolunye ulwazi lwesigqeba esifanelekileyo njengaku: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, ulwazi lemali neyebhajethi ngokuhlobene namacebo afakwe kumanethi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi ahlobene nokhathalelo lwamagaza. Amandla okukhokela, okuqamba, okuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi komda wekhowudi yoluntu nengqikitho yamagqabantshintshi essebenzi. Amandla okusebenza nabantu kuquka izindaba zobhadanazo, ukuxoxisana, ukusombulula iingxabano kunye namandla okunceda ngengcebiso. Amandla ekhompyutha kwii-program ezingundoqo.
xh.duties: Nceda kwiqekesha/ukuhlela nokuhlola iinjongo ze-Haemodialysis Unit. Lawula kwaye unikeze indawo yokwelapha kubasebenzi, iigulana noluntu olufikelela kwiinkonzo zempilo e Grey's Hospital. Bonisa ukunyaniseka ekunxibelelaneni nagulgulana, nezaphi, lamalungu eqela elisenza imisebenzi egqithisileyo nabanomdla ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Qinisekisa ukuba kukhathalelo lwamagaza olungangomoya olunikelwa kubo bonke abafikelela kwiinkonzo zempilo ze-Renal e Grey's Hospital, ukuthathelwa ingqalelo iinjongano ezibenzi amathuba eengozi zokhuseleko iigulana nokuqhuba iingxelo ezithintela iingozi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa nokuqondisa onke amacebo, ukuthathelwa ingqalelo izinto ezithintela amaxaabiso. Lawula, qondanisa kwaye uqekeshe unikezelo lokuqeqesha nokuphandwa ngokusebenzayo, ukugqithisa kwiinkqubo ezijolise ekuphuculeni ukhathalelo lwamagaza lwe-Nephrology. Lawula kwaye ufake isithintelo, ubungcali kunye nobomi bokuziphatha kwabasebenzi. Phuhliza amacebo ayo kuqinisekise ukuthobela ekunikezelweni kokhathalelo olungangomoya, iinkqubo zokuthintela ukuveliswa kolunyulula nolawulo (IPC), umz. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kunye ne-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina indawo yokusebenza eqakambisayo ngabalamnye beqela elisenza imisebenzi egqithisileyo. Nika inkxaso ngokusebenzayo iinkonzo zamagaza, umz. nceda kumsebenzi wokuncedisa kulawulo lwezamagaza.

jobs.title: Operational Manager (SPECIALTY)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 - R821 454 per annum. Other benefits (medical aid optional), housing Allowance (applicant must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Operational Manager needed at Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick to lead a psychiatric nursing unit and provide clinical care to mental health service users.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 or equivalent. Degree/ Diploma in General and Psychiatric Nursing/R425.Diploma in Psychiatric Nursing-Post Basic/Child Psychiatric Nursing. A minimum of nine (9) years of appropriate/recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least seven (7) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience after obtaining one (1) year post basic qualification in advanced Psychiatric Nursing/Child Psychiatric Nursing. Valid Driver’s License. Computer Literacy. Degree/Diploma in Nursing Management will be an advantage. Knowledge And Skills: Good communication, leadership, interpersonal skills. Conflict management and knowledge of labour basic qualification in Psychiatry (Advanced Psychiatric Nursing). Relations and disciplinary process/procedures. Human Resources and financial management skills. Sound knowledge of disciplinary processes and grievance procedures. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety, Infection Control, medical waste and risk assessment and Mental Health Care Act and team building and supervisory skills. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal and conflict management skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and lead the unit in rendering efficient and professional nursing care as laid down by the Nursing Act. Engages in clinical assessment of Mental Health Care Users in a specialized psychiatric setting. Work effectively, co- operatively, amicably at supervisory level with people of diverse intellectual cultural or racial or differences. Ensures provision of optimal, holistic, specialized care in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care in the Unit. Participates in training and research with a view to increasing body of knowledge in a specialized psychiatric setting. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing practices. Maintain constructive working relationships with nursing and other stakeholders. Exercise control and account for expenditure by managing and monitor utilization of human, financial and material resources. Manage disciplinary and grievance matters including monitoring and managing absenteeism in terms of laid down policies and procedures. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and development of self and personnel, by analysing their needs, formulating and implementing training and developmental strategies and monitoring its effectiveness. Participate in performance reviews i.e. EPMDS. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives within the institution.
