af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder (SPESIALITEIT)
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder benodig by Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick om 'n psigiatriese verpleegseenheid te lei en kliniese sorg aan geestesgesondheidsdiensgebruikers te bied.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 of gelykwaardig. Graad/Diploma in Algemene en Psigiatriese Verpleging/R425. Diploma in Psigiatriese Verpleging-Post Basies/Kinderpsigiatriese Verpleging. 'n Minimum van nege (9) jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste sewe (7) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verkryging van een (1) jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleging/Kinderpsigiatriese Verpleging. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Graad/Diploma in Verpleegbestuur sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede. Konflikbestuur en kennis van arbeid basiese kwalifikasie in Psigiatrie (Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleging). Verhoudings en dissiplinêre prosesse/prosedures. Menslike hulpbronne en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van dissiplinêre prosesse en klagteprosedures. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures. Kennis van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, Infeksiebeheer, mediese afval en risikobepaling en Wet op Geestesgesondheidsorg en spanbou en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike en konflikbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en lei die eenheid in die lewer van doeltreffende en professionele verpleegsorg soos neergelê deur die Verpleegwet. Neem deel aan kliniese assessering van Geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers in 'n gespesialiseerde psigiatriese omgewing. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend, vreedsaam op toesigvlak met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele kulturele of rasse- of verskille. Verseker voorsiening van optimale, holistiese, gespesialiseerde sorg ooreenkomstig wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg in die Eenheid. Neem deel aan opleiding en navorsing met die doel om die kennisbasis in 'n gespesialiseerde psigiatriese omgewing te vergroot. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalte verpleegpraktyke. Handhaaf konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met verpleegkunde en ander belanghebbendes. Oefen beheer uit en hou verantwoording vir uitgawes deur die bestuur en monitering van benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne. Bestuur dissiplinêre en klagte-aangeleenthede insluitend die monitering en bestuur van afwesigheid volgens neergelêde beleide en prosedures. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en ontwikkeling van self en personeel, deur hul behoeftes te analiseer, opleidings- en ontwikkelingstrategieë te formuleer en te implementeer en die doeltreffendheid daarvan te moniteer. Neem deel aan prestasieherbesinning d.w.s. EPMDS. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkominginisiatiewe binne die instelling.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokusebenza (SPECIALTY)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Wokusebenza e-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick ukuba ahole iqembu lokunakekelwa kwezokuhlalisana kwengqondo futhi anikeze ukunakekelwa kokwelapha kubasebenzisi benkonzo yezempilo yengqondo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. I-Degree/Diploma ku-General and Psychiatric Nursing/R425. I-Diploma ku-Psychiatric Nursing-Post Basic/Child Psychiatric Nursing. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisishiyagalolunye (9) yohlelo olufanele/oluzwayo lokunakekelwa kwezokuhlalisana emgqamini wokubhaliswa njengesiHlalisana esiNguni e-SANC ku-General Nursing. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisikhombisa (7) kobudlelwane obushiwo ngenhla kufanele kube uhlelo olufanele/oluzwayo emva kokuthola isikhundla somnyaka omunye (1) samakhwalifikheshini asho ukuqeqeshwa okuthuthukileyo kwezokuhlalisana kwengqondo/ezokuhlalisana kwengqondo kwezingane. I-License evumelekile yokushayela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. I-Degree/Diploma ku-Nursing Management izoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi Nezakhono: Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulalela, izakhono zabantu. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nolwazi ngesikhundla sokufunda okuyisisekelo kwe-Psychiatry (Advanced Psychiatric Nursing). Izinqubo nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa umthetho kanye nezinqubo zesithunywa. Amabhuloho emithwalo kanye nezakhono zokuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi olunamandla ngezinqubo zokuqinisekisa umthetho kanye nezinhlela zezikhalazo. Ulwazi ngezinqubo nezinhlela zokunakekelwa kwezokuhlalisana. Ulwazi ngokuPhepha komsebenzi nokuQinisekiswa, ukulawula ukutheleleka, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ezingcolile kanye nokuhlola ubungozi kanye noMthetho wezeMpilo yengQondo nokwakhiwa kweqembu kanye nezakhono zokulalela. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulalela, izakhono zabantu kanye nezakhono zokuphathwa kwezinkinga.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhole iyunithi ekunikezeni ukunakekelwa okusebenza kahle nangobuchwepheshe bezokuhlalisana njengoba kumiswe umthetho wezokuhlalisana. Ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ukwelapha kwabasebenzisi beseMpilo yengQondo kwindawo ethize yokuhlalisana kwengqondo. Usebenze ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana, ngokuzwana kwizinga lokulalela nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo noma ngenhlalo noma ngokubumbano. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa okungcono kakhulu, okuphelele, okuthize ngokuhambisana nomthetho nemithetho ehlobene nezokuhlalisana nenzalo yezempilo kwiYunithi. Bambe iqhaza ekufundweni nasekuqoqweni kolwazi ngenjongo yokwandisa ulwazi kwindawo ethize yokuhlalisana kwengqondo. Wethule amazinga, izindlela, izidingo nezinkomba zezokuhlalisana zezinga eliphezulu. Gcina ubudlelwano obwakha ukusebenza kahle nabahlalisana nabalabo abanye abahlobene nayo. Lawula futhi unake izinkathi ngokuphatha futhi ubheke ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zabantu, zamabhange nezensiza. Phatha izinkinga zokuqinisekisa umthetho nanezikhalazo kuhlanganise nokuqapha futhi kuphathe ukungabi nalo ikhaya ngokwemithetho nezinhlela ezibekiwe. Gcina ukukhula okuyisikhundla/izinga zomzimba nokuqinisekisa izinkomba nokuthuthukiswa kwakho nabasebenzi, ngokuhlaziya izidingo zabo, ukwenza futhi ukuphatha izinhlela zokufunda nokuqeqesha futhi ubheke ukuzwela kwazo. Bambe iqhaza ekubukeni ukusebenza okusho ukuqoka ukusetshenziswa kwamandla i-EPMDS. Bambe iqhaza ekukhuthazeni impilo nasekuqaleni izinketho zokuvikela ukugula ohambweni lolwandle.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi (ISEBE ELIQHELEKILEYO)
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi weMisebenzi kwiSibhedlele i-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital eHowick ukuba alawe icebo lokunyanga izigulo ezingomoya abenze kwindalo yezempilo engomoya, anike nesityalo sokunyanga.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphakamileyo/Isatifikethi se-Graji 12 okwa salingana neso. Isidanga/Isidiploma kokuNyanga ngokubanzi nokuNyanga ngomoya/I-R425. Isidiploma eNyanga ngomoya-Emva kwesiseko sokufunda eNyanga ngomoya abantwana. Apha kubekho iminyaka elishumi elinethoba (9) yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo ekuNyanyeni emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha /Nesi eNyanga ngomoya ngokubanzi. Kuye kubekho iminyaka esixhenxe (7) yexesha elitshiwo ngasentla, emva kokufumana isidanga semyaka (1) esilandela isiseko sokufunda ekuNyanyeni ngomoya okuphakamileyo /Nyanga abantwana ngomoya. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba elisebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isidanga/Isidiploma eLawuleni iNyanga kuya kuba yinzuzo. ULwazi namakhono: Inkcetho ngokucace gca, ukulathisa, namakhono abantu phakathi. Ulawulo lokuphatha iingxabano kwaye ulwazi ngesiseko somsebenzi kwizifo zengqondo (I-Nursing eNgqondo ePhakamileyo). Izithethe namagqabantshi_phambili ezendalo zokulawula abantu neemali. Ulwazi olubanzi ngamagqabantshi_phambili wokulawula izigaba nezinkqubo zemibuzo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo namagqabantshi_phambili wokunyanga. Ulwazi ngoMsebenzi wokuQinisekisa uKhuseleko, uLawulo loMva wokuNtsalwa, amaphiko waseKliniki eNyanga ngomoya, ukulawula imveliso yezigulo kunye namaphakamisto engozinayo; Nemigangatho yokwakha iqela namakhono okulawula. Inkcetho ngokucace gca, ukulathisa, namakhono abantu phakathi.
xh.duties: Qhuba ulawule icebo ekunikezeni inkonzo ekhuselekileyo nangobuchwepheshe kumanyango eNyanga njengoko kuqulunwe nguMgango weNyanga. UQatso ekuqwalaselweni kweKliniki koBomi baseMandla baseMental Health abasebenzisi kwindawo eNgqondo ekhethekileyo. Usebenze ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokusebenzisana, ngokuzwana kwizigaba eziphezulu ngeendidi ezahlukeneyo zabantu abanobulumko, inkcubeko, iintlanga okanye ezingezo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwenkonzo eyona inkulu ethanda abanye, ethanda amandla o nokuba yinkqubo ekhethekileyo ngokulandelwa kwemithetho neemvumile ezidityaniswa noNyango nezempilo eNgoweni. UQatso ekuqeqeshweni nasekuphandweni ngokuzama ukwandisa inzuzo yolwazi kwindawo eNgqondo ekhethekileyo. Zise iinkqubo, amanyango, amagqabantshi_phambili namagqabantshi_phambili okulinganisa ulwazi olumandla kumanyango weNyanga. Gcina amagqabantshi_phambili okusebenza nokusebenzisana okwakhiwe nabaNyango nabalawuli abanye. Lawula uzibe ngokuchitheka kwemali ngokuphatha ulawulo nokuhlawulela imisebenzi kubantu, iimali, namaphakamiso. Phatha iinkqubo zokumelwa nezigaba zemibuzo ngokubandakanya ukuqwalasela nokulawula ukungalikhanga kwemisebenzi ngokwemigaqo nengincwadi ezikiweyo. Gcina ukukhula ngobuGqirha /amagqabantshi_phambili abalungileyo nokuphuhliswa kolwazi ngokuphanda iimfuno, ukwenza nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuphatha nokuQeqesha, nokugcina ukusebenza kwayo. Qatsha ekuqwalaselweni ngokuQaliswa kwamandla e-EPMDS. Qatsha ekuQalisweni kwamandla okuthuthuzisa izempilo nokuthintela ukugula ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Audiology
jobs.salary_text: R664 410 per annum. Other benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Audiology at Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, requiring an Audiology degree, HPCSA registration and 8 years' experience including 5 in management.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent. Diploma / Degree as an Audiologist. A minimum of 8 years’ experience after registration as an Audiologist of which 5 years must be appropriate experience in Management. Current registration with HPCSA as an Audiologist. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Sound knowledge of clinical and patient managements skills within the discipline. Ability to assess, diagnose and manage patients. Good communication skills. Sound ethical practice skills. Knowledge of data verification procedure and budgeting.
jobs.duties: Represent the department on various meetings including cashflow. Monthly in- service training for Audiologists and Community Service staff. Development, implementation and supervision of quality improvement programmes within the Audiology department. Development & implementation of protocols and guidelines in line with local and international standards and best practice. Provide continuous professional development. Monitor and control all expenditure in the department. Conduct employee performance and development system. Cover the day-to-day management, administration and supervising of clinical services. Ensure that audiology services comply with health, safety and IPC regulations.
jobs.enquiries: Dr. Z.D Adonis Tel No: (039) 688 6044 or Dr. M.L Jona Tel No: (039) 688 6184
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone 4240. NB: Applicants are encouraged to utilise courier services/ S’THESHA WAYA WAYA or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications. Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. (Copies should be submitted by shortlisted candidates only). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (Ethical Conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Audiologie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Audiologie by Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, wat 'n Audiologie-graad, HPCSA-registrasie en 8 jaar se ervaring waarvan 5 in bestuur, vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of gelykwaardig. Diploma / Graad as 'n Audioloog. 'n Minimum van 8 jaar se ervaring na registrasie as 'n Audioloog waarvan 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Bestuur moet wees. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Audioloog. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van kliniese en pasiëntbestuursvaardighede binne die dissipline. Vermoë om pasiënte te assesseer, te diagnoseer en te bestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike etiese praktykvaardighede. Kennis van dataverifikasieprosedure en begroting.
af.duties: Verteenwoordig die departement op verskeie vergaderings insluitend kontantvloei. Maandelikse indiensopleiding vir Audioloë en Gemeenskapsdienspersoneel. Ontwikkeling, implementering en toesig gehalteverbeteringsprogramme binne die Audiologie-departement. Ontwikkeling en implementering van protokolle en riglyne in ooreenstemming met plaaslike en internasionale standaarde en beste praktyk. Verskaf deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Monitor en beheer alle uitgawes in die departement. Voer werknemerprestasie- en ontwikkelingstelsel uit. Behartig die dag-tot-dag bestuur, administrasie en toesig van kliniese dienste. Verseker dat audiologiese dienste aan gesondheids-, veiligheids- en IPC-regulasies voldoen.

zu.title: I-Assistant Director: i-Audiology
zu.summary: I-Assistant Director: i-Audiology ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, idinga i-degree ye-Audiology, ukuqanjwa igama kwa-HPCSA neminyaka engu-8 yemisebenzi okubandakanya eminyakeni eyi-5 ekuphathweni.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / i-Matric noma okulingana nayo. I-Diploma / I-Degree njengoma-Audiologist. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-8 yemisebenzi ngemva kokuqanjwa igama njengoma-Audiologist, okuyilapho eminyakeni eyi-5 kumele ibe yimisebenzi ehambisana nokuphatha. Ukuqanjwa igama okusebekho ne-HPCSA njengoma-Audiologist. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi olunamandla lwamakhono okuphatha iziguli kanye namakhono ohlelo lwemikhoboyise ngaphakathi kwale nkambiso. Ikhono lokuhlola, ukuxiluma nokuphatha iziguli. Amakhano mahle okuxhumana. Amakhono amahle enkolo yesintu. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokufanisa imininingwane kanye nokwenza ihesimali.
zu.duties: Mebula umnyango emihlanganweni ehlukene okubandakanya ukuphatha imali ehamba. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngenkathi yenyanga kwa-Audiologists nabasebenzi bezebenzi komphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa nokuphequlula izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga ngaphakathi kumnyango we-Audiology. Ukuthuthukisa nokuqeqesha amaphrotokholu nemihlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nemigidingo yaseduze nangeyasemhlaba kanye nenkonzo eyingqayizive. Ukunikeza ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komsebenzi wekhono. Ukuqapha noku lawula yonke imali echithwa kumnyango. Ukwenza isistimu yokuhlolwa nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuqhuba ngokusuku nosuku ukuphatha, ukulawula nokuqapha izinsiza zezokwelapha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ze-audiology zihambisana nemithetho yezenempilo, yokuphephakaliswa kanye ne-IPC.

xh.title: Usikhokheli Oncedwayo: I-Audiology
xh.summary: Usikhokheli Oncedwayo: I-Audiology ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, kufuneka kubekho inqaku le-Audiology, ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kunye namava emyanga engama-8 aquka iminyaka eyi-5 kulawulo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Matric okanye efanayo. Isatifikethi / Inqaku njengomGcini-wezindle. Uncedo lwamava amnyange aqala kwamava angama-8 emva kokubhalisa njengomGcini-wezindle apho iminyaka emi-5 kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo kuLawulo. Ukubhalisa kwangoku ku-HPCSA njengomGcini-wezindle. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namandla aFunekayo: Ulwazi oluzinzileyo lwamandla okulawula iziguli kunye nezingcali kule ndlela. Amandla okuqonda, ukuvakalisisa nokulawula iziguli. Amandla amaxa ibali alungileyo. Amandla okuziphatha ngokuthe ngqo. Ulwazi ngendlelaokuqinisekisa i-data kunye nokuqwalasela ibhajethi.
xh.duties: Zimele isebe kwiindibano ezahlukeneyo eziquka i-cashflow. Uqeqesho lokwenzela ngaphakathi kwinyanga labaGcini-bezindle kunye nabasebenzi baseNkonzo yeNxweme. Ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho ngaphakathi kwesebe le-Audiology. Ukuphuhliswa & ukusebenzisa iiprotocol kunye nezikhokelo ngokwemigaqo yendawo namazwe ngamazwe nendlelaengcono yokwenza. Unika uqeqesho oluchasiweyo lwamandla. Qaphela lolawula yonke imali echiywa kwisebe. Qhuba inkqubo yokuqwalasela namandla abasebenzi. Gquma ukulawula usuku nanosuku, ukulawula and nokulawula iinkonzo zeziguli. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo ze-audiology zihambelana nemigaqo yeza, lokhuseleko kunye ne-IPC.

jobs.title: Ultra-sonographer
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1 R510 906 – R581 892 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 – R683 808 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 – R756 444 per annum Other benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Rural Allowance and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Ultra-sonographer position at Dannhauser CHC in KwaZulu-Natal requiring an ultrasound diploma, HPCSA registration and offering salaries across three grades.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Senior Certificate. Degree/ National Diploma in Ultrasound. Current registration with HPCSA as Sonographer. Grade 1: Experience: No experience after registration with the Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employee who performed Community Service as required in South Africa. 1-year relevant experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration with HPCSA as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed community Service. 11 years’ experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees. Grade 3: Experience: A minimum of 20 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration with HPCSA as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Service. 21 years’ experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies required for the post: Sound knowledge of Obstetrics and Gynaecology ultrasound. Sound knowledge of general ultrasound scans. Sound knowledge of Ultrasound procedures. Knowledge of relevant Health and Safety policies, regulations and acts. Sound report writing and administrative skills. Knowledge of Quality Assurance procedure and methods. Sound communication, interpersonal, problem solving, teaching and training skills. Good interpersonal relations and ability to perform with a team. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide high quality ultrasound services consistent with scope of practice and clinical standards. Provide high quality ultrasound services according to the patient’s needs. To promote good health practices and ensure optimal patient care. Execute all ultrasound procedure completely to prevent complications. Provide general administrative duties as required. Provide guidance and supervision to junior staff. Participate in multidisciplinary team as part of medical and allied team. Participate in institutional radiographic policy making and planning for service delivery. Promote Batho Pele Principles in the execution of all duties for effective service delivery. Give factual information to patients and clients on ultrasound examinations. Participate in departmental Quality Assurance, Quality Improvement Programmes and National Core Standards. Inspect and utilize equipment professionally to ensure that they comply with safety standards. Develop protocols to ensure that sonographic services comply with the required prescripts. Participate in ultrasound quality assurance programmes. Participate in Continued Professional Development (CPD) programmes. Compile report and memos as required in the working environment. Assist with ultrasound patient booking. Perform other duties as per delegation by radiography management.
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to Assistant Director: HRM; KZN: Department of Health; Hand delivery to: Dannhauser Community Health Centre; No 7 Durnacol Road; Dannhauser: 3080. Email Address: DannhauserCHC.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mrs DBP Buthelezi
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed application for employment form (Z83-fully completed) and Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents and proof of current registration with the respective council on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Reference Number must be indicated in the column (Part A) provided thereof on the Z83 form. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. Faxed applications will NOT be accepted. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records and citizenship, verification of educational qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Preference will be given to African Male

af.title: Ultra-sonograaf
af.summary: Ultra-sonograafpos by Dannhauser CHC in KwaZulu-Natal wat 'n ultraklankdiploma, HPCSA-registrasie vereis en salarisse oor drie grade aanbied.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat. Graad/ Nasionale Diploma in Ultraklank. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as Sonograaf. Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen ervaring na registrasie by die Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, verrig het nie. 1 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het. 11 jaar ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Graad 3: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het. 21 jaar ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, te verrig nie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede wat vir die pos vereis word: Deeglike kennis van Verloskunde en Ginekologie-ultraklank. Deeglike kennis van algemene ultraklankskanderings. Deeglike kennis van ultraklankprosedures. Kennis van relevante Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeleid, regulasies en wette. Deeglike verslagskryf- en administratiewe vaardighede. Kennis van Kwaliteitsversekeringsprosedure en -metodes. Deeglike kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossings-, onderrig- en opleidingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en vermoë om in 'n span te funksioneer. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf hoë gehalte ultraklankdienste in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en kliniese standaarde. Verskaf hoë gehalte ultraklankdienste volgens die pasiënt se behoeftes. Bevorder goeie gesondheidspraktyke en verseker optimale pasiëntsorg. Voer alle ultraklankprosedures volledig uit om komplikasies te voorkom. Voer algemene administratiewe pligte soos vereis uit. Verskaf leiding en toesig aan junior personeel. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre span as deel van mediese en verwante span. Neem deel aan institusionele radiografiese beleidsbepaling en beplanning vir dienslewering. Bevorder Batho Pele-beginsels by die uitvoering van alle pligte vir effektiewe dienslewering. Verskaf feitelike inligting aan pasiënte en kliënte oor ultraklankondersoeke. Neem deel aan departementele Kwaliteitsversekering, Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme en Nasionale Kerntandaarde. Inspekteer en benut toerusting professioneel om te verseker dat dit aan veiligheidsstandaarde voldoen. Ontwikkel protokolle om te verseker dat sonografiedienste aan die voorgeskrewe voorskrifte voldoen. Neem deel aan ultraklank-kwaliteitsversekeringsprogramme. Neem deel aan Volgehoue Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD)-programme. Stel verslae en memo's soos in die werksomgewing vereis op. Bied hulp met ultraklank-pasiëntbesprekings. Voer ander pligte volgens afbakening deur radiografiebestuur uit.

zu.title: I-Ultra-sonographer
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumqasheli wokuhlola ngomsindo (ultra-sonographer) e-Dannhauser CHC e-KwaZulu-Natal esidinga i-diploma yokuhlola ngomsindo, ukubhalwa ne-HPCSA futhi sinikeza amaholo kumazinga amathatu.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ Isitifikedi samabanga aphezulu. I-Degree/ i-National Diploma kwi-Ultrasound. Ukwemikelwa okwamanje ne-HPCSA njengoSonographer. I-Grade 1: Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni emva kokubhalwa ne-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo-ultra-sonographer mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe e-RSA owenze i-Community Service njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni sonyaka unyaka owodwa emva kokubhalwa ne-HPCSA mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe kwamanye amazwe. I-Grade 2: Isipiliyoni: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-10 isipiliyoni esifanele/ esingabonakalayo emva kokubhalwa ne-HPCSA njengo-ultra-sonographer mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe e-RSA owenze i-Community Service. Isipiliyoni seminyaka engu-11 emva kokubhalwa ne-HPCSA mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe kwamanye amazwe. I-Grade 3: Isipiliyoni: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-20 isipiliyoni esifanele/ esingabonakalayo emva kokubhalwa ne-HPCSA njengo-ultra-sonographer mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe e-RSA owenze i-Community Service. Isipiliyoni seminyaka engu-21 emva kokubhalwa ne-HPCSA mayelana nomsebenzisi ogqoqwe kwamanye amazwe okungalindelek ukuthi enze i-Community Service njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namandla adingekayo kuleso sikhundla: Ulwazi olukhulu lokuhlola ngomsindo kwezokuqala ukuya kwezokuqumisa indodana. Ulwazi olukhulu mayelana nokuqashelwa ngomsindo okujwayelekile. Ulwazi olukhulu mayelana nezinqubo zokuqashelwa ngomsindo. Ulwazi mayelana nemigomo, imithetho nemithethonqubo ephathelene nezempilo nokuphepha. Amakhono okubhala imibiko nobulungiswa ahamba kahle. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo nezindlela zokuqinisekiswa kokulingana. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, okuxazulula izinkinga, okufundisa nokuphatha ahamba kahle. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu kanye nethuba lokusebenza eqenjini. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi yokuhlola ngomsindo (ultrasound) ehamba kakhulu ngokwezinga elihambisana nomkhakha wokusebenza nemigomo yezokwelapha. Nikela ngemisebenzi yokuhlola ngomsindo ehamba kakhulu ngokwezidingo zomuntu ofuna usizo. Ukukhuthaza izindlela ezinhle zempilo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhamba kahle kweziguli. Qedela yonke inqubo yokuhlola ngomsindo ngokuphelele ukuze kugqamwe izinkinga. Nikela ngemisebenzi yezobulungiswa ejwayelekile njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza isiqondiso futhi uhlole abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Zibandakanye eqenjini elinamakhono ahlukahlukene njengengxenye yeqembu lezokwelapha nezokunakekelwa. Zibandakanye ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zesikhungo mayelana nokushintshwa kwezithombe kanye nokuhlela ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Khuthaza Iimiso zeBatho Pele ekwenzeni wonke umsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo okusebenzayo. Nikeza ulwazi olufanele iziguli namakhasimayedu mayelana nokuqashelwa ngomsindo. Zibandakanye kwenza imiqulu yezikhungo mayelana nokuqinisekiswa kokulingana, Amaphulo Okuthuthukisa Izinga kanye Nemigomo Yezizwe Esiyisisekelo. Hlola futhi usebenzise izinsiza ngobungcweti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihambisana nemigomo yokuphepha. Buthula imigomo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkonzo zokuhlola ngomsindo zihambisana nemiyalo edingekayo. Zibandakanye kumaphulo okuqinisekiswa kweninga lokuhlolwa ngomsindo. Zibandakanye kumaphulo e-Continued Professional Development (CPD). Hlela imibiko namamu njengoba kudingeka endaweni yokusebenza. Siza ngokubhukuda iziguli ezingahlolwa ngomsindo. Yenza omunye umsebenzi njengoba kunikezwe ababalusi bezokushintshwa kwezithombe.

xh.title: Umhekantlofuzo-msizi
xh.summary: Isithuba somhekantlofuzo-msizi kwi-Dannhauser CHC kwi-KwaZulu-Natal esifuna idiploma yokuqhwesha unyuso, ukuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA kwaye inika imivuzo kwizigaba ezintathu.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-Grade 12/ ePhakamileyo. I-Degree/ i-National Diploma kwi-Ultrasound. Ukuqinisekiswa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengakaSonographer. I-Grade 1: Isiphaluka: Akukho siphaluka emva kokuqinisekiswa ngomhlathi wezempilo waseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomhekantlofuzo-msizi malunga nomsebenzisi oqeqeshiweyo kwi-RSA othe wenza iNkonzo yoLuntu njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Isiphaluka seminyaka el-1 ngokufanelekayo emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzisi bagangeyo abaqeqeshiweyo. I-Grade 2: Isiphaluka: Amava amncinci aneminyaka eli-10 efanelekileyo/ evakalayo emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengomhekantlofuzo-msizi malunga nabasebenzisi baqeqeshiweyo kwi-RSA abo beze benze iNkonzo yoLuntu. Amava eminyaka elishumi elinanye emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzisi bagangeyo abaqeqeshiweyo. I-Grade 3: Isiphaluka: Amava amncinci aneminyaka angama-20 afanelekileyo/ evakalayo emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengomhekantlofuzo-msizi malunga nabasebenzisi baqeqeshiweyo kwi-RSA abo beze benze iNkonzo yoLuntu. Amava eminyaka engama-21 emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzisi bagangeyo abaqeqeshiweyo abangekufuneki benze iNkonzo yoLuntu njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo kwisithuba: Ulwazi olunzulu lokulungiselwa kwezokusika unyuso kwezokuqaliswa komzimba kunye neyabasetyhini. Ulwazi olunzulu ngemifanekiso yokuqhwesha unyuso jikelele. Ulwazi olunzulu ngeendlela zokuqhwesha unyuso. Ulwazi ngeendlebo zokuqhoboshwa koluntu namagunya ahambelana nempilo, imithetho nemithethweni. Amakhono anzulu okubhala iingxelo kunye nokulawula izinto. Ulwazi ngeendlela ngezinyathelo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho. Amakhono anzulu okunxibelelana nabantu, okusombulula iingxaki, okufundisa nokuqeqesha. Ibanga elilodwa lokunxibelelana nabantu nendlela yokusebenza ngaphakathi kwqembu. Ukwazi ukusebenza nekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngeenkonzo zokuqhwesha unyuso ezinomgangatho ophezahu ezihambelana nolulinganiselo lomsebenzi kunye nemilinganiselo yezempilo. Kubonelele ngeenkonzo zokuqhwesha unyuso ezinomgangatho ophezemu ngokweemfuno zomguli. Ukukhuthaza iindlela ezilulo zempilo kwaye uqinisekise ukhatho olululo lomguli. Kubonelela ngokuqhathwa nokulawula abasebenzisi abasezantsi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwqembu elinabochwepheshe abahlukeneyo njengenxalenye yeqembu lezempilo kunye neyamakhono ahlobene. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo nokucazulwa iplani zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Unike iingcali zonxibelelwano ezenzinyanisekileyo kumaguli nakumaxhasi ngeenkcukacha zokuqhwesha unyuso. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwindlela yolawulo ngokwemigaqo ye-radiography yoluntu nakuqwalasela iplani yokuphothulwa kweenkonzo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-Quality Assurance yesebe, nakwikqubo ze-Quality Improvement kwiSebe kunye nemiGaqo yeZiko eNtloko yeNtango. Ukukhangela nokusebenzisa izixhobo ngobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzalathiseka kwemigaqo yokhuseleko lweemveliso. Ukuqamba iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzalathiseka kweekonzo zokuqhwesha unyuso ngokwemigaqo efunekayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho lokuqhwesha unyuso. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuqhubeka nokuphucula ulwazi lweminyaka (CPD). Ukwenza iingxelo namamemo njengoko kufuneka kwindalo yokusebenza. Ukuncedisa kogcino lwesicelo sabomguli kwiinkqubo zokuqhwesha unyuso. Ukwenza eminye imisebenzi njengoko kuchaziwe ngurhulumente we-radiography.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum Plus 13th cheque, Housing Allowance (employees must meet the prescribed requirement), medical Aid Optional
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed for the critical care unit at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, requiring a postgraduate qualification in critical care nursing and at least four years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Degree/Diploma in General Nursing that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. 1 Year post basic/post graduate qualification in Clinical Nursing Science (Critical Care). Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience as a General Nurse. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the speciality after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in the relevant speciality. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients’ rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem- solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring objectives of the critical care unit. Provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public. Demonstrate effective communication to patients, families, multidisciplinary team members and other stakeholders within the hospital. Ensure that high- quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing the critical nursing care services at Grey’s Hospital. Ensure effective and efficient utilisation and supervision of resources. Coordinate the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at improving critical care nursing. Instill discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Ensure compliance with quality, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain constructive working relationships with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management within the unit.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F.S. Matibela- Nursing Manager Tel No: (033) 897 3331
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources). The employment equity target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, White Male, White Female.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige word benodig vir die kritiese sorgeenheid by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, wat 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie in kritiese sorgverpleging en ten minste vier jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleging wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 1 Jaar na-basiese/nagraadse kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde (Kritiese Sorg). Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC-kwitansie). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die een jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in die betrokke spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute, en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele-beginsels, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, dissiplinêre kodes en prosedures, grieweprosedure, finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende die tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en instelling se beleidsraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Help met beplanning/organisering en monitering van doelwitte van die kritiese sorgeenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie aan pasiënte, families, multidissiplinêre spanlede en ander belanghebbendes binne die hospitaal. Verseker dat hoëgehalte verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat die kritiese verpleegsorgdienste by Grey's Hospital besoek, verskaf word. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting en toesig oor hulpbronne. Koördineer die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met die fokus op programme wat gemik is op die verbetering van kritiese sorgverpleging. Instill dissipline, professionaliteit en werketiek onder werknemers. Verseker nakoming van gehalte-, infeksievoorkoming- en beheerprogramme (IPC), bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S). Onderhou konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste, bv. help met verpligtingspligte aan verpleegbestuur binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi oPhumelelayo Ekhono Elikhethekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhlengikazi ophumelelayo oselecelweni sokunakekelwa okubalulekile esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital e-Pietermaritzburg, ofuna iziqu zesiqu esiphezulu ekuholenweni kokunakekelwa okubalulekile nobuhle bokulinga iminyaka engancane kuneyane.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12. I-Degree/Diploma ekuholenweni jikelele evumela ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengomhlengikazi ophumelelayo. Isiqu se-1 Year post basic/post graduate kwi-Clinical Nursing Science (Critical Care). Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yokulinga okufanele/okuhlonishwayo ekuholenweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ophumelelayo ne-SANC ekuholenweni jikelele. I-Grade 1: Okuhlangenwe nakho: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yokulinga okufanele/okuhlonishwayo njengomhlengikazi jikelele. I-Grade 2: Okuhlangenwe nakho: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-14 yokulinga okufanele/okuhlonishwayo ekuholenweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ophumelelayo ne-SANC ekuholenweni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kibe ukulinga okufanele/okuhlonishwayo ekhono elikhethekile emva kokuthola isiqu semnyaka eyi-1 post basic ekhweneni elihlotshaniswayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nemiyalo yokunakekelwa kokuholwa, izitatimende zokuholwa, nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlotshaniswayo ezinjengalezi: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Ulwazi lwezimali namabhajethi mayelana nezinsiza ezikuphathi. Ukuqonda imikhuba namapholisi ahlotshaniswe nokunakekelwa kokuholwa. Amandla okuba ngumholi, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomkhakha kazwelonke nesakhiwo samapholisi esikhungo. Amakhano okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga namakhono okweluleka. Amakhano othibhidi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisisekelo.
zu.duties: Siza ekwenzeni uhlelo/okuhlela nokuqaphela izinhloso zeseleceli sokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Nikeza indawo yokuqasha abasebenzi, abagulayo nomphakathi. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubagulayo, kumapho, kolunye uchungechunge lwamakhasimede nasabanye abahlanganyeli ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kokuholwa okwenyiwe kahle kunikwa bonke abathengi bafinyelela kwinzinkalo zokuholwa kokunakekelwa okubalulekile e-Grey's Hospital. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokuhle okwezinsiza nokuqapha. Hlelela ukunikezwa kokuqeqeshwa okusebenzayo nokuqeqesha, ukugxila kuzinhlelo ezihlose ukuthuthukisa ukuhola kokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Faka isiyalwaliqiniso, ubungcweti nezimiso zomsebenzi phakathi kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izinga, izinhlelo zokuvimbela ukuthelelelana nokulawula (IPC), njeng. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kanye Ne-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina ubudlelwano bokusebenza okwakha ngokwakho lalabo abakulunye uchungechunge lwamakhasimede. Nikeza ukwesekwa okusebenzayo kwinzinkalo zokuholwa, njeng. ukusiza nemisebenzi yokuqeqesha ekuphathweni kokuholwa ngaphakathi kwesele.

xh.title: Umongikazi ochungaphezulu owahlulelweyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho umongikazi ochungaphezulu kwiqumrhu lokunyanga iimeko ezibuthathaka e Grey's Hospital e Pietermaritzburg, kwaye kufuneka abe nesidanga samabanga aphezulu ekufundela ukunyanga iimeko ezibuthathaka kwaye abe nohlobo lokusebenza olungeni unyaka ubuncinane.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12. Isidanga/Isidanga ezincinci ekunyanga ngokubanzi esivumela ukubhalisa kwi SANC njengomongikazi ochungaphezulu. Isidanga seminyaka elingu-1 samabanga aphezulu/emaphezulu kwisoNcitho senzululwazi sokuNyangwa kwezeMpilo yaseKliniki (iimeko ezibuthathaka). Ukubhalisa okusekunjalo kwi South African Nursing Council (isirhafu ye SANC ka-2026). Uhlobo lokusebenza olufanelekileyo/olusaziwayo onyaka ubuncinane abango-4 ekunyangeni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ochungaphezulu kwi SANC ekunyangenweni ngokubanzi. Inqanaba 1: Uhlobo lokusebenza: Uhlobo lokusebenza olufanelekileyo/olusaziwayo onyaka ubuncinane abango-4 njengomongikazi ongugqirha. Inqanaba 2: Uhlobo lokusebenza: Uhlobo lokusebenza olufanelekileyo/olusaziwayo kwinkqubo yokunyanga unyaka ubuncinane abango-14 emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ochungaphezulu kwi SANC ekunyangweni ngokubanzi. Ubuncinane iminyaka elingu-10 kuloo minyaka kuthe ngasentla kufuneka ibe yuhlobo lokusebenza olufanelekileyo/olusaziwayo kweso sifundo emva kokuqeqeshwa okwonyaka owodwa ngaphezulu kweso sifundo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaNgcwalise anokuFuna: Ulwazi ngakunyani kunyanga iinkqubo neenkqubo, izinto ezithile ezingumthetho wokunyanga, nezinye iinkqubo ezithile zomthetho ezinjenge: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Batho Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Ulwazi lwezimali nezemali ngakunyani kumithombo ehambelana nalawo uphatha. Ukuqonda iinkqubo namapholisi ahambelana nonyango. Amandla okukhokela, ukuqamba, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yomthetho wabasebenzi basemthethweni nongqamano wenqanaba lesikhongozeli. Amakhono okuhamba nabantu kuquka imikhobo yentatho-nxaxheka nemizila yoluntu, ukuxoxisana ngeenkxalabo, ukusingathwa kweenkcadi nokuqonda iingxaki. Amakhono okusebenza isikhangela-manani kumanqaku abalulekileyo.
xh.duties: Uncedile ekwaziseni/ukuqamba kwaye alawule iinjongo zequmrhu lokunyanga iimeko ezibuthathaka. Ukubonelela isihlalo esinokusonyeza kubasebenzi, kubaguli nakuluntu. Ukubonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kubaguli, kumaphaphu, kwabasebenzi basequmrhu eliqulunqwe ngokwemimiselo yamanye amaphaphu nakulabo benza umthetho ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba unyango lwezempilo lwakanobomi olusemgangathweni ophezulu lunikelwa kwabo bonke abaxhasi abangenayo iinkonzo zokunyanga ezingozayo ezibuthathaka e Grey's Hospital. Kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nangexesho kwaye kulawulwe imithobo engcono. Ukulawula ukubonelelwa kwexesha elisebenzayo ngezifundo nokuphonononga, ukusuka kumanqaku abalulekileyo okuzama ukuphucula ukunyanga iimeko ezibuthathaka. Ukufaka urhwebo, ubuzigqangqa namaziko abasebenzi ngokomthetho wokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi. Ukuqinisekiswa ngokusetyenziswa kokusebenza ngomgangatho, iinkqubo zokuthintela kwaye kulawulwe iimeko zokudlula kunyando (IPC), umzekelo Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kunye ne Norms and Standards (N&S). Ukuzisa amava amacaba ngakunyani equmrhu lokusebenza nabasebenzi basequmrhu eliqulunqwe ngokwemimiselo yamanye amaphaphu. Ukubonelela inkxaso olusebenzayo eNkonzo zokuNyangwa, umzekelo ukunceda ngemisebenzi yokunceda ekulawulweni kokunyanga ngaphakathi kwale qumrhu.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty- Child Nursing Science

Ensure that high- quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing the Paediatric nursing care services at Grey’s Hospital. Ensure effective and efficient utilisation and supervision of resources. Coordinate the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at improving paediatric nursing care. Instill discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Ensure compliance with quality, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain constructive working relationships with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management within the unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit- Kinderverpleegkunde
af.summary: Die Department of Health in KwaZulu-Natal soek 'n professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in kinderverpleegkunde by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 1 Jaar postbasiese/postgraduose kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde (Kinderverpleegkunde). Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC-kwitansie). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die eenjarige postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele-beginsels, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, dissiplinêre kodes en prosedures, klagteprosedure, finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot die tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en instellingsbeleidraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die beplanning/organisasie en monitering van doelwitte van die Pediatriese eenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie aan pasiënte, families, multidissiplinêre spanlede en ander belanghebbendes binne die hospitaal. Verseker dat hoë gehalte verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat toegang tot die Pediatriese verpleegsorgdienste by Grey's Hospital verkry, verleen word. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting en toesig oor hulpbronne. Koördineer die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met die fokus op programme wat daarop gemik is om pediatriese verpleegsorg te verbeter. Kweek dissipline, professionaliteit en werk-etiek onder werknemers. Verseker nakoming van gehalte-, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IVB)-programme, bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S). Onderhou konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste, bv. help met verligtingspligte aan verpleegbestuur binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ochwepheshe - Isayensi Yokunakeka Abantwana
zu.summary: I-Department of Health e-KwaZulu-Natal ifuna umhlengikazi ochwepheshe ohlose ukunakeka abantwana e-Grey's Hospital e-Pietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Degree/Diploma e-General Nursing evumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe. Isifundo esiyimnyaka esedlule kwesisekelo/esikhundleni sokuthweswa iziqu kwi-Clinical Nursing Science (Child Nursing Science). Ukubhalisa njengamanje kwi-South African Nursing Council (isirhivisi se-2026 SANC). Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlonishwayo lokunakeka emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ku-General Nursing. I-Grade 1: Uholo: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlonishwayo njengomhlengikazi jikelele. I-Grade 2: Uholo: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlonishwayo lokunakeka emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ku-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 enkathi ekhunjulwe ngenhla kumele ibe yiluvo oluhambisana/oluhlonishwayo kwesikhundla esithize emva kokuthola isifundo esiyimnyaka esedlule kwesisekelo kwesikhundla esihambisana naleso. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa namakhono abekwe ngaphambila: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nemigomo yokunakeka, izimitsethu yokunakeka, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana nalokhu njengoku: i-Nursing act, i-Occupational health and safety act, i-Patients' rights charter, izimiso ze-Bathe Pele, izimiso zomsebenzi kahulumeni, i-Labor relations act, amakhodi nemikhuba yesigwegqesigwe, umkhuba wokuphathwa kwezinkinga, nolwazi lwezimali nomgcinamafa ngokuphathwa kwesibambolelo. Ukuqonda imikhuba nemigobo ezama ukunakekela. Amandla okuhola, lokuhlelela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwegadi yomthetho wesekthari kahulumeni nesezikhungo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezingxabano kanye namakhono okweluleka. Amakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha kumuhlela okuyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Siza ekuhleleni/ukuhleleleni kanye nokuqondanisa izinhloso zedolobha labantwana. Nikeza isimo sokwelashwa kubasebenzi, iziguli nomphakathi. Khombisa ukuxhumana ngokusebenzayo kuziguli, kumaphakathi, kwabasebenzi beqembu elihlangene nakwezinye izinhlaka esibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa ukunakeka kwekhwalithi ephezulu kuyo yonke imikhakha efikelela kumasevisi okunakekelwa kwabantwana e-Grey's Hospital. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqondanisa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwesibambolelo. Hlelela ukunikezwa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqashwa okusebenzayo, ukugxila kumuhlela ojwayele ukuphucula ukunakekelwa kwabantwana. Faka isigwegwe, ubuchwepheshe kanye nezindlela zokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuzigqiza ngekhwalithi, ukuvikelwa ukutheleleka nokulawula izinhlela (IPC), njengakwi-Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kanye nama-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina ubudlelwano bokusebenza obwakha iqembu elihlangene. Nikeza ukusekelwa okusebenzayo kumasevisi okunakekela, njengokulekelela emisebenzini yokukhululeka ekuphathweni kokunakekelwa ngaphakathi kwebhodi.

xh.title: Unongqishi Ophantsi Onegunya Esikweni- ISayensi Yokunonga Abantwana
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eKwaZulu-Natal lifuna unongqishi ophantsi onegunya ongamkhethekanga kwisayensi yokunonga abantwana e Grey's Hospital e Pietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seMatriki. IDigri/IDiploma kwiNongqishi jikelele evumela ukubhalisa kwi SANC njengongqishi ophantsi onegunya. Isifundo seminyaka eli-1 kamva kwesiseko/ikamva lekholejji kwiSayensi Yonongqishi lokwelapha (ISayensi Yokunonga Abantwana). Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwiBhungo leNongqishi lakwaMzantsi Afrika (2026 SANC receipt). Amava amabalulekekileyo/amakuqatyelwayo angaphezu kweminyaka emi-4 kwiNongqishi emva kokubhalisa njengongqishi ophantsi onegunya kwi SANC kwiNongqishi jikelele. Inqanaba 1: Amava: Amava amabalulekekileyo/amakuqatyelwayo angaphezu kweminyaka emi-4 njengongqishi jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Amava: Amava amabalulekekileyo/amakuqatyelwayo angaphezu kweminyaka eli-14 kunongqishi emva kokubhalisa njengongqishi ophantsi onegunya kwi SANC kwiNongqishi jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eli-10 yexesha elibalwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava amabalulekekileyo/amakuqatyelwayo kwelongoqamkhetheko emva kokufumana isifundo sonyaka omnye kamva kwesiseko kwelongoqamkhetheko ekufaneleyo. Ulwazi, Amaxabiso, uQeqesho namakhono Afunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nenkqubo yonongqishi, imithetho yonongqishi, nakwezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezibalulekileyo ezinjenge: Umthetho weNongqishi, umthetho woMpilo woMsebenzi nokuKhusuleka, ibhodi yamalungelo abagulayo, iimigaqo yeBatho Pele, iimigaqo zomsebenzi womntu wonke, umthetho weQabunzima, iikhowudi nenkqubo zolawulo, inkqubo yokuvezwa iingxaki, nolwazi lwezimali neyebhajeti malunga namaphakha abalulekileyo aphantsi kolawulo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo neenkqabo ezithinta ukunonga kwabagulayo. Amaxabiso obuqhawe, ebungcalo, okuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yommandla womsebenzi womntu wonke nongqopheleleko besebe. Amaxabiso obudlelwane nababantu kuquka izithethi zikawonke-wonke, iindlela zoxoxo, ukupatha iingxabano kwaye uncedise ngokweluleka. Amaxabiso ekhompyutha kwinkqubo esisiseko.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuqwenzeni/ulungiseni nokuqwalasela iinjongo zeYuniti yabantwana. Qinisekisa indawo yokuphola abasebenzini, abagulayo nakawonke-wonke. Bonisa ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo kubagulayo, oosapho, amalungu eqela elisebenza ngokwahlukahlukana nakwezinye iindidi kwlisibhedlele. Qinisekisa ukuba kunongqishi olulinganiselweyo nolusemgangathweni ophezulu lwenziwa kubo bonke abakhangelayo iinkonzo zonongqishi lwabantwana e Grey's Hospital. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kolawulo ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo kwamaphakha. Lungisa ubuncwadi bokunika uqeqesho nophando olusebenzayo, elijoliswe kwiinkqubo ezijolise ekuphuculeni ukunonga kwabantwana. Faka isithunzi sobuzwere nobusebenziseki nendlela yomsebenzi phakathi kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukutshatyiswa kweemigaqo yomgangatho, yokuthintela ukutshatyalaliswa kolwazi kwaye ulawule iinkqubo, njenge-Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) ne-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obwakha ngokwakho namalungu eqela elisebenza ngokwahlukahlukana. Nika inkxaso ngokusebenzayo kwiinkonzo zonongqishi, njengokunceda kumisebenzi yesikhululo kulawulo lonongqishi ngaphakathi kweyuniti.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty- Advanced Midwife
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum Plus 13th cheque, Housing Allowance (employees must meet the prescribed requirement), medical Aid Optional
jobs.summary: Advanced midwife professional nurse sought at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg to reduce maternal and infant mortality and provide quality maternal nursing care.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Degree/Diploma in General Nursing that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. 1 Year post basic/post graduate qualification in Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (Advanced Midwifery). Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience as a General Nurse. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the speciality after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in the relevant speciality. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients’ rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem- solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Implement the activities that are aimed at the reduction of infant, under-five, and maternal mortality. Implement activities aimed at the improvement of women’s health. Ensure that high-quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing maternal services in the facility, taking into consideration that CARMA objectives, ESMOE, KINC, Helping Babies Breathe, and IMCI programs are properly implemented. Implement BANC and other Antenatal care programs to enhance antenatal care for all pregnant women accessing care at the facility. Ensure that there is proper management and integration of HAST programs within the maternity unit of the facility. Manage the utilisation and supervision of resources. Coordinate the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at the improvement of maternal and child health. Instill discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Ensure compliance with quality, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain constructive working relationships with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management within the unit

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit- Gevorderde Vroedvrou
af.summary: Gevorderde vroedvrou professionele verpleegkundige gesoek by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg om maternale en zuigelingsterftes te verminder en gehalte maternale verpleegsorg te bied.
af.requirements: Graad 12 Sertifikaat. Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 1 Jaar post basiese/post grade studiekwalifikasie in Vroedkunde en Neonatale Verpleegkunde Wetenskap (Gevorderde Vroedkunde). Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (2026 SANC kwitansie). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesialiteit wees na verowering van die een jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatutes, en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Verpleegwet, Beroeps Gesondheid en Veiligheidswet, Pasiente se regte handves, Batho Pele-beginsels, Openbare diensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Dissiplinêre kodes en prosedures, Klagteprosedure, Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandelings-, konflikhanterings- en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Implementeer die aktiwiteite wat gemik is op die vermindering van zuigeling-, onder-vyf- en maternale sterftes. Implementeer aktiwiteite gemik op die verbetering van vroue se gesondheid. Verseker dat hoë gehalte verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat maternale dienste by die fasiliteit bywoon, gelewer word, met inagneming dat CARMA- doelwitte, ESMOE, KINC, Helping Babies Breathe, en IMCI-programme behoorlik geïmplementeer word. Implementeer BANC en ander voorgeboortelike sorgprogramme om voorgeboortelike sorg vir alle swanger vroue wat sorg by die fasiliteit soek, te verbeter. Verseker dat daar behoorlike bestuur en integrasie van HAST-programme binne die kraameenheid van die fasiliteit is. Bestuur die benutting en toesig van hulpbronne. Koördineer die voorsiening van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met fokus op die programme wat gemik is op die verbetering van maternale en kinder gesondheid. Kweek dissipline, profesionaliteit en werketiek onder werknemers. Verseker nakoming van gehalte-, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IVB-) programme, bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S). Onderhou konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste, bv. help met verligtingspligte aan verpleegbestuur binne die eenheid

zu.title: Unesi Wezinga Eliphezulu Ekheli Ekuhlinzweni- Ubelethisi Ophakeme
zu.summary: Kufunwa unesi webelethisi ozinga eliphezulu esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital e-Pietermaritzburg ukunciphisa ukufa kwabesifazane kanye nezinsana nokunikeza ukunakekelwa kokuhlinza okulingana nobuhle obuphezulu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Degree/Diploma ekuhlinzeni okujwayelekile evumela ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengonesi wezinga eliphezulu. Isifundo seminyaka yoku-1 ngemuva kokweseka/ngemuva kokuqeda ekutholeni izifundo ezibalulekile ekubelethisweni nasemzimbeni wesifo sezinsana ezingakazalwa (Ukubeletha Okuphakeme). Ukubhalisa okwamanje ne-South African Nursing Council (isipeshadi se-2026 SANC). Okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yohlelo oluhambisana/olungabonakalo olwaziwe ekuhlinzeni ngemuva kokubhalisa njengonesi wezinga eliphezulu ne-SANC ekuhlinzeni okujwayelekile. I-Grade 1: Isipiliyoni: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yohlelo oluhambisana/olungabonakalo olwaziwe njengonesi jikelele. I-Grade 2: Isipiliyoni: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-14 yohlelo oluhambisana/olungabonakalo olwaziwe ekuhlinzeni ngemuva kokubhalisa njengonesi wezinga eliphezulu ne-SANC ekuhlinzeni okujwayelekile. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 kule minyaka ekushiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esihambisana/esingabonakalo esiwaziwe ekubhekene naleso sikhulumi ngemuva kokuthola isifundo seminyaka yoku-1 ngemuva kokweseka ohlelweni olubalulekile ekubhekene naleso sikhulumi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nezinqubo zokunakekelwa kunesi, izimiso zokuhlinza, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana nalokho ezinjenge: I-Nursing act, i-Occupational health and safety act, i-Patients' rights charter, izimiso ze-Bathe Pele, izimiso zomphakathi wangaphansi, i-Labor relations act, imikhuba nezinqubo yokuqondisa izindleko, inqubo yezikhalazo, ulwazi lwezimali namabhajethi mayelana namathuluzi ahambisana nokuphathwa. Ukuqonda izinqubo nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nokuhlinza. Ukuba nogunya lokuhola, ukuhlela, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomphakathi nomsakazo wezinqubomgomo zesikhungo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu ohlanganisa ukuhlobana nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga namakhono okweluleka. Amakhono wekhompyutha ohlelweni oluyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Ukuqamba imisebenzi ehlose ukunciphisa ukufa kwabezinsana, abangaphansi kweminyaka eyisihlanu, nabesifazane. Ukuqamba imisebenzi ehlose ukuthuthukisa impilo yabesifazane. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa ukunakekelwa kwakhozela okulingana nobuhle okuphezulu kubo bonke abafuna izinsiza zokuhlinza esikhungweni, ucabange ukuthi imigomo ye-CARMA, i-ESMOE, i-KINC, i-Helping Babies Breathe, namaphrogremu ye-IMCI setshenziswa kahle. jobs.title: Diagnostic Radiographer
jobs.centre: General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid optional and Housing Allowance- Employee must meet prescribed requirements. In-hospitable Allowance 12%. Basic Knowledge of computed tomography (CT) will be an added advantage.
jobs.summary: Diagnostic Radiographer position at General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring HPCSA registration and a qualification in Diagnostic Radiography.
jobs.requirements: Matric (Grade 12) or Senior Certificate. National Diploma / Degree in Diagnostic Radiography. Certificate with the Health Professionals Council of SA (HPCSA). Current Registration practice receipt with HPCSA as a Diagnostic Radiographer (Independent Practice). Grade 1: Experience: No experience required after registration. Grade 2: Experience: A Minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Diagnostic Radiographer after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – Independent Practice. Grade 3: Experience: A Minimum of 20 years appropriate experience as a Diagnostic Radiographer after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – Independent Practice. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies: Sound knowledge of diagnostic radiographic procedures and equipment. Sound knowledge of radiation control and safety. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of relevant Health and Safety Acts.
jobs.duties: Provide high quality diagnostic radiography services. Execute all clinical procedures competently to prevent complications. Provide a 24 hour diagnostic radiography service. Promote good health practices and ensure optimal patient care. Promote Batho Pele principle in the execution of duties for effective service delivery. Perform reception and clerical duties when necessary. Participate in Radiography quality assurance programs. Participate in departmental policies and procedure development. Participate in monthly departmental meetings. Supervision of junior radiography staff and community service radiographers. Perform Employee Performance Management and Development (EPMDS) of junior staff as required.

Graad 3: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar gepaste ervaring as 'n Diagnostiese Radiograaf na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – Onafhanklike Praktyk. af.duties: Verskaf hoëgehalte diagnostiese radiografiedienste. Voer alle kliniese prosedures bevoerd uit om komplikasies te voorkom. Verskaf 'n 24-uur diagnostiese radiografiediens. zu.title: I-Diagnostic Radiographer
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Diagnostic Radiographer esibhedlela i-General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA noma isiqu kwi-Diagnostic Radiography.
zu.requirements: I-Matric (i-Grade 12) noma i-Senior Certificate. I-National Diploma / i-Degree ku-Diagnostic Radiography. Isitifiketi ne-Health Professionals Council of SA (HPCSA). Isipethupethu samanje senkqubo yokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Diagnostic Radiographer (i-Independent Practice). I-Grade 1: Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni esidingekayo emva kokubhaliswa. I-Grade 2: Isipiliyoni: Ubuncinane iminyaka engu-10 yomuhla wokuhlobene nesipiliyoni njenge-Diagnostic Radiographer emva kokubhaliswa ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – i-Independent Practice. I-Grade 3: Isipiliyoni: Ubuncinane iminyaka engu-20 yomuhla wokuhlobene nesipiliyoni njenge-Diagnostic Radiographer emva kokubhaliswa ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – i-Independent Practice. Ulwazi, Amandla & Amakhono: Ulwazi olujulile ngenqubo nokubamba isikhathi se-radiography yokuhlonza kanye nesithombe. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuqatshelwa nokuvikelwa kusak radiation. Amandla okuxhumana abantu ngokuhle kanye namakhono okusebenza nomuntu. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nokwakha kanye nokuvinjelwa kwesiphephelo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngamasevisi azele ikhwalithi yokuqoqwa kokuqondiswa kwe-radiography. Qedela onke amaqoqo okwelapha ngokukhulu ukuze uqonde okungalungi. Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokuqoqwa kokuqondiswa kwe-radiography amahora angu-24. Khuthaza izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza impilo uqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okuhle. Khuthaza isimiso se-Batho Pele ekwenzeni imisebenzi ukuze kuhlinzekwe isevisi ephumelelayo. Yenza imisebenzi yokwamukela abantu kanye nokubhala lapho kudingeka khona. Thatha inhlalo ezinhlelweni zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ye-Radiography. Thatha inhlalo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo zomnyango kanye nokuqoqwa kwemisebenzi. Thatha inhlalo emihlanganweni yomnyango evela njalo ngenyanga. Qapha abasebenzi abasha be-radiography kanye nabathunywa bekhomuyunithi be-radiography. Yenza i-Employee Performance Management and Development (EPMDS) yabasebenzi abasha njengoba kudingeka.

Isiphathi semvuzo yokubhalisa ngoku nge-HPCSA njengomthathathinxaxhe we-Radiography Yokuxilobela (Ukuzilolonga Ngazibini). I-Grade 1: Esiphaluka: Akukho esiphaluka lifunekayo emva kokubhalisa. I-Grade 2: Esiphaluka: Ubuncinane lonyaka we-10 woluhlu loqeqesho olufanelekileyo njengomthathathinxaxhe we-Radiography Yokuxilobela emva kokubhalisa kwikhonse le-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – Ukuzilolonga Ngazibini. I-Grade 3: Esiphaluka: Ubuncinane lonyaka we-20 woluhlu loqeqesho olufanelekileyo njengomthathathinxaxhe we-Radiography Yokuxilobela emva kokubhalisa kwikhonse le-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) – Ukuzilolonga Ngazibini. Ulwazi, Amandla Obuqhawe & Ikhono: Ulwazi olubhekise kumaxwebhu okuzilolonga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zoradiography yokuxilobela nokuzilolonga iinkqubo. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngokulawula nokhuselwa kokuchithwa kwemitha yamandla. Amandla obuqhawe okunxibelelwana nabantu nokuxoxa ngokucacileyo. Ulwazi ngemiGaqo ephathelene nezeMpilo nakhoKhuseleko.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo ye-radiography yokuxilobela ekumgangatho ophezulu. Zonke iinkqubo zokwelapha zibenziwe ngokuzipatha kakuhle ukuze kuthintelwe iinkinga ezingezelo. Nika inkonzo ye-radiography yokuxilobela yamaxesha ama-24. Khuthaza amasiko obomi obunempilo uze uqinisekishe ukhatho olulungileyo lwesigulane. Khuthaza isimilo seBatho Pele ekwenzeni imisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwinkonzo ekumgangatho ophezulu. Yenza imisebenzi yamalungiselelo nexesha lokwazisa amagama ukuba kufuneka. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukwabiwa kakhulu kwe-radiography. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni iindlela ezisetyenziswayo nemiGaqo kwisebe. Thatha inxaxheba kwintlanganiso yamnye yonke lenyanga zekomkhulu. Khothisa abasebenzi abancinci be-radiography nabaqeqeshiweyo basebenzela uluntu. Yenza i-Employee Performance Management and Development (EPMDS) yabasebenzi abancinci njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Physiotherapist
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 - R472 395 per annum. Other benefits (medical aid optional), housing Allowance (applicant must meet prescribed requirements) CENTRE             Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital: Howick
jobs.summary: Physiotherapist sought at Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring an HPCSA-registered physiotherapy degree and Grade 12.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 or equivalent. Degree in Physiotherapy Current registration with the HPCSA as a qualified physiotherapist. Computer literate. Experience: No experience after registration with HPCSA as an Independent Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees who performed one year of community service. One (1) year relevant experience after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of physiotherapy diagnostic assessment, therapeutic procedures and equipment. Good clinical reasoning skills, ability to plan and implement appropriate treatment plans/programs based on patient’s needs. Practical knowledge of ethical code of conduct and Batho Pele principles, Disability Rights Charter and various clinical physiotherapy policies based on evidence -based practice. Good written and verbal communication skills. Good interpersonal skills, cultural competency and excellent ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Knowledge of scope of practice and referral criteria for other disciplines is essential. Good computer literacy skills. Ability to plan, organize and manage resources (both human and material). Creativity and Initiative, ability to think laterally and work independently. Insight into Community Based Rehabilitation. Ability to plan and implement individual and group programs where possible. Ability to determine need for assistive/mobility devices.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate a sound understanding of Physiotherapy, techniques and practices. Assessment and appropriate physiotherapeutic management of MHCUs (Mental Health Care Users) with various levels of Intellectual and Physical Disabilities presenting with acute, sub-acute and chronic conditions requiring physiotherapy intervention. To attend regular ward rounds. Maintain up to date clinical records and daily statistics and generate reports as required. Participate in the implementation of EPMDS for junior staff. To provide guidance and supervision to junior staff, physiotherapy technicians, students. Participate in planning the HR and equipment requirements for the department e.g. Procurement Plans. Participate in activities aimed at ensuring quality service delivery e.g. Identify the need for, plan, implement and monitor Quality Improvement Projects, participate in peer review/Clinical audits/IHRM audits, assist in developing and reviewing SOPs and Risk Management Plans. Be responsible for general administrative duties of the department e.g. monthly stock take, ordering of monthly stock and non-stock items, submitting job requests. Function within a multi-disciplinary team and link to outside service providers, NGO’s and organizations for people with disabilities to provide comprehensive holistic care. Assist in ensuring the delivery of a quality Physiotherapy service based on Batho Pele Principle and Human Rights Ethics with due consideration for people with disabilities and according to HPCS guidelines.
