af.title: Fisioterapeut
af.summary: Fisioterapeut gesoek by Umgeni Spesialis Psigiatriese Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n HPCSA-geregistreerde fisioterapiegraad en Grade 12 vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12 of ekwivalent. Graad in Fisioterapie. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n gekwalifiseerde fisioterapeut. Rekenaarvaardig. Ervaring: Geen ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Onafhanklike Beoefenaar met betrekking tot Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat een jaar gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het nie. Een (1) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad van Suid-Afrika in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) met betrekking tot buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te doen nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van fisioterapie-diagnostiese assessering, terapeutiese prosedures en toerusting. Goeie kliniese redeneervaardighede, vermoë om toepaslike behandelingsplanne/programme te beplan en te implementeer gebaseer op pasiënt se behoeftes. Praktiese kennis van etiese gedragskode en Batho Pele-beginsels, Handves vir Regte van Gestremdes en verskeie kliniese fisioterapie-beleide gebaseer op getuigebaseerde praktyk. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, kulturele bevoegdheid en uitstekende vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Kennis van omvang van praktyk en verwysingskriteria vir ander dissiplines is noodsaaklik. Goeie rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Vermoë om hulpbronne (sowel menslike as materiële) te beplan, te organiseer en te bestuur. Kreatiwiteit en inisiatief, vermoë om lateraal te dink en onafhanklik te werk. Insig in Gemeenskapsgebaseerde Rehabilitasie. Vermoë om individuele en groep programme te beplan en te implementeer waar moontlik. Vermoë om behoefte aan ondersteunende/mobiliteitsapparate te bepaal.
af.duties: Toon 'n goeie begrip van fisioterapie, tegnieke en praktyke. Assessering en toepaslike fisioterapeutiese bestuur van MGV'e (Mentaalgesondheidsorggebruikers) met verskeie vlakke van intellektuele en fisiese gestremdhede wat aanbied met akute, subakute en chroniese toestande wat fisioterapie-ingryping vereis. Om gereelde saalrondes by te woon. Onderhou op-datum kliniese rekords en daaglikse statistieke en genereer verslae soos vereis. Neem deel aan die implementering van EPMDS vir junior personeel. Verskaf leiding en toesig aan junior personeel, fisioterapietegnici, studente. Neem deel aan beplanning van die HR- en toerusterereistes vir die departement bv. Aanbestedingsplanne. Neem deel aan aktiwiteite wat gemik is daarop om gehaldienslewering te verseker bv. Identifiseer die behoefte aan, beplan, implementeer en monitor Gehaltsverbeteringsprojekte, neem deel portuurontleding/Kliniese oudits/IHRM-oudits, help met die ontwikkeling en hersiening van SOP's en Risikobestuurplanne. Wees verantwoordelik vir algemene administratiewe pligte van die departement bv. maandelikse voorraadopname, bestelling van maandelikse voorraad- en nie-voorraaditems, indiening van werkversoeke. Funksioneer binne 'n multidissiplinêre span en skakel met buitediensverskaffers, NGO's en organisasies vir persone met gestremdhede om omvattende holistiese sorg te verskaf. Help om die levering van 'n gehalte fisioterapiediens gebaseer op Batho Pele-beginsels en Menseregte-etiek te verseker met behoorlike oorweging vir persone met gestremdhede en ooreenkomstig HPCS-riglyne.

Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni ngemuva kokungeniswa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisi ozimele mayelana nabasebenzi abagqoqwe eNingizimu Afrika abenze unyaka oyedwa wenkonzo yomphakathi. Unyaka (1) owodwa wesipiliyoni esihambisana nalesi simo ngemuva kokungeniswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa esikhundleni esihambisanayo (lapho kusemhlatshela) mayelana nabasebenzi begazi lamanye izwe, okungekho isidingo sokwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi Nobukhono: Ulwazi lokuhlola ukuxilongo kokukwelisa umzimba, izinqubo zokwelapha nezisetshenziswa. Amandla okuqonda izinto ngokwesayensi yokugcina, ikhono lokuhlela nokuphepha izinhlelo zokwelapha ezifanele ezisekelwe izidingo zesiguli. Ulwazi lokwenza lwemikhono yokuziphatha kanye nemigomo kaBatho Pele, isibambelo samalungelo abakhubazekile kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zezokwelisa umzimba ezingokwesayensi. Amandla ahle angokubhala nangokukhuluma. Amandla kahle bokuxhumana nabantu, ukuqonda izinkolelo-njalo kanye nenhlanhlaza yokusebenza eqhagamshelweni esinabanzi bokusebenza. Kuyadingeka ukwazi ukuphakama kokusebenza kanye nemigomo yokuthumela kwezinye izikhungo. Amandla ahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuhlela, ukulungisa nokuphatha izinsiza (abantu nempahla). Ukubhaqabhaza nokuhlela, ikhono lokucabanga ngokwesibonelo kanye nokusebenza ngokuzimele. Ukuqonda isinxaxa sokulashwa komphakathi. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuphumeza izinhlelo zomuntu oyedwa nokuqoqa lapho kungenzekwa khona. Ikhono lokuqonda isidingo sezinsiza zokunyathela/zokusiza ekuhambeni.
zu.duties: Ukubonisa ukuqonda okuhle kokukwelisa umzimba, izindlela nezinqubo. Ukuhlola nokuphatha ngokufanele abasebenzisi bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo (MHCUs) abanamazinga ahlukene okukhubazeka kwengqondo nomzimba abafika nezinkinga ezibuhlungu, ezingabuhlungu kakhulu noma ezingapheli kudinga ukwelashwa kokukwelisa umzimba. Ukuya njalo ezindaweni zokuhamba ezibedlizi. Ukugcina imibhalo yesikhathi esibuko yokwelapha kanye namanani ansuku zonke futhi ukhiyo izincazelo njengoba kudingekile. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphumezeni i-EPMDS yabasebenzi abangaphansi. Ukunikeza inkokelo nokuhlola abasebenzi abangaphansi, abashoshovi bokukwelisa umzimba, abafundi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuhlelweni kwezidingo ze-HR nezempahla zomnyango isb. Izinhlela zokuthenga. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa kwesevisi yemigondo isb. Ukuqonda isidingo, ukuhlela, ukuphumeza futhi ulawule Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa Imigondo, ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqoqweni kwezinkampani/Izihlabekazo zeClinical/Izihlabekazo ze-IHRM, ukusiza ekwakheni futhi uhlole ama-SOP namahlela Okuphatha Izengozi. Ukubeke okuyinhloko emisebenzini yobalulele eceli yomnyango isb. ukuqoqa izinto zenyanga zonke, ukuthenga izinto zenyanga nezinto ezingezona zesitoko, nokuthumela izicelo zemisebenzi. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqhagamshelane esibanzi bese ukuxhumanisa kunabathuli besevisi bangaphandle, ama-NGO kanye nenhlanganiso zabakhubazekile ukunikeza ukwelashwa okuyikho okuphelele. Ukusiza ekuqinisekiseni ukulethwa kwezinsiza zokukwelisa umzimba ezinhle ngokwemigomo kaBatho Pele kanye Nengikadeli Yamalungelo Abantu obheka abakhubazekile futhi ngokwezinqobo zika-HPCS.

xh.title: Umthathi wezempilo oyoqobo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umthathi wezempilo oyoqobo kwa Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal, kwaye kufunelwe ukuba negesi ye-physiotherapy ebhaliswe kwi-HPCSA kunye ne-Grade 12.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12 okanye efanayo. I-degree kwi-Physiotherapy. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengomthathi wezempilo oyoqobo onemvume. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. I-Experience: Akukho nqanaba lomfundo lwemisebenzi emva kwebhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompractitioner ozimeleyo mayela nabasebenzi abagqithiswe eSouth Africa abo benze unyaka wothenkithinkithi lomphakathi. Unyaka owodwa (1) womfundo ofaneleyo emva kwebhaliso kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa kwishishini elichanekileyo (apho kusemthethweni) mayela nabasebenzi bagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abo abayi funeka ukwenza thenkithinkithi lomphakathi. ULwazi Namaqhawu: Ulwazi lokuhlola uxilongo lwe-physiotherapy, iinkqubo zonyango nemisebenzi yamajelo. Iakhono amahle okuqonda izifo ngokweklinikhi, ikhono lokuceba nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zonyanga/eenkqubo ezifanelekileyo ngokwemfuno yomgunyathi. Ulwazi ngokwenzeko lwemithethonkqubo yokuziphatha kunye neemigaqo ze-Batho Pele, isatifikethi samalungelo abantu abakhubazekileyo kunye neenqobo ezahlukeneyo zezenqobo ze-physiotherapy ngokwenzeko ezingxamiseko ezenziwayo. Iakhono amahle okuqamba eluntswini nakuthetha. Iakhono amahle zomntu nomntu, ukuziphatha kwezentlalo kunye nakhono amahle okusebenza kwiqela elinabasebenzi beenguqu zezinto ezininzi. Ulwazi ngommandla wothenkithinkithi kunye neemigaqo zokuqamba iinkqubo kwamanye amasebe kubalulekile. Iakhono amahle okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuceba, ukuqamba nokulawula imithombo yemali (kokwabantu nendalo). Ubulungisa kunye nokuzinza, ikhono lokucinga ngaphandle komda kwaye usebenze wedwa. Ukuqonda ngokuqinisekileyo ukulondolozwa komphakathi. Ikhono lokuceba nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zabantu ngamanye namakumphu xa kusemthethweni. Ikhono lokunqumla ukuyimfuno yamajelo abo bakhubazekileyo.
xh.duties: Ibonise ukuqonda okuqinisekileyo ngokuqobo lwe-Physiotherapy, iindlela nemisebenzi yonke. Ukuhlola nokulawula ngokwemfuno iinkqubo zonyango ezifanelekileyo ezimalunga nezempilo ezingqondwe kwiziguli ezikwi-HPCUs (Abasebenzisi bemfuno yokuqonda ngokomkhwa) ngezikhulu ezahlukeneyo ezingqondwe kwizifo ezikrelekrele nezomzimba ezibonakalisa ngobunzima obukhawulezayo, obungenasiphithiphithi nobungalawulekiyo bofuzo obufuna unyango ngokwe-physiotherapy. Ukuhamba rhoqo kwiziganga zesibhedlele. Ukugcina iirekhodi ezisemthethweni ezibhalwe ngonmanje kunye nolunye uluhlu lwemiqulu ngemihla nokwenza iingxelo njengoko kuyimfuno. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni i-EPMDS kubasebenzi abasezantsi. Ukubonelela ngengcebiso nokulawula abasebenzi abasezantsi, abasebenzi bamacandwe we-physiotherapy, omafundi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekucwebeni iimfuno ze-HR kunye nezixhobo zesebe umzekelo iinkqubo zokuzeza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumasebenzi aphulukene nokuqinisekiswa kwenkonzo ezilungileyo umzekelo ukuqonda ukuyimfuno, ukuqamba nokusebenzisa ukulandela iiprojekthi zokuphucula inkonzo, ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuhlolweni koluntu/ezamaklinikhi/i-IHRM audits, ukuncedisa ekwakheni nokuqamba iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lwengozi. Kuba nomdla wokwenza imisebenzi engowiso yonke yesebe umzekelo ukubala iinkunzi ezingeyiyonzi ngenyanga, ukuzeza iinkunzi ezingeyiyo kunye namanani ezingeyiyo zenyanga, ukuza izicelo zemisebenzi. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwamaqela amaninzi kunye nokuzama ukudibanisa ababoneleli besebenza ngaphandle, ama-NGO nokubakho kwabakhubazekileyo abanokubonelela ngomdla wokuzeza iinkonzo ezibonelela ngokugqibeleleyo. Ukuncedisa ekunqweniseni ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo ye-Physiotherapy ngokwemigaqo ye-Batho Pele kunye neLungelo lomntu ezingcaleni ngokulandela i-HPCS.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 - R472 359 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Medical Aid and Housing Allowance optional (employees must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist needed at Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick to assess, plan and implement occupational therapy treatment for psychiatric patients.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Occupational Therapy that allows for registration with HPCSA as an occupational therapist. Registration certificate with Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Occupational Therapist. Computer Literacy. Valid Driver’s License. Knowledge And Skills: Good communication and teambuilding skills. Sound knowledge of the current Health and Public Service Legislation, Regulations and Policies. Sound knowledge in the application of clinical Occupational Therapy theory, practice and ethics. Adequate knowledge and competent use of therapeutic media, equipment, craft and rehabilitation activities. Sound problem solving skills. Demonstrate leadership ability, discipline and interpersonal relationship skills. Ability to function under pressure with Mental Health Care Users. Good ability to organize self and the duties allocated for efficient time management.
jobs.duties: To assess, plan and implement Occupational Therapy treatment methods within Occupational Therapy Services and the other allocated areas of work, including management of Intellectual Impairment services. Perform administrative tasks such as accurate compilation of monthly statistics, clinical audits, report writing, attend and participate in meetings and assist in the development and implementation of protocols and polices. Provide mentorship and guidance to Community Service Therapists and university students. Ensure accurate record keeping and all quality assurance requirements. Engage in skills development accordingly. Assist in safeguarding and evaluating the status of equipment and infrastructure with a repair and maintenance programme as well as stock control management. Contribute towards planning, budgeting, procurement processes and exercise control of expenditure within your department cost center. Support the immediate manager in all transformative changes and additional supervisory tasks as needed. Assist in the provision of high-quality Occupational Therapy Services through the development and implementation of appropriate systems, protocols, quality assurance programs and internal controls. Market and promote Occupational Therapy Services and contribute towards research and training as required.

af.title: Ergoterapeut
af.summary: Ergoterapeut benodig by Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick om ergoterapiebehandeling vir psigiatriese pasiënte te assesseer, te beplan en te implementeer.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate. Baccalaureusgraad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Ergoterapie wat registrasie by HPCSA as 'n ergoterapeut moontlik maak. Registrasiesertifikaat by die Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Ergoterapeut. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie en spanbouvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van die huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Deeglike kennis van die toepassing van kliniese ergoterapieteorie, -praktyk en -etiek. Voldoende kennis en bevoegde gebruik van terapeutiese media, toerusting, handwerk en rehabilitasie-aktiwiteite. Deeglike probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Toon leierskapsvermoë, dissipline en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer met Mentale Gesondheidsorggebruikers. Goeie vermoë om self en toegewese pligte te organiseer vir doeltreffende tydbestuur.
af.duties: Om ergoterapiebehandelingsmetodes binne Ergoterapie-dienste en die ander toegewese werksareas te assesseer, te beplan en te implementeer, insluitend die bestuur van Intellektuele Beperking-dienste. Voer administratiewe take uit soos die akkurate samestelling van maandelikse statistieke, kliniese oudits, verslaglaing, bywoon van en deelname aan vergaderings en hulp met die ontwikkeling en implementering van protokolle en beleide. Verskaf mentorskap en leiding aan Gemeenskapsdiens-terapeute en universiteitstudente. Verseker akkurate rekordhouding en alle gehalteversekeringsvereistes. Raak betrokke by vaardigheidsontwikkeling dienooreenkomstig. Help met die beskerming en evaluering van die status van toerusting en infrastruktuur met 'n herstel- en instandhoudingsprogram asook voorraadbeheerbestuur. Dra by tot beplanning, begroting, verkrygingsprosesse en oefen beheer oor besteding binne jou departement-kostesentrum. Ondersteun die onmiddellike bestuurder in alle transformasieveranderinge en bykomende toesigtake soos benodig. Help met die voorsiening van hoëgehalte Ergoterapie-dienste deur die ontwikkeling en implementering van toepaslike stelsels, protokolle, gehalteversekeringsprogramme en interne kontroles. Bemark en bevorder Ergoterapie-dienste en dra by tot navorsing en opleiding soos vereis.

zu.title: Umsebenzi weTherapy yokusebenza
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ongumTherapist wokuSebenza e-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick ukuba ahlolisise, ahlele futhi asebenzise unyaka wezokwelashwa kweTherapy yokusebenza kwabaguli bengqondo.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate. I-Bachelor's degree noma iziqu ezilinganayo ku-Occupational Therapy ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomTherapist wokuSebenza. Isitifikedi sokubhalisa ne-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMTherapist wokuSebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. I-Driver's License evumelekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono okuxoxa kahle nokwakha iqembu. Ulwazi olunjani ngemithetho yamanje yezeMpilo nakwoMnyango woMphakathi, Izinqubo kanye neNqubomgomo. Ulwazi olunjani ekusetshenzisweni kwetheori, umzimba kanye nezimiso zokuziphatha zokuSebenza kweTherapy yokwelapha. Ulwazi olwanele nokusebenzisa ngokugqamile izinto zokwelapha, izisetshenziswa, ubuciko namasevisi okuphulukisa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kahle. Kubonise ikhono lokuba nguMholi, isiyalo namakhono ohlotshaneni nabantu. Ikholo lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcushuwa nabasebenzisi beNakekelwa ezeNgqondo. Ikholo elihle lokuzihlela kanye nemisebenzi edunyiswe ukuphatha isikhathi ngokusebenza kahle.
zu.duties: Ukuhlolisisa, ukuhlela futhi usebenzise izindlela zokwelashwa kweTherapy yokusebenza ngaphakathi kwezinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza nakwezinye izindawo edunyisiwe zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa nokuqondisa izinkonzo zokuLahlekelwa kobuKhaladi. Wenze imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokubhalisa ngokuchanekile izibalo zanyanga zonke, ukuhlola izimo, ukubhala imibiko, ukuhamba ubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni futhi usize ekuthuthukiseni nakusebenziseni izinqubo kanye namapholisi. Nikeze isiqondiso nomsindo kuTherapist beseKhombeJMuzi nabafundi bayunivesithi. Qinisekisa ukugcina irekhodi ngokuchanekile nezidingo zonke zokuqinisekisa izinga. Zibandakanye ekuthuthukiseni amakhono ngokufanele. Siza ekugcineni nokuhlola isimo yezisetshenziswa nempahla ngohlelo lokulungisa nolokugcina kanye nokulawula isitoko. Babe ekwenzele ukuhlela, ukwenza iholo, inqubo yokuthenga futhi ulawule ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sakho sezindleko somnyango. Sekela umphathi osondelene nawe kuzo zonke izinguquko zoguquko nemisebenzi yokugcina eyongezelelwe njengoba kudingeka. Siza ekunikeni izinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza ezingeni eliphezulu ngokuthuthukiswa nakusebenziswa kwezimiso ezifanele, izinqubo, izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga kanye nolawulo lwangaphakathi. Thengisa futhi ukhiqize izinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza futhi abe ekutholeni ulwazi nakufundeni njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Umngcwathi Wemisebenzi Ehlobene Neempilo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umngcwathi wemisebenzi ehlobene neempilo kwiSibhedlele i-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick ukuze alinganise, acele kwaye asebenzise inkqubo yokuqonyobwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene neempilo kumagula e-psychiatric.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate. Isidanga se-Bachelor okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwi-Occupational Therapy esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomngcwathi wemisebenzi ehlobene neempilo. Isatifikethi sobhaliso nge-HPCSA njengomngcwathi wemisebenzi ehlobene neempilo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi Namasakhono: Amakhono amahle okunxibelelana nomasakhono okwakha iqela. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemigaqo ekhoyo ye-Health and Public Service, iimeko nezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi olusisiseko ekusebenziseni ingcamango, inkqubo namaqabango e-Occupational Therapy ekliniki. Ulwazi olwaneleyo nokusebenzisa ngobuchule izixhobo zokwelapha, izixhobo, ubugcisa nemisebenzi yokubuyisela empilweni. Amakhono amahle okusombulula iingxaki. Umboniso wamakhono okuba ngumhola, inqindi namakhono obudlelwano nabantu. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo ne-Mental Health Care Users. Ukwazi okuhle kokuqamba ngokwakhe nemisebenzi enikiweyo ukuze kuqhutywe kakuhle ingxoxo yexesha.
xh.duties: Ukulinganisa, ukucela kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuqonyobwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene neempilo ngaphakathi kweenkonzo ze-Occupational Therapy nakwezinye iindawo zomsebenzi ezinikiweyo, kuquka nophatho lweenkonzo ze-Intellectual Impairment. Ukuzenza imisebenzi yolawulo njengokubhala ngokuchanekileyo izibalo zenyanga, ukujongwa kwezempilo ekliniki, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuhamba ukuya kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwiintlanganiso kwaye uncede ekuthuthweni nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo neezinqubomgomo. Ukunika isakhono nokuqonda abaTherapist be-Community Service nabafundi beyunivesithi. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi ngokuchanekileyo nazo zonke iimfuno zokuqinisekiswa komgangatho. Ukuthatwa kwexesha kakhulu ekuthuthweni kwamakhono. Ukunceda ekukhuseleni nokuqwalasela imeko yezixhobo neyakhiwo ngeenkqubo zokulungisa nokuqhuba imilonde, kunye nolawulo lwempahla. Ukunikela ngokucwangcisa, ukucwangcisa ingxwaja, iinkqubo zokuthenga nokulawula ukuchithwa kweedola ngaphakathi kwesebe lakho elibeka ixabiso. Ukuxhasa umphathi wakho waso lonke iinguquko eziphilisayo nemisebenzi yokuqeqesha njengoko kufuneka. Ukunceda ekuboneleleni ngeenkonzo ze-Occupational Therapy zamgangatho ophezulu ngokuthutha nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zoqinisekiso lomgangatho nolawulo langaphakathi. Ukusasaza kwaye ukhuthaze iinkonzo ze-Occupational Therapy kwaye uncede ekuphando nakwiqeqesho njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Management Practitioner (DEMAND)
jobs.centre: General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus 13th Cheque Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements). Medical Aid (Optional)
jobs.summary: Seeking a Supply Chain Management Practitioner for demand functions at General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate Grade 12 or equivalent plus Degree or National diploma in SCM or relevant qualification plus 1-2 years clerical experience in public sector SCM environment. A Valid driver’s licence code 8/10. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: PFMA, Treasury Regulations and GRAP, Computer literacy (Basic Skills) and Excel knowledge Ability to work under pressure. Good interpersonal and communication skills. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Must have eligible hand writing. Knowledge of administration procedures and Logis Certificate will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Provide need assessment to ensure that required goods and services follow Departmental SCM Policy Framework, Practice Notes and Treasury Regulations. Determine clear specification for the quality of goods and services required. Ensure that the requirements are linked to budget and analyse the supplying industry for compliance, Conduct Market Research. Match required goods to relevant mandatory requirements. Respond promptly, courteously, and efficiently to suggestions, queries, and complaints. Manage the contract management function, Manage processes to customise standard contracts and service level agreements to ensure adequate SCM security and minimise departmental risk. Ensure that end users oversee contractual compliance by the service providers and those instances of non-compliance are addressed appropriately with suppliers. Manage early warning arrangements to minimise the impact of suppliers defaulting on service delivery. Liaise with provincial treasury on the restriction of non-performing suppliers. Manage a central database of all contracts for goods and services falling outside the scope of delegation of institutions and report on a regular basis on compliance issues and value for money. Adequate reporting and management of Irregular Expenditure, Deviations, Unauthorised and Fruitless & Wasteful Expenditure, Ensure risk and compliance. Manage the procurement plan and its implementation. Supervise the Demand Management Section.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingbestuurpraktisyn (VRAAG)
af.summary: Soek 'n Voorsieningskettingbestuurpraktisyn vir vraagfunksies by General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate Grade 12 of gelykwaardig plus 'n Graad of Nasionale diploma in SCM of tersykreikwante kwalifikasie plus 1-2 jaar se klerklike ervaring in 'n openbare sektor SCM-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie kode 8/10. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en GRAP, rekenaargeletterdheid (basiese vaardighede) en Excel-kennis Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Moet leesbare handskrif hê. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures en 'n Logis-sertifikaat sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf behoeftebepaling om te verseker dat vereiste goedere en dienste die departementele SCM-beleidsraamwerk, praktyknotas en Tesourie-regulasies volg. Bepaal duidelike spesifikasies vir die gehalte van vereiste goedere en dienste. Verseker dat die vereistes aan die begroting gekoppel is en ontleed die verskaffingsbedryf vir nakoming, voer marknavorsing uit. Pas vereiste goedere aan tersykreikwante verpligte vereistes. Reageer vinnig, hoflik en doeltreffend op voorstelle, navrae en klagtes. Bestuur die kontrakbestuursfunksie, bestuur prosesse om standaardkontrakte en diensvlakooreenkomste aan te pas om voldoende SCM-sekuriteit te verseker en departementele risiko te minimeer. Verseker dat eindgebruikers kontraktuele nakoming deur diensverskaffers toesien en dat gevalle van nie-nakoming gepas met verskaffers hanteer word. Bestuur vroeë waarskuwingsreëlings om die impak van verskaffers wat op dienslewering in gebreke bly te minimeer. Skakel met provinsiale tesourie oor die beperking van nie-presterende verskaffers. Bestuur 'n sentrale databasis van alle kontrakte vir goedere en dienste wat buite die bestek van delegasie van instansies val en doen gereel verslag oor nakomingsake en waarde vir geld. Voldoende verslagdoening en bestuur van Onreëlmatige Uitgawes, Afwykings, Ongemagtigde en Verkwistende & Onnodige Uitgawes, verseker risiko en nakoming. Bestuur die procurementsplan en die implementering daarvan. Hou toesig oor die Vraagbestuursafdeling.

zu.title: Umuntu osebenza ngokuqashwa kwenkonzo yeziqu nemithelela (DEMAND)
zu.summary: Sifuna umuntu osebenza ngokuqashwa kwenkonzo yeziqu nemithelela emsebenzini wokuqonda isidingo esibhedlela i-General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate Grade 12 noma okulingana nayo kanye ne-Degree noma i-National diploma kwi-SCM noma izifundo ezihambisana naleyo kanye neminyaka yohlelo lwe-1-2 lemisebenzi yobungqangi kumazinga e-SCM komphakathi. I-Driver's licence evumelekileyo ikhodi 8/10. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla: i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-GRAP, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Amakhono okuqala) kanye nolwazi lwe-Excel Bakwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokucommunicate. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-Batho Pele. Kufuneka abe nobhalo wezandla okuvumelekileyo. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yolawulo kwaye i-Logis Certificate iya kuba ngeluncedo.
zu.duties: Nikeza isilinganiso sesidingoukuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ezidingwayo nezenkonzo zilandela i-Departmental SCM Policy Framework, i-Practice Notes ne-Treasury Regulations. Qamba izicazaniso ezicacileyo ngomgangatho wezinto ezidingwayo nezenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuba izidingo zihambahamabiswa kubhajethi kwaye uhloliswe inkampani enikezelayo ukulandelwa kwemigaqo, Yenza ucociso lwe-market research. Qambanisela izinto ezidingwayo kwizidingo ezinganyanzelekileyo. Phendula ngokukhawuleza, ngobubele nangokusebenza kakuhle iingcinga zimibuzo neengxaki. Lawula inkqubo yolawulo kwankqubo yamagama, Lawula iinkqubo zokulungelelanisa amagama abalulelekileyo kwankqubo yamagama namagama abalulelekileyo yokwenzayo kuqinisekise ukhuseleko lwe-SCM kunciphise ingozi yomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzisi balawula ukulandelwa kwemigaqo yamagama abaniki baze bona bakwazi ukuba ezo zingxaki zangakulandelwa kwemigaqo zixoxwe kakuhle nama-suppliers. Lawula izicolululo zokuqaphela kakhulu ukuze kuncitshiswe isiphithiphithi sabaniki bengonakali ngokunikela iinkonzo. Xhumanisa netreasury yesifunda ekubeni thintela abaniki abangasebenzayo. Lawula idatabase ephakathi yamagama onke ezinto nezenkonzo ezikwindawo ezingaphandle kokummandla weziko nokuxela ngokwenzekekayo ngezinkinga zokulandelwa kwemigaqo nokubalo lexabiso lamaziko. Uxela ngokwaneleyo nolawulo loxabiso olungalulanga, eziNgqungquthela, eziNgagunyaziswa nolwaziswa luxhaphazalala nokutshatyalaliswa kwezimali, Qinisekisa ingozi nangokulandelwa kwemigaqo. Lawula iplelan yokuthenga nokuqaliswa kwayo. Lawula i-Demand Management Section.

xh.title: Umntu oqeqeselwe ukulawula iqela lembonelelo (DEMAND)
xh.summary: Kuyafuneka umntu oqeqeselwe ukulawula iqela lembonelelo ukwenza imisebenzi yokufuna kwisibhedlele i-General Justice Gizenga Mpanza Regional Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu sika Grade 12 oku sesisantya salo kunye ne-Degree okanye i-National diploma kwi-SCM okanye isifactileko esifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka 1-2 yamava olusebenzayo kwindalo kaqabaniso kwimeko ye-SCM yomphakathi. Ilayisensi yokuqamba esemthethweni ikhodi 8/10. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okusebenza: PFMA, Iimithetho yeTreasury kunye ne-GRAP, Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (amakhono angasemva) kunye nolwazi lwe-Excel. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalwe mhle ekunxibelelaneni nasekuthetheni. Ulwazi ngeemvisiswano zeBatho Pele. Kufuneka ube nokubhala ngentsandla echanekileyo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zolawulo kunye neLogis Certificate kuya kuba lisibonelelo esibi ngenye imfuno.
xh.duties: Nika isicwangciso sokulinganisa iimfuno ukuqinisekisa ukuba izinto neenzame ezifunekayo zilandela iNkqubo yeMigaqo ye-SCM yeSebe, iNqumamano zoBuzobe kunye neMithetho yeTreasury. Misela iinkcazelo ezicacileyo ngomgangatho wezinto neenzame ezifunekayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zidityaniswe kwisinqwemela uze uhlaziye ingcali yemithiyo ngokwemigaqo yayo, Yenza uphononongo loMthengiso. Qamanisa izinto ezifunekayo neemfuno eziphoqwe ngumthetho. Phendula ngokukhawuleza, ngobubele, nangokusebenza kakuhle kwiingcinga, imibuzo, neengxaki. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo lweenkqubo zemithetho, Lawula iinkqubo zokulungelelanisa iinkqubo zemithetho eziqhelekileyo kunye neendibano zanqanaba lokuvelisa ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko lwe-SCM olwaneleyo nokunciphisa ingozi yesebe. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzisi balawula ukwamkelwa kweenkqubo zemithetho ngabaxhasi nokuba iimeko ezingamkelekanga ziphathwa ngokufanelekileyo nabaxhasi. Lawula izikhathi zokuqaliswa okungaphambili ukunciphisa impembelelo yabaxhasi abahlulekayo ekunikezeni inkonzo. Thintana netreasury yephondo ngokuthintela abaxhasi abangenzi msebenzi. Lawula idatabase ephakathi yazo zonke iinkqubo zemithetho zamathuba neenzame angaphandle kwamandla okunikwa iindlebe zeendawo uze uxela ngoko nangoko ngemiba yokwamkelwa kwemigaqo nexabiso lembonelelo. Ingxelo ekwaneleyo nolawulo lokuchithwa kwemali engaqabaniswanga, Iintsu, enganyusiweyo nengachithwa buthereza, Qinisekisa ingozi nokuwamkelwa kwemigaqo. Lawula isicwangciso sokuthenga kwaye sisenziwe. Lawula icandelo elilawula iimfuno.

jobs.title: Social Worker
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum. Other benefits (medical aid optional), housing Allowance (applicant must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Social worker at Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital in Howick providing psychosocial assessments, counselling and admission facilitation for mental health care users.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 or equivalent. Bachelor of Social Work. Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Valid Driver’s licence. Computer certificate. Experience: No experience required. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge and understanding of Mental Health Care Act No: 17 of 2002, Intellectual disability and physical disabilities. Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social system. Knowledge of government policies, Acts, legislation pertaining to social work practice. Theoretical knowledge, practical knowledge of all social work methods and social work principles. Decision-making, problem-solving skills, crisis intervention, planning and organizing skills. Ability to work under pressure with good insight, diplomacy and work with multidisciplinary team members. Good interpersonal relations and listening skills. Ability to write comprehensive social work reports. Ability to safeguard confidentiality. Verbal and written communication skills both in IsiZulu and English.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the process of application for possible admission to Umgeni thus liaising with all the relevant external stakeholders and Umgeni MDT. Conduct psychosocial assessments of mental health care users and their families. Arrange and attend screening meetings. Provide counselling, social support, and psychoeducation to families living and caring for mental health care users with intellectual disabilities and other medical conditions. Strengthen family relations after admission. Provide pre-discharge planning. Design and implement quality improvement programmes. Develop and maintain good working relations with both external and internal stakeholders for better co- ordination of services and effective service delivery. Produce and maintain accurate records of social work interventions, process and outcomes. Keep up to date with new developments in the social work profession. Attend to ward rounds and meetings with other departments and non-governmental institutions to take cognizance of the latest developments in the relevant fields. Perform all the administrative functions required of the job, including writing comprehensive social work reports. Conduct home visits. Relieve in the absence of Social Worker.

af.title: Maatskaplike werker
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker by Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital in Howick wat psigososiale assessments, berading en toelatingsfasilitering vir geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers bied.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 of ekwivalent. Bachelor of Social Work. Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarsertifikaat. Ervaring: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van Mental Health Care Act No: 17 of 2002, intellektuele gestremdheid en fisiese gestremdhede. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en die sosiale stelsel. Kennis van regeringsbeleid, Wette, wetgewing met betrekking tot maatskaplikewerkpraktyk. Teoretiese kennis, praktiese kennis van alle maatskaplikewerkmetodes en maatskaplikewerkbeginsels. Besluitneming, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, krisisintervensie, beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk met goeie insig, diplomasie en saam met multidissiplinêre spanlede te werk. Goed interpersoonlike verhoudinge en luistervaardighede. Vermoë om omvattende maatskaplikewerkverslae te skryf. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te beskerm. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede in beide IsiZulu en Engels.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die proses van aansoek vir moontlike toelating tot Umgeni deur dus met alle relevante eksterne belanghebbendes en Umgeni MDT te skakel. Voer psigososiale assessments van geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers en hul gesinne uit. Reël en woon siftingsvergaderings by. Verskaf berading, sosiale ondersteuning en psigo-opvoeding aan gesinne wat saamleef en versorging bied aan geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers met intellektuele gestremdhede en ander mediese toestande. Versterk gesinsverhoudinge na toelating. Verskaf voorontslagbeplanning. Ontwerp en implementeer gehaltsverbeteringsprogramme. Ontwikkel en handhaaf goeie werksverhoudinge met beide eksterne en interne belanghebbendes vir beter koördinasie van dienste en effektiewe dienslewering. Produeer en handhaaf akkurate rekords van maatskaplikewerkintervensies, proses en uitkomste. Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die maatskaplikewerkberoep. Woon saalrondtes en vergaderings met ander departemente en nie-regeringsinstellings by om kennis te neem van die jongste ontwikkelinge in die relevante velde. Voer alle administratiewe funksies uit wat vir die werk vereis word, insluitend die skryf van omvattende maatskaplikewerkverslae. Voer huisbesoeke uit. Tree op as plaasvervanger tydens afwesigheid van die Maatskaplike werker.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokwengcondvo
zu.summary: Umsebenzi wezokwengcondvo e-Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick ohlinzela ngekuhlola ngengcondvo, wangnikela ngeluleko nokuhebana kungena ngemizamo yezempilo yengcondvo.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 noma okufanayo. Bachelor of Social Work. Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifikedi sekhompyutha. Isipiliwhi: Asikho isipiliwhi esidingekayo. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Mental Health Care Act No: 17 of 2002, ukukhabeleka ngengcondvo nokukhabeleka ngomzimba. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu nenkqubo yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwemigaganyelwekahulumeni, emiThethweni, nomthetho ophathelene nenkonzo yezokwengcondvo. Ulwazi lokulingene lokutheorikhi, lokwenzayo kwazo zonke izindlela zomsebenzi wezokwengcondvo nezimiso zomsebenzi wezokwengcondvo. Ukwenza izinqumo, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukungenelela esimeni esibucayi, ukuhlela nokuhlela imisebenzi. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesidingo ngokuqonda okuhle, ngokuziphatha kahle nokuqasha ngokuhlanganyela nabasebenzi besiqendu. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu namakhono okulalela. Ikono lokubhala imibiko yokwengcondvo. Ikono lokugcina imfihlo. Amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala ngesiZulu nangesiNgisi.
zu.duties: Myalela inqubo yesicelo sokungena okungenzeka e-Umgeni, ngakho-ke uxinzelelana nabo bonke abahlangothi abahlobene bangaphandle ne-Umgeni MDT. Yenza ukuhlola ngengcondvo kubasebenzisi bezempilo yengcondvo nemindeni yabo. Hlela ubuye uhlole imihlangano yokuhlola. Nikela ngeluleko, ukusekela ngokwengcondvo, nokuqondisa ngengcondvo emindenini ehlala inakekela abasebenzisi bezempilo yengcondvo abakhabeleka ngengcondvo nezinye izimo zezokwelapha. Qinisekisa ubuhlobo bemindeni ngemva kokungena. Nikela ngocwaningo lokuhlela ngaphambi kokukhishwa. Hlela futhi usebenzise amahlelo okuthuthukisa izinga. Buye ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza nomhlangothi wangaphandle nangaphakathi ukuze kuhleleke kahle izinsiza futhi kuhlolakale inkonzo. Bhala futhi ugcile imibiko equkethe ukuzwana komsebenzi wezokwengcondvo, inqubo nemiphumela. Gcina ukuzibophezela ngaphezulu ezintweni ezintsha kumsebenzi wezokwengcondvo. Yiba khona kumajaha ezigula nemihlangano namanyangwe amanye nezikhungo ezingahlanganyeli kahulumeni ukuze ukwazi okusha kulezo zinkomba. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yentunja efunekayo ohlangothini, okufaka phakathi ukubhala imibiko yokwengcondvo. Yenza ukuvakatshela emakhaya. Siza ngenkathi engekho umsebenzi wezokwengcondvo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezoLuntu
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wezoluntu e-Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick onika olunxulumene nokuqikelela ngobomi bengqondo, ululeko nokulungelelanisa ukungena kwabasebenzisi bezempilo yengqondo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo/Grade 12 okanye eselinganayo. I-Bachelor of Social Work. Uku Correction: Registration kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isatifikethi sekhompyutha. Isipili: Asikho isipili esifunekayo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda iMental Health Care Act No: 17 of 2002, ukukhubazeka kwengqondo nokuwaluka kwesiqu. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela abaphehlela ngayo abantu nokuhlelwa koluntu. Ulwazi ngamapoli kaRhulumente, iMithetho, nemicimbi yolwimi ngomsebenzi wezoLuntu. Ulwazi lwengcamango, ulwazi lwenkqubo ngazo zonke iindlela zomsebenzi wezoLuntu nemiBhalo yawo. Ukwenza izigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukungenisa uluntu kolunye uhlelo ngokukhawuleza, ukuhlela nokuzelelisa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngxamiseka ngokukhanya okuhle, imfanelo yokudibanisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo, nokusebenza nabadlali boqhakamshelwano. Ukuchaneka koluntu nokulalela. Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo ezele izibalo ezibalulekileyo ngezoluntu. Ikhono lokwenza ngokufihla. Ulwazi lokuthetha nokubhala ngesiZulu nangesiNgesi.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa inkqubo yosetyenziso lokungenwa kwa-Umgeni ngokudibana namaphandle eemvulindlela kwaye udibane nayo yonke imiphakathi edibana laye kwa-Umgeni MDT. Yenza iziphelo ezifana ngemigaqo yezoLuntu kwabasebenzisi bezempilo yengqondo nasemaphandleni abo. Lungelelanise kwaye uzame iindibano. Nikela ngoluleko, inkxaso yoluntu, nolwazi ngemiba kumaphandle aphilayo anakekelwa abasebenzisi bezempilo yengqondo ngokuwaluka kwengqondo nangemininigxilileko yezempilo. Phucula iintsapho emva kokungenwa. Lungelelanisa iinkqubo zokuphuma. Yila kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokuphucula. Phucula ukubakho koluntu kumaphandle nangamaphakathi ukwenzela ulungelelaniso oluhle naLuntu nezigaba ezisebenzayo. Phucula igunya lemininigxilileko kwisiphakama sezoLuntu ezibalulekileyo ngokusesikweni.

jobs.summary: Professional Nurse position at Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick, requiring basic nursing qualification with psychiatric registration and no prior experience.

Basic R425 qualification (Degree/Diploma in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with South African Nursing Council as Professional Nurse with Psychiatric. Experience: No experience required. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles. Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Able to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations. Knowledge of nursing care delivery approaches and special interest in Psychiatric Nursing. Good communication skills, report writing skills, Facilitation skills, Coordination skills, Liaison skills, Networking skills, Problem solving skills. Information management, Knowledge management, Planning and Organizing. Computer Literacy. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety, Infection control, medical waste and risk assessment and Mental Health Care Act and team building and supervisory skills

Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and heath care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilize human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Perform a clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope pf practice and nursing standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope pf practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility and Nursing Act. Work as part of the multidisciplinary team to ensure good nursing care and work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural and racial or religious differences. Assist the unit manager with overall management and the necessary support for the effective functioning of the unit. Execute duties and functions with proficiency in support of the aims and strategic objective of the institution and provide nursing care that lends itself to improve service delivery and maintain accurate and complete patient records. Ensure proper utilization of human and material resources and liaise with multi-disciplinary team to ensure continuity of patient care and supervise the provision of nursing care services by the other categories of nursing staff. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives within the institution and outreach programmes. Assist with performance planning, monitoring and evaluation of staff. Promote the culture of ethics and professionalism within the nursing profession. Ensure provision of accurate statistical information for data management. Participating in CPD (Continuous Professional Development)

All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, however correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraints no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundiges (ALGEMENE Stroom)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige pos by Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick, wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met psigiatriese registrasie vereis en geen vooraf ervaring nie.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 of gelykwaardig. Basiese R425 kwalifikasie (Graad/Diploma in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as Professionele Verpleegkundige met Psigiatrie toelaat. Ervaring: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegwette, en ander tersaaklike regskader soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles. Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywer vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te voldoen. Kennis van verpleegsorgleweringbenaderings en spesiale belang in Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, koördinasievaardighede, skakelvaardighede, netwerkvaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur, kennisbestuur, beplanning en organisering. Rekenvaardigheid. Kennis van Occupational Health and Safety, infeksiebeheer, mediese afval en risikobepaling en Mental Health Care Act en spanbou en toesigvaardighede
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitsorg vir pasiënte. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder die gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit en Nursing Act. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker en werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele en rasse- of godsdienste verskille. Ondersteun die eenheidbestuurder met algehele bestuur en die nodige ondersteuning vir die effektiewe funksionering van die eenheid. Voer pligte en funksies uit met vaardigheid ter ondersteuning van die doelstellings en strategiese doelwitte van die instelling en verskaf verpleegsorg wat bydra tot verbeterde dienslewering en handhaaf akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike en materiële hulpbronne en skakel met die multidissiplinêre span om kontinuïteit van pasiëntsorg te verseker en hou toesig oor die voorsiening van verpleegsorgdienste deur die ander kategorieë van verpleegpersoneel. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming inisiatiewe binne die instelling en uitreikprogramme. Ondersteun met prestasiebeplanning, monitering en evaluering van personeel. Bevorder die kultuur van etiek en professionaliteit binne die verpleegprofessie. Verseker voorsiening van akkurate statistiese inligting vir databestuur. Deelneem aan CPD (Continuous Professional Development)

zu.title: Amanesi Aphanayo (Umthetho Jikelele)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNesi ophathekayo esibhedlela i-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital eHowick, sifuna isifundo esiyisiseko sokunakekelwa kokugula esibhaliswe ngokwegazi leengqondo futhi asikho isipiliyoni sangaphambili.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme noma iKhosi le-12 noma okulingana nalo. Isifundo esiyisiseko i-R425 (IDigri/IDiploma ekuqapheleni kokugula) noma isifundo esilingana nesifundo esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council njengengane ehlengelayo yokugula ehlengisa ngokwegazi leengqondo. Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Ulwazi kanye Namakhono: Ulwazi lwezenzo zokuqaphela kokugula kanye nemikhakha, izimiso zokunakekelwa, kanye namanye amakhulu amathemu okungomthetho anjengalawo: uMthetho Wabahlinzeki BempiIay, uMthetho Wezempilo, uMthetho Wezempilo kanye Nokuqinisekiswa Kolwazi Empilweni, Ikhadi Lamalungelo Yesiguli, Izimiso Zamasiko Asethnoni, Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi, uMthetho Wobudlelwano Basebenzi, Ikhodi Yokuhlolwa kanye Nenhlulelekile, Inhlulelekile Yezikhala. Bonisa ukuxhumana okuphindaphindwe kahle neziguli, abaphathi kanye nabanye osovo bokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukubhala umbhalo uma kudingeka. Ukulungele ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela umsebenzi wakho nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi osekela ukunakekelwa kokugula okuhle. Khombisa inkathi enkulu kubaguli, ukukhuthaza kanye nokukhuthaza ukunakekelwa nokwelashwa okuhle okuhlanganisa ukuzwela kanye nokulungele ukuphendula izidingo, imfuneko kanye nezethemba zesiguli. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokuqaphela kokugula ezitholakalayo kanye nentshisekelo ekhetheyile ekuqapheleni kokugula ngokwegazi leengqondo. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, amakhono okubhala umbhalo, amakhono okusiza, amakhono okuqondanisa, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okuxhuma, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuhlela kanye Nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lwezempilo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi, ukulawulwa kokutheleleka, ukulahleka kokwelashwa kanye nokuqapha ubungozi kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Zengqondo nokwakhiwa kweqembu kanye namakhono okuhlola
zu.duties: Nikela iziqondiso kanye nenhlulelekile ekusebenzeni inhlelo yokunakekelwa kokugula (umkhakha wezempilo/ukunakekelwa okuhle kwesiguli. Qamba izindinganiso, amasiko, imigomo nemiboniso yezokunakekelwa okuhle kwezokunakekelwa (izinga lokwensekela). Zinza ukunakekelwa kokugula kanye nezenzo zezempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho kanye nemithetho elawula ukunakekelwa kokugula kanye nezenzo zezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuqotho bokusebenza nabonakekelwa kanye nabanye abahlengikazi. Sebenzisa izinsizakalo zendalo, izinto kanye nezinsiza ezingokomzimba ngokuphindaphindeka nangokusebenza. Zinza umkhakha wezokunakekelwa kokugula ngokuvumelana nekheli lokwensekela kanye nezindinganiso zokunakekelwa njengoba kulinjwe yisikhungo sezempilo esithintekile. Khuthaza izinga lokunakekelwa kokugula njengoba kuqondiswa yikheli lokwensekela kanye nezindinganiso njengoba kulinjwe yisikhungo sezempilo esithintekile kanye noMthetho Wabahlinzeki BempiIay. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu eliningi amakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kokugula kanye nokusebenza ngokuphindaphindeka, ngokubambisana futhi ngokuzwana nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, njengoba kukhona ngamasiko, izinkolo noma izinhlanga ezingafani. Siza umphathi weyunithi ngokuphatha konke okudingekayo kanye nezinsiza eziyimfuneko ukuze iyunithi isebenze ngokuphindaphindeka. Zenza imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngokuphindaphindeka ekusizeni amagugu kanye nenhloso yenhlelomgomo yesikhungo kanye nokunikeza ukunakekelwa kokugula okukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwesevisi kanye nokugcina imibhalo egcwele futhi elungele yeziguli. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile kwendalo kanye nezinsizakalo ezithintekayo futhi uxhumane neqembu eliningi amakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa kwesiguli kanye nokuhlola izinsiza ezinikezelwa ekunakekelweni kokugula ezinikezwa izigaba ezinye zabasebenzi bokuqaphela kokugula. Thatha inxaxheba ekukhuthazeni ezempilo kanye nokuvinjelwa kokugula ngaphakathi kwesikhungo kanye namaphrojekhi okuqhubele phambili. Siza ngekheli lokuhlela, ukuqapha nokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi. Khuthaza isiko lokuziphatha kahle kanye nobugcosa emkhakheni wokunakekelwa kokugula. Qinisekisa ukunikezelwa kolwazi olulungele ngezibalo ekulawulweni kolwazi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni amakhono (ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwamakhono).

xh.title: Oongqondo bokuhlola (General Stream)
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuhlola komngqondi kumGeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital eHowick, sifuna izifundo ezisisiseko zokuhlola kunye nokubhaliswa njengongqondo bexeshu lokuhlola ingqondo kwaye akukho mava efunekayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiPhezulu/IBhedi 12 okanye esingenayo. Isifundo esisisiseko seR425 (IDigri/IDiploma kokuhlola) okanye isifundo esingenayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council njengongqondi bokuhlola iPsychiatric. Iimvakalelo: Akukho mva efunekayo. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi lwamasinkelo nemiqathango yokunikelwa konakekelo lokuhlola, izigaba ezithile zokuhlola, nolunye ulwazi olumelelolona olunjengalwesi: iNursing Act, iHealth Act, iOccupational Health and Safety Act, iPatients Right Charter, iBatho Pele Principles; Izicwangciso zePublic Service Regulations, iLabour Relations Act, iDisciplinary Code and Procedure, iGrievance Procedure. Bonisa ukunyaniseka kwexesha kunye nabaguli, ootitshala kunye nabanye oongqondi bokuhlola, kuquka nezibhalo zangaphambi kwexesha xa kufuneka. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa ngokwendalo nakwelinye iqela lamagosa ahlukaneyo ukonakalisa amava okunikelwa konakekelo lokuhlola. Bonisa ingatho ngabaguli nokukhuthaza nokuvakalisa ngokuphathwa kakuhle nabaguli nakunyamezela iimfuno zabo; Ulwazi olunamava ngamathuba okwazi neengqalelo ekuphathweni kwesisu nokuhlinzwa ngakumbi ngokweliswa kweNyanga yokuhlola ingqondo. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelela, amava okubhala iirepothi, amava okukhuthaza, amava okuhlanganisa, amava okusebenzisana, amava okuzonxulumana, amava okusombulula iingxaki; Ulwazi oluhle ngendlela yokulawula ulwazi, ulwazi olulula ngokucwangcisa ngakumbi nokuqwalasela iinkqubo nendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela.
xh.duties: Nikezela iziqondiso nolawulo kumisebenzi yokwenza isicwangciso sokuhlinza (isigaba sokwenziwa komthetho/ukhathalo lokunikelwa komthetho kubaguli.; Zonke izindalo, iinkqubo namagunya ayo akuqhutywe ngokobuchule bokuhlinza. Gcina uloqhawe lwemisebenzi nolunye uqhagamshelo njengesinyathelo somthetho olukhoyo. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto ezithileyo nengqoleleko ngokuchanekileyo nangokuza kwangaphambili; Phefumlela kwangoku kwamagunya amakhulu okubakho, igalelo lokunikezela kolwazi onjengamanqanaba athile alingana ukubakho kolwazi kunye nobugcisa obuyinkqubo, nokugcina ulwazi olunika isaziso kubakho kolwazi; Kubakho kolwazi oluzoza kubakho kolwazi ngokwamathuba amathathu akuwo namathuba okubakho kolwazi.

jobs.title: Physiotherapy Technician
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R279 870 - R317 880 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Medical Aid and Housing Allowance optional (employee must meet prescribed requirements) CENTRE              Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital: Howick
jobs.summary: Physiotherapy Technician sought at Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric facility to provide limited physiotherapy services to mental health care users under supervision of a registered physiotherapist.
jobs.requirements: Standard 8 (Grade 10). Physiotherapy Assistant diploma Physiotherapy Technician upgrade or 2-year Physiotherapy Technician diploma. HPCSA registration as a Physiotherapy Technician. Knowledge And Skills: Sound knowledge of all facets of physiotherapy related policies and practices as well as other relevant hospital and Department of Health policies and practices, sound knowledge of HPCSA guidelines and Code of Conduct. Sound knowledge of clinical Physiotherapy theory, practice and ethics, therapeutic procedures and use of therapeutic equipment. Knowledge of the condition and treatment of Intellectual Disability with associated physical disabilities. Good clinical skills in Physiotherapy within basic scope of practice as a Physiotherapy Technician. Good verbal and written communication skills, time management and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and within limited resources. Special ability to interact with patients with intellectual disability and associated physical disabilities and behavioural problems. Basic ability to co-ordinate, plan and organize with minimal guidance. Willing to learn and develop, open to correction and guidance.
jobs.duties: Provide a limited Physiotherapy service to Mental Health Care Users according to physiotherapy professional standards of practice and within scope of practice. Conduct basic assessments, carry out treatment in consultation with a registered Physiotherapist and provide feedback regarding patient progress. Educate and train patients on use of assistive devices. Assist physiotherapists with treatment sessions and preparing treatment areas. Be responsible for the maintenance and monitoring of physical resources, assist with monthly stock take, assist in maintaining a neat and organized stockroom. To perform administrative functions as directed by supervisor. Ensure daily capturing of statistics of own caseload and timeous submission to supervisor. Compile reports as required. Assist with relevant clinics as delegated. Participate in health promotion and education and in-service training at institutional and community level. Participate in activities directed at improving the quality of physiotherapy service delivery including audits and implementation of QIPs. Participate in monthly departmental meetings. Serve as a physiotherapy representative on various relevant committees as allocated by supervisor. Ensure attendance of relevant training to obtain the number of CEUs determined by HPCSA to ensure continued HPCSA membership and to ensure personal and professional growth and development. Maintain healthy professional relationships with clients and staff.

af.title: Fisioterapietegnikus
af.summary: Fisioterapietegnikus gesoek by Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric-fasiliteit om beperkte fisioterapiedienste aan geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers onder toesig van 'n geregistreerde fisioterapeut te verskaf.
af.requirements: Standaard 8 (Graad 10). Fisioterapie-assistent diploma Fisioterapietegnikus-opgradering of 2-jaar Fisioterapietegnikus-diploma. HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Fisioterapietegnikus. Kennis en vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van alle aspekte van fisioterapie-verwante beleide en praktyke sowel as ander relevante hospitaal- en Departement van Gesondheid-beleide en praktyke, deeglike kennis van HPCSA-riglyne en Gedragskode. Deeglike kennis van kliniese fisioterapieteorie, -praktyk en -etiek, terapeutiese prosedures en gebruik van terapeutiese toerusting. Kennis van die toestand en behandeling van intellektuele gestremdheid met geassosieerde fisiese gestremdhede. Goeie kliniese vaardighede in fisioterapie binne basiese omvang van praktyk as 'n Fisioterapietegnikus. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, tydsbestuur en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk en met beperkte hulpbronne te werk. Spesiale vermoë om met pasiënte met intellektuele gestremdheid en geassosieerde fisiese gestremdhede en gedragsprobleme om te gaan. Basiese vermoë om met minimale leiding te koördineer, te beplan en te organiseer. Gewillig om te leer en te ontwikkel, oop vir korreksie en leiding.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n beperkte fisioterapiediens aan Geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers volgens fisioterapie-professionele praktykstandaarde en binne die omvang van praktyk. Voer basiese assesserings uit, voer behandeling uit in oorleg met 'n geregistreerde Fisioterapeut en verskaf terugvoer aangaande pasiëntvooruitgang. Edukeer en lei pasiënte oor die gebruik van hulptoestelle. Help fisioterapeute met behandelingsessies en die voorbereiding van behandelingsareas. Wees verantwoordelik vir die instandhouding en monitering van fisiese hulpbronne, help met maandelikse voorraadopname, help om 'n netjiese en georganiseerde voorraadkamer te handhaaf. Voer administratiewe funksies uit soos deur toesighouer gerig. Verseker daaglikse vaslegging van statistieke van eie gevallewerk en tydige voorlegging aan toesighouer. Stel verslae op soos vereis. Help met relevante klinieke soos gedelegeer. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en -opvoeding en indiensopleiding op instellings- en gemeenskapsvlak. Neem deel aan aktiwiteite wat gemik is op die verbetering van die gehalte van fisioterapiedienslewering, insluitend oudits en implementering van QIP's. Neem deel aan maandelikse departementele vergaderings. Dien as 'n fisioterapie-verteeenwoordiger op verskeie relevante komitees soos deur toesighouer toegewys. Verseker bywoning van relevante opleiding om die aantal CEU's wat deur HPCSA bepaal is te verkry om voortgesette HPCSA-lidmaatskap te verseker en om persoonlike en professionele groei en ontwikkeling te verseker. Handhaaf gesonde professionele verhoudings met kliënte en personeel.

zu.title: Ithekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba
zu.summary: Kufunwa ithekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba esikhungweni sezomondo sase-Umgeni ukunikeza izinkonzo ezigxekiwe zokwelapha ngokomzimba kubasebenzisi bezokunakekela impilo yengqondo ngaphansi kolawulo katherepisti eqeqeshiwe ebhalisiwe.
zu.requirements: I-Standards 8 (i-Grade 10). Isitifikadi sesisebenzi sesiPhakeme sokwelapha ngokomzimba, ukuthuthukiswa kweThekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba noma isitifikadi sezinhanga eziyi-2 seThekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeThekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi olujulile ngezinkinga zonke ezihlobene nemigomo nemitapo yolwazi yokwelapha ngokomzimba kanye nezinye imigomo nemitapo yolwashi ehlobene nesibhedlela kanye namagatsha oMnyango Wezempilo, kanye nolwazi olujulile ngemihlahlandlela le-HPCSA nomthethosisekelo wokuziphatha. Ulwazi olujulile ngokwetheori, umthetho wokuziphatha kanye nokusebenza kokuhlinzeka kwesikhathi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezisetshenziswayo ekwelapheni. Ulwazi ngomumo wokukhubazeka kokuhlakanipha phakathi kanye nokukhubazeka komzimba okuhlotshanisiwe. Amakhono amahle okuhlinzeka ngokwelapha ngokomzimba ngaphakathi kogalo oluqeqeshwe lokusebenza njengeThekinikha yokwelapha ngokomzimba. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala, ukuphatha isikhathi namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphezulu komthwalo nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwemithombo ekhawulelwe. Ikhono elikhethekile lokuxhumana nabagulane abanokukhubazeka kokuhlakanipha nokukhubazeka komzimba okuhlotshanisiwe kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ikhono elisisekelo sokuhlanganisa, ukucubungula futhi uhlele ngaphandle kokuqondiswa okuncane. Ukuzonda ukufunda nokuzithuthukisa, ukuthatha iziyalo nokubhekana nokuqondiswa.
zu.duties: Yinkeza inkonzo egxekiwe yokwelapha ngokomzimba kubasebenzisi Bezokunakekela Impilo Yengqondo ngokuvumelana nemigomo yezobungcweti yokusebenza kwesoqulu esihlinzelayo ngokomzimba kanye ngaphakathi kwenhloso yokusebenza. Yenza ukuvivinyo okusisekelo, ukwelapha ngokubonisana noTherapista ebhalisiwe futhi unikeze umbiko ngomsebenzi weziguli. Fundisa futhi uqeqeshe abagulane ngokusetyenziswa kwamadivayisi asizayo. Siza otharepista ukwelapha ngokumiswa kwemikhosi yokwelapha nokulungiselela izindawo zokwelapha. Ube nomthwalo wokugcina nokulinda izinto zomzimba ongakeqwa, usize kumtholampilo wanyanga zonke, usize ukugcina futhi uhlele ibhulwe elsicini kakhulu. Yemisebenzi yokuphatha ngokwezwi somqondisi bese iyalelwa. Qiniseka ukuthi izibalo zegalaji yakho zitholakala nsuku zonke futhi zithunyelwe kumqondisi ngesikhathi esifanele. Hlanganisa imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Siza kumtholampilo ohlobene njengoba kumele. Hlanganyela ekukhuthazeni impilo kanye nokufundisa kanye noqeqeshe olungaphandle kwesikhungo nasemmigwaqeni. Hlanganyela emisebenzini ehlotshanisiwe nokwenza ngcono izinga lenkonzo yokwelapha ngokomzimba kuhlanganise ukuhlola nokuthumela okuncane ngokusebenza kwe-QIPs. Hlanganyela emihlanganweni yamnyango yanyanga zonke. Zithathe njengesithunywa soqeqesho lwabasebenzi bakho kumakomidi ahlobene njengoba kukalwa umqondisi. Qiniseka ukuhlanganyela emiqeqeshweni ehlobene ukuze uthole inani lezinkomba ezinqunyiwe yi-HPCSA ukuze uqinisekise ukuhlala uyilunga le-HPCSA nokuthuthukiswa kokuzithuthukisa komuntu siqu kanye nangobuchwepheshe. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabathengi kanye nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedi we-Physiotherapy
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumncedi we-Physiotherapy kumaziko aKwa-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric ukunika iinkonzo zephysiotherapy ezilinganiselwe kubasebenzisi bengkonzo yempilo yengqondo phantsi kolawulo logqitha we-physiotherapy obhalisiweyo.
xh.requirements: I-Standard 8 (I-Grade 10). I-diploma yomncedi we-Physiotherapy Assistant okanye uphuculo lwe-Physiotherapy Technician okanye i-diploma yomncedi we-Physiotherapy yeminyaka emi-2. Ukuqesha kwi-HPCSA njengomncedi we-Physiotherapy. Ulwazi nemisebenzi yezandla: Ulwazi olulunjiyo ngazo zonke iinkqubo namagatya njengoko kuchazwa kumagatya aphathelene nophysiotherapy nakwezinye iinkquba namagatya ezibhedlele nesebe lezeempilo. Ulwazi olunjiyo ngemiqathango yomthetho we-HPCSA neKhowudi yokuziphatha. Ulwazi olulunjiyo ngokweliso lokwelapha ngokusebenzisa i-Physiotherapy, inkqubo ngokwelapha nengqungquthela yamalungelo, iinkqubo zokwelapha nokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokwelapha. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezithile zokuphathwa nokwelaphwa kwe-Intellectual Disability ngokuhambelana nokuphathwa komzimba. Iziqu ezilungileyo ekuvelisa imisebenzi yephysiotherapy ngokulandela imigaqo nokuqonda ubugcisa bosetyenziso olulinganiselwe njengoko kuyimfuno kumncedi we-Physiotherapy. Isakhono esilungileyo sokuzithetha nokubhala, ulawulo lwexesha nokuqamba iisixaziso. Isakhono sokusebenza ngocinezelo lokungenisa nenkcitha ezingahlawulelwayo. Isakhono esithileyo sokunxibelelana nabaguli abanokuphathwa ngokungalathi ngengqondo nokusilela emzimbeni nengxaki ezingokuziphatha. Isakhono esisisiseko sokulungisa, ulungelelwaniso nemisebenzi ehlelewayo ngencedo encinane. Ukoluleka ukufunda nokuziphucula ukwamkela isixixo nenkuthazo.
xh.duties: Unike iinkonzo zephysiotherapy ezilinganiselwe kubasebenzisi beNkonzo yezeMpilo eNgqondweni ngokumiselwa kwemigaqo yemisebenzi yamagqirha kwaye ulandela imigaqo yawo wonke umsebenzi wakho. Yenza ukuvavanya okusesiseko unikezelwe ngokubonisana negqirha lika-Physiotherapist kunye nokubuyisela ingxelo ngentshukumo yomntu. Fundisa kwaye ulathe abaguli ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ezincedayo. Nceda ophysiotherapist kwii-sessions zokwelapha kwaye ulungiselela iindawo zokwelapha. Yiba nomganyelo ekusingathweni nokuphawulweni kwezibonelelo ezingokomzimba nceda ngenkundla yamanye amanye ukuthatha kwisitoreji kwaye ugcine izitoreji zicocekile kwaye zihleleke. Yenza imisebenzi yophalalise njengoko alawulwa ngumlawuli wakho. Qinisekisa ukubhala i-data yemisebenzi yawo wonke umhla kwaye uze uyinike umlawuli wakho ngenjabulo. Hlela iingxelo njengoko kufunwa. Nceda ngeekliniki ezahlukeneyo njengoko kulawuliwe. Thatha inxaxheba kulwazi olukhuthazwayo ngempilo nolwandiso lweenkqubo zolwazi kweziko nakuluntu. Thatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi ekulungelelwaneni ukuphuculwa kweNkonzo yamagqirha aphathelene nophysiotherapy kubandakanya o-Audits no-QIPs ezifunwa kwenziwe. Thatha inxaxheba kwintlanganiso yamanye amanye yesebe. Yiba ngumela we-Physiotherapy kumagatya ahlukeneyo njengoko akhethwe ngumlawuli. Qinisekisa ukuzithutha kuluntu kubandakanya i-CEUs ezibalulwa yi-HPCSA ukugcina ulwazi lwe-HPCSA kwaye ukhule ngobuqu nokwazi ukwazi imisebenzi yakho. Gcina uluhlu olukhulu nomzozzi wakho nabathengi bakho kwaye nabasebenzi.

af.summary: Geregistreerde verpleegkundiges word benodig by Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in Howick om basiese kliniese psigiatriese verpleegsorg onder toesig te verskaf.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 of gelykwaardig. Ingeskrewe verpleegsertifikaat wat registrasie by die SANC as ingeskryfde verpleegkundige toelaat. Ervaring: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgeprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante wetlike raamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure. Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Goeie kommunikasie, skryf-, fasiliterings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Basiese begrip van kliniese verpleegsorg binne 'n gespesialiseerde eenheid.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntesorgplan. Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg binne die psigiatriese eenheid onder toesig. Doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Handhaaf pasiënthigiëne, gerief en veiligheid. Neem waar en rapporteer veranderings in pasiënttoestand. Handhaaf akkurate rekords en verslae. Verseker nakoming van infeksievoorkoming en beheerstandaarde. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om gehalte pasiëntesorg te verseker.

zu.title: Oanesheliwe Abonghlaza
zu.summary: Abonghlaza ohanjisiwe badingeka esibhedlela i-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital e-Howick ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha kwengqondo ngaphansi kolawulo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior Certificate/Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. Isitifikedi sokuhlonza ezingadi esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengonghlaza ohanjisiwe. Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi lwezinqubo nezindlela zokunakekelwa kwezingadi, izimiso zokunakekelwa kwezingadi, nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisanayo ezinjengezo: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure. Ulwazi lwezimiso nomthetho we-SANC. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, okubhala, okuqondisa nokuhlale nomuntu. Ikono lokusebenza kahle njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene elinemikhakha eminingi. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kwezingadi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo esikhethekile.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha uhlelo oluyisisekelo lokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha kwezingadi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sezokwelapha kwengqondo ngaphansi kolawulo. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngempumelelo. Ukugcina ukukhula ngomsebenzi/izinga zokuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. Ukugcina izinhlanzi, ukuphila nokuhamba kahle kwesiguli. Ukubukela futhi ukubika izinguquko ezimeni yesiguli. Ukugcina amarekhodi namabiko aqukethe inqanaba oluphakeme. Ukuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka ngamagciwano.

xh.title: Oonese Babhalisiweyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe kuso Oonese Babhalisiweyo kwi-Hospital ye-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric e-Howick ukuze banikeze elona nqanaba lisiseko lonakeko lweempilo zenkqubo yopoko phantsi kolawulo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12 okuba yinto eleyileyo. Isatifikethi Sokubhaliswa kweZokunyesa esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SABC njengonese Othunyiweyo. Ulwazi: Akukho lwazi luziwayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nezendlela zonakeko lwezempilo, ngemithetho yonakeko loyilo, nangemigaqo ezinye engqamlezleyo efana ne-: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, iBatho Pele Principles, iPublic Service Regulations, iLabour Relations Act, iDisciplinary Code and Procedure, iGrievance Procedure. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo ye-SANC. Amakhono abalulekileyo okuthetha nokubhala, okukhokela iinkomfa, nabantu abanomdla. Ikwat ingcapable yokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo njengenxalenye yeqela elinabasebenzi bezigaba ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqonda okusesingeneni ngenqanaba elingundoqo lonakeko lwezempilo ngaphakathi kwuniti ekhethekileyo.
xh.duties: Inkqulo nokusebenzisa iplani elingundoqo yonakeko lwegazi lenmama. Ukunika inqanaba elisesiseko lonakeko lwezempilo ngaphakathi kwesitudiyo se-psychiatric phantsi kolawulo. Ukusebenzisa amacebo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukugcina intshukela yobugcisa/iizinga zokuziphatha nokuziphumelela. Ukugcina ukhuseleko, kolunye nelondolozo lenmama. Ukuqapha nokuba nikuxelele iinguqu ezikwindlela yobugcisa bendalo yenmama. Ukugcina iingxelo ezichanekileyo nezicatshulweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yokutshabalalisa nokulawula iinfeksiyo. Ukusebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elinabasebenzi bezigaba ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba kuye kubekho nakeko elingundoqo lenmama.
