af.title: Ingeskryfde Verpleegassistent
af.summary: Ingeskryfde Verpleegassistant gesoek vir Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg verskaf en pasiënte help met daaglikse lewensaktiwiteite.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 of gelykwaardig. Nursing Assistant-sertifikaat wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council toelaat. Ervaring: Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele-beginsels. Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure. Elementêre kommunikasievaardighede. Elementêre skryfvaardighede. Vermoë om as deel van 'n span te funksioneer. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kennis van die omvang van praktyk van 'n Ingeskryfde Verpleegassistent. Vermoë om gestruktureerde take onder direkte en indirekte toesig van 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige uit te voer. Empatie, sensitiwiteit en dryfkrag vir uitnemendheid. Kennis van SANC-reëls en -regulasies. Kennis van Gedragskode en Arbeidsverhoudinge. Vaardighede in die organiseer en beplanning van geskeduleerde pligte.
af.duties: Help pasiënte met aktiwiteite van daaglike lewe (fisiese sorg). Verskaf elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg. Onderhou professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Verskaffing van gehalte-verpleegsorg deur die implementering van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Om by verpleegsorgplanne te hou en die implementering daarvan te verseker. Handhaaf die Batho Pele- en Patients’ Rights Charter-beginsels. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese omgewing soos uiteengesit deur die Nursing Act, Occupational Health and Safety en alle ander toepaslike voorskrifte. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords volgens regsvereistes en omvang van praktyk. Verseker effektiewe benutting van alle hulpbronne. Hou by Infeksiebeheer- en -voorkomingsprotokolle. Voer pligte en funksies binne die omvang van praktyk uit. Om elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg te verskaf. Help om pasiënte na ander hospitale te vergesel. Om pligte met vaardigheid uit te voer binne die voorskrifte van toepaslike wetgewing en die doel en doelstellings van die instelling te ondersteun. Om die Operational Manager te help om 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing te verskaf. Om kliëntetevredenheid deur gehaltdienslewering te handhaaf. Om higiënebehoeftes van pasiënte te handhaaf en bystand aan alle spanlede te verleen. Verskaf gesondheidsopvoeding volgens kennis en omvang van praktyk

zu.title: Umncedi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Obhalisiwe
zu.summary: Kufunwa umncedi wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo obhalisiwe ohamba esibhedlela i-Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, onikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo futhi asize iziguli emisebenzini yansuku zonke.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 noma okufana nalokho. Isitifiketi sokuba ngumncedi wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council. Isipiliyoni: Akukho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nezinqubo zokunakekelwa kwezokunuringa, izimiso zezokunuringa, kanye namanye amakhalwe ezomthetho ahambisana nalokhu njengoba kukhona: i-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Patients Right Charter, izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Imithethonqubo yesebenza kahulumeni, i-Labour Relations Act, iKhodiye Nesinqubo Yokuhlwayo, Inqubo Yezikhalazo. Amakhono okuxhumana ayisisekelo. Amakhono okubhala ayisisekelo. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu. Amakhono abantu. Ulwazi ngebanga lokwenza umsebenzi womncedi wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo obhalisiwe. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi eyisakhiwo ngaphansi kolawulo oluya phambili nangaphandle kuka-Nesi Obhalisiwe. Ukuzwelana, ukuzwela nokuzifunela ukuphumelela. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemiqondo ye-SANC. Ulwazi lwekhodi yokuziphatha nobuququmbela. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele imisebenzi eshiselwe.
zu.duties: Usiza iziguli emisebenzini yansuku zonke (ukunakekelwa komzimba). Unikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo. Ugcina ukukhula ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo/izimo ezomthetho nokuziphucula. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokunuringa okulingeneyo ngokuqaliswa kwezimo, izinqubo nemithethonqubo. Ukuhambisana nokugunyaza ukusebenza kwezinhlela zokunakekelwa kwezokunuringa. Ugcine izimiso ze-Batho Pele ne-Patients’ Rights Charter. Unikeza indawo ephephile, eyaphilisa njengoba kushiwo yi-Nursing Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety kwaye nakho konke okunye okuhunyushwe ngomthetho. Ugcina amarekhodi aziguli aphelele futhi eqinisekisiwe ngokwezidingo zomthetho kanye nebanga lomsebenzi. Uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kothise wonke amatholwane. Ulanda imikhuba nokuvinjelwa kokutheleleka. Uqhuba imisebenzi nomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwebanga lomsebenzi. Unikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo. Usiza ukululeka iziguli kumanye amabheshi. Uqhuba imisebenzi ngokuphumelela ngaphakathi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho ophathekayo futhi usekela inhloso namagebe esikhungo. Usiza umphathi wezokusebenza ukuthi anikeze indawo ephephile futhi eyaphilisa. Ugcina ukwaneliseka klayenti ngokulethwa kwesevisi emahle. Ugcina izidingo zokuhlanzeka zeziguli futhi anikeza usizo kuyo yonke imiqondo yeqembu. Unikeza ezemfundo yezempilo ngokwelwazi nangebanga lomsebenzi

xh.title: Ingcini yokuBhalisa kwiZemphi ekaRhulumente
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNgcini yokuBhalisa kwiZemphi ekaRhulumente yeSibhedlele iNgcibi ekuhlaleni i Umgeni Specialized Psychiatric Hospital, e KwaZulu-Natal, ukunika ukhathalo lokuqeqesha kolunye lweemphi ezincinane kwaye nceda abaguli kwimisebenzi yansuku zonke.
xh.requirements: Iqinisekiso leNqanaba le-12 okanye isiqinisekiso esalinganayo naleso. Iqinisekiso leNgcini elivumela ukubhalisa kwi South African Nursing Council. Iqinisekiso: Akukho nako akubalulekanga. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngokwenziwa kolunye lweemphi nezixelo, izigaba zeemphi, nezinye iinkqubo zamaza-ngoko esifanekisayo. Isakhono seemphi esincinane nangokubhala. Isakhono sokusebenza njengesinye isiqu senkundla. Isakhono sabantu. Ulwazi lobukhosi beemphi kunye nabanye abantu. Isakhono sokwenza imisebenzi exeliwe ngaphantsi kolawulo oluthe ngqo nolungalutho lwabhalisiweyo. Isakhono sokuvakalelwa, umonde nokuqonda iimfuno zabantu. Ulwazi lobuqu buka Rhulumente weNgcini.
xh.duties: Kunceda abaguli ngokwenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke (ukunika ukhathalo). Kuthi ke kubakho isakhono sokuphuhlisa iinkqubo zokhathalelo lokubakho kolunye lweemphi. zu.title: Umphathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Othwebule Kulinga A-C
zu.summary: Umnyango we Human Settlements ufuna Abaphathi Bephrojekthi Yokwakha Abathwebule Kulinga kumakhula amasifunda e KwaZulu-Natal ukuphatha futhi uhlele zonke izindaba zephrojekthi zamakhaya.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma isitifiketi esilinganayo. I-National Higher Diploma (endaweni ye-Built Environment) nobuhlobo bonywanga osukwini abayisikhombisa ohlolwe njengoba ngumPhathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Othwebule Kulinga, NGE i-BTech (endaweni ye-Built Environment) nobuhlobo bonywanga ohlolwe ohlele njengoba ngumphathi, NGE iziqu ze-Honours kunoma iyiphi indawo ye-Built Environment nobuhlobo bonywana abathathu obuhlobene. Ukuqanjiswa nge-SACPCMP njengengXenye yomPhathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Othwebule Kulinga esikhathini sokwamukelwa kuyasinyatela. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambisana. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuqhotho: Ulwazi ngemigomo nangomthetho we Human Settlements, amakhono ohlela izinhlelo, imigomo nendlela yokwenza imisebenzi yephrojekthi, ulwazi ngocwaningo nangomthuthukiswa, izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha ekwakheni, ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho nangokumayelana nendlela nemigomo yembona yokwakha, ukubhala imibiko yobugigwa, ukwakha isiko lokusebenza kakuhle, ukubuka ubugigwa nokwahlulela ngokuthwebule. Amakhono okuqumisa izinqumo. Amakhono okubeka ihlela iqembu. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okudala. Amakhono okuzibusa. Amakhono okuphatha imali yephrojekthi. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokuphendula. Amakhono okukhulumisana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono ohlela nokuqamba. Amakhono okulawula izinxaxhe. Ixazulula izinkinga futhi uhlaziye. Amakhono okulawula abantu. Ulwazi ngoPublic Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management Regulations nangayi inkqubo yokuthenga. Ulwazi ngokuPhatha Isivumelwano nokuLawula Isivumelwano.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlele zonke izindaba zephrojekthi ngokuthi:- Holisa ukuhlela iphrojekthi, ukwenza, ukulandelela, ukubika nokuqokomisa ngokuhambisana nendlela yokwenza imisebenzi yephrojekthi; Dala futhi uqibe izinhlela zokusebenza zephrojekthi ushintshe njengoba kufanele ukuze uhambisane nezidingo ezishintshayo; Qinise izinsiza ezidingekayo bese unikeza abantu ubuncwazi bezindima zabo; Lawula izindaba zangemini ngemini eziphathelene nephrojekthi bese ubuka isibonakaliso; Futhi usebenzise ngenkalo ndlela yokwenza imisebenzi bese uphoqa imigisa yephrojekthi ukuze unciphise ingozi kumaphrojekthi. Ukwabalazisa nokulawula imali yephrojekthi ngokuthi: Bika inqubo yephrojekthi kuPhathi Omkhulu Wephrojekthi Yokwakha, bese uLawula amabhajethi nezinsiza zephrojekthi. Ukulawula Ihhovisi ngokuthi: Nikeza okufakwe ngabanye abathwebule abangemukela / ukugcinwa kwebhajethi; Xhumana uthintane nabahlinzeka ngeminsiza, nabathengi baphethe; Nikela ekubeni ingxenye yabantu imisebenzi ehlobene; Gcina inkqubo yokubhalisa imibhalo nangomtapo oluzulazula ophelele; Futhi usebenzise ngokuphumelelayo izinsiza ezinikelwe. Ukucwaningo nomPhakamiso ngokuthi: Landela izitayela ezintsha zezobuchwepheshe nemigudu; Cwaninga/ imibhalo ngophakamiso olusha endleleni yokwenza imisebenzi yephrojekthi; Futhi xhumana namahlelo / namakhonza amayelana nokuPhatha Iphrojekthi.

xh.summary: Isebe loZozo Lwabantu lifuna abaPhathi Bezaphakamiso Zokwakha Oyingcalani kumazana amaninzi eKwaZulu-Natal ukuba balawule balungelelanise onke amacala amaphakathi kwaphakathi kwamaphakamiso okwakha amakhaya.

Amandla okwenza iigqibo. Amandla okukhokela iqela. Amandla okuhlola. Amandla okudala. Amandla okuzilawula. Amandla okulawula imali ephathe kwindalo yaphakamiso. Uqwalaselo kumthengi nempendulo. Amandla ekunxibelelaneni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuqamba. Amandla okulawula iingxabano. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki nohlolojlovo. Amandla okulawula abantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act, umthetho we-Municipal Finance Management Act, i-Supply Chain Management Regulations neendlela zokuthenga. Ulwazi ngokuLawula Amayile nokuLawulwa kweMisebenzi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ulungelelanise onke amacala amaphakamiso ngokwala:- Ukukhokela uqwalaselo lwakho, ukuphumeza, ukulandelela, ukwenza iingxelo nokuqwalasela ngokwala iinkqubo zokulawula amaphakamiso; Ukudala ukuphumeza iinqcinenba zomsebenzi waphakamiso zize zilungwe ngokufanelekileyo ukuze zihambelane neemfuno ezishintshiyo; Ukuqonda izixhobo ezingfunekayo unike umntu ngamnye iimanyano ezakhe; Ukulawula iinkalo ezize ngemini zomsebenzi waphakamiso nolwalelo; kwaye usebenzise ngempumelelo iinkqubo uze uyiqinise iinkqubo zophakamiso ukuze unciphise ingozi kumaphakamiso. Ukubala imali yokwakha nokulawula imali ngeendlela: Ukwenza iingxelo ngaphambili kwaphakamiso kuMphathi Wamaphakamiso Okwakha Oyintloko, kwaye Ulawule imigca yemali kunye nezixhobo zomsebenzi. Ukulawulwa kwe-Ofisi ngeendlela: Ukubonelela ngeengcalani ngesixhobo sokulawula iintengiso/okuthenga; Uxhobelelane nodibane nababoneleli, namathengi nakulawulo; Unike ngokuhambisana nabalulekile bemiba ehambelana nabantu abambelelayo; Ugcine inkqubo yokulawula iirekhodi kunye nendawo yokugcina iimpawu zokwakha; kwaye Usebenzise izixhobo ezabelwe ngempumelelo. Uphando nokuQhubela Phambili ngeendlela: Zama ugcine ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe olutsha ngeendlela: Uphando/novimba lwamagama ngezinto ezintsha ezithethwa ngolu hambu ngokulawula amaphakamiso: kwaye Uxhobelelane namagunya/amarhulu ahambelana nokulawula amaphakamiso.

Ukubhalisa okuyimpoqo ne-SACPCMP njenge-Nkomba Ephathwa Nayo Yomklamo Wokwakha ngosuku lokuthunyelwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono Kwaye Nawe: Ulwazi ngemigomo kwaye nemithetho yokubuyiselwa kwabantu, amakhono okulawula uhlelo, izinsiza zokulawula imiklamo nendlela zokuqashwa, ulwazi ngokuvulwa kolwazi kwaye nokuqashwa, izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha ezisiza kwezokwakha, ulwazi ngemithetho evumelana nenqubo yokwakha kwaye nemicu, ukubhala amabiko obuchwepheshe, ukwakha isiko elikhulu lokusebenza kahle, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe kwaye nesinqumo sezobuchwepheshe. Amakhono okwenza isinqumo. Amakhono okuhola iqembu. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono ekuqamba. Amakhono okuzilawula. Amakhono okuphatha imali ehlobene nomklamo. Ukugxila kubathengi kwaye ukuphendula. Amakhono okuxhumana. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhonookuqamba nokuhlela. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kwaye ukuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuPhatha Imali Yoluntu, umthetho wokuPhatha Imali Yasemadolobheni, Imithetho YokuPhatha Ikhondo Lokuhlinzeka kwaye nendlela zokuthenga. Ulwazi ngokuPhatha Isivumelwano kwaye ngokuBusa Isivumelwano.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlobole ngokuhlangenwe nakho konke mayelana nemiklamo ngokwegatsha:- Hola ukulethwa kwemiklamo, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi, ukuqapha, ukubika nokuhlola ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokuphatha imiklamo; Akha futhi ugcube amaphulani omsebenzi womklamo ubuye uwahlamule njengoba kufanelekile ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo nezidingo ezishintshayo; Hlonza izinsiza eadingekayo futhi wabezelise izinzuzo zomuntu ngamunye; Phatha izinhlaka zansuku zonke ezingokwemisebenzi yomklamo nendawo yawo ohlangabezane nayo; Futhi usebenzise ngempumelelo izindlela futhi phoqe izinga lomklamo ukuze unciphise ingozi kumiklamo. Ukuhlola izimali zomklamo kanye nengqalasizinda yezimali ngokuthi: Bika inqubo yomklamo kwiNkomba Ephathwa Nayo Yomklamo Wokwakha futhi Phatha izabelo zemali kanye nezinsiza zemiklamo. Ukulawulwa Kwezindlu Ezinkulu ngokuthi: Nikeza izincomo ezinye izisebenzi ezifundisile ngokulawulwa kothengo / ukuthenga; Xhumana nobubanzi nezinsizakalo, abathengi kanye nabalawuli; Siza kubasebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo; Lugcine indlela yokuphatha amarekhodi kanye nendawo yokulonda imiklamo yezakhiwo; Futhi usebenzise ngempumelelo izinsiza ezabeliwe. Into ebalulekile yokuvulwa kolwazi kanye nokuqashwa ngokuthi: Gcina isikhathi esisha kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nendlela ezilandelayo; Funda / izincwadi ngokuvulwa kwesinto entsha kwezindlela zokuphatha imiklamo; Futhi xhumana namaphuzu / amakhonsathi ahlobene nomsindo womklamo.

xh.title: Umlawuli weZakhiwo zeMisebenzi ongaqeqeshwanga inqanaba A-C
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMlawuli weZakhiwo zeMisebenzi ongaqeqeshwanga eDurban ukulawula nokuhambelanisa onke amacala amasebenzi ezakhiwo ezindaweni eziyakhiwayo kwisebe leZezindlu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye esalinganayo naso. I-National Higher Diploma (kummandla we-Built Environment) eneminye elive ubuncinane yeminyaka esi kwaye nangamavesi amathandathu ejolise ekuqinisekisiweyo njengoMlawuli weZakhiwo zeMisebenzi ongaqeqeshwanga, OKUZE i-BTech (kummandla we-Built Environment) eneminye elive ubuncinane yeminyaka emi-4 ejolise ekuqinisekisiweyo kulawulo, OKUZE izidanga ze-Honours nakuphi na kummandla we-Built Environment eneminye elive ubuncinane yeminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelana naleyomsebenzi. Ukuqatwa njengelungu kwi-SACPCMP njengoMlawuli weZakhiwo zeMisebenzi ongaqeqeshwanga kumthetho obekiweyo ekubeni lungelelaniswa. Ilayisenisi yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono abantu: Ulwazi ngeengqinelwano nomthetho weZezindlu, amakhono okulawula iinkqubo, iingcombolo zokulawula amaprojekthi neendlela zokwenza izinto, ulwazi ngopando nophuhliso, iinkqubo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezisebenziswa khompyutha, ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho ngokwemiqathango yamashishini ezakhiwo, ukubhala iingxelo ezinobuchule, ukuyila inkqubo yemveliso ephezulu, iingcebiso zobugcisa bobuchule negqwetha ngobuchule. Amakhono okwenza izigqibo. Amakhono okuba nokulawula iqela. Amakhono okuhlaluhlula. Amakhono okuyila izinto. Amakhono okuzilawula. Amakhono okulawula imali yeprojekthi. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula. Amakhono okunxibelelana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano. Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlaluhlulo. Amakhono okulawula abantu. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act, i-Municipal Finance Management Act, i-Supply Chain Management Regulations neenkqubo zokuthenga. Ulwazi nokuLawula iNkqubo yeKontraki nokuLawulwa kwayo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuze uhambelanise onke amacala amasebenzi ngokwe:- Ukukhokela iplani yeprojekthi, ukuze yenziwe, iqhutshwe kwapheliswa, kubhalwe ingxelo kwaye iqatywe ngokwelandelelwano lolawulo lwamaprojekthi; Yila uphumeze iinkqubo zokusebenza kwamaprojekthi uze uzilungise ngokufanelekileyo ngokwemfuneko ebatshazekileyo namagunya; Chonga izibonelelo efunekayo uze umze abantu ngabanye iimisebenzi; Lawula iimpawu zomhla nosuku ekusebenzeni kweprojekthi nommandla wayo; ze Ukuze sebenzise ngokuchanekileyo iindlela zenziwe iinkqubo kwaye uphakamise izingqinisekiso zemigqathiso yamaprojekthi ukuze kuncitithe isengo sakwiinkqubo. Ukubala iimali kunye nolawulo lwemali kweprojekthi ngokwe-: Bhala ingxelo ngokuqhubeka kweprojekthi kuLawuli weZakhiwo weMisebenzi omkhulu uze ulawule iibajeti ezimali kunye nezibonelelo zamaprojekthi. Ukulawulwa kweNkonzo ngokwe-: Nikeza iingxelo kwabanye abantu abanobuchule ngokulawula iinkontraki/izibonelelo; Qhagamshelana naye nxibelelane nabahanjiswa, namakhasi nolawulo; Nikela ngenxaxhe kumisebenzi nakuqokelela abantu abangenampumezo; Gcina inkqubo yokuqokelela iingxelo kunye nencwadi yemimiselo; ze Sebenzisa ngokusebenzayo izibonelelo ezabeliwe. Upando nophuhliso ngokwe-; Zibalasele iindlela ezintsha zezobuchwephesha neenkqubo zokwenza izinto: Zenza upando/ukufunda ngeentshiso ezintsha ngendlela zokulawula iinkqubo zokwenza amaprojekthi; ze Qhagamshelane namabanga/amaqela ahambelana nolawulo lweenkqubo.

jobs.title: Professional Construction Project Manager Grade A-C
jobs.summary: Manage and co-ordinate construction projects for the Department of Human Settlements in Durban, requiring a Built Environment qualification and relevant project management experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent certificate. National Higher Diploma (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years and six months certified experience as a Professional Construction Project Manager, OR a BTech (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years certified managerial experience, OR an Honours degree in any Built Environment field with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager on appointment. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of Human Settlement policies and legislation, programme management skills, project management principles and methodologies, knowledge of research and development, computer aided engineering applications, knowledge of legal compliance with building industry norms and standards, technical report writing, creating a high-performance culture, technical consulting and professional judgement. Decision making skills. Team leadership skills. Analytical skills. Creativity skills. Self-management skills. Project-related financial management skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication skills. Computer literacy. Planning and organising skills. Conflict management skills. Problem solving and analysis. People management skills. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management Regulations and procurement processes. Knowledge of Contract Management and Contract Administration.
jobs.duties: Manage and co-ordinate all aspects of projects in terms of:- Guide the project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and evaluation in line with project management methodology; Create and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements; Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities; Manage day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope; and Effectively apply methodology and enforce project standards to minimize risk on projects. Project accounting and financial management in terms of: Report project progress to the Chief Construction Project Manager, and Manage the projects’ budgets and resources. Office Administration in terms of: Provide inputs to other professionals with tender/procurement administration; Liaise and interact with service providers, clients and management; Contribute to human resources and related activities; Maintain the record management system and the architectural library; and Utilize resources allocated effectively. Research and Development in terms of: Keep up with new technologies and procedures: Research/ literature on new developments on project management methodologies: and Liaise with relevant bodies/ councils on project management.
jobs.applications: Applications must be posted to: The Head of Department, KwaZulu-Natal Department of Human Settlements, Private Bag X54367, Durban, 4000 or hand delivered to: The Acting Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Department of Human Settlements, Ground Floor, Murchison Passage, 353-363 Dr Pixley ka Seme Street, Durban, 4001. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs FOR ATTENTION : Mr. TW Khalishwayo
jobs.notes: Directions to applicants: Applicants using the manual application process must ensure that the new Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service institution) is completed, duly signed and initialed, a detailed curriculum vitae, as failure to do so may lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources. Applicants are discouraged from sending applications through registered mail because the Department will not be responsible for non-collection of these applications. No late applications will be accepted. Applications submitted electronically will be taken as a final application and may not be amended or supplemented in any way after the closing date indicated in the advertisement. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in the disqualification of your application. NB: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications not submitted on the fully completed new Z83 application forms will not considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and the interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioral preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. af.title: Professionele Konstruksie-projekbestuurder Graad A-C
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer konstruksieprojekte vir die Department of Human Settlements in Durban, wat 'n bouomgewingskwalifikasie en tersaaklike projekbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12 of gelykwaardige sertifikaat. Nasionale Hoër Diploma (Bouomgewingsveld) met 'n minimum van 4 jaar en ses maande gesertifiseerde ervaring as 'n Professionele Konstruksie-projekbestuurder, OF 'n BTech (Bouomgewingsveld) met 'n minimum van 4 jaar gesertifiseerde bestuurservaring, OF 'n Honneursgraad in enige Bouomgewingsveld met 'n minimum van 3 jaar tersaaklike ervaring. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksie-projekbestuurder by aanstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Human Settlement-beleide en -wetgewing, programbestuursvaardighede, projekbestuursbeginsels en -metodes, kennis van navorsing en ontwikkeling, rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings, kennis van regsvoorskrif nakoming met boubedryf-norme en -standaarde, tegniese verslagdoening, skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, tegniese konsultasie en professionele oordeel. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Spanleierskapsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Kreatiwiteitsvaardighede. Selfbestuursvaardighede. Projekverwante finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Kliëntefokus en reaktiwiteit. Kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise. Menslike hulpbronbestuursvaardighede. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management Regulations en verwervingsprosesse. Kennis van Kontrakbestuur en Kontrakadministrasie.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van projekte in terme van:- Lei die projekbeplanning, -implementering, -monitering, -verslagdoening en -evaluering in ooreenstemming met projekbestuurmetodologie; Skep en voer projekwerksplanne uit en hersien dit soos gepas om veranderende behoeftes en vereistes te akkommodeer; Identifiseer benodigde hulpbronne en ken individuele verantwoordelikhede toe; Bestuur die alledaagse operasionele aspekte van 'n projek en omvang; en Pas metodologie doeltreffend toe en handhaaf projekstandaarde om risiko op projekte te minimaliseer. Projekrekenkunde en finansiële bestuur in terme van: Rapporteer projekvordering aan die Hoofkonstruksie-projekbestuurder, en Bestuur die projekte se begrotings en hulpbronne. Kantooradministrasie in terme van: Verskaf insette aan ander professionele persone met tender/verkrygingsadministrasie; Skakel en interakteer met diensverskaffers, kliënte en bestuur; Dra by tot menslike hulpbronne en verwante aktiwiteite; Onderhou die rekordbestuurstelsel en die argitektuurbiblioteek; en Benut toegekende hulpbronne doeltreffend. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling in terme van: Bly tuis met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures: Doen navorsing/literatuur oor nuwe ontwikkelings in projekbestuurmetodologieë: en Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/ rade oor projekbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Wezinga Likawunobumba A-C
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhlele amaphrojekthi okwakha eKwakhiwa Kwamakhaya eThekwini, okudinga izifundo zeNdawo Yokwakhiwe futhi nokubeletha kwenza imisebenzi yokuphatha amaphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: Ikheth lethu lesi-12 noma isitifikedi esilinganayo. I-Diploma Ephakeme Kazwelonke (Indawo Yokwakhiwe) eneminyaka engu-4 nesikhathi esingu-6 wenyanga isiphekelelwe ukubeletha okwenziwa njengomPhathi Wezinhlelo Zokwakha, noma i-BTech (Indawo Yokwakhiwe) eneminyaka engu-4 isiphekelelwe ukubeletha ukuba ngumphathi, noma i-degree ye-Honours nangasiphi isikhundla se-Indawo Yokwakhiwe eneminyaka engu-3 yokubeletha okuhlobene. Kuyadingeka ukuba uzibhalise kwi-SACPCMP njengomPhathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla: Ulwazi ngemithetho nangemigomo yamakhaya, amakhono okuphatha izinhlelo, imigomo nendlela yokuphatha amaphrojekthi, ulwazi ngocwaningo nentuthuko, izinhlelo zokwakha ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho nemigomo yemboni yokwakha, ukubhala imibhiko yobuchwepheshe, ukwakha isiko elibangele ukusebenza ngamandla amakhulu, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe nokuqamba kwengqondo. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okukhokhela iqembu. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okwenzela ubuciko. Amakhono okuzilawula. Amakhono okuphatha imali ehlobene nephrojekthi. Ukuqondiswa kwamakhasimende futhi ukuphendula. Amakhono okukhuluma. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okucabanga nokuhlela. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuze kuhlaziywe. Amakhono okulawula abantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuPhatha Imali kaZwelonke, umthetho wokuPhatha Imali kaMasipala, imithetho yokuLawula i-Supply Chain kanye nendlela zokuthenga. Ulwazi ngokuPha kanye NokuLawula Amakonthulakthi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlele zonke iziqondiso zamaphrojekthi ngokwale mikhakha:- Qondisa ukuhlelwa, ukwenza, ukubuka, ukubika kanye nokuhlola ukuthi kuphume kanjani ngokuhambisana nendlela yokuphatha amaphrojekthi; Yakhe futhi usebenzise iplani yokusebenza yephrojekthi, bese uyilungisa ukuze ihambelane nezidingo ezishintshayo; Hlakanipha izinsiza ezingadingekayo bese ubeka izibopho zabantu ngabanye; Lawula izinyathelo zansuku zonke zokusebenza kwephrojekthi nesesikhundla; futhi Sebenzisisa ngokusebenza kakhulu futhi phoqa ukuthi kuhlonishwe imigomo yephrojekthi ukuze kuncishwe nengozi emaphrojekthini. Ukubala futhi ukulawula imali yephrojekthi ngokwalesi sikhundla: Bika nganqeqeko yephrojekthi kuMphathi Omkhulu Wephrojekthi Yokwakha, bese ULawula imitholamfundo nemithombo yephrojekthi. Ukulawula ofisi ngokwalesi sikhundla: Nika abanye abasebenza ngezinyathelo ezingayisodwa ezihlobene nokuLawula imibhikisho/ezokuthenga; Xhumana futhi ukhulume nabahlinzeki, namakhasimende futhi nalabo abaphethe; Yisana imtholampilo kwemisebenzi ehlobene nabantu; Imisebenzi yokulawula imibhalo: Isimiso sokugcina imibhalo namalabhulali esakhiwo; futhi Sebenzisisa izinsiza ezabelwe ngokusebenza kakhulu. Ukucwaningo nentuthuko ngokwalesi sikhundla: Zinze ngokwamathuluzi namanye amakhona amasha; Cwaningo/ imibhalo ngentuthuko ezinhlelweni zokuphatha amaphrojekthi; bese Uxhumana namabhandla/ amaphuzu ahlobene nokuLawulwa kwephrojekthi.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi woKwakha oYilesi A-C
xh.summary: Cofa iqela kwaye ulungelelanise amaprojekthi okwakha eka Department of Human Settlements e Durban, okufuna isiqinisekiso kwindawo eyakhiweyo nolwazi oluthe ngqo lolawulo lwaprojekthi.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se Grade 12 okwa seningathi. National Higher Diploma (kummandla we-Built Environment) ngeyona mvela kwiminyaka eli-4 nenyanga ezintandathu yamava aqinisekisiweyo njengoko kuMphathi weProjekthi yoKwakha oYilesi, OKU umqondo we BTech (kummandla we-Built Environment) ongethosha kwiminyaka eli-4 yamava alawulo aqinisekisiweyo, OKU isidanga se Honours nakuyo nayiphi na ndawo yayo i-Built Environment ngeyona mvela kwiminyaka esi-3 yamava ahambelanayo. Ukubhalisa ngokunyanzelekileyo kwi SACPCMP njengeMphathi weMisebenzi woKwakha oYilesi ngexesha lokwenzelwa kumsebenzi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi, Amandla nobuNtetho: Ulwazi ngeengqungquthela zoluntu nomthetho we Human Settlement, amandla okulawula iinkqubo, iinkqubo namacebo okulawula amaprojekthi, ulwazi ngophando nophuhliso, izicelo zobugcisa bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemigqaliselo yemigaqo yoshishino lokwakha, ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ukudala inkqubo yentsimo ephezulu yokusebenza, ingcebiso zobugcisa nesigqibo sesigqi. Amandla okwenza izigqibo. Amandla okukhokela iqela. Amandla okuhlalutya. Amandla okudalisa. Amandla okuzilawula. Amandla okulawula iimali zeprojekthi. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokupha impendulo. Amandla okunxibelelana. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuqamba. Amandla okulawula ingxabano. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki noHlalo. Amandla okulawula abantu. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali koMasipala, Imigaqo yoLawulo loQhagamshelo nokuqhuba iinkqubo zokuthenga. Ulwazi ngoLawulo lweQela loQeqesho nokuLawulwa kweQela loQeqesho.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise onke amacala amaprojekthi ngokuka:- Qondisa ucwangciso lweprojekthi, ukusebenza kwayo, ukuqwalasela, ukuvela iingxelo nokuhlolwa ngokwamagebu ne nkqubo yokulawula amaprojekthi; Dala kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokusebenza zamaprojekthi kwaye uzihlengihlengi ngokufanelekileyo ukuze zihambelane neemfuno ezitshintshayo; Batya amacebo afunekayo kwaye wabelane ngeemfanelo zobunini bomntu ngamnye; Lawula iimpawu zangemini zangemini zokusebenza kwiprojekthi nendima yayo; kwaye Usebenzise ngokufanelekileyo iinkqubo zamacebo ukuze unciphise ingozi kwaprojekthi. I-akhawunti yeprojekthi nolawulo lwemali ngokuka: Velisa iingxelo ngephulo leprojekthi kuMphathi weProjekthi yoKwakha oMkhulu, kwaye Lawula amabhajeti nawamacebo amaprojekthi. I-Administration ye-Ofisi ngokuka: Nikeza izigqibo kwezinye iingcali ngolawulo lwe tender/procurement; Qinana unxibelelane nabanikiweenkonzo, abathengi nolawulo; Ngenisa isandla kumandla obomi abantu nemisebenzi ehambelanayo; Phatha inkqubo yokulawula iirekhodi nakwithala leencwadi eziyimilingo; kwaye Sebenzisa amacebo abekwe ngokufanelekileyo. UPhando noPhuhliso ngokuka: Hlala ufumana iindlela ezintsha zobugcisa nolawulo; Phanda/umagama ngophuhliso olutsha kwiinkqubo nolawulo lwamaprojekthi; kwaye Qinana unxibelelane namagunya/namabhunga ahambelanayo ngolawulo lwaprojekthi.

jobs.title: Professional Construction Project Manager Grade A-C
jobs.summary: Manage and co-ordinate construction projects for the Department of Human Settlements in Durban, overseeing planning, implementation, monitoring and reporting.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent certificate. National Higher Diploma (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years and six months certified experience as a Professional Construction Project Manager, OR a BTech (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years certified managerial experience, OR an Honours degree in any Built Environment field with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF level 4 as recognised by SAQA). Relevant courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: General computer literacy skills (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint and MS Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting independently, professionally, accountably, and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound planning, organising, administrative and problem-solving skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: Render duties of administrative nature which will include general administration duties as well as specific administrative duties. Maintain and Administer the Human Resource. Maintain the financial Resources of the section. Maintain and control physical Resources. Maintain and co-ordinate administrative services of the station.
jobs.enquiries: Lieutenant Colonel S N Zondo/Captain Machaie /SAC Nkosi/AC Petersen/PO Moodley Tel No: (031) 325-4808 / 6194 / 4957/6404/6403
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS, will be expected to undergo a personal interview and shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct). Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short- listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk benodig by SAPS Technology Management Services in Durban om algemene administratiewe, menslike hulpbron-, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronbestuurspligte te verrig.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees bedrywig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Beskik oor Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat / NCV Vlak 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Relevante kursusse op die gebied van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goed mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Gesonde beplannings-, organisasie-, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntgerigtheid en reaksievermoë. Wees bereid om onder druk en verlengde ure te werk.
af.duties: Lewer pligte van administratiewe aard wat algemene administrasiepligte sowel as spesifieke administratiewe pligte sal insluit. Onderhou en administreer die Menslike Hulpbron. Onderhou die finansiële Hulpbronne van die afdeling. Onderhou en beheer fisiese Hulpbronne. Onderhou en koördineer administratiewe dienste van die stasie.

zu.title: Iklekhi Lolulawulo
zu.summary: Kudingeka iKlekhi Lolulawulo eSAPS Technology Management Services eDurban ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene nolawulo olunjalo, lwemithombo yabantu, lwezimali kanye nolawulwa kwezinsiza eziphathekayo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele baveze ikhono emisebenzini eyisiseko yesikhundla. Kumele bakwazi ukusebenzisa kahle ngokubhalayo uLimi yesiNgisi kanye nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni okungenani olulodwa. Kumele babe ngamakhand' amnyama weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, okufanele kufakwe ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi ngosuku lokuhlolwa. Kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 noma iziqu ezingangaleyo (i-NQF level 4 njengoba kusho i-SAQA). Oqeqeshwe kakhulu kwezifundo eziphathelene nalesi sikhundla kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono nokuqonda ukusebenza: Amakhono jikelele okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS Office, i-MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook). Kumele kwaziwe ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcweti, ngokubekezelelekayo, futhi ngesibindi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngokukhuluma nangokubhala. Amakhono amahle ohlelo, ekwelakeni, ekulawulweni kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana nabantu. Ukuqonda izidingo zabatholele izinsebenzo kanye nokuqashelwa kwabo. Kumele bazithobele ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo nangamahora amakhulu kakhulu.
zu.duties: Kwenziwe imisebenzi yolawulo okuhlanganisa imisebenzi evela kumkhakha wolawulo ngokujikelele, kanye nemisebenzi evela kumkhakha wolawulo othize. Kugcinwe futhi kulawulwe Iminthombo yabantu. Kugcinwe izinsiza ezimali zebhisi. Kugcinwe kanye nokulawula izinsiza eziphathekayo. Kugcinwe kanye nohlanganiselwa kolawulo kwezinsiza zesiteshi.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wonkonzo Lolawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umLawuli Wonkonzo Lwolawulo kwi-SAPS Technology Management Services e-Durban ukwenza imisebenzi jikelele yolawulo, lwamabala abantu, lemali nakulawulo lwamabala abanjimvelo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka abonise ulwazi kwimisebenzi enkulu yesithuba. Babenguchwepheshe kwelitha ngesiNgesi nanelinye ilulwimi esemthethweni ngosuku lomphuliswano. Babe ngabemi bonke belizwe laseMzantsi Afrika abo bakunika ubungqina ngamafxatsho emini yokuphuliswa. Babe nobungqina be-Garde 12 / Isatifikethi Emdala / i-NCV Level 4 okanye isidanga esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA). Iindonga ezifanelekileyo kwicala lesithuba ziya kuba ngusizo olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi, Amandla, Nakwimisebenzi Ekuyo: Amandla jikelele okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook). Bonisa ulwazi lokuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobuchwepheshe, ngokubhekisele kwimisebenzi, nakwinkundla yokuzinikela. Amandla amabalwe nangokubhala ethethwa namagama. Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuqamba, kwimisebenzi yolawulo nakulawulo lwezinkinga. Amandla amakhulu okuzelisa kwabaninzi. Ugqozi kwizigqebi nempendulo. Baqinisekise ukuba bangaphantsi komthwalo kwaye bangasebenze iiyure ezinde.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo equka imisebenzi yolawulo jikelele nangakunye imisebenzi yolawulo ethile. Gcina uLawule Amaxhala Abantu. Gcina amabala eMali ecaleni. Lawula Amaxhala Engqamla. Gcina ukuqamba ulawulo lweenkonzo kwisitishi.

af.title: Administrasie Klerk
af.summary: Administrasie klerk wat eerste-lyn IT-tegniese ondersteuning aan gebruikers vir hardeware-, netwerk- en radio probleme by SAPS Technology Management Services in Durban verskaf.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid in die kernfunksies van die pos toon. Bevoeg wees in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. 'n Burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika wees waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. In besit wees van Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat / NCV Level 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF level 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Relevante ervaring en relevante kursusse in die veld van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook). Bevoegdheid toon om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Skande beplanning, organisasie, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterke interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntfokus en doelgerigtheid. Gewillig wees om onder druk en gedurende uitgebreide ure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf eerste-lyn tegniese ondersteuning aan gebruikers vir hardeware, drukkers, netwerkverwante en Radio tegniese probleme. Registreer, volg en eskaleer IT-voorval- en diensversoeke soos vereis. Bied gebruikers bystand met wagwoordherstel; gebruikersrekeningadministrasie en stelseltoegangversoeke. Voer basiese probleemoplossing uit op lessenaars, skootrekenaars, drukker skandeerders en mobiele toestelle. Ondersteun die installasie, konfigurasie en ontplooiing van IT-toerusting en sagteware. Monitor en rapporteer IT-toerustingfoute en instandhoudingsvereistes. Bied bystand met die opstelling van werkstasies, videokonferensiefasiliteite en aanbiedingstoerusting. Verskaf basiese ondersteuning vir Microsoft Office-toepassings, e-posstelsel en besigheidstoepassings. Skakel in verband met tegniese probleme met ICT Tegnikus, diensverskaffers en verskaffers. Lewer pligte van administratiewe aard wat algemene administrasiepligte asook spesifieke administratiewe pligte sal insluit.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphathwa
zu.summary: Uclerk wezokuphathwa onikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ye-IT yokugcina kubasebenzisi ngaphakathi kwemikhuba ngezingxoxo ezinkundleni zocingo kanye nezinkinga zomsakazo eSAPS Technology Management Services eDurban.
zu.requirements: Kubafakiwe kumele babonise ukuziqonda kumisebenzi eyisiseko yesikhundla; Baphefumulela kahle okungenani isiNgisi nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni; Babe ngabazwe-BaseNingizimu Afrika abakube ngabakhombisa iziqiniseko zokushicilelwa ngelesiQeshana ngosuku lokuqhathaniswa; Babe nokuqeda izinga 12 / Isiqiniseko sePhakeme / NCV Level 4 noma ukulingana kweziqui (NQF level 4 njengesiqiniseko esamukelwa yi-SAQA). Okuhlelele ngemikhuba kanye nokuqeqeswa okuhlelele kule ndawo yesikhundla kuyoba usizo olukhulu. Ulwazi, Amakhono kanye nokuziqonda: Khono ekuqondeni nokusebenzisa khompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook). Kubonise khono ngokuzenzela ngokuyedwa, ekuwodwebeni, ekuphatheni izezimali, kanye nokukholwa ngokwedlulela; Khono elokuhle lokuthetha nokubhala; Khono ekuhlelelweni, ukuhlela, ukuphatha nokusombulula izinkinga; Khono eliphezulu ekuhlobana nabanye; Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula; Bezelwe ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa kakhulu nangamahora amide.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe yokugcina kubasebenzisi ngezinhlelo zokusebenza, iziphrinta, ezocingo nobungozi obuhlobene nomsakazo khompyutha eSAPS; Qamba, landa kanye nokuphakamisa izinkinga ze-IT kanye nezicelo zonke njengokudingekile; Siza abasebenzisi ngokusetha kabusha igama lokungena; ukuphathwa kwe-akhawunti kanye nesicelo sokufinyelela kwinkundla eSAPS; Yenza ukuxazulula ngokwesisekelo izinkinga kumadesktopi, amakhompyutha aphathwayo, iziphrinta noma oskhemkhukhu kanye nezinto ezingamakhompyutha apha; Nesiza ekuyekeleni, ukuhlelela ukusetshenziswa, nokuba amakhompyutha nabasebenzi be-IT eSAPS; Hlole futhi ube ngumnikazi wezinkinga zokulungiswa kobungozi eSAPS ebusuku; Siza ekusetheni iziteshi zokusebenza, izinto ezokuxoxa ngesikhathi esibonakalayo kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhombisa amaphrojekthi eSAPS; Hlinzeka ngokwesisekelo inkxaso kwizinhlelo ze-Microsoft Office ezidluliswayo, kubasebenzisi eSAPS; Hlanganyela nabasebenzisi be-ICT, ukuphathwa kwezolimo, ukunikezwa kwemali ekuqwashisweni kwesikhashana eSAPS; Wenze imisebenzi yokuphatha ehlobene nezokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yonke emnyangweni nakwezinye izikhala ezikhethekile.

xh.title: Iklek yokuLawula izinto zoMmiso
xh.summary: Iklek yokuLawula izinto zoMmiso ebonelela ngenkxaso yokuqala yobuchwepheshe kubasebenzisi kumaxhulu amatshati, urhulumente kunye nezinto ezinxulumene nomsakazo kwi SAPS Technology Management Services e Durban.
xh.requirements: Abafake isicelo kufuneka babonise ukuba banamakhono kwimisebenzi engundoqo yesithuba. Benokulinganisela ubuchwepheshe buntsomi kolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni ngaphezu koko kolunye ulwimi. Bengamabo aHlomela siZwe eHlabathini somBuwo eNjingalanga apho kusenokwa afungwa isiqinisekiso ngomhla wokuqwalasela. Bakube nesiXhosa esilUlu 12 / isatifikethi eNkulu / NCV Level 4 okanye isifundo esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengoko samkelwe yi SAQA). Imfundo nengqondo kwizifundo ezinxulumene nendawo yesithuba ziya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, namandla okuSebenza: Amakhono e-Computer jikelele (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint, ne MS Outlook). Bonise ukuba nakho ukuzimeka, ukuziphatha ngobungcali, ukuziphathisa, nokuLinganisa. Amakhono aman de wokuThetha nokubhal a. Amakhono oluHlelo, ukuCwangcisa, ulawulo, nosombulo lwezinkinga. Amakhono aman de wokuHamba nabantu. Ukuqwalasela abakwayo bakhetha nokusabela. Kufuneka besebenze ngaphantsi kwexesha elifutshane nangaphandle kweyure ezichaziweyo.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe yokuqala kubasebenzisi nge hardware, abaphathi beshicilelo, urhulumente, nezinto ezinxulumene nobuchwepheshe be Radio. Bhala, landela, nokuNyusa iinkcukacha ze IT nemibuzo yesebenze njengoko kuyimfuno. Nceda abasebenzisi ngokuSeta iphaswedi; ulawulo lwe-akhawunti yomsebenzisi, nesicelo sokufikelela kwinkqubo. Yenza ukuhlola ngokubanzi ngokwe desktops, laptops, abaphathi beshicilelo, abaskanbathi, nezixhobo ezingathathwa ngesandla. Xhasa ukufakwa, ukuLungiselelwa, nokuHamba kwezixhobo ze IT nesoftware. Qwalasa nokuChaza iimpazamo zezixhobo ze IT nokuLungelelanisa okuyimfuneko. Nceda ekuLungiseleleni izikhongozela zokusebenza, iziseko zokwenza umdhimbilwano we-video, nezixhobo zoku Lungelelanisa iLungiselelo. Bonelela ngenkxaso yakuqala kwezicelo ze Microsoft Office, inkqubo ye-imeyile, nezicelo zeshishini. Thetha ne ICT Technician, ababi basebenzisi, nabathengi ngezinto ezinxulumene nobuchwepheshe. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo eLula efuna ukuba kubekho ulawulo jikelele nangaphezu koko imisebenzi yolawulo ethile.

jobs.centre: Technology Management Services: PHO Ref No: KZN CL 01/06/2026 (X1 Post) SAPS Durban ICTU Ref No: KZN CL 02/06/2026 (X1 Post) SAPS Ulundi ICTU Ref No: KZN CL 03/06/2026 (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The South African Police Service seeks three cleaners for Technology Management Services centres in KwaZulu-Natal, responsible for maintaining workplace hygiene.

Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7 certificate/ report (NQF level 1 as recognized by SAQA), for which documentary proof can be produced when required. Knowledge, Skills Competencies: Understanding of how to handle cleaning detergents; Occupational AND Health and Safety protocol; Basic literacy, numeracy and communication skills; Be able to read and write; Ability to interact with other officials in a professional manner; The ability to operate elementary machines and equipment; Willing to work extended hours when necessary.
jobs.duties: Maintaining of a high level of hygiene in and around the workplace with the cleaning of the SAPS premises assigned to, which may include either or both inner and outer parameters; Performing tasks of a routine nature, such as dusting; Polish furniture and floors. Vacuum carpets and mopping of tile floor; Remove refuse; Perform maintenance tasks in and around the assigned premises; Clean bathrooms and kitchens; Safekeeping and handling of a variety of Aids in the cleaning of the premise; Loading and unloading of goods. Garden maintenance services; Washing and cleaning of state vehicles, kitchenware and utensils.

af.title: Skoonmaker
af.summary: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens soek drie skoonmakers vir Tegnologiebestuursdienste-sentrums in KwaZulu-Natal, verantwoordelik vir die handhawing van werkplekhiëgiene.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Bevoeg wees in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. 'n Burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika wees waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. In besit wees van 'n ABET-vlak 4/ Graad 9/ Standaard 7-sertifikaat/ verslag (NQF-vlak 1 soos deur SAQA erken), waarvoor dokumentêre bewys gelewer kan word wanneer vereis. Kennis, Vaardighede Bevoegdhede: Begrip van hoe om skoonmaakmiddels te hanteer; Beroeps- EN Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsprotokol; Basiese geletterdheid, syferkundigheid en kommunikasievaardighede; Kan lees en skryf; Vermoë om op 'n professionele wyse met ander beamptes te skakel; Die vermoë om elementêre masjiene en toerusting te bedryf; Bereid om ekstra ure te werk wanneer nodig.
af.duties: Handhawing van 'n hoë vlak van hiëgiene in en om die werkplek met die skoonmaak van die SAPS-persele toegeken aan, wat óf of beide binne- en buiteparameters kan insluit; Uitvoer van roetine-take, soos afstoffing; Meubels en vloere oppoets. Vakuumteepee matte en mop van teëlvloere; Verwyder afval; Onderhoudstake in en om die toegewysde persele uitvoer; Badkamers en kombuise skoonmaak; Veiligkeeping en hantering van 'n verskeidenheid hulpmiddels by die skoonmaak van die perseel; Laai en los goedere. Tuinonderhoudsdienste; Was en skoonmaak van staatsvoertuie, kombuisware en gereedskap.

zu.title: Umsuli
zu.summary: Isevisi Yephoyisa LaseNingizimu Afrika ifuna abasuli abathathu izikhungo ze Technology Management Services e KwaZulu-Natal, abanezibopho zokugcina izikhungo zokusebenza zihlanze.

Babe ngabakhamuzi be Republic of South Africa okufakwa ngomuntu ubukhosi bewomadothulomentshi osukwini lwengxoxo. Babe nesiwatshana se ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7 (NQF level 1 njengokuqashelwa yi SAQA), okungakhiqizwa ubufakela bobukhosi bawo lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi, Amakhono Nokwazi: Ukuqonda indlela yokuphatha amakhemikhali okuhlanza; Iphrothokholi Yokuphepha Nokugcina Ukuphila emsebenzini; Amakhono ayisisekelo okufunda, okubala nokuxhumana; Bakwazi ukufunda nokubhala; Ikono lokuxhumana nabanye abasebenzi ngendlela eprofeshinali; Ikono lokusebenzisa imishini nezisetshenziswa eziyisisekelo; Bethande ukusebenza amasikhathi amade uma kudingeka.
zu.duties: Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanzwa ngaphakathi nakuleyo yonke indawo yokusebenza ngokuholwa kwemisebenzi ephathelene nokuholwa kwe SAPS, okungahlanganisa nokungabi nanjalo imikhakha yaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukwenza imisebenzi evamile, njengokwesula uthuli; Ukupolisha ifanitsha nezansi. Ukupholula ikapethi nokuphalaza izansi eziteyiliwe; Ukususa izinkunkula; Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulungisa ngaphakathi nakuleyo ndawo enikelwe kuyo; Ukohlanza indlu yokugezela nasekhishini; Ukugcina nokuphatha inhlobonhlobo yezinto ezisiza ekuhlanzweni kwesikhungo; Ukulayisha nokukhipha izimpahla. Isevisi yokulungisa isivande; Ukuhlamba nokuhlanza izimoto zombuso, izimpahla zekhishini nezimpahla zokusebenzisa ekhishini.

Babe ngamakhaya azele eRiphabhuliki yaseMzantsi Afrika, into eqinisekiswa ngezibizo ezingamabhali ngosuku lokuposwa imibuzo. Babe nesi satifikheti/irekhodi se-ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7 (inqanaba le-NQF 1 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA), esinokuthi izibizo ezingamabhali zenziwe xa kufuneka. xh.duties: Ukugcina inqanaba eliphezulu lococeko ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo yokusebenza ngokucoca izikhulu ze-SAPS ezenzelwe kuzo,oko kunokubandakanya iindlela zangaphakathi nangaphandle okanye zombini; Ukweniza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo, njengokutyusha; Ukubhola ifenitsho namaza. Ukuyixa iikhapethi nokucoca amaza ebulewe ngeethayili; Ukususa irhabaxa; Ukweniza imisebenzi yokugcina izikhulu ezenzelwe kuzo ngaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukucoca iindlwana zangasese nasekhitshi; Ukulondoloza nokuphatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuncedisa ekucoceni izikhulu; Ukufaka nokukhupha izinto ezithengwayo. Iinkonzo zokulondoloza isivande; Ukutsha nokucoca iimoto zembuso, izinto zekhitshi nezixhobo zekhitshi.

jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology sought for Themba Hospital in Mpumalanga, requiring HPCSA registration and relevant qualifications.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualifications that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (2026). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of one 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognized Foreign Professions and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) for foreign qualified employees. Grade: 2: A minimum of five (5) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). A minimum of six (6) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) for qualified foreign employees. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of eleven (11) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) for qualified foreign employees. Knowledge, skills, Training and Competences required. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge. Competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programs and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach and guide junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.
jobs.duties: Supervising the management of and managing Obstetrics & Gynaecology and coordinate services. To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programs. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services maintained. Comply with the performance Management and Development System (conducting quarterly reviews and final assessment).

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 - 3: Verloskunde & Ginekologie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie gesoek vir Themba Hospitaal in Mpumalanga, wat HPCSA-registrasie en relevante kwalifikasies vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde & Ginekologie (2026) moontlik maak. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ondervinding in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige gesondheids- en openbare diensregulasies en -beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Minimum van een 1-jarige relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse beroepsraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Verloskunde & Ginekologie) vir buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Graad: 2: 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Onafhanklike Praktyk). 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Verloskunde & Ginekologie) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Minimum van elf (11) jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Verloskunde & Ginekologie) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ondervinding in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk en buite normale werksure te werk en met 'n diverse span te werk. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede, en om betrokke te raak wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleide, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor die bestuur van en die bestuur van Verloskunde & Ginekologie en die koördineer van dienste. Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die instelling te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakkie-fasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning verleen aan hospitaalbestuur tot 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en gehandhaafde dienste. Voldoen aan die prestasiebestuur- en ontwikkelingstelsel (voer kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering uit).

Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengochwepheshe besizinda kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho kuleso sifundo somtholampilo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokutholakala kwemitholampilo namaphoyisa asebekhona manje. Amandla okubonisana, okuthatha umlando, okuvehla, okuhlola ngokwesibalo sokwelashwa nokuphatha. Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo ( Ukuzijamelana). Ukuze kube khona okuncane unyaka oyedwa we-1 wokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo ( Ukuhlinzeka kwezokusetha ne-Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ebaleni. Izinga: 2: Okuncane iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo (Ukuzijamelana). Okuncane iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo (Ukuhlinzeka kwezokusetha ne-Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ebaleni. Izinga 3: Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo (Ukuzijamelana). Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeqhawe lemtholampilo (Ukuhlinzeka kwezokusetha ne-Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ebaleni. Ulwazi, amandla, ukuqeqeshwa namakhono adingekayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngezokuziphatha komtholampilo. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengochwepheshe besizinda kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho kuleso sifundo somtholampilo. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwelashwa. Amandla namakhono kumagatsha ajwayelekile omtholampilo. Ikhono lokusebenza nosuku nokusebenza ngaphandle kwamahora ajwayelekile nokusebenza nochwepheshe besizinda. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ubuqhawe, nobudlelwano nabantu, nokuthatha inxaxheba lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zezempilo zanamuhla, imithetho, izinhlelo nezinto ezibalulekile kuleso sizinda. Ikhono lokufundisaokuqondisa osebenza ngaphantsi kwakho esigabeni. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukwamukela inkinga yokwesaba, ukusebenza nochwepheshe besizinda, ukuzethemba nokuqhakambisa ubudlelwano obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukubukeka ukuphathwa kwe-Ukuhlinzeka kwezokusetha ne-Gynaecology nokuphatha nokuhlanganisa izinsiza. Ukwenza imisebenzi nangezindlela ngobuchwepheshe, ukuze uxhase imigomo nezinhloso zesikhungo esihambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kweguli. Ukumukela inxaxheba yokuphatha abaguli abangene ngephakethe lokuNakekelwa kwezigaba 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiselelweni nokusetshenzisweni kwemihlahlandlela nemithetho yokusebenza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwezinhlelo zemfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza ngokuhlola imitholampilo bese uthatha inxaxheba kokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komsebenzi. Ukunikeza inkxaso kuphathi wesibhedlela ukuze kugcinwe amazinga okunakekelwa kweguli nensiza eziphumelelayo. Ukulandela iNkqubo ye-PMS (yokuqamba okuholela emkuqeni wesikhathi kanye nokuqeqesheka).

xh.title: Isikhululi sempilo Inqanaba 1 - 3: I-Obstetric & Gynaecology
xh.summary: Kufunwa isikhululi sempilo kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology kwisibhedlele i-Themba Hospital e-Mpumalanga, kudingeka ubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA kwaye ube nemimiselo ehambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ubhaliso kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhululi sempilo kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology (2026). I-permit yomsebenzi egqithisiweyo iyakufuneka kubantu abangeyo baseMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngokuziphatha kwemigaqo yezempilo. Ukulawulwa ngokweentlobo ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengesebe kunye namava kwelongo lezempilo elichaziweyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lwamananga nezixhobo zempilo kunye nemigaqo yesebenzo yangoku. Amakhono anengxoxo, ukuthatha imbali, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganisela ngokwezempilo kunye nokulawula ngokwezempilo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (Ukuzilolonga ngokwayo). Uqobo lwenyanga enye yonyaka unyaka o-1 wamava ahambelanayo emva kobhaliso kwi-Foreign Professions eqinisekisiweyo nakanye okanye kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (I-Obstetrics & Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Inqanaba 2: Inyanga ezintlanu (5) zamva emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (Ukuzilolonga ngokwayo). Inyanga ezintandathu (6) zamva emva kobhaliso kwi-bhunga lezempilo lasemazweni eliqinisekisiweyo nakanye okanye kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (I-Obstetrics & Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Inqanaba 3: Inyanga ezilishumi (10) zamva emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (Ukuzilolonga ngokwayo). Inyanga ezilishumi elinanye (11) zamva emva kobhaliso kwi-bhunga lezempilo lasemazweni eliqinisekisiweyo nakanye okanye kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sempilo (I-Obstetrics & Gynaecology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho kunye namandla afunekayo. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngokuziphatha kwemigaqo yezempilo. Ukulawulwa ngokweentlobo ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengesebe kunye namava kwelongo lezempilo elichaziweyo. Ulwazi oluzinileyo ngokwezempilo. Amandla namakhono kwimimandla yonke yezempilo. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nangxwara ngexesha elingenamda eliqhelekileyo nangaphaya kweyure ezize ngokwesiqhelo nokusebenza nesebe elahlukahlukeneyo. Iliso elihle lokunxibelelana, ukulatha, nokukwazi ukusebenza nabantu, nokuzibandakanya xa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yezempilo yangoku, umthetho, iinkqubo nangabaphambili kule mimandla. Ikhono lokufundisa nokukhokela abasebenzi abangakwaziyo kwesebe. Iimpawu zozenzo: Ukumelana nengxwara, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe, ukuzithemba nokwazi ukwakha kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukulawulwa kwe-Obstetrics & Gynaecology nasekuqwalaselwa iinkonzo. Ukwenza imisebenzi kunye nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuxhasa iinjongo nemiqobo yesebe ehambelana namazinga okunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukuba nawo oluwesibini ekunakekelweni kwabaguli abangenwe kwindawo enqanaba 2/3 yenkonzo. Ukunceda kulungiselelwa nokuphunyezwa kwezikhokelo nemigaqo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwinkqubo yezemfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukunceda ngokuqwalaswa ngokwezempilo nokubamba iqhaza ngokubandakanya ngokukhawuleza ekuphuhlisenwe ngobungcali. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lwesibhedlele ngakumbi ukugcinwa kwezinga elizinzileyo lokunakekelwa kwabaguli kunye neenkonzo. Ukuzithobela iNkqubo yoLawulo noPhuhliso loSebenzo (ukwenza iingxoxo zenyanga ezintathu kunye nokuqwalaselwa kokugqibela).

jobs.title: Health Information Officer

Knowledge of public health indicators and data elements. Advanced knowledge in the management of registers and all relevant source documents. Knowledge of data quality assessment tools and methods. af.title: Gesondheidsinligtingbeampte
af.summary: Gesondheidsinligtingbeampte by Rob Ferreira Hospital in Mpumalanga wat DHIS-databasisbedrywighede, dataverifikasie en prestasie-oorsigte bestuur, met vereistes van Graad 12 met ses jaar se DHIS-ervaring of 'n tersaaklike diploma of graad.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Graad 12 plus ses (6) jaar se ervaring in DHIS of Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Statistic / Information Management soos deur SAQA erken met drie (3) tersaaklike ervaring in DHIS. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid. Voorleggings- en data-ontledingsvaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van Gesondheidsinligtingstelsels. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Kennis van openbare gesondheidsaanwysers en data-elemente. Gevorderde kennis van die bestuur van registers en alle tersaaklike brondokumente. Kennis van datakwaliteitsassesseringsnutsgoed en -metodes. Vaardighede in datakonsolidasie, verifikasie en validasieprosesse. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.

Ondersteun DHIS-weergawerkstellings en werkswinkels rakende nuwe weergawes. Ondersteun implementering van Nasionale, Provinsiale en Distrik Gesondheidsinligtingstelsels. Voer datakwaliteitsoudit vir die fasiliteit en gehaltsverbeteringsplanne uit. Monitor implementering van gesondheidsinligtingsbeleid.

zu.title: Umphathi Wolwazi Ngempilo
zu.summary: Umphathi Wolwazi Ngempilo e-Rob Ferreira Hospital e-Mpumalanga uphatha izimsebenzi zedatabase ye-DHIS, ukuqinisekisa idatha nokubuyekezwa kwentengo, kudingwa ibhadi le-Grade 12 eminyakeni eyisithupha yamava ne-DHIS noma idiploma noma idigri ehambisana nayo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kanye namava eminyakeni eyisithupha (6) ku-DHIS noma i-Diploma / i-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Statistic / Information Management njengoba kuqashwa i-SAQA kanye namava amathathu (3) ahambisana no-DHIS. Ukuthanda ngamazinga aphezulu ikhompuyutha. Amakhono okubamba inkulumo nokuhlaziya idatha. Ukuqonda okubalulekile ngezimiso zolwazi ngempilo. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi komfungo. Ulwazi ngesikhombi sezempilo sabantu ne-elementi yedatha. Ulwazi olusezingeni eliphezulu ekuphateni amarejista nayo yonke imibhalo ehambisana nayo. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi nezindlela zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yedatha. Amakhono ohlelweni lokuhlanganisa, ukuqinisekisa nokugunyaza idatha. ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qasha ukuphatwa kwedatabase ye-DHIS esibhedlela nakwezinye izimiso ezihambisana nazo. Qasha imihlangano yokubuyekeza idatha yesikhungo nentengo. Qasha ukuqinisekisa, ukugunyaza nokuhlanganisa idatha yesibhedlela kuzo zonke izinto ezingomthombo. Thwebula idatha ngokushesha kwi-Web-DHIS uyifake kulesimiso. Sekela izibuyekezo zenguqulo ye-DHIS namakilasi abuciko ahlobene nenguqulo entsha. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso zolwazi ngempilo zezwe, nzesifundazwe nasendawo. Qasha ukuhlolwa kwakhwalithi yedatha yesikhungo nehlelo lokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo zolwazi ngempilo.

xh.title: Iofisa yolwazi ngeMpilo
xh.summary: Iofisa yolwazi ngeMpilo kwisibhedlele iRob Ferreira Hospital eMpumalanga elilawula imisebenzi yedatabase yeDHIS, ukuqinisekisa i-data kunye nokuphonononga inkqubo, kufuneka abe nesiphelo samabanga aGrade 12 aneminyaka yamafa amithandathu yamava a-DHIS okanye idiploma okanye idigri efanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 ngaphezulu kweminyaka emithandathu (6) yamava kwi-DHIS okanye i-Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Statistic / ulawulo lolwazi njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA eneminyaka emithathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo kwi-DHIS. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo lwekhompyutha. Amakhono okubonisa nokuhlalutya i-data. Ulwazi olubanzi lweekqubo zonke zelwazi zeMpilo. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi ngemixholo yempilo yoluntu nedata elements. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo kulawulo lwerejista nawo wonke amaxwebhu afanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngamathuba okuqinisekisa ubungakanani bedata kunye neendlela. Amakhono kwi-data consolidation, ukuqinisekisa nendlela yokuhambisa isiqinisekiso. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qhuba ulawulo lwedatabase ye-DHIS kwisibhedlele nakwezinye iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Qhuba iindibano zokuqinisekisa i-data yefasilita nokuphonononga inkqubo. Qhuba ukuqinisekisa i-data, ukuhambisa isiqinisekiso nokuqhina kolwazi lwesibhedlele kuzo zonke iindawo. Thumela i-data ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwi-Web-DHIS uze uyifakele kwindalo. Xhasa ukuqhutywa koluhlaziyo lwe-DHIS kunye neendibano ezimalunga neenguqulo ezintsha. Xhasa ukusebenza kweenkqubo zelwazi zeMpilo zeZwelonke, eNgingqi nakwiSithili. Qhuba uluvo lobungakanani bedata yefasilita nendlela zokuphucula ubungakanani. Lilinde ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zelwazi lempilo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk

Bonise isakhono sokuzenza bodwa, ngokungatshintshi, ngokubambisana nokuqinisekiswa. Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi loluhlelo, loluhlelo lolawulo namakhono axazulula iingxaki. Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqonda iimfuno. Bazi ukusebenza ngexesha elinzima nangamavesi amaninzi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenza kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa koluhlelo lokulawula abasebenzi (HRM) nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela. Lawula inkxaso yesebe leemali nolawulo lokuchitha imali. Lawula ukusebenza koluhlelo lokulawula ukuthengiswa nokuthengiswa (SCM) ngokufanelekileyo nokusebenza kakuhle: imisebenzi ethengisa kwesebe. Nikezela ngendlela efanelekileyo nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza koluhlelo lolawulo ecaleni kweMali. Lawula ukulahlekelwa ngokulawula iinkcitho kwisebe.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Assessment and Examinations
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14). An all-inclusive salary package consists of a basic salary, and the employer's contribution to the Pension Fund. The remainder of the package may be structured according to your personal needs
jobs.summary: Chief Director position at the Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, responsible for managing assessment and examination systems at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA. At least 5 years of experience at a senior management level. Successful completion of the Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Proven knowledge of and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions. Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function. Proven knowledge and understanding of programme and project management. Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration. Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems. Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape. Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector. Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements. Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments. Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day. Basic knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations. Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy. Literacy. Computer Literacy. Language skills. Project Management. Accounting, Finance and Audit. Economic, Financial and Statistical analysis. Legal Administration. Strategic Planning.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Line management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Develop and maintain the assessment systems pertaining to all phases of curriculum delivery: Develop provincial assessment systems and see to application of national assessment systems; Build skills and capacity in respect of the application of assessment systems; Review assessment systems based on feedback and feed into provincial intervention programmes and national review processes; Administration support regarding examination irregularities. Manage the planning and administration of examinations and certification throughout the education system: Administer examination and certification processes; Provide a provincial printing service and manage examination distribution and marking services; Provide administrative support services. Plan, manage and coordinate the development and implementation of examination and assessment information systems for the Chief Directorate: Manage the development, implementation and review of policies to govern the implementation and use of examination and assessment information systems; Manage and monitor the development of new systems and the optimal implementation of existing systems in the Chief Directorate, in collaboration with CeI and SITA; Oversee the provision of user management services; Drive training, capacity-building and knowledge sharing practices; Build capacity of district staff to perform examination and assessment related functions.
