Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Chief Directorate. Drive the Chief Directorate’s strategic planning process. Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Chief Directorate. Evaluate the performance of the Chief Directorate on a continuing basis against pre- determined measurable key objectives and standards. Report to the Deputy Director-General on a regular basis on the activities of the Chief Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to Digital government and ICT. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Chief Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it. Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Chief Directorate, and the Branch. Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Chief Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Chief Directorate Plan. Motivate, train and guide employees within the Chief Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery. Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Chief Directorate. Monitor information capacity building within the Chief Directorate. Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Chief Directorate. Promote sound labour relations within the Chief Directorate. Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Chief Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Chief Directorate level. Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Chief Directorate budget and expenditure. Assume direct accountability to ensure that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Chief Directorate. Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Chief Directorate and Department. Report to the Deputy Director-General and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Chief Directorate finances. Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Chief Directorate. Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Chief Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards. Complete and submit record as per reporting requirements. Risk Management: Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to by the Chief Directorate. Consult with security service partners and structures.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted by using the following URL https://wcedonline.westerncape.gov.za/home/, via Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.
jobs.notes: The applicants are advised to read the foreword available on the WCED website before applying for the post/s. Applications must be made via the department’s on-line E-Recruitment system. The on-line system will automatically generate a Curriculum Vitae; applicants are therefore required to ensure that their profiles are fully completed. Certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary, will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. All applicants must be SA Citizens/Permanent Residents or Non-SA Citizens with a valid work permit. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and competency assessments at a time, date and place as determined by Western Cape Education Department (WCED). The Department reserves the right to conduct pre-employment security screening, and appointment is subject to positive security clearance outcome. Applicants must declare any/pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered post the interview the application will not be considered for the post and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Assessoring en Eksamens
af.summary: Hoofdirekteurpos by die Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van assessorings- en eksamenstelsels op SMS Vlak 14.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n seniorbestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Service (SMS). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Bewese kennis van en werkservaring met die wetgewing, regulasieraamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies. Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting rakende die lynfunksie. Bewese kennis en begrip van program- en projektebestuur. Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings- en tenderprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van bewind en administrasie. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels. Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale, streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape. Bewese kennis en begrip van grondwetlike, regs- en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Bewese kennis en begrip van die funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente. Bewese kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag. Basiese kennis en begrip van Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies. Bewese kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Syfergeletterdheid. Geletterdheid. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Taalvaardighede. Projektebestuur. Rekeningkunde, Finansies en Oudit. Ekonomiese, Finansiële en Statistiese analise. Regsadministrasie. Strategiese beplanning.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Lynbestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Ontwikkel en onderhou die assessoringstelsels wat op alle fases van kurrikulumlewering betrekking het: Ontwikkel provinsiale assessoringstelsels en sien toe dat nasionale assessoringstelsels toegepas word; Bou vaardighede en kapasiteit ten opsigte van die toepassing van assessoringstelsels; Hersien assessoringstelsels op grond van terugvoer en voed dit in provinsiale ingrypingsprogramme en nasionale hersieningsprosesse; Administratiewe ondersteuning rakende eksamenonreëlmatighede. Bestuur die beplanning en administrasie van eksamens en sertifisering deur die hele onderwysstelsel: Administreer eksamen- en sertifiseringsprosesse; Verskaf 'n provinsiale drukdiens en bestuur eksamensverspreiding en nasien Dienste; Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Beplan, bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van eksamen- en assessoringsinligtingstelsels vir die Hoofdirektoraat: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van beleide om die implementering en gebruik van eksamen- en assessoringsinligtingstelsels te regeer; Bestuur en monitor die ontwikkeling van nuwe stelsels en die optimale implementering van bestaande stelsels in die Hoofdirektoraat, in samewerking met CeI en SITA; Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van gebruikersbestuursdienste; Druk opleiding, kapasiteitsbou en kennisdelingspraktyke vooruit; Bou kapasiteit van distrikspersoneel om eksamen- en assessoringsverwante funksies uit te voer. Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingbestuur): Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelstellings, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat. Druk die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses vooruit. Druk die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Hoofdirektoraat vooruit. Evalueer die prestasie van die Hoofdirektoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen voorafbepaalde meetbare sleuteldoelstellings en standaarde. Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal oor die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat en oor sake van wesenlike belang rakende Digitale regering en IKD. Monitor en verseker nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daarvan gebruik gemaak word. Skep en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovering binne die Hoofdirektoraat, en die Tak. Voer sorgvuldig alle pligte toegewys aan die pos van Hoofdirekteur uit. Menslikehulpbronbestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraatplan te verseker. Motiveer, lei en begelei werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat, om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf. Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n arbeidsmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Bevorder gesonde arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Hoofdirektoraatvlak. Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat se begroting en uitgawes. Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures gevolg word ten opsigte van aankope vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Hoofdirektoraat bestuur word. Verseker dat alle besteding in lyn is met die strategiese doelstellings van die Hoofdirektoraat en Departement. Rapporteer aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal en tersaaklike toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Hoofdirektoraat se finansies. Aanvaar algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Hoofdirektoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde. Voltooi en dien rekord in soos per verslagdoeningsvereistes. Risikobestuur: Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en deur die Hoofdirektoraat nagekom word. Raadpleeg sekuriteitsdienspartners en strukture.

zu.title: Umlingisi Omkhulu: Ukubuyekezwa kanye Nezivivinyo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somMlingisi oMkhulu e-Western Cape Education Department e-Cape Town, ongumuntu ophethe izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa nezivivinyo ezingeni le-SMS Level 14.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesigaba (NQF level 7) ezibonwa ngu-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yohlelo lokusebenza ezingeni laphethwe abaphethe abaphakeme. Ukuphumelela ukuqedela i-Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubonakalayo noluhambisanayo mayelana nemithetho, izakhiwo zomthetho ezilawulayo, izinqubo ezinhle ezisebenza kakhulu kumisebenzi ohlelweni. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinhlelo zolwazi ezesekela ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi ohlelweni. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinqubo zokuthenga nokuqashwa kwezinsizakalo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukugcina iliso kanye namaphrothokholi okubuyekeza. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinhlelo zanamuhla zokubusa nokuphatha. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinqubo, izinkambu kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi wumphakathi. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izindaba ezomhlaba, zesifundazwe nedolobha ezibambe iqhaza kumphakathi ohleli we-Western Cape. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho nezikhungo ezilawula umphakathi wakuNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda imali yomphakathi, abantu abasebenzayo kanye nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkulumo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, eminye imithetho yezimali, imiyalo, imiyalo yokuhola kanye nezivumelwano. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda ukusebenza kwesifundazwe namaphrolomu amaphela abelawuli abafanayo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda izinqubo zahulumeni osenzayo bakhona. Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda umthetho nemiyinge yezihlobo zabasebenzi. Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokuqonda ukuphathwa kokuqalisebenza ngokuvamile. Amakhono: Ukubala. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ukusebenzisana ikhompyutha. Amakhono olimi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ukubalwa kwemali, ezezezimali kanye nokuhlolwa. Ukuxazulula kwezomnotho, ezezimali nezibalo. Ukuphathwa komthetho. Ukucwangcisa ngendlela eqondile.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa Komugqa: Ukuphathwa komugqa, ukunika izeluleko nokuqondisa ngokuhlobene namabhulogi okusebenza alandelwayo: Ukuthuthukisa kanye nogcino lwezinhlelo zokubuyekezwa ezihlobene nazo zonke izingqikithi zokuletha uhlelo lokufunda: Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa zesifundazwe kanye nokubheka ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokubuyekezwa ezingezizwe; Ukwakha amakhono n'amandla ngokuhlobene nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokubuyekezwa; Ukubuyekeza izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa ngokususelwa eziphuzo futhi kufake ezinhlelweni zesifundazwe zokungenelela kanye nemitsetho yombuso yokubuyekeza; Ukusekelwa kokulawula ngokuhlobene nokungahambanga kahle kwezivivinyo. Ukuphatha ukucwangcisa kanye nokulawulwa kwezivivinyo nezitifikedi kulo lonke uhlelo lokufunda: Ukuphatha izinqubo zezivivinyo nezitifikedi; Ukunika isevisi yokushicilela yesifundazwe futhi ukulawula ukusatshalaliswa kwezivivinyo kanye namasevisi okumaka; Ukunika amasevisi okusekelwa okulawula. Ukucwangcisa, ukuphatha kanye nohlelo lokubumba ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zolwazi zezivivinyo nokubuyekezwa kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu: Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokubuyekeza izinqubo ezilawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zolwazi zezivivinyo nokubuyekezwa; Ukuphatha kanye nogciniso liso ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezintsha kanye nokusetshenziswa okuhamba kahle kwezinhlelo ezikhona e-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu, ngokubambisana ne-CeI kanye ne-SITA; Ukugcina iliso ekunikweni amasevisi okuphathwa kwezisebenzisi; Ukuqhuba ukuqeqeshwa, ukwakha amandla nokwabelana ngolwazi; Ukwakha amandla abasebenzi bezifunda ukuba benze imisebenzi ehlobene nezivivinyo nokubuyekezwa. Ukuphathwa Kwesu (okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa koshintsho): Ukuchaza kanye nokubuyekeza njalo ngesikhathi injongo, imigomo, izinto eziyisihluthulelo kanye nemisebenzi ye-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqhuba inqubo yokucwangcisisa ngendlela eqondise ihlelo i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqhuba ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo eziqondile nezoshintsha i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukubuyekeza ukusebenza kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu njalo ngesikhathi ngokuhambisana nezigaba ezingashengiswa ezibalulekayo nezimo ezisethwe ngaphambilini. Ukubika ku-Deputy Director-General njalo ngesikhathi ngokuhlobene nemisebenzi ye-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu kanye nezinto eziyisihluthulelo ezibalule kakhulu eziphathelene nehulumeni wekhompyutha kanye ne-ICT. Ukugcina inhlalo futhi uqinisekise ukuziphatha ngemithetho nemiyalo ehlobene nokugcina amarekhodi afanele kahle amathuba kanye nokwenziwa kwemisebenzi ye-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu, futhi nemithombo (abantu, izimali nama-asethi) esetshenziswa kuyo. Ukukhuthaza futhi ukugqugquzela isiko lokubhaqa kwezinto ezintsha ngaphakathi kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu, naseRhodini. Ukwenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe esikhundleni somMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuphathwa kwezenkuhlale: Ukuthatha inhlangothi ekubizweni kwabasebenzi ngamaphuzu namazinga okufanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza ihlelo i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukukhuthaza, ukuqeqesha futhi ukuqondisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu, ukufeza kwaye ukugcina ukukhanya ekuletheni isevisi. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo ukusebenza, ukuhlolwa nokubakhokha abasebenzi base-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukugcina amaphuzu ngokwakhiwa kwamandla kolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukubandakanyeka ekubhalweni kohlelo lwabasebenzi, uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ukuletha isevisi, kanye nohlelo lwezinsiza zolwazi i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukukhuthaza izinhlobonhlobo zezimo ezinhle zabasebenzi base-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo futhi ukukhuthaza ukugcina isiyalo ngaphakathi kwe-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Ukuphatha ukubandakanyeka ekubhaleni amabhajethi ezingeni le-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwebhajethi yoNyaka kanye noKulungiswa kwebhajethi ye-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuthatha inxulumene ngokuqondile ngokuphathwa okusebenza kahle, ngokwezimali nangokusebenziseka kwezimali ekulawulweni kanye nokuphathweni kwebhajethi nezimali ezichithe i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuthatha inxulumene ngokuqondile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulethwa izinqubo ezifanele zokuqasha nokuthenga ngokuhlobene nokuthenga i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuthatha inxulumene ngokuqondile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakontrathi aphathwa kahle futhi asebenza i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali okushise ihambisana nezinhloso eziqondile ze-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu neMnyango. Ukubika ku-Deputy Director-General kanye nalabo abaphethe / amakomidi ohlelo mayelana nazo zonke izinhlangothi zezimali ze-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuthatha inxulumene ngokuphelele ekuphathweni, ekugcineni nasekugqamiseni i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa amarekhodi aze afanele kahle ngesimo semali ye-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu ngokuhambisana namagunya namazinga awo wonke umthetho. Ukugqiba nokuthumela amarekhodi njengoba kudingwa umbiko. Ukuphathwa kengozi: Ukuthatha inxulumene ngokuqondile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunezinqubo ezifanele zokuphathwa kwezengozi ezikhona futhi ezilandwa i-Office yomMlingisi oMkhulu. Ukubonisana nabalingane besevisi yokuphepha kanye nezakhiwo.

xh.title: Umlawuli Oyintloko: Ilinganiselo ngeVavvi
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli oyintloko kwisebe lezemfundo leWestern Cape Education Department eCape Town, sijongene nokulawula iinkqubo zokulinganisa nokuvavva kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesiqu esingaphantsi (NQF level 7) ezivunywa yi-SAQA. Ubuncwane beminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Ukuqeda ngokuphumeleyo i-Certificate yokungena kwi-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluchaziweyo nolwamava okusebenza ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo-mthetho namava amagqibela angothombo kumisebenzi yemimiselo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zonikezelo lwolwazi ezisiza ekulawuleni ulwazi nolwazi oluthe ngqo kumisebenzi yemimiselo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga nokwenza izitsha. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ukuthuthwa kweenkqubo-mthetho, nokuqonda ukulawula amachu, ukuqwalasela nokuhlaziya iinkqubo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zangoku zolawulo nentengiso. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo kunye nendlela zolawulo karhulumente. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iindaba zepolitiki, ezomnoho nentlalo zehlabathi, ngummandla nakwindawo ezithinta urhulumente wephondo leWestern Cape. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda izikhongozela-mthetho, ezomthetho nengqungquthela ezilawula ingxenye kaRhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda mali karhulumente, abantu nokuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo ngokubanzi. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, iNATIONAL and Provincial Treasury Regulations, eminye imithetho yemali, iimvume, iimiyalelo nengqungquthela. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ukusebenza kwephondo nemisebenzi yeenkonzo ezisesandleni. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo-mthetho karhulumente wakulo namhlanje. Ulwazi olusisiqalo nokuqonda umthetho kunye nemithetho yemiba yabasebenzi. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ukulawula ukusebenza ngokubanzi. Amakhono: Ukuyila amanani. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono olwimi. Ukulawula amaphulo. Ukubala, ezoMali nokuQwalasela. Ukuqwalasela kwezoQoqosho, ezoMali nokutshintsha inani. Urhulumente ngokomthetho. Ulawulo lweMichu.
xh.duties: Ukulawula Ummandla: Ukulawula ummandla, kunye nokucebisa kunye nokukhokeza ngokumayelana nawo mandla alandelayo: Ukuthutha nokugcina iinkqubo zokulinganisa ezithinta onke amanqanaba okunikela inkqubo yemfundo: Ukuthutha iinkqubo zokulinganisa zephondo kuze kube kukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokulinganisa zamazwe; Ukwakha amakhono namandla ngokumayelana nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokulinganisa; Ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zokulinganisa ngokusekelwe kwimpendulo nokuzidlulisa kwiinkqubo zokungenelela zephondo nakuqwalaselo kwamanye amazwe; Inkxaso yolawulo ngokumayelana nokungathathi hlangothi kovavvi. Ukulawula uqeqesho lolawulo lovavvi nokugunyazwa ukhondo lwemfundo konke: Ukulawula iinkqubo zovavvi nokugunyazwa; Ukunika inkonzo yoshicilelo yephondo ukulawula usasazo luvavvi namasevisi okuphawula; Ukunika amasevisi enkxaso yolawulo. Ukucwangcisa, ukulawula nokuqulunqa ukuthutha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zonikezelo lwolwazi zovavvi nokulinganisa kulo Mmandla kaMlawuli Oyintloko: Ukulawula ukuthuthwa, ukusebenza nokuphinda kuqwalaselwe kweenkqubo-mthetho ezilawula ukusebenziswa kwezonkezo zovavvi nokulinganisa; Ukulawula nokuqwalasela ukuthuthwa kweenkqubo ezintsha nokugqibelela ekusebenzeni kweenkqubo ezikhoyo kulo Mmandla, ngokusebenzisana neCeI ne-SITA; Ukulawula ukunikwa kwamasevisi okulawula abasebenzisi; Ukukhokeza uqeqesho, ukwakha amandla nokwabelana ngolwazi; Ukwakha amandla abasebenzi basezithili ukuba benze imisebenzi ehlobene novavvi nokulinganisa. Ulawulo lweMichu (kuquka nokulawula utshintsho): Ukuchaza nokuqwalasela rhoqo injongo, iinjongo ezibalulekileyo, izinto ezibalulekileyo nemisebenzi yalo Mmandla kaMlawuli Oyintloko. Ukukhokeza inqubo yocwangciso lomchu walo Mmandla kaMlawuli Oyintloko. Ukukhokeza ukuthutha nokulawula iincwangciso zomchu nezoshishino. Ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kolawulo ngokubiya ngokuchasene neenjongo ezibalulekileyo ezifanyekiswayo neemigangatho. Ukubika kuMlawuli Jikelele njalo ngokumayelana nemisebenzi yalo Mmandla nangokumayelana nezinto ezibalulekileyo ezihlobene norhulumente we-Digital kunye ne-ICT. Ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo ukulandelwa kolwazi oluchaziweyo lweendaba kwimisebenzi yalo Mmandla, nangaphezulu kwemithombo (abantu, imali nezinto) esetyenziswayo. Ukuxhasa nokuqinisekisa inkcultu yokudala iinto ezintsha kulo Mmandla nasekhusini. Ukwenza ngokuzimisela onke amasebenzi anikiweyo kummandla kaMlawuli Oyintloko. Ulawulo Babantu: Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekungeniseni abasebenzi ngamanani nangezigaba ezifanelekileyo ukugqiba kuqaliswe icwangciso. Ukukhuthaza, ukuqeqesha nokukhokeza abasebenzi, ukugqiba nokugcina ukuphumelela kwantlalo yamandla. Ukulawula ngokuzimisela ukusebenza, ukuqwalasela nokubakhawulezisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kommandla. Ukuqwalasela ukwakha amandla o lwazi kummandla. Ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo ukuthabathekho ekwenzeni icwangciso labasebenzi, inkqubo yokuphucula ukunikezela inkonzo, kunye necwangciso lemithobo yolwazi. Ukukhuthaza iziproito ezilungele phakathi kwabasebenzi. Ukulawula ngokuzimisela nokukhuthaza ukugcina inyaniso ngommandla. Ulawulo lweMali: Ukulawula ukuthabathekho kwinkqubo yemali. Ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo ukuqokelelwa kweMali kaNyaka neMali esilungiswayo yamachu. Ukubeka ngqo inxaxheba ekulawuleni, ekulawuleni nasekusebenziseni ngokugqibelela ibheji nokuqhathwa. Ukubeka ngqo inxaxheba ekutheni kuqinisekiswe ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Ukubeka ngqo inxaxheba ekutheni kuqinisekiswe ukuba ii-contracs zilawulwa ngokuchanileyo. Ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba wonke umcelo mngqamle namachu nasebe. Ukubika kuMlawuli Jikelele kunye nabalawuli bokuhlola/babhangqa bommandla ngazo zonke iinkqubo zamashishini. Ukubeka ngqo inxaxheba ekulawuleni, ekugcineni nasekugcineni ngokuchanileyo. Ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba kugcinwe iirekhodi ezizez zonke iinkxwabo zamashishini. Ukugqiba nokungenisa irekhodi njengoko kufuneka kusetyenziswa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa. Ulawulo lweengozi: Ukubeka ngqo inxaxheba ekwenzeni ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba kuye kwabekwa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zolawulo lweengozi. Ukucangcangela nabahlohli bamasevisi zokhuseleko nangeendaba.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Physical Resources
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14). An all-inclusive salary package consists of a basic salary, and the employer's contribution to the Pension Fund. The remainder of the package may be structured according to your personal needs
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Physical Resources for the Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA. At least 5 years of experience at a senior management level. Successful completion of the Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Proven knowledge of and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions. Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function. Proven knowledge and understanding of programme and project management. Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration. Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems. Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape. Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector. Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements. Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments. Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day. Proven knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations. Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy. Literacy. Computer Literacy. Language skills. Project Management. Accounting, Finance and Audit. Economic, Financial and Statistical analysis. Legal Administration. Strategic Planning.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Develop and manage strategies, policies, systems, norms / standards, plans and leases related to infrastructure programmes / projects: Determine and maintain physical resources framework for schools, hostels and office accommodation. Determine policies, strategies and procedures for capital, scheduled, day-to-day and emergency maintenance projects. Draft infrastructure inputs for Provincial Infrastructure-, Departmental Strategic-, Annual Performance- and Service Plans and Annual Report. Compile the U-AMP. Interpret, customise / develop and legislate functional and technical norms and standards as issues by DBE. (Technical norms and standards need to be interpreted, customised and approved in consultation with the implementing agent. Manage leases and facilities estate management. Manage the delivery of the total programme of infrastructure projects through the interaction with and monitoring / oversight of the Implementing sound financial accounting practices: Prepare the IPMP (including construction procurement strategy) based on the U-AMP and the MTEF with inputs being provided by the implementing agent. Provide project / programme information and inputs when the IPIP is drafted by the implementing agent. Draft SDA with implementing agent. Rigorously review and sign-off IPIP, different PEPs during the different phases of project implementation. Implement day-to-day maintenance and emergency projects and programmes. Implement compliance with OHS requirements. Develop and implement Disaster Management Plan. Financial management and reporting. Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Chief Directorate. Drive the Chief Directorate’s strategic planning process. Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Chief Directorate. Evaluate the performance of the Chief Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined measurable key objectives and standards. Report to the Deputy Director-General on a regular basis on the activities of the Chief Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Chief Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it. Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Chief Directorate, and the Department. Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Chief Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Chief Directorate’s Business Plan. Motivate, train and guide employees within the Chief Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery. Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Chief Directorate. Monitor information capacity building within the Chief Directorate. Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Chief Directorate. Promote sound labour relations within the Chief Directorate. Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Chief Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Chief Directorate level. Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Chief Directorate’s budget and expenditure. Assume direct accountability to ensure that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Chief Directorate. Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Chief Directorate and Department. Report to the Deputy Director-General and relevant oversight role players/ committees on all aspects of the Chief Directorate’s finances. Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Chief Directorate assets. Assume direct accountability to ensure that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to by the Chief Directorate. Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Chief Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted by using the following URL https://wcedonline.westerncape.gov.za/home/, via Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.
jobs.notes: The applicants are advised to read the foreword available on the WCED website before applying for the post/s. Applications must be made via the department’s on-line E-Recruitment system. The on-line system will automatically generate a Curriculum Vitae; applicants are therefore required to ensure that their profiles are fully completed. Certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary, will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. All applicants must be SA Citizens/Permanent Residents or Non-SA Citizens with a valid work permit. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and competency assessments at a time, date and place as determined by Western Cape Education Department (WCED). The Department reserves the right to conduct pre-employment security screening, and appointment is subject to positive security clearance outcome. Applicants must declare any/pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered post the interview the application will not be considered for the post and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Fisieke Hulpbronne
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Fisieke Hulpbronne vir die Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toelating tot Senior Management Service (SMS). Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Bewese kennis van en werkservaring met die wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies. Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help by die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie. Bewese kennis en begrip van program- en projeksbestuur. Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings en tenderprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels. Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale, streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape. Bewese kennis en begrip van konstitusionele, regs- en institusionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Bewese kennis en begrip van die funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente. Bewese kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag. Bewese kennis en begrip van Arbeidsverhoudings-wetgewing en regulasies. Bewese kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid in wiskunde. Geletterdheid. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Taalvaardighede. Projeksbestuur. Rekenkunde, Finansies en Oudit. Ekonomiese, finansiële en statistiese ontleding. Regsadministrasie. Strategiese beplanning.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Ontwikkel en bestuur strategieë, beleide, stelsels, norme/standaarde, planne en huise wat verband hou met infrastruktuurprogramme/projekte: Bepaal en handhaaf 'n fisieke hulpbroneraamwerk vir skole, koshuisse en kantoorakkommodasie. Bepaal beleide, strategieë en prosedures vir kapitale, geskeduleerde, daaglikse en noodonderhoudsprojekte. Opstel van infrastruktuurtoevoere vir Provincial Infrastructure-, Departmental Strategic-, Annual Performance- en Service Plans en Annual Report. Opstel van die U-AMP. Interpreteer, pas aan/ontwikkel en wetgew funksionele en tegniese norme en standaarde soos deur DBE uitgereik. (Tegniese norme en standaarde moet geïnterpreteer, aangepas en goedgekeur word in oorleg met die implementerende agent. Bestuur huise en fasiliteiteboedelbestuur. Bestuur die lewering van die totale program van infrastruktuurprojekte deur die interaksie met en monitering/toesig van die Implementering van basiese finansiële rekenkundige praktyke: Berei die IPMP (insluitend konstruksieverkrygingsstrategie) voor op grond van die U-AMP en die MTEF met toevoere wat deur die implementerende agent verskaf word. Verskaf projek/programinligting en toevoere wanneer die IPIP deur die implementerende agent opgestel word. Opstel van SDA met implementerende agent. Grondig hersien en onderteken IPIP, verskillende PEPs gedurende die verskillende fases van projeksimplementering. Implementeer daaglikse onderhouds- en noodprojekte en -programme. Implementeer voldoening aan OHS-vereistes. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n Disaster Management Plan. Finansiële bestuur en verslagdoening. Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingbestuur): Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat. Dryf die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses. Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Evalueer die prestasie van die Hoofdirektoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen vooraf bepaalde meetbare sleuteldoelwitte en standaarde. Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal oor die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang wat verband hou met operasionele bestuursondersteuning. Monitor en verseker voldoening aan relevante wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en gepaste rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur gebruik word. Bevorder en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Hoofdirektoraat, en die departement. Voer ywerig alle pligte uit wat aan die pos van Hoofdirekteur opgedra is. Mensbestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraat se besigheidsplan te verseker. Motiveer, oplei en begelei werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat om uitnemendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf. Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker betrokkenheid by die samestelling van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Hoofdirektoraatvlak. Verseker die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse en aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat se begroting en besteding. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word ten opsigte van aankope vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief bestuur word vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker dat alle besteding in ooreenstemming is met die strategiese doelwitte van die Hoofdirektoraat en departement. Rapporteer aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal en relevante toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Hoofdirektoraat se finansies. Neem algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veiligheid van die Hoofdirektoraat se bates. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en deur die Hoofdirektoraat nagekom word. Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Hoofdirektoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Izinsiza Eziyisicaba
zu.summary: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Izinsiza Eziyisicaba e-Western Cape Education Department e-Cape Town, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlumo oluphezulu kokuphatheka kwezinsiza eziyisicaba.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esingaphansi kwamadiploma (i-NQF level 7) esimukelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yohlumo oluphezulu kwezinsiza eziyisicaba. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-Certificate yokungena kwi-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ileyisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubonisiwe kanye nohlobo lokuqondiswa ngemisebenzi emayelana nomthetho, izakhiwo zolawulo, izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili ezithinta imisebenzi eqokiwe. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi kanye nezinkomba mayelana nomsebenzi eqokiwe. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda inqubo yokuqasha kanye nokuqashisa izinkontileka. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, kanye nokuphathwa, okuhloliwe kwayokuqiniswa kwezinhlelo. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izinhlelo zanamuhla zokuphatha kanye nokuqashiswa komsebenzi. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izinqubo, izinkomba kanye nezinhlelo zezeze lomphakathi. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izindaba ezingamazwe ngamazwe, ezifundeni nasekhaya mayelana nezepolitiki, ezomnotho kanye nezenhlalo ezithinta urhulumende wesifundazwe wakwaWestern Cape. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho kanye nezamasiko eziphatha umkhakha womphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izimali zomphakathi, izinsiza zomuntu kanye nezinkomba zokuphathwa kwezinkulumo. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, Izilawuli Zesikhwama Sizwe Nasesifundazwe, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo kanye nomaqondana amanye. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ehlobene. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda izinqubomgomo zohulumende waso maso. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda umthetho kanye nezilawuli mayelana nobudlelwano bbasebenzini. Ulwazi olubonisiwe nokugonda ukuphathwa kokusebenza ngokuvamile. Amakhono: Ukubala. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono olimi. Ukuphathwa Namaphrojekthi. Izibalo, Izimali kanye Nokuqaphela. Ukuhlola ngemnotho, Izimali kanye nezibalo. Ukuphathwa Komthetho. Ukuhlela Ngokobuchule.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa Kwemisebenzi Eqokiwe: Ukuphathwa ngokobuchule, ukunikeza kelula kanye noqeqesho mayelana nezindawo zomsebenzi ezelwayo: Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuphatha izinhlelo, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, izilinganiso / izitandards, izinhlelo kanye nokuqashisa izindawo ezihlobene nezinhlelo / amaphrojekthi ezokwakhiwa: Ukucubungula kanye nokugcina isakhiwo sezinsiza eziyisicaba sezikole, amahhotela abafundi kanye nezindawo zokusebenza. Ukucubungula izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo kanye nezinqubo zemibhalo yemali equkethwe kumaphrojekthi abhalwe phansi, kuleyo yokulungisa nsuku zonke noma yezesikhashana. Ukubhala izinkomba zokwakhiwa kumaProvincial Infrastructure, i-Departmental Strategic, amaAnnual Performance kanye namaService Plans kanye noNguqulo Yonyaka. Ukulungisa i-U-AMP. Ukuhumusha, ukulungiselela / ukuthuthukisa nokwenza umthetho izilinganiso ezenza ngokoqobo nangobuchule njengoba kusho i-DBE. (Izilinganiso ezibekiwe ngokoqobo nangobuchule kufanele zihunyushwe, zilungiselwe futhi zivunyelwe kubonisana nomenzi osungule iphrojekthi. Ukuphatha ukuqashisa kanye nokuphathwa kwesikhwama sezinsiza. Ukuphatha ukulethwa kwesibopho sehlelo lamaphrojekthi okwakhiwa kungafinyeleleki ekuxhumaneni kwaye kuhlwaye / kulawulelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemikhuba kahle yezimali zokubhala: Ukulungisa i-IPMP (okuhlanganisa inqubo yokuthenga izinsiza zokwakha) ngokusekelwe kwi-U-AMP nakuMTEF izinkomba ezinikelwe yimenzi osungule iphrojekthi. Ukunikela ngolwazi / izinkomba lapho i-IPIP ibhalwa ngumenzi osungule iphrojekthi. Ukubhala i-SDA kanye nomenzi osungule iphrojekthi. Ukuhlola ngokucophelela futhi uvume i-IPIP, izinhlelo ezingaqedanga ezihlukene phakathi kwamamuu awoyela abo abaphila ngokushintsha okucishe bahlakahlakene nohlelo lokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha izinhlupho zokuphatha imisebenzi egqamile ngemuva kokwamukela izigaba ezithile ezibhekele ekwamukelweni. Ukusebenzisa izinhlupho zokugcina izinsiza kusengozini ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-OHS. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa iHlelo Lokuphatha Izinsongo Zemvelo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokubika. Ukuphathwa Ngokobuchule (okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa koshintshintsho lwesimo): Ukuchaza futhi ukuhlola njalo ngesikhathi isiqondiso, izinhloso, izinto ebalulekile kanye nemisebenzi yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuphatha inqubo yokuhlela ngokobuchule yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kwaye kugqamise izinhlelo ngokobuchule nezohwebo zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuhlola ukusebenza kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo njalo ngokusebenzisa izinhloso ezingaguquki futhi ezilinganisekayo kanye nezilinganiso. Ukubika kuMphathihlwapezulu Jikelele njalo ngesikhathi mayelana nemisebenzi yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo kanye nalezindaba ezibalulekile mayelana nokusekela ukuphathwa kokubhalisa. Ukugcina futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho kanye nemiyalo engqondweni ngokuzele kokuze okungqondwa kwezibhalo zemisebenzi yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo, kanye nezinsiza (abantu, izimali kanye nezimpahla) ezisetshenziswayo. Ukukhuthaza futhi ukugqugquzela isiko lokuqonda okusha ngaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo, kanye nomnyango. Ukusebenzela ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe esikhundleni sobuMqondisi Omkhulu. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Ukubamba iqhaza ekubhaleni abasebenzi ngosuku olufanele nangamazinga afanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza iNkqubo YeHwebo yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukukhuthaza, ukuqeqesha futhi kuqondise abasebenzi abangaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo, ukuze kufinyelelwe kugcinwe izinga eliphezulu ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Ukuphatha ngokuzibophezela ukusebenza, ukuhlola futhi ukukhumbula abasebenzi abangaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuhlola ukwakhiwa kokusebenza kwolwazi ngaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubekhona ekwelweni kohlelo lwabasebenzi, inkqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwalethwa kwenkonzo, kanye nohlelo lwezinsiza eziningi zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle bokuqashwa komsebenzi ngaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuphatha futhi ukukhuthaza ukugcinwa kwenkambiso ngaphakathi kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuphatha ukubamba iqhaza ekwenqubweni yokubhala ngemali ezingeni leNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulungiswa kokubhala kwamabhudzethi Ohlelo Lonyaka kanye nokulungiswa kwezimali zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuthatha inkinobho eqondile yokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okulula, okushibhile kwaye kusebenza kahle kweNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo kanye nokuchithwa kwemali. Ukuthatha inkinobho eqondile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhlonishwa izinqubo zokuqashisa izinkontileka kwaye kuthengwe izinto zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuthatha inkinobho eqondile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakontraxi aphathwa ngokusebenza kahle futhi ngempumelelo eNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali echithwayo ihambisana nezinhloso ezibhaliwe ngokobuchule zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo kanye nomnyango. Ukubika kuMphathihlwapezulu Jikelele kwaye kubambe iqhaza abadlali bekuqapha / amakomidi ohlelo lonke mayelana nezimali zeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuthatha inkinobho yonke yonke yokuphathwa, ukugcina nokugcina impahla yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuthatha inkinobho eqondile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona futhi zihambisana izinqubo ezifanele zokuphatha ubungozi eNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zigcinwa izibhalo eziphelele futhi ezifanele zemisebenzi yezimali yeNkantolo Ephilayo Eqondisayo ngokuhambisana noma yisiphi isilinganiso noma izinkomba ezibekiwe.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Izixhobo eziPhathwayo
xh.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu: Izixhobo eziPhathwayo kwi Western Cape Education Department e Cape Town, efunza isatifikethi senqanaba le-NQF 7 kunye neminye emihlanu yamava enkulumbuso yakwisikhulu esenior.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane leminye elingu-5 yamava kwinqanaba lenkulumbuso esenior. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kweSatifikethi sokuNgena kwiSenior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisense yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluchaziweyo nolusebenzayo ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iindlela zomgaqo-nkqubo namacebo amakhulu anengcinga ngokusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ezinceda ekulawuleni ulwazi nolwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekh. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga nokuqashisa. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda uphuhliso womgaqo-nkqubo, nolawulo lwezicwangciso, ulawulo lolungelelwaniso kwaye kuphuhliswe iinkqubo zokuqwalasela. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zangoku zolawulo nophatho. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezixokeko zesebe lomphakathi. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda izinto ezizezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nezentlalontle zehlabathi jikelele, ezingasemmandakunye nasedolophini ezithintela urhulumente wesifunda we Western Cape. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda izicwangciso zomgaqo-siseko, ezomthetho nezolawulo ezibusa isebe lomphakathi lase South Africa. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda mali yomphakathi, izixhobo zomthwalo wabasebenzi nolawulo lwencoko. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoMphakathi, iQela leNgeniso leSizwe kunye neloSifunda, elinye igazethi yemali, imigaqo-nkqubo, imiyalelo kunye nemiqathango ebandakanyeneyo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ukusebenza kwesifunda kunye nemisebenzi yamasebe ohlobene nayo. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda iimigaqo-nkqubo zorhulumente wemini. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda umthetho wolawulo lwabasebenzi nemiqatho. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo nokuqonda ulawulo lwenkqubo yemisebenzi ngokubanzi. Amapiko: Ukwazi ukubala. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amapiko ulwimi. Ulawulo lweephrojekth. UkuBala iimali, iMali noKucinga. Uhlalutyo lwezoqoqosho, lweMali nolwezibalo. Ulawulo ngokomthetho. Uqwalaselo lwezicwangciso.
xh.duties: Ulawulo loMgca: Ulawulo lwezicwangciso, incelo kunye nolwedwa kwimimandla elandelayo yomsebenzi: Ukuphuhlisa nokuLawula iindlela, imigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo / iinkqubo, iiplani nezivumelwano zokubhalisa ezinxulumene nezicwangciso ze-infrastructure / amaphrojekthi: Ukumisela nokuGCina inkqubo yezixhobo eziphathekayo kumasebe, kumanxhama nakwindawo yolawulo. Ukumisela imigaqo-nkqubo, iindlela nemiqatho yamaphrojekthi obunyulu, okujadulwayo, okwemihla ngemihla nobungapheliyo. Ukuqamba izigqibo ze-infrastructure kwiProvincial Infrastructure-, Departmental Strategic-, Annual Performance- kunye neeService Plans kunye neNyanga eNtshihayiyo. Ukuqamba i-U-AMP. Ukutolika, ukwenza ngokwemfuno / ukuphuhlisa kwaye kwenze umthetho iinkqubo zobugcisa ngeenkcukacha ezikhutshwa yi-DBE. (Iinkqubo zobugcisa ngeenkcukacha kufuneka zitolikwe, zenziwe ngokwemfuno, zivunywe ngokubonisana nomenzi oselawulweni. Ulawulo nezivumelwano zokubhalisa kunye nolawulo lwendawo yokusebenza. Ulawulo lokufika kwenkqubo yonke yamaphrojekthi e-infrastructure ngokunxibelelana nokulawula / ukusika phezulu komenzi oselawulweni ukuqulunqa iindlela ezilungileyo zokubala imali: Ukuqulunqa i-IPMP (kuquka nendlela yokuthenga ezakhiwo) ngesiseko se-U-AMP ne-MTEF ngezigqibo ezinikiwe yomenzi oselawulweni. Ukunika ulwazi / ulwazi lweplani lwenkqubo xa i-IPIP iqanjwa yomenzi oselawulweni. Ukuqamba i-SDA nomenzi oselawulweni. Ukuqwalasela ngokucokisekileyo kunye nokuvumela i-IPIP, iipepahali ezahlukeneyo ze-PEP kumagqibo ahlukeneyo okwenza umsebenzi wephrojekthi. Ukwenza amaphrojekthi nobungapheliyo bemihla ngemihla. Ukwenza ukuthobela iimfuno ze-OHS. Ukuphuhlisa nokwenza iNkqubo yoLawulo lwezizeko ezingalindelekanga. Ulawulo lwemali kunye nokubika. Ulawulo lweZicwangciso (okuquka nobutshintsho bolawulo): Ukuchaza nokulungisa ngokokuqhubekayo injongo, iinjongo, iipereyori kunye nemisebenzi yeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukukhuthaza inkqubo yokuqwalasela iindleka zeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukukhuthaza ukuphuhlisa nokuLawula iindleka zeNkqubo ePhambili kwaye kwenze iiplani zenkqubo yomsebenzi weNkqubo ePhambili. Ukulinganisa inkqubo yemisebenzi yeNkqubo ePhambili ngokokuqhubekayo ngokuchasene neenjongo eziphawulwayo ezilinganisiweyo noma kubekho ukulingana kwazo. Ukubika kuMongami oNcintsheleyo njalo ngokubakho kweNkqubo ePhambili nangemiba ekhokelela kwinkxaso yolawulo. Ukulawula kuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho ochanekileyo kunye namagazethi malunga nokugcina ulwazi olufanelekileyo malunga nemisebenzi yeNkqubo ePhambili, ngezixhobo (abantu, imali kunye nezixhobo) eziye zasetyenziswa. Ukwakha kwaye ukhuthaze inkqubo yobudala obutsha ngaphakathi kwenkqubo, naseKhabhini. Ukwenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikwe kulesi sikhundla sikaMphathi Omkhulu. Ulawulo lweSincedo Abantu: Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuzeni abasebenzi ngomanyano nangemigangatho efanelekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela kweNkqubo yeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukukhuthaza, ukuyala kwaye kulandise abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkqubo, ukuphumeza kwaye kugcine ukuphumelela ekuletweni inkonzo. Ulawulo ngokuzenzakalelayo lwenkqubo yomsebenzi, ukuqwalasela nokubakhuphela induku abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkqubo. Ukulawula ukwakhiwa kwamandla kolwazi ngaphakathi kwenkqubo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthathwa kwexesha ekwenziweni kweNkqubo yomsebenzi, inkqubo yokwenza inkonzo ngcono, kwaye uphuhlise iNkqubo yezixhobo zolwazi yeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukukhuthaza amasiko olawulo oluhle ngaphakathi kwenkqubo. Ukulawula ngokuzenzakalelayo kwaye ukhuthaze ukuGcina inzondo ngaphakathi kwenkqubo. Ulawulo lweMali: Ulawulo lokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokwenza igqeji leNkqubo ePhambili. Ukuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwegqeji leNyanga kunye nokulungiswa kweNyanga yeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukumisa ngokuthe ngqo oluNyanzima kuLawulo okusebenzayo, okugandathelayo nokuSebenzayo nolawulo lwebhajethi yokusebenziswa kweNkqubo ePhambili. Ukumisa ngokuthe ngqo oluNyanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuthenga zilandelwa ngokuchanekileyo ngokomthetho ngokwemiba yokuthenga kwiNkqubo ePhambili. Ukumisa ngokuthe ngqo oluNyanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuba amagqibelo alawulwa ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo kweNkqubo ePhambili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imali ithathwa ngokuvumelana nemiNjongo yeNkqubo ePhambili nesebe. Ukubika kuMongami oNcintsheleyo nakuwo onke amanqanaba alawula / ngokwemiba yemali yeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukumisa oluNyanzima ngokubanzi ngolawulo, ukugcina nokusindwa kwezixhobo zeNkqubo ePhambili. Ukumisa ngokuthe ngqo oluNyanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zolawulo lengozi zikho kwaye zilandelelwa yiNkqubo ePhambili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olupheleleyo noluchanekileyo lweNkqubo ePhambili lugcinwa ngokomthetho nangokweenkqubo ezichaziweyo.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Business Intelligence Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14). An all-inclusive salary package consists of a basic salary, and the employer's contribution to the Pension Fund. The remainder of the package may be structured according to your personal needs
jobs.summary: Chief Director for Business Intelligence Management at the Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, requiring senior management experience and an NQF level 7 qualification.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA. At least 5 years of experience at a senior management level. Successful completion of the Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Proven knowledge of and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions. Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function. Proven knowledge and understanding of programme and project management. Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration. Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems. Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape. Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector. Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes. Proven knowledge and understanding of the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements. Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments. Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day. Basic knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations. Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy. Literacy. Computer Literacy. Language skills. Project Management. Accounting, Finance and Audit. Economic, Financial and Statistical analysis. Legal Administration. Strategic Planning.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Line management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Plan, manage and coordinate education research: Plan required research; Manage and coordinate research; Publish and report on research findings. Coordinate the departmental policy development process: Initiate and evaluate requests for policy development; Facilitate policy alignment within the department; Manage the policy register; Facilitate the policy communication process; Provide expert advice and support on policy development; Facilitate the legislative process of primary and secondary statutory policy. Develop and manage education knowledge, information-, record systems and coordinate ICT: Develop and maintain WCED knowledge management and information systems; Develop and maintain record management systems; Plan, manage and coordinate ICT infrastructure and services. Monitor and evaluate the performance of education delivery at all levels and areas of the education system: Develop and maintain a departmental framework for M&E aligned to Provincial and National M&E Frameworks i.e WSE / SE); Provide advice in generating and developing performance and output indicators; Collate, process and analyse data for relevant performance and output indicators for transversal and departmental programmes; Ensure efficiency and effectiveness in organisational performance systems and reporting; Provide baseline / benchmark information to measure results on the programme in relation to the PSOs; Evaluate relevance, efficiency, effectiveness, impact and sustainability of departmental policies and interventions. Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Chief Directorate. Drive the Chief Directorate’s strategic planning process. Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Chief Directorate. Evaluate the performance of the Chief Directorate on a continuing basis against pre- determined measurable key objectives and standards. Report to the Deputy Director-General on a regular basis on the activities of the Chief Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to Digital government and ICT. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Chief Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it. Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Chief Directorate, and the Branch. Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Chief Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Chief Directorate Plan. Motivate, train and guide employees within the Chief Directorate to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery. Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Chief Directorate. Monitor information capacity building within the Chief Directorate. Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Chief Directorate. Promote sound labour relations within the Chief Directorate. Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Chief Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Chief Directorate level. Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Chief Directorate budget and expenditure. Assume direct accountability to ensure that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Chief Directorate. Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Chief Directorate and Department. Report to the Deputy Director-General and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Chief Directorate finances. Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Chief Directorate. Assume direct accountability to ensure that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to by the Chief Directorate. Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Chief Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted by using the following URL https://wcedonline.westerncape.gov.za/home/, via Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.
jobs.notes: The applicants are advised to read the foreword available on the WCED website before applying for the post/s. Applications must be made via the department’s on-line E-Recruitment system. The on-line system will automatically generate a Curriculum Vitae; applicants are therefore required to ensure that their profiles are fully completed. Certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary, will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. All applicants must be SA Citizens/Permanent Residents or Non-SA Citizens with a valid work permit. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and competency assessments at a time, date and place as determined by Western Cape Education Department (WCED). The Department reserves the right to conduct pre-employment security screening, and appointment is subject to positive security clearance outcome. Applicants must declare any/pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered post the interview the application will not be considered for the post and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsintelligensiebestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur vir Besigheidsintelligensiebestuur by die Western Cape Education Department in Cape Town, wat seniorbestuurservaring en 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n seniorbestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toelating tot Senior Management Service (SMS). Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Bewese kennis van en werkervaring met die wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies. Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie. Bewese kennis en begrip van program- en projektebestuur. Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings- en tenderprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbaardiensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels. Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale, streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape. Bewese kennis en begrip van die grondwetlike, regtelike en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer. Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse. Bewese kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, direktiewe en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Bewese kennis en begrip van die funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente. Bewese kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag. Basiese kennis en begrip van Arbeidsverhoudingwetgewing en -regulasies. Bewese kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Syfergeletterdheid. Geletterdheid. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Taalvaardighede. Projektebestuur. Rekeningkunde, Finansies en Oudit. Ekonomiese, finansiële en statistiese analise. Regsadministrasie. Strategiese beplanning.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Lynbestuur, advies en leiding met betrekking tot die volgende funksionele areas: Beplan, bestuur en koördineer opvoedkundige navorsing: Beplan benodigde navorsing; Bestuur en koördineer navorsing; Publiseer en rapporteer oor navorsingsbevindings. Koördineer die departementele beleidsontwikkelingsproses: Inisieer en evalueer versoeke vir beleidsontwikkeling; Fasiliteer beleidsbelyning binne die departement; Bestuur die beleidsregister; Fasiliteer die beleidskommunikasieproses; Verskaf deskundige advies en ondersteuning oor beleidsontwikkeling; Fasiliteer die wetgewingsproses van primêre en sekondêre statutêre beleid. Ontwikkel en bestuur opvoedkundige kennis, inligting- en rekordstelsels en koördineer IKTV: Ontwikkel en onderhou WCED-kennisbestuur- en inligtingstelsels; Ontwikkel en onderhou rekordbestuurstelsels; Beplan, bestuur en koördineer IKTV-infrastruktuur en -dienste. Monitor en evalueer die prestasie van opvoedkundige leweransie op alle vlakke en areas van die opvoedingstelsel: Ontwikkel en onderhou 'n departementele raamwerk vir M&E belyn met Provinsiale en Nasionale M&E-raamwerke, d.w.s. WSE / SE); Verskaf advies by die generering en ontwikkeling van prestasie- en uitset-aanwysers; Versamel, verwerk en ontleed data vir toepaslike prestasie- en uitset-aanwysers vir transversale en departementele programme; Verseker doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit in organisatoriese prestasiestelsels en verslagdoening; Verskaf basislyn-/ maatstafinligting om resultate van die program te meet in verhouding tot die PSO's; Evalueer die relevantheid, doeltreffendheid, effektiwiteit, impak en volhoubaarheid van departementele beleide en intervensies. Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingbestuur): Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat. Dryf die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses. Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Evalueer die prestasie van die Hoofdirektoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen voorafbepaalde meetbare sleuteldoelwitte en standaarde. Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal oor die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang rakende Digitale regering en IKTV. Monitor en verseker nakoming met toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte met betrekking tot voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Hoofdirektoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur gebruik word. Bevorder en stoot 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Hoofdirektoraat, en die Tak aan. Voer getrou al die pligte uit wat aan die pos van Hoofdirekteur opgedra is. Mensbestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraatplan te verseker. Motiveer, lei en begelei werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat om uitmuntendheid in diensleweransie te bereik en te handhaaf. Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Monitor inligting-kapasiiteitsopbou binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweransieverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Hoofdirektoraatvlak. Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Hoofdirektoraatbegroting en -besteding. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word met betrekking tot aankope vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Hoofdirektoraat bestuur word. Verseker dat alle besteding belyn is met die strategiese doelwitte van die Hoofdirektoraat en Departement. Rapporteer aan die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal en toepaslike toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Hoofdirektoraat se finansies. Neem algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veiligkeeping van die Hoofdirektoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuursprosedures in plek is en deur die Hoofdirektoraat nagekom word. Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Hoofdirektoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskryfde norms en standaarde.

zu.title: Umholi Omkhulu: Ukuphathwa Kwezolwazi Ezelwe Izinhlelo
zu.summary: Umholi Omkhulu Wokuphathwa Kwezolwazi Ezelwe Izinhlelo e Western Cape Education Department e Cape Town, ofuna olunye ulwazi lokusebenza kolunye uholi oluphezulu nangaphezulu nesitifiketi sabanga le-NQF level 7.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphezulu kwesikolo (NQF level 7) njengoba kuqashwa ngu-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yohlalelo emzinganweni wolunye uholi oluphezulu. Ukuphothulela ngokuphumelelayo isitifiketi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisense yomshayeli esevisiwe. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nolwazi lokusebenza ngomthetho, izinhlelo zokulawula, izinqubomgomo nezindlela ezinhle eziba namandla emisebenzi yelayini. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda amasistimu wolwazi asiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi welayini. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda inqubo yokuthenga nokuqashisa. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, nokuphathwa kwenqubomgomo, ukulandela kanye nokubuyekeza izinqobo. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda amasistimu amasha okubusa kanye nokuphatha. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda izinqubo, izinhlelo namasistimu omphakathi. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda izindaba zezombusazwe, nezomnotho nentando yeningi emhlabeni jikelele, kumazwe nasemiphakathini ezingena kumnyango kahulumeni wesiZinginingi se Western Cape. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho namasiko ephatha umkhakha kahulumeni wase Ningizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda imali yomphakathi, abantu abasebenza kanye nezenqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkulumo. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Womphakathi, Izinqubomgomo Zesikhwama Senarha NesiFunda, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo yomthetho ngezimali, kanye nezivumelwano. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nokuqonda ukusebenza kwesifunda kanye nemisebenzi yamanye amanyango ahlobene. Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izinqubomgomo kahulumeni wasesikhathini. Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda umthetho kanye nezinqubo zomthetho wezibopho. Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukuphathwa kokuqhuba umsebenzi jikelele. Amakhono: Ukubala. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono olimi. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi. Izimali, ukuhola nokuhlolwa. Ukuxazulula izomnotho, izimali kanye nezibalo. Ukuphathwa komthetho. Ukuhlela inqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa Kwelayini: Ukuphathwa kwelayini, ukweluleka kanye nokuhola ngokwemisebenzi elandelayo: Hlela, phatha kanye uhlokanise ucwaningo lomfundo; Hlela ucwaningo oludingekayo; Phatha futhi uhlokanise ucwaningo; Shicilela kanye nibike ngemiphumela yocwaningo. Hlokanise inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo komnyango; Qala kanye uhlole izicelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo; Yenza ukuqondanisana kwezinqubomgomo ngaphakathi komnyango; Phatha irekhodi lezinqubomgomo; Yenza inqubo yokuxhumana ngezinqubomgomo; Nikeza izeluleko kanye nokuweseka ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo; Yenza inqubo yomthetho wezinqubomgomo zomthetho okuyisisekelo nesesikhundla. Thuthukisa kanye upheze izinhlelo zolwazi lomfundo, izinhlebo zolwazi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza kanye nohlokaniso lwe-ICT; Thuthukisa kanye ulondoloze izinhlebo zolwazi zika-WCED kanye namasistimu wolwazi; Thuthukisa kanye ulondoloze izinhlebo zokuphatha irekhodi; Hlela, phatha kanye nohlokanise izisekelo kanye namasevisi e-ICT. Landela kanye uhlolle ukusebenza kokulethwa kolwazi emazingeni onke nasezindaweni zonke zesistimu yemfundo; Thuthukisa kanye ulondoloze umthetho wangaphakathi wokulandela nokuhlolwa ohambisana ne-Provincial kanye ne-National M&E Frameworks okungukuthi WSE / SE); Nikeza izeluleko ekwakheni nasekuthuthukisweni kokulinganisa ukusebenza kanye nokuvela komphumela; Qoqa, ucubungula futhi uhlaziye imininingwane okulinganisa ukusebenza kanye nokuvela komphumela wezinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe kanye nezomnyango; Qinisekisa ukusebenza kanye nempumelelo ezinhlelweni zokusebenza kwezinhlangano kanye nokubikwa; Nikeza imininingwane yesisekelo / yokulinganisa ukulinganisa imiphumela yehlelo ekuphathweni kwe-PSOs; Hlola ubuhlobene, ukusebenza, impumelelo, umthelela kanye nokugcina ukuphila kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezinye izinyathelo zomnyango. Ukuphathwa Kwenqubomgomo (kuhlanganise ukuphathwa koshintsho): Chaza kanye ubuyekeze njalo injongo, imigomo, izinhloso ezibalulekile kanye nomsebenzi we-Chief Directorate.
