Phatha inqubo yokuqamba amasu ye-Chief Directorate. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlela zokuqamba amasu nezohwebo ze-Chief Directorate. Hlola ukusebenza kwe-Chief Directorate njalo kokugqamayo okulinganiswayo okubalulekile kanye nemitapo. Bika njalo ku-Deputy Director-General ngomsebenzi we-Chief Directorate nangemindeni ebalulekile ehlobene nehulumeni yedijithali kanye ne-ICT. Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuzigcina emthethweni ngokomthetho ofanele kanye nemiyalo mayelana nokugcina ngokufanele ukulondoloza irekhodi lomsebenzi we-Chief Directorate, kanye namathuluzi (abantu, imali, izimpahla) asetshenziswa. Khulisa futhi usize udaba lokubuchophha ngezinhlebo ezintsha ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate, nasekhonini. Yenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe esikhundleni somholi omkhulu. Ukuphathwa Kubantu: Thatha inxaxheba ekubeni abasebenzi ngosayizi namabanga afanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuphumelela iNqubo ye-Chief Directorate. Phazamisa, hlole futhi ohole abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate ukufeza kanye nogcina ukuphumelela ekuletheni inkonzo. Phatha ngokuzimisela ukusebenza, ukuhlolwa kanye nokubekwa kwesikhundla ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Hlola ukwakhiwa kwamandla emininingwane ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni iplani yabantu abasebenzayo, iplani yokuthuthukisa inkonzo, kanye neplani yamathuluzi emininingwane ye-Chief Directorate. Khuthaza ubuhlobo obuhle bomthetho abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Phatha ngokuzimisela futhi ukhuthaze ukugcina isithunzi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Ukuphathwa Kwemali: Phatha ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqaleni inqubo yokubhekanela imali emzinganweni we-Chief Directorate. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwegadi lemali yonyaka kanye ne-Adjustment Budgets ye-Chief Directorate. Thatka inxaxhebe ngokuqondene ngokushelelwa okusebenzayo, okuphephile kanye nokulawula futhi ukuphatha ibhajethi kanye nokuchithwa kwemali. Thatka ubunkuni ngokuqondene nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqubo ezifanele zokuqashisa kanye nezokuqasha ngokokuthengiweyo ku-Chief Directorate. Thatka ubunkini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkontathka zilawulwa ngokusebenzayo futhi ngempumelelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi konke ukuchithwa kuhambisana nokuqondiswa ngemigomo ebalulekile ye-Chief Directorate kanye ne-Department. Bika njalo ku-Deputy Director-General kanye nabalinganisela abaphatha namanoma ikomidi ngezinto ezibhalwe ngokubamba ibhalansi yeziNdaba zezezimali ze-Chief Directorate. Thatka ubunkini ngokuphela ngokuphathwa, ukulondoloza nokugcina ngokuphephile i-Chief Directorate. Thatka inxaxhebe ngokuqondene nokuqinisekisa izinqubo ezifanele zokuphatha amengo ezibekwe futhi zilandwa yi-Chief Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa amarekhodi aze afanele ngokwezimali ze-Chief Directorate ngaphandle kobunkundla nganoma yimuphi umthetho othi ngawo okumele kwenzeke.

xh.title: Umongameli Oyintlofo: Ulawulo loQondo lweShishino
xh.summary: Umongameli Oyintlofo woLawulo loQondo lweShishino kwiSebe leMfundo saseWestern Cape eCape Town, lifuna amava ohlelo lolawulo oluphezulu nesidanga se-NQF level 7.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esamkelwe yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphezulu. Ukuqeda ngempumelelo i-Certificate yokuqesha kwi-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubonwayo nolusebenzayo ngemithetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo kunye nezona nzila eziluncedo ezithinta imisebenzi yemigca. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda ekulawulweni kolwazi nolwazi oluthe lekhe kwimisebenzi yomgca. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga nokuthenga ngeenthetho. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda ukwenza umgaqo-nkqubo, nolawulo lwe-strategy, ukuqhuba uqikelelo kunye nokuhlolwa kweenkqubo. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo zangoku zolawulo nokulawula. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezixhobo zesebe likarhulumente. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda izindaba ezamazwe ngamazwe, ezifutshane nasedoluhlwini ezizezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nezentlalo ezichukumisa urhulumente wephondo leWestern Cape. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda ezoMgaqo-siseko, ezomthetho nendlela ezilawula eyona nkqubo karhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda mali karhulumente, amathuba abasebenzi kunye neenkqubo zokulawula ingxoxo. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, namanye amagazetha emali, imiyalelo, ngezivumelwano ngokubumbisana. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda ukusebenza kwephondo nemisebenzi yamanye amasebe. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo karhulumente wakule minyaka. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda umthetho neemigaqo ezimalunga neSimo seBasebenzi. Ulwazi olubonwayo nokuqonda ukulawulwa kokusebenza ngokubanzi. Amakhono: Ukubala. Ukufunda nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono olwimi. Ulawulo lwe-Project. I-Accounting, imali kunye nokuhlolwa. Uhlalutyo loqoqosho, lwemali nolwezibalo. Ulawulo ngokomthetho. Uqwalaselo lwe-Strategic.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lomgca: Ulawulo lomgca, ingcebiso kunye nokukhokela kwelaliswe kule migqa yemisebenzi ilandelayo: Uqwalaselo, ukulawula nokuqwalasela uphando lwemfundo: Cwangcisa uphando olufunekayo; Qwalasela nokuqwalasela uphando; Shicilela nichele amaxwebhu phantsi kuphando. Qwalasela inkqubo yokwenza umgaqo-nkqubo wesebe: Qalisa nokuqwalasela izicelo zokwenza umgaqo-nkqubo; Qhobosa uqhathaniso lomgaqo-nkqubo ngaphakathi kwesebe; Lawula isicwangciso somgaqo-nkqubo; Qhobosa inkqubo yokunyaniseka komgaqo-nkqubo; Nikela ngeengcebiso ezichanekileyo ninkxaso ekwenzeni umgaqo-nkqubo; Qhobosa inkqubo yomthetho yomgaqo-nkqubo wezenkqubo ezingunaphakadi nangesibini. Phakamisa nolawula ulwazi lwemfundo, iinkqubo zolwazi, zerekhodi nokuqwalasela i-ICT: Phakamisa nolondoloza ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi lwe-WCED; Phakamisa nolondoloza iinkqubo zokulawula irekhodi; Cwangcisa, lawula nokuqwalasela i-infrastructure neesevisi ze-ICT. Qwalasela nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kokuletha imfundo kuzo zonke iinqanaba nendawo zeqondo lemfundo: Phakamisa nolondoloza inkqubo yesebe ye-M&E eqhathaniswe ne-M&E Frameworks yephondo nasekarhulumente, oko kukuthi WSE / SE; Nikela ngingcebiso ekudaleni nophuhliso lwababalisi bokusebenza nokuveliswa; Qokelela, qhobosa uhlalutyo lwedatha yababalisi abafanelekileyo bokusebenza nokuveliswa kweenkqubo ezingqukuva nasedabenzi; Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuvela iziphumo kwiinkqubo zolawulo nokuchaza amaxwebhu abalisi; Nikela nolwazi olusisiseko / lolulinganiso lokulinganisa iziphumo kwinkqubo ngokuya kwi-PSO; Qwalasela ukufaneleka, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ukusebenza ngempumelelo, umphumo nokuqhubekayo koomgaqo-nkqubo besebe nokungenelela. Ulawulo lwe-Strategic (kuquka nokulawula iinguqu): Chaza uqinge ulandela njalo njalo injongo, iinjongo, izinto eziphambili nemisebenzi yeNkulumbuso eNkulu. Qhuba inkqubo yokucwangcisa i-strategy yeNkulumbuso eNkulu. Qhuba ukuphakamisa nokulawula iinkqubo zoqwalaselo nezoshishino zeNkulumbuso eNkulu. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweNkulumbuso eNkulu ngokuqhubeka ngokuchasene nemiqulu ebalulekileyo eqqhothiweyo nemiqulu eqikelelo. Nikela ingxelo kuMlawuli-Oyintloko ngokubanzi ngokwexesha ngemisebenzi yeNkulumbuso eNkulu nangemiba ekhoyo ebangelwa urhulumente we-Digital kunye ne-ICT. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho namagazetho abalulekileyo ekugcineni nokulondoloza okufanelekileyo nokuqikelelwa kwayo ngemisebenzi yeNkulumbuso eNkulu, ngezixhobo (abantu, iimali namafa) aseqhagamshelwaneni nayo. Khuthaza nokuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuzoba ezintsha ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu, nasoSebe. Yenza ngokuzimisela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe kwindawo kaMongameli Oyintloho. Ulawulo labantu: Thatha inxaxheba ekuqesheni abasebenzi ngamanani nangezigaba ezifanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukufezekiswa kwoCwangciso lweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Khuthaza, qeqesha nkqobo abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu ukuyakufezekisa nokugcina ukuphumelela ekuletheni inkonzo. Lawula ngokubandakanyekayo ukusebenza, uqikelelo nokuqqwulelwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Qwalasela ukwakhiwa kwamakhono yolwazi ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni icwangciso labasebenzi, inkqubo yononngcali yoletha inkonzo, kunye nocwangciso lweziphixhobo zolwazi lweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Khuthaza izimo ezilungele zentlalo yoluntu ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Lawula ngokubandakanyekayo nokuqhubela phambili ukugcinwa kwengqiqo ngaphakathi kweNkulumbuso eNkulu. Ulawulo lweMali: Lawula ukuthathwa inxaxheba kwenkqubo yecwangciso le-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwe-Budgets ezoNyaka nokuLungiselelwa i-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Landela ngokuqinisekileyo ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo, ngokugqithisa kakhulu nangempumelelo isabelo senkonzo neyemali ye-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Landela ngokuqinisekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokuthenga ezichanekileyo zilandelwa ngokomthetho ekuthengeni nge-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Landela ngokuqinisekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuthengisa zilawulwa ngempumelelo nangokuchanekileyo kwi-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imali edliwayo ihambelana neenjongo zoqwalaselo ze-Nkulumbuso eNkulu nesebe. Nikela ingxelo kuMlawuli-Oyintloko kunye nabadlali beqondo elibalulekileyo / kumakomiti nazo zonke iindawo zeemali ze-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Landela ngokuqinisekileyo ukulawula ngokubanzi, ukulondoloza nokugcina i-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Landela ngokuqinisekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zolawulo lwengozi ezifanelekileko zikho kwaye zilandelwa yi-Nkulumbuso eNkulu. Qinisekisa ukuba izikhululo ezizezenene nezichanekileyo zeemali ze-Nkulumbuso eNkulu zigcinwa ngokwemigaqo nemiqulu efunekayo.

jobs.title: District Director
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13). An all-inclusive salary package consists of a basic salary, and the employer's contribution to the Pension Fund. The remainder of the package may be structured according to your personal needs.
jobs.summary: District Director for the Western Cape Education Department in Worcester, overseeing management of public ordinary and special schools at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA. At least 5 years of experience at middle or senior management level. Successful completion of the Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Knowledge of the Education Environment. Extensive knowledge of applicable policies and procedures. Management principles. Public Service procedures. Knowledge of People Management processes. Employee relations. Financial management. Project Management. Skills: Interpret and apply relevant policies and procedures. People management planning. Problem solving skills. Sound Budgeting skills. Communication & Facilitation Skills (including report writing & presentation skills). Strong organisational skills. Strategic thinking and planning. Core Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. People Management and Empowerment. Programme and Project Management. Financial Management. Change Management. Process competencies: Knowledge Management. Service Delivery. Innovation. Problem Solving and Analysis. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Communication.
jobs.duties: Oversee the management of Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools within the district circuits to be effective and efficient in order to deliver quality education: Ensure that Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools are effectively and efficiently managed and governed. Promote leadership and managing principals and support the management of staff (employees) in Public Ordinary Schools and Public Special Schools. Ensure the implementation of the curriculum at Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools within the district. Ensure Learner Support (Inclusive and Specialised Learner and Educator Support) services to Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools. Oversee the district business planning, information management, school management and governance support and, people management within the Education District: Ensure the implementation and dissemination of information, facilitate ICT services and prepare, implement and monitor the district business planning processes and intergovernmental relations. Provide developmental support to Public Ordinary-, Public Special Schools and Hostels to ensure effective and efficient school management and governance. Develop, support and monitor the implementation of sound administration and financial management processes and the implementation of recommendations within Public Ordinary-, Public Special Schools and Hostels. Provide infrastructure planning and monitor delivery of Public Ordinary-, Public Special Schools and Hostels within the district. Administer and monitor learner transport. Manage and monitor the implementation of the National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP). Manage and monitor the implementation of School Safety and Occupational Health and Safety within Public Ordinary-, Public Special Schools and Hostels. Manage and monitor the implementation of school enrichment programmes within Public Ordinary- and Public Special Schools. Provide a people management service in the district. Develop, manage, monitor and report on the workplace skills and the professional development plans for the district. Monitor and administer the staff performance management systems within the district. Manage the health and wellness programmes within the district. Facilitate the compilation of the district people management plan and placement of interns within the district. Oversee the delivery of the curriculum at Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools: Advise schools on national and provincial policies and assist schools to implement them appropriately. Monitor, evaluate and support curriculum implementation. Provide school-based assessments, internal and external examinations (National Senior Certificate – NSC), and national and provincial assessments at district level. Facilitate and support the implementation of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) at Public Schools (including communication, e-Education and e-Administration). Promote the establishment, development, administration and effective use of various school library models (including mobile libraries). Oversee learner support to Public Ordinary- and Public Special Schools: Facilitate and coordinate specialised education programmes including psychological, social work, HIV/AIDS, career guidance, remedial and therapeutic services for all learners. Advance learner health and well-being. Oversee district level corporate service: Promote sound financial and supply chain management (SCM) services. Render a financial accounting service. Provide a management accounting service. Render an asset management service. Manage the SCM service. Monitor financial compliance of Public Ordinary-, Public Special Schools, hostels and provide pre-forensic investigations within the Education District. Evaluation of approved budget of Public Schools and hostels. Manage the evaluation of annual financial statements of Public Schools. Manage the evaluation of the bi-annual financial statements of Public Schools. Verify the monthly compliance of payments (e.g. municipal accounts, LTS, LTSM, etc.). Perform a budget monitoring function in respect of Section 20 schools. Manage pre-forensic investigations. Provide a logistical support service. Manage and monitor GG transport in the district. Manage and maintain district records. Provide a facility support service. Manage and maintain the district- and Circuit Offices infrastructure and grounds. Manage Occupational Health and Safety at the District and Circuit Offices. Strategic Management: Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate. Participate in the Branch strategic planning process. Active involvement in the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate. Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards. Report to the Chief Director on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources employed by it. People Management: Participation in the recruitment of staff in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan. Motivate, train and guide staff within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery. Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of staff within the Directorate. Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate. Active involvement in the compilation of people management plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate. Promote sound employee relations within the Directorate. Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Active participation in the budgeting process at Branch level. Preparing of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate. Assume direct responsibility for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure. Assume direct responsibility for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate. Report to the Chief Director on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances. Assume overall responsibility for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of Directorate’s assets. Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Heather Van Ster Tel No: (021) 467 2089
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted by using the following URL https://wcedonline.westerncape.gov.za/home/, via Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.
jobs.notes: The applicants are advised to read the foreword available on the WCED website before applying for the post/s. Applications must be made via the department’s on-line E-Recruitment system. The on-line system will automatically generate a Curriculum Vitae; applicants are therefore required to ensure that their profiles are fully completed. Certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary, will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. All applicants must be SA Citizens/Permanent Residents or Non-SA Citizens with a valid work permit. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and competency assessments at a time, date and place as determined by Western Cape Education Department (WCED). The Department reserves the right to conduct pre-employment security screening, and appointment is subject to positive security clearance outcome. Applicants must declare any/pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered post the interview the application will not be considered for the post and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Distrikdirekteur
af.summary: Distrikdirekteur vir die Western Cape Education Department in Worcester, wat toesig hou oor die bestuur van openbare gewone en spesiale skole op SMS-vlak 13.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot Senior Management Service (SMS). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Kennis van die Onderwysomgewing. Uitgebreide kennis van toepaslike beleide en prosedures. Bestuursbeginsels. Openbare diensprosedures. Kennis van personeelbestuursprosesse. Werknemerverhoudinge. Finansiële bestuur. Projekbestuur. Vaardighede: Interpretasie en toepassing van relevante beleide en prosedures. Personeelbestuursbeplanning. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Gesonde begrotingsvaardighede. Kommunikasie en fasiliteringsvaardighede (insluitend verslagskrywing en voorleggingsvaardighede). Sterk organisatoriese vaardighede. Strategiese denke en beplanning. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Personeelbestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur. Dienslewering. Innovasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus. Kommunikasie.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die bestuur van Openbare Gewone en Openbare Spesiale Skole binne die distrikkringe om effektief en doeltreffend te wees ten einde gehalte-onderwys te lewer: Verseker dat Openbare Gewone en Openbare Spesiale Skole doeltreffend en effektief bestuur en regeer word. Bevorder leierskap en bestuur van skoolhoofde en ondersteun die bestuur van personeel (werknemers) in Openbare Gewone Skole en Openbare Spesiale Skole. Verseker die implementering van die kurrikulum by Openbare Gewone en Openbare Spesiale Skole binne die distrik. Verseker Leerderondersteunings- (Inklusiewe en Gespesialiseerde Leerder- en Opvoederondersteuning-) dienste aan Openbare Gewone en Openbare Spesiale Skole. Hou toesig oor die distriksakebeplanning, inligtingsbestuur, skoolbestuur en -regeringsondersteuning en personeelbestuur binne die Onderwysdistrik: Verseker die implementering en verspreiding van inligting, fasiliteer ICT-dienste en berei voor, implementeer en monitor die distriksakebeplanningsprosesse en interowerheidsverhoudinge. Verskaf ontwikkelingsondersteuning aan Openbare Gewone-, Openbare Spesiale Skole en koshuise om effektiewe en doeltreffende skoolbestuur en -regering te verseker. Ontwikkel, ondersteun en monitor die implementering van gesonde administratiewe en finansiële bestuursprosesse en die implementering van aanbevelings binne Openbare Gewone-, Openbare Spesiale Skole en koshuise. Verskaf infrastruktuurbeplanning en monitor die lewering van Openbare Gewone-, Openbare Spesiale Skole en koshuise binne die distrik. Administreer en monitor leerdervervoer. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van die National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP). Bestuur en monitor die implementering van Skoolveiligheid en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid binne Openbare Gewone-, Openbare Spesiale Skole en koshuise. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van skoolverrykingsprogramme binne Openbare Gewone- en Openbare Spesiale Skole. Verskaf 'n personeelbestuursdiens in die distrik. Ontwikkel, bestuur, monitor en rapporteer oor die werksplekvaardighede en die professionele ontwikkelingsplanne vir die distrik. Monitor en administreer die personeelprestasiebestuurstelsels binne die distrik. Bestuur die gesondheids- en welstandsprogramme binne die distrik. Fasiliteer die opstel van die distrikspersoneelbestuursplan en plasing van internes binne die distrik. Hou toesig oor die lewering van die kurrikulum by Openbare Gewone en Openbare Spesiale Skole: Adviseer skole oor nasionale en provinsiale beleide en help skole om dit toepaslik te implementeer. Monitor, evalueer en ondersteun kurrikulumimplementering. Verskaf skoolgebaseerde assesserings, interne en eksterne eksamens (National Senior Certificate – NSC), en nasionale en provinsiale assesserings op distriksvlak. Fasiliteer en ondersteun die implementering van Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie (ICT) by Openbare Skole (insluitend kommunikasie, e-Onderwys en e-Administrasie). Bevorder die vestiging, ontwikkeling, administrasie en effektiewe gebruik van verskeie skoolbiblioteekmodelle (insluitend mobiele biblioteke). Hou toesig oor leerderondersteuning aan Openbare Gewone- en Openbare Spesiale Skole: Fasiliteer en koördineer gespesialiseerde onderwysprogramme insluitend sielkundige, maatskaplike werk, MIV/VIGS, beroepsleiding, remediërende en terapeutiese dienste vir alle leerders. Bevorder leerdergesondheid en welstand. Hou toesig oor korporatiewe diens op distriksvlak: Bevorder gesonde finansiële en voorsieningskettingbestuurs- (SCM-) dienste. Lewer 'n finansiële rekenkundige diens. Verskaf 'n bestuursrekenkundige diens. Lewer 'n batebestuursdiens. Bestuur die SCM-diens. Monitor finansiële nakoming van Openbare Gewone-, Openbare Spesiale Skole, koshuise en verskaf voor-forensiese ondersoeke binne die Onderwysdistrik. Evaluering van goedgekeurde begroting van Openbare Skole en koshuise. Bestuur die evaluering van jaarlikse finansiële state van Openbare Skole. Bestuur die evaluering van die halfjaarlikse finansiële state van Openbare Skole. Verifieer die maandelikse nakoming van betalings (bv. munisipale rekeninge, LTS, LTSM, ens.). Voer 'n begrotingsmoniteringsfunksie uit ten opsigte van Afdeling 20-skole. Bestuur voor-forensiese ondersoeke. Verskaf 'n logistieke ondersteuningsdiens. Bestuur en monitor GG-vervoer in die distrik. Bestuur en handhaaf distriksrekords. Verskaf 'n fasiliteersondersteuningsdiens. Bestuur en handhaaf die distriks- en Kringkantore se infrastruktuur en gronde. Bestuur Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid by die Distrik- en Kringkantore. Strategiese Bestuur: Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat. Neem deel aan die Tak se strategiese beplanningsproses. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en sakeplanne vir die Direktoraat. Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen voorafbepaalde kern meetbare doelwitte en standaarde. Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Hoofdirekteur oor die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat. Monitor en verseker nakoming van relevante wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne wat daardeur aangewend word. Personeelbestuur: Deelname aan die werwing van personeel in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se Sakeplan te verseker. motiveer, lei en gee opleiding aan personeel binne die Direktoraat om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf. Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van personeel binne die Direktoraat. Monitor inligtingkapasiteitsbou binne die Direktoraat. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by die opstel van personeelbestuursplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingsbronneplan vir die Direktoraat. Bevorder gesonde werknemerverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat. Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële Bestuur: Aktiewe deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Takvlak. Voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat. Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en uitgawes. Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word ten opsigte van aankope vir die Direktoraat. Rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies. Aanvaar algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates. Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Direktoraat gehou word ooreenkomstig enige voorgeskrewe norms en standaarde.

zu.title: Umqondisi Wesifunda
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wesifunda we-Western Cape Education Department e-Worcester, oqapha ukuphathekwa kwezikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiqu sempilo (NQF level 7) njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yenhlalo yokusebenza ezingeni lokuqonda noma eliphezulu lokuphatha. Ukugqamela ngempumelelo isitifiketi sokungena ku-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngeMvelo yeMfundo. Ulwazi olubanzi mayelana namapholisi namasu okusebenza asetshenziswayo. Imigomo yokuphatha. Amasu okusebenza aseZikhungweni zomphakathi. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokuphatha abantu. Izinkambiso zomsebenzi. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amakhono: Ukutolika nokusebenzisa amapholisi namasu okusebenza ahlobene nawo. Ukuhlela ukuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okulungela amabhalansi ohlelo. Amakhono okuxhumana nokwenza izinkomishi (okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko namakhono okubonisa). Amakhono amakhulu ohlelo nokuhlela. Ukucabanga ngokuqonda nokuhlela. Izakhiwo eziyisisekelo: Ikhono lokubuka ngokuqonda nokuqoka. Ukuphatha kanye nokunika amandla abantu. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nanohlelo. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphatha inguquko. Izakhiwo zenhlekelele: Ukuphatha ulwazi. Ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Ukubumba. Ukuxazulula kanye nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Ukuqondiswa kubathengi ukugxila kwabo. Ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuphathekwa kwezikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi ngaphakathi kwamasensi esifunda ukuze zibe negalelo futhi zisebenze kahle ukuze kulethwe imfundo emhlabeni: Qinisekisa ukuthi izikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi zisetshenziswa futhi zilawulwa ngempumelelo nangempumelelo. Khuthaza ukuqoka nokuphatha abaphathi kanye nokusekela ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lwezifundo ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Qinisekisa izinsizakalo zokusekela abafundi (ukusekela abafundi kanye nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile zokuqonda kanye nezinsizakalo zokusekela abafundisi) ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi. Qapha ukuhlela amabhizinisi esifunda, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukusekela ukuphatha nokuphatha izikole, nokuphatha abantu ngaphakathi kwesiFunda seMfundo: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kanye nokusakazwa kolwazi, qinisekisa izinsizakalo ze-ICT futhi ulungise, usebenzise futhi uqashe inqubo yokuhlela amabhizinisi esifunda kanye nobuhlobo phakathi kahulumende. Nikeza ukusekela ekuthuthukiseni izikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi namahhosithela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle nokuphathwa kwezikole. Bheka, sekela futhi uqashe ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokulawula nokuphatha imali ezinhle kanye nokusetshenziswa kanye nokuphathwa kwamahhosithela. Hlela ukwakhiwa komgwaqo futhi uqashe ukulethwa kwamahhosithela ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi. Lawula futhi uqashe ukuthuthwa kwabafundi. Phatha futhi uqashe ukusetshenziswa kwe-National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP). Phatha futhi uqashe ukusetshenziswa kokuphepha kwezikole kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi namahhosithela. Phatha futhi uqashe ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokwazisa izikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi. Nikeza insizakalo yokuphatha abantu esifundeni. Bheka, phatha, qashe futhi umbike ngohlelo lwamakhono emsebenzini kanye namaphulani ekuthuthukiseni ngobungcweti esifundeni. Qasha futhi ulawule izinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi esifundeni. Phatha izinhlelo zezempilo nentokozo esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kohlaka lokuphatha abantu wesifunda nokubekwa kwabathweswe iziqu esifundeni. Qapha ukulethwa kohlaka lwezifundo ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi: Sela izikole ngamapholisi kazwelonke nasifundazwe futhi usize izikole ukuzisebenzisa kahle. Qapha, hlaziya futhi usekele ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lwezifundo. Nikeza izikole ngokuhlola izifundo, ukuhola kwangaphakathi nangaphandle (National Senior Certificate – NSC), kanye nokuhlola kwazwelonke nasifundazwe ezingeni lesifunda. Qinisekisa futhi usekele ukusetshenziswa kwe-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) ezikoleni zomphakathi (okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana, e-Education naku-e-Administration). Khuthaza ukusungulwa, ukuthuthukiswa, ukulawulwa nokusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zomtapo wezincwadi wesikole (okuhlanganisa namatapo wezincwadi e-adilali). Qapha ukusekelwa kwabafundi ezikoleni ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile zomphakathi: Qinisekisa futhi uhlanganise izinhlelo zemfundo ezikhethekile okuhlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhlola ngengqondo, umsebenzi ongokomthetho, i-HIV/AIDS, iseluleko ngemisebenzi, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha nakuzo zonke izidingo zabafundi. Phambisa impilo kanye nenhlalo kahle yabafundi. Qapha izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezingeni lesifunda: Khuthaza izinsizakalo ezinhle zokuphatha imali nokuqashwa kwezinsizakulo (SCM). Nikeza insizakalo yokubala imali. Nikeza insizakalo yokubala imali yekakhono lokuphatha. Nikeza insizakalo yokuphatha impahla. Phatha insizakalo ye-SCM. Qapha ukuvumelana kwezimali kwezikole ezijwayelekile, izikole ezikhethekile, amahhosithela futhi nikeza ukuphenya ngaphambi kwesikhashana ngaphakathi kwesiFunda seMfundo. Hlola amabhajethi avunyiwe eziSikole zomphakathi namahhosithela. Phatha ukuhlolwa kwemibiko yemali yonyaka wezikole zomphakathi. Phatha ukuhlolwa kwemibiko yemali yamahhosithela kashoni eminyakeni emibili yezikole zomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kwemali ekhishwa njalo ngenyanga (isb. ama-akhawunti omasipala, i-LTS, i-LTSM, njll.). Yenza umsebenzi wokuqapha ibhajethi mayelana nezikole ze-Section 20. Phatha ukuphenya ngaphambi kwesikhashana. Nikeza insizakalo yokulawulwa kwezokuthutha. Phatha futhi uqashe ukuthuthwa kwe-GG esifundeni. Phatha futhi ulondoloze imibiko yesifunda. Nikeza insizakalo yokusekela izinsiza. Phatha futhi ulondoloze ukwakhiwa kwezokuhlela komgwaqo wezinsiza kanye namasensi eNdiya esifundeni. Phatha i-Occupational Health and Safety eNdiya nasemasensini. Ukuphatha ngokuqonda: Chaza futhi uhlole njalo ngesikhathi isikhathi, injongo, izinhloso, izinto eziyisibopho kanye nemisebenzi yeNdawo. Ngena ohlelweni lokuqonda lokuhlela ibhizinisi. Ngena ngokubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni nokuphathweni kohlaka lokusebenza ngokuqonda nokuhlela amabhizinisi eNdawo. Hlola ngokuqonda ukusebenza kweNdawo njalo ngesikhathi ngokumelana nezinhloso nezinga ezinqunyiwe ngaphambili. Bika ngoMqondisi oyinhloko njalo ngesikhathi ngezenzo ezenziwa yiNdawo. Qapha futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlotshaniswa ngemithetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene nokugcina imibiko ngokufanelekile kwezenzo ezenziwa yiNdawo, nakuzinsiza ezisetshenziswa yona. Ukuphatha abantu: Ukubambe iqhaza ekubeni abasebenzi ngesibalo nangemigomo ehambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza iNdawo yohlelo lwebhizinisi. Khuthaza, funda futhi ohle abasebenzi abakuleNdawo, ukuze kuzuze kugcinwe ukuphumelela ekuletheni izinsizakalo. Phatha ngokubambe iqhaza ukusebenza kahle, ukuhlola kanye nokukhululela abasebenzi abakuleNdawo. Qapha ukwakhiwa kwamandla kolwazi abakuleNdawo. Bambe iqhaza ngokuqamba uhlaka lokuphatha abantu, ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwezinsizakalo, kanye nohlaka lwezinsiza zolwazi leNdawo. Khuthaza ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi abakuleNdawo. Phatha ngokubambe iqhaza futhi khuthaza ukugcina inhlalo eqotho phakathi kwabasebenzi abakuleNdawo. Ukuphatha imali: Ukubambe iqhaza ohlelweni lokuqamba amabhajethi ezingeni lesiphakamu. Ukulungiselela amabhajethi sonyaka kanye nokulungiselela iNdawo. Thatha inxaxheba eqondile ekulawuleni, ekulawuleni amabhajethi nokusebenza ngemali kahle nangempumelelo yokuqonda kweNdawo. Thatha inxaxheba eqondile ekuletheni izinsizakulo futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwezindlela zokuqasha namapholisi ngokuthenga okuhlobene neNdawo. Bika ngoMqondisi oyinhloko ngazo zonke izinto ezenza ngemali yeNdawo. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuphelele ekuphathweni, ekuqapheleweni nasekugcineni impahla yeNdawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa imibiko eqophe kanye neqondo ngemali yeNdawo ngokuhambisana nanoma yimiphi imigogo noma izinga elishiwo.

xh.title: Umqondisi wesithili
xh.summary: Umqondisi wesithili we Western Cape Education Department e Worcester, olawula ulawulo lwezikolo zikawonke-wonke ezizezakho ngezohlu kwinqanaba le SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: I nziqu-matica ezingaphantsi kwesidanga (NQF level 7) esamkelwa yi SAQA. Unyakeni ongalinganisela i 5 ophila ngawo kwindidi elingana nayo noma ephezulu yolawulo. Ukugqibela ngemvume ye Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngendalo yoMfundo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenkqubo neemiyalelo ezifanelekileyo. Iinkqubo zolawulo. Iinkqubo zeNkonzo kaWonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoLawulo labaBantu. Ubumediani basebenzi. Ukulawulwa kwezorimali. Ukulawulwa kweeprojekthi. Amakhono: Ukutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo neemiyalelo ezifanelekileyo. Uqqho lokuqwalasela ulawulo labantu. A manyathelo okusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono obugcisa bokwakha ijonga-bhayile. Amakhono oNxibelelwano noQeqesho (kuquka ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okubonisa). Amakhono angqamweni wokuhlela. Ukucinga ngokubakho kokuqhubela phambili noqqho. Amakhono abalulekileyo: Ukuba namandla nokubakho kokuQhubela phambili noBuntu. Ukulawulwa kweziBantu noKuvuselelwa. Ukulawulwa kweNkqubo neeprojekthi. Ukulawulwa kwezoRimali. Ukushintshwa kolawulo. Amakhono oNkonzo: Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa. Ukunikwa kweNkonzo. Indalo entsha. Ukusombulula iingxaki noQqho. Umdla woxhasi nogqaliselo lomthengi. Unxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ulawulo lwezikolo zikawonke-wonke naziqhobo ezingajeyiswanga kumanqanaba ezithili ukuze zibe nempembelelo nokusebenza kakuhle ukuze zikwazi ukuvelisa imfundo yomgangatho ophezulu: Qinisekisa ukuba iNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke nezizezakho ilawulwa kwaye ilawulwa ngempembelelo nokusebenza kakuhle. Khuthaza ukuba ngabakhokeli kwaye uqwalasele iingomaqhwebebebe kwaye uxhase ulawulo lwabasebenzi (abasebenzi) kwiNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo. Qinisekisa ukuphunyezelwa kwenkqubo yemfundo kwiNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo. Qinisekisa iinkonzo zoXhaso lwabafundi (iNkonzo yoXhaso lwabafundi nothisha abakhoyo nezizezakho) kwiNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo. Qwalasela uqhho loqhuseho lwesithili, ulawulo lolwazi, ulawulo neNkqubo yoxhaso lokuziqhelanisa noqho, ukulawulwa kwabantu ngaphakathi kwendawo yoMfundo yesithili: Qinisekisa ukuphunyezelwa nokusasazwa kolwazi, kwangu uqeqesho ngeenkonzo ze ICT yaye ulungise, uziphumeze kwaye uqwalasele iinkqubo zokuqhelanisa ngokuqhelana nophando phakathi kweedolophu nokusebenzisana namazwe amaninzi. Nikeza inkxaso ephuhlisayo kwiNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo neBawo ukuqinisekisa ulawulo nolawulo olusebenzayo neNkqubo efanelekileyo yazo. Phuhlisa, uxhase kwaye uqwalasele ukuphunyezelwa kweenkqubo zolawulo nezorimali ezilungileyo nokuphunyezelwa kweenkcazelo phakathi kweNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo neBawo. Nikeza uqhho lokubakho kweNdlela yokuqwalasela iNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo neBawo kwaye ulawule ukunikwa kwazo ngaphakathi kwesithili. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezelwa kweNkqubo yoXhelo lwezeMoto lwabafundi. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezelwa kweNkqubo yokuQhathwa kweZiko leZiko leSizwe (iNSNP). Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezelwa kweNkqubo yeKhaya leSikolo noLawulo lweMiba yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni ngaphakathi kwesithili. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezelwa kweenkqubo zokugcisa ukuzonwabisa kwelakhaya phakathi kweNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo. Nikeza inkonzo yokulawula abantu kwisithili. Phuhlisa, ulawule, uqwalasele kwaye uchaze ngenkqubo yamakhono emsebenzi neNkqubo yophuhliso ochwephesha yesithili. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokulawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kwisithili. Lawula iinkqubo zeempilo kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zemfundo kwisithili. Khokela uqeqesho abaqeqeshi abaqeqeshwa kwiNdlela yokuQhathwa ngokusemthethweni yabaBantu yaye abakho kwindawo ethileyo. Qwalasela ukunikwa kweNkqubo yeMfundo ekuqwalaselwa kwaye ixhaswe iNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo: Wceda iNdlela yokuQhathwa ngokusemthethweni kweeNdawo zikaHulumeni kwaye uxhase iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwakha iiNdawo zikaHulumeni. Qwalasela, ulinganise kwaye uxhase ukuphunyezelwa kweNkqubo yeNdalo entsha yamakhono, ulawulo lweekhompyutha, ukuvakalelwa nokusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha kwiSikolo sabo. Nikeza uqeqesho lwesikolo ngokwemfundo ngokwemfundo, ukhupelo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle (iNATIONAL SENIENTIFICATE – NSC), yaye ukhupelo ngamazinga esiZwe noMmandla kwisithili. Khuthaza ukubakho, ukuphuhliswa, ukulawulwa nokusetyenziswa ngempembelelo kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zamathala eencwadi esikolo (kuquka namathala eencwadi ahambahambayo). Qwalasela inkxaso kwabafundi kwiNkundla yamaphlola aZikawonke-wonke naziqhobo: Khuthaza kwaye ulawule ulawulo lweNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, ukubakho kweNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni ngaphakathi kwesithili, ukubakho kweNkqubo yoXhaso lweNkqubo yoXhaso lwaBafundi kuwo onke amaphlola. Qwalasela inkonzo yolawulo yolwazi lwesithili: Khuthaza iinkonzo ezilungileyo zokulawula iimali kwisithili nokulawulwa kwamayila eNkonzo yaseSigxina esinje nje njengoko kunesiSayithi. Khupela inkonzo yezimali yesithili. Khupela inkonzo yolawulo lwamandla eNkqubo yamayila eNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni kummandla wakho. Khuthaza iNkonzo yoLawulo lwesithili. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuhamba kweekhompyutha phakathi kwesithili. Lawula kwaye ziguqule kwaye uqwalasele iindlela zokukhwela kweSigxina kwindalo yamandla esiXukile. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukugcinwa kolwazi kwindawo yokuqhelanisa. Khupela inkonzo yezinto ezininzi ezifuneka kwindalo yamandla esiXukile. Lawula kwaye ulawule iNkqubo yeNdawo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni neMiba ekuQhathwa ngokusesikweni esiXukile. Ukulawula ngokusesikweni eNdaweni yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni kwaye kwindawo yoQhushululu: Qamba kwaye uqwalasele ngokwendlela eqhubekayo iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni yaye iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yoQhushululu ngokusesikweni. Thatha inxaxheba kwindalo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni yaye iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni yesithili. Qwalasela inkonzo yolawulo kwesithili ngokwendlela eqhubekayo ngokuchasene neNdlela ezimiselweyo nokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni. Chaza ngoMhla weSithili ngokwendlela eqhubekayo ngokuchasene neNdlela ezimiselweyo nokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukuzalathiswa kolwazi ngokusesikweni kolwazi ekuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, nokugcinwa kwakho konke okubalulekileyo. Lawula iNkqubo yolwazi kwindawo esemthethweni. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokusesikweni kwindawo yokugcina. Qwalasela iNkqubo yolwazi lwesithili: Thatha inxaxheba ekubeni abantu abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abangakanani nabakunqanaba elifanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuphunyezelwa kweNkqubo yeNkampani yeNdawo. Khuthaza, qeqesha kwaye ukhokele abantu abakhethwa ngokusesikweni, ukuze bafikelele kwaye bagcine ukuphumelela ekunikezeni inkonzo. Lawula ngokusesikweni iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, ukulinganisa nokunika abantu abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni. Qwalasela iNkqubo yolwazi lwesithili. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni, iNkqubo yokuphucula inkonzo, kwaye iNkqubo yolwazi ngendlela yokusetyenziswa kolwazi kwindawo yokugcina. Khuthaza iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni ngabasebenzi. Lawula ngokusesikweni kwaye khuthaza ukugcinwa kwesithili. Lawula iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni: Thatha inxaxheba ekubeni abantu abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni. Lungiselela umhla wokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni kwindawo yokugcina. Thatha inxaxheba ekubeni abantu abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni abakhethwa ngokusesikweni. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni iyagcinwa ngokwendlela eqhubekayo ngokuchasene neNdlela ezimiselweyo nokuQhathwa ngokusesikweni.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit (MEDICAL) Grade 1 (HEPATOBILIARY Surgery)
jobs.salary_text: R2 168 145 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs).
jobs.summary: Head of the Hepatobiliary Surgery clinical unit at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Sub-Specialist and minimum three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Sub-Specialist in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Sub-Specialist Surgical Gastroenterologist, Hepatobiliary Surgeon. Experience: A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a Medical Sub- specialist after registration as a Medical Sub specialist in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Inherent requirements of the job: It will be expected of the Head: Clinical Unit to work commuted overtime, limited to 12 hours, if operational requirements so demand. Participate in the after- hours call system. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to conduct clinically relevant research in the field of Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Ability to teach and train undergraduate and post graduate students and sub specialist fellows. Ability to work in a high-volume clinic and surgical environment. Clinical and surgical competency in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Insight into challenges of local health care delivery, diversity, transformation and equity.
jobs.duties: Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery clinical service provision and management in the Groote Schuur Hospital Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery Unit. Management and training of surgical staff. Participation in academic and management activities of the division.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid (MEDIES) Graad 1 (HEPATOBILIAIRE Chirurgie)
af.summary: Hoof van die hepatobiliaire chirurgie kliniese eenheid by Groote Schuur Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Subspesialis en minimum drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Subspesialis in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Subspesialis Surgical Gastroenterologist, Hepatobiliary Surgeon. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Subspesialis na registrasie as 'n Mediese Subspesialis in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Dit sal van die Hoof: Kliniese Eenheid verwag word om kommuteringsoortyd te werk, beperk tot 12 ure, indien bedryfsvereistes dit vereis. Deelneem aan die buite-ure oproepstelsel. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om klinies relevante navorsing in die veld van Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery uit te voer. Vermoë om voor- en nagraadse studente en subspesialisgenote onderrig te gee en op te lei. Vermoë om in 'n hoë-volume kliniek en chirurgiese omgewing te werk. Kliniese en chirurgiese bevoegdheid in Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Insig in uitdagings van plaaslike gesondheidsorglewering, diversiteit, transformasie en billikheid.
af.duties: Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery kliniese dienslewering en bestuur in die Groote Schuur Hospital Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery Eenheid. Bestuur en opleiding van chirurgiese personeel. Deelname aan akademiese en bestuursaktiwiteite van die afdeling.

zu.title: Umholi Weyunithi Yezokwelapha (YEZOKUQEQESHELA EKUYILOKO) Izinga 1 (Ukuhlinzwa kwe-Hepatobiliary)
zu.summary: Umholi weyunithi yezokwelapha yokuhlinzwa kwe-Hepatobiliary esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengqangi ye-Sub-Specialist kwezokwelapha kanye novalo lweminyaka engu-3 lwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane sokufunda: Ithelifayethi efanele evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengqangi ye-Sub-Specialist kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery. Ukubhaliswa kunomphakathi wabaphathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengqangi ye-Sub-Specialist kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgeon. Isipiliyoni: Uvalo lweminyaka engu-3 yomsebenzi ofanele njengengqangi ye-Sub-Specialist ngemva kokubhaliswa njengengqangi ye-Sub-Specialist kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Izidingo ezingokwemisebenzi ngokwalo: Kuzolindelwa kumholi: weyunithi yezokwelapha ukusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe, esinqunyelwe emahoreni angu-12, uma izidingo zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokubiza olwenzeka ngemva kwamahora emisbhalo. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ikono lokwenza ucwaningo oluhambisana nezokwelapha endaweni yokuhlinzwa kwe-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Ikono lokufundisa noqeqesha abafundi abakwesikhashana nangemva kweziqu kanye nabafundi be-sub specialist. Ikono lokusebenza endaweni eyinani elikhulu lezokwelapha nokuhlinzwa. Ikono lokwelapha nokuhlinzwa kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery. Ukuqonda izinselelo zokulethwa kwezempilo kuleyondawo, ukubumbili, ukuguqulwa nokulingana.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkonzo yokwelapha nokuphatha ukuhlinzwa kwe-Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary surgery kwi-Groote Schuur Hospital Surgical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary Surgery Unit. Ukuphatha noqeqesha abasebenzi bokuhlinzwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi yezemfundo nephunga lesigaba.

xh.title: Umlawuli Weyoni Yokwelapha (MEDICAL) Inqanaba 1 (HEPATOBILIARY Surgery)
xh.summary: Umlawuli weyoni yokwelapha i-Hepatobiliary Surgery esibhedlele iGroote Schuur Hospital, efunayo ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha ophantsi wesigaba esithile kunye nonva wobuchule obuncinane eminyaka elishumi elinesithathu.
xh.requirements: Isidingo esincinane sezemfundo: Iziqulatho ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha ophantsi wesigaba esithile kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary Surgery. Ukubhalisa kwi ngoncedo lwezamaphulo: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha ophantsi wesigaba esithile we-Surgical Gastroenterology, uGqirha wokurhweba we-Hepatobiliary. Isipili: Ukuba nomva wobuchule obuncinane eminyaka elishumi elinesithathu njengoGqirha ophantsi wesigaba esithile emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha ophantsi wesigaba esithile kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary surgery. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kuyakuthintelwa kumlawuli weSigaba sokwelapha ukuba aze asebenze isixa esongezelelweyo esivityiweyo, ukuya kwiyure ezili-12, ukuba iimfuno zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Ukubandakanya ekwisystem yokubiza kwangelixa ongasebenziyo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nakhona ukwenza uphando oluhambelana nolwelapho kwindawo ye-Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary surgery. Ukuba nakhona ukufundisa nokulunga abafundi abangenayo nabaphumelelayo kwindawo yezifundo kunye nabafundi abangesigaba esithile. Ukuba nakhona ukusebenza kwikliniki enomthamo ophezulu nendawo yokurhweba. Ikhono lokwelapha nangokurhweba kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary surgery. Ukuqonda iingxaki zokuqulunqa inkonzo yezempilo kwangaphakathi, ukwahlukana, iinguquko kunye nolungelelwaniso.
xh.duties: Ukunikezwa kweenkonzo ezingabonakaloyo zokwelapha kwi-Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary surgery nokulawula kwiGroote Schuur Hospital Surgical Gastroenterology, i-Hepatobiliary Surgery Unit. Ukulawula nokuzimisela abasebenzi bedokotela zokurhweba. Inkcitho kwiinkqubo zezifundo nezokulawula zecandelo.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager (MEDICAL) Grade 1
jobs.centre: Mossel Bay Hospital, Mossel Bay Sub-district
jobs.salary_text: R1 479 723 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: The Western Cape Department of Health seeks a Clinical Manager to oversee clinical care, staff supervision and administration at Mossel Bay Hospital.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPSCA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: A minimum of 3 years of appropriate experience as a Medical Officer after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB) and willingness to travel throughout the district. A commuted overtime contract is compulsory, and willingness to work after-hours. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Appropriate management experience in a Health Facility. Postgraduate qualification in healthcare management.
jobs.duties: Quality clinical, non-clinical and medico-legal patient care as required by the various programmes of the Department of Health. Supervise-, Support -, transfer of knowledge to-, training- and mentoring of the clinical staff and auxiliary staff. Provide an efficient administration service regarding all clinical and non-clinical matters and medico-legal work. Provide guidance and leadership towards the realisation of strategic goals and objectives of the division. Ensure a cost-efficient service at the clinical level with regard to laboratory services, blood, medicine, consumables and equipment.
jobs.enquiries: Dr JB van Jaarsveld Tel No: (044) 604 - 6101
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written assessment and competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kliniese Bestuurder (MEDIES) Graad 1
af.summary: Die Wes-Kaapse Departement van Gesondheid soek 'n Kliniese Bestuurder om kliniese sorg, personeeltoesig en administrasie by Mossel Bay-hospitaal te oorsien.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPSCA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Beampte na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Innewoonde vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om regdeur die distrik te reis. 'n Gepaardgaande oortydkontrak is verpligtend, asook bereidwilligheid om buite gewone ure te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondeling en skriftelik). Toepaslike bestuurservaring in 'n Gesondheidsfasiliteit. Nagraadse kwalifikasie in gesondheidsorgbestuur.
af.duties: Kwaliteitskliniese, nie-kliniese en medies-juridiese pasiëntsorg soos vereis deur die verskeie programme van die Departement van Gesondheid. Toesig hou oor, ondersteun, kennisoordrag aan, opleiding en mentorskap van die kliniese personeel en hulppersoneel. Verskaf 'n doeltreffende administrasiediens ten opsigte van alle kliniese en nie-kliniese aangeleenthede en medies-juridiese werk. Verskaf leiding en leierskap ter verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die afdeling. Verseker 'n koste-doeltreffende diens op kliniese vlak met betrekking tot laboratoriumdienste, bloed, medisyne, verbruiksgoedere en toerusting.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha (EZOKWELAPHA) Isigaba 1
zu.summary: I-Western Cape Department of Health ifuna uMphathi Wezokwelapha okuqaphela ukunakekelwa kokwelapha, ukuqapha abasebenzi nokuphatha eMossel Bay Hospital.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Iqualifications ehambisana nokuqinisekisa ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMsebenzi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kubhalisa labaphathi: Ukubhalisa ku-HPSCA njengoMsebenzi Wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Ukwendlula iminyaka engu-3 yesipiliyoni esihambisana njengoMedical Officer ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoMsebenzi Wezokwelapha. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile (Code B/EB) nokuthanda ukuhamba kulo lonke idolobha. Isivumelwano sokusebenza ngemva kwamahora esikhundini sibopho, nokuthanda ukusebenza ngemva kwamahora. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokuxhumana kakuhle (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe). Isipiliyoni esihambisana sokuphatwa esikhungeni Sezempilo. Iqualifications yesiqu ephezulu ekuphatweni kwezempilo.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa okuhle kwegula, okungelona igula nezomthetho wezokwelapha komuntu okudingwa izinhlela ezahlukene ze-Department of Health. Ukubheka, ukusekela, ukudlulisa ulwazi ku, ukuqeqesha futhi ukuyalela abasebenzi bokwelapha nabasebenzi abosizo. Ukunikeza inkonzo yokuqashwa esebenzayo mayelana nazo zonke izindaba zegula nezangelayona igula nomsebenzi wezomthetho wezokwelapha. Ukunikeza imibono nobuholi ngokuqondiswa ekweniweni amanqobo ajwayelekile nezinhloso zenkundla. Ukuqinisekisa inkonzo enezindleko ezisebenzayo ezingeni lokwelapha ngokubhekiselela izinkonzo zegumbi legazi, igazi, imithi, okusetshenziswa kanye nezisetshenziswa.

xh.title: iMphathi yezeMigaço (YezoNyango) inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo loMzantsi Kapa lifuna iMphathi yezeMigaço e kuzo kuze kugqitywe ukunakekelwa kwezonyango, ulawulo lwabasebenzi nolulawulo kwiMthatha yeVeki?
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingagqibekanga: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiBhunga lezeMpilo zeNtlalo yaseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomGqirha wezonyango. Ukubhalisa kwibhunga lemigaqo: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPSCA njengomGqirha wezonyango. Isipilo: Ukuba nezinyanga ezingayi ngaphantsi kwe-3 zesipilo esifanelekileyo njengesiPhe phakathi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomGqirha wezonyango. Iminikelo yemisebenzi: Ilayiseni yokushayela (ikhowudi B/EB) nolungelo lokuhamba hamba iphela kwidolophu. Ikontrekhi yokusebenza ngoovimba ngeeyure ezongezelelweyo iyacityiswa, nolungelelwanisa lokusebenza ngeeyure ezize ngemva kweyure ezisesikweni. Iimfuno (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulawulo lokuvakalisa (ngolwimi nangokubhalwayo). Isipilo solawulo kwiFasilithi yezeMpilo. Isifundo esingagqibekanga sokuphela kwezonyango kwintloko yonake.
xh.duties: Ukunakekelwa kwezonyango, okungalunganga ngesigqa nesomthetho kumguliwa njengoko kufunwa ziinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeSebe lezeMpilo. Ukulawula, ukuxhasa, ukudlulisa ulwazi, ukuyala kwaye nakwaziyo olwimi abasebenzi basesigqeni kwecandelo lezonyango. Ukunika inkonzo esebenzayo nolawulo ngezonto zonke ezingowonyango nezingalunganga ngesigqa nangomthetho. Ukunika ingqiqo noyilo olukhokela ukwenzeka kwamagqabantshintshi amkhulu ngamakhulu namagqabantshintshi ecandelo. Ukuqinisekisa inkonzo egqithisayo ngokugqitha kwemivuzo kwisigqibo ngezonto zokulungisa, igazi, amayeza, amacebo omanyano namacebo ayo.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar position in Otorhinolaryngology at Tygerberg Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (code B/EB) driver’s licence. Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training complex but could be required to work across the platform on request. Competencies (knowledge/skills): FCS part 1 as well as experience in research/publications. Appropriate clinical experience in General and/or ENT Surgery. Effective leadership and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Provision of safe surgical care to patients. Peri-operative care of surgical patients. Participation in Intensive Care management. Learn the art and science of ENT Surgery. Attend tutorials and assist with the training of interns, medical students, nursing staff and paramedics. On-site after-hours duties relating to care of newly arriving acute patients as well as inpatients. Involvement in research/audits relating to ENT.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Appointment as Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 5 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment as a Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with Stelllenbosch University according to the yearbook and guidelines. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES) (OTORHINOLARINGOLOGIE)
af.summary: Registrateurpos in Otorhinolaringologie by Tygerberg Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Gekommuteerde oortyd is verpligtend. Nood- en buite-ure oproepdekking. Elke Registrateur sal in 'n spesifieke opleidingskompleks aangestel word, maar kan op versoek oor die platform heen werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): FCS deel 1 sowel as ervaring in navorsing/publikasies. Toepaslike kliniese ervaring in Algemene en/of ENT-chirurgie. Effektiewe leierskaps- en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van veilige chirurgiese sorg aan pasiënte. Peri-operatiewe sorg van chirurgiese pasiënte. Deelname aan Intensive Care-bestuur. Leer die kuns en wetenskap van ENT-chirurgie. Bywoon van tutoriale en bystand met die opleiding van interniste, mediese studente, verpleegpersoneel en paramedici. Terrein gebaseerde buite-ure pligte met betrekking tot sorg van pas aankomende akute pasiënte sowel as ingeluide pasiënte. Betrokkenheid by navorsing/oudits met betrekking tot ENT.

zu.title: Umlobi wezempilo (OKUDOKOTELA) (I-OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
zu.summary: Isikhundla soblobi wezempilo kwi-Otorhinolaryngology esibhedlela i-Tygerberg, sidingobho ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela kanye nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibalo: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa kubungekho obungcweti: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela (okwenziwa ngokuzimele). Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekile (code B/EB) yokushayela. Isikhathi esengeziwe sokusebenza siyimephulo. Ukuvala okungakagi wayesikhathi nezinsuku ezingeyona zamabhizinisi. Umlobi wezempilo ngamunye uzobekwa kwikhompleksi ethize yokwesikash funda kodwa angadingwa ukusebenza kwindiza ehlukile ngenkethelo yakhe. Amakhono (ulwazi/amasu): I-FCS part 1 nolwazi ocwaningweni/okusanyayo. Ulwazi olufanele ngokwelapha ngokudokotela komjolo kanye noma/i-ENT Surgery. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuba ngumholi nokuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza inakekelo ephephile lokuhlinza abagulayo. Ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo abahlinzwayo ngaphambi kwaye emva kokuhlinzwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni kwe-Intensive Care. Ukufunda ubuciko kanye nenzululwazi i-ENT Surgery. Ukuhlanganyela emakilasini okufundiswa kanye nokuweseka ukufundiswa kwabafundi abasha kwezokudokotela, abafundi kwezempilo, abasebenzi bokunakekelwa nabahlinzwa baphila. Izinsuku zangemva kwamahora zokusebenza kwindawo ezihlobene nokuynakekela abagulayo abafika kasheshe kanye nalabo abasengozini egunjini. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ocwaningweni/okuhlaziya ngokuqhathaniswa okuhlobene i-ENT.

xh.title: Umnonwadi (WEEZOMZIMBA) (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
xh.summary: Isithuba somnonwadi kwi-OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY eTygerberg Hospital, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezomzimba nelayisensi evakalayo yokushaya itheksi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezomzimba. Ukubhaliswa kwikhorum yabaphathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezomzimba (UKUZIMELA EKWENZENI IMISEBENZI). Imfuno engaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi evakalayo (code B/EB) yokushaya itheksi. Iikhopha ezenziwayo ngaphandle kweyure emsebenzini ziyinyikima. Ukubakhona ekusingathweni kwezithuba ezingozini nangaphaya kweeyure. Ngamnonwadi ngamnye uza kugqitywa kwicandelo elithile loqeqesho kodwa angafunwa ukuba asebenze kundawo ehlala ixesha elithile ngenkcazelo. Amandla (ulwazi/obugcisa): I-FCS part 1 nangaphezulu kolwazi oluphathelele ucwaningo/okushicilelweyo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lomsebenzi wezomzimba kwi-General nakwi-ENT Surgery. Amandla aphezulu okukhokela kunye nobuchule bokuhlovana nabantu.
xh.duties: Ukunikezela konyuso lwezomzimba olukhuselekileyo kubantu abagulayo. Ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo abenzela ukuqatywa kwebandakuqala nangemva kokwenza ibandakuqala. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni kwe-Intensive Care. Ukufunda ubugcisa nolwazi lwe-ENT Surgery. Ukuwohloka kumabanga afundwa kunye nencoko yonxaxhe ekqeqesheni abaqeqeshwa bebanga eliphantsi, oogqirha abafundi, abasebenzi bokhathalelo lwamakhwa kunye namaqabane okhathalelo lwengozikaempilo. Iimisebenzi yokubakhona emva kweeyure ezithile yomhla ngenkcazelo yokunakekela abafikelayo abasandula kufika ngokukhawuleza ngokwendalo kunye nabagulayo ababambe ilifu esibhedlele. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwicwaningo/ukuphonononga okuthintela i-ENT.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (ORTHOPAEDICS)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery sought for Groote Schuur Hospital to provide clinical trauma surgery, supervise junior staff and participate in after-hours service.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Orthopaedic Surgery. Inherent requirement of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to work in a high-volume clinic and surgical environment. Computer literacy and interest in data collection for service improvement. Insight into challenges of local health care delivery, diversity, transformation and equity. Experience in supervision and training of staff and students at under- and post-graduate levels. Clinical and surgical competency in orthopaedic trauma surgery, Clinical experience in secondary and tertiary orthopaedic trauma surgery provision.
jobs.duties: Supervision and training of junior surgical staff. Participation in under- and post-graduate divisional activities. Participate in after hour service provision. Orthopaedic trauma surgery specialist clinical service provision. Be prepared to work across western metropole platform ecosystem as service requirements dictate.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all medical specialist appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (ORTOPEDIE)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie gesoek vir Groote Schuur Hospital om kliniese traumatirurgie te lever, junior personeel te superviseer en aan buite-ure diens deel te neem.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Ortopediese Chirurgie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Gekommuteerde oortyd is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om in 'n hoëvolume kliniek en chirurgiese omgewing te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid en belangstelling in data-insameling vir diensverbetering. Insig in uitdagings van plaaslike gesondheidsorglewering, diversiteit, transformasie en billikheid. Ervaring in supervisie en opleiding van personeel en studente op voor- en nagraadse vlakke. Kliniese en chirurgiese bevoegdheid in ortopediese traumatirurgie. Kliniese ervaring in sekondêre en tersiêre ortopediese traumatirurgie-lewering.
af.duties: Supervisie en opleiding van junior chirurgiese personeel. Deelname aan voor- en nagraadse afdelingsaktiwiteite. Neem deel aan buite-ure dienslewering. Ortopediese traumatirurgie spesialis kliniese dienslewering. Wees bereid om oor die western metropole platform ekosisteem te werk soos diensvereistes dicteer.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (ORTHOPAEDICS)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isikhulu Sokwelapha Ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji eGroote Schuur Hospital ukuze kunikezwe inkonzo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngokusoka kwezomzimba, kugqitshwe abasebenzi abasha futhi kuthathwe inxaxheba kwinkonzo yamahoraemuva.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Iqualifications ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu sokwelapha ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji. Ukubhalisa kubhunga labangabhekeli: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu sokwelapha ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu sokwelapha ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji. Izinga 2: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesikhulu sokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma i-foreign Health Professional Council eqashwayo ngokomthetho mayelana nomsebenzi oqeqeshwe kumazwe angaphandle) njengesikhulu sokwelapha ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji. Izinga 3: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesikhulu sokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma i-foreign Health Professional Council eqashwayo ngokomthetho mayelana nomsebenzi oqeqeshwe kumazwe angaphandle) njengesikhulu sokwelapha ezokusoka ukuqhakambisa ibhayolo yokuqhuba ukwelapha ngesokoloji. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ikhono lokusebenza ngehora elingejiwe kuyisidingo. Izikhono (ulwazi/ikhono): Ukukwazi ukusebenza esikhungweni esibambe kakhulu nendawo yokusoka. Ulwazi lokusebenzana ikhompyutha nesithakazelo sokuthola idatha ukuze kuphuthushwe inkonzo. Ukuqonda izinselelo zalethwa izinhlaka, ukuzisusa nobulungiswa ekulethweni kwemitholampilo yezempilo yendawo. Isipiliyoni ekugqitsheni nokuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi nabafundi ezingeni laphansi kanye nalapha phezulu kwezinga. Ikhono lokwelapha nokusoka ekubhukudeni kwamandu wokuqhuba ukwelapha ngokusoka kwezomzimba, isipiliyoni sezokwelapha esibekiwe ekuboneleleni ngokusoka kwezomzimba ngokusuka eziteshini zesibili nasesithathu.
zu.duties: Ukugqitsha kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha abangenela ukusoka. Ukuthathwa kwenxaxheba kwemisebenzi yahlulo emazingeni laphansi nesesigaba phakathi nasephezulu kweminyaka yokufunda.
