Ukuthathwa kwenxaxheba ekuboneleleni ngehora ezingeziwe. Ukubonelela ngenkonzo yezokwelapha ngezandla ngokusoka kwezomzimba ebandakanya amandu okusoka. Ukuze ube ulungele ukusebenza kuso sonke isimiso sendawo yase-western metropole njengoba izidingo zale nkizo bizwa.

xh.title: Igcisa leMezisa leNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (I-ORTHOPAEDICS)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe iGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo kwi Groote Schuur Hospital ukunika inkonzo ye surgery yethram, ukulawula abasebenzi abancinci nokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yemiyalezo yangasemva kweyure zomsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphantsi kweyure: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo. Ukubhalisa koluntu olunesidanga: Ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengeGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo. Isipho sokuba sekwindawo ethile: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntoni emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengeGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo. Inqanaba 2: Iyure elingaphantsi kweyure ezingama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcisa leMezisa emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA (okanye i Health Professional Council yamanye amazanga evunyelweyo kumsebenzi oneziqu zamanye amazanga) njengeGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo. Inqanaba 3: Iyure elingaphantsi kweyure ezingama-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcisa leMezisa emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA (okanye i Health Professional Council yamanye amazanga evunyelweyo kumsebenzi oneziqu zamanye amazanga) njengeGcisa leMezisa kwi Surgery yamathambo. Iyure efunekayo yokwazi ukuba uyenzisa ngokupheleleyo: Ukusebenza ngaphezulu kweyure kuyaphoqwa. Iimfuno zokusebenza (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kwindawo negumbi le surgery elinomthamo omkhulu wabaguli. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha nentshisekelookuqokelela iinkcukacha ngokucono inkonzo. Ukuqonda iingozi ezingenzeka ekuhanjisweni kwentlalo yamayeza, iintsingiselo ezahlukeneyo, iinguquko nolwabiwo. Ukuba namava ekulawuleni nokuqeqesha abasebenzi nabafundi kwinqanaba elingaphantsi nangaphezulu leziqu. Ukusebenza kakuhle kwezamathambo ngesaziso se surgery yethram yamathambo, Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwamathambo kwinkonzo yesaziso ngamathambo yethram kwinqanaba lesibini nasesithathu.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuqeqesha abasebenzi abancinci kwizaziso ezinqamlezileyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezikwinqanaba elingaphantsi nangaphezulu leziqu. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni inkonzo yangasemva kweyure. Ukunikeza inkonzo yesaziso ngesaziso se surgery yethram. Ukuba #ulungele ukusebenza kwinkqubo ye western metropole platform njengoko iimfuno zenkonzo zifuna.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar in Anaesthesiology sought at Tygerberg Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (code B/EB) driver’s licence. Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training hospital but will be required to work across the distributed training platform. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Diploma in Anaesthesia [DA(SA)] successfully completed. FCA(SA) Primary exams successfully completed. Effective leadership & interpersonal skills. Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience since obtaining the degree of MBChB. Knowledge and practical skills. Appropriate Anaesthesiology experience.
jobs.duties: Provision of safe medical care to patients in the operating theatres and Intensive Care Units at Tygerberg Hospital and associated training hospitals. Provide clinical support to other medical and surgical disciplines at Tygerberg Hospital and associated training hospitals. Perform onsite after-hours duties as per call roster. Supervise and support medical interns and medical officers providing medical care on the service platform. Attend teaching program activities, tutorials and assessments as part of the registrar training program. Assist with the training of interns, medical students, nursing staff and paramedics. Learn critical skills required of an Anaesthesiology specialist. Involvement in research/audits relating to Anaesthesia, Critical Care, Pain and Peri-operative Medicine.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Appointment as Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 4 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment as a Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with Stelllenbosch University according to the yearbook and guidelines. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES) (NARKOSE),
af.summary: Registrateur in Narkose gesoek by Tygerberg Hospitaal, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Practitioner en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Practitioner toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherente vereiste van die pos: 'n Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Gepensioneerde oortyd is verpligtend. Nood- en buite-ure diensdekking. Elke Registrateur sal in 'n spesifieke opleidingshospitaal aangestel word maar sal oor die verspreide opleidingsplatform moet werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Diploma in Anaesthesia [DA(SA)] suksesvol voltooi. FCA(SA) Primêre eksamens suksesvol voltooi. Effektiewe leierskap- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Toepaslike en voldoende kliniese ervaring sedert die behaling van die graad MBChB. Kennis en praktiese vaardighede. Toepaslike Narkose-ervaring.
af.duties: Verskaffing van veilige mediese sorg aan pasiënte in die operasiesale en Intensive Care Units by Tygerberg Hospitaal en geassosieerde opleidingshospitale. Verskaf kliniese ondersteuning aan ander mediese en chirurgiese dissiplines by Tygerberg Hospitaal en geassosieerde opleidingshospitale. Voer ter plaatse buite-ure pligte uit volgens die diensrooster. Superviseer en ondersteun mediese interne en mediese beamptes wat mediese sorg op die diensplatform verskaf. Bywoon van onderrigprogramaktiwiteite, tutoriale en assesserings as deel van die registrateur-opleidingsprogram. Bystand verleen met die opleiding van interne, mediese studente, verpleegpersoneel en paramedics. Aanleer van kritiese vaardighede wat van 'n Narkose-spesialis vereis word. Betrokkenheid by navorsing/oudits rakende Narkose, Critical Care, Pyn en Peri-operatiewe Geneeskunde.

zu.title: Umlobi (WEZOKwelapha) (Ukuqothulwa komzimba ngokwelapha)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umlobi wokuqothulwa komzimba ngokwelapha eTygerberg Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela kanye nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezincane zemfundo: Isiqinelo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa kunhlangano yezobungqangi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela. Isidingo esibhekele emsebenzini: Ilayisensi evumelekile (code B/EB) yokushayela. Ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esivunyiwe kuyinyanzela. Ukuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo nasekunqotshwa isikhathi. Umlobi ngamunye uzoqokwa esibhedlela esithile sokhothamisa kodwa uzodinga ukusebenza kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuqothulwa ukhothamisa. Amandla (ulwazi/iziklili): Isidiploma sokuqothulwa komzimba ngokwelapha [DA(SA)] siphumelelwe. Ukuhlolwa kwe-FCA(SA) Primary kuphumelelwe. Amandla asembusweni kanye nakhono okuhlobana nabantu. Ulwazi lwezokwelapha ngokwesibonakaliso elanele ukusukela etholwe idigri ye-MBChB. Ulwazi kanye namakhono okwenza ngokwesibonakaliso. Ulwazi olufanele lokulawula ukuvulwa kwezulu ekufakwa kwamathumbu lapha kusetshenziswa iziyabathu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwelapha ngokuphephile iziguli ezitheatri zokusebenza nasemaphephandleni wezokwelapha ngokugcizelela eTygerberg Hospital nasezibhedlela ezihlotshaniswa zokhothamisa. Nikeza ngokwesibonakaliso inkxaso eminye imigabathi yezokwelapha kanye nezobuhhontshisiwe eTygerberg Hospital nasezibhedlela ezihlotshaniswa zokhothamisa. Yenza imisebenzi yasemva kwesikhathi endaweni ngokwesishejuli sokuhlola. Qaphisela futhi useke abafundi bezokwelapha nabalawuli bezokwelapha abanika ukwelashwa emhlabeni. Hlanganyela izinhlelo zokufundisa, ithuba lokufunda kanye nokuqathaniswa njengengxenye yohlelo lokhothamisa abalobi. Siza ngokuqeqesha abafundi, abafundi bezokwelapha, abasebenzi bazokhunula kanye namapharamedikhi. Fundisa amakhono abalulekile adingwa ngumqothuli wezokwelapha wokuqothulwa komzimba. Ukubandakanyeka kophando/ukuhlolwa okuhlobene nokuvulwa kwesisulu sokuqothulwa komzimba, ukwelashwa okubalulekile, inhlazo kanye nezokwelapha zangaphambi kokuhlinzwa.

xh.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-Registrar kwi-Anaesthesiology eTygerberg Hospital, kwaye kufuneka abe naloregister yakwa-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner kwaye abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo ephantsi: Iminikelo efanelekileyo evumela uku registerwa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njenge-Medical Practitioner. Uku registerwa kwikhoram yabasebenzi bamabanga: Uku registerwa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (code B/EB) esemthethweni. I-overtime ehlawuliswa ngokutsha ngokutsha ngokwemiyalezo yamaxesha iyayimfunza. Ikhava yamaxesha okusingqongileyo nangemini xa kungekho msebenzi. Ngamnye i-Registrar uza kuqatshelwa kwisibedlele esithile sokolunye ulwazi kodwa uza kufuneka aze adlule kwindalo eqhubekayo ekolunye ulwazi. Ukwazi okubonelelayo (ulwazi/amakhono): IDiploma kwi-Anaesthesia [DA(SA)] egqitywe ngempumelelo. Ii-FCA(SA) Primary exams egqitywe ngempumelelo. Amakhono abalulekileyo obunkokeli nokuqhathanisa nabantu. Ulwazi ngokwaneleyo lokwenza imisebenzi yokugula emthethweni ukususela kumaxesha wokufumana isidanga se-MBChB. Ulwazi namakhono abalulekileyo. Ulwazi ngokwaneleyo kwi-Anaesthesiology.
xh.duties: Ukuhlinzwa ngokuchanekileyo kokunyanga abaguli kwii-operating theatres nakwi-Intensive Care Units eTygerberg Hospital nasemabedleni olwazi ahlotshaniswe nawo. Ukuhlinza ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemisebenzi yolunye ulwazi kumasebe enkosi nakomahlulela eTygerberg Hospital nasemabedleni olwazi ahlotshaniswe nawo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yasemva kwamavesi kwindawo ngokwe-call roster. Ukulawula nokunceda abantu abangakwaziyo nabalawuli abayenza imisebenzi yonyango lwezifo eqhubekayo. Ukuza kumisebenzi yokulolonga, kumathutoriali nakuqinisekiso lokulinganisa njengenxalenye yohlelo lokulolonga i-registrar. Uncedo lokulolonga abantu abangakwaziyo, abafundi bekolunye ulwazi, abasebenzi bezo khusheko nabasebenzi bezinye iindawo zokhathalelo lwamandla. Ukufunda amakhono abalulekileyo afunekayo kwisigqi se-Anaesthesiology specialist. Ukujanyelwa kuphando/okulinganisiweyo malunga ne-Anaesthesia, i-Critical Care, i-Pain ne-Peri-operative Medicine.

af.title: Registrateur (MEDIESE Familiegeneeskunde)
af.summary: Registrateur in Mediese Familiegeneeskunde gesetel by Beaufort West Hospital, wat kliniese dienste, onderrig en navorsing bied, met HPCSA-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk. (Dit sal van die suksesvolle kandidaat verwag word om aan 'n stelsel van vergoede omgeruilde oortyd deel te neem). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid (d.w.s. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en internetnavorsing). Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en tydsbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering, insluitend deelname aan gemeenskapsgeoriënteerde primêre sorgaktiwiteite. Neem deel aan die onderrigprogram, insluitend in-diens kapasiteitsbou van personeel en toesig oor gesondheidswetenskappe-studente. Navorsing en Professionele Ontwikkeling (insl. voltooiing van MMED-miniverhandeling). Effektiewe Kliniese Administrasie in pasiëntrekords en pasiëntverslae as deel van die leierskaps- en kliniese bestuursaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umgwetji (UMKHANDLU WEZOKWENZA Umndeni)
zu.summary: Umgwetji ezokwelashwa komkhulu womndeni osekelwe esibhedlela iBeaufort West, ehlinzeka ngemisebenzi yezokwelapha, ukufundisa, nokuphenya kanti kudingeka ukubhaliswa kweHPCSA.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesibalo: Ikhwalifikheshini efanele evumela ukubhaliswa kolunge lwemisebenzi yezempilo eNingizimu Afrika (HPCSA) njengodokotela ohlinzayo. Ukubhaliswa kolunge olunesipesheli: Ukubhaliswa kweHPCSA njengodokotela ohlinzayo (Ukwenza ngokuzimele). Isidingo esibekiwe somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha (ikhowudi B/EB) evumelekile nesithakazelo sokuhamba. Isithakazelo sokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi. (Kulindeleke ukuthi umphakethi ophumeleleyo athathe inhlanga kusistimu yokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi okukhokhelwayo). Ikhompedense (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha (okungukuthi, iMS Word, iExcel, iPowerPoint nokucinga nge-inthanethi). Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe. Amakhono amahle okuhlobana nabantu nokuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzwa ngemisebenzi yezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukuthatha inhlanga emisebenzini eyisisekelo ehlongoza umphakathi. Ukuthatha inhlanga ohlelweni lokufundisa, okuhlanganisa ukwakha amandla abasebenzi ngaphakathi komsebenzi nokuqeqesha abafundi bezesayensi yezempilo. Ukuphenya nokuthuthukiswa ngomsebenzi wezeshumi (okuhlanganisa ukugcwalisa idisetheshini encane yeMMED). Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezokulawula ezokwelapha kumarekhodi egula naku umbikowegula njengengxenye yemisebenzi yobuholo nokulawulwa kwezokwelapha.

xh.title: Umengoqoshi (MEDICAL Family Medicine)
xh.summary: Umengoqoshi kwi-Medical Family Medicine osekwe kwi-Beaufort West Hospital, enimiselwe ukunika iinkonzo zonyango, ukufundisa, nophando elinokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezingowona mgangatho ophezulu: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktisi wezonyango. Ukubhaliswa kwiBhunga lomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyango (Independent Practice). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kumsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqesha (code B/EB) eseleyo nolungelelwaniso lokuhamba. Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngeyure egezelayo. (Kulindeleke ukuba umkhethwana ophumeleleyo athabathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yeeyure egezelayo eziyahrholwa). Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (o.k., i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint nokucinga ulwazi kwi-intanethi). Amakhono amabalave nengcebiso okuthetha nobhalo. Amakhono amabalave aphakathi komntu nomntu nokuqonda ukulawula ixesha.
xh.duties: Ukunikezela iinkonzo zonyango, kuquka ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokhathalelo lokuqala eziqhelaniswe nomphakathi. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokufundisa, kuquka ukwakhiswa kwamandla abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkonzo nokulawula abafundi basezosenzo sempilo. Uphenando nokuPhephula ngamakhono eGqwethe (kuqu. ukuqwalasela okupheleleyo kwesi-dissertation se-MMED). ULawulo Lonyango Olusebenzayo olulungileyo kwirekhodi yegazi kunye neengxelo zegazi njengenxaxheba kwiinkqubo zobukhosi bolawulo kunye nolawulo lonyango.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (NEUROSURGERY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Neurosurgery at Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years ‘appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. Minimum van 13 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Tandarts by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessionele raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos nodig in Suid-Afrika. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om deur die Sentraal-Karoo Distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Voldoen aan alle departementele vereistes en protokolle. Uitstekende verslagskryf-, kliniese dokumentasie-, rekordhoudings- en verwysingskryfvaardighede. Deeglike mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Voldoen aan Nasionale Kernstandaarde of ideale fasiliteite/kliniekvereistes soos van toepassing en goeie tydbestuur. Kliniese terapeutiese vaardighede insluitend assesserings tegnieke, behandeling, ontslagbeplanning en opvolg soos nodig. Vermoë om buigsaam en innoverend te wees in reaksie op uiteenlopende kliëntbehoeftes.
af.duties: Verskaf kliniese primêre en sekondêre tandheelkundige behandeling aan kinders op die welstandsbus en pasiënte binne en buite soos van toepassing op die aangewese werkareas. Verskaf tandheelkundige sorgondersteuning in tandheelkundige klinieke in die verskillende subdistrikte binne Sentraal-Karoo Distrik. Verskaf 'n holistiese tandheelkundige diens onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span in 'n hospitaal en primêre gesondheidsorgomgewing. Diagnoseer en toepaslike bestuur van pasiënte. Daaglikse insameling en maandelikse voorlegging van data volgens departementele protokolle. Effektiewe, doeltreffende en optimale gebruik van hulpbronne insluitend die facilitering van herstel en onderhoud van tandheelkundige toerusting. Voorraadopname en bestelling van verbruiksgoedere soos vereis binne departementele norme. Relevante in-diens opleiding en vaardigheidsoordrag. Verskaf toepaslike verligtingsdiens binne Sentraal-Karoo Distrik in afwesigheid van 'n kollega.

zu.title: Ummezimempuphu izinga 1 kuye ku-3
zu.summary: Izikhundla bommezimempuphu ezingeni lesi-1 kuye kwesi-3 e-Beaufort West, okunika inxulumano nokwelashwa kwamabele amabucayi kanye nakwesibili kulo lonke i-Central Karoo District, okufuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda okuncane: Isifaneleko esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengommezimempuphu. Ukubhaliswa komkhakha wabacwaningi: Ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengommezimempuphu. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Alikho ngemva kokubhaliswa njengommezimempuphu ku-HPCSA mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe e-South Africa. Unyaka we-1 wokuphila okuhlobene nokubhaliswa njengommezimempuphu komkhakha webazomtholampilo wamanye amazwe ovunyiwe mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe kulelo zwe, okungalindelekile ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-7 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengommezimempuphu ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengommezimempuphu mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe e-South Africa. Okungenani eminyaka engu-8 yesipiliyoni esihlobene nokubhaliswa njengommezimempuphu komkhakha webazomtholampilo wamanye amazwe ovunyiwe mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe kulelo zwe, okungalindelekile ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-12 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengommezimempuphu ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengommezimempuphu mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe e-South Africa. Okungenani eminyaka engu-13 yesipiliyoni esihlobene nokubhaliswa njengommezimempuphu komkhakha webazomtholampilo wamanye amazwe ovunyiwe mayelana namaphoyisa aqeqeshwe kulelo zwe, okungalindelekile ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izidingo zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (i-Code B/EB) kanye nokuzithoba ukuhamba lonke i-Central Karoo District. Izindlela eziwumtholampilo wolwazi/izinkomba: Ukuzithoba kuzo zonke izidingo kanye namaphrotokholi omnyango. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuqamba amaphoyisa, ukugcina irekhodi nokubhala izinkomba zokuqasha. Amakhono okukhuluma kanye nokubhala kahle. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ukuzithoba ngemigidingo ye-National Core Standards noma izidingo zomnyango/ikliniki njengoba kufanele kanye nokuphatha isikhathi kahle. Amakhono okwelapha okutholakala ngokwelashwa okubandakanya izindlela zokuqinisekisa, ukwelashwa, ukuhlela ukukhishwa kwephoyisa kanye nokulandela njengoba kudingeka. Ukukwazi ukuguquka nokuba nentwela ekubhleni izidingo ezihlukene zabathengi.
zu.duties: Nika inxulumano nokwelashwa kwamabele amabucayi kanye nakwesibili kubantwana abasesiginobhasi baphilayo kanye namaphoyisa ahlinzwa kanye namaphoyisa angahlinzwa njengoba kufanele kumakhono abekelwe umsebenzi. Nika inkxaso yokunakekelwa kwamabele emakliniki wamabele ezifundazini ezahlukene ngaphakathi kwi-Central Karoo District. Nikeza inkonzo yamabele ebanzi ngokuzimele kanye nakuthi ube yingxenye yeqembu esibhedlela nasemahhovisi okunakekelwa kwesikhathi esiphakeme. Qinisekisa futhi uphe abaphoyisa kahle. Ukuqoqa nsuku zonke kanye nokuhambisa idatha nyanga zonke njengoba kumaphrotokholi omnyango. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okupumelelo nokuhle kwezinsiza okuhlanganisa ukwenza izinkonzo zokulungisa nokugcina izinto zokwelashwa amabele. Ukubala izitoko kanye nokufaka izidingo ezidingwayo ngaphakathi kwemigidingo yomnyango. Ukuqeqesha okufanele kuleminyaka yokusebenza kanye nokudlulisela amakhono. Nikeza inkonzo yokushintsha okufanele ngaphakathi kwi-Central Karoo District ekushintshweni kwethangi elingenayo.

xh.title: uDokhonti weNyanga inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Izithuba zabadokhonta beenyanga kwinqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 eBeaufort West, banika unyango lwamathambo oluyintsapho nolwesibini kulo lonke iCentral Karoo District, befuna ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA.
xh.requirements: Iminyanya yemfundo: Ifanelekile leyendsimbo evumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokhonti weenyanga. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-7 yamava afanelekileyo njengodokhonti weenyanga emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengodokhonti weenyanga malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele eSouth Africa. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-8 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengodokhonti weenyanga komphakathi wamagcisa obona basemazwe angaphandle malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele emazwe aphaya, abangekadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-12 yamava afanelekileyo njengodokhonti weenyanga emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengodokhonti weenyanga malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele eSouth Africa. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-13 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengodokhonti weenyanga komphakathi wamagcisa obona basemazwe angaphandle malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele emazwe aphaya, abangekadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (Code B/EB) nolonakalo lokuhamba kwalo lonke iCentral Karoo District. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuhambelana nayo yonke iimfuno zecebey kunye nemithetho yokusebenza. Amakhono amabaleni okubhala iingxelo, uxwebhu lokusebenza ngokwesezo, ukugcina iirekhodi nokubhala iinguqulo. Amakhono amabaleni okuthetha nokubhala. Amakhono amaninzi ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel nePowerPoint). Ukuhambelana neNational Core Standards okanye iimfuno zesixeko/ikliniki ezifanelekileyo njengoko zisebenza nolawulo lokusingatha ixesha elilungileyo. Amakhono okwelapha ngokwesezo aquka iindlela zokuqwalasela, unyango, icebo lokuphuma kwesibhedlele nokuqhubela phambili njengoko kufuneka. Ulawulo lokuzinza nokuba nobuntu obutsha phantsi kokuvisisa iimfuno ezahlukene zabathengi.
xh.duties: Nika unyango lwamathambo oluyintsapho nolwesibini kubantwana kubhasi yempilo nakwizigulana ezikwisiyingqi nangaphandle njengoko kusebenza kumaphandle omsebenzi abekiweyo. Nikezisa inkxaso yenkathalo yamathambo kwiikliniki zamathambo kumaphinda-aphinda amange00 aphakathi kwesiCentral Karoo District. Nikezisa inkonzo yamathambo epheleleyo eyedwa njengethemba kuluntu kummandla wesibhedlele nolononophelo lwempilo. Beka isifo ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwezigulana. Ukuqokelela i-data yemihla ngemihla nokuyinika ngomhla ngonnye njengoko kumithetho yecebe. Ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo, okusembathweni nokugqibeleleyo kwezibonelelo kuquka ukukhuthaza ulungiso nolondolozo lweqeto lamathambo. Ukuqokelela nokugcina amatshaji okusetyenziswa njengoko kufuneka ngaphakathi kwemilinganiselo yecebe. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanelekileyo kwabasebenzi nakudluliselo kwamakhono. Nikezisa inkonzo yokuncedisa ngaphakathi kweCentral Karoo District ekubeni kungabikho komnye wabo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY: Forensics)
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position in Forensics at Valkenberg Hospital, requiring registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse with Psychiatry and a post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse with Psychiatry. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). Or A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the above period must be appropriate/recognisable experience in Psychiatric Nursing after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science OR a post graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Inherent requirements of the job: Ability and willingness to assist with shifts and after-hours hospital cover including weekends, public holidays, night duty relief and overtime as the need arises. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy skills. Basic financial and statistics management skills. The ability to communicate (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Effective management of the Psychiatric wards and coordination of all activities and communication with the relevant supervisors and stakeholder. Management and monitoring the effective utilisation of human, financial and physical resources. Deliver a quality psychiatric nursing care throughout the hospital and provide on-going support to the nursing service. Participate in the analysis, formulation and implementation of nursing guidelines, practices, standards and procedures incorporating the Ideal Hospital Standards. Supervision of the implementation of effective processes and practices to all statistical information needed to render a quality mental health service. Liaising with relevant stakeholders on day and night shift including referring hospitals, family members, security service and SAPS. Participate in and encourage nursing research at the institution.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde (SPESIALITEIT: Forensies)
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde-posisie in Forensies by Valkenberg Hospital, wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met Psigiatrie en 'n na-grondse kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde Wetenskap vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met Psigiatrie toelaat. 'n Na-grondse verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde Wetenskap (R212). Of 'n 4-jarige Bachelorggraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse Diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Geestesgesondheid Verpleegkunde. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 6 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde wees na verwerwing van die 1-jaar na-grondse kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde Wetenskap OF 'n nagraadse Diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Geestesgesondheid Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 3 jaar van die hierbo genoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om met skofte en buite-ure hospitaaldek insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae, nagdiensverligting en oortyd by te staan soos die behoefte ontstaan. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese finansiële en statistiese bestuursvaardighede. Die vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Doeltreffende bestuur van die Psigiatriese sale en koördinering van alle aktiwiteite en kommunikasie met die relevante toesighouers en belanghebbendes. Bestuur en monitering van die doeltreffende benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Lewer van gehalte psigiatriese verpleegsorg deur die hospitaal en bied voortdurende ondersteuning aan die verpleegdiens. Deelname aan die analise, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, praktyke, standaarde en prosedures wat die Ideal Hospital Standards inkorporeer. Toesig oor die implementering van doeltreffende prosesse en praktyke tot alle statistiese inligting wat benodig word om 'n gehalte geestesgesondheidsdiens te lewer. Skakeling met relevante belanghebbendes op dag- en nagdiens insluitend verwysende hospitale, familielede, sekuriteitsdiens en SAPS. Deelname aan en aanmoediging van verpleegnavoring by die instelling.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlelayo Wezokunakekela (IZIHLOKO: Izezicala)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi oHlelayo Wezokunakekela kwezezicala esibhedlela i-Valkenberg, sidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqabhaza boBuhlengikazi obunele Isayikhiyathri kanye nokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kwaze kwaba ngaphezulu ngesayensi yokunakekela ngokwengqondo ezeKwindla.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwe ngaphansi zemfundo: Isidingo esiyisisekelo sika-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezingokunakekelwa) noma isidingo esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R880) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqabhaza boBuhlengikazi obunele Isayikhiyathri. Isidingo sokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe ezingokunakekelwa esibude bonyaka osungu-1 esemthethweni kwi-SANC kuzesayensi ezeKwindla yokunakekela ngokwengqondo (i-R212). Noma Idigri yezinga le-4 eBhayoloji ezingokunakekelwa (i-R174) noma isidingo esilinganayo (i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqabhaza boBuhlengikazi. Idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu (i-R635) esemthethweni kwi-SANC ezingokunakekela impilo yengqondo. Ukubhaliswa kwabekwe ngaphezulu: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqabhaza boBuhlengikazi. Isiphephelo: Umkhawulo weminyaka engu-10 wokuhlakanipha okuhambisana/okwaziwayo ezokunakekelwa ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoGqabhaza boBuhlengikazi kwi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 kuleso sikhathi kufanele kube ukuhlakanipha okuhambisana/okwaziwayo ezingokunakekela ngokwengqondo ngemva kokuthola isidingo sokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kwamnyaka o-1 kuzesayensi ezeKwindla yokunakekela ngokwengqondo Noma idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu (i-R635) esemthethweni kwi-SANC ezingokunakekela impilo yengqondo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yaleso sikhathi esikhunjulwe ngenhla kufanele ibe ukuhlakanipha okuhambisana/okwaziwayo ezingeni lophatho. Izidingo ezingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ikhono nesabelo nosizo ngokushintshana kwezikhathi nokugqamisa isibhedlela ngemva kwezihlobo sokuqala, kuhlanganise ngamasonto, ngezihlola zomphakathi, ekusizeni ekuphumulelweni ubusuku nangaphezulu kwesikhathi njengoba kudingeka. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (iKhodi i-B/EB). Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono aysisekelo okuphatha izimali nezibalo. Ikhono lokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala).
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ngempumelelo izigodi zezingqondo kanye nokuhlelwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi nokuxhumana nabaphathi abahambisanayo nalabo abanomthelela. Ukuphatha kanye nokubuka ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwemithombo yabantu, yezimali nezokwenziwa. Ukunikeza inakekelo elikhulu lomuntu ofuywayo ezingqondweni kulo lonke isibhedlela kanye nokunika ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo kumnyango wezokunakekela. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuhlaziyeni, ekuqondweni nasekwenziweni kwemihlahlandlela, amasiko, izinga namaphuzu ezokunakekela ekuveza izimiso zeZibhedlela Ezinhle. Ukugadlela ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo namasiko kuyo yonke imininingwane yesibalo edingekayo ukuze kunikezwe isevisi ephumelelayo yempilo yengqondo. Ukuxhumana nalabo abanomthelela ngosuku nangobusuku okuhlanganisa izibhedlela ezithumelayo, ilungu lomndeni, inkonzo yokuvikela kanye ne-SAPS. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kanye nokukhuthaza ucwaningo olumayelana nezokunakekela esikhungweni.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkulumbuso zeMveliso (ISEBE LELIZWE: Izinga leZophulo)
xh.summary: Isikhundla somncedi weNkulumbuso zeMveliso kwisi seMveliso esibizwa iValkenberg Hospital, kufuneka abhalwe kwi-SANC njengogqirha weMveliso ongcali weZigulane zeZinzo, anesidanga seziqalelo ezingowasemva kwindalo ePhakamileyo yeSayensi yokuNyangwa kweZigulane zeZinzo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingowasemva seziqalelo: Isidanga iR425 esisekelo (okt isatifikethi/isidanga kwimveliso) okt isidanga esilinganayo (iR683 ngakunye neR880) esivumela ukubhalwa kwisiBungeni seMveliso seMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengogqirha weMveliso ongcali weZigulane zeZinzo. Isidanga seMveliso esingowasemva kwindalo esiza inyanga enye ubuncinane esivunyiwe ngapha kwesiBungeni seMveliso seMzantsi Afrika (SANC) kwizSayensi ePhakamileyo zokuNyangwa kweZigulane zeZinzo (iR212). Okt Isidanga seNyaka ezine esiBhalwe njengeNqanaba leSiqu kwimveliso (iR174) okt isidanga esilinganayo (iR171 ngakunye neR1497) esivumela ukubhalwa kwisiBungeni seMveliso seMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengogqirha weMveliso. Isidanga esiNgowasemva kwindalo (iR635) esivunyiwe ngapha kwesiBungeni seMveliso seMzantsi Afrika (SANC) kwakhathazo leMveliso yeZigulane zeZinzo. Ukubhalwa kwisikhululo esingowabasebenzi: Ukubhalwa kwi-SANC njengogqirha weMveliso. Ikwaziso: Iminyaka elishumi ubuncinane emfanelekileyo/eqatshelwayo kwimveliso emva kokubhalwa njengogqirha weMveliso kwi-SANC kwimVeliso jikelele. Inyaka ezintandathu ubuncinane kule minyaka ingentla kufuneka ibe ngumfutshane/eqatshelwayo kwimveliso yeZigulane zeZinzo emva kokufumana isidanga seNyaka elilodwa seMveliso esingowasemva kwizeSayensi ePhakamileyo zokuNyangwa kweZigulane zeZinzo OKT isidanga esiNgowasemva kwindalo (iR635) esivunyiwe kwi-SANC kwakhathazo leMveliso yeZigulane zeZinzo. Inyaka ezintathu ubuncinane kweli xesha elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngumfutshane/eqatshelwayo kwinQanaba leNkulumbuso. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ikwazi kwaye ithande ukuncedisa ngokutshintsha izikhululo nokugquma kwasekhusini emva kweeyure kuquka iimpelaveki, iintsuku zihlobo, inkululeko yomsebenzi wasebusuku nasekuhlengezweni njengoko kufuneka. Ikwazi ukuzithetha nokubhala (ngomlomo nangokubhala).

Ukulawula nokuhlola ukusebenziswa okusebenzayo kweendalo ezimali, ezomzimba nengokwasemzimbeni. Ukuhlinza ngengondleko yemveliso yezigulane ezinzileyo kulo lonke isibhedlele kunye nokunika inkxaso ezingamaqondo kumkhwa wemveliso. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kokwahlulwa-hlulwa, ukuqamba nokusebenzisa iingongoma zemveliso, imikhwa, izinto ezichanekileyo nendlela eziquka iZinto ezichanekileyo zeSixeba esiNgcwatileyo. Amapathaka: Iminyaka engaphezulu kwe7 yamava afanelekileyo / aqaqambileyo ekunakekelweni kokugula emva kokuqhutywa ngokurejista njengogqiha wokuNakekela ukugula kwiSANC kuNakekelo lokugula ngokuqhelekileyo. Iimfuno ezibekwe ngokwendalo somsebenzi: Ikhono nentwelenkuthazo yokuncedisa ngokutshintsha ngokudibana phakathi kweeshithi kunye nokuhlala uvulekile nasemva kwiiyure zomsebenzi esibedlele kuquka iiveki zonke, iintsuku zihloniphekwe zikarhulumente, ukunika ixesya abanye abasebenzi beshithi yokulala, kunye nokugqitha ixesha elibekiweyo xa kusenako isidingo. Iikhomphethensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olusisiseko lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMS Word, iExcel, iPowerPoint kunye neOutlook). Ikhono lokuthetha ngomlomo nangokubhalayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokucacileyo komthetho wezondakalo kunye nemigaqo elingana nendawo yokusebenza, kwaye nendawo ekufuneka igqitywe kuyo lomthetho. Ikhono lokukhuthaza nokuqinisa ukunakekela ngomgangatho ophezulu abaguli ngokumisela, nokulandela, nokulawula iinkqubo zemigaqo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokwakhe nangokusebenzisana naye omnye eqela elinobumanyano kwinkqubo ekwazi ukuyenza (FBU). Ikhono elisezinzeko elisebenza nzimeni yonke, elikhokela, elilawula izicwangciso, elithatha iigqibo, elisombulula iingxaki (ezimalini nezabasebenzi) nokuqonda amava ngokumanya umsebenzi.
xh.duties: Umama wamathembu kufuneka abenekhono lokucinga ngokusuka nangokuphanda, ukulawula, ukulungelelanisa nokugcina inkqubo ekunakekelweni kokugula engangoyena mlungu weqela eliya kumana nokuqonda ngokucacileyo kwindawo ekuyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe. Ukulawula ngokubambisana nemisebenzi yonke engqondweni ukuzaliselela iinkqubo zokusika kunye neenkqubo zokuphuhlisa kwalo mmandla. Ukulawula nokulandela iinkqubo zemali ekule ndawo yamandla ngokunakekelwa kokugula. Ukuqalisa nangokubandakanyeka ngokuyisebenzisa kakhulu ekwakhiweni, ekuphuhliseni, ekuphando, nasekuphuhliseni abantu basebenzayo, kuquka namandla okutitshala abanako ukulawula umsebenzi wokunakekela. Ukunikela ngenkxaso kumsebenzi weNkxaso yokuNakekela nasekule ndawo yokusebenzela. Ukugcina iinkqubo zobugqiya, ukukhuthaza nokwandisa ulwazi ngokuziqhelanisa nobugqiya bokusebenza ngeziqu ezahlukeneyo, kuquka nokuqonda ngokubanzi ngamandla okukhokela.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist Grade 1 to 3 (5/8TH Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R567 261 per annum Grade 2: R659 559 per annum Grade 3: R763 653 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Clinical psychologist needed at Tygerberg Hospital to provide psychological services, supervise interns and contribute to student training across child, adolescent and adult mental health.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Clinical Psychologist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. One year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 8 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. Minimum of 9 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 16 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. Minimum of 17 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Relevant experience in comprehensive personality and neuropsychological assessment of child, adolescent and adult patients. Relevant experience in assessment diagnosis and psychotherapy with respect to individual, group, couples and families. Ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams.
jobs.duties: To manage and provide psychological services to patients of designated units in Tygerberg Hospital including Child, Adolescent and Adult Psychology; to train and supervise interns in Clinical Psychology. -Contribute to the teaching and training of students at the associated Faculty of Health Sciences. Participate in the academic activities of the associated university. Administrative duties.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Kliniese Sielkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 2: Minimum van 8 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 9 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 3: Minimum van 16 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 17 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Sielkundige ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Relevante ervaring in omvattende persoonlikheids- en neuropsigologiese assessering van kinder-, adolessent- en volwasse pasiënte. Relevante ervaring in assesseringsdiagnose en psigoterapie ten opsigte van individue, groepe, paartjies en gesinne. Vermoë om binne multidissiplinêre spanne te werk.
af.duties: Om sielkundige dienste aan pasiënte van aangewese eenhede in Tygerberg-hospitaal te bestuur en te verskaf, insluitend Kinder-, Adolessent- en Volwasse Sielkunde; om internship in Kliniese Sielkunde op te lei en te supervisor. -Dra by tot die onderrig en opleiding van studente by die geassosieerde Fakulteit Gesondheidswetenskappe. Neem deel aan die akademiese aktiwiteite van die geassosieerde universiteit. Administratiewe pligte.

zu.title: Izikoloshi sezengqondo Ezingasesebenzo Isilinganiso 1 kuya ku-3 (Isikhundla se-5/8TH)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo esibhedlela i-Tygerberg ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezenkqondo, ukugcina amakhosi abafundi abangaholelwa kanye nokufaka isandla ekugadeni abafudi kulo lonke izinkinga zengqondo zabantwana, abasha nabantu abadala.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesigaba: Iqualifying efanele evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo. Ukubhalisa kukahulumende wezikhungo: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo. Isiphiwo: Isilinganiso 1: Akukho sidalwa ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde e-RSA. Unyaka oyedwa wokuhlangabezana nokwesiphiwo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde kwezinye izwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengokuba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isilinganiso 2: Ubumnyama beminyaka eyi-8 yokuhlangabezana nokwesiphiwo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde e-RSA. Ubumnyama beminyaka eyi-9 yokuhlangabezana nokwesiphiwo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde kwezinye izwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengokuba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isilinganiso 3: Ubumnyama beminyaka eyi-16 yokuhlangabezana nokwesiphiwo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde e-RSA. Ubumnyama beminyaka eyi-17 yokuhlangabezana nokwesiphiwo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesikoloshi sezengqondo ezingasesebenzo kubasebenzi abafunde kwezinye izwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengokuba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Isiphiwo esihambisanayo ekuhloleni ngobuni bomuntu kanye nezenhlalo yolwazi kwabantwana, abasha nabantu abadala. Isiphiwo esihambisanayo ekuloleni ukuxilongwa kanye nengozi yokwelapha ngengqondo kumuntu ngamunye, qembu, abashadile kanye nomndeni. Ikhono lokusebenza kumaphuzu ahlukene enkundla yezemfundo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezengqondo kubaphathi balezi zikhungo e-Tygerberg Hospital kubandakanya Izengqondo zabantwana, abasha nabantu abadala; ukufundisa kanye nokugcina abafundi abangaholelwa kwezengqondo ezingasesebenzo. -Ukufaka isandla ekufundiseni kanye nokugadeni abafundi eNyuvesi yezenhlalo ezigaba sezemfundo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yeNyuvesi ohambisanayo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha.

xh.title: Ingcali yengqondo yasekhilini Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Isithuba se-5/8TH)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ingcali yengqondo yasekhilini eTygerberg Hospital ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zabungcali bokuchaza umcimbi wengqondo, ukulatha abafundi abangenangomsebensi kunye nokunikela ekolathweni abafundi kuwo onke amanqanaba obuchopho bomntwana, usesabungcali nomsilu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowona siseko: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini. Ukubhaliswa koluntu lwabaphili: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini. Isipho sokusebenza: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele i-RSA. Unyaka omnye wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiwenzi iinkonzo zoLuntu, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Uburyo beminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasekenzi abagqityele i-RSA. Uburyo beminyaka elithoba yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiwenzi iinkonzo zoLuntu, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Uburyo beminyaka elishumi elinesithandathu yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele i-RSA. Uburyo beminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yengqondo yasekhilini malunga nabasebenzi abagqityele kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiwenzi iinkonzo zoLuntu, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amava afanelekileyo kuqondo-ngqondo elipheleleyo nokulinganiswa kobuchopho komntwana, usesabungcali nomdala. Amava afanelekileyo ekuqondeni iingxaki nokwelapha ngokuchaneka kwangqondo malunga nomntu ngamnye, iqela, amaqabane noluntu. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela elahlekileyo lemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha kunye nokubonelela ngeenkonzo zabungcali kubaguli kwiindawo ezifunekayo kwiTygerberg Hospital ezibandakanya iNgcali yengqondo yabantwana, abasesabungcali kunye nabadala; ukulatha abafundi abangenangomsebensi kwengcali yengqondo yasekhilini. -Nikela ekufundiseni nasekolathweni abafundi kwiFakhalthi yezeMfundo ezeMipro yobomi ehlotyeni. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yezemfundo eyunivesity ehlotyeni. Imisebenzi yolawulo.

jobs.title: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (ULTRASOUND)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 per annum
jobs.summary: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 in Ultrasound at Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, requiring HPCSA registration in ultrasound radiography.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasound Radiography. Registration with a professional council: Registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Ultrasound Radiography. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of RSA qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of RSA-qualified employees. Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of RSA-qualified employees. Minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Competencies (knowledge/skills): A commitment to ethical practice, maintaining patient confidentiality, a professional demeanor, and the capacity to manage stressful situations calmly are essential. A thorough understanding of human anatomy and physiology is required, along with knowledge of disease pathologies as they relate to sonographic findings. Appropriate experience in vascular ultrasound. Strong abilities to interact effectively with both patients and medical staff, clearly explaining technical information and collaborating on patient care. Understanding of basic computer programs and the use of reporting systems. Comprehensive sonography education and extensive hands-on experience, demonstrating a strong commitment to professional growth and lifelong learning through advanced education, research, and staff training.
jobs.duties: Perform procedures in vascular ultrasonography. Ensure quality image analysis to accurately contribute to diagnosis of abnormalities. Provide quality patient-centered care to all patients. Actively participate as a member of the health service institution. Perform clinical audits in the department. Attend departmental meetings and participate in presentations. Perform other appropriate duties as allocated by the Head of Department. Maintain clinical, professional, and ethical standards. Operate imaging equipment and review images to ensure they are of good quality. Provide training and support as appropriate.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 (ULTRASOUND)
af.summary: Radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 in Ultrasound by Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, waarvoor HPCSA-registrasie in ultrasone radiografie vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasone Radiografie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiograaf in Ultrasone Radiografie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in Ultrasone Radiografie met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Ultrasound) met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Ultrasound) met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Ultrasound) met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Ultrasound) met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Ultrasound) met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): 'n Toewyding aan etiese praktyk, die handhawing van pasiëntvertroulikheid, 'n professionele houding en die vermoë om stresvolle situasies kalm te hanteer, is noodsaaklik. 'n Deeglike kennis van menslike anatomie en fisiologie word vereis, tesame met kennis van siekte-pathologie soos dit verband hou met sonografiese bevindings. Toepaslike ervaring in vaskulêre ultraklank. Sterk vermoëns om doeltreffend met beide pasiënte en mediese personeel te kommunikeer, tegniese inligting duidelik te verduidelik en saam te werk aan pasiëntsorg. Kennis van basiese rekenaarprogramme en die gebruik van verslagdoeningstelsels. Omvattende sonografie-onderwys en uitgebreide praktiese ervaring, wat 'n sterk toewyding aan professionele groei en lewenslange leer toon deur gevorderde onderwys, navorsing en personeelsopleiding.
af.duties: Voer prosedures in vaskulêre ultrasonografie uit. Verseker gehalte beeldanalise om akkuraat by te dra tot die diagnose van abnormaliteite. Verskaf gehalte pasiëntgesentreerde sorg aan alle pasiënte. Neem aktief deel as 'n lid van die gesondheidsdiensinstelling. Voer kliniese oudite in die departement uit. Bwoon departementele vergaderings en neem deel aan voorleggings. Voer ander toepaslike pligte uit soos deur die Hoof van die Departement toegewys. Handhaaf kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde. Bedryf beeldtoerusting en hersien beelde om te verseker dat hulle van goeie gehalte is. Verskaf opleiding en ondersteuning soos toepaslik.

zu.title: I-Radiographer Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (ULTRASOUND)
zu.summary: I-Radiographer Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 kwi-Ultrasound esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, e-Observatory, idinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kul Abelusomfana be-Ultrasound.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda esingavunyelwe: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) kubu-Radiographer be-Ultrasound. Ukubhaliswa komhlangano wezitshudeni: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomlingisi we-Radiography kubu-Ultrasound Radiography. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Asikho isipiliyoni emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele ngaphakathi kwe-RSA. Unyaka oyedwa isipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele kozyalwa yangaphandle laba abadingwa ukwenza umsebenzi wentshonalanga njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka elishumi (10) emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele ngaphakathi kwe-RSA. Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele yangaphandle laba abadingwa ukwenza umsebenzi wentshonalanga njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka eyishumi (20) emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele ngaphakathi kwe-RSA. Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka eyishumi nanye (21) emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubu-Radiography (Ultrasound) ngakumphakathi wemisebenzi yomphakathi abagqoki laba bantu abafundele yangaphandle laba abadingwa ukwenza umsebenzi wentshonalanga njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izindlwana (ulwazi/izikhokelo): Ukuzibophezela ekwenzeni okuhle ngokomoya, ukugcina imfihlo yegula lesiko, ukuziphatha ngendlela eqotho, kanye nokuqonda ukuphatha izimo ezinzima ngokuzola kuyimfuneko. Kudingwa ukuqonda okujulile ngokwakheka komzimba kanye nokusebenza kwawo, kanye nolwazi ngezifo nendlela ezithinta ngayo iziphumo zesithombe esithathwa ngegazi. Isipiliyoni esifanele kubu-ultrasound yemithambo yegazi. Ikhono elikhulu lokuxhumana kahle nabagulayo nabalengisisi bezokwelapha, ukuchaza ulwazi olucacile futhi usebenze nomunye wena ekunakekeleni isiguli. Ukuqonda ngohlelo lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela zokubika. Ukufunda okuphelele ngokuthatha izithombe nge-ultrasound kanye nesipiliyoni esiningi sokusebenza ngesandla, okukhombisa ukuzibophezela okukhulu ekukhululweni kwesikhathi emsebenzini kanye nokufunda impilo yonke ngokufunda okuthuthukisiwe, uphenyo, kanye nokuhlelela abasebenzi.

Yiba khona emihlanganweni yomnyango futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekubhukwini. Yenza eminye imisebenzi efanele njengoba umnikazi wesikhundla abengumholi. Gcina izindinganilo ezingokwempilo ezingokwemisebenzi nengokomoya. Sebenzisa utho ukuthumba izithombe ubuke izithombe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zinhle. Nikeza imfundiso nokuweseka njengoba kufanele.

Izakhono ezilungileyo zokunxibelelwana Izakhono zokuxazula iingxaki, zokubhala iingxelo, zokuqukaufa zokuvakalalisana nezokusombulula iingxaki. Izakhono ezisisiseko zekhompyutha (oko kukuthi MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).

zu.title: Umozuli Wezokwelapha Ohlonishwayo Isigaba 1 kuya ku-2 (EzempiLo Eyisiseko Sezempilo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somozuli wezokwelapha ohlonishwayo e George esinikeza izinsiza eziyisiseko sezempilo emaklinishi wesifunda esincane, kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC nesimemezelo sekhono lezokwelapha ngemva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisiseko.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesibili: Isimemezelo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu kwezokunakekelwa kwabaguli) noma isimemezelo esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogziwe wezokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Isimemezelo sezokunakekelwa kwabaguli ngemva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisiseko esithatha okungenani unyaka oyedwa wediploma kweSayensi Lezokwelapha Esiyisekelo: Ukulinganisa Impilo, Ukwelapha Nanakekelwa, esigunyaziwe yi-SANC (R48). Noma Iziqu ze-Bachelor zeminyaka emi-4 kwezokunakekelwa kwabaguli (R174) noma isimemezelo esilinganayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogziwe wezokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Idiploma yangemva kweziqu (R635) esigunyaziwe yi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa Ezisiseko Zezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kubahlengikazi abagunyaziwe: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogziwe wezokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ekunakekelweni kwabaguli ngemva kokubhaliswa njengogziwe wezokunakekelwa kwabaguli ne-SANC ekunakekelweni kwabaguli jikelele. Isigaba 2: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-14 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ekunakekelweni kwabaguli ngemva kokubhaliswa njengogziwe wezokunakekelwa kwabaguli ne-SANC ekunakekelweni kwabaguli jikelele. Okungenani eminyaka eyi-10 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ngemva kokuthola isimemezelo sangemva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisiseko kwamunyaka oyedwa noma idiploma yangemva kweziqu kwikhono elihambisana nalokhu. Isidingo esingokwakwemisebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzethemba ekusebenzeni ihora elingaphezulu kwaleso elijwayelekile uma kudingeka. Ukuzethemba ekushayeleni isithuthi sesikhungo sokwelapha esihambahambayo. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukuqeqeshwa noma isipiliyono kwe-NIMART. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nokwenza kube lula. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuyisiseko (okungukuthi i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).
zu.duties: Siza ekuphatweni kobunzima besifo ngokwesohlelo sezempilo esiqoqeme konke. Ikhwalithi yenkonzo: Hlela futhi usebenzise imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa izempilo nokuvikela esikhungweni nakumphakathi. Xhuma namaphoyinti emphakathi kanye ne-NPO. Qoqa ulwazi futhi uhlole imibiko. Nikeza izinsiza ze-PHC emphakathini osezungezeni. Siza ekuphatweni kwezinsiza zabantu, ezezezimali, ze-SCM, ISuKomisi kanye nokwesekwa izempilo, kanye nokuphathwa kwesakhiwo nezisetshenziswa ngaphansi kokugcinwa.

xh.title: Umpraktisi weNesi yeKliniki inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (IMPILYO yeMpilo
xh.summary: Isithuba somPraktisi weNesi yeKliniki eGeorge esinika iinkonzo zenkathazo yempilo ezingongcali kwiikliniki zesithili, kufuneka kubekho upekelo lwe-SANC nesidanga sokuba yenesi yekliniki ngemva kwesidanga sangundoqo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinci semfundo: Isidanga seR425 esisekelo (okt. idiploma/isidanga ekunyiseni i-inthouse) okt. isidanga esilinganayo (R683 nge-R254) esivumela upekelo kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNgcali kweziNesi. Isidanga sokuba yenesi ngemva kwesidanga sangundoqo esithatha ubuncinane unyaka o-1 widiploma kwiSayensi yeKliniki yeNesi: Impilo ekuqwalaselweni, Unyango nokuNakekela, esamkelwe yi-SANC (R48). OKT. Isidanga se-4 unyaka kwi-inthouse (R174) okt. isidanga esilinganayo (R171 nge-R1497) esivumela upekelo kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNgcali kweziNesi. Idiploma yangemva kokufunda esamkelwe yi-SANC (R635) ekuNakekelweni kweNkathazo yeMpilo eNgongcali. Upekelo kolwazi lwezamabomu: Upekelo kwi-SANC njengesiNgcali kweziNesi. Isipho: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka e-4 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo ekunyiseni i-inthouse emva kokupekela njengesiNgcali kweziNesi kwi-SANC ekuNyiseni i-inthouse ngokubanzi.
