jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Maternity)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum (Plus non pensionable rural allowance of 12% of your annual basic salary)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 specialising in maternity care at Beaufort West Hospital, requiring SANC registration and advanced midwifery qualification.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC Advance Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212). OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Midwifery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, night duty, overtime, public holidays and weekends. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (both written and verbal). Appropriate supervisory skills and optimal utilisation of subordinates. Knowledge of maternal and neonatal health care services within the hospital setting. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic specialized quality patient care and health service delivery. Effective implementation of infection control policies and health and safety legislation. Effective utilization of all human- and physical resources. Assist with Financial management and cost containment. Participate in health research, data collection & quality improvement initiatives. Provision of Support to Nursing Services.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical/written and oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification or post graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionale Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Verloskunde)
af.summary: Professionale Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 2 wat spesialiseer in verloskundesorg by Beaufort West Hospitaal, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n gevorderde verloskundige kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionale Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SACC Gevorderde Verloskunde en Neonatale Verpleegkunde (R212) geakkrediteer is. OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionale Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC in Verloskunde geakkrediteer is. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionale Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionale Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar se gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionale Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verkryging van die 1-jarige nagraadse kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, nagdiens, oortyd, openbare vakansiedae en naweke te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Gepaste toesigvaardighede en optimale benutting van ondergeskiktes. Kennis van moederlike en neonatale gesondheidsorgdienste binne die hospitaalopset. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Lewering van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde gehalte pasiëntsorg en gesondheidsdienslewering. Effektiewe implementering van infeksiebeheerbeleid en gesondheids- en veiligheidswetgewing. Effektiewe benutting van alle menslike en fisiese hulpbronne. Bystand met finansiële bestuur en kostebeheer. Deelname aan gesondheidsnavorsing, data-insameling en gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Verskaffing van ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohlotshaniswa Ngoqobo Lwemisebenzi Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-2 (IZINDLULA: Ukubelethiswa)
zu.summary: Umhlengikazi Ohlotshaniswa Ngoqobo Lwemisebenzi Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-2 ogxile ekunakekeleni kwabelethiswe eBeaufort West Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC noma iziqu eziphakeme zenokubeletha.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuqala semfundo: Isiqu somgangatho we-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezenhlekelelo) noma isiqu esihambisana nalokho (R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yonhlangothi lwezwe eNingizimu Afrika (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohlotshaniswa ngoqobo lwemisebenzi. Isiqu sebuhlungu benokubeletha esikhathi esingangenani unyaka owodwa esamukelekwe yi-SANC kwi-Advance Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212). Noma Iziqu ezingeminyaka emi-4 ezenhlekelelo (R174) noma isiqu esihambisana nalokho (R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yonhlangothi lwezwe eNingizimu Afrika (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohlotshaniswa ngoqobo lwemisebenzi. Idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu (R635) evunyiwe yi-SANC ekubeletheni. Ukubhaliswa kunchazamhlangothi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi ohlotshaniswa ngoqobo lwemisebenzi. Isipiliyoni: Isikhundla 1: Isipiliyoni esingangenani eminyaka engu-4 esifanele/esibonakalayo ekweni umsebenzi wehlekelelo emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohlotshaniswa ngoqobo lwemisebenzi kwi-SANC kuHlekelelo Jikelele. Isikhundla 2: Isipiliyoni esingangenani eminyaka engu-14 esifanele/esibonakalayo ekweni umsebenzi wehlekelelo emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohlotshaniswa ngoqobo lwemisebenzi kwi-SANC kuHlekelelo Jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yalesosikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esibonakalayo emva kokuqeda isiqu sebuhlungu benyaka owodwa noma idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu kuleyo ndawo ephathekayo. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwaleso sikhandla: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, umsebenzi wobusuku, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, nsuku ziholide zikawomhlabakhethwa namasonto. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (kokubili okushiwo nokwenziwa amagama). Amakhono ahle okuhlola abasebenzi abangaphansi kanye nokusebenzisa ngokugcwele abantu abangaphansi kwakho. Ulwazi ngesevisi yezempilo yomama kanye nezesi*singane* esibhedlela. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikeza inakekelo elihle, elibhekele konke, elikhulu elinobunjalo kubathengi nesevisi yezempilo elandiweyo. Ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinqubomgomo zokulawula izifo kanye nomthetho wezokuphila nokugqama. Ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo wonke amabafundabuso abantu nemiHlaba yomPhumalanga. Siza ngokuLawula imali kanye nokugcina imali. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ocwaningweni ngempilo, ukuqoqa imininingwane namaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa ngobunjalo. Nikela Ngesekelo kumasevisi weHlekelelo.

xh.title: Ummelikazi weNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEBELO ELIKHULU: Ukunyamezela)
xh.summary: Ummelikazi weNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 ogqitha kwisifundo sokunyamezela kwiBeaufort West Hospital, efunwa ukubhalisa kwiSANC nokuqeqeshelwa izifundo eziphakamileyo zokunyamezela.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwazo: Isifundo esisisiseko seR425 (okt. idiploma/inqqango kukunyangwa) okt isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kwaye R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengommelikazi. Isifundo sokunyangwa esingaphaya kwesiseko esithatha ubuncinane nyaka o-1 esemthethweni kwiSANC Advance Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212). OKT Inqqango yeminyaka emi-4 yokunyangwa (R174) okt isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kwaye R1497 okt R171 kwaye R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengommelikazi. Idiploma yangaphaya kwesiseko (R635) esemthethweni kwiSANC kwisoLwazi lokunyamezela. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo leMmeli: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengommelikazi. Iimfuno zemfundo nolwazi: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-4 yamava aifanelekileyo/avakalayo ekunyangweni emva kokubhalisa njengommelikazi kwiSANC kwisoLwazi loGqitho lokunyangwa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-14 yamava aifanelekileyo/avakalayo ekunyangweni emva kokubhalisa njengommelikazi kwiSANC kwisoLwazi loGqitho lokunyangwa. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yexesha elibalwe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isifundo sonyaka o-1 esingaphaya kwesiseko okt idiploma yangaphaya kwesiseko kule ndawo ethileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngokutshintshana, umsebenzi wasebusuku, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, iintsuku zihluleleyo namaviki. Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabalawuni okuthetha (kokubhaliweyo nakunokuTHetha). Amakhono abalulekileyo okulawula nokusebenzisa kakuhle abangaphantsi. ULwazi ngezikebe zokuKhusela iMama noMtshana kwindawo yesibhedlele. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukunikezela ngokukhathalela ngokugqibeleleyo, ngokubanzi, ngokwesoLwazi kumThwalo weGazi noNakekelo lwempilo. Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo iNkqubo yokulawula ukuQhubeka kweNtsholongwane nelwaZiso ngokuKhuseleko koMphefumlo. Ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo onke amaNdiya aMvela kubantu nokoBuNgcali. Ukuncedisa ngoLawulo lweMali nokugcina iMali. UKuthatha inxaxheba kuPhando lweMpiIlo, ukuQokelela iZifundo neZiganeko zokuPhucula. UKunikela ngaluncedo kwiNkonzo zoNakekelo.

Amandla (ulwazi/izikhokelo): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word ne-Excel) nokwazi izinqubo zokulondolozwa kwegama. zu.duties: Ukunikeza inakekelo lokusesiba elibhukadrhisiwe, elibophezela kanye nezinkomba ezilawaqondene ngokomthetho ohlelweni lokubeletha lwengxenye ekhethekileyo. Ukusebenzisa ngemvela ngaphandle abantu, imali nezinto zomqondo. Ukuphila ekuthuthukiseni ukwaziswa nokungenza ucwaningo. Ukunikeza ukusekela kumakhonothi yokusesiba. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenziseleyo abantu, izixhobo zezimali nezinto zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuzuzeni ulwazi nokuphanda. Ukuza ngenkxaso ekuNgeniseni kwabaNtu. jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Maternity) (X5
jobs.centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley: (Post Natal and Antenatal (X2 Posts) Antenatal (X1 Post) OBS and Gynaecology (X2 Posts)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Five Professional Nurse positions at Tygerberg Hospital in maternity specialties including post natal, antenatal, and OBS and gynaecology wards.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science. Or A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post Graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Midwifery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the relevant speciality after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, day & night duty, weekends and public holidays to meet the operational requirements. Willingness to rotate within the maternity module. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to nursing within the Department of Health Western Cape. Plan, Organize, & Coordinate the service by analysing, problem solving, and decision making. Leadership towards the realization of strategic goals and objective of the speciality clinical department. Display core values of the Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) on the execution of duties while practicing within the legislation, regulations and protocols applicable to the public service.
jobs.duties: Ensure quality patient care regarding the identification of nursing care needs, the planning and implementation of nursing care plans and the education of the nursing personnel as a Professional Nurse in the specific speciality clinical area. Render and supervise specialised clinical nursing care and support clinical staff with procedures within the specific clinical speciality unit. Utilise human, material and physical resources and develop self and others.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the required qualification will be appointed into the general stream, and they will be required to obtain the necessary qualification within the predetermined period of time. Candidates who are not in possession of stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post- basic qualification in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science or post Graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Midwifery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskap en Neonatale Verpleegkunde Wetenskap. Of 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse Diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Vroedvrouenskap. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die relevante spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jarige post-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die relevante spesialiteit. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Bereidwilligheid om binne die verloskundemodule te roteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en insig van relevante wetgewing en beleid rakende verpleging binne die Department of Health Western Cape. Beplan, organiseer en koördineer die diens deur te ontleed, probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Leierskap gerig op die verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die spesialiteit kliniese departement. Toon kernwaardes van die Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) by die uitvoering van pligte terwyl daar binne die wetgewing, regulasies en protokolle toepaslik op die openbare diens gepraktyk word.
af.duties: Verseker gehalte pasiëntsorg met betrekking tot die identifisering van verpleegsorgbehoeftes, die beplanning en implementering van verpleegsorgplanne en die opleiding van verpleegpersoneel as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in die spesifieke spesialiteit kliniese area. Lewer en hou toesig oor gespesialiseerde kliniese verpleegsorg en ondersteun kliniese personeel met prosedures binne die spesifieke kliniese spesialiteiteenheid. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne en ontwikkel self en ander.

zu.title: Unesi Othwebhile Izinga 1 kuye ku-2 (ESIGABA: Ukubeletha) (X5
zu.summary: Izikhundla ezinhlanu zOnesi Othwebhile eTygerberg Hospital kuleso sigaba sokubeletha okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwabesimama ngemva kokubeletha, ngaphambi kokubeletha, kanye namawadi e-OBS nokuwunyanga isifiso sokuqala.

Ukuza ngenkuthalo yokujikeleza ngaphakathi kwesimiso sokubeletha. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho kanye nenhlahla ehlobene nokunakekelwa kwegazi ehlotshaniswa nomnyango we-Department of Health Western Cape. Ukucubungula, ukuhlela, nokuhlanganisa insiza ngokuhlaziya ukudida izinkinga, nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuhola ngokuqondiswe ekufezeni amagagu nomgomo wesigaba sezokwelapha. Ukubonisa izigaba zokwazisa umnyango we-Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) ekwenzeni imisebenzi ngenkathi usebenza ngaphansi komthetho, imilayelo nemithetho yomphakathi ethinteka kumnyango wosebenza.

xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Isigqibo seR425 esisisiseko (oko nge-diploma/degree yokongeza) okanye isigqibo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi weNgango. Ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-10 yexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelanayo/avunywayo kweso khonza emva kokufumana isigqibo seNyaka o-1 sokongeza okanye i-diploma yokongeza kweso khonza. Iminfuno ephangqeleleyo yomsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza iishifithi, umsebenzi wemini nakuqobo, amavela ngeentsuku zokuphumla zoluntu ukwanelisa iimfuno zokusebenza. Ukuzimisela ukujikeleza ngaphakathi kwemodyuli yokunyela. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi nokuqonda komthetho nengqungquthela ebandakanya ukongeza ngaphakathi kwiDepartment of Health Western Cape. Ukuhola ngakumbi ekuphumezeni iinjongo nendima eqhagamshelwe nayo kweso khonza lesebe le kliniki. Ukubonisa amaxabiso ambalwa weDepartment of Health and Wellness (WCG) ekuphumezeni imisebenzi ngelixa usebenza ngaphakathi komthetho, iimigaqo nemiqathango yokusebenza eya kophuhliso loluntu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukhatho olulinganayo lomntu ogulayo malunga nokuchonga iimfuno zokongeza, ukuqamba nokuphumeza iplani zokongeza nokufundisa abasebenzi bomsebenzi wokongeza njengomongikazi weNgango kulawulo ekhetheke kulo kliniki. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto ezingabonwayo nezinto ezibonakalayo ziphathe ngendlela efanayo nokuqeqesha ukuziphatha nokwabanye.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Vlak 1 tot 2 (PRIMÊRE Gesondheid
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn-pos by Malmesbury CDC in die Western Cape, wat 'n verpleegdiploma en nagraadse kliniese kwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 'n 1-jaar diploma, in Kliniese Verpleegwetenskap: Gesondheids assessering, Behandeling en Sorg, geakkrediteer by die SANC (R 48) OF 'n 4-jaar baccalaureusgraad in verpleging (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorgverpleging. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene verpleging. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die eenjaar-nagraadse kwalifikasie soos bovermeld. OF 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorgverpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word en Excel). Toon diepgaande kennis van verpleeg- en openbare dienswetgewing. Toepaslike ervaring in 'n primêre gesondheidsorgomgewing. Toepaslike ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens.
af.duties: Die effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van toepaslike Kuratiewe Programme binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorpleit te wees vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van toepaslike Kindgesondheid binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorpleit te wees vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektief uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van toepaslike Vrouegesondheid binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorpleit te wees vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van toepaslike HAST-programme binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorpleit te wees vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektiewe voorsiening van hoë gehalte dienste gemeet aan die uitkomste van al die gehalteversekeringsaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umqashi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha Wesigaba 1 kuya ku-2 (IMPILYO EYISISO
zu.summary: Isikhundla somqashi wezokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha e-Malmesbury CDC e-Western Cape, sidinga idiploma yokunakekela kanye nethuli lezifundo ze-post-basic e-Clinical kunegunyazwe lokubhalisa kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Ithuli le-Basic R425 (okungukuthi, idiploma/idigri ekunakekelweni) noma ithuli elifanayo (R683 kanye no-R254) elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoba yimhunonurse. Ithuli le-post-basic, ngobude besikhathi esingasapheli unyaka wgidiploma, ekunakekelwa kwe-Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, eligunyazisiwe yi-SANC (R 48) noma idigri yeminyaka emi-4 yokunakekela (R174) noma ithuli elifanayo (R683 kanye no-R1497 noma u-R171 kanye no-R1497) elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoba yimhunonurse. Idiploma ye-postgraduate (R635) egunyazisiwe yi-SANC ekunakekelwa kwe-Primary Care Nursing. Ukubhalisa kubahluleki: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse. Isipili: IGrade 1: Okungenani eminyaka engu-4 yesipili esifanelekile/esihlonishwayo sokunakekela ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse ekunakekelweni jikelele. IGrade 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-14 yesipili esifanelekile/esihlonishwayo sokunakekela ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse ekunakekelweni jikelele. Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yalesosikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele ibe yisipili esifanelekile/esihlonishwayo kuleyo ndawo ethize ngemuva kokuthola ithuli le-post-basic lonyaka olu-1 njengoba kushiwo ngenhla. Noma Idiploma ye-postgraduate (R635) egunyazisiwe yi-SANC ekunakekelwa kwe-Primary Care Nursing. Izidingo ezibulethi emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokuqasha (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Izindlela zomsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word kanye ne-Excel). Ukubonisa ulwazi olujulile lomthetho wezokunakekela nowomphakathi. Isipili esifanelekile endaweni yempilo eyisiso. Isipili esifanelekile ekunikeleni ngenkonzo yesekelo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka okusebenzayo nokunikela ngosizo ekuphathweni kwe-Curative Programs ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwesibopho somsebenzi nokuba ngumgxageli womguli ukuqinisekisa ukunikezelwa kwezokunakekelwa ezidingekayo. Ukuhlinzeka okusebenzayo nokunikela ngosizo ekuphathweni kwe-Child Health ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwesibopho somsebenzi nokuba ngumgxageli womguli ukuqinisekisa ukunikezelwa kwezokunakekelwa ezidingekayo. Ukuhlinzeka okusebenzayo nokunikela ngosizo ekuphathweni kwe-Women's Health ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwesibopho somsebenzi nokuba ngumgxageli womguli ukuqinisekisa ukunikezelwa kwezokunakekelwa ezidingekayo. Ukuhlinzeka okusebenzayo nokunikela ngosizo ekuphathweni kwe-HAST programs ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwesibopho somsebenzi nokuba ngumgxageli womguli ukuqinisekisa ukunikezelwa kwezokunakekelwa ezidingekayo. Ukunikela ngempumelelo ngenkonzo yemigco ekukho okuqinisekiswa ukuthola iziphetho zonke izinkalo zokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi.

xh.title: uMqeqeshi weGazi weSikhwikwi isigaba 1 ukuya kwi-2 (PRIMARY Health
xh.summary: Isithuba somQeqeshi weGazi weSikhwikwi kwi-Malmesbury CDC e-Western Cape, sifuna idiploma yokuhlola nokugqatshwa kwesikhwikwi sangemva kwesiseko ngenqanaba le-Clinical kunye nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingoko kwangoko: Isigaba se-Basic R425 (okt yidiploma/iphondo kuhlolo) okt isigaba esilinganayo (R683 kwaye R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoGqatshwa lwesikhwikwi. Isigaba sangemva kwesiseko, ngobude bexesha obunganga nyanga ze-1 yediploma, kwi-Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, egunyaziswe yi-SANC (R 48) OKT iphondo leminyaka eyi-4 yonke (R174) okt isigaba esilinganayo (R683 kwaye R1497 okt R171 kwaye R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoGqatshwa lwesikhwikwi. Idiploma yongeza-phondo (R635) egunyaziswe yi-SANC kwi-Primary Care Nursing. Ukubhaliswa kolwazi olungamkelo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqatshwa lwesikhwikwi. Ikwahlelwa: Isigaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-4 yamava ahambelana nokuqatshwa oluchazwe ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqatshwa lwesikhwikwi kuhlolo jikelele. Isigaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-14 yamava ahambelana nokuqatshwa oluchazwe ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqatshwa lwesikhwikwi kuhlolo jikelele. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yexesha elichaziwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelana nokuqatshwa oluchazwe kwikhondo elithile emva kokufumana idiploma yeminyaka eyi-1 yesigaba sangemva kwesiseko njengoko kuchaziwe ngasentla. OKT Idiploma yongeza-phondo (R635) egunyaziswe yi-SANC kwi-Primary Care Nursing. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisense evakalayo (Code B/EB). Ulwazi (olwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word ne-Excel). Bonisa ulwazi olujulile ngokuMthetho wekuhlola nakuwo wonke umthetho wesebe loNkonzoyoluntu. Amava ahambelana nesimo sendawo ye-primary health care. Amava ahambelana nokubonelela ngesebe lenkxaso.
xh.duties: Ukuqatshwa ngokusebenziseyo kwaye uncede ngolawulo lweCurative Programs ezihambelanayo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yokuqatshwa kwaye ube ngumxelaneli wesigulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuqatshwa ngokusebenziseyo kwaye uncede ngolawulo lweChild Health ezihambelanayo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yokuqatshwa kwaye ube ngumxelaneli wesigulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuqatshwa ngokusebenziseyo kwaye uncede ngolawulo lweWomen's Health ezihambelanayo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yokuqatshwa kwaye ube ngumxelaneli wesigulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuqatshwa ngokusebenziseyo kwaye uncede ngolawulo lweHAST programs ezihambelanayo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yokuqatshwa kwaye ube ngumxelaneli wesigulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukubonelela ngokusebenziseyo ngeendlela ezikhoyo ezingomlingo ngokulinganiswa ngeziphumo zazo zonke iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa khwalithi.

jobs.title: EMS Station Manager Grade 3 to 6
jobs.centre: Overberg (Swellendam and Caledon) Cape Winelands (Robertson) West Coast (Vredenburg), Emergency Medical Services
jobs.salary_text: Grade 3: R413 199 per annum Grade 4: R499 311 per annum Grade 5: R584 604 per annum Grade 6: R649 260 per annum
jobs.summary: Manage pre-hospital emergency care services at stations across the Overberg, Cape Winelands and West Coast regions, ensuring vehicle maintenance and audit compliance.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 3: Successful completion of the Immediate Life Support (ILS) that allows registration with the HPCSA as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Successful completion of the Emergency Care Technician Course (ECT) that allows registration with HPCSA as Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant course (CCA) or National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic. Grade 6: Successful completion of the B-Tech Degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as an Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Registration with a professional council: Grade 3: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as an AEA. Grade 4: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as an ECT. Grade 5: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Paramedic. Grade 6: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as an ECP. Experience: Grade 3: Minimum of 3 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Minimum of 3 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Minimum of 3 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Paramedic. Grade 6: Minimum of 3 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Inherent requirement of the job: Current registration as an AEA, ECT, Paramedic or ECP. Valid code C1 driver’s license. Valid Code 10 Professional driver’s permit. Physical and mental fitness as an Emergency Services practitioner. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent knowledge of all levels of Emergency Care protocols. Good communication and interpersonal skills. -Computer literacy in the MS Office package. Report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Manage pre-hospital Emergency Care Services within the geographic area and respond to incidents when required. Ensure that the maintenance of Emergency vehicles and equipment are managed effectively and efficiently. Maintain responsibility for the audit compliance with regards to Supply Chain Management and Human Resource matters, inclusive of the Station’s budget allocation and facilitation of account payments for goods and services. Effectively manage and supervise staff in relation to the Human Resource and Labour Relations function. Ensure effective communication with regards to meetings, workshops, debriefs, compiling stats and report writing. Effective support to District Manager and act in management capacity when required.
jobs.enquiries: EMS Overberg District Office – Ms Y Avontuur Tel No: (028) 312-3219 / Mr M Jacobs Tel No: (028) 284-9100 EMS West Coast District Office; Mr E Pedro Tel No: (022) 433-8853 / Ms S Andrew Tel No: (022) 433-8853 EMS Winelands District Office - Mr I Naidoo Tel No: (023) 346-6000 / Ms A Botha Tel No: (023) 346-6022
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: EMS Stasiebestuurder Vlak 3 tot 6
af.summary: Bestuur pre-hospitaal nood-sorgdienste by stasies oor die Overberg, Cape Winelands en West Coast streke, en verseker voertuigonderhoud en ouditnakoming.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Vlak 3: Voltooide Immediate Life Support (ILS) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA) moontlik maak. Vlak 4: Voltooide Emergency Care Technician Course (ECT) wat registrasie by HPCSA as Emergency Care Technician (ECT) moontlik maak. Vlak 5: Voltooide Critical Care Assistant course (CCA) of National Diploma wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Paramedic moontlik maak. Vlak 6: Voltooide B-Tech Degree wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Vlak 3: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n AEA. Vlak 4: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n ECT. Vlak 5: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Paramedic. Vlak 6: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n ECP. Ervaring: Vlak 3: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Vlak 4: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Vlak 5: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Paramedic. Vlak 6: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Inherente vereiste van die werk: Huidige registrasie as 'n AEA, ECT, Paramedic of ECP. Geldige kode C1 bestuurderslisensie. Geldige Code 10 Professionele bestuurderspermit. Fisiese en geestelike geskiktheid as 'n Nooddiensbeoefenaar. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende kennis van alle vlakke van Emergency Care protokolle. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. -Rekenaargeletterdheid in die MS Office-pakket. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur pre-hospitaal Emergency Care Services binne die geografiese gebied en reageer op voorvalle wanneer vereis. Verseker dat die onderhoud van Emergency voertuie en toerusting doeltreffend en doeltugend bestuur word. Behou verantwoordelikheid vir ouditnakome met betrekking tot Supply Chain Management en Human Resource aangeleenthede, insluitend die stasie se begrotingstoekenning en fasilitering van rekeningsbetalings vir goedere en dienste. Bestuur en hou toesig oor personeel doeltreffend in verhouding tot die Human Resource en Labour Relations funksie. Verseker effektiewe kommunikasie met betrekking tot vergaderings, werkswinkels, debriewings, samestelling van statistieke en verslagdoening. Effektiewe ondersteuning aan Distrikbestuurder en tree in bestuurskapasiteit op wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Menja weSiteshi se-EMS Isigaba 3 kuya ku-6
zu.summary: Phatha izinkonzo zokunakekelwa kwezimpilo ezingaphambi kwesibhedlela eziteshini kulo lonke elase-Overberg, Cape Winelands nase-West Coast, ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezimoto nokuhambisana nomhloli.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ebalulekile: Grade 3: Ukuphothula ngenhlanhla i-Immediate Life Support (ILS) ekuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-HPCSA njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Ukuphothula ngenhlanhla i-Emergency Care Technician Course (ECT) ekuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-HPCSA njenge-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Ukuphothula ngenhlanhla i-Critical Care Assistant course (CCA) noma i-National Diploma ekuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-HPCSA njenge-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ukuphothula ngenhlanhla i-B-Tech Degree ekuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-HPCSA njenge-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Uku-bhalisa kumkhandlu wezifundo: Grade 3: Uku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-AEA. Grade 4: Uku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-ECT. Grade 5: Uku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Paramedic. Grade 6: Uku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-ECP. Isipiliyangi: Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yisipiliyangi ngemuva koku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yisipiliyangi ngemuva koku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yisipiliyangi ngemuva koku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Paramedic. Grade 6: Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yisipiliyangi ngemuva koku-bhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Isidingo esibalulekile somsebenzi: Uku-bhalise kwamanje njenge-AEA, ECT, Paramedic noma ECP. Ilayisensi yokushayela ebizwa ngokuthi i-code C1 esemthethweni. I-permit esemthethweni yokushayela ebizwa ngokuthi i-Code 10 Professional driver's. Ukuhambisana komzimba nengqondo njengomuntu osebenzayo kuma-Emergency Services. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaskills): Ulwazi oluhle ngamaphrotokholu onke amanani e-Emergency Care. Amandla okuxhumana kahle nabantu nokusebenza nabo. -Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Office package. Amandla okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkonzo zokunakekelwa kwezimpilo ezingaphambi kwesibhedlela endaweni egiografikhi uphendule kwezenzakalo lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukugcinwa kwezimoto zoku-Gijima nezempahla kuphathwa ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Gcina inxaxheba ekubeni uhambisana nomhloli ngemayelana nezindaba ze-Supply Chain Management ne-Human Resource, okuhlanganisa ukwabiwa kwesabelomali sesiteshi kanye nokuqondisa ukukhokhelwa kwezikweletu zempahla nezinkonzo. Phatha futhi ulawule abasebenzi ngokusebenza kahle mayelana nomsebenzi we-Human Resource ne-Labour Relations. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo mayelana nezinkulumo, amawokishophu, ukwembula izindaba, ukuqamba izibalo nokubhala imibiko. Nikela ngokwesekela okusebenzayo ku-District Manager ube ngomunye wabaphathi lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: UMphathi WeZiko le-EMS Inqanaba 3 ukuya kwi-6
xh.summary: Phatha iinkonzo zolunyango lwezigulo ezixhakekileyo ngaphambi kokuya esibhedlele kumaziko kuwo onke amanndla angakweli Overberg, Cape Winelands naku West Coast, kuqinisekiswa ukwengciselo kweenkumbi nokuhambelana neempawu zokuhlola.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Grade 3: Ukuphumelela kwi-Immediate Life Support (ILS) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoko-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Ukuphumelela kwi-Emergency Care Technician Course (ECT) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoko-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Ukuphumelela kwizifundo ze-Critical Care Assistant course (CCA) okanye i-National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ukuphumelela kwi-B-Tech Degree evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Ukubhalisa kolunyazi lwebhodi: Grade 3: Ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo-AEA. Grade 4: Ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo-ECT. Grade 5: Ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo-ECP. Isiphiwo: Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yamava emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoko-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yamava emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoko-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yamava emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yamava emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoko-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Iminyanya eqinisekileyo yomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa ngokwangoku njengo-AEA, ECT, Paramedic okanye ECP. Ilayisensi yomqhubi ye-code C1 esebenzayo. Ipermithi yomqhubi ngobuchwephesha ye-Code 10 esebenzayo. Ulwalamano lwemizimba nengqondo njengomsebenzi weziko lee-EMS. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olugqithisileyo malunga nezithintelo zonamanqanaba oLunyango lweZigulo ezixhakekileyo. Amakhono amabalwa okunxibelelana nabantu nokuvelwana nabo. -Ukuzazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office package. Amakhono okubhala iiripoti.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkonzo zoLunyango lweZigulo ezixhakekileyo ngaphambi kokuya esibhedlele ngaphakathi kwendawo yommandla wenkcwadi yomhlaba bese uzabela kwiiganeko xa kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuba ukwengciselo kweekhenditha ze-EMS nemixhobo yolunyango lwezigulo ezixhakekileye ziphathwa ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanileyo. GCina urhululo wokuhambelana neempawu zokuhlolo malunga nezindaba zoNylonzeyo yokuqamba Isixhobo nezeMinyanya yabaSebenzi, kuquka nokwabiwa kwebhajeti yeZiko nokulungelelanisa imirhumo yezikoluthi nolonikezelo. Phatha ngokusebenza kakuhle bese ulawula abasebenzi ngokuthatha ingqalelo kumisebenzi yoNylonzo yabaSebenzi nezeMinyanya yamaQabane. Qinisekisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo ngokuthatha ingqalelo kwiintlanganiso, amawonketho, iinkcukacha ezisusiweyo, ukuqamba iintatho bese ubhala iiripoti. Nika inkxaso esebenzayo kuMphathi weSithili bese uzithatha njengomphathi xa kufuneka.

jobs.title: Speech Therapist Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Speech Therapist wanted at Garden Route District Office in George to provide speech therapy services at facility and community level for adult and paediatric patients.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Speech Therapist and Audiologist or Speech Therapist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Speech Therapist and Audiologist or Speech Therapist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession in Speech Therapy or Speech Therapy and Audiology (where applicable in respect of RSA qualified employees). 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Speech Therapy or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of SA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Speech Therapy or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Adhere to all departmental requirements and protocols. Excellent report, clinical note and referral writing skills. Good computer skills (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Comply with National Core Standards and or ideal facility/clinic requirements as applicable. Ability to provide Speech Therapy services independently and as part of a team. Clinical therapeutic skills including assessment techniques, treatment, discharge planning and follow up as needed.
jobs.duties: To provide Speech Therapy services at facility level (hospitals and primary healthcare facilities) and community level in the Garden Route District, inclusive of adult and paediatric patients with disorders in speech, language, feeding, swallowing, fluency, voice and cognition within the scope of practice of a Speech Therapist. To provide education and training to healthcare professionals, community health workers and patients and plan Speech Therapy related health awareness activities according to the health awareness calendar. To adhere to departmental rules and values. To work and be part of a multi-disciplinary team. Daily collection and monthly submission of data as per departmental protocols. Effective, efficient and optimal use of resource management such as managing stock and ordering consumables. Complete weekly stats and service reports as required. Maintain own professional development, facilitate in-service training as identified. Manage review of personal performance. Provide relevant relief duty in absence of a peer colleague and provide support to supervisor.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Spraakterapeut Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Spraakterapeut benodig by Garden Route District Office in George om spraakterapiedienste op fasiliteits- en gemeenskapsvlak vir volwasse en pediatriese pasiënte te verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Spraakterapeut en Oudioloog of Spraakterapeut toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Spraakterapeut en Oudioloog of Spraakterapeut. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante professie in Spraakterapie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie (waar toepaslik ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers). 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Spraakterapie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Spraakterapie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Inherente vereiste van die pos: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Voldoen aan alle departementele vereistes en protokolle. Uitstekende skryfvaardighede vir verslae, kliniese notas en verwysings. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Voldoen aan Nasionale Kernstandaarde en/of ideale fasiliteits-/kliniekevereistes soos toepaslik. Vermoë om Spraakterapiedienste onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te verskaf. Kliniese terapeutiese vaardighede insluitend assesseringstegnieke, behandeling, ontslagbeplanning en opvolg soos benodig.
af.duties: Om Spraakterapiedienste op fasiliteitsvlak (hospitale en primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite) en gemeenskapsvlak in die Garden Route District te verskaf, insluitend volwasse en pediatriese pasiënte met afwykings in spraak, taal, voeding, slukking, vloei, stem en kognisie binne die omvang van praktyk van 'n Spraakterapeut. Om opvoeding en opleiding aan gesondheidsorgprofessioneles, gemeenskapsgesondheidswerkers en pasiënte te verskaf en Spraakterapie-verwante gesondheidsbewustheidsaktiwiteite volgens die gesondheidsbewustheidskalender te beplan. Om aan departementele reëls en waardes te voldoen. Om te werk en deel te wees van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Daaglikse versameling en maandelikse indiening van data volgens departementele protokolle. Effektiewe, doeltreffende en optimale gebruik van hulpbronbestuur soos die bestuur van voorraad en bestelling van verbruiksgoedere. Voltooi weeklikse statistieke en diensverslae soos vereis. Handhaaf eie professionele ontwikkeling, fasiliteer in-diens opleiding soos geïdentifiseer. Bestuur hersiening van persoonlike prestasie. Verskaf relevante aflosdiens in afwesigheid van 'n eweknie en verskaf ondersteuning aan toesighouer.

zu.title: Umxhashi wezwi izinga 1 kuye ku-3
zu.summary: Umxhashi wezwi ofunwayo eGarden Route District Office eGeorge ukunikeza izinsiza zokuxhasha izwi esikhungweni nangesigabeni somphakathi kubaphathi abadala nabanabafana.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isiqu esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba nguMxhashi wezwi nezezele noma uMxhashi wezwi. Ukubhalisa kolimi lwemithethonqangi: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba nguMxhashi wezwi nezezele noma uMxhashi wezwi. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA emsebenzini ofanelekene wokuxhasha izwi noma wokuxhasha izwi nezezele (lapho kusebenza khona mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu e-RSA). Unyaka o-1 wokuphilana okuhambisana nemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kwi-Audiology noma i-Speech Therapy and Audiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki kubo ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okuncane ukuthi uneminyaka engu-10 yokuphilana okuhambisana nemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kwi-Speech Therapy noma i-Speech Therapy and Audiology mayelana nabasebenzi base-South Africa abathweswe iziqu. Okuncane ukuthi uneminyaka engu-11 yokuphilana okuhambisana nemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kwi-Audiology noma i-Speech Therapy and Audiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki kubo ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okuncane ukuthi uneminyaka engu-20 yokuphilana okuhambisana nemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kwi-Speech Therapy noma i-Speech Therapy and Audiology mayelana nabasebenzi base-South Africa abathweswe iziqu. Okuncane ukuthi uneminyaka engu-21 yokuphilana okuhambisana nemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kwi-Audiology noma i-Speech Therapy and Audiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki kubo ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esingokuzalwa somsebenzi: Ilayisenisi evumelekile (Code B/EB). Ulwazi (ulwazi/izikhono): Ukulandela yonke imithethonqangi kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko, amanothi ezokwelapha nokulungiselela izincomo. Amakhono amahle ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ukulandela izidingo ze-National Core Standards kanye noma izidingo zesikhungo/ikliniki ejuqule njengoba kufanele. Ikono lokunikeza izinsiza zokuxhasha izwi ngokuzimele futhi njengengxenye yeqembu. Amakhono okwelapha okuhambisana nemizwa okuhlanganisa izindlela zokuqagela, ukwelapha, ukuhlela ukuphuma kwindawokwelashwa kanye nokuqhubeka njengoba kudingeka.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsiza zokuxhasha izwi esikhungweni (ezibhedlela kanye nalezinsiza eziphakeme zezempilo yokunakekelwa kokuqala) nangesigabeni somphakathi e-Garden Route District, okuhlanganisa abaphathi abadala nabanabafana abanenkimbinkimbi yezwi, ulimi, ukudla, ukugidayisa, ukuzwakala, iphimbo kanye nokuqonda ngaphakathi kwesigaba somsebenzi kaMxhashi wezwi. Ukunikeza imfundo nokuqeqesha izisebenzi zezempilo, abasebenzi bezempilo bomphakathi kanye nabaphathi futhi uhlele imisebenzi ehambisana nokuxhasha izwi ehlobene nokwazisa ngempilo ngokwekhalenda yokwazisa ngempilo. Ukulandela imithetho kanye namagugu omnyango. Ukusebenza futhi ube yingxenye yeqembu elisebenza emikhakheni eminingi. Ukuqoqa usuku ngalunye kanye nokuhambisa idatha nyanga zonke ngokwezinqubo zomnyango. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okufanele kanye nokuhamba kahle kwezinsiza ezinjengokuphatha izitoki nokulungiselela okuzosetshenziswa. Ukuqedela izibalo zansuku zonke kanye nemibiko yesevisi njengoba kudingeka. Ukugcina ukuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu ngobuchwepheshe, ukwenza qeqeshe ngaphakathi kwesevisi njengoba kutholwa kudingeka. Ukuphatha ukuqoqwa kokusebenza komuntu siqu. Ukunikeza umsebenzi wokuletha lapho kungekhona umsebenzi nosonto, nokunikeza inkumselo omqondisi.

xh.title: Umganga Wokwel ulwimi Esigqini 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Kufunwa umganga wokwelisa ulwimi kwiOfisi yoMmandla we-Garden Route e-George ukunika iinkonzo zokwelisa ulwimi kwizinga lefasilithi nakummandla womphakathi abantu abadala nabanengi abangabantwana.
xh.requirements: Igcwegcwe lomfundo osezantsi: Ifomeshane efanelekile evumela ukubhalisa kwi-Komkhulu Loongcali Bezempilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomganga wokwelisa ulwimi nolalelo okanye umganga wokwelisa ulwimi. Ukubhalisa kolunye ibalathongo leongcali: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomganga wokwelisa ulwimi nolalelo okanye umganga wokwelisa ulwimi. Isipilipongongoma: Isigaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwishishini elicetyisiweyo ekunyuselelweni kolwimi okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo (apho kusemthethweni ngokwabasebenzi abagqithiswe e-RSA). I-1-year isipilipongongama elifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwilalelo okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo kubasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithisiweyo, abangekafunelwe ukwenza iNkonzo yoMphakathi, njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Isigaba 2: Ubuncinane be-10 years isipilipongongama elifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ekunyuselelweni kulwimi okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo kubasebenzi base-SA abagqithisiweyo. Ubuncinane be-11 years isipilipongongama elifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwilalelo okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo kubasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithisiweyo, abangekafunelwe ukwenza iNkonzo yoMphakathi, njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Isigaba 3: Ubuncinane be-20 years isipilipongongama elifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ekunyuselelweni kulwimi okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo kubasebenzi base-SA abagqithisiweyo. Ubuncinane be-21 years isipilipongongama elifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwilalelo okanye ekunyuselelweni kulwimi nolalelo kubasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithisiweyo, abangekafunelwe ukwenza iNkonzo yoMphakathi, njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi (Code B/EB) evakalayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuzinikela kuwo onke amagqabantshi athi ebalathongo elifanelekileyo nemigaqo yesebe. Amakhono amninzi okubhala iingxelo, iinguqu zabengcali zokwelapha kunye nezincwadana ezinika isalathiso. Amakhono amninzi ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint). Ukuzinikela kumagqabantshi eSizwe eBalulekileyo okanye iimfuno zokulinganiselwa kwefasilithi/iqhembu elilingana njengoko kufuneka. Ukubakho nokwenza iinkonzo zokwelisa ulwimi ngokuzimeleyo njengelunga loqembu. Amakhono okunyuselelwa uxakekileyo olubandakanya iindlela zovavayo, unyuso, uqwalaselo lokuqhotyoshelwa kulwazi nokuqwalaselo ngokwemfuneko.
xh.duties: Ukuze kubekho iinkonzo zokwelisa ulwimi kwizinga lefasilithi (iibhedlele neendawo zokhathalelo olutsha lolwazi lzempilo) nakummandla wesiqhingi kummandla wakwa-Garden Route, ngokubandakanya abantu abadala nengiabantwana abanengozi bokukhuluma, ukusebenzisa ulwimi, ukutya, ukumiswa, ukubakwa mntu ngenxa yolwimi, ukuvakalelwa kolwimi, ulwazi lokubakho kwaye baxakeke ngakumbi kwindlela yokukhulisa ulwimi loludidi. Ukunika inyathiso nokuqeqesha abongcali bezempilo, oosebenzisiweyo kwezo mpilo komphakathi kunye nabaguli baze nokuqhubeleka iinkonzo ezinxulumene nokulwazi komphakathi ngokwamakhalenda wokuqwalaselo lolwazi. Ukuba ngumsebenzi ngokwemigaqo yesebe nokuqwalasela indlela yokwenza umsebenzi. Ukusebenza njengelunga loqembu olunengcali ezininzi. Ukuqokelela iinkcukacha zemihla ngemihla nokuzithumela ngenyanga ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo, ngokulungele ngokuchanekileyo nangokulinganiselwa ukulawula imithombo ejwayelekileyo njengokulawula izikhwama nokuodola izinto ezisetyenziswa. Ukugqiba iingxelo ze-stats ngeveki ezinzima njengoko kufuneka. Ukugcina ukuqhubeleka kolwazi lwakho ngokwexesha, ukuqeqesha kwindawo yomsebenzi njengoko kuchongiwe. Ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zokulawula ukusebenza kwakho. Ukubonelela ngokungenelela okukhankanyiweyo ngexesha lokungabi kolunye uqhwamsha likalungu kunye nokunika inkxaso kumkhuphi wakho.

jobs.title: Community Liaison Officer
jobs.summary: Community Liaison Officer needed at the Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure office to facilitate community participation and implement health facility board programmes.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate experience in facilitating community participation. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code B/EB driver’s license and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Understanding of Project Management and evaluation of projects. A working knowledge of Health-related regulation pertaining to the district health council, the hospital boards and clinic committees. Good co-ordination, problem solving and training skills. Computer literacy (Ms Word, PowerPoint and Excel). Working knowledge of governance-related legislation and regulations, and health promotion principles. Understanding of communication processes with communities, internal staff, and external partners. Ability to compile reports, take minutes, capture community feedback, and perform administrative duties accurately.
jobs.duties: Plan and ensure successful implementation of the Health Facilities Board Act. Liaise with health orientated community organisations to ensure effective communication between services and the communities. Organise, co-ordinate, conduct and monitor effective capacity building programs for relevant role players. Responsible for the representation and marketing of the Sub-structure Office health services at the relevant health orientated community organisations. Interact with management and other colleagues of the Sub- structure Office. Perform related administrative duties. Provide technical and administrative support to the Violence Prevention unit, as required.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Gemeenskapskakelbeampte
af.summary: Gemeenskapskakelbeampte benodig by die Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-struktuurkantoor om gemeenskapsdeelname te fasiliteer en gesondheidsfasiliteitsraad-programme te implementeer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of ekwivalent. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die fasilitering van gemeenskapsdeelname. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Begrip van Projekbestuur en evaluering van projekte. Werkende kennis van gesondheidsverwante regulasies met betrekking tot die distriksgesondheidsraad, die hospitaalrade en kliniekkomitees. Goeie koördinasie-, probleemoplossings- en opleidingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Ms Word, PowerPoint en Excel). Werkende kennis van bestuursverwante wetgewing en regulasies, en gesondheidsbevorderingsbeginsels. Begrip van kommunikasieprosesse met gemeenskappe, interne personeel en eksterne vennote. Vermoë om verslae op te stel, notule te neem, gemeenskapterugvoer vas te lê en administratiewe pligte akkuraat uit te voer.
af.duties: Beplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering van die Health Facilities Board Act. Skakel met gesondheidsgeoriënteerde gemeenskapsorganisasies om doeltreffende kommunikasie tussen dienste en die gemeenskappe te verseker. Organiseer, koördineer, voer uit en monitor doeltreffende kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir tersaaklike rolspelers. Verantwoordelik vir die verteenwoordiging en bemarking van die Sub-struktuurkantoor se gesondheidsdienste by die tersaaklike gesondheidsgeoriënteerde gemeenskapsorganisasies. Skakel met bestuur en ander kollegas van die Sub-struktuurkantoor. Voer verwante administratiewe pligte uit. Verskaf tegniese en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Violence Prevention-eenheid soos vereis.

zu.title: Inhluleli Yokuxhumana Nomphakathi
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNhluleli Yokuxhumana Nomphakathi eKlipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure office ukukhuthaza ukuzibandakanya komphakathi nokuphatha izinhlelo zamabhodi eziteshi sezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekile noma okulingana nayo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ekukhuthazeni ukuzibandakanya komphakathi. Isidingo esingezandlela somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esemthethweni nokugonna ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ukuqonda ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi nokuhlola amaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemithetho ehlobene nezempilo ebhekise kwi-district health council, amabhodi esibhedlela namakomidi amakliniki. Amakhono okuhle okuhlanganisa, okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlinzeka ngokutoholo. Ulwazi lokusebenzana ikhompuytha (i-Ms Word, i-PowerPoint ne-Excel). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomthetho nezimiso ezihlobene nobulungiswa, nezinhlobo zokuthuthukiswa kwempilo. Ukuqonda inqubo yokuxhumana nomphakathi, abasebenzi bangaphakathi, nabalingani bangaphandle. Ikono lokubhalisa okubikayo, ukuthatha imizuzu, ukuqoq ulwazi oluphuwa umphakathi, nokwenza imisebenzi yobulungiswa ngokunembile.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwe-Health Facilities Board Act. Xhumana nenhlangano zomphakathi ezibheke ezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenza phakathi kwezinsiza nomphakathi. Hlela, hlanganisa, yenza futhi ulawule izinhlelo zokwakha ikhono ezisebenzayo abadlali abahlobene nendima. Uxibhe ekumelwa nekuthengiseni izinsiza sezempilo ze-Sub-structure Office kumahlelo omphakathi abheke ezempilo. Xhumana nobaqondisi nabanye abasebenzi be-Sub-structure Office. Yenza eminye imisebenzi yobulungiswa ehlobene nokuthi okuwona. Nikela ngesikhuzo nosekelo lwezobulungishi eyunithi ye-Violence Prevention njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Nothi Wothothamiso Lomthonyama

xh.requirements: Isiqu semfundo esincinci: iDiploma yeSizwe (NQF 6) efanelekile okanye esilingana nayo. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekile sokunceda ekuthini umthonyama uthathe inxaxheba. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: ilayisenisi elifanelekile lekhodi ye-B/EB kwaye kubakho isabelo sokuhamba. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuqonda ukulawula iiprojekthi nokuqonda iiprojekthi. Ulwazi olusebenzayo malunga nemithetho ehambelana nezempilo ngokumayelana negqiza lempilo yommandla, amabhunga ezibhedlele namakomiti amabanga. Amandla okuhlanganisa, okusombulula iingxaki nokuyila. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, PowerPoint ne-Excel). Ulwazi olusebenzayo malunga nemithetho nolawulo oluhambelana nokulawula, nemiingqgiselo yokukhuthaza izempilo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokunxibelelana namathonyama, abasebenzi bangaphakathi, kunye nabahlobo bangaphandle. Amandla okubhala iingxelo, okubhala amaminithi,okuqokelela imibono yomthonyama, nokuwenza imisebenzi yolawulo ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa ukuqinisekisa ukuphumeza ngempumelelo uMthetho weBhunga leziFasilithi zeMpilo. Nxibelelana nabahlobo bomthonyama abajolise ezempilo ukuqinisekisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo phakathi kweenkonzo namathonyama. Hlela, hlanganisa, yenze ulwazi wakhe aphinde alawule iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokwakha amandla kubathathi nxaxheba abafanelekile. Uxanduva lokumela nokuthengisa iinkonzo ezempilo zwindawo yomsebenzi yesakhiwo esincinci kubahlobo bomthonyama abajolise ezempilo. Nxibelelana nabaphathi nabanakwabo bonke bendawo yomsebenzi yesakhiwo esincinci. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ehambelana nayo. Nikela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe nolawulo kuqoqosho lokuthintela ukuqhushumbisa, njengoko kufunekayo.

Inkxaso kwazo zonke iintlobo zemfundo njengoko kulindelekile kwindlu yokufunda.

jobs.title: Community Liaison Officer
jobs.summary: Community Liaison Officer needed at the Northern/Tygerberg Sub-structure Office to coordinate governance structures and capacity-building programmes for the Western Cape Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent qualification. Experience: Appropriate experience in community engagement, communication, and stakeholder coordination. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid Code B/EB driver’s license. Willingness and ability to travel for official duties. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Working knowledge of governance-related legislation and regulations, and health promotion principles. A working knowledge of Health related regulation pertaining to the district health council, the hospital boards and clinic committees. Good co-ordination, problem solving and training skills. Computer literacy (Ms Word, PowerPoint and Excel). Understanding of Project Management and evaluation of projects. Understanding of communication processes with communities, internal staff, and external partners. Ability to compile reports, take minutes, capture community feedback, and perform administrative duties accurately.
jobs.duties: Implement the Western Cape Health Facility Boards and Committees Act (“the Act”) by planning, coordinating, and supporting effective governance structures. Coordinate capacity-building programmes by organising, implementing, and monitoring training initiatives for relevant community and facility role players. Represent and promote Sub-Structure Office health services within relevant health-orientated community organisations. Facilitate and support stakeholder engagement meetings, forums, and community dialogues and meetings. Identify community needs, concerns, and service delivery challenges and report these to management. Compile reports, minutes, community feedback summaries, and attendance registers, and provide technical and administrative support to the Violence Prevention Unit and other components as required.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Gemeenskapskakelbeampte
af.summary: Gemeenskapskakelbeampte benodig by die Northern/Tygerberg Sub-structure Office om bestuursstrukture en kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir die Western Cape Department of Health te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike National Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid, kommunikasie en belanghebbende-koördinering. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bereidheid en vermoë om vir amptelike pligte te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Werkende kennis van bestuursverwante wetgewing en regulasies, en gesondheidsbevorderingsbeginsels. 'n Werkende kennis van gesondheidsverwante regulasie rakende die distriksgesondheidsraad, die hospitaalrade en kliniekkomitees. Goeie koördinasie-, probleemoplossings- en opleidingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Ms Word, PowerPoint en Excel). Begrip van projekbestuur en die evaluering van projekte. Begrip van kommunikasieprosesse met gemeenskappe, interne personeel en eksterne vennote. Vermoë om verslae op te stel, notules te neem, gemeenskapterugvoer vas te lê en administratiewe pligte akkuraat uit te voer.
af.duties: Implementeer die Western Cape Health Facility Boards and Committees Act ("die Wet") deur effektiewe bestuursstrukture te beplan, te koördineer en te ondersteun. Koördineer kapasiteitsbouprogramme deur opleidingsinisiatiewe vir tersaaklike gemeenskaps- en fasiliteitsrolspelers te organiseer, te implementeer en te monitor. Verteenwoordig en bevorder Sub-Structure Office-gesondheidsdienste binne tersaaklike gesondheidsgeoriënteerde gemeenskapsorganisasies. Fasiliteer en ondersteun belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvergaderings, forums en gemeenskapsdialoë en -vergaderings. Identifiseer gemeenskapsbehoeftes, kwessies en diensleweringuitdagings en rapporteer dit aan bestuur. Stel verslae, notules, opsommings van gemeenskapterugvoer en bywoningsregister op, en verskaf tegniese en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Violence Prevention Unit en ander komponente soos vereis.

zu.title: I-Community Liaison Officer
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Community Liaison Officer ehhoteli i-Northern/Tygerberg Sub-structure Office ukuhlanganisa izakhiwo zokubuswa kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha amandla ze-Western Cape Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanele noma iziqu ezinga elinganayo. Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele kokubandakanywa komphakathi, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuqashwa kwabaphathi. Izidingo ezingokwemisebenzi ngokwalo: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esemthethweni. Ukuzithoba nokuba nokusheshwaokuhamba ngenxa yemisebenzi esemthethweni. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngemithetho kanye nemithetho elawulayo ehlobene nokubuswa, kanye nezimiso zokukhuthaza impilo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngemithetho ehlobene nezempilo ehlobene nesigungu sezempilo sesifunda, amabhodi ezibhedlela kanye namakomidi wezikliniki. Amandla okuhlanganisa, okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqeqesha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (Ms Word, PowerPoint kanye ne-Excel). Ukuqonda ukuqashwa kanye nokuhlola amaphulo. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuxhumana namaphakathi, abasebenzi bangaphakathi, kanye nabahlanganyeli bangaphandle. Amandla okuhlela imibiko, okuthatha amaminithi, okuqamba impendulo yomphakathi, kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqashwa ngokunembile.
zu.duties: Qalasela i-Western Cape Health Facility Boards and Committees Act (“i-Act”) ngokuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, kanye nokusekela izakhiwo zokubuswa eziyisisekelo. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha amandla ngokuhlela, ukuqalisa, kanye nokubheka izinhlela zokuqeqesha abadlali ababalulekile bethimba kanye nesikhungo. Mele futhi ukhuthaze izinsiza zezempilo ze-Sub-Structure Office ngaphakathi kwezinhlangano zomphakathi eziholiswa ngempilo. Sikisela futhi useke izinkulumo ezibandakanya abaningi abaphathekayo, amaphora, kanye nezingxoxano zomphakathi kanye nezinkulumo. Bula izidingo zomphakathi, izinkathazo, kanye nobunzima bokuletha izinsiza bese ukuzibika kubaphathi. Hlela imibiko, amaminithi, izifinyezo zempendulo yomphakathi, kanye namafomu okubhalisa, futhi unikeze inkuxo yobuchwepheshe nokuqashwa kwe-Violence Prevention Unit nakwezinye izingxenye njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Iofisa Wokuqhubana Nomphakathi
xh.summary: Kufuneka Iofisa Wokuqhubana Nomphakathi kwiNqanaba leSebe elingaphantsi leNorthern/Tygerberg ukuze alungiselele iinkqubo zolawulo namaxesha okwakha amandla kwisebe leWestern Cape Department of Health.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sezinga elincinci: Isidanga seSizwe esifanelekileyo (NQF 6) okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo ekubonisweni nomphakathi, ekunxibelelaneni, nakuqhubanisweni kwabathintekayo. Iimfuno eziphathelekayo nensebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela nokuze ukwazi ukuhamba ngenjongo yomsebenzi osemthethweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngemithetho nemigaqo enxulumene nolawulo, nemiqathango yokukhuthaza impilo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngemigaqo enxulumene nempilo ngokumalunga neBhunga lempilo lasemmandini, amabhowikki wezigqibo, namakomiti ezikliniki. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokuqhuba, ukuxazulula iingxaki, nokuzigqatsa. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (Ms Word, PowerPoint, noExcel). Ukuqonda uLawulo loMsebenzi woMvuzo wabaphangeli woMnyama no zimvo ngemisebenzi yoLuntu. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokunxibelelana nomphakathi, abasebenzi bangaphakathi, nababambisana nabo bangaphandle. Ukuba nakho ukubhala iingxelo, ukuthabatha imizuzu yokubhaliweyo, ukubamba ulwazi oluvela komphakathi, nokuwenza imisebenzi yolawulo ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusebenze umthetho weWestern Cape Health Facility Boards and Committees Act (“uMthetho”) ngokucwangcisa, ukuqhuba, nokuinxaxa iinkqubo zolawulo ezisebenzayo. Ukuqhuba iinkqubo zokwakha amandla ngokuqamba, ukusebenzisa, nokulola iinkqubo zokuzigqatsa kubathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo bomphakathi nabezikhulu. Ukumela nokuqhutywa amacebo ezenza iinkonzo zempilo eNqanabeni leSebe lingaphantsi ngaphakathi kwezinhlangano ezihamba ngokwempilo komphakathi. Ukuqhubeza nokuqhuba iindibano zonxibelelwano nabathintekayo, iindawo zokuxoxa, neendibano zomphakathi. Ukubona iimfuno zomphakathi, iingxaki, neengxaki ezikwinkonzo yabaphakathi neze kundulule ezingxelo ekuqoqosho. Ukubhala iingxelo, imizuzu yokubhalweyo, iingxelo zemibono yomphakathi, namagama abakhoyo, ukunika inkxaso yobuchwephheshe nolawulo kuNyiko loThintelo lweNkohlakalo nakwezinye iindawo njengoko kufuneka.

Report writing skills.
