af.title: EMS Skiftleier Vlak 3 tot 6 (PLASELIK)
af.summary: EMS Skiftleierposte (Vlak 3 tot 6) in Western Cape landelike distrikte, wat voor-hospitaal noodmediese sorg verskaf en toegis hou oor noodvoertuie en toerusting.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Vlak 3: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Intermediate Life Support (ILS) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA) moontlik maak. Vlak 4: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Emergency Care Technician (ECT) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Emergency Care Technician (ECT) moontlik maak. Vlak 5: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant kursus (CCA) of Nasionale Diploma wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Paramedic moontlik maak. Vlak 6: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die B-Tech graad wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Vlak 3: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n AEA. Vlak 4: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n ECT. Vlak 5: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Paramedic. Vlak 6: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n ECP. Ervaring: Vlak 3: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring binne u huidige registrasiekategorie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Vlak 4: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring binne u huidige registrasiekategorie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Vlak 5: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring binne u huidige registrasiekategorie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Paramedic (CCA of N.DIP). Vlak 6: Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring binne u huidige registrasiekategorie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Inherente vereistes van die pos: Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n AEA, ECT, Paramedic of ECP. Geldige C1-kode bestuurslisensie. Huidige professionele bestuurderstoelatingspermit. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende kennis van alle vlakke van Emergency Care protokolle. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in die MS Office-pakket. Vaardigheid in verslagskrywing.
af.duties: Doeltreffende voor-hospitaal Noodmediese Sorg en reaksie op voorvalle wanneer vereis. Verseker doeltreffende toesig en instandhouding van Noodvoertuie en toerusting in ooreenstemming met die Finansiële en Vlootriglyne. Verseker doeltreffende verslagskrywing met betrekking tot ongeluks- en voorvalverslae, verlies- en diefstalbeheervoorvalle en veiligheidsvoorvalle. Verseker doeltreffende kommunikasie met betrekking tot pasiënte, kollegas, ander dienste en lede van die publiek. Toesig hou oor en bestuur van roosterskofte en personeel in ooreenstemming met Menslike Bestuursbeleid en -praktyke. Verskaf doeltreffende administratiewe ondersteuning aan die toesighouer wanneer vereis.

zu.title: UMHOLA Weshifthi we-EMS Izinga 3 kuya ku-6 (ASEMAPHAKATHINI)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomhola weshifthi we-EMS (Izinga 3 kuya ku-6) kumakhoni amaphakathi ase-Western Cape, ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesikhashana kwezokwelapha ngaphambi kokufika esibhedlela kanye nokuphatha izimoto nezinto zokusebenza ezenza umsebenzi wezezimo eziphuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokungemfundo okuncane: Izinga 3: Ukuphela ngempumelelo kwe-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) okuvumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Izinga 4: Ukuphela ngempumelelo kwe-Emergency Care Technician (ECT) okuvumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njenge-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Izinga 5: Ukuphela ngempumelelo kwaleso sifundo se-Critical Care Assistant course (CCA) noma i-National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njenge-Paramedic. Izinga 6: Ukuphela ngempumelelo kwe-B-Tech Degree evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njenge-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Ukubhalisa kubuhlakani obungumthetho: Izinga 3: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-AEA. Izinga 4: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-ECT. Izinga 5: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Paramedic. Izinga 6: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-ECP. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 3: Okungenani unyaka lengu-3 wesipiliyoni ngaphakathi kwekharidi yakho yokubhalisa njengamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Izinga 4: Okungenani unyaka lengu-3 wesipiliyoni ngaphakathi kwekharidi yakho yokubhalisa njengamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Izinga 5: Okungenani unyaka lengu-3 wesipiliyoni ikharidi yakho yokubhalisa njengamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Paramedic (CCA noma N.DIP). Izinga 6: Okungenani unyaka lengu-3 wesipiliyoni ikharidi yakho yokubhalisa njengamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njenge-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukubhalisa njengamanje ku-HPCSA njenge-AEA, ECT, Paramedic noma ECP. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yomshayeli we-code C1. I-permit yomshayeli oyingcweti njengamanje. Izikhono (ulwazi/amacashi): Ulwazi oluhle lwawo wonke amazinga emihakanyo ye-Emergency Care protocols. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye namakhono okusebenza nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumsoftwe le-MS Office package. Amakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa okusemphumeleni kwesikhashana kwe-Emergency Medical Care kanye nokusabela ezimeni uma kuthiwa kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusemphumeleni kanye nolondolozo lwezimoto ze-Emergency Vehicles nezinto zokusebenza ngokuhambisana neziyalezo ze-Financial and Fleet directives. Qinisekisa ukubhala okusemphumeleni imibiko ngokuphathelene nemibiko yezehlakalo nezikhathi ezingozi, ukulawulwa kokulahlekelwa nokwebiwa kanye nemiyoni ezinkathazweni zezokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana okusemphumeleni ngokuphathelene nabagulayo, abasebenzi nabo, izinyonzi ezinye, kanye namalungu e-Public. Phatha futhi ulawule izikhathi ezahlelwe zokushayela kanye nabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nemigomo kanye namasiko e-People Management policies and practices. Nikeza usekelo olusemphumeleni oluphathelene nemibhalo yesikhungo kumphathi uma kuthiwa kudingeka.

xh.title: UMqhankqatho we-Shift we-EMS Inqanaba 3 ukuya ku-6 (RURAL)
xh.summary: Izikhundla zabo Baqhankqathi be-Shift be-EMS (Inqanaba 3 ukuya ku-6) kumaphondo ase Western Cape amaphakathi, kunika unyango lwezifo ezingozini ngaphambi kokufika esibhedlele nokuqondisa iimoto zengozi neq twins.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowona mgangatho ongaphantsi: Grade 3: Ukugqiba ngempumeleko kwi-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) ekuvumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoba i-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Ukugqiba ngempumeleko kwi-Emergency Care Technician (ECT) ekuvumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoba i-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Ukugqiba ngempumeleko kwesiKholeji se-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) okanye i-National Diploma ekuvumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ukugqiba ngempumeleko kwi-Digri ye-B-Tech ekuvumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Ukubhalisa kwiNkundla yamagunya eshishini: Grade 3: Ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpi lo Zempilo eMzantsi Afrika njengoba ngu-AEA. Grade 4: Ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpi lo Zempilo eMzantsi Afrika njengoba ngu-ECT. Grade 5: Ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpi lo Zempilo eMzantsi Afrika njengoba ngu-Paramedic. Grade 6: Ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpi lo Zempilo eMzantsi Afrika njengoba ngu-ECP. Ukungqongqoza: Grade 3: Uhlu lokugqibela emva kweminyaka engama-3 wobuchule obuhleliyo ngexesha lokubhaliswa kwakho ne-HPCSA njengoba i-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 4: Uhlu lokugqibela emva kweminyaka engama-3 wobuchule obuhleliyo ngexesha lokubhaliswa kwakho ne-HPCSA njengoba i-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Grade 5: Uhlu lokugqibela emva kweminyaka engama-3 wobuchule obuhleliyo ngexesha lokubhaliswa kwakho ne-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Paramedic (CCA or N.DIP). Grade 6: Uhlu lokugqibela emva kweminyaka engama-3 wobuchule obuhleliyo ngexesha lokubhaliswa kwakho ne-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ukubhaliswa okuhleliyo kwi-HPCSA njengoba ngu-AEA, ECT, Paramedic okanye i-ECP. Ilayisensi yokushayela ekhoyo ye-code C1. Ithumente ekhoyo yomqambi-magazini onegunya. Ukuzinza (ulwazi/amasimi): Ulwazi olugqithisileyo ngeNkqubo yoNyango lweNgOzi kuwo onke amanqanaba. Amakhono amde wokuNxibelelana nabantu nokubakho kubo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwinkqubo ye-MS Office. Amakhono okubhala iirepothi.
xh.duties: UNyango olusebenzayo lweNgOzi yeziZe ezingaphandle kwesibhedlele nokuPhendula kumanxwemenge xa kufunekayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lokwakha nokugcina iimoto ezingozi neq twins ngokuNhambisana neelaNkqubo zeMal ne-Fleet. Qinisekisa ukubhala iirepothi ezisebenzayo ngeendaba ezimalunga neengozI, iingxweme ze-accident nentshibhelo, ukulawulwa kweentshiba nokwetywa kwempahla i-incident yokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo ngeendaba ezimalunga neziguli, abasebenzi nabo, izinkonzo ezingeyona, namalungu esiZwe. Lawula nokuPhehlela iziShIft nendlela yokumisela abantu ngokuhambisana neNkqubo yokuLawula abantu nendlela yokuziphatha. Nikezela inkxaso eDministrative ethile kuLawuli xa kufunekayo.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Finance/admin (REVENUE)
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer in Finance and Revenue at Tygerberg Hospital, overseeing hospital fees, financial transactions, and debt management processes.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accountancy as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KRA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in a Debt and Revenue Management/Hospital accounting environment. Appropriate experience in BAS, AR, Clinicom and supervisory exposure. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to rotate within Revenue Section and relieve colleagues. Willingness to work overtime when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to plan, organize and prioritize responsibilities. Ability to work under pressure, independently and meet time-frames. Good management skills with analytical abilities. Good interpersonal and labour relations abilities. Knowledge of Hospital Fees Memorandum Chapter 18, UPFS, BAS, HIS, Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR) System, JAC and Finance instructions. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Strong sense of confidentiality and trustworthiness. Knowledge of PFMA, Treasury and Finance Instructions.
jobs.duties: Supervise and coordinate the operational duties of the Hospital Fees Department (all categories). Monitor and oversee financial transactions relating to HIS, BAS, Cash Management, Credit Balances, and JAC. Supervise and coordinate Patient Fees Debt Management processes, including Irrecoverable Debt Relief Delegations. Oversee and monitor Patient Fees Revenue Management functions (EDI, follow-up of medical aid and non-medical aid invoices, RAF, Foreign Patients, Research Patients, IOD, and State Departments) in accordance with the Hospital Fees Manual Chapter 18 and relevant Finance Instructions. -Supervise human resource administration, performance management, and labour relations matters within the section. Facilitate client liaison and information management, including the interpretation, communication, and implementation of Finance Instructions. Oversee file management and the disposal/destruction of State records in accordance with applicable policies. Attend and participate in relevant meetings and forums.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Finansies/admin (INKOMSTE)
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte in Finansies en Inkomste by Tygerberg Hospital, wat toesig hou oor hospitaalfooi, finansiële transaksies en skuldbestuursprosesse.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekenkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Sleutelprestasie-areas (KRA's) van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Skuld- en Inkomste-bestuurs-/hospitaalrekenkundige omgewing. Toepaslike ervaring in BAS, AR, Clinicom en toesigervaring. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om binne die Inkomste-afdeling te roteer en kollegas te ontlast. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer dit vereis word. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Vermoë om verantwoordelikhede te beplan, te organiseer en te prioriteer. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, onafhanklik te wees en tydraamwerke na te kom. Goeie bestuursvaardighede met analitiese vermoëns. Goeie interpersoonlike en arbeidsverhoudingsvermoëns. Kennis van Hospital Fees Memorandum Chapter 18, UPFS, BAS, HIS, Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR) System, JAC en Finansies-instruksies. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office). Sterk sin vir vertroulikheid en betroubaarheid. Kennis van PFMA, Treasury en Finance Instructions.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en koördineer die operasionele pligte van die Hospitaalfooi-departement (alle kategorieë). Monitor en hou toesig oor finansiële transaksies rakende HIS, BAS, Cash Management, Credit Balances en JAC. Hou toesig oor en koördineer Pasientfooi-skuldbestuursprosesse, insluitend Irrecoverable Debt Relief Delegations. Hou toesig oor en monitor Pasientfooi-inkomste-bestuursfunksies (EDI, opvolg van mediese hulp- en nie-mediese hulp-fakture, RAF, Foreign Patients, Research Patients, IOD en State Departments) in ooreenstemming met die Hospital Fees Manual Chapter 18 en tersaaklike Finance Instructions. -Hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronadministrasie, prestasiebestuur en arbeidsverhoudingsake binne die afdeling. Fasiliteer kliëntskakeling en inligtingsbestuur, insluitend die interpretasie, kommunikasie en implementering van Finance Instructions. Hou toesig oor lêerbestuur en die beskikkingstelling/vernietiging van Staatsrekords in ooreenstemming met toepaslike beleide. Woon en neem deel aan tersaaklike vergaderings en forums.

zu.title: I-ofisa Ophethe Izindaba Zokuphatha: Izimali/ukuphatha (INGENISO)
zu.summary: I-ofisa Ophethe Izindaba Zokuphatha kwabango lezezimali nengeniso esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital, ebusa ngeemali zesibhedlela, izinkomba ezimalini, kanye nokuqondanisa izindlela zokuphatha amanikinamo.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphansi kwesidingo: Senior Certificate (noma esilinganayo) ene-Mathematics futhi/noma i-Accountancy njengesisindo esidlulile kanye/noma Senior Certificate (noma esilinganayo) enamava/amakhono agxila kumagunya okusebenza okuwumongo (KRA's) wesikhundla. Amava: Amafanele endaweni yokuphatha amanikinamo nengeniso/kubuqwanga kwezimali zesibhedlela. Amava afanele kuma-BAS, AR, Clinicom kanye nokubonakala ekubuseni. Isidingo esikusizi kulesi sebazi: Ukuzithoba ukujikeleza ngaphakathi kwindima yengeniso kanye nokusiza abasebenzi. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi lapho kudingeka khona. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhalwayo nokuqhutshwa). Isikhono sokuhlela, ukuhlela kanye nokubeka ngaphambili izibopho. Isikhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ngokuzimela nokuhlanganisa izikhathi. Amakhono okuphatha amahle anamandla okuhlaziya. Amakhono amahle wabantu nokuba nobudlelwano nomsebenzi. Ulwazi lwe-Hospital Fees Memorandum Chapter 18, UPFS, BAS, HIS, Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR) System, JAC kanye neziyalezo zezezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Indima enkulu yegciniko lokwazula nokwethembeka. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, Treasury kanye neziyalezo zezezimali.
zu.duties: Qapha kanye nokuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokusebenza yomnyango we-Hospital Fees (azo zingaba ziwonke). Qapha kanye nokubusa izinkamba zamanye amazwe ezihlobene ne-HIS, BAS, Cash Management, Credit Balances, kanye ne-JAC. Qapha kanye nokuhlanganisa izindlela zokuphatha amanikinamo e-Patient Fees, okubandakanya Irrecoverable Debt Relief Delegations. Buka kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi yengeniso yamafu e-Patient Fees (EDI, ukulandelwa kwamabhili atholwe kusizo lonyaka kanye namabhili angatholakali ngosizo lonyaka, RAF, Foreign Patients, Research Patients, IOD, kanye namanyango) ngokuvumelana ne-Hospital Fees Manual Chapter 18 kanye neziyalezo ezihlobene nezezimali. -Qapha ukuphathwa kwabantu abayisekeli, ukuphatha ukusebenza, kanye nezindaba zokuba nobudlelwano nomsebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo. Siza abathintekayo ekuxhumaneni kanye nokuphatha ulwazi, okubandakanya ukutolikwa, ukuthumela, kanye nokusebenzisa iziyalezo zezezimali. Buka ukuphatha amafayela kanye nokulahla/ukubhujiswa kwemibhalo kabuso yezwe ngokuvumelana nezinqumo ezisebenzayo. Zibandakanye futhi uthathe inxaxheba emihlanganweni nasezindaweni eziyinhloko ezihlobene.

xh.title: Isikhulu Sezolawulo: Ngenxa yemali/ulawulo (INGENISO)
xh.summary: Isikhulu Sezolawulo kwiNgeniso kwaye kwimali ezingenisa kwiTygerberg Hospital, silawula imali ezahlawulwa esibhedlele, iintengiso zemali, kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lwetyala.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esincinci: Isatifikate Esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) enze kubeye afunde izibalo kwaye/okuba ebalulekile njengesihloko asipassayo kwaye/okuba iSatifikate Esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) emva kokuba nomva oqinisekisa kwaye oqwalasela iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokusetyenziswa okuPhambili (KRA’s) kulo sithuba. Isipholo: Isipholo esifanelekileyo kwimeko yetyala nengeniso yolawulo/nokubala kwesibhedlele. Isipholo esifanelekileyo kwiBAS, AR, Clinicom nakwimeko yokulawula abanye. Isimfuno esibalulekileyo kwalo msebenzi: Kulungelelwanisa ukujikeleza kwicandela leNgeniso nasesinye isithuba sokuncedisa abanye abasebenzi. Kulungelelwanisa ukusebenza ngaphezu kweyure xa kufuneka. Ukuzilolonga (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono alexibha elilungileyo (elibhalwayo nelithethwayo). Ukuba nakho ukucwangcisa, ukuhlela nokubeka phambili iimbophelelo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngocinezelo, uzime ngokwakho nangokuzimisela ukugqiba ngexesha. Amakhono olawulo amalungileyo anamandla okuhlola. Amakhono athembisa kubantu abanye nolawulo lwabasebenzi alungileyo. Ulwazi ngesiSixaxa soku-18 seSixaxa semali yaseTygerberg, i-UPFS, BAS, HIS, Clinicom, iNkqubo yeBhuku le-Accounts (AR), i-JAC nokuqwalasela imiyalelo yemali. Ukuzikwazi ukusebenza ngokwesikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Unemvakalelo enkulu yokugcina imfihlelo nokuba nesithembiso esiqinileyo. Ulwazi ngePFMA, uLawulo lweNgxowa-mali nokuqwalasela imiyalelo yemali.
xh.duties: Ukuba namandla okulawula ukusebenza ngokwexesha lemisebenzi yoqhube kwisebe lemali ezahlawulwa esibhedlele (azo zonke iindidi). Ukugcina ngeliso nokuqwalasela iintengiso zemali ezinxulumene neHIS, BAS, ukulawula imali, iibalansi ezikwi-credit, kunye neJAC. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zolawulo lwetyala lemfutshane yamalini asetyenziswa esibhedlele, kuquka neNkxaso yotyala ongenakubuyiswa. Ukugcina ngeliso nokulawula imisebenzi yolawulo lwemali engeniswa kwindawo yamalini esetyenziswa esibhedlele (EDI, ukulandelela i-invoisi zemali yosizo lonyango ezingenayo nazo ezingayo, iRAF, amalini abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe, amalini abantu abafunda ngokucwaninga, i-IOD, kunye namasebe karhulumente) ngokwesiSixaxa soku-18 seSixaxa semali yaseTygerberg nakweminye imiyalelo yemali ethize. -Ukulawula ulawulo lwezolimo lwabasebenzi, ukulawula ukusebenza, kunye nezommandla zabasebenzi kwicala. Ukukhuthaza uqhagamshelo namalini nabathengi nakulawulo lwexabiso, kuquka nokutolika, ukuyidlanga, nokusebenzisa imiyalelo yemali. Ukugcina ngeliso ulawulo lwamaxwebhu nokuqhuba nokutshatyalalisa ixwebhu karhulumente ngokomthetho osebenzayo. Ukuya nokuqhula imiganu ekwindawo zokubaluleka kwaye kumashumi amakhulu.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Supply Chain Management
jobs.centre: Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital, Rondebosch
jobs.summary: Administrative officer needed at Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital to manage procurement processes from demand to delivery using Logis and ePS systems.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics or Accounting as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KPA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in Supply Chain Management (Procurement). Appropriate experience in the Procurement Process. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate knowledge of and practical experience in Logis and the Integrated Procurement Solutions (ePS). Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy in MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook. Good organizational skills. Be able to manage a team of Procurement Clerks. Knowledge and experience of the Procurement process. Knowledge of Asset and Inventory (warehouse) Management procedures. Knowledge of PFMA, Finance instructions, Provincial and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA). Ability to apply the Disciplinary code. Knowledge of Accounting officer system and maintenance services 16B.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the Procurement process for Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital from demand to delivery, inclusive of non-performance management administrative duties. Effective and efficient management of the Procurement on Logis and Electronic Procurement Solutions (ePS) environment. Perform the duties as an Approver on ePS. Ensure the effective application of procurement policy processes including management of acquisition, contract and demand management. Coordinate and advise on the process of drafting specifications. Authorize transaction on LOGIS. Reporting on internal and external stakeholders (IFS, AFS and other). Accurate and timeous reporting of information related to medical consumables and all the other items that are used in the Hospital environment to internal and external stakeholders. Effective procurement of all institutional assets, consumables, medical items, major and minor and ensuring budgets are spent. Liaise with end users, service providers and other departments regarding Supply Chain matters. Effective management of Institution’s Infrastructure procurement. Ability to work overtime as and when required. Developing and training staff in Supply Chain Management. Perform supervisory functions by advising training and development of own staff.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte benodig by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital om verkrygingsprosesse vanaf aanvraag tot aflewering te bestuur deur gebruik van Logis- en ePS-stelsels.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat fokus op die Kernprestasie-areas (KPA's) van die pos. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur (Verkryging). Toepaslike ervaring in die Verkrygingsproses. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kennis van en praktiese ervaring in Logis en die Integrated Procurement Solutions (ePS). Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook. Goeie organisasievaardighede. In staat wees om 'n span Verkrygingsklerke te bestuur. Kennis en ervaring van die Verkrygingsproses. Kennis van Bate- en Voorraad-(pakhuise)bestuursprosedures. Kennis van PFMA, Finansiële instruksies, Provinsiale en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA). Vermoë om die disiplinêre kode toe te pas. Kennis van die rekenaarbeamptestelsel en instandhoudingsdienste 16B.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die Verkrygingsproses vir Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital vanaf aanvraag tot aflewering, insluitend nie-prestasiebestuursadministratiewe pligte. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van die Verkryging in die Logis- en Electronic Procurement Solutions (ePS)-omgewing. Verrig die pligte as 'n Goedkeurder op ePS. Verseker die effektiewe toepassing van verkrygingsbeleidprosesse insluitend bestuur van verkryging, kontrak en aanvraagbestuur. Koördineer en gee advies oor die proses van die opstel van spesifikasies. Magtig transaksies op LOGIS. Verslagdoening aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes (IFS, AFS en andere. Akkurate en tydige verslagdoening van inligting wat verband hou met mediese verbruiksgoedere en alle ander items wat in die Hospitaalomgewing gebruik word aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Effektiewe verkryging van alle institusionele bates, verbruiksgoedere, mediese items, hoof en klein, en verseker dat begrotings bestee word. Skakel met eindgebruikers, diensverskaffers en ander departemente rakende Voorsieningskettingaangeleenthede. Effektiewe bestuur van die Instituut se infrastruktuurverkryging. Vermoë om oortyd te werk soos wanneer nodig. Ontwikkeling en opleiding van personeel in Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Verrig toesighoudende funksies deur advies te gee oor opleiding en ontwikkeling van eie personeel.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokuphatha: Ukulawula Inqubomgomo Yomthengiso
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkinobhe yokuphatha esibhedlela i-Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukulawula inqubo yokuthenga kusuka ekufunweni kuye kokuhlinzwa kusetshenziswa amasistemu e-Logis nase-ePS.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemininingwane zemfundo: Isitifiketi se-Senior (noma okulingana naso) se-Mathematics noma i-Accounting njengesifundo esidlulile futhi/noma Isitifiketi se-Senior (noma okulingana naso) senza/obukhono obugxila kumaphu e-Key Performance Areas (KPA’s) yesikhundla. Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele ekulawuleni Inqubomgomo Yomthengiso (Ukuthenga). Isiphephelo esifanele ku-Inqubo Yokuthenga. Obukhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olufanele nolwemisebenzi yezandla kuma-Logis nase-Integrated Procurement Solutions (ePS). Amakhono mahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kuma-MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook. Amakhono mahle okuhlelela. Ukuba nakho ukulawula iqembu labaklipha bokuthenga. Ulwazi noluphephelo lo-Inqubo Yokuthenga. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yolawulwa kwamafa namathuluzi (emsangweni). Ulwazi nge-PFMA, imiyalo yezimali, kanye nemithetho ye-Provincial kanye ne-Treasury. Ulwazi nge-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhodi yokuYesiyabanga. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-Accounting officer kanye namasevisi okulondolozwa 16B.
zu.duties: Qondisa inqubo Yokuthenga esibhedlela i-Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital kusuka ekufunweni kuye kokuhlinzwa, okuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yokuphatha engenayo enza. Ukulawula ngempumelelo nangokushesha Ukuthenga kwesistimu ye-Logis nendawo ye-Electronic Procurement Solutions (ePS). Wenze imisebenzi njengoba-Approver kwi-ePS. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwezinqubo zengqikithi zokuthenga okuhlanganisa nokuphatha ukutholwa, konke nokuqashwa kanye nokuphatha ekuqweni. Hlela futhi unikeze izeluleko ngohlelo lokubhala izinhlaka. Vumela ukuhweba kwi-LOGIS. Ukubika kubambeleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle (IFS, AFS kanye nabanye). Ukuhlola kahle nangesikhathi ukubika kolwazi oluhlobene nezinto zokwelapha ezisetshenziswa kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa emzileni wesibhedlela kubambeleli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuthenga ngempumelela wonke amafa, izinto ezisetshenziswa, izinto zokwelapha, ezinkulu nancane kanye futhi neqinisekisa ukuthi imali yesabelo ijwayele ukuchithwa. Xhumana nabalawuli-aphethe, abahlinzayo namanye eminye iminyango ngemayelana nezindaba Zokulawula Inqubomgomo Yomthengiso. Ukuphatha ngempumelela ukuthengiswa kwezinsiza zesikhungo. Ukuba nakuwo ukusebenza ngecala ngemuva kwezikhathi njengoba kudingeka. Ukuthuthukisa nokhoqaba abasebenzi ekulawuleni Inqubomgomo Yomthengiso. Wenze imisebenzi yasesiyingini ngokunika izeluleko ukuthuthukisa nokukhoqaba izakhamuzi zakini.

xh.title: Umphathi wezabasebenzi: Ulawulo lweNqanaba leMbalela
xh.summary: Kufuneka igosa lezabasebenzi kwi Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital eliza kulawula iinkqubo zokuthenga ukusela kumfuno kude kube kukuhlinzwa kusebenzisa iinkqubo ze Logis ne ePS.
xh.requirements: Iindlela ezifanelekileyo zemfundo: Senior Certificate (okanye ezingqwalaselo ezingangenwa) ngesebe le Mathematics okanye i-Accounting njengesifundo esidlulileyo kwaye/okanye Senior Certificate (okanye ezingqwalaselo ezingangenwa) noluhlu lwamava/ukuziphilisa olugqithiselwa kummandla wokusebenza ophawulekileyo (i-KPA) wesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kuLawulo lweNqanaba leMbalela (UkuThenga). Amava afanelekileyo eNkqubweni yoKuthenga. Iinkqobo zamava (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olufanelekileyo noluhlu lwamava lokusebenza ku Logis nakwi Integrated Procurement Solutions (ePS). Izakhono ezimble ukuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kwi MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook. Izakhono ezimble zoluntu. Ukuba nakho ukulawula iqela labaCacelo boKuthenga. Ulwazi noluhlu lwamava benkqubo yoKuthenga. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoLawulo lweSehlulo nezinto ezigcinwa (kwindlu yokugcina). Ulwazi lwe PFMA, imiyalelo yeeMali, nemigaqo ye Provincial ne Treasury. Ulwazi lwe Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA). Isakhono sokusebenzisa ikhowudi yoGxalwa. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yegoqa le-akhawundi nesevisi yokugcina izinto 16B.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambili inkqubo yoKuthenga ye Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukusela kumfuno kude kube kukuhlinzwa, kuquka imisebenzi yolawulo yabasebenzi abangenazo ngokwaneleyo iziphumo. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nokulunga kwexesha lokuThenga kulawulo lwe Logis ne Electronic Procurement Solutions (ePS). Wenze imisebenzi njengesigunyaziswa kwi ePS. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa ngokusebenzayo iinkqubo zeendlela zolawulo lokuthenga kuquka ulawulo lolufundo, olweentengiso nolwemfuno. Lumathanise kwaye useke inkqubo yokubhala iinkcazelo. Gunyazisa urhwebo kwi LOGIS. Ukuchaza ngabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle (i-IFS, i-AFS nakwabanye). Ukuchaza ulwazi kakuhle nangexesha elifanelekileyo malunga nezinto zonyango ezisetyenziswa kunye nazo zonke ezinye izinto ezisetyenziswa kwiziko leRed Cross kubathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle. UkuThenga ngokusebenzayo onke amaxhobo esikhungo, izinto ezisetyenziswa, izinto zonyango, ezinkulu nancinci kwaye uqinisekisa ukuba umgangatho usetyenziswe. Thethathu nabasebenzisi ekupheleni, abanikezeli bendlela namanye amasebe malunga nemiba yoLawulo lweNqanaba leMbalela. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lokuThenga kweziKhephu zesikhungo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphaya kweyure nangaliphi na ixesha elifunekayo. Ukuphuhlisa nokuzimasa abasebenzi kuLawulo lweNqanaba leMbalela. Wenza imisebenzi yolawulo ngokusika abasebenzi bakho isiko lokuzimasa nokuphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Wellness Coordinator
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer: Wellness Coordinator at Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, requiring a National Diploma and employee wellness experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate experience in an Employee Wellness space. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Need to have insight into the epistemology of wellness. Report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Conduct monitoring and evaluation and compile regular reports. Ensure contract administration related to employee health and wellness projects and programmes implementation. Administer and implement projects and programmes that promote employee health and wellness. Provide input into policy development and facilitate the implementation of strategy / policies.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe beampte: Welstandskoördineerder
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte: Welstandskoördineerder by Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma en ervaring in werknemerwelstand vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n werknemerwelstandsomgewing. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Moet insig hê in die epistemologie van welstand. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer monitering en evaluering uit en stel gereelde verslae op. Verseker kontrakadministrasie verbonde aan die implementering van projekte en programme vir werknemergesondheid en -welstand. Administreer en implementeer projekte en programme wat werknemergesondheid en -welstand bevorder. Lewer insette tot beleidsontwikkeling en fasiliteer die implementering van strategie / beleide.

zu.title: Inhloli Yeziphathimandla: Umcoordinator We-Wellness
zu.summary: Inhloli Yeziphathimandla: Umcoordinator We-Wellness eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, edinga i-National Diploma nemfundo yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ebanzi: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekile noma okulinganayo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanelekile endaweni yokuphathwa kwezempilo zabasebenzi. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasheya): Kudingeka abe nokuqonda mayelana nesazi sezimfundo ngokuphathwa kwempilo. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uhlolise bese uhlanganisa imibiko evamile. Qinisekisa uphatho lwezinkontileka ehlotshaneni nezinhlelo zezempilo nabasebenzi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezikuthuthukiseni izempilo nabasebenzi. Nikeza umbhalo ekuthuthukisweni kwemithetho futhi wenze kube lula ukusebenzisa izindlela / imithetho.

xh.title: Isikhululi sikaMlawuli: Njengenekaladi yeZenzo loMzimba
xh.summary: Isikhululi sikaMlawuli: Njengenekaladi yeZenzo loMzimba eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, sifuna i-National Diploma namava okuqondene nezenzo zabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwamaxa: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okulingana nayo. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kwizinto ezichwayo ukwenza izenzo zabasebenzi. Iimpawu zokwazi/ukwazi ukusebenza: Kufuneka kubekho ukuqonda ngemvelaphi yolwazi ngaleyo ndlela ekunikezelwa kuyo ukwazi ngokwakheka kwezenzo zemihla ngemihla. Amandla okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Qeqesha ulwazi lokuyila nokuqwalasela ukuze uhlole izinto azisebenzayo udwe lwezenzo uze uhlombe iingxelo ezizizo ngezixa ezithileyo. Qinisekisa ukwenza konke okubhalwe ngokwesiCinga ngokwemiGaqo yeNgqalile, oko kukuthi imigaqo equlunthe ngamagama afunyaniswe kumaxwebhu ethileyo ngokwemigaqo yaseNdingcatshatsheni kaRhulumente ekwelinye. Lawula uphumelele ekubuyiselweni koluntu nokubakho Izenzo ezikwalisa iinkqubo ezikhusela abantu abanomoya ongazange ugcine okomzimba.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Administrative officer needed at Groote Schuur Hospital to manage recruitment and selection functions, oversee contracts, handle grievances, and supervise subordinates.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in Human Resource Management: Recruitment and Selection. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent verbal and written communication. Ability to work in a team. Computer skills. Extensive knowledge of HR Policies, procedures, practises relevant to Recruitment and Selection.
jobs.duties: Render a recruitment and selection function. Ensure paid and unpaid employment contract are accurately and timeously issued. Assist with grievances/disputes linked to recruitment and selection. Compile database on status of advertised posts. Supervise and develop subordinates.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a competency test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Amptenaar: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe amptenaar benodig by Groote Schuur Hospital om werwings- en keuringsfunksies te bestuur, kontrakte te hou, griewe te hanteer en ondergeskiktes te toesien.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur: Werwing en Keuring. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Rekenaarvaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van HR-beleide, prosedures, praktyke relevant tot Werwing en Keuring.
af.duties: Lewer 'n werwings- en keuringsfunksie. Verseker dat betaalde en onbetaalde dienskontrakte akkuraat en betyds uitgereik word. Bied hulp met griewe/geskille wat verband hou met werwing en keuring. Stel 'n databasis op oor die status van geadverteerde poste. Oorsien en ontwikkel ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: IOfisa Oyinhloko Wokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi: Abaphathi Bensizakusebenza Yomuntu
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-ofisa oyinhloko wokuphatha eGroote Schuur Hospital ukuphatha imisebenzi yokubiza abantu nokukhethwa kwabo, ukugcina amakontraki, ukuphatha izikhalazo, kanye nokulawula ababekelayo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Senior Certificate (noma esingulinganiso). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ePhathweni Kwensizakusebenza Yomuntu: Ukubiza Abantu Nokukhethwa Kwabo. Izindlela (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala okuhle. Isakhono sokusebenza eqenjini. Amakhono wokusebenza ngakhompyutha. Ulwazi olujulile ngeNqubomgomo Yezabasebenzi, izinqubo, nezindlela ezihlobene Nokubiza Abantu Nokukhethwa Kwabo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngumsebenzi wokubiza abantu nokukhethwa kwabo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amakontraki abasebenzi aholelwe nalawo angaholelwa akhiqizwa ngokunembile ngesikhathi. Siza ngezikhalazo/izinxatshwa ezihlobene nokubiza abantu nokukhethwa kwabo. Hlela idatha yalesimo wamaphosphu eshiwewe. Lawula futhi uthuthukise ababekelayo.

xh.title: Iofisa yeNdlela yoLawulo: uLawulo lweMisebenzi yaBantu
xh.summary: Kufuneka kwenziwe iofisa yendlela yolawulo eGroote Schuur Hospital ukulawula imisebenzi yokubakhangela abantu nokubakhetha, ukujonga iinkontraxi, ukuphatha iingxaki, nokuqondisa abanye basalwa.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezincinane: Senior Certificate (okanye ezifanayo). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kuLawulo lweMisebenzi yaBantu: Ukubakhangela abantu noKubakhetha. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaziko): Unxibelelwano oluhle olwenziwa ngomlomo nangokubhalayo. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeNqumamagama zeHR, iindlela nezithethe ezinxulumene noKubakhangela abantu noKubakhetha.
xh.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wokubakhangela abantu nokubakhetha. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkontraxi zabasebenzi ezihlawulwayo nangezingazihlawulwayo zikhutshwa ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Nceda kwiingxakingo/ingxabano ezinxulumene nokubakhangela abantu nokubakhetha. Hlanganisela idatha yemeko yamabanga abhaliswe ngaphandle. Qondisa aze aphaphise abo ngaphantsi kwakho.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Female/
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse positions at Mossel Bay Hospital requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration, offering salaries from R337,359 to R495,423 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, night duty, overtime, public holidays and weekends. Willingness to rotate to other wards in the hospital. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic Computer literacy (MS Office). Ability to function independently, as well as in a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good patient care. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (both written and verbal). Knowledge of nursing practices and Infection Prevention and Control measures.
jobs.duties: Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice or patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria, and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise human, material, and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Participate in training, development and research within the nursing department. Provision of support to nursing services.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). -It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMEEN: Vroulike/
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige posisies by Mossel Bay Hospital wat 'n verpleegingsdiploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis, met salarisse vanaf R337,359 tot R495,423 per annum.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4 jaar Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, nagskof, oortyd, openbare vakansiedae en naweke te werk. Bereidwilligheid om na ander sale in die hospitaal te roteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office). Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer, asook in 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie pasiëntsorg te verseker. Uitstekende kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Kennis van verpleegpraktyke en Infeksievoorkoming en Beheer-maatreëls.
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegingsplan (kliniese praktyk of pasiëntsorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleging en gesondheidsorg van toepassing is. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegingsdepartement. Verskaf van ondersteuning aan verpleegingsdienste.

zu.title: Uesesikeliwe Wezokwelapha Isigaba 1 kuya ku-3 (EVAMAYINHLANGANO: owesifazane/
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabaNesiwothando eMossel Bay Hospital ezifuna idiploma noma idigri yokunesa ekhethe ukubhalisa kwi-SANC, eznika amaholo asukela ku-R337,359 kuya ku-R495,423 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi: Isiqu se-Basic R425 (okuyidiploma/idigri yokunyuka) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNesiwothando. Noma Idigri yeminyaka emi-4 eNyuvesi (R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNesiwothando. Ukubhalisa kwiSigungu sesikhundla: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesiNesiwothando. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Akukho. Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esihambisanayo/esibonakalayo ekunyeseni ngemva kokubhalisa njengesiNesiwothando kwi-SANC eNyuvesi Yokunesa. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yesipiliyoni esihambisanayo/esibonakalayo ekunyeseni ngemva kokubhalisa njengesiNesiwothando kwi-SANC eNyuvesi Yokunesa. Isidingo esibhalwe esikhundleni: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngoshintsho, isibambe sewusuku, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, izinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi nangamasonto. Ukuzithoba ukujika kwezinye izigaba esibhedlela. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebo): Ulwazi olusisekelo lwegumbi lokusebenza (MS Office). Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela, kanye n equkethini eyinkimbinkimbi yokuhlanga ukunikeza isinakekelo esihle somgwago. Amashebo okukhuluma nokuhlobana abantu abahle (kokubili okulotshiwe nokukhulunywayo). Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kokunyusesa kanye nezinyawo zokuvikela ukutheleleka nokulawula.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso nokuphatha ukuze kusetshenziswe umgomo wokunyesa (okuziphatha okwelapha noma isinakekelo somgwago). Seka amaphuzu, izindlela, izinqumo, nezinkomba zokwakha isilinganiso sokunyesa (isilinganiso sokuziphatha). Ziphatha ngokunyusa nokwelapha ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemihlahlandlela ehambisana nokunyesa nokwelapha. Gcina ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nabanesi nabanye abanikazi bemitsetfo. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto, kanye nezinsiza eziphathekayo ngobuncgunkunca nomphumela obalulekile. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundeni, ekuthuthukiseni nokuphenyeni ngaphakathi komnyango wezokunyusa. Nikela ngesikhuthazo ezinsiza zemisebenzi yokunyusa.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGqithisayo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (JONIKELO: Wesifazane/
xh.summary: Izithuba zomongikazi oGqithisayo eMossel Bay Hospital ezifuna i-diploma okanye i-degree yokunongikaza ezinomagcino we-SANC, zinika imivuzo eqala ukusuka kwi-R337,359 ukuya kwi-R495,423 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isigaba esisisiseko se-R425 (okt i-diploma/i-degree yokunongikaza) okanye isiqu eslinganayo (R683 kwaye nabu-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisayo. OKanye I-Degree yeBachelor yeminyaka engama-4 kwaNongikazo (R174) okanye isiqu eslinganayo (R683 kwaye nabu-R1497 okanye R171 kwaye nabu-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisayo. Ukubhalisa kwi-bhungo lomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGqithisayo. Amafundo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo/awabonwayo kwinongikazo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGqithisayo kwi-SANC kwiNongikazo jikelele. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo/awabonwayo kwinongikazo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGqithisayo kwi-SANC kwiNongikazo jikelele. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza iishifti, umsebenzi wasebusuku, ixesha elidluleyo elingaphezu kwemisebenzi eqeshiweyo, iiholideyi zomphakathi nangeempelaveki. Ukulungele ukutshintshela kwezinye izigulana esibhedlele. Izakhono (ulwazi/amashe); Ulwazi olusisiseko lwekhompyutha (i-MS Office). Amandla okusebenza kodwa, nakwinqanaba elinabasebenzi abanemimoya ngokusebenzisa amandla okunika isigulane. Izakhono ezidumileyo zokunxibelelane nabantu (nokubhala nokuthetha). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokunongikaza nokuGqiba iingxaki zeMbuledlule koNdlelwane.

Yenza umsebenzi wonongikazo nonyameko lwezempilo ngokwemithetho nemigaqo echweba ngqo ngonongikazo nonyameko lwezempilo. Gcina ulunye ngokusebenza nogqithiselwano oluhle nabongikazi nakwezinye iindaba. Sebenzisa izixhobo zomntu, izixhobo ezibonakalayo, nezinto ezibonakalayo ngokusebenza okunengqondo. jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1 to 3) sought at Radie Kotze Hospital in the Western Cape to provide holistic nursing care and support training.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS A General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, public holidays, after-hours, night duty and weekend cover for nursing. Willingness to travel, work extra hours and be on standby. Rotate to other Departments, excluding Maternity department. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of Infection Prevention Control, control measures and practices. Knowledge of Nursing practices. Problem solving, report writing, liaison and facilitation skills. Good interpersonal and organisational skills and the ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic nursing care with set standards and within a professional/legal framework. Effective utilisation of resources. Participation in training and research. Provision of Support to Nursing Services. Maintain professional/ethical standards and self-development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Profesionele Verpleegster Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMENE Verpleging)
af.summary: Profesionele Verpleegster (Graad 1 tot 3) gesoek by Radie Kotze Hospital in die Western Cape om holistiese verpleegsorg te bied en opleiding te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/grade in verpleging) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Profesionele Verpleegster toelaat OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgraad in Verpleging (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Profesionele Verpleegster toelaat OF 'n 3-jarige Diploma in Verpleging (R171) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS 'n Algemene Verpleegster toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster of Algemene Verpleegster. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, openbare vakansiedae, naure, nagdiens en naweekdekking vir verpleging. Bereidwilligheid om te reis, ekstra ure te werk en op bystand te wees. Roteer na ander Departemente, uitgesluit die Kraamafdeling. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van Infeksievoorkomingbeheer, beheermaatreëls en praktyke. Kennis van verpleegpraktyke. Probleemoplossing, verslagskrywing, skakeling en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese verpleegsorg met vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele/regtelike raamwerk. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne. Deelname aan opleiding en navorsing. Verskaffing van ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste. Handhaaf professionele/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umongi Ochwepheshe Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (Ukunakekelwa Jikelele)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umongi ochwepheshe (Izinga 1 kuya ku-3) eRadie Kotze Hospital eWestern Cape ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuphelele kanye nokuxhasa ukuqeqesha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi: Isifundo esiyisiseko se-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri enkabeni) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongi ochwepheshe Noma Idigri yeminyaka engu-4 eNursing (R174) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongi ochwepheshe Noma Idiploma yeminyaka engu-3 eNursing (R171) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongi jikelele. Ukwethulwa kubhalise kumphakathi ochwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengomongi ochwepheshe noma umongi jikelele. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Uuncingo olungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esivelelako ekunakekelweni ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengomongi ochwepheshe ekuNakekelweni Jikelele. Izinga 3: Uuncingo olungenani eminyakeni engu-20 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esivelelako ekunakekelweni ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengomongi ochwepheshe ekuNakekelweni Jikelele. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, ngezinsuku zeholide, emahoreni angemva kwesikhathi, njalo ebusuku kanye nokumbo kwamaphelisonto ekunakekelweni. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba, ukusebenza amahora engeziwe kanye nokuba kulungele. Ukujikelezela kwezinye Iminyango, ngaphandle komnyango weMaternity. Izindlela eziyisipiliyoni (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nokuLawula Ukuvikelwa Kokutheleleka, izinyathelo zokulawula kanye nezendlela. Ulwazi ngendlela zokunakekela. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana kanye nokwenza kube lula. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuhlela kanye namandla okuxhumana kahle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe).
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle kakhulu, okuphelele ngaphakathi kwezindinganiso ezibekiwe nangesikhathi esithize esiyomthetho/obunjwengabochwepheshe. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuqeqeshweni nasekuphenyeni. Ukunikeza ukusekelwa kumasevisi okunakekela. Ukugcina izinga lomthetho/obuchwepheshe kanye nokuziphucula.

xh.title: Umhlengikazi Ochwepheshe Inqanaba 1 kuye kwa-3 (iNURSING jikelele)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ochwepheshe (Inqanaba 1 kuye kwa-3) kwiSibhedlele seRadie Kotze eWestern Cape ukuze anikezela ngomonakalo wokunyanga ongabandakanyiyo ngenkxaso yokuzimisela ukufundela.
xh.requirements: Isiqu semfundo esingaphantsi: Isiqu seBASIC R425 (okt. idiploma/ideshi kwinurses) okanye isiqu esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe OKT Ideshi yeminyaka engama-4 kwiNursing (R174) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe OKT Idiploma yeminyaka engamat-3 kwiNursing (R171) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) NJENGE nkosi jikelele yokunyanga. Ukubhalisa kwiRhululu Professional: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe okanye umhlengikazi jikelele. Iimfuno zangaphambili: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqatshelwa ekunyangen emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe kwisoNursing jikelele. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-20 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqatshelwa ekunyangeni emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe kwisoNursing jikelele. Iimfuno ezisekwe kumsebenzi: Qonda yokusebenza ngokuqhubeka, ngemihla yodlidlivo, emva kweeyure zomsebenzi, ngobusuku nangaphezu kwevekendi ukunyanga. Qonda yokuhamba, ukusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweyo nokulungele ukutyhila. Ukujikelela kwamanye amasebe, ngaphandle kweisebe leMaternity. Iikhompedensi (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi ngeNyuso yokuthintela ukusuleleka, izixhobo zolawulo nokuzilolonga. Ulwazi ngokuzilolonga ngokunyanga. Izakhono zokuxazulula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo, unxibelelwano nomanyano lwabantu. Izakhono ezilungileyo zothungo phakathi komntu nomntu nokuqhelanisa kwakho ukunxibelelana kakuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo).
xh.duties: Inikezelo lomonakalo wokunyanga ongcono kakhulu, ongabandakanyiyo ngamagqabantshintshi alungileyo naphakathi kwesakhokelo samagunya esiyimithetho/seplofeshinal. Ukusetyenziswa okusempilweni kwezibonelelo. Ulwazi lokuxhamla kokuqeqesha nokuphandla. Inikezelo lenkxaso kwiinkonzo zokunyanga. Ukugcina amagunya eplofeshinal/ethikal nokuziphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Assistant (POST Basic) Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R275 340 per annum Grade 2: R318 666 per annum Grade 3: R343 761 per annum
jobs.summary: Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant position at Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure office, supporting pharmaceutical services and private providers across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: As required by the training facility and the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant qualification that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) (Institutional) or Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) Institutional or Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post- Basic) with the SAPC. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post- Basic) with the SAPC. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) drivers license.
jobs.duties: Engage and liaise with relevant internal and external stakeholders. Assist the Manager: Pharmaceutical Services with the management and coordination of private providers within KMPSS. Assist private providers with stock-related and other operational pharmacy queries. Provide Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post- Basic) services at Primary Health Care facilities within KMPSS on a rotational basis.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Apotheekassistent (Post-Basies) Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Post-Basies Apoteekassistent-pos by die Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-struktuurkantoor, wat farmaseutiese dienste en private verskaffers oor drie graadvlakke ondersteun.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Soos deur die opleidingsfasiliteit en die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) vereis, plus Post-Basies Apoteekassistent-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) (Institutioneel) of Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SAPC as Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) Institutioneel of Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies). Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die SAPC as Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies). Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Apoteekassistent na registrasie as 'n Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) by die SAPC. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Apoteekassistent na registrasie as 'n Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) by die SAPC. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Skakel met en tree in verbinding met relevante interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Assisteer die Bestuurder: Farmaseutiese Dienste met die bestuur en koördinering van private verskaffers binne KMPSS. Assisteer private verskaffers met voorraadverwante en ander operasionele apteeknavrae. Verskaf Apoteekassistent (Post-Basies) dienste by Primary Health Care-fasiliteite binne KMPSS op 'n rotasiegrondslag.

zu.title: Umncedi wePharmacy (POST Basic) Izinga 1 kuye ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedi wepharmacy ongaphansi kwesisekelo esikhundweni sikanhlamvu kwesikhungo se-Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure, ukusekela izinkonzo ze-pharmaceutical kanye nabahlinzeki abangingaphandle kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezincane zemfundo: Njengoba kudingwa isikhungo sokulolonga kanye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kanye neziqu zomncedi wepharmacy ongaphansi kwesisekelo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ne-SAPC njengomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic) (Institutional) noma umncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic). Ukuqashwa kubhalwe kwikhaladi lemhando: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic) Institutional noma umncedi wepharmacy (Post Basic). Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic). Izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengomncedi wepharmacy ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Izinga 3: Okuncane iminyaka engu-13 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengomncedi wepharmacy ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Isidingo esiphelele sokuqasha: Ilayisensi yokuqasha (Code B/EB) evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuxhumana kanye nokwenzelana nabahlalekisi abahambisanayo bangesaphetha kanye nangaphandle. Ukusiza abaphathi: Izinkonzo ze-Pharmaceutical ngokuphathwa kanye nokuhlanganisa abahlinzeki abangingaphandle ngaphakathi kwe-KMPSS. Ukusiza abahlinzeki abangingaphandle ngemibuzo ehlobene nemitshwalo kanye namanye amapharmacy. Ukunikeza izinkonzo zomncedi wepharmacy (Post-Basic) emazweni ezempilo ayingeni eliphansi angaphakathi kwe-KMPSS ngendlela yokujikeleza.

xh.title: Umncedi wePharmacy (POST Basic) inqanaba 1 ukusa kwi-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi wePharmacy ongumva kwesiseko e-ofisini yesakhiwo esingaphansi se-Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain, exhasa iinkonzo zezamayeza kunye nabahanisi ababucala kumanqanaba amathathu.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphantsi kweminyaniselo: Njengoko kufunwa sisikhululo zolwazi kunye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kwaye uqobe isifundo somncedi wePharmacy ongumva kwesiseko esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (Post-Basic) (Institutional) okanye umncedi wePharmacy (Post-Basic). Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo lamahlathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (Post-Basic) Institutional okanye umncedi wePharmacy (Post Basic). Ulwazi: inqanaba 1: Akukho kuthiwa kusemva kokubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (Post-Basic). Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengomncedi wePharmacy emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wePharmacy (Post- Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-13 yamava afanelekileyo njengomncedi wePharmacy emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wePharmacy (Post- Basic) kwi-SAPC. Iynamo efuneka kulo msebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Zibandakanya kwaye uzalisekisise nabaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle abahlobene nalomsebenzi. Uncede uMphathi: Iinkonzo zePharmacy ekulawuleni nasekuhlangeneyo abahanisi ababucala ngaphakathi kwe-KMPSS. Uncede abahanisi ababucala ngemibuzo engumlinganiselo wesitokhwe nangamanye amaphakathi wepharmacy. Unikeze iinkonzo zomncedi wePharmacy (Post- Basic) kwizikhululo ezingunyulo lwePrimary Health Care ngaphakathi kwe-KMPSS ngokujikeleza.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Healthnet (RURAL)
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk benodig vir Emergency Medical Services in die Cape Winelands en West Coast Distrik, met vereistes van Matric, rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige Code 8 bestuurderslisensie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Matric (Grade 12) kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike rekenaarervaring in Microsoft Word en Excel. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige Code 8 bestuurderslisensie. Bereid om tussen EMS-distrikte en eksterne belanghebbendes te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardig in MS Word en Excel. Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Dien inligting akkuraat op die aanlyn besprekingstelsel in om data-integriteit te verseker. Skakel daagliks met distrik- en sekondêre hospitale om ontslagpasiente te ontlas. Stel daaglikse ontslag- en HealthNet-statistieke akkuraat vir die distrik op. Daaglikse verspreiding van dokumente aan HealthNet-personeel en bestuur.
