zu.title: Clerk Wokuphatha: Healthnet (RURAL)
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Clerk Wokuphatha kuma-Emergency Medical Services e-Cape Winelands nase-West Coast District, kudingeka i-Matric, ukwazi kusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nephesenti elikhonziwe le-Code 8 driver's licence.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda esingaphansi kwesibili: I-Matric (Grade 12) noma okulinganayo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele sokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-Microsoft Word ne-Excel. Isidingo esingokwemisebenzi: Ipesenti elikhonziwe le-Code 8 driver's license. Ukubekezela ukuhamba phakathi kwamadistirikithi ama-EMS nabanikabelomsebenzi bangaphandle. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-MS Word ne-Excel. Ikono lokusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Iqopha ulwazi ngendlela eqinisekileyo kwisimiso sabhukhi esixhaxha ukuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza kwedatha. Xhumana njalo namashospitha adistirikithi namashospitha wesibili ukukhipha iziguli ezikhishwe esibhedlela. Qamba ngendlela eqinisekileyo izibalo zansuku zonke zokukhishwa esibhedlela ne-HealthNet zedistirikithi. Yabelana njalo ngamadokhumenti abasebenzi be-HealthNet nabaphathi. Thintana namakhasimedi ubanike ulwazi olusha lapho kudingeka. Qapha ibhodi yezimoto ze-Healthnet ukusekela ingxenye yokusebenza.

xh.title: Umlindi Wezomphathi: Healthnet (RURAL)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuba nguMlindi Wezomphathi kwiinkonzo zeZezimo ngokubakhalayo kwiCape Winelands nakwiWest Coast District, kufuneka abe neMatric, akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha aneValid Code 8 driver's license.
xh.requirements: Isigaba sokufunda esincinci: Isigaba seMatric (Grade 12) okanye esilinganayo. Isiphaluko: Isiphaluko esifanelekileko sokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Word nakwiExcel. Isimfuno esingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: IValid Code 8 driver’s license. Kube nokulungele ukuhamba phakathi kweendawo zeEMS nabantu bangaphandle. Amandla (ulwazi/amazilolwazi): Ukuwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiMS Word nakwiExcel. Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nakwisiquphe.
xh.duties: Bhala ngokuchanekileyo iinkcukacha kwinkqubo yokubhala nge-intanethi ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkcukacha ziluluhle. Thintana yonke imihla nezibhedlele zesithili nezabaphakathi ukubuyisela abagulayo abakhutshiweyo. Hlengahlengisa ngokuchanekileyo yonke imihla izitathistic zabakhutshiweyo nezeHealthNet zesithili. Sazisa yonke imihla amaxwebhu kubasebenzi beHealthNet nakubalawuli. Qhagamshelana nabakhili umze ubanike iinkcukacha ezintsha xa kufuneka. Qhuba amaqhinga okulawula iifloti zeHealthnet ukuncedisa isiquphe esisebenzayo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support (AEROMEDICAL Services)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed to manage and verify invoices from contracted aeromedical and ambulance providers within the Western Cape Emergency Medical Services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience with administration of financial processes and information. Appropriate experience verifying invoices, claims and supporting proof of service. Appropriate experience dealing with contracted providers, Finance and Supply Chain Management. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver's license. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office, e-mail and internet. Willingness to travel when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of invoice processing, claims reconciliation, expenditure monitoring and recordkeeping. Knowledge of service level agreements, purchase orders, financial controls and PFMA requirements. Ability to prioritize, solve problems, meet deadlines and maintain accurate records. Ability to work independently and in a team, with good communication and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Receive, register and track invoices from contracted providers, including private ambulance companies, AMS and NPOs. Verify invoices and supporting proof of service against service level agreements, purchase orders, tariffs and approved activity. Reconcile provider claims and follow up on missing, duplicate or inconsistent information. Maintain monthly expenditure and utilisation records for the Business Solutions contract and contracted provider portfolio. Flag expenditure risks, outstanding invoices and over- or under- utilisation for management attention. Liaise with contracted providers, Finance and Supply Chain Management and provide administrative support to the EMS Supervisors.
jobs.enquiries: Dr L van Rensburg Tel No: (083) 320-6584 or email: Louis.VanRensburg@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Ondersteuning (AEROMEDICAL Dienste)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig om fakture van gekontakteerde lugmediese en ambulansverskaffers binne die Wes-Kaapse Noodmediese Dienste te bestuur en te verifieer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring met administrasie van finansële prosesse en inligting. Toepaslike ervaring met die verifiëring van fakture, eise en ondersteunende bewys van diens. Toepaslike ervaring in die hantering van gekontakteerde verskaffers, Finansies en Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office, e-pos en die internet. Bereidwilligheid om te reis wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van faktuurbewerking, afstemming van eise, monitering van uitgawes en rekordhouding. Kennis van diensvlakooreenkomste, bestellings, finansiële kontroles en PFMA-vereistes. Vermoë om te prioritiseer, probleme op te los, sperdatums na te kom en akkurate rekords te hou. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk, met goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Ontvang, registreer en volg fakture van gekontakteerde verskaffers na, insluitend privaat ambulansmaatskappye, AMS en NPO's. Verifieer fakture en ondersteunende bewys van diens teen diensvlakooreenkomste, bestellings, tariewe en goedgekeurde aktiwiteit. Stem verskaffers se eise af en volg ontbrekende, duplikaat- of inkonsekwente inligting na. Onderhou maandelikse uitgawe- en benuttingsrekords vir die Business Solutions-kontrak en gekontakteerde verskafferportefeulje. Merk uitgawerisiko's, uitstaande fakture en oor- of onderbenutting vir bestuursaandag. Skakel met gekontakteerde verskaffers, Finansies en Voorsieningskettingbestuur en verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die EMS-toesighouers.

zu.title: Iklekhi lokuphathwa kwezokulawula: Ukusekelwa (Izinsizakusebenza ze-AEROMEDICAL)
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekhi lokuphathwa kwezokulawula ukuphatha futhi kuqinisekise izikweletu ezivela kubanikezeli be-aeromedical nezokwelasha abayisivumelwano ngaphakathi kwezinsizakusebenza eZinguqulo ze-Western Cape Emergency Medical Services.
zu.requirements: Ithimba lemfundo elingaphansi kwesigaba: Isitifiketi seSenior Certificate (noma esilinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ngokuphathwa kwezinqubo zezimali nolwazi. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuqinisekiseni izikweletu, izimangalo nobufakazi obusekela inkonzo. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuphatheni abanikezeli abayisivumelwano, i-Finance kanye no-Supply Chain Management. Isidingo esibangelwe umsebenzi: Isilayisensi sokushayela esisebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-Microsoft Office, i-imeyili naku-inthanethi. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba ngesikhathi esidingekayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi ngokucutshungula izikweletu, ukuqinisekisa izimangalo, ukuqapha ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nokugcina irekhodi. Ulwazi ngomvumelwano wamazinga enkonzo, amaholide wokuthenga, izilawuli zezimali kanye nezidingo ze-PFMA. Ikono lokubeka izidingo ezibalulekile, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlangabezana nezikhathi ezimisiwe kanye nokugcina amarekhodi anembile. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nangaphakathi kwethimba, elinesikhathi sokuxhumana esihle kanye namakhono okuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Thola, bhalise futhi ulandele izikweletu ezivela kubanikezeli abayisivumelwano, kuhlanganise namakhampani ezokwelasha abangasese, i-AMS kanye nama-NPO. Qinisekisa izikweletu nobufakazi obusekela inkonzo ngokumisela umvumelwano wamazinga enkonzo, amaholide wokuthenga, izinto ezibiziwe kanye nemisebenzi evunyiwe. Qinisekisa izimangalo zabanikezeli ulandele okushodayekile, okuphindwe kabili noma ulwazi olungahambisani. Gcina amarekhodi zenyanga zokuchithwa kwemali nokusetshenziswa nge-Business Solutions contract kanye nomhlahlandlela wabanikezeli abayisivumelwano. Phawula izingozi zokuchithwa kwemali, izikweletu ezingaxoliswanga kanye nokungasetshenziswa ngokweqile noma ngaphantsi kokuqinisekiswa ukunakwa kokuphatha. Xhumana nababaleli abayisivumelwano, i-Finance kanye no-Supply Chain Management futhi unikeze ukusekelwa ngokuphathwa kwezokulawula kubaphathi be-EMS.

xh.title: Iclerk yolawulo: Inkxaso (Iinkonzo ze-AEROMEDICAL)
xh.summary: Kufuneka iclerk yolawulo ekwazona ukulawula nokuqinisekisa i-invois ezivela kubaphathi be-aeromedical nabe-ambulans abanamagqithiso ngaphakathi kwekonzo zeWestern Cape Emergency Medical Services.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesigqibo: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isipilingo: Isipilingo esifanelekileyo ngolawulo lweenkqubo zezimali nolwazi. Isipilingo esifanelekileyo ekuqinisekiseni i-invois, iklaimi nokuqinisekisa inkonzo. Isipilingo esifanelekileyo ekusebenzeni nabaphathi abanamagqithiso, kuFinance nakwiSupply Chain Management. Isimfuno esingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomkhaya kwiMicrosoft Office, i-imeyile nakwi-intanethi. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba xa kufuneka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngokucubungula i-invois, ukuqwalaselwa kweklaimi, okuqwalaselwa kwe-rhoqo yokuhola kunye nokugcina irekhodi. Ulwazi ngamagqithiso emvimbo wenkonzo, oodolo bokuthenga, izilawulo zezimali neemfuno zePFMA. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ngokweenqanaba zokubaluleka, ukusomba iingxaki, ukumiselwa iimini zokuqedela kwaye ugcinire irekhodi enyani. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela nakwinqanaba leqela, elinesakhono sokuthetha nzpto kunye namakhono okusebenza nabantu.
xh.duties: Wamkele, ubhalise kwaye ulandele i-invois ezivela kubaphathi abanamagqithiso, kuquka namakampani e-ambulans ezingabantu, iAMS namaNPO. Qinisekisa i-invois nokuqinisekisa inkonzo ngokuchasene namagqithiso emvimbo wenkonzo, oodolo bokuthenga, iindleko zamaxabiso nemisebenzi evunyiweyo. Qwalasela iklaimi zabaphathi ulandele inkcazelo engekhayoyo, ephindwe kabini enodliwano-ndlebe kuyo. Gcina irekhodi yoku-hola kwinyanga kunye nokusetyenziselwa kwesivumelwano seBusiness Solutions nabadliiweyo abanamagqithiso. Phawula ingozi yokuhola, i-invois ezingazalwanga nokusetyenziswa ngaphezulu nangaphantsi kwesilinganiselo ukuya kulungelelwaniso lolawulo. Yenza uxhumo nabaphathi abanamagqithiso, kuFinance nakuSupply Chain Management kwaye unike inkxaso yolawulo kuSupervisors be-EMS.

Amakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olulungeleyo ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-National ne-Provincial Treasury Regulations, nesixokelelwanisi se-Accounting Officer kwisebe lezeMpilo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Qamba, qinisekisa ukuze uphuhliswe iindlela zokuhlawula kwiinkqubo ze-BAS ne-LOGIS, ilungelelanise iinkcazelo zabathengi-bakho. Lawula, qinisekisa, lungelelanisa iijournalize kwaye ubhale nge-Asset and Liability accounts kuquka ukucoca ama-Asset and Liability Accounts. Lawula imali oyngenelayo nakuncedisa ngokomthetho kwezimali ezincinci. Nceda ekulungelelaniseni i-IFS nakwi-AFS, iileases nakubhalo lwemihla le-30 yokuhlawula. Nceda nomphathi wakho ngokwemisebenzi yakhe.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Supply Chain Management
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed for supply chain management at Victoria Hospital, Western Cape, requiring a Senior Certificate with Mathematics or Accountancy and relevant procurement experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics or Accountancy as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KRA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate Supply Chain Management experience including Procurement of Goods and Services. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Code E/EB Driver’s License. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Office: Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ability to function independently as well as in a multi- disciplinary team. Knowledge of LOGIS, ESL (Essential Supplier List) and Electronic Procurement System systems. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National, Provincial Treasury, Regulations, Policies. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management and Finance administrative processes.
jobs.duties: Demand and Acquisitioning of goods and services including drafting of specifications, conducting site meetings, advertising and evaluations of RFQs on the Electronic Purchasing System. Ensure Audit Compliance. Internal control and Supply Chain Management Reporting. Support to Supervisor, Team and end users in terms of procurement related queries.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig vir voorsieningskettingbestuur by Victoria Hospital, Western Cape, wat 'n Senior Sertifikaat met Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde en toepaslike verkrygingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat fokus op die Kernprestasieareas (KPA's) van die pos. Ervaring: Toepaslike Voorsieningskettingbestuur-ervaring insluitend Verkryging van Goedere en Dienste. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige Kode E/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office: Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Kennis van LOGIS, ESL (Essential Supplier List) en Elektroniese Verkrygingstelsel-stelsels. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Nasionale, Provinciale Tesourie, Regulasies, Beleide. Kennis van Voorsieningskettingbestuur en Finansiële administratiewe prosesse.
af.duties: Vraag en verkryging van goedere en dienste, insluitend die opstel van spesifikasies, die hou van terreinvergaderings, advertering en evaluerings van RFQ's op die Elektroniese Aankoopstelsel. Verseker oudit-nakoming. Interne beheer en Voorsieningskettingbestuur-verslagdoening. Ondersteuning aan toesighouer, span en eindgebruikers ten opsigte van verkrygingverwante navrae.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Ukuphathwa Kwenkethe Yezimpahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka clerk wezolawulo wokuphathwa kwenkethe yezimpahla e Victoria Hospital, Western Cape, okudinga i-Senior Certificate ene-Mathematics noma i-Accountancy kanye nomuzwa ofanele wokuthenga izimpahla nezinsizakalo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane sokumfundo: i-Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ene-Mathematics noma i-Accountancy njengesihlakala esidlule kanye/noma i-Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) enomuzwa/ikhalithi egxila Kuma-Key Performance Areas (KRA's) esikhundla. Umuzwa: Umuzwa ofanele Wokuphathwa Kwenkethe Yezimpahla okuhlanganisa Ukuthenga Izimpahla Nezinsizakalo. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: i-Code E/EB Driver's License evumelekile. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (i-MS Office: Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nelokusebenza eqenjini elihlanganisiwe. Ulwazi lwesistimu ye-LOGIS, i-ESL (Essential Supplier List) kanye nesistimu ye-Electronic Procurement System. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-National, i-Provincial Treasury, Izimiso, Amapholisi. Ulwazi lokuqondiswa kokuphathwa kwenkethe yezimpahla nezomnotho.
zu.duties: Ukuclinga nokuthola izimpahla nezinsizakalo okuhlanganisa ukulungisa izinkomba, ukubamba imihlangano yendawo, ukukhiqiza nokuhlola ama-RFQ kusistimu ye-Electronic Purchasing System. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela kwe-Audit. Ukulawula ngaphakathi nokubika nge-Supply Chain Management. Ukusekela umphathi, Iqembu kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina ngemibuzo ehlobene nokuthenga.

xh.title: Iklerk yeWoncedo: Ulawulo lweNkokelo eThunyelwayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iklerk yoloncedo lolawulo lwenkokelo ethunyelwayo eVictoria Hospital, eWestern Cape, efunisa iSatifikhate Senyanga ngeMathematics okanye iAccountancy namava ahambelanayo ekuthengweni.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphantsi: iSatifikhate Senyanga (okanye eselifanayo) ngeMathematics okanye iAccountancy njengesifundo esiphunyeweyo kunye/nokuba yiSatifikhate Senyanga (okanye elilinganayo) namava/amandla aqwalaselwa kwimimisela yokuSebenza ePhambili (KRA’s) yesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo eLawulo lweNkokelo eThunyelwayo aquka ukuThenga izinto nokusebenza. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zemisebenzi: ilayisenisi yokuQhuba yeCode E/EB esebenzayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (iMS Office: iWord, iExcel nePowerPoint). Uluho lokusebenza uzimele ngokwakho nakwinqanaba elinamagatya amaninji. Ulwazi ngeLOGIS, i-ESL (Essential Supplier List) kunye neenkqubo ze-Electronic Procurement System. Ulwazi ngePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iNational, iProvincial Treasury, iRegulations, iPolicies. Ulwazi ngeLawulo lweNkokelo eThunyelwayo nemithelelo yoloncedo lwezeMali.
xh.duties: UkuFuna nokuThenga izinto nokusebenza kuquka ukuLemba iimbaliso, ukuQumba iintlanganiso zendawo, ukuZahlisa nokubeka ulwazi nokuTyhilwa kwe-RFQs kwi-Electronic Purchasing System. Qinisekisa ukuThobela i-Audit. Ulawulo olungaphakathi nokuZingela ngokulawulo lweNkokelo eThunyelwayo. Uncedo kuMphathi, uQeqesha abantu kwaye ekugqibeleni ngemibuzo ethengwa ngayo into yokuthengwa.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (PSYCHOGERIATRIC Ward)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 per annum Grade 2: R272 778 per annum Grade 3: R319 071 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse sought for the psychogeriatric ward at Alexandra Hospital in the Western Cape, with SANC registration and graded experience requirements.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, and public holidays to meet the operational requirements. Must be prepared to assist in all departments according to operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication and interpersonal relationships. Basic computer skills in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape.
jobs.duties: Development and implementation of basic patient care plans. Provide basic clinical nursing care. Effective utilisation of physical and financial resources. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Stafverpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (PSIGOGERIATRIESE Saal)
af.summary: Stafverpleegkundige gesoek vir die psigogeriatriese saal by Alexandra Hospital in die Western Cape, met SANC-registrasie en graderingservaringvereistes.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Stafverpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Stafverpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Stafverpleegkundige. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Stafverpleegkundige. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Moet bereid wees om in alle departemente te assisteer volgens operasionele vereistes. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntsorgplanne. Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg. Effektiewe benutting van fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne. Onderhou professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi wesikhundla se-1 kuya ku-3 (Esebenza ebhedlela labadala abanegciwane lengqondo)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ohlela i-psychogeriatric ward Alexandra Hospital Western Cape, one-registration SANC namazinga okuhlolwa okuhle emsebenzini.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esikhulu sokufunda: I-qualification evumela ukubhaliswa e-SANC njengoba ngumhlengikazi wesikhundla. I-registration: Kufanele ubhaliswe e-SANC njengoba ngumhlengikazi wesikhundla. Okuhlolwe: Izinga loku-1: Akukho. Izinga loku-2: Uzoba neminyaka eliyishumi engu-10 ngenkathi usebenza emsebenzini we-nursing emva kokubhaliswa e-SANC njengoba ngumhlengikazi wesikhundla. Izinga loku-3: Uzoba neminyaka eliyishumi nambili engu-20 ngenkathi usebenza emsebenzini we-nursing emva kokubhaliswa e-SANC njengoba ngumhlengikazi wesikhundla. Okudingekayo emsebenzini: Kufanele uvume ukusebenza ngamashemu, emini nas ebusuku, ngezginsi namaholide, ngokwesidingo semisebenzi yebhedlela. Kufanele ube lubambeko lokusiza emnyangweni onke ngokwesidingo semisebenzi. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukhuluma kahle nokuxhumana labantu ngokuhle. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ku-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi Department of Health Western Cape.
zu.duties: Ukudala futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokunakekela abagula ngokwesisindo. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha komhlengikazi. Ukusebenzisa okuphumayo nezimali ngokusebenza kahle. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga elihle nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umongikazi ongumsebenzi weNqanaba 1 ukusa kwi-3 (IWadi ye-PSYCHOGERIATRIC)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongikazi ongumsebenzi ewardini ye-psychogeriatric e-Alexandra Hospital e-Western Cape, anobhaliso kwi-SANC naye kufuneka ahambelane neemfuno zeminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Isigaba sokufunda esingaphantsi kwesimida: Isigaba esivumela ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongumsebenzi. Ubhaliso kwikundla yabaphathi bemizi: Ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongumsebenzi. Amava: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo angaphantsi kweminyaka elingunqamlezo eli-10 kumisebenzi wokhongikole emva kokuqatshelwa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongumsebenzi. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo angaphantsi kweminyaka elingunqamlezo eli-20 kumisebenzi wokhongikole emva kokuqatshelwa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongumsebenzi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishithi, umsebenzi wemini nobusuku, iiveki zokuphumla, namaholide aphuma ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi. Kufuneka alungele ukuncedisa kuzo zonke iindawo ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaziko): Unxibelelwano oluhle nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ikhono elisisiseko lekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngomthetho ochanekileyo namagqabantshenti ka-Department of Health Western Cape.
xh.duties: Uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iicebo ezisisiseko zokhathalelo lwegazi lenkongoloshi. Unika khathalelo lwesiseko lwekhondo yamakhongothi. Ukusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo amakhaya emali nezixhobo. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga elungileyo lokuziphatha nokuziphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Food Services Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise food services at Stellenbosch Hospital, overseeing ordering, preparation, distribution and hygiene within the food service unit.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate and relevant supervisory experience in a Food Service Unit. Inherent requirements of the job: Ability to lift/move heavy objects and be on their feet the entire day. Willingness to work shifts, public holidays/ weekends and overtime as needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy and numerical skills. Knowledge of production and cooking methods for normal and therapeutic diets. Knowledge of hygiene, Occupation Health and Safety and HACCP principles. Sound organizing, interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work according to rules and policies to meet deadlines. Ability to work independently and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Order, receipt, storage and issue all food provisions and stock in the foodservice unit. Supervise food pre-preparation and production of all full and therapeutic diets. Supervise the weighing, dishing and distribution of food to various wards. Supervise hygiene, use and maintenance of equipment and occupational health and safety. Supervise adherence to prescripts, elementary control measures and standard operational procedures. Supervise human resources, financial resources and do stock control. Process food statistics and keep records.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Voedseldiens Toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor voedseldienste by Stellenbosch Hospital en oorsien bestelling, voorbereiding, verspreiding en higiëne binne die voedseldienseenheid.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Algemene Onderwys- en Opleidingsertifikaat (GETC)/ Graad 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike en relevante toesighoudervaring in 'n Voedseldienseenheid. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Vermoë om swaar voorwerpe op te lig/te beweeg en die hele dag op die voete te wees. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, openbare vakansdae/ naweke en oortyd soos nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid en numeriese vaardighede. Kennis van produksie- en kookmetodes vir normale en terapeutiese diëte. Kennis van higiëne, Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid en HACCP-beginsels. Soliede organiserings-, interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om volgens reëls en beleide te werk om sperdatums te haal. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Bestel, ontvang, berg en verskaf alle voedselvoorrade en voorraad in die voedseldiensseenheid. Hou toesig oor voorafbereiding en produksie van alle volle en terapeutiese diëte. Hou toesig oor die weeg, opskep en verspreiding van voedsel na verskeie sale. Hou toesig oor higiëne, gebruik en onderhoud van toerusting en beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Hou toesig oor nakoming van voorskrifte, elementêre beheermaatreëls en standaardoperasionele prosedures. Hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronne, finansiële hulpbronne en doen voorraadbeheer. Verwerk voedselstatistiek en hou rekords.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinkonzo Zokudla
zu.summary: Qapha izinkonzo zokudla eStellenbosch Hospital, ubheke ukuthumela izimpilo, ukulungiselela, ukusatshalaliswa kanye nokuhlanzwa endaweni yenkonzo yokudla.
zu.requirements: Ithuba lemfundo elincane: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele somphathi endaweni yenkonzo yokudla. Izidingo zomsebenzi ngokwako: Amandla okuphakamisa/hambisa izinto ezisindayo futhi ube emilenzeni yonke imihla. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngoshifti, ngezikhathi zetholideyasikahulumathi/ ngasomini kanye naloikhetha njengoba kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha namakhono ezibalo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokukhiqiza nokupheka ukudla okuvamile nokwelaphayo. Ulwazi lokuhlanzwa, Occupation Health and Safety kanye nemigomo yeHACCP. Amakhono ohlelo, okuxhumana nabantu nokukhuluma. Amandla okusebenza ngemithetho kanye nemigomo ukuze ugcwalise izikhathi ezinqunyiwe. Amandla okusebenza wedwa naphansi kwengcindezi.
zu.duties: Thumela, yamukele, gcine futhi umnze konke ukudla kanye nempahla kwelabhuluko endaweni yenkonzo yokudla. Qapha ukulungiselela nokukhiqizwa kokudla okuphelele nampilo yokwelapha. Qapha ukunesisindo, ukubeka esitsheni kanye nokusatshalalisa ukudla kumawadihlukene. Qapha ukuhlanzwa, ukusetshenziswa nokuqashelwa kolwendlu kanye nemphiliso yokuzivikela emsebenzini. Qapha ukulandelwa komthetho, izindlela zokulawula ze-elementary kanye ne-standard operational procedures. Qapha abantu abasebenzayo, izinsiza zemali kwenze ukulawula impahla. Hlela izibalo zokudla ugcine amarekhodi.

xh.title: Somlawuli weeNkonzo zeKutya
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zokutya e Stellenbosch Hospital, ezingqinelaniswe nokutsha, ulungiselelo, ukusasaza kunye nocolo lweh条 ngaphakathi kwincomingo yeenkonzo zokutya.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezisezantsi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo nesinxulumeneyo sokulawula kwiFood Service Unit. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ikelo lokuphakamisa/tshixa izinto ezisindayo nokuqhosha iinyawo ixesha lonke lemini. Ukulungelelaniswa ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ngokutshintsha ii-shifts, ngeeholideyi zikawonke-wonke/ ngeempelaveki nakwi-overtime xa kufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/akhono): Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yekhompyutha namakhono okubala. Ulwazi ngendlela zokukhiqiza nokupheka amadiyeti ajikeleze kwaye ayinyangayo. Ulwazi ngocolo, i-Occupation Health and Safety nemiGaqo ye-HACCP. Amakhono amabalawuli, axhusayo nokunxibelelanisa afanelekileyo. Ikelo lokusebenza ngokwemiqathango kunye namacebo ukuze ugcwalise iimvumeso. Ikelo lokusebenza kodwa nangaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Funa, wamkele, ugcine usize zonke izinto zokutya neziqulatho ezikwincomingo yeenkonzo zokutya. Lawula ulungiselelo ngaphambili kokutya nokukhiqizwa kwayo nakuzo zonke iidieti ezigqibeleleyo nezinyangayo. Lawula ukubeka umlinganiselo, ukubiza nokusasaza ukutya kumagumbi ahlukeneyo. Lawula ucolo, ukusetyenziswa nolondolozo lwesixhobo kunye namaphupha ompilo nakhuseleko emsebenzini. Lawula ukuzinikela kumagqabantshintshi, iziphithiphiti zolawulo kumacandelo alinganiselweyo nemiqatho ebambele kumacebo abambeleleyo. Lawula amabango abantu, amabango eemali wenze ulawulo lwesiqulatho. Songa isibalo sokutya ugcine iirekhodi.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 per annum
jobs.summary: Nursing Assistant position at Laingsburg Hospital requiring SANC registration, with three grade levels based on experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Nursing Assistant with the SANC. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Nursing Assistant with the SANC. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work overtime, shifts, public holidays, night duty and weekends. Willingness to rotate to other wards in the hospital. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (written and verbal). Self- discipline and motivation.
jobs.duties: Provide quality basic nursing care. Provide elementary clinical nursing care. Assist patients with activities of daily living which include patient hygiene, nutritional status, mobility and elimination needs. Effective utilization of physical and financial resources. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Record keeping.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. jobs.title: General Worker: Pharmacy
jobs.summary: General worker needed at New Somerset Hospital pharmacy to handle medicine collection, transportation and stock distribution, requiring basic literacy and relevant healthcare logistics experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic numeracy and literacy skills. Experience: Appropriate experience in a pharmaceutical, healthcare logistics or stock distribution environment. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, weekends, public holidays and overtime when required. Ability to perform physical tasks involving the movement and transportation of medicine boxes, stock, trolleys and supplies. Ability to walk long distances within the hospital environment. Ability to work in a healthcare environment and handle pharmaceutical stock and related supplies. Competencies (knowledge/skills): The ability to receive, handle, distribute and issue stock, supplies and pharmaceutical products according to prescribed procedures and standard operating practices. Ability to read, interpret and process requisitions, stock orders and related documentation. Basic knowledge of stock rotation principles (FIFO/FEFO). Basic numerical skills. Good interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a team. Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding patient information and prescriptions. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety principles.
jobs.duties: Provide effective operational and logistical support to pharmacy services through the collection, transportation and distribution of medicines, pharmaceutical stock, supplies, prescriptions and related documentation within the hospital and associated service areas. Assist with the receiving, handling, picking, packing, issuing and movement of pharmaceutical stock and supplies in accordance with prescribed procedures and stock rotation principles. Support medicine distribution and stock movement processes by collecting and delivering ward stock, prescriptions, pharmaceutical supplies and other authorised documentation between pharmacy, wards, clinics and designated service points. Maintain a clean, safe and organised working environment in accordance with Occupational Health and Safety requirements and departmental procedures. Report operational concerns, delays, incidents and stock-related issues to supervisors timeously. Maintain professional conduct and compliance by adhering to attendance requirements, working hours, departmental policies, confidentiality requirements and the Code of Conduct. Demonstrate accountability, effective communication and positive working relationships while carrying out assigned duties.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Algemene Werknemer: Apteek
af.summary: Algemene werknemer benodig by die New Somerset Hospital-apotheek om die versameling, vervoer en voorraadverspreiding van medisyne te hanteer, met basiese geletterdheid en relevante ervaring in gesondheidsorglogistiek as vereistes.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese syfer- en geletterdheidsvaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n farmaseutiese, gesondheidsorglogistieke of voorraadverspreidingsomgewing. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, naweke, openbare vakansiedae en oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Vermoë om fisieke take te verrig wat die beweging en vervoer van medisynekissies, voorraad, trollies en voorrade behels. Vermoë om lang afstande binne die hospitaalomgewing te loop. Vermoë om in 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing te werk en farmaseutiese voorraad en verwante voorrade te hanteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Die vermoë om voorraad, voorrade en farmaseutiese produkte te ontvang, te hanteer, te versprei en uit te reik volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures en standaard bedryfspraktyke. Vermoë om rekwisisies, voorraadbestellings en verwante dokumentasie te lees, te interpreteer en te verwerk. Basiese kennis van voorraadrotasiebeginsels (FIFO/FEFO). Basiese numeriese vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om vertroulikheid rakende pasiëntinligting en voorskrifte te handhaaf. Kennis van Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeginsels.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende bedryfs- en logistieke ondersteuning aan apteekdienste deur die versameling, vervoer en verspreiding van medisyne, farmaseutiese voorraad, voorrade, voorskrifte en verwante dokumentasie binne die hospitaal en geassosieerde diensareas. Bystand verleen met die ontvangs, hantering, pluk, verpakking, uitreiking en beweging van farmaseutiese voorraad en voorrade in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe prosedures en voorraadrotasiebeginsels. Ondersteun medisyneverspreidings- en voorraadbewegingsprosesse deur saalvoorraad, voorskrifte, farmaseutiese voorrade en ander gemagtigde dokumentasie tussen apteek, sale, klinieke en aangewese dienspunte te versamel en af te lewer. Handhaaf 'n skoon, veilige en georganiseerde werkomgewing in ooreenstemming met Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsvereistes en departementele prosedures. Rapporteer bedryfsbekommernisse, vertragings, voorvalle en voorraadverwante kwessies betyds aan toesighouers. Handhaaf professionele gedrag en nakoming deur bywoningsvereistes, werksure, departementele beleid, vertroulikheidsvereistes en die Gedragskode na te kom. Toon aanspreeklikheid, doeltreffende kommunikasie en positiewe werksverhoudinge terwyl toegekende pligte uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele: IPharmacy
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi jikelele epharmacy yesibhedlela i-New Somerset Hospital ukuphatha ukuthutha nokusatshalaliswa kwemithi, kudingeka ukubala nokubhala okuyisiseko kanye nocwaningo oluhlobene nezenzo zezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi: Ubuchule bokubala nokubhala okuyisiseko. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanele kwindawo yamapharmacy, izinkomba zezempilo noma ukusatshalaliswa kwempahla. Izidingo ezingokwemisebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshana, ngezinsuku zokuphumula, ngezinsuku zokuhlala zomphakathi nangaphezulu kwesikhathi lapho kudingeka khona. Ikono lokwenza imisebenzi emzimba ehilela ukunyakaza nokuthutha amabhokisi emithi, impahla, amathrola nezinsiza. Ikono lokuhamba ibanga elide ngaphakathi kwindawo yesibhedlela. Ikono lokusebenza emondlweni wezempilo nokuphatha impahla yamapharmacy nezinye izinsiza eziyinhlobo. Izindlela zokusebenza (ulwazi/obuchule): Ikono lokwamukela, nokuphatha, nokusatshalalisa, nokunikeza impahla, izinsiza nemikhiqizo yamapharmacy ngokusho kwezinqubo ezishiwo nangezinqubo eziyisiseko zokusebenza. Ikono lokufunda, ukuqonda futhi kululame izicelo, amasodi impahla namanye amaphepha. Ulwazi oluyisiseko mayelana nezinqubo zokuqhuba impahla (FIFO/FEFO). Ubuchule bokubala obuyisiseko. Ubuhle bokuzwana nabantu kanye nobuchule bokuxhumana. Ikono lokusebenza kahle eqenjini. Ikono lokugcina imfihlo ngemayelana nolwazi lwesiguli kanye namapheshisi. Ulwazi mayelana nezinkomba ezingaphezu kwezempilo nokuphephile.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesixhaso esiphumelelayo sezokusebenza nasezokuthutha kumasevisi epharmacy ngokuqoqa, ukuthutha nokusatshalaliswa kwemithi, impahla yamapharmacy, izinsiza, amapheshisi kanye namanye amaphepha ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nasezindaweni zesevisi ezihlobene. Siza ekwamukeleni, ekuphatheni, ekukhetheni, ekupakeni, ekunikezeni nokunyakazeni impahla namapharmacy nezinsiza ngokusho kwezinqubo ezishiwo nangezinqubo zokuqhuba impahla. Xhasa inqubo yokusatshalaliswa kwemithi nokunyakaza impahla ngokuqoqa nokuletha impahla yamawadi, amapheshizi, izinsiza zamapharmacy kanye nalolunye ulwazi oluvunyiwe phakathi kwepharmacy, amawadi, amaklinikhi nezindawo eziyisikhungo. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ehlanzekile, ephephile neyinhle ngokusho kwezidingo zezempilo nokuphephile kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Bika izinkinga zokusebenza, ukulibaziseka, izehlakalo nezingxubevumbo ezihlobene nempahla kumaphathi ngesikhathi. Gcina ukuziphatha okuyimfanelo nokuzwana ngokulandela izidingo zokubakho, amahora okusebenza, izinqubo zomnyango, izidingo zokugcina imfihlo kanye nokuKhothameswa. Bonisa ubunschibe lokuziphendulela, ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kanye nobuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza ngenkathi kuqhubwa imisebenzi enikeziwe.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Oqhelekileyo: IPharmacy
xh.summary: Kufuneka abanjwe umsebenzi oqhelekileyo kwisebe le pharmacy esibhedlele iNew Somerset Hospital ukubamba iinkonzo zokuqokelela iishishini, ukuzisa kunye nokusasaza isitokhwe, kuxhomekeke kwimfundo yokufunda nokubala nokulinganisela kunye namava ahambelanayo ekusebenzeleni izinto zempilo.
xh.requirements: Isingeniso esincinci semfundo: Amakhono okubala nokufunda. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kwimeko yokusebenzela amachiza, ukusebenzela izinto zempilo okanye ukusasaza isitokhwe. Iimfuno zomsebenzi ngokwako: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ishifthi, iintsuku zeeveki, iintsuku zihlala zingeye mxeshana nokuqhubela phambathi xa kufuneka. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi yomzimba equka ukushukuma nokuthutha iibhokisi zamachiza, isitokhwe, amatrolleyi nezinto ezifunekayo. Amandla okuhamba ibanga elide ngaphakathi kwendawo yesibhedlele. Amandla okusebenza kwimeko yezempilo nokuphatha isitokhwe samachiza nezinto ezinxulumene nazo. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla okwamkela, ukuphatha, ukusasaza nokunika isitokhwe, izinto ezifunekayo namachiza ngokweendlela ezichaziweyo nendlela eziqhelekileyo zokusebenza. Amandla okufunda, ukuqonda nokusebenza izicelo, oorde wesitokhwe nolwazi olunxulumene nalo. Ulwazi olusisiseko lwenkqubo yokujikeleza kwesitokhwe (FIFO/FEFO). Amakhono okubala. Amakhono amabalwa okuchasana nabantu nokuThungathswana. Amandla okusebenza ngokusebenzayo kwiqela. Amandla okugcina iyimfihlo malunga nolwazi lwesiguliswa namagama amachiza. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoKhuseleko loMsebenzi nokuNakekelwa kweMpilo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso esebenzayo kumasebe amachiza ngokuqokelela, ukuthutha nokusasaza amachiza, isitokhwe samachiza, izinto ezifunekayo, amagama amachiza nolwazi olunxulumene nalo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele nakuwo onke amanye amasebe. Nceda ekwamkelweni, ekuphathweni, ekukhelweni, ekupakishweni, ekunikeni nasekushukumeni kwesitokhwe samachiza nezinto ezifunekayo ngokweendlela ezichaziweyo nakuqikelelo lokujikeleza kwesitokhwe. Xhasa inkqubo yokusasaza amachiza nokushukuma kwesitokhwe ngokuqokelela kunye nokuhamba isitokhwe samachiza, amagama amachiza, izinto zisebe nolwazi olunxulumene nalo phakathi kopharmacy, amawadi, amaklinikhi nakuwo onke amanye amasebe agqityiweyo. Gcina indawo ehlanjiweyo, ekhuselekileyo ehleli ngokwendalo yemisebenzi ngokweemfuno zoKhuseleko loMsebenzi nokuNakekelwa kweMpilo nendlela zomsebenzi zesebe. Chaza iingxaki, ukubambezekela, iinkxalabo nokuqhubeka phambathi kwexesha ngokuchanekileyo kubaphathi abaphezulu. Gcina indlela echanekileyo yokuziphatha nokuthobela iimfuno zokuza kuqala, amaxesha okusebenza, iinkqubo zesebe, iimfuno zokugcina iyimfihlo kunye nendlela ethile yokuziphatha. Bonisa uxabiso, inkxaso echanekileyo nokuhlobana ngokulungileyo nabantu xa usebenzisa imisebenzi onikwe yona.

af.title: Kosdiensassistent
af.summary: Kosdiensassistent by Montagu Hospital wat basiese geletterdheid en ondervinding in 'n kosdienseenheid vereis, teen 'n salaris van R144 024 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese syfer- en letterkunde. zu.title: Umsizi Wezekho Lokudla

Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngamachiza okucoca, ukucoca ngaphezulu kwaye ukwazi ukuzisa izixhobo ezinzima nempahla. Ukuba nakho ukumila iiyure ezingama-12 ngosuku. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokutshintsha iishishini ngemini, ngeekweekend, ngeeholide zoluntu nokuba nesonjongo xa kucelwa. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nakho ukulungisa ukutya ngokwamasiko eresiphi, nokuphatha ngokhuseleko nangendlela efanelekileyo izixhobo zendalo. Ulwazi oluyintsusa ngezenzo zohlelo lokucoca nokhuseleko kwinkonzo yokutya. Ulawulo lokusingatha iingxabano.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela iinkonzo zokutya. Ukusebenzisa nokuqhuba ngokulungileyo ukunciphisa ingozi. Ukugcina izixhobo nemichilo. Ukucoca nokuqhuba zonke iindawo, izixhobo zokutya nempahla kwisebe lenkonzo yokutya ukuze kugcinwe izidingo zokhuseleko nolungelelwane. Ukunika inkxaso kumlawuli.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671 per hour Grade 2: R766 per hour Grade 3: R887 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology sought for George Regional Hospital, providing ENT care including elective surgery and referrals to tertiary facilities.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good work etiquette; excellent communication skills; conflict management; cost conscious care provision. Manage own theatre lists and provide clear guidance on outpatient bookings. Good technology and computer skills; problem-solving experience; leadership and mentoring experience. Performance of audits, research and publications. Experience in teaching, conducting and supervising research. Proven knowledge of public health policies, guidelines and related prescript to manage resources effectively.
jobs.duties: Provision of definitive Otorhinolaryngology care within the scope of a regional hospital service, including assessment, management, elective surgery, ongoing care, and appropriate referral of complex cases in accordance with established referral pathways to tertiary facilities. Delivery of high-quality, patient-centred Otorhinolaryngology services, ensuring efficient management of patient workload while maintaining clinical standards, patient safety, and service satisfaction. -Support and supervision of junior medical staff in the assessment, diagnosis, and management of Otorhinolaryngology conditions, including bedside and procedural guidance within the clinical environment. Commitment to structured teaching and training of junior doctors, interns, and other healthcare professionals through informal bedside teaching, as well as formal academic activities such as lectures, tutorials, and case discussions. Render an efficient, cost-effective high-quality clinical service to patients managed by the hospital and district as the Rural East Ecosystem, by balancing throughput with quality. -Active participation in departmental training programmes, continuing medical education (CME) activities, workshops, and professional development forums relevant to Otorhinolaryngology and district/regional service delivery. Involvement in clinical audits, quality assurance processes, and service improvement initiatives to strengthen Otorhinolaryngology service delivery within the district and regional health system. -Participation in data collection, clinical data management, and reporting of service statistics to support governance, monitoring, and planning of Otorhinolaryngology services. Support clinical governance and administrative functions within the Otorhinolaryngology service, including medico-legal documentation, reporting requirements, staff-related administration, and compliance with departmental policies and protocols. - Active participation in the development and maintenance of clinical guidelines, protocols, and referral systems to ensure safe and effective Otorhinolaryngology service delivery within a regional hospital platform. Strong ethical standards and sound clinical judgement, with appropriate counselling skills for patients and families. Strong leadership, communication, interpersonal, teamwork, and organisational skills suitable for a multidisciplinary regional hospital environment.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates are subjects to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology gesoek vir George Regional Hospital, wat ENT-sorg verskaf insluitend elektiewe chirurgie en verwysings na tersiêre fasiliteite.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Otorhinolaryngology. Ingeborede vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie werksetieket; uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede; konflikbestuur; kostebewuste sorgvoorsiening. Bestuur eie teaterlyste en verskaf duidelike leiding aangaande buitepasiëntbesprekings. Goeie tegnologie- en rekenaarvaardighede; probleemoplossingservaring; leierskaps- en mentorskapervaring. Uitvoering van oudits, navorsing en publikasies. Ervaring in onderrig, uitvoer en toesig van navorsing. Bewese kennis van openbare gesondheidsbeleid, riglyne en verwante voorskrifte om hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaffing van definitiewe Otorhinolaryngology-sorg binne die bestek van 'n streeks hospitaaldiens, insluitend assessering, bestuur, elektiewe chirurgie, deurlopende sorg, en toepaslike verwysing van komplekse gevalle in ooreenstemming met gevestigde verwysingsroetes na tersiêre fasiliteite. Lewering van hoëgehalte, pasiëntgesentrede Otorhinolaryngology-dienste, wat doeltreffende bestuur van pasiëntwerklading verseker terwyl kliniese standaarde, pasiëntveiligheid en dienstetevredenheid gehandhaaf word. -Ondersteuning en toesig van junior mediese personeel in die assessering, diagnose en bestuur van Otorhinolaryngology-toestande, insluitend bed- en prosedurale leiding binne die kliniese omgewing. Toewyding aan gestruktureerde onderrig en opleiding van junior dokters, interns en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionele deur informele bedonderrig, asook formele akademiese aktiwiteite soos lesings, tutoriale en gevalbesprekings. Lewer 'n doeltreffende, koste-effektiewe hoëgehalte kliniese diens aan pasiënte wat deur die hospitaal en distrik as die Rural East Ecosystem bestuur word, deur deurvoer met kwaliteit te balanseer. -Aktiewe deelname aan departementele opleidingsprogramme, voortgesette mediese opleiding (CME) aktiwiteite, werkswinkels en professionele ontwikkelingsforums wat relevant is tot Otorhinolaryngology en distrik/streeks dienslewering. Betrokkenheid by kliniese oudits, gehaltversekeringsprosesse en diensverbeteringsinisiatiewe om Otorhinolaryngology-dienslewering binne die distrik- en streeksgesondheidsstelsel te versterk. -Deelname aan data-insameling, kliniese databestuur en verslagdoening van diensstatistieke om bestuur, monitering en beplanning van Otorhinolaryngology-dienste te ondersteun. Ondersteun kliniese bestuur en administratiewe funksies binne die Otorhinolaryngology-diens, insluitend medies-regtelike dokumentasie, verslagdoeningsvereistes, personeelverwante administrasie en nakoming van departementele beleide en protokolle. - Aktiewe deelname aan die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van kliniese riglyne, protokolle en verwysingstelsels om veilige en doeltreffende Otorhinolaryngology-dienslewering binne 'n streekshospitaalplatform te verseker. Sterk etiese standaarde en gesonde kliniese oordeel, met toepaslike voorligtingsvaardighede vir pasiënte en gesinne. Sterk leierskap, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, spanwerk en organisatoriese vaardighede geskik vir 'n multidissiplinêre streekshospitaalomgewing.

zu.title: Iziqu Zokwelapha Ezinga 1 kuye kweziyi-3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa ngumuthi wezokwelapha ochungechunge kwi-Otorhinolaryngology kumtholampilo waseGeorge Regional Hospital, unikele ngenakekelo lwe-ENT kumbhalo wokusubatha, okuhlanganisa ukwenziwa kwezibopho zokwelapha nokuthumela abagula kwezinye izikhungo eziphezulu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi zemfundo: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengongcweti wezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukwaziswa nokungabikho kokungalunga: Amafomu okuqinisekisa ukuthi awukwazi ukuhlala ugcine ukubhalisa kwakho ku-HPCSA njengongcweti wezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwenkonzo yokwelapha eqinisekisiwe ye-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwenhloso yenkonzo yesibhedlela sendawo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa, ukuphathwa, ukwenziwa kwezibopho, ukunakekelwa okuqhubekayo, nokuthumela izimo eziyinkimbimbi ngokuhamba nezindlela ezisunguliwe zokuthumela kuzo izikhungo eziphezulu. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo ehamba phambili, ehlongoza ngomuntu onakekelwa, yonke i-Otorhinolaryngology, kuqinisekiswa ukuphathwa okusebenza kahle kwesigaba sabagula kuyilawula izindinga zokwelapha, ukuphepha komuntu onakekelwa, nokwaneliseka ngenkonzo. -Ukusekela nogogoqo abasebenzi besizinda abancane ekuhloleni, ukwaziswa, nasekuphathweni kwezimo ze-Otorhinolaryngology, okuhlanganisa ukweluleza eduze kwembhede nasekwenzeni izenzo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokwelapha. Ukuzibophezela ekufundiseni nasekuletheni okulungiswe kothisha abancane, abafundi abangangenayo, nabanye ochwepheshe bemithi ngokufundisa okungalawuleki eduze kwembhede, kanye nokungenwa emsebenzini wezemfundo okufana nokuya kolunye, izifundo, kanye nezinkulumo mayelana nezimo. Ukunikeza inkonzo ehamba phambili, ehlinzeka ngemali ethile, ehamba phambili kubantu abaphathwa yisibhedlela nesesithili njengendawo yase-Rural East Ecosystem, ngokulinganisa ukuphuma nalokho okuhamba phambili. -Ukubambe iqhaza kokuqeqeshwa kumnyango, ekolunyeni okuqhubekayo kwemfundo yezokwelapha (CME), kumhlangano, nasemabhodini aphathelene nokuziphatha ezihlobene ne-Otorhinolaryngology nokulethwa kwenkonzo yesithili/sendawo. Ukungenwa kokuqinisekiswa kwezokwelapha, ekuchitshiyelweni kolunye, nasemizamweni yokuthuthukisa inkonzo ukuze kuqiniswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo ye-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwesithili nasemthethweni wezokwelapha wesithili. -Ukubamba iqhaza ekuqoqweni kolwazi, ekuqoqweni kolunye olukhulu, nokushicilelwa kwezibalo ukuze kusekelwe ukuphathwa, ukubukwa, nokuhlela kwezinkonzo ze-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukusekela ukuphathwa kokwelapha nemisebenzi yemitapo yolwazi ngaphakathi kwenkonzo ye-Otorhinolaryngology, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibhalo ephathelene nomthetho, izidingo zokushicilela, ukuphathwa okuphathelene nabasebenzi, nokuhambisana nemithetho yomnyango nemithetho. - Ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni nasekugcineni izinkomba zokwelapha, imithetho, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthumela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo eqinisekisiwe neziphephe ye-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela sendawo. Izindinga ezinqamlezile nezibukhali zokwelapha, kanye namandla okuwisa iseluleko abaguleni nasemindeni. Ukubusa okuhamba phambili, ukuthetha, ukuxhumana, ukusebenza ngokubumbana, kanye namandla okuhlela okufanele indawo yesibhedlela sendawo equkethe iziqu eziningi.

xh.title: Igcisa lezonyango lesigaba 1 ukuya ko-3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwa igcisa lezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology kwiGeorge Regional Hospital, elinika inkathalo ye-ENT equka unyaziwo lokwenza izesthetic kunye nokuthumela abantu kwezinye izikhongozamaphilo ezincwadi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo semininwamfundo esingaphantsi: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogcisa wezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukubhalisa koluntu lwabagcisa: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Isipho sendalo: Isigaba 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Isigaba 2: Ukungadinwa nje ngeminye eliqela elingu-5 njengogcisa wezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye i-Health Professional Council yamanye amazwe eyaziwayo ngokusingathwa kwabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe) njengogcisa wezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Isigaba 3: Ukungadinwa nje ngeminye eliqela elingu-10 njengogcisa wezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye i-Health Professional Council yamanye amazwe eyaziwayo ngokusingathwa kwabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe) njengogcisa wezonyango kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Imonqekomsi yomsebenzi: Ileyisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Izimanga (ulwazi/amakhono): Indlela elungileyo yokusebenza; amakhono omthethonjenge omhle; ulawulo lweengxabano; ukunikela ngosizo oluncedisa ngeefuthe. Lawula uluhlu lwakho lweetiyetha kwindlu yokwenza unyaziwo yonke kunye nokunika inkqubo ecacileyo ngenqanawa labakhwelwa kwindlu yokhunjuzwa. Amakhono obuchwepheshe anelisa kunye namakhono ekhompyutha; isipho sokubak izisombulu; isipho sokuba ngumkhokeli kunye nokuqeqesha. Ukwenza okutsalwa nzima, uphando nokushicilela. Isipho sokufundisa, nokulawula uphando. Ulwazi olucacisiweyo kwiindlela ezisemthethweni zezonyango lwentlalontle, iinkqubo zokulawula kunye nezinye izikhokelo ezilandela umthetho ukulawula amacebo ngokusebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngosizo olugqibeleleyo lwe-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwesiphithiphithi seenkonzo zesibhedlele somandla, kuquka isiphatho, ulawulo, unyaziwo lonyanze, inkathalo eza kwangoko, kunye nokuthumela abanobunzima kwezinye iindawo ngokulandela iindlela ezibekiweyo ezithumela abantu ezikhongozamaphilo ezincwadi. Ukuza ngenkonzo ye-Otorhinolaryngology ephezulu ngangobuni obukhali, elundweni uluntu, kuqinisekiswa ukulawula ngokusebenza kobuninzi bemiqulu yabakhwelwa ngelixa kugcinwa iinkqubo zokhathazo, ukhuseleko lomkhweli, kunye nentswela yenkonzo. -Ukuxhasa kunye nokuqondisa abasebenzi boonyezi abancinane kwisiphatho, isimo sokuxilumela, kunye nolawulo lwezifo ze-Otorhinolaryngology, kuquka inkqubo yokukhokela kwindlu yokhunjuzwa kunye nenyani elandela isimo kwindlu ekhunjuzwa ngaphandle. Ukuzinikela ngokutsha nokufundisa abonyezi abancinane, oonyezi abakhupha kumzi, kunye nabanye oogcisa bokhathazo ngokufundisa okungalunganga ngenkundla yakho, nangokusemthethweni njengokubakwa kweenkqubo zokutsha njengeziqhingeni, izifundo, kunye nemibono yetheko. Ukunikela ngenkonzo ikrwada, ngentswela efanelekileyo ephezulu ngokwekuality kwigumbi labakhwelwa abalawulwa sisibhedlele nasesithili njengesihlabathi saseRural East, ngokulinganisa ukungena kwabakhwelwa nomthamo. -Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusoloko kwiinkqubo zokutsha kwisebe, iinkqubo zokophucula ulwazi ngaphezulu (CME), iindawo zokusebenza, nakuqoqosho lokuziphucula ezifanele kwi-Otorhinolaryngology nakuqhingi lweenkonzo zesithili/emandla. UkuNxitywa kwiinkqubo ezitsalwa nzima, ezijolise ekugcineni intswele, kunye neenkqubo zokupucula inkonzo ukuqinisa ukunikela ngenkonzo ye-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwesithili nasekQonqothi lwamandla ezonyango lwentlalontle. -Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekugqokeleleni idatha, ekulawuleni idatha yonyezi, nokubika ngenani leenkonzo ukuxhasa ulawulo, ukulolonga, kunye nokuqamba i-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukuxhasa ulawulo lokhathazo kunye nemiqulu yokulawula ngaphakathi kweenkonzo ze-Otorhinolaryngology, kuquka imibhalo yamathongo omtsetho, iinkqubo zokubika, ulawulo oluchazwe ngokomsebenzi, kunye nokuhambisana neenkqubo kunye neendikimba zolawulo zesebe. - Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusoloko ekwakheni kunye nokugcina iinkqubo zokukhokela ukhathazo, iindikimba, kunye neendlela ezithumela abakho ukuba kungabikho buphuhlisi nokusebenza ngobukhali be-Otorhinolaryngology kwindlu yokhunjuzwa yamandla. Iindlela zokukhohlwa ezomeleleyo zolawulo lwamathongo amakhulu, kunye namakhono obungcali obuyisekileyo abakhwelwa njengabasebenzi bendlu, kubakho namakhono okukhokela iziphakamiso ezintle. Isiphithiphithi sokubak okukhulu, iindlela ezimnandi zokuthetha nabantu, amakhono okusebenza ndawonye nobuchwepheshe bokuhamba phambili, kunye nokuqonda ukulawula iindawo ezifanele kwindlu yokhunjuzwa yamandla enamagumbi amaninzi.

Toepaslike kennis van Departement van Radiografie-tegnieke en -protokolle. Toepaslike kennis van stralingsbeskerming en toerustingveiligheid.
af.duties: Lewer optimale radiografiese diens binne 'n multidissiplinêre span deur gebruik van die ALARA-beginsels. Rekordhouding van pasiënt- en ondersoekstatistiek. Doeltreffende voorraadbestuur. Monitor en voer gereelde gehaltversekeringskontroles en -toetse uit. Superviseer, lei studente tydens kliniese sessie. Woon departementele vergaderings en KTV-aktiwiteite by.

zu.title: Umdidiyeli Wezithombe Onqenqema 1 kuya ku-3 (OKUHLOLWAYO) (OKWESIKHATHI ESITHUNGE)
zu.summary: Kudingeka abadidiyeli bezithombe abohlolwayo basesikhathini esithunge kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu e-Oral Health Centre e-Tygerberg, kudingwa ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography Yokuhlolwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwendlula: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA ku-Radiography Yokuhlolwa. Ukubhaliswa kwikhandlu lemisebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomdidiyeli wezithombe kohlobo lokuhlolwa. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengomdidiyeli wezithombe kohlobo lokuhlolwa mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe e-SA. Unyaka o-1 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA esikhundleni esihlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe kunamazwe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze Umsebenzi Womphakathi, njengokudingekile eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Umyalele weminyaka engu-10 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengomdidiyeli wezithombe ohlobo lokuhlolwa mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe e-SA. Umyalele weminyaka engu-11 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA esikhundleni esihlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe kunamazwe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze Umsebenzi Womphakathi, njengokudingekile eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Umyalele weminyaka engu-20 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengomdidiyeli wezithombe ohlobo lokuhlolwa mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe e-SA. Umyalele weminyaka engu-21 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA esikhundleni esihlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabezemisebenzi abaqeqeshwe kunamazwe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze Umsebenzi Womphakathi, njengokudingekile eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibe khona somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela okusebenzayo (Ikhodi B/EB). Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kahle (MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook). Amakhono ohlelo lokusebenza nabantu nokusebenza ngempumelelo njengengxenye yeqembu elisebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Izingcalu zobungcweti bokusebenza. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimela. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphansi koxinu. Ulwazi olufanele mayelana nendlela kanye nemigomo Yomnyango We-Radiography. Ulwazi olufanele mayelana nokuvikelwa kokushisa kanye nokuphepha kwemishini.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi eyinhle yokuthatha izithombe ngaphakathi kweqembu elisebenza ngokuhlanganyela kusetshenziswa imigomo ye-ALARA. Ukubhala izibalo zebhayimathi nokuhlolwa kwesiguli. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezinto. Qapha futhi wenze ukuhlola nokuhlolwa okujwayelekile. Qondisa, qeqesha abafundi ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa komtholampilo. Buthana kuzinhlangano zomnyango kanye nemisebenzi ye-CPD.

Ukulawula nokufundisa abafundi phakathi kweseshoni yamawelele. Ukubakho kwiindibano zesebe nemisebenzi ye-CPD.
